title: Common Taqeebat Duas.org

segments.translation: There is no god save Allah;
One and Only God;
and we are submissive to Him.
There is no god save Allah
and we worship none save Him,
making our devotion sincere as in His sight,
even though the polytheists may detest it.
There is no god save Allah;
(He is) Our Lord and the Lord of our fathers of old.
There is no god save Allah;
Alone, alone, alone.
He has truly fulfilled His promise,
granted His servant victory,
made powerful His soldiers,
and defeated the parties alone.
So, sovereignty be His and praise be His.
He grants life and causes (others) to die,
and (then) causes to die and raises from the dead;
while He is eternally ever-living and He never dies.
All goodness is at His Hand,
and He has power over all things.

segments.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ ٱلْحَيُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha alladhi la ilaha illa huwa,alhayyu alqayyumu wa atubu ilayhi
segments.translation: I seek forgiveness of Allah; there is no god save Him, the Ever-living and Self-Subsisting; and to Him do I turn in repentance.
O Allah, (please do) guide me to the true guidance of Yours,
pour upon me from Your grace,
spread over me from Your mercy,
and bring down upon me from Your blessings.
Glory be to You; there is no god save You.
(Please) forgive my sinsâall of them entirely,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ كُلَّهَا جَمِيعاً إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
segments.transliteration: fa'innahu la yaghfiru aldhdhunuba kulliha jami`an illa anta
segments.translation: because none can forgive all sins entirely save You.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka min kulli khayrin ahata bihi `ilmuka
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You to grant me part of all good things that are encompassed by Your knowledge

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min kulli sharrin ahata bihi `ilmuka
segments.translation: and I seek Your protection against all evils that are encompassed by Your knowledge.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عَافِيَتَكَ في أُمُوري كُلِّهَا
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka `afiyataka fi umuri kulliha
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You to grant me wellbeing from You in all of my affairs

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ خِزْيِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ ٱلآخَرَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min khizyi alddunya wa `adhabi alakhirati
segments.translation: and I seek Your protection against the disgrace of this world and the chastisement in the Next World.
I also seek protection of Your Noble Face,
Your invulnerable omnipotence,

segments.arabic: وَقُدْرَتِكَ ٱلَّتِي لاَ يَمْتَنِعُ مِنْهَا شَيْءٌ
segments.transliteration: wa qudratika allati la yamtani`u minha shay'un
segments.translation: and Your power that none can deter
against the evils of this world and the Next World,
the evils of all pains,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri kulli dabbatin anta akhidhun binasiyatiha
segments.translation: and the evil of all moving creatures that You grasp from forelocks.
Verily, my Lord is on a Straight Path.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: There is neither strength nor power save with Allah, the All-high and All-great.

segments.arabic: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ
segments.translation: I put my trust in the Ever-living (Lord) Who never dies.

segments.arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَداً
segments.transliteration: walhamdu lillahi alladhi lam yattakhidh waladan
segments.translation: All praise be to Allah Who has not taken to Himself a son,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَريكٌ فِي ٱلْمُلْكِ
segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu sharikun fi almulki
segments.translation: nor has He had any partner in sovereignty,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ
segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu waliyyun mina aldhdhulli
segments.translation: nor does He need any to protect Him from humiliation.
And magnify Him with all magnificence.

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ash-hadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah;
(He is) One and Only; and there is no partner with Him;
a Single God;
One, Unique, and eternally Besought of all.

segments.transliteration: lam yattakhidh sahibatan wa la waladan
segments.translation: He has taken to Himself neither a wife nor a son.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ كُلَّما سَبَّحَ ٱللَّهَ شَيءٌ
segments.transliteration: subhana allahi kullama sabbaha allaha shay'un
segments.translation: All Glory be to Allah whenever Allah is glorified by things,

segments.transliteration: wa kama yuhibbu allahu an yusabbaha
segments.translation: as exactly as Allah likes to be glorified,
as exactly as He is worthy of glorification,

segments.arabic: وَكمَا يَنْبَغِي لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِهِ وَعِزِّ جَلاَلِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa kama yanbaghi likarami wajhihi wa `izzi jalalihi
segments.translation: and as it is suitable for the nobility of His Face and the might of His Majesty.

segments.arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كُلَّمَا حَمِدَ ٱللَّهَ شَيءٌ
segments.transliteration: walhamdu lillahi kullama hamida allaha shay'un
segments.translation: All praise be to Allah whenever Allah is praised by things,

segments.transliteration: wa kama yuhibbu allahu an yuhmada
segments.translation: as exactly as Allah likes to be praised,
as exactly as He is worthy of praising,

segments.arabic: وَكَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِهِ وَعِزِّ جَلاَلِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa kama yanbaghi likarami wajhihi wa `izzi jalalihi
segments.translation: and as it is suitable for the nobility of His Face and the might of His Majesty.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّمَا هَلَّلَ ٱللَّهَ شَيءٌ
segments.transliteration: wa la ilaha illa allahu kullama hallala allaha shay'un
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah whenever Allahâs Oneness in Godhead is professed,

segments.transliteration: wa kama yuhibbu allahu an yuhallala
segments.translation: as exactly as Allah likes His Oneness in Godhead to be professed,
as exactly as He is worthy of being the One and Only God,

segments.arabic: وَكَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِهِ وَعِزِّ جَلاَلِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa kama yanbaghi likarami wajhihi wa `izzi jalalihi
segments.translation: and as it is suitable for the nobility of His Face and the might of His Majesty.

segments.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كُلَّمَا كَبَّرَ ٱللَّهَ شَيءٌ
segments.transliteration: wallahu akbaru kullama kabbara allaha shay'un
segments.translation: Allah is the Greatest whenever Allahâs Most Greatness is professed,

segments.transliteration: wa kama yuhibbu allahu an yukabbara
segments.translation: as exactly as Allah likes His Most Greatness to be professed,
as exactly as He is worthy of being the Greatest,

segments.arabic: وَكَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِهِ وَعِزِّ جَلاَلِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa kama yanbaghi likarami wajhihi wa `izzi jalalihi
segments.translation: and as it is suitable for the nobility of His Face and the might of His Majesty.
All glory be to Allah;
all praise be to Allah;
there is no god save Allah;
and Allah is the Greatest

segments.arabic: عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نِعْمَة أَنْعَمَ بِهَا عَلَيَّ
segments.translation: for all bounties that He has bestowed upon me
and upon each and every being of His creatures,

segments.arabic: مِمَّنْ كَانَ أَوْ يَكُونُ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ
segments.transliteration: mimman kana aw yakunu ila yawmi alqiyamati
segments.translation: including those who passed away and those who will exist up to the Resurrection Day.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا أَرْجُو
segments.transliteration: wa as'aluka min khayri ma arju
segments.translation: and I beseech You to grant me the best of what I hope
and the best of what I have not included with my hopes.

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَحْذَرُ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min sharri ma ahdharu
segments.translation: I also beseech You to protect me against the evil of what I anticipate

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri ma la ahdharu
segments.translation: and the evils of what I do not anticipate.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (Please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ أَمْرِي فَرَجاً وَمَخْرَجاً
segments.transliteration: waj`al li min amri farajan wa makhrajan
segments.translation: cause all my affairs to arrive at a relief, prepare for me a way out,

segments.arabic: وَٱرْزُقْنِي مِنْ حَيْثُ أَحْتَسِبُ وَمِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ أَحْتَسِبُ
segments.transliteration: warzuqni min haythu ahtasibu wa min haythu la ahtasibu
segments.translation: and give me sustenance from whence I think and from whence I do not think.
O Lord of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad:
(Please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and hasten the Relief of the Household of Muhammad.
O Lord of Majesty and Honor,
(Please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
have mercy upon me, and deliver me from Hellfire.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِٱسْمِكَ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ ٱلْمَخْزُونِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bismika almaknuni almakhzuni
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You in Your Name: the well-guarded, stored,
pure, immaculate, and blessed.
And I beseech You in Your Great Name
and Your eternal power.
O Donor of gifts!
O Releaser of captives!

segments.transliteration: wa ya fakkaka alrriqabi mina alnnari
segments.translation: O Deliverer of necks from the Fire!

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: I beseech You to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تُعْتِقَ رَقَبَتِي مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
segments.transliteration: wa an tu`tiqa raqabati mina alnnari
segments.translation: to deliver me from the Fire,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تُخْرِجَنِي مِنَ ٱلدُّنْيَا سَالِماً
segments.transliteration: wa an tukhrijani mina alddunya saliman
segments.translation: to cause me leave this world free (from liabilities),
to allow me to Paradise with security,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ دُعَائِي أَوَّلَهُ فَلاَحاً
segments.transliteration: wa an taj`ala du`a'i awwalahu falahan
segments.translation: and to make the beginning of my prayer successful,
the middle of it a gain,
and the end of it a prosperity.
Verily, You are the Knower of all unseen things.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَشْغَلُهُ سَمْعٌ عَنْ سَمْعٍ
segments.transliteration: ya man la yashghaluhu sam`un `an sam`in
segments.translation: O He Who is not distracted by a sound from hearing another sound!

segments.transliteration: wa ya man la yughallituhu alssa'iluna
segments.translation: O He Who is not confused by the beseechers!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُبْرِمُهُ إِلْحَاحُ ٱلْمُلِحِّينَ
segments.transliteration: wa ya man la yubrimuhu ilhahu almulihhina
segments.translation: O He Who is not annoyed by the insistence of those who entreat Him persistently!
(Please do) Make me taste the nice flavor of Your pardon
and the sweetness of Your mercy and forgiveness.
O Allah, This is my prayer that I have just offered
on account of neither a need that You may have for it
nor a desire that You may have for it;
rather, it is only glorification of You, obedience to You,

segments.arabic: وَإِجَابَةً لَكَ إِلَىٰ مَا أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa ijabatan laka ila ma amartani bihi
segments.translation: and response to You to carry out what You have ordered me to do.

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي إِنْ كَانَ فِيهَا خَلَلٌ أَوْ نَقْصٌ
segments.transliteration: ilahi in kana fiha khalalun aw naqsun
segments.translation: O my God: If there is a defect or a deficiency in my prayer,
whether in the genuflection or the prostration;
then, (please) do not reproach me for it;
rather, confer upon me with Your acceptance (of it) and forgiveness (of me).

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لاَ يَعْتَدي عَلَىٰ أَهْلِ مَمْلَكَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: subhana man la ya`tadi `ala ahli mamlakatihi
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who does not treat the people of His realm with transgression!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لاَ يَأْخُذُ أَهْلَ ٱلأَرْضِ بِأَلْوَانِ الْعَذَابِ
segments.transliteration: subhana man la ya'khudhu ahla al-ardi bi-alwani al`adhabi
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who does not inflict on the inhabitants of the earth various sorts of torture!
Glory be to the Affectionate, the Merciful!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجَعلْ لِي فِي قَلْبِي نُوراً وَبَصَراً
segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`al li fi qalbi nuran wa basaran
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) fill my heart with illumination, discernment,
(faculty of) understanding, and knowledge.
Verily, You have power over all things.
I seek for myself, my religion,
my family members, my possessions,

segments.transliteration: wa waladi wa ikhwani fi dini
segments.translation: my descendants, my brethren-in-faith,

segments.transliteration: wa ma razaqani rabbi wa khawatima `amali
segments.translation: all sustenance that my Lord has provided to me as sustenance, the results of my deeds,
and whomever I may concern about,
(I seek for all these) the protection of Allah, the Single,
the One, and the eternally Besought of all

segments.transliteration: alladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad
segments.translation: Who begets not, nor is He begotten;

segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu kufwan ahadun
segments.translation: and the like of Whom there is none.
And [I seek the protection of] the Lord of the dawn
from the evil of what He has created,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqaba
segments.translation: the evil of the utterly dark night when it comes,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri alnnaffathati fi al`uqadi
segments.translation: the evil of those who blow on knots,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri hasidin idha hasada
segments.translation: and the evil of the envious when he envies.
And [I seek the protection of] the Lord of men,
the King of men,
the God of men,
from the evil of the whisperings of the slinking (Satan),
who whispers into the hearts of men
from among the jinn and the men.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ مَغْفِرَتَكَ أَرْجَىٰ مِنْ عَمَلِي
segments.translation: O Allah, Truly, I hope for Your forgiveness more than I trust my deed.

segments.transliteration: wa inna rahmataka awsa`u min dhanbi
segments.translation: Your mercy is verily more expansive than my sin.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إنْ كَانَ ذَنبِي عِنْدَكَ عَظِيماً
segments.translation: O Allah, If my sin is grave in Your view,
then Your pardon is greater than my sin.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ لَمْ أَكُنْ أَهْلاً أَنْ أَبْلُغَ رَحْمَتَكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma in lam akun ahlan an ablugha rahmataka
segments.translation: O Allah, If I do not deserve to attain Your mercy,

segments.transliteration: farahmatuka ahlun an tablughani wa tasa`ani
segments.translation: then Your mercy is so liberal that it can reach and include me,
because it has included all things;
[Let it be] by Your mercy; O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
O Allah, You are the [source of] peace,
peace is coming from You,
peace is for You,
and to You does peace belong.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
segments.translation: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Honor, above what they describe.
Peace be on the messengers.
All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet.
Allahâs mercy and blessings be upon you.
Peace be upon the Imams; the guides and well-guided.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَاءِ ٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `ala jami`i anbya'i allahi wa rusulihi wa mala'ikatihi
segments.translation: Peace be upon all Prophets, Messengers, and angels of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَىٰ عِبَادِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah.
Peace be upon `Ali, the Commander of the Believers.
Peace be upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
the two chiefs of all the youth of Paradise.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ زَيْنِ ٱلْعَابِدِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon `Ali the son of al-Husayn, the Adornment of the Worshippers.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ بَاقِرِ عِلْمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon Muhammad the son of `Ali, the splitter of the knowledge of the Prophets.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلصَّادِقِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon Ja`far the son of Muhammad, the veracious.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ ٱلْكَاظِمِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon Musa the son of Ja`far, the suppressor of rage.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَىٰ ٱلرِّضَا
segments.translation: Peace be upon `Ali the son of Musa, the amiable.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ٱلْجَوَادِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon Muhammad the son of `Ali, the magnanimous.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْهَادِي
segments.translation: Peace be upon `Ali the son of Muhammad, the guide.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ٱلزَّكِيِّ ٱلْعَسْكَرِيِّ
segments.translation: Peace be upon al-Hasan the son of `Ali, the bright and resident of `Askar.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحُجَّةِ بْنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ ٱلْقَائِمِ ٱلْمَهْدِيِّ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `ala alhujjati bni alhasani alqa'imi almahdiyyi
segments.translation: Peace be upon the Argument (of Allah), the son of al-Hasan, the Assumer and the well-guided.
Blessings of Allah be upon them all.
I have submitted to Allah being my Lord,
to Islam being my religion,

segments.arabic: وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ نَبِيّاً
segments.transliteration: wa bimuhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi nabiyyan
segments.translation: to Muhammadâpeace be upon him and his Householdâbeing the Prophet,
to `Ali being my leader,
to al-Hasan, al-Husayn,
`Ali, Muhammad,
Ja`far, Musa,
`Ali, Muhammad,
`Ali, al-Hasan,
and the Righteous Successorâpeace be upon them allâ
being my Imams, masters, and leaders.

segments.transliteration: bihim atawalla wa min a`da'ihim atabarra'u
segments.translation: Only them should I follow and their enemies will I disavow.
O Allah, I ask You for amnesty, good health,
and wellbeing in this world as well as the Next World.

segments.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
segments.translation: I seek refuge in Your Noble Face and Your unassailable might,

segments.arabic: لَآ إِكْرَاهَ فِى ٱلدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ ٱلرُّشْدُ مِنَ ٱلْغَىِّ ۚ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱلطَّـٰغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ لَا ٱنفِصَامَ لَهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
segments.translation: And in Your power from which nothing can escape,

segments.arabic: ٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُمُ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتُ يُخْرِجُونَهُم مِّنَ ٱلنُّورِ إِلَى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ ۗ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
segments.translation: From the evils of this world and the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
segments.transliteration: Ya man yamliku hawÄâija as-sÄâilÄ«na, wa yaâlamu dhamÄ«ra as-sÄmitÄ«n
segments.translation: And from the harm of all ailments.

segments.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمُ ۗ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
segments.transliteration: Likulli masâalatin minka samâun hÄdirun, wa jawÄbun âatÄ«d
segments.translation: Allahâthere is no god except Himâis the Living One, the All-sustainer. Neither drowsiness befalls Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that may intercede with Him except with His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they do not comprehend anything of His knowledge except what He wishes. His seat embraces the heavens and the earth and He is not wearied by their preservation, and He is the All-exalted, the All-supreme.Holy Quran 2:255

segments.arabic:
قُلِ اللّٰهُمَّ مٰلِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى الْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشَآءُ وَتَنْزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِمَّنْ تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشَآءُ‌ ؕ بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ‌ؕ اِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ‏
تُوْلِجُ الَّيْلَ فِى النَّهَارِ وَتُوْلِجُ النَّهَارَ فِى الَّيْلِ‌ وَتُخْرِجُ الْحَىَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَىِّ‌ وَتَرْزُقُ مَنْ تَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ‏
segments.transliteration: Wa likulli sÄmitin minka âilmun bÄtinun muhÄ«t
segments.translation: There is no compulsion in religion: rectitude has become distinct from error. So one who disavows fake deities and has faith in Allah has held fast to the firmest handle for which there is no breaking; and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.Holy Quran 2:256

segments.arabic:
اِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِىْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ فِىْ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُغْشِى الَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهٗ حَثِيْثًا ۙ وَّالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُوْمَ مُسَخَّرٰتٍۢ بِاَمْرِهٖ ؕ اَلَا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَالْاَمْرُ‌ ؕ تَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ‏
اُدْعُوْا رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَّخُفْيَةً‌ ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِيْنَ‌ ۚ‏
وَلَا تُفْسِدُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ بَعْدَ اِصْلَاحِهَا وَادْعُوْهُ خَوْفًا وَّطَمَعًا‌ ؕ اِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللّٰهِ قَرِيْبٌ مِّنَ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ‏
segments.transliteration: Asâaluka bi-mawÄâÄ«dika as-sÄdiqati, wa ayÄdÄ«ka al-fÄdhilati, wa rahmatika al-wÄsiâah
segments.translation: Allah is the wali of the faithful: He brings them out of darkness into light. As for the faithless, their awliya are the fake deities, who drive them out of light into darkness. They shall be the inmates of the Fire, and they will remain in it [forever]Holy Quran 2:257.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
segments.transliteration: Wa sultÄnika alqÄhiri, wa mulkika addÄâimi, wa kalimÄtika attÄmmÄt
segments.translation: Allah, maintainer of justice, the Almighty and the All-wise, besides whom there is no god, bears witness that there is no god except Him, and [so do] the angels and those who possess knowledge.Holy Quran 3:18

segments.transliteration: Ya man lÄ tanfaâuhu tÄâatu almutÄ«âÄ«na, wa lÄ yadhurruhu maâsiyatu alâÄsÄ«n
segments.translation: Indeed, with Allah religion is Islam, and those who were given the Book did not differ except after knowledge had come to them, out of envy among themselves. And whoever denies Allahâs signs [should know that] Allah is swift at reckoning.Holy Quran 3:19

segments.transliteration: Salli âalÄ Muhammadin wa Älihi, warzuqnÄ« min fadhlika
segments.translation: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Honor, above what they describe.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَمْلِكُ حَوَائِجَ السَّائِلِينَ، وَيَعْلَمُ ضَمِيرَ الصَّامِتِينَ
segments.transliteration: Wa aâtinÄ« fÄ«mÄ tarzuqunÄ« alâÄfiyata, birahmatika yÄ arhama arrÄhimÄ«n
segments.translation: And peace be on the messengers.

segments.arabic: لِكُلِّ مَسْأَلَةٍ مِنْكَ سَمْعٌ حَاضِرٌ، وَجَوَابٌ عَتِيدٌ
segments.transliteration: Would you like me to find the specific source or context of this beautiful supplication for you?
segments.translation: And all praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: وَلِكُلِّ صَامِتٍ مِنْكَ عِلْمٌ بَاطِنٌ مُحِيطٌ
segments.transliteration: yaa man yamleko hawaaejas saaa-eleena wa yaâlamo zameeras saameteena le-kulle mas-alatin minka sam-uân haazerun wa jawaabun aâteedun
segments.translation: O He who possesses the needs of the seekers, and knows the inner thoughts of the silent

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَوَاعِيدِكَ الصَّادِقَةِ، وَأَيَادِيكَ الْفَاضِلَةِ، وَرَحْمَتِكَ الْوَاسِعَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa lekulle saametin minka iâlmun baatenun moheetun as-aloka be-mawaa-eâedekas saadeqate wa ayaadeekal faazelate wa rahmatekal waa-se-aâte wa sultaanekal qaahere wa mulkekad daa-eme wa kalemaatekat taam-maate
segments.translation: For every petition You have a listening ear and a ready answer

segments.arabic: وَسُلْطَانِكَ الْقَاهِرِ، وَمُلْكِكَ الدَّائِمِ، وَكَلِمَاتِكَ التَّامَّاتِ
segments.transliteration: yaa man laa tanfa-oâhu taa-aâtul mo-tee-eâena wa laa yazurrohu maâseyatul aâaseena
segments.translation: And for every silent one You have a hidden, encompassing knowledge

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا تَنْفَعُهُ طَاعَةُ الْمُطِيعِينَ، وَلَا يَضُرُّهُ مَعْصِيَةُ الْعَاصِينَ
segments.transliteration: salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aalehi war zuqnee min fazleka wa a-aâtenee feemaa tarzoqonil aâafeyata be-rahmateka yaa arhamar raahemeen
segments.translation: I ask You by Your truthful promises, Your virtuous favors, and Your vast mercy

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ، وَارْزُقْنِي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
segments.transliteration: yaa mozilla kulle jabbaarin aâneedin yaa o-iâzza kulle zaleelin qad wa haqqeqa balagha majhoodee fa-salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aalehi wa farrij aânnee.
segments.translation: And Your overpowering authority, Your everlasting kingdom, and Your perfect words

segments.arabic: وَأَعْطِنِي فِيمَا تَرْزُقُنِي الْعَافِيَةَ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
segments.transliteration: SubhÄna-llÄhi kamÄ yanbaghÄ« lillÄh, wa-l-hamdu lillÄhi kamÄ yanbaghÄ« lillÄh
segments.translation: O He whom the obedience of the obedient does not benefit, nor the disobedience of the sinners harm

segments.arabic: Would you like me to find the specific source or context of this beautiful supplication for you?
segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ ilÄha illÄ-llÄhu kamÄ yanbaghÄ« lillÄh, wa lÄ hawla wa lÄ quwwata illÄ billÄh
segments.translation: Bless Muhammad and his family, and provide for me from Your grace

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَـمْلِكُ حَوَائِـجَ السَّائِلِيْنَ وَ يَعْلَمُ ضَمِيْرَ الصَّامِتِيْنَ لِكُلِّ مَسْاَلَةٍ مِنْكَ سَمْعٌ حَاضِرٌ وَ جَوَابٌ عَتِيْدٌ
segments.transliteration: Wa sallÄ-llÄhu âalÄ Muhammadin-in-nabiyyi wa ahli baytihi an-nabiyyi al-âarabiyyi al-hÄshimÄ«
segments.translation: And grant me wellbeing in what You provide for me, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful

segments.arabic: وَ لِكُلِّ صَامِتٍ مِنْكَ عِلْمٌ بَاطِنٌ مُـحِيْطٌ اَسْاَلُكَ بِـمَوَاعِيْدِكَ الصَّادِقَةِ وَ اَيَادِيْكَ الْفَاضِلَةِ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ الْوَاسِعَةِ وَ سُلْطَانِكَ الْقَاهِرِ وَ مُلْكِكَ الدَّائِمِ وَ كَلِمَاتِكَ التَّامَّاتِ
segments.transliteration: Wa sallÄ-llÄhu âalÄ jamÄ«âi al-mursalÄ«na wa-n-nabiyyÄ«na hattÄ yardhÄ-llÄh
segments.translation: Would you like me to find the specific source or context of this beautiful supplication for you?

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا تَنْفَعُهٗ طَاعَةُ الْمُطِيْعِيْنَ وَ لَا یَضُرُّهٗ مَعْصِيَةُ الْعَاصِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: subhaanal laahe kamaa yanbaghee lillaahe wal hamdo lillaahe kamaa yanbaghee lillaahe wa laa elaaha illal laaho kamaa yanbaghee lillaahe wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaahe wa sallal laaho aâlaa mohammadin nabiyye wa ahle baytehin nabiyyil aârabiyyil haashemiyye wa sallal laaho aâlaa jamee-iâl mursaleena wan nabiyyeena hattaa yarzal laah.
segments.translation: O One Who has command over the fulfillment of the desires of those who beg. He knows what is in the hearts of those who remain quiet. Every question is heard by You and for it answer is provided

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِہٖ وَ ارْزُقْنِيْ مِنْ فِضْلِكَ وَ اَعْطِنِيْ فِيْمَا تَرْزُقُنِي الْعَافِيَةَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Yaa Man Laa Yashghalohu Sam-Uân Aân Sam-Iân, Yaa Man Laa Yoghalletohus Saa-Eloona, Wa Yaa Man Laa Yubremohu Ilhaahul Molehheena, Aziqnee Barda Aâfweka, Wa Maghferateka Wa Halaawata Rahmateka.
segments.translation: and for every silence has hidden encompassing knowledge from Your side. I beseech You with Your true promises, and Your abundant blessings, and your encompassing Mercy, and Your encompassing power, and Your everlasting kingdom, and Your complete words.

segments.arabic: يَا مُذِلَّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيْدٍ يَا مُعِزَّ كُلِّ ذَلِيْلٍ قَدْ وَ حَقِّكَ بَلَغَ مَـجْهُوْدِيْ فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهٖ وَ فَرِّجْ عَنِّيْ.
segments.transliteration: Subhaana Man Laa Yaâtadee Aâlaa Ahle Mamlakatehi, Subhaana Man Laa Yaakhozo Ahlal Arze Be-Alwaanil Aâzaabe, Subhaanar Ra-Oofir Raheeme, Allaahummaj Aâl Lee Fee Qalbee Nooran Wa Basaran Wa Fahman Wa Iâlman, Innaka Aâlaa Kulle Shay-In Qadeer.
segments.translation: O the One Who does not benefit from the obedience of the obedient, and does not get hurt by the disobedience of the disobedient,

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلّٰهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلّٰهِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma innahu lam yumsi ahadun min khalqika
segments.translation: send blessing upon Muhammad and his progeny and grant me sustenance from Your favour, and bestow me wellbeing as my sustenance by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of all.

segments.arabic: وَلَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلّٰهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
segments.translation: O Humiliator of all tyrants! O Dignifier of all humble ones! I, swearing by You, have exerted all efforts; so, send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household and relieve me.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ النَّبِيِّ الْعَرَبِيِّ الْهَاشِمِيِّ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah as is fitting for Allah, and praise be to Allah as is fitting for Allah

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَىٰ جَمِيعِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالنَّبِيِّينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْضَى اللهُ
segments.translation: There is no god but Allah as is fitting for Allah, and there is no power nor strength except with Allah

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِيْ لِلهِ وَ الْـحَمْدُ لِلهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلهِ وَ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلهِ وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ وَ اَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ النَّبِيِّ الْعَرَبِيِّ الْهَاشِمِيِّ وَ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلٰی جَمِيْعِ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ وَ النَّبِيِّيْنَ حَتّٰى يَرْضَى اللهُ.
segments.translation: And may Allah bless Muhammad the Prophet and his household, the Arabian, Hashemite Prophet

segments.arabic: يا مَنْ إِذا تَضايَقَتِ الْاُمُورُ فَتَحَ لَها باباً لَمْ تَذْهَبْ إِلَيْهِ الْأَوْهامُ ، صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَافْتَحْ لِاُمُورِي الْمُتَضايِقَةِ باباً لَمْ يَذْهَبْ إِلَيْهِ وَهْمٌ يا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمينَ .
segments.translation: And may Allah bless all the messengers and the prophets until Allah is pleased

segments.arabic: یَا مَنْ لَا یَشْغَلُہٗ سَمْعٌ عَنْ سَمْعٍ، یَا مِنْ لَا یُغَلِّطُہُ السَّائِلُوْنَ، وَ یَا مَنْ لَا یُبْرِمُہٗ اِلْحَاحُ الْمُلِحِّیْنَ، اَذِقْنِیْ بَرْدَ عَفْوِکَ، وَ مَغْفِرَتِکَ وَ حَلَاوَۃَ رَحْمَتِکَ.
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah as it should be due for Allah and praise be to Allah as it should be due for Allah and there is no god but Allah as it should be due for Allah and there are no means and no power without Allah and salutation of Allah upon Muhammad, the Prophet and the progeny of Prophet, the Arab, the Hashmite and salutation of Allah upon all the messengers and the prophets till Allah is satisfied.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا یَعْتَدِیْ عَلٰی اَہْلِ مَمْلَکَتِہٖ، سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا یَاخُذُ اَہْلَ الْاَرْضِ بِاَلْوَانِ الْعَذَابِ، سُبْحَانَ الرَّؤُوْفِ الرَّحِیْمِ، اَللّٰہُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِیْ فِیْ قَلْبِیْ نُوْرًا وَ بَصَرًا وَ فَہْمًا وَ عِلْمًا، اِنَّکَ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ.
segments.translation: O' He when the affairs has become difficult He opens ways we didn't imagine, so send Your blessing on Muhammad and on the family of Muhammad, open ways out of my difficulties that I didn't imagine, O' the Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يُمْسِ احَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord and Islam as my religion,
And the Qur'an as my book, and Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, as my Prophet,
And Ali as my guardian,
And Hasan and Husayn, and Ali, the son of Husayn,
And Muhammad, son of Ali, and Ja'far, son of Muhammad,
And Musa, son of Ja'far, and Ali, son of Musa,
And the Proof (Imam al-Mahdi), son of Hasan, son of Ali, peace be upon them, as leaders.
O Allah, guard Your Proof (Imam al-Mahdi),
Protect him from in front of him and from behind him,

segments.transliteration: wa tawwiqni amanan min hululi alssakhati liqillati alshshukri
segments.translation: And from his right and from his left, and from above and below him,

segments.transliteration: wa awjib li ziyadatan min itmami alnni`mati bisa`ati almaghfirati
segments.translation: And extend his life,
And make him the one who rises by Your command, the supporter of Your religion,
And let him see what he loves and what delights his eyes in himself and his descendants,
And in his family and wealth, and in his followers and his enemies,
And let them (his enemies) see from him what they fear,
And let him see in them what he loves and what delights his eyes,
And heal through him our hearts and the hearts of a believing people.

segments.arabic: وَطَوِّقْنِي امَاناً مِنْ حُلُولِ ٱلسَّخَطِ لِقِلَّةِ ٱلشُّكْرِ
segments.transliteration: wa la taj`alhu liluzumi shubhatin aw fakhrin aw riya'in
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

segments.arabic: وَاوْجِبْ لِي زِيَادَةً مِنْ إِتْمَامِ ٱلنِّعْمَةِ بِسَعَةِ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
segments.translation: O Allah, convey our salutations to our Master, the Lord of Time,
wherever he may be, in any place he may reside,
from the east to the west, in its plains and mountains,
on my behalf, on behalf of my parents, children, and siblings, peace and blessings.
Equal to the number of His creations and the weight of His throne,
and to all that His book records and His knowledge encompasses.
O Allah, I renew for him today,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْهُ لِلُزُومِ شُبْهَةٍ اوْ فَخْرٍ اوْ رِيَاءٍ
segments.translation: and in every day of my life,
a covenant, a contract, and a pledge upon my neck,

segments.arabic:
اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لا اِلهَ اِلا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريكَ لَهُ

اِلها واحِدا اَحَدا صَمَدا لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صاحِبَةً وَلا وَلَدا.
segments.translation: which I shall never turn away from or break.

segments.arabic:
اَللّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لى فَرَجا وَمَخْرَجا

وَارْزُقْنى مِنْ حَيْثُ اَحْتَسِبُ وَمِنْ حَيْثُ لا اَحْتَسِبُ
segments.translation: O Allah, make me among his supporters and those who defend him,

segments.arabic:
تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى الْحَىِّ الَّذى لا يَمُوتُ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ الَّذى لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صاحِبَةً

وَلا وَلَدا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَريكٌ فِى الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِىُّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبيرا.
segments.translation: and those who obey his commands and prohibitions during his time.
and those who achieve martyrdom in his presence.

segments.arabic:
اَللّهُمَّ انْفَعْنا بِالْعِلْمِ وَزَيِّنّا بِالْحِلْمِ وَجَمِّلْنا بِالْعافِيَةِ وَكَرِّمْنا بِالتَّقْوى

اِنَّ وَلِيِّىَ اللَّهُ الَّذى نَزَّلَ الْكِتابَ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصّالِحينَ
segments.translation: O Allah, if death separates me from him,
the death You decreed upon Your servants inevitably,
then resurrect me from my grave, girded in my shroud, wielding my sword,
ready with my lance, answering the call of the caller, in every place.
O Allah, let me behold his noble visage and praiseworthy forehead,
and brighten my sight with a glance toward him,
hasten his reappearance and make his emergence smooth.
O Allah, strengthen his resolve, fortify his back, and prolong his life,
and through him, revive Your lands and enliven Your servants,
for You have said, and Your word is true: "Corruption has appeared on land and sea because of what the hands of people have earned."
So reveal to us, O Allah, Your Guardian, the son of Your Prophetâs daughter,
who bears the name of Your Messenger, peace be upon him and his family,
so that he does not encounter any falsehood without tearing it apart,
and establish the truth by his words, and fulfill it.
O Allah, remove this distress from this nation with his appearance,
for they see it as distant, but we see it as near.
And may Allah send His blessings upon Muhammad and his family.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
O Allah, indeed, Your truthful and trustworthy Messenger, Your blessings upon him and his family,
said that You have declared: "I have not hesitated in anything I do,
as much as I hesitate to take the soul of My believing servant,
who dislikes death, while I dislike causing him sorrow."
O Allah, so send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
and hasten relief, victory, and wellbeing for Your guardian,
and do not leave me to myself or to anyone besides You.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
O Allah, indeed, al-á¹¢Ädiq (peace be upon him) said that You have declared:
"I have not hesitated in anything I do,
as much as I hesitate to take the soul of My believing servant,
who dislikes death, while I dislike causing him sorrow."
O Allah, so send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
and hasten the relief, well-being, and victory for Your guardian,
and do not afflict me in myself or in any of my loved ones.
O Lord of Muhammad, hasten Your relief for the family of Muhammad,
O Lord of Muhammad, protect the concealment of Muhammad,
O Lord of Muhammad, take vengeance for the daughter of Muhammad,
May Allah's blessings and peace be upon him and his family.
Openly, You are the Originator, and You are the Restorer.
I ask You by Your right over Your chosen ones from Your creation,
and by his right, which You have made binding upon Yourself,
to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, the people of his household,
and to bestow upon me at this moment the freeing of my neck from the Fire,
and to fulfill for Your guardian and the son of Your Prophet,
the one who calls to You by Your permission, Your trustee among Your creation,
Your eye upon Your servants and Your proof over Your creation,
Your blessings and grace be upon him, as You have promised.
O Allah, support him with Your help,
and grant victory to Your servant, strengthen his companions, and grant them patience.
Grant them from Your presence a helping authority,
and hasten his relief and give him power over Your enemies,
and the enemies of Your Messenger, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
With a flat belly and joined eyebrows,
Lean in the legs, with broad shoulders,
Brown-skinned, tinged with pallor from sleepless nights,
My father be sacrificed for one who watches the stars in prostration and bowing.
My father be sacrificed for one unshaken by the blame of critics in Godâs way, the lamp of darkness.
My father be sacrificed for the one who upholds Godâs command.
O Allah, I ask You by Your hidden, sacred, pure, and blessed Name.
And I ask You by Your Great Name and Your Mighty, Eternal Power.
O Giver of gifts, O Liberator of the captives, O One who frees the necks from the Fire.
I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and to free my neck from the Fire.
And to take me out of this world in peace, and to enter me into Paradise safely.
And to make my prayer its beginning successful, its middle prosperous, and its end righteous.
Indeed, You are the Knower of the unseen.

O He Who is not distracted by a sound from hearing another sound! O He Who is not confused by the beseechers! O He Who is not annoyed by the insistence of those who entreat Him persistently! Make me taste the nice flavor of Your pardon and forgivenessand the sweetness of Your mercy.

Glory be to Him Who does not treat the people of His realm with transgression! Glory be to Him Who does not inflict on the inhabitants of the earth various sorts of torture! Glory be to the Affectionate, the Merciful! O Allah! Fill my heart with illumination, discernment, (faculty of) understanding, and knowledge. Verily, You have power over all things.
O Allah! Indeed, none of Your creatures
You have granted more favors,
longer honors,
more manifest graces,
more lenient acts,
stronger protection,
and more compassionate treatment
than I am,
although all of Your creatures
can count the same as what I have counted.
So, (please) bear witness, O He Whose witness is sufficient to me
that I ask You to bear witness to me with honest intention
that Yours are all favors and all bounties
that have been done to me
although I have shown You very little gratitude for all that.
O Doer of all wills,
(please) bless Muhammad and his Household,
surround me with security against the befalling of Your wrath on account of my little gratitude,
decide for me more complete graces  through expansive forgiveness of You,
and pour down upon me Your good turns.
So, (please) bless Muhammad and his Household
and do not treat me according to the amount of my ill intention;
rather, (please) test my heart in order to win Your pleasure
and make pure that through which I have sought nearness to You
with regard to the affairs of Your religion,
and do not make it to be accompanied by any suspicion, pride, or ostentation.
O All-generous!

I bear witness that there is no god save Allah,
One and Only and having no associate with Him (in Godhead);
He is the One God,the Unique, the Besought of all,
and He has taken to Himself neither a wife nor a son.

O Allah, cause all my affairs to arrive at a relief and a way out
and give me sustenance from whence I expect
and from whence I do not expect.

I put my trust in the Ever-living (Lord) Who never dies.
All praise is due to Allah, Who has not taken a wife or a son
and Who has not a partner in the kingdom,
and Who has not a helper to save Him from disgrace;
and magnify Him with all magnificence.
There is neither might nor power except with Allah.

O Allah, (please) make us benefit by knowledge,
adorn us with forbearance,
beautify us with wellbeing,
and honor us with piety.
Surely, my guardian is Allah, Who revealed the Book,
and He guards the righteous ones.
