title: Fajr Taqeebat Duas.org

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ علَىٰ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَٱهْدِنِي لِمَا ٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ
segments.transliteration: wahdini lima ukhtulifa fihi mina alhaqqi bi-idhnika
segments.translation: and guide me, by Your permission, to the right about which discrepancies have taken place.

segments.arabic: إِنَّكَ تَهْدي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
segments.transliteration: innaka tahdi man tasha'u ila siratin mustaqimin
segments.translation: Verily, You guide him whom You wish to a straight path.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
the consenting and pleased Successors,
with the best of Your blessings,
and confer upon them the best of your favors.
Peace be upon them
and their souls and bodies.
Allahâs mercy and blessings be upon them.

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ أَحْيِنِي عَلى ما أَحْيَيْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طالِبٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ahyini `ala ma ahiyayta `alayhi `aliyya bna abi talibin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) make me live carrying the conducts on which You made `Ali the son of Abu-Talib live

segments.arabic: ÙÙØ£ÙÙÙØªÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙ ÙØ§ ÙØ§ØªÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙÙÙ Ø£ÙØ¨ÙÙ Ø·Ø§ÙÙØ¨Ù Ø¹ÙÙÙâØ§ÙØ³ÙØ§Ù
segments.transliteration: wa amitni `ala ma mata `alayhi `aliyyu bnu abi talibin `alayhi alssalamu
segments.translation: and make me die on the principles for which `Ali the son of Abu-Talibâpeace be upon himâdied.
(i) I pray the forgiveness of Allah and I repent before Him.
(ii) I beseech Allah for good health.
(iii) I seek Allahâs protection against Hellfire.
(iv) I ask Him for Paradise.
(v) I ask Allah for the Paradisiacal Women.

segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْمُبينُ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu almaliku alhaqqu almubinu
segments.translation: (vi) There is no god save Allah the King and evident Truth.

segments.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
segments.transliteration: salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: (viii) May Allah send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِوَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِوَلاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُوَٱللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.transliteration: subhana allahi walhamdu lillahi wa la ilaha illa allahu wallahu akbarwa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation:
(ix) All glory be to Allah,all praise be to Allah,there is no god save Allah  Allah is the Greatest
										and there is neither might nor power save with Allah, the All-high and All-great.

segments.arabic: مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ كَانَ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.transliteration: ma sha'a allahu kana wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: (x) Only that which Allah wills shall come to pass and there is neither might nor power save with Allah, the All-high and All-great.
All glory be to Allah, the All-great and in praise of Him;

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: and there is neither might nor power save with Allah, the All-high and All-great.
In the Name of Allah the All-compassionate, the All-merciful;

segments.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: there is neither might nor power save with Allah, the All-high and All-great.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد عَلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bihaqqi muhammadin wa ali muhammadin `alayka
segments.translation: O Allah, I do beseech You, in the name of the right of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad that is incumbent upon You
to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and to give light to my insight,
make me discerning in my religion,
have conviction in my heart,
sincerity in my deeds,
safety in my self,
vastness in my sustenance,
and perpetual thankfulness for You as long as you keep me alive.

segments.arabic: يا رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ .
segments.translation: âOâ Lord of Mohammad and his Holy Progeny, send mercy upon Mohammad and his Holy Progeny, and show haste in the relief of Mohammad and his Holy Progeny.â

segments.arabic: يا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَأَعْتِقْ رَقَبَتي مِنَ النَّارِ.
segments.transliteration: istamsakto be-uârwatil laahil wusqal latee lan fesaama lahaa was taâsamto be-hablil laahil mateen
segments.translation: O Mighty.

segments.transliteration: a-oâozo billaahe min fawratil aârabe wal aâjame wa a-oâozo billaahe min sharre shayaateenil inse wal ji
segments.translation: I have laid hold of the firmest handle of Allah which shall not break off and I have clung to the strong rope of Allah.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ الْعَظيْمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ وَاَسْئَلُهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ۔
segments.transliteration: tawakkalto aâlal laahe talabto haajatee menal laahe hasbeyal laaho wa neâmal wakeelo laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaahil aâliyyil aâzeeme.
segments.translation: I seek refuge with Allah from the outbursts of the Arab and the non-Arab, and I seek refuge with Allah from the evil of the devils from the man and jinn.

segments.arabic: اِسْتَمْسَكْتُ بِعُرْوَةِ اللهِ الْوُثْقٰى الَّتِيْ لَا انْفِصَامَ لَهَا وَ اسْتَعْصَمْتُ بِحَبْلِ اللهِ الْمَتِيْنِ.
segments.translation: I trust in Allah. I seek the fulfillment of my needs from Allah. Allah is enough for me and He is the best Procurator, there is no power or might but by (the will of) Allah the Sublime, the Mighty.

segments.arabic: اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ فَوْرَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَ الْعَجَمِ وَ اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ شَرِّ شَيَاطِيْنِ الْاِنْسِ وَ الْجِنِّ. ‏
segments.transliteration: Allahumma inna dhunoobi wa in kanat qatee'atan
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

segments.arabic: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ طَلَبْتُ حَاجَتِيْ مِنَ اللهِ حَسْبِيَ اللهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ.
segments.transliteration: Fa-innee ma aradtu bihi qatee'atan wa la aqoolu laka al-'utba
segments.translation: O Allah, even though my sins may be numerous,

segments.transliteration: La a'oodu bima a'lamuhu min khallatee wa la astatimmu al-tawbata lima a'lamuhu min du'afi
segments.translation: I never intended separation from You, nor do I claim innocence before You.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنَّ ذُنُوْبِیْ وَ اِنْ کَانَتْ قَطِیْعَۃً
segments.transliteration: Wa qad ji'tu atlubu 'afwaka wa waseelatee ilayka karamuka
segments.translation: I do not deny my flaws, and I am unable to complete my repentance due to my weakness.

segments.arabic: فَاِنِّیْ مَا اَرَدْتُ بِہٖ قَطِیْعَۃً وَ لَا اَقُوْلُ لَکَ الْعُتْبٰی
segments.transliteration: Fa salli 'ala Muhammad wa aali Muhammad wa akrimnee bimaghfiratika ya arhamar-raahimeen
segments.translation: And I have come seeking Your forgiveness, with Your generosity as my means to You.

segments.arabic: لَا اَعُوْدُ بِمَا اَعْلَمُہٗ مِنْ خَلَّتِیْ وَ لَا اسْتَتِمُّ التَّوْبَۃَ لِمَا اَعْلَمُہٗ مِنْ ضَعُفِیْ
segments.translation: So bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and honor me with Your forgiveness, O Most Merciful of the merciful

segments.arabic: وَ قَدْ جِئْتُ اَطْلُبُ عَفْوَکَ وَ وَسِیْلَتِیْ اِلَیْکَ کَرَمُکَ
segments.translation: I hold firmly to the trustworthy handhold of Allah,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَکْرِمْنِیْ بِمَغْفِرَتِکَ یَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِیْنَ
segments.translation: That will never break,

segments.transliteration: AÊ¿Å«dhu bi-llÄh min sharri shayÄá¹­Ä«n al-insi wa al-jinn,
segments.translation: And I seek refuge with the strong rope of Allah,

segments.transliteration: AÊ¿Å«dhu bi-llÄh min sharri fasaqah al-Ê¿arab wa al-Ê¿ajam,
segments.translation: I seek refuge with Allah from the evil of the devils among humans and jinn,
I seek refuge with Allah from the evil of the immoral among Arabs and non-Arabs,

segments.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ شَيَاطِينِ الْإِنْسِ وَالْجِنِّ ،
segments.translation: Allah is sufficient for me,

segments.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ فَسَقَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَالْعَجَمِ ،
segments.translation: I rely on Allah,
I place my back towards Allah,

segments.transliteration: LÄ á¸¥awla wa lÄ quwwata illÄ bi-llÄh.
segments.translation: I seek my need from Allah,

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma ajÊ¿al lÄ« nÅ«ran fÄ« qalbÄ«,
segments.translation: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
O Allah, place light in my heart,

segments.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
segments.translation: And light in my sight,

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي نُوراً فِي قَلْبِي ،
segments.translation: And light in my hearing,
And light on my tongue,
And light in my skin,
And light in my hair,
And light in my flesh,
And light in my blood,
And light in my bones,
And light in my nerves,
And light before me,
And light behind me,
And light to my right,
And light to my left,
And light above me,
And light beneath me,

segments.transliteration: Inna fÄ« khalq as-samÄwÄt wa al-ará¸,
segments.translation: O Allah, make my light great.

segments.transliteration: WakhtilÄf al-layl wa an-nahÄr la-ÄyÄt li-ulÄ« al-albÄb (190),
segments.translation: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth,

segments.transliteration: AlladhÄ«na yadhkurÅ«na AllÄh qiyÄman wa quÊ¿Å«dan,
segments.translation: And the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding (190),
Who remember Allah while standing or sitting,

segments.arabic: وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لِّأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ ﴿١٩٠﴾ ،
segments.transliteration: Wa yatafakkarÅ«na fÄ« khalq as-samÄwÄt wa al-ará¸,
segments.translation: And [lying] on their sides,
And give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth,
[Saying], "Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly;

segments.transliteration: Rabbana innaka man tudkhil an-nÄr faqad akhzaytah,
segments.translation: Exalted are You [above such a thing]; protect us from the punishment of the Fire (191),
Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him,

segments.transliteration: Rabbana innanÄ samiÊ¿nÄ munÄdiyan yunÄdÄ« lil-Ä«mÄn an ÄminÅ« bi-rabbikum,
segments.translation: And for the wrongdoers there are no helpers (192),

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ ،
segments.translation: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,'
And we have believed, so forgive us our sins,

segments.arabic: رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ ،
segments.translation: And remove from us our misdeeds,

segments.transliteration: Rabbana wa ÄtinÄ mÄ waÊ¿adttanÄ Ê¿alÄ rusulik,
segments.translation: And cause us to die with the righteous (193),
Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers,
And do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection,

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ ،
segments.translation: Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise (194).
Glory be to the Lord of the morning,
The Cleaver of the dawn,
And the Maker of the night for rest,

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma ajÊ¿al awwal yawmÄ« hÄdhÄ á¹£alÄá¸¥Ä,
segments.translation: And the sun and the moon for reckoning.
O Allah, make the beginning of my day righteous,
And its middle successful,

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوَّلَ يَوْمِي هَذَا صَلَاحاً ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa man aá¹£baá¸¥a wa á¸¥Äjatuhu,
segments.translation: And its end prosperous.
O Allah, whoever begins their day seeking their need,

segments.transliteration: Fa-inna á¸¥ÄjatÄ« wa á¹­alibatÄ« ilayka waá¸¥daka,
segments.translation: And directs their request to a creature,
Then indeed, my need and my request are directed to You alone,
You haveÂ noÂ partner.

segments.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
segments.translation: O Opener
There is neither might nor power except with Allah.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
segments.transliteration: walhamdu lillahi alladhi lam yattakhidh waladan
segments.translation: I put my trust in the Ever-living (Lord) Who never dies.

segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu sharikun fi almulki
segments.translation: All praise is due to Allah, Who has not taken a wife or a son

segments.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاََّ بِٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu waliyyun min aldhdhulli
segments.translation: and Who has not have a partner in the kingdom,

segments.arabic: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ
segments.translation: and Who has not have a helper to save Him from disgrace;

segments.arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَداً
segments.translation: and magnify Him with all magnificence.

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي ٱلْمُلْكِ
segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah.

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ
segments.translation: May Allah bless Muhammad and his Household.
âI confide my cause unto Allah.
Surely, Allah is Seer of His slaves.
So, Allah warded off from him the evils which they plotted.â
âThere is no god save You. Be You Glorified!

segments.transliteration: fastajabna lahu wa najjaynahu mina alghammi
segments.translation: Lo! I have been a wrongdoer.
Then, We heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish.
Thus do We save the believers.â

segments.transliteration: fanqalabu bini`matin mina allahi wa fadlin
segments.translation: âAllah is Sufficient for us! Most Excellent is He in Whom we trust.
So, they returned with grace and favor from Allah,
and no harm touched them.â

segments.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
segments.translation: Only that which Allah wills shall come to pass.

segments.transliteration: ma sha'a allahu la ma sha'a alnnasu
segments.translation: There is neither strength nor power save with Allah.

segments.transliteration: ma sha'a allahu wa in kariha alnnasu
segments.translation: Only that which Allah, but not people, wills shall come to pass.
Only that which Allah wills shall come to pass even if people detest it.

segments.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Sufficient for me is the Lord against the lorded.

segments.arabic: مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ مَا شَاءَ ٱلنَّاسُ
segments.translation: Sufficient for me is the Creator against the creatures.

segments.arabic: مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنْ كَرِهَ ٱلنَّاسُ
segments.translation: Sufficient for me is the Sustainer against the sustained.
Sufficient for me is Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
Sufficient for me is He Who is sufficient for me.

segments.transliteration: hasbi man kana mudh kuntu lam yazal hasbi
segments.translation: Sufficient for me is He Who has been always sufficient for me.

segments.transliteration: hasbiya allahu la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: Sufficient for me is He Who had been since eternity and still sufficient for me.
âAllah suffices me. There is no god save Him.
In Him have I put my trust,

segments.arabic: حَسْبِي مَنْ كَانَ مُذْ كُنْتُ لَمْ يَزَلْ حَسْبِي
segments.transliteration: alh'amdu lillaahil lad'ee a'rrafnee nafsahoo wa lam yatruknee u'myaanal qalbi
segments.translation: and He is the Lord of the Tremendous Throne.â

segments.transliteration: alh'amdu lillaahil lad'ee ja-a'lanee min ummati muh'ammadin s'allallaahu a'layji wa aalihee wa sallam
segments.translation: All Praise to Allah who made Himself known to me & did not make me blind hearted

segments.transliteration: alh'amdu lillaahil lad'ee ja-a'la rizqee fee yadihee wa lam yaj-a'lhu fee aydin naasi
segments.translation: All Praise to Allah who included me among the followers of Muhammad (saws)

segments.transliteration: alh'amdu lillaahil lad'ee satara u'yoobee wa lam  yafz'ah'nee baynan naasi
segments.translation: All Praise to Allah who has ordained my sustenance to be in HIS own hands & not in the hands of human beings

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ‏ عَرَّفَنِيْ‏ نَفْسَهٗ‏ وَ لَمْ يَتْرُكْنِيْ عَمْيَانَ الْقَلْبِ
segments.transliteration: laa elaaha illal laaho wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul mulko wa lahul hamdo, yohyee wa yomeeto, be-yadehil khayro, wa howa aâlaa kulle shay-in qadeer.
segments.translation: All Praise to Allah who has covered my sins & shortcomings & did not degrade me in the eyes of Human beings

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَنِيْ مِنْ اُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّی اللہُ عَلَیْہِ وَ اٰلِہ
segments.translation: There is no god, except Allah, the one, there is no partner for Him. For Him is the kingdom and for Him is the praise. He enlivens and gives death, in His hands is the good. And He is powerful over everything.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ رِزْقِيْ فِيْ يَدَيْهِ وَ لَمْ يَجْعَلْ رِزْقِيْ فِي اَيْدِيْ النَّاسِ
segments.transliteration: alladhi la yutawalu wa la yuhawalu
segments.translation: O Allah, I have begun this morning seeking refuge with Your invulnerable security

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ سَتَرَ ذُنُوْبِيْ وَ عُيُوْبِيْ وَ لَمْ يَفْضَحْنِيْ بَيْنَ الْخَلَایِقِ.
segments.transliteration: min sharri kulli ghashimin wa tariqin
segments.translation: that is neither touched nor caught

segments.arabic: لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللہُ وَحْدَہٗ لَا شَرِیْكَ لَہٗ، لَہُ الْمُلْكُ وَ لَہُ الْحَمْدُ، یُحْیِیْ وَ یُمِیْتُ، بِیَدِہِ الْخَیْرُ، وَ ہُوَ عَلٰی كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ.
segments.transliteration: min sa'iri man khalaqta wa ma khalaqta
segments.translation: against the evil of all oppressive and domineering ones
from among all Your animate and inanimate creatures
both the silent and the speaking;
and being in protection against all terrifying things;

segments.arabic: مِنْ سَائِرِ مَنْ خَلَقْتَ وَمَا خَلَقْتَ
segments.translation: and being in the complete garb

segments.transliteration: muhtajiban min kulli qasidin li ila adhiyyatin
segments.translation: of my loyalty to the Household of Your Prophet;
and veiling myself against all those who intend harm to me,
behind an impervious wall,
which is my sincerity in the profession of their (Divinely commissioned) right (of leadership)

segments.arabic: مُحْتَجِباً مِنْ كُلِّ قَاصِدٍ لِي إِلىٰ أَذِيَّةٍ
segments.transliteration: muqinan anna alhaqqa lahum wa ma`ahum
segments.translation: and my adherence to their Rope,
and bearing with certainty that the Right is theirs, with them,
in them, and amid them.
I thus accede to those whom they accept
and depart those whom they depart.

segments.transliteration: min sharri kulli ma attaqihi ya `azimu
segments.translation: O Allah, protect me, in the names of them,
against the evil of all that which I fear, O All-great.

segments.transliteration: inna ja`alna min bayni aydihim saddan
segments.translation: I am restraining the enemies against me through the Originator of the heavens and the earth;
âAnd We have set a bar before them

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ مَا أَتَّقيهِ يَا عَظِيمُ
segments.translation: and a bar behind them,

segments.arabic: حَجَزْتُ ٱلأَعَادِيَ عَنِّي بِبَدِيعِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ
segments.transliteration: allaahumma asleh lee deeneyal lazee ja-aâltahu lee iâsmatan.
segments.translation: and (thus) have covered them so that they see not.â

segments.transliteration: allaahumma asleh lee dunyaayal latee ja-aâlta feehaa ma-aâashee.
segments.translation: O Allah! Set right for me the religion that You have made a safeguard for me.

segments.transliteration: allaahumma asleh lee aakherateyal latee ja-aâlta elayhaa marja-eâe.
segments.translation: O Allah! Set right for me this world that You have made me live in.

segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee a-oâozo berezaaka min sakhateka wa a-oâozo be-aâfweka min niqmateka.
segments.translation: O Allah! Set right for me my hereafter that you have made my place of return.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَصْلِحْ لِيْ دِيْنِيَ الَّذِيْ جَعَلْتَهٗ لِيْ عِصْمَةً.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee a-oâozo beka laa maane-aâ lemaa a-aâtayta wa laa moâteya lemaa manaâta wa laa yanfa-oâ zal jadde minkaljaddo.
segments.translation: O Allah! I seek refuge with Your pleasure from Your ire and I seek refuge with Your forgiveness from Your wrath.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِيْ جَعَلْتَ فِيْهَا مَعَاشِيْ.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma matteânee be-sam-eâe wa basaree waj aâlhomal waaresayne minnee wa arenee saaree min aâduwwee.
segments.translation: O Allah! I seek refuge with You â nobody can deny to the one whom You have given, and nobody can give to the one whom You have denied and nobodyâs efforts come to fruition without You.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَصْلِحْ لِيْ آخِرَتِيَ الَّتِيْ جَعَلْتَ اِلَيْهَا مَرْجَعِيْ.
segments.transliteration: Allahumma inni aâudhu bika minal-hammi wal-huzn
segments.translation: O Allah! Grant me the use of my hearing and sight and let them stay with me till my death and show me the destruction of my enemies.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَ اَعُوْذُ بِعَفْوِكَ مِنْ نِقْمَتِكَ.
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief,

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا اَعْطَيْتَ وَ لَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَ لَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ.
segments.translation: And from inability, laziness, miserliness, and cowardice,

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَتِّعْنِيْ بِسَمْعِيْ وَ بَصَرِيْ وَ اجْعَلْهُمَا الْوَارِثَيْنِ مِنِّيْ وَ اَرِنِيْ ثَارِيْ مِنْ عَدُوِّيْ.
segments.translation: And from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَ الْحُزْنِ
segments.translation: And the ruin of days, and heedlessness, and humiliation.

segments.arabic: وَ الْعَجْزِ وَ الْكَسَلِ وَ الْبُخْلِ وَ الْجُبْنِ
segments.transliteration: Wa aâudhu bika min nafsin la tashbaâ
segments.translation: And from hardheartedness, poverty, and misery.

segments.arabic: وَ ضَلْعِ الدَّيْنِ وَ غَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
segments.transliteration: Wa min qalbin la yakhshaâ wa min âaynin la tadmaâ
segments.translation: And I seek refuge in You from a soul that is never satisfied,

segments.arabic: وَ بَوَارِ الْاَيَّمِ وَ الْغَفْلَةِ وَ الذِّلَّةِ
segments.transliteration: Wa min duâaâin la yusmaâ wa min salatin la tanfaâ
segments.translation: And from a heart that does not humble itself, and an eye that does not weep (from Divine awe),

segments.arabic: وَ الْقَسْوَةِ وَ الْعَيْلَةِ وَ الْمَسْكَنَةِ
segments.transliteration: Wa aâudhu bika min-imraâatin tushayyibuni qabla awana mashyibi
segments.translation: And from a prayer that is not heard, and a formal prayer that does not benefit.

segments.arabic: وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ
segments.transliteration: Wa aâudhu bika min waladin yakunu âalayya ribba
segments.translation: And I seek refuge in You from a woman who causes me to turn grey before my time,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَ مِنْ عَيْنٍ لَا تَدْمَعُ
segments.transliteration: Wa aâudhu bika min malin yakunu âalayya âadhaba
segments.translation: And I seek refuge in You from a child who becomes a master (tyrant) over me,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ دُعَاءٍ لَا يُسْمَعُ وَ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ لَا تَنْفَعُ
segments.transliteration: Wa aâudhu bika min sahibi khadiâah
segments.translation: And I seek refuge in You from wealth that becomes a torment for me,

segments.arabic: وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنِ امْرَاَةٍ تُشَيِّبُنِيْ قَبْلَ اَوَانَ مَشِيْبِيْ
segments.transliteration: In raâa hasanatin dafanaha wa in raâa sayyiâatan afshaha
segments.translation: And I seek refuge in You from a deceitful companion,

segments.arabic: وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَلَدٍ يَكُوْنُ عَلَيَّ رِبًّا
segments.transliteration: Allahumma la tajâal li-fajirin âalayya yadan wa la minnah
segments.translation: Who, if he sees a good deed, conceals it, and if he sees an evil deed, spreads it.

segments.arabic: وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ مَالٍ يَكُوْنُ عَلَيَّ عَذَابًا
segments.transliteration: Allahumma wa kun li-waliyyika fi khalqika waliyyan wa hafidha
segments.translation: O Allah, do not allow a wicked person to have any favor or influence over me.

segments.arabic: وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ صَاحِبِ خَدِيْعَةٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa qaâidan wa nasiran hatta tuskinahu ardaka tawâa
segments.translation: O Allah, be for Your representative among Your creation a Guardian and a Protector,

segments.arabic: اِنْ رَاَى حَسَنَةٍ دَفَنَهَا وَ اِنْ رَاَىْ سَيِّئَةً اَفْشَاهَا
segments.translation: And a Leader and a Helper, until You settle him in Your earth obediently,

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ لِفَاجِرٍ عَلَیَّ يَدًا وَ لَا مِنَّةً
segments.translation: And grant him long enjoyment within it.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ کُنْ لِوَلِيِّكَ فِيْ خَلْقِكَ وَلِيًّا وَ حَافِظًا
segments.transliteration: Wajmaâ lahu shamlahu, wa akmil lahu amrah
segments.translation: And make him and his progeny therein the inheriting leaders.

segments.arabic: وَ قَائِدًا وَ نَاصِرًا حَتّیٰ تُسْكِنَهُ اَرْضَكَ طَوْعًا
segments.transliteration: Wa aslih lahu raâiyyatahu, wa thabbit ruknah
segments.translation: And gather for him his scattered affairs, and complete for him his matter,

segments.transliteration: Wa afrighis-sabra minka âalayhi hatta yantaqim
segments.translation: And rectify for him his subjects, and strengthen his pillar.

segments.arabic: وَ تَجْعَلَهُ وَ ذُرِّيَّتَهُ فِيْهَا الْأَئِمَّةَ الْوَارِثِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Fa yashtafi wa yashfi hazazati qulubin naghilah
segments.translation: And pour patience from You upon him until he takes retribution,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْمَعْ لَهُ شَمْلَهُ، وَ اَکْمِلْ لَهُ اَمْرَهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa hararati sudurin wa ghiratin wa hasarati anfusin tarihah
segments.translation: So that he may be healed and may heal the pains of rancorous hearts,

segments.arabic: وَ اَصْلِحْ لَهُ رَعِيَّتَهُ، وَ ثَبِّتْ رُکْنَهُ
segments.transliteration: Min dimaâin masfukatin wa arhamin maqtÅ«âatin wa taâatin majhulah
segments.translation: And the burning of breasts and anger, and the regrets of sorrowful souls,

segments.arabic: وَ اَفْرِغِ الصَّبْرَ مِنْكَ عَلَيْهِ حَتّیٰ يَنْتَقِمَ
segments.transliteration: Qad ahsanta ilayhil-balaâa wa wassaâta âalayhil-alaâ
segments.translation: Resulting from spilled blood, severed family ties, and neglected obedience.

segments.arabic: فِيْشْتَفِيْ وَ يَشْفِيْ حَزَازَاتِ قُلُوْبٍ نَغِلَةٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa atmamta âalayhin-naâmaâa fi husnil-hifdhi minka lah
segments.translation: You have tested him with a goodly trial, and expanded for him Your bounties,

segments.arabic: وَ حَرَارَاتِ صُدُرٍ وَ غِرَةٍ وَ حَسَرَاتِ اَنْفُسٍ تَرِحَةٍ
segments.transliteration: Allahumm-akfihi hawla âaduwwihi, wa ansihim dhikrah
segments.translation: And completed for him the blessings through Your beautiful protection of him.

segments.arabic: مِنْ دِمَاءٍ مَسْفُوكَةٍ وَ اَرْحَامٍ مَقْطُوْعَةٍ وَ طَاعَةٍ مَجْهُوْلَةٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa arid man aradahu wa kid man kadah
segments.translation: O Allah, suffice him against the terror of his enemy, and make them forget his mention,

segments.arabic: قَدْ اَحْسَنْتَ اِلَيْهِ الْبَلاَءَ وَ وَسَّعْتَ عَلَيْهِ الْآلَاءَ
segments.transliteration: Wamkur biman makara bihi wajâal daâiratas-sawâi âalayhim
segments.translation: And intend (against) whoever intends against him, and scheme against whoever schemes against him,

segments.arabic: وَ اَتْمَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ النَّعْمَاءَ فِيْ حُسْنِ الْحِفْظِ مِنْكَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa ali Muhammadin wa 'ajjil farajahum.
segments.translation: And outwit whoever tries to outwit him, and let the circle of evil fall upon them.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اکْفِهِ هَوْلَ عَدُوِّهِ، وَ اَنْسِهِمْ ذِکْرَهُ
segments.transliteration: Ilahi hadhihi salati sallaytuha la li-hajatin minka ilayha
segments.translation: "O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and hasten their relief."

segments.arabic: وَ اَرِدْ مَنْ اَرَادَهُ وَ كِدْ مَنْ كَادَهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa la raghbatin minka fiha illa taâdhiman wa taâatan
segments.translation: My God, this is my prayer which I have offered, not because of any need You have for it,

segments.arabic: وَ امْکُرْ بِمَنْ مَكَرَ بِهِ وَ اجْعَلْ دَائِرَةَ السَّوْءِ عَلَيْهِمْ
segments.transliteration: Wa ijabatan laka ila ma amartani bih
segments.translation: Nor because of any desire You have for it, but only for Your glorification and obedience,

segments.arabic: اََللَّهُمََّّ صَلِّ عَلیٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ.
segments.transliteration: Ilahi in kana fiha khalalun aw naqsun
segments.translation: And in response to what You have commanded me to do.

segments.arabic: اِلٰہِیْ ہٰذِہٖ صَلَاتِیْ صَلَّیْتُہَا لَا لِحَاجَۃٍ مِنْکَ اِلَیْہَا
segments.translation: My God, if there is any flaw or deficiency in it,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا رَغْبَۃٍ مِنْکَ فِیْہَا اِلَّا تَعْظِیْمًا وَ طَاعَۃً
segments.transliteration: Fala tuâakhidhni wa tafaddal âalayya bil-qabuli wal-ghufran
segments.translation: In its bowing or its prostration,

segments.arabic: وَ اِجَابَۃً لَکَ اِلٰی مَا اَمَرْتَنِیْ بِہٖ
segments.translation: Then do not hold me accountable, and favor me with acceptance and forgiveness,

segments.arabic: اِلٰہِیْ اِنْ کَانَ فِیْہا خَلَلٌ اَوْ نَقْصٌ
segments.translation: By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
"I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.

segments.arabic: فَلَا تُؤَاخِذْنِیْ وَ تَفَضَّلَ عَلَیَّ بِالْقُبُوْلِ وَ الْغُفْرَانِ
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

segments.transliteration: âAla dini Muhammadin (sallallahu âalayhi wa alih) wa sunnatih
segments.translation: I have entered the evening and the morning as a believer in Allah,

segments.arabic: أَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ اكْتُبَا رَحِمَكُمَا اللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa âala dini âAliyyin (âalayhis-salam) wa sunnatih
segments.translation: Upon the religion of Muhammad (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) and his Sunnah,

segments.transliteration: Wa âala dini Fatimata (âalayhas-salam) wa sunnatiha
segments.translation: And upon the religion of Ali (peace be upon him) and his Sunnah,

segments.transliteration: Wa âala dinil-awsiyaâi salawatullahi âalayhim wa sunnatihim
segments.translation: And upon the religion of Fatima (peace be upon her) and her Sunnah,

segments.arabic: عَلَى دِينِ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلّى اللهُ عليه وآله) وَ سُنَّتِهِ
segments.translation: And upon the religion of the Successors (blessings of Allah be upon them) and their Sunnah.

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَى دِينِ عَلِيٍّ (عليه السَّلامُ) وَ سُنَّتِهِ
segments.translation: I believe in their secret and their manifest,

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَى دِينِ فَاطِمَةَ (عليها السَّلامُ) وَ سُنَّتِهَا
segments.transliteration: Wa astaâidhu billahi fi laylati hadhihi wa yawmi hadha
segments.translation: And in their unseen and their witnessed.

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَى دِينِ الْأَوْصِيَاءِ صَلَواتُ اللهِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ سُنَّتِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: Mimma-staâadha minhu Muhammadun wa âAliyyun wa Fatimatu wal-awsiyaâ
segments.translation: And I seek refuge in Allah, in this night of mine and this day of mine,

segments.transliteration: Sallallahu âalayhim wa arghabu ilallahi fima raghibu fih
segments.translation: From whatever Muhammad, Ali, Fatima, and the Successors sought refuge,

segments.transliteration: Wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
segments.translation: May Allah bless them; and I desire from Allah whatever they desired.

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ فِي لَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ وَ يَوْمِي هَذَا
segments.transliteration: "Amantu billahi waá¸¥dahu lÄ sharÄ«ka lahÅ« wa kafartu bil-jibt wa al-á¹­ÄghÅ«t, wa amantu bi-sirri Äli Muá¸¥ammadin wa Ê¿alÄniyatihim, wa áºÄhirihim wa bÄá¹­inihim wa awwalihim wa Äkhirihim.
segments.translation: And there is no power nor strength except by Allah.

segments.arabic: مِمَّا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ مُحَمَّدٌ وَ عَلِيٌّ وَ فَاطِمَةُ وَ الْأَوْصِيَاءُ
segments.translation: I believe in Allah alone, with no partners, and I reject idols and false deities. I believe in the secrets and manifestations of the family of Muhammad, their outward and inward qualities, their beginning and their end

segments.arabic: صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ أَرْغَبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ فِيمَا رَغِبُوا فِيهِ
segments.transliteration: YÄ MÄjid, YÄ JawÄd, YÄ á¸¤ayyÄn á¸¥Ä«na lÄ á¸¥ayy
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: YÄ man lÄ yashtabihu âalayhi al-aá¹£wÄt
segments.translation: O Majestic One, O Generous One, O Ever-Living when none lives.

segments.arabic: اٰمَنْتُ بِاللهِ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ وَ كَفَرْتُ بِالْجِبْتِ وَ الطَّاغُوْتِ،وَ اٰمَنْتُ بِسِرِّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَانِيَتِهِمْ،وَ ظَاهِرِهِمْ وَ بَاطِنِهِمْ وَ اَوَّلِهِمْ وَ اٰخِرِهِمْ۔
segments.transliteration: YÄ man lÄ yakhfÄ âalayhi al-lughÄt
segments.translation: O Unique One, O the One Alone in Oneness.

segments.arabic: *قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّـهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَانَا ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّـهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ*
segments.transliteration: YÄ man yaâlamu mÄ taá¸¥milu kullu unthÄ
segments.translation: O He to whom no voices are confusing.

segments.arabic: *وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّـهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلَا رَادَّ لِفَضْلِهِ ۚ يُصِيبُ بِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ۚ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ*
segments.transliteration: Wa mÄ taghÄ«á¸u al-ará¸¥Ämu wa mÄ tazdÄd
segments.translation: O He to whom no languages are hidden.

segments.arabic: *وَمَا مِن دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّـهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا ۚ كُلٌّ فِي كِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ*
segments.transliteration: YÄ man yaâlamu khÄâinat al-aâyun wa mÄ tukhfÄ« aá¹£-á¹£udÅ«r
segments.translation: O He who knows what every female bears.

segments.arabic: *وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَابَّةٍ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا اللَّـهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ*
segments.transliteration: YÄ man huwa aâlamu bisarÄ«ratÄ« minnÄ« bihÄ
segments.translation: And what the wombs reduce and what they increase.

segments.arabic: *مَّا يَفْتَحِ اللَّـهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِن بَعْدِهِ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ*
segments.translation: O He who knows the betrayal of the eyes and what hearts conceal.

segments.arabic: *وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّـهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِيَ اللَّـهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَاشِفَاتُ ضُرِّهِ أَوْ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَاتُ رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ قُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ*
segments.transliteration: Asâaluka bismika al-maknÅ«n al-makhzÅ«n al-á¸¥ayy al-qayyÅ«m
segments.translation: O He who knows my secrets better than I know them.

segments.arabic: *حسْبِیَ اللَّهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَیْهِ تَوَکَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیمِ‏ وَأَمْتَنِعُ بِحَوْلِ اللَّهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ وَقُوَّتِهِمْ وَأَسْتَشْفِعُ‏ بِرَبِّ‏ الْفَلَقِ‏ مِنْ شَرِّ ما خَلَقَ‏ وَأَعُوذُ بِمَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّهَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِیِّ الْعَظِیمِ.*
segments.translation: O Owner of all things before their creation.

segments.arabic: ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًا
segments.transliteration: Wa asâaluka binÅ«rika as-sÄá¹­iâ fÄ« aáº-áºulumÄt
segments.translation: I ask You by Your hidden and preserved Name, the Living, the Sustainer.

segments.transliteration: Wa sulá¹­Änika al-ghÄlib wa mulkika al-qÄhir liman dÅ«naka
segments.translation: Who is Light from Light.

segments.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ
segments.transliteration: Wa biqudratika allÄtÄ« bihÄ tudhillu kulla shayâ
segments.translation: And I ask You by Your radiant Light in the darkness.

segments.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَـٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا
segments.transliteration: Wa biraá¸¥matika allÄtÄ« wasiâat kulla shayâ
segments.translation: And by Your prevailing authority and overpowering sovereignty over all.

segments.transliteration: Asâaluka an tuá¹£allÄ« âalÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Äli baytihi
segments.translation: And by Your power through which You humble all things.

segments.transliteration: Wa an tuâÄ«dhani min jamÄ«â maá¸allÄt al-fitan
segments.translation: And by Your mercy which encompasses all things.

segments.transliteration: Wa min sharri jamÄ«â mÄ yakhÄfu aá¸¥adun min khalqik
segments.translation: I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

segments.transliteration: Innaka SamÄ«â ad-duâÄâ wa anta Ará¸¥am ar-RÄá¸¥imÄ«n
segments.translation: And to protect me from all misguiding trials.

segments.transliteration: wa maiyn yattaqil laaha yaj'al lahoo makhrajaa
segments.translation: And from the evil of all that any of Your creation fears.

segments.transliteration: Wa yarzuqhu min haisu laa yahtasib;
segments.translation: Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplications, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.transliteration: wa many yatawakkal 'alal laahi fahuwa husbuh;
segments.translation: "Say, âNothing will befall us except what Allah has ordained for us. He is our Master, and in Allah let the faithful trust.'"(al-Tawbah, 9:51)

segments.transliteration: innal laaha baalighu amrih; qad ja'alal laahu likulli shai'in qadraa
segments.translation: "And if Allah should touch you with affliction, none can remove it save He; and if He intends for you good, none can hold back His Bounty. He causes it to reach whomsoever He wills among His servants. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful." (Yunus, 10:107)
"And there is no creature on earth but that its sustenance lies with Allah, and He knows its [enduring] abode and its temporary place of lodging. All is in a manifest Book."Hud, 11:6)
"And how many a creature bears not its own provision, yet God provides for it and for you? And He is the All-Hearing and All-Knowing."(al-'Ankabut, 29:60)
"Whatever mercy Allah unfolds for mankind, none shall withhold. And whatever he withholds, none shall release thereafter. And He is the Almighty, the Wise."(al-Fatir, 35:2)

"And were you to ask them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' They would surely say, 'Allah.' Say, âThen have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? Should Allah desire some harm for me, can they remove His Harm? Or, should He desire some mercy for me, can they withhold His Mercy?â Say, âAllah is sufficient for me. In Him, let the trusting put their trust.â" (al-Zumar, 39:38)

"Say, âAllah is sufficient for me. There is no god except Him. In Him, I put my trust, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne. I seek protection in Allah's Power and Strength from that of others, and I ask the intercession of the Lord of the Daybreak from the evil of what He has created. I seek refuge in what Allah wills; there is no power except with Allah, the Exalted, the Magnificent.'"
Whoever is wary of Allah, He shall make for him a way out [of the adversities of the world and the Hereafter]
and provide for him from whence he does not count upon.
And whoever puts his trust in Allah, He will suffice him.
Indeed Allah carries through His commands. Certainly, Allah has ordained a measure [and extent] for everything.

title: Dh'ur Asr Taqeebat Duas.org

segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ٱلْحَلِيمُ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu al`azimu alhalimu
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah, the All-great and Most Forbearing.

segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيـمِ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu rabbu al`arshi alkarimu
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah, the Lord of the Throne of Honor.
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
O Allah, I ask You for the motives of Your mercy,
the determining causes of Your forgiveness,
the advantage of each act of kindness,
and the safeguarding against each and every sin.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَدَعْ لِي ذَنْباً إِلاَّ غَفَرْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma la tada` li dhanban illa ghafartahu
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) do not leave any of my offenses unforgiven,
any of my misfortunes unrelieved,
any of my ailments unhealed,
any of my defects uncovered,
any (item of my) sustenance not including (me),
any fear (that I experience) unsecured,
any evil (that comes upon me) uncontrollable,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَاجَةً هِيَ لَكَ رِضاً وَلِيَ فيهَا صَلاَحٌ إِلاَّ قَضَيْتَهَا
segments.transliteration: wa la hajatan hiya laka ridan wa liya fiha salahun illa qadaytaha
segments.translation: and any need that achieves Your satisfaction and my benefit unanswered.
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
(please) Respond, O Lord of the worlds.
With Allah I seek protection,
in Allah I trust,
and upon Allah I rely.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ عَظُمَتْ ذُنُوبِي فَأَنْتَ أَعْظَمُ
segments.translation: O Allah! if my sins are enormous, surely You are more Tremendous.

segments.transliteration: wa in kabura tafriti fa-anta akbaru
segments.translation: If my transgression has exceeded all limits, surely You are Greater.

segments.transliteration: wa in dama bukhli fa-anta ajwadu
segments.translation: If my stinginess has perpetuated, surely You are more Generous.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱغْفِرْ لِي عَظيمَ ذُنُوبِي بِعَظِيمِ عَفْوِكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) forgive my enormous sins out of Your tremendous pardon,
forgive my limitless transgression out of Your obvious generosity,
and impede my stinginess by the virtue of Your magnanimity.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَة فَمِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ma bina min ni`matin faminka
segments.translation: O Allah, You are certainly the source of each and every favor that covers us.
There is no god save You.
I pray Your forgiveness and I repent before You.

segments.arabic: اََللّهُمّ صَلّ عَلٰی مُحَمّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمّدٍ وَ عَجّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ.
segments.transliteration: Allahuma Inni Ataqqarabu Elaika B-Jodik Wa-Karamik,
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek closeness towards you through your goodness and generosity,

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اِنّي اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ بِجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa Ataqarabu Elaika B Mohammed Abdik Wa-Rasoolik,
segments.translation: and I closeness towards you through Muhammad; your servant and messenger,

segments.transliteration: Wa Ataqarabu Elaika B Malaikatik Al Moqarabeen Wa Anbiyaik Wa Rosolik,
segments.translation: and I seek closeness towards you through your closest most dearest angles, prophets and apostles;

segments.arabic: وَاَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ بِمَلائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبينَ وَاَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: An Tosali Ala Mohammed Abdik Wa Rasoolik Wa Ala Aali Mohammed,
segments.translation: That to send your blessings onto Muhammed your servant and messenger and onto Muhammadâs progeny,

segments.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّد عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ وَعَلى آلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.transliteration: Wa An Tqilni Asrati Wa-Tastor Ala Znoobi Wa Tagfirha Lee
segments.translation: That so you let go of what I have stumbled upon and that you cover my sins and you forgive them for me

segments.arabic: وَاْنَ تُقيلَني عَثْرَتي وَتَسْتُرَ عَلَيَّ ذُنُوبي وَتَغْفِرَها لي،
segments.transliteration: Wa Taqdi Lee Hawaeiji Wa La Toazbni B Qabeehin Kaan Min-ni
segments.translation: and  grant me my needs and  do not torment me due to the filth of what was done by me,

segments.arabic: وَتَقْضِيَ لي حَوائجي وَلا تُعَذِّبْني بِقَبيحٍ كانَ مِنّي،
segments.transliteration: Fa Inna Afwaka Wa Joodak Yasaoni
segments.translation: For your mercy and generosity suffices me
As you are capable to do all things
O Source of Piety and Forgiveness, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: يَا اَهْلَ التَّقْوٰى وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segments.translation: You are my Guardian and my Master, so provide for me.

segments.transliteration: Anta khayrun li min abi wa ummi wa minan-nasi ajmaâin
segments.translation: You are better for me than my father, my mother, and all of mankind.

segments.arabic: اَنْتَ خَيْرٌ لِيْ مِنْ اَبِيْ وَ اُمِّيْ وَ مِنَ النَّاسِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Bi ilayka faqrun wa faqah, wa anta ghaniyyun âanni
segments.translation: I am in state of poverty and need toward You, while You are free of any need for me.

segments.arabic: بِيْ اِلَيْكَ فَقْرٌ وَ فَاقَةٌ وَ اَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِّيْ
segments.translation: I ask You by Your Noble Countenance.

segments.transliteration: Wa as-aluka an tusalliya âala Muhammadin wa ali Muhammad
segments.translation: And I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُـحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: And upon his brothers among the Prophets and the purified Imams.

segments.arabic: وَ عَلٰى اِخْوَانِهِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ وَ الْاَئـِمَّةِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Wa tastajiba duâaâi wa tarhama tadarruâi
segments.translation: And that You answer my prayer and have mercy on my humble pleading.

segments.arabic: وَ تَسْتَجِيْبَ دُعَائِيْ وَ تَرْحَمَ تَضَرُّعِيْ
segments.translation: And turn away from me all types of affliction, O Most Gracious.

segments.arabic: وَ اصْرِفْ عَنِّيْ اَنْوَاعَ الْبَلَاءِ يَا رَحْمٰنُ
segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha alladhi la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: Â« O Allah, I draw near to You with Your generosity  and I draw near to You through Muhammad Your servant and Messenger, and I draw near to You with Your close angels, Your messenger prophets, and with You.

segments.arabic: « اللّهُمَّ ، إنِّي أَتَقَرَّبً إلَيَْكَ بِجُودِكَ ، وَكَرَمِكَ ، وَأَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ ، وَأَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِمَلَائِكَتِكَ المُقَرَّبِينَ ، وَأَنْبِيَائِكَ المُرْسَلِينَ ، وَبِكَ.
segments.translation: O God, You are the One who is needless of me, and I am in need of You, and You are the Rich, and I am poor.

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ ، أَنْتَ الغَنِّى عَنِّي ، وَبي الفَاقَةُ إلَيْكَ ، وَأَنْتَ الغَنِيُ ، وَأَنَا الفقيرُ
segments.translation: You have lifted me up from my stumble, and covered my sins, so fulfill my need today, and do not torture me due to what is ugly that you know of me, but your forgiveness and your presence are enough for me..  Â»

segments.arabic: إلَيْكَ أقلْتني مِنْ عَثْرَتي ، وَسَتَرْتَ عَلَيَّ ذُنُوبي ، فَاقْضِ اليَوْمَ حاجتي ، ولا تُعَذّبْني بِقَبِيحِ ما تَعْلَمُ مِنِّي ، بَلْ عَفْوُكَ وَجُودُكَ يَسَعُني .. »
segments.translation: "O people of piety, O people of forgiveness, O righteousness, O merciful, you are more honorable to me than my father, my mother, and all creatures. Accept me by fulfilling my needs and answering my supplications.â Have mercy on my voice, you have revealed all kinds of afflictions from me"

segments.arabic: « يا أَهْلَ التَقْوَى ، وَيَا أَهْلَ المَغْفِرَةِ ، يا بِرُّ يا رَحِيمُ ، أَنْتَ أَبرُّ بي مِنْ أَبي ، وَأُمِّي ، وَمِنْ جَمِيعِ الخَلَائِقِ ، إقْبَلْني بِقَضَاءِ حَاجَتي ، مُجَاباً دُعَائي ، مَرْحُوماً صَوْتي ، قَدْ كَشَفْتَ أَنْوَاعَ البَلَاءِ عَنِّي .. »
segments.translation: O' He who hear all voice, O' He who gathered every thing, O' He who created soul after death,

segments.arabic:
يا سامِعَ كُلِّ صَوْتٍ ،
 يا جامِعَ (كُلِّ فَوْتٍ) ،
 يا بارِئَ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ ،
segments.translation: O' the causer, O' the Inheritor, O' master of the masters, O' God of gods,

segments.arabic:
يا باعِثُ ،
 يا وارِثُ ،
 يا سَيِّدَ السَّادَةِ ،
 يا إِلهَ الْآلِهَةِ ،
segments.translation: O' The Mighty over the oppressors, O' The king of this world and the Hereafter,

segments.arabic:
يا جَبَّارَ الْجَبابِرَةِ ،
 يا مَلِكَ الدُّنْيا وَالْآخِرَةِ ،
segments.translation: O' the Lord of the lords, O' the King of the kings,

segments.arabic:
يا رَبَّ الْأَرْبابِ ،
 يا مَلِكَ الْمُلُوكِ
segments.transliteration: la yamliku linafsihi naf`an wa la darran
segments.translation: O' the vigorous, O' He who attain extreme vigorous, O' He who did what He wishes,

segments.arabic:
يا بَطَّاشُ ، يا ذَا الْبَطْشِ الشَّديدِ ،
 يا فَعَّالاً لِما يُريدُ ،
segments.transliteration: wa la mawtan wa la hayatan wa la nushuran
segments.translation: O' He who knows the number of breaths and movement of feet,

segments.arabic: يا مُحْصِيَ عَدَدِ الْأَنْفاسِ وَنَقْلِ الْأَقْدامِ ،
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min nafsin la tashba`u
segments.translation: O' He who to Him all secrets are visible, O' the starter, O' He who  returns every thing.

segments.arabic:
يا مَنِ السِّرُّ عِنْدَهُ عَلانِيَةٌ ،
 يا مُبْدِئُ ، يا مُعيدُ .
segments.translation: I requested from You by the sake of your right over the best among Your creatures and for the sake of their right you have made incumbent on Yourself

segments.arabic:
أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ عَلى خِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ، وَبِحَقِّهِمُ الَّذي أَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ عَلى نَفْسِكَ ،
I requested from You by the sake of your right over the best among Your creatures and for the sake of their right you have made incumbent on Yourself 
 أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلامُ ، وَأَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيَّ السَّاعَةَ السَّاعَةَ بِفِكاكِ رَقَبَتي مِنَ النَّارِ ، وَأَنْجِزْ لِوَلِيِّكَ وَابْنِ نَبِيِّكَ الدَّاعي إِلَيْكَ بِإِذْنِكَ ،
segments.translation: to send Your blessing on Muhammad and members of his house and to grant me the rescue of my neck from the Hell fire, execute for Your good friends from the descendant of Your Prophet, the callers to Your course with Your permission,

segments.arabic: وَأَمينِكَ في خَلْقِكَ ، وَعَيْنِكَ في عِبادِكَ ، وَحُجَّتِكَ عَلى خَلْقِكَ ، عَلَيْهِ صَلَواتُكَ وَبَرَكاتُكَ وَعْدَهُ .
segments.translation: Your trustee among Your creatures, Your sight among Your servants, Your proof among Your creatures, may Your peace and blessing be upon him.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ أَيِّدْهُ بِنَصْرِكَ ، وَانْصُرْ عَبْدَكَ ، وَقَوِّ أَصْحابَهُ وَصَبِّرْهُمْ ،
segments.translation: O' Allah! Support him with Your assistance and assist Your servant, empowered his companions and grant them patience

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطاناً نَصيراً ، وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُ ، وَأَمْكِنْهُ مِنْ أَعْدائِكَ وَأَعْداءِ رَسُولِكَ ، يا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمينَ .
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka alyusra ba`da al`usri
segments.translation: Open for them a protected authority and hasten his relief, let him prevail over Yours and Your Prophet's enemies, O' the Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
segments.translation: I pray the forgiveness of Allah; there is no god save Him,
the Ever-living, the Self-Subsisting,

segments.transliteration: allahumma ma bina min ni`matin faminka
segments.translation: the All-compassionate, the All-merciful,
and the Lord of Majesty and Honor.
And I ask Him to accept my repentance,
like His acceptance of the repentance of a slave who is submissive, acquiescent,

segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-alukatâtâayyibaati wa tarkal munkaraati wa fiâ-kak khayraati an taghfira lanaa wa tarhâamanaa wa tatooba aâlaynaa wa tawaffanaa ghayra maftoonin birahâmatika yaa arhâamar raahâimeen
segments.translation: poor, miserable,
despondent, dejected, seeking refuge (with Him),

segments.arabic: لاَ يَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِهِ نَفْعَاً وَلاَ ضَرّاً
segments.translation: not controlling for himself any harm or profit,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ مَوْتاً وَلاَ حَيَاةً وَلاَ نُشُوراً
segments.transliteration: ikhtim li fi yawmi hadha bikhayrin
segments.translation: and not controlling death nor life nor raising (the dead) to life.

segments.arabic:
ا
َللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَفْسٍ لاَ تَشْبَعُ
segments.translation: O Allah, I surely seek Your protection against a self that never has enough,
a heart that does not feel apprehension,
knowledge that does not avail,
a prayer that is not accepted,
and a supplication that is not responded.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ ٱلْيُسْرَ بَعْدَ ٱلْعُسْرِ
segments.translation: O Allah, I surely beseech You for easiness after difficulty,

segments.transliteration: Yaa man ghalabta fa 'azumta bi qudratika,
segments.translation: relief after misfortune,
and comfort after hardship.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنْكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, You are certainly the source of each and every favor that covers us.
There is no god save You.

segments.transliteration: Yaa man yantaqimu bi qudratihi min ahlil ilhaadi,
segments.translation: I pray Your forgiveness and repent before You.

segments.transliteration: As'aluka bihaqqi waliyyika 'Aliyyi bni Abi Talib,
segments.translation: Praise is for Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبَّ الْاَرَضِيْنَ السَّبْعِ وَ مَا فِيْهِنَّ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ وَ مَا تَحْتَهُنَّ وَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ
segments.transliteration: Wa atawassalu bihi ilayka fi qada'i hawa'iji,
segments.translation: "Oh Allah! The Lord of seven heavens, and the Lord of seven earths, and whatever is in them, and whatever is between them, and whatever is beneath them, and the Lord of tremendous throne.

segments.arabic: وَ رَبَّ جِبْرَآئِيْلَ وَ مِيْكَائِيْلَ وَ اِسْرَافِيْلَ وَ رَبَّ السَّبْعِ الْمَثَانِيْ وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيْمِ وَ رَبَّ مُـحَمَّدٍ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهٖ خَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Wa an tarhama Muhammadan wa Aala Muhammadin,
segments.translation: And the Lord of Gabriel, Michael and Israfeel, and the Lord of Sab-e-Masani (surah Al-Fateha), and the Lord of tremendous Quran; and the Lord of Muhammad, the l

segments.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْاَعْظَمِ الَّذِيْ بِهِ تَقُوْمُ السَّمٰوَاتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ وَ بِهٖ تُـحْيِي الْمَوْتٰى وَ تَرْزُقُ الْاَحْيَا وَ تُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ الْمُجْتَمَعِ بَيْنَ الْمُتَفَرِّقِ وَ بِهٖ اَحْصَيْتَ عَدَدَ الْآجَالِ وَ وَزْنَ الْـجِبَالِ وَ كِيْلَ الْبِحَارِ
segments.translation: I ask Thee by Thy mightiest name, by Whom heavens and earth are sustained, and by Whom the dead are given life and the living are provided with sustenance, and the gathered, and the scattered are gathered, and by Whom are encompassed the number of the spans of life, and the weight of mountains, and the measure of oceans.

segments.arabic: اَسْاَلُكَ يَا مَنْ هُوَ كَذٰلِكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَنْ تَفْعَلَ بِيْ كَذَا وَ كَذَا.
segments.translation: Oh one! Who are like this, I ask Thee to Shower unbounded blessing on Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad and do for me such and such (in the place of âsuch and suchâ ask for you need)."

segments.arabic:
---
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ وَفَكَاكَ خِيرَتِي، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمَنَا وَتَتُوبَ عَلَيْنَا وَتَتَوَفَّنَا غَيْرَ مَفْتُونِينَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: Wa birri ikhwaani, wa tamaami taa'atika,
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask you to make me do pious deeds, and that which is lawful, prevent me from ding that which is forbidden, let me do that which is good; protect us have pity on us, admit us to your mercy, and cause us to die without ever having been seduced to evil, by your mercy, O the most merciful

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، 
اَلْاَوَّلُ وَالْاٰخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُالْبَاطِنُ،
segments.translation: You are God, there is no any other deity except You, the first and the last, the apparent, the Inward,

segments.arabic:
وَاَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،

 اِلَيْكَ زِيَادَةُ الْاَشْيَاۤءِ وَنُقْصَانُهَا،
segments.translation:
You are God, there is no any other deity except You,
  unto You the increase and decrease of all things,

segments.arabic:
وَاَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 خَلَقْتَ الْخَلْقَ بِغَيْرِ مَعُوْنَةٍ مِنْ غَيْرِكَ، 
 وَلَاحَاجَةٍ اِلَيْهِمْ،
segments.translation: You are God, there is no any other deity except You, You create the creations without helping hand from other than You and You are not in need of them;

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، 
 مِنْكَ الْمَشِيَّةُ وَاِلَيْكَ الْبَدْءُ۔
segments.translation: You are God, there is no any other deity except You, all wishes from You and unto You all the initiation.

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 قَبْلَ الْقَبْلِ وَخَالِقُ الْقَبْلِ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any other deity except You, before the previous and the creator of the previous,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤاِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 بَعْدَ الْبَعْدِ وَخَالِقُ الْبَعْدِ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any deity except You, after afterward  the creator of afterward,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 تَمْحُوْ مَا تَشَاۤءُ وَتُثْبِتُ وَعِنْدَكَ اُمُّ الْكِتَابِ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any deity except You, You erase and establish what ever You wishes and with You the essence  of the Book,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ، 
 غَايَةُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَوَارِثُهُ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any other deity except You, the Goal and the Inheritor of every thing,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، 
 لَايَعْزُبُ عَنْكَ الدَّقِيْقُ وَلَا الْجَلِيْلُ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any other deity except You, both small and mighty are not far away from You,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 لَايَخْفٰى عَلَيْكَ اللُّغَاتُ، 
 وَلَاتَتَشَابَهُ عَلَيْكَ الْاَصْوَاتُ۔
segments.transliteration: walhamdu lillahi alladhi lam yattakhidh sahibatan wa laÂ waladan
segments.translation: You are God there is no any other deity except You, there is no any language hidden to You and voices are not similar to You.

segments.arabic:
كُلَّ يَوْمٍ اَنْتَ فِيْ شَاْنٍ،
 لَايَشْغَلُكَ شَاْنٌ عَنْ شَاْنٍ، 
 عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَاَخْفٰى، 
 دَيَّانُ الدِّيْنِ،
 مُدَبِّرُ الْاُمُوْرِ،
segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu sharikun fi almulki
segments.translation: Every day You are at Your duty and a duty did not disturb You from another, the Knower of all hidden and concealed things, the owner of Religion, the director of all things,

segments.arabic:
بَاعِثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُوْرِ، 
 مُحْيِ الْعِظَامِ وَهِيَ رَمِيْمٌ،
segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu waliyyun min aldhdhulli
segments.translation: He who raises those in the graves, He who gave life to bone after they have became decayed.

segments.arabic:
اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْمَكْنُوْنِ الْمَخْزُوْنِ،
 اَلْحَيِّ الْقَيُّوْمِ، 
 اَلَّذِيْ لَايَخِيْبُ مَنْ سَاَلَكَ بِهِ،
 اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهِ،
segments.translation: I requested from You by Your sheltered Name, the Eternal the Everlasting, who did not disappoint who ever call Him by His name, to send blessing on Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic:
وَاَنْ تُعَجِّلَ فَرَجَ الْمُنْتَقِمِ لَكَ مِنْ اَعْدَاۤئِكَ،
 وَاَنْجِزْلَهُ مَا وَعَدْتَهُ، 
 يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ۔
segments.translation: and hasten the reappearance of Your retaliator from Your enemies and execute for him all You have promised him, O' the possessor of Magnificence and Honour.

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ الله الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سُبْحَانَ اللهِ والْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلا إلهَ إلاَّ اللهُ واللهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلا حَوْلَ ولا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ باللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation:
âGlory be to Allah, all praise is due to Him! There is no god but Allah. 
Allah is the greatest; and there is no might and no strength but from Allah, the most superior, the All-tremendous.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالآصَالِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالإبْكَارِ فَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
segments.translation:
Glory be to Allah at morning and evening.
 Glorify His purity when you enter upon the time of evening and morning.

segments.arabic: وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّموَاتِ والأَرْضِ وَعَشِيّاً وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عمَّا يَصِفُونَ
segments.translation: And to Him belongs praise in the heavens and the earth, at night fall and mid-day.Glory be to Allah and all honour for He is free from the stories ascribed (about Him).

segments.arabic: وَسَلاَمٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be on His apostles. And all praise rightly belongs to Allah â Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْمُلْكِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ سُبْحَانَ ذِي العِزَّةِ والْجَبَرُوتِ سُبْحَان الحَيّ الَّذِي لا يَمُوتُ
segments.transliteration: wa barik li fimaÂ qasamta li
segments.translation: Glory be to possessor of the dominion and the Kingdom. Glory be to possessor of might and invincibility. Glory be to the Living, the one Who will never die.

segments.arabic:
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْقَائِمِ الدَّائِمِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْحَيِّ الْقَيُّومِ سُبْحَانَ الْعَلِيِّ الأَعْلى سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالى
 سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلائِكَةِ والرُّوحِ.
segments.transliteration: wa ballighni birahmatika kulla alladhi arju minka
segments.translation: Glory be to the All-Self-existent, the Everlasting, Glory be to the Living the Self-subsistent. Glory be to the All-high, the Most High. Glory be to Him and exalted be He, All-glory and All-holy, our Lord and the Lord of Angels and spirit.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إنّ ذَنْبِي أَمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِعَفَوِكَ وَخَوْفِي أَمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِأَمْنِكَ وَفَقْرِي أمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِغِنَاكَ وذُلّي أمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِعِزّكَ،
segments.translation: Oh Allah, surely my sin seeks the refuge of Thy pardon; and my fear seeks the refuge of Thy peace; and my indigence seeks the refuge of Thy self-sufficiency; and my abasement seeks the refuge of Thy exaltation.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ واغْفِرْ لي وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Bless Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad, and pardon me, and have mercy on me, for surely Thou art the Praised and the Glorious.

segments.arabic:
اَللَّهُمَّ تَمَّ نُورُكَ فَهَدَيْتَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَعَظُمَ حِلْمُكَ فَعَفَوْتَ 
 فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَجْهُكَ رَبَّنَا أَكْرَمُ الْوُجُوهِ وَجَاهُكَ أَعْظَمُ الْجَاهِ وَعَطِيَّتُكَ أَفْضَلُ الْعَطَايَا تُطَاعُ
segments.translation: Oh Allah! as Thy light has guided me, so all praise is due to Thee; and by the bounty of Thy clemency pardon me, so all praise is due to Thee Oh our Lord! Thou art the Most Generous of the generous and Thy Splendour is greater than all splendour, and Thy gift is greater in merit than all gifts.

segments.arabic:
ربَّنَا وَتَشْكُرُ وَتُعْصى فَتَغْفِرُ وَتُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ وَتَكْشِفُ الضُّرَّ وَتُنْجِي مِنَ الْكَرْبِ وَتُغْني الْفُقِيرَ 
 وَتَشْفي السَّقِيمَ ولا يُجَاري آلاءَكَ أَحَدٌ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.translation: Thou thank those who obey thee and forgive when disobeyed, and grants the supplication of one in distress, and removes the harm, and rescues from affliction, and enriches the indigent, and cures the ailing, and nobody can recompense for any of Thy blessings. Oh Most Merciful of the Merciful!â.
O He Who has sealed the Prophethood with Muhammad,

segments.transliteration: balligh muhammadan sallaÂ allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: Allah may bless him and his Household,

segments.arabic: إِخْتِمْ لِي فِي يَوْمِي هٰذَا بِخَيْرٍ
segments.translation: (please) seal with goodness this day of mine,
this month of mine,
this year of mine,
and my entire lifetime.

segments.transliteration: wa bimuhammadin sallaÂ allahu `alayhi wa alihi atawajjahu
segments.translation: O You Who have risen high and become great.

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `alaÂ muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: And You subdued and overcame.

segments.transliteration: waj`alni bihim `indaka wajihan fi alddunyaÂ wal-akhirati wa min almuqarrabina
segments.translation: And You overcame and subdued.
O You Who became mighty and great through Your power.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ بَسَطْتَ ظِلَّكَ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ،
segments.translation: O You Who have spread Your shadow over Your creation.
And bestowed Your blessings upon Your servants.
I ask You, O Severe in punishment.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَنْتَقِمُ بِقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْإِلْحَادِ،
segments.translation: O You Who avenges with His power against the people of disbelief.

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ وَلِيِّكَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ،
segments.translation: I ask You by the right of Your guardian, Ali ibn Abi Talib.

segments.arabic: وَأَتَوَسَّلُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ فِي قَضَاءِ حَوَائِجِي،
segments.translation: And I seek his intercession with You to fulfill my needs.
And that You have mercy on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
And help me to fulfill my needs.
And to perform my supererogatory prayers and obligations.
And to be kind to my brothers and complete in Your obedience.
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
O Allah, when You called at me, I responded to Your call,
performed the prayer prescribed by You,
and dispersed through the land as You have ordered me to do.
So, I beseech You to make me, out of Your favoring, work in obedience to You,
avoid disobedience to You,
and gain sufficient sustenance, in the name of Your mercy.
All glory be to Allah,
there is no god save Allah,

segments.arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صَاحِبَةً وَلاَ وَلَداً
segments.translation: and all praise is due to Allah, Who has not taken a wife or a son

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي ٱلْمُلْكِ
segments.translation: and Who has not a partner in the kingdom,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ
segments.translation: and Who has not a helper to save Him from disgrace;
and magnify Him with all magnificence.
I pray for Allahâs protection from Satan, the accursed.
O Allah, I am weak;
so, (please) strengthen my weakness in the course of Your pleasure,
lead my forelock to goodness,
cause faith to be the utmost of my pleasure,
bless for me that which You have decided for me,

segments.arabic: وَبَلِّغْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ كُلَّ ٱلَّذِي ارْجُو مِنْكَ
segments.translation: make me attain, by means of Your mercy, all that which I wish from You,
and appoint love for me,
delight for the believers,
and a covenant with You.
O Allah, Lord of this perfect supplication
and established prayer,

segments.arabic: بَلِّغْ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.translation: (please) assign to Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household,
the rank, right of mediation,
excellence, and advantage.
With Allah do I commence,
from Allah do I seek success,

segments.arabic: وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ اتَوَجَّهُ
segments.translation: and in the name of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, do I turn my face (towards Allah).

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِي بِهِمْ عِنْدَكَ وَجِيهاً فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
segments.translation: and, in their names, make me worthy of regard in this world and in the Hereafter, and of those drawn near to You.
And (please) admit his intercessionÂ and raise his rank.
