title: Magrib-Isha Taqeebat Duas.org

segments.transliteration: inna allaha wa mala'ikatahu yusalluna `ala alnnabiyyi
segments.translation: âSurely, Allah and His angels bless the Prophet.

segments.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا ٱلَّذينَ آمَنُوٱ صَلُّوٱ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوٱ تَسْليماً﴾
segments.transliteration: ya ayyuha alladhina amanu sallu `alayhi wa sallimu tasliman
segments.translation: O you who believe! Call for Divine blessings on him and salute him with a becoming salutation.â
O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad the Prophet,
upon his offspring, and upon his Household.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظيِمِ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power save with Allah, the All-high, the All-great.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذي يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ
segments.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi yaf`alu ma yasha'u
segments.translation: All praise be to Allah Who does whatever He desires,

segments.transliteration: wa la yaf`alu ma yasha'u ghayruhu
segments.translation: and none else can ever do whatever one desires save Him.
O Allah! I beseech You for the motives of Your mercy,
the determining causes of Your forgiveness,

segments.arabic: وَٱلنَّجَاةَ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِنْ كُلِّ بِلِيَّةٍ
segments.transliteration: walnnajata mina alnnari wa min kulli baliyyatin
segments.translation: deliverance from Hellfire and all misfortunes,

segments.arabic: وَٱلْفَوْزَ بِٱلْجَنَّةِ وَٱلرِّضْوَانِ في دَارِ ٱلسَّلاَمِ
segments.transliteration: walfawza biljannati walrridwani fi dari alssalami
segments.translation: winning Paradise,Divine Contentment in the Abode of Peace,

segments.arabic: وَجَوَارِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segments.transliteration: wa jiwari nabiyyika muhammadin `alayhi wa alihi alssalamu
segments.translation: and the vicinity of Your Prophet Muhammadâpeace be upon him and his Household.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ma bina min ni`matin faminka
segments.translation: O Allah, You are certainly the source of each and every favor that covers us.
There is no god save You.
I pray Your forgiveness and I repent before You.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ أَجِرْنَا مِنَ النَّارِ سَالِمِیْنَ وَ أَدْخِلْنَا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلَامٍ آمِنِيْنَ
segments.translation: O Allah help us to depart from life of this world in safety and save us from fire and make us enter Paradise with peace and safety.

segments.arabic: وَ تَوَفَّنا مُسْلِمِيْنَ‏ وَ أَلْحِقْنَا بِالصَّالِحِيْنَ‏ بِفَضْلِکَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
segments.translation: And make us die in Thy submission and include us with the righteous, I beseech You by Thy grace and mercy on us, Oh Most Merciful of the Merciful! ".

segments.transliteration: fa'innahu la yaghfiru aldhdhunuba kullaha jami`an illa anta
segments.translation: All glory be to You. There is no god save You.
Forgive my sins all in all,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ كُلَّهَا جَمِيعاً إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
segments.translation: for none can forgive all sins save You.
O Allah, I beseech You in the name of the coming of Your night,
the departure of Your daylight,
the presence of Your prayers,

segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: the voices of Your supplicants,
and the glorification of Your angels,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.transliteration: Fa Subhaanal laahi heena tumsoona wa heena tusbihoon
segments.translation: and to accept my repentance.

segments.transliteration: Wa lahul hamdu fis samaawaati wal ardi wa 'ashiyyanw wa heena
segments.translation: You are verily, the Oft-Returning, the Most Merciful

segments.arabic: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma muqallibal-quloobi wal-absaar, thabbit qalbee âalaa deenik.
segments.translation: So glorify Allah when you enter evening and when you rise at dawn.

segments.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ
segments.transliteration: Wa laa tuzigh qalbee baâda idh hadaytanee wahab lee min ladunka rahmatan innaka antal-wahhaab.
segments.translation: To Him belongs all praise in the heavens and the earth, at nightfall and when you enter noontime.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوْبِ وَ الْأَبْصَارِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلىٰ دِيْنِكَ
segments.translation: âO Allah, Controller of hearts and eyes, keep my heart firm on Your religion.â

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تُزِغْ قَلْبِي بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنِي وَ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma amdud lee fee âumree wa awsiâ âalayya fee rizqee wanshur âalayya rahmatak.
segments.translation: âDo not let my heart go astray after You have guided me. Grant me mercy from Yourself. Truly, You are the Bestower.â

segments.transliteration: Wa in kunta âindaka fee ummil-kitaabi shaqeeyyan fajâalnee saâeeda.
segments.translation: âBy Your mercy, protect me from the Fire.â

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ امْدُدْ لِي فِيْ عُمُرِي وَ اَوْسِعْ عَلیَّ فِيْ رِزْقِي وَانْشُرْ عَلَيَّ رَحْمَتَكَ
segments.transliteration: Fa innaka tamhoo ma tashaao wa tuthbito wa âindaka ummul-kitaab.
segments.translation: âO Allah, give me a long life, increase my provision, and cover me with Your mercy.â

segments.arabic: وَ إِنْ كُنْتُ عِنْدَكَ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ شَقِيًّا فَاجْعَلْنِي سَعِيْدًا
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bihaqqi muhammadin wa ali muhammadin `alayka
segments.translation: âAnd if, in Your record, I am written as unhappy, then change it to happiness.â

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّكَ تَمْحُوْ مَا تَشَاءُ وَ تُثْبِتُ وَ عِنْدَكَ أُمُّ الْكِتَاب‏
segments.translation: âFor You erase what You will, and You affirm what You will. With You is the Master Record.â

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد عَلَيْكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, I do beseech You, in the name of the right of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad that is incumbent upon You
to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and to give light to my insight,
make me discerning in my religion,
have conviction in my heart,
sincerity in my deeds,
safety in my self,

segments.transliteration: Astaaâeedhu billaahi minash-shaytaani r-rajeem, uktubaa rahimakumallaah.
segments.translation: vastness in my sustenance,
and perpetual thankfulness for You as long as you keep me alive.

segments.arabic: أَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ اكْتُبَا رَحِمَكُمَا اللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: Amsaytu wa-aá¹£baá¸¥tu bi-llÄhi muâminan âalÄ dÄ«ni Muá¸¥ammadin (á¹£allÄ AllÄhu âalayhi wa-Älih) wa-sunnatih.
segments.translation:
"I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan. Write me as one of those whom You have shown mercy to, "
Then say

segments.transliteration: Wa-âalÄ dÄ«ni âAliyyin (âalayhi as-salÄm) wa-sunnatih, wa-âalÄ dÄ«ni FÄá¹­imata (âalayhÄ as-salÄm) wa-sunnatihÄ.
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

segments.arabic: أَمْسَيْتُ وَأَصْبَحْتُ بِاللَّهِ مُؤْمِنًا عَلَى دِينِ مُحَمَّدٍ (صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ) وَسُنَّتِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-âalÄ dÄ«ni al-awá¹£iyÄâi á¹£alawÄtu AllÄhi âalayhim wa-sunanihim.
segments.translation: I ended my evening and began my morning as a believer in Allah, upon the religion of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) and his tradition.

segments.arabic: وَعَلَى دِينِ عَلِيٍّ (عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ) وَسُنَّتِهِ وَعَلَى دِينِ فَاطِمَةَ (عَلَيْهَا السَّلَامُ) وَسُنَّتِهَا
segments.translation: And upon the religion of Ê¿AlÄ« (peace be upon him) and his tradition, and upon the religion of FÄá¹­imah (peace be upon her) and her tradition.

segments.arabic: وَعَلَى دِينِ الْأَوْصِيَاءِ صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَسُنَنِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: Wa-astaâÄ«dhÅ« bi-llÄhi fÄ« laylatÄ« hÄdhihi wa-yawmÄ« hÄdhÄ.
segments.translation: And upon the religion of the Successors, may Allahâs blessings be upon them, and their traditions.

segments.transliteration: MimmÄ istaâÄdha minhu Muá¸¥ammadun wa-âAliyyun wa-FÄá¹­imatu wa-l-awá¹£iyÄâu á¹£allÄ AllÄhu âalayhim.
segments.translation: I believe in their secrets and their openness, in their unseen and their witnessed presence.

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ فِي لَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ وَيَوْمِي هَذَا
segments.transliteration: Wa-arghabu ilÄ AllÄhi fÄ«mÄ raghibÅ« fÄ«hi.
segments.translation: And I seek refuge in Allah during this night of mine and this day of mine.

segments.arabic: مِمَّا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ مُحَمَّدٌ وَعَلِيٌّ وَفَاطِمَةُ وَالْأَوْصِيَاءُ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِمْ
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ á¸¥awla wa-lÄ quwwata illÄ bi-llÄh.
segments.translation: From that which Muhammad, Ê¿AlÄ«, FÄá¹­imah, and the Successors (peace be upon them) sought refuge from.

segments.arabic: وَأَرْغَبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ فِيمَا رَغِبُوا فِيهِ
segments.transliteration:
Bismillahi alrrahmani alrraheemi
Alhamdu lillahi alladhi yulij al layla fee alnnahari wayuliju alnnahara fee allayli
Alhamdu lillahi kullama waqaba laylun waghassaq waalhamdu lillahi kullama laha najmun wakhafaq.
segments.translation: And I desire from Allah what they desired.

segments.arabic: وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
segments.translation: And there is no power and no strength except through Allah.

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ الله الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ

الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ 
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كُلَّمَا وَقَبَ لَيْلٌ وَغَسَقَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كُلَّمَا لَاحَ نَجْمٌ وَخَفَقَ.
segments.translation: "In the Name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Compassionate. Praise be to Allah, who causes the night to enter into the day and causes the day to enter into the night. Praise be to Allah every time the night falls and every time the stars twinkle."

segments.transliteration: Wa aâudhu bi-maghfiratillahi wa aâudhu bi-rahmatillah
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

segments.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِقُدْرَةِ اللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa aâudhu bi-sultanillahil-ladhi huwa âala kulli shayâin qadir
segments.translation: I seek refuge in the Glory of Allah, and I seek refuge in the Power of Allah.

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِمَغْفِرَةِ اللَّهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa aâudhu bi-karamillahi wa aâudhu bi-jamâillah
segments.translation: I seek refuge in the Forgiveness of Allah, and I seek refuge in the Mercy of Allah.

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِسُلْطَانِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي هُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.transliteration: Min sharri kulli jabbarin âanidin wa shaytanin marid
segments.translation: I seek refuge in the Authority of Allah, who has power over all things.

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَرَمِ اللَّهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِجَمْعِ اللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa kulli mughtalin wa sariqin wa âarid
segments.translation: I seek refuge in the Generosity of Allah, and I seek refuge in the Protection of Allah.

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ وَشَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ
segments.translation: From the evil of every obstinate tyrant and rebellious devil.

segments.transliteration: Wa min sharri kulli dabbatin saghiratin aw kabiratin bi-laylin aw nahar
segments.translation: And from every assassin, thief, and sudden affliction.

segments.transliteration: Wa min sharri fussaqil-âarabi wal-âajami wa fujjarihim
segments.translation: From the evil of poisonous pests, creeping insects, and the common folk.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ أَوْ كَبِيرَةٍ بِلَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ
segments.translation: From the evil of every creature, small or large, by night or by day.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ فُسَّاقِ الْعَرَبِ وَالْعَجَمِ وَفُجَّارِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: Wa min sharri kulli dabbatin rabbi akhidhun bi-nasiyatiha
segments.translation: From the evil of the wicked among Arabs and non-Arabs, and their transgressors.
From the evil of the transgressors among Jinn and mankind.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ رَبِّي آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.translation: From the evil of every creature whose forelock my Lord holds.

segments.transliteration: Uâidhu nafsi wa dhurriyati wa ahla bayti
segments.translation: Indeed, my Lord is on a straight path.
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
I seek protection for myself, my offspring, and my household.
And for my wealth, by the perfect words of Allah.

segments.transliteration: Wa hiyal âuudhat-ul-lati âawwadha biha Jabraâilul-Hasana wal-Husayn
segments.translation: From every devil and poisonous pest.
And from every envious, evil eye.

segments.arabic: وهي العوذة الَّتِي عَوَّذَ بِهَا جَبْرَائِيلُ الْحَسَنَ وَالْحُسَيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Ya âazizan dhallalta bi-âizzatika jamiâa ma khalaqt
segments.translation: And this is the refuge with which Gabriel protected Hasan and Husayn.
O He whose might is severe.

segments.arabic: يَا عَزِيزاً ذَلَّلْتَ بِعِزَّتِكَ جَمِيعَ مَا خَلَقْتَ
segments.translation: O Mighty One, You have humbled all Your creation through Your power.
Protect me from the evil of (name) however You wish.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يَبْلُغُ مَدْحَتَهُ الْقَائِلُوْنَ
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah, whose praise cannot be reached by those who speak.

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُحْصِيْ نَعْمَاءَهُ الْعَادُّوْنَ
segments.translation: And praise be to Allah, whose blessings cannot be counted by those who count.

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُؤَدِّيْ حَقَّهُ الْمُجْتَهِدُوْنَ
segments.translation: And praise be to Allah, whose right cannot be fulfilled by those who strive.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الْاَوَّلُ وَ الْاٰخِرُ
segments.translation: And there is no god but Allah, the First and the Last.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الظَّاهِرُ وَ الْبَاطِنُ
segments.translation: And there is no god but Allah, the Manifest and the Hidden.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الْمُحْيِيْ الْمُمِيْتُ
segments.translation: And there is no god but Allah, the Giver of life and the Bringer of death.
And Allah is Greatest, the Possessor of Abundance.

segments.arabic: وَ اللهُ اَكْبَرُ ذُوْ الْبَقَاءِ الدَّائِمِ
segments.translation: And Allah is Greatest, the Possessor of Eternal Permanence.

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُدْرِكُ الْعَالِمُوْنَ عِلْمَهٗ
segments.translation: And praise be to Allah, whose knowledge the scholars cannot grasp.
And whose forbearance the ignorant cannot underestimate.
And whose praise the praisers cannot reach.
And whose attributes the describers cannot describe.
And whose description the creation cannot perfect.

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ ذِيْ الْمُلْكِ وَ الْمَلَكُوْتِ
segments.translation: And praise be to Allah, Owner of the Kingdom and the Sovereignty.

segments.arabic: وَ الْعَظَمَةِ وَ الْجَبَرُوْتِ وَ الْعِزِّ وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءِ
segments.translation: And of Greatness, Omnipotence, Might, and Grandeur.

segments.arabic: وَ الْبَهَاءِ وَ الْجَلَالِ، وَ الْمَهَابَةِ وَ الْجَمَالِ
segments.translation: And of Radiance, Majesty, Awe, and Beauty.

segments.arabic: وَ الْعِزَّةِ وَ الْقُدْرَةِ وَ الْحَوْلِ وَ الْقُوَّةِ
segments.translation: And of Honor, Power, Might, and Strength.

segments.arabic: وَ الْمِنَّةِ وَ الْغَلَبَةِ، وَ الْفَضْلِ وَ الطَّوْلِ
segments.translation: And of Favor, Dominance, Grace, and Abundance.

segments.arabic: وَ الْعَدْلِ وَ الْحَقِّ وَ الْخَلْقِ وَ الْعَلَاءِ
segments.translation: And of Justice, Truth, Creation, and Exaltation.

segments.arabic: وَ الرِّفْعَةِ وَ الْمَجْدِ، وَ الْفَضِيْلَةِ وَ الْحِكْمَةِ
segments.translation: And of Elevation, Glory, Virtue, and Wisdom.

segments.arabic: وَ الْغِنَاءِ وَ السَّعَةِ وَ الْبَسْطِ وَ الْقَبْضِ
segments.translation: And of Wealth, Vastness, Expanding, and Withholding.

segments.arabic: وَ الْحِلْمِ وَ الْعِلْمِ، وَ الْحُجَّةِ الْبَالِغَةِ
segments.translation: And of Forbearance, Knowledge, and the Conclusive Argument.

segments.arabic: وَ النِّعْمَةِ السَّابِغَةِ وَ الثَّنَاءِ الْحَسَنِ الْجَمِيْلِ
segments.transliteration: Wal-jannati wan-nar, wa ma fihinna tabarakallahu wa taâala
segments.translation: And of Profuse Blessing and Beautiful, Goodly Praise.

segments.arabic: وَ الْاٰلَاءِ الْكَرِيْمَةِ، مَلِكِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ
segments.translation: And of Noble Bounties, King of the world and the hereafter,

segments.arabic: وَ الْجَنَّةِ وَ النَّارِ، وَ مَا فِيْهِنَّ تَبَارَكَ اللهُ وَ تَعَالٰى
segments.translation: And of Paradise and the Fire, and all that is within them; Blessed and Exalted is Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ عَلِمَ اَسْرَارَ الْغُيُوْبِ
segments.transliteration: Fa laysa âanhu madh-habun wa la mahrab
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah, who knows the secrets of the unseen,

segments.arabic: وَ اطَّلَعَ عَلٰى مَا تَجِنُّ الْقُلُوْبُ
segments.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-mutakabbiri fi sultanihi al-âazizi fi makÄnih
segments.translation: And is aware of what the hearts conceal.

segments.arabic: فَلَيْسَ عَنْهُ مَذْهَبٌ وَ لَا مَهْرَبٌ
segments.transliteration: Al-mutajabbiri fi mulkihi, al-qawiyyi fi batshih
segments.translation: For there is neither a way away from Him nor a place of escape.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الْمُتَكَبِّرِ فِيْ سُلْطَانِهِ الْعَزِيْزِ فِيْ مَكَانِهِ
segments.transliteration: Ar-rafiâi fawqa âarshih, al-muttaliâi âala khalqih
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah, the Supreme in His Authority, the Mighty in His Station.

segments.arabic: الْمُتَجَبِّرِ فِيْ مُلْكِهِ، الْقَوِيِّ فِيْ بَطْشِهِ
segments.translation: The Irresistible in His Kingdom, the Strong in His Seizing.

segments.arabic: الرَّفِيْعِ فَوْقَ عَرْشِهِ، الْمُطَّلِعِ عَلٰى خَلْقِهٖ
segments.translation: The Exalted above His Throne, the Observer of His creation.

segments.arabic: وَ الْبَالِغِ لِمَا اَرَادَ مِنْ عِلْمِهٖ
segments.translation: And the One who attains whatever He intends through His knowledge.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ بِكَلِمَاتِهٖ قَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ الشِّدَادُ
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah, by whose words the firm heavens stand.
And the cradling earths became stable.
And the firm, anchoring mountains were erected.
And the fertilizing winds blew.

segments.arabic: وَ سَارَ فِيْ جَوِّ السَّمَاءِ السَّحَابُ
segments.translation: And the clouds traveled through the atmosphere of the sky.
And the seas stopped at their boundaries.

segments.transliteration: Tabarakta ya muhsi qatril-matari wa waraqish-shajar
segments.translation: And hearts trembled from the fear of Him.
And all masters were subdued by His Lordship.

segments.arabic: تَبَارَكْتَ يَا مُحْصِيْ قَطْرِ الْمَطَرِ، وَ وَرَقِ الشَّجَرِ
segments.translation: Blessed are You, O Counter of the raindrops and the leaves of trees.

segments.transliteration: Ma faâalta bil-gharibil-faqiri idha ataka mustajiran mustaghitha?
segments.translation: And the One who gives life to the bodies of the dead for the Resurrection.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْاِكْرَامِ
segments.transliteration: Ma faâalta biman anakha bi-finaâika wa taâarrada li-ridak?
segments.translation: Glory be to You, O Owner of Majesty and Honor!

segments.arabic: مَا فَعَلْتَ بِالْغَرِيْبِ الْفَقِيْرِ اِذَا اَتَاكَ مُسْتَجِيْرًا مُسْتَغِيْثًا؟
segments.transliteration: Fala yakunanna ya rabbi hadh-dhi min duâaâil-hirman
segments.translation: What have You done for the poor stranger when he comes to You seeking refuge and help?

segments.arabic: مَا فَعَلْتَ بِمَنْ اَنَاخَ بِفِنَائِكَ وَ تَعَرَّضَ لِرِضَاكَ؟
segments.transliteration: Wa la nasibi mimma arju minka al-khidhlan
segments.translation: What have You done for the one who halts at Your courtyard seeking Your pleasure?

segments.arabic: فَلَا يَكُوْنَنَّ يَا رَبِّ حَظِّيْ مِنْ دُعَائِيْ الْحِرْمَانُ
segments.transliteration: Ya man lam yazal wa la yazul
segments.translation: O Lord, let not my lot from this prayer be deprivation.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا نَصِيْبِيْ مِمَّا اَرْجُوْ مِنْكَ الْخِذْلَانُ
segments.transliteration: Ya man jaâala ayyamad-dunya tazul, wa shuhuraha tahul
segments.translation: Nor let my share of what I hope from You be abandonment.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَزَلْ وَ لَا يَزُوْلُ
segments.transliteration: Wa antad-daâimu la tublikal-azman wa la tughayyirukad-duhur
segments.translation: O He who has always been and shall never cease to be.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ جَعَلَ اَيَّامَ الدُّنْيَا تَزُوْلُ، وَ شُهُوْرَهَا تَحُوْلُ
segments.transliteration: Ya man kullu yawmin âindahu jadid, wa kullu rizqin âindahu âatid
segments.translation: O He who made the days of this world vanish and its months change.

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ الدَّائِمُ لَا تُبْلِيْكَ الْاَزْمَانُ، وَ لَا تُغَيِّرُكَ الدُّهُوْرُ
segments.translation: While You are the Eternal; time does not wear You out nor do the ages change You.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ كُلُّ يَوْمٍ عِنْدَهٗ جَدِيْدٌ، وَ كُلُّ رِزْقٍ عِنْدَهٗ عَتِيْدٌ
segments.translation: O He for whom every day is new, and for whom every provision is ready.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma idha daqal-muqamu bin-nas, fanaâudhu bika min diqil-muqam
segments.translation: You have distributed sustenance among all creatures.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma idha tala yawmul-qiyamah, faqassir dhalikal-yawma âalayna
segments.translation: Treating the tiny ant and the sparrow equally.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِذَا ضَاقَ الْمُقَامُ بِالنَّاسِ، فَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ ضِيْقِ الْمُقَامِ
segments.translation: O Allah, when the standing-place becomes tight for people, we seek refuge in You from that tightness.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِذَا طَالَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ، فَقَصِّرْ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْنَا
segments.transliteration: Fa inna nas-aluka an tudhillana bil-ghamÄm
segments.translation: O Allah, if the Day of Resurrection feels long, shorten that day for us.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِذَا اَدْنَيْتَ الشَّمْسَ مِنَ الْجَمَاجِمِ
segments.transliteration: Wa tansiba lanal-manabira wal-karasiya najlisu âalayha
segments.translation: O Allah, when You bring the sun close to the skulls.

segments.transliteration: As-aluka Allahumma illa ghafarta li wa tajawazta âanni
segments.translation: Then we ask You to shade us with the clouds.

segments.arabic: وَ تَنْصِبَ لَنَا الْمَنَابِرَ وَ الْكَرَاسِيَّ نَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهَا
segments.transliteration: Wa albastanil-âafiyata fi badani wa razaqtani-salamat fi dini
segments.translation: And set up for us pulpits and seats upon which we may sit.

segments.arabic: اَسْاَلُكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِلَّا غَفَرْتَ لِيْ وَ تَجَاوَزْتَ عَنِّيْ
segments.transliteration: Rabbi fastajib li wamnun âalayya bi-âafwik
segments.translation: I ask You, O Allah, to forgive me and overlook my faults.

segments.arabic: وَ اَلْبَسْتَنِيْ الْعَافِيَةَ فِيْ بَدَنِيْ، وَ رَزَقْتَنِيْ السَّلَامَةَ فِيْ دِيْنِيْ
segments.translation: And clothe me with well-being in my body, and grant me safety in my religion.

segments.arabic: رَبِّ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِيْ، وَ امْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِعَفْوِكَ
segments.translation: Lord, respond to me, and favor me with Your pardon.

segments.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْ عِنْدَ فِرَاقِ الْاَحِبَّةِ صَرْعَتِيْ
segments.translation: Lord, have mercy on my fall when I am separated from my loved ones.

segments.transliteration: Wa yawmal-qiyamati fa-bayyid wajhi wa hisaban yasiran fa-hasibni
segments.translation: And have mercy on my loneliness in the stillness of the grave.

segments.arabic: رَبِّ اَسْتَجِيْرُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ فَاَجِرْنِيْ
segments.translation: Lord, I seek refuge in You from the Fire, so protect me.

segments.arabic: وَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَبَيِّضْ وَجْهِيْ، وَ حِسَابًا يَسِيْرًا فَحَاسِبْنِيْ
segments.transliteration: Wa ma la taqata li bihi fala tuhammilni
segments.translation: And on the Day of Resurrection, make my face bright and judge me with an easy reckoning.

segments.transliteration: Wa ila daris-salami fahdini wa bil-qurâani fanfaâni
segments.translation: And grant me patience over Your trials.

segments.arabic: وَ مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لِيْ بِهٖ فَلَا تُحَمِّلْنِيْ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma wa aâdaâi wa man kadani bi-suâ
segments.translation: And do not burden me with what I have no strength to bear.

segments.arabic: وَ اِلٰى دَارِ السَّلَامِ فَاهْدِنِيْ، وَ بِالْقُرْاٰنِ فَانْفَعْنِيْ
segments.translation: And guide me to the Abode of Peace, and benefit me by the Quran.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ اَعْدَائِيْ وَ مَنْ كَادَنِيْ بِسُوْءٍ
segments.transliteration: Anzilhum min sayasihim wa amkinna min nawasihim
segments.translation: O Allah, as for my enemies and whoever plots evil against me.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma salli âala Muhammadin wa ali Muhammad
segments.translation: Make their brave ones cowardly, and scatter their gatherings.

segments.arabic: اَنْزِلْهُمْ مِنْ صَيَاصِيْهِمْ، وَ اَمْكِنَّا مِنْ نَوَاصِيْهِمْ
segments.translation: Bring them down from their fortresses, and give us power over them.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
Amen, O Lord of the Worlds.
O Allah, I surely beseech You in the name of Your Honorable Face,
Your Tremendous Name,

segments.transliteration: wa an taghfira li dhanbiya al`azima
segments.translation: and Your Timeless Kingdom,

segments.transliteration: innahu laÂ yaghfiru al`azima illaÂ al`azimu
segments.translation: to send blessings to Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَ انْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذَنْبِيَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
segments.translation: and to forgive my enormous sin;

segments.arabic: إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلْعَظِيمَ إِلاَّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
segments.translation: for none can forgive the enormous save the All-tremendous (Lord).
Only that which Allah wills shall come to pass!

segments.transliteration: sabbaha lillahi ma fi alssamawati wal-ardi
segments.translation: There is no strength save with Allah.
I pray the forgiveness of Allah.

segments.arabic: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلارْضِ
segments.translation: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth declares the glory of Allah,
and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth;
He gives life and causes death;
and He has power over all things.
He is the First and the Last
and the Ascendant (over all) and the Knower of hidden things,
and He is Cognizant of all things.
He it is who created the heavens and the earth
in six periods,
and He is firm in power;
He knows that which goes deep down into the earth
and that which comes forth out of it,

segments.transliteration: wa huwa ma`akum ayna ma kuntum
segments.translation: and that which comes down from the heaven
and that which goes up into it,
and He is with you wherever you are;
and Allah sees what you do.
His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth;
and to Allah are (all) affairs returned.
He causes the night to enter in upon the day,
and causes the day to enter in upon the night,

segments.transliteration: lara'aytahu khashi`an mutasaddi`an min khashyati allahi
segments.translation: and He is Cognizant of what is in the hearts.

segments.arabic: لَوْ انْزَلْنَا هٰذَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ
segments.translation: Had We sent down this Qur'an on a mountain,

segments.arabic: لَرَايْتَهُ خَاشِعاً مُتَصَدِّعاً مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ
segments.translation: you would certainly have seen it falling down, splitting asunder because of the fear of Allah,

segments.transliteration: huwa allahu alladhi la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: and We set forth these parables to men
that they may reflect.

segments.arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
segments.translation: He is Allah besides Whom there is no god;

segments.transliteration: huwa allahu alladhi la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: the Knower of the unseen and the seen;
He is the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segments.arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
segments.translation: He is Allah, besides Whom there is no god;
the King, the Holy,
the Giver of peace, the Granter of security, Guardian over all,
the Mighty, the Supreme, the Possessor of every greatness.
Glory be to Allah from what they set up with Him.

segments.transliteration: yusabbihu lahu ma fi alssamawati wal-ardi
segments.translation: He is Allah the Creator, the Maker, the Fashioner;
His are the most excellent names;

segments.arabic: يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلارْضِ
segments.translation: whatever is in the heavens and the earth declares His glory;

segments.transliteration: bismillahi alladhi la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
Thanks, thanks, thanks.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ هُوَ
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah save Whom there is no god,
the Knower of the unseen and the seen,

segments.transliteration: allahumma innahu laysa li `ilmun bimawadi`i rizqi
segments.translation: the All-beneficent, and the All-merciful.

segments.transliteration: wa innma atlubuhu bikhataratin takhturu `ala qalbi
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) take away from me grief and distress.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لِي عِلْمٌ بِمَوْضِعِ رِزْقِي
segments.translation: O Allah! verily, I lack acquaintance with the place of my sustenance;

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا أَطْلُبُهُ بِخَطَرَاتٍ تَخْطُرُ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِي
segments.translation: rather, I am seeking it owing to ideas that come upon my mind.

segments.transliteration: la adri afi sahlin huwa am fi jabalin
segments.translation: I consequently wander in countries searching for it.

segments.transliteration: am fi ardin am fi sama'in
segments.translation: By doing such, I am as confused as the confounded,

segments.arabic: لاَ أَدْرِي أَفِي سَهْلٍ هَوُ أَمْ فِي جَبَلٍ
segments.transliteration: am fi barrin am fi bahrin
segments.translation: since I do not know whether my sustenance lies in a plain, on a mountain,

segments.arabic: أَمْ في أَرْضٍ أَمْ في سَمَاءٍ
segments.translation: on the ground, in the air,

segments.arabic: أَمْ فِي بَرٍّ أَمْ فِي بَحْرٍ
segments.translation: on lands, in seas,
at whose hands,
or who the source of it is.
I have full knowledge that You know all these,
the causes of them are in Your Hands,
and it is You Who distribute it out of Your compassion

segments.transliteration: waj`al ya rabbi rizqaka li wasi`an
segments.translation: and cause it out of Your mercy.
O Allah, please send blessings to Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ يَا رَبِّ رِزْقَكَ لِي وَاسِعاً
segments.translation: and make, O Lord, Your sustenance that is provided (by You) to me expansive,

segments.transliteration: wa la tu`annini bitalbi ma lam tuqaddiru li fihi rizqan
segments.translation: my seeking for it easy for me,
and its source close to me.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُعَنِّنِي بِطَلَبِ مَا لَمْ تُقَدِّرْ لِي فيهِ رِزْقاً
segments.translation: Please, do not fatigue me by seeking that which You have not decided for me to take,
because You are certainly in no need for tormenting me
while I am in full need for Your mercy.
(Please) Send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household

segments.transliteration: allahumma rabba alssamawati alssab`i wa ma azallat
segments.translation: and confer liberally upon me, Your slave, out of Your graciousness.

segments.transliteration: wa rabba al-aradina alssab`i wa ma aqallat
segments.translation: You are surely the Lord of great favor.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَمَا اظَلَّتْ
segments.transliteration: wa rabba alshshayatini wa ma adallat
segments.translation: O Allah, O Lord of the seven skies and whatever they shade,

segments.transliteration: wa rabba alrriyahi wa ma dharat
segments.translation: Lord of the seven layers of the earth and whatever they carry,
Lord of the devils and whatever they mislead,
and Lord of the winds and whatever they winnow!
O Allah, O Lord of all things,
God of all things,

segments.transliteration: anta allahu al-awwalu fala shay'a qablaka
segments.translation: and Possessor of all things!

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُقْتَدِرُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
segments.transliteration: wa anta al-akhiru fala shay'a ba`daka
segments.translation: You are Allah, the Omnipotent over all things.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلاوَّلُ فَلاَ شَيْءَ قَبْلَكَ
segments.transliteration: wa anta alzzahiru fala shay'a fawqaka
segments.translation: You are Allah the Foremost; there is thus nothing before You.

segments.transliteration: wa anta albatinu fala shay'a dunaka
segments.translation: You are the Last; there is thus nothing after You.

segments.transliteration: rabba jabra'ila wa mika'ila wa israfila
segments.translation: You are the Ascendant; there is thus nothing above You.
You are the Inward; there is thus nothing concealed from You.
O Lord of Gabriel, Michael, and Seraph!

segments.transliteration: as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O God of Abraham, Ishmael,
Isaac, Jacob, and the Tribes!

segments.arabic: اسْالُكَ انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: wa la tusallit `alayya ahadan min khalqika
segments.translation: I beseech You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
to oversee me with Your mercy

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيَّ احَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: and not to give any of Your creatures power over me
that I cannot stand.

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri shshayatini aljinn wal-insi fasallimni
segments.translation: O Allah, I am endearing myself to You; so (please) endear me to the others,
create affection for me among people,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ شَّيَاطِينِ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلإِنْسِ فَسَلِّمْنِي
segments.translation: and keep me sound from the evil of the devils of jinn and men,

segments.transliteration: ya mudhill kull jabbar wamueizz kull dhalyl qad wahaqqik balligh majhudi
segments.translation: O Lord of the Worlds,

segments.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka yaa man laa tarahu al-'uyoonu wa laa tukhaalituhu ath-thunoonu
segments.translation: and bless Muhammad and his Household.

segments.arabic:
يَا مُذِلَّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ وَمُعِزَّ كُلِّ ذَليلٍ قَدْ وَحَقِّكَ بَلِّغْ مَجْهُودِي

ya mudhill kull jabbar wamueizz kull dhalyl qad wahaqqik balligh majhudi

O You who humbles every tyrant and exalts every lowly one, by Your right, grant me my utmost effort.

Recite this for 3 nights for relief 

8.Salat 2 Rakat First Rakat :S Hamd, Aytaul Kursi ,Kaferoon
Second Rakat S Hamd and 30 times Sura Ikhlass
 then Raise your hands and say
اَللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا مَنْ لَا تَرَاهُ الْعُيُونُ وَلَا تُخَالِطُهُ الظُّنُونُ
segments.translation: O You who humbles every tyrant and exalts every lowly one, by Your right, grant me my utmost effort.

segments.transliteration: Yaa man laa taghayyiruhu adduhooru wa laa tublihi alazminatu wa laa tahmiluhu alumooru
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You, O One whom eyes cannot see, and thoughts cannot perceive.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا تُغَيِّرُهُ الدُّهُورُ وَلَا تُبْلِيهِ الْأَزْمِنَةُ وَلَا تَحْمِلُهُ الْأُمُورُ
segments.transliteration: Yaa man laa yadhooq almawta wa laa yakhaafu alfawta
segments.translation: And whom describers cannot describe.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يَذُوقُ الْمَوْتَ وَلَا يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ
segments.transliteration: Yaa man laa tadhurruhu adhdhunoobu wa laa tanqusu almaghfirah
segments.translation: O One whom time does not change, nor do ages wear out, nor is He burdened by matters.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا تَضُرُّهُ الذُّنُوبُ وَلَا تَنْقُصُهُ الْمَغْفِرَةُ
segments.translation: O One who does not taste death and does not fear loss.

segments.transliteration: Wahab li ma laa yanqusuq wa ighfir li ma laa yadhurruq wa af'al bi ma anta ahluh
segments.translation: O One whom sins do not harm, nor does forgiveness diminish Him.

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي مَا لَا يَنْقُصُكَ وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لَا يَضُرُّكَ وَافْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ
segments.translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰھُمَّ عَافِنَا مِنْ كُلِّ بَلَاءِ الدُّنْیَا
segments.translation: Grant me what does not diminish You, forgive me for what does not harm You, and deal with me as You are worthy.

segments.arabic: وَاصْرِفْ عَنَّا شَرَّ الدُّنْیَا وَ شَرَّ الْآخِرَۃِ
segments.translation: O Allah, grant us well-being from every affliction of this world.

segments.arabic: وَارْزُقْنَا خَیْرَ الدُّنْیَا وَ خَیْرَ الْآخِرَۃِ
segments.translation: And turn away from us the evil of this world and the evil of the hereafter.

segments.arabic: بِفَضْلِکَ وَ رَحْمَتِکَ یَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِیْنَ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma hadhihi salati sallaytuha la li-hajatin minka ilayha
segments.translation: And provide us with the good of this world and the good of the hereafter.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ هٰذِهٖ صَلَاتِي صَلَّيْتُهَا لَا لِحَاجَةٍ مِنْكَ‏ إِلَيْهَا
segments.transliteration: Wa la raghbatin minka fiha illa taâdhiman wa taâatan
segments.translation: By Your grace and Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا رَغْبَةٍ مِنْكَ فِيْهَا إِلَّا تَعْظِيمًا وَ طَاعَةً
segments.transliteration: Wa ijabatan laka ila ma amartani
segments.translation: O Allah, this is my prayer which I have offered, not because of any need You have for it,

segments.arabic: وَ إِجَابَةً لَّكَ إِلىٰ مَا أَمَرْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: Ilahi in kana fiha khalalun aw naqsun
segments.translation: Nor because of any desire You have for it, but only to glorify You and out of obedience,

segments.arabic: إِلَهِي إِنْ كَانَ فِيْهَا خَلَلٌ أَوْ نَقْصٌ
segments.transliteration: Min rukuâiha aw sujudiha aw qiyamiha aw quâudiha
segments.translation: And in response to what You have commanded me.

segments.arabic: مِنْ رُكُوْعِهَا أَوْ سُجُوْدِهَا أَوْ قِیَامِھَا أَوْ قُعُوْدِھَا
segments.transliteration: Fala tuâakhidhni wa tafaddal âalayya bil-qabuli wal-ghufrani
segments.translation: My God, if there is any flaw or deficiency in it,

segments.arabic: فَلَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي وَ تَفَضَّلْ عَلَيَّ بِالْقَبُوْلِ وَ الْغُفْرَانِ
segments.translation: In its bowing, its prostration, its standing, or its sitting,
Then do not hold me accountable, and favor me with acceptance and forgiveness,

segments.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللہِ وَ أَعُوْذُ بِقُدْرَةِ اللہ
segments.transliteration: Wa aâudhu bi-maghfiratillahi wa aâudhu bi-rahmatillah
segments.translation: By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوْذُ بِمَغْفِرَةِ اللہِ وَ أَعُوْذُ بِرَحْمَةِ اللہِ
segments.transliteration: Wa aâudhu bi-sultanillahil-ladhi huwa âala kulli shayâin qadir
segments.translation: I seek refuge in the Glory of Allah, and I seek refuge in the Power of Allah.

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوْذُ بِسُلْطَانِ اللہِ الَّذِيْ‏ هُوَ عَلىٰ‏ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
segments.transliteration: Wa aâudhu bi-karamillahi wa aâudhu bi-jamâillah
segments.translation: I seek refuge in the Forgiveness of Allah, and I seek refuge in the Mercy of Allah.

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوْذُ بِكَرَمِ اللہِ وَ أَعُوْذُ بِجَمْعِ اللہِ
segments.transliteration: Min sharri kulli jabbarin âanidin wa shaytanin marid
segments.translation: I seek refuge in the Authority of Allah, who has power over all things.

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيْدٍ وَ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيْدٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa kulli mughtalin wa sariqin wa âarid
segments.translation: I seek refuge in the Generosity of Allah, and I seek refuge in the Protection of Allah.

segments.arabic: وَ كُلِّ مُغْتَالٍ وَ سَارِقٍ وَ عَارِضٍ
segments.translation: From the evil of every obstinate tyrant and rebellious devil.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ السَّامَّةِ وَ الْهَامَّةِ وَ الْعَامَّةِ
segments.transliteration: Wa min sharri kulli dabbatin saghiratin wa kabiratin bi-laylin aw nahar
segments.translation: And from every assassin, thief, and sudden affliction.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ صَغِيْرَةٍ وَ كَبِيْرَةٍ بِلَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa min sharri fussaqil-âarabi wal-âajami wa fujjarihim
segments.translation: From the evil of poisonous pests, creeping insects, and the common folk.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ فُسَّاقِ الْعَرَبِ وَ الْعَجَمِ وَ فُجَّارِهِمْ
segments.translation: From the evil of every creature, small or large, by night or by day.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ فَسَقَةِ الْجِنِّ وَ الْإِنْسِ
segments.transliteration: Wa min sharri kulli dabbatin rabbi akhidhun bi-nasiyatiha
segments.translation: From the evil of the wicked among Arabs and non-Arabs, and their transgressors.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ رَبِّي‏ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.translation: From the evil of the transgressors among Jinn and mankind.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma bi-á¸¥aqqi Muá¸¥ammadin wa Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: From the evil of every creature whose forelock my Lord holds.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: á¹¢alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: Indeed, my Lord is on a straight path.

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ tuâminnÄ makraka wa lÄ tunsinÄ dhikrak
segments.translation: O Allah, by the right of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تُؤْمِنَّا مَكْرَكَ وَ لَا تُنْسِنَا ذِكْرَكَ
segments.translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ taá¸¥rimnÄ faá¸laka wa lÄ tuá¸¥illa âalaynÄ ghaá¸abak
segments.translation: And do not make us feel secure from Your plan, nor make us forget Your remembrance,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا فَضْلَكَ وَ لَا تُحِلَّ عَلَيْنَا غَضَبَكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ tubÄâidnÄ min jiwÄrika wa lÄ tanquá¹£nÄ min raá¸¥matik
segments.translation: And do not remove from us Your covering.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تُبَاعِدْنَا مِنْ جِوَارِكَ وَ لَا تَنْقُصْنَا مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ tanziâ minnÄ barakataka wa lÄ tamnaânÄ âÄfiyatak
segments.translation: And do not deprive us of Your ÙØ¶Ù, nor unleash upon us Your anger,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَنْزِعْ مِنَّا بَرَكَتَكَ وَ لَا تَمْنَعْنَا عَافِيَتَكَ
segments.translation: And do not distance us from Your nearness, nor reduce for us Your mercy.

segments.transliteration: Wa zidnÄ min faá¸lika al-mubÄraki aá¹­-á¹­ayyib
segments.translation: And do not take away from us Your blessings, nor withhold from us Your well-being,

segments.arabic: وَ زِدْنَا مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْمُبَارَكِ الطَّيِّبِ
segments.translation: And set right for us what You have given us.

segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ tughayyir mÄ binÄ min niâmatik
segments.translation: And increase us from Your blessed and pure bounty,

With You is the Master Record.â 10.Imam Ja`far al-Sadiq(peace be upon him) is also reported to have said that one who desires to enjoy both the worldly life and the Next World, and one who has eye ache, should say the following prayer after the Dawn and Sunset Prayers: Fajr Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙ Ø¥ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø£ÙØ³ÙØ£ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙØ­ÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙÙØ¯ ÙÙØ¢ÙÙ Ù ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙÙØ¯ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ allahumma inni as'aluka bihaqqi muhammadin wa ali muhammadin `alayka O Allah, I do beseech You, in the name of the right of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad that is incumbent upon You ØµÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙ° Ù ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙÙØ¯ ÙÙØ¢ÙÙ Ù ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙÙØ¯ salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad ÙÙÙ±Ø¬ÙØ¹ÙÙÙ Ù±ÙÙÙÙÙØ±Ù ÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙØµÙØ±ÙÙ waj`al alnnura fi basari and to give light to my insight, ÙÙÙ±ÙÙØ¨ÙØµÙÙÙØ±ÙØ

title: Sajda Shukr /Thanksgiving Prostration

segments.translation: âThere is no god save You. Be You Glorified!
Lo! I have been a wrongdoer.â
Thanks, thanks.
Pardon! Pardon!
Praise be to Allah.
O Lord of all lords,
O King of all kings,
O master of all masters,
O Omnipotent of all the omnipotent,
and O God of all gods,
(please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammadâ¦
For I am Your servant and my forelock is in Your grasp.
All glory be to You, O Allah.
You are my Lord, truly, truly.

segments.arabic: سَجَدْتُ لَكَ يَا رَبِّ تَعَبُّداً وَرِقّاً
segments.transliteration: sajadtu laka ya rabbi ta`abbudan wa riqqan
segments.translation: I prostrate myself before You, O my Lord, out of my servitude and subjugation to You.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ عَمَلِي ضَعِيفٌ فَضَاعِفْهُ لِي
segments.translation: O Allah, my deed is certainly feeble; so, (please do) grant it strength by increasing it many times.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) save me from Your chastisement on the day when You shall resurrect Your servants,

segments.arabic: وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ انْتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
segments.transliteration: wa tub `alayya innaka anta alttawwabu alrrahimu
segments.translation: and (please) accept my repentance. Verily, You are the Oft-Returning, the Most Merciful.

segments.arabic: اعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَارٍ حَرُّهَا لاَ يُطْفَىٰ
segments.transliteration: a`udhu bika min narin harruha la yutfa
segments.translation: I pray for Your protection against the fire whose heat is inextinguishable.

segments.arabic: وَاعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَارٍ جَدِيدُهَا لاَ يَبْلىٰ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min narin jadiduha la yabla
segments.translation: I pray for Your protection against the fire whose newness never decays.

segments.arabic: وَاعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَارٍ عَطْشَانُهَا لاَ يُرْوىٰ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min narin`atshanuha la yurwa
segments.translation: I pray for Your protection against the fire whose thirsty is never quenched.

segments.arabic: وَاعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَارٍ مَسْلُوبُهَا لاَ يُكْسَىٰ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min narin maslubuha la yuksa
segments.translation: I pray for Your protection against the fire whose disrobed is never clothed.
O All-kind! O All-merciful!
O my Lord! O my Master!
I beseech You for rest at death
and pardon at (final) judgment.

segments.transliteration: sajada wajhiya alla'imu liwajhi rabbiya alkarimi
segments.translation: My mean face is prostrating before My Lordâs Noble Face.
I have wronged myself; so, (please) forgive me.
O Allah, Your forgiveness is more expansive than my sin
and Your mercy is more hopeful for me than my deeds.

segments.arabic: فَٱغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي يَا  حَيّاً لاَ يَمُوتُ
segments.transliteration: faghfir li dhunubi ya hayyan la yamutu
segments.translation: So, (please) forgive my sins. O He Who is Ever-living and never dies!
O Humiliator of all tyrants!
O Dignifier of all humble ones!
I, swearing by You, have exerted all efforts;
so, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household
and relieve me.

segments.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا رَبَّاهُ يَا سَيِّدَاهُ
segments.transliteration: ya allahu ya rabbahu ya sayyidahu
segments.translation: O Allah! O my Lord! O my Master!
O my Lord! O my Master!
O my Lord, what will harm You

segments.arabic: انْ تُرْضِيَ عَنِّي كُلَّ مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ عِنْدِي تَبِعَةٌ
segments.transliteration: an turdiya `anni kulla man kana lahu `indi tabi`atun
segments.translation: if You cause all those to whom I am indebted by a claim to be pleased with me,
forgive my sins,
and allow me enter Paradise, out of Your mercy.
Verily, Your pardon is for the wrongdoers,
and I am one of the wrongdoers;
so, (please) let Your mercy include me, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

segments.arabic: عَظُمَ الذَّنْبُ مِنْ عَبْدِكَ فَلْيُحْسِنِ الْعَفْوُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
segments.transliteration: Ê¿Aáºuma adh-dhanbu min Ê¿abdika fa-lyaá¸¥sini al-Ê¿afwu min Ê¿indika
segments.translation: Great is the sin from Your servant, so let forgiveness be better and good from You.

segments.arabic: إلٰهي عُبَيْدُكَ بِفِنَائِك ، مِسْكِينُكَ بِفِنَائِك ، فَقِيرُكَ بِفِنَائِك
segments.transliteration: âIlÄhÄ« `Ubayduka bi FinÄâik; MiskÄ«nuka bi FinÄâik, FaqÄ«ruka bi FinÄâik
segments.translation:
(O AllÄh ! Your slave is at Your dooryard; Your wretched one is at Your dooryard, Your
destitute is at Your dooryard)â.
O my Lord, You advised me, but I did not take heed.
And You warned me against Your prohibitions, but I did not refrain.

segments.transliteration: Wa ghamaratni ayÄdÄ«ka fÄ mÄ shakartu
segments.translation: And Your blessings overwhelmed me, but I did not show gratitude.
Your pardon, Your pardon, O Generous One!
I ask You for comfort at the time of death.
And I ask You for pardon during the reckoning.

segments.arabic: یَا مَنْ لَا یَزِیْدُہٗ اِلْحَاحُ الْمُلِحِّیْنَ اِلَّا جُوْدًا وَ کَرَمًا
segments.transliteration: Ya man la yazeeduhu ilhÄhu al-mulihheena illa joodan wa karama
segments.translation: O One whose generosity and kindness only increase with persistent requests.

segments.arabic: یَا مَنْ لَہٗ خَزَائِنُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ
segments.transliteration: Ya man lahu khazÄâinu as-samÄwÄti wal-ard
segments.translation: O One to whom belong the treasures of the heavens and the earth.

segments.arabic: یَا مَنْ لَہٗ خَزَائِنُ مَا دَقَّ وَ جَلَّ
segments.transliteration: Ya man lahu khazÄâinu ma daqqa wa jalla
segments.translation: O One who holds the treasures of all that is small and great.
My wrongdoing does not prevent Your goodness.

segments.arabic: اَسْئَلُکَ اَنْ تَفْعَلَ بِیْ مَا اَنْتَ اَہْلَہٗ
segments.transliteration: Asâaluka an tafâala bee ma anta ahluhu
segments.translation: I ask You to treat me as You deserve.

segments.arabic: فَاَنْتَ اَہْلُ الْجُوْدِ وَ الْکَرَمِ وَ الْعَفْوِ
segments.transliteration: Fa anta ahlu al-joodi wal-karami wal-'afwi
segments.translation: For You are worthy of generosity, kindness, and forgiveness.

segments.arabic: یَا رَبِّ وَ اَنْتَ قَادِرٌ عَلَی الْعُقُوْبَۃِ
segments.transliteration: Ya Rabbi wa anta qadirun 'ala al-'uqooba
segments.translation: O my Lord, You are able to punish.
O my Lord, and indeed I deserve it.

segments.arabic: لَا حُجَّۃَ لِیْ وَ لَا عُذْرَ لِیْ عِنْدَکَ
segments.transliteration: La hujjata li wa la âudhra li âindak
segments.translation: I have no argument and no excuse before You.
To You, I surrender all my affairs.
I admit them so that You may forgive me.
And You know them better than I do.
I bring before You every sin I have committed.
And every mistake I have made.
And every bad deed I have done.

segments.arabic: فَاغْفِرْ وَ ارْحَمْ وَ تَجَاوَزْ عَمَّا تَعْلَمُ
segments.transliteration: Faghfir warham wa tajÄwaz âamma taâlam
segments.translation: So forgive, have mercy, and overlook what You know.
Indeed, You are the Most Mighty, the Most Generous.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ بِجُودِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma inni ataqarrabu ilayka bijoodika wa karamika
segments.translation: O Allah, I draw near to You through Your generosity and kindness.

segments.transliteration: Wa ataqarrabu ilayka bi-Muhammadin 'abdika wa rasoolika
segments.translation: And I draw near to You through Muhammad, Your servant and Messenger.
And I draw near to You through Your close angels.
And through Your sent prophets.
And through You, O Allah, You are independent of me.
And I am in need of You.

segments.arabic: اَنْتَ الْغَنِيُّ وَ اَنَا الْفَقِيرُ اِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: Anta al-ghaniyyu wa ana al-faqeeru ilayk
segments.translation: You are the Rich, and I am the poor towards You.
Pardon my mistakes.
And cover my sins.
And fulfill my needs today.

segments.arabic: وَلَا تُعَذِّبْنِي بِقَبِيحِ مَا تَعْلَمُ مِنِّي
segments.transliteration: Wala tu'adh-dhibni bi-qabeehi ma ta'lamu minni
segments.translation: And do not punish me for the ugly things You know of me.
But rather, let Your pardon and generosity encompass me.
O Allah, O Lord of the daybreak, the ten nights,
the even and the odd,
and the night when it departs!
O Lord of all things!
O Lord of all things!
O Creator of all things!
O King of all things!
(Please) send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَٱفْعَلْ بِي وَبِـ… مَا انْتَ اهْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: waf`al bi wa biâ¦ ma anta ahluhu
segments.translation: do to me and to so-and-so that which befits You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَفْعَلْ بِنَا مَا نَحْنُ اهْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: wa la taf`al bina ma nahnu ahluhu
segments.translation: but do not do to us that which we deserve,

segments.transliteration: fa'innaka ahlu alttaqwa wa ahlu almaghfirati
segments.translation: for You are verily worthy to be feared and worthy to forgive.
O Allah, all praise be to You;
there is no god save You;
(You are) the Knower of all the unseen and the seen
and You are the All-beneficent and All-merciful.
O Allah, (please) put away from me distress, grief,
vicissitudes (of time), and seditious matters;

segments.transliteration: ma zahara minha wa ma batana
segments.translation: both the explicit and the implicit.

segments.arabic:
اََللّهُم اِلَيْكَ تَوَ جّهْتُ وَ بِكَ اعْتَصَمْتُ وَ عَلَيْكَ تَوَ كَلْتُ، 
اََللّهُم اَنْتَ ثِقَتِىْ وَ رَجَائِىْ، 
فَاکْفِنِىْ مَا اَهَمّنِىْ وَ مَا لَمْ يُهِمّنِىْ وَ مَا اَنْتَ اَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنّىْ،
عَزّ جَارُكَ وَ جَلّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَ لَ اِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ،
 صَلّ عَلٰی مُحَمّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمّدٍ وَ
عَجّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ...
segments.transliteration: La ilaha illal lahu haqqan haqqa; La ilaha illal lahu imanan wa tasdiqa; la ilaha illal lahu 'ubudiyyatan wa riqqa; Sajadtu laka ya Rabbi ta'abbudan wa riqqa la mustankifan wa la mustak biran bal ana 'abdun zalilun za'ifun kha'ifun mustajir.
segments.translation: âOâ Allah, I hold You witness, and I hold all Your angels and Prophets and Messengers and the entire creation witness on the fact that certainly You are Allah, My Lord, and my religion is Islam, and Mohammad is my Prophet, and Ali is my Guardian, and Hasan, Husain, Ali bn Husain, Mohamad bin Ali, Jafar bin Mohammad, Musa bin Jafar, Ali bin Musa, Mohammad bin Ali, Ali bin Mohammad, Hasan bin Ali, and their noble successor, peace be upon them, my Imams, I express my devotion towards them, and my dislike towards their enemies. Oâ Allah, I adjure You for the blood of the oppressed.

segments.arabic:
أَللَّهُمَّ إِنّي اُشْهِدُكَ ، وَاُشْهِدُ مَلائِكَتَكَ وَأَنْبِياءَكَ وَرُسُلَكَ وَجَميعَ خَلْقِكَ بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ رَبّي ، 
وَالْإِسْلامُ ديني ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيّي ، وَعَلِيٌّ وَلِيّي ، وَالْحَسَنُ وَالْحُسَيْنُ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ وَمُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُوسى وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ وَالْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ وَالْخَلَفُ الصَّالِحُ صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَئِمَّتي ،
 بِهِمْ أَتَوَلَّى ، وَمِنْ عَدُوِّهِمْ أَتَبَرَّءُ .
 أَللَّهُمَّ إِنّي اُنْشِدُكَ دَمَ الْمَظْلُومِ .
segments.translation: Oâ Allah, I adjure You by the promise You made to Your friends that You will make them victorious over Your enemies and their enemies, I adjure You to bless Mohammad and the protectors from his household.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنّي اُنْشِدُكَ بِوَأْيِكَ عَلى نَفْسِكَ لِأَوْلِيائِكَ ، لَتُظْهِرَنَّهُمْ عَلى عَدُوِّكَ وَعَدُوِّهِمْ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى الْمُسْتَحْفَظينَ مِنْ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ .
segments.translation: Oâ Allah, indeed I adjure You by the pledge You made to yourself regarding Your enemies that You will destroy them, and will humiliate them by their own hands and by the hands of the believers, I adjure You to bless Mohammad and the Protectors from Mohammadâs household.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنّي اُنْشِدُكَ بِإيوائِكَ عَلى نَفْسِكَ لِأَعْدائِكَ ، لَتُهْلِكَنَّهُمْ وَلَتُخْزِيَنَّهُمْ بَأَيْديهِمْ وَأَيْدِى الْمُؤْمِنينَ ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى الْمُسْتَحْفَظينَ مِنْ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Oâ Allah, I ask You for ease and relief after difficulties and hardships. [1]

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْيُسْرَ بَعْدَ الْعُسْرِ
segments.translation: O Allah! Choose me (for goodness).

segments.arabic:
لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ حَقّاً حَقّاً 
لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ إِيمَاناً وَ تَصْدِيقاً 
لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عُبُودِيَّةً وَ رِقّاً 
سَجَدْتُ لَكَ يَا رَبِّ تَعَبُّداًوَ رِقّاً لَا مُسْتَنْكِفاً وَ لَا مُسْتَكْبِراً
 بَلْ أَنَا عَبْدٌ ذَلِيلٌ خَائِفٌ مُسْتَجِير
segments.translation: O Worthy of being feared and Lord of forgiveness,

segments.transliteration: Anta khayrun lÄ« min abÄ« wa ummÄ«,
segments.translation: O Most Merciful of the merciful!
You are my Master and my Lord,
So grant me sustenance and grace.
You are better for me than my father and my mother,
And better than all people together.

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ خَيْرٌ لِي مِنْ أَبِي وَأُمِّي،
segments.transliteration: Wa asâaluka an tuá¹£alliya Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Äli Muá¸¥ammad,
segments.translation: From me to You is poverty and need,

segments.transliteration: Wa Ê¿alÄ ikhwanihi an-nabiyyÄ«n wa al-aâimmati aá¹­-á¹­ÄhirÄ«n,
segments.translation: And You are free of any need from me.
I beseech You by Your Noble and Generous Face,
And I ask You to send blessings upon Muá¸¥ammad and the family of Muá¸¥ammad,
And upon his brothers â the Prophets â and the pure, immaculate Imams.

segments.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.translation: And that You answer my supplication,
Have mercy on my humble plea,
And turn away from me every kind of trial and affliction,

text: Sajda Shukr /Thanksgiving Prostration Significance Importance × Thanksgiving Prostration (Sajdat al-Shukr) Merits Once you finish the post-prayer utterances, you may do the thanksgiving prostration. As is unanimously agreed by all ShÂ¢`ite scholars, thanksgiving prostration may be done whenever a new bliss is obtained or a misfortune is fended off. It is most favorable to do it after the prayers as expression of thanks to Almighty Allah for performing the prayer. Through a valid chain of authority, Imam al-BÂ¡qir (`a) is reported to have said, âWhenever (Imam) `Ali ibn al-Husayn (`a) remembered a grace of Allah the Almighty and Majestic, he would prostrate. Whenever he recited a verse from the Book of Allah in which prostration is mentioned, he would prostrate. Whenever Almighty Allah warded off from him an evil that he feared, he would prostrate. Whenever he accomplished an obligatory prayer, he would prostrate. Whenever he was granted success to conciliate between two persons, he would prostrate.â The traces of prostration were seen in all organs of prostration in his body; therefore, he was called the Prostrating (al-Sajjad). Through an authentic chain of authority, Imam al-Sadiq (`a) is reported to have said, âWhenever a faithful believer prostrates himself before Almighty Allah as expression of thanks for a grace in other than a prayer, Almighty Allah will certainly record for him ten rewards, erase from him ten sins, and raise him ten ranks in Paradise.â Through a valid chain of authority too, Imam al-Sadiq (`a) is also reported to have said, âThe nearest position a servant may be to Almighty Allah is when he prostrates himself and weeps.â Through another authentic chain of authority, Imam al Sadiq (`a) is also reported to have said: The thanksgiving prostration is obligatory upon all Muslims. Through it, you make your prayers perfect and attain your Lordâs pleasure and the angelsâ admiration. When a servant does a thanksgiving prostration after a prayer, the Exalted Lord removes the screen between the angels and that servant, saying to them, âO my angels, look at this servant of Mine. He has carried out his duty towards Me, perfected his pledge to Me, and then prostrated himself before Me as expression of thanking Me for what I have given him of my graces. O my angels! What will I grant him?â The angels will answer, âO our Lord! Grant him Your mercy.â Then the Blessed and Exalted Lord will say, âWhat more will I grant him?â The angels will answer, âO our Lord! Grant him Your Paradise.â Then the Blessed and Exalted Lord will say, âWhat more will I grant him?â The angels will answer, âO our Lord! Grant him settlement of what concerns him.â The Blessed and Exalted Lord will keep on asking them and the angels will answer with similar answers, leaving no single item of goodness. Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, will then say, âWhat more will I grant him?â The angels will then answer, âO our Lord! We do not know.â Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, will say, âI will thank him just as he has thanked Me, attend him with My graces, and show him My great mercy on the Resurrection Day.â Through an authentic chain of authority, Imam al-Â¯Â¡diq (`a) is also reported to have said, âAlmighty Allah has taken (Prophet) Abraham as His friend just because he used to prostrate himself on the ground very frequently.â According to another validly reported tradition, Imam al-Â¯Â¡diq (`a) is reported to have said, âWhenever you remember any of Almighty Allahâs favors to you and you are in a place where no dissident can see you, you should place your cheek on the ground (i.e. prostrating yourself before Almighty Allah). When you are in a place where you fear lest a dissident can see you, you may bow yourself in submission to Almighty Allah by putting your hand under your stomach to make the dissident believe that you have been affected by colic.â According to many traditions, Almighty Allah revealed to Prophet Moses (`a), saying, âDo you know why I have chosen you to speak to Me over My other creatures?â âNo, I do not, my Lord,â answered Moses (`a). Almighty Allah said, âO Moses, I had turned over all My servants, but I could not find any one of them more submissive to Me than you are. O Moses, whenever you prayed, you would place your cheeks on the soil.â Through an authenticated chain of authority, Imam al-RiÂ¤Â¡ (`a) is reported to have said, âA prostration after an obligatory prayer is an expression of thanking Almighty Allah for granting His servant success to carry out his duty towards Him. The least of what can be said while prostrating is to repeat the following words three times: Ø´ÙÙÙØ±Ø§Ù ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ shukran lillÂ¡hi Thanks to Allah. âWhat is the meaning of Thanks to Allah?â the reporter asked, and the Imam (`a) answered, âIt means that this prostration is a thanksgiving from me to Almighty Allah for the success that He has granted me to serve Him and carry out my duty towards Him. Verily, thanking Almighty Allah increases graces and grants more success to obey Him. If it happens that a prayer is still imperfect and the supererogatory prayer has not covered that imperfection, then this thanksgiving prostration will perfect it.â Method of Thanksgiving Prostration The validity of thanksgiving prostration is not conditional upon any thing; it is therefore acceptable to do it any way one chooses. However, it is precautionary to prostrate on the ground, to use the seven organs of prostration that are used in the prostrations of prayers, to put the forehead on a thing acceptable to prostrate on, and to more preferably stick your arms and abdomen to the ground on the contrary of what is done in the prostrations of prayers. One of the traditions of thanksgiving prostrations is to put the forehead on the ground, the right and then the left cheeks, and then return to the normal position of prostration; that is putting the forehead on the ground again. Therefore, this prostration is sometimes called the two thanksgiving prostrations. Apparently, it is unobjectionable to prostrate oneself on the ground without uttering any supplication or doxology although it is a tradition to say any statement while prostrating oneself. It is therefore more preferable to choose any statement from the following utterances of thanksgiving prostration. It is also recommended to prolong the prostration. Imam al-KÂ¡Â¨im (`a) is reported to have kept himself in the position of prostration from post-dawning up to midday and from post-afternoon up to sunset. According to another tradition, for more than ten years, Imam al-KÂ¡Â¨im (`a) used to prostrate himself every day for the space of time between the first light up to midday. Through an authentic chain of authority, Imam al-RiÂ¤Â¡ (`a) is reported to have prostrated himself for such a long time that the pebbles of the mosque would be wet by his sweat and he used to stick his two cheeks to the ground of the mosque. The following is quoted from al-KashshÂ¢âs famous book of biographies of narrators (i.e. KitÂ¡b al-RijÂ¡l): Al-FaÂ¤l ibn ShÂ¡dhÂ¡n said that he, once, visited MuÂ¦ammad ibn AbÂ¢-`Umayr and found him in the state of a very long prostration. When he raised his head, al-FaÂ¤l asked him about such a long prostration. MuÂ¦ammad answered, âWhat will you say if you see the prostration of JamÂ¢l ibn DarrÂ¡j? One day, I visited him and found him in a state of prostration, which took very long time. When he raised his head, I asked him about that very long prostration. JamÂ¢l said, âWhat will you say if you see the prostration of Ma`rÂ£f ibn KharrabÂ£z?ââ In another narration, al-FaÂ¤l ibn ShÂ¡dhÂ¡n related that Â°asan ibn `AlÂ¢ ibn FadhdhÂ¡l used to go out for serving Almighty Allah. He used to prostrate himself for such a long time that even birds would fall down on him, thinking that he was a piece of cloth or a rotten material. When beasts grazed around him, they would not run away, because they would not feel any thing strange. In another narration, it is reported that `AlÂ¢ ibn MahziyÂ¡r would fall in prostration at sunrise and would not raise his head before he supplicated for the good of one thousand persons of his brethren-in-faith as same as he would supplicate for himself. Because of such very long prostrations, there was a mark on his forehead similar to the marks found on camelsâ knees. In another narration, it is reported that Ibn AbÂ¢-`Umayr used to prostrate himself after the Dawn Prayer and raise it at the Noon (Â²uhr) Prayer. It is better to do the thanksgiving prostrations immediately after the post-prayer utterances and before the supererogatory prayers except for the Sunset (Maghrib) Prayers, because the majority of scholars believe that the thanksgiving prostration after this prayer should be done after the supererogatory prayer, while others see the opposite. Hence, to do it according to any partyâs notion is good enough although it may be more preferable to precede it to the supererogatory prayers, according to the report of al-Â°imyarÂ¢ from the Awaited Imam, may Allah hasten his reappearance. To solve the question, it must be more preferable to do it before and after the supererogatory prayers. × . You may then pray to Him for your personal needs, for it has been narrated that any one who offers this prayer and supplicates Almighty Allah will have his requests granted. al-islam source Another video on importance Source https://islamiced.org : Indepth analysis of Salat -Book One of the most recommended prayers in Islamic teachings, is Salat ul-Ghufayla. It is a two unit prayer that takes only a few minutes to perform between Maghrib and Isha' prayers but comes highly recommended by the Ahlul Bayt, 'alayhum as-salam, with great rewards. A hadith from Imam As-Sadiq, alayhi as-salam, from his fathers, from Rasul Allah Muhammad, Salallahu alahi' wa 'aali wa sallam, found in the book Thawab ul-Amal by Shaykh as-Sadooq, places the reward of praying Salat ul-Ghufayla, as inheriting paradise. Other narrations point to the fulfillment of wishes because of the Salah. We usually pray Maghrib followed by Isha' and not reflect upon the short time in between these two prayers. It's called the time of Ghafla', meaning negligence, since people are generally heedless of its importance as well as potential. The period between Maghrib and Isha' is also suggested as a symbol of how short this life is. Hence the time for Ghufayla' prayers is straight after Maghrib Salah and before we pray Isha' prayers. However, according to some scholars, it can still be prayed after Isha' prayers, if we forget to do so between Maghrib and Isha'. The other thing to remember is how Islamic teachings emphasize the importance of recommendatory prayers to compensate for the lack of focus or attention in our daily obligatory Salah. The more Mustahab Salaahs we perform, the more likely our daily Wajib prayers will be accepted by Allah Subhana wa Ta'ala. Now this is how Salatul Ghufayla is performed. Number one, have the Niyyah' in your mind. I am praying Salat ul-Ghufayla, Two Rak'aats Qurbatan illa Allahi Ta'ala, to get close to Allah. Second recite Surat ul-Fatiha'. Third without saying Bismillah recite verses 87 and 88 of chapter 21 as follows: "Wa dhannuni idh dhahaba mughadiban fadhanna an lan naqdira 'alayhi fanada fi adhdhulumati an la ilaha illa anta, subhanaka inni kuntu min adh-dhalimeen. (21:87) "Fastajabna lahu wa najjaynahu min al-ghammi wa kadhalika nunjee al-mu'minin"(21:88) Four, go down to Ru'ku, then stand up, then go down to sajda as normal. Five, in the second Ruk'aah recite Surah Al-Fatiha. Six, after Fatiha, immediately and without reciting Bismillah, recite Ayah 59 of chapter number 6. "Wa 'indahu mafatih al-ghaybi la ya'lamuha illa huwa, wa ya'lamu ma fi al-barri wa al-bahr, wa ma tasqutu min waraqatin illa ya'lamuha, wa la habbatin fee dhulumati al-ardhi, wa la ratbin, wala yabisin, illa fi kitabin mubeen"(6:59) Then raise your hands in Qunoot and say "Allahumma inni as'aluka bi mafatih ul-ghaybi allati la ya'lamuha illa Ant. Antu Salli' Alaa' Muhammad wa 'aali'. Then you can ask for your wishes and whatever you wish to supplicate for. Finally recite the following "Allahumma Anta Waliun na'mati, Wa al-Qa'diuru 'aala Talibati, Ta'lamu Haajati. Fa' as'aluka Bi haqqi Muhammad wa 'aali, alayhi wa 'alayhimu as-salam lamma qadhaitaha li". Now you might be asking, can we hold a piece of paper, or use the phone, or listen to it being recited and repeat? The answer is yes to all these. Hopefully with practice it's eventually memorized. Now the prayer is then completed as normal. There is so much emphasis by scholars on the Salaah, Salat ul-Ghufaylah, that if we have the intention of praying it as Nafilah of Maghrib and Ghufaylah prayers , we get the reward of praying both of them. SubhanaAllah! The number of Rak'aahs for Maghrib Nafilah is four, of course, however, just praying Salat ul-Ghufaylah by itself without adding the Niyyah of the Nafilah prayer as well, does not cover for their Nafilah. Sometimes what happens is we forget to recite the specific Ayat like chapter six, verse 59 and instead recite a chapter of the Qur'an after Fatiha, like Surat ul-Ikhlaas. So what should we do then? Well, we should finish recitation of that chapter, then recite the Ayat afterwards. We can pray Salat ul-Ghufaylah was sitting also, but if doing it in the sitting position two Raka'at sitting equals one standing. There is no Qa'dha for Salat ul-Ghufayla. So if we missed it, we can plan to do it the next day, inshaAllah. Dear Brothers and Sisters, I strongly recommend you start praying Salat ul-Ghufaylah, If you haven't already done so, it will change your life inshaAllah. We are all desperate for the Mercy and reward from Allah Subhana wa Ta'ala, and the more righteous and recommended deeds we can do, the more we advance and progress towards success, happiness, and the pleasure of the Almighty Subhanah wa Ta'ala.
