segments.arabic: وَ ﻳَﻄْﻠُﺐُ رُوْﺣَﻪُ ﺑِﺎﻟْﺒَﻴَﺎتِ وَ ﻓِﻲ آﻧَﺎءِ السَّاعَاتِ
segments.translation: and seeks his soul in the state of sleep and in the middle of the hours

segments.arabic: اَﺳْﺄَﻟُﻚَ الرَّوحَ وَ الرَّاحةَ ﻋِﻨْﺪَ اﻟْﻤَﻮْتِ وَ اﻟْﻌَﻔْﻮَ عَنِّي ﺣِﻴْﻦَ اَﻟْﻘَﺎك
segments.transliteration: Ähin min ghamratin min lahabÄtin laáºÃ¡
segments.translation: I beseech You to give me ease and comfort at the time of death and forgiveness when I meet You

segments.arabic: اِلٰہِیْ کَمْ مِنْ مُوْبِقَۃٍ حَلُمْتَ عَنْ مُقَابِلَتِہَا بِنِقْمَتِکَ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« Ê¾asÊ¾aluka biá¸¥urmati man Ê¿Ädha bika minka
segments.translation: My God, how many destructive deeds have You forborne from meeting with Your vengeance,

segments.arabic: وَکَمْ مِنْ جَرِیْرَۃٍ تَکَرَّمْتَ عَنْ کَشْفِہَا بِکَرَمِکَ
segments.transliteration: wa lajaÊ¾a Ê¾ilÃ¡ Ê¿izzika wastaáºalla bifayÊ¾ika waÊ¾Ê¿taá¹£ama biá¸¥ablik
segments.translation: And how many offenses have You graciously overlooked by Your generosity!

segments.arabic: اِلٰہِیْ اِنْ طَالَ فِیْ عِصْیَانِکَ عُمْرِیْ، وَ عَظُمَ فیِ الصُّحُفِ ذَنْبِیْ
segments.transliteration: wa lam yathiq illÄ bika yÄ muá¹­liqa al-Ê¾usÄrÄ
segments.translation: My God, if my life is prolonged in disobedience to You, and my sin is great in the records,

segments.arabic: فَمَا اَنَا مُؤَمِّلٌ غَیْرَ غُفْرَانِکَ، وَ لَا اَنَا بِرَاجٍ غَیْرَ رِضْوَانِکَ
segments.transliteration: YÄ man sammÄ nafsahÅ« min jÅ«dihÄ« wahhÄban wa hÄ anÄ Ê¾adÊ¿Å«ka
segments.translation: Then I have no hope except in Your forgiveness, and I have no expectation except in Your pleasure.

segments.arabic: اِلٰہِیْ اُفَکِّرُ فِیْ عَفْوِکَ فَتَہُوْنُ عَلَیَّ خَطِیْئَتِیْ
segments.transliteration: raghaban wa rahban wa khawfan wa á¹­amaÊ¿an wa Ê¾injÄá¸¥an wa Ê¾ilhÄá¸¥an
segments.translation: My God, I think of Your pardon, and my sin becomes easy for me,

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ اَذْکُرُ الْعَظِیْمَ مِنْ اَخْذِکَ فَتَعْظُمُ عَلَیَّ بَلِیَّتِیْ
segments.transliteration: wa taá¸arruÊ¿an wa tamalluqan wa qÄÊ¾iman wa qÄÊ¿idan wa rÄkiÊ¿an
segments.translation: Then I remember the severity of Your seizure, and my affliction becomes great for me.

segments.arabic: اٰہٍ اِنْ اَنَا قَرَاْتُ فِیْ الصُّحُفِ سَیِّئَۃً اَنَا نَاسِیْہَا وَ اَنْتَ مُحْصِیْہَا
segments.transliteration: wa sÄjidan wa rÄkiban wa mÄshiyan wa dhÄhiban wa jÄÊ¾iyan
segments.translation: Ah, if I read in the records an evil deed that I have forgotten, and You have recorded,

segments.arabic: فَتَقُوْلُ: خُذُوْہُ، فَیَا لَہٗ مِنْ مَاْخُوْذٍ لَا تُنْجِیْہِ عَشِیْرَتُہٗ
segments.transliteration: wa fÄ« kulli á¸¥ÄlÄtÄ« Ê¾asÊ¾aluka Ê¾an tuá¹£alliya Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin
segments.translation: Then You say, "Seize him!" So woe to him who is seized, whom his clan will not save,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَنْفَعُہٗ قَبِيْلَتُہٗ یَرْحَمُہُ الْمَلَأُ اِذَا اُذِنَ فِیْہِ بِالنِّدَاءِ
segments.transliteration: wa Äli Muá¸¥ammadin (wa Ê¾an tafÊ¿al bÄ« kadhÄ wa kadhÄ wa tadhkuru á¸¥Äjataka)
segments.translation: And his tribe will not benefit him. The angels will have mercy on him when the call is authorized for him.

segments.arabic: اٰہٍ مِنْ نَارٍ تُنْضِجُ الْاَکْبَادَ وَ الْکُلٰی،
segments.translation: Ah, from a fire that ripens the livers and the kidneys,
Ah, from a fire that snatches away the extremities,

segments.arabic: اٰہٍ مِنْ غَمْرَۃٍ مِنْ لَہَبَاتٍ لَظٰی
segments.translation: Ah, from an immersion in the flames of Hellfire!
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّد
segments.transliteration: wa maa fihinna wa maa baynahunna
segments.translation: O Allah bless Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ اَلْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ
segments.translation: O Allah You are the Ever Living, the Eternal the Elevated, the Mighty
the Creator, the Sustainer the One who gives life and the One who causes to die
the Beginner, the Unique
For You is nobility and for You is generosity

segments.arabic: وَ لَكَ الْمَنُّ وَ لَكَ الاَمْرُ
segments.translation: and for You is grace and for You is the command
You are One there is no partner for You

segments.transliteration: rabbighfirli warhamni wa tub alayya ,innaka antat-tawwabur-rahim
segments.translation: O Creator, O Sustainer

segments.transliteration: haazaa maqaamul aâa-eze beka menan naar.
segments.translation: O the One who gives life and the One who causes to die

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma ihdinÄ« fÄ«man hadayt, wa âÄfinÄ« fÄ«man âÄfayt
segments.translation: O the Unique, the Sublime

segments.arabic: اَسْأَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: wa tawallanÄ« fÄ«man tawallayt, wa bÄrik lÄ« fÄ«mÄ aâá¹­ayt
segments.translation: I ask you to bless Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْ تَرْحَمَ ذُلِّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ  وَ تَضَرُّعِي اِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa qinÄ« sharra mÄ qaá¸ayt, innaka taqá¸Ä« wa lÄ yuqá¸Ä âalayk
segments.translation: and to have mercy on my lowliness before You and my beseeching You

segments.arabic: وَحْشَتِي مِنَ النَّاسِ وَ اُنْسِي بِك
segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Änaka rabba al-bayti, astaghfiruka wa atÅ«bu ilayk
segments.translation: and my loneliness from people and my intimacy with You

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُکَ بِحُرْمَۃِ مَنْ عَاذَ بِکَ مِنْکَ
segments.transliteration: wa Å«minu bika wa atawakkalu âalayk, wa lÄ á¸¥awla wa lÄ quwwata illÄ bik
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You by the sanctity of whoever seeks refuge in You from You,

segments.arabic: وَ لَجَأَ اِلٰی عِزِّکَ وَ اسْتَظَلَّ بِفَیْئِکَ وَ اعْتَصَمَ بِحَبْلِکَ
segments.translation: And seeks shelter in Your might, and shade in Your shadow, and holds fast to Your rope,

segments.arabic: وَ لَمْ یَثِقْ اِلاَّ بِکَ یَا مُطْلِقَ الْاُسَارٰی
segments.transliteration: ilahi kayfa asduru `an babika bikhaybatin minka
segments.translation: And trusts none but You, O Reliever of captives.

segments.arabic: یَامَنْ سَمّٰی نَفْسَہٗ مِنْ جُوْدِہٖ وَہَّابًا وَ ہَا اَنَا اَدْعُوْکَ
segments.translation: O You who named Yourself, out of Your generosity, "The Giver," and here I am calling upon You,

segments.arabic: رَغَبًا وَ رَہَبًا وَخَوْفًا وَ طَمَعًا وَ اِنْجَاحًا وَ اِلْحَاحًا
segments.translation: With desire and awe, and fear and hope, and earnestly and insistently,

segments.arabic: وَ تَضَرُّعًا وَ تَمَلُّقًا وَ قَائِمًا وَ قَاعِدًا وَّرَاکِعًا
segments.translation: And beseechingly and entreatingly, and standing and sitting and bowing

segments.arabic: وَ سَاجِدًا وَ رَاکِبًا وَمَا شِیًا وَ ذَاہِبًا وَ جَآئِیًا
segments.translation: And prostrating, and riding and walking and going and coming,

segments.arabic: وَ فِیْ کُلِّ حَالاَتِیْ اَسْئَلُکَ اَنْ تُصَلِّیَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: And in all my states, I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ (’’وَاَنْ تَفْعَلْ بِیْ کَذَا وَکَذَا وَ تَذْکُرُ حَاجَتَکَ‘‘)
segments.translation: And the family of Muhammad (and that You do for me such and such, and mention your need).
In the name of Allah the Beneficent the Merciful

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah bless Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: اِلهِي تَعَرَّضَ لَكَ فِي هذَا اللَّيْلِ الْمُتَعَرِّضُوْنَ
segments.translation: O Allah, on this night the seekers have sought You
and the aspirers have aspired for You

segments.arabic: وَ اَمَّلَ فَضْلَكَ وَ مَعْرُوْفَكَ الطَّالِبُوْنَ
segments.translation: and the searchers have hoped for Your blessings and grace

segments.arabic: وَ لَكَ فِي هذَا اللَّيْلِ نَفَحَاتٌ
segments.translation: For You have in this night, hidden bounties

segments.arabic: وَ جَوَائِزُ وَ عَطَايَا وَ مَوَاهِبُ
segments.translation: and rewards and presents and gifts

segments.arabic: تَمُنُّ بِهَا عَلى مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segments.translation: which You bestow upon whom you please from Your servants

segments.arabic: وَ تَمْنَعُهَا مَنْ لَمْ تَسْبِقُ لَهُ الْعِنَايَةُ مِنْكَ
segments.translation: and You deny them to one who has not reached Your regard

segments.arabic: وَ هَا اَنَا ذَا عُبَيْدُكَ الْفَقِيْرُ اِلَيْكَ
segments.translation: Here I am,Your abject servant in need of You
hopeful of Your blessings and grace

segments.arabic: فَاِنْ كُنْتَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ تَفَضَّلْتَ فِي هذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ
segments.translation: So, O my Master if You have bestowed blessings on this night
on anyone of Your creatures

segments.arabic: وَ عُدْتَ عَلَيْهِ بِعَائِدَةٍ مِنْ عَطْفِكَ
segments.translation: and turned to him with affection

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: then bless Muhammad and his family the pure, the purified,

segments.transliteration: salli allahumma `alaÂ muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: the virtuous onesthe excellent ones

segments.arabic: وَ جُدْ عَلَيَّ بِطَوْلِكَ وَ مَعْرُوْفِكَ
segments.translation: and favor me with Your grace and bounty

segments.arabic: يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ وَ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Lord of the worlds And send blessings on Muhammad

segments.arabic: خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ وَ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيْمًا
segments.translation: the seal of the Prophets and his family, the Purified and salute them witha perfect salutation
Surely Allah is praiseworthy, Glorious

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اِنِّي اَدْعُوْكَ كَمَا اَمَرْتَ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِي كَمَا وَعَدْتَ
segments.translation: O Allah I have supplicated to You'as You have commanded.then answer me as You have promised.
Surely You do not break Your promises.

segments.arabic: لآ اِلَهَ اِلاَّ اللّهُ الْحَلِيْمُ الْكَرِيْمُ
segments.transliteration: falaÂ taruddani mahruman wa laÂ kha'iban
segments.translation: There is none worth worshipping but Allah Who is Forbearing and Generous

segments.arabic: لآ اِلَهَ اِلاَّ اللّهُ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ
segments.translation: There is none worth worshipping but Allah Who is Most High and Great
Glory be to Allah, Who is the Sustainer of the seven heavens and of the seven earth
And Who is the Sustainer of all the things

segments.arabic: وَ مَا فِيْهِنَّ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ وَ
segments.translation: in them, and between them,
And Who is the Lord of the great âArsh (Divine Center of Authority & Power)
And all praise for Allah, the Sustainer of the worlds.

segments.arabic: وَمَا فَوْقَهُنَّ وَمَا تَحْتَهُنَّ وَ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ
segments.translation: and what is above them and what is under them Rabb of the Mighty throne

segments.arabic: اَلَّلهُمَّ اَنْتَ اللهُ نُوْرُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli âalaa muhammadin wa ali muhammad
segments.translation: O Allah , You are Allah,the Light of the heavens and the earth

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ زَيْنُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ
segments.transliteration: unaajika ya mawjoodan fi kulli makaan
segments.translation: You are Allah, the Ornament of the heavens and the earth

segments.arabic: وَ انت اللهُ جَمَالُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ
segments.transliteration: laâallaka tasmaâoo nidaaee faqad âadhuma  jurmi wa qalla hayaaee
segments.translation: You are Allah, the Beauty of the heavens and the earth

segments.arabic: وَاَنْتَ اللهُ عِمَادُ السَّمَاوَاتِ  وَ الْاَرْضِ
segments.transliteration: mawlaya ya mawlaya ayyal ahwali atadhakkar
segments.translation: You are Allah, the Pillar of the heavens and the earth

segments.arabic: اَنْتَ اللهُ قِوَامُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ
segments.transliteration: wa ayyahaa ansaa wa law lam yakun illal maawtu lakafaa
segments.translation: You are Allah, the Support of the heavens and the earth

segments.transliteration: kayfaa wa maa bâadal mawti aâadhamoo wa ad-haa
segments.translation: You are Allah, the Object of those who call out for help

segments.transliteration: mawlaya ya mawlaya hatta mata wa ilaa mata aqulu
segments.translation: You are Allah, the Helper of those who seek help

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ المُفَرَّجُ عَنِ الْمَكْرُوْبِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: lakal âutbaa marratan bâada ukhraa thumma laa tajidu âindee sidqan wa laa wafaa-an
segments.translation: You are Allah, the Reliever of those in distress

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ الْمُرَوِّحُ عَنِ الْمُغْمُومِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: fa yaa ghawthaa-hu thumma wa ghaw'thaahu bika
segments.translation: You are Allah , the one who gives happiness to the grieved

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ مُجِيْبُ دَعْوَةُ الْمُضْطَرِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: ya allahu min hawaa qad ghalabanee wa min âaduwwin qad-istaklaba âalayya
segments.translation: You are Allah, the one who answers the call of the distressed

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ اِلهُ العَالَمِيْنَ وَ اَنْتَ اللهُ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيْمْ
segments.transliteration: wa min dunyaa qad-tazayyanat lee wa min nafsin ammaaratin bis-suui illa ma rahima rabbee
segments.translation: You are Allah, God of the worlds You are Allah, the most merciful

segments.transliteration: mawlaya ya mawlaya in kunta rahimta mithlee farhamnee
segments.translation: O Allah, forgive (Name)â¦

segments.arabic: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّهَ رَبِّي وَ اَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ
segments.translation: I seek forgiveness of Allah my Lord and I turn to Him

segments.arabic: هذَا مَقَامُ الْعَآئِذِ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
segments.transliteration: ya qabilas-saharati iqbalnee ya man lam azal atâarrafu min hul husna
segments.translation: This is the position of one who seeks refuge in You from the fire [of Hell]

segments.transliteration: ya man yughadh-dhinee bin-nâeami sabaahan wa masaa-an  irhamnee yawma aateeka fardan shakhisan ilayka
segments.translation: (I ask for) forgiveness

segments.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَ ارْحَمْنِي وَ تُبْ عَلَيَّ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ
segments.transliteration: basari muqaliddan âamali qad ta barra-a jamee'ul khalqi minni
segments.translation: Lord, forgive me and have mercy on me, and turn to me, Surely You are the Oft-returning, the Merciful

segments.arabic: هٰذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ.
segments.transliteration: na'am wa abi wa ummi wa man kana lahoo kaddee wa saâayi
segments.translation: This is the position of the seeker of protection with You from the hell fire

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اهْدِنِيْ فِيْمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَ عَافِنِيْ فِيْمَنْ عَافَيْتَ
segments.transliteration: fa in -am tarhamni fa man yarhamuni
segments.translation: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, and grant me health among those You have granted health,

segments.arabic: وَ تَوَلَّنِيْ فِيْمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَ بَارِكْ لِيْ فِيْمَا اَعْطَيْتَ
segments.transliteration: wa man yunisu fil qabri wahshati wa man yuntiqoo lisanee idha khalawtu bi âamali
segments.translation: And take me as a protector among those You have taken as protectors, and bless me in what You have given,

segments.arabic: وَ قِنِيْ شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ اِنَّكَ تَقْضِيْ وَ لَا يُقْضٰى عَلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa saa-altanee âamma anta aâalamu bihi minni
segments.translation: And protect me from the evil of what You have decreed, for indeed You decree and none can decree over You.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ رَبَّ الْبَيْتِ اَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَ اَتُوْبُ اِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: fa-in qultu naâam fa aynal mahraboo min âadlik
segments.translation: Glory be to You, Lord of the House, I seek Your forgiveness and I repent to You,

segments.arabic: وَ اُوْمِنُ بِكَ وَ اَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْكَ وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa in qulta lam afâal qulta alam akunish-shahida âalayka
segments.translation: And I believe in You and I place my trust in You, and there is no might nor power except with You,

segments.transliteration: fa âawfuka âawfuka ya mawlaaya qabla saraabeelil qatiraan
segments.translation: O Most Merciful.

segments.arabic: رَبِّ اَسَاْتُ وَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَ بِئْسَ مَا صَنَعْتُ
segments.transliteration: fa âawfuka âawfuka ya mawlaaya qabla jahannama wan-neeraan
segments.translation: O Allah! I am a sinner, I have done oppression on my self, and whatever I have done is wrong,

segments.arabic: فَهَذِهِ يَدَایَ یَا رَبِِّ جَزَآءَ بِمَا کَسَبْتُ وَ هَاذِهِ
segments.transliteration: fa âawfuka âawfuka ya mawlaaya qabla an tughallal aydee ilal aâanaaq
segments.translation: now both these hands are presented for punishment,

segments.arabic: رَقَبَتِى خَاضِعَةً لِِّمَا اَتَيْتُ وَهَا اَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
segments.translation: and the neck is bowed down due to my sins and now I have presented myself in Your presence.

segments.arabic: فَخُذْ لِنَنفْسِی مِنْ نَفْسِى الرِِّضَا حَتَّى تَرْضَى لَكَ
segments.transliteration: fa á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ muá¸¥ammadin wa Äli muá¸¥ammad,
segments.translation: So take for me my satisfaction from myself until it is satisfied with you.

segments.transliteration: wajÊ¿al lÄ« fÄ« mÄ tashÄÊ¾u an tuÊ¿ajjila faraja Äli
segments.translation: so that You love my actions and then I never repeat such deeds again.

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي كَيْفَ اصْدُرُ عَنْ بَابِكَ بِخَيْبَةٍ مِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: muá¸¥ammadin á¹£allÃ¡ allÄhu Ê¿alayhi wa Älihi wa sallam,
segments.translation: O my God, how can it be that I return from Your door carrying disappointment of You

segments.transliteration: wa Ê¿ajjil farajÄ« wa faraja Ê¾ikhwÄnÄ« maqrÅ«nan bifarajihim,
segments.translation: after I have come to it putting my trust in You?

segments.transliteration: wa tafÊ¿ala bÄ« mÄ anta Ê¾ahluh.
segments.translation: O my God, how can it be that You make me despair of Your gifts

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« as'aluka wa lam yus'al mithluka, anta mawá¸i'u mas'alati al-ssÄ'ilÄ«n,
segments.translation: after You have ordered me to pray You?

segments.transliteration: wa muntahÄ raghbati al-rrÄghibÄ«n, ad'Å«ka wa lam yud'a mithluka
segments.translation: (Please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.transliteration: wa arghabu ilayka wa lam yurghab ilÄ mithlika, anta mujÄ«bu da'wati al-muá¸á¹­arrÄ«n
segments.translation: and have mercy upon me when moaning will intensify,
when action will be banned,

segments.transliteration: As'aluka bi-afá¸ali al-masÄ'ili wa anjaá¸¥ihÄ wa a'áºamihÄ, yÄ AllÄhu yÄ Raá¸¥mÄnu yÄ Raá¸¥Ä«m
segments.translation: when hope will be cut off,

segments.transliteration: wa bi-asmÄ'ika al-á¸¥usnÃ¡, wa amthÄlika al-'ulyÄ, wa ni'amika allatÄ« lÄ tuá¸¥á¹£Ä
segments.translation: when I will be led to death,

segments.transliteration: wa bi-akrami asmÄ'ika 'alayka, wa aá¸¥abbiha ilayka, wa aqrabiha minka wasÄ«latan
segments.translation: when eyes will weep for me,

segments.transliteration: wa ashrafiha 'indaka manzilaÙ, wa ajzaliha ladayka thawÄbaÙ, wa asra'iha fÄ« al-umÅ«ri Ê¾ijÄbatan
segments.translation: when my family members and dear ones will bid farewell to me,

segments.transliteration: wa bi-ismika al-maknÅ«ni al-akbari al-a'azzi al-ajalli al-a'áºami al-akrami
segments.translation: when dust will be poured upon me,

segments.transliteration: alladhÄ« tuá¸¥ibbuhu wa tahwÄhu, wa tará¸Ã¡ bihi 'amman da'Äka
segments.translation: when my name will be forgotten,

segments.transliteration: fasta jabta lahu du'Ä'ahu, wa á¸¥aqqun 'alayka an lÄ taá¸¥rima sÄ'ilaka wa lÄ taruddah.
segments.translation: when my body will be rotten,

segments.transliteration: Wa bi-kulli ismin huwa laka fÄ« al-TawrÄt wa al-InjÄ«l wa al-ZabÅ«r wa al-Qur'Än al-'aáºÄ«m
segments.translation: when my remembrance will be wiped out,

segments.transliteration: Wa bi-kulli ismin da'Äka bihi á¸¥amalatÙ 'arshika wa malÄ'ikatuka, wa anbiyÄ'uka wa rusuluka
segments.translation: when my grave will be deserted;

segments.transliteration: Wa ahlu á¹­Ä'atika min khalqika, an tuá¹£alliya 'alÃ¡ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: so, no one will ever visit me

segments.transliteration: Wa an tu'ajjila faraja waliyyika wabni waliyyika, wa tu'ajjila khizya a'dÄ'ih
segments.translation: and no one will ever remember me,
when the responsibilities of my sins will appear,
when my violations of the othersâ rights will overtake me,
when the complaints of my rivals will be admitted,
and when the prayer of the oppressed ones against me will be responded.

segments.arabic: صَلِّ ٱللَّهُمَّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
make my rivals be pleased with me
out of Your favoring and Your good turns,
and treat me magnanimously out of Your pardon and pleasure.
O Allah, the days of my pleasures have gone away
and nothing remained but my sins and the liabilities of my wrongdoings.
I have thus come to You repentant and penitent.
So, (please) do not reject me deprived and disappointed.
O Allah, (please) secure my fear,
forgive my slips,
and accept my repentance.
Verily, You are the Oft-Returning, the All-merciful.
In the name of Allah the Beneficent, the Merciful

segments.arabic: اَلَّلهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلىَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah bless Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: سَيِّدِي سَيِّدِي هذِهِ يَدَايَ قَدْ مَدَدْن.تُهُمَا اِلَيْكَ بِاذُنُوْبِ مَمْلُوْءَةً
segments.translation: My Master, My Master, I have stretched out these hands to You full of sins

segments.arabic: وَ عَيْنَايَ بِالرَّجَاءِ مَمْدُوْدَةً وَحَقٌّ يِمَنْ دَعَاكَ بِالْكَرَمِ تَفَضُّلاَ
segments.translation: and my eyes stretched out with hope and it is the right of the one who calls You with regret and humility that You answer him with Generosity and Grace

segments.arabic: سَيِّدِي آمِنْ اَهْلِ الشَّقَاءِ خَلُقْتَنِي قَاَطِيْلُ بُكَائِي
segments.translation: My master,have You created me from the unfortunate ones so I should lengthen my weeping?
or have You created me from the fortunate ones
so I should give glad tidings to my hopes?

segments.arabic: سَيِّدِي لَوْ اَنَّ عَبْدًا اِسْتَطَاعَ الْهَرَبَ مِنْ مَوْلاَهُ
segments.translation: My master, if a servant was able to escape from his Master

segments.arabic: لَكُنْتُ اَوَّلَ الْهَارِبِيْنَ مِنْكَ لكِنِّي اَعْلَمُ اَنِّي لاَ اَفُوْتُكَ
segments.translation: then I would be the first of those who escape from You but I know that I cannot escape You

segments.arabic: اِلَهِي وَ سَيِّدِي اِرْحَمْنِي مَصْرُوْعًا عَلى الْفِرَاشِ
segments.translation: My God and my master, have mercy on me when I am lying on my bed[dead]

segments.arabic: تُقَلِّبُنِي اَيْدِي اَحِبَّتِي وَارْحَمْنِي مَصطْرُوحًا عَلى الْمُغْتَسَلِ يُغَسِّلَنِي صَالِحُ جِيْرَتِي
segments.translation: Have mercy on me when the hands of my loved ones turn me when I am placed on the place of ghusl and the virtuous near ones wash me

segments.arabic: وَاَرْحَمْنِي مَحْمُولاَ قَدْ تَنَاوَلَ اَلاَقْرِبَاءُ اَطْرَافَ جَنَازَتِي
segments.translation: Have mercy on me when I am being carried, and my relatives have surrounded my coffin

segments.arabic: وَ ارْحَمْ فِي ذَلِكَ الْبَيْتِ الْمُظْلِمِ وَحْشَتِي وَ غُرْبَتِي وَ وَحْدَتِي
segments.translation: Have mercy on me in that dark house on my fear, my separation, and my loneliness have mercy on me
All Glorious, All Holy, Lord of the Angels and the Spirit.
All Glorious, All Holy, Lord of the Angels and the Spirit.
In the name of Allah, The Beneficent, the Merciful

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah bless Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: اُنَاجِیْکَ یَا مَوْجُوْدًا فِیْ کُلِّ مَکَانٍ
segments.translation: I whisper unto You O One Who is present in every place

segments.arabic: لَعَلَّکَ تَسْمَعُ نِدَآئِیْ فَقَدْ عَظُمَ جُرْمِیْ وَ قَلَّ حَیَآئِیْ
segments.translation: So that you may hear my call for surely my sin is excessive and my shame is less

segments.arabic: مَوْلَایَ یَا مَوْلَایَ اَیَّ الْاَھْوَالِ اَتَذَکَّرُ
segments.translation: My Master, O my Master which of the terrifying states shall I remember

segments.arabic: وَ اَیَّهَا اَنْسٰی وَ لَوْ لَمْ یَکُنْ اِلاَّ الْمَوْتُ لَکَفٰی
segments.translation: and which of them shall I forget for if there was nothing except death it would be enough

segments.arabic: کَیْفَ وَمَا بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ اَعْظَمُ وَ اَدْهَی
segments.translation: then what about after death greater and much worse?

segments.arabic: مَولاَیَ یَا مَوْلاَیَ حَتّٰی مَتٰی وَ اِلٰي مَتٰي اَقُوْلُ
segments.translation: My master O my Master up to when and till when will I say,

segments.arabic: لَکَ الْعُتْبٰی مَرَّةً بَعْدَ اُخْرٰی ثُمَّ لاَ تَجِدُ عِنْدِیْ صِدْقًا وَ لاَ وَفَآءً
segments.translation: I am to blame, again and again, but then You do not find any truth or loyalty in me?
I call for help and I call for help,

segments.arabic: یَا اَللّٰهُ مِنْ هَوًی قَدْ غَلَبَنِیْ وَ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ قَدِ اسْتَکْلَبَ عَلَیَّ
segments.translation: O Allah from desires which have overpowered me and from the enemy which has pounced on me

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ دُنْیَا قَدْ تَزَیَّنَتْ لِیْ وَ مِنْ نَفْسٍ اَمَّارَةٍ بِالسُّوٓءِ اِلاَّ مَا رَحِمَ رَبِّیْ
segments.translation: and from the world which attracts me and from the soul that leads towards evil except that on which my Lord has mercy (12:53)

segments.arabic: مَوْلاَیَ یَا مَوْلاَیَ اِنْ کُنْتَ رَحِمْتَ مِثْلِی فَارْحَمْنِیْ
segments.translation: My master O my master if You have had mercy on the likes of me then have mercy on me

segments.arabic: وَ اِنْ کُنْتَ قَبِلْتَ مِثْلِیْ فَاقْبَلْنِیْ
segments.translation: and if You have accepted from the likes of me then accept from me

segments.arabic: یَا قَبِلَ السَّحَرَةِ اِقْبَلْنِیْ یَا مَنْ لَمْ اَزَلْ اَتَعَرَّفُ مِنْهُ الْحُسْنٰی
segments.translation: O One Who accepts the early morning prayer accept me, O One who, I still know only good from Him

segments.arabic: یَا مَنْ یُغَذِّیْنِیْ بِالنِّعَمِ صَبَاحًا وَ مَسَآءً اِرْحَمْنِیْ یَوْمَ اٰتِیْکَ فَرْدًا شَاخِصًا اِلَیْکَ
segments.translation: O One who nourishes me with blessings morning and evening have mercy on me when I come to You alone,

segments.arabic: بَصَرِیْ مُقَلَّدًا عَمَلِیْ قَدْ تَبَرَّءَ جَمِیْعُ الْخَلْقِ مِنِّیْ
segments.translation: my glance fixed on You my actions carried on my neck When all of creation will withdraw away from me

segments.arabic: نَعَمْ وَ اَبِیْ وَ اُمِّیْ وَ مَنْ کَانَ لَهُ کَدِّیْ وَ سَعْیِیْ
segments.translation: yes, even my father and mother and those for whom I worked and struggled
then if You will not have mercy on me who will have mercy on me

segments.arabic: وَ مَنْ یُوْنِسُ فِیْ الْقَبْرِ وَحْشَتِیْ وَ مَنْ یُنْطِقُ لِسَانِیْ اِذَا خَلَوْتُ بِعَمَلِیْ
segments.translation: who will give me solace from the loneliness of the grave and who will make me speak when I am alone with my deeds

segments.arabic: وَ سَاءَلْتَنِیْ عَمَّا اَنْتَ اَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّیْ
segments.translation: and when You will ask me about what You know better than me?

segments.arabic: فَاِنْ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ فَاَیْنَ الْمَحْرَبُ مِنْ عَدْلِکَ
segments.translation: Then if I say yes (to my sins) where will be the escape from Your Justice?

segments.arabic: وَ اِنْ قُلْتُ لَمْ اَفْعَلْ قُلْتَ اَلَمْ اَکُنِ الشَّاهِدَ  عَلَیْکَ
segments.translation: And if I say I did not commit it You will say was I not a witness over you?

segments.arabic: فَعَفْوُکَ عَفْوُکَ یَا مَوْلاَیَ قَبْلَ سَرَابِیْلِ الْقَطِرَانِ
segments.translation: So (I beseech) Your Forgiveness Your Pardon O my master before the wearing of the clothes of Hell

segments.arabic: عَفْوُکَ عَفْوُکَ یَا مَوْلاَیَ قَبْلَ جَهَنَّمَ وَ النِّیْرَانِ
segments.translation: Your Forgiveness Your Pardon O my Master before the Hell and the Fire

segments.arabic: عَفْوُکَ عَفْوُکَ یَا مَوْلاَیَ قَبْلَ اَنْ تُغَلَّ الْاَیْدِیْ اِلٰی الْاَعْنَاقِ
segments.translation: Your Forgiveness Your Forgiveness O my Master before the hands are tied to the necks

segments.arabic: یَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِیْنَ وَ خَیْرَ الْغَافِرِیْنَ.
segments.translation: O the most Merciful and the best of Forgivers

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْعَظِيْمِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ وَاَسْألَهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him. I seek protection of Allah and I beseech Him to give me His bounties generously.
So send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: فَ صَلّ عَل یٰ مُحَمّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمّدٍ،
segments.translation: And grant me, in what You will, that You hasten the relief of the family

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ لِىْ فِيْ مَا تَشَاءُ اَنْ تُعَجّلَ فَرَجَ آلِ
segments.translation: Of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace,

segments.arabic: مُحَمّدٍ صَلّی الُ عَلَيْْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ سَلّمَ،
segments.translation: And hasten my relief and the relief of my brothers, joined with their relief,

segments.arabic: وَ عَجّلْ فَرَجِىْ وَ فَرَجَ اِخْوَ انِىْ مَقْرُوْناً بِفَرَجِهِمْ،
segments.translation: And do with me what You are worthy of.

segments.arabic: وَ تَفْعَلَ بِىْ مَا اَنْتَ اَهْلُهُ.
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You, and none like You has been asked. You are the place where those who ask direct their questions,

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنّي أَسْأَلُكَ وَلَمْ يُسْأَلْ مِثْلُكَ ، أَنْتَ مَوْضِعُ مَسْأَلَةِ السَّائِلينَ
segments.translation: And the ultimate desire of those who yearn. I call upon You, and none like You has been called upon.

segments.arabic: وَمُنْتَهى رَغْبَةِ الرَّاغِبينَ ، أَدْعُوكَ وَلَمْ يُدْعَ مِثْلُكَ
segments.translation: And I yearn to You, and none like You is yearned to. You are the responder to the prayer of those in distress,

segments.arabic: وَأَرْغَبُ إِلَيْكَ وَلَمْ يُرْغَبْ إِلى مِثْلِكَ ، أَنْتَ مُجيبُ دَعْوَةِ الْمُضْطَرّينَ
segments.translation: And the Most Merciful of the merciful.
I ask You by the best of requests, and the most successful, and the greatest, O Allah, O Most Gracious, O Most Merciful,

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَفْضَلِ الْمَسائِلِ وَأَنْجَحِها وَأَعْظَمِها ، يا اَللَّهُ يا رَحْمانُ يا رَحيمُ
segments.translation: And by Your most beautiful names, and Your highest attributes, and Your blessings that cannot be counted,

segments.arabic: وَبِأَسْمائِكَ الْحُسْنى ، وَأَمْثالِكَ الْعُلْيا ، وَنِعَمِكَ الَّتي لاتُحْصى
segments.translation: And by the most honorable of Your names to You, and the most beloved of them to You, and the closest of them to You as a means,

segments.arabic: وَبِأَكْرَمِ أَسْمائِكَ عَلَيْكَ ، وَأَحَبِّها إِلَيْكَ ، وَأَقْرَبِها مِنْكَ وَسيلَةً
segments.translation: And the most noble of them in status with You, and the most abundant of them in reward with You, and the swiftest of them in answering matters,

segments.arabic: وَأَشْرَفِها عِنْدَكَ مَنْزِلَةً ، وأَجْزَلِها لَدَيْكَ ثَواباً ، وَأَسْرَعِها فِي الْاُمُورِ إِجابَةً
segments.translation: And by Your hidden name, the Greatest, the Mightiest, the Most Sublime, the Most Magnificent, the Most Honorable,

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الْمَكْنُونِ الْأَكْبَرِ الْأَعَزِّ الْأَجَلِّ الْأَعْظَمِ الْأَكْرَمِ
segments.translation: Which You love and desire, and You are pleased with it from whoever calls upon You,

segments.arabic: اَلَّذي تُحِبُّهُ وَتَهْواهُ ، وَتَرْضى بِهِ عَمَّنْ دَعاكَ ،
segments.translation: So You answer his prayer, and it is incumbent upon You not to deprive Your asker and not to turn him away.

segments.arabic: فَاسْتَجَبْتَ لَهُ دُعاءَهُ ، وَحَقٌّ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ لاتَحْرِمَ سائِلَكَ وَلاتَرُدَّهُ .
segments.translation: And by every name that is Yours in the Torah and the Gospel and the Psalms and the Great Quran,

segments.arabic: وَبِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ فِي التَّوْراةِ وَالْإِنْجيلِ وَالزَّبُورِ وَالْقُرْآنِ الْعَظيمِ
segments.translation: And by every name that the bearers of Your Throne and Your angels called You by, and Your prophets and Your messengers,

segments.arabic: وَبِكُلِّ اسْمٍ دَعاكَ بِهِ حَمَلَةُ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلائِكَتُكَ ، وَأَنْبِياؤُكَ وَرُسُلُكَ
segments.translation: And those who obey You from Your creation, that You send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَأَهْلُ طاعَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: And that You hasten the relief of Your Wali and the son of Your Wali, and hasten the disgrace of his enemies.

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُعَجِّلَ فَرَجَ وَلِيِّكَ وَابْنِ وَلِيِّكَ ، وَتُعَجِّلَ خِزْيَ أَعْدائِهِ

text: Tahajjud Prayer - Salatul Layl Night Prayer To be offered after Midnight - Recommended Daily Importance Importance × AHADEETH ON SALATUL LAYL Hadith 1 Salatul Layl In the Words of Allah (swt) Imam as-Sadiq (AS) has said: "The reward of every good action that a person with true faith performs has been mentioned in the Quran, except for Salatul Layl, since due to the importance (and high status) of it, Allah (SWT) has not explicitly mentioned it and has only said the following (in regards to it): ((Those who forsake their beds to cry unto their Lord in fear and hope, and spend out of that which We have bestowed upon them.)) Surah as-Sajdah (32:16) Hadith 2 Purification of the Soul by Salatul Layl Allah (SWT) in explaining Salatul Layl and those who stay up during the night (doing Ibadaat) has said: ((Surely the rising by night is the firmest way to tread and the best corrective of speech. Surely you have in the day time a long occupation.)) Surah Muzzammil (73:6-7) Hadith 3 Salatul Layl and the Nafilah-e-Subh Allah (SWT) says: ((And in the night, give Him glory too, and at the setting of the stars.)) Surah Tur (52:49) Hadith 4 The Worship of the Sincere Ones Allah (SWT) says: ((And they who pass the night prostrating themselves before their Lord and standing.)) Surah Furqaan (25:64) Hadith 5 Explaining the Pious Ones (Muttaqeen) Allah (SWT) says: ((They used to sleep but little in the night. And in the morning they asked for forgiveness.)) Surah Zariyat (51:17-18) Hadith 6 Seeking Forgiveness at the Time of Sahr Allah (SWT) says: ((The patient, and the truthful, and the obedient, and those who spend (benevolently) and those who ask forgiveness in the morning times.)) Surah Ale Imran (3:17) Hadith 7 Salatul Layl Having Been Waajib (Obligatory) for the Prophet of Allah (SWT) Allah (SWT) says: ((And during a part of the night, pray Tahajjud beyond what is incumbent on you; maybe your Lord will raise you to a position of great glory.)) Surah Bani Israeel (17:79) Hadith 8 Wake up for Salatul Layl Allah (SWT) says: (O you who have wrapped up in your garments! Rise to pray in the night except a little.) Surah Muzzammil (73:1-2) Hadith 9 Wake up for Salatul Layl ((Rise to pray in the night except a little, Half of it, or lessen it a little, Or add to it, and recite the Quran as it ought to be recited.)) Surah Muzzammil (73:2-4) Hadith 10 Those Who Prostrate Allah (SWT) says: ((And rely on the Mighty, the Merciful. Who sees you when you stand up. And your turning over and over among those who prostrate themselves before Allah.)) Surah Shuara (26:217-219) Hadith 11 Describing Those Who Stay Up in the Night Allah (SWT) says: "(Can he who passes his night in sajdah (adoration), standing up or on his knees, who dreads the terrors of the life to come and hopes to earn the mercy of his Lord, (be compared to the unbeliever?" Surah Zumar (39:9) Hadith 12 Pleasure of Allah (SWT) Imam Ja'far as-Sadiq (AS) has said:"The pleasure of Allah (SWT) lies in Salatul-Layl." Hadith 13 Sign of True Faith in Allah (SWT) and Belief in the Day of Judgement Imam Muhammad al-Baqir(AS) has said: "One who has true faith in Allah (SWT) and the last day, will not allow the night to pass into the day without performing Salatul-Witr." Hadith 14 The Greatness of a Believer Imam Ja'far as-Sadiq (AS) has said: "The greatness of a believer is his Salat in the night and his dignity lies in not asking others for his needs." Hadith 15 Beauty of the Next Life Imam Ja'far as-Sadiq (AS) has said: "Allah (SWT) - the Noble and the Great has said that the wealth and children are a beautification of this world and surely the 8 Rakat (of Salatul Layl) that a servant performs at the end of the night is a beautification for the next life." MERITS By praying Salatul-Layl oneâs livelihood is increased, one passes easily through âSakaraatâ (great and grueling pain a dying person suffers at the time of death) and finds happiness in âBarzakhâ (the Spiritual world where the departed souls stay either in happiness or misery, until the Day of Resurrection). Imam Jaffar Sadiq (a.s.) quotes Imam Ali (as) as saying that the Prophet (saww) said that a person who prays Salatul-Layl gets the following twenty four kinds of benefits: Secures Allahâs pleasure. Makes friendship with Angels. Is the Sunnat of the Prophets (a.s.) Provides the means to pursue knowledge. Constitutes the root of our faith. Keeps one physically fit. Drives Shaytan away. Protects one from enemies. Serves as a means of acceptance of oneâs Duas and good deeds. Increases oneâs livelihood. Intercedes with the Angel of Death. Lights up the grave. Provides comfortable bedding in the grave. Helps answering with ease the questioning of Munkar and Nakir in the grave. Gives companionship in the grave. Provides shelter on the Day of Judgment. Crowns one on the Day of Reckoning. Clothes one on the Day of Resurrection. Provides one with light on the Day of Judgment. Forms a barrier against the fire of Hell. Gets Allahâs pardon on the Day of Judgment. Increases the weight of good deeds on the scale. Helps one crossing the Bridge of âSiraatâ without any difficulty. Forms the key to the Paradise. × . Arabic Transliteration Translation Method Before After each 2 rakat After 4th After 8 Raka'at After Shifa In Witr On Completion Resources Salatul-Layl consists up of 11 (eleven) Rakâats The first 8 (eight) Rakâats are prayed as normal (like morning prayer) in pairs of two Rakâats each with the niyyah of Nawafilatul-Layl. The next 2 (two) Rakâats are prayed (like morning prayer) with the Niyyah of 'Salatul Shifâa' The remaining 1 (one) Rakâat is prayed (as below) with the Niyyah of 'Salatul Witr.' as follows.. segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ‏ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاِقْبَالِ نَهَارِكَ وَ اِدْبَارِ لَيْلِكَ
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-aloka be-iqbaale nahaareka wa idbaare layleka
segments.translation: O Allah! I ask You on behalf of Your morning and Your night,

segments.arabic: وَ حُضُوْرِ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَ اَصْوَاتِ دُعَآئِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa hozoore salawaateka wa aswaate do-aâaa-eka
segments.translation: and the voice of Your callers

segments.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an tosalleya aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin
segments.translation: that You send Blessings upon Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْ تَتُوْبَ عَلَيَّ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ.
segments.transliteration: wa an tatooba aâlayya innaka antat tawwaabur raheem
segments.translation: and that You forgive me as You are the Forgiver, the Merciful.
I prostrate to you in humility & abjectness
O Allah, (please) make my heart dutiful,
my actions pleasing
my livelihood delightful,
my sustenance profuse,
my childrenÂ righteous
and make for me at the tomb of Your Messenger,
may Allah bless him and his Household,
an abode and a dwelling.
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
O Allah, to You have I turned my face,
Your pleasure have I sought,
for Your reward have I desired,
in You do I believe,
and on You do I rely.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `alaÂ muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
open the ears of my hearts to remembering You,

segments.transliteration: wa thabbitni `alaÂ dinika wa dini nabiyyika
segments.translation: make me stand firmly on the religion of You and Your Prophet,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُزِغْ قَلْبِي بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: wa laÂ tuzigh qalbi ba`da idh hadaytani
segments.translation: make not my hearts to deviate after You have guided me aright,

segments.transliteration: wa hab li min ladunka rahmatan
segments.translation: and grant me from You mercy.
Surely, You are the most liberal Giver.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ هٰذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّآمَّةِ وَ الصَّلَاةِ الْقَآئِمَةِ بَلِّغْ مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهِ الدَّرَجَةَ وَ الْوَسِيْلَةَ وَ الْفَضْلَ وَ الْفَضِيلَةَ
segments.transliteration: allaahumma rabba haazehid daâwatit taam-mate was salaatil qaaa-emate balligh mohammadan sallal laaho aâlayhe wa aalehid darajata wal waseelata wal fazla wal fazeelata
segments.translation: O Allah! Lord of this perfect supplication and established prayer, assign to Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his progeny, the rank, right of mediation, excellence, and advantage.

segments.arabic: بِاللهِ اَسْتَفْتِحُ وَ بِاللهِ اَسْتَنْجِحُ وَ بِـمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَتَوَجَّهُ.
segments.transliteration: bil-laahe astafteho wa bil-laahe astanjeho wa be-mohammadin rasoolil laahe wa aale mohammadin atawajjaho.
segments.translation: With Allah do I commence, from Allah do I seek success, and in the name of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his progeny, do I turn my face (towards Allah).

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اجْعَلْنِي بِهِمْ عِنْدَكَ وَجِيْهًا فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ وَ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ.‏
segments.transliteration: allaahumma salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin waj aâlnee behim iândaka wajeehan fid dunyaa wal aakherate wa menal moqarrabeen.
segments.translation: O Allah! Send blessings upon Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad, and, in their names, make me worthy of regard in this world and in the Hereafter, and of those drawn near to You.0
O Allah, I submit Muhammad,
may Allah bless him and his Household,
to You before mentioning my needs,
and I turn to You in his name;
so, (please) make me of high regard with You
in this world and the Hereafter,
and of those drawn near to You,
and (please) decide, in his name, my prayer to be admitted,
my sin to be forgiven,
and my supplication to be responded.
You are verily the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي تَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni atawajjahu ilayka bimuhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, I turn my face towards You in the name of Muhammad and Muhammadâs Household,
present them before You before I begin my prayers,
and seek nearness to You in their names.
So, in their names, (please) make me of high regard with You
in this world and the Hereafter
and of those drawn near to You.
You have endued me with the great favor of making me know them;
so, (please) seal my life with obedience to them,
recognition of them, and loyalty to them,
because this is the true happiness.
Therefore, (please) seal my life with these things,
for You have power over all things.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْنِي مَعَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`alni ma`a muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) make me with Muhammad and Muhammadâs Household
in every item of wellbeing and tribulation

segments.transliteration: waj`alni ma`a muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: and make me with Muhammad and Muhammadâs Household
in every place of returning and place of rest.
O Allah, (please) make me live their lives
and die their death,
include me with them in all situations,

segments.transliteration: wa laÂ tufarriq bayni wa baynahum
segments.translation: and do not depart me from them.
Verily, You have power over all things.
O Allah, (please) do not make me despair of Your soothing mercy,
do not make me lose hope of Your mercy,
and do not make me feel secure against Your plans,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَامَنُ مَكْرَ ٱللَّهِ إِلاَّ ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْخَاسِرُونَ
segments.transliteration: fa'innahu laÂ ya'manu makra allahi illaÂ alqawmu alkhasiruna
segments.translation: for none feels secure against Allahâs plans except the losing people.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَ بِاللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
segments.transliteration: bismi l-lahi wa  bi l-lahi, tawa kaltu Ê¿ala l-lahi, aÊ¿Å«dhu bi l-lahi s-samÄ«Ê¿i l-Ê¿alÄ«mi mina sh-shayá¹­ÄniÂ ÄlrrajÄ«mi
segments.translation: In the Name of God and by God, I put my trust in God, I seek refuge in God, the All-hearing, the All-knowing from Satan, the Stoned One. You will exorcize him and drive him away.
O Allah, You are verily the King and the Manifest Truth.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have wronged myself;
so, (please) forgive my sin.

segments.arabic: إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ إِلاََّ انْتَ
segments.transliteration: innahu laÂ yaghfiru aldhdhunuba illaÂ anta
segments.translation: Verily, none can forgive sins save You.
Here I am responding to You and here I am trying to please You.
All goodness is at Your Hand.
Evil is never ascribed to You.
A true guided is he whom You guide.
I, Your servant and the son of Your two servants,
am standing in submission before You,

segments.transliteration: minka wa bika wa laka wa ilayka
segments.translation: and I am from You, through You, to You, and for You.
There is neither haven nor shelter

segments.transliteration: wa laÂ mafarra minka illaÂ ilayka
segments.translation: nor escape from You except with You.
All glory be to You; I am seeking Your kindness.
Blessed You are and Exalted You are.
All glory be to You, O Lord of the Sacred House.

segments.arabic: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلارْضَ
segments.transliteration: wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhi fatara alssamawati wal-arda
segments.translation: I have turned myself to Him Who originated the heavens and the earth,
the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed,
[and I am] upright and Muslim
and I am not of the polytheists.
Surely, my prayer, my sacrifice,
my life, and my death
are (all) for Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
No associate has He;
and this am I commanded,
and I am of those who submit.

segments.arabic: «إِيمَانِي بِأُمَّةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَدِينِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَمَسَارِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، وَأُصَلِّي صَلَاتِي بِقَبُولِ قِيَادَةِ ذُرِّيَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَأَنَا أَعْبُدُ وَأَسْتَسْلِمُ لِلَّهِ دُونَ أَنْ أَنْسِبَ لَهُ شَرِيكاً»
segments.transliteration: ('iimani bi'umat 'iibrahim wadin muhamad wamasar ealii bn 'abi talib , wa'usaliy salaati biqabul qiadat dhariyat muhamad , wa'ana 'aebud wa'astaslim lilah dun 'an 'unsib lah shrykaan).

Such is Allah my Lord, or.
Such is Allah our Lord.
All glory be to my Lord, the All-great, and in praise of Him.
May Allah listen to him who praises Him.

segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allahu rabbi wa atubu ilayhi
segments.translation: I implore Allah, my Lord, for forgiveness and I repent to Him.

segments.transliteration: bihawli allah wa quwwatihi aqumu wa aq`udu
segments.translation: With the might of Allah and with His power, I stand up and sit down.
Such is Allah, my Lord.

segments.translation: O Allah! Forgive me.
O the Best of those who are Asked, and O the Best Giver! Grant me sustenance and grant my family sustenance with Your grace, for indeed, You are the Possessor of Great Grace;

segments.arabic: یَا خَیْـرَ الْمَسْـــــــئُولِینَ وَ یَا خـَـــیْـرَ الْمُعْطِینَ، اُرْزُقْنِي وَ ارْزُقْ عِیَاِلي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، فَإِنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِیمِ

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah (I begin) and in Allah (I trust).
All praise be to Allah.
The most excellent names be to Allah.
I bear witness that there is no god save Allah.

segments.arabic: اشْهَدُ انْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ اللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: O Allah, to You alone have I genuflected,
to You alone have I submitted,
in You have I believed,
and in You have I put my trust.
And You are my Lord.
Revering to You are my hearing, my sight,
my hair, my skin,
my flesh, my blood,
my brain, my nerve, my bones,
and whatever is borne by my two feet.
I am neither disdaining, nor arrogant, nor regretful.

segments.arabic: غَيْرَ مُسْتَنْكِفٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَكْبِرٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَحْسِرٍ
segments.transliteration: ghayra mustankifin wa la mustakbirin wa la mustahsir
segments.translation: O Allah, to You (alone) do I prostrate,
in You do I have faith,
to You do I submit,
in You do I put trust,
and You are my Lord.
My face is prostrating the One Who has created it
and split its hearing and sight.
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
Blessed be Allah, the most excellent of all creators.
O Allah, (please) forgive us, have mercy upon us,
endue us with wellbeing, and pardon us
in this world and in the Hereafter.
Verily, You have power over all things.
O Allah, if there is any one who begins his day by putting his trust and his hope in any one other than

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ كَانَ اصْبَحَ وَلَهُ ثِقَةٌ اوْ رَجَاءٌ غَيْرُكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma man kana asbaha wa lahu thiqatun aw raja'un ghayruka
segments.translation: then You (alone) is my trust and my hope.
O most magnanimous of all those who may be besought!
O most merciful of all those whose mercy may be prayed!
(Please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
have mercy upon my weakness, neediness,
and lack of solution,
bestow upon me with Paradise out of Your favoring,
set my neck free from Hellfire,
and endue me with wellbeing in my self
and in all of my affairs,
in the name of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy
There is none worth worshipping but Allah Who is Forbearing and Generous

segments.arabic: لآ اِلَهَ اِلاَّ اللّهُ الْحَلِيْمُ الْكَرِيْمُ
segments.translation: There is none worth worshipping but Allah Who is Most High and

segments.arabic: لآ اِلَهَ اِلاَّ اللّهُ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, Who is the Sustainer of the seven heavens and of the seven earth
And Who is the Sustainer of all the things
in them, and between them,

segments.transliteration: wa maa fihinna wa maa baynahunna
segments.translation: And Who is the Lord of the great âArsh
And all praise for Allah, the Sustainer of the worlds.
