Imam al-Sadiq (as) is reported to have said : Imam `Ali (as) used to say:" Whoever says these words,Before commencing a ritual prayer will be added to the group of Muhammad and his Household:" Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙ Ø¥ÙÙÙÙÙ ØªÙÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙÙ Ø¥ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙÙ ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙÙØ¯Ù ÙÙØ¢ÙÙ Ù ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙÙØ¯Ù allahumma inni atawajjahu ilayka bimuhammadin wa ali muhammadin O Allah, I turn my face towards You in the name of Muhammad and Muhammadâs Household, ÙÙØ§ÙÙØ¯ÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙ Ù Ø¨ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ¯ÙÙÙ ØµÙÙÙÙÙØ§ØªÙÙ wa uqaddimuhum bayna yaday salawati present them before You before I begin my prayers, ÙÙØªÙÙÙØ±ÙÙØ¨Ù Ø¨ÙÙÙÙ Ù Ø¥ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ wa ataqarrabu bihim ilayka and seek nearness to You in their names. ÙÙÙ±Ø¬ÙØ¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙØ§Ù faj`alni bihim wajihan So, in their names, (please) make me of high regard with You ÙÙÙ Ù±ÙØ¯ÙÙÙÙÙÙØ§ ÙÙÙ±ÙØ¢Ø®ÙØ±ÙØ©Ù fi alddunyaÂ wal-akhirati in this world and the Hereafter ÙÙÙ ÙÙÙ Ù±ÙÙÙ ÙÙÙØ±ÙÙØ¨ÙÙÙÙ wa min almuqarrabina and of those drawn near to You. Ù ÙÙÙÙÙØªÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙÙ ÙØ¹ÙØ±ÙÙÙØªÙÙÙÙ Ù mananta `alayya bima`rifatihim You have endued me with the great favor of making me know them; ÙÙÙ±Ø®ÙØªÙÙ ÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙØ·ÙØ§Ø¹ÙØªÙÙÙÙ Ù fakhtim li bita`atihim so, (please) seal my life with obedience to them, ÙÙÙ ÙØ¹ÙØ±ÙÙÙØªÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙÙÙÙØ§ÙÙÙØªÙÙÙÙ Ù wa ma`rifatihim wa wilayatihim recognition of them, and loyalty to them, ÙÙØ¥ÙÙÙÙÙÙØ§ Ù±ÙØ³ÙÙØ¹ÙØ§Ø¯ÙØ©Ù fa'innahaÂ alssa`adatu because this is the true happiness. ÙÙÙ±Ø®ÙØªÙÙ Ù ÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙÙÙØ§ wakhtim li biha Therefore, (please) seal my life with these things, ÙÙØ¥ÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙ° ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø´ÙÙÙØ¡Ù ÙÙØ¯ÙÙØ±Ù fa'innaka `ala kulli shay'in qadirun for You have power over all things. 8.Dua " Allahumma ij`alni" Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙ Ù±Ø¬ÙØ¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙØ¹Ù Ù ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙÙØ¯Ù ÙÙØ¢ÙÙ Ù ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙÙØ¯Ù allahumma ij`alni ma`a muhammadin wa ali muhammadin O Allah, (please) make me with Muhammad and Muhammadâs Household ÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙØ§ÙÙÙÙØ©Ù ÙÙØ¨ÙÙØ§ÙØ¡Ù fi kulli `afiyatin wa bala'in in every item of wellbeing and tribulation ÙÙÙ±Ø¬ÙØ¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙØ¹Ù Ù ÙØ­

title: Duas to be recited during Wudhu(Ablution)
text: Duas to be recited during Wudhu(Ablution) Toggle navigation Home Desktop Page PDF Performing Wudhu Duas while doing Wudhu Duas to be recited during/After Wudhu(Ablution) Recite Sura Qadr continiously while doing Wudhu - Best Zikr Upon looking at the water, it is recommended to say the following: Ø¨ÙØ³ÙÙ Ù Ø§ÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙ ÙÙØ¨ÙØ§ÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙ Ø§ÙÙÙØ­ÙÙ ÙØ¯Ù ÙÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙ Ø§ÙÙÙØ°ÙÙÙ Ø¬ÙØ¹ÙÙÙ Ø§ÙÙÙ ÙØ§Û¤Ø¡Ù Ø·ÙÙÙÙÙØ±ÙØ§ ÙÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙØ¬ÙØ¹ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ¬ÙØ³ÙØ§Û Bismillahi wa billahi wal hamdu lil lahil lazi ja'alal ma'a tahura wa lam yaj alhu najisa. I begin my ablution in the Name of Allah. All praise is due to Allah, Who made water purifying, and not najis. While washing the hands before performing Wudhu, one should say: Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙÙ ÙÙ Ø§Ø¬ÙØ¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙÙ Ø§ÙØªÙÙÙÙÙØ§Ø¨ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ§Ø¬ÙØ¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙÙ Ø§ÙÙÙ ÙØªÙØ·ÙÙÙÙØ±ÙÙÙÙÙÛ Alla hummaj alni minat tawwabina waj alni minal mutatah hirin. O Lord! Make me of those who repent and purify themselves. While rinsing the mouth one should say: Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙÙ ÙÙ ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø­ÙØ¬ÙÙØªÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙÙ Ù Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙØ§ÙÙ ÙÙØ§ÙØ·ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ³ÙØ§ÙÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙØ°ÙÙÙØ±ÙØ§ÙÙÛ Alla Humma laq qini hujjati yawma alqaka wa atliq lisani bizikrika. O Lord! Dictate to me the principles of faith on the Day I meet You, and make my tongue fluent with Your remembrance. While washing the nose one should say: Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙÙ ÙÙ ÙÙØ§ ØªÙØ­ÙØ±ÙÙÙ Ù Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø±ÙÙÙØ­Ù Ø§ÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙÙØ©Ù ÙÙØ§Ø¬ÙØ¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙ ÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ´ÙÙ ÙÙ Ø±ÙÙÙØ­ÙÙÙØ§ ÙÙØ±ÙÙÙØ­ÙÙÙØ§ ÙÙØ·ÙÙÙØ¨ÙÙÙØ§Û Alla humma la tuharrim 'alaya rihal jannati waj 'alni mim man yashummu riha ha wa rawha ha wa tiba ha. O Lord! Do not deprive me of the fragrance of Paradise, and make me of those who smell its fragrance and per fume. While washing the face, one should say: Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙÙ ÙÙ Ø¨ÙÙÙÙØ¶Ù ÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙÙ Ù ØªÙØ³ÙÙÙØ¯ÙÙ Ø§ÙÙÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙØ§ ØªÙØ³ÙÙÙÙØ¯Ù ÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙÙ Ù ØªÙØ¨ÙÙÙØ¶ÙÙ Ø§ÙÙÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙÙÙÛ Alla humma bayyiz wajhi yawma taswaddufihil wujuh wala tusawwid waj hi yawma tabyazzul wujuh. O Lord! Make my face bright on the Day when the faces will turn dark. Do not darken my face on the Day when the face s are bright. While pouring water over the right elbow, one should say: Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙÙ ÙÙ Ø§ÙØ¹ÙØ·ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØªÙØ§Ø¨ÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ§ÙÙØ®ÙÙÙØ¯Ù ÙÙÙ Ø§ÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙØ§ÙÙ Ø¨ÙÙÙØ³ÙØ§Ø±ÙÙÙ ÙÙØ­ÙØ§Ø³ÙØ¨ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø­ÙØ³ÙØ§Ø¨ÙØ§ ÙÙØ³ÙÙÙØ±ÙØ§Û Alla humma a'tini kitabi bi yamini wal khulda fil jinani bi yasari wa hasibni hisaban yasira. O Lord! Give my book of deeds in my right hand, and a permanent stay in Paradise on my left, and make my reckoning an easy one. While pouring water over the left elbow, one should say: Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙÙ ÙÙ ÙÙØ§ ØªÙØ¹ÙØ·ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØªÙØ§Ø¨ÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙØ´ÙÙ ÙØ§ÙÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙØ§ Ù ÙÙÙ ÙÙØ±ÙØ§Û¤Ø¡Ù Ø¸ÙÙÙØ±ÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙØ§ ØªÙØ¬ÙØ¹ÙÙÙÙÙØ§ Ù ÙØºÙÙÙÙÙÙÙØ©Ù Ø§ÙÙÙ°Ù Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ§ÙØ¹ÙÙÙØ°Ù Ø¨ÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙÙØ·ÙÙØ¹ÙØ§ØªÙ Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙÙØ±ÙØ§ÙÙÛ Alla humma la tutini kitabi bishimali wala min wara'i zahri wala taj alha maghlu latan ila unuqi wa a'uzu bika min muqat ta'atin niran. O Lord! Do not give my book of deeds in my left hand, n or from behind my back, nor chain it to my neck. I seek refuge in You from the Hell-fire. While performing the wiping of the head, one should say: Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙÙ ÙÙ ØºÙØ´ÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø±ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙØªÙÙÙ ÙÙØ¨ÙØ±ÙÙÙØ§ØªÙÙÙÛ Alla humma ghashshini bi rahmatika wa barakatika wa 'afwika. O Lord! Cover me with Your Mercy, Blessings and Forgiveness. While performing the wiping of the feet, one should say: Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙÙ ÙÙ Ø«ÙØ¨ÙÙØªÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙ Ø§ÙØµÙÙØ±ÙØ§Ø·Ù ÙÙÙÙÙ Ù ØªÙØ²ÙÙÙÙ Ø§ÙÙØ§ÙÙÙØ¯ÙØ§Ù Ù ÙÙØ§Ø¬ÙØ¹ÙÙÙ Ø³ÙØ¹ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙØ§ ÙÙØ±ÙØ¶ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ§ Ø°ÙØ§Ø§ÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙØ§ÙÙ ÙÙØ§ÙÙØ§ÙÙÙØ±ÙØ§Ù ÙÛ Alla humma thabbitni alas sirati yawma tazillu fihil aqdam. Waj'al sa'yi fi ma yurzika 'anni ya zal jalali wal ikram. O Lord! Keep me firm on the Bridge (to Paradise) on the Day when the feet will slip, and help me in my efforts to do things which will please You, O' Glorious and Mighty!. Upon completion say the following: Ø§ÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙÙ ÙÙ Ø§ÙÙÙÙ Ø§ÙØ³ÙØ¦ÙÙÙÙÙ ØªÙÙ ÙØ§Ù Ù Ø§ÙÙÙÙØ¶ÙÙÙØ¡Ù ÙÙØªÙÙ ÙØ§Ù Ù Ø§ÙØµÙÙÙÙØ§Ø©Ù ÙÙØªÙÙ ÙØ§Ù Ù Ø±ÙØ¶ÙÙÙØ§ÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ§ÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙÙØ©ÙÛ -ÙØªÙ Ø§Ù Ù ØºÙØ±ØªÙ- Ø§ÙÙÙØ­ÙÙ ÙØ¯Ù ÙÙÙÙÙ°ÙÙ Ø±ÙØ¨ÙÙ Ø§ÙÙØ¹ÙØ§ÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙÙÛ- Ø³ÙØ¨Ø­Ø§ÙÙ Ø§ÙÙÙÙ ÙÙ ÙØ¨Ø­Ù Ø¯Ù Ø Ø£Ø´ÙØ¯Ù Ø£ÙÙ ÙØ§ Ø¥ÙÙÙ Ø¥ÙØ§ Ø£ÙØª Ø Ø£Ø³ØªØºÙØ±ÙÙÙ ÙØ£ØªÙØ¨Ù Ø¥ÙÙÙ Ø ÙØ£Ø´ÙØ¯Ù Ø£ÙÙÙ Ù Ø­Ù Ø¯ÙØ§ Ø¹Ø¨Ø¯ÙÙÙ ÙØ±Ø³ÙÙÙÙ Ø ÙØ£Ø´ÙØ¯Ù Ø£ÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙØ§ ÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙØ®ÙÙÙØªÙÙ Ø¨Ø¹Ø¯ ÙØ¨ÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙÙ Ø®ÙÙÙ Ø ÙØ£ÙÙÙ Ø£ÙÙÙØ§Ø¡ÙÙÙ Ø£ÙÙÙØ§Ø¤Ù Ø ÙØ®ÙÙÙØ§Ø¡ÙÙÙ Ø®ÙÙÙØ§Ø¤Ù Ø ÙØ£ÙØµÙØ§Ø¡ÙÙÙ Ø£ÙØµÙØ§Ø¤Ù Recite Surah al-Qadr (No. 97) three times and apply fragrance to your clothes and body.

title: Bedtime and Waking up Duas

segments.arabic: Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ØµÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙ° ÙÙØ­ÙÙÙÙØ¯Ù ÙÙØ¢ÙÙ ÙÙØ­ÙÙÙÙØ¯ÙÂ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma Salle Ala Muhammadin Wa Aale Muhammad"
segments.translation: O Allah send blessings on Muhammad & his family

segments.transliteration: Allahuma maghfir le momineen wal moninaat "
segments.translation: O Allah Please forgive all the believing men & women

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ وَ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَ اللهُ اَكْبَر
segments.transliteration: "Subhaanallaahi waâl hamdu lillaahi wa laa ilaaha illallaahu wallaahu Akbar ".
segments.translation: Glory be to God, and praise be to God; there is no god but Allah, and Allah is Greater Â

segments.arabic: يفْعَلُ اللهُ مَا يَشَاءُ بِقُدْرَتِهِ وَيَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ بِعِزَّتِهِ
segments.transliteration: "Yafalollaho Mashao be qudrati wa yahkomo ma yurido be izzate"
segments.translation: He does what HE wills and rule what HE wills by HIS power

segments.transliteration: Bismeka Allhumma Ahyaa wa bismeka amooto
segments.translation: With Your name do I live and with Your name I die
All praise be to Allah Who has exalted, thus dominated.
All praise be to Allah Who has been immanent, thus known all things.
All praise be to Allah Who has owned all things, thus had power over them all.
All praise be to Allah Who gives life to the dead,
causes the living to die,
and He has power over all things.
In the Name of Allah.I believe in Allah
and disavow the false deity.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱحْفَظْنِي فِي مَنَامِي وَفِي يَقَظَتِي
segments.transliteration: allahumma ihfazni fi manami wa fi yaqazati
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) safeguard me in my sleep and in my waking.

segments.arabic: أَللّٰهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ.
segments.transliteration: Bismil Laahe, Wazaâto Janbee Lillaahe Aâlaa Millate Ibraaheema Wa Deene Mohammadin Sallal Laaho Aâlayhe Wa Aalehi, Wa Welaayate Manif Tarazal Laaho Taa-Aâtahu. Maa Shaa-Al Laaho Kaana Wa Maa Lan Yashaa Lam Yakun.
segments.translation: O  "Allah" ! Keep me safe from Your Wrath on the day when You resurrect Your servants.[i]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ أَمُوتُ وَ أَحْـيَا وَ إِلـى اللّٰهِ الْمَصِيرُ. أَللّٰهُمَّ آمِنْ رَوْعَتِي وَ اسْـتُرْ عَوْرَتِي وَ أَدِّ عَنِّي أَمَانَتِي.
segments.transliteration: Laa Elaaha Illaa Howal Hayyul Qayyoomo, Subhaanal Laahe Rabbin Nabiyyeena Wal Mursaleena, Subhaanal Laahe Rabbis Samaawaate Wa Maa Feehinna Wa Rabbil Aârshil Aâzeeme, Wa Salaamun Aâlal Mursaleena, Wal Hamdo Lillaahe Rabbil Aâalameena.
segments.translation: In the name of  "Allah"  do I die and live and to Allah is the return. O Allah! Dispel my fears and hide my faults and (help me to) return what has been entrusted to me.[ii]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِیْ لِلهِ عَلٰی مِلَّۃِ اِبْرَاہِیْمَ وَ دِیْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْہِ وَ اٰلِہٖ، وَ وِلَایَۃِ مَنِ افْتَرَضَ اللهُ طَاعَتَہٗ. مَا شَاءَ اللهُ کَانَ وَ مَا لَمْ یَشَأْ لَمْ یَکُنْ.
segments.transliteration: alhamdo lillaahil kaafee, subhaanal laahil a-aâlaa, hasbeyal laaho wa kafaa, maa shaa allaho qazaa, same-aâl laaho leman da-aâa, laysa menal laahe malja-un, wa laa waraa allahe multaja-un.
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah. I put my side for Allah, following the faith of Ibrahim, the religion of Muhammad, blessings of Allah be upon him and his Household, and showing loyalty to those the obedience to whom has been made incumbent upon us by Allah. Only what Allah wills shall come to pass, but what Allah does not will shall never come to pass.

segments.arabic: لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ الْحَیُّ الْقَیُّوْمُ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ رَبِّ النَّبِیِّیٖنَ وَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِیْہِنَّ وَ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیْمِ، وَ سَلَامٌ عَلَی الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ، وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِیْنَ.
segments.transliteration: tawakkalto aâlal laahe rabbee wa rabbekum, maa min daabbatin illaa howa aakhezun be-naaseyatehaa, inna rabbee aâlaa seraatim mustaqeem.
segments.translation: There is no god but He, the living, the self Existing. Glory be to Allah Lord of the Prophets and Messengers. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the Heavens and everything in it and he is the Lord of the Great Throne and peace be upon the Messenger, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الْكَافِيْ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْاَعْلٰى، حَسْبِىَ اللهُ وَ كَفٰى، مَا شَاءَ اللهُ قَضٰى، سَمِعَ اللهُ لِمَنْ دَعَا، لَيْسَ مِنَ اللهِ مَلْجَاٌ، وَ لَا وَرَاءَ اللهِ مُلْتَجَاٌ.
segments.transliteration: al-hamdolil laahil lazee lam yattakhiz waladanw wa lam yakul lahu shareekun fil mulke wa lam yakul lahu waliyyum menaz zulle wa kabbirho takbeeraa.
segments.translation: All praise is for that God, Who is sufficient and Who is pure and untainted is the God, Who is lofty and great. Allah is sufficient for me and He does whatever He likes. He harkens to the supplication of every supplicant. There is no refuge other than Allah, and there is no protection other than Him.

segments.arabic: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَي اللہِ رَبِّيْ وَرَبِّكُمْ۝۰ۭ مَا مِنْ دَاۗبَّۃٍ اِلَّا ہُوَ اٰخِذٌۢ بِنَاصِيَتِہَا۝۰ۭ اِنَّ رَبِّيْ عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ.
segments.transliteration: a-oâozo bemaa aâazat behi malaa-ekatul laahil moqarraboona, wa anbeyaa-ul laahil mursaloona, wa eâbaadul laahis saalehoona, min sharre roayaayal latee ra-ayto: an tazurranee fee deenee wa dunyaaya.
segments.translation: I rely upon Allah, Who is my Lord and your Lord and everything that moves on the surface of the earth is within His control. Indeed, the path of My Lord is the straight path.[1]

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلہِ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَّ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَّہٗ شَرِيْكٌ فِيْ الْمُلْكِ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَّہٗ وَلِيٌّ مِّنَ الذُّلِّ وَكَبِّرْہُ تَكْبِيْرًا.
segments.translation: All praise is for that God, who did not deem anyone as His son nor is there any partner in His kingdom or a support in His weakness. And it is incumbent on everyone to confess to His greatness.[2]

segments.arabic: اَعُوْذُ بِمَا عَاذَتْ بِهٖ مَلَائِكَةُ اللهِ الْمُقَرَّبُوْنَ، وَ اَنْبِيَاءُ اللهِ الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ، وَ عِبَادُهُ اللهِ الصَّالِحُونَ، مِنْ شَرِّ رُؤْيَايَ الَّتِيْ رَاَيْتُ: اَنْ تَضُرَّنِيْ فِيْ دِيْنِيْ وَ دُنْيَايَ.‏
segments.translation: I seek refuge of the one, whose refuge is sought by the proximate angels, prophets, messengers, and the righteous from the mischief of the dreams that I see: that prove harmful in the world and the hereafter.
I pray the protection of Allahâs almightiness,
I pray for the protection of Allahâs omnipotence,
I pray for the protection of Allahâs majesty,
I pray the protection of Allahâs authority,
I pray for the protection of Allahâs beauty,
I pray the protection of Allahâs defense,
I pray for the protection of Allahâs guard,
I pray for the protection of Allahâs wholeness,
I pray for the protection of Allahâs control,
I pray for the protection of Allahâs face,

segments.transliteration: min sharri ma khalaqa wa bara'a wa dhara'a
segments.translation: and I pray for the protection of Allahâs Messenger,

segments.transliteration: yaa mushbe-aâl botoonil jaa-e-aâte, wa yaa kaaseyal josoomil aâareyate wa yaa saakenal oârooqiz zaarebate, wa yaa monawwemal oâyoonis saaherate, sakkin oârooqeyaz zaarebate, waa zan le-aâynee nawman aâajelan.
segments.translation: may Allah bless him and his Household,

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَبَرَا وَذَرَا
segments.transliteration: Sub'haanallaahi Zish-Shaani Daa'imis-Sultwaani Kulla Yawmin Huwa Fish-Shaan.
segments.translation: against the evil of whatever He has created, originated, and made.

segments.arabic: يَا مُشْبِعَ الْبُطُوْنِ الْجَائِعَةِ، وَ يَا كَاسِيَ الْجُسُوْمِ الْعَارِيَةِ وَ يَا سَاكِنَ الْعُرُوْقِ الضَّارِبَةِ، وَ يَا مُنَوِّمَ الْعُيُوْنِ السَّاهِرَةِ، سَكِّنْ عُرُوْقِيَ الضَّارِبَةِ، وَ اْذَنْ لِعَيْنِيْ نَوْمًا عَاجِلًا.
segments.transliteration: ezaa amsaa amsaynaa wa amsal mulko lillaahil waahedil qahhaare wal hamdo lillaahe rabbil aâalameenal lazee azhaba bin-nahaare wa jaaa-a bil-layle wa nahno fee aâafeyatin minh. allaahumma haaza khal-qun jadeedun qad ghashshanaa, famaa aâmilto feehe min khayrin fa-sah-hil-ho wa qayyiz-ho wa kubbahu az-aâafan mozaa-aâfatan, wa maa aâmilto feehe min sharrin fa-tajaa-waz aânho be-rahmatek. amsayto laa amleko maa arjoo, wa laa ad-fa-oâ sharra maa akh-shaa, amsal amro le-ghayree, wa amsayto mur-tahanan be-kas-bee, wa amsayto laa faqeera af-qaro minne, fat-taseâ le-faqree min se-aâteka mimmaa katabta aâlaa nafsekat taqwaa maa ab-qaytanee, wal karaamata ezaa tawaffaytanee, was sabra aâlaa mab talaytane, wal barakata feemaa razaqtanee, wal aâzma aâlaa taa-aâteka feemaa baqeya min uâmree, wash shukra laka feemaa an-aâmta behi aâlayya.
segments.translation: O One, Who fills the empty stomachs and One, Who covers the naked bodies, O One, Who steadies the throbbing veins. O One, Who puts to sleep, the wakeful eyes. Make my throbbing veins steady and allow sleep for my eyes soon.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ ذِي الشَّأنِ، دَائِمِ السُّلْطَانِ ، كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي الشَّان
segments.transliteration: Bismillaahi Innee Aslamtu Nafsee Ilayka Wa Wajjahtu Wajhiya Ilayka Wa Fawwadhtu Amri Ilayka Wa Al'ja'atu Dhwahri Ilayka Wa Tawaqqaltu Ilayka Rahabatan Minka Wa Raghbatan Ilayka Laa Manjaa Walaa Malja'a Minka Illaa Ilayka Aamantu Bi Kitaabikal-ladhee Anzalta Wa Bi Rasoolikal-Ladhee Arsalat.
segments.translation: When evening comes, we spend the evening, and Kingdom became Allahâs; the One and All-Omnipotent, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds, Who has taken away the day and brought the night and we are in safety from it. O Allah! This is new creation which has certainly wraped us, then whatever good I have done in it make it easy and available, increase it many folds, and whatever evil I have done in it then overlook it with Your Mercy. I did evening while I do not own anything except what I hope, and I defend evil for which I fear, my affair is in the hands of other, and I did evening while I depend upon my earning, and I did evening in the condition that nobody is poorer than me, so remove my poorness with Your wealth for what You have written upon Yourself â piety â till the time I remain, and honour till I die, and patience till You test me, and blessing in what you bestow, and determination upon Your obedience till my remaining life, and thankfulness to You in what You have blessed me.[7]

segments.arabic: اِذَا اَمْسٰى اَمْسَيْنَا وَ اَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلهِ الْواحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ، وَ الْـحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعالَمِيْنَ الَّذِيْ اَذْهَبَ بِالنَّهَارِ وَ جَآءَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَ نَـحْنُ فِيْ عَافِيَةٍ مِنْهُ، اَللّٰهُمَّ هٰذَا خَلْقٌ جَدِيْدٌ قَدْ غَشَّانَا، فَمَا عَمِلْتُ فِيْهِ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَسَهِّلْهُ وَ قَيِّضْهُ وَ كُبَّهٗ اَضْعَافًا مُضَاعَفَةً، وَ مَا عَمِلْتُ فِيْهِ مِنْ شَرٍّ فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، اَمْسَيْتُ لَا اَمْلِكُ مَا اَرْجُوْ، وَ لَا اَدْفَعُ شَرَّ مَا اَخْشٰى، اَمْسَى الْاَمْرُ لِغَيْرِيْ، وَ اَمْسَيْتُ مُرْتَهِنًا بِكَسْبِيْ، وَ اَمْسَيْتُ لَا فَقِيْرَ اَفْقَرُ مِنِّيْ، فَاتَّسِعْ لِفَقْرِيْ مِنْ سِعَتِكَ مِمَّا كَتَبْتَ عَلٰى نَفْسِكَ التَّقْوٰي مَا اَبْقَيْتَنِيْ، وَ الْكَرَامَةَ اِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنِيْ، وَ الصَّبْرَ عَلٰى مَا ابْتَلَيْتَنِيْ، وَ الْبَرَكَةَ فِيْمَا رَزَقْتَنِيْ، وَ الْعَزْمَ عَلٰى طَاعَتِكَ فِيْمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمُرِيْ، وَ الشُّكْرَ لَكَ فِيْمَا اَنْعَمْتَ بِهٖ عَلَيَّ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma Aoodhu Bika Minal Ihtillaami Wa Min Soo'il Ihlaami Wa Min An Yatalaa Abaa Bi Yash-Shaytaanu Fil Yaqdhati Wal Manaam.
segments.translation: âO Lord, I have placed my soul in Your custody, keep it secure in a place that You like, and forgive, and if You return it to my body, return it with belief, and with knowledge of the rights of Your friends until it will die upon such belief.ââ

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللهِ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي عَلَى مِلَّةِ إِبْرَاهيمَ وَدِينِ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلّى اللهُ عليه وآله) وَوِلاَيَةِ مَنِ افْتَرَضَ اللهُ طَاعَتَهُ مَا شَاءَ اللهُ كَانَ وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ.
فظله
segments.translation: âI believe in Allah and reject the devil. O Lord, protect me in my sleep and when I am awake.ââ

segments.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّـهُ الَّذي خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ وَالأَرضَ في سِتَّةِ أَيّامٍ ثُمَّ استَوى عَلَى العَرشِ يُغشِي اللَّيلَ النَّهارَ يَطلُبُهُ حَثيثًا وَالشَّمسَ وَالقَمَرَ وَالنُّجومَ مُسَخَّراتٍ بِأَمرِهِ أَلا لَهُ الخَلقُ وَالأَمرُ تَبارَكَ اللَّـهُ رَبُّ العالَمينَ ﴿٥٤﴾ ادعوا رَبَّكُم تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفيَةً إِنَّهُ لا يُحِبُّ المُعتَدينَ ﴿٥٥﴾ وَلا تُفسِدوا فِي الأَرضِ بَعدَ إِصلاحِها وَادعوهُ خَوفًا وَطَمَعًا إِنَّ رَحمَتَ اللَّـهِ قَريبٌ مِنَ المُحسِنينَ ﴿٥٦﴾
segments.translation: â(I begin) in the name of Allah, I believe in Allah, and reject the devil. O Lord, protect me in my sleep and when I am awake.ââ

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اَللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَتَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَيْكَ رَهْبَةً مِنْكَ وَرَغْبَةً إِلَيْكَ لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَى مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَبِرَسُولِكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ.
segments.translation: âO Lord, I seek protection with You against wet dreams and bad dreams and from Satan playing with me during my sleep or when awake.ââ

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتُ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتُهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا
segments.translation: âNo one deserves to be worshipped except Allah, alone Who has no partner, to Him belongs the Kingdom, all praise belongs to Him, He gives life, causes death, causes death and gives life, in His hand is all good, for Him is the changing of the night and the day and He has power over all things, ten times.ââ

segments.arabic: اللهمَّ إِنِّي احْتَبَسْتُ نَفْسِي عِنْدَكَ فَاحْتَبِسْهَا فِي مَحَلِّ رِضْوَانِكَ وَمَغْفِرَتِكَ وَإِنْ رَدَدْتَهَا إِلَى بَدَنِي فَارْدُدْهَا مُؤْمِنَةً عَارِفَةً بِحَقِّ أَوْلِيَائِكَ حَتَّى تَتَوَفَّاهَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ.
segments.translation: â1 testify that no one deserves to be worshipped except Allah, that Muhammad (a.s) is the servant and messenger of Allah. I seek protection with the greatness of Allah. I seek protection with majesty of Allah, I seek protection with the power of Allah, I seek protection with the glory of Allah, I seek protection with the authority of Allah; He has power over all things. I seek protection with the immunity of Allah, I seek protection with the forgiveness of Allah, I seek protection with the mercy of Allah, against the evil of poisonous reptiles and insects, against the evil of small and large animals during the day or night, against the evil of sinful Jinn and human beings, against the evil of the sinful Arab and non-Arab people, against the evil of lightning and cold. O Lord, grant al-Salat (favors) upon Muhammad, Your servant and messenger.â

segments.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِالله وَكَفَرْتُ بِالطَّاغُوتِ اللهمَّ احْفَظْنِي فِي مَنَامِي وَفِي يَقَظَتِي.
segments.transliteration: Hasbeyar Rabbo Menal Eâbaade, Hasbeyal Lazee Howa Hasbee, Hasbee Muz Kunto Hasbee, Hasbeyal Laaho Wa Neâmal Wakeelo.
segments.translation: âIn the name of Allah, I have placed my right side (for Allah) according to the Millah (tradition and culture) of Ibrahim, submitted to the will of Allah and I am not of the pagans.ââ

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ الله آمَنْتُ بِالله وَكَفَرْتُ بِالطَّاغُوتِ اللهمَّ احْفَظْنِي فِي مَنَامِي وَفِي يَقَظَتِي.
segments.translation: âAllah is free of defects, the Lord of the prophets, the Holy Being of the Messengers and the Lord of the suppressed people (â Aâimmah from the family of the Holy Prophet) all praise belongs to Allah, Who gives life to the dead and He has power over all things,â

segments.arabic: اللهمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الإحْتِلامِ وَمِنْ سُوءِ الأحْلامِ وَأَنْ يَلْعَبَ بِيَ الشَّيْطَانُ فِي الْيَقَظَةِ وَالْمَنَامِ.
segments.translation: âO the Faultless, the Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit, Your mercy comes before Your anger and no one deserves to be worshipped except You alone. I have committed evil deeds and has wronged myself, please forgive me. No one can forgive sins except You.â

segments.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلا الله وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَيُمِيتُ وَيُحْيِي بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَلَهُ اخْتِلافُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.translation:
âO AllÄh, neither is the dark night hidden from You, nor the star-lit sky, nor the
expansive earth, nor the darkness that covers darkness, nor the deep dark
sea. You turn towards the one among Your creation who turns to you by
night, and You know the [secret] treacherous gazes and what is hidden in
the hearts. The stars are setting and the eyes are asleep, while You are the
Ever-Living, theAll-Sustaining, neither drowsiness nor sleep befalls You.
Glory be to my Lord, the Lord of the worlds, the Master of the Messengers,
and all praise belongs to AllÄh, Lord of the worlds.ââ

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلا الله وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً (صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وآلِه) عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَةِ الله وَأَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ الله وَأَعُوذُ بِقُدْرَةِ الله وَأَعُوذُ بِجَلالِ الله وَأَعُوذُ بِسُلْطَانِ الله إِنَّ الله عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَعُوذُ بِعَفْوِ الله وَأَعُوذُ بِغُفْرَانِ الله وَأَعُوذُ بِرَحْمَةِ الله مِنْ شَرِّ السَّامَّةِ وَالْهَامَّةِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ أَوْ كَبِيرَةٍ بِلَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فَسَقَةِ الْجِنِّ وَالإنْسِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فَسَقَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَالْعَجَمِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ الصَّوَاعِقِ وَالْبَرَدِ اللهمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
segments.translation: âO Lord, support me against the horror of the Day of Judgment, expand for me the congestion of the grave, grant me the best of what is before death and grant me what is best thereafter.ââ

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ الله وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِيَ الأيْمَنَ لله عَلَى مِلَّةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفاً لله مُسْلِماً وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ.
segments.transliteration: "Qul Innamaa Basharun Mislokum Yoohaa Elayya Annamaa Elaahokum Elaahin Waahid, Famankaana Yarjoo Liqaa'a Rabbihee Falya'amal Swaalihan Walaa Yushrik Bee Ibaadatee Rabbihee Ahadaa."
segments.translation: âO Lord, if You holdback my soul from returning to my body, have mercy on it and if You will allow it to return, please protect it. ââ

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ النَّبِيِّينَ وَإِلَهِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَرَبِّ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ لله الَّذِي يُحْيِي الْمَوْتَى وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيرٌ يَقُولُ الله عَزَّ وَجَلَّ صَدَقَ عَبْدِي وَشَكَرَ.
segments.translation: âO Lord, in Your name I live and in Your name I will die,â

segments.arabic: سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ سَبَقَتْ رَحْمَتُكَ غَضَبَكَ لا إِلَهَ إِلا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ عَمِلْتُ سُوءاً وَظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلا أَنْتَ
segments.translation: âAll praise belongs to Allah, Who has given me life after causing me to die and before Him is the resurrection.â

segments.arabic: اللهمَّ لا يُوَارِي مِنْكَ لَيْلٌ دَاجٍ وَلا سَمَاءٌ ذَاتُ أَبْرَاجٍ وَلا أَرْضٌ ذَاتُ مِهَادٍ وَلا ظُلُمَاتٌ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ وَلا بَحْرٌ لُجِّيٌّ تُدْلِجُ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ الْمُدْلِجِ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ تَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الأعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ غَارَتِ النُّجُومُ وَنَامَتِ الْعُيُونُ وَأَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لا تَأْخُذُكَ سِنَةٌ وَلا نَوْمٌ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّي رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ وَإِلَهِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ لله رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
segments.translation: â(In the name of Allah) O Lord, do not allow me to ignore Your anger, do not allow me to forget speaking of You, do not make me of the careless ones, so I will wake up at such and such hour,â

segments.arabic: اللهمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى هَوْلِ الْمُطَّلَعِ وَوَسِّعْ عَلَيَّ ضِيقَ الْمَضْجَعِ وَارْزُقْنِي خَيْرَ مَا قَبْلَ الْمَوْتِ وَارْزُقْنِي خَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ.
segments.translation: âO Lord, in Your name I live and in Your name I will die,â

segments.arabic: اللهمَّ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا.
segments.translation: âAll praise belongs to Allah, Who has given me life after causing me to die and before Him is the resurrection.â
All glory be to Allah the Lord of the prophets,

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لله الَّذِي أَحْيَانِي بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنِي وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
segments.translation: the God of the messengers,

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ الله اللهمَّ لا تُؤْمِنِّي مَكْرَكَ وَلا تُنْسِنِي ذِكْرَكَ وَلا تَجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ أَقُومُ سَاعَةَ كَذَا وَكَذَا إِلا وَكَّلَ الله عَزَّ وَجَلَّ بِهِ مَلَكاً يُنَبِّهُهُ تِلْكَ السَّاعَةَ.
segments.translation: and the Lord of the enfeebled ones.
All praise be to Allah Who gives life to the dead

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لله الَّذِي أَحْيَانِي بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنِي وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
segments.translation: and He has power over all things.
Sufficient unto me is the Lord against the servants. Sufficient unto me is He. He is sufficient since the time of my existence. God is Sufficient as the best Guardian.

âI arise a believer in AllÄh,upon the religion of Muá¸¥ammad and his sunnah, the religion of âAlÄ« and
his sunnah, and the religion of the Legatees (i.e. the infallible ImÄms) and
their sunnah. I believe in their secrets and open declarations, when they are
present or hidden; and I seek AllÄhâs refuge from that which the Messenger
of AllÄh (á¹£) sought refuge, as did âAlÄ« (âa.s.) and the Legatees; and I desire
from AllÄh that which they desired from Him, and there is no might or
power except by [the will of] AllÄh.ââ

âGlory be to AllÄh, the King, the Most Holy [thrice].â [Then he would
say:] âO AllÄh, I seek refuge with You from the waning of Your blessings,
change in the good health You have granted, the suddenness of Your
chastisement, from falling into wretchedness, and from the evil that has
previously befallen in the Book. O AllÄh, I beg You by the glory of Your
kingdom, the might of Your strength, the greatness of Your dominion and
Your power over Your creation.âââ
âI awake and my Lord be praised. I awake without ascribing anything as a partner to AllÄh, and I do not call upon any other god with Him, nor do I take any guardian besides Him.â

âI wake up taking
You as my witness that whatever I have awoken with of blessings and wellbeing
in my religion or of this world â it is all from You alone, without and
partner. So, all praise belongs to You for this, and plentiful gratitude.â

segments.arabic: حَسْبِیَ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْعِبَادِ، حَسْبِیَ الَّذِیْ ہُوَ حَسْبِیْ، حَسْبِیْ مُذْ کُنْتُ حَسْبِیْ، حَسْبِیَ اللهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَکِیْلُ.
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) do not make me feel secure against Your plans,

segments.arabic: اٰمَنْتُ بِاللهِ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ وَ كَفَرْتُ بِالْجِبْتِ وَ الطَّاغُوْتِ،وَ اٰمَنْتُ بِسِرِّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَانِيَتِهِمْ،وَ ظَاهِرِهِمْ وَ بَاطِنِهِمْ وَ اَوَّلِهِمْ وَ اٰخِرِهِمْ۔
segments.translation: do not make me forget remembrance of You,

segments.arabic:
إِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ أَصْبَحْتُ بِللَِّ مُؤْمِناً عَلَى دِينِ مَُمَّدٍ وَ سُنَّتِهِ وَ دِينِ عَلِيٍّ وَ سُنَّتِهِ وَ
ِينِ الَْوْصِيَاءِ وَ سُنَّتِهِمْ آمَنْتُ بِسِرِّهِمْ وَ عَلَنِيَتِهِمْ وَ شَاهِدِهِمْ وَ غَائِبِهِمْ وَ أَعُوذُ بِللَِّ مَِّا
اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَِّ  وَ عَلِيٌّ  وَ الَْوْصِيَاءُ وَ أَرْغَبُاللَِّ فِيمَا رَغِبُوا إِلَيْهِ
وَ لَ حَوْلَ وَ لَ قُوَّةَ إِلَّ بِللَِّ.
segments.translation: and do not include me with the inattentive ones.

segments.arabic:
سُبْحَانَ اللَِّ
الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ ثَلَثاً اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَ مِنْ تَْوِيلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَ مِنْ
فَجْأَةِ نَقِمَتِكَ وَ مِنْ دَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا سَبَقَ فِ الْكِتَابِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّ أَسْأَلُكَ بِعِزَّةِ
مُلْكِكَ وَ شِدَّةِ قُوَّتِكَ وَ بِعَظِيمِ سُلْطَانِكَ وَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: I may wake up atâ¦ (The time at which one intends to wake up may be mentioned now.)

segments.arabic:
أَصْبَحْتُ وَ رَبِّ مَْمُودٌ أَصْبَحْتُ لَ أُشْرِكُ بِللَِّ شَيْئاً وَ لَ أَدْعُو مَعَهُ
إِلَاً وَ لَ أَتَِّذُ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَلِيّاً
segments.translation: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord -  let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."

segments.arabic:
إِذَا أَصْبَحَ قَالَ أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ مَا أَصْبَحَتْ بِ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ
أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ فِ دِينٍ أَوْ دُنْيَا فَإِنَّهَا مِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الَْمْدُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَ لَكَ
الشُّكْرُ كَثِير
segments.translation: O Allah, help me stand the horror of the after-death scene,
expand for me the narrow abode,
provide me with the welfare of what is before death,
and provide me with the welfare of what is after death.

segments.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلۡيَعۡمَلۡ عَمَلًا صَٰلِحًا وَلَا يُشۡرِكۡ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا

الدُّعَاءِ عِنْدَ النَّوْمِ وَ الِنْتِبَاهِ
-13313/ عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ الُْسَيُْ بْنُ مَُمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحَْدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ جَِيعاً عَنْ
بَكْرِ بْنِ مَُمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِ عَبْدِ اللَِّ 
4 قَالَ: مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يَْخُذُ مَضْجَعَهُ ثَلَثَ مَرَّاتٍ 
الَْمْدُ لَِِّ الَّذِي عَلَ فَقَهَرَ وَ الَْمْدُ لَِِّ الَّذِي
بَطَنَ فَخَبَرَ وَ الَْمْدُ لَِِّ الَّذِي مَلَكَ فَقَدَرَ وَ الَْمْدُ لَِِّ الَّذِي يُْيِي الْمَوْتَى وَ يُِيتُ الَْحْيَاءَ
وَ هُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ ءٍ قَدِيرٌ
 خَرَجَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ كَهَيْئَةِ يَوْمَ وَلَدَتْهُ أُمُّهُ.
-23314/ مَُمَّدُ بْنُ يَْيَ عَنْ أَحَْدَ بْنِ مَُمَّدٍ رَفَعَهُ إِلَ أَبِ عَبْدِ اللَِّ 4 قَالَ:
إِذَا أَوَى أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَ فِرَاشِهِ فَلْيَقُلِ
 اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّ احْتَبَسْتُ نَفْسِي عِنْدَكَ فَاحْتَبِسْهَا فِ مََلِّ
رِضْوَانِكَ وَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ إِنْ رَدَدْتَهَا إِلَ بَدَنِ فَارْدُدْهَا مُؤْمِنَةً عَارِفَةً بَِقِّ أَوْلِيَائِكَ حَتَّ تَتَوَفَّاهَا
عَلَى ذَلِكَ.
-33315/ حَُيْدُ بْنُ زِيَدٍ عَنِ الُْسَيِْ بْنِ مَُمَّدٍ عَنْ غَيِْ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ أَبَنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ
يَْيَ بْنِ أَبِ الْعَلَءِ عَنْ أَبِ عَبْدِ اللَِّ 4 أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ مَنَامِهِ
 آمَنْتُ بِللَِّ وَ كَفَرْتُ بِلطَّاغُوتِ اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِ فِ مَنَامِي وَ فِ يَقَظَتِ.

بِوَجْهِ اللَِّ وَ أَعُوذُ بِرَسُولِ اللَِّ 3 مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَ بَرَأَ وَ ذَرَأَ وَ تَعَوَّذْ بِهِ كُلَّمَا شِئْتَ.

-73319 عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحَْدَ بْنِ مَُمَّدٍ عَنِ الُْسَيِْ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ /
بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ أَنَّ شِهَابَ بْنَ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ سَأَلَهُ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ أَبَ عَبْدِ اللَِّ 4 وَ قَالَ قُلْ
لَهُ إِنَّ امْرَأَةً تُفْزِعُنِ فِ الْمَنَامِ بِللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ قُلْ لَهُ اجْعَلْ مِسْبَاحاً وَ كَبِِّ اللََّ أَرْبَعاً وَ ثَلَثِينَ
تَكْبِيرةًَ وَ سَبِّحِ اللََّ ثَلَثاً وَ ثَلَثِينَ تَسْبِيحَةً وَ احَْدِ اللََّ ثَلَثاً وَ ثَلَثِينَ وَ قُلْ لَ إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَُّ
وَحْدَهُ لَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَ لَهُ الَْمْدُ يُْيِي وَ يُِيتُ وَ يُِيتُ وَ يُْيِي بِيَدِهِ الَْيْرُ وَ لَهُ
اخْتِلَفُ اللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ وَ هُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ ءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ.
-83320/ مَُمَّدُ بْنُ يَْيَ عَنْ أَحَْدَ بْنِ مَُمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الَْكَمِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ
عَنْ أَبِ عَبْدِ اللَِّ 4 أَنَّهُ أَتَهُ ابْنٌ لَهُ لَيْلَةً فَقَالَ لَهُ يَ أَبَهْ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَنَمَ فَقَالَ يَ بُنََّ قُلْ

أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَ إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَُّ وَ أَنَّ مَُمَّداً 3 عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ أَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَةِ اللَِّ وَ أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ
اللَِّ وَ أَعُوذُ بِقُدْرَةِ اللَِّ وَ أَعُوذُ بَِلَلِ اللَِّ وَ أَعُوذُ بِسُلْطَانِ اللَِّ إِنَّ اللََّ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ ءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَ
أَعُوذُ بِعَفْوِ اللَِّ وَ أَعُوذُ بِغُفْرَانِ اللَِّ وَ أَعُوذُ بِرَحَْةِ اللَِّ مِنْ شَرِّ السَّامَّةِ وَ الَْامَّةِ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ
دَابَّةٍ صَغِيرةٍَ أَوْ كَبِيرةٍَ بِلَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ فَسَقَةِ الِْنِّ وَ الِْنْسِ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ فَسَقَةِ الْعَرَبِ
وَ الْعَجَمِ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ الصَّوَاعِقِ وَ الْبَرَدِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَُمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُولِكَ قَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ
فَيَقُولُ الصَّبُِّ الطَّيِّبِ عِنْدَ ذِكْرِ النَّبِِّ الْمُبَارَكِ قَالَ نَعَمْ يَ بُنََّ الطَّيِّبِ الْمُبَارَكِ.

-93321/ عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ مُفَضَّلِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ:
قَالَ لِ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَِّ 4: إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ لَ تَبِيتَ لَيْلَةً حَتَّ تَعَوَّذَ بَِحَدَ عَشَرَ حَرْفاً قُلْتُ
أَخْبِْنِ بَِا قَالَ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَِّ وَ أَعُوذُ بِقُدْرَةِ اللَِّ وَ أَعُوذُ بَِلَلِ اللَِّ وَ أَعُوذُ بِسُلْطَانِ اللَِّ وَ

بْنِ نَِيحٍ قَالَ:
كَانَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَِّ 4 يَقُولُ إِذَا أَوَيْتَ إِلَ فِرَاشِكَ فَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللَِّ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبَِ الَْيَْنَ
لَِِّ عَلَى مِلَّةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفاً لَِِّ مُسْلِماً وَ مَا أَنَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ.

-113323/ مَُمَّدُ بْنُ يَْيَ عَنْ أَحَْدَ بْنِ مَُمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حُسَيِْ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ
النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ جَرَّاحٍ الْمَدَائِنِِّ عَنْ أَبِ عَبْدِ اللَِّ 4 قَالَ:
إِذَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَلْيَقُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ النَّبِيِّينَ وَ إِلَهِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَ رَبِّ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ
وَ الَْمْدُ لَِِّ الَّذِي يُْيِي الْمَوْتَى وَ هُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ ءٍ قَدِيرٌ يَقُولُ اللَُّ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ صَدَقَ
عَبْدِي وَ شَكَرَ.

-123324/ عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حََّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِ
جَعْفَرٍ 4 قَالَ:
إِذَا قُمْتَ بِللَّيْلِ مِنْ مَنَامِكَ فَقُلِ الَْمْدُ لَِِّ الَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي لَِحَْدَهُ وَ أَعْبُدَهُ فَإِذَا سَِعْتَ
صَوْتَ الدِّيكِ فَقُلْ: سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلَئِكَةِ وَ الرُّوحِ سَبَقَتْ رَحَْتُكَ غَضَبَكَ لَ إِلَهَ إِلَّ
أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ عَمِلْتُ سُوءاً وَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِ فَإِنَّهُ لَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ فَإِذَا قُمْتَ
فَانْظُرْ فِ آفَاقِ السَّمَاءِ وَ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ لَ يُوَارِي مِنْكَ لَيْلٌ دَاجٍ وَ لَ سََاءٌ ذَاتُ أَبْرَاجٍ وَ لَ أَرْضٌ
ذَاتُ مِهَادٍ وَ لَ ظُلُمَاتٌ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ وَ لَ بَْرٌ لُِّيٌّ تُدْلِجُ بَيَْ يَدَيِ الْمُدْلِجِ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
تَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الَْعْيُِ وَ مَا تُْفِي الصُّدُورُ غَارَتِ النُّجُومُ وَ نَمَتِ الْعُيُونُ وَ أَنْتَ الَْيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَ
تَْخُذُكَ سِنَةٌ وَ لَ نَوْمٌ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ وَ إِلَهِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَ الَْمْدُ لَِِّ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
-133325/ أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الَْشْعَرِيُّ عَنْ مَُمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الَْبَّارِ وَ مَُمَّدُ بْنُ إِسَْاعِيلَ عَنِ
الْفَضْ ل بْنِ شَاذَانَ جَِيعاً عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَْيَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحَْنِ بْنِ الَْجَّاجِ قَالَ:
كَانَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَِّ 4 إِذَا قَامَ آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ يَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ حَتَّ يُسْمِعَ أَهْلَ الدَّارِ وَ يَقُولُ:
اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّ عَلَى هَوْلِ الْمُطَّلَعِ وَ وَسِّعْ عَلَيَّ ضِيقَ الْمَضْجَعِ وَ ارْزُقْنِ خَيْرَ مَا قَبْلَ الْمَوْتِ
وَ ارْزُقْنِ خَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ.

-143326/ عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِ عُمَيٍْ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ رَفَعَهُ قَالَ
تَقُولُ إِذَا أَرَدْتَ النَّوْمَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَْهَا وَ إِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا.
-153327/ مَُمَّدُ بْنُ يَْيَ عَنْ أَحَْدَ بْنِ مَُمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مَُمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ وَ الُْسَيِْ

سَِعْتُ أَبَ عَبْدِ اللَِّ 4 يَقُولُ: مَنْ قَرَأَ قُلْ هُوَ اللَُّ أَحَدٌ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حِينَ يَْخُذُ مَضْجَعَهُ غُفِرَ
لَهُ مَا عَمِلَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ خَْسِينَ عَاماً وَ قَالَ يَْيَ فَسَأَلْتُ سََاعَةَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِ أَبُو بَصِيرٍ
قَالَ سَِعْتُ أَبَ عَبْدِ اللَِّ 4 يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ وَ قَالَ يَ أَبَ مَُمَّدٍ أَمَا إِنَّكَ إِنْ جَرَّبْتَهُ وَجَدْتَهُ سَدِيداً.

163328/ عِدَّةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَدٍ وَ أَحَْدَ بْنِ مَُمَّدٍ جَِيعاً عَنْ جَعْفَرِ
بْنِ مَُمَّدٍ الَْشْعَرِيِّ عَنِ ابْنِ الْقَدَّاحِ عَنْ أَبِ عَبْدِ اللَِّ 4 قَالَ:
كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَِّ 3 إِذَا أَوَى إِلَ فِرَاشِهِ قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ بِسِْكَ أَحْيَا وَ بِسِْكَ أَمُوتُ فَإِذَا
قَامَ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ قَالَ الَْمْدُ لَِِّ الَّذِي أَحْيَانِ بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنِ وَ إِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ وَ قَالَ:
قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَِّ 4: مَنْ قَرَأَ عِنْدَ مَنَامِهِ آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ ثَلَثَ مَرَّاتٍ وَ الْيَةَ الَّتِ فِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ
شَهِدَ اللَُّ أَنَّهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّ هُوَ وَ الْمَلائِكَةُ وَ آيَةَ السُّخْرَةِ وَ آيَةَ السَّجْدَةِ وُكِّلَ بِهِ شَيْطَانَ ن يَْفَظَانِهِ مِنْ
مَرَدَةِ الشَّيَاطِينِ شَاءُوا أَوْ أَبَوْا وَ مَعَهُمَا مِنَ اللَِّ ثَلَثُونَ مَلَكاً يَْمَدُونَ اللََّ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ يُسَبِّحُونَهُ
وَ يُهَلِّلُونَهُ وَ يُكَبُِّونَهُ وَ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لَهُ إِلَ أَنْ يَنْتَبِهَ ذَلِكَ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ وَ ثَوَابُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ.

title: Mealtime Eating Drinking Duas

segments.arabic: بسم الله من أوليه إلى آخره
segments.translation: (In the Name of Allah from its beginning to its end).

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ . اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
اَللَّهُمَّ اِنِّي  اَسْئَلُكَ  فِي اَكْلِي وَ شُرْبِي السَّلاَمَةَ مِنْ وَعْكَهِ وَ الْقُوَّةَ بِهِ عَلى طَاعَتِكَ وَ ذِكْرِكَ وَ شُكْرِكَ ،
 فِيْمَا اَبْقَيْتَهُ فِي بَدَنِي وَ اَنْ تَشَجِّعْنِي بِقُوَّتِهَا عَلى عِبَادَتِكَ وَ اَنْ تُلْهِمَنِي حُسْنَ التَّحْرِرِ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ. 
 اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration:
bismillaahir rah'maanir rah'eem
li-eelaafi qurayshin
eelaafihim rih'latash shitaa-i was'-s'ayf
fal ya'-budoo rabba haad'al bayt
allad'ee at'-a'mahum min joo-i'w wa aamanahum min khawf
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family. O Allah, I ask You, in my eating and drinking, safety from illness, and to obey You and remember You and be thankful to You,  as long as it remains in my body, and through its strength encourage me towards Your worship and inspire me to refrain from Your disobedience. O Allah bless Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ أَللّٰهُمَّ مَا أَحْسَنَ مَا تَبْتَلِينَا، سُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَكْثَرَ مَا تُعْطِيناَ، سُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَكْثَرَ مَا تُعَافِينَا. أَللّٰهُمَّ أَوْسِعْ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلـى فُقَرَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ.
segments.transliteration: lahum rizquhum feehaa bukrataw wa a'shiyyaa
segments.translation: Glory be to You O  "Allah" ! How wonderful is that which You have tested us with. Glory be to You, how plentiful is that which You have given us. Glory be to You, how plentiful is that which You have bestowed on us. O Allah! Increase for us (our sustenance) and for the poor believing men and women and (for the poor) Muslim men and women.[i]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ. أَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا نِعْمَةً مَشْكُورَةً تَصِلُ بِهَا نِعْمَةَ الْجَنَّةِ.
segments.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi saqani maâan âadhban, walam yaj âalhu milhan ujajan bidhunubi
segments.translation: In the name of  "Allah" . O Allah! Make it an appreciated blessing by means of which the bounties of paradise are attained.[ii]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ، بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَعَلَيْكَ خَلْفَهُ.
segments.transliteration: Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim. Alhamdu lillahil ladhi saqani fa-arwani, wa-aâtani wa-ardani, wa-âafani wakafani. Allahummajâalni mim-man tasqihi fil maâadi min hawdi Muhammadin sallal-lahu âalayhi wa-alih. Watus âidhu bimurafaqatih, birahmatika ya arhamar rahimin. Allahumma salli âala Muhammadiwn wa-ali Muhammad
segments.translation: In the name of Allah  (O Allah!) bless for us from what you have given us of sustenance and upon You do we rely for its replenishment.[i]

segments.arabic: أَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَبْدِلْنَا بِهِ خَيْراً مِنْهُ.
segments.transliteration: alhamd lilh munzil alma' min alssama' wamusarrif al'amr kayf yasha' bism alllahÂ khayrÂ al'asma'i
segments.translation: O  "Allah" ! Bless it for us and replenish it with that which is better.

segments.arabic: أَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ.
segments.transliteration: Allahummajaâlhu Ilman Nafian Wa Rizqan Wasian Wa Shifa-am Min Kulli Daaiw wa Suqam.
segments.translation: O Allah   ! Bless it for us and increase it for us.[i]

segments.arabic: أَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَطْعَمْتَ وَأَسْقَيْتَ وَرَوَيْتَ. فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ غَيْرُ مَكْفُورٍ وَلاَ مُوَدَّعٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنـى عَـنْكَ.
segments.translation: O  "Allah" ! Praise be to You. You have nourished and quenched and satisfied (us), so to You be praise - praise without ingratitude and without leave and without (seeking) independence from You.[iii]

segments.arabic: أَللّٰهُمَّ كَمَا أَرَيْتَنَا أَوَّلَهَا فِي عَافِيةٍ فَأَرِنَا آخِرَهَا فِي عَافِيةٍ
segments.translation: O   "Allah" ! Just as You have shown us its beginning in well-being, show us its end in well-being.[i]

In the name of Allah, the beneficent, the merciful.
For the uniting of the Quraysh,
For the union during their winter and summer journeys,
Let them worship the Lord of this house,
Who fed them when they were hungry and gave them security against fear.
They shall have their sustenance therein, morning and evening.

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
 اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّد
اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِيْ اَطْعَمَنَا، وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَاَيَّدَنَا، وَآوانَا، وَاَنْعَمَ عَلَيْنَا، وَاَفْضَلَ. اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِيْ يُطْعِمُ وَلاَ يُطْعَمُ.
اَللهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدً وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
segments.translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful

O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family 
Praise be to Allah Who has: fed us, provided water for us, sufficed us, supported us, sheltered us, favored us, and bestowed benefits.

Praise be to Allah Who feeds but is not fed.

O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: أَللّٰهُمَّ أَكْثَرْتَ وَأَطَبْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ فَأَشْبَعْتَ وَأَرْوَيْتَ. أَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي يُطْعِمُ وَلاَ يُطْعَمُ.
segments.translation: O   "Allah" ! You have increased Your bounties and made them good and blessed, thereby making us satiated and quenched. All praise be to Allah, The One who nourishes and is not nourished.[i]

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي سَقَانِي مَاءً عَذْبًا وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ مِلْحًا أُجَاجًا بِذُنُونِي
segments.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, Who has served me with fresh water, and He did not make it salty and bitter on account of my sins

segments.arabic: االْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي سَقَانِي فَأَرْوَانِي، وَأَعْطَانِي وَأَرْضَانِي وَعَافَانِي وَكَفَانِي اللهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ تَسْقِيهِ فِي الْمَعَادِ مِنْ حَوْضِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَتُسْعِدْهُ بِمُرَافَقَتِهِ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ اللّهُمّ صَلّ عَلَى مُحَمّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمّدٍ
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. All praise belongs to Allah, Who has served me with water to quench my thirst, provided for me and pleased me, given me good health and sufficed me. O Allah, make me amongst those who will drink water in the Hereafter from the spring of Muhammad â may Allah bless him and his family. And make it a good fortune by being in his company. With Your mercy, O the Most merciful, of the merciful. O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ مُنْزِلِ الْمَاءِ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمُصَرِّفِ الْأَمْرِ کَیْفَ یَشَاءُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَیْرِ الْأَسْمَاءِ.
segments.translation: Praise be to God, who sends down water from the sky and decides the matter as He wills. In the name of God, the Best of Names.â

segments.arabic: اَللهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ عِلْماً نَافِعاً وَرِزْقاً وَاسِعاً وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ وَسُقْمٍ
segments.translation: O Allah! grant me useful knowledge, abundant sustenance and spare me all sickness and evil.

title: Recitation when leaving home Duas.org

segments.translation: Allah is the Most Great.
I leave (putting my trust) in Allah,
I return (putting my trust) in Allah,
and on Allah do I depend.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱفْتَحْ لِي فِي وَجْهِي هٰذَا بِخَيْرٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma iftah li fi wajhi hadha bikhayrin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) grant me easiness in the beginning of this affair of mine
seal it for me with easiness,

segments.arabic: وَقِنِي شَرَّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ انْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa qini sharra kulli dabbatin anta akhidun binasiyatiha
segments.translation: and guard me against the evil of every living creature that You hold by its forelock.
Surely, my Lord is on the right path.
In the Name of Allah (I begin) and in Allah (I trust).
I put my trust in Allah.
In the Name of Allah (I begin).
Sufficient to me is Allah.
I put my trust in Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اسْالُكَ خَيْرَ امُورِي كُلِّهَا
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka khayra umuri kulliha
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You for success in all of my affairs

segments.arabic: وَاعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ خِزْيِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ ٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min khizyi alddunya wa `adhabi al-akhirati
segments.translation: and I pray Your protection against disgrace in this world and chastisement in the Hereafter.
In the Name of Allah (I begin).
In Allah I put my trust.

segments.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power except with Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اسْالُكَ خَيْرَ مَا خَرَجْتُ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka khayra ma kharajtu lahu
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You for success in what I am leaving to do

segments.arabic: وَاعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَرَجْتُ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min sharri ma kharajtu lahu
segments.translation: and pray Your protection against failure in what I am leaving to do.
O Allah, (please) expand Your favors to me,
make perfect Your graces to me,
dedicate me to obedience to You,
make me desire for what You have in possession,

segments.transliteration: wa tawaffani `ala millatika wa millati rasulika
segments.translation: and cause me to die carrying the principles You have instructed and the principles of Your Messenger,

segments.arabic:
صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.transliteration: ah bless him and his Househo
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
I am leaving by the might and power of Allah,
but not by my own might or power;
rather, by the might and power of You, O Lord,

segments.arabic: بَلْ بِحَوْ لِكَ وَقُوَّتِكَ يَا رَبِّ
segments.transliteration: bal bihawlika wa quwwatika ya rabbi
segments.translation: seeking Your sustenance.
So, (please) provide me with it easily.
O Allah, (please) safeguard me and safeguard whatever is with me,
keep me safe and keep safe whatever is with me,

segments.transliteration: wa sallimni wa sallim ma ma`iya
segments.translation: and make me and whatever is with me reach my destination in a perfect way.

segments.arabic: وَبَلِّغْنِي وَبَلِّغْ مَا مَعِيَ بَلاَغاً حَسَناً
segments.transliteration: wa ballighni wa balligh ma ma`iya balaghan hasanan
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah (I begin),
in Allah do I believe,
and in Allah do I put my trust.
Only what Allah wills (shall come to pass).
There is neither might nor power except with Allah.

segments.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
segments.translation: Peace be on us from our Lord.
O Allah  ! Open for me the doors of Your Mercy.
O Allah  ! Open for me the doors of Your Sustenance.[i]
In the name of Allah  "Allah" . O Allah! Bless Muhammad   and the progeny of Muhammad, and forgive my sins and open for me the doors of Your Mercy.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ. أَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلـى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اغْفِرْلِي ذُنُوبِي وَ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah  . O Allah! Bless Muhammad   and the progeny of Muhammad, and forgive my sins and open for me the doors of Your Grace.[ii]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ. أَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلـى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اغْفِرْلِي ذُنُوبِي وَ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ فَضْلِكَ.

title: Travel Duas Etiquettes

segments.arabic: بسم الله آمنت بالله توكلت على الله ماشاءالله لاحول ولاقوة إلا بالله
segments.translation: In the name of Allah! I have placed faith in Allah and I have put full trust in Allah.  (It is) as Allah wills! There is no strength and no power save with Allah.

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ، وَتَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.  
اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي وَاحْفَظْ مَعِي، وَبَلِّغْنِي وَبَلِّغْ مَعِي بِبَلَاغِكَ الْحُسْنِ.  
بِاللَّهِ أَسْتَفْتِحُ وَبِاللَّهِ أَسْتَنْجِحُ وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَتَوَجَّهُ.  
اللَّهُمَّ سَهِّلْ لِي كُلَّ حُزُونَةٍ، وَذَلِّلْ لِي كُلَّ صُعُوبَةٍ، وَأَعْطِنِي مِنْ خَيْرِ كُلِّهِ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا أَرْجُو، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي مِنَ الشَّرِّ مِمَّا أُحَذِّرُ فِي عَافِيَةٍ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: Bismillahi,aamantu billahi, wa tawakkaltu allallahi, ma-sha-allah, la haula wala quawwata illa billah. Allahumma ahadhni wahfadh ma ma`ee wa ballighnee wa balligh ma ma ma`ee bi blalaghikalhusn, billahi astaftihu wa billahi astanjihu wa bi muhammadin sallallahu alaiyhi wa aalihi atawajjahu.  Allahukka sahhil lee kulla huzoonatin wa dhallil lee kulla huzoonatin wa dhallil lee kulla su`oobatin wa a`tinee mina khairi kullih akhtar mimma arju wasirf annee minash-sharri mimma uhad-diru fee aafi;yatin, ya arhamarrahimeen.
segments.translation: O Allah! Protect me and protect what is with me (my possessions), and deliver me (to my destination and delivery what is with me the best of your delivery.  By Allah I commence (my journey) and by Allah I seek to accomplish (the purpose of my journey) and by Muhammad (s.a.w.) I have set out (towards my destination). O Allah make me overcome all (my grief); and make easy for me all difficulties; and give me more of goodness than I hope for; and keep away all evil of which I am apprehensive for my health.  O the most Merciful.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ. الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ.
segments.transliteration: Bismillahi walaa Quwwata illa Billahi.  Alhamdu lillahil-ladhee sakh-khara lana haadha wama kaunna lahu muqrineen .
segments.translation: In the name of Allah and there is no power save with Allah.  Praise be to Allah who made this (the means of transport) subservient to us, and we (by ourselves) could never have accomplished it.

segments.arabic: رَبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
segments.transliteration: Rabbee anzilnee manzilan mubarakan wa anta khairul-munzileen.
segments.translation: O`My Lord! Cause me to disembark a blessed alighting and you are the Best of all who cause to alight.

segments.arabic: قُلْ لَّنْ يُّصِيْبَنَاۤ اِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللّٰهُ لَنَا ۚ هُوَ مَوْلٰٮنَا ‌ ۚ وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ‏
segments.transliteration: Qul lany-yuseebanaaa illaa maa katabal laahu lanaa Huwa mawlaanaa; wa 'alal laahi falyatawak kalimu 'minoon
segments.translation: Say, âNothing will befall us except what Allah has ordained for us. He is our master, and in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.â

segments.arabic:
ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي هَدَانَا لِلْإِسْلَامِ وَعَلَّمَنَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ وَمَنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ.  
سُبْحَانَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ.  
وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ.  
ٱللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ ٱلْحَامِلُ عَلَى ٱلظَّهْرِ وَٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى ٱلْأَمْرِ.  
وَأَنتَ ٱلصَّاحِبُ فِي ٱلسَّفَرِ وَٱلْخَلِيفَةُ فِي ٱلْأَهْلِ وَٱلْمَالِ وَٱلْوَلَدِ.  
ٱللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ عَضُدِي وَنَاصِرِي.
segments.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhee hadaana Lil-Islam wa allamanal Qu`ran wa manna alayna bi muhammadin sallallhu alayhi wa aalihi.  Subhanal-ladhee sakh-khara lana haadha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, Wa inna illa rabbina lamuqaliboon.  Walhamdu lillahi rabbil aalameen.  Allahumma antal haamilu aladhdhahr walmusta`anu alal-amr.  Wa antas-sahibu fis-sfar wal khaleefatu fil-ahli wal-maali wal-walad.  Allahumma anta adhdee wa naasiree.
segments.translation:
All praise is for Allah Who guided us in Islam and taught us the Quran and graced us with Muhammad (s.a.w.).  Glory be to Allah Who made this (the means of transport) subservient to us, and we (by ourselves) could never have accomplished it.  
And surely to our Lord we shall return.  All praise is for Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
  `O` Allah! You are the Facilitator of the journey and the helper in the affair and you are the Companion in the journey, and the Successor (incharge of my) family, property and son.  `O` Allah! You are my supporter and my Helper to Victory.

segments.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا.  
اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْنَا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهَا وَحَبِّبْ صَالِحِي أَهْلِهَا إِلَيْنَا.
segments.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka khairaha wa a`oodhu bika min sharriha.  Allahumma habbibna ilaa ahliha wa habbib saalihi ahliha ilayna.
segments.translation: O Allah! I beseech from you its (town, city or village) goodness and seek refuge in you from its wickedness.  O Allah! let its inhabitants love us and let us love its virtous inhabitants.

segments.arabic:
آئِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ عَابِدُونَ رَاكِعُونَ سَاجِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ.  
اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ حِفْظِكَ إِيَّايَ فِي سَفَرِي وَحَضَرِي.  
اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوْبَتِي هَذِهِ مُبَارَكَةً مَيْمُونَةً مَقْرُونَةً بِتَوْبَةٍ نَصُوحٍ تُوجِبُ لِي بِهَا السَّعَادَةَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
segments.transliteration: Aa-iboona taa-iboona insha Allah aabi doona raki`oona saajidoona lirabbina haamidoon.  Allahumma lakal hamdu ala hifdhika iyyaya fee safaree wa hadharee.  Allahummaj`al aubatee haadhihi mubarakatan maimoonatan maqroonatan be taubatin nasoohin toojablee bihas-sa`adah ya Arhamar-Rahimeen.
segments.translation: If Allah wills, we repent and seek pardon from Him; we worship Him and Him we bow and prostrate.  Our Lord we praise.  O` Allah! Make this return (journey) of mine a blessed one, a fruitful one, associated with a sincere repentance; one that will make prosperity incumbent for me.  O the Most Merciful.

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْمَلِكِ الْحَقِّ.  
وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ.  
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ.
segments.transliteration:
Bismillahil malikil Haq.  Wama qadarullahahaqqa qadarihi wal ardhu jamee`an qabdhatuhu yaumall qiyamati was-sawamatu matwiyyatun biyameenihi subhaanahu wata`ala amma yshrikoon.  Bismillahi majraha wa mursaha inna rabbee laghafoorun Raheemen.

In the name of Allah! The Master! The Truth! They esteemed not Allah with an esteem due to Him.  The whole earth is under His hold on the day of resurrection and the heavens folded at His command.Az-Zumar (39:67)  Glory be to him and the High above! He is beyond the attribution of any partner.  In the name of Allah be its course (sailing)  and its arrival (anchorage).  Verily my Lord is All Forgiving, All Merciful.(11:41)



 
 
   

	


    

			   		   
						

Munajat no. 3 for travel from 10 Munajats of Imam Taqi(as)

allahumma inni uridu safaran

segments.translation: O Allah, I intend to travel;

segments.transliteration: wa awdih li fihi sabila alrra'yi wa fahhimnihi
segments.translation: so, choose for me the best in my journey,
make clear before me and inspire to me the right understanding of the most accurate attitude,

segments.arabic: وَاوْضِحْ لِي فِيهِ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّايِ وَفَهِّمْنِيهِ
segments.translation: release my determination by means of straightforwardness,
include me with safety during my journey,
furnish me with abundant fortune and honor,
and preserve me with the excellent safeguard and watching.
O Allah, send away from me the inconvenience of journeys,
make easy for me the difficulty of roughness,

segments.transliteration: wa qarrib minni bu`da na'yi almanahili
segments.translation: unwrap before me the rug of covering the stations,

segments.transliteration: wa ba`id fi almasiri bayna khutaÂ alrrawahili
segments.translation: bring nearer to me the remote watering places,
and make spaces to be longer between the steps of our riding animals,

segments.arabic: وَبَاعِدْ فِي ٱلْمَسِيرِ بَيْنَ خُطَىٰ ٱلرَّوَاحِلِ
segments.translation: so that the remote distances will be nearby

segments.transliteration: wa laqqini allahumma fi safari nujha ta'iri alwaqiyati
segments.translation: and the rough roads will be smooth.
O Allah, make me find in this journey success over evil omens,

segments.arabic: وَلَقِّنِي ٱللَّهُمَّ فِي سَفَرِي نُجْحَ طَائِرِ ٱلْوَاقِيَةِ
segments.translation: endue me with achievement of wellbeing,
safeguard against failure,
guidance to survive dangers,
incentives to gain adequacy,
and good opportunity to be protected against authorities.
O Allah, cause my journey to be a reason for winning marvelous security
and obtaining profits.
Make night cover me against banes

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلِ ٱللَّيْلَ عَلَيَّ سِتْراً مِنَ ٱلآفَاتِ
segments.translation: and daytime defend me against perishing things.
Out of Your omnipotence, (please) hold back the robbers from reaching me
and, out of Your power, guard me against the beasts
so that safety will accompany me in my journey,
wellbeing will attend me,
good omen will be driven along with me,
easiness will embrace me,
difficulty will depart me,
triumph will agree with me,
and security will associate with me.
Verily, You are the Lord of bestowals, conferrals,
power, and might,
and You have power over all things
and You know and regard all of Your servants.

segments.transliteration: wa ahli wa mali wa wuldi
segments.translation: O Allah, I, on this day, beseech You to accept as trusts my self,
my family members, my property, my sons,
and every one who is under my custodyâ
the present and the absent.
O Allah, (please do) protect us with the protection of faith and surround us with Your care.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱحْفَظْنَا بِحِفْظِ ٱلإِيـمَانِ وَٱحْفَظْ عَلَيْنَا
segments.translation: O Allah, (please do) include us with Your mercy
and do not divest us of Your favors,

segments.transliteration: allahumma inna na`udhu bika min wa`tha'i alssafari
segments.translation: for we do desire for You.
O Allah, we do seek Your safeguard against troubles of traveling,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ ٱلسَّفَرِ
segments.transliteration: wa su'i almanzari fi al-ahli walmali walwaladi
segments.translation: disappointing objectives,
and bad result in my family members, property, and sons

segments.arabic: وَسُوءِ ٱلْمَنْظَرِ فِي ٱلاهْلِ وَٱلْمَالِ وَٱلْوَلَدِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni atawajjahu ilayka hadha alttawajjuha
segments.translation: in this world as well as the world to come.
O Allah, I am turning my face towards You in this way

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ هٰذَا ٱلتَّوَجُّهَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma faballighni ma u'ammiluhu wa arjuhu
segments.translation: seeking Your pleasure and seeking nearness to You.
O Allah, (please) help me achieve my aim and attain my hope
in You and in Your Saints.
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

segments.transliteration: wa `alayka khallaftu ahli wa mali wa ma khawwaltani
segments.translation: O Allah, to You am I turning my face

segments.transliteration: wa qad wathiqtu bika fala tukhayyibni
segments.translation: and with You do I keep my family members, my property, and everything with which You have allowed me to behave.

segments.arabic: وَعَلَيْكَ خَلَّفْتُ اهْلِي وَمَالِي وَمَا خَوَّلْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: ya man la yukhayyibu man aradahu
segments.translation: I have trusted in You; so, do not disappoint me.
O He Who saves those who trust in Him from disappointment

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاََ يُخَيِّبُ مَنْ ارَادَهُ
segments.translation: and does not give up those whom He safeguards.
O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
watch over all that from which I am absent,
and do not refer my affairs to myself,

segments.transliteration: allahumma inni ishtaraytu bihadhihi alssadaqati salamati
segments.translation: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.([2])

segments.transliteration: wa salamata safari wa ma ma`i
segments.translation: O Allah, I am purchasing, with this alms, my safety

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ٱِشْتَرَيْتُ بِهٰذِهِ ٱلصَّدَقَةِ سَلاَمَتِي
segments.translation: and the safety of my journey and my possessions.

segments.transliteration: wa sallimni wa sallim ma ma`iya
segments.translation: O Allah, (please do) safeguard me and whatever is with me,

segments.transliteration: wa ballighni wa balligh ma ma`iya
segments.translation: save me and whatever is with me,
and observe me and whatever is with me
with Your excellent, pleasant care.
O Allah, (please) help me attain that for which I am directing,
prepare for me the causes of the achievement of my intention,

segments.transliteration: warzuqni ziyarata babiyyika wa waliyyika amiri almu'minina
segments.translation: make helpful for me Your servants and Your lands,
facilitate for me visitations to Your Prophet, Your Saint the Commander of the Believers,

segments.arabic: وَٱرْزُقْنِي زِيَارَةَ نَبِيِّكَ وَوَلِيِّكَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa jami`i ahli baytihi `alayhi wa `layhim alssalamu
segments.translation: the Imams from his progeny,

segments.transliteration: wa muddani bilma`unati fi jami`i ahwali
segments.translation: and all the members of his householdâpeace be upon him and them.

segments.arabic: وَجَمِيعِ اهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segments.transliteration: wa la takilni ila nafsi wa la ila ghayri
segments.translation: (Please) supply me with aid under all conditions of mine,
never leave me to myself or to anyone else;

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَىٰ نَفْسِي وَلاَ إِلَىٰ غَيْرِي
segments.translation: lest, I will tire myself and I will suffer loss,
(please) provide me with piety,

segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`alni awjaha man tawajjaha ilayka
segments.translation: and forgive me in the Next World and this world.

segments.transliteration: allahumma hadhihi tinatu qabri alhusayni `alayhi alssalamu
segments.translation: O Allah, make me the most acceptable of all those who turn their faces to You.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْنِي اوْجَهَ مَنْ تَوَجَّهَ إِِلَيْكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, this soil from the tomb of al-Husayn, peace be upon him,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ هٰذِهِ طِينَةُ قَبْرِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segments.transliteration: ittakhadhtuha hirzan lima akhafu wa ma la akhafu
segments.translation: Your saint and the son of Your saint,
I have taken with me as refuge against whatever I fear and whatever I do not fear.

segments.arabic: إِتَّخَذْتُهَا حِرْزاً لِمَا اخَافُ وَمَا لاََ اخَافُ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please do) make me learn lessons while I am walking (in this journey),
ponder (over the creation of things) while I am silent,
and mention You while I am talking.

segments.transliteration: wa min allahi wa ila allahi
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I trust),
from Allah (I derive power), to Allah (I refer all my affairs),
and on the way of Allah (I proceed).
O Allah, to You have I submitted myself,
towards You have I turned to face,
and to You do I refer all my affairs;

segments.transliteration: min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi
segments.translation: so, (please do) safeguard me with the guard of faith
from my front, from my back,

segments.transliteration: wa min fawqi wa min tahti
segments.translation: from my right side, from my left side,
from above, and from beneath me;

segments.transliteration: fa'innahu la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: and (please do) defend me with Your Might and Power,
for there is no might and no power save with Allah the All-high and All-great.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لاََ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation: All glory be to Allah,
all praise be to Allah,
there is no god save Allah,
and Allah is the Most Great.

segments.transliteration: qala `asa rabbe an yahdiyane sawa'a alssabeli
segments.translation: And when he turned his face toward Midian,
he said, Peradventure, my Lord will guide me in the right road.
And when he came unto the water of Midian,

segments.transliteration: wa wajada min dunihim imra'atayni tadhudani
segments.translation: he found there a whole tribe of men, watering.
And he found apart from them two women keeping back their flocks.

segments.transliteration: qalata la nasqe hatta yudira alrri`a'u
segments.translation: He said, What ails you?
The two said, We cannot give our flocks to drink until the shepherds return from the water;
and our father is a very old man.
So, he watered their flock for them.

segments.transliteration: faqala rabbi inne lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqerun
segments.translation: Then he turned aside into the shade,
and said, My Lord! I am needy of whatever good You send for me.

segments.transliteration: qalat inna abe yad`uka liyajziyaka ajra ma saqayta lana
segments.translation: Then, there came unto him one of the two women, walking shyly.

segments.transliteration: falamma ja'ahu wa qaa `alayhi alqaaa qala la takhaf
segments.translation: She said, Lo! My father bids you that he may reward you with a payment for that you did water (the flock) for us.
Then, when he came unto him and told him the whole story, he said, Fear not!
You have escaped from the wrongdoing folk.

segments.transliteration: inna khayra man ista'jarta alqawiyyu al'amenu
segments.translation: One of the two women said, O my father! Hire him!

segments.transliteration: qala inne uredu an unkihaka ihda ibnatayya hatayni
segments.translation: For the best man that you can hire is the strong, the trustworthy.
He said, Lo! I fain would marry you to one of these two daughters of mine
on condition that you hire yourself to me for the term of eight years.
Then if you complete ten, it will be of your own accord,

segments.transliteration: satajidune in sha'a allahu min alalihena
segments.translation: for I would not make it hard for you.
Allah willing, you will find me of the righteous.
He said, That is settled between you and me.
Whichever of the two terms I fulfill, there will be no injustice to me,
and Allah is Surety over what we say.
O Allah, (please do) make me learn lessons while I am walking (in this journey),
ponder (over the creation of things) while I am silent,
and mention You while I am talking.

segments.transliteration: wa min allahi wa ila allahi
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I trust),
from Allah (I derive power), to Allah (I refer all my affairs),
and on the way of Allah (I proceed).
O Allah, to You have I submitted myself,
towards You have I turned to face,
and to You do I refer all my affairs;

segments.transliteration: min bayni yadayya wa min khalfe
segments.translation: so, (please do) safeguard me with the guard of faith
from my front, from my back,

segments.transliteration: wa min fawqe wa min tahte
segments.translation: from my right side, from my left side,
from above, and from beneath me;

segments.transliteration: fa'innahu la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`aemi
segments.translation: and (please do) defend me with Your Might and Power,
for there is no might and no power save with Allah the All-high and All-great.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لاََ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah is my leaving

segments.transliteration: wa qad `alima qabla an akhruja khuruje
segments.translation: and by His permission I have left.

segments.transliteration: wa qad aha `ilmuhu ma fe makhraje wa marji`e
segments.translation: He has known about my leaving before I left

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ عَلِمَ قَبْلَ انْ اخْرُجَ خُرُوجِي
segments.translation: and His knowledge has encompassed what I will face in my departure and my return.

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ احْصَىٰ عِلْمُهُ مَا فِي مَخْرَجِي وَمَرْجِعِي
segments.translation: I put my trust in the All-great God;
a trust of one who delegates all of his affairs to Him,
who seeks His help in all of his affairs,
who prays for more favors of Him,

segments.transliteration: wa min kulli quwwatin illa bihe
segments.translation: and who disavows that there may be any might
or any power except with Him.
[I thus leave] the leaving of an injured one
who has left, carrying his injury, towards the One Who can relieve it,
the leaving of a poor one
who has left carrying his poverty to the One Who can fill it,
the leaving of a needy one

segments.transliteration: wa khuruja man rabbuhu akbaru thiqatihe
segments.translation: who has left carrying his neediness to the One Who can meet it,
the leaving of one whose Lord is his grandest trustworthy,
his greatest hoped,

segments.transliteration: allahu thiqate fe jame`i umure kulliha
segments.translation: and his most favorable grantor of wishes.
Allah is my trust in all of my affairs

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُ ثِقَتِي فِي جَمِيعِ امُورِي كُلِّهَا
segments.transliteration: wa la shay'a illa ma sha'a allahu fe `ilmihe
segments.translation: in all of which I seek His help.
Nothing can come to pass except what Allah has willed in His [eternal] knowledge.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ شَيْءَ إِلاَّ مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ فِي عِلْمِهِ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa huwa ilayhi almaeru
segments.translation: I pray Allah for guiding to the best departure and the best return.
There is no god save Him. To Him is the final return.

segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) help me attain that for which I am directing,
prepare for me the causes of the achievement of my intention,

segments.transliteration: warzuqne ziyarata babiyyika wa waliyyika ameri almu'minena
segments.translation: make helpful for me Your servants and Your lands,
facilitate for me visitations to Your Prophet, Your Saint the Commander of the Believers,

segments.arabic: وَٱرْزُقْنِي زِيَارَةَ نَبِيِّكَ وَوَلِيِّكَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa jame`i ahli baytihe `alayhi wa `layhim alssalamu
segments.translation: the Imams from his progeny,

segments.transliteration: wa muddane bilma`unati fe jame`i ahwale
segments.translation: and all the members of his householdpeace be upon him and them.

segments.arabic: وَجَمِيعِ اهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segments.transliteration: wa la takilne ila nafse wa la ila ghayre
segments.translation: (Please) supply me with aid under all conditions of mine,
never leave me to myself or to anyone else;

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَىٰ نَفْسِي وَلاَ إِلَىٰ غَيْرِي
segments.translation: lest, I will tire myself and I will suffer loss,
(please) provide me with piety,

segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`alne awjaha man tawajjaha ilayka
segments.translation: and forgive me in the Next World and this world.
O Allah, make me the most acceptable of all those who turn their faces to You.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْنِي اوْجَهَ مَنْ تَوَجَّهَ إِِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: Yaa saaleho yaa abaa saalehin arshedoona elat tareeqe rahemakomul laaho.
segments.translation: O Saleh! Render help unto me!

segments.transliteration: Rabbe adkhilnee mudkhala sidqiwn wa akhrijnee mukhraja sidqiwn waj-aÃ¯'l lee mil ladunka sultaanan naseeraa.
segments.translation: O Saleh and Abaa Saleh may God show His mercy on you show us the right way.

segments.arabic: يَا صَالِحُ يَا اَبَا صَالِحٍ أَرْشِدُوْنَا إِلَى الطَّرِيْقِ رَحِمَكُمُ اللهُ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma anzilnee munzalan mobaarakan wa anta khayrul munzeleen.
segments.translation: Ã¯'O My Lord! Cause me to enter a goodly entrance and cause me to go out (of) a goodly exit, and grant me from unto Thee an authority to assist (me)Ã¯'

segments.arabic: رَبِّ اَدْخِلْنِىْ مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَّ اَخْرِجْنِىْ مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَّ اجْعَلْ لِّىْ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَصِيْرًا.
segments.transliteration: Laa takhaafo darakan wa laa takhshaa.
segments.translation: O Allah make my arrival over here rewarding, for Thou art the best host and care-taker.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ أَنْزِلْنِيْ مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَ أَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahul laze nazzalal ketaaba, wa howa yatawallas saaleheen.
segments.translation: Not fearing to be overtaken, nor being afraid

segments.arabic: لَا تَخَافُ دَرَكاً وَ لَا تَخْشٰى‏
segments.transliteration: wa maa qadarul laaha haqqa qadrehi, wal-arzo jamee-aÃ¯'n qabzatohu yawmal qeyaamate was-samaawaato matwiyyaatum be-yameenehi, subhaanahu wa ta-aÃ¯'alaa aÃ¯'mmaa yushrekoon.
segments.translation: He is Allah who sent down the book (Quran) and He guardeth the virtuous one.[2]

segments.arabic: اَللهُ الَّذِىْ نَزَّلَ الْكِتَابَ، وَ هُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصَّالِحِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Inna waliyyeyal laahul lazee nazzalal ketaaba, wa howa yatawallas saaleheen.
segments.translation: They have esteemed not Allah, as is His due: While the whole earth shall be in His grip on the day of Judgement and heavens rolled up (shall be) in the right hand: Hallowed is He and Exalted is He, high above what they associate (with Him).[3]

segments.arabic: وَ مَا قَدَرُوْا اللهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖ، وَ الْاَرْضُ جَمِيْعًا قَبْضَتُهٗ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَ السَّمٰوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌۢ بِيَمِيْنِهٖ، سُبْحَانَهٗ وَ تَعَالٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ.
segments.transliteration: wa maa qadarul laaha haqqa qadrehi, wal-arzo jamee-aÃ¯'n qabzatohu yawmal qeyaamate was-samaawaato matwiyyaatum be-yameenehi, subhaanahu wa ta-aÃ¯'alaa aÃ¯'mmaa yushrekoon.
segments.translation: Verily my protector is God who sent down the Book (QurÃ¯'an) and He gradeth the virtuous once.[4]

segments.arabic: اِنَّ وَلِىِّىَ اللهُ الَّذِىْ نَزَّلَ الْكِتَابَ، وَ هُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصَّالِحِيْنَ.
segments.translation: They have esteemed not God, as is His due: while the whole earth shall Be in His grip on the Day of judgement and heavens rolled up (shall be) in His right hand, Hallowed is He, and Exalted is He, high above what they associate (with Him)[5]

segments.arabic: وَ مَا قَدَرُوْا اللهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖ، وَ الْاَرْضُ جَمِيْعًا قَبْضَتُهٗ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَ السَّمٰوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌۢ بِيَمِيْنِهٖ، سُبْحَانَهٗ وَ تَعَالٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ.
segments.translation: Only what Allah wills will come to pass!
There is no strength save in Allah!
I implore Allah forgiveness.
Muhammad and `Ale
Allah is the King.
Kingdom is AllahÃ¯s; the One and All-omnipotent.
