Bismillahi,aamantu billahi, wa tawakkaltu allallahi, ma-sha-allah, la haula wala quawwata illa billah. Allahumma ahadhni wahfadh ma ma`ee wa ballighnee wa balligh ma ma ma`ee bi blalaghikalhusn, billahi astaftihu wa billahi astanjihu wa bi muhammadin sallallahu alaiyhi wa aalihi atawajjahu. Allahukka sahhil lee kulla huzoonatin wa dhallil lee kulla huzoonatin wa dhallil lee kulla su`oobatin wa a`tinee mina khairi kullih akhtar mimma arju wasirf annee minash-sharri mimma uhad-diru fee aafi;yatin, ya arhamarrahimeen. O Allah! Protect me and protect what is with me (my possessions), and deliver me (to my destination and delivery what is with me the best of your delivery. By Allah I commence (my journey) and by Allah I seek to accomplish (the purpose of my journey) and by Muhammad (s.a.w.) I have set out (towards my destination). O Allah make me overcome all (my grief); and make easy for me all difficulties; and give me more of goodness than I hope for; and keep away all evil of which I am apprehensive for my health. O the most Merciful. Dua` to be recited when mounting or boarding the means of transport Ø¨ÙØ³ÙÙ Ù Ø§ÙÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙØ§ ÙÙÙÙÙØ©Ù Ø¥ÙÙÙÙØ§ Ø¨ÙØ§ÙÙÙÙÙÙ. O`My Lord! Cause me to disembark a blessed alighting and you are the Best of all who cause to alight. The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.) in his journey use to praise Allah (s.w.t.) by saying 'SUBHAAN ALLAH' when dismounting and 'ALLAHU AKBER' when mounting. SOME RECOMMENDED ACTS Imam Ja`ffer as-Sadiq (a.s.) has said: Whoever recites sura Tawheed ten times when leaving his house, he will remain in the protection of the Al-Mighty Allah and His angles until he returns to his house. Ref: (Makarimul Akhlaaq) Some scholars also emphasize the recitation of Tasbeeh of Sayyidah Fatima (a.s.) daughter of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.). The Tasbeeh is recited in the following manner: 34 times Allahu Akber 33 times Alhumdu Lillah and 33 times Subhan Allah. Subhanal-ladhee sakh-khara lana haadha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, Wa inna illa rabbina lamuqaliboon. Walhamdu lillahi rabbil aalameen. Allahumma antal haamilu aladhdhahr walmusta`anu alal-amr. Wa antas-sahibu fis-sfar wal khaleefatu fil-ahli wal-maali wal-walad. Allahumma anta adhdee wa naasiree. All praise is for Allah Who guided us in Islam and taught us the Quran and graced us with Muhammad (s.a.w.). Glory be to Allah Who made this (the means of transport) subservient to us, and we (by ourselves) could never have accomplished it. And surely to our Lord we shall return. All praise is for Allah, the Lord of the worlds. `O` Allah! You are the Facilitator of the journey and the helper in the affair and you are the Companion in the journey, and the Successor (incharge of my) family, property and son. `O` Allah! You are my supporter and my Helper to Victory. Dua` to be recited when entering a new town, city or village. title: Morning and Evening Duas Duas.org

segments.arabic: أَبْتَدِئُ يَوْمِي هٰذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نِسْيَانِي وَعَجَلَتِي
segments.transliteration: abtati'u yawmi hadha bayna yaday nisyani wa `ajalati
segments.translation: I begin this day of mine before I should forget and hasten to other affairs,
âwith the Name of Allahâ
and âOnly what Allah wills (shall come to pass).â
In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I put my trust),
to Allah (I resort),
in the way of Allah (I proceed),
and the principles of Allahâs Messenger,
may Allah bless him and his Household (I follow).
O Allah, (please) protect me with the protection of faith

segments.transliteration: min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi
segments.translation: before me, behind me,
to my right side, to my left side,

segments.transliteration: wa min fawqi wa min tahti
segments.translation: above me, beneath me,
and in front of me.
There is no god save You.

segments.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: la hawla wala quwwata illa billahi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power except with Allah.
We beseech You for pardon and wellbeing
from all wicked matters and all evils
in this world and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ عَذَابِ ٱلْقَبْرِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min `adhabi alqabri
segments.translation: O Allah, I pray for Your protection against the chastisement in the grave,
the pressure of graves,
and the tightness of graves.

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سَطَوَاتِ ٱللَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min satawati allayli walnnahari
segments.translation: I pray Your protection against the calamities in nights and days.
O Allah, Lord of the Sacred Monument,
the Sacred City,
the lawful, and the consecration,

segments.arabic: أَبْلِغْ مُحَمَّداً وَآلَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِّيَ ٱلسَّلاَمَ
segments.transliteration: abligh muhammadan wa ala muhammadin `anni alssalama
segments.translation: (please) convey peace to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad on behalf of me.
O Allah, I pray the protection of Your invulnerable armor
and I pray the protection of Your Wholeness
lest that You might cause me to die drowned, burned,
choked, beaten,
murdered, poisoned,
fallen in a well,
eaten by a beast,
sudden death,
or any violent death;
rather, cause me to die on my bed
obeying You and Your Messenger,
may Allah bless him and his Household,
following the truth unfailingly,

segments.arabic: أَوْ فِي ٱلصَّفِّ ٱلَّذِينَ نَعَتَّهُمْ فِي كِتَابِكَ
segments.transliteration: aw fi alssaffi alladhina na`attahum fi kitabika
segments.translation: or to die in the ranks that You have described in Your Book
as a solid structure.
I pray for myself, my children,
and whatever my Lord has provided me
the protection of âSay: I seek refuge in the Lord of the dawn
from the evil of what He has created,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqaba
segments.translation: from the evil of the utterly dark night when it comes,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri alnnaffathati fi al`uqadi
segments.translation: from the evil of those who blow on knots,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri hasidin idha hasada
segments.translation: and from the evil of the envious when he envies.â
I pray for myself, my children,
and whatever my Lord has provided me
the protection of âSay: I seek refuge in the Lord of men,
the King of men,
the god of men,
from the evil of the whisperings of the slinking (Satan)
who whispers into the hearts of men
from among the jinn and the men.â

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah as many as what Allah has created.
Praise be to Allah as same as what He has created.
Praise be to Allah as full as what He has created.
Praise be to Allah as much as the ink of His Words.
Praise be to Allah as weighty as His Throne.
Praise be to Allah as much as it pleases Him.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
segments.transliteration: wa la ilaha illa allahu alhalimu alkarimu
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah the Forbearing and All-generous.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَلِيُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
segments.transliteration: wa la ilaha illa allahu al`aliyu al`azimu
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah the Most High and All-great.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَوَاتِ وَٱلأَرَضِينَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا
segments.transliteration: subhana allahi rabbi alssamawati wal-aradina wa ma baynahuma
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah the Lord of the heavens, the layers of the earth, and whatsoever is between them
and the Lord of the great Throne.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ دَرَكِ ٱلشَّقَاءِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min daraki alshshqa'i
segments.translation: O Allah, I pray Your protection against encounter of misery
and gloating of the enemies.

segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min alfaqri walwaqri
segments.translation: I pray Your protection against poverty and rupture.

segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min su'i almanzari
segments.translation: I pray Your protection against evil result
with regard to the wife, the property, and the children.</

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
O Allah, all praise be to You.
I praise You and seek Your help.
You are my Lord
and I am Your servant.
I begin this morning committing myself to my pledge and promise to You,
having faith in Your promise,
and fulfilling my covenant to You as much as I can.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power except with Allah,
One and Only and having no associate with Him.

segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.
I am in this morning following the nature of Islam,
the creed of sincerity,
the principles of Abraham,
and the faith of Muhammad,
blessings of Allah be upon them and upon their households.
Carrying this faith, I will live and die,
if Allah wills.
O Allah, (please) make me live as long as You determine me to live
and cause me to die when You will decide to make me die following this faith,
and resurrect me, when You will resurrect me following this faith.
By so, I only desire for Your pleasure and for following Your path.
To You do I resort
and with You do I entrust my affairs.
The Family of Muhammad are my leaders;
I have no other leaders than they are.
I follow them,
accede to them,
and pattern after their examples.
O Allah, (please) make them my leaders
in this world and in the Hereafter,
keep me loyalist to their loyalists
and enemy of their enemies
in this world and in the Hereafter,
and include me with the righteous ones,
along with my ancestors.

segments.arabic: إِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ أَصْبَحْتُ بِللَِّ مُؤْمِناً عَلَى دِينِ مَُمَّدٍ وَ سُنَّتِهِ وَ دِينِ عَلِيٍّ وَ سُنَّتِهِ وَِينِ الَْوْصِيَاءِ وَ سُنَّتِهِمْ
segments.translation:
âI arise a believer in AllÄh,upon the religion of Muá¸¥ammad and his sunnah, the religion of âAlÄ« and
his sunnah, and the religion of the Legatees (i.e. the infallible ImÄms) and their sunnah.

segments.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِسِرِّهِمْ وَ عَلَنِيَتِهِمْ وَ شَاهِدِهِمْ وَ غَائِبِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma Innee A-Oâozo Beka Min Zawaale Neâmateka
segments.translation: I believe in their secrets and open declarations, when they are present or hidden;

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِللَِّ مَِّااسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَِّ  وَ عَلِيٌّ  وَ الَْوْصِيَاءُ
segments.translation: and I seek AllÄhâs refuge from that which the Messenger of AllÄh (á¹£) sought refuge, as did âAlÄ« (âa.s.) and the Legatees;
and I desire from AllÄh that which they desired from Him,

segments.arabic: وَ لَ حَوْلَ وَ لَ قُوَّةَ إِلَّ بِللَِّ
segments.translation: and there is no might or power except by [the will of] AllÄh.ââ

segments.transliteration: Wa Min Sharre Maa Sabaqa Fil Kitabik
segments.translation: âGlory be to AllÄh, the King, the Most Holy

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma Innee As-Aloka Be-Iâzzate Mulkeka Wa Be-Shiddate Quwwateka Wa Be-Aâzame Sultaaneka Wa Be-Qudrateka Aâlaa Khalqeka An Tosalleya Aâlaa Mohammadin Wa Aale Mohammadin Wa An Taf-Aâla Be Kazaa
segments.translation: O AllÄh, I seek refuge with You from the waning of Your blessings,
change in the good health You have granted,

segments.transliteration: Alhamdo Lillaahil Lazee Lam Yusbeh Bee Mayyetan.
segments.translation: the suddenness of Your chastisement,

segments.transliteration: Wa Laa Saqeeman Wa Laa Mazrooban Aâlaa Oârooqee Be-Sooo-In.
segments.translation: from falling into wretchedness,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا سَبَقَ فِ الْكِتَابِ
segments.transliteration: Wa Laa Maakhoozan Be-Aswa-E Aâmalee Wa Laa Maqtoo-Aân Daaberee.
segments.translation: and from the evil that has previously befallen in the Book.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّ أَسْأَلُكَ بِعِزَّةِ مُلْكِكَ وَ شِدَّةِ قُوَّتِكَ وَ بِعَظِيمِ سُلْطَانِكَ وَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa Laa Murtaddan Aân Deenee Wa Laa Munkeran Lerabbee.
segments.translation: O AllÄh, I beg You by the glory of Your kingdom, the might of Your strength, the greatness of Your dominion and Your power over Your creation.âââ

segments.transliteration: Wa Laa Mustawheshan Min Eemaanee Wa Laa Multabesan Aâqlee.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِیْ لَمْ یُصْبِحْ بِی مَیِّتًا.
segments.transliteration: Wa Laa Mo-Aâzzaban Be-Aâzaabil Omame Min Qablee.
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah, Who made me such that I have not died.

segments.arabic: وَلَا سَقِیْمًا وَ لَا مَضْرُوْبًا عَلٰی عُرُوْقِیْ بِسُوٓءٍ.
segments.translation: Nor am I sick, nor have my veins been infected with disease.

segments.arabic: وَلَا مَاْخُوْذًا بِاَسْوَءِ عَمَلِیْ وَ لَا مَقْطُوْعًا دَابِرِیْ.
segments.transliteration: Lakal Hujjato Aâlayya Wa Laa Hujjata Lee.
segments.translation: Nor have I been hauled up for my evil acts, nor am I without progeny.

segments.arabic: وَلَا مُرْتَدًّا عَنْ دِیْنِیْ وَ لَا مُنْکِرًا لِرَبِّیْ.
segments.transliteration: Wa Laa Astatee-Oâ An Aakhoza Illaa Maa A-Aâtaytanee.
segments.translation: Nor have I forsaken my religion, nor do I disbelieve in my Lord.

segments.arabic: وَلَا مُسْتَوْحِشًا مِنْ اِیْمَانِیْ وَ لَا مُلْتَبِسًا عَقْلِیْ.
segments.transliteration: Wa Laa Attaqeya Illaa Maa Waqaytanee.
segments.translation: Nor do I feel strangeness with my faith, nor is my intelligence affected.

segments.arabic: وَلَا مُعَذَّبًا بِعَذَابِ الْاُمَمِ مِنْ قَبْلِیْ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma Innee A-Oâozo Beka An Aftaqera Fee Ghenaaka.
segments.translation: Nor have I been punished with the punishment of peoples before me.

segments.transliteration: Aw Azilla Fee Hodaaka Aw Ozaama Fee Sultaaneka.
segments.translation: I am a slave in Your possession; I have been guilty of excesses over myself.

segments.arabic: لَکَ الْحُجَّۃُ عَلَیَّ وَ لَا حُجَّۃَ لِیْ.
segments.translation: You have exhausted Your pleas over me and I have no plea (before You).

segments.arabic: وَلَا اَسْتَطِیْعُ اَنْ آخُذَ اِلَّا مَا اَعْطَیْتَنِیْ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahummaj Aâl Nafsee Awwala Kareematin Tantaze-Oâhaa Min Karaaa-Emee.
segments.translation: I have no power to take except what You give me.

segments.transliteration: Wa Awwala Wadee-Aâtin Tartaje-Oâhaa Min Wadaaa-E-Eâ Ne-Aâmeka Iândee.
segments.translation: And I cannot evade except what You save me from.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنِّی اَعُوْدُ بِکَ اَنْ اَفْتَقِرَ فِی غِنَاکَ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma Innaa Na-Oâozo Beka An Tazhaba Aân Qawleka.
segments.translation: O Allah! I seek Your protection from becoming destitute despite Your riches.

segments.arabic: اَوْ اَضِلَّ فِی ہُدَاکَ اَوْ اُضَامَ فِی سُلْطَانِکَ.
segments.translation: From being misguided despite Your guidance, from being molested in Your realm.

segments.transliteration: Aw Tataa-Ba-Aâ Benaa Ahwaaa-Onaa Doonal Hodal Lazee Jaaa-A Min Iândeka.
segments.translation: And from being humiliated while authority rests with You.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اجْمَعَل نَفְسِی أَوَّلَ کَرِیْمَۃٍ تَنْتَزِعُہَا مِن کَرَآئِمِی۔
segments.translation: O Allah! Let my spirit be the first of those good objects that You take from me.

segments.arabic: وَاَوَّلَ وَدِیعَۃٍ تَرْتَجِعُہَا مِن وَدَآئِع نِّعَمک عِنְدِي۔
segments.translation: And the first trust out of Your favors held in trust with me.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنَّا نَعُؤوز بِک أَنْ تَذہَب عَنْ قَوِلک۔
segments.translation: O Allah! We seek Your protection from turning away from Your command.
Or revolting against Your religion.

segments.arabic: اَو تَعَالَى بِنَا أَهَوَىٰنَا دُونَهُدَى الَّذِي جَآءَ مِن عِنَدک۔
segments.translation: Or being led away by our desires instead of by guidance that comes from You.
There is no god save Allah;
One and Only Lord and having no associate with Him.

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: To him is the kingdom and to Him is all praise.
He gives life and causes to die
while He is Ever-living and He never dies.
In His hand is the good
and He has power over all things.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: Ya Man LÄ SharÄ«ka Lahu Wa LÄ WazÄ«ra
segments.translation: O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

segments.transliteration: Ya KhÄliq Ash-Shamsi Wa Al-Qamar Al-MunÄ«ri
segments.translation: All glory be to Allah.
There is no god save Allah.
All praise be to Allah.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذي بِهِ تَقُومُ السَّماءَ ، وَبِهِ تَقُومُ الْأَرْضَ،
segments.translation: âOâ Allah! Indeed I beseech You in You name with which the sky is upright, and with which the earth is upright
, and with which we differentiate between truth and evil,

segments.arabic: وَبِهِ تَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الْمُتَفَرِّقِ ، وَبِهِ تُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ الْمُجْتَمَعِ ،
segments.translation: and with which we join the separated ones, and with which we segregate the joined ones,

segments.arabic: وَبِهِ أَحْصَيْتَ عَدَدَ الرِّمالِ ، وَزِنَةَ الْجِبالِ ، وَكَيْلَ الْبِحارِ ،
segments.translation: and with which we count the number of pebbles, and the weight of the mountains, and the measurement of the Oceans,

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَ لي مِنْ أَمْري فَرَجاً وَمَخْرَجاً .
segments.translation: to bless Mohammad and his holy Progeny, and to give me relief and a point of exit for my affair.[1]
O Greatest of the great,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ لَا وَزِيرَ
segments.translation: O One without partner or helper,

segments.arabic: يَا خَالِقَ الشَّمْسِ وَ الْقَمَرِ الْمُنِيرِ
segments.transliteration: Ya Man LÄ Yashghaluhu Shughulun 'An Shughulin
segments.translation: Creator of the shining sun and moon,

segments.transliteration: Ya Man LÄ Yataghayyaru Min á¸¤Älin IlÄ á¸¤Älin
segments.translation: Protector of the fearful seeker of refuge,

segments.transliteration: Ya Man LÄ Yaá¸¥tÄju IlÄ TajashÅ¡umi á¸¤arakatin Wa LÄ IntiqÄlin
segments.translation: Liberator of the bound captive,

segments.transliteration: Ya Man LÄ Yashghaluhu Sha'nun 'An Sha'nin
segments.translation: Provider of the small child,

segments.transliteration: Ya Man LÄ Yuá¸¥Ä«á¹­u Bihi Mawá¸i'un Wa LÄ MakÄnun
segments.translation: Healer of the broken bones,

segments.transliteration: Ya Man Yaruddu Bi-Alá¹­afi á¹¢adaqati Wa Ad-Du'Ä'i
segments.translation: Merciful to the elderly,

segments.transliteration: 'An A'nÄni As-SamÄ'i MÄ á¸¤atama Wa Abrama Min SÅ«'i Al-Qaá¸Ä'i
segments.translation: Light of all light,

segments.transliteration: Ya Man Yaj'alu Ash-ShifÄ'a FÄ«mÄ YashÄ'u Min Al-AshyÄ'i
segments.translation: Director of all affairs,

segments.transliteration: Ya Man Yum'siku Ar-Ramaq Min Al-Mudhnifi Al-'AmÄ«di Al-'AlÄ«li Bi-MÄ Qalla Min Al-Ghiá¸Ä'i
segments.translation: Resurrector of those in graves,

segments.transliteration: Ya Man YuzÄ«lu Bi-AdnÄ Ad-DawÄ'i MÄ Ghaluáºa Min Ad-Da'i
segments.translation: Healer of the hearts,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يَشْغَلُهُ شُغُلٌ عَنْ شُغُلٍ
segments.translation: O One whose work is not hindered by other tasks,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يَتَغَيَّرُ مِنْ حَالٍ إِلَى حَالٍ
segments.translation: O One who is not subject to change from state to state,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى تَجَشُّمِ حَرَكَةٍ وَ لَا انْتِقَالٍ
segments.transliteration: Ya Man Yunazzilu As-SakÄ«nata 'AlÄ QulÅ«bi Al-Mu'minÄ«n
segments.translation: O One who does not need movement or transfer,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يَشْغَلُهُ شَأْنٌ عَنْ شَأْنٍ
segments.translation: O One whose affairs do not preoccupy Him from other matters,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يُحِيطُ بِهِ مَوْضِعٌ وَ لَا مَكَانٌ
segments.translation: O One who is bound by no place or space,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَرُدُّ بِأَلْطَفِ الصَّدَقَةِ وَ الدُّعَاءِ
segments.transliteration: Ya Man Yaj'alu Al-á¸¤arba Silman Wa Al-Khawfa Amnan
segments.translation: O One who turns away decreed harm by subtle charity and supplication.

segments.arabic: عَنْ أَعْنَانِ السَّمَاءِ مَا حَتَمَ وَ أَبْرَمَ مِنْ سُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ
segments.transliteration: Ya Man Yursilu Ar-RiyÄá¸¥a Lil-Riyy Wa Al-Maá¹­ari
segments.translation: From the heavens, what has been decreed and determined of evil fate,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَجْعَلُ الشِّفَاءَ فِيمَا يَشَاءُ مِنَ الْأَشْيَاءِ
segments.translation: O One who places healing in whatever He wills of things,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يُمْسِكُ الرَّمَقَ مِنَ الْمُدْنِفِ الْعَمِيدِ الْعَلِيلِ بِمَا قَلَّ مِنَ الْغِذَاءِ
segments.transliteration: Ya Man Yuá¸¥aqqiqu Al-AmÄl Wa Yasma'u Ad-Du'Ä'a
segments.translation: Who sustains the strength of the weary, weakened sick with minimal nourishment,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يُزِيلُ بِأَدْنَى الدَّوَاءِ مَا غَلُظَ مِنَ الدَّاءِ
segments.transliteration: Ya Man Yarzuqu An-NÄsa Min Ghayri á¸¤isÄbin
segments.translation: Who removes severe illness with the simplest of remedies,

segments.transliteration: Ya Man Lahu Kullu Shay'in Wa Kullu Qadar
segments.translation: O One who teaches the ignorant,
O One who guides the misguided,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يُنَزِّلُ السَّكِينَةَ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: O One who sends tranquility upon the hearts of believers,
O One who loves the truthful,
O One who employs angels for His servants,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَجْعَلُ الْحَرْبَ سِلْمًا وَ الْخَوْفَ أَمْنًا
segments.translation: O One who turns war into peace and fear into security,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ لِلرِّيَّ وَ الْمَطَرِ
segments.transliteration: Wa Istaqbil BÄ« á¹¢iá¸¥á¸¥atan Min SuqmÄ«
segments.translation: O One who sends winds for irrigation and rain,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يُنْعِمُ عَلَى الْعَبِيدِ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ
segments.translation: O One who bestows blessings upon His servants,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يُحَقِّقُ الْأَمَالَ وَ يَسْمَعُ الدُّعَاءَ
segments.translation: O One who fulfills hopes and hears supplications,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَرْزُقُ النَّاسَ مِنْ غَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
segments.translation: O One who provides for people without account,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ وَ كُلُّ قَدَرٍ
segments.translation: O One to whom all things and all destinies belong,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa IstiqÄlatiKa Qabla An YafnÄ Al-Ajal
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family,
And hasten my relief,
And forgive my missteps,
And have mercy on my tears,

segments.arabic: وَ ارْدُدْنِي إِلَى أَفْضَلِ عَادَاتِكَ عِنْدِي
segments.transliteration: Wa As'aluka NajÄá¸¥a Al-'Amal Qabla Inqiá¹­Ä'i Al-Ajal
segments.translation: And return me to Your best practices with me,

segments.arabic: وَ اسْتَقْبِلْ بِي صِحَّةً مِنْ سُقْمِي
segments.transliteration: Wa Quwwatan FÄ« Sam'Ä« Wa Baá¹£arÄ«
segments.translation: And grant me health from my illness,

segments.transliteration: Wa Isti'mÄla Al-'Amal As-á¹¢Äliá¸¥ MimmÄ 'AllamtanÄ« Wa FahhamtanÄ«
segments.translation: And abundance from my poverty,
And comprehensive well-being in my body,
And clear insight in my faith,

segments.arabic: وَ مَهِّدْنِي وَ أَعِنِّي عَلَى اسْتِغْفَارِكَ
segments.translation: And enable me, and aid me in seeking Your forgiveness,

segments.arabic: وَ اسْتِقَالَتِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْنَى الْأَجَلُ
segments.translation: Before the term ends,
And hope is cut off.

segments.arabic: وَ أَعِنِّي عَلَى الْمَوْتِ وَ كُرْبَتِهِ
segments.translation: Assist me in death and its pangs,

segments.transliteration: Wa Huwa Aqrabu WasÄ«linÄ Ilayka Rabbana Muá¸¥ammadin Wa Älihi Wa 'Itratihi At-á¹¬ÄhirÄ«n
segments.translation: The grave and its isolation,

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ نَجَاحَ الْعَمَلِ قَبْلَ انْقِطَاعِ الْأَجَلِ
segments.translation: And I ask You for success in deeds before life ends,
Strength in my hearing and sight,

segments.arabic: وَ اسْتِعْمَالِ الْعَمَلِ الصَّالِحِ مِمَّا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَ فَهَّمْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi adh-haba allayla biqudratihi
segments.translation: And the ability to use good deeds from what You taught me and made me understand.
Indeed, You are the Glorious Lord,
And I am the weak servant,
And the difference between us is vast.
O Most Compassionate, O Most Beneficent,
O Lord of Majesty and Honor,

segments.transliteration: wa abra'u ilayka min ahli la`natika
segments.translation: Bless the one who brought us understanding,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ أَقْرَبُ وَسَائِلِنَا إِلَيْكَ رَبَّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ عِتْرَتِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ‏
segments.translation: And is our nearest intercessor to You, our LordâMuhammad and his pure family and lineage.
All praise be to the Lord of morning.
All praise be to the Cleaver of daybreak.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي أَذْهَبَ ٱللَّيْلَ بِقُدْرَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: mimman nahnu bayna zahranihim min almushrikina
segments.translation: All praise be to Allah Who has taken away the night by His power
and brought the day through His mercy.
O Allah, I implore for You forgiveness

segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`al ma anzalta min alssama'i ila al-ardi
segments.translation: in this morning
and on this day
for purpose of winning Your mercy.
I disavow in Your presence the people cursed by You.
O Allah, I disavow in Your presence
on this day
and in this morning

segments.arabic: مِمَّنْ نَحْنُ بَيْنَ ظَهْرَانيْهِمْ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
segments.translation: the polytheists we live among them
and (disavow) what they are worshipping.
Truly, they were a people given to evil, a rebellious people.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ مَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ إِلَىٰ ٱلأَرْضِ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) cause what You have brought down from the heavens to the earth
in this morning
and on this day
to be blessing for Your saints

segments.transliteration: allahumma innaka ta`lamu munqalabahum wa mathwahum
segments.translation: and punishment poured on Your enemies.
O Allah, (please) accede to those who are loyal to You
and feud with those who act hostilely towards You.
O Allah, (please) seal my affairs with security and faith
whenever the sun rises or sets.

segments.transliteration: waj`al lahu wa lana min ladunka sultanan nasiran
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) forgive me and my parents
and have mercy upon them as they have cherished me in my childhood.
O Allah, (please) forgive the believing men and women
and the Muslim men and women,
both the alive and the dead.
O Allah, You do know their place of returning and their place of rest.
O Allah, (please) safeguard the leader of Muslims
with the protection of faith,
help him with powerful help,
grant him easy victory,

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ لَهُ وَلَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَاناً نَصِيراً
segments.transliteration: wa la ashtari bihi thamanan qalilan
segments.translation: and grant him and us from Your presence a sustaining power.
O Allah, (please) curse so-and-so and so-and-soÂ­
as well as the factions that have dissented from Your Messenger,
from the men of authority after Your Messenger,
from the leaders who came after him, and from their partisans.
I also beseech You from more favor,

segments.arabic: وَٱلإِقْرَارَ بِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
segments.translation: acknowledgement of what has come from You,
submission to Your decree,

segments.transliteration: wa ma taqarrabtu bihi ilayka min khayrin
segments.translation: and steadfastness in what You have ordered of.
I neither intend to find another alternative than it
nor do I take a mean price in exchange for it.
O Allah, (please) guide me among those whom You guide
and save me from the evil of what You have decided,
for You decree and no one can decree against Your decree
and no humiliation will ever afflict one whom You support.
Blessed by You and exalted by You.
Glory be to You, O Lord of the House.
Accept my prayer.

segments.arabic: وَمَا تَقَرَّبْتُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ خَيْرٍ
segments.translation: As for whatever virtuous item through which I have sought nearness to You,

segments.transliteration: wa mil'a ma sha'a rabbi wa radiya
segments.translation: (please) double it for me many folds.
Grant us from Your Presence a great reward.
O my Lord, how excellent Your favors to me are!
How great Your donations to me are!
How lasting the wellbeing with which You have endued me is!
Too many times have You covered my faults!
So, all praise be to You, O my God;
such praise that is pleasant, blessed,
as full as the heavens,

segments.transliteration: fasubhana allahi hina tumsuna wa hina tusbihuna
segments.translation: as full as the earth,

segments.transliteration: wa lahu alhamdu fi alssamawati wal-ardi
segments.translation: as full as what my Lord wills and pleases,
and as it fits the Face of my Lord,
the Lord of majesty and honoring.
Allah, Allah, Allah is my lord,
the All-beneficent and All-merciful.
I do not admit any one as partner of Him.
âGlory be to your Lord, the Lord of Honor, above what they describe.
And Peace be upon the messengers.
And all praise is due to Allah the Lord of the worlds.â
âTherefore, glory be to Allah when you enter upon the time of the evening and when you enter upon the time of the morning;

segments.transliteration: subhanaka inni zalamtu nafsi faghfir li
segments.translation: and to Him belongs praise in the heavens and the earth,

segments.transliteration: warhamni wa tub `alayya innaka anta alttawwabu alrrahimu
segments.translation: and at nightfall and when you are at midday.
He brings forth the living from the dead

segments.transliteration: yaa hayyo yaa qayyoomo be-rahmateka ataghnaito,
segments.translation: and brings forth the dead from the living,

segments.transliteration: fa-aghisnee wa laa tiklnee elaa nafsee tarfata aâynin abadan,
segments.translation: and gives life to the earth after its death,
and thus shall you be brought forth.â
Glorified and Sacred be You;
our Lord and the Lord of the angels and the Holy Spirit.
Your mercy has preceded Your wrath.
There is no god save You.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَٱغْفِرْ لِي
segments.translation: Glory be to You. I have wronged myself; so, forgive me,

segments.arabic: وَٱرْحَمْنِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
segments.translation: have mercy upon me, and accept my repentance, for You are the Oft-Returning, the All-merciful.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segments.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اسْتَغِيْتُ فَاَغِثْنِيْ
segments.translation: O Living. O eternal, by your mercy, I seek your refuge (so give me refuge)

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَكِلْنِيْ اِلٰى نَفْسِيْ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ اَبَدًا،
segments.translation: and do not leave me to my self even for the blink of the eye, ever.
And reform all my conditions
on account of your mercy, o most merciful

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ ما شاءَ اللَّهُ ، لايَصْرِفُ السُّوءَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ ما شاءَ اللَّهُ ، لايَسُوقُ الْخَيْرَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ ما شاءَ اللَّهُ ، ما يَكُونُ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ . بِسْمِ اللَّهِ ما شاءَ اللَّهُ ، لا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظيمِ ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ ما شاءَ اللَّهُ ، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ الطَّيِّبينَ .
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: By the name of Allah and His wishes, no one turns away evils except Allah, by the name of Allah and His wishes, no one that do convey goods except Allah, by the name of Allah and His wishes, what ever bounty one possess is from Allah, by the name of Allah and His wishes, there is no power nor strength except that of Allah the Exalted, the Greatest, blessing be on Muhammad and on his pure and holy progeny.

segments.arabic:
الْحَمْدُ لَِِّ الَّذِي يَفْعَلُ مَا
يَشَاءُ وَ لَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ غَيْرُهُ الَْمْدُ لَِِّ كَمَا يُِبُّ اللَُّ أَنْ يُْمَدَ الَْمْدُ لَِِّ كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ
اللَّهُمَّ أَدْخِلْنِ فِ كُلِّ خَيٍْ أَدْخَلْتَ فِيهِ مَُمَّداً وَ آلَ مَُمَّدٍ وَ أَخْرِجْنِ مِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ أَخْرَجْتَ
مِنْهُ مَُمَّداً وَ آلَ مَُمَّدٍ وَ صَلَّى اللَُّ عَلَى مَُمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مَُمَّدٍ.
segments.translation:
âAll praise belongs to
AllÄh Who does as He wishes and no one other than Him can do as he
wishes. All praise be to AllÄh, the way AllÄh loves to be praised. All praise
be to AllÄh, just as He is deserving of it. O AllÄh, make me enter upon every
good that you made Muá¸¥ammad and the Household of Muá¸¥ammad enter,
and take me out of every evil that you took Muá¸¥ammad and the Household
of Muá¸¥ammad out of it, and the blessing of AllÄh be upon Muá¸¥ammad and
the Household of Muá¸¥ammad.âââ

segments.arabic:
لَ
إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَُّ وَحْدَهُ لَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَ لَ ه الَْمْدُ يُْيِي وَ يُِيتُ وَ يُِيتُ وَ يُْيِي وَ هُوَ حَيٌّ
لَ يَُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الَْيْرُ وَ هُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَ يءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ وَ تَقُولُ أَعُوذُ بِللَِّ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ
مِنْ هََزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَْضُرُونِ إِنَّ اللََّ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
segments.translation:
âThere is no deity but AllÄh,
alone, without any partner. His is the Kingdom and all praise belongs to
Him. He gives life and causes death, He causes death and gives life, and He
is ever-living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He has power
over all things.â Then he should say ten times: âI seek refuge with AllÄh,the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the whisperings of the devils and
I seek Your refuge, O Lord, from their presence near me, indeed AllÄh is
All-Hearing, All-Knowing,â

segments.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِ
فِ دِرْعِكَ الَْصِينَةِ الَّتِ تَْعَلُ فِيهَا مَنْ تُرِيدُ
segments.translation:
âO AllÄh, place me in your protective shield
wherein You place those whom You wish.â

segments.arabic:
أَصْبَحْتُ وَ رَبِّ مَْمُودٌ أَصْبَحْتُ لَ أُشْرِكُ بِللَِّ شَيْئاً وَ لَ أَدْعُو مَعَهُ
إِلَاً وَ لَ أَتَِّذُ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَلِيّاً
segments.transliteration: al-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi alladhÄ« lam yattakhidh waladan wa lam yakun lahu sharÄ«kun
segments.translation:
âI awake and my Lord be praised. I awake without
ascribing anything as a partner to AllÄh, and I do not call upon any other
god with Him, nor do I take any guardian besides Him.â

segments.arabic:
إِذَا أَصْبَحَ قَالَ أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ مَا أَصْبَحَتْ بِ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ
أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ فِ دِينٍ أَوْ دُنْيَا فَإِنَّهَا مِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الَْمْدُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَ لَكَ
الشُّكْرُ كَثِير
segments.transliteration: fÄ« al-mulki al-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi alladhÄ« yaá¹£ifu wa lÄ yÅ«á¹£afu
segments.translation:
âI wake up taking You as my witness that whatever I have awoken with of blessings and wellbeing
in my religion or of this world 

â it is all from You alone, without and
partner. So, all praise belongs to You for this, and plentiful gratitude.â

segments.transliteration: wa yaÊ¿lamu wa lÄ yuÊ¿lamu yaÊ¿lamu khÄÊ¾inata al-Ê¾aÊ¿yuni wa mÄ tukhfÄ« al-á¹£udÅ«ru
segments.translation: I entrust with Allah the Most High, the All-high,

segments.transliteration: Ê¾aÊ¿Å«dhu bi-wajhi AllÄhi al-karÄ«mi wa bi-smi AllÄhi al-Ê¿aáºÄ«mi
segments.translation: the All-majestic, and the All-great

segments.transliteration: min sharri mÄ dharaÊ¾a wa mÄ baraÊ¾a wa min sharri mÄ taá¸¥ta al-tharÃ¡
segments.translation: my self and whatever concerns me.

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri mÄ áºahara wa mÄ baá¹­ana wa min sharri mÄ kÄna
segments.translation: I entrust my self with Allah

segments.transliteration: fÄ« al-layli wa al-nahÄri wa min sharri abÄ« murrata wa mÄ walada
segments.translation: the feared, the dreaded,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri al-rasÄ«si wa min sharri mÄ waá¹£aftu wa mÄ lam aá¹£if
segments.translation: and to Whose greatness all things submit.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِنْدَ إِقْبَالِ لَيْلِكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You at the coming of Your night,
the departure of Your daytime,
the presence of the prayers to You,
and the voices of supplications to You

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.translation: to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
O Allah, (please) include me with Your invulnerable shield
with which You include whomever You want.
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah, who has not taken a son and has no partner

segments.arabic: فِي الْمُلْكِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يَصِفُ وَلَا يُوصَفُ
segments.translation: In the kingdom. Praise be to Allah, who describes and is not described,

segments.arabic: وَيَعْلَمُ وَلَا يُعْلَمُ يَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ
segments.translation: And knows and is not known. He knows the treachery of the eyes and what the hearts conceal.

segments.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation: I seek refuge in the noble countenance of Allah and in the name of Allah, the Great,

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ وَمَا بَرَأَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَحْتَ الثَّرَى
segments.translation: From the evil of what He created and originated, and from the evil of what is beneath the soil,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ظَهَرَ وَمَا بَطَنَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا كَانَ
segments.translation: And from the evil of what is visible and what is hidden, and from the evil of what is

segments.arabic: فِي اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ أَبِي مُرَّةَ وَمَا وَلَدَ
segments.translation: In the night and the day, and from the evil of Abi Murrah and what he begets,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ الرَّسِيسِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا وَصَفْتُ وَمَا لَمْ أَصِفْ
segments.translation: And from the evil of ar-Rasees, and from the evil of what I have described and what I have not described.
So praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

title: Sunset Duas

segments.arabic: وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ.
segments.translation: And sing the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before the setting.
In this evening, my wrongdoing is taking shelter in Your pardon,
my sins are taking shelter in Your forgiveness,
my fear is taking shelter in Your security,
my humility is taking shelter in Your dignity,

segments.transliteration: wa amsa wajhiya albali mustajiran biwajhika aldda'imi albaqi
segments.translation: my poverty is taking shelter in Your richness,

segments.arabic: وَامْسَىٰ وَجْهِيَ ٱلْبَالِي مُسْتَجِيراً بِوَجْهِكَ ٱلدَّائِمِ ٱلْبَاقِي
segments.translation: and my mortal face is taking shelter in Your Face, the Undying and Perpetual.
O Allah, (please) dress me with Your wellbeing,
cover me with Your mercy,

segments.transliteration: wa qini sharra khalqika min aljinni wal-insi
segments.translation: overshadow me with Your honoring,

segments.arabic: وَقِنِي شَرَّ خَلْقِكَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلإِنْسِ
segments.transliteration: ya allahu ya rahmanu ya rahimu
segments.translation: and protect me against the evils of Your creaturesâjinn and men.

segments.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحِيمُ
segments.translation: O Allah! O All-beneficent! O All-merciful!
O He Who has sealed the Prophethood with Muhammad,

segments.transliteration: ikhtim li fi yawmi hadha bikhayrin
segments.translation: Allah may bless him and his Household,

segments.arabic: إِخْتِمْ لِي فِي يَوْمِي هٰذَا بِخَيْرٍ
segments.translation: (please) seal with goodness this day of mine,
this month of mine,
this year of mine,
and my entire lifetime.
I include myself, my family,
my property, and my sons,

segments.transliteration: billahi alladhi la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: both the absent and the present

segments.arabic: بِٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ هُوَ
segments.translation: with Allah save Whom there is no god,
the Knower of the unseen and the seen,
the All-beneficent, the All-merciful,

segments.transliteration: la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawmun
segments.translation: the Ever-living, the Self-subsisting.

segments.transliteration: lahu ma fi alssamawati wa ma fi al-ardi
segments.translation: Slumber does not overtake Him nor sleep.

segments.arabic: لَهُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلارْضِ
segments.transliteration: man dha alladhi yashfa`u `indahu illa bi'idhnihi
segments.translation: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth is His.

segments.arabic: مَنْ ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ
segments.transliteration: ya`lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum
segments.translation: Who is he that can intercede with Him but by His permission?

segments.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ ايْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa la yuhituna bishay'in min `ilmihi illa bima sha'a
segments.translation: He knows what is before them and what is behind them,

segments.arabic: وَلا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ
segments.translation: and they cannot comprehend anything out of His knowledge except what He pleases.
His knowledge extends over the heavens and the earth,
and the preservation of them both tires Him not,
and He is the Most High, the Great.

segments.transliteration: al-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi alladhÄ« lam yattakhidh waladan wa lam yakun lahu sharÄ«kun
segments.translation: In the name of Allah the Beneficent the Merciful.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ لَکَ الْغِنٰی وَ بِیَ الْفَاقَۃُ اِلَیْکَ اَنْتَ الْغَنِیُّ وَ اَنَا الْفَقِیْرُ اِلَیْکَ اَقِلْنِیْ عَثْرَتِیْ وَاسْتُرْ عَلَیَّ ذُنُوْبِیْ وَاقْضِ الْیَوْمَ حَاجَتِیْ وَلاَ تُعَذِّبْنِیْ بِقَبِیْحِ مَا تَعْلَمُ مِنِّیْ بَلْ عَفْوُکَ یَسْعُنِیْ وَ جُوْدُکَ

segments.translation: O Allah Self Sufficiency belongs to You and for me is the dependency in Your Presence You are rich and I am indigent forgive my laxities, conceal my sins, and today fulfill my desires, and whatever sins You are aware of, don't chastise me, but put me in Your mercy and Generosity

segments.arabic: یَا اَہْلَ التَّقْوٰی وَ یَا اَہْلَ الْمَغْفِرَۃِ یَا بَرُّ یَا رَحِیْمُ اَنْتَ اَبَرُّ بِیْ مِنْ اَبِیْ وَ اُمِّیْ وَ مِنْ جَمِیْعٍ الْخَلَآئِقِ اَقْبِسْنِیْ بِقَضَآءِ حَاجَتِیْ مُجَاباً دُعَآئِیْ مَرْحُوْمًا صَوْتِیْ قَدْ کَشَفْتَ اَنْوَاعَ الْبَلاَ یَا عَنِیْ
segments.transliteration: Ê¾aÊ¿Å«dhu bi-wajhi AllÄhi al-karÄ«mi wa bi-smi AllÄhi al-Ê¿aáºÄ«mi
segments.translation: O the center of piety, O the possessor of forgiveness, O the most generous for the doers of good. You are more generous than my father, my mother and the entire universe. Pass my life in fulfilling my desires. Accept my prayers, have mercy on my voice, You have averted various types of difficulties from me.

segments.translation: Praise be to Allah, who has not taken a son and has no partner

segments.arabic: فِي الْمُلْكِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يَصِفُ وَلَا يُوصَفُ

segments.arabic: وَيَعْلَمُ وَلَا يُعْلَمُ يَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ

segments.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation: I seek refuge in the noble countenance of Allah and in the name of Allah, the Great,

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ وَمَا بَرَأَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَحْتَ الثَّرَى
segments.translation: From the evil of what He created and originated, and from the evil of what is beneath the soil,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ظَهَرَ وَمَا بَطَنَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا كَانَ
segments.translation: And from the evil of what is visible and what is hidden, and from the evil of what is

segments.arabic: فِي اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ أَبِي مُرَّةَ وَمَا وَلَدَ
segments.translation: In the night and the day, and from the evil of Abi Murrah and what he begets,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ الرَّسِيسِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا وَصَفْتُ وَمَا لَمْ أَصِفْ
segments.translation: And from the evil of ar-Rasees, and from the evil of what I have described and what I have not described.
So praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

title: Duas for each Time period (hour)of day- Ahlulbayt (as)

segments.translation: O Allah, O Lord of brilliance, greatness,
grandeur, and authority!
You have demonstrated the power as You wished,
bestowed upon Your servants with Your forgiveness,
dominated over them with Your supremacy,
and taught them how to thank Your graces.
O Allah, in the name of `Ali, the well-pleased for the religion,
the well-versed with the judgment and the streams of piety,
and the leader of the pious,

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ فِي ٱلاوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: salli `ala muhammadin wa alihi fi al-awwalina wal-akhirina
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household among the past and the coming generations,
and I present him (i.e. `Ali) as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ …
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: [I beseech You] to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَبِسْتَ بَهَاءَكَ فِي اعْظَمِ قُدْرَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma labista baha'aka fi a`zami qudratika
segments.translation: O Allah, You have dressed Yourself with Your brilliance in the greatest level of Your power.

segments.transliteration: wa safa nuruka fi anwari daw'ika
segments.translation: Your Light has been clear in the most glowing level of Your brightness.
Your knowledge has surpassed Your Screen.

segments.arabic: وَخَلَّصْتَ فِيهِ اهْلَ ٱلثِّقَةِ بِكَ عِنْدَ جُودِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa khallasta fihi ahla alththiqati bika `inda judika
segments.translation: Through it (i.e. knowledge), You have accurately selected those having full trust in You, out of Your magnanimity.
So, exalted by You in Your grandeur

segments.arabic: عُلُوّاً عَظُمَتْ فِيهِ مِنَّتُكَ عَلَىٰ اهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ
segments.translation: with such exaltation due to which Your conferrals upon the people of obedience to You have been immense.

segments.arabic: فَبَاهَيْتَ بِهِمْ اهْلَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ بِمِنَّتِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ
segments.translation: You therefore boasted the inhabitants of Your heavens about Your favoring upon them (i.e. the obedient to You).

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَبِحَقِّ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْكَ اسْالُكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, in the name the regard of al-Hasan, the son of `Ali, with You I beseech You,
and in his name too, I seek Your succor
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَجَبَّرَ فَلاَ عَيْنٌ تَرَاهُ
segments.translation: O He Who is too Omnipotent to be seen by any eye!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَعَظَّمَ فَلاَ تَخْطُرُ ٱلْقُلُوبُ بِكُنْهِهِ
segments.transliteration: ya man ta`azzama fala takhturu alqulubu bikunhihi
segments.translation: O He Who is so Great that hearts cannot even imagine His quiddity!
O most Excellent in favoring!
O most Excellent in condonation!
O most Excellent in pardoning!
O All-magnanimous! O All-generous!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يُشْبِهُهُ شَيْءٌ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
segments.transliteration: ya man la yushbihuhu shay'un min khalqihi
segments.translation: O He none of Whose creatures is like Him!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ مَنَّ عَلَىٰ خَلْقِهِ بِاوْلِيَائِهِ
segments.translation: O He Who has conferred a benefit upon His creatures through His Vicegerents
whom He has accepted for His religion,
through whom He has disciplined His servants,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلَهُمْ حُجَجاً مَنّاً مِنْهُ عَلَىٰ خَلْقِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa ja`alahum hujajan mannan minhu `ala khalqihi
segments.translation: and whom He has made arguments against His creatures, out of His favor!
I beseech You in the name of al-Husayn the son of `Ali,
peace be upon both of them,
the grandson who is subservient to Your pleasure,
sincere in Your religion,
and the signpost on Your Essence;
I thus beseech You in the name of him
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَفَا نُورُكَ فِي اتَمِّ عَظَمَتِكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, very clear is Your Light in Your most perfect greatness.
Very exalted is Your brightness in Your most brilliant glow.

segments.arabic: اسْالُكَ بِنُورِكَ ٱلَّذِي نَوَّرْتَ بِهِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلارَضِينَ
segments.transliteration: as'aluka binurika alladhi nawwarta bihi alssamawati wal-aradina
segments.translation: I beseech You in the name of Your Light by which You have lit up the heavens and the layers of the earth,
annihilated the tyrants,
restored the dead to life,
caused the alive to die,
brought together the scattered,
split the brought together,
perfected the Words,
and established the heavens.

segments.arabic: اسْالُكَ بِحَقِّ وَلِيِّكَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
segments.translation: I beseech You in the name of Your vicegerent, `Ali the son of al-Husayn,
peace be upon both of them,
who defended Your religion
and strove painstakingly for Your sake;
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
O Allah, O Lord of brightness, greatness,
light, grandeur, and authority!
You have practiced omnipotence in the greatness of Your brilliance,
conferred upon Your servants with the favor of Your kindness and mercy,
showed them where Your pleasure lies,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَ لَهُمْ دَلِيلاًَ يَدُلُّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَحَبَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa ja`alta lahum dalilan yadulluhum `ala mahabbatika
segments.translation: and made for them a sign guiding them to Your love,
teaching them the items that You love,
and showing them Your volition.
O Allah, in the name of the regard of Muhammad, the son of `Ali,
peace be upon both of them, with You, I beseech You
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَطُفَ عَنْ إِدْرَاكِ ٱلاوْهَامِ
segments.translation: O He Who is too subtle to be comprehended by illusions!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ كَبُرَ عَنْ مَوْجُودِ ٱلْبَصَرِ
segments.translation: O He Who is too great to be observed by existent sights!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَعَالَىٰ عَنِ ٱلصِّفَاتِ كُلِّهَا
segments.translation: O He Who is too exalted above all attributes!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ جَلَّ عَنْ مَعَانِي ٱللُّطْفِ
segments.translation: O He Who is too majestic above all significances of subtlety
and too subtle above all significances of majesty!

segments.transliteration: as'aluka binuri wajhika wa diya'i kibriya'ika
segments.translation: I beseech You in the name of the light of Your Face and the brightness of Your grandeur
and I beseech You in the name of Your greatness
to grant me salvation from Your Fire.

segments.arabic: وَاسْالُكَ بِحَقِّ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa as'aluka bihaqqi ja`fari bni muhammadin `alayka
segments.translation: I also beseech You in the name of the regard of Ja`far, the son of Muhammad, with You
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَكَبَّرَ عَنِ ٱلاوْهَامِ صُورَتُهُ
segments.translation: O He Whose Figure is too great above all illusions!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَعَالَىٰ عَنِ ٱلصِّفَاتِ نُورُهُ
segments.translation: O He Whose Light is too elevated above attributes!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ قَرُبَ عِنْدَ دُعَاءِ خَلْقِهِ
segments.translation: O He Whose is Nigh when His creatures pray Him!
O He Whom is supplicated by the distressed,
to Whom the afraid have recourse,
asked by the believers,
served by the thankful,
and praised by the sincere!
I beseech You in the name of Your glowing light
and the regard of Musa, the son of Ja`far, with You
through whom I seek nearness to You
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
O Best of all besought ones!
O Best of all givers!
O Best of all asked ones!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ اضَاءَ بِاسْمِهِ ضَوْءُ ٱلنَّهَارِ
segments.transliteration: ya man ada'a bismihi daw'u alnnahari
segments.translation: O He by Whose Name the light of days beams,
the darkness of nights dims,
the heavy rain of floods flows,
and has provided His intimate servants with all prosperity!
O He Whose light has gone up the heavens,
Whose beam has gone up the earth,
and Whose mercy has gone up the east and the west!
O Ample in magnanimity,

segments.arabic: اسْالُكَ بِحَقِّ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَىٰ ٱلرِّضَا
segments.translation: I beseech You in the name of `Ali, the son of Musa, the well-contented,
peace be upon both of them,
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
O He Who, when the distressed prayed Him, responded to them,
when the afraid had recourse with Him, granted them security,
when the obedient served Him, thanked them,
when the believers thanked Him, favored upon them,
when they obeyed Him, safeguarded them,
when they asked Him, gave them,

segments.arabic: وَنَسُوا نِعْمَتَهُ فَلَمْ يُخْلِ شُكْرَهُ مِنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: wa nasu ni`matahu falam yukhli shukrahu min qulubihim
segments.translation: and when they forgot His grace, did not evacuate thanking Him from their hearts;

segments.arabic: وَٱمْتَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ فَلَمْ يَجْعَلِ ٱسْمَهُ مَنْسِيّاً عِنْدَهُمْ
segments.translation: and He favored them when He did not make His Name forgotten by them.
I beseech You in the name of Muhammad, the son of `Ali,
peace be upon both of them,
You conclusive argument,
affluent grace,
and patent course,
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
O He Who is Exalted and thus All-great!
O He Who is All-powerful and thus Omnipotent!
O He Who is Omnipotent and thus All-powerful!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ عَزَّ فَٱسْتَكْبَرَ فِي عِزِّهِ
segments.translation: O He Who is Almighty and thus All-grand in His almightiness!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ عَلَىٰ خَلْقِهِ
segments.translation: O He Who extended the shadow on His creatures!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنِ ٱمْتَنَّ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ
segments.translation: O He Who has conferred upon His servants with favors!
O Mighty and Lord of retribution!

segments.arabic: يَا مُنْتَقِماً بِعِزَّتِهِ مِنْ اهْلِ ٱلشِّرْكِ
segments.transliteration: ya muntaqiman bi`izzatihi min ahli alshshirki
segments.translation: O He Who retaliates upon the people of polytheism by His Might!
I beseech You in the name of `Ali, the son of Muhammad,
peace be upon both of them,
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
O Foremost without having beginning!
O Ultimate without having end!
O Self-Subsisting without there being termination of His eternity!
O Almighty without cessation of His almightiness!

segments.arabic: يَا مُتَسَلِّطاً بِلاَ ضَعْفٍ مِنْ سُلْطَانِهِ
segments.transliteration: ya mutasallitan bila da`fin min sultanihi
segments.translation: O All-powerful without there being weak point in His overpowering!
O All-generous along with perpetuity of His graces!
O Omnipotent and Dignifier of His intimate servants!
O All-aware in His knowledge!
O All-knowledgeable in His power!
O Powerful in His Essence!
I beseech You in the name of al-Hasan, the son of `Ali,
peace be upon both of them,
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَوَحَّدَ بِنَفْسِهِ عَنْ خَلْقِهِ
segments.translation: O He Who has excluded Himself lonely from His creatures!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ غَنِيَ عَنْ خَلْقِهِ بِصُنْعِهِ
segments.translation: O He Who has sufficed Himself from His creatures by His making!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ عَرَّفَ نَفْسَهُ خَلْقَهُ بِلُطْفِهِ
segments.translation: O He Who has introduced Himself to His creatures out of His gentleness!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ سَلَكَ بِاهْلِ طَاعَتِهِ مَرْضَاتَهُ
segments.transliteration: ya man salaka bi'ahli ta`atihi mardatahu
segments.translation: O He Who has led the people of obedience to Him to His pleasure!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ اعَانَ اهْلَ مَحَبَّتِهِ عَلَىٰ شُكْرِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: ya man a`ana ahla mahabbatihi `ala shukrihim
segments.translation: O He Who has helped the people of love for Him to thank Him!
O He Who has conferred upon them with the favor of His religion
and has been kind to them through His rewards!

segments.arabic: اسْالُكَ بِحَقِّ ٱلْخَلَفِ ٱلصَّالِحِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ
segments.translation: I beseech You in the name of the regard of the Righteous Successor, peace be upon him, with You,
implore to You in his name,
and present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
the men of authority whom You have ordered us to obey,

segments.transliteration: wa uli al-arhami alladhina amarta bisilatihim
segments.translation: the kindred by blood whom You have ordered us to connect,

segments.transliteration: wa dhawi alqurba alladhina amarta bimawaddatihim
segments.translation: the relatives whom You have ordered us to love,
the masters whom You have ordered us to recognize their right,

segments.arabic: وَاهْلِ ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلَّذِينَ اذْهَبْتَ عَنْهُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ وَطَهَّرْتَهُمْ تَطْهِيراً
segments.transliteration: wa ahli albayti alladhina adhhabta `anhum alrrijsa wa tahhartahum tathiran
segments.translation: and the People of the House from whom You have removed away filth and whom You have purified with thorough purifying,

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadinâ¦
segments.translation: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ انْتَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta rabbu al`alamina
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the Lord of the Worlds.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ انْتَ ٱلرَّحْمٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta alrrahmanu alrrahimu
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ انْتَ ٱلْعَلِيُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta al`aliyyu alkabiru
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the All-High, the All-great.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ انْتَ مَلِكُ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta maliku yawmi alddini
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the Master of the Judgment Day.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ انْتَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta alghafuru alrrahimu
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ انْتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta al`azizu alhakimu
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the Almighty, the All-wise.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ مِنْكَ بَدْءُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta minka bad'u kulli shay'in
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You, from You is the beginning of all things
and to You do all things return.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ انْتَ لَمْ تَزَلْ وَلاَ تَزَالُ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu alladhi la ilaha illa anta lam tazal wa la tazalu
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You, You have been always existent and You will always be existent.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ انْتَ خَالِقُ ٱلْخَيْرِ وَٱلشَّرِّ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta khaliqu alkhayri walshsharri
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the Creator of good and evil.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ انْتَ خَالِقُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَٱلنَّارِ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta khaliqu aljannati walnnari
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the Creator of Paradise and Hell.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ انْتَ ٱلاحَدُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta al-ahadu alssamadu
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the One and the eternally besought of all.
He begets not nor was begotten

segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu kufwan ahadun
segments.translation: and there is none comparable to Him.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ انْتَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta almaliku alquddusu
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the King, the All-holy,
the Giver of peace, the Granter of security, the Guardian over all,
the Almighty, the Omnipotent, and the Grand.
Glory be to Allah from what they set up with Him.
You are Allah; the Creator, the Originator, and the Fashioner.
Yours are the most excellent names.

segments.arabic: يُسَبِّحُ لَكَ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَوَاتِ وَٱلارْضِ
segments.transliteration: yusabbihu laka ma fi alssamawati wal-ardi
segments.translation: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth declares Your glory;
and You are the Almighty, the All-wise.

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ انْتَ
segments.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
segments.translation: You are Allah; there is no god save You,
the Great, the Most High. Grandeur is Your dress.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ بَلِّغْ مَوْلَانَا فُلَانًا صَلَوَاتُ اللہِ عَلَیْہِ اِنَّنِیْ اُسَلِّمُ عَلَیْہِ وَ اِنَّنِیْ اَتَوَجَّہُ اِلَیْہِ بِاِقْبَالِكَ عَلَیْہِ فِیْ اَنْ یَكُوْنَ خَفَارَتِیْ وَ حِمَایَتِیْ وَ سَلَامَتِیْ وَ كَمَالُ سَعَادَتِیْ ضِمَانَہَا بِكَ عَلَیْہِ حَیْثُ قَدْ تَوَجَّہْتُ فِیْ السَّاعَۃِ الَّتِیْ جَعَلْتَہٗ كَالْـخَفِیْرِ فِیْہَا وَ حَدِیْثِہَا فِیْ ذٰلِكَ اِلَیْہِ.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma balligh mawlaanaa folaanan salawaatul laahe aâlayhe innanee osallemo aâlayhe wa innanee atawajjaho elayhe be-iqbaaleka aâlayhe fee an yakoona khafaaratee wa hemaayatee wa salaamatee wa kamaalo sa-aâadatee zamaanahaa beka aâlayhe hayso qad tawajjahto fis saa-aâtil latee ja-aâltahu kal-khafeere feehaa wa hadeesehaa fee zaaleka elayhe.
segments.translation: O Allah! Convey to our master, so and so, Allahâs blessings be upon him, that I send salutation upon him, and I turn towards him for Your closeness to him, to be my guardian, my protector, my safety and complete happiness because of the guarantee on him by You, certainly when I turned to him in the hour which You have appointed him as the guard in it and protector towards it.

text: Duas for each Time period (hour)of day- Ahlulbayt (as) . Duas Resources Arabic Transliteration Translation Shaykh al-Tusi, Sayyid Ibn Baqi, and Shaykh al-Kaf`ami have divided the day into twelve time periods (called 'hours' but of unequal durations), dedicating each to one of the Twelve Imams (`a) and mentioning an advocacy-seeking supplication (i.e. tawassul) addressed to the Imam of that time period/hour. title: Saturday   Duas.org

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
âIn the name of Allah,â the word of those who hold fast to Him,
the speech of those who seek His protection

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ مِنْ جَوْرِ ٱلْجَائِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu billahi ta`ala min jawri alja'irina
segments.translation: I seek refuge in Allah, high exalted is He, from the injustice of the unjust,
the trickery of the enviers,
and the oppression of the wrongdoers,
and I praise Him beyond the praise of the praisers!
O Allah, You are the One without partner,
and the King without having been made sovereign;
no one opposes You in Your decree
and no one contests You in Your kingdom.
I beseech You to bless Muhammad
Your servant and Your messenger,

segments.transliteration: wa an tuzi`ani min shukri na`maka
segments.translation: inspire me with a thanksgiving for Your favors
that You take to the utmost limit of Your good pleasure,
help me to obey You,
hold fast to worshiping You,
and deserve Your reward,
through the gentleness of Your solicitude

segments.arabic: وَتَرْحَمَنِي وَتَصُدَّنِي عَنْ مَعَاصِيكَ مَا أَحْيَيْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: wa tarhamani wa tasuddani `an ma`asika ma ahyaytani
segments.translation: have mercy upon me, bar me from acts of disobedience to You as long as You keep me alive,

segments.transliteration: wa tuwaffiqani lima yanfa`uni ma abqaytani
segments.translation: give me success in what profits me as long as You spare me,
expand my breast through Your Book,
lessen my burden through its recitation,

segments.transliteration: wa tamnahani alssalamata fi dini wa nafsi
segments.translation: bestow upon me health in my religion and my soul,

segments.transliteration: wa la tuhisha bi ahla unsi
segments.translation: estrange not my intimates from me,

segments.arabic: وَتُتِمَّ إِحْسَانَكَ فِيمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمُرِي
segments.transliteration: wa tutimma ihsanaka fima baqiya min `umri
segments.translation: and complete Your beneficence in what is left of my lifetime,
just as You have shown beneficence in that of it which has passed!
O Most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
O God, open for us the treasures of mercy

segments.arabic: وَ هَبْ لَنَا اللّٰهُمَّ رَحْمَةً لَا تُعَذِّبُنَا بَعْدَهَا فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ،

segments.translation: and bestow upon us that mercy, after which there is no chastisement whether in the world or the hereafter

segments.translation: Through your vast favors  bestow upon us lawful and pure sustenance

segments.transliteration: wa laa tohwijnaa, wa laa tufqirnaa elaa ahadin sewaaka
segments.translation: and other than Yourself, do not make us needful of anyone.

segments.arabic: وَ زِدْنَا بِذٰلِكَ شُكْرًا وَ اِلَيْكَ فَقْرًا وَ فَاقَةً
segments.transliteration: wa zidnaa be-zaaleka shukran wa elayka faqran wa faaqatan
segments.translation: Increase our thankfulness and keep us in need of You and Poor in front of You

segments.translation: and make us needless and respectable to everyone other than You.

segments.arabic: مِنْ تَوَاتُرِ مِنَنِہٖ وَ تَظَاہُرِ نِعَمِہٖ

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ اﷲِ الَّذِیْ یَتَوَکَّلُ کُلُّ مُؤْمِنٍ عَلَیْہِ

segments.translation: Glory be to Allah upon whom every believer relies

segments.arabic: وَلاَ یَسْتَغْنِیْ اَحَدٌ اِلاَّ بِفَضْلِ مَا لَدَیْہِ
segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ yastaghnÄ« aá¸¥adun illÄ bifaá¸li mÄ ladayh
segments.translation: And no one is independent except by His ÙØ¶Ù

segments.translation: There is no god but Allah, who grants respite even to one who turns away

segments.arabic: التَّوَّابُ عَلٰی مَنْ تَابَ اِلَیْہِ مِنْ عَظِیْمِ ذَنْبِہٖ

segments.translation: The Accepter of repentance for one who returns from great sin

segments.translation: Angry with one who despairs of His vast mercy
And loses hope in His immediate relief

segments.arabic: وَاﷲُ اَکْبَرُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَالِكُهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa llÄhu akbar khÄliqu kulli shayâin wa mÄlikuh
segments.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Creator of everything and its Owner

segments.translation: And the One who annihilates and destroys all things

segments.transliteration: Wa llÄhu akbaru kabÄ«ran kamÄ huwa ahluh
segments.translation: Allah is supremely Great as befits Him
And as He deserves

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِکَ وَ نَبِیِّکَ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin Ê¿abdika wa nabiyyik
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad, Your servant and Prophet

segments.arabic: وَ رَسُوْلِکَ وَ اَمِیْنِکَ وَ شَاہِدِکَ
segments.transliteration: Wa rasÅ«lik wa amÄ«nik wa shÄhidik
segments.translation: Your Messenger, Your trustee, and Your witness

segments.arabic: التَّقِیِّ النَّقِیِّ وَ عَلٰی اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: At-taqiyyi n-naqiyyi wa Ê¿alÄ Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: The pious, the pure, and upon the family of Muhammad
The good and purified ones

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُکَ سُؤَالَ مُعْتَرِفٍ بِذَنْبِہٖ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« asâaluka suâÄla muÊ¿tarifin bidhanbih
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You like one who admits his sin
Regretful over committing its consequences

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ اَوْلٰی مَنِ اعْتُمِدَ وَ عُفِيَ
segments.transliteration: Wa anta awlÄ man iÊ¿tumida wa Ê¿ufiya
segments.translation: And You are most worthy to be relied upon and to pardon

segments.arabic: وَ جَادَ بِالْمَغْفِرَةِ مَنْ ظَلَمَ وَ أَسَاءَ
segments.transliteration: Wa jÄda bil-maghfirati man áºalama wa asÄâ
segments.translation: And to grant forgiveness to one who Ø¸ÙÙ and did wrong

segments.arabic: فَقَدْ أَوْبَقَتْنِي الذُّنُوبُ فِي مَهَادِي الْهَلَكَةِ
segments.transliteration: Faqad awbaqatnÄ« dh-dhunÅ«bu fÄ« mahÄdi l-halak
segments.translation: My sins have cast me into the beds of destruction
And sins have surrounded me
And I remain unable to bear them

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْتَ الْمُرْتَجَى وَ عَلَيْكَ مُعَوَّلِي
segments.transliteration: Wa anta l-murtajÄ wa Ê¿alayka muÊ¿awwalÄ«
segments.translation: You are the hoped One and upon You I rely
In hardship and ease
You are the refuge of the fearful drowning one
And more compassionate than any compassionate
And to You I have directed myself

segments.arabic: سَيِّدِي وَ أَنْتَ مُنْتَهَى الْقَصْدِ لِلْقَاصِدِينَ

segments.translation: My Master, You are the ultimate aim of seekers
And the most merciful of those asked for mercy
In Your overlooking of sinners

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ أَنْتَ الَّذِي لَا يَتَعَاظَمُكَ غُفْرَانُ الذُّنُوبِ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma anta alladhÄ« lÄ yataÊ¿Äáºamuka ghufrÄnu dh-dhunÅ«b
segments.translation: O Allah, forgiveness of sins is not difficult for You

segments.arabic: وَ كَشْفُ الْكُرُوبِ وَ أَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
segments.transliteration: Wa kashfu l-kurÅ«b wa anta Ê¿allÄmu l-ghuyÅ«b
segments.translation: Nor is removing distress; You are Knower of the unseen

segments.arabic: وَ سَتَّارُ الْعُيُوبِ وَ كَشَّافُ الْكُرُوبِ
segments.transliteration: Wa sattÄru l-Ê¿uyÅ«b wa kashshÄfu l-kurÅ«b
segments.translation: Concealer of faults and remover of troubles

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّكَ الْبَاقِي الرَّحِيمُ الَّذِي تَسَرْبَلْتَ بِالرُّبُوبِيَّةِ
segments.transliteration: Liâannaka l-bÄqÄ« r-raá¸¥Ä«m alladhÄ« tasarbalta bir-rubÅ«biyyah
segments.translation: For You are the Everlasting, the Merciful, clothed in Lordship
And singular in divinity
And exalted beyond modality
No describer can define You by âhowâ

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَقَعْ فِي الْأَوْهَامِ بِالْمَاهِيَّةِ وَ الْحَيْنُونِيَّةِ
segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ taqaÊ¿ fÄ« l-awhÄm bil-mÄhiyyah wal-á¸¥aynÅ«niyyah
segments.translation: Nor do You fall into imagination by essence or temporality

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ نِعْمَائِكَ عَلَى الْأَنَامِ
segments.transliteration: Falaka l-á¸¥amdu Ê¿adada niÊ¿mÄâika Ê¿alÄ l-anÄm
segments.translation: So to You is praise equal to Your blessings upon creation

segments.transliteration: Wa laka sh-shukru Ê¿alÄ kurÅ«ri l-layÄlÄ« wal-ayyÄm
segments.translation: And to You is thanks through passing nights and days

segments.arabic: اِلٰهِی بِیَدِکَ الْخَیْرُ وَ اَنْتَ وَلِیُّہٗ
segments.transliteration: IlÄhÄ« biyadika l-khayr wa anta waliyyuh
segments.translation: My God, Ø§ÙØ®ÙØ± is in Your hand and You are its guardian
Giver of desires and the ultimate goal of requests
I draw near to You through the vastness of Your mercy

segments.arabic: الَّتِیْ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَقَدْ تَرَى
segments.transliteration: AllatÄ« wasiÊ¿at kulla shayâ faqad tarÄ
segments.translation: Which encompasses everything, and You indeed see

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ مَكَانِي وَ تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ضَمِيرِي
segments.transliteration: YÄ rabb makÄnÄ« wa taá¹­á¹­aliÊ¿u Ê¿alÄ á¸amÄ«rÄ«
segments.translation: My Lord, You see my place and know my inner self

segments.transliteration: Wa taÊ¿lamu sirrÄ« wa lÄ yakhfÄ Ê¿alayka amrÄ«
segments.translation: You know my secret and nothing about me is hidden

segments.transliteration: Wa anta aqrabu ilayya min á¸¥abli l-warÄ«d
segments.translation: You are nearer to me than my jugular vein

segments.translation: So accept my repentance and forgive me
A forgiveness after which I do not return to sin
O Most Generous of the generous

segments.arabic: اِلٰهِی أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَصْلَحْتَ قُلُوبَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
segments.transliteration: IlÄhÄ« anta alladhÄ« aá¹£aá¸¥ta qulÅ«ba l-mufsidÄ«n
segments.translation: My God, You are the One who rectifies corrupt hearts
So rectify me through Your rectification
You bestowed upon the misguided and guided them
You corrected their slips and granted them Your love
And kept them away from disobedience

segments.arabic: وَ أَدْرَجْتَهُمْ فِي دَرَجَاتِ الْمَغْفُورِ لَهُمْ
segments.transliteration: Wa adrajtahum fÄ« darajÄti l-maghfÅ«r lahum
segments.translation: And placed them among the forgiven
And settled them in the station of the successful

segments.transliteration: Fa asâaluka yÄ mawlÄy an tulá¸¥iqanÄ« bihim
segments.translation: So I ask You, my Master, to join me with them
O Most Merciful of the merciful
