segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« asâaluka an tuá¹£alliya Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You to bless Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَرْزُقَنِي رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا
segments.transliteration: Wa an tarzuqanÄ« rizqan wÄsiÊ¿an á¸¥alÄlan á¹­ayyiban
segments.translation: And grant me wide, lawful, pure provision

segments.arabic: فِي عَافِيَةٍ وَ عَمَلًا يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: FÄ« Ê¿Äfiyah wa Ê¿amalan yuqarribunÄ« ilayk
segments.translation: In well-being, and deeds that bring me closer to You
O Best of those who are asked

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ وَ أَتَضَرَّعُ إِلَيْكَ ضَرَاعَةً مُقِرٍّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa ataá¸arraÊ¿u ilayka á¸arÄÊ¿atan muqirr Ê¿alÄ nafsih
segments.translation: O Allah, I humbly plead to You, confessing against myself
For my slips; I repent to You, O Accepter of repentance
Do not return me disappointed, O Bestower
For long You have been generous to sinners with forgiveness
And concealed ugly deeds
O Majestic, O Most High

segments.arabic: أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِمَنْ أَوْجَبْتَ حَقَّهُ عَلَيَّ
segments.transliteration: Atawajjahu ilayka biman awjabta á¸¥aqqahu Ê¿alayya
segments.translation: I turn to You through those whose right You made obligatory

segments.arabic: إِذْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِي مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَا أَتَوَجَّهُ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: Idh lam yakun lÄ« mina l-khayr mÄ atawajjahu bih
segments.translation: As I have no good deeds to present to You

segments.arabic: وَ حَالَتِ الذُّنُوبُ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
segments.transliteration: Wa á¸¥Älat adh-dhunÅ«b baynÄ« wa bayna l-muá¸¥sinÄ«n
segments.translation: And sins have come between me and the righteous

segments.arabic: وَ إِذْ لَمْ يُوجِبْ لِي عَمَلِي مُرَافَقَةَ النَّبِيِّينَ
segments.transliteration: Wa idh lam yÅ«jib lÄ« Ê¿amalÄ« murÄfaqata n-nabiyyÄ«n
segments.translation: And my deeds do not entitle me to the company of prophets
So do not reject my turning, my Master
Will You disappoint me, my Lord, while You are my hope?

segments.arabic: أَمْ تُرَدُّ يَدِي صِفْرًا مِنَ الْعَفْوِ
segments.transliteration: Am turaddu yadÄ« á¹£ifran mina l-Ê¿afw
segments.translation: Or will my hand return empty of forgiveness
While You are the end of my desire

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ مَوْجُودٌ مَوْصُوفٌ مَعْرُوفٌ بِالْجُودِ
segments.transliteration: YÄ man huwa mawjÅ«d mawsÅ«f maÊ¿rÅ«f bil-jÅ«d
segments.translation: O One who exists, described and known by generosity

segments.arabic: وَ الْخَلْقُ لَهُ عَبِيدٌ وَ إِلَيْهِ مَرَدُّ الْأُمُورِ
segments.transliteration: Wal-khalqu lahu Ê¿abÄ«d wa ilayhi maraddu l-umÅ«r
segments.translation: Creation are His servants and to Him return all matters

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: Fa á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And bestow upon me from Your goodness

segments.arabic: الَّذِي فِيهِ الْغِنَى عَنِ الْقَرِيبِ وَ الْبَعِيدِ
segments.transliteration: AlladhÄ« fÄ«hi l-ghinÄ Ê¿ani l-qarÄ«b wal-baÊ¿Ä«d
segments.translation: Which grants independence from near and far
From enemies and brothers
And join me with those whom You enveloped in Your grace

segments.arabic: وَ جَعَلْتَهُمْ أَطَائِبَ أَبْرَارًا أَتْقِيَاءَ أَخْيَارًا
segments.transliteration: Wa jaÊ¿altahum aá¹­Äâiba abrÄran atqiyÄâa akhyÄrÄ
segments.translation: And made them pure, righteous, God-conscious, and chosen

segments.arabic: وَ لِنَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ فِي دَارِكَ جِيرَانًا
segments.transliteration: Wa linabiyyika Muá¸¥ammad fÄ« dÄrik jÄ«rÄnÄ
segments.translation: And neighbors of Your Prophet Muhammad in Your abode

segments.arabic: وَ اغْفِرْ لِي وَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
segments.translation: And forgive me and the believing men and women

segments.arabic: مَعَ الْآبَاءِ وَ الْأُمَّهَاتِ وَ الْإِخْوَانِ وَ الْأَخَوَاتِ
segments.translation: Along with fathers, mothers, brothers, and sisters
O Most Merciful of the merciful

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ash-hadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah;
alone without having any partner;
and I bear witness that you are His messenger
and you are Muhammad, the son of `Abdullah.

segments.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنّكَ قَدْ بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالاتِ رَبِّكَ
segments.transliteration: wa ash-hadu annaka qad ballaghta risalati rabbika
segments.translation: And I bear witness that you have truly conveyed the missions of your Lord,
well-wished for your nation,
striven hard in the way of Allah
by means of wisdom and excellent preaching,
and fulfilled the duty that is incumbent upon you;
and you have been sympathetic with the believers
and unyielding to the unbelievers;
and you have worshipped Allah sincerely
until death came upon you.

segments.arabic: فَبَلَغَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَ أَشْرَفَ مَحَلِّ ٱلْمُكَرَّمِينَ
segments.transliteration: fabalagha allahu bika ashrafa mahalli almukarramina
segments.translation: Allah therefore has lifted you up to the most honorable place of the honored ones.
All praise be to Allah Who has saved us, through you,
from polytheism and deviation.
O Allah, (please) send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,
and make Your blessings, the blessings of Your angels,
Your prophets, the Messengers,
Your righteous servants,
the inhabitants of the heavens and the [layers of the] earth,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ سَبَّحَ لَكَ يَا رَبَّ ٱلعَالَمِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa man sabbaha laka ya rabba al`alamina
segments.translation: and ever one who glorifies You, O Lord of the worlds,
from the past and the late generations,
be on Muhammad, Your servant, messenger,
prophet, trustee,
elite, most-beloved,
elect, choice,
dignitary, select,
and the best of Your creatures.
And grant him preference, virtue,
[right of] mediation, and sublime rank;
and send him a praiseworthy status
which all the past and the late generations wish to have.
O Allah, You have said:

segments.transliteration: wa law annahum idh zalamu anfusahum
segments.translation: âAnd had they, when they were unjust to themselves,
come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah,
and the Messenger had also asked forgiveness for them,
they would have found Allah Oft-returning to mercy, Merciful.â
O my God, I have come to Your Prophet, seeking forgiveness of You
and repenting before You from my sins;
so, (please) send blessings to Muhammad and his Household
and forgive them for me.
O our master,
I turn by you and by your Household

segments.transliteration: ila allahi ta`ala rabbika wa rabbi
segments.translation: towards Allah, the Exalted, your and my Lord,
so that He may forgive me.

segments.transliteration: inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji`una
segments.translation: Verily, we are Allah's and verily unto Him shall we return.
We are stricken by losing you, O beloved of our hearts!
Too shocking is our misfortune of losing you!
Because the Revelation has been interrupted
and because we have missed you.

segments.transliteration: fa inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji`una
segments.translation: Nevertheless, we are Allahâs and to Him shall we return.
O our master, O Allahâs Messenger!

segments.arabic: صَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ بَيْتِكَ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: salawatu allahi `alayka wa `ala ali baytika alttahirina
segments.translation: May Allahâs blessings be upon you and upon your Household, the immaculate.

segments.transliteration: hadha yawmu alssabti wa huwa yawmuka
segments.translation: This day is Saturday, which is your day,

segments.transliteration: wa ana fihi dayfuka wa jaruka
segments.translation: and on this day I am your guest and in your vicinity;
so, receive me as your guest and as your neighbor.
Indeed, you are generous and hospitable
and you are commanded [by Allah] to host your neighbors.
So, receive me as your guest and treat me hospitably;
and accept us as your neighbors and treat us in due hospitability;

segments.arabic: بِمَنْزِلَةِ ٱللَّهِ عِنْدَكَ وَعِنْدَ آلِ بَيْتِكَ
segments.translation: [I ask you] in the name of Allahâs standing with you and with your Household
and in the name of their standing with Him
and in the name of the knowledge that He has entrusted with you all.
Verily, He is the most generous of all those who show generosity.
In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Glory be to the God of truth.
Glory be to The Constrictor and the Outspreader.
Glory be to Him Who can expose anyone to loss or gain.
Glory be to the Judge with the truth.
Glory be to Him and to glorify Him is one of His graces.
Glory be to the Highest, the All-high.
Glory be to who has exalted in the air;
Glory be to Him, and most Exalted He be.
Glory be to The magnificent and beautiful.
Glory be to The All-Merciful and The Ever-Compassionate.
Glory be to The Creator and the Maker.
Glory be to The all Sufficient and the Praised.
Glory be to The highest and elevated.
Glory be to The Great and The Greatest.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ هَكَذَا وَ لَا يَكُونُ هَكَذَا غَيْرُهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who is in this state, and nothing else can be ever in his state.
Glorified (is He), Holy (is He), for Him the Living and the Forbearing.
Glory be to Allah, the Supreme!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ دَائِمٌ لَا يَسْهُو
segments.translation: Praise be to He! Glory be to him Who is alert and steady; never forgets one thing over another.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ قَائِمٌ لَا يَلْهُو
segments.translation: Glory be to him Who is vigilant; never is engrossed with a thing to overlook another.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ غَنِيٌّ لَا يَفْتَقِرُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him, Who is Independent that doesn't need.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ تَوَاضَعَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ لِعَظَمَتِهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to He who before his greatness everything bows.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ ذَلَّ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ لِعِزَّتِهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to He who before his might everything overshadows.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ (اسْتَسْلَمَ‏) كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ لِقُدْرَتِهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to him who everything surrenders for his power.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَضَعَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ لِمُلْكِهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to him who everything obeyed to his kingdom.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنِ انْقَادَتْ لَهُ الْأُمُورُ بِأَزِمَّتِهَا
segments.translation: Glory be to him who all things follow His charge.
In the Name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate,

segments.arabic: ‏ أُعِيذُ نَفْسِي بِاللهِ الَّذِي‏ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
segments.translation: I seek protection for myself in Allah, whom There is no god except Him, the living, the Everlasting.
Neither slumber overtakes Him nor sleep.

segments.arabic: لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ
segments.translation: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth.

segments.arabic: مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ
segments.translation: Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His permission?

segments.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ
segments.translation: He knows what is before them and what is behind them,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء
segments.translation: and they cannot grasp any of His knowledge except as He wills.
His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
segments.translation: and their preservation does not burden Him. He is the Highest, the Great.

segments.arabic: كَذَلِكَ اللهُ رَبُّنَا وَ سَيِّدُنَا وَ مَوْلَانَا
segments.translation: Allah, the One, the Refuge, has not begotten and has not been begotten,

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ نُورُ النُّورِ وَ مُدَبِّرُ الْأُمُورِ
segments.translation: and equal to Him is not anyone, Light of the Light and the Regulator of affairs,
the Light of the heavens and the earth.

segments.arabic: مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكاةٍ فِيها مِصْباحٌ الْمِصْباحُ
segments.translation: The likeness of His Light is as a niche wherein is a lamp,

segments.arabic: فِي زُجاجَةٍ الزُّجاجَةُ كَأَنَّها كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ
segments.translation: the lamp in a glass, the glass as it were a glittering star
kindled from a Blessed Tree, an olive
that is neither of the East nor of the West,

segments.arabic: يَكادُ زَيْتُها يُضِيءُ وَ لَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نارٌ
segments.translation: whose oil well nigh would shine, even if no fire touched it.

segments.arabic: نُورٌ عَلى‏ نُورٍ يَهْدِي اللهُ لِنُورِهِ مَنْ يَشاءُ
segments.translation: Light upon Light God guides to His Light whom He will.
And God strikes similitudes for men,
and God has knowledge of everything.
He created the heavens and the earth

segments.arabic: بِالْحَقِّ وَ يَوْمَ يَقُولُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
segments.translation: by truth and the day, He says, Be, and it is

segments.arabic: قَوْلُهُ الْحَقُّ وَ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ
segments.translation: His saying is the truth, and to Him belongs the kingdom on the day when the trumpet are blown

segments.arabic: عالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَ الشَّهادَةِ وَ هُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ
segments.translation: He is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He is the All-wise, the All-Aware.

segments.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَماواتٍ طِباقاً وَ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ
segments.translation: He created seven heavens, and they are like the earth.
Therefore, the Command descends through them so;

segments.arabic: لِتَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللهَ عَلى‏ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.translation: that you may know that God is capable of everything.

segments.arabic: وَ أَنَّ اللهَ قَدْ أَحاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ عِلْماً
segments.translation: And that God Encompasses everything in knowledge
and has numbered everything in numbers.

segments.arabic: (وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرِّ مُعْلِنٍ بِهِ أَوْ مُسِرٍّ (مُسْتَتِرٍ
segments.translation: (I seek protection) from; the evil of everything possessed of evil, whether openly or secretly,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ الْجِنَّةِ وَ الْبَشَرِ
segments.translation: the evil of jinn and man,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَظْهَرُ بِاللَّيْلِ وَ يَكْمُنُ بِالنَّهَارِ
segments.translation: and the evil of what flies at night and rests during the day,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ طَوَارِقِ اللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ
segments.translation: and from the evils of the night and day

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ الْحَمَّامَاتِ وَ الْحُشُوشَ
segments.translation: and from the evils of that which descends into the bathrooms and the lawn

segments.arabic: وَ الْخَرَابَاتِ وَ الْأَوْدِيَةَ وَ الصَّحَارِيَ
segments.translation: and the evil which lives in; ruins, valleys, desserts,

segments.arabic: وَ الغِيَاضَ وَ الشَّجَرَ وَ يَكُونُ فِي الْأَنْهَارِ
segments.translation: jungles and trees, and from that which is in rivers.

segments.arabic: وَ أُعِيذُ نَفْسِي وَ مَنْ يَعْنِينِي أَمْرُهُ بِالله
segments.translation: I seek the protection of Allah,

segments.arabic: ِ‏ مالِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشاءُ
segments.translation: Master of the Kingdom, You give the Kingdom to whom Your wilt
and seizest the Kingdom from whom You wilt.

segments.arabic: وَ تُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشاءُ وَ تُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشاءُ
segments.translation: You honor whomever you will and humiliate whomever you will

segments.arabic: بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ إِنَّكَ عَلى‏ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.translation: In Your hand is the good. You are influential over everything.

segments.arabic: تُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهارِ وَ تُولِجُ النَّهارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ
segments.translation: You make the night to enter into the day, and You make the day to enter into the night.

segments.arabic: وَ تُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَ تُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ
segments.translation: You bring forth the living from the dead and the dead from the living

segments.arabic: وَ تَرْزُقُ مَنْ تَشاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسابٍ
segments.translation: and provide whomsoever wilt without reckoning.
To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth.
He stretches out His provision to whom He will.

segments.arabic: وَ يَقْدِرُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ عَلِيمٌ
segments.translation: Indeed He has knowledge of everything.
(I seek protection) from the One Who created the earth and the high heavens.
The All-compassionate seated himself upon the Throne.

segments.arabic: لَهُ ما فِي السَّماواتِ وَ ما فِي الْأَرْضِ
segments.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens, earth,

segments.arabic: وَ ما بَيْنَهُما وَ ما تَحْتَ الثَّرى‏
segments.translation: all that is between them, and all that is underneath the soil.

segments.arabic: وَ إِنْ تَجْهَرْ بِالْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَ أَخْفى‏ اللهُ
segments.translation: You be loud in Your speech, yet surely He knows the secret and that still more hidden.

segments.arabic: لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهُ الْأَسْماءُ الْحُسْنى‏ لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَ الْأَمْرُ
segments.translation: Allah-there is no god save He. To Him belong the Most New Beautiful Names, creation, and the Command.

segments.arabic: مُنْزِلُ التَّوْرَاةِ وَ الْإِنْجِيلِ وَ الزَّبُورِ وَ الْفُرْقَانِ الْعَظِيمُ
segments.translation: The revealer of the Torah, the Gospels (al-Injil), the Zabur, and the Mighty Furqan,

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَاغٍ وَ بَاغٍ وَ نَافِثٍ وَ شَيْطَانٍ
segments.translation: from the evil of every tyrant and oppressor, demon,

segments.arabic: وَ سُلْطَانٍ وَ سَاحِرٍ وَ كَاهِنٍ وَ نَاظِرٍ وَ طَارِقٍ
segments.translation: ruler, enchanter, soothsayer, watcher, nocturnal visitor,

segments.arabic: وَ مُتَحَرِّكٍ وَ سَاكِنٍ وَ مُتَكَلِّمٍ وَ سَاكِتٍ
segments.translation: everything moving or still, and speaking and silent,

segments.arabic: وَ نَاطِقٍ وَ صَامِتٍ وَ مُتَخَيِّلٍ وَ مُتَمَثِّلٍ
segments.translation: and speaking, and silent, and imaginary and assimilated

segments.arabic: وَ مُتَلَوِّنٍ‏) وَ مُحْتَقِرٍ (وَ مُتَجَبِّرٍ) وَ نَسْتَجِيرُ )
segments.translation: apparent, changeable, or varying.

segments.arabic: بِاللهِ حِرْزِنَا وَ نَاصِرِنَا وَ مُونِسِنَا وَ هُوَ يَدْفَعُ عَنَّا
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, your Protector and Helper, and Solace. He will defend you.

segments.arabic: لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ لَا مُعِزَّ لِمَنْ أَذَلَّ
segments.translation: He has no partner. There is no one to elevate the one.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا مُذِلَّ لِمَنْ أَعَزَّ وَ هُوَ الْواحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
segments.translation: He abases nor anyone to abase the one He elevates. He is the One, the Subduer,

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and may Allah's peace be upon our master Muhammad
and his pure family.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَ لَكَ الْمُلْكُ
segments.translation: O, Allah, for You the praise and the kingdom.

segments.arabic: وَ بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ وَ أَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.translation: In Your Hand is all good, and You have the power over all things.
Glory be to You, for You the praise

segments.arabic: وَ التَّهْلِيلُ وَ التَّكْبِيرُ وَ التَّمْجِيدُ وَ التَّحْمِيدُ
segments.translation: and Tahlil, magnification, glorification, gratitude,

segments.arabic: وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَ الْجَبَرُوتُ وَ الْمَلَكُوتُ وَ الْعَظَمَةُ
segments.translation: pride, force, dominion, greatness,

segments.arabic: وَ الْعُلُوُّ وَ الْوَقَارُ وَ الْجَمَالُ وَ الْعِزَّةُ وَ الْجَلَالُ
segments.translation: highness, solemnity, beauty, mightiness, majesty,

segments.arabic: وَ الْغَايَةُ وَ السُّلْطَانُ وَ الْمَنَعَةُ وَ الْعِزَّةُ وَ الْحَوْلُ
segments.translation: the aim, control, strength, Glory, solidity,

segments.arabic: وَ الْقُوَّةُ وَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةُ وَ الْخَلْقُ وَ الْأَمْرُ
segments.translation: power, the world, hereafter, the creation and the command
blessed and exalted be You, Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: وَ تَعَالَيْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَ لَكَ الْبَهْجَةُ
segments.translation: Glory be to You, for You, the praise and; pleasantness,

segments.arabic: وَ الْجَمَالُ وَ الْبَهَاءُ وَ النُّورُ وَ الْوَقَارُ
segments.translation: gorgeousness, elegance, illumination, solemnity,

segments.arabic: وَ الْكَمَالُ وَ الْعِزَّةُ وَ الْجَلَالُ وَ الْفَضْلُ
segments.translation: perfection, mightiness, majesty, grace,

segments.arabic: وَ الْإِحْسَانُ وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَ الْجَبَرُوتُ
segments.translation: goodwill, pride, mightiness,
and stretched mercy and wellness.

segments.arabic: وَ وُلِّيتَ الْحَمْدَ (وَحْدَكَ‏) لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
segments.translation: You fulfilled (only you) for the praise;
You alone, who has no associate, You are Allah, nothing is like You.

segments.arabic: فَسُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ وَ أَعَزَّ سُلْطَانَكَ
segments.translation: Therefore Glory be to you, how mighty is Your station, how treasured is Your authority,
how great is Your force.
Therefore, Glory be to You,

segments.arabic: الْخَلْقُ كُلُّهُمْ لَكَ وَ قَامَ الْخَلْقُ كُلُّهُمْ بِكَ
segments.translation: all the creation glorifies You, stood up by You,

segments.arabic: وَ أَشْفَقَ الْخَلْقُ كُلُّهُمْ مِنْكَ وَ ضَرَعَ الْخَلْقُ
segments.translation: frightened by You, and supplicated by you.

segments.arabic: كُلُّهُمْ إِلَيْكَ وَ سُبْحَانَكَ تَسْبِيحاً يَنْبَغِي لَكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to you, with a glorification indeed to You

segments.arabic: وَ لِوَجْهِكَ وَ يَبْلُغُ مُنْتَهَى عِلْمِكَ
segments.translation: and Your Being; reaches your knowledge's end,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يَقْصُرُ دُونَ أَفْضَلِ رِضَاكَ
segments.translation: doesn't fail your splendid satisfaction

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يَفْضُلُهُ شَيْ‏ءٌ مِنْ مَحَامِدِ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: and not preferred by your laudation creation.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ خَلَقْتَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ إِلَيْكَ مَعَادُهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to you, You created everything that; for you will be returned,

segments.arabic: وَ بَدَأْتَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ إِلَيْكَ مُنْتَهَاهُ
segments.translation: started everything that; to you will end,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْشَأْتَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ إِلَيْكَ مَصِيرُهُ
segments.translation: originated everything that; will be destined to you,
and you are the most merciful of the merciful ones.

segments.arabic: بِأَمْرِكَ ارْتَفَعَتِ السَّمَاءُ وَ وُضِعَتِ الْأَرَضُونَ
segments.translation: In your order, the heavens rose, the earth delivered,

segments.arabic: وَ أُرْسِيَتِ الْجِبَالُ وَ سُجِّرَتِ الْبُحُورُ
segments.translation: firmed the mountains, made the seas overflow;
therefore, your authority is above every kingdom.
Therefore, blessed you are by your mercy, exalted you are by your clemency,
glorified You are in your solemnity place.
Praising are for Your clemency,
glorification for your graces,

segments.arabic: وَ لَكَ الْحَوْلُ بِقُوَّتِكَ  وَ لَكَ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ
segments.translation: solidity for your strength, pride in your greatness.

segments.arabic: بِعَظَمَتِكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَ الْجَبَرُوتُ بِسُلْطَانِكَ
segments.translation: For your authority the praise and strength,

segments.arabic: وَ لَكَ الْمَلَكُوتُ بِعِزَّتِكَ وَ لَكَ الْقُدْرَةُ بِمُلْكِكَ
segments.translation: Your might for your kingdom, the ability in your authority,

segments.arabic: وَ لَكَ الرِّضَا بِأَمْرِكَ وَ لَكَ الطَّاعَةُ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: the satisfaction by your command, and obedience upon your creation;

segments.arabic: أَحْصَيْتَ‏ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَداً وَ أَحَطْتَ‏ بِكُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ عِلْماً
segments.translation: counted everything in numbers, encompass all things with knowledge,

segments.arabic: وَ وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ رَحْمَةً وَ أَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
segments.translation: embracest everything in mercy, and are the most merciful of the merciful ones;
Mightiness is great; authority is well-beloved,

segments.arabic: قَوِيُّ الْبَطْشِ مَلِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ
segments.translation: punishment is severe; the king of the heavens and earth,
the Lord of all the worlds; The Lord of the great Throne,
and favorite angels praising
night and day; without showing sluggishness.

segments.arabic: فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ أَبَدَ الْآبِدِ
segments.translation: Therefore, Glory be to Him who never dies,

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ أَبَدَ الْآبِدِ
segments.translation: Glory be to the ever Lord of Majesty,

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ الْقُدُّوسِ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ أَبَدَ الْآبِدِ
segments.translation: Glory be to the ever holy majesty,

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَ الرُّوحِ
segments.translation: Lord, Glory be to the Lord of the Angles and heavenly spirits.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى سُبْحَانَ رَبِّي وَ تَعَالَى
segments.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Highest. Glory be to my Lord, the exalted.
Glory be to Him, who is His throne in the heavens
and his power (satisfaction) on earth.

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي فِي الْقُبُورِ قَضَاؤُهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah Whose decree is in the graves.

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي فِي الْجَنَّةِ رِضَاهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, Whose pleasure is in paradise.

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي فِي الْبَحْرِ سَبِيلُهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, Who surfaced a path over the ocean!

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي فِي جَهَنَّمَ سُلْطَانُهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, Who has the mightiness in hell!
Glory be to Allah Whose mercy overtakes His Wrath.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَهُ‏ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِالْإِبْكَارِ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah when ye enter evening, Glory be to Allah when ye enter the morning.

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَهُ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ عَزَّ وَجْهُهُ وَ نَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ
segments.translation: Glory and Praise for His almightiness being; who granted His servant victory,

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَا اسْمُهُ وَ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَقَدَّسَ فِي مَجْلِسِ وَقَارِهِ وَ كُرْسِيِّ عَرْشِهِ
segments.translation: exalted and blessed His name, hallowed You are in your solemnity place and throne chair.

segments.arabic: يَرَى كُلَّ عَيْنٍ وَ لَا تَرَاهُ كُلُّ عَيْنٍ
segments.translation: Sees every eye; neither eye can see Him!

segments.arabic: وَ يُدْرِكُ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ لا تُدْرِكُهُ الْأَبْصارُ
segments.translation: He is Comprehending everything while visions cannot comprehend Him,

segments.arabic: وَ هُوَ يُدْرِكُ الْأَبْصارَ وَ هُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ
segments.translation: yet He comprehends all visions! He is the Knower of subtleties, the Aware.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُولِكَ  وَ نَبِيِّكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad, Your servant, messenger, and prophet;

segments.arabic: أَمْراً اخْتَصَصْتَنَا بِهِ دُونَ مَنْ عَبَدَ غَيْرَكَ وَ تَوَلَّى سِوَاكَ
segments.translation: a matter you distinguished us, excluding them who worships and embraces other than You.

segments.arabic: وَ صَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ بِمَا انْتَجَبْتَ لَهُ مِنْ
segments.translation: Therefore, Allah's blessings upon him with what you;

segments.arabic: رِسَالَتِكَ وَ أَكْرَمْتَهُ بِهِ مِنْ نُبُوَّتِكَ
segments.translation: distinguished him from your message and dignified him from your prophecy.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا النَّظَرَ   إِلَى وَجْهِهِ
segments.translation: Do not deprive us of; looking to his face,

segments.arabic: وَ الْكَوْنَ مَعَهُ فِي دَارِكَ وَ مُسْتَقَرٍّ مِنْ جِوَارِكَ
segments.translation: being with him in Your home, residing at your safeguard.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا أَرْسَلْتَهُ فَبَلَّغَ وَ حَمَّلْتَهُ
segments.translation: O, Allah, as you sent him, he informed and charged him with he delivered;
until your authority has been shown

segments.arabic: وَ آمَنَ بِكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
segments.translation: and believed in you, no partner with you.

segments.arabic: فَضَاعِفِ اللَّهُمَّ ثَوَابَهُ وَ كَرَمَهُ بِقُرْبِهِ
segments.translation: Therefore, O, Allah duplicates his reward and salutes him by your closeness,

segments.arabic: مِنْكَ‏ كَرَامَةً يُفَضَّلُ بِهَا عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: a preferred dignity above all Your creation,

segments.arabic: وَ يَغْبِطُهُ بِهِ الْأَوَّلُونَ وَ الْآخَرُونَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segments.translation: which the past and last generations of your worshippers will wish to have.

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ مَثْوَانَا مَعَهُ فِيمَا لَا ظَعْنَ لَهُ مِنْهُ
segments.translation: Make our abode with him, where there is no leave from it,
O, Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah: send blessings upon Muhammad and His Household,

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَوْلِكَ وَ قُوَّتِكَ وَ طَوْلِكَ وَ مَنِّكَ
segments.translation: and I ask You by your; might, power, graciousness, generosity,

segments.arabic: وَ عَظِيمِ مُلْكِكَ وَ جَلَالِ ذِكْرِكَ وَ كِبَرِ مَجْدِكَ
segments.translation: great kingdom, majestic reputation, splendid glorious,

segments.arabic: وَ عِظَمِ سُلْطَانِكَ وَ لُطْفِ جَبَرُوتِكَ
segments.translation: great power, lenity mightiness,

segments.arabic: وَ تَجَبُّرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَ حِلْمِ عَفْوِكَ وَ تَحَنُّنِ رَحْمَتِكَ
segments.translation: displays Your overwhelming power greatness, clemency pardon, tender mercy,

segments.arabic: وَ تَمَامِ كَلِمَاتِكَ وَ نَفَاذِ أَمْرِكَ
segments.translation: complete words, and execution of Your command;

segments.arabic: وَ رُبُوبِيَّتِكَ الَّتِي دَانَ لَكَ بِهَا كُلُّ ذِي رُبُوبِيَّةٍ
segments.translation: Your Lordship, which each believer embraces,

segments.arabic: وَ أَطَاعَكَ بِهَا كُلُّ ذِي طَاعَةٍ
segments.translation: obeyed by every obeyance,

segments.arabic: وَ تَقَرُّبٍ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ كُلُّ ذِي رَغْبَةٍ فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ
segments.translation: each of desire your pleasure will seek its nearness

segments.arabic: وَ يَلُوذُ بِهَا كُلُّ ذِي رَهْبَةٍ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ
segments.translation: and each of fear your displeasure will resort to it.

segments.arabic: أَنْ تَرْزُقَنِي فَوَاتِحَ الْخَيْرِ وَ خَوَاتِمَهُ وَ ذَخَائِرَهُ
segments.translation: So do bless me with goodness beginning, finale, supply,

segments.arabic: وَ جَوَائِزَهُ (وَ فَوَاضِلَهُ) وَ فَضَائِلَهُ وَ خَيْرَهُ وَ نَوَافِلَهُ
segments.translation: rewards, benefits, reasonable, and support.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah: send blessings upon Muhammad and His Household,

segments.arabic: وَ اهْدِ بِالْيَقِينِ مُعْلَنَنَا وَ أَصْلِحْ بِالْيَقِينِ
segments.translation: guide our declared one by certainty, reform our secrets thought by certainty,

segments.arabic: سَرَائِرَنَا وَ اجْعَلْ قُلُوبَنَا مُطْمَئِنَّةً إِلَى ذِكْرِكَ
segments.translation: make our hearts entirely tranquil to your mention
and our deeds sincerely intended for You.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah: send blessings upon Muhammad and His Household,

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ الرِّبْحَ مِنَ التِّجَارَةِ الَّتِي لَا تَبُورُ
segments.translation: I ask You for; commerce that comes not to naught,

segments.arabic: وَ الْغَنِيمَةَ مِنَ الْأَعْمَالِ الْخَالِصَةِ الْفَاضِلَةِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
segments.translation: benefit in this worldly existence and hereafter from the immaculate gracefully deeds,

segments.arabic: وَ الذِّكْرَ الْكَثِيرَ لَكَ وَ الْعَفَافَ وَ السَّلَامَةَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَ الْخَطَايَا
segments.translation: the heavy mention of You, chasteness and safety from the vices and sins.
O, Allah, bless me with blameless accepted works

segments.arabic: تَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا وَ تُسَهِّلَ لَنَا سَكْرَةَ الْمَوْتِ
segments.translation: that make You pleased upon us with and ease the agony of death
and the intense horror of the Resurrection Day.
O, Allah, we ask You for the special goodness

segments.arabic: وَ عَامَّتَهُ لِخَاصِّنَا وَ عَامِّنَا وَ الزِّيَادَةَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
segments.translation: and the general for both of us, unique and regular, increasing your sustenance;

segments.arabic: فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ وَ لَيْلَةٍ وَ النَّجَاةَ مِنْ عَذَابِكَ
segments.translation: every day and night and deliverance from Your torture
and winning your mercy.
O, Allah makes us love meeting You,
reward us witnessing your face,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي لِقَائِكَ‏ نَضْرَةً وَ سُرُوراً
segments.translation: and make us meet You with ease and happiness.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah: send blessings upon Muhammad and His Household,

segments.arabic: وَ أَحْضِرْنَا ذِكْرَكَ عِنْدَ كُلِّ غَفْلَةٍ
segments.translation: gain us your mention in every distraction time,

segments.arabic: وَ شُكْرَكَ عِنْدَ كُلِّ نِعْمَةٍ وَ الصَّبْرَ عِنْدَ كُلِّ بَلَاءٍ
segments.translation: thank you in every blessing, patience on every misfortune,

segments.arabic: وَ ارْزُقْنَا قُلُوباً وَجِلَةً مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ خَاشِعَةً
segments.translation: and bless us with quake hearts in your dread;
devoted to Your mention and repentant to You!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah: send blessings upon Muhammad and His Household,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يُوفِي بِعَهْدِكَ وَ يُؤْمِنُ بِوَعْدِكَ
segments.translation: make us among them who fulfill your promises, believe in your words,

segments.arabic: وَ يَعْمَلُ بِطَاعَتِكَ وَ يَسْعَى فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ
segments.translation: work on Your obeying, aim at your excellent pleasure,

segments.arabic: وَ يَرْغَبُ‏ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ وَ يَفِرُّ إِلَيْكَ مِنْكَ
segments.translation: wants what You have, escape from You to You,

segments.arabic: وَ يَرْجُو أَيَّامَكَ (أَمَانَكَ‏) وَ يَخَافُ سُؤ َ حِسَابِكَ
segments.translation: anticipate your days, fear Your Day of Reckoning,

segments.arabic: وَ يَخْشَاكَ حَقَّ خَشْيَتِكَ وَ اجْعَلْ ثَوَابَ أَعْمَالِنَا
segments.translation: fear You with dread, make our deeds reward

segments.arabic: جَنَّتَّكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَ تَجَاوَزْ عَنْ ذُنُوبِنَا بِرَأْفَتِكَ
segments.translation: Your heaven with Your mercy, overlook our sins with your mercifulness,

segments.arabic: وَ أَعِذْنَا مِنْ ظُلْمَةِ خَطَايَانَا بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ
segments.translation: we seek refuge in Allah from the darkness of our sins with Your illuminance face,

segments.arabic: وَ تَغَمَّدْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَ أَلْبِسْنَا عَافِيَتَكَ
segments.translation: encompass us with your benefits, veil us with your wellness,

segments.arabic: وَ هَنِّئْنَا كَرَامَتَكَ وَ أَتْمِمْ عَلَيْنَا نِعْمَتَكَ
segments.translation: felicitate us with Your miracles, complete for us Your favors,
and give as due share on praising Your mercy.
May it be so Allah of Truth, Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ
segments.translation: Allah's blessings upon our Master Muhammad are the seal of the prophets
and his immaculate household.

title: Sunday   Duas.org

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-compassionate, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ أَرْجُو إِلاَّ فَضْلَهُ
segments.transliteration: bismillahi alladhi la arju illa fadlahu
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, from whom I hope for nothing but bounty,
I fear nothing but justice,
I rely upon nothing but His word,
and I cling to nothing but His Rope.

segments.arabic: بِكَ أَسْتَجِيـرُ يَا ذَا ٱلْعَفْوِ وَٱلرِّضْوَانِ
segments.translation: In You do I seek sanctuaryâ O Possessor of pardon and good pleasureâ
from wrong and enmity,
from the vicissitudes of time
from recurrence of sorrows,
from the striking of mishaps,

segments.arabic: وَمِنِ ٱنْقِضَاءِ ٱلْمُدَّةِ قَبْلَ ٱلتَّأَهُّبِ وَٱلْعُدَّةِ
segments.transliteration: wa min inqida'i almuddati qabla altta'ahhubi wal`uddati
segments.translation: and from the expiration of the term before preparation and readiness.

segments.arabic: وَإِيَّاكَ أَسْتَرْشِدُ لِمَا فيهِ ٱلصَّلاَحُ وَٱلإِصْلاَحُ
segments.transliteration: wa iyyaka astarshidu lima fihi alssalahu wal-islahu
segments.translation: From You do I seek guidance to that wherein is righteousness and setting aright.

segments.arabic: وَبِكَ أَسْتَعينُ فيمَا يَقْتَرِنُ بِهِ ٱلنَّجَاحُ وَٱلإِنْجَاحُ
segments.transliteration: wa bika asta`inu fima yaqtarinu bihi alnnajahu wal-injahu
segments.translation: From You do I seek help in that which is linked to success and favorable response.

segments.arabic: وَإِيَّاكَ أَرْغَبُ فِي لِبَاسِ ٱلْعَافِيَةِ وَتَمَامِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa iyyaka arghabu fi libasi al`afiyati wa tamamiha
segments.translation: From You do I desire for the garment of wellbeing and its completion,
and the covering of health and its permanence.

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ ٱلشَّيَاطينِ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika ya rabbi min hamazati alshshayatini
segments.translation: I seek refuge in You, O my Lord, from the evil suggestions of the devils.

segments.arabic: وَ أَحْتَرِزُ بِسُلْطَانِكَ مِنْ جَوْرِ ٱلسَّلاَطِينِ
segments.transliteration: wa ahtarizu bisultanika min jawri alssalatini
segments.translation: I seek protection in Your sovereignty from the injustice of the sovereigns.

segments.arabic: فَتَقَبَّلْ مَا كَانَ مِنْ صَلاَتِي وَصَوْمِي
segments.transliteration: fataqabbal ma kana min salati wa sawmi
segments.translation: So, (please) accept my past prayers and fasting,

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ غَدِي وَمَا بَعْدَهُ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ سَاعَتِي وَيَوْمِي
segments.transliteration: waj`al ghadi wa ma ba`dahu afdala min sa`ati wa yawmi
segments.translation: make my morrow and what is after it better than my present hour and my day,
exalt me in my clan and people,
and protect me in my waking and sleep,
for You are Allah, the Best Guardian,
and You are the most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَبْرَأُ إِلَيْكَ فِي يَوْمِي هٰذَا
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni abra'u ilayka fi yawmi hadha
segments.translation: O Allah, I repudiate, before You on this day of mine
and on all Sundays that follow it,
polytheism and atheism.
I devote my supplication sincerely to You,
addressing myself to Your response.
I observe the acts of obedience to You
for hope of gaining Your rewards.
So, (please) bless Muhammad, the best of Your creation
and the caller to Your truth,

segments.arabic: وَ أَعِزَّنِي بِعِزِّكَ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يُضَامُ
segments.transliteration: wa a`izzani bi`izzika alladhi la yudamu
segments.translation: and fortify me with Your almightiness, which is invulnerable,
protect me with Your Eye, which never sleeps,
and seal my affair by acting devoutly to You
and my life with forgiveness!
Surely, You are the All-forgiving, the All-compassionate!

segments.arabic:
ا
َللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ اَوَّلَ يَوْمِيْ هٰذَا فَلَاحًا،
segments.transliteration: allaahummaj aâl awwala yawmee haazaa falaahan,
segments.translation: O God, make the beginning of this day as welfare
its end success
and its middle reformation.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: allaahumma salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin
segments.translation: O Allah bless Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ اَنَابَ اِلَيْكَ فَقَبِلْتَهٗ،
segments.transliteration: waj aâlnaa mimman anaaba elayka faqabiltahu,`
segments.translation: and make us among those, when they turn to You, You accept them;
and if they rely on You, You are sufficient for them
and if they beseech to You, You have mercy on them.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful
Praise is for Allah for His tolerance and His giving respite
Praise is for Allah and I am certain that my sins
- and even if they are great - are insignificant in front of His forgiveness
And my crime - even if it is great - is insignificant in front of His mercy
And glorification is for Allah who has raised the skies without any pillars
And created heavens without any passage of time
And created the creatures without any support

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةِ ٱلْمُحْدِقِينَ بِكَ
segments.translation: And there is no Lord except Allah who warns those who disobey Him
And exceed the limits, and scares those who persist in disobedience
And are arrogant in worship, and He accepts the excuses of those who stray in their ignorance
And deviation to establish His proof against them
And His knowledge of their evil consequences, and Allah is Great

segments.transliteration: wa ana dayfuka fihi wa jaruka
segments.translation: The Generous and Merciful whose unlimited favours have no end
Upon all His creation, nor is there any boundary for His power and authority
Upon His creatures, O Allah, bestow blessings on Muhammad and his family
And bless Muhammad and his family, as You have blessed
Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim, indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious
O Allah, I call upon You like a sinner whose sins have destroyed him by narrowing his path
And there is no hope and respite except You
Nor anyone more merciful than You to listen to his complaints, nor a support better than You
You send the bounties even before the commencement of merit

segments.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa sallama
segments.translation: And have bestowed favours on those who were not entitled for it
Neither miserliness makes You rich or strong nor the question of those who beseech You decreases Your Munificence
You have taken the responsibility of sustaining the creatures
So that You can bestow Your Grace and Mercy upon them
O Allah! Prayers fall short in praising You

segments.arabic: أَنَا لَكِ مُصَدِّقٌ صَابِرٌ عَلَىٰ مَا أَتَىٰ بِهِ أَبُوكِ وَوَصِيُّهُ صَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا
segments.transliteration: ana laki musaddiqun sabirun `ala ma ata bihi abuki wa wasiyyuhu salawatu allahi `alayhima
segments.translation: And tongues become dumb while enumerating Your favours

segments.transliteration: wa ana as'aluki in kuntu saddaqtuki
segments.translation: O Lord! I have come in Your presence with a firm determination
Although my sins have engulfed me but You are the most Benevolent
The most Honoured, the most Generous among all
The best sustainer, the greatest Creator
The First, the Last
The Apparent, the Concealed, the Most Honourable

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مُمْتَحَنَةُ امْتَحَنَكِ الَّذِي خَلَقَكِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَكِ وَ كُنْتِ لِمَا امْتَحَنَكِ بِهِ صَابِرَةً
segments.translation: You are too great to refuse those whose hopes are pinned on You

segments.arabic: وَ نَحْنُ لَكِ أَوْلِيَاءُ مُصَدِّقُونَ وَ لِكُلِّ مَا أَتَى بِهِ أَبُوكِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ سَلَّمَ
segments.translation: O the One Who deserves the praise, all the praise is for You

segments.arabic: وَ أَتَى بِهِ وَصِيُّهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مُسَلِّمُونَ
segments.translation: O my Lord, if I have been negligent in being attentive to my soul

segments.arabic: وَ نَحْنُ نَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِذْ كُنَّا مُصَدِّقِينَ لَهُمْ أَنْ تُلْحِقَنَا بِتَصْدِيقِنَا بِالدَّرَجَةِ الْعَالِيَةِ
segments.translation: And have spent the days of my life in disobedience

segments.arabic: لِنُبَشِّرَ أَنْفُسَنَا بِأَنَّا قَدْ طَهُرْنَا بِوِلاَيَتِهِمْ (بِوَلاَيَتِهِمْ) عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ
segments.translation: Still You are the Lord of Bestowals, Possessor of Majesty, and Grandeur
Still Your attention remains on this soul
Now make this soul successful in Your Presence
Because You are the only Bestower, the Benefactor

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ أَشْرَقَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ ضَوْؤُهُ
segments.translation: Possessor of Generosity, O the One to illuminate the dawn

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ يُدَانُ بِدِينِهِ كُلُّ دِينٍ وَ لَا يُدَانُ بِغَيْرِ دِينِهِ
segments.translation: Grant the favours of this heart although it does not deserve

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ قَدَرَ بِقُدْرَتِهِ كُلَّ قَدَرٍ وَ لَا يَقْدِرُ أَحَدٌ قَدْرَهُ
segments.translation: O the excessive forgiver, O Allah I beseech You by those names which moulds the destiny
By Your Honour which complete the actions

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يَعْتَدِي عَلَى أَهْلِ مَمْلَكَتِهِ
segments.translation: Bless Muhammad and his progeny

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يَأْخُذُ أَهْلَ الْأَرْضِ بِأَلْوَانِ الْعَذَابِ
segments.translation: And grant me pure and vast sustenance from Your bounty
And do not let any barrier come between me and what brings me closer to You

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ مُطَّلِعٌ عَلَى خَزَائِنِ الْقُلُوبِ
segments.translation: O the Most Compassionate, O the Most Beneficent
O Allah, include me among those whom You have granted Your forgiveness

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا تَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ خَافِيَةٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَ لَا فِي السَّمَاءِ
segments.translation: And Your pardon and pleasure, and have settled them in Your gardens
By Your kindness, generosity, and grace
O my Lord, You have honored Your friends with Your signs (miracles)
And have made Your protection necessary for them
And have put them under Your care to save them from destruction

segments.arabic: اللهُ أَ كْبَرُ اللهُ أَ كْبَرُ اسْتَوَى الرَّبُّ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ
segments.translation: I am also Your servant, so grant me salvation and protection

segments.arabic: وَ قَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَ الْأَرْضُ بِحِكْمَتِهِ
segments.translation: And make me attentive towards Your obedience, and turn me away from disobedience

segments.arabic: وَ زَهَرَتِ النُّجُومُ بِأَمْرِهِ وَ رَسَتِ الْجِبَالُ بِإِذْنِهِ
segments.translation: Voices have been raised to You in various languages

segments.arabic: لَا يُجَاوِزُ اسْمُهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ
segments.translation: Asking You for their needs, hoping for the erasure of their defects

segments.arabic: الَّذِي دَانَتْ لَهُ الْجِبَالُ وَ هِيَ طَائِعَةٌ
segments.translation: And forgiveness of sins, O Knower of all unseen

segments.arabic: وَ انْبَعَثَتْ لَهُ الْأَجْسَادُ وَ هِيَ بَالِيَةٌ
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek guidance from You, so guide me

segments.arabic: وَ بِهِ أَحْتَجِبُ [احْتَجَبْتُ‏] بِاللهِ الَّذِي عَنْ كُلِّ غَاوٍ وَ بَاغٍ وَ طَاغٍ وَ جَبَّارٍ وَ حَاسِدٍ
segments.translation: And I seek protection from You, so protect me

segments.arabic: وَ بِاسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَ بِهِ‏ بَيْنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ
segments.translation: And fulfill Your rights upon me

segments.arabic: [حاجِزاً وَ أَحْتَجِبُ [احْتَجَبْتُ‏ بِاللهِ‏ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي السَّماءِ بُرُوجاً
segments.translation: Surely You are worthy to be feared and worthy to forgive

segments.arabic: وَ جَعَلَ فِيها سِراجاً وَ قَمَراً مُنِيراً
segments.translation: And repel from me the evil of every evil person to the good that nobody except You owns

segments.arabic: وَ زَيَّنَهَا لِلنَّاظِرِينَ وَ حَفِظَهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطانٍ رَجِيمٍ‏
segments.translation: And help me to bear the obligatory rights of the fathers and the mothers

segments.arabic: وَ جَعَلَ فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ جِبِالًا أَوْتَاداً
segments.translation: And forgive me and both of them and the believing men and the believing women

segments.arabic: أَنْ يُوصَلَ إِلَيَّ سُوءٌ أَوْ فَاحِشَةٌ أَوْ بَلِيَّةٌ
segments.translation: And the brothers and the sisters and the near ones
O the Owner of the blessings and Knower of the concealed

segments.arabic: عسق كَذلِكَ يُوحِي إِلَيْكَ وَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon the Prophetic Tree
and the Hashemite plant that is luminous,

segments.arabic: ‏ وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً
segments.translation: fruitful of Prophethood,
and elegant with Imamate.
And [peace be] upon your two grave-fellows; Adam and Noah,
peace be upon both of them.
Peace be upon you and upon your Household,
the pure and immaculate.

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْتَ الْبَاقِي الْكَرِيمُ الْقَائِمُ الدَّائِمُ بَعْدَ فَنَاءِ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you and upon the angels surrounding you

segments.arabic: الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِكَ مَلَكُوتُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ وَ دَهْرُ الدَّاهِرِينَ
segments.translation: and encompassing your tomb.
O my master, O Commander of the Believers!
Today is Sunday,
which is your day and carrying your name,
and, on this day, I am your guest and in your vicinity;
therefore, my master, receive me as your guest and neighbor.
Surely, you are generous and hospitable

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَّمْتَ تَسْبِيحَكَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَ الْآخِرِينَ
segments.translation: and you are commanded to treat your neighbors hospitably.

segments.arabic: وَ انْقَادَتْ لَكَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةُ بِأِزمَّتِهَا
segments.translation: So, (please) do to me that which I desire from you
and I hope you to do,

segments.arabic: وَ الْأَرَضِينَ بِمَقَالِيدِهَا وَ أَذْعَنَتْ لَكَ بِالطَّاعَةِ
segments.translation: [I ask you] in the name of your and your Householdâs standing with Allah

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا وَ أَبَتْ حَمْلَ الْأَمَانَةِ مِنْ شَفَقَتِهَا
segments.translation: and His standing with you all,
and in the name of your cousin, Allahâs Messenger,
may Allahâs peace and blessings be upon him

segments.arabic: وَ اخْتَلَفَ اللَّيْلُ وَ النَّهَارُ كَمَا أَمَرْتَهُمَا
segments.translation: and upon them all.

segments.arabic: وَ أَحْصَيْتَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ فِيهِمَا عَدَداً
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O examined lady.

segments.arabic: وَ أَحَطْتَ بِهِمَا عِلْماً خَالِقَ الْخَلْقِ
segments.translation: He Who created you has examined you

segments.arabic: وَ مُصْطَفِيَهُ وَ مُهَيْمِنَهُ وَ مُنْشِيَهً [وَ بَارِيَهُ] وَ ذَارِيَهُ
segments.translation: and found that you have passed the examination patiently.

segments.arabic: كُنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ إِلَهاً
segments.translation: I verify that you were patient about what came upon your father and his his successor peace be upon both of

segments.arabic: وَاحِداً وَ كَانَ عَرْشُكَ عَلَى الْمَاءِ
segments.translation: I now beseech you by my belief in you

segments.arabic: مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ أَرْضٌ وَ لَا سَمَاءٌ
segments.translation: to attach & associate me with my belief in both of them
so that I will be delighted.

segments.arabic: بِعِزَّتِكَ كُنْتَ قَدِيماً بَدِيعاً مُبْتَدِعاً كَيْنُوناً
segments.translation: So, testify for me that I am totally loyal to you

segments.arabic: كَائِناً مُكَوِّناً كَمَا سَمَّيْتَ نَفْسَكَ ابْتَدَعْتَ
segments.translation: and to your Household;

segments.arabic: الْخَلْقَ بِعَظَمَتِكَ وَ دَبَّرْتَ أُمُورَهُمْ بِعِلْمِكَ
segments.translation: peace of Allah be upon them all.

segments.arabic: فَكَانَ عَظِيمُ مَا ابْتَدَعْتَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the carefully examined, tried and measured by Him who created you, and found you, in your test, cool and compact, steady and stable.

segments.arabic: وَ قَدَرْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ عَلَيْكَ
segments.translation: We tell the truth about you; calm and quiet, with self control and composure (you) put up with all that which your father blessings of Allah be on him and on his family

segments.arabic: هَيِّناً يَسِيراً لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ ظَهِيرٌ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: and his "Wasi" (successor) peace be on him came across.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا مُعِينٌ عَلَى حِفْظِكَ وَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فِي مُلْكِكَ
segments.translation: We beseech you, (If I have stated the truth), to bind us together with the testimony, concerning both of them, in order to give joy and satisfaction to my heart and soul.
So bear witness that truly I, by heart, made evident your, and your children's "wilayat" (superintendent guardianship), blessings of Allah be on them all

segments.arabic: وَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ عَلِيّاً غَنِيّاً
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
Glory be to him, who fulfilled the time with his holiness.
Glory be to him, who his light covers the unlimited times.

segments.arabic: ‏ لَا يُخَالِفُ شَيْءٌ مِنْهُ مَحَبَّتَكَ فَسُبْحَانَكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to you who his light shines upon everything.

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَمْدِكَ وَ تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to him who every religion has admitted to his religion and do not admit to others.

segments.arabic: وَ تَعَالَيْتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ عُلُوّاً كَبِيراً
segments.translation: Glory be to him who decreed with his power every fate, and no one can decree his fate.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُولِكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to him who; His knowledge can not be described.

segments.arabic: وَ نَبِيِّكَ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who does not transgress against the inhabitants of his Kingdom!
Glory be to him who does not chastise the people of the earth with various punishments.

segments.arabic: وَ قَرُبَ إِلَيْنَا بِهِ هُدَاكَ وَ أَوْرَثْتَنَا بِهِ كِتَابَكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him who is kind and Merciful.
Glory be to him who is aware of the hearts' treasuries.

segments.arabic: فَأَصْبَحْنَا مُبْصِرِينَ بِنُورِ الْهُدَى الَّذِي جَاءَ بِهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who knows the exact count of the sins!

segments.arabic: ظَاهِرِين بِعِزِّ الدِّينِ الَّذِي دَعَا إِلَيْهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to him who does not deceive those who do everything in secret, in earth or heavens.

segments.arabic: نَاجِينَ بِحُجَجِ الْكِتَابِ الَّذِي نَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to the Loving Lord!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَآثَرَهُ بِقُرْبِ الْمَجْلِسِ مِنْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
segments.translation: Glory be to the Unique Single!
Glory be to the Greatest Great!
In the Name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate

segments.arabic: وَ تَشْرِيفاً مِنْكَ لَهُ عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ
segments.translation: Allah is the Most Great, Allah is the Most great, The Lord sat on the Throne,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَ امْنَحْنَا مِنْ شَفَاعَتِهِ نَصِيباً نَرِدُ بِهِ
segments.translation: and His Command established the heavens and the earth.

segments.arabic: مَعَ الصَّادِقِينَ جِنَانَهُ وَ نَنْزِلُ بِهِ مَعَ الْآمِنِينَ
segments.translation: The stars were stilled, and the mountains were fixed firmly by His permission.

segments.arabic: فُسْحَةَ رِيَاضِهِ غَيْرَ مَرْفُوضِينَ عَنْ دَعْوَتِهِ
segments.translation: His name does not pass by those in the heavens and the earth.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا مَرْدُودِينَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ مَا بَعَثْتَهُ بِهِ
segments.translation: The mountains draw near Him, obedient,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا مَحْجُوبَةٍ عَنَّا مُرَافَقَتُهُ  وَ لَا مَحْظُورَةٍ عَنَّا دَارُهُ
segments.translation: and the bodies are resurrected for Him when they are rotten.
Veil every harmful thing and envious One by the Might of Allah from so-and-so, son of so-and-so,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: by the One who placed a partition between the two seas;
and set in heaven constellations,
and set a lamp and an illuminating moon among them.

segments.arabic: وَ الَّذِي سَخَّرْتَ بِهِ اللَّيْلَ وَ النَّهَارَ
segments.translation: I seek protection for him in the One who decked them out fair to the beholders and guarded them against every accursed demon.

segments.arabic: وَ أَجْرَيْتَ بِهِ الشَّمْسَ وَ الْقَمَرَ وَ النُّجُومَ
segments.translation: I seek protection for him in the One who set firm mountains and pegs in the earth,

segments.arabic: وَ بِهِ أَنْشَأْتَ السَّحَابَ وَ الْمَطَرَ وَ الرِّيَاحَ
segments.translation: lest evil, indecency, or affliction should get to him.

segments.arabic: وَ الَّذِي بِهِ تُنَزْلُ الْغَيْثَ وَ تَذْرَأُ الْمَرْعَى
segments.translation: 'Ha Mim' a revelation from the Merciful, the Compassionate

segments.arabic: وَ تُحْيِي‏ الْعِظامَ وَ هِيَ رَمِيمٌ
segments.translation: So reveals to You, and those before You,

segments.arabic: ‏ وَ الَّذِي بِهِ تَرْزُقُ مَنْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَ الْبَحْرِ
segments.translation: God, the All-mighty, the All-wise.
Blessings of Allah upon Muhammad, the Prophet, and his family.

segments.arabic: وَ الَّذِي هُوَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ وَ الْإِنْجِيلِ وَ الزَّبُورِ
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segments.arabic: وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيمِ وَ الَّذِي فَلَقْتَ بِهِ الْبَحْرَ لِمُوسَى
segments.translation: All praise be to You, our Lord; to You belong the praise.

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْرَيْتَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
segments.translation: You are Allah, the bearer of Your Throne forever.

segments.arabic: وَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ لَكَ مَخْزُونٍ وَ مَكْنُونٍ
segments.translation: You have encompassed the perceptiveness of every creature.

segments.arabic: وَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ دَعَاكَ بِهِ مَلَكٌ مُقَرَّبٌ
segments.translation: And all creatures are upon annihilation;

segments.arabic: أَوْ نَبِيٌّ مُرْسَلٌ أَوْ عَبْدٌ مُصْطَفًى
segments.translation: You are the Eternal, the All generous, the Existing, and the Everlasting, which subsists after annihilating all things.

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: The Everlasting Whom shall not perish; The One in Whose control is the kingdom of the heavens and earth eternally.

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ رَاحَتِي فِي لِقَائِكَ
segments.translation: You are the one who demolished the unjust ones by Your voice!

segments.arabic: وَ خَاتِمَ عَمَلِي فِي سَبِيلِكَ وَ حَجَّ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ
segments.translation: Added the earth in Your grasp

segments.arabic: وَ اخْتِلَافٍ إِلَى مَسَاجِدِكَ وَ مَجَالِسِ الذِّكْرِ
segments.translation: and covered with Your illumination light beholders' eyes.

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ خَيْرَ أَيَّامِي يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ
segments.translation: You fulfilled by Your favor; livelihood the eaters

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and elevated Your throne upon worlds.

segments.arabic: وَ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَ مِنْ خَلْفِي
segments.translation: You made the heavens inhabited by The nearest angels

segments.arabic: وَ عَنْ يَمِينِي وَ عَنْ شِمَالِي وَ مِنْ فَوْقِي وَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
segments.translation: and teach Your glorifying; for the early generations and last.

segments.arabic: أَسْفَلَ مِنِّي وَ احْفَظْنِي مِنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ
segments.translation: The here and hereafter submitted its leashes for You,
kept the heavens and earth keys,

segments.arabic: وَ مَكِّنْ لِي فِي دِينِي الَّذِي ارْتَضَيْتَ لِي
segments.translation: and submitted to You with obeying with things above it too!

segments.arabic: [ وَ فَهِّمْنِي فِيهِ وَ اجْعَلْهُ لِي نُوراً [وَ بِشْراً
segments.translation: And refused to bear the Trust out of the compassion,

segments.arabic: وَ يَسِّرْ لِيَ الْيُسْرَ وَ الْعَافِيَةَ وَ اعْزِمْ عَلَى رُشْدِي
segments.translation: and stood solid with Your words

segments.arabic: كَمَا عَزَمْتَ عَلَى خَلْقِي وَ أَعِنِّي عَلَى نَفْسِي بِبِرٍّ
segments.translation: and the seas sat straight on its places.

segments.arabic: وَ تَقْوَى وَ عَمَلٍ رَاجِحٍ وَ بَيْعٍ رَابِحٍ
segments.translation: The night and day opposed each other as You commanded them
and You who has counted in it everything in numbers.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَ مَا قَرُبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ
segments.translation: And You encompassed it with knowledge, the Creator of creatures;

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ‏ مِنْ خَوْنِ الْأَمَانَةِ
segments.translation: who are chosen one, ruling upon, thems Creator and strew,
You were and only You without a partner.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنَ التَّزَيُّنِ بِمَا لَيْسَ فِيَّ
segments.translation: One God and Your throne were above the water

segments.arabic: وَ مِنَ الْآثَامِ وَ الْبَغْيِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ
segments.translation: before the being of the earth, heavens,
or anything out of your creation!

segments.arabic: وَ أَجِرْنِي مِنْ مَضَلَّاتِ الْفِتَنِ‏ ما ظَهَرَ مِنْها
segments.translation: By Your might, You were the sempiternal, splendid, creative entity,

segments.arabic: وَ ما بَطَنَ‏ وَ مِنْ مُحِيطَاتِ الْخَطَايَا
segments.translation: exists and Creator as You named Yourself!

segments.arabic: وَ نَجِّنِي مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
segments.translation: You originated the creation with Your mightiness and governed their matters with Your knowledge.

segments.arabic: وَ اهْدِنِي سَبِيلَ الْإِسْلَامِ وَ اكْسُنِي حُلَلَ الْإِيمَانِ
segments.translation: Therefore the greatness of Your creation
and Your ability is from Your command upon them;
easy and gradual! You didn't need an aid upon Your creation,
no help on Your custody, no partner in Your kingdom,
and You were our God; glorified are your names

segments.arabic: وَ أَلْقِنِي مِنْكَ بِرَوْحٍ وَ رَيْحَانٍ
segments.translation: and splendid be the praising of You upon this the highest and free of need!
Indeed; so Your order to something you want

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً
segments.translation: is only that You say to it, "Be," and it is;
none of would contradict your love! So; Glory be to You
and praise, blessed You are our God, splendid be the praising of You
and exalted high indeed above all that!
O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant
and Messenger, Your Prophet and His Household.
As; You surpassed to us by him Your mercy,
lead on us by him Your guidance, inherited us by him Your Book
and directed us by him on Your obeying!
So we become subtle upon the light of guidance that he bought to us,
standing by the superiority of the religion that he invited to
and rescued by The Book (Quran) proofs revealed upon him.
O, Lord, so favor him with the nearest place beside You on the Day of Resurrection!
Dignify him with the accepted enablement intercession to You;
excellence from You upon the righteousness
and solemnity from You upon the god-fearing!
O, Lord, grant us from his intercession a share that; will acquaint us
with the sincere to His heavens and with the secure in His spacious gardens;
Not dismissed from his invite,
apostate from the way that You sent him with,
his company is veiled nor forbidden his home on us,
may it be so, O, Allah of Truth; Lord of the worlds!
O, Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and His Household,
O, Allah! I beseech You through Your great Name;
that is not known to anybody except you,
which subdued with the night and day,
which moved smoothly by it the sun, moon, and stars,
by which the clouds, rain, and the wind is done,
by that which You make the rainfall and multiply the pasture;
enliven the bones when they are decayed,
by that which You endow who are in lands and seas;
look after (safeguard) and protect them,
by the Taurat, Injeel, Zabur,
and the Holy Quran where it is in, You caused the sea to cleave asunder for Moses
and the midnight journey to the seven heavens by Muhammed; God bless him and his Household.
And by every name that is saved and well protected,
by everyone who did beseech You by your name; every brought near angels
or sent Prophet or chosen servant.
Do send Your blessings upon Mohammad and His Household,
make my relief in Your meeting,
the seal for my deeds is toward You, the grace of pilgrimage to Your Holy House,
follow Your mosques and gatherings in which Allah's name is being invoked,
and make my best day is Your meeting day!
O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad, and His Household
protects me; before and behind me,
my right and left, above and below;
beneath me! Protect me from the sins,
and your all forbidden.
And strength in my religion what You; accepted for me,
apprehend me in it, make it a light (good omen)
and ease for me the solvency and well-being.
Determine my consciousness; as You determined my creation. Help me against myself with;
God-fearing, faithfulness, accepted deed, gainer selling,
and commerce that comes not to naught.
O, Allah, I beseech You for heaven, and what a saying or work can make me near to it.
I seek refuge in You from; betraying the Trust,
devouring others property unjustly,
refinding myself with what I don't own,
sins and tyranny without righteousness, and associate with You;
whom You didn't consider a dominion!
Please take me away from mischief and deviations,
whether open or secret, and the enormous sins!
Rescue me from the darkness to the light.
Guide me to the Islam path, drape us with robes of faithfulness,
veil us with apparel of piety,
shield me with the righteous shield,
beautify me with the believers' ornament,
load the balance with my deeds,
and meet me with Thy spirit and pleasant.
May it be so, O Lord of the worlds,
and blessings of Allah upon Muhammed and His Household and give them abundant peace!
