title: Monday   Duas.org

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يُشْهِدْ أَحَداً
segments.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi lam yushhid ahadan
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah Who allowed none to witness
when He created the heavens and the earth,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ ٱتَّخَذَ مُعِيناً حِيـنَ بَرَأَ ٱلنَّسَمَاتِ
segments.transliteration: wa lattakhadha mu`inan hina bara`a annasamati
segments.translation: and Who took no helper when He authored the spirits!
He has no associate in Divinity
and no support in Unity.
Tongues fall silent before the limit of describing Him,
intellects fail before the core of knowing Him,
tyrants fall low in awe of Him,
faces are humbled in fear of Him,
and everything mighty yields to His mightiness!
So, to You belongs praise, again and again, well-measured,
continually, methodically!
And may His blessings be upon His Messenger endlessly,
and His salutation (be upon him) everlastingly, eternally!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ أَوَّلَ يَوْمِي هٰذَا صَلاَحاً
segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`al awwala yawmi hadha salahan
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) make the beginning of this day of mine righteousness,
its middle prosperity,
and its end success!

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ يَوْمٍ اَوَّلُهُ فَزَعٌ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min yawmin awwaluhu faza`un
segments.translation: I seek refuge in You from a day whose beginning is fright,
whose middle is anxiety,
and whose end is pain!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِكُلِّ نَذْرٍ نَذَرْتُهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni astaghfiruka likulli nadhrin nadhartuhu
segments.translation: O Allah, I pray forgiveness from You for every vow I have vowed,
every promise I have made,
and every pledge I have pledged
and then I failed to keep for You.

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ فِي مَظَالِمِ عِبَادِكَ عِنْدِي
segments.translation: I ask You concerning the complaints of Your servants against me:
If there is a servant from among Your servants
or a bondmaid from among Your bondmaids,

segments.arabic: كَانَتْ لَهُ قِبَلِي مَظْلَمَةٌ ظَلَمْتُهَا إِيَّاهُ
segments.transliteration: kanat lahu qibali mazlamatun zalamtuha iyyahu
segments.translation: who has against me a complaint
because I have wronged him in respect to himself, his reputation,

segments.arabic: أَوْ فِي مَالِهِ أَوْ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ
segments.transliteration: aw fi malihi aw fi ahlihi wa waladihi
segments.translation: his property, his wife or his child,
or because evil words I have spoken about him in his absence,

segments.arabic: أَوْ تَحَامُلٌ عَلَيهِ بِمَيْلٍ أَوْ هَوًىٰ
segments.translation: an imposition upon him through inclination, caprice,
scorn, zeal,
false show, bigotry,
whether he be absent or present,
alive or dead,
such that my hand has fallen short
and my capacity has been too narrow to make restitution to him
or to annul my obligation to him,

segments.transliteration: fa as'alika ya man yamliku alhajati
segments.translation: I ask You, O He who owns all objects of need,
which are granted by His will
and hasten to His desire

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: that You bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and make [the one I have wronged] satisfied with me in the manner that You will,
and gift me mercy from You,
because, indeed, forgiveness decreases You not
and giving injures You not.
O Most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَوْلِنِي فِي كُلِّ يَومِ ٱثْنَيْنِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma awlini fi kulli yawmi ithnayni
segments.translation: O Allah, bestow upon me on every Monday
with two favors from You:
the felicity to obey You at its beginning
and the favor of Your forgiveness at its end!
O He who is the God
and none other than Whom grants forgiveness for sins!

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ قُوَّةً فِيْ عِبَادَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-aloka quwwatan fee eâbaadateka
segments.translation: O God, I ask You for the strength to worship (You),
insight of book (Quran),
cognizance of religious laws

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: allaahumma salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin,
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَجْعَلِ الْقُرْاٰنَ بِنَا مَاحِلًا وَ الصِّرَاطَ زَائِلًا،
segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-aâlil quraana benaa maahelan was seraata zaaelan,
segments.translation: and do not make the Quran distant from us and the Siraat as downfall for us

segments.transliteration: wa mohammadan sallal laaho aâlayhe wa aalehi aânnaa mowalleyan.
segments.translation: and His Eminence, Muhammad as one, who turns away from us.
Praise be to Allah, who guided me to Islam,

segments.arabic: وَ اَکْرَمَنِیْ بِالْاِیْمَانِ وَ بَصَّرَنِیْ بِالدِّیْنِ
segments.transliteration: Wa akramani bil-iman wa bassarani bid-din
segments.translation: And honored me with faith, and gave me insight into the religion,

segments.arabic: وَ شَرَّفَنِیْ بِالْیَقِیْنِ وَ عَرَّفَنِیْ الْحَقَّ الَّذِیْ عَنْہُ یُؤْفَکُوْنَ
segments.transliteration: Wa sharrafani bil-yaqin wa âarrafanil-haqqa-ladhi âanhu yuâfakun
segments.translation: And ennobled me with certainty, and made me know the Truth from which they are turned away,

segments.arabic: وَالنَّبَائِ الْعَظِیْمَ الَّذِیْ ہُمْ فِیْہِ مُخْتَلِفُوْنَ
segments.translation: And the Great News about which they are in disagreement.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اﷲِ الَّذِیْ یَرْزُقُ الْقَاسِطَ الْعَادِلَ وَالْعَاقِلَ وَالْجَاہِلَ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, who provides for the just, the sensible, and the ignorant alike,

segments.arabic: وَ یَرْحَمُ السَّاہِیَ وَالْغَافِلَ فَکَیْفَ الدَّاعِیَ السَّآئِلَ
segments.translation: And has mercy on the inadvertent and the heedless; so how then [would He treat] the one who calls and asks?

segments.arabic: وَ لاَ اِلٰہَ اِلاَّ اﷲُ اللَّطِیْفُ بِمَنْ شَرَدَ عَنْہُ مِنْ مُسْرِفِیْ عِبَادِہٖ
segments.transliteration: Wa la ilaha illallahul-latifu biman sharada âanhu min musrifi âibadih
segments.translation: And there is no god but Allah, the Kind toward those among His extravagant servants who have strayed from Him,
So that they may return from their defiance and stubbornness.

segments.arabic: الرَّاضِیْ مِنَ الْمُنِیْبِ الْمُخْلِصِ بِدُوْنِ الْوُسْعِ وَالطَّاقَۃِ
segments.translation: Who is pleased with the sincere, turning servant even with little capacity or strength.

segments.arabic: وَ عَلٰی کُلِّ نَوْعٍ مِنْ غَوَامِضِ تَقْدِیْرِہ وَ حُسْنِ تَدْبِیْرِہٖ دَلِیْلٌ وَاضِحٌ
segments.transliteration: Wa âala kulli nawâin min ghawamidi taqdirihi wa husni tadbirihi dalilun wadih
segments.translation: And in every kind of His mysterious decrees and His beautiful management, there is a clear proof,

segments.arabic: وَ شَاہِدُ عَدْلٍ یَقْضِیَانِ لَہٗ بِالْوَحْدَانِیَّۃِ
segments.transliteration: Wa shahidu âadlin yaqdhiyani lahu bil-wahdaniyyah
segments.translation: And a just witness; both testify to His Oneness.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُکَ یَا مَنْ یَصْرِفُ الْبَلاَیَا وَ یَعْلَمُ الْخَفَایَا وَ یُجْزِلُ الْعَطَایَا
segments.transliteration: Allahumma inni as-aluka ya man yasriful-balaya wa yaâlamul-khafaya wa yujzilul-âataya
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask YouâO He who turns away afflictions, knows the hidden secrets, and gives abundant gifts,

segments.arabic: سُؤَالَ نَادِمٍ عَلٰی اِقْتِرَافِ الْاٰثَامِ وَ سَالِمٍ عَلَی الْمَعَاصِیْ مِنَ اللَّیَالِیْ وَالْاَیَّامِ
segments.transliteration: Suâala nadimin âala-qtirafil-atham wa salimin âalal-maâasi minal-layali wal-ayyam
segments.translation: The asking of one who is regretful over committing sins and who has been constant in disobedience through the nights and days,

segments.arabic: اِذْلَمْ یَجِدْ مُجِیْرًا سِوَاکَ لِغُفْرَانِہَا وَلاَ مَوْئِلاً یَفْزَعُ اِلَیْہِ لِاِرْتِجَآءِ کَشْفِ فَاقَتِہٖ اِلاَّ اِیَّاکَ
segments.transliteration: Idh lam yajid mujiran siwaka li-ghufraniha wa la maw-ilan yafzaâu ilayhi li-rtijaâi kashfi faqatihi illa iyyak
segments.translation: Since he finds no protector other than You for their forgiveness, nor any refuge to flee to in hope of relieving his poverty, except You.

segments.arabic: یَا جَلِیْلُ اَنْتَ الَّذِیْ عَمَّ الْخَلآئِقَ مَنُّکَ وَ غَمَرَتْہُمْ سَعَۃُ رَحْمَتُکَ
segments.transliteration: Ya Jalilu anta-ladhi âammal-khalaâiqa mannuk wa ghamarathum saâatu rahmatik
segments.translation: O Majestic One, You are the one whose favor encompasses all creatures, and the vastness of Your mercy has overwhelmed them.
And Your profuse blessings have made life pleasant for them.

segments.arabic: یَا کَرِیْمُ الْمَاٰبِ وَالْجَوَادُ الْوَہَّابِ وَالْمُنْتَقِمُ مِمَّنْ عَصَاہُ بِاَلِیْمِ الْعَذَابِ
segments.transliteration: Ya karimul-maâabi wal-jawadul-wahhabi wal-muntaqimu mimman âasahu bi-alim-il-âadhab
segments.translation: O Noble in Return, the Generous, the Bestower, and the Avenger against those who disobey Him with painful punishment.

segments.arabic: دَعَوْتُکَ مُقِرًّا بِالْاِسَائَۃِ عَلٰی نَفْسِیْ اِذْلَمْ اَجِدُ مَلْجَأ اَلْجَاَہُ اِلَیْہِ فِیْ اِغْتِفَادِ مَا اکْتَسَبْتَ مِنَ الْاٰثَامِ
segments.transliteration: Daâawtuka muqirran bil-isaâati âala nafsi idh lam ajid maljaâan aljaâuhu ilayhi fi-ghtifadi ma-ktasabta minal-atham
segments.translation: I call upon You, admitting to the wrong I have done to myself, since I found no shelter to turn to for the pardon of the sins I have earned.

segments.arabic: یَا خَیْرَ مَنِ اسْتُدْعٰی لِبَذْلِ الرَّغَآئِبِ وَ اَنْجَحَ مَامُوْلٍ لِکَشْفِ الْکَوَارِبِ
segments.transliteration: Ya khayra man istudâiya li-badhlir-raghaâib wa anjaha maâmulin li-kashfil-kawarib
segments.translation: O Best of those called upon to grant desires, and most successful of those hoped for to remove distress.

segments.arabic: لَکَ عَنَتِ الْوُجُوْہُ فَلاَ تَرُدَّنِیْ مِنْکَ بِالْحِرْمَانِ اِنَّکَ تَفْعَلُ مَا تَشَآءُ وَ تَحْکُمُ مَا تُرِیْدُ
segments.transliteration: Laka âanatil-wujuhu fala taruddani minka bil-hirman, innaka tafâalu ma tashaâu wa tahkumu ma turid
segments.translation: Before You all faces are humbled, so do not turn me away with deprivation; indeed You do what You will and decree what You intend.

segments.arabic: اِلٰہِیْ وَ سَیِّدِیْ وَ مَوْلاَیَ اَیَّ رَبٍّ اِرْتَجِیْہِ اَمْ اَیَّ اِلٰہٍ اَقْصُدُہٗ
segments.transliteration: Ilahi wa sayyidi wa mawlaya ayya rabbin artajih am ayya ilahin aqsuduh
segments.translation: My God, my Master, and my Guardian, what other Lord could I hope for, or what other deity could I turn to?

segments.arabic: اِذَا اَلَمَّ بِیَ النَّدَمُ وَ اَحَاطَتْ بِیَ الْمَعَاصِیْ وَ نَکَائِبُ خَوْفِ النِّقَمِ
segments.transliteration: Idha alamma biyan-nadam wa ahatat biyal-maâasi wa nakaâibu khawfin-niqam
segments.translation: When regret strikes me, and sins and the calamities of the fear of punishment surround me.

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ وَلِیَّ الصَّفْحِ وَ میَاوَی الْکَرَمِ
segments.translation: While You are the Master of Pardon and the Abode of Generosity.

segments.arabic: اِلٰہِیْ اَتُقِیْمُنِیْ مَقَامَ الْہَلَکَۃِ وَ اَنْتَ جَمِیْلُ السِّتْرِ
segments.transliteration: Ilahi atuqimuni maqamal-halakati wa anta jamilus-sitri
segments.translation: My God, would You place me in a state of destruction when You are the Beautiful Veiler (of faults)?

segments.arabic: وَ تَسَأَلُنِیْ عنْ اِقْتِرَافِیْ عَلٰی رُئُوْسِ الْاَشْہَادِ وَ قَدْ مَخَبَّاتِ السِّتْرِ
segments.transliteration: Wa tas-aluni âan iqtirafi âala ruâusil-ash-had wa qad makhabbat-is-sitri
segments.translation: And would You question me about my crimes in front of all witnesses, even though You are the One who provides the hidden veils of protection?

segments.arabic: فَاِنْ کُنْتُ اِلٰہِیْ مُسْرِفًا عَلٰی نَفْسِیْ مُخْطِئًا عَلَیْہَا بِاِنْتِہَاکَ الْحُرُمَاتِ
segments.transliteration: Fa in kuntu ilahi musrifan âala nafsi mukhtiâan âalayha bintiha-kil-hurumat
segments.translation: For even if I have been extravagant against myself, and erring against it by violating sanctities,

segments.arabic: نَاسِیًا لِمَا اجْتَرَمْتُ مِنَ الْہَفَوَاتِ فَاَنْتَ لَطِیْفٌ تَجُوْدُ عَلَی الْمُسْرِفِیْنَ بِرَحْمَتِکَ
segments.transliteration: Nasiyan lima-jtaramtu minal-hafawati fa anta latifun tajudu âalal-musrifina bi-rahmatik
segments.translation: Being forgetful of the slips and errors I have committed, You are Kind, granting Your mercy to the extravagant.

segments.arabic: وَ تَتَفَضَّلْ عَلَی الْخَاطِئِیْنَ بِکَرَمِکَ فَارْحَمْنِیْ یَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِیْنَ
segments.transliteration: Wa tatafaddal âalal-khatiâina bi-karamika farhamni ya arhamar-rahimin
segments.translation: And You favor the sinners with Your generosity; so have mercy on me, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: فَاِنَّکَ تُسَکِّنَ یَا اِلٰہِیْ بِتَحَبُّنِکَ رَوْعَاتِ قُلُوْبِ الْوَجِلِیْنَ
segments.transliteration: Fa innaka tusakkinu ya ilahi bi-tahabbunika rawâati qulubil-wajilin
segments.translation: For You, my God, through Your love, calm the fears of the hearts of the frightened.

segments.arabic: وَ تُحَقُّقِ بِتَطَوُّلِکَ اَمَلَ الْاٰمِلِیْنَ وَ تُفِیْضُ سَجَالَ عَطَایَاکَ عَلٰی غَيْرِ الْمُسْتَاہِلِیْنَ
segments.transliteration: Wa tuhaqqiqu bi-tatawwulika amalal-amilina wa tufidu sajala âatayaka âala ghayril-mustahilin
segments.translation: And You fulfill, through Your favor, the expectations of those who hope, and pour out the buckets of Your gifts even upon those who are undeserving.

segments.arabic: فَاٰمِنِّیْ بِرَجَآئٍ لاَ یَشُوْبُہٗ قُنُوْطٌ وَ اَمَلٍ لاَ یُکَدِّرُہُ بَاْسٌ
segments.transliteration: Fa-aminni bi-rajaâin la yashubuhu qunut wa amalin la yukaddiruhu baâs
segments.translation: So grant me security with a hope not tainted by despair, and an expectation not clouded by misery.

segments.arabic: یَا مُحِیْطًا بِکُلِّ شَیْءٍ عِلْمًا وَ قَدْ اَصْبَحْتُ سَیِّدِیْ وَ اَمْسَیْتُ عَلٰی بَابٍ مِنْ اَبْوَابِ مِنَحِکَ سَآئِلاً
segments.transliteration: Ya muhitan bi-kulli shayâin âilma wa qad asbahtu sayyidi wa amsaytu âala babin min abwabi minahika saâila
segments.translation: O He who encompasses everything in knowledge; I have entered the morning and the evening, my Master, as a beggar at one of the doors of Your gifts.

segments.arabic: وَ عَنِ التَّعَرُّضِ لِسِوَاکَ بِالْمَسْأَلَۃِ عَادِلاً
segments.translation: Turning away from asking anyone other than You.

segments.arabic: وَ لَیْسَ مِنْ جَمِیْلِ اِمْتِنَانِکَ رَدُّ سَآئِلٍ مَأْسُوْرٍ مَلْہُوْفٍ وَ مُضْطَرٍّ لِانْتِظَارِ خَیْرِکَ الْمَالُوْفِ
segments.transliteration: Wa laysa min jamili imtinanika raddu saâilin maâsurin malhufin wa mudtarrin lintidhari khayrikal-maluf
segments.translation: And it is not like Your beautiful grace to turn away a captive, grieving, and distressed petitioner who waits for Your accustomed goodness.

segments.arabic: اِلٰہِیْ اَنْتَ الَّذِیْ عَجَزَتِ الْاَوْهَامُ عَنِ الْاِحَاطَۃِ بِکَ وَ کَلَّتِ الْاَلْسُنُ عَنْ نَعْتِ ذٰلِکَ
segments.transliteration: Ilahi anta-ladhi âajazatil-awhamu âanil-ihatati bik wa kallatil-alsunu âan naâti dhalik
segments.translation: My God, You are the one whom imaginations fail to encompass, and tongues grow weary of describing Your Essence.

segments.arabic: فَبِاٰلَآئِکَ وَ طَوْلِکَ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاغْفِرْلِیْ ذُنُوْبِیْ
segments.transliteration: Fa bi-alaâika wa tawlika salli âala Muhammadin wa ali Muhammad waghfir-li dhunubi
segments.translation: So by Your bounties and Your power, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and forgive me my sins.

segments.arabic: وَ اَوْسِعْ عَلَیَّ مِنْ فَضْلِکَ الْوَاسَعِ رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا حَلٰلاً طَیِّبًا فِیْ عَافِیَۃٍ وَ اَقِلْنِیْ الْعَثْرَۃَ
segments.transliteration: Wa awsiâ âalayya min fadlikal-wasiâi rizqan wasiâan halalan tayyiban fi âafiyatin wa aqilniyal-âathrah
segments.translation: And expand for me, from Your vast favor, a wide, lawful, and good sustenance in well-being, and forgive my stumbling.

segments.arabic: یَا غَایَۃَ الْاٰمِلِیْنَ وَ جَبَّارَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِیْنَ وَالْبَاقِیْ بَعْدَ فَنَآءِ الْخَلْقِ اَجْمَعِیْنَ وَ دَیَّانَ یَوْمِ الدِّیْنِ
segments.transliteration: Ya ghayatal-amilina wa jabbaras-samawati wal-ardina wal-baqi baâda fanaâil-khalqi ajmaâina wa dayyana yawmid-din
segments.translation: O Ultimate Goal of the hopeful, Compeller of the heavens and the earths, the One who remains after the annihilation of all creation, and the Judge of the Day of Judgment.

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ یَا مَوْلاَیَ ثِقَۃُ مَنْ لَمْ یَثْقِ بِنَفْسِہٖ لِاِفْرَاطِ خَلَلِہٖ
segments.transliteration: Wa anta ya mawlaya thiqatu man lam yathq bi-nafsihi li-ifrati khalalih
segments.translation: And You, my Master, are the reliance of him who does not trust himself due to the excess of his flaws.

segments.arabic: وَ اَمَلُ مَنْ لَمْ یَکُنْ لَہٗ تَاْمِیْلٌ لِکَثْرَۃِ زَلَلِہٖ وَ رَجَآءُ مَنْ لَمْ یَرْتَجِ لِنَفْسِہٖ بِوَسِیْلَۃِ عَمَلِہٖ
segments.transliteration: Wa amalu man lam yakun lahu taâmilun li-kathrati zalalihi wa rajaâu man lam yartaji li-nafsihi bi-wasilati âamalih
segments.translation: The hope of him who has no hope due to the frequency of his slips, and the expectation of him who finds no hope for himself through his own deeds.

segments.arabic: اِلٰہِیْ فَاَنْقِذْنِیْ بِرَحْمَتِکَ مِنَ الْمَہَالِکِ وَ اَحْلِلْنِیْ دَارَ الْاَخْیَارِ
segments.transliteration: Ilahi fa-anqidhni bi-rahmatika minal-mahaliki wa ahlilni daral-akhyar
segments.translation: My God, rescue me by Your mercy from the places of destruction, and settle me in the abode of the chosen ones.

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِیْ مِنْ مُرَافِقِیْ الْاَبْرَارِ وَاغْفِرْلِیْ ذُنُوْبَ اللَّیْلِ وَالنَّہَارِ
segments.transliteration: Wajâalni min mura fiqil-abrari waghfir-li dhunubal-layli wan-nahar
segments.translation: Make me among the companions of the righteous, and forgive me the sins of the night and the day.

segments.arabic: یَا مُطَّلِعًا عَلَی الْاَسْرَارِ اِحْتَمِلْ عَنِّیْ مَوْلاَیَ اَدَآءَ مَا افْتَرَضْتَ عَلَیَّ
segments.transliteration: Ya muttaliâan âalal-asrari ihtamil âanni mawlaya adaâa ma-ftaradta âalay
segments.translation: O Knower of secrets, fulfill on my behalf, my Master, the duties You made obligatory upon me,

segments.arabic: لِلْاٰبَآءِ وَالْاُمَّہَاتِ وَالْاِخْوَانِ وَالْاَخْوَاتِ بِلُطْفِکَ وَ کَرِمَکَ یَا ذَاالْجَلاَلِ وَالْاِکْرَامِ
segments.transliteration: Lil-abaâi wal-ummahati wal-ikhwani wal-akhawati bi-lutfika wa karamika ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram
segments.translation: Toward fathers, mothers, brothers, and sisters, by Your kindness and Your generosity, O Owner of Majesty and Honor.

segments.arabic: وَ اَشْرِکْنَا فِیْ دُعَآءِ مَنِ اسْتَجَبْتَ لَہٗ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتِ
segments.transliteration: Wa ashrikna fi duâaâi man istajabta lahu minal-muâminina wal-muâminat
segments.translation: And include us in the prayers of those among the believing men and women whose supplications You have answered.

segments.arabic: اِنَّکَ جَوَادٌ کَرِیْمٌ وَہَّابٌ صَلَّی اﷲُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِہٖ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِیْمًا
segments.transliteration: Innaka jawadun karimun wahhabun salla-llahu âala Muhammadin wa alihi wa sallama taslima
segments.translation: Indeed You are Generous, Noble, and the Bestower. May Allah bless Muhammad and his family and grant them perfect peace.

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِیْ ہُدَانِیْ لِلْاِسْلاَمِ وَ اَکْرَمَنِیْ بِالْاِیْمَانِ وَ بَصَّرَنِیْ بِالدِّیْنِ وَ شَرَّفَنِیْ بِالْیَقِیْنِ وَ عَرَّفَنِیْ الْحَقَّ الَّذِیْ عَنْہُ یُؤْفَکُوْنَ وَالنَّبَائِ الْعَظِیْمَ الَّذِیْ ہُمْ فِیْہِ مُخْتَلِفُوْنَ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya ibna rasuli rabbi al`alamina
segments.translation: Praise is for Allah Who guided me towards Islam, enlightened me in religion and granted me insight about those things in which people look for allegations and accusation.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اﷲِ الَّذِیْ یَرْزُقُ الْقَاسِطَ الْعَادِلَ وَالْعَاقِلَ وَالْجَاہِلَ وَ یَرْحَمُ السَّاہِیَ وَالْغَافِلَ فَکَیْفَ الدَّاعِیَ السَّآئِلَ
segments.translation: Pure is Allah Who sustains the great and the unjust, the intelligent and the fools, when He is Merciful towards the negligent and careless, why will He not be Merciful on those who invoke and beseech Him.

segments.arabic: َوَ لاَ اِلٰہَ اِلاَّ اﷲُ  اللَّطِیْفُ بِمَنْ شَرَدَ عَنْہُ مِنْ مُسْرِفِیْ عِبَادِہٖ لِیَرْجِعَ عَنْ عَتُوِّہٖ وَ عِنَادِنہٖ الرَّاضِیْ مِنَ الْمُنِیْبِ الْمُخْلِصِ بِدُوْنِ الْوُسْعِ وَالطَّاقَۃِ
segments.translation: There is no Lord except Allah and He bestows His grace and Mercy on those who run away from His obedience so that they may refrain from their tyranny and oppression and are prepared to do good deeds with sincere people.
And Allah is Great. He is tolerant and knowledgeable who has such amazing and marvelous proofs in the universe which proves His Godhood, without a doubt.

segments.arabic: اوَ عَلٰی کُلِّ نَوْعٍ مِنْ غَوَامِضِ تَقْدِیْرِہ وَ حُسْنِ تَدْبِیْرِہٖ دَلِیْلٌ وَاضِحٌ وَ شَاہِدُ عَدْلٍ یَقْضِیَانِ لَہٗ بِالْوَحْدَانِیَّۃِ
segments.translation: His recognition of destinies and the excellent policies are adequate evidences and the just witnesses are sufficient proof of His Oneness.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُکَ یَا مَنْ یَصْرِفُ الْبَلاَیَا وَ یَعْلَمُ الْخَفَایَا وَ یُجْزِلُ الْعَطَایَا سُؤَالَ نَادِمٍ عَلٰی اِقْتِرَافِ الْاٰثَامِ وَ سَالِمٍ عَلَی الْمَعَاصِیْ مِنَ اللَّیَالِیْ
segments.translation: O my Creator! O He who wards off the misfortune, aware of the secrets, gives abundance in bestowal of rewards, I ask You, as the one who is ashamed of his sins and is persistently absorbed in disobedience.

segments.arabic: وَالْاَیَّامِ اِذْلَمْ یَجِدْ مُجِیْرًا سِوَاکَ لِغُفْرَانِہَا وَلاَ مَوْئِلاً یَفْزَعُ اِلَیْہِ لِاِرْتِجَآءِ کَشْفِ فَاقَتِہٖ اِلاَّاِیَّاکَ
segments.translation: I don't find anyone other than You who can grant me refuge in it.And there is none other than You, with whom I can get my helplessness dispelled and can put forth my grievances.

segments.arabic: یَا جَلِیْلُ اَنْتَ الَّذِیْ عَمَّ الْخَلآئِقَ مَنُّکَ وَ غَمَرَتْہُمْ سَعَۃُ رَحْمَتُکَ وَ سَوَّغَتْہُمْ سََوَابِغُ  نِعْمَتِکَ
segments.translation: O the Lord of Majestic Your obligations have spread over the entire creation and our vast bounties have covered them up, and Your complete bestowals are a source of happiness

segments.arabic: ا کَرِیْمُ الْمَاٰبِ وَالْجَوَادُ الْوَہَّابِ وَالْمُنْتَقِمُ مِمَّنْ عَصَاہُ بِاَلِیْمِ الْعَذَابِ دَعَوْتُکَ مُقِرًّا بِالْاِسَائَۃِ عَلٰی نَفْسِیْ اِذْلَمْ اَجِدُ مَلْجَأ اَلْجَاَہُ اِلَیْہِ فِیْ اِغْتِفَادِ مَا اکْتَسَبْتَ مِنَ الْاٰثَامِ
segments.translation: O the Honorable and the Generous and the abundant forgiver, and the one to deal strictly with the disobedient. I confess the errors of my soul and I plead to You because I don't find a better place to seek pardon for my evil deeds, other than You.

segments.arabic: یَا خَیْرَ مَنِ اسْتُدْعٰی لِبَذْلِ الرَّغَآئِبِ وَ اَنْجَحَ مَامُوْلٍ لِکَشْفِ الْکَوَارِبِ لَکَ عَنَتِ الْوُجُوْہُ فَلاَ تَرُدَّنِیْ مِنْکَ بِالْحِرْمَانِ
segments.translation: O the bestower of the favorite bounties, and the warder of calamities and the foremost in making the wishes come true. The foreheads are bowed before You, don't send them dejected.

segments.arabic: اِنَّکَ تَفْعَلُ مَا تَشَآءُ وَ تَحْکُمُ مَا تُرِیْدُ اِلٰہِیْ وَ سَیِّدِیْ وَ مَوْلاَیَ اَیَّ رَبٍّ اِرْتَجِیْہِ اَمْ اَیَّ اِلٰہٍ اَقْصُدُہٗ اِذَا اَلَمَّ بِیَ النَّدَمُ وَ اَحَاطَتْ بِیَ الْمَعَاصِیْ وَ نَکَائِبُ خَوْفِ النِّقَمِ وَ اَنْتَ وَلِیَّ الصَّفْحِ وَ میَاوَی الْکَرَمِ
segments.translation: Indeed You do what pleases You and command what You like. O My Lord! O my Master! When sorrow and shame is open and the feeling of fear and chastisement has fallen down, then who is the lord from whom I can have hopes, who is He to whom I can have hopes, who is He to whom I can turn and You are the Lord of forgiveness and the peak of Mercy.

segments.arabic: َ  اِلٰہِیْ اَتُقِیْمُنِیْ مَقَامَ الْہَلَکَۃِ وَ اَنْتَ جَمِیْلُ السِّتْرِ وَ تَسَأَلُنِیْ عَنْ اِقْتِرَافِیْ عَلٰی رُئُوْسِ الْاَشْہَادِ وَ قَدْ مَخَبَّاتِ السِّتْرِ
segments.translation: O My Lord! Will you put me among those who will be destroyed, whereas You are the best concealer (of sins), will You question me for my sins in everybody's presence, whereas You are aware of the secrets of the hearts.

segments.arabic: فَاِنْ کُنْتُی اِلٰہِیْ مُسْرِفًا عَلٰی نَفْسِیْ مُخْطِئًا عَلَیْہَا بِاِنْتِہَاکَ الْحُرُمَاتِ نَاسِیًا لِمَا اجْتَرَمْتُ مِنَ الْہَفَوَاتِ فَاَنْتَ لَطِیْفٌ تَجُوْدُ عَلَی الْمُسْرِفِیْنَ بِرَحْمَتِکَ وَ تَتَفَضَّلْ عَلَی الْخَاطِئِیْنَ بِکَرَمِکَ فَارْحَمْنِیْ یَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِیْنَ فَاِنَّکَ تُسَکِّنَ
segments.translation: O Allah although I have been unjust on my soul, and have overlooked Your commands, and have indulged myself in sins, and have forgotten everything, but still You are the Owner of favours who is extremely kind towards the sinners and is benevolent upon the evil doers by Your Grace.

segments.arabic: َ یَا اِلٰہِیْ بِتَحَبُّنِکَ رَوْعَاتِ قُلُوْبِ الْوَجِلِیْنَ وَ تُحَقُّقِ بِتَطَوُّلِکَ اَمَلَ الْاٰمِلِیْنَ وَ تُفِیْضُ سَجَالَ عَطَایَاکَ عَلٰی غَیْرِ الْمُسْتَاہِلِیْنَ ف
segments.translation: Thus O the great Merciful be kind to me, as You are the one Who can give peace to the living heart and by Your favours, make the wishes of the hopeful come true. Your mercy also showers on the undeserving.

segments.arabic: َاٰمِنِّیْ بِرَجَآئٍ لاَ یَشُوْبُہٗ قُنُوْطٌ وَ اَمَلٍ لاَ یُکَدِّرُہُ بَاْسٌی
segments.translation: Give me shade in those desires, where there is the sign of despair, and such a hope which is not destined by Your Chastisement.

segments.arabic: ا مُحِیْطًا بِکُلِّ شَیْءٍ عِلْمًا وَ قَدْ اَصْبَحْتُ سَیِّدِیْ وَ اَمْسَیْتُ عَلٰی بَابٍ مِنْ اَبْوَابِ مِنَحِکَ سَآئِلاً وَ عَنِ التَّعَرُّضِ لِسِوَاکَ
segments.translation: O He who has covered everything by His knowledge, O my Master, now my state is such that from dawn to dusk I am begging at the door of Your Mercy and am away from asking from anyone else other than You.

segments.arabic: بِالْمَسْأَلَۃِ عَادِلاً وَّ لَیْسَ مِنْ جَمِیْلِ اِمْتِنَانِکَ رَدُّ سَآئِلٍ مَا سُوْرٍ مَلْہُوْفٍ وَ مُضْطَرٍّ لِانْتِظَارِ خَیْرِکَ الْمَالُوْفِی
segments.translation: And Your immense grace is too great to reject the plea of a beggar, of a person who is imprisoned, one who is inflicted in problems, and one who impatiently awaits Your forgiveness to turn him down

segments.arabic: الٰہِیْ اَنْتَ الَّذِیْ عَجَزَتِ الْاَوْہَامُ عَنِ الْاِحَاطَۃِ بِکَ وَ کَلَّتِ الْاَلْسُنُ عَنْ نَعْتِ ذٰلِکَ فَبِاٰلَآئِکَ وَ طَوْلِکَ
segments.translation: O my Lord, the strength, intellect and thoughts are incapable to gather knowledge about You and the tongues are dumbstruck in praising You.

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاغْفِرْلِیْ ذُنُوْبِیْ وَ اَوْسِعْ عَلَیَّ مِنْ فَضْلِکَ الْوَاسَعِ رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا حَلٰلاً طَیِّبًا فِیْ عَافِیَۃٍ وَ اَقِلْنِیْ الْعَثْرَۃ
segments.translation: Thus send blessings on Mohammed and his progeny by Your Grace and forgive my sins and Grant me pure and excellent and honorable sustenance by Your vast Grace.

segments.arabic: َ یَا غَایَۃَ الْاٰمِلِیْنَ وَ جَبَّارَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِیْنَ وَالْبَاقِیْ بَعْدَ فَنَآءِ الْخَلْقِ اَجْمَعِیْنَ وَ دَیَّانَ یَوْمِ الدِّیْنِ
segments.translation: O the only support of hopeful, O the  one having power on the Heavens and the Earth,O the one to remain after the destruction of entire creation, the Judge on the day of reward and punishment,

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ یَا مَوْلاَیَ ثِقَۃُ مَنْ لَمْ یَثْقِ بِنَفْسِہٖ لِاِفْرَاطِ خَلَلِہٖ وَ اَمَلُ مَنْ لَمْ یَکُنْ لَہٗ تَاْمِیْلٌ لِکَثْرَۃِ زَلَلِہٖ وَ رَجَآءُ مَنْ لَمْ یَرْتَجِ لِنَفْسِہٖ بِوَسِیْلَۃِ عَمَلِہ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya aba muhammadin alhasana ibna `aliyyin
segments.translation: O my Lord! One who due to errors does not have trust on himself, then his trust and the hope of the one who does not find any destination and the hope of the one who does not have any hopes left due to his deeds.

segments.arabic: الٰہِیْ فَاَنْقِذْنِیْ بِرَحْمَتِکَ مِنَ الْمَہَالِکِ وَ اَحْلِلْنِیْ دَارَ الْاَخْیَارِ وَاجْعَلْنِیْ مِنْ مُرَافِقِیْ الْاَبْرَارِ وَاغْفِرْلِیْ ذُنُوْبَ اللَّیْلِ وَالنَّہَارِ
segments.translation: O my Lord save me from destruction by Your Mercy, and put me among Your appointed people, count me among the pious ones, forgive my sins of the night and days,

segments.arabic: ََِِیَا مُطَّلِعًا عَلَی الْاَسْرَارِ اِحْتَمِلْ عَنِّیْ مَوْلاَیَ اَدَآءَ مَا افْتَرَضْتَ عَلَیَّ لِلْاٰبَآءِ وَالْاُمَّہَاتِ وَالْاِخْوَانِ وَالْاَخْوَاتِ بِلُطْفِکَ وَ کَرِمَکَ یَا ذَاالْجَلاَلِ وَالْاِکْرَامِ وَ اَشْرِکْنَا فِیْ دُعَآءِ مَنِ اسْتَجَبْتَ لَہٗ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتِ
segments.translation: O the Knower of the secrets of the hearts, O the possessor of grandeur and Majestic, the rights of my parents, brothers, and sisters which are obligatory upon me, You fulfill it and relieve me of it with Your Mercy and include me among those believers, whose supplication You have accepted.

segments.arabic: اِنَّکَ جَوَادٌ کَرِیْمٌ وَہَّابٌ  صَلَّی اﷲُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِہٖ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِیْمًا
segments.translation: Indeed You are Generous and on excessive forgiver. O Allah send blessings on Mohammad and his progeny and bestow Your best protection

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya ibna sayyidati nisa'i al`alamina
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O son of the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O son of the Commander of the Believers!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O son of Fatimah, the luminous lady!
Peace be on you, O beloved of Allah!
Peace be on you, O choice of Allah!
Peace be on you, O trustee of Allah!

segments.transliteration: wa jahadta fi allahi haqqa jihadihi
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O Argument of Allah!
Peace be on you, O Light of Allah!
Peace be on you, O Path of Allah!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بَيَانَ حُكْمِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O elucidation of the rule of Allah!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَاصِرَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O supporter of the religion of Allah!

segments.transliteration: ana ya mawlaya mawlan laka wa li-ali baytika
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O pure master!
Peace be on you, O self-righteous and truthful!
Peace be on you, O practiser (of Godâs commands) and trustee!
Peace be on you, O well-experienced in the interpretation (of the Qur'an)!
Peace be on you, O guide and well-guided!
Peace be on you, O immaculate and pure!
Peace be on you, O pious and infallible!

segments.transliteration: wa ana abra'u ila allahi ta`ala minhum
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O veritable truth!
Peace be on you, O martyr and veracious!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O Abu-Muhammad al-Hasan, the son of `Ali!
Allahâs mercy and blessings be upon you!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of Allahâs Messenger!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Believers!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the doyenne of the women of the world!
I bear witness that you performed the prayers [duly],

segments.transliteration: wa ana fihi min jiwarikuma fa-ajirani
segments.translation: defrayed the poor-rate,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,
worshipped Allah sincerely,
and strove for the sake of Allah with due striving
until death came upon you.
So, peace from me be upon you
as long as I am alive and as long as day and night remain,
and peace be upon your Household, the pure, the immaculate.

segments.arabic: أَنَا يَا مَوْلاَيَ مَوْلىٰ لَكَ وَلآِلِ بَيْتِكَ
segments.translation: O my master, I am a servant of you and of your Household,
peaceful with those who keep peace with you,
at war against those who are at war against you,
and believing in your secret and open affairs
and your inward and outward affairs.
May Allah curse your enemies
from the past and late generations.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا أَبْرَأُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ مِنْهُمْ
segments.translation: And I release myself from them before Almighty Allah!
O my master, Abu-Muhammad;

segments.arabic: يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: and my master, Abu-`Abdullah!
Today is Monday,
which is the day of both of you and carrying your names.
On this day, I am your guest;
therefore, receive me as your guest and treat me hospitably.
Verily, you both are the most excellent hosts a guest may gain.
On this day too, I am in your vicinity; so, treat me as your neighbor,
since you are commanded to receive your guests and neighbors hospitably.
May Allahâs peace be upon you both and upon your immaculate household.
In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Glory be to the Kind, Compassionate, and the All-magnanimous!
Glory be to the Generous and the most generous!
Glory be to the Discerning and the Wise!
Glory be to him, the all-hearing and immense!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَلَى إِقْبَالِ النَّهَارِ وَ إِقْبَالِ اللَّيْلِ
segments.translation: Glory be to him upon daytime and nighttime arriving!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَلَى إِدْبَارِ النَّهَارِ وَ إِدْبَارِ اللَّيْلِ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah upon the time of sunset and the zero hours of the departing night.

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ فِي آنَاءِ اللَّيْلِ وَ آنَاءِ النَّهَارِ
segments.translation: There is no God except Allah in the watches of the night and day.

segments.arabic: وَ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَ الْمَجْدُ وَ الْعَظَمَةُ وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ
segments.translation: For Him alone is; the praise, might, greatness and omnipotence.

segments.arabic: مَعَ كُلِّ نَفَسٍ وَ كُلِّ طَرْفَةٍ
segments.translation: With every breath and twinkle of an eye

segments.arabic: وَ كُلِّ لَمْحَةٍ سَبَقَتْ فِي عِلْمِهِ
segments.translation: and every moment already registered in His all-embracing awareness,
Glory be counted to you!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ زِنَةَ ذَلِكَ وَ مَا أَحْصَى كِتَابُكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to you equal to the measure and the infinite range that covers Your Book!
Glory be to You; that is equal to the measure of Your Throne!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ [سُبْحَانَكَ‏] سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا ذِي الْجَلالِ وَ الْإِكْرامِ‏
segments.translation: Glorified be our Allah, the Glorious and Gracious.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا تَسْبِيحاً كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِهِ وَ عِزِّ جَلَالِهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah with a proper glorification due to His distinct Munificence and His Excellent Glory!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا تَسْبِيحاً مُقَدَّساً مُزَكًّى كَذَلِكَ فَعَلَ رَبُّنَا
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah with a righteous and holy glorification.
Glory be to Allah the ever-living and clement!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي‏ كَتَبَ عَلى‏ نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ
segments.translation: Glory be to him who has written upon himself The Mercy!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ آدَمَ وَ أَخْرَجَنَا مِنْ صُلْبِهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to him who Created Adam and bought us from his essence.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي الْأَمْوَاتَ وَ يُمِيتُ الْأَحْيَاءَ
segments.translation: Glory be to him who revives the deceased's and causes the living to die.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ رَحِيمٌ [حَلِيمٌ‏] لَا يَعْجَلُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who is Merciful, never does a thing in haste.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ رَقِيبٌ [قَرِيبٌ‏] لَا يَغْفُلُ
segments.translation: Glory be to you, who is watchful and never misses.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ جَوَادٌ لَا يَبْخَلُ
segments.translation: Glory be to you, The Generous who is never a miser.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ حَلِيمٌ لَا يَجْهَلُ
segments.translation: Glory be to you, The Forbearing who never forgets.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ وَ لَهُ الْمِدْحَةُ الْبَالِغَةُ
segments.translation: Glory be to you, who He-great is His praise.

segments.arabic: فِي جَمِيعِ مَا يُثْنَى عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَجْدِ
segments.translation: And for him is the conclusive praise in his every Glory that is praised.
Glory be to Allah, The forbearing,

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ‏
segments.translation: and God bless our chief, Muhammad; and his immaculate Household.
In the Name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

segments.arabic: ‏ أُعِيذُ نَفْسِي بِرَبِّي الْأَكْبَرِ مِمَّا يَخْفَى وَ مَا يَظْهَرُ
segments.translation: I seek protection for me, in my Lord, the Most Great from; the evil of what is hidden and apparent,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ أُنْثَى وَ ذَكَرٍ
segments.translation: the evil of every female and male,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَتِ الشَّمْسَ وَ الْقَمَرَ
segments.translation: the evil of what the sun and moon behold.

segments.arabic: قُدُّوسٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَ الرُّوحِ
segments.translation: Most Holy, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

segments.arabic: أَدْعُوكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْجِنُّ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ سَامِعِينَ مُطِيعِينَ
segments.translation: I call on you, O jinn, if you are hearing, obedient,

segments.arabic: وَ أَدْعُوكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْإِنْسُ إِلَى اللَّطِيفِ‏ الْخَبِيرِ
segments.translation: and I call you, O humankind, to the Gracious, the All-knowing.

segments.arabic: وَ أَدْعُوكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْجِنُّ وَ الْإِنْسُ
segments.translation: I call you, O humankind and jinn,

segments.arabic: إِلَى الَّذِي خَتَمْتُهُ بِخَاتَمِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
segments.translation: to Him Who is obeyed by all creation stamped with the seal of the Lord of the Worlds,

segments.arabic: وَ خَاتَمِ جِبْرِيلَ وَ مِيْكَالَ وَ إِسْرَافِيلَ
segments.translation: and the seal of Jibrail, Mikail, and Israfil,

segments.arabic: وَ خَاتَمِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ
segments.translation: and the seal of Sulayman b. Dawud, peace be upon them

segments.arabic: وَ خَاتَمِ مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَ النَّبِيِّينَ
segments.translation: and the seal of Muhammad, the chief of the Prophets,

segments.arabic: صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
segments.translation: blessings of Allah on Muhammad and his Ahl Al-Bayt, the good and pure.

segments.arabic: وَ أَزْجُرُ [وَ آخُذُ] عَنْ فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍ كُلَّمَا يَغْدُو وَ يَرُوحُ مِنْ ذِي حَيٍّ أَوْ عَقْرَبٍ أَوْ سَاحِرٍ أَوْ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ أَوْ سُلْطَانٍ عَنِيدٍ
segments.translation: Remove from so-and-so, son of so-and-so, every female jinn with a rebellious spirit, a jinn or demon or rebellious enchanter, or obstinate ruler or an accursed devil.

segments.arabic: أَخَذْتُ عَنْهُ مَا يُرَى وَ مَا لَا يُرَى
segments.translation: Remove from so-and-so, which is seen and unseen;

segments.arabic: وَ مَا رَأَتْ عَيْنُ نَائِمٍ أَوْ يَقْظَانٍ بِإِذْنِ اللهِ اللَّطِيفِ الْخَبِيرِ
segments.translation: seen by an eye, sleeping or awake, by the will of Allah, the Gracious, the All-knowing.

segments.arabic: لَا سُلْطَانَ لَكُمْ عَلَى اللهِ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ وَ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً
segments.translation: There is no way for you over him, nor over what is feared for him. Allah, no partner has He, and Allah bless Muhammad and his Ahl Al-Bayt.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
O, Allah, glory be to You and praise.
You are Allah; the Truth king,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْتَ مَلِكٌ لَا مَلِكَ مَعَكَ وَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
segments.translation: You are the King without a king with nor a partner

segments.arabic: وَ لَا إِلَهَ دُونَكَ اعْتَرَفَ لَكَ الْخَلَائِقُ
segments.translation: and no God besides You; the creation confessed to You.

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَ لَكَ الْمُلْكُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي لَا يَزُولُ
segments.translation: O, Lord to You belongs praise, and For You; is the Great Kingdom which doesn't change,

segments.arabic: وَ الْغَنِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ الَّذِي لَا يَعُولُ
segments.translation: The great rich Whom doesn't wail,

segments.arabic: وَ السُّلْطَانُ الْعَزِيزُ الَّذِي لَا يُضَامُ
segments.translation: The mighty King Whom is never overpowered,

segments.arabic: وَ الْعِزُّ الْمَنِيعُ الَّذِي لَا يُرَامُ
segments.translation: The indomitable superiority which never leaves,

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَوْلُ الْوَاسِعُ الَّذِي لَا يَضِيقُ
segments.translation: The immense might which doesn't constrain,

segments.arabic: وَ الْقُوَّةُ الْمَتِينَةُ الَّتِي لَا تَضْعُفُ
segments.translation: The excellent strength which doesn't get weak,

segments.arabic: وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي لَا يُوصَفُ
segments.translation: The great grandeur which can't be described,
and the excellent greatness!

segments.arabic: فَحَوْلَ أَرْكَانِ عَرْشِكَ النُّورُ وَ الْوَقَارُ
segments.translation: Hence, Your Throne Pillars are surrounded with light and solemnity;

segments.arabic: مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَخْلُقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضَ
segments.translation: before the heavens and earth were created.
And Your throne was above the water;
Your seat was glowing with the light!

segments.arabic: وَ سُرَادِقُكَ سُرَادِقُ النُّورِ وَ الْعَظَمَةِ
segments.translation: Your pavilions were pavillions of light and greatness,

segments.arabic: وَ الْإِكْلِيلُ الْمُحِيطُ بِهِ هَيْكَلُ السُّلْطَانِ
segments.translation: and the surrounding diadem has; the King's entity,
pride, and glorification.

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation: There is no God save You, the Lord of the Great Throne

segments.arabic: وَ [ذُو] الْبَهَاءِ وَ النُّورِ وَ الْحُسْنِ وَ الْجَمَالِ
segments.translation: (Owner of); elegance, light, comeliness, beauty,

segments.arabic: وَ الْعُلَى وَ الْعَظَمَةِ وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَ الْجَبَرُوتِ وَ السُّلْطَانِ وَ الْقُدْرَةِ
segments.translation: highness, greatness, grandeur, power, supremacy, and ability.
You indeed are the generous Allmighty.
(The All-Capable) upon everything You created,
nothing can measure Your loftiness
and weak Your greatness.
You created everything with Your desire;

segments.arabic: فَنَفَذَ فِيمَا خَلَقْتَ عِلْمُكَ وَ أَحَاطَ بِهِ خُبْرُكَ
segments.translation: fulfilled in Your creation Your knowledge, surrounded by Your announcement,

segments.arabic: وَ أَتَى عَلَى ذَلِكَ أَمْرُكَ وَ وَسِعَهُ حَوْلُكَ وَ قُوَّتُكَ
segments.translation: completed it by Your command and extended over Your force and strength!

segments.arabic: لَكَ الْخَلْقُ وَ الْأَمْرُ وَ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى
segments.translation: ForYou; belong the creation and command, the Most Excellent Names,

segments.arabic: وَ الْأَمْثَالُ الْعُلْيَا وَ الْآلَاءُ وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ
segments.translation: the loftiest likenesses, bounties, and grandeur.

segments.arabic: ذُو الْجَلالِ وَ الْإِكْرامِ‏ وَ النِّعَمُ الْعِظَامُ
segments.translation: You are the possessor of; majesty and munificence, great blessings,
and the pride that doesn't leave.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ وَ بِحَمْدِكَ تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ
segments.translation: Glory and praise be to You, blessed You are, and splendid be the praising of You.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُولِكَ
segments.translation: O, Allah (please) do send blessings upon Muhammed, Your servant, messenger,

segments.arabic: وَ نَبِيِّكَ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ الْمُقَفِّي عَلَى آثَارِهِمْ
segments.translation: and Prophet; the seal of prophets who trace their footsteps,
the proof upon their nations,
the ruler upon their believing,

segments.arabic: وَ النَّاصِرِ لَهُمْ مِنْ ضَلَالِ مَنِ ادَّعَى مِنْ غَيْرِهِمْ دَعْوَتَهُمْ وَ سَارَ بِخِلَافِ سِيرَتِهِمْ
segments.translation: and the helper for them before the error of who claims it without a right; and walked opposite their path.

segments.arabic: صَلَاةً تُعَظِّمُ بِهَا نُورَهُ عَلَى نُورِهِمْ
segments.translation: A blessing that; glorifies his light upon their,

segments.arabic: وَ تَزِيدُ بِهَا شَرَفاً عَلَى شَرَفِهِمْ
segments.translation: decreases his honor upon their,

segments.arabic: وَ تُبَلِّغُهُ بِهَا أَفْضَلَ مَا بَلَّغْتَ نَبِيّاً مِنْهُمْ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.translation: will take him with the most excellent from what other Prophet reached and upon his Household.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَزِدْ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
segments.translation: O, Allah does increase Muhammed blessings upon him and his Household;
with every merit another merit,
and with every nobility another nobility;

segments.arabic: حَتَّى تُعَرِّفَ فَضِيلَتَهُ وَ كَرَامَتَهُ أَهْلَ الْكَرَامَةِ عِنْدَكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
segments.translation: until The people of dignity will realize his merit and nobility for You on the Day of Resurrection.

segments.arabic: وَ هَبْ لَهُ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
segments.translation: Bless him, blessings of Allah upon him and his Household;
the best of greatness,
the best of satisfaction,
raise his highest degree,
accept his great intercession,

segments.arabic: وَ آتِهِ سُؤْلَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ وَ الْأُولَى
segments.translation: and grant him his request in the end and the beginning.
May it be so; Allah of Truth, Lord of the worlds!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْأَكْبَرِ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation: O, Allah, I beseech you by Your enormous saved great name;

segments.arabic: الْمَخْزُونِ الَّذِي تُفَتَّحُ بِهِ أَبْوَابُ سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ
segments.translation: that opens Your heavens door and mercy,

segments.arabic: وَ يَسْتَوْجِبُ بِهِ رِضْوَانَكَ الَّذِي تُحِبُّ
segments.translation: demands by it Your satisfaction that You like,

segments.arabic: وَ تَهْوَى وَ تَرْضَى عَمَّنْ دَعَاكَ بِهِ
segments.translation: desire, and accept upon whom prayed for You!

segments.arabic: وَ هُوَ حَقٌّ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ لَا تَحْرِمَ بِهِ سَائِلَكَ
segments.translation: And it is the right that You do not deny the one who asks from you,

segments.arabic: وَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ دَعَاكَ بِهِ الرُّوحُ الْأَمِينُ
segments.translation: and by every name was called on You by; the trustworthy spirit,
the close Angels,
the recorders of deeds,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْبِيَاؤُكَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ وَ الْأَخْيَارُ الْمُنْتَجَبُونَ
segments.translation: Your sent Prophets, the chosen good.

segments.arabic: وَ جَمِيعُ مَنْ فِي سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَ أَقْطَارِ أَرْضِكَ
segments.translation: And all who are in your heavens, the quarters of the earth,

segments.arabic: وَ الصُّفُوفُ حَوْلَ عَرْشِكَ تُقَدِّسُ لَكَ
segments.translation: and queues around Your throne indeed do glorify You to;

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: send Your blessings upon Muhammed and his Household

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَنْظُرَ فِي حَاجَتِي إِلَيْكَ
segments.translation: and look into my need from You.

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَرْزُقَنِي نَعِيمَ الْآخِرَةِ وَ حُسْنَ ثَوَابِ
segments.translation: Bestow upon me with Your favor of blisses of the end,

segments.arabic: أَهْلِهَا فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
segments.translation: the splendid reward of its people in the home that is made from Your Bounties,

segments.arabic: وَ مَنَازِلَ الْأَخْيَارِ فِي ظِلٍّ أَمِينٍ
segments.translation: and the high standing of the best in a safe shade!

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ بَرَأْتَنِي وَ أَنْتَ تُعِيدُنِي لَكَ
segments.translation: You are indeed The One who created me and will send me back to You.

segments.arabic: أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَ إِلَيْكَ فَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي
segments.translation: To You have I; submitted myself, and I entrusted my affairs with You.
To You have I; commend my cause

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَ بِكَ وَثِقْتُ
segments.translation: and rely and trust on You!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَدْعُوكَ دُعَاءَ ضَعِيفٍ مُضْطَرٍّ
segments.translation: O, Allah, I supplicate You with the supplication of a compelled weak one!

segments.arabic: وَ رَحْمَتُكَ يَا رَبِّ أَوْثَقُ عِنْدِي مِنْ دُعَائِي
segments.translation: And Your mercy is much more trusted to me than my prayer.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَأْذَنِ اللَّيْلَةَ لِدُعَائِي أَنْ يَعْرُجَ إِلَيْكَ
segments.translation: O, Allah, therefore; permit my prayer to rise to You,

segments.arabic: وَ أْذَنْ لِكَلَامِي أَنْ يَلِجَ إِلَيْكَ
segments.translation: permit my words to reach You,
and turn away Your sight from my sins.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad;

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ
segments.translation: I do seek Your refuge upon astray this night;
of disobedience or luring a believer!
Or to do deeds in what You don't like
because You are; the God of the high heavens,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْتَ تَرَى وَ لَا تُرَى وَ أَنْتَ بِالْمَنْظَرِ الْأَعْلَى
segments.translation: Verily You see but cannot be seen while You are in the Highest Prospect;
splits the grain and the date-stone.
O Allah, I beseech You this night;
the best of the destinies,
completing in blisses,
the best praise in the ease,
the best patience in the adversity,

segments.arabic: وَ أَفْضَلَ الرُّجُوعِ   إِلَى أَفْضَلِ دَارِ الْمَأْوَى
segments.translation: and the best return to the best house of Permanence!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
I ask; the love for Your well-beloved,
the hindering of which You have deemed forbidden,
be apprehended from Your fear,
fearing Your chastisement,
salvation from Your punishment,
desire in a proper reward for You,

segments.arabic: وَ الْفِقْهَ فِي دِينِكَ وَ الْفَهْمَ فِي كِتَابِكَ
segments.translation: knowledge in Your religion, understanding Your book,

segments.arabic: وَ الْقُنُوعَ بِرِزْقِكَ وَ الْوَرَعَ عَنْ مَحَارِمِكَ
segments.translation: feeling the satisfaction in Your livelihood, God-fearing of which You have deemed forbidden,

segments.arabic: وَ الِاسْتِحْلَالَ لِحَلَالِكَ وَ التَّحْرِيمَ لِحَرَامِكَ
segments.translation: deeming permissible for Your unforbidden, Forebodement of what You have deemed forbidden,

segments.arabic: وَ الِانْتِهَاءَ عَنْ مَعَاصِيكَ وَ الْحِفْظَ لِوَصِيَّتِكَ
segments.translation: preventing sinful deeds, living up to Your will,

segments.arabic: وَ الصِّدْقَ بِوَعْدِكَ وَ الْوَفَاءَ بِعَهْدِكَ
segments.translation: credence to Your promise, fulfillment of Your oath,

segments.arabic: وَ الِاعْتِصَامَ بِحَبْلِكَ وَ الْوُقُوفَ عِنْدَ مَوْعِظَتِكَ
segments.translation: holding fast to Your bond, sticking at Your admonition,
restrain from Your prohibitions,
patience upon Your worshipping
and working on all Your commands.
O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ
segments.translation: And send Your blessings upon Muhammed; the seal of prophets
and his leading Household

segments.arabic: وَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ‏
segments.translation: and peace be upon them with God's mercy and blessings.

title: Tuesday   Duas.org

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
All praise be to Allah;
and praise is His right, since He deserves it,
abundant praise!

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي:
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bihi min sharri nafsi
segments.translation: I seek refuge in Him from the evil of my soul,
âFor surely, the soul commands to evil
except as my Lord has mercy.â

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ ٱلشَّيْطَانِ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bihi min sharri ashshaytani
segments.translation: I seek refuge in Him from the evil of Satan
who adds sins to my sin.

segments.arabic: وَ أَحْتَرِزُ بِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ فَاجِرٍ
segments.transliteration: wa ahtarizu bihi min kulli jabbarin fajirin
segments.translation: I seek protection with Him from every wicked tyrant,
unjust sovereign,
and conquering enemy.
O Allah, place me among Your troops,
for Your troopsâthey are the victors,
and place me in Your party,
for Your partyâthey are the ones who prosper,
and place me among Your friends,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّ أَوْلِيَائَكَ لاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
segments.transliteration: fa-inna awliya'aka la khawfun `alayhim wala hum yahzanuna
segments.translation: for Your friendsâno fear shall be upon them, nor shall they experience sorrow.
O Allah, set right for me my religion,
for it is the preserving tie of my affair;
set right for me my hereafter,
for it is the abode of my permanent lodging

segments.transliteration: wa ilayha min mujawarati alli'ami mafarri
segments.translation: and to it I flee from the neighborhood of the vile!

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلِ ٱلْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ
segments.transliteration: waj`al alhayata ziyadatan li fi kulli khayrin
segments.translation: Make life an increase for me in every good

segments.arabic: وَٱلْوَفَاةَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
segments.transliteration: walwafata rahatan li min kulli sharrin
segments.translation: and death an ease for me from every evil!
O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad,
the Seal of the Prophets
and the completion of the number of the envoys,
and upon his Household, the good, the pure,
and upon his Companions, the distinguished,

segments.transliteration: wa hab li fi alththulatha'i thalathan
segments.translation: and give me on Tuesday three things:

segments.arabic: لاَ تَدَعْ لِي ذَنْباً إِلاَّ غَفَرْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: la tada` li dhanban illa ghafartahu
segments.translation: Leave no sin for me unless You forgive it,
no grief unless You take it away,
and no enemy unless You repel him!
In the name of âIn the name of Allah,â the best of the Names,
In the name of Allah, the Lord of the earth and the heaven,
I seek to repulse every hateful thing, the first of which is His anger,

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْتَجْلِبُ كُلَّ مَحْبُوبٍ أَوَّلُهُ رِضَاهُ
segments.transliteration: wa astajlibu kulla mahbubin awwaluhu ridahu
segments.translation: and I seek to attract every lovable thing, the first of which is His good pleasure!
So, seal me with forgiveness from You,
O Patron of beneficence!

segments.arabic: اَلّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ غَفْلَةَ النَّاسِ لَنَا ذِكْرً

By granting abundance of provision.
And You are the Knower of the unseen,

segments.arabic: سَتَرْتَ عَلَيَّ عُيُوبِي وَأَحْصَيْتَ عَلَيَّ ذُنُوبِي
segments.transliteration: Satarta âalayya âuyÅ«bÄ« wa aá¸¥á¹£ayta âalayya dhunÅ«bÄ«
segments.translation: You concealed my faults and counted my sins,
And honored me with knowledge of Your religion.

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ تَهْتِكْ عَنِّي سِتْرَكَ يَا حَنَّانُ
segments.transliteration: Wa lam tahtik âannÄ« sitrak yÄ á¸¥annÄn
segments.translation: And You did not tear away Your covering from me, O Most Kind,
And You did not disgrace me, O Bestower.

segments.arabic: اَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: Asâaluka an tuá¹£alliya âalÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُوَسِّعَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْوَاسِعِ
segments.transliteration: Wa an tuwassiâa âalayya min faá¸lika al-wÄsiâ
segments.translation: And to expand for me from Your vast bounty,
A wide, lawful, and pure provision,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ ذُنُوبًا حَالَتْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa an taghfira dhunÅ«ban á¸¥Älat baynÄ« wa baynak
segments.translation: And forgive sins that stand between me and You,
Through my committing them.

segments.arabic: فَأَنْتَ أَهْلٌ أَنْ تَجُودَ عَلَيَّ بِسَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: Fa-anta ahlun an tajÅ«da âalayya bi-saâati raá¸¥matik
segments.translation: For You are worthy to bestow upon me Your vast mercy,
And save me from painful punishment,
And raise me to the ranks of the honored.
And join me, my Master, with the righteous,
Those whom the angels take in a pure state,
Saying: Peace be upon you,
Enter Paradise for what you used to do.
Through Your pardon and covering,
O Kind, O Merciful.

segments.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ الصَّلَاةَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa asâaluka aá¹£-á¹£alÄta âalÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: And I ask You for blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تَحْتَمِلَ عَنِّي وَاجِبَ الْآبَاءِ وَالْأُمَّهَاتِ
segments.transliteration: Wa an taá¸¥tamila âannÄ« wÄjiba al-ÄbÄâi wal-ummahÄt
segments.translation: And to bear on my behalf the rights of my parents,
And fulfill their dues for me,
And join me with them among the righteous,
And the brothers and sisters, the believing men and women,
And forgive me and all of them.
Surely, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ وَآلِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
segments.transliteration: Wa á¹£allÄ llÄhu âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin an-nabiyy wa Älihi ajmaâÄ«n
segments.translation: And may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad the Prophet and all his family.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا خُزَّانَ عِلْمِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O depositories of Allahâs knowledge!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا تَرَاجِمَةَ وَحْيِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O interpreters of Allahâs Revelation!
Peace be on you, O leaders to true guidance!
Peace be on you, O signs of piety!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَوْلاَدَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O descendants of Allahâs Messenger!
I recognize your rights,
I discernibly acknowledge your true standing,
I incur the hostility of your enemies,
and I show loyalty to your loyalists.
May Allah accept me, my father, and mother as ransoms for you!
Blessings of Allah be upon you.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَوَالَىٰ آخِرَهُمْ كَمَا تَوَالَيْتُ أَوَّلَهُمْ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni atawala akhirahum kama tawalaytu awwalahum
segments.translation: O Allah, I am willingly showing loyalty to the last of them just as I have shown loyalty to the first of them,

segments.transliteration: wa abra'u min kulli walijatin dunahum
segments.translation: I release myself from any confidant other than them,

segments.transliteration: wa akfuru biljibti walttaghuti wallati wal`uzza
segments.translation: and I reject all idols, false deities, al-Lat, and al-`Uzza.
Blessings of Allah be upon you, O my Masters!
Mercy of Allah and His benedictions be upon you, too.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدَ ٱلْعَابِدِينَ وَسُلاَلَةَ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya sayyida al`abidina wa sulalata alwasiyyina
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O master of the worshippers and descendant of the Prophetsâ successors.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بَاقِرَ عِلْمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O he who split open the knowledge of the Prophets.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَادِقاً مُصَدِّقاً فِي ٱلْقَوْلِ وَٱلْفِعْلِ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya sadiqan musaddaqan fi alqawli walfi`li
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O veracious and honest in all [your] words and deeds.
O my Masters! Today is your day,
which is Tuesday,
and on this day, I am your guest
and I am in your vicinity;
so, receive me as your guest and treat me as your neighbor,
[I ask you] by Allahâs standing with you
and with your Household, the pure and immaculate.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent and Merciful

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي عُلُوِّهِ دَانٍ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who is nigh in His sublimity,

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي دُنُوِّهِ عَالٍ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who is Sublime in His nearness,

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي إِشْرَاقِهِ مُنِيرٌ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him who is Brilliant in His glow.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي سُلْطَانِهِ قَوِيٌّ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him who is Powerful in His (absolute) authority!
Glory be to, The forbearing and Graceful.
Glory be to, The All-Sufficient and Praised.
Glory be to, The highest and Immense.
Glory be to Him who removes the Grief.

segments.arabic: وَ هُوَ الدَّائِمُ الصَّمَدُ الْفَرْدُ الْقَدِيمُ
segments.translation: And He is; The everlasting, eternal, Sempiternal and Unique.
Glory be to him who exalted in the air.
Glory be to, The eminent and Ever-living!
Glory be to the Living, the Self-Subsistent.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الدَّائِمِ الْبَاقِي الَّذِي لَا يَزُولُ
segments.translation: Glory be to the Remaining, the Perpetual; Who isn't endless!
Glory be to Him who nothing decreases His treasure!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يَنْفَدُ مَا عِنْدَهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Whose possessions never run out.
Glory be to Him Whose signs never perish.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يُشَاوِرُ فِي أَمْرِهِ أَحَداً
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who never betakes to Himself a partner in His affairs.
Glory be to Him except Whom there is no god.
Glory be to the Highest, the Incomparably Great.
Glory be to Allah, and in praise of Him.
Glory be to the Possessor of Grandeur, High Respect.
Glory be to Allah, The Possessor of eternal, superior Manifest.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي عُلُوِّهِ دَانٍَ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, Who is; nigh in His sublimity,

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ] وَ فِي دُنُوِّهِ عَالٍ]
segments.translation: Sublime in His nearness,

segments.arabic: وَ فِي إِشْرَاقِهِ مُنِيرٌ وَ فِي سُلْطَانِهِ قَوِيٌّ
segments.translation: Brilliant in His glow, and Powerful in His (absolute) authority!
And is Everlasting in His Kingdom!

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّهِ‏ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ‏
segments.translation: Allah's blessings be upon His Messenger, our Master Muhammed, and his immaculate household.
In the Name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

segments.arabic: أُعِيذُ نَفْسِي بِاللهِ الْأَكْبَرِ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ الْقَائِمَاتِ بِلَا عَمْدٍ
segments.translation: I seek protection for myself in Allah, the Great, the Lord of the upright heavens,

segments.arabic: وَ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَهَا فِي يَوْمَيْنِ‏ وَ قَضَى‏ فِي كُلِّ سَماءٍ أَمْرَها وَ خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ‏ وَ قَدَّرَ فِيها أَقْواتَها
segments.translation: and He Who created them in two days and determined affairs throughout all of them; heavens created the earth and determined in it its sustenance.

segments.arabic: وَ جَعَلَ فِيهَا جِبِالًا أَوْتَاداً وَ جَعَلَهَا فِجاجاً سُبُلًا
segments.translation: Made in its mountains and set in ravines to serve as ways.
Produced the heavy clouds, making it subservient,

segments.arabic: وَ أَجْرَى الْفُلْكَ وَ سَخَّرَ الْبَحْرَ
segments.translation: made the ships sail, made subservient the sea,

segments.arabic: وَ جَعَلَ فِي الْأَرْضِ‏ رَواسِيَ وَ أَنْهاراً
segments.translation: and made in the earth mountains and rivers;

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَكُونُ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ
segments.translation: from the evil of what is in the night and the day

segments.arabic: وَ تَعْقِدُ عَلَيْهِ الْقُلُوبُ وَ تَرَاهُ الْعُيُونُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْإِنْسِ
segments.translation: and entangles the hearts, which the eyes of jinn and humankind see.

segments.arabic: كَفَانَا اللهُ كَفَانَا اللهُ كَفَانَا اللهُ
segments.translation: Allah protects us, Allah protects us, Allah protects us,
there is no god save Allah,

segments.arabic: مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً كَثِيرا
segments.translation: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, blessings of Allah be on him and his family.

segments.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ‎﴿٢٨٥﴾‏ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ ‎﴿٢٨٦﴾‏
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
Glory be to You our God; to You belongs the praise.

segments.arabic: ‏ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ
segments.translation: You are Allah, the Independent, the Everlasting, and the King.
I bear witness that You are the God Whose kingdom cannot be destroyed,

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ إِلَهٌ لَا تَخْتَرِمُ الْأَيَّامُ مُلْكَكَ
segments.translation: and sins can not change Your superiority!
There is no god save You, You alone, with no associate, no other God than You.

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ وَ لَا رَبَّ سِوَاكَ
segments.translation: And there is no creator but You
And the Creator of all things and everything is Your creation!

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ‏ خالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ خَلْقُكَ
segments.translation: You are Lord of all things, and everything is Your Worshippers!

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْتَ رَبُّ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ عَبْدُكَ
segments.translation: You are the God of everything and everything; worships You,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْتَ إِلَهُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ يَعْبُدُكَ
segments.translation: celebrates Your praise, and prostrate to You;

segments.arabic: وَ يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ وَ يَسْجُدُ لَكَ
segments.translation: therefore, praise and glory be to You
and blessed be Your all Most Excellent Names!
A worshiped God in You majestic greatness and grandeur;

segments.arabic: إِلَهاً مَعْبُوداً فِي جَلَالِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَ كِبْرِيَائِكَ
segments.translation: exalted mighty king in Your self-glory solemnity Kingdom.

segments.arabic: وَ تَعَالَيْتَ مَلِكاً جَبَّاراً فِي وَقَارِ عِزَّةِ مُلْكِكَ
segments.translation: And hallowed worshipped God; in Your eternal mighty authority.

segments.arabic: وَ تَقَدَّسْتَ رَبّاً مَعْبُوداً [مَنْعُوتاً] فِي تَأْبِيدِ
segments.translation: Exalted conquering God You are, upon Your kingdom throne,

segments.arabic: مَنَعَةِ سُلْطَانِكَ وَ ارْتَفَعْتَ إِلَهاً قَاهِراً فَوْقَ مَلَكُوتِ عَرْشِكَ
segments.translation: You surpassed everything with Your highness,
and Your vision goes through everything.
Your awareness is delicate to everything;
Your knowledge surrounds everything,
Your protection is capable for everything,
and everything is safeguarded in Your Book.
Your light has fulfilled everywhere;
Your authority has conquered everything.
Your judgment is fair in everything;

segments.arabic: وَ عَدَلَ فِي كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ حُكْمُكَ
segments.translation: everything fears Your wrath,

segments.arabic: وَ خَافَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ
segments.translation: and Your veneration has stepped in everything.

segments.arabic: وَ دَخَلَتْ فِي كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ مَهَابَتُكَ
segments.translation: O, My Lord, through Your fear, severity,
and approval has the heavens, earth,

segments.arabic: وَ تَأْيِيدِكَ قَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَ الْأَرْضُ
segments.translation: and what are in them stood up to You with obedience,

segments.arabic: وَ مَا فِيهِنَ‏ مِنْ شَيْ‏ءٍ طَاعَةً لَكَ
segments.translation: frightening Your Place, and fearing You.

segments.arabic: وَ خَوْفاً مِنْ مَقَامِكَ وَ خَشْيَتِكَ
segments.translation: So determined is everything in Your decision;
everything ended out to Your command.

segments.arabic: وَ انْتَهَى كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ إِلَى أَمْرِكَ
segments.translation: Through The intensity of Your might and honor,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ جَبَرُوتِكَ وَ عِزَّتِكَ
segments.translation: everything yields to Your authority,
and all things are dwarfed in the presence of Your sovereignty.
Through Your generosity and broad benevolence, everything requires You

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ غِنَاكَ وَ سَعَتِكَ افْتَقَرَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ إِلَيْكَ
segments.translation: because everything is living upon Your sustenance
Your ability makes You above everything of Your creation from Your highest place.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ عُلُوِّ مَكَانِكَ وَ قُدْرَتِكَ عَلَوْتَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ
segments.translation: Your judgment decides on everything below You,
and by Your will, their destinies run among them;
what You offered of it didn't pass You,

segments.arabic: بِمَشِيَّتِكَ مَا قَدَّمْتَ مِنْهَا لَمْ يَسْبِقْكَ
segments.translation: what You delayed of it didn't make You powerless,

segments.arabic: وَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ مِنْهَا لَمْ يُعْجِزْكَ
segments.translation: and what You accomplished of it is being accomplished by Your judgment and knowledge.

segments.arabic: وَ مَا أَمْضَيْتَ مِنْهَا أَمْضَيْتَهُ بِحُكْمِكَ وَ عِلْمِكَ
segments.translation: Glory and praise be to You;
blessed You are our Lord, and sublime is Your Praise!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Your; Servant, Messenger, and Prophet
prefer him with the elite charismata upon all Your creations

segments.arabic: وَ آثِرْهُ بِصَفْوِ كَرَامَتِكَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: and grant him with the best merits from You.
Get him to achieve; the best place of the honored ones,

segments.arabic: وَ بَلِّغْ بِهِ [بَلِّغْهُ‏] أَفْضَلَ مَحَلِّ الْمُكَرَّمِينَ
segments.translation: the noblest mercy among the closest companions nobility,

segments.arabic: وَ أَشْرَفَ رَحْمَتِكَ فِي شَرَفِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
segments.translation: and the highest degree among the superiors.
O, Allah, get him to raise his status to reach Paradise in exaltation from You and excellence.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَلِّغْ بِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ فِي الرِّفْعَةِ مِنْكَ وَ الْفَضِيلَةِ
segments.translation: And carry on his phase with the best honor
until the blesses are fulfilled upon him,
his remembrance upon the created beings extended,
and make us from his company; face to face on couches with our father, Ibrahim.

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْنَا مِنْ رُفَقَائِهِ‏ عَلى‏ سُرُرٍ مُتَقابِلِينَ مَعَ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ
segments.translation: May it be so; O, Allah of Truth and Lord of the worlds.
O Allah, I, verily, beseech You by Your Name that has been revealed upon Musa on the tablets.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَهُ عَلَى مُوسَى فِي الْأَلْوَاحِ
segments.translation: I beseech You, by Your name that got placed
on the; skies thereupon are settled on,
earth established, and mountains steadied.

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ فَاسْتَقَرَّتْ وَ عَلَى الْجِبَالِ فَأَرْسَتْ
segments.translation: And for the sake of Muhammad, Allah's blessing upon him and his Household; Your Prophet,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ نَبِيِّكَ
segments.translation: Ibraham; Your intimate friend, Musa; Your survivor

segments.arabic: وَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ وَ مُوسَى نَجِيِّكَ
segments.translation: and Issa; Your word and spirit.
And I beseech You by the; Torah of Musa, Gospel of Issa,

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِتَوْرَاةِ مُوسَى وَ إِنْجِيلِ عِيسَى
segments.translation: Psalms of Dawood, and Muhammed's blessings of Allah upon him and his Household Quraan, peace be upon them and all the Prophets.

segments.arabic: وَ زَبُورِ دَاوُدَ وَ قُرْآنِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ وَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ
segments.translation: And by every; revelation You did, fulfillment You completed

segments.arabic: وَ بِكُلِّ وَحْيٍ أَوْحَيْتَهُ وَ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ
segments.translation: and a book You has sent down;
O, God of the Truth that makes all things manifest and The luminous light;

segments.arabic: يَا إِلَهَ الْحَقِّ الْمُبِينِ وَ النُّورِ الْمُنِيرِ
segments.translation: fulfill the grace upon me
and aid me in the outcome (wellness) in all things.

segments.arabic: وَ تُحْسِنَ لِيَ الْعَاقِبَةَ [الْعَافِيَةَ] فِي الْأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا
segments.translation: I am only Your servant and the son of Your servant;

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ
segments.translation: my forelock is in Your grasp, and I turn living under Your control.
Not miraculous nor refusing; incapable before myself,

segments.arabic: غَيْرَ مُعْجِزٍ وَ لَا مُمْتَنِعٍ عَجَزْتُ عَنْ نَفْسِي
segments.translation: and people are incapable of me.
Therefore, there is not a tribe that is enough for me,

segments.arabic: فَلَا عَشِيرَةَ تَكْفِينِي وَ لَا مَالَ يَفْدِينِي
segments.translation: a work that can make me survive; neither power for me to win,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا عَمَلَ يُنْجِينِي وَ لَا قُوَّةَ لِي فَأَنْتَصِرَ
segments.translation: and I am not innocent of the sins.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا أَنَا بَرِي‏ءٌ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ
segments.translation: So I apologize; my sin is much greater thereupon I seek Your pardon tonight to forgive me in the name of that You have made incumbent upon Yourself.

segments.arabic: فَأَعْتَذِرَ وَ عَظُمَ ذَنْبِي فَلْيَسَعْ عَفْوُكَ لِمَغْفِرَتِي اللَّيْلَةَ بِمَا وَأَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
segments.translation: And grant me; the power as long as You keep me,
the reform as long as You keep me alive,
the help upon what You placed on me,
the patience in Your trying me,
the thankfulness in what You conferred upon me,
and blessing in what you bestow upon me.
O, Lord, dictate to me the principles of faith on the Day of Death
and, do not make me see my deeds in regret,
do not disgrace me through my secret thoughts on the day of Your meeting,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَفْضَحْنِي بِسَرِيرَتِي يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ
segments.translation: do not make me ashamed of my evil deeds and Your afflictions when You are deciding.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تُخْزِنِي بِسَيِّئَاتِي وَ بِبَلَائِكَ عِنْدَ قَضَائِكَ
segments.translation: And do reform conditions in between You and me,

segments.arabic: وَ أَصْلِحْ مَا بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَكَ
segments.translation: assign my love in Your piety,
spare me the time of the narration; what concerned me

segments.arabic: وَ اكْفِنِي هَوْلَ الْمُطَّلَعِ وَ مَا أَهَمَّنِي
segments.translation: nor did not concern me in this world and the next which You knowest more than I,

segments.arabic: وَ مَا لَمْ يُهِمَّنِي مِمَّا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي مِنْ أَمْرِ دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِي
segments.translation: help me encounter what defeated me and what did not;

segments.arabic: وَ أَعِنِّي عَلَى مَا غَلَبَنِي وَ مَا لَمْ يَغْلِبْنِي
segments.translation: because all that is in Your hand, O, Lord!
Therefore, secure me, guide me, reform my condition,

segments.arabic: فَاكْفِنِي وَ اهْدِنِي وَ أَصْلِحْ بَالِي
segments.translation: admit me to Paradise, and make it known for me.
And make me come upon those who are superior to me

segments.arabic: وَ أَلْحِقْنِي بِالَّذِينَ هُمْ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي
segments.translation: and, grant me the company of the; prophets, the truthful one,

segments.arabic: وَ ارْزُقْنِي مُرَافَقَةَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَ الصِّدِّيقِينَ
segments.translation: martyrs, righteous ones
and a goodly company are they.
You are indeed God of truth, Lord of the worlds;
blessings of Allah may be upon our Master Muhammed, the Prophet,

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا رَسُولِهِ مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ
segments.translation: And his good and pure Household, and may He spread thorough blessings over them.

segments.arabic: وَ آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً

title: Wednesday   Duas.org

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱللَّيلَ لِبَاساً
segments.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi ja`ala allayla libasan
segments.translation: All praise be to Allah Who appointed the night to be a garment,
and sleep for a rest,
and day He appointed for a rising!

segments.arabic: لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ أَنْ بَعَثْتَنِي مِنْ مَرْقَدِي
segments.transliteration: laka alhamdu an ba`athtani min marqadi
segments.translation: To You belongs praise, for You roused me from my sleep,
and had You willed, You would have made it everlasting;
an endless praise that will never be cut off
and whose number the creatures will never count!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ أَنْ خَلَقْتَ فَسَوَّيْتَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma laka alhamdu an khalaqta fasawwayta
segments.translation: O Allah, to You belongs praise, for You created, then fashioned,
ordained and decreed,
gave death and bestowed life,
made sick and healed,
made well and afflicted,
established the Throne
and encompassed the Kingdom!
I supplicate You with the supplication of one whose mediation is weak,
whose stratagems have been cut off,
whose term has drawn near,
whose expectation from this world has shrunk,
whose neediness for Your mercy has intensified,
whose remorse for his neglect has become great,
whose slips and stumbles have become many,
and whose repentance is devoted sincerely to Your face.
So, bless Muhammad,
the Seal of the Prophets,
and his Household, the good, the pure,
and provide me with the intercession of Muhammad,
Allah bless him and his Household,
and deprive me not of his companionship!
Surely, You are the Most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱقْضِ لِي فِي ٱلأَرْبِعَاءِ اَرْبَعاً
segments.translation: O Allah, decree for me on Wednesday four things:
Induce me to be strong in obedience to You,
to be active in worshiping You,
to be desirous for Your reward,

You are Gentle to whom You will!
