segments.transliteration: Fa innaka ØªÙØ¬ÙØ±ÙÙ l-umÅ«ra Ê¿alÄ irÄdatik
segments.translation: For You run all affairs according to Your will

segments.transliteration: Wa tujÄ«ru wa lÄ yujÄru Ê¿alayk
segments.translation: You grant refuge and none can oppose You

segments.transliteration: Wa anta Ê¿alÄ kulli shayâin qadÄ«r
segments.translation: And You have power over all things
And You are the Kind, the Merciful, the All-aware

segments.arabic: تَعْلَمُ مَا فِي نَفْسِي وَلَا أَعْلَمُ مَا فِي نَفْسِكَ
segments.transliteration: TaÊ¿lamu mÄ fÄ« nafsÄ« wa lÄ aÊ¿lamu mÄ fÄ« nafsik
segments.translation: You know what is within me, and I do not know what is within You
Surely You are the Knower of the unseen

segments.arabic: فَالْطُفْ بِي فَقَدِيمًا لَطُفْتَ بِمُسْرِفٍ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ
segments.transliteration: Falá¹­uf bÄ« faqadÄ«man laá¹­ufta bimusrifin Ê¿alÄ nafsih
segments.translation: So be gentle with me, for You have been gentle before

segments.arabic: فَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ فَقَدْ مَنَنْتَ عَلَى غَرِيقٍ
segments.transliteration: Famnun Ê¿alayya faqad mananta Ê¿alÄ gharÄ«q
segments.translation: Bestow upon me, as You bestowed upon one drowning
Lost in oceans of sin
Whom many slips had delivered to destruction

segments.arabic: وَتَطَوَّلْ عَلَيَّ يَا مُتَطَوِّلًا عَلَى الْمُذْنِبِينَ
segments.transliteration: Wa taá¹­awwal Ê¿alayya yÄ mutaá¹­awwilan Ê¿alÄ l-mudhnibÄ«n
segments.translation: And extend Your favor upon me, O Bestower upon sinners
With pardon and forgiveness

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تَزَلْ آخِذًا بِالْفَضْلِ عَلَى الْخَاطِئِينَ
segments.transliteration: Fa innaka lam tazal Äkhidhan bil-faá¸l Ê¿alÄ l-khÄá¹­iâÄ«n
segments.translation: For You have always dealt with sinners by grace
And pardon toward those who stumble

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ وَجَبَ لَهُ بِاجْتِرَائِهِ عَلَى الْآثَامِ
segments.transliteration: Wa man wajaba lahu bijtirÄâihi Ê¿alÄ l-ÄthÄm
segments.translation: Even one deserving punishment for bold sins
The abode of ruin
O Knower of hidden things and secrets
O Compeller, O Subduer

segments.arabic: وَمَا أَلْزَمْتَنِي مِنْ فَرْضِ الْآبَاءِ وَالْأُمَّهَاتِ
segments.transliteration: Wa mÄ alzamtanÄ« min fará¸i l-ÄbÄâ wal-ummahÄt
segments.translation: And what You have obligated upon me toward parents

segments.transliteration: Wa wÄjibi á¸¥uqÅ«qihim maÊ¿a l-ikhwÄn wal-akhawÄt
segments.translation: And their rights along with brothers and sisters

segments.transliteration: Faá¸¥tamil dhÄlika Ê¿annÄ« ilayhim wa addih
segments.translation: Then bear it on my behalf and fulfill it
O Possessor of Majesty and Honor
And forgive the believing men and women
Surely You have power over all things
Peace be upon you [all], O saints of Allah!
Peace be upon you, O arguments of Allah!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا نُورَ ٱللَّهِ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ ٱلأَرْضِ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum ya nura allahi fi zulumati al-ardi
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O light of Allah in the darkness of the earth!
Peace be upon you.
Blessings of Allah be upon you
and upon your Household, the pure and immaculate.
May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you!
Indeed, you worshipped Allah sincerely

segments.transliteration: wa jahadtum fi allahi haqqa jihadihi
segments.translation: and strove for His sake with due strife
until death came upon you.
So, may Allah curse all your enemies
from the jinn and human beings.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا أَبْرَأُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ وَإِلَيْكُمْ مِنْهُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa ana abra'u ila allahi wa ilaykum minhum
segments.translation: And I release myself before Allah and before you from them (i.e. your enemies).
O my master, O Abu-Ibrahim,
Musa, the son of Ja`far!
O my master, O Abuâl-Hasan,
`Ali, the son of Musa!
O my master, O Abu-Ja`far,
Muhammad, the son of `Ali!
O my master, O Abuâl-Hasan,
`Ali, the son of Muhammad!
I am your servant,
I believe in your secret and open affairs,
and I am staying with you as your guest, on this day,
which is Wednesday,
and I am in your vicinity;
so, receive me as your guest and neighbor,
[I ask you] by your Household, the pure and immaculate.

segments.transliteration: Allaahu latâeefum bi-iâbaadihi yarzuqu mayn ya shaa-u wa huwal qaweeyul aâzeez.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent and Merciful.

segments.arabic: ‏ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ الْأَنْعَامُ بِأَصْوَاتِهَا يَقُولُونَ سُبُّوحاً قُدُّوساً
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma adim niâmataka waltâuf binaa feemaa qaddartah.
segments.translation: Glory be to Him who The Cattles do glory Him with their voice saying: O, the Oft-Praised and Sacred!

segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alÄ ar-Riá¸Ä al-Murtaá¸Ä samiyyi sayyidi al-waá¹£iyyÄ«n
segments.translation: Glory be to the Manifest, Truth Master.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ الْبِحَارُ بِأَمْوَاجِهَا
segments.transliteration: Wa imÄmi al-muttaqÄ«n khalÄ«fati ar-Raá¸¥mÄn wa imÄmi ahl al-QurÊ¾Än
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who The Seas do glory Him with its waves!

segments.transliteration: Wa á¹£Äá¸¥ibi at-taÊ¾wÄ«l wa maÊ¿dini al-furqÄn
segments.translation: Glory be to you, Our Allah, and Praise in you.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَلَائِكَةُ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِأَصْوَاتِهَا
segments.transliteration: Wa á¸¥Ämili at-TawrÄt wa al-InjÄ«l wa ifnÄÊ¾i al-khabÄ«thÄt wa al-abÄá¹­Ä«l
segments.translation: Glory be to Him, Who The Angels of Heavens do Glory him with their voices!

segments.transliteration: Wa al-qÄÊ¾ili al-fÄÊ¿il wa al-á¸¥Äkimi al-Ê¿Ädil wa aá¹£-á¹£Ädiqi al-barr
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, who is Praised in every discourse!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ الْكُرْسِيُّ وَ مَا حَوْلَهُ وَ مَا تَحْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa al-á¸¥ÄÊ¾izi al-fakhr jaddahu sayyidu an-nabiyyÄ«n
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, who is glorified by The throne from around and under it!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْجَبَّارِ الَّذِي مَلَأَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعَ وَ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعَ
segments.transliteration: Wa abÅ«hu sayyidu al-waá¹£iyyÄ«n wa ilayhi maÊ¾Äbu al-awwalÄ«n wa al-ÄkhirÄ«n
segments.translation: Glory be to The most Powerful Master, who His Throne has filled the seven havens and The seven earths!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِعَدَدِ مَا سَبَّحَهُ الْمُسَبِّحُونَ
segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alayka yÄ AbÄ al-á¸¤asan Ê¿AlÄ«yya ibn MÅ«sÄ ar-Riá¸Ä
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah at the amount of how much the praises do glory Him!

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ بِعَدَدِ مَا حَمِدَهُ الْحَامِدُونَ
segments.transliteration: Wa raá¸¥matullÄhi wa barakÄtuh AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: All praises are to Allah at the amount of how much The Praiser does thanks Him!

segments.arabic: وَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ بِعَدَدِ مَا هَلَّلَهُ الْمُهَلِّلُونَ
segments.transliteration: Wa Ê¿alÄ Äli Muá¸¥ammad wa kamÄ akramtahu bi-Muá¸¥ammad rasÅ«lik
segments.translation: And there is no god but You! at the amount of whom do declare worship only for You.

segments.arabic: وَ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ بِعَدَدِ مَا كَبَّرَهُ الْمُكَبِّرُونَ
segments.transliteration: Wa jaÊ¿altahu fÄ« al-á¸¥aqq dalÄ«lak fadaÊ¿Ä ilÄ sabÄ«lik
segments.translation: And Allah is the Magnificent! At the amount of whom do magnify Him!

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ بِعَدَدِ مَا اسْتَغْفَرَهُ الْمُسْتَغْفِرُونَ
segments.translation: And I ask God's forgiveness! At the number of whom do Implor for His forgiveness!

segments.arabic: وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.transliteration: Fa akmil lahu al-Ê¿ahd wa tammim lahu al-waÊ¿d
segments.translation: And there is no power and strength except with Allah, the Most High, the All-great;

segments.transliteration: Wa ayyidhu wa dhurriyyatahu wa awliyÄÊ¾ahu bin-naá¹£r wa al-jund
segments.translation: at the number of people who say it!

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: Li-yukhalliá¹£a ad-dÄ«n bil-jidd fayaÊ¿mala fÄ« dhÄlika bil-jahd
segments.translation: And Allah's Blessings be upon Muhammed and his Household;

segments.transliteration: Wa yuá¹£ayyira laka ad-dÄ«n khÄliá¹£an wa al-á¸¥amd tÄmmÄ
segments.translation: at the amount of whom do send their blessings upon Him!

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alayhi á¸¥ayyan wa mayyitÄ
segments.translation: Glory be to You, There is no God save you!

segments.transliteration: Wa Ê¿ajjil farajanÄ bihÄ« wa bil-waá¹£iyy min baÊ¿dih
segments.translation: The livestock; do glorify you in their rangeland,

segments.transliteration: Wa aná¹£urhu Ê¿alÄ ahl á¹­ÄÊ¿ati ash-shayá¹­Än
segments.translation: The Wild animals; do glorify you in Their most likely place,

segments.transliteration: Wa aÊ¿ziz bihi al-Ä«mÄn wa adh-lil bihi ash-shayá¹­Än
segments.translation: The predatory beasts do glorify you in their landscape,
and The birds do glorify you in their nests!
Glory to you, There is no God save you,
glorified You are by; The oceans' waves,
The whales in its water,
The water in its rivers
and the vermin in its places!
Glory to you, There is no God save you;
the Generous Who is never a miser,
the All-Sufficient who is never missing,
the Unprecedented who is never worn out!

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الْبَاقِي الَّذِي تَسَرْبَلَ بِالْبَقَاءِ
segments.translation: All Praise to Allah; The Remaining, who demonstrates Himself through his present.
The Perpetual, Who will never cease to exist!
The Noble, Who will not be humiliated!
The Ruler, who will not be removed!
Glory to you, There is no God save you;
The Upright, Who is imperishable!
The Perpetual, Who is imperishable!
The All-Knowing, Who will not raise a doubt!
The All-Seeing, Who will not go astray!
The Forbearing, Who will not ignore!
Glory to you, There is no God save you,
The Wise, Who will never be oppressive!
The Watcher, Who will never forget one thing over another!
The Encompasser, Who is never engrossed with a thing to overlook another!
The Witness, Who will never is absent!
Glory to you, There is no God save you;
The All-Powerful, Who will never be in harm!
The Noble, Who is invulnerable!
The King, Who will never be overcome!
The Percipient, who will never be perceived!
The Demandant, who will never be incapable!
In the Name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate.
I seek the protection of you; the One, the Refuge,
from the evil of what is blown on, knotted,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ ابْنِ قِتْرَةَ وَ مَا وَلَدَ
segments.translation: and from the evil of Abu Mura (Satan) and what he has begotten.
I seek your protection; the One, the Highest,

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَتْ عَيْنِي وَ مَا لَمْ تَرَ
segments.translation: from that which the eye sees and does not see.

segments.arabic: أَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْفَرْدِ الْكَبِيرِ الْأَعْلَى
segments.translation: I seek your protection in the Unequalled, the Great,

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ مَنْ أَرَادَنِي بِأَمْرٍ عَسِيرٍ
segments.translation: from the evil of what it intends for you (by the decree of the Sovereign).

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammed and his Household;

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْنِي فِي جِوَارِكَ وَ حِصْنِكَ الْحَصِينِ
segments.translation: Therefore, go, O, to the protection of Allah,
the Mighty, the Omnipotent, the King, the Most Holy, the Subduer,

segments.arabic: السَّلَامِ الْمُؤْمِنِ الْمُهَيْمِنِ الْغَفَّارِ عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ
segments.translation: the Perfect, the Faithful, the Guardian, the Mighty, the All-forgiving, the Knower of the unseen,
and the apparent, the Great and the Most High.

segments.arabic: هُوَ اللهُ هُوَ اللهُ هُوَ اللهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
segments.translation: He is Allah; He is Allah; He is Allah; no partner he has;

segments.arabic: مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
segments.translation: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, blessings,
and mercy of Allah on him and his family.

segments.arabic:
المصدر
المصباح للكفعمي
							

ثم تتعوذ بعوذة يوم الأحد
segments.translation: Allah is Benignant to His servants; He gives sustenance to whom He pleases, and He is the Strong, the Mighty.[6]

segments.arabic: اَللهُ لَطِيْفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَآءُ وَ هُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيْزُ.
segments.translation: O Allah make permanent Your bounty and Your Grace for us in what You have ordained.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اَدِمْ نِعْمَتَكَ وَ الْطُفْ بِنَا فِيْمَا قَدَّرْتَهُ.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
Glory be to You, our Lord, and praise for You;
You are, Who created all Your creatures with Your word;
thereupon Your will came without burdening ascertained Your will.

segments.arabic: خَلْقِكَ فَكُلُّ مَشِيَّتِكَ أَتَتْكَ بِلَا لُغُوبٍ أَثْبَتَّ مَشِيَّتَكَ
segments.translation: And You did not consider careful on it for intent nor arrange over it for hardship!

segments.arabic: وَ لَمْ تَأَنَّ فِيهَا لِمَئُونَةٍ وَ لَمْ تَنْصِبْ فِيهَا لِمَشَقَّةٍ
segments.translation: And Your throne was above the water; darkness in the air and the Angels will bear Your throne.

segments.arabic: وَ كَانَ عَرْشُكَ عَلَى الْمَاءِ وَ الظُّلْمَةُ فِي [عَلَى‏] الْهَوَاءِ وَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَحْمِلُونَ عَرْشَكَ
segments.translation: The throne of light and Glory, glorifying with Your praise,

segments.arabic: عَرْشَ النُّورِ وَ الْكَرَامَةِ وَ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِكَ
segments.translation: and the creatures are obedient toward You; humble of You fear,

segments.arabic: وَ الْخَلْقُ مُطِيعٌ لَكَ خَاشِعٌ مِنْ خَوْفِكَ
segments.translation: can't be seen in it a light other than Your light

segments.arabic: لَا يُرَى فِيهِ نُورٌ إِلَّا نُورُكَ
segments.translation: nor be heard a voice other than Your voice,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يُسْمَعُ فِيهِ صَوْتٌ إِلَّا صَوْتُكَ
segments.translation: entitled in what is not ascertain to other than You!

segments.arabic: حَقِيقٌ بِمَا لَا يَحِقُّ إِلَّا لَكَ
segments.translation: The Creator of creatures and their originator, You are one and alone with Your decisions;

segments.arabic: ‏ خَالِقُ الْخَلْقِ وَ مُبْتَدِعُهُ تَوَحَّدْتَ بِأَمْرِكَ
segments.translation: you showed Your Uniqueness through Your kingdom. And verily; You showed Your Greatness through Your pride,

segments.arabic: وَ تَفَرَّدْتَ بِمُلْكِكَ وَ تَعَظَّمْتَ بِكِبْرِيَائِكَ
segments.translation: You expressed Your Might through Your supremacy, You reigned through Your Power

segments.arabic: وَ تَعَزَّزْتَ بِجَبَرُوتِكَ وَ تَسَلَّطْتَ بِقُوَّتِكَ
segments.translation: and exalted with Your ability.
Thereupon, You are in the highest viewpoint above the high heavens!

segments.arabic: فَأَنْتَ بِالْمَنْظَرِ الْأَعْلَى فَوْقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ الْعُلَى
segments.translation: How could not the scholars' knowledge be incapable before You,

segments.arabic: كَيْفَ لَا يَقْصُرُ دُونَكَ عِلْمُ الْعُلَمَاءِ
segments.translation: and Glory be to You; You counted Your creation and ordainments;

segments.arabic: وَ لَكَ الْعِزَّةُ أَحْصَيْتَ خَلْقَكَ وَ مَقَادِيرَكَ
segments.translation: for the sublime exalt of Your splendid mention

segments.arabic: لِمَا جَلَّ مِنْ جَلَالِ مَا جَلَّ مِنْ ذِكْرِكَ
segments.translation: and for the highest pitch from what upraised of Your throne.

segments.arabic: وَ لِمَا ارْتَفَعَ مِنْ رَفِيعِ مَا ارْتَفَعَ مِنْ كُرْسِيِّكَ
segments.translation: You advanced Your highness above the elevation of what overcome upon Your place!

segments.arabic: عَلَوْتَ عَلَى عُلُوِّ مَا اسْتَعْلَى مِنْ مَكَانِكَ
segments.translation: You existed before Your all creation.
No assessor can assess Your value,
and the describers cannot describe Your being;
glorious base, illuminated proof, great solemnity,

segments.arabic: رَفِيعُ الْبُنْيَانِ مُضِيْ‏ءُ الْبُرْهَانِ عَظِيمُ الْجَلَالِ
segments.translation: eternal Glory, encompassing of knowledge,
very pleasing tradition, and wise command!
Your making excelled the commands, and Your power conquered everything

segments.arabic: أَحْكَمَ الْأَمْرَ صُنْعُكَ وَ قَهَرَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ سُلْطَانُكَ
segments.translation: and took over the mightiness with Your mighty authority
and the sublimity of your great magnificence.
Moreover, You arranged everything with Your wisdom
and Enumerated this world and the hereafter case with Your knowledge.

segments.arabic: وَ أَحْصَيْتَ أَمْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ كُلَّهَا بِعِلْمِكَ
segments.translation: And the death and life are in Your hand,

segments.arabic: وَ كَانَ الْمَوْتُ وَ الْحَيَاةُ بِيَدِكَ
segments.translation: and everything implored to You, and everything submitted to Your authority,

segments.arabic: وَ ضَرَعَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ إِلَيْكَ وَ ذَلَّ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ لِمُلْكِكَ
segments.translation: and everything yielded to Your obedience.
Therefore glorified be our Lord, and glorified is Your name;
blessed is our Lord, high exalted is Your mention

segments.arabic: وَ تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَ تَعَالَى ذِكْرُكَ
segments.translation: and by Your omnipotence upon Your creation and Your gentleness with Your command.

segments.arabic: وَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ وَ لُطْفِكَ فِي أَمْرِكَ
segments.translation: The weight of a dust mote; doesn't escape from you in heavens and earth,

segments.arabic: لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْكَ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمَا وَاتِ وَ الْأَرْض
segments.translation: not even less than that nor more but (it is noted) in a clear record!

segments.arabic: ‏ وَ لا أَصْغَرُ مِنْ ذلِكَ وَ لا أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِي كِتابٍ مُبِينٍ
segments.translation: So, Glory and praise be to You;
blessed is our Lord, and splendid be the praising of You!
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant, Messenger, and Prophet,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُولِكَ  وَ نَبِيِّكَ
segments.translation: with the most excellent blessings you have ever sent upon any Muslim houses.

segments.arabic: أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ بُيُوتَاتِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
segments.translation: The blessing in that which You illuminate with his face makes him delighted,

segments.arabic: صَلَاةً تُبَيِّضُ بِهَا وَجْهَهُ وَ تُقِرُّ بِهَا عَيْنَهُ
segments.translation: adorning with it his position.
And make him an orator to Your laudations,
what he says; You believed, what he asks for, You grant

segments.arabic: مَا قَالَ صَدَّقْتَهُ وَ مَا سَأَلَ أَعْطَيْتَهُ
segments.translation: and to who he mediates for; You mediated.
And assign to him of Your bestowal; full bestowal completed portion,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ عَطَائِكَ عَطَاءً تَامّاً وَ قَسَماً
segments.translation: large share and, a high name upon the prophets,

segments.arabic: وَافِياً وَ نَصِيباً جَزِيلًا وَ اسْماً عَالِياً عَلَى‏ النَّبِيِّينَ
segments.translation: righteous', martyrs,
the most elevated rank ones and, a goodly company are they!

segments.arabic: وَ الصَّالِحِينَ وَ حَسُنَ أُولئِكَ رَفِيقاً
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You by Your Name;
if it is mentioned, Your throne shook, Your light gleamed,

segments.arabic: إِذَا ذُكِرَ اهْتَزَّ لَهُ عَرْشُكَ وَ تَهَلَّلَ لَهُ نُورُكَ
segments.translation: and Your Angels rejoiced to it!
And in which if it is mentioned the; heavens, earth, mountains, trees, animals will be shaken for Him!

segments.arabic: ‏ وَ الَّذِي إِذَا ذُكِرَ تَزَعْزَعَتْ لَهُ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَ الْأَرْضُ وَ الْجِبَالُ وَ الشَّجَرُ وَ الدَّوَابُّ
segments.translation: And in which if it is mentioned; the gates of heavens will be unfolded to Him,

segments.arabic: وَ الَّذِي إِذَا ذُكِرَ تَفَتَّحَتْ لَهُ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ
segments.translation: the earth shone for Him
and the mountains glorified Him!
And in which if it is mentioned; the earth be cracked for Him,

segments.arabic: وَ الَّذِي إِذَا ذُكِرَ تَصَدَّعَتْ لَهُ الْأَرْضُ
segments.translation: hallowed Him the Angels and humankind,

segments.arabic: وَ قَدَّسَتْ لَهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَ الْإِنْسُ
segments.translation: the rivers for Him burst out!
And in which if it is mentioned; the souls are violent fear seized of Him and sounds are submitted of Him.

segments.arabic: وَ الَّذِي إِذَا ذُكِرَ ارْتَعَدَتْ مِنْهُ النُّفُوسُ وَ وَجِلَتْ مِنْهُ الْقُلُوبُ وَ خَشَعَتْ لَهُ الْأَصْوَاتُ
segments.translation: Therefore, forgive my parents and me, bestow Your grace upon them as they cherished and reared me when I was a child,

segments.arabic: أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَ لِوَالِدَيَّ وَ ارْحَمْهُما كَما رَبَّيانِي صَغِيراً
segments.translation: grant me their fidelity reward and satisfaction,

segments.arabic: وَ ارْزُقْنِي ثَوَابَ طَاعَتِهِمَا وَ مَرْضَاتِهِمَا
segments.translation: and make awareness between them in Your heaven and me!

segments.arabic: وَ عَرِّفْ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَهُمَا فِي جَنَّتِكَ
segments.translation: For them and me, I beseech You for the reward in the hereafter; the Day of Resurrection.

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ لِي وَ لَهُمَا الْأَجْرَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
segments.translation: And the pardoning on the Doomsday, decree for ease after death,

segments.arabic: وَ الْعَفْوَ يَوْمَ الْقَضَاءِ وَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ
segments.translation: the light of eyes that do not cease,
and the delight of witnessing Your presence and longing for Your meeting!

segments.arabic: وَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ  إِلَى وَجْهِكَ وَ شَوْقاً إِلَى لِقَائِكَ
segments.translation: O, Allah, I am weak; so strengthen my weakness in the course of Your pleasure,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ضَعِيفٌ فَقَوِّ فِي رِضَاكَ ضَعْفِي
segments.translation: and lead my forelock to goodness,
and cause Islam to be the utmost of my pleasure.
And appoint faithfulness as my most significant moral and Your reverential fear as my provision.

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلِ الْبِرَّ أَكْبَرَ أَخْلَاقِي وَ التَّقْوَى زَادِي
segments.translation: Grant me to achieve goodness for myself
and set right my religion that is the preserving tie of my affair.

segments.arabic: وَ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِيَ الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي
segments.translation: And bless me in this world that has my reach

segments.arabic: وَ بَارِكْ فِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا بَلَاغِي
segments.translation: and reforms my hereafter, where my recourses head for and my return;

segments.arabic: وَ أَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِيَ الَّتِي إِلَيْهَا مُنْقَلَبِي وَ مَعَادِي
segments.translation: make my life (in this world) more in every good

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ دُنْيَايَ زِيَادَةً فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ
segments.translation: and my hereafter a relief of every evil!

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ آخِرَ  تِي عَافِيَةً مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
segments.translation: And, prepare me for having love in the world Hereafter,

segments.arabic: وَ هَيِّئْ لِيَ الْإِنَابَةَ إِلَى دَارِ الْخُلُودِ
segments.translation: not being proud and the preparedness to death before it lays down on me!

segments.arabic: وَ التَّجَافِيَ عَنْ دَارِ الْغُرُورِ وَ الِاسْتِعْدَادَ لِلْمَوْتِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ بِي
segments.translation: O, Allah, do not overtake me all of a sudden and do not kill me, surprisingly,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْنِي بَغْتَةً وَ لَا تَقْتُلْنِي فَجْأَةً
segments.translation: and do not make me give up on the right or deprive me of it!

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تُعَجِّلْنِي عَنْ حَقٍّ وَ لَا تَسْلُبْنِيهِ
segments.translation: And recover me from; performing the sins' act with sincere repentance,

segments.arabic: وَ عَافِنِي مِنْ مُمَارَسَةِ الذُّنُوبِ بِتَوْبَةٍ نَصُوحٍ
segments.translation: chronic illnesses with pardon and well-being

segments.arabic: وَ مِنَ الْأَسْقَامِ الدَّوِيَّةِ بِالْعَفْوِ وَ الْعَافِيَةِ
segments.translation: and make myself die reassured safely.
Satisfied with what it had pleasingly, neither have fear nor;

segments.arabic: رَاضِيَةً بِمَا لَهَا مَرْضِيَّةً لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا خَوْفٌ
segments.translation: sadness, fright, anxiety, worry,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا حَزَنٌ وَ لَا جَزَعٌ وَ لَا فَزَعٌ وَ لَا وَجَلٌ
segments.translation: and hatred from You upon the believers

segments.arabic: وَ لَا مَقْتٌ مِنْكَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: who have got precedence from You in Your rewards;
they shall be kept far from hell.
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and His Household;

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: And as for anyone who intends good to me, assist them with and pave it for me;

segments.arabic: وَ مَنْ أَرَادَنِي بِحُسْنٍ فَأَعِنْهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ يَسِّرْهُ لِي
segments.translation: because surely I require whatever good You may send down to me.

segments.arabic: فَ إِنِّي لِما أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
segments.translation: And whoever desires for me;
evil, envy, offense, enmity or tyranny;

segments.arabic: أَوْ حَسَدٍ أَوْ بَغْيٍ أَوْ عَدَاوَةٍ أَوْ ظُلْمٍ
segments.translation: indeed, then take me out from his machinations, and I seek Your help regarding him.

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي أَدْرَأُ بِكَ فِي نَحْرِهِ وَ أَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَيْهِ
segments.translation: So suffice me with what You will and preoccupy him against me with what You will;

segments.arabic: فَاكْفِنِيهِ بِمَ شِئْتَ وَ اشْغَلْهُ عَنِّي بِمَ شِئْتَ فَإِنَّهُ
segments.translation: because there is no change nor any strength except by You!

segments.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِكَ
segments.translation: O, Allah, I seek refuge with You from the accursed shaytan,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ   إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
segments.translation: from his; temptations, disagreements, fear, and whispers.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ مَغَاوِيهِ وَ اعْتِرَاضِهِ وَ فَزَعِهِ وَ وَسْوَسَتِهِ
segments.translation: O, Allah, do not make for him authority upon me,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْ لَهُ عَلَيَّ سُلْطَاناً
segments.translation: and do not let him find a way to me

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ لَهُ عَلَيَّ سَبِيلًا
segments.translation: and make for him neither a share nor portion in my properties and sons.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ لَهُ فِي مَالِي وَ وُلْدِي شِرْكاً
segments.translation: And Keep us far away from him

segments.arabic: وَ لَا نَصِيباً وَ بَاعِدْ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَهُ
segments.translation: as You have kept the East far away from the West

segments.arabic: كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَ الْمَغْرِبِ
segments.translation: so that he does not ruin any of our obeying to You,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لَا يُفْسِدَ شَيْئاً مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ عَلَيْنَا
segments.translation: and complete Your grace, to us with Your pleasure upon us;
O, Most Merciful of the merciful!
And blessings of Allah be upon our Master, His Messenger; the Prophet Muhammed

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا رَسُولِهِ مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ
segments.translation: and his pure Household; and exalt you thoroughly.

segments.arabic: وَ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً
segments.translation: Peace be upon al-Riá¸Ä, the chosen, namesake of the master of successors

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَى الرِّضَا الْمُرْتَضٰى سَـمِيِّ سَيِّدِ الْوَصِيِّيْنَ
segments.translation: And the leader of the God-conscious, the vicegerent of the Most Merciful, and the Imam of the people of the Qurâan

segments.arabic: وَ اِمَامِ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ خَلِيْفَةِ الرَّحْمٰنِ وَ اِمَامِ اَهْلِ الْقُرْآنِ
segments.translation: And the possessor of interpretation and the ÙØ¹Ø¯Ù of discernment

segments.arabic: وَ صَاحِبِ التَّاْوِيْلِ وَ مَعْدِنِ الْفُرْقَانِ
segments.translation: And the bearer of the Torah and the Gospel, and the destroyer of impurities and falsehoods

segments.arabic: وَ حَامِلِ التَّوْرَاةِ وَ الْاِنْـجِيْلِ وَ اِفْنَاءِ الْـخَبِيْثَاتِ وَ الْاَبَاطِيْلِ
segments.translation: And the one who speaks and acts, the just ruler, the truthful and righteous

segments.arabic: وَ الْقَائِلِ الْفَاعِلِ وَ الْـحَاكِمِ الْعَادِلِ وَ الصَّادِقِ الْبَرِّ
segments.translation: And the possessor of honor, whose grandfather is the master of the prophets

segments.arabic: وَ الْـحَائِزِ الْفَخْرِ جَدُّهٗ سَيِّدُ النَّبِيِّيْنَ
segments.translation: And whose father is the master of the successors, and to him is the return of the first and the last

segments.arabic: وَ اَبُوْهُ سَيِّدُ الْوَصِيِّيْنَ وَ اِلَيْهِ مَآبُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ وَ الْآخِرِيْنَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O AbÄ al-á¸¤asan, Ê¿AlÄ« son of MÅ«sÄ al-Riá¸Ä

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَا الْـحَسَنِ عَلِيَّ بْنَ مُوسَى الرِّضَا
segments.translation: And the mercy of Allah and His blessings. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهٗ اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: And upon the family of Muhammad, as You honored him through Muhammad Your Messenger

segments.arabic: وَ عَلٰى اٰلِ مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ كَمَا اَكْرَمْتَهٗ بِـمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُوْلِكَ
segments.translation: And You made him, in truth, Your guide, so he called to Your path

segments.arabic: وَ جَعَلْتَهٗ فِيْ الْـحَقِّ دَلِيْلَكَ فَدَعَا اِلٰى سَبِيْلِكَ
segments.translation: With wisdom and good exhortation
So complete for him the covenant and fulfill for him the promise

segments.arabic: فَاَكْمِلْ لَهُ الْعَهْدَ وَ تَـمِّمْ لَهُ الْوَعْدَ
segments.translation: And support him, his progeny, and his allies with help and armies

segments.arabic: وَ اَيِّدْهُ وَ ذُرِّيَّتَهٗ وَ اَوْلِيَآئَهٗ بِالنَّصْرِ وَ الْـجُنْدِ
segments.translation: So that he may purify the religion with seriousness and strive therein with effort

segments.arabic: لِيُخَلِّصَ الدِّيْنَ بِالْـجِدِّ فَيَعْمَلَ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ بِالْـجَهْدِ
segments.translation: And make the religion purely for You and the praise complete

segments.arabic: وَ يُصَيِّرَ لَكَ الدِّيْنَ خَالِصًا وَ الْـحَمْدَ تَامًّا
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon him, living and deceased

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ حَيًّا وَ مَيِّتًا
segments.translation: And hasten our relief through him and through the successor after him

segments.arabic: وَ عَـجِّلْ فَرَجَنَا بِهٖ وَ بِالْوَصِيِّ مِنْ بَعْدِهٖ
segments.translation: And grant him victory over the people who obey Satan

segments.arabic: وَ انْصُرْهُ عَلٰى اَهْلِ طَاعَةِ الشَّيْطَانِ
segments.translation: And strengthen the faith through him and humiliate Satan

segments.arabic: وَ اَعْزِزْ بِهِ الْاِيْـمَانَ وَ اَذْلِلْ بِهِ الشَّيْطَانَ

title: Thursday   Duas.org

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي أَذْهَبَ ٱللَّيْلَ مُظْلِماً بِقُدْرَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi adh-haba allayla muzliman biqudratihi
segments.translation: All praise be to Allah Who has taken away the shadowy night by His power
and brought the sight-giving day through His mercy.

segments.transliteration: wa kasani diya'ahu wa atani ni`matahu
segments.translation: He has clothed me in its brightness and given me its favor.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي لَهُ فَ أَبْقِنِي لأَمْثَالِهِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma fakama abqaytani lahu fa-abqini li-amthalihi
segments.translation: O Allah, just as You have spared me for this day, so also spare me for its likes,

segments.transliteration: wa salli `ala alnnabiyyi muhammadin wa alihi
segments.translation: bless the Prophet Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa la tafja`ni fihi wa fi ghayrihi
segments.translation: torment me not in it and in other
nights and days
by my commitment of unlawful acts
and clothing myself in sins;
provide me with its good,
the good of all within it,
and the good of everything after it;
and turn away from me its evil,
the evil of all within it,
and the evil of everything after it!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي بِذِمَّةِ ٱلإِسْلامِ أَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni bidhimmati al-islami atawassalu ilayka
segments.translation: O Allah, by the protective compact of Islam, I seek mediation with You!
By the inviolability of the Qur'an, I rely upon You!
By Muhammad the chosen,
Allah bless him and his Household,
I seek intercession with You.
So, recognize my protective compact
by which I hope my need will be granted,
O Most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱقْضِ لِي فِي ٱلْخَمِيسِ خَمْساً
segments.transliteration: allahumma iqdi li fi alkhamisi khamsan
segments.translation: O Allah, decree for me on Thursday five things,
which none embraces but Your generosity
and none supports but Your favors:
health through which I may have the strength to obey You,
worship by which I may deserve Your plentiful reward,

segments.arabic: وَسَعَةً فِي ٱلْحَالِ مِنَ ٱلرِّزْقِ ٱلْحَلالِ
segments.transliteration: wa sa`atan fi alhali min alrrizqi alhalali
segments.translation: plenty in my state through lawful provision,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَنِي فِي مَوَاقِفِ ٱلْخَوْفِ بِأَمْنِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa an tu'minani fi mawaqifi alkhawfi bi-amnika
segments.translation: and that You make me secure in the places of fear through Your security,

segments.arabic: وَتَجْعَلَنِي مِنْ طَوَارِقِ ٱلْهُمُومِ وَٱلْغُمُومِ فِي حِصْنِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa taj`alani min tawariqi alhumumi walghumumi fi hisnika
segments.translation: and place me in Your fortress against the striking of worries and sorrows!
Bless Muhammad and his Household,
and make my seeking his mediation as an intercessor give profit
on the Day of Resurrection!
Surely, You are the Most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ الْهُدٰى وَ التُّقٰى،
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-alokal hodaa wat toqaa
segments.translation: O God, I ask You for guidance and piety,
and I am hopeful for chastity and needlessness.

segments.arabic: وَ الْعَمَلَ بِمَا تُحِبُّ وَ تَرْضٰى،
segments.transliteration: wal aâmala bemaa tohibbo wa tarzaa,
segments.translation: And I seek every that act, which is liked and approved by You

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ مِنْ قُوَّتِكَ لِضَعْفِنَا،
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-aloka min quwwateka le-zaâfenaa
segments.translation: O God, I ask You from your strength for our weakness

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ غِنَاكَ لِفَقْرِنَا وَ فَاقَتِنَا،
segments.transliteration: wa min ghenaaka le-faqrenaa wa faaqatenaa,
segments.translation: and your needlessness for our poverty and hunger

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ حِلْمِكَ وَ عِلْمِكَ لِجَهْلِنَا
segments.transliteration: wa min hilmeka wa iâlmeka le-jahlenaa.
segments.translation: and your forbearance and knowledge for our ignorance.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: allaahumma salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَ اَعِنَّا عَلٰى شُكْرِكَ وَ ذِكْرِكَ وَ طَاعَتِكَ وَ عِبَادَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa a-iânnaa aâlaa shukreka wa zikreka wa taa-aâteka wa eâbaadateka,
segments.translation: and help us in your thankfulness and remembrance and obedience and worship
O the most merciful of the merciful ones.
In the name of Allah the Beneficent the Merciful.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِیْ لَہٗ مِنْ کُلِّ نَفْسٍ مِنَ الْاَنْفَاسِ وَ خَطَرَۃٍ مِنَ الْخَطَرَاتِ مِنَّا مِنَنٌ لاَ تُحْصٰی
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi wa khalisatahu
segments.translation: Praise is for Allah, His obligations are on our ingress and egress of breathing and all thoughts of mind are so much, that we can't count.

segments.arabic: وَ فِیْ کُلِّ لَحْظَۃٍ مِنَ الَّلَحَظَاتِ نِعَمٌ لاَ تُنْسٰی وَ فِیْ کُلِّ حَالٍ مِنَ الْحَالاَتِ عَائِدَۃٌ لاَ تُخْفٰی وَ سُبْحَانَ اﷲِ الَّذِیْ یَقْہَرُ الْقَوِیَّ وَ یَنْصُرُ الضَّعِیْفَ وَ یَجْبُرُ الْکَسِیْرَ وَ یُغْنِیْ الْفَقِیْرَ وَ یَقْبَلُ الْیَسِیْرَ وَ یُعْطِیْ الْکَثِیْرَ وَ ہُوَ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ
segments.translation: And His blessing in every moment that we can't forget and in every condition there is a benefit that is not secret. And He is Pure, He subdues the strong and helps the weak and makes the poor rich and accepts an ordinary deeds and bestows his numerous blessings . He has power over all things.

segments.translation: And there is no other god except Allah. His perfectness of blessings, correct wisdom , and incontrovertible arguments and gives security as Allah is Great.His kingdom is safe and its foundations are firm. His arrangement is incomparable His settlement of account is very swift. And from all of His prophets Mohammad (s.a.w.a.) is best. O Allah bestow Your blessings on Mohammad (s.a.w.a.) and his progeny

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُکَ سُؤَالَ الْخَآئِفِ مِنْ وَقْفِہِ الْمَوْقَفِ الْوَجِلِ مِنَ الْعَرْضِ الْمُشْفِقِ مِنَ الْخَشْیَۃِ لِبَوَآئِقِ الْقِیٰمَۃِ الْمَاخُوْذِ عَلَی الْغِزَّۃِ النَّادِمِ عَلٰی خَطِیْئَتِہِ الْمَسْئُوْلِ الْمُحَاسَبِ الْمُثَابِ الْمُعَاقَبِ الَّذِیْ لَمْ یَکِنُّہٗ مُکَانٌ عَنْکَ وَلاَ وَجَدَ مَفَرًّا اِلاَّ اِلَیْکَ مُتَنَصِّلاً (١)
segments.translation: O My Lord! On the day of resurrection one who is frightened or trembled or terrified to be caught in resurrection day, or one who was proud and now felt ashamed and idolaters, afflicted in checking their accounts, terrified person pray to Allah.No shelter can hide him in this situation and no one can give them shelter except you.

segments.arabic: مُلْتَجِاً مِنْ سَیِّئ عَمَلِہٖ مُقِرًّا بِعَظِیْمِ ذُنُوْبِہٖ قَدْ اَحَاطَتْ بِہِ الْہُمُوْمِ وَ ضَاقَتْ عَلَیْہِ رَحَآئِبُ التُّخُوْمِ مُوْقِنٌ بِالْمَوْتِ  مُبَادِرٍ بِالتَّوْبَۃٍ قَبْلَ الْفَوْتِ اِنْ مَنَنْتَ بِہَا عَلَیْہِ وَ عَفَوْتَ
segments.translation: He was repenting for his bad deeds and was confessing for his great sins. Sorrows arrest him or an expansion of earth which becomes narrow for him and he is assured of his death and makes haste to repent before his death If you do Your favour on him and forgive

segments.arabic: فَاَنْتَ اِلٰہِیْ رَجَآئِیْ اِذَا ضَاقَ عَنِّیْ الرَّجَآءُ وَ مَلْجَآئِیْ اِذْ لَمْ اَجِدْ فِنَآئً لِلْاِلْتِجَآءِ تَوَحَّدْتَ سَیِّدِیْ بِالْعِزِّ وَالْعُلَآءِ وَ تَفَرَّدْتَ بِالْوَحْدَانِیَّۃِ وَ الْبَقَآءِ فَاَنْتَ الْمُتَعَزِّزُ الْمُتَفَرِّدُ بِالْمَجْدِ فَلَکَ
segments.translation: then O my Lord! That time you are my wish, when my desires die, You are my shelter when I do not find any shelter. O my Lord, You are one and alone in faith and greatness and in Oneness. You are great in grandeur and magnificence.

segments.arabic: رَبِّیَ الْحَمْدُ لاَ یُوَارِیْ مِنْکَ مَکَانٌ وَّ لاَ یُغَیِّرُکَ دَہْرٌ وَلاَ زَمَانٌ اَلَّفْتَ بِقُدْرَتِکَ الْفِرَقَ وَ فَلَقْتَ بِقُدْرَتِکَ الْفَلْقَ وَ اَنْئَیْتَ بِکَرَمِکَ دَیَاجِیْ الَغَسَقِ وَ اَجْرَیْتَ مِنَ الصُّمِّ الصَّیَاخِیْدِ عَذْبًا وَ فُرَاتًا وَ اَہْمَرْتَ مِنَ الْمُعْصِرَاتِ مَآئً ثَجَّاجًا وَ جَعَلْتَ الشَّمْسَ لِلْبَرِیَّۃِ سِرَاجًا وَّہَّاجًا وَ الْقَمَرَ وَالنَّجُوْمَ اِبْرَاجًا مِنْ غَیْرِ اَنْ تُمَارِسَ فِیْمَا ابْتَدَأْتَ لُغُوْبًا وَلاَ عِلاَجًا
segments.translation: O my Lord, all praise is for You. No shelter can hide You. No time or circumstance can change you, You have created various things together in one place and created the light of dawn and avert the darkness of night and makes sweet and pure streams. How from the hand rocks and flows cold shower from the clouds and makes the Sun shine like a lamp and makes the moon and the stars like the towers of light for the world and created the things in very beginning without any effort or without taking pain.

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ اِلٰہُ کُلِّ شَیْءٍ وَ خَالِقُہٗ وَ جَبَّارُ کُلِّ مَخْلُوْقٍ وَ رَازِقُہ ٗفَالْعَزِیْزُ مَنْ اَعْزَزْتَ وَالذَّلِیْلُ مَنْ اَذْلَلْتَ وَالسَّعِیْدُ مَنْ اَسْعَدْتَ وَالشَّقِیُّ مَنْ اَشْقَیْتَ َ الْغَنِیُّ مَنْ اَغْنَیْتَ وَالْفَقِیْرُ مَنْ اَفْقَرْتَ
segments.translation: As You are the master of all things and You are the Provider and Powerful over all things. One can be said respectable only if you respect him and One who is dishonored by You is disgraced and if you can make one fortunate is lucky and if You make whom unfortunate is miserable and if You make one rich is a rich and if You make whom dependant is a beggar.

segments.arabic: اَنْتَ وَلِّیٖ وَ مَوْلاَيَ وَ عَلَیْکَ رِزْقِیْ وَ بِیَدِکَ نَاصِیَتِیْ فَصَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ افْعَلْ بِیْ مَا اَنْتَ اَہْلُہٗ
segments.transliteration: ana mawlan laka wa li-ali baytika
segments.translation: O Allah! You are my guardian and my fortune and my sustenance is in Your hand. Send Your blessing on Sayyedana Mohammad and his progeny (saws.). And do good turn with me which is worthy of Your splendor.

segments.arabic: وَعْدُ بِفَضْلِکَ عَلٰی عَبْدٍ غَمَرَہٗ جَہْلَہٗ وَاسْتَوْلٰی عَلَیْہِ التَّسْوِیْفُ حَتّٰی سَالَمَ الْاَیَّامَ فَارْتَکَبَ الْمَحَارِمَ وَ الْاٰثَامَ فَاجْعَلْنِیْ
segments.transliteration: wa hadha yawmuka wa huwa yawmu alkhamisi
segments.translation: Be kind with one who is ignored or falsehood has over-whelmed him and make a truce with the world and make commission of prohibition and sins.

segments.arabic: سَیِّدِیْ عَبْدًا یَفْزَعُ اِلَی التَّوْبَۃِ فَاِنَّہَا مَفْزَعُ الْمُذْنِبِیْنَ وَ اَغْنِنِیْ بِجُوْدِکَ الْوَاسِعِ عَنِ الْمَخْلُوْقِیْنَ وَلاَ تُخْرِجْنِیْ اِلٰی شِرَارِ الْعَالَمِیْنَ وَہَبْ لِیْ عَفْوَکَ فِیْ مَوْقِفِ یَوْمِ الدِّیْنِ (١)
segments.transliteration: wa ana dayfuka fihi wa mustajirun bika fihi
segments.translation:
O my Lord, settle me with those who seek protection by repent. Repentance is an asylum of a sinful person. Make me independent from the world by Your high power and kindness.

 Do not make me dependant of any one. Forgive me on the day of Judgment.

segments.arabic: فَاِنَّکَ اَرَحَمَ الرَّاحِمِیْنَ وَ اَجْوَدُ الْاَجْوَدِیْنَ وَ اَکْرَمُ الْاَکْرَمِیْنَ یَا مَنْ لَہٗ الْاَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنٰی وَالْاَمْثَالُ الْعُلْیَا جَبَّارُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِیْنَ اِلَیْکَ قَصَدْتُ رَاجِیًا فَلاَ تَرُدَّ یَدِیْ عَنْ سِنِّیْ مَوَاہِبِکَ صِفْرًا اِنَّکَ جَوَادٌ مِفْضَالٌ یَا رَؤُوْفًا بِالْعِبَادِ وَ مَنْ ہُوَ لَہُمْ بِالْمِرْصَاد
segments.translation:
No doubt You are kind and most generous . Your esteem is honorable of all. O my Lord, Your Beautiful Names and great instances are over whelming on the earth and the heaven.

 I in the hopeful manner turned my face towards You so do not send me our empty handed from Your bounties. No doubt You are generous and grateful and kind to all and takes care of the people.

segments.arabic: ِ اَسْئَلُکَ اَنْ تُصَلِّیَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَنْ تُجْزِلَ ثَوَابِیْ وَ تُحْسِنَ مَاٰبِیْ وَ تَسْتُرَ عُیُوْبِیْ
segments.translation: I request You to send blessing on Mohammad Mustafa and his Progeny (s.a.w.a.) and increase my virtues and make my last stage of my journey good, conceal my sins.

segments.arabic: وَ تَغْفِرَ ذُنُوْبِیْ وَ تُنْقِذَنِیْ مَوْلاَیَ بِفَضْلِکَ مِنْ اَلِیْمِ الْعِقَابِ اِنَّکَ جَوَادٌ کَرِیْمٌ وَہَّابٌ فَقَدْ اَلْقَتْنِیْ السَّیِّئَاتُ وَالْحَسَنَاتُ بَیْنَ ثَوَابٍ وَ عِقَابٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O my Lord save me from Your severe chastisement. You are merciful and generous. O Allah, my good and bad deeds keep me in between virtues and chastisement.

segments.arabic: فَقَدْ رَجَوْتُ اَنْ تَکُوْنَ بِلُطْفِکَ تَتَغَمَّدُ عَبْدَکَ الْمُقِرُّ بِفَوَادِحِ الْعُیُوْبِ بِجُوْدِکَ وَ کَرَمِکَ یَا غَافِرَ الذُّنُوْبِ وَ تَصْفَحُ عَنْ زَلَلِہٖ فَلَیْسَ لِیْ سَیِّدَیْ رَبٌّ اَرْتَحِیْہِ غَیْرُکَ وَلَآ اِلٰہَ اَسْئَلُکَ جَبْرَ فَاقَتِیْ وَ مَسْکَنَتِیْ سِوَاکَ فَلاَ تُرَدَّنِیْ مِنْکَ بِالْخَیْبَۃِ یَا مُقِیْلُ الْعَثَرَاتِ وَ کَاشِفَ الْکُرُبَاتِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation:
I hope You shall conceal my bad virtues after confessing.O Pardoner, for the sake of Your Mercy, forgive me for taken false steps. Because O my Lord, no one is other god except You to whom I raise hope. 

No one is mine except You to whom I raise hope. No one is mine except You that I seek request to remove my poverty. O Pardoner of sins and troubles do not turn me without blessings.

segments.arabic: اِلٰہِیْ فَسُرَّنِیْ فَاِنِّیْ لَسْتُ بِاَوَّلَ مَنْ سَرَرْتَہُ یَا وَلِیَّ النِّعَمِ وَ شَدِیْدَ النِّقَمِ وَ دَآئِمَ الْمَجْدِ وَالْکَرَمِ وَاخْصُصْنِیْ مِنْکَ بِمَغْفِرَۃٍ لاَ یُقَارِنُہَا شَقَآئٌ وَ سَعَادَۃٌ لاَ یُدَانِیْہَا اَذًی
segments.translation: O my Lord! Make me happy as I will not be first one from the happiest men whom you made happy before. O Master of blessings and given of severe chastisement, let me particular for salvation that misfortune cannot pass by and conferred me good fortune that no trouble can come near it.

segments.arabic: وَ اَلْہِمَنِیْ تُقَاکَ وَ مَحَبَّتَکَ وَ جَنِّبْنِیْ مُؤْبِقَاتِ مَعْصِیَتِکَ وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ لِلنَّارِ عَلَیَّ سُلْطَانًا اِنَّکَ اَہْلُ التَّقْوٰی وَ اَہْلُ الْمَغْفِرَۃِ وَ قَدْ دَعَوْتُکَ وَ تَکَفَّلْتَ بِالْاِجَابَۃِ فَلاَ تُخَیِّبْ سَآئِلَکَ وَلاَ تَخْذُلْ طَالِبَکَ وَ لاَ تَرُدَّ اٰمِلَکَ یَا خَیْرَ مَامُوْلٍ وَ اَسْئَلُکَ بِرَافَتِکَ وَ رَحْمَتِکَ وَ فَرْدَانِیَّتِکَ وَ رُبُوْبِیَّتِکَ یَا مَنْ ہُوَ عَلٰی کُلِ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ وَ بِکُلِّ شَیْءٍ مُحِیْطٌ
segments.translation:
Send me divine help of love and fear of You and keep me safe from destruction and do not allow the fire of hell over me.

 You are only worthy for salvation and piety. I pray to you and You have promised acceptance so do not make me disappointed. For the sake of your blessings, favours and providence I pray to you. O Allah you have power over all things.

segments.arabic: فَاَکْفِنِیْ مَا اَہَمَّنِیْ مِنْ اَمْرِ دُنْیَایَ وَ اٰخِرَتِیْ فَاِنَّکَ سَمِیْعُ الدُّعَآءِ لَطِیْفٌ لِّمَا تَشَآءُ وَ اَدْرِجْنِیْ دَرَجَ مَنْ اَوْجَبْتَ لَہٗ حُلُوْلُ دَارَکَرَامَتِکَ مَعَ اَصْفِیَآئِکَ وَ اَہْلِ اِخْتِصَاصِکَ بِجَزِیْلِ مَوَاہِبِکَ فِیْ دَرَجَات جَنَّاتِکَ مَعَ الَّذِیْنَ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَیْہِمْ مِنَ النَّبِیِّیْنَ وَالصِّدِّیْقِیْنَ وَالشُّہَدَآءِ وَالصَّالِحِیْنَ وَ حَسُنُ اُوْلٰٓئِکَ رِفِیْقًا
segments.translation: The matters of the world and resurrection have made me sad, so make me free as you are hearing and merciful to whom you like. Keep me among the pious and your beloved people who will be along with your Apostles, sincere, and martyred people in paradise. They will be good virtuous people. How nice will be their companionship?

segments.arabic: وَ مَا افْتَرَضْتَ عَلَیَّ فَاحْتَمِلْہُ عَنِّیْ اِلٰی مَنْ اَوْجَبَتْ حُقَوْقَہٗ مِنَ الْاٰبَآءِ وَالْاُمَّہَاتِ وَالْاِخْوَۃِ وَالْاَخْوَاتِ وَاغْفِرِلِیْ وَلَہُمْ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتِ اِنَّکَ قَرِیْبٌ مُجِیْبٌ وَاسِعُ الْبَرَکَاتِ
segments.translation: O My Lord! Whatever the duties are on me, accomplish them especially the duties of my parents, brothers and sisters and forgive all Shiite Muslims along with them my relatives and myself. You are very near, knower and hearer of prayers and great auspicious. O the kind, the great kind of all.

segments.arabic: وَ ذٰلِکَ عَلَیْکَ یَسِیْرٌ یَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِیْنَ۔ وَ صَلَّی اﷲُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِیِّ وَ اٰلِہٖ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِیْمًا۔
segments.translation: My request is very easy for you. O Allah! Grant Complete Safety with your blessings on Muhammed Mustafa (saws) and his innocent and most pure Progeny.
Peace be upon you, O saint of Allah!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ وَخَالِصَتَهُ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O argument of Allah and His choicest!

segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha alladhi la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O leader of the faithful believers,
inheritor of the messengers,
and argument of the Lord of the Worlds!

segments.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ بَيْتِكَ
segments.translation: May Allah send peace upon you and upon your Household,
the pure and immaculate!

segments.transliteration: la yastati`u linafsihi sarfan wa la `adlan
segments.translation: O my master, O Abu-Muhammad,

segments.transliteration: wa la naf`an wa la darran
segments.translation: al-Hasan, the son of `Ali!

segments.transliteration: wa la hayatan wa la mawtan wa la nushuran
segments.translation: I am a servant of you and of your Household
and today is your day, which is Thursday,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا ضَيْفُكَ فِيهِ وَمُسْتَجِيرٌ بِكَ فِيهِ
segments.translation: and on this day, I am your guest and in your vicinity;
so, receive me hospitably as your guest and neighbor,
[I ask you] in the name of your Household, the pure and immaculate.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent and Merciful.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْوَاسِعُ الَّذِي لَا يَضِيقُ
segments.translation: Glory be to you, There is no God save you; The Immense, Who will not be narrowed!

segments.arabic: الْبَصِيرُ الَّذِي لَا يَضِلُّ النُّورُ الَّذِي لَا يُخْمَدُ
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: The All-Seeing, Who will never astray! The Divine Light, Who will never be extinguished!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ
segments.transliteration: wa an taghfira li dhanbiya al`azima
segments.translation: Glory be to you, There is no God save you; The Ever-living, Who will never die!

segments.arabic: الْقَيُّومُ الَّذِي لَا يَهِنُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَا يُطْعَمُ
segments.translation: The Self-Subsistent, who The Eternally Besought and Will never be fed!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to you, There is no God save you;

segments.arabic: [وَ أَعَزَّ سُلْطَانَكَ وَ أَعْلَى مَكَانَكَ [وَ أَشْمَخَ مُلْكَكَ‏
segments.translation: How mighty is your authority! How mighty is Your station!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ مَا أَبَرَّكَ وَ أَرْحَمَكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to you, There is no God save you; O, The most; Merciful, Benevolence,

segments.arabic: وَ أَحْلَمَكَ وَ أَعْظَمَكَ وَ أَسْمَحَكَ وَ أَجَلَّكَ
segments.translation: Forbearance, Greatness, forgiver, sublime,

segments.arabic: وَ أَكْرَمَكَ وَ أَعْلَمَكَ وَ أَعَزَّكَ وَ أَعْلَاكَ
segments.translation: generous, All-Knowing, Mighty, High,

segments.arabic: وَ أَقْوَاكَ وَ أَسْمَعَكَ وَ أَبْصَرَكَ
segments.translation: All-Powerful, All-Hearing, and All-Watching!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;

segments.arabic: مَا أَكْرَمَ عَفْوَكَ وَ أَعْظَمَ تَجَاوُزَكَ
segments.translation: O, How; generous is your pardon, and great is your overlooking!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;

segments.arabic: مَا أَوْسَعَ رَحْمَتَكَ وَ أَكْثَرَ فَضْلَكَ
segments.translation: O, How; expanded is your mercy and abundant is your bounties!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;

segments.arabic: مَا أَنْعَمَ آلَاءَكَ وَ أَسْبَغَ نَعْمَاءَكَ
segments.translation: O, How, Bestowed is his blessings and graces!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;

segments.arabic: مَا أَفْضَلَ ثَوَابَكَ وَ أَجْزَلَ عَطَاءَكَ
segments.translation: O, How; great is your Reward, and abundant is your gifts!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;

segments.arabic: مَا أَوْسَعَ حُجَّتَكَ وَ أَوْضَحَ بُرْهَانَكَ
segments.translation: O, How; immense is your Claim, and obvious is your Proof!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;

segments.arabic: مَا أَشَدَّ أَخْذَكَ وَ أَوْجَعَ عِقَابَكَ
segments.translation: O, How; tough is your taking, and Hurtful is your punishment!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;

segments.arabic: مَا أَشَدَّ مَكْرَكَ وَ أَمْتَنَ كَيْدَكَ
segments.translation: O, How; strong is your resourcefulness and firm cunning!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;

segments.arabic: تُسَبِّحُ لَكَ السَّمَاوَاتُ السَّبْعُ وَ الْأَرَضُونَ السَّبْعُ
segments.translation: Glorify you The seven Heavens and seven Earths!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;

segments.arabic: الْقَرِيبُ فِي عُلُوِّكَ الْمُتَعَالِي فِي دُنُوِّكَ الْمُتَدَانِي دُونَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: O, the high in your nearness and yet exalted in your nearness before your creatures!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;
O, The close; Who is a priori to all existence!
O, The Everlasting when everything disappears!

segments.arabic: وَ الْبَاقِي بَعْدَ فَنَاءِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
segments.translation: O, The Remaining, after everything (created) shall perish!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;
Everything is minor before your omnipotence
and follows your authority.
Before your respect, all things are Lowly.
Everything obeyed your authority
and submitted to your All-Poweness!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;
You are the One who rules over the kings by Your Power
Defeated the tyrants with your power!
You degraded The greats with your mightiness!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;
with glorification that exceeds all the glorification of those who glorify Him,

segments.arabic: كُلِّهِمْ مِنْ أَوَّلِ الدَّهْرِ    إِلَى آخِرِهِ
segments.translation: from The beginning of time till eternity fulfilling The;

segments.arabic: وَ مِلْ‏ءَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرَضِينَ وَ مِلْ‏ءَ مَا خَلَقْتَ وَ مِلْ‏ءَ مَا قَدَّرْتَ
segments.translation: heavens, earth, what you created, and what you fated!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;
The heavens glorify you on all its sides!
The sun is in its streaming;

segments.arabic: وَ الْقَمَرُ فِي مَنَازِلِهِ وَ النُّجُومُ فِي سَيَرَانِهَا
segments.translation: The moon is in its places, the stars in its pacing,
and The orbit in its ascension.
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;

segments.arabic: يُسَبِّحُ لَكَ النَّهَارُ بِضَوْئِهِ وَ اللَّيْلُ بِدُجَائِهِ
segments.translation: The day glorifies you by its Light, night by its darkness,

segments.arabic: وَ النُّورُ بِشُعَاعِهِ وَ الظُّلْمَةُ بِغُمُوضِهَا
segments.translation: Light by its brightness, and The darkness with its Obscurely!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;
The winds glorify you by blowing,
clouds by rain,

segments.arabic: وَ الْبَرْقُ بِأَخْطَافِهِ وَ الرَّعْدُ بِأَرْزَامِهِ
segments.translation: lightning by snatching, and thunder by bundling!
Glory be to you, There is no God save you;
The earth glorifies you by its sustenance,

segments.arabic: وَ الْجِبَالُ بِأَطْوَادِهَا وَ الْأَشْجَارُ بِأَوْرَاقِهَا
segments.translation: mountains by its floating, trees by their leaves,
and pastureland by its arboretums!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ وَ بِحَمْدِكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to you, there is no God save You alone without having any partner;
at the amount of everything that glorifies you,

segments.arabic: وَ كَمَا تُحِبُّ يَا رَبِّ أَنْ تُحْمَدَ
segments.translation: as you like to be Praised,

segments.arabic: [ وَ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِعَظَمَتِكَ وَ كِبْرِيَائِكَ [وَ عِزِّكَ‏
segments.translation: and as should Your; Grandeur, Magnificence,

segments.arabic: وَ عِزَّتِكَ وَ قُوَّتِكَ وَ قُدْرَتِكَ
segments.translation: honor, power, and ability glorified!

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَ آلِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ‏
segments.translation: O, Allah; send The blessings upon Muhammed, The seal of prophets and His household.
In the Name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

segments.arabic: أُعِيذُ نَفْسِي‏ بِرَبِّ الْمَشارِقِ وَ الْمَغارِبِ
segments.translation: I seek protection for myself in the Lord of the East and the West

segments.arabic: ‏ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَارِدٍ وَ قَائِمٍ وَ قَاعِدٍ وَ عَدُوٍّ وَ حَاسِدٍ
segments.translation: from the evil of every rebellious, standing, sitting, envious.

segments.arabic: وَ مُعَانِدٍ وَ يُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ السَّماءِماءً
segments.translation: Refractory demon and We send down on you water from heaven,

segments.arabic: لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ بِهِ وَ يُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمْ رِجْزَ الشَّيْطانِ
segments.translation: to purify you thereby, to put away from you the defilement of Satan

segments.arabic: وَ لِيَرْبِطَ عَلى‏ قُلُوبِكُمْ وَ يُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الْأَقْدامَ‏
segments.translation: and to strengthen your hearts, and to make firm your feet.
Stamp Your foot!
This is a washing-place cool for drinking.

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْزَلْنا مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً طَهُوراً لِنُحْيِيَ بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتاً
segments.translation: And We sent down from heaven pure water to revive dead land,

segments.arabic: وَ نُسْقِيَهُ مِمَّا خَلَقْنا أَنْعاماً وَ أَناسِيَّ كَثِيراً
segments.translation: and give to drink of it what We created, many cattle and men.
Now God has lightened it for you.

segments.arabic: ذلِكَ تَخْفِيفٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَ رَحْمَةٌ يُرِيدُ اللهُ
segments.translation: So that a lightening granted you by your Lord and the mercy that Allah desires
to lighten things for you, God will suffice you for them.
He is the All-hearer and the All-knower.

segments.arabic: لا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ‏ وَ اللهُ غالِبٌ عَلى‏ أَمْرِهِ‏
segments.translation: There is no power except with Allah, no conqueror except Allah. God prevails in His purpose.

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللهِ
segments.translation: There is no God save Allah; Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah,
blessings of Allah be on him and his family.

segments.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللهِ وَ أَعُوذُ بِقُدْرَةِ اللهِ
segments.translation: I seek refuge in the might of Allah and I seek refuge in the power of Allah

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِرَسُولِهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ  وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً
segments.translation: and I seek refuge in His Messenger,  may Allah bless him and his family and may He salute them with thorough salutation.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and his Household.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
hasten their Relief,
and destroy their enemies
from both jinn and human beings,
both the foremost and the later ones.
All Glory be to Allah.
Allah is the Most Great.
There is no god save Allah.

segments.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
segments.translation: I pray the forgiveness of Allah; there is no god but He,
the Ever-living, the Self-Subsisting,
and I repent to Him
as a slave who is submissive,
acquiescent, and poor,

segments.arabic: لاَ يَسْتَطيعُ لِنَفْسِهِ صَرْفاً وَلاَ عَدْلاً
segments.translation: not controlling for himself any harm or profit,
or benefit or damage

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَيَاةً وَلاَ مَوْتاً وَلاَ نُشُوراً
segments.translation: and not controlling death nor life, nor raising (the dead) to life.
May Allah send peace upon Muhammad
and his Household; the pure, the immaculate,
the choicest, and the pious;
and may He spread thorough blessings over them.
O Allah, I beseech You in the name of Your Noble Face
and in the name of Your Sublime Name
to send blessings to Muhammad and his Household
and to forgive me my grave sin.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا كُنْتَ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ قَبْلَكَ شَيْ‏ءٌ
segments.translation: O, Allah, our Lord, You were, and nothing was there before You,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْتَ تَكُونُ حِينَ لَا يَكُونُ غَيْرَكَ شَيْ‏ءٌ
segments.translation: and You will exist when there is nothing except You.

segments.arabic: لَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ كُنْهَ عِزَّتِكَ وَ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَحَدٌ أَنْ يَنْعَتَ عَظَمَتَكَ
segments.translation: No one knows Your mightiness essence nor describes Your greatness,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ أَيْنَ مُسَتَقَرُّكَ
segments.translation: no one knows where is Your dwelling place;

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ فَوْقَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ أَنْتَ وَرَاءَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ
segments.translation: You are above everything, behind everything,

segments.arabic: وَ أَمَامَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ مَعَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ
segments.translation: in front of everything, and with everything.

segments.arabic: خَلَقْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ
segments.translation: You created, O Possessor of majesty and munificence;
glorification for Your Face purified the pride

segments.arabic: وَ الْعَظَمَةَ لِنَفْسِكَ وَ خَلَقْتَ الْقُوَّةَ
segments.translation: and greatness of Your being and created the power
and competence of Your authority!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى عَظَمَةِ مُلْكِكَ  وَ جَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ
segments.translation: So, Glory be to You, our God, and to you be the Praise upon the greatness of Your kingdom and Your Honorable Face;
whose light-filled everything,

segments.arabic: وَ هُوَ حَيْثُ لَا يَرَاهُ شَيْءٌ يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ
segments.translation: and He is where nothing can witness Him; glorified is Him with His Praise
so, Glory and Praise be to You!
O God, our Lord to You belongs Praise;

segments.arabic: تَسَلَّطْتَ فَلَا أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْعِبَادِ يَحُدُّ وَصْفَكَ
segments.translation: You ruled over the servants so no one will limit Your description.
You ruled with Your mightiness; You braced Yourself with Your omnipotence,

segments.arabic: وَ تَجَبَّرْتَ بِكِبْرِيَائِكَ وَ تَكَبَّرْتَ بِمُلْكِكَ
segments.translation: You compelled with your pride, and You magnified with Your possessions,

segments.arabic: وَ تَمَلَّكْتَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ‏ وَ قَدَرْتَ بِقُوَّتِكَ‏
segments.translation: You possessed with Your power, You got capable with Your power.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْعِبَادِ وَصْفَكَ
segments.translation: No one among the servants can describe You,
and no one can evaluate Your value,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يَسْبِقُ أَحَدٌ مِنْ قَضَائِكَ
segments.translation: nor can anyone go beyond Your decree.
O God, our Lord to You belongs Praise;

segments.arabic: عَلَى جَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ وَ عَظَمَةِ مُلْكِكَ
segments.translation: upon Your majestic face and the greatness of Your possessions;

segments.arabic: الَّذِي بِهِ قَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَ الْأَرْضُ
segments.translation: through which the heavens and earth endure.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ
segments.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord; to You belongs Praise.
You filled everything with greatness,
and You created everything with power;
You encompass all things with knowledge,
count everything in numbers,
save everything in a record,

segments.arabic: وَ وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ رَحْمَةً وَ عِلْماً
segments.translation: and embracest everything in mercy and knowledge;
indeed, You are Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: ‏ فَ سُبْحَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى عِزَّةِ سُلْطَانِكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to You, our God, and to you be the Praise upon Your glorified authority;

segments.arabic: الَّذِي خَشَعَ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: which everything humbled to, from Your creation
and all Your servants got cautious of,
all Your creations are submitted to it.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammed;

segments.arabic: وَ اجْزِهِ أَفْضَلَ الْجَزَاءِ وَ أَفْضَلَ
segments.translation: repay him with the best reward, and with the best reward,

segments.arabic: مَا أَنْتَ جَازٍ أَحَداً مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِكَ عَلَى حِفْظِهِ دِينَكَ وَ إِبْلَاغِهِ  وَ اتِّبَاعِهِ وَصِيَّتَكَ
segments.translation: You ever granted to anyone of Your Prophets as he; safeguards Your religion and informs it, following Your will and command.

segments.arabic: وَ أَمْرَكَ حَتَّى تُشَرِّفَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِتَفْضِيلِكَ إِيَّاهُ عَلَى جَمِيعِ رُسُلِكَ
segments.translation: Until You honor him with Your preferring upon all Your Messengers on the Day of Resurrection;
O Possessor of majesty and munificence!
O, Allah, just as You have rescued us through what You distinguished;

segments.arabic: مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
segments.translation: Muhammed, blessings of Allah be upon him, and his Household
and have guided us through what You sent,

segments.arabic: وَ بَصَّرْتَنَا بِمَا أَوْصَيْتَهُ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ
segments.translation: and have shown us through what deeds you command.
Therefore, send Your blessings upon him and his Household,
and repay him the best reward on our behalf.

segments.arabic: وَ أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ‏ نَبِيّاً مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَ رُسُلِكَ
segments.translation: Best reward; You ever granted to any of Your Prophets and Messengers,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَجْمَعَ لِي بِهِ خَيْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
segments.translation: and please grant me the best of this world and Hereafter.

segments.arabic: إِنَّكَ ذُو فَضْلٍ كَرِيمٍ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَام‏
segments.translation: You are Possessor of generous bounty; O Possessor of majesty and munificence!
