title: Friday   Duas.org

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مَا قُلْتُ فِي جُمُعَتِي هٰذِهِ مِنْ قَوْلٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ma qultu fi jumu`ati hadhihi min qawlin
segments.translation: O Allah, whatever saying I have uttered this week,
whatever oath I have taken during it,
and whatever vow I have made during it,
verily, it is Your will that is before all that.

segments.arabic: فَمَا شِئْتَ مِنْهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ كَانَ
segments.transliteration: fama shi'ta minhu an yakuna kana
segments.translation: Hence, only that which You will to have effect will come to pass

segments.arabic: وَمَا لَمْ تَشَأْ  مِنْهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ
segments.transliteration: wa ma lam tasha' minhu lam yakun
segments.translation: and whatever You do not will to have effect will never come to pass.
O Allah, (please) forgive me and overlook my offenses.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مَنْ صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ فَصَلاَتِي عَلَيْهِ
segments.translation: O Allah, whosoever You bless, then I invoke Your blessings upon him
and whosoever You curse, then I invoke Your curse upon him.
O Allah, I am resorting to You with my needs,
and I am putting in Your presence my poverty,
my indigence, and my deprivation.
Verily, I hope for Your forgiveness more than I rely on my deeds.

segments.transliteration: wa lamaghfiratuka wa rahmatuka awsa`u min dhunubi
segments.translation: Indeed, Your forgiveness and Your mercy are more inclusive than my sins are.

segments.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ قَضَاءَ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ لِي بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَيْهَا
segments.transliteration: fatawalla qada'a kulli hajatin li biqudratika `alayha
segments.translation: So, (please) embark on settling all my needs out of Your power over them,
out of the easiness for You to do that,
and out of my urgent need for that.

segments.arabic: فَإنِّي لَمْ أُصِبْ خَيْراً قَطُّ إِلاَّ مِنَكَ
segments.transliteration: fa'inni lam usib khayran qattu illa minka
segments.translation: Verily, I have not gained any good thing save from You

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَصْرِفْ عَنِّي سُوءاً قَطُّ أَحَدٌ سِوَاكَ
segments.transliteration: wa lam yasrif `anni su'an qattu ahadun siwaka
segments.translation: and none could ever repel evil from me save You.

segments.transliteration: wa lastu arju li-akhirati wa dunyaya wa
segments.translation: I hope for none to stand for me in my affairs of this world and the Next World
and on the day of my poverty,
when people will leave me alone in my hole (i.e. grave)
and I will then confess of my sins before You, except You.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin wa `ajjil farajahum
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and hasten their Reappearance

segments.arabic: لَا بِشَيْءٍ مِن آلَاءِكَ رَبِّي اُكَذِّبُ
segments.transliteration: la bishay'in min ala'ika rabbi ukadhdhibu.
segments.translation: âNone of Your favors do I deny,â

segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha rabbi wa atubu ilayhi
segments.translation: I pray for the forgiveness of Allahâmy Lord, and I repent before Him.
O Allah, (please do) let Your blessings
and the blessings of Your angels and Messengers
be on Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,
grant me Your satisfaction this very early morning,
place fear of You in my heart,
and separate it from (leaning to) anyone other than You,

segments.arabic: حَتَّىٰ لاَ أَرْجُوَ وَلاَ أَخَافَ إِلاَّ إِيَّاكَ
segments.transliteration: hatta la arjwa wa la akhafa illa iyyaka
segments.translation: so that I will hope for and fear none save You.
O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and his Household
and grant me resolute faith,
pure sincerity (to You),
honorable belief in (Your) oneness,
persistent straightness,
essential tolerance,
and satisfaction with (Your) predetermination and decrees.
O He Who settles the needs of His beseechers;

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي ضَمِيرِ ٱلصَّامِتِينَ
segments.transliteration: ya man ya`lamu ma fi damiri alssamitina
segments.translation: O He Who knows what is in the innermost of the silent;
send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,
respond to my prayers,
forgive my sins,
expand my means of livelihood,
and settle the needs of myself

segments.transliteration: wa ikhwani fi dini wa ahli
segments.translation: and my brethren-in-faith and my family members.

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي طُمُوحُ ٱلآمَالِ قَدْ خَابَتْ إِلاَّ لَدَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: ilahi tumuhu al-amali qad khabat illa ladayka
segments.translation: O Allah, all ambitions of expectations are disappointed except those addressed to You,

segments.arabic: وَمَعَاكِفُ ٱلْهِمَمِ قَدْ تَعَطَّلَتْ إِلاَّ عَلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa ma`akifu alhimami qad ta`attalat illa `alayka
segments.translation: all resolute determinations are paralyzed except those relied upon You,

segments.arabic: وَمَذَاهِبُ ٱلْعُقُولِ قَدْ سَمَتْ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa madhahibu al`uquli qad samat illa ilayka
segments.translation: and all reason-based tendencies are wasted except those directed to You.
So, You are the ultimate hope and to You is the resort.

segments.transliteration: ya akrama maqsudin wa ajwada mas'ulin
segments.translation: O He Who is the noblest objective and the most magnanimous desired,
I am fleeing to You from myself.
O shelter of those who flee overburdened with the heavy loads of sins,
carrying my sins on my back,
I cannot find any interceder for me

segments.arabic: سِوَىٰ مَعْرِفَتِي بِأَنَّكَ أَقْرَبُ مَنْ رَجَاهُ ٱلطَّالِبُونَ
segments.transliteration: siwa ma`rifati bi'annaka aqrabu man rajahu alttalibuna
segments.translation: except that I know for sure that You are the nearest of all those who are hoped by beseechers
and of all those whose donations are expected by the desirous.
O He Who has split the intellects on the recognition of Him,
made tongues articulate with the praising of Him

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلَ مَا ٱمْتَنَّ بِهِ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ فِي كِفَاءٍ لِتَاْدِيَةِ حَقِّهِ
segments.transliteration: wa ja`ala ma imtanna bihi `ala `ibadihi fi kifa'in lita'diyati haqqhi
segments.translation: and made that which He has conferred upon His servants enough means for the fulfillment of their duties towards Him;
(please) send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ عَلَىٰ عَقْلِي سَبيلاًَ
segments.translation: do not give Satan any way (of success) over my reason,
and do not give wrongness a way to reach my deeds.

segments.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha alladhi la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: I pray the forgiveness of Allah save Whom there is no god;
the Ever-living and Ever-subsisting,and I turn in repentance to Him
I begin this morning seeking the protection of Allah,
the protection of His angels,

segments.transliteration: wa dhimami anbiya'ihi wa rusulihi `alayhimu alssalamu
segments.translation: the protections of His prophets and messengers, peace be upon them,

segments.arabic: وَذِمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa dhimmati muhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: the protection of Muhammad, peace be upon him and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَذِمَمِ ٱلأَوْصِيَاءِ مِنَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segments.transliteration: wa dhimami al-awsiya'i min ali muhammadin `alayhimu alssalamu
segments.translation: and the protections of the Successors from Muhammadâs progeny, peace be upon them.

segments.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِسِرِّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ وَعَلاَنِيَتِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: amantu bisirri ali muhammadin `alayhimu alssalamu wa `alaniyatihim
segments.translation: I believe in the secrets of Muhammadâs progeny, peace be upon them, and in their open affairs
and in their exoteric and their esoteric affairs.

segments.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّهُمْ فِي عِلْمِ ٱللَّهِ وَطَاعَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa ash-hadu annahum fi `ilmi allahi wa ta`atihi
segments.translation: I bear witness that they, as regarding their knowledge of Allah and their obedience to Him,
are just like Muhammad, peace be upon him and his Household.
All glory be to Allah, the All-great and with the Praising of Him;

segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha rabbi wa atubu ilayhi
segments.translation: I pray the forgiveness of Allah, my Lord, and I turn repentant to Him.

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ash-hadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: I bear witness that there is no god except Allah,
the One, (there is) no associate with Him;

segments.transliteration: wa ash-hadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin waj`alni mina alttawwabina
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and make me of those who turn to You constantly

segments.transliteration: ash-hadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: and those who keep themselves pure and clean.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِيْ وَ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِيْ وَ انْقِ غُسْلِيْ وَ اَجْرِ عَلٰى لِسَانِيْ ذِكْرَكَ وَ ذِكْرَ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِہٖ وَ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنَ التَّوَّابِيْنَ وَ مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma tahhirnee wa tahhir qalbee wan qe ghuslee wa ajre aâlaa lesaanee zikraka wa zikra nabiyyeka mohammadin sallal laaho aâlayhe wa aalehi waj aâlnee menat tawwaabeena wa menal motatahhereen.
segments.translation: O Allah! Purify me and purify my heart, adorn my bath, and make Your remembrance and remembrance of Your prophet Muhammad, peace of Allah be on him and his progeny, flow on my tongue. Make me amongst the repantent and the purified ones.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صَلَواتِكَ وَصَلَوَاتِ مَلَاْئِكَتِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ وَجَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وأَهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ وَعَليْهِمُ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ.
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah (I begin);and by (the command of) Allah

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa `ala sunnati muhammadin wa ali muhammad
segments.translation: and according to the tradition of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad (I do this).
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi al-awwali qabla al-insha'i wal-ihya'i
segments.translation: All praise be to Allah, the First before the bringing forth and the giving of life,
and the Last after the annihilation of all things,

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ قَبْلَ ٱلْإِنْشَاءِ وَٱلْإِحْيَاءِ
segments.transliteration: al`alimi alladhi la yansa man dhakarahu
segments.translation: the All-knowing Who forgets not him who remembers Him,
decreases not him who thanks Him,

segments.arabic: ٱلْعَلِيمِ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَنْسَىٰ مَنْ ذَكَرَهُ
segments.translation: disappoints not him who supplicates Him,

segments.transliteration: wa la yaqta`u raja'a man rajahu
segments.translation: and cuts not off the hope of him who hopes in Him!
O Allah, I call You to witness
and You are sufficient Witness
and I call to witness all Your angels,
the inhabitants of Your heavens,
the bearers of Your Throne,

segments.transliteration: wa man ba`athta min anbiya'ika wa rusulika
segments.translation: Your prophets and Your messengers whom You have sent out,
and the various kinds of creatures You have brought forth,
that I bear witness that You are Allah;
there is no god but You, You alone,
Who have no associate nor any equal,

segments.transliteration: wa la khulfa liqawlika wa la tabdila
segments.translation: and Your word has no failing, nor any change;

segments.transliteration: wa anna muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi `abduka wa rasuluka
segments.translation: and that Muhammad, Allah bless him and his Household, is Your servant and Your messenger;
he delivered to the servants that with which You charged him,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa jahada fi allahi `azza wa jalla haqqa aljihadi
segments.translation: struggled for Allah as is His due,

segments.transliteration: wa annahu bashshara bima huwa haqqun min alththawabi
segments.translation: gave the good news of the truth of reward,

segments.arabic: وَجَاهَدَ فِي ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ حَقَّ ٱلْجِهَادِ
segments.transliteration: wa andhara bima huwa sidqun min al`iqabi
segments.translation: and warned of the veracity of punishment.

segments.arabic: وَ أَنَّهُ بَشَّرَ بِما هُوَ حَقُّ مِنَ ٱلثَّوابِ
segments.translation: O Allah, make me firm in Your religion as long as You keep me alive,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْذَرَ بِما هُوَ صِدْقٌ مِنَ ٱلعِقَابِ
segments.transliteration: wa la tuzigh qalbi ba`da idh hadaytani
segments.translation: make not my heart swerve after You have guided me,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْنِي عَلَىٰ دِينِكَ مَا أَحْيَيْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: wa hab li min ladunka rahmatan
segments.translation: and give me mercy from You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُزِغْ قَلْبِي بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنِي
segments.translation: surely, You are the All-bestower.
Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
make me one of his followers and his partisans,
muster me in his band,
and give me the success of accomplishing the obligatory observance of Fridays,

segments.transliteration: wa ma awjabta `alayya fiha min atta`ati
segments.translation: performing the acts of obedience which You have made incumbent upon me within it,
and receiving the bestowal which You have apportioned for its people

segments.arabic: وَمَا أَوْجَبْتَ عَلَيَّ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلطَّاعَاتِ
segments.translation: on the Day of Recompense!
Surely, You are the Almighty, the All-wise!
O Allah, You are my Lord;
there is no god save You;
You have created me, and I am Your slave and the son of Your bondmaid;

segments.transliteration: wa fi qabdatika wa nasiyati biyadika
segments.translation: and I am in Your grip; and my forehead is in Your Hand;
I come to observe my covenant and promise to You as much as I can.

segments.transliteration: a`udhu biridaka min sharri maÂ sana`tu
segments.translation: I take refuge in Your pleasure against the evil of my deeds.

segments.arabic: امْسَيْتُ عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ
segments.translation: I acknowledge Your favors and confess of my sins.

segments.arabic: اعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

segments.transliteration: AssalÄmu âalayka ayyuhÄ lyawmu ljadÄ«du lmubÄraku alladhÄ« jaâala llÄhu âÄ«dan liawliyÄâihi lmuá¹­ahharÄ«na mina ddanasi lkhÄrijÄ«na âani lbalwÄ.
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O new blessed day, which Allah has made a celebration for His purified allies who are free from defilement and tribulation.

segments.transliteration: AlmakrÅ«rÄ«na maâa awliyÄâihi lmuá¹£á¹­afayyna mina lâakari lbÄdilÄ«na anfusahum maâa awliyÄâi rRaá¸¥mÄni taslÄ«man.
segments.translation: The ones enduring trials with His chosen allies, those purified of impurities, who sacrificed themselves in submission alongside the allies of the Most Merciful.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا الْيَوْمُ الْجَدِيدُ الْمُبَارَكُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ اللَّهُ عِيداً لِأَوْلِيَائِهِ الْمُطَهَّرِينَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ الْخَارِجِينَ عَنِ الْبَلْوَى
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, an everlasting and eternal peace.

segments.arabic: الْمَكْرُورِينَ مَعَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ الْمُصطَفَّيْنَ مِنَ الْعَكَرِ الْبَاذِلِينَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ مَعَ أَوْلِيَاءِ الرَّحْمَنِ تَسْلِيماً
segments.translation: And turn to the sun and say:

segments.transliteration: AssalÄmu âalayki ayyatuha shshamsu á¹­á¹­Äliâatu wa nnÅ«ru lfÄá¸ilu lbahiyy.
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O shining sun, the radiant and resplendent light.

segments.transliteration: Ushhiduki bitawá¸¥Ä«di llÄhi litakÅ«nÄ« shÄhidÄ« idhÄ áºahara rRabbu lifaá¹£li lqaá¸Äâi fÄ« lâÄlamÄ« ljadÄ«d.
segments.translation: I bear witness through you to the Oneness of Allah so that you may be my witness when the Lord appears to settle judgment in the new world.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتُهَا الشَّمْسُ الطَّالِعَةُ وَالنُّورُ الْفَاضِلُ الْبَهِيُّ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« aâÅ«dhu bika wa binÅ«ri wajhika lkarÄ«mi an tushawwih khalqÄ«.
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You and in the light of Your noble face from any distortion of my form.

segments.arabic: أُشْهِدُكِ بِتَوْحِيدِ اللَّهِ لِتَكُونِي شَاهِدِي إِذَا ظَهَرَ الرَّبُّ لِفَصْلِ الْقَضَاءِ فِي الْعَالَمِ الْجَدِيدِ.
segments.transliteration: Wa an turaddida rÅ«á¸¥Ä« fÄ« lâadhÄbi binÅ«rika lmaá¸¥jÅ«bi âan kulli nÄáºirin nawwir qalbÄ«.
segments.translation: And from my soul being returned to torment; by Your light concealed from all eyes, illuminate my heart.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ وَبِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ أَنْ تُشَوِّهَ خَلْقِي
segments.transliteration: Fa innÄ« anÄ âabduka wa fÄ« qabá¸atika wa lÄ Rabba lÄ« siwÄka.
segments.translation: For indeed, I am Your servant, within Your grasp, and I have no Lord besides You.

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُرَدِّدَ رُوحِي فِي الْعَذَابِ بِنُورِكَ الْمَحْجُوبِ عَنْ كُلِّ نَاظِرٍ نَوِّرْ قَلْبِي
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« ataqarrabu ilayka biqalbin khÄá¸iâin wa ilÄ waliyyika bibaá¸anin khÄshiâin wa ilÄ laâimma rrÄshidÄ«na bifuâÄdin mutawÄá¸iâ.
segments.translation: O Allah, I draw near to You with a submissive heart, to Your guardian with a humble body, and to the rightlyguided Imams with a modest soul.

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي أَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَفِي قَبْضَتِكَ وَلَا رَبَّ لِي سِوَاكَ.
segments.transliteration: Wa ilÄ nnuqabÄâi lkirÄmi wa nnujabÄâi laghirrah.
segments.translation: And to the noble leaders and the distinguished chosen ones.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِقَلْبٍ خَاضِعٍ وَإِلَى وَلِيِّكَ بِبَدَنٍ خَاشِعٍ وَإِلَى الْأَئِمَّةِ الرَّاشِدِينَ بِفُؤَادٍ مُتَوَاضِعٍ
segments.transliteration: Bidhdhulli wa urghimu anfÄ« liman waá¸¥á¸¥adaka wa lÄ ilÄha ghayruka wa lÄ khÄliqa siwÄka.
segments.translation: With humility, I lower my nose in submission to the One who declares Your Oneness, for there is no deity besides You, nor creator other than You.

segments.transliteration: Wa uá¹£aghghiru khaddÄ« liawliyÄâika lmuqarrabÄ«n wa ufá¸Ä« âanka kulla á¸iddin wa nidd.
segments.translation: I humble my cheek before Your close allies and renounce every opposition or equal to You.

segments.arabic: بِالذُّلِّ وَأَرْغُمُ أَنْفِي لِمَنْ وَحَّدَكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ وَلَا خَالِقَ سِوَاكَ

segments.translation: For I am Your humble servant, acknowledging my sin.

segments.arabic: وَأُصَغِّرُ خَدِّي لِأَوْلِيَائِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَأَفْضِي عَنْكَ كُلَّ ضِدٍّ وَنِدٍّ
segments.transliteration: Asâaluka yÄ SayyidÄ« á¸¥aá¹­á¹­ahÄ âannÄ« wa takhlÄ«á¹£Ä« mina ladnÄsi wa larjÄs.
segments.translation: I ask You, O my Master, to remove it from me and purify me from filth and impurities.

segments.transliteration: IlÄhÄ« wa SayyidÄ« qad inqaá¹­aâtu âan dhawÄ« lqurbÄ wa istaghnaytu bika âan ahli ddunyÄ mutaâarriá¸an limaârÅ«fik.
segments.translation: My God and Master, I have cut off ties with relatives and found sufficiency in You over the people of the world, seeking Your favor.

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ يَا سَيِّدِي حَطَّهَا عَنِّي وَتَخْلِيصِي مِنَ الْأَدْنَاسِ وَالْأَرْجَاسِ.
segments.transliteration: Aâá¹­inÄ« min maârÅ«fika maârÅ«fan tughnÄ«nÄ« bihi âamman siwÄka.
segments.translation: Grant me from Your bounty a favor that makes me independent of all besides You.

segments.arabic: إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي قَدِ انْقَطَعْتُ عَنْ ذَوِي الْقُرْبَى وَاسْتَغْنَيْتُ بِكَ عَنْ أَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا مُتَعَرِّضاً لِمَعْرُوفِكَ
segments.transliteration: allahummaj-aâlnee akhshaaka hâattaa ka annee araaka wa as-iâdnee bi-taqwaaka wa laa tushqinee bi-ma-aâasâeeka wa khir lee fee qazâaaa-ika wa baarik lee fee qadrika hâattaa laa uhâibba taaâjeela maa akhkharta wa laa taakheera maa aâjjalta
segments.translation: O Allah make me submissive, till I surrender to Thee, make me happy by putting âfear of Godâ in my heart, Do not make me miserable on account of disobedience unto Thee. Write (prescribe) for me freedom from pain, trouble and anxiety, make ready for me blessings and happiness, so that what is last does not come in advance. Or what is urged to happen quickly is not delayed. Give me contentment and an independent disposition.

segments.arabic: أَعْطِنِي مِنْ مَعْرُوفِكَ مَعْرُوفاً تُغْنِينِي بِهِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ.
segments.transliteration: waj-aâl ghinaaya fee nafsee wa mattiaâ-nee bi-sam-eâe. wa basâaree waj-aâl humal waaritheena minnee wan sâurnee aâlaa man zâalamanee wa arinee feehi qudrataka yaa rabbi wa aqrir bidâaalika aâynee
segments.translation: Make me derive advantage from the power of hearing (listen to and accept advise and obey), And seeing (discernment, intelligence, and perception of truth); And both of them to my inheritors (children) Give me an upper hand over him who intimidates me, and treat me well through Thy might and power;

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ اجْعَلْني أخْشاكَ كأني أراكَ وَأسْعِدْني بِتَقْواكَ، وَلاتُشْقِني بِنَشْطي لِمَعاصيكَ وَخِرْ لي في قَضائِكَ وَبارِكْ لي في قَدَرِكَ حَتّى لا أحُبَّ تأخيرَ ما عَجّلْتَ وَلاتَعْجيلَ ماأخّرْتَ،
segments.transliteration: allahumma a-iânnee aâlaa hawli yawmil qiyaamah wa akhrijnee minad dunyaa saaliman wa adkhinil jannata aaminanâw wa zawwijnee minal hâooril eâeni wakfinee moo-natee wa moo-nata aâyaalee wa moo-natan naasi wa adkhilnee birahâmatika fee iâbaadikasâ sâaalihâeena
segments.translation: O Lord, and keep me in that exact state. O Allah! Attend to and take care of me in the frightening hours of the Day of Judgment. Make me leave this world in safe and sound condition, and enter the permanent land of bliss and beauty (Paradise) in peace and tranquility; And join the delightful charming people who have refined manners, intelligent minds and beautiful faces, multiply provisions allotted to me, and to my dependents, also promote welfare of the people and make me sit, through Thy mercy, in the company of Thy upright servants.

segments.translation: O Allah! If penalized (it means) I deserved punishment; if forgiven ( it is because) Thou art (the Most Merciful) Master. How would Thou punish?

segments.transliteration: yaa sayyidee wa hâubbuka fee qalbee amaa wa iâzzatika la-in fa-aâlta dâaalika bee li-najma-uânna baynee wa bayna qawmin tâaala maa aâadaytuhum feeka
segments.translation: Â O My Master! My heart is full of Thy Love, undoubtedly, and Thy absolute authority, very kindly, take notice of that, and keep us together with people who are given respite. How much less attention they may pay to Thy commands

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ إنْ تُعَذِّبْني فَأهْلٌ لِذلِكَ أنا وَإنْ تَغْفِرْ لي فأهْلٌ لِذلك أنْتَ ، وكيف تعذبني

segments.translation: O Allah! For the sake of Thy pure and pious friends, peace be upon them, make us preserve true traditions of the Holy Prophet (S.A), And come up to the confidence put in us, to keep safe and watch over the âbackboneâ of Thy religion (adoration and worship of Allah).

segments.arabic: يَا سَيِّدِي وَ حُبُّكَ فِي قَلْبِي ، أَمَا وَ عِزَّتِكَ لَئِنْ فَعَلْتَ لَتَجْمَعَنَّ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَ قَوْمٍ طَالَمَا عَادَيْتُهُمْ فِيْكَ
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innaa ahâaqqu khalqika an taf-aâla aâaalika binaa allaahummaf aâlhu binaa birahâmatika
segments.translation: O Allah! Truly, we are the worthiest among thy creation, treat us in that context. O Allah! Treat us mercifully.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِحَقِّ أَوْلِيَائِكَ الطَّاهِرِينَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا صِدْقَ الْحَدِيثِ، وَأَدَاءَ الْأَمَانَةِ، وَالْمُحَافَظَةَ عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma arfaaâzâannee ilayka sâaa-iâdan wa laa tatâma-inna fiyya aâduwwan wa laa hâaasidan wahâfazânee qaaa-iman wa qaa-iâdan wa yaqtâanna wa raaqidan
segments.translation: O Allah! Make my knowledge about thee of the highest quality. Do not let me drown myself in hatred, nor feel resentful; keep me steadfast, within bounds, obedient, enduring.

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ إنَّا أحَقُّ خَلْقِكَ أنْ تَفْعَلَهُ بِنا، اللّهُمَّ افْعَلْهُ بِنا برحمتك
segments.transliteration: allaahummaghfir lee warhâamnee wahdinee sabeelakal aqwamu wa qinee hâarra jahannama wa hâareeqal muzârami wahâtâutâ aânnil maghrama wal maa-thuma waj-aâlnee min khiyaaril aâalami
segments.translation: O Allah forgive me, have mercy on me, make me strive in Thy way honestly, free me from the heat of burning Hell, from being consumed by the blazing fire, make less what I have to pay back, and punishment I deserve, make me be one of the choicest people for all times.

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ ارْفَعْ ظَنّي صاعِداً وَلا تُطْمِعْ فِيَّ عَدوّا وَلا حاسِداً وَأحْفَظْنِي قائِما وَقاعِداً وَيَقْظانَ وَراقِداً،
segments.transliteration: allaahumma arhâamnee mimmaa laa tâaaqai lee bihee wa laa sâabra lee aâlayhi bi-rahâmatika yaa arhâamar raahâimeen allaahumma sâalli aâlaa muhâammadinâw wa aali muhâammad.
segments.translation: Â O Allah! Have mercy on me because have not the strength, nor patience to withstand it (punishment), Through Thy mercy, O the Most Merciful. Â O Allah send blessings on Muhammad and on the children of Muhammad.

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ إغْفِرْ لي وَارْحَمْني وَاهْدِني سَبيلَكَ الاقْوَمُ وَقِني حَرَّ جَهَنَّمَ وَ احْطِطْ عَنّي المَغْرَمَ وَالمَأثَمَ وَاجْعَلْني مِنْ خيارِ العالَمِ.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

segments.arabic: إرْحَمْنِي مِمَّا لَا طَاقَةَ لِي بِهِ وَلَا صَبْرَ لِي عَلَيْهِ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ بَيْتِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ.
segments.transliteration: YÄ Man Yará¸¥am Man LÄ Yará¸¥amuhu al-âIbÄd
segments.translation: O He Who shows mercy to those whom the servants do not show mercy,

segments.transliteration: Wa YÄ Man Yaqbal Man LÄ Taqbaluhu al-BilÄd
segments.translation: O He Who accepts those whom the lands do not accept,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَرْحَمُ مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُهُ الْعِبَادُ
segments.transliteration: Wa YÄ Man LÄ Yaá¸¥taqir Ahl al-á¸¤Äjah ilayh
segments.translation: O He Who does not despise those in need of Him,

segments.translation: O He Who does not disappoint those who persist in asking Him,

segments.translation: O He Who does not respond with rejection to those who depend on Him,

segments.transliteration: Wa YÄ Man YajtabÄ« á¹¢aghÄ«r MÄ Yutá¸¥af bih
segments.translation: O He Who accepts the little that is offered to Him,

segments.transliteration: Wa Yashkur YasÄ«r MÄ Yuâmal lah
segments.translation: And appreciates the small deeds done for Him,

segments.translation: O He Who calls to Himself those who turn away from Him,

segments.transliteration: Wa YÄ Man LÄ Yughayyir al-Niâmah
segments.translation: O He Who does not change the blessings,

segments.translation: And does not hasten to punish,

segments.translation: O He Who makes the good deed grow until He completes it,

segments.translation: And forgives the bad deed until He removes it,

segments.translation: Hopes have turned away before reaching the extent of Your generosity,
With needs, and the containers of requests have been filled with the abundance of Your generosity,

segments.translation: So You have the highest loftiness above all that is high,

segments.arabic: أَوْعِيَةُ الطَّلِبَاتِ، وَتَفَسَّخَتْ دُونَ بُلُوغِ نَعْتِكَ
segments.translation: And the most glorious majesty above all that is majestic,

segments.translation: And every honorable thing beside Your honor is insignificant.
Those who approach anyone other than You are disappointed,

segments.translation: And those who expose themselves except to You are losers,
And those who seek assistance except by You are lost,

segments.translation: And those who seek pastures except for Your bounty are barren.
Your door is open for those who desire,

segments.arabic: وَأَجْدَبَ الْمُنْتَجِعُونَ إِلَّا مَنِ انْتَجَعَ فَضْلَكَ
segments.translation: And Your generosity is available to the seekers,
And Your help is near to those who cry out for it.
Those who hope in You are not disappointed,
And those who expose themselves to Your gifts do not despair,
And those who seek Your forgiveness are not afflicted by Your punishment.
Your provision is extended to those who disobey You,
And Your forbearance is offered to those who oppose You,
Your habit is to be kind to those who do wrong,
And Your way is to preserve those who transgress,
Until Your patience has deceived them,

segments.transliteration: âan al-RujÅ«â, wa-á¹¢addahum ImhÄluka âan al-NuzÅ«â
segments.translation: From returning, and Your delay has prevented them from repenting.
You only delayed them so that they might return,

segments.arabic: عَنِ الرُّجُوعِ، وَصَدَّهُمْ إِمْهَالُكَ عَنِ النُّزُوعِ
segments.transliteration: ilÄ Amrik, wa-Amhaltahum Thiqatan bi-DawÄm Mulkik
segments.translation: To Your command, and You gave them respite trusting in the permanence of Your dominion.

segments.translation: So, whoever is among the people of happiness, You have sealed it for him,

segments.transliteration: wa-Man KÄn Min Ahl al-ShaqÄwah Khadhaltahu LahÄ
segments.translation: And whoever is among the people of misery, You have forsaken him to it.

segments.translation: All of them are returning to Your judgment,

segments.translation: And their affairs will return to Your command.

segments.translation: Your authority has not weakened over the length of their duration,
And Your proof has not been invalidated by Your delay in punishing them.

segments.arabic: لَمْ يَهِنْ عَلَى طُولِ مُدَّتِهِمْ سُلْطَانُكَ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤ujjatuka QÄâimah LÄ Tudá¸¥aá¸, wa-Sulá¹­Änuka ThÄbit
segments.translation: Your argument is established and cannot be invalidated, and Your authority is firm,

segments.transliteration: LÄ YazÅ«l, Fa-al-Wayl al-DÄâim li-Man Janaá¸¥ âank
segments.translation: It does not waver, so the eternal woe is for those who deviate from You,

segments.arabic: حُجَّتُكَ قَائِمَةٌ لَا تُدْحَضُ، وَسُلْطَانُكَ ثَابِتٌ
segments.translation: And the disgrace that ruins for those who lose hope in You,

segments.arabic: لَا يَزُولُ، فَالْوَيْلُ الدَّائِمُ لِمَنْ جَنَحَ عَنْكَ
segments.translation: And the most severe misery for those who are deluded by You.
How much he will wander in Your punishment,
And how long he will hesitate in Your retribution,
And how far his end is from relief,
And how hopeless he is of an easy way out.

segments.translation: It is justice from Your judgment that is not unjust,

segments.translation: And fairness from Your rule that is not biased against him.

segments.arabic: عَدْلًا مِنْ قَضَائِكَ لَا تَجُورُ فِيهِ
segments.translation: You have made the arguments clear, and exhausted the excuses,

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ تَقَدَّمْتَ بِالْوَعِيدِ، وَتَلَطَّفْتَ فِي التَّرْغِيبِ
segments.translation: And You have delayed while being capable of hastening,
And You have been patient while being able to act promptly.
Your patience is not out of weakness,
Nor is Your delay out of helplessness,
Nor is Your withholding out of neglect,
Nor is Your waiting out of pretense,
But so that Your argument may be more complete,
And Your generosity more perfect,
And Your beneficence more abundant,
And Your blessings more complete.
All of that was and has not ceased to be,

segments.translation: From praising You, and my restraint has hindered me,

segments.arabic: عَلَى أَقَلِّهِ، وَقَدْ قَصَّرَ بِيَ السُّكُوتُ

So bless Muhammad and his family,
And hear my whispers, and answer my supplication,
And do not seal my day with disappointment,
And do not confront me with rejection in my request,
And honor my departure from You,

The Most High, the Most Great.

segments.translation: In the name of Allah and by Allah,
I have taken the first,
And I have taken the last,
And I have taken those standing,
And I have taken those sitting,

And Allah, the King, the Compeller, raises me,

God of the heavens and the earth,
To You, Allah, I call,
God of the near angels,
To You, Allah, I call,
God of all creation,

God of the sun and the moon,

God of the East and the West,

And make my matters first in righteousness,

segments.arabic: أَدِمْ مَا أَنَا فِيهِ مِنْ نِعْمَتِكَ وَ عَافِيَتِكَ،
segments.translation: And last in success,
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi fi ardihi
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O argument of Allah in His lands!
Peace be upon you, O sight of Allah on His creatures!

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِي أَرْضِهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O light of Allah

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ فِي خَلْقِهِ
segments.translation: by which those who have been guided [to the true guidance] are guided
and by which the believers are relieved!
Peace be upon you, O polite and fearful!
Peace be upon you, O sincere patron!
Peace be upon you, O ark of salvation!
Peace be upon you, O essence of life!
Peace be upon you.
May Allah send blessings to you
and upon your Household,
the pure and immaculate.
Peace be upon you.
May Allah hasten that which He has promised you;
namely, victory and prevalence of your authority.
Peace be upon you, O my master.
I am a servant of you
and I recognize the first and the last of your affair.

segments.transliteration: ataqarrabu ila allahi ta`ala bika wa bi-ali baytika
segments.translation: I seek nearness to Allah, the Exalted, through your Household and you

segments.transliteration: wa antaziru zuhuraka wa zuhura alhaqqi `ala yadayka
segments.translation: and I am expecting your advent and the prevalence of the truth at your hands.

segments.arabic: أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ بِكَ وَبِآلِ بَيْتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa as'alu allaha an yusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: And I beseech Allah to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَظِرُ ظُهُورَكَ وَظُهُورَ ٱلْحَقِّ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa an yaj`alani mina almuntazirina laka
segments.translation: and to include me with those who are expecting you,

segments.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُ ٱللَّهَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: those who follow you and support you against your enemies,

segments.transliteration: walmustash-hadina bayna yadayka fi jumlati awliya'ika
segments.translation: and those who will be martyred in front of you in the group of your loyalists.
O my master, O Patron of the Age!

segments.arabic: وَٱلْمُسْتَشْهَدِينَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ فِي جُمْلَةِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
segments.translation: May Allahâs blessings be upon you
and upon your Household.
Today is Friday,

segments.transliteration: wa huwa yawmuka almutawaqqa`u fihi zuhuruka
segments.translation: which is your day on which your advent is expected
to bring about relief to the believers at your hands,
and killing of the disbelievers with your sword.

segments.transliteration: wa ana ya mawlaya fihi dayfuka wa jaruka
segments.translation: On this day, O my master, I am your guest and in your vicinity

segments.transliteration: wa anta ya mawlaya karimun min awladi alkirami
segments.translation: and you, my master, are generous and the descendant of the generous people,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا يَا مَوْلاَيَ فِيهِ ضَيْفُكَ وَجَارُكَ
segments.translation: and you are commanded to receive your guests and neighbors hospitably;

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ كَرِيمٌ مِنْ أَوْلاَدِ ٱلْكِرَامِ
segments.translation: so, receive me as your guest and neighbor.
May Allahâs blessings be upon you
and upon your Household, the immaculate.
"I am your visitor wherever my mount turns.. and I am your guest whicheverÂ placeÂ IÂ mayÂ be"
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent and Merciful.

segments.arabic: نَزِيْلُكَ حَيْثُ مَا اتَّجَهَتْ رِكَابِيْ وَ ضَيْفُكَ حَيْثُ كُنْتُ مِنَ الْبِلَادِ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who has dressed with grandeur and owned it!

segments.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi lam yattakhidh waladan
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who has deigned and condescended with grandeur!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْعِزَّ وَ فَازَ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu sharikun fi almulki
segments.translation: Glory be to Him save Whom none is worthy of being glorified!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ تَعَطَّفَ بِالْمَجْدِ وَ تَكَرَّمَ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu waliyyun mina aldhdhulli
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Whose knowledge has counted all things!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يَنْبَغِي التَّسْبِيحُ إِلَّا لَهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to The endurance and The Most gracious!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ أَحْصَى كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ بِعِلْمِهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to You Who holds all abundance and bounties!
Glory be to the Powerful and Generous!
O Allah, I beseech You in the name of the objects of dignity in Your Throne,
in the name of the utmost mercy in Your Book,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَعَاقِدِ الْعِزِّ مِنْ عَرْشِكَ
segments.translation: and in the name of Your Greatest Name, Your highest remembrance,
and Your Accomplished Words.

segments.arabic: وَ بِاسْمِكَ الْأَعْظَمِ وَ ذِكْرِكَ الْأَعْلَى
segments.translation: And Your words became perfected in truth and justice.
None can change Thy words;

segments.arabic: وَ تَمَّتْ كَلِمَاتُكَ‏ صِدْقاً وَ عَدْلًا
segments.translation: indeed You are The noble and wise!
O, The Possessor of Majesty and Grace;
I beseech you in the name of The requests that are made to you which nothing can match it,
To bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا لَا يَعْدِلُهُ شَيْ‏ءٌ مِنْ مَسَائِلِكَ
segments.translation: and make for my relief and exit regarding my affair,

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and is possible for me enough means of livelihood with easiness and good health from you!

segments.arabic: وَ تَجْعَلَ لِي مِنْ أَمْرِي فَرَجاً وَ مَخْرَجاً
segments.translation: Glory be to the Living, the Self-Subsistent, and the most Forbearing!

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تُوَسِّعَ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِي فِي يُسْرٍ مِنْكَ وَ عَافِيَةٍ
segments.translation: Glory be to The wise and Noble!
Glory be to the awakener and Successor!
Glory be to Allah the Most High and the Incomparably Great!
Glory be to Him, and (all) the praise be to Him!
O Allah, Send Blessings upon Muhammed and the household Of Muhammed;
as You bestowed blessings, increase, and mercy upon Ibrahim

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and the progeny of Ibrahim, indeed You are the praised and the glorious!

segments.arabic: كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَ بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

segments.arabic: وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin wa `ajjil farajahum
segments.translation: There is no might nor power except with Allah, the Highest, the Mighty;
Allah, the Lord of the angels, Spirits, Prophets, and Messengers,

segments.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation: Subduer of those in the heavens and earth,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَ الرُّوحِ وَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
segments.translation: Creator of all things, and their King.

segments.arabic: وَ قَاهِرَ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرَضِينَ
segments.translation: Protect me from our enemies' might, whether human or Jinn,

segments.arabic: وَ خَالِقَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ مَالِكَهُ
segments.translation: blind their sight and hearts,

segments.arabic: كُفَّ عَنَّا بَأْسَ أَعْدَائِنَا وَ مَنْ أَرَادَ بِنَا سُؤاً مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْإِنْسِ
segments.translation: and make between them and us a guard, a barrier, and a defense.

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin wa `ajjil farajahum
segments.translation: Surely You are the defenser Lord. There is no might nor power except with You.

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَهُمْ حِجَاباً وَ حَرَساً وَ مَدْفَعاً
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: In You we trust; to You, we turn.

segments.arabic: إِنَّكَ رَبُّنَا لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ لَنَا إِلَّا بِاللهِ عَلَيْهِ
segments.translation: You are the Mighty, the Wise.
Therefore, protect us from the evil of every creature
You have taken by the forelock,

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا عَافِنَا مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ سُوؤٍ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ
segments.translation: the evil of what inhabits the night and day,
and evil of every evil thing.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ ما سَكَنَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهارِ
segments.translation: May it be so, O Lord of the Worlds, and bless Muhammad, the Prophet of mercy, and his pure family

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ [شَرِّ] كُلِّ سُوؤٍ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ
segments.translation: and companions, especially Muhammed and his family.

segments.arabic: رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ وَ إِلَهَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
segments.translation: And there is no strength or power, except for Allah, the high and the mighty.

segments.arabic: وَ أَوْلِيَائِكَ وَ خُصَّ مُحَمَّداً وَ آلَهُ بِأَتَمِّ ذَلِكَ
segments.translation: In the name of Allah; by Allah, I believe; by Allah, I seek protection;

segments.arabic: وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation: by Allah, hold fast; by Allah, I seek sanctuary.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَ بِاللهِ أُومِنُ وَ بِاللهِ أَعُوذُ وَ بِاللهِ
segments.translation: I repel against Satan of humans and Jinn,

segments.arabic: أَعْتَصِمُ وَ بِاللهِ أَسْتَجِيرُ وَ بِعِزَّةِ اللهِ
segments.translation: from their walkers; riders, runners, sympathy,

segments.arabic: وَ مَنَعَتِهِ أَمْتَنِعُ مِنْ شَيَاطِينِ الْإِنْسِ وَ الْجِنِّ
segments.translation: return, deceit, and evil by Allah's might and defense.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ رَجِلِهِمْ وَ خَيْلِهِمْ وَ رَكْضِهِمْ وَ عَطْفِهِمْ
segments.translation: And the evil of what they bring beneath the night and day,

segments.arabic: وَ رَجْعَتِهِمْ وَ كَيْدِهِمْ وَ شَرِّهِمْ وَ شَرِّ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: whether far or close.

segments.arabic: مَا يَأْتُونَ بِهِ تَحْتَ اللَّيْلِ وَ تَحْتَ النَّهَارِ
segments.translation: And the evil of the absentee, presented,
witness, and visitor, whether alive and dead; endowed with eyesight and blind.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ الْغَائِبِ وَ الْحَاضِرِ
segments.translation: And the evil of the general and special, and self's tempting!

segments.arabic: وَ الشَّاهِدِ وَ الزَّائِرِ أَحْيَاءً وَ أَمْوَاتاً أَعْمَى وَ بَصِيراً
segments.translation: And the evil of Al-Dinahesh (kind of Jinn), faint nose, taction,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ الْعَامَّةِ وَ الْخَاصَّةِ وَ مَنْ نَفْسٍ وَ وَسْوَسَتِهَا
segments.translation: possess of Jinn and humans.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ الدَّنَاهِشِ وَ الْحِسِّ وَ اللَّمْسِ
segments.translation: And by the name of this particular name which Balqees' throne shook.

segments.arabic: وَ وَ اللَّبْسِ وَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْإِنْسِ
segments.translation: And, I seek refuge for myself, religion, and everything that is surrounded by my consideration

segments.arabic: وَ بِالْاِسْمِ الَّذِي اهْتَزَّ لَهُ عَرْشُ بِلْقِيسَ
segments.translation: from the evil of every picture and imagination,

segments.arabic: وَ أُعِيذُ نَفْسِي وَ دِينِي وَ جَمِيعَ مَا تُحِيطُهُ [تَحُوطُهُ‏] عِنَايَتِي
segments.translation: or whiteness, blackness, sculpture, alley or not.

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ صُورَةٍ وَ خِيَالٍ
segments.translation: From who reside in the air, clouds,

segments.arabic: أَوْ بَيَاضٍ أَوْ سَوَادٍ أَوْ تِمْثَالٍ أَوْ مُعَاهَدٍ أَوْ غَيْرِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa alihi fi al-awwalina
segments.translation: darknesses, lights, shadows, heat,

segments.arabic: مُعَاهَدٍ مِمَّنْ يَسْكُنُ الْهَوَاءَ وَ السَّحَابَ
segments.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin wa alihi fi al-akhirina
segments.translation: land, seas, plains, rough roads,

segments.arabic: وَ الظُّلُمَاتِ وَ النُّورَ وَ الظِّلَّ وَ الْحَرُورَ
segments.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin wa alihi fi almala'i al-a`la
segments.translation: ruins, civilization, hillocks, bushes,

segments.arabic: وَ الْبَرَّ وَ الْبُحُورَ وَ السَّهْلَ وَ الْوُعُورَ
segments.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin wa alihi fi almursalina
segments.translation: jungles, churches, sarcophaguses,

segments.arabic: وَ الْخَرَابَ وَ الْعُمْرَانَ وَ الْآكَامَ وَ الْآجَامَ
segments.translation: wilderness, and Cemeteries.

segments.arabic: وَ الْمَغَايِضَ وَ الْكَنَائِسَ وَ النَّوَاوِيسَ
segments.translation: The coming and going from who appears
in the night and spreads in the day;

segments.arabic: مِنَ الصَّادِرِينَ وَ الْوَارِدِينَ مِمَّنْ يَبْدُو
segments.translation: in the early hours of night and morning, in the morning and the evening hours,
and the; suspicious, conversationalists, devils, tyrants,

segments.arabic: وَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَ الْإِبْكَارِ وَ الْغُدُوِّ وَ الْآصَالِ
segments.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa lam arahu
segments.translation: and satans, and from their; soldiers, partners,

segments.arabic: وَ الْمُرِيبِينَ وَ الْأَسَامِرَةِ وَ الْأَفَاتِرَةِ وَ الْفَرَاعِنَةِ
segments.translation: clans, and tribes, and from their; backbiting, slandering,

segments.arabic: وَ الْأَبَالِسَةِ وَ مِنْ جُنُودِهِمْ وَ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ
segments.translation: the defamed poem (puffing up), plotting, taking,

segments.arabic: وَ عَشَائِرِهِمْ وَ قَبَائِلِهِمْ وَ مِنْ هَمْزِهِمْ وَ لَمْزِهِمْ
segments.translation: magic, hitting, existing, (playing),

segments.arabic: وَ نَفْثِهِمْ [وَ نَفْخِهِمْ‏] وَ وِقَاعِهِمْ وَ أَخْذِهِمْ
segments.translation: hinting, deceiving, and morals.
And against the evil of all; the magicians, monsters,

segments.arabic: وَ لَمْحِهِمْ وَ احْتِيَالِهِمْ وَ أَخْلَاقِهِمْ
segments.translation: Um Al-Sibiaan evil and what they gave birth to and came out of them.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ مِنَ السَّحَرَةِ وَ الْغِيلَانِ
segments.translation: And against the evil of all that is; coming in and going out,

segments.arabic: وَ أُمِّ الصِّبْيَانِ وَ مَا وَلَدُوا وَ مَا وَرَدُوا
segments.translation: clashing and exposed, quiet and moving,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ دَاخِلٍ وَ خَارِجٍ
segments.translation: veins throbbing, headache, migraine, (Um-Muldim),

segments.arabic: وَ عَارِضٍ وَ مُتَعَرِّضٍ وَ سَاكِنٍ وَ مُتَحَرِّكٍ
segments.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa lam arahu
segments.translation: fever, triple (days of fever), quartan fever, every other day fever, shivering fever,

segments.arabic: وَ ضَرَبَانِ عِرْقٍ وَ صُدَاعٍ وَ شَقِيقَةٍ وَ أُمِّ مِلْدَمٍ
segments.translation: stiffing fever and coming in and going out evil.

segments.arabic: وَ الْحُمَّى وَ الْمُثَلَّثَةِ وَ الرِّبْعِ وَ الْغِبِّ وَ النَّافِضَةِ
segments.translation: And the evil of "every crawling creature that You has taken by the forelock!

segments.arabic: وَ الصَّالِبَةِ وَ الدَّاخِلَةِ وَ الْخَارِجَةِ
segments.translation: Surely You are on a straight path

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ‏ آخِذٌ بِناصِيَتِها
segments.translation: and send Allah your enormous blessings upon Muhammad and his Household,
and give them abundant peace!

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدِ
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah.

segments.transliteration: wa la ilaha illa allahu wallahu akbaru
segments.translation: Allah is the Most Great.

segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah.

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: All praise be to Allah Who has not taken to Himself a son
nor has He had any partner in sovereignty

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَداً
segments.translation: nor does He need any to protect Him from humiliation,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي ٱلْمُلْكِ
segments.translation: and magnify Him for His greatness and glory.

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ
segments.translation: O Conferrer of boon amply!
O Repeller of troubles!
O Maker of souls!
O Sublime in determinations!
O Coverer [of daylight] with darkness!
O Lord of magnanimity and nobility!
O Remover of harm and pains!
O Entertainer of those lonely in darkness!
O All-knowing Who never needs teaching!
(Please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and do to me all that which befits You.
O He Whose Name is remedy,
the remembrance of Whom is cure,
and the obedience to Whom is sufficiency,
(please) have mercy upon him whose wealth is only hope [for You]
and whose weapon is only weeping.
Glory be to You. There is no god save You.
O All-tender, O All-Bestower,
O Fashioner of the heavens and the earth,
O Lord of majesty and honor.
O Allah, (please do) let Your blessings
and the blessings of Your angels and Messengers
be on Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and hasten their Relief.
O Allah, include me with the inhabitants of Paradise

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ
segments.translation: whose stuffing is blessing
and whose constructors are the angels
with our Prophet Muhammad,
peace of Allah be upon him and his Household,
and our father Abraham, peace be upon him.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and hasten their Relief.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammadâ

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمُّ صَلّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ
segments.translation: the Successors and the pleasedâ

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: with the best of Your blessings,
and confer upon them
with the best of your favors.
And peace be upon them
and upon their souls and bodies;
and Allahâs mercy and blessings be upon them.
The blessings of Allah, His angels,
His prophets, His messengers,
and all of His creatures
be upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
And peace be upon him and upon them
and upon their souls and bodies.
So be Allahâs mercy and blessings.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
the Successors and the pleased

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: with the best of Your blessings,
and confer upon them
with the best of your favors.
And peace be upon him and them
and Allahâs mercy and blessings be also upon them.
I pray the forgiveness of Allah and I repent before Him.
O Allah, O He Who is the most magnanimous of all those who may grant!
O He Who is the best of all those who are asked!
O He Who is the most Merciful of all those whose mercy may be sought!
O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and his Household among the foremost generations,
send blessings to Muhammad and his Household among the last generations,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ فِي ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
segments.translation: send blessings to Muhammad and his Household among the Highest Chiefs,

segments.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
segments.translation: and send blessings to Muhammad and his Household among the Messengers.

segments.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ فِي ٱلْمَلأِ ٱلأَعْلَىٰ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) grant Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ فِي ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
segments.translation: the right of mediation, preference,
honor, loftiness,
and the grand rank.
O Allah, I believed in Muhammad,
may Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household, while I have not seen him;
so, do not deprive me of seeing him on the Resurrection Day,

segments.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ
segments.translation: confer upon me with the favor of accompanying him,
cause me to die while I follow his creed,
and allow me to drink from his Pool
a drink that is quenching,
palatable, and pleasant,
after which I will never be thirsty.
Verily, You have power over all things.
O Allah, I believe in Muhammad,
may Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household, while I have not seen him;
so, (please) show me his face in the gardens of Paradise.

segments.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ
segments.translation: O Allah, convey to Muhammad,
may Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household,
many greetings and compliments from me.
I implore for Allahâs forgiveness.
All glory be to Allah all praise be to Allah;;
there is no god save Allah;Allah is the Greatest;
and there is no power and no might save with Allah, the All-high, the All-Great.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ اكْبَرُ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation: All glory be to Allah and with the Praising o

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Glory be to You! There is no god save You!
O All-tender! O All-bestower!
O Fashioner of the heavens and the earth!
of Majesty and Honor.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
Glory be to You, O Allah, our God, (and for You is the praise!) To You be all praise;
You the Ever-living, Self-Subsisting,

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا [وَ بِحَمْدِكَ‏] وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ
segments.translation: The first existing; none was creating you,
or any of your possessions were seen

segments.arabic: الْأَوَّلُ الْكَائِنُ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ شَيْ‏ءٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: or contemplated in any of your matters or accomplishment.
Sitting on your throne, standing by your justice, controller of your affairs.

segments.arabic: أَوْ يُتَدَبَّرْ فِي شَيْ‏ءٍ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ أَوْ يُتَفَكَّرْ فِي شَيْ‏ءٍ
segments.translation: Your destiny has been applied to what happened,

segments.arabic: مِنْ قَضَائِكَ قَائِمٌ بِقِسْطِكَ مُدَبِّرٌ لِأَمْرِكَ
segments.translation: and your knowledge has been applied to what you created.

segments.arabic: قَدْ جَرَى فِيمَا هُوَ كَائِنٌ قَدَرُكَ
segments.translation: You created the heavens and earth as a spreading and covering!

segments.arabic: وَ مَضَى فِيمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقٌ عِلْمُكَ
segments.translation: Furthermore, you made the heavens accepted home to your majesty,

segments.arabic: خَلَقْتَ السَّمَاوَاتِ‏ وَ الْأَرْضَ فِرَاشاً وَ بِنَاءً
segments.translation: solemnity, superiority, and supremacy.
Therefore, you maintained your chair and throne in it,

segments.arabic: وَ وَقَارِكَ وَ عِزَّتِكَ وَ سُلْطَانِكَ
segments.translation: lived in it without anything except You;

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْتَ فِيهَا كُرْسِيَّكَ وَ عَرْشَكَ
segments.translation: proud in your greatness; significant in your pride;

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ سَكَنْتَهَا لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَيْ‏ءٌ غَيْرُكَ
segments.translation: the only one in your highness; capable of your kingdom;

segments.arabic: مُتَكَبِّراً فِي عَظَمَتِكَ مُتَعَظِّماً فِي كِبْرِيَائِكَ
segments.translation: exalting in your authority; veiling yourself by your knowledge,

segments.arabic: مُتَوَحِّداً فِي عُلُوِّكَ مُتَمَكِّناً فِي مُلْكِكَ
segments.translation: sitting on your throne.

segments.arabic: مُتَعَالِياً فِي سُلْطَانِكَ مُحْتَجِباً فِي عِلْمِكَ
segments.translation: Therefore, blessed are You and high exalted!
Up there, your; glory, light, might, omnipotence,
authority, solidity, power, mercy,

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَا هُنَاكَ بَهَاؤُكَ وَ نُورُكَ وَ عِزَّتُكَ وَ قُدْرَتُكَ
segments.translation: holiness, command, apprehension strengthening distinguished,

segments.arabic: وَ سُلْطَانُكَ وَ حَوْلُكَ وَ قُوَّتُكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ
segments.translation: splendid enormousness and great mightiness are soaring.

segments.arabic: وَ قُدْسُكَ وَ أَمْرُكَ وَ مَخَافَتُكَ وَ تَمْكِينُكَ الْمَكِينُ
segments.translation: You Allah the Ever-Living who was there before anything else,

segments.arabic: وَ كِبْرُكَ الْكَبِيرُ وَ عَظَمَتُكَ الْعَظِيمَةُ
segments.translation: the Sempiternal before any eternal,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْتَ اللهُ الْحَيُّ قَبْلَ كُلِّ حَيٍّ
segments.translation: The king with the great kingdom,
the praised praiseworthy name in heavens, earth,
its; creator, light, God, and Allah and what's in them.

segments.arabic: الْمُمْتَدَحُ الْمُمُدَحُ اسْمُكَ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ
segments.translation: Glory and praise be to You, Allah and Your Praise-worthiness is Most Exalted.

segments.arabic: وَ خَالِقُهُنَّ وَ نُورُهُنَّ وَ رَبُّهُنَّ وَ إِلَهُهُنَّ وَ مَا فِيهِنَّ
segments.translation: God, bless Muhammad, Your slave, messenger, prophet,

segments.arabic: فَسُبْحَانَكَ وَ بِحَمْدِكَ رَبَّنَا وَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ
segments.translation: and reward him by; the best he did of, an evil he dispels, simplicity he accomplished,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُولِكَ وَ نَبِيِّكَ
segments.translation: strengthing of a weaker, sheltering an orphan, having mercy upon paupers,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْزِهِ بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَبْلَاهُ وَ شَرٍّ جَلَاهُ وَ يُسْرٍ أَتَاهُ
segments.translation: the teaching of the ignorant, enlightening a pious

segments.arabic: وَ ضَعِيفٍ قَوَّاهُ وَ يَتِيمٍ آوَاهُ وَ مِسْكِينٍ رَحِمَهُ
segments.translation: and truth he helped with the; fullest repayment,highest helping friend

segments.arabic: وَ جَاهِلٍ عَلَّمَهُ وَ دِينٍ بَصَّرَهُ
segments.translation: rewarded intercession and a raised home in heaven close by you; may it be so, Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: وَ حَقٍّ نَصَرَهُ الْجَزَاءَ الْأَوْفَى وَ الرَّفِيقَ الْأَعْلَى
segments.translation: Make; an envied home for him, a high seated position,

segments.arabic: وَ الشَّفَاعَةَ الْجَائِزَةَ وَ الْمَنْزِلَ الرَّفِيعَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ عِنْدَكَ آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
segments.translation: shadowy shade, enormous graceful lofty

segments.arabic: اجْعَلْ لَهُ مَنْزِلًا مَغْبُوطاً وَ مَجْلِساً رَفِيعاً
segments.translation: and gazing upon Your face when you hinder it from the criminals.

segments.arabic: وَ ظِلًّا ظَلِيلًا وَ مُرْتَفِعاً جَسِيماً جَمِيلًا
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

segments.arabic: وَ نَظَراً إِلَى وَجْهِكَ يَوْمَ تَحْجُبُهُ عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
segments.translation: Make him for us; a precede, his pool our reach,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and his meeting a promise that our first and last be cheerful about,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطاً وَ اجْعَلْ حَوْضَهُ لَنَا مَوْرِداً
segments.translation: while You are satisfied with us in Your home; the abode of Islam,

segments.arabic: وَ لِقَاءَهُ لَنَا مَوْعِداً يَسْتَبْشِرُ بِهِ أَوَّلُنَا وَ آخِرُنَا
segments.translation: heavens; the Gardens of Delight

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْتَ عَنَّا رَاضٍ فِي دَارِكَ دَارِ السَّلَامِ
segments.translation: may it be so, Allah of Truth, Lord of the worlds.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
I beseech You in Your name, which is a light from light, and light upon every light.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: And the light which illuminates every darkness,

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي هُوَ نُورٌ مِنْ نُورٍ وَ نُورٌ فَوْقَ كُلِّ نُورٍ
segments.translation: and You break with it the disobedient, obstinate tyrant, and prepared Jinn Satan (devil) power.

segments.arabic: وَ نُورٌ تُضِي‏ءُ بِهِ كُلَّ ظُلْمَةٍ
segments.translation: And secure the fear of every frightened.

segments.arabic: وَ تَكْسِرُ بِهِ قُوَّةَ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ وَ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ وَ جِنِّيٍّ عَتِيدٍ
segments.translation: And inactive every magic of a magician and the evil of all those who are jealous!

segments.arabic: وَ تُؤْمِنُ بِهِ خَوْفَ كُلِّ خَائِفٍ
segments.translation: His greatness is beseeched by every faithful and libertine.

segments.arabic: وَ تُبْطِلُ بِهِ سِحْرَ كُلِّ سَاحِرٍ  وَ حَسَدَ كُلِّ حَاسِدٍ
segments.translation: And (I beseech ) by your great name that; You named Yourself with,

segments.arabic: وَ يَتَضَرَّعُ لِعَظَمَتِهِ الْبَرُّ وَ الْفَاجِرُ
segments.translation: the throne You established Yourself on

segments.arabic: وَ بِاسْمِكَ الْأَكْبَرِ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ
segments.translation: and Your chair that You sat firmly on
to send the blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
Do open before me (the door) this night,

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O, Lord of every goodness door You opened before anyone of Your creatures,
Your intimate servants, and those who obey You.

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ بَابَ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ فَتَحْتَهُ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: Then do not ever close it before me;
until I meet You while You are satisfied with me.
I ask You for that by Your mercy and by Your ability, wishing for Your help in this request.

segments.arabic: حَتَّى أَلْقَاكَ وَ أَنْتَ عَنِّي رَاضٍ
segments.translation: Therefore, My Lord mediate for me tonight my desire; settle my need,

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ ذَلِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَ أَرْغَبُ إِلَيْكَ فِيهِ بِقُدْرَتِكَ
segments.translation: relieve my distress, mercy upon my weeping,

segments.arabic: فَشَفِّعِ اللَّيْلَةَ يَا رَبِّ رَغْبَتِي وَ أَكْرِمْ طَلِبَتِي
segments.translation: associate my loneliness, divert my soleness,

segments.arabic: وَ نَفِّسْ كُرْبَتِي وَ ارْحَمْ عَبْرَتِي
segments.translation: hide my faults, calm my fear, settle my neediness,

segments.arabic: وَ صِلْ وَحْدَتِي وَ آنِسْ وَحْشَتِي
segments.translation: dictate to me the principles of faith and lessen my lapses.

segments.arabic: وَ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَتِي وَ آمِنْ رَوْعَتِي وَ اجْبُرْ فَاقَتِي
segments.translation: Respond to my supplication today, (please) Answer my request,

segments.arabic: وَ لَقِّنِّي حُجَّتِي وَ أَقِلْنِي عَثْرَتِي
segments.translation: make my request considerable, be gracious toward my prayer,

segments.arabic: وَ اسْتَجِبْ اللَّيْلَةَ دُعَائِي وَ أَعْطِنِي مَسْأَلَتِي
segments.translation: be merciful on me; do not make me lose hope of Your mercy.

segments.arabic: وَ أَعْظِمْ مِنْ مَسْأَلَتِي وَ كُنْ بِدُعَائِي حَفِيّاً
segments.translation: (Please) do not make me despair of Your soothing mercy, do not abandon me;

segments.arabic: [وَ كُنْ بِي رَحِيماً وَ لَا تُقَنِّطْنِي [مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ‏
segments.translation: while I beseech You, do not deprive me;

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تُؤْيِسْنِي مِنْ رَوْحِكَ وَ لَا تَخْذُلْنِي
segments.translation: while I ask You and do not punish me while I seek forgiveness of you.

segments.arabic: وَ أَنَا أَدْعُوكَ وَ لَا تَحْرِمْنِي
segments.translation: O, Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: وَ أَنَا أَسْأَلُكَ وَ لَا تُعَذِّبَنِي وَ أَنَا أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ
segments.translation: O, Allah's blessings upon Muhammed and his whole Household.

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ

text: Friday Rites Signifance of Friday Signifance of Friday × Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) says,âVerily, Fridays enjoy rights (incumbent upon people). Therefore, beware of violating Fridaysâ sanctity through showing shortcoming in acts of worship; rather, seek nearness to Almighty Allah by means of righteous deeds and abandonment of all forbidden acts. Certainly, on Fridays, Almighty Allah doubles up the rewards (of good deeds), erases forgivingly punishments (for evildoings), and raises the ranks (of faith) Merits of Fridays Friday days and nights excel the other days and nights in standing, honor, and regard. In this connection, the Holy Prophet (Â¥) is reported to have said, âSurely, in each hour of the twenty-four hours of the Friday day and night, Almighty Allah releases from Hellfire six hundred thousand persons.â Imam Ja`far al-sadiq (`a) is reported to have said, âOne who dies in the period between midday on Thursdays and midday on Fridays will be released, by Almighty Allah, from pressure in graves.â Imam al-sadiq (as) is also reported as saying, âVerily, Fridays enjoy rights (incumbent upon people). Therefore, beware of violating Fridaysâ sanctity through showing shortcoming in acts of worship; rather, seek nearness to Almighty Allah by means of righteous deeds and abandonment of all forbidden acts. Certainly, on Fridays, Almighty Allah doubles up the rewards (of good deeds), erases forgivingly punishments (for evildoings), and raises the ranks (of faith). Friday daytimes are as same as Friday nights; therefore, you may, when possible, stay up supplicating and offering prayers to Almighty Allah Who, at that night, orders the angels to descend to the lower sky in order to double up the rewards and erase the evildoings. Most surely, Allah is Ample-giving and All-generous.â Imam al-sadiq (as) is also reported, in a validly reported tradition, to have said, âWhen a believing individual prays to Him for granting him his request, Almighty Allah may postpone the answer of that request to Friday in order that the individual will be given all the more due to the exclusive merit of Fridays.â Imam al-sadiq (as) is also reported as narrating that when Prophet Josephâs brothers asked their father, Prophet Jacob, to ask Almighty Allahâs forgiveness of their faults, he promised to do that. Yet, he postponed that appeal to Friday early dawn so as to guarantee response. Again, Imam al-sadiq (as) is reported as saying that on Friday nights, fishes in oceans and beasts in wildernesses raise their heads and pray Almighty Allah saying in a loud sound, âO Our Lord; torture us not for the sins of the human beings.â Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (as) is reported to have said that on Friday nights, Almighty Allah gives orders to an angelâon behalf of Himâto call out, from above the Divine Throne, throughout the night, âIs there not any believing servant who will, right now, supplicate Me, before dawn comes upon him, for his world and Next World needs so that I will respond to him? Is there not any believing servant who, right now, repents to Me, before dawn comes upon him, and gives up his sins so that I will accept his repentance? Is there not any believing servant whose sustenance has been made reduced who will, right now, prays Me for increase, before dawn comes upon him, so that I will increase and develop his sustenance? Is there not any believing servant, being ailed, who will, right now, pray Me for healing, before dawn comes upon him, so that I will heal him? Is there not any believing servant, being grieved and detained, who will, right now, pray Me for relief and release, before dawn comes upon him, so that I will relieve and release him? Is there not any believing servant, being oppressed, who will, right now, pray Me for giving him victory and releasing him from oppression, before dawn comes upon him, so that I will back and release from oppression?â This angel will keep saying so until dawn. Likewise, Imam Ali Amir al-Mu'minÂ¢n (as) is reported to have said, âAs He has chosen Friday, Almighty Allah has decided their daytimes and nights to be feasts. One of its merits, whoever beseeches Him on Fridays will be granted his request. Chastisement that is decided for a people because of an evildoing will be canceled by Him if that evildoing is committed on Friday. All graces that Almighty Allah decides are put into practice on Friday nights. Hence, Friday nights are more favorable than other nights and so are their days.â Imam al sadiq (as) is reported as saying, âAvoid committing any act of disobedience (to Almighty Allah) on Friday nights, for the punishments (of evildoing) are doubled up, and rewards (for good deeds) are also doubled up. Whoever avoids committing an act of disobedience at Friday nights, Almighty Allah will forgive all of his previous sins. In the same way, whoever challenges Almighty Allah by committing an act of disobedience at such nights, Almighty Allah will punish him for each and every act of disobedience that he did in his whole lifetime and will double up the punishment for him.â It has been authentically narrated on the authority of Imam `Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha (as) that the Holy Prophet (saw) said, âVerily, Friday is the master of days. On Fridays, Almighty Allah doubles up the rewards (for good deeds), erases, forgivingly, the punishments (for evildoings), raises the ranks (of faith), responds to prayers, relieves from misfortunes, and fulfills the grand requests. Friday is the day of bonus. Almighty Allah, on Fridays, releases numerous individuals from Hellfire. When anyone prays Him on Friday while having already appreciated the actual standing and the sanctity of this day, it will be incumbent upon Almighty Allah to release him/her from Hellfire. If that individual dies on that day or night, he/she will be decided as martyr and will be resurrected (on the Judgment Day) secured. Conversely, if one belittles the sanctity of Friday and disrespects its standings, it will be incumbent upon Almighty Allah to cast him/her into Hellfire unless he/she repents thereafter.â Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (as) is reported, through an authentic chain of authority, to have said, âSunlight has never risen in a day better than Friday. When beards meet each other on that day, they greet each other with, Peace! Good day!â Imam Ja`far al-sadiq (as) is authentically reported to have said, âOn Fridays, do not engage yourselves in anything other than acts of worship, for the servantsâ faults are forgiven and the divine mercy is sent down on Fridays.â Friday and Friday Nights Importance : The children of Hazrat Yaqoob ( a.s.) [Jacob] asked their father to request Allah to forgive them. Hazrat Yaqoob (a.s.) said; " I will ask for you forgiveness from, my Lord" (Yusuf12, verse 98) .Interpreting this verse, Imam Sadiq (a.s.) has said: " Hazrat Yaqoob (a.s.) delayed asking forgiveness until dawn of Friday night." There are two hours on Friday when Duas are answered: one is when Friday leader has completed the sermon and the worshippers are prepared for Friday prayer. The other is the last moments of Friday that is: "When half face of the sun is hidden." × . Before Fajr After Fajr General Acts 4/6th Imams dua Main Duas Misc. In the first unit of the Dawn Prayer, it is recommended to recite Surah al-Jumu`ah (No. 62) and, in the second unit, Surah al-Tawhid (No. 112). 5.
