title: Thursday Nights (Shab e Juma)   Duas.org

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and his Household.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
hasten their Relief,
and destroy their enemies
from both jinn and human beings,
both the foremost and the later ones.
All Glory be to Allah.
Allah is the Most Great.
There is no god save Allah.

segments.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha alladhi la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: I pray the forgiveness of Allah; there is no god but He,
the Ever-living, the Self-Subsisting,
and I repent to Him
as a slave who is submissive,
acquiescent, and poor,

segments.arabic: لاَ يَسْتَطيعُ لِنَفْسِهِ صَرْفاً وَلاَ عَدْلاً
segments.transliteration: la yastati`u linafsihi sarfan wa la `adlan
segments.translation: not controlling for himself any harm or profit,

segments.transliteration: wa la naf`an wa la darran
segments.translation: or benefit or damage

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَيَاةً وَلاَ مَوْتاً وَلاَ نُشُوراً
segments.transliteration: wa la hayatan wa la mawtan wa la nushuran
segments.translation: and not controlling death nor life, nor raising (the dead) to life.
May Allah send peace upon Muhammad
and his Household; the pure, the immaculate,
the choicest, and the pious;
and may He spread thorough blessings over them.
O Allah, I beseech You in the name of Your Noble Face
and in the name of Your Sublime Name

segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: to send blessings to Muhammad and his Household

segments.transliteration: wa an taghfira li dhanbiya al`azima
segments.translation: and to forgive me my grave sin.
O Allah, I beseech You in the name of Your Noble Face
and in the name of Your Sublime Name

segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: to send blessings to Muhammad and his Household

segments.transliteration: wa an taghfira li dhanbiya al`azima
segments.translation: and to forgive me my grave sin.
O He Who is ever-Favorer on the beings!
O He Who is openhandedly Bestower of gifts!
O He Who is the Giver of sublime donations!
Bless Muhammad and his Household,
the best of all creatures in traits,
and forgive us, O Lord of Highness,
at this evening.
O Allah, You are my Lord;
there is no god save You;
You have created me, and I am Your slave and the son of Your bondmaid;

segments.transliteration: wa fi qabdatika wa nasiyati biyadika
segments.translation: and I am in Your grip; and my forehead is in Your Hand;

segments.arabic: أَمْسَيْتُ عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ
segments.translation: I come to observe my covenant and promise to You as much as I can.

segments.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ
segments.transliteration: a`udhu biridaka min sharri ma sana`tu
segments.translation: I take refuge in Your pleasure against the evil of my deeds.
I acknowledge Your favors and confess of my sins.
So, (please) forgive my sins,

segments.arabic: إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
segments.transliteration: innahu la yaghfiru aldhdhunuba illa anta
segments.translation: for none can forgive sins save You.
In the Name of Allah the All-compassionate, the All-merciful;

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma anta al-awwalu fÄ lÄ shayâ qablak
segments.translation: O Allah make me Submissive,till I surrender to Thee,

segments.transliteration: Wa anta al-Äkhiru alladhÄ« lÄ yahlik
segments.translation: make me happy by putting "fear of God" in my heart,do not make me miserable on account of disobedience unto Thee.

segments.arabic: وَخِرْ لِي فِي قَضَائِكَ وَبَارِكْ لِي فِي قَدَرِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa anta al-á¸¥ayyÅ« alladhÄ« lÄ yamÅ«t
segments.translation: Write (prescribe) for me freedom from pain, trouble and anxiety,make ready for me blessings and happiness,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ أُحِبَّ تَعْجِيلَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَلاَ تَأَخِيرَ مَا عَجّلْتَ
segments.translation: so that I do not like what You delay to come in advance,or what You make happen quickly to be delayed.

segments.transliteration: Wa anta al-Baá¹£Ä«r alladhÄ« lÄ yartÄb
segments.translation: Give me contentment and an independent disposition.

segments.arabic: وَمَتِّعْنِي بِسَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَاجْعَلْهُمَا الوَارِثِينَ مِنِّي
segments.transliteration: Wa anta as-á¹¢Ädiq alladhÄ« lÄ yakdhib
segments.translation: Make me derive advantage from the power of hearing (I listen to and accept advise and obey) and seeing (discernment,intelligence, and perception of truth);and both of them to my inheritors

segments.arabic: وَانْصُرْنِي عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنِي وَأَرِنِي فِيِهِ قُدْرَتَكَ
segments.translation: Give me an upper hand over him who intimidates me, and treat me well through Thy might and power,
o Lord,and keep me in that exact state.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ أَعِنِّيْ عَلَى هَوْلِ يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ
segments.translation: o Allah! Attend to and, take care of me in the frightening hour of the Day of Judgement.

segments.arabic: وَأَخْرِجْنِي مِنَ الدُّنْيا سَالِمَاً وَأَدْخِلْنِي الْجَنَّةَ آمِنَاً
segments.translation: Make me leave this world in safe and sound condition,and enter the permanent land of bliss and beauty (Paradise)in peace and tranquillity;
and houries as mates

segments.arabic: وَاكفِنِي مُؤُنَتِي ومُؤنَةَ عِيالِي وَمُؤُنَةَ النَّاسِ
segments.translation: multiply provisions alloted to me, and to my dependents, also promote welfare of the people and make me sit,through Thy mercy, in the company of Thy upright servants.
and join the delightful charming people who have refined manners, intellegent minds and beautiful faces,.
O Allah! If penalised (it means) I deserved punishment;

segments.arabic: أَنَا وَإِنْ تَغْفِرْ لِي فَأَهْلٌ لِذَلِكَ
segments.translation: if forgiven (it is because) Thou art (the Most Merciful) Master. How would Thou punish?

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ وَكَيْفَ تُعَذِّبْنِي يَا سَيِّدِي وَحُبُّكَ فِي قَلْبِي أَمَا
segments.translation: My Master! My heart is full of Thy love,undoubtedly,and Thy absolute authority,
very 'kindly, take notice of that,and keep, us together with people who are given respite.

segments.arabic: لَتَجْمَعَنَّ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ قَوْمٍ طَالَمَا عَادَيْتَهُم فِيكَ
segments.translation: How much less attention they may pay to ' Thy commands!

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ بِحَقِ أَوْلِيائِكَ الطَّاهِرِينَ عَلَيْهُمُ السَّلامُ
segments.translation: O Allah ! For the sake of Thy pure and pious friends, peace be upon them,
make us preserve true traditions of the Holy Prophet (saws).
Return the possessions,to keep safe and watch over the Salat (adoration and worship of Allaah)

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ أَنَا أَحَقُّ خَلْقِكَ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ ذَلِكَ بِنَا
segments.translation: O Allah! truely, we are the worthiest among Thy creation,treat us in that context.
O Allah treat us mercifulIy.
O Allah! . Make my knowledge about Thee of the highest quality.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُطْمِعَنَّ فِيَّ عَدُوَّاً وَلا حَاسِداًوَاحْفَظْنِي قَائِمَاً وَقَاعِدَاً وَيَقْظَانَ وَرَاقِدَاً
segments.translation: Do not let me drown myself in hatred,nor feel resentfuI;keep me steadfast, within bounds, obedient,enduring.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي سَبِيلَكَ الأقْوَمَ
segments.translation: O Allah forgive me,have mercy on me,make me strive in Thy honesty,
free me from the of burning Hell,from being consumed by the blazing fire,
make less what I have to pay back,and the punishment deserved
,make me be one of the choicest people for all times.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي مِمَّا لا طَاقَةَ لِي بِهِ وَلا صَبْرَ لِي عَلَيْهِ بِرَحْمَتِك يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.translation: o Allah' ' have mercy on me because I have not the strength,nor patience to withstand it (punishment) ,through Thy mercy,O the Most Merciful.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا كُنْتَ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ قَبْلَكَ شَيْ‏ءٌ
segments.translation: O, Allah, our Lord, You were, and nothing was there before You,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْتَ تَكُونُ حِينَ لَا يَكُونُ غَيْرَكَ شَيْ‏ءٌ
segments.translation: and You will exist when there is nothing except You.

segments.arabic: لَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ كُنْهَ عِزَّتِكَ وَ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَحَدٌ أَنْ يَنْعَتَ عَظَمَتَكَ
segments.translation: No one knows Your mightiness essence nor describes Your greatness,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ أَيْنَ مُسَتَقَرُّكَ
segments.translation: no one knows where is Your dwelling place;

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ فَوْقَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ أَنْتَ وَرَاءَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ
segments.translation: You are above everything, behind everything,

segments.arabic: وَ أَمَامَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ مَعَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ
segments.translation: in front of everything, and with everything.

segments.arabic: خَلَقْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ
segments.translation: You created, O Possessor of majesty and munificence;
glorification for Your Face purified the pride

segments.arabic: وَ الْعَظَمَةَ لِنَفْسِكَ وَ خَلَقْتَ الْقُوَّةَ
segments.translation: and greatness of Your being and created the power

segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ yaâkhudhuka nawmun wa lÄ sinah
segments.translation: and competence of Your authority!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى عَظَمَةِ مُلْكِكَ  وَ جَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ
segments.translation: So, Glory be to You, our God, and to you be the Praise upon the greatness of Your kingdom and Your Honorable Face;
whose light-filled everything,

segments.arabic: وَ هُوَ حَيْثُ لَا يَرَاهُ شَيْءٌ يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ
segments.translation: and He is where nothing can witness Him; glorified is Him with His Praise
so, Glory and Praise be to You!

segments.transliteration: Kullu shayâin hÄlikun illÄ wajhaka al-karÄ«m
segments.translation: O God, our Lord to You belongs Praise;

segments.arabic: تَسَلَّطْتَ فَلَا أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْعِبَادِ يَحُدُّ وَصْفَكَ
segments.translation: You ruled over the servants so no one will limit Your description.
You ruled with Your mightiness; You braced Yourself with Your omnipotence,

segments.arabic: وَ تَجَبَّرْتَ بِكِبْرِيَائِكَ وَ تَكَبَّرْتَ بِمُلْكِكَ
segments.translation: You compelled with your pride, and You magnified with Your possessions,

segments.arabic: وَ تَمَلَّكْتَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ‏ وَ قَدَرْتَ بِقُوَّتِكَ‏
segments.transliteration: Wa arghabu ilayka wa lÄ arghabu ilÄ ghayrik
segments.translation: You possessed with Your power, You got capable with Your power.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْعِبَادِ وَصْفَكَ
segments.translation: No one among the servants can describe You,

segments.transliteration: Wa anjahihÄ allati lÄ yanbaghÄ« lil-âibÄd
segments.translation: and no one can evaluate Your value,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يَسْبِقُ أَحَدٌ مِنْ قَضَائِكَ
segments.translation: nor can anyone go beyond Your decree.
O God, our Lord to You belongs Praise;

segments.arabic: عَلَى جَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ وَ عَظَمَةِ مُلْكِكَ
segments.translation: upon Your majestic face and the greatness of Your possessions;

segments.arabic: الَّذِي بِهِ قَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَ الْأَرْضُ
segments.translation: through which the heavens and earth endure.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ
segments.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord; to You belongs Praise.
You filled everything with greatness,
and You created everything with power;

segments.transliteration: Wa kalimÄtika al-âuliyÄ wa niâamik allati lÄ tuá¸¥á¹£Ä
segments.translation: You encompass all things with knowledge,
count everything in numbers,

segments.transliteration: Wa aá¸¥abbihÄ ilayka wa ashrufihÄ âindaka
segments.translation: save everything in a record,

segments.arabic: وَ وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ رَحْمَةً وَ عِلْماً
segments.transliteration: Manzilah wa aqrabihÄ minka wa wasÄ«lah
segments.translation: and embracest everything in mercy and knowledge;
indeed, You are Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: ‏ فَ سُبْحَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى عِزَّةِ سُلْطَانِكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to You, our God, and to you be the Praise upon Your glorified authority;

segments.arabic: الَّذِي خَشَعَ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: which everything humbled to, from Your creation

segments.transliteration: AlladhÄ« tuá¸¥ibbuhu wa tará¸Ä âamman daâÄka bihÄ«
segments.translation: and all Your servants got cautious of,
all Your creations are submitted to it.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa á¸¥aqqun âalayka allÄ taá¸¥rima sÄâilaka
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammed;

segments.arabic: وَ اجْزِهِ أَفْضَلَ الْجَزَاءِ وَ أَفْضَلَ
segments.transliteration: Wa bi-kulli ismin huwa laka fi at-TawrÄt wa al-InjÄ«l
segments.translation: repay him with the best reward, and with the best reward,

segments.arabic: مَا أَنْتَ جَازٍ أَحَداً مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِكَ عَلَى حِفْظِهِ دِينَكَ وَ إِبْلَاغِهِ  وَ اتِّبَاعِهِ وَصِيَّتَكَ
segments.translation: You ever granted to anyone of Your Prophets as he; safeguards Your religion and informs it, following Your will and command.

segments.arabic: وَ أَمْرَكَ حَتَّى تُشَرِّفَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِتَفْضِيلِكَ إِيَّاهُ عَلَى جَمِيعِ رُسُلِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa bi-kulli ismin huwa laka âallamtahÅ« aá¸¥adan min khalqik
segments.translation: Until You honor him with Your preferring upon all Your Messengers on the Day of Resurrection;
O Possessor of majesty and munificence!

segments.transliteration: Aw istaâtharta bihÄ« fi âilm al-ghayb âindak
segments.translation: O, Allah, just as You have rescued us through what You distinguished;

segments.arabic: مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa bi-kulli ismin daâÄk bihÄ« á¸¥amalat âarshik
segments.translation: Muhammed, blessings of Allah be upon him, and his Household

segments.transliteration: Wa malÄâikatuka wa aá¹£fiyÄâuka min khalqik
segments.translation: and have guided us through what You sent,

segments.arabic: وَ بَصَّرْتَنَا بِمَا أَوْصَيْتَهُ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ
segments.transliteration: Wa bi-á¸¥aqq as-sÄâilÄ«n laka wa ar-rÄghibÄ«n ilayk
segments.translation: and have shown us through what deeds you command.

segments.transliteration: Wa al-mutaâawidhÄ«n bika wa al-mutaá¸arriâÄ«n ilayk
segments.translation: Therefore, send Your blessings upon him and his Household,

segments.transliteration: AdâÅ«ka yÄ AllÄhÅ« duâÄâ man qad ishtaddat fÄqatuhu
segments.translation: and repay him the best reward on our behalf.

segments.arabic: وَ أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ‏ نَبِيّاً مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَ رُسُلِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa âaáºuma jurmuhu wa ashrÄfa âalÄ al-halakÄti nafsuh
segments.translation: Best reward; You ever granted to any of Your Prophets and Messengers,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَجْمَعَ لِي بِهِ خَيْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: Wa á¸aâufat quwwatuhu wa man lÄ yaá¹¯iqu bishayâin min âamalih
segments.translation: and please grant me the best of this world and Hereafter.

segments.arabic: إِنَّكَ ذُو فَضْلٍ كَرِيمٍ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَام‏
segments.transliteration: Wa laa yajidu lifaaqatihi saaddan ghayrak.
segments.translation: You are Possessor of generous bounty; O Possessor of majesty and munificence!
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلا شَيْ‏ءَ قَبْلَكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, You are the First, and nothing is before You
And You are the Last, and nothing will outlast You
And You are the Ever-Living, who never dies
And You are the Creator, who is never incapable
And You are the All-Seeing, with no doubt
And You are the Truthful, who never lies
The Subduer, who is never defeated
The Incomparable, whose works never come to an end
The Near, who never becomes distant
The Omnipotent, who is never wronged
The Forgiver, who never wrongs
The Eternal, who is not in need of sustenance
The Sustainer, who never sleeps
The Responder, who never tires
The Most Compassionate, who cannot be sought in vain
The All-Knowing, who is not taught
The Strong, who is never weak
The Magnificent, who cannot be described fully
The Faithful, who never betrays
The Just, who never wrongs
The Self-Sufficient, who is never poor
The Great, who never diminishes
The Protector, who cannot be defeated
The Benefactor, whose goodness is never denied
The Victor, who is never defeated

segments.transliteration: Ilahi kam min mudhnib qad ghafarta lahu.
segments.translation: The Unique One, who is never dependent

segments.transliteration: Wa kam min museeâin qad tajawazta âanhu.
segments.translation: The One, who seeks no counsel
The Bestower, who never tires
The Generous, who is never stingy

segments.transliteration: Wa âaafini waftah li min fadhlik.
segments.translation: The Almighty, who is never humbled
The Preserver, who never forgets
The Ever-Sustaining, who never sleeps

segments.transliteration: Yassir li min amri ma akhaafu âusrahu.
segments.translation: The Hidden One, who cannot be seen

segments.transliteration: Wa farraj âanni wa âan kulli muâminin wa muâminah.
segments.translation: The Everlasting, who never perishes
The Remaining, who never decays
The Omnipotent, who is never contested

segments.transliteration: Wa sahhil li wa likulli muâminin ma arjooh.
segments.translation: The One, who is not compared
There is no god but You
The Truth, who is not altered by time
And whose presence is not contained by places

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« asâaluka raá¸¥matan min âindik.
segments.translation: And no sleep or drowsiness overtakes You

segments.transliteration: TahdÄ« bihÄ qalbÄ«, wa tajmaâu bihÄ amrÄ«.
segments.translation: And nothing is comparable to You

segments.transliteration: Wa tallummu bihÄ shaâathÄ«, wa taá¸¥faáºu bihÄ ghÄâibÄ«.
segments.translation: And how can it be otherwise

segments.transliteration: Wa tuá¹£liá¸¥u bihÄ shÄhidÄ«, wa tuzakkÄ« bihÄ âamalÄ«.
segments.translation: When You are the Creator of everything

segments.transliteration: Wa tulhimunÄ« bihÄ rushdÄ«, wa taâá¹£imunÄ« bihÄ min kulli sÅ«â.
segments.translation: There is no god but You

segments.arabic: كُلُّ شَي‏ءٍ هَالِكٌ إلاّ وَجْهَكَ الْكَرِيمَ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma aâá¹­inÄ« Ä«mÄnan á¹£Ädiqan, wa yaqÄ«nan khÄliá¹£an.
segments.translation: Everything perishes except Your Noble Face

segments.transliteration: Wa raá¸¥matan anÄlu bihÄ sharafa karÄmatika.
segments.translation: The most honorable of faces
The refuge for the fearful and the protector of those seeking shelter

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« asâaluka lfawza fi lqaá¸Äâ.
segments.translation: I ask You and not anyone else

segments.arabic: وَأَرْغَبُ إليكَ وَلاَ أَرْغَبُ إلى غَيْرِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa manÄzila lâulamÄâ, wa âaysha ssaâadÄâ.
segments.translation: And I turn to You with hope, not to anyone else
I ask You with the best of all requests
And I ask You for the most successful of them, which Your servants cannot ask except through You

segments.transliteration: Wa in á¸aâufa âamalÄ« faqad iftaqartu ilÄ raá¸¥matika.
segments.translation: That they should not ask You except with it

segments.transliteration: Fa asâaluka yÄ QÄá¸Ä« lUmÅ«r, wa yÄ ShÄfÄ« á¹£á¹¢udÅ«r.
segments.translation: You are the Opener, the Bestower

segments.transliteration: KamÄ tujÄ«ru bayna lbuá¸¥Å«r, an tujÄ«ranÄ«.
segments.translation: The Source of all goodness, the Remover of faults

segments.transliteration: Min âadhÄbi sSaâÄ«r, wa min daâwati tThubÅ«r.
segments.translation: The Recorder of good deeds, the Eraser of sins
The Exalter of ranks

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa mÄ qaá¹£urat âanhu masâalatÄ«.
segments.translation: I ask You, O Allah, O Most Merciful

segments.transliteration: Wa lam tablughhu niyyatÄ«, wa lam tuá¸¥iá¹­ bihÄ« masâalatÄ«.
segments.translation: By Your most beautiful names

segments.arabic: وَكَلِمَاتِكَ الْعُليا وَنِعَمِكَ الَّتي لا تُحْصَى
segments.transliteration: Min khayrin waâadtahu aá¸¥adan min khalqika.
segments.translation: And by Your highest words and Your blessings that cannot be counted
And I ask You with the most honored of Your names to You

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma yÄ DhÄ lá¸¥abli shshadÄ«d, wa lamri rrashÄ«d.
segments.translation: And with the most beloved and the most honored of them to You
In rank and the closest of them to You and the means to You
And the quickest of them to be answered by You
And by Your hidden and guarded name

segments.transliteration: Wa rrukkaâ wa ssujÅ«d, almÅ«fÄ«na bi lâuhÅ«d.
segments.translation: The Majestic, the Glorious, the Great

segments.arabic: الَّذي تُحِبُّهُ وَتَرضَى عَمَّنْ دَعَاكَ بِهِ
segments.translation: Whom You love and are pleased with those who call You by it
And You answer their supplication
And it is Your right that You never reject the one who asks

segments.arabic: وَبُكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ فِي التَوْرَاةِ وَالإِنْجيلِ
segments.translation: And by every name that is Yours in the Torah and the Gospel
And in the Psalms and the Qurâan, the great scripture

segments.arabic: وَبِكُلِّ اسمٍ هُوَ لَكَ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: And by every name You have taught to anyone among Your creation
Or kept it hidden from all creation

segments.arabic: أَوْ اسْتَأثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيِبِ عِنْدَكَ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma hÄdhÄ dduâÄâu, wa âalayka listijÄbah.
segments.translation: Or You have kept it for Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen

segments.arabic: وَبِكُلِّ اسْمٍ دَعَاكَ بِهِ حَمَلَةُ عَرْشِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa hÄdhÄ ljuhdu, wa âalayka ttuklÄn.
segments.translation: And by every name You are called by the bearers of Your Throne

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma ajâal lÄ« nÅ«ran fÄ« qalbÄ«.
segments.translation: And by Your angels and Your chosen ones among Your creation

segments.transliteration: Wa nÅ«ran fÄ« qabri, wa nÅ«ran bayna yadayya.
segments.translation: And by the right of those who ask of You and those who yearn towards You

segments.transliteration: Wa nÅ«ran taá¸¥tÄ«, wa nÅ«ran fawqÄ«.
segments.translation: And by  those who seek refuge in You and those who humble themselves before You

segments.arabic: أَدْعُوكَ يَا أَللهُ دُعَاءَ مَنْ قَدْ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa nÅ«ran fÄ« samâÄ«, wa nÅ«ran fÄ« baá¹£arÄ«.
segments.translation: I call upon You, O Allah, as the one whose need has grown severe

segments.arabic: وَعَظُمَ جُرْمُهُ وَأَشْرَفَ عَلى الهَلَكَةِ نَفْسُهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa nÅ«ran fÄ« shaârÄ«, wa nÅ«ran fÄ« basharÄ«.
segments.translation: And whose sin has grown immense, and his soul is close to destruction

segments.arabic: وَضَعُفَتْ قُوَّتُهُ وَمَنْ لاَ يَثِقُ بِشَي‏ءٍ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa nÅ«ran fÄ« laá¸¥mÄ«, wa nÅ«ran fÄ« âiáºÄmÄ«.
segments.translation: And whose strength has weakened, and who trusts nothing of his deeds
And he finds no reliever for his need but You.

segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Äna lladhÄ« irtadÄ bilâizz wa bÄna bih.
segments.translation: I have fled from it to You.

segments.arabic: غيرَ مُستنكِفٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَكبِرٍ عَنْ عِبَادَتِكَ.
segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Äna lladhÄ« labisa lmajd wa takarrama bih.
segments.translation: Without reluctance or arrogance in worshiping You.

segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Äna man lÄ yanbaghÄ« ttasbÄ«á¸¥ illÄ lah.
segments.translation: O comfort of every seeker of refuge.
O support of every needy one.
I ask You, as You are Allah.
The Most Compassionate, the Most Generous.
There is no god but You.
The Creator of the heavens and the earth.
The Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
The Knower of the unseen and the seen.

segments.transliteration: hatta la arjwa wa la akhafa illa iyyaka
segments.translation: The Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
You are the Lord, and I am the servant.
You are the Master, and I am the owned.
You are the Mighty, and I am the humble.
You are the Rich, and I am the poor.
You are the Ever-Living, and I am the dead.
You are the Eternal, and I am the perishing.
You are the Benefactor, and I am the wrongdoer.
You are the Forgiving, and I am the sinner.

segments.transliteration: ya man ya`lamu ma fi damiri alssamitina
segments.translation: You are the Merciful, and I am the erring.
You are the Creator, and I am the created.
You are the Strong, and I am the weak.
You are the Giver, and I am the beggar.
You are the Sustainer, and I am the sustained.
You are the most deserving of my complaints.

segments.transliteration: wa ikhwani fi dini wa ahli
segments.translation: I sought His help and placed my hope in Him.

segments.arabic: إِلهي كَمْ مِنْ مُذْنِبٍ قَدْ غَفَرْتَ لَهُ.
segments.transliteration: ilahi tumuhu al-amali qad khabat illa ladayka
segments.translation: O my God, how many sinners You have forgiven.

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ مُسي‏ءٍ قَدْ تَجَاوَزْتَ عَنْهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa ma`akifu alhimami qad ta`attalat illa `alayka
segments.translation: And how many wrongdoers You have overlooked.

segments.transliteration: wa madhahibu al`uquli qad samat illa ilayka
segments.translation: So bless Muhammad and his family.
Forgive me, have mercy on me, and pardon me.

segments.transliteration: ya akrama maqsudin wa ajwada mas'ulin
segments.translation: Grant me well-being and open for me from Your bounty.
Holy is Your mention, Sacred is Your command.
Your decree is final.

segments.arabic: يَسِّرْ لِي مِنْ أَمْرِي مَا أَخَافُ عُسْرَهُ.
segments.translation: Ease for me the matters I fear difficulty in.

segments.arabic: وَفَرِّجْ عَنِّي وَعَنْ كُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ وَمُؤْمِنَةٍ.
segments.translation: And relieve me and every believing man and woman.

segments.transliteration: siwa ma`rifati bi'annaka aqrabu man rajahu alttalibuna
segments.translation: And suffice me from what I fear of necessity.
And avert from me what I fear of sorrow.

segments.arabic: وَسَهِّلْ لِي وَلِكُلِّ مُؤمِنٍ مَا أَرْجُوهُ.
segments.translation: And make easy for me and every believer what I hope for.
There is no god but YOU

segments.transliteration: wa ja`ala ma imtanna bihi `ala `ibadihi fi kifa'in lita'diyati haqqhi
segments.translation: Glory be to You I have been an opressor to myself
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدكَ.
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You for mercy from You.

segments.arabic: تَهْدِي بِهَا قَلْبِي، وَتَجْمَعُ بِهَا أَمْرِي.
segments.translation: That guides my heart and unites my affairs.

segments.arabic: وَتَلُّمُ بِهَا شَعَثِي، وَتَحْفَظُ بِهَا غَائِبِي.
segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha alladhi la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: That mends my brokenness and protects what is absent of mine.

segments.arabic: وَتُصْلِحُ بِهَا شَاهِدِي، وَتَزَكِّي بِهَا عَمَلِي.
segments.translation: That rectifies my present state and purifies my deeds.

segments.arabic: وَتُلْهِمُنِي بِهَا رُشْدِي، وَتَعْصِمُنِي بِهَا مِنْ كُلِّ سُوْءٍ.
segments.translation: That inspires my guidance and protects me from all evil.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي إيمَانَاً صَادِقَاً، وَيَقِيناً خَالِصَاً.
segments.translation: O Allah, grant me true faith and pure certainty.

segments.transliteration: wa dhimami anbiya'ihi wa rusulihi `alayhimu alssalamu
segments.translation: And mercy through which I attain the honor of Your grace.

segments.transliteration: wa dhimmati muhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: In this world and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْفَوْزَ فِي الْقَضَاءِ.
segments.transliteration: wa dhimami al-awsiya'i min ali muhammadin `alayhimu alssalamu
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You for success in judgment.

segments.transliteration: amantu bisirri ali muhammadin `alayhimu alssalamu wa `alaniyatihim
segments.translation: And the ranks of the scholars, and the life of the joyful.
And victory over the enemies.

segments.transliteration: wa ash-hadu annahum fi `ilmi allahi wa ta`atihi
segments.translation: O Allah, I have placed my need before You.

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ ضَعُفَ عَمَلِي فَقَدْ افْتَقَرْتُ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ.
segments.translation: And though my deeds are weak, I am in need of Your mercy.

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا قَاضِي الأُمُورِ، وَيَا شَافِي الصُّدُورِ.
segments.translation: So I ask You, O Arbiter of matters, and Healer of hearts.

segments.arabic: كَمَا تُجيرُ بَيْنَ الْبُحُورِ، أَنْ تُجِيرَنِي.
segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha rabbi wa atubu ilayhi
segments.translation: As You reconcile between the seas, to grant me safety.

segments.arabic: مِنْ عَذَابِ الْسَعِيرِ، وَمِنْ دَعْوَةِ الْثُّبُورِ.
segments.translation: From the torment of Hellfire and the call of despair.
And from the trial of the graves.

segments.transliteration: wa la ilaha illa allahu wallahu akbaru
segments.translation: O Allah, whatever is beyond my asking,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ تَبْلَغْهُ نِيَّتِي، وَلَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ مَسْأَلَتِي.
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: And my intention could not encompass, nor my request comprehend,

segments.arabic: مِنْ خَيْرٍ وَعَدْتَهُ أَحَدَاً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ.
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: Of the good You promised to any of Your creation,
Indeed, I turn to You in earnest for it.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ يَا ذَا الْحَبْلِ الَّشدِيدِ، وَالأَمْرِ الرَّشِيدِ.
segments.translation: O Allah, O Possessor of firm resolve and wise command!
I ask You for safety on the Day of Judgment,
And Paradise on the Day of Eternity,
With the near ones who are witnesses.
And those who bow and prostrate, fulfilling their pledges.
Indeed, You are Merciful and Loving.
And You do whatever You will.
O Allah, make us guides who are rightly guided,
Neither astray nor leading others astray.
At peace with Your allies and at war with Your enemies.
We love those who repent, out of love for You,
And oppose those who oppose You.
O Allah, this is the supplication, and it is upon You to respond.
And this is the effort, and upon You is the reliance.

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي نُورَاً فِي قَلْبِي.
segments.translation: O Allah, make for me light in my heart,

segments.arabic: وَنُورَاً فِي قَبْرِي، وَنُورَاً بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ.
segments.translation: And light in my grave, and light before me,
And light beneath me, and light above me,

segments.arabic: وَنُورَاً فِي سَمْعِي، وَنُورَاً فِي بَصَرِي.
segments.translation: And light in my hearing, and light in my sight,

segments.arabic: وَنُورَاً فِي شَعْرِي، وَنُورَاً فِي بَشَرِي.
segments.translation: And light in my hair, and light in my skin,

segments.arabic: وَنُورَاً فِي لَحْمِي، وَنُورَاً فِي عِظَامِي.
segments.translation: And light in my flesh, and light in my bones.
O Allah, magnify the light for me.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذي اِرْتَدى بِالعِزِّ وَبَانَ بِهِ.
segments.translation: Glory be to Him who is cloaked in might and manifests through it.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذي لَبِسَ الْمَجْدَ وَتَكَرَّمَ بِهِ.
segments.translation: Glory be to Him who adorns majesty and ennobles through it.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لا يَنْبَغِي التَّسْبيحُ إلاّ لَهُ.
segments.translation: Glory be to Him to whom no glorification is due but His.
Glory be to the Possessor of bounty and blessings.
Glory be to the Possessor of glory and generosity.
Glory be to the Possessor of majesty and honor.
O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,
grant me Your satisfaction this very early morning,
place fear of You in my heart,
and separate it from (leaning to) anyone other than You,

segments.arabic: حَتَّىٰ لاَ أَرْجُوَ وَلاَ أَخَافَ إِلاَّ إِيَّاكَ
segments.translation: so that I will hope for and fear none save You.
O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and his Household
and grant me resolute faith,
pure sincerity (to You),
honorable belief in (Your) oneness,
persistent straightness,
essential tolerance,
and satisfaction with (Your) predetermination and decrees.
O He Who settles the needs of His beseechers;

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي ضَمِيرِ ٱلصَّامِتِينَ
segments.translation: O He Who knows what is in the innermost of the silent;
send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,
respond to my prayers,
forgive my sins,
expand my means of livelihood,
and settle the needs of myself
and my brethren-in-faith and my family members.

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي طُمُوحُ ٱلآمَالِ قَدْ خَابَتْ إِلاَّ لَدَيْكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, all ambitions of expectations are disappointed except those addressed to You,

segments.arabic: وَمَعَاكِفُ ٱلْهِمَمِ قَدْ تَعَطَّلَتْ إِلاَّ عَلَيْكَ
segments.translation: all resolute determinations are paralyzed except those relied upon You,

segments.arabic: وَمَذَاهِبُ ٱلْعُقُولِ قَدْ سَمَتْ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ
segments.translation: and all reason-based tendencies are wasted except those directed to You.
So, You are the ultimate hope and to You is the resort.
O He Who is the noblest objective and the most magnanimous desired,
I am fleeing to You from myself.
O shelter of those who flee overburdened with the heavy loads of sins,
carrying my sins on my back,
I cannot find any interceder for me

segments.arabic: سِوَىٰ مَعْرِفَتِي بِأَنَّكَ أَقْرَبُ مَنْ رَجَاهُ ٱلطَّالِبُونَ
segments.translation: except that I know for sure that You are the nearest of all those who are hoped by beseechers
and of all those whose donations are expected by the desirous.
O He Who has split the intellects on the recognition of Him,
made tongues articulate with the praising of Him

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلَ مَا ٱمْتَنَّ بِهِ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ فِي كِفَاءٍ لِتَاْدِيَةِ حَقِّهِ
segments.translation: and made that which He has conferred upon His servants enough means for the fulfillment of their duties towards Him;
(please) send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ عَلَىٰ عَقْلِي سَبيلاًَ
segments.translation: do not give Satan any way (of success) over my reason,
and do not give wrongness a way to reach my deeds.

segments.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
segments.translation: I pray the forgiveness of Allah save Whom there is no god;
the Ever-living and Ever-subsisting,and I turn in repentance to Him
I begin this morning seeking the protection of Allah,
the protection of His angels,
the protections of His prophets and messengers, peace be upon them,

segments.arabic: وَذِمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.translation: the protection of Muhammad, peace be upon him and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَذِمَمِ ٱلأَوْصِيَاءِ مِنَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segments.translation: and the protections of the Successors from Muhammadâs progeny, peace be upon them.

segments.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِسِرِّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ وَعَلاَنِيَتِهِمْ
segments.translation: I believe in the secrets of Muhammadâs progeny, peace be upon them, and in their open affairs
and in their exoteric and their esoteric affairs.

segments.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّهُمْ فِي عِلْمِ ٱللَّهِ وَطَاعَتِهِ
segments.translation: I bear witness that they, as regarding their knowledge of Allah and their obedience to Him,
are just like Muhammad, peace be upon him and his Household.
All glory be to Allah, the All-great and with the Praising of Him;
I pray the forgiveness of Allah, my Lord, and I turn repentant to Him.
I implore for Allahâs forgiveness.
All glory be to Allah all praise be to Allah;;
there is no god save Allah;Allah is the Greatest;

segments.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ إنْ أطَعْتُكَ فَالَمحْمَدَةُ لَكَ وَإنْ عَصَيْتُكَ فَالحُجَّةُ لَكَ مِنْكَ الرّوحُ وَمِنْكَ الفَرَجُ

سُبْحانَ مَنْ أنْعَمَ وَشَكَرَ سُبْحانَ مَنْ قَدَرَ وَغَفَرَ. اللَّهُمَّ إنْ كُنْتُ عَصَيْتُكَ فَإنّي قَدْ أطَعْتُكَ في أحَبِّ الاشْياءِ

إلَيكَ وَهوَ الايمانُ بِكَ، لَمْ أتَّخِذْ لَكَ وَلَداً وَلَمْ أدْعُ لَكَ شَريكا مَنّا مِنْكَ بِهِ عَليّ لامنّا مِنّي بِهِ عَلَيْكَ، وَقَدْ عَصَيْتُكَ ياإلهي عَلى غَيْرِ وَجْهِ المُكابَرَةِ وَلا الخُروجَ عَنْ عُبودِيَّتِكَ وَلا الجُحودِ لِرِبوبيَّتِكَ،

ولكِنْ أطَعْتُ هَوايَ وَأزَلَّني الشَّيْطانُ فَلَكَ الحُجَّةُ عَليّ وَالبَيانُ، فَإنْ تُعَذِبْني فَبِذنوبي غَيْرَ ظالِمٍ وَإنْ تَغْفِرْ لي وَتَرْحَمْنِي فَإنَّكَ جَوادٌ كَريمٌ.
segments.translation: and there is no power and no might save with Allah, the All-high, the All-Great.
O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic:
ياآمِنا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيٍ وَكُلُّ شَيٍ مِنْكَ خائِفٌ حَذِرٌ أسْأَلَكَ بِأمْنِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيٍ وَخَوفِ كُلِّ شَيٍ مِنْكَ
أنْ تُصَلّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وِآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَأنْ تُعْطيَني أمانا لِنَفْسي وَأهْلي وَمالي وَوَلَدي
حَتّى لاأخافَ أحَداً وَلاأحْذَرَ مِنْ شَيٍ أبَداً إنَّكَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيٍ قَديرٌ
وَحَسْبُنا اللَّه وَنِعْمَ الوَكيلُ ياكافيَ إبْراهيمَ نَمْرودَ وَياكافيَ موسى فِرْعَوْنَ
أَسْأَلُكَ أنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآل مُحَمَّدٍ وَأنْ تَكْفيَني شَرَّ
segments.translation: All glory be to Allah and with the Praising o

segments.arabic: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْكَافِرِينَ عَرْضًا ﴿١٠٠﴾ الَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِي غِطَاءٍ عَن ذِكْرِي وَكَانُوا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا ﴿١٠١﴾ أَفَحَسِبَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَن يَتَّخِذُوا عِبَادِي مِن دُونِي أَوْلِيَاءَ ۚ إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ نُزُلًا ﴿١٠٢﴾ قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِالْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَالًا﴿١٠٣﴾ الَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا ﴿١٠٤﴾ أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَائِهِ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَزْنًا ﴿١٠٥﴾ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا وَاتَّخَذُوا آيَاتِي وَرُسُلِي هُزُوًا ﴿١٠٦﴾ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا﴿١٠٧﴾ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًا ﴿١٠٨﴾ قُل لَّوْ كَانَ الْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِّكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ الْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَاتُ رَبِّي وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ مَدَدًا ﴿١٠٩﴾ قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُو لِقَاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَدًا ﴿١١٠﴾
وَلاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ اكْبَرُ
وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ

text: Thursday Nights Rites (Shab e Juma) Signifance of Thursday Nights Signifance of Thursday Nights × Throughout the night Allah (s.w.t.) calls: [ Oddatol Daee , Hadees 67] -Isnât there any believing servant who calls upon Me until before dawn so that I will grant his worldly and spiritual request? -Isnât there any believing servant who repents his sins before down so that I will forgive him? -Isnât there any believing servant whose sustenance is meager and asks Me to increase it before dawn so that I will increase his sustenance? -Isnât there any ailing and believing servant who asks Me to heal him before dawn so that I will heal him? -Isnât there any oppressed believing servant who asks Me to take his right from the oppressor before dawn so that I will help him and restore his right? .â" Certain Days & Times have been preferred for Prayers . 'Thursday Nights' Shab e Juma , have a Special place in Spiritual progress :- -The Souls of our deceased relatives wait for gifts (Fateha, sadqa Quran) & cry out to us ,which we are oblivious of. -We remember our own death / grave & reflect on the inevitable end -We remember Our Imam Mahdi ajtfs who himself is Muntazar AND Muntazir Awaits the order to return & is Awaited by followers -We pray for Forgiveness of sins esp thru Dua Kumayl -We recite Ziyarat Waritha remembering Imam Hussain(as) his companions & pray to be in his camp -Recite last 10 Ayats of Sura Kahf 13 before sleeping to be saved from Dajjal ...& We pray for the Oppressed , the ill & the deprived Momineen × . title: Duas.org

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيٍْء
segments.transliteration: allahumma in-ni as-aluka bi-rah-matikal-lati wasi`at kul-la shay
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which embraces all things;

segments.arabic: وَبِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِي قَهَرْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيٍْء
segments.transliteration: wa bi-qu-watikal-lati qahar-ta biha kul-la shay
segments.translation: And by Your strength, through which You dominatest all things,
And toward which all things are humble
And before which all things are lowly;

segments.arabic: وَبِجَبرُوتِكَ الَّتِي غَلَبْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيٍْء
segments.transliteration: wa bi-jabarutikal-lati ghalab-ta biha kul-la shay
segments.translation: And by Your invincibility through which You overwhelmest all things,

segments.arabic: وَبِعِزَّتِكَ الَّتِي لا يَقُومُ لَهَا شَيْءٌ
segments.transliteration: wa bi`izzatikal-lati la yaqumu laha shay
segments.translation: And by Your might, which nothing can resist;
And by Your tremendousness, which has filled all things;
by Your force, which towers over all things;

segments.arabic: وَبِوَجْهِكَ الْبَاقِي بَعْدَ فَنَاءِ كُلِّ شَيٍْء
segments.transliteration: wa bi-waj-hikal-baqi ba`da fana-i kul-li shay
segments.translation: And by Your face, which subsists after the annihilation of all things,

segments.arabic: وَبِأَسْمَائِكَ الَّتِي مَلأَتْ أَرْكَانَ كُلِّ شَيٍْء
segments.transliteration: wa bi-as-ma-ikal-lati malat ar-kana kul-li shay
segments.translation: And by Your Names, which have filled the foundations of all things;
And by Your knowledge, which encompasses all things;

segments.arabic: وَبِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِي أَضَاءَ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيٍْء
segments.transliteration: wa bi-nuri waj-hikal-ladhi ada-a lahu kul-lu shay
segments.translation: And by the light of Your face, through which all things are illumined!
O Light! O All-holy!
O First of those who are first
And O Last of those who are last!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَهتِكُ الْعِصَمَ
segments.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins which tear apart safeguards!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُنْزِلُ النِّقَمَ
segments.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down adversities!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُغيِّرُ النِّعَمَ
segments.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins which alter blessings!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَحْبِسُ الدُّعَاءَ
segments.translation: O Allah forgive me those sins which hold back supplication!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَقْطَعُ الرََّّجَاءَ
segments.translation: O Allah forgive me those sins which cut down the hopes!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُنْزِلُ البَلاءَ
segments.translation: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down tribulation!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ وَكُلَّ خَطِيئَةٍ أَخْطَأْتُهَا
segments.transliteration: allahumma-igh-fir liya kul-la dham-bin adhnabtuhu wa kul-la khati-atin akh-tatuha
segments.translation: O Allah, forgive me every sin I have committed and every mistake I have made!
O Allah, verily I seek nearness to You through remembrance of You,
And I seek intercession from You with Yourself,

segments.arabic: وَأَسْألُكَ بِجُودِكَ أَن تُدْنِيَنِي مِن قُرْبِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa as-aluka bi-judika an tud-ni-yani min qur-bik
segments.translation: And I ask You through Your munificence to bring me near to Your proximity,
And to provide me with gratitude toward You
And to inspire me with Your remembrance.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ سُؤَالَ خَاضِعٍ مُّتَذَلِّلٍ خَاشِعٍ أَن تُسَامِحَنِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي
segments.transliteration: allahumma in-ni as-luka suala khadii'm-mutadhal-lilin kha-shii'n an tusamihani wa tar-hamani
segments.translation: O Allah, verily I ask You with the asking of a submissive, abased and lowly man to show me forbearance, to have mercy on me

segments.arabic: وَتَجْعلَنِي بِقَسَمِكَ رَاضِياً قَانِعاً، وَفِي جَمِيعِ الأَحْوَاِل مُتَوَاضِعاً
segments.transliteration: wa taj-`alani bi-qasamika radiyan qani`n wa fi jamii'l-ah-wali mutawadi`aa
segments.translation: And to make me satisfied and content with Your appointment and [make me] humble in every state.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَسْألُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma wa as-aluka suala manish-tad-dat faqatuh
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You the question of one whose indigence is extreme,
And who has stated to You in difficulties his need
And whose desire for what is with You has become great.
O Allah, Your force is tremendous, Your place is lofty,
And Your plan is hidden, Your command is manifest,

segments.transliteration: wa ghalaba qah-ruka wa jarat qud-ratuk
segments.translation: And Your domination is overwhelming, Your power is unhindered
And escape from Your governance is impossible.
O Allah, I find no forgiver of my sins,
Nor concealer of my ugly acts

segments.arabic: وَّلا لِشَيٍْء مِّنْ عَمَلِي الْقَبِيحِ بِالْحَسَنِ مُبَدِّلاً غَيْرَكَ
segments.translation: Nor transformer of any of my ugly acts into good acts but You
There is no god but You!
Glory be to You, and Thine is the praise!
I have wronged myself,
And I have been audacious in my ignorance

segments.arabic: وَسَكَنتُ إِلَي قَدِيمِ ذِكْرِكَ لِي وَمَنِّكَ عَلَيَّ
segments.transliteration: wa sakan-tu ila qadimi dhik-rika li wa man-nika `alay
segments.translation: And I have depended upon Your ancient remembrance of me and Your favour toward me.
O Allah! O my Protector!
How many ugly things You hast concealed!

segments.arabic: وَكَم مِّن فَاِدحٍ مِّنَ البَلاءِ أَقَلْتَهُ
segments.translation: How many burdensome tribulations You hast abolished!
And how many stumbles You hast prevented!
And how many ordeals You hast repelled!

segments.arabic: وَكَم مِّن ثَنَاٍء جَمِيلٍ لَّسْتُ أَهْلاً لَّهُ نَشَرْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa kam-min thana-in jamilil-las-tu ah-lal-lahu nashar-tah
segments.translation: And how much beautiful praise, for which I was unworthy, You hast spread abroad!
O Allah, my tribulation is tremendous,
And my bad state is excessive,
And my acts are inadequate,
And my fetters have tied me down,
And my far-fetched hopes have held me back from my gain

segments.arabic: وَخَدَعَتْنِي الدُّنْيَا بِغُرُورِهَا وَنَفْسِي بِجِنَايَتِهَا وَمِطَاِلي
segments.transliteration: wa khada`at-nid-dunya bi-ghururi-ha wa naf-si bi-jinayatiha wa mita-li
segments.translation: And this world with its delusions, my own soul with its offences and my delay have deceived me.

segments.arabic: يَا سَيِّدِي فَأَسْألُكَ بِعِزَّتِكَ أَن لا يَحْجُبَ عَنْكَ دُعَائِي سُوءُ عَمَلِي وَفِعَاِلي
segments.transliteration: ya say-yidi fa-as-aluka bi-i'z-zatika an la yah-juba `an-ka du`aa-i suo-u `amali wa fi`ali
segments.translation: O my Master! So I ask You by Your might not to let my evil works and acts veil my supplication from You,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَفْضَحَنِي بِخَفِيِّ مَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سِرِّي
segments.transliteration: wa-la taf-dah-ni bi-khafi-yi mat-tala`ta `ailayhi min sir-ri
segments.translation: And not to disgrace me through the hidden things You knowest of my secrets

segments.arabic: وَلا تُعَاجِلْنِي بِالْعُقُوبَةِ عَلَى مَا عَمِلْتُهُ فِي خَلَوَاتِي
segments.transliteration: wa-la tu`ajil-ni bil-u'qubati `ala ma `amil-tuhu fi khalawati
segments.translation: And not to hasten me to punishment for what I have done in private:
My evil acts in secrecy and my misdeeds
And my continuous negligence and my ignorance
And my manifold passions and my forgetfulness.

segments.arabic: وَكُنِ اَللَّهُمَّ بِعِزَّتِكَ لِي فِي كُلِّ الأَحْوَاِل رَؤُوفاً
segments.transliteration: wa kunil-lahumma bi-i'z-zatika li fi kul-lil-ah-wali ra’ufa
segments.translation: And by Your might, O Allah, be kind to me in all states
And be gracious to me in all affairs!

segments.arabic: إِلَهِي وَرَبِّي مَن لِّي غَيْرُكَ أَسْألُهُ كَشْفَ ضُرِّي وَالْنَّظَرَ فِي أَمْرِي!
segments.transliteration: ilahi wa rab-bi mal-li ghayruka as-aluhu kash-fa dur-ri wan-nazara fi am-ri!
segments.translation: My God and my Lord! Have I any but You from whom to ask removal of my affliction and regard for my affairs!

segments.arabic: إِلَهِي وَمَوْلاي أَجْرَيْتَ عَلَيَّ حُكْماً اتَّبَعْتُ فِيهِ هَوَى نَفْسِي،
segments.transliteration: ilahi wa maw-laya aj-rayta `alay-ya huk-mant-taba`tu fihi hawa naf-si
segments.translation: My God and my Protector! You put into effect through me a decree in which I followed the caprice of my own soul

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ أَحْتَرِسْ فِيهِ مِن تَزْيينِ عَدُوِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa lam ah-taris fihi min tazyini `adu-wi
segments.translation: And [I] did not remain wary of adorning my enemy.

segments.arabic: فَغَرَّنِي بِمَا أَهْوَى وَأَسْعَدَهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ القَضَاءُ
segments.transliteration: fa-ghar-rani bi-ma ah-wa wa as-`adahu `ala dha-likal-qada
segments.translation: So he deluded me through my soul's caprice and therein destiny favoured him

segments.arabic: فَتَجَاوَزْتُ بِمَا جَرَى عَلَيَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ بَعْضَ حُدُودِكَ
segments.transliteration: fa-taja-waztu bi-ma jara `alay-ya min dha-lika ba`da hududik
segments.translation: So, in what was put into effect through me in that situation, I transgressed some of Your statutes
And disobeyed some of Your commands.

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحُجَّةُ عَلَيَّ فِي جَمِيعِ ذَلِكَ
segments.translation: So Thine is the argument against me in all of that

segments.arabic: وَلا حُجَّةَ لِي فِيمَا جَرَي عَلَيَّ فِيهِ قَضَاؤُكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-la huj-jata li fima jara `alay-ya fihi qadauka
segments.translation: I have no argument in what Your destiny put into effect through me therein
nor in what Your decree and Your tribulation imposed upon me.

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ أَتَيْتُكَ يَا إِلَهِي بَعْدَ تَقْصِيرِي وَإِسْرَافِي عَلَى نَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: wa qad ataytuka ya ilahi ba`da taq-siri wa is-rafi `ala naf-si
segments.translation: Now I have come to You, My God, after my shortcoming and my immoderation toward myself,
Proffering my excuse, regretful,
Broken, apologizing,
Asking forgiveness, repenting,
Acknowledging, submissive, confessing.

segments.arabic: لا أَجِدُ مَفَرّاً مِّمَّا كَانَ مِنِّي
segments.translation: I find no place to flee from what occurred through me,

segments.arabic: وَلا مَفْزَعاً أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْهِ في أَمْرِي
segments.transliteration: wa-la mafza'an atawaj-jahu ilayhi fi am-ri
segments.translation: Nor any place of escape to which I may turn in my affairs,

segments.arabic: غَيْرَ قَبُولِكَ عُذْرِي، وَإِدخَاِلكَ إِيَاي فِي سَعَةٍ مِّن رَّحْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: ghayra qabulika u'dhri wa id-khalika i-yaya fi sa'tim-mir-rah-matik
segments.translation: Other than Your acceptance of my excuse and Your entering me into the compass of Your mercy.
O Allah, so accept my excuse,
Have mercy upon the severity of my affliction
And release me from the tightness of my fetters,

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ ارْحَمْ ضَعْفَ بَدَنِي وَرِقَّةَ جِلْدِي وَدِقَّةَ عَظْمِي
segments.transliteration: ya rab-bir-ham da`fa badani wa riq-qata jil-di wa diq-qata `azmi
segments.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon the weakness of my body, the thinness of my skin and the frailty of my bones.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ بَدَأَ خَلْقِي وَذِكْرِي وَتَرْبِيَتِي وَبِرِّي وَتَغْذِيَتِي
segments.transliteration: ya mam bada khal-qi wa dhik-ri wa tar-bi-yati wa biri wa tagh-dhi-yati
segments.translation: O You who gave rise to my creation, to the remembrance of me, to the nurture of me, to goodness toward me and to nourishment on me,

segments.arabic: هَبْنِي لابْتِدَاءِ كَرَمِكَ وَسَاِلفِ بِرِّكَ بِي
segments.transliteration: hab-ni lb-tida-i karamika wa salifi bir-rika bi
segments.translation: Bestow upon me for the sake of Your having given rise [to me] with generosity and Your previous goodness to me!

segments.transliteration: ya ilahi wa say-yidi wa rab-bi
segments.translation: O Allah, my Master and my Lord!
Canst You see Yourself tormenting me with Your fire after I have professed Your Unity

segments.arabic: وَبَعْدَ مَا انْطَوَى عَلَيْهِ قَلْبِي مِن مَّعْرِفَتِكَ
segments.translation: And after the knowledge of You my heart has embraced,

segments.transliteration: wa lahija bihi lisani min dhik-rik
segments.translation: And the remembrance of You my tongue has constantly mentioned
And the love of You to which my mind has clung,

segments.arabic: وَبَعْدَ صِدْقِ اعْتِرَافِي وَدُعَائِي خَاضِعاً لِّرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa ba`da sid-qi-`a-tirafi wa du`aa-i khadi`aal-li-rububi-yatika
segments.translation: And after the sincerity of my confession and my supplication, humble before Your lordship?

segments.arabic: هَيْهَاتَ أَنتَ أَكْرَمُ مِنْ أَن تُضَيِّعَ مَن رَّبَّيْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: hayhata anta ak-ramu min an tuday-yi`a mar-rab-baytah
segments.translation: Far be it from You! You art more generous than that You shouldst squander him whom You hast nurtured,
Or banish him whom You hast brought nigh,
Or drive away him whom You hast given an abode

segments.arabic: أَوْ تُسْلِّمَ إِلىَ الْبلاءِ مَن كَفَيْتَهُ وَرَحِمْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: aw tus-s-lima ilal-bala-i man kafay-tahu wa rahim-tah
segments.translation: Or submit to tribulation him whom You hast spared and shown mercy.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْتَ شِعْرِي يَا سَيِّدِي وَإِلَهِي وَمَوْلاي
segments.transliteration: wa layta shi`a-ri yay say-yidi wa ilahi wa maw-lay
segments.translation: Would that I knew, my Master, My God and my Protector,

segments.arabic: أَتُسَلِّطُ النَّارَ عَلَى وُجُوهٍ خَرَّتْ لِعَظَمَتِكَ سَاجِدَةً
segments.translation: Whether You wilt give the Fire dominion over faces fallen down prostrate before Your Tremendousness,

segments.arabic: وَّعَلَى أَلْسُنٍ نَّطَقَتْ بِتَوْحِيدِكَ صَادِقَةً وَّبِشُكْرِكَ مَادِحَةً
segments.transliteration: wa `ala al-sunin-nataqat bi-taw-hidika sadiqataw-wa bishuk-rika madihah
segments.translation: And over tongues voicing sincerely the profession of Your Unity and giving thanks to You in praise,
And over hearts acknowledging Your Divinity through verification,

segments.arabic: وَّعَلَى ضَمَائِرَ حَوَتْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ بِكَ حَتَّى صَارَتْ خَاشِعَةً
segments.transliteration: wa `ala dama-ira hawat minal-i'l-mi bika hat-ta sarat khashi`ah
segments.translation: And over minds encompassing knowledge of You until they have become humble

segments.arabic: وَّعَلَى جَواِرحَ سَعَتْ إِلَى أَوْطَانِ تَعَبُّدِكَ طَائِعَةً وَّأَشَارَتْ بِاسْتِغْفَارِكَ مُذْعِنَةً
segments.transliteration: wa `ala jawariha sa't ila aw-tani ta'b-budika ta-i`ataw-wa asharat bis-tigh-farika mudhi'nah
segments.translation: And over bodily members speeding to the places of Your worship in obedience and beckoning for Your forgiveness in submission.

segments.arabic: مَّا هَكَذَا الظَّنُّ بِكَ وَلا أُخْبِرْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ عَنكَ
segments.transliteration: ma hkadhaz-zan-nu bika wa-la ukh-bir-na bi-fadlika `anka
segments.translation: No such opinion is held of You! Nor has such been reported - thanks to Your bounty — concerning You,
O All-generous! My Lord,

segments.arabic: وَأَنتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفِي عَن قَلِيلٍ مِّن بَلاءِ الدُّنْيَا وَعُقُوبَاتِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa anta ta`lamu da`fi `an qalilim-min bala-id-dun-ya wa u'qubatiha
segments.translation: And You knowest my weakness before a little of this world's tribulations and punishments,

segments.arabic: وَمَا يَجْرِي فِيهَا مِنَ الْمَكَارِهِ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa ma yaj-ri fiha minal-makarihi `ala ah-liha
segments.translation: And before those ordeals which befall its inhabitants,

segments.arabic: عَلَى أَنَّ ذَلِكَ بَلاءٌ وَّمَكْرُوهٌ، قَلِيلٌ مَّكْثُهُ، يَسِيرٌ بَقَاؤُهُ، قَصِيرٌ مُّدَّتُهُ
segments.transliteration: `ala an-na dha-lika bala-uw-wa mak-ruhun, qalilum-mak-thuhu, yasirum baqa-uhu, qasirum-mud-datuh
segments.translation: Even though it is a tribulation and ordeal whose stay is short, whose subsistence is but little and, whose period is but fleeting.

segments.arabic: فَكَيْفَ احْتِمَاِلي لِبَلاءِ الآخِرَةِ وَجَلِيلِ وُقُوعِ الْمَكَارِهِ فِيهَا!
segments.transliteration: fa-kayfah-timali li-bala-il-akhirati wa jalili wuqui'l-makarihi fiha!
segments.translation: So how can I endure the tribulations of the next world and the great ordeals that occur within it?

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ بَلاءٌ تَطُولُ مُدَّتُهُ، وَيَدُومُ مَقَامُهُ، وَلا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa huwa bala-un tatulu mud-datuhu, wa yadumu maqamuhu, wa-la yukhaf-fafu `an ah-lih
segments.translation: For it is a tribulation whose period is long, whose station endures and whose sufferers are given no respite,

segments.arabic: لأَنَّهُ لا يَكُونُ إِلاَّ عَنْ غَضَبِكَ وَانتِقَامِكَ وَسَخَطِكَ
segments.transliteration: li-an-nahu la yakunu il-la `an ghadabika wan-tiqamika wa sakhatik
segments.translation: Since it only occurs as a result of Your wrath, Your vengeance and Your anger,

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا مَا لا تَقُومُ لَهُ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالأَرْضُ
segments.transliteration: wa hadha ma la taqumu lahus-samawatu wal-ardu
segments.translation: And these cannot be withstood by the heavens and the earth.
O Master, so what about me?!

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ الضَّعِيفُ الذَّلِيلُ الْحَقِيرُ الْمِسْكِينُ الْمُسْتَكِينُ
segments.translation: For I am Your weak, lowly, base, wretched and miserable slave.

segments.transliteration: ya ilahi wa rab-bi wa say-yidi wa maw-lay
segments.translation: My God! My Lord! My Master! My Protector!
For which things would I complain to You?

segments.transliteration: wa lima minha adij-ju wa ab-ki
segments.translation: And for which of them would I lament and weep?
For the pain and severity of chastisement?
Or for the length and period of tribulation?
So if You takest me to the punishments with Your enemies,

segments.transliteration: wa jama`ta bayni wa bayna ahli bala-ik
segments.translation: And gatherest me with the people of Your tribulation

segments.transliteration: wa far-raq-ta bay-ni wa bay-na ahib-ba-ika wa aw-li-ya-ik
segments.translation: And separatest me from Your friends and saints,

segments.arabic: فَهَبْنِي يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي وَرَبِّي صَبَرْتُ عَلَى عَذَابِكَ،
segments.transliteration: fa-hab-ni ya ilahi wasay-yidi wa mawlaya wa rab-bi sabar-tu `ala `adhabika
segments.translation: Then suppose, My God, my Master, my Protector and my Lord that I am able to endure Your chastisement,
How can I endure separation from You?
And suppose that I am able to endure the heat of Your fire,

segments.arabic: فَكَيْفَ أَصْبِرُ عَنِ النَّظَرِ إِلَى كَرَامَتِكَ
segments.translation: How can I endure not gazing upon Your generosity?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ أَسْكُنُ فِي النَّارِ وَرَجَائِي عَفْوُكَ
segments.transliteration: am kayfa as-kunu fin-nari wa raja-i `af-wuk
segments.translation: Or how can I dwell in the Fire while my hope is Your pardon?

segments.arabic: فَبِعِزَّتِكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي أُقْسِمُ صَادِقاً، لَئِن تَرَكْتَنِي نَاطِقاً
segments.transliteration: fabi-i'z-zatika ya say-yidi wa mawlaya uq-simu sadiqal-la-in tarak-tani natiqan
segments.translation: So by Your might, my Master and my protector, I swear sincerely, if You leavest me with speech,

segments.arabic: لأَضِجَّنَّ إِلَيْكَ بَيْنَ أَهْلِهَا ضَجِيجَ الآمِلِينَ
segments.translation: I will lament to You from the midst of the Fire's inhabitants with lamentation of the hopeful;
I will cry to You with the cry of those crying for help;
I will weep to You with the weeping of the bereft;

segments.arabic: وَلأُنَادِيَنَّكَ أَيْنَ كُنتَ يَا وَلِيَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa la-unadi-yan-naka ay-na kun-ta ya wali-yal-mu-minin
segments.translation: And I will call to You, Where art You, O Sponsor of the believers,
O Goal of the hopes of Your knowers,
O Aid of those who seek assistance,
O Friend of the hearts of the sincere
And O God of all the world's inhabitants!

segments.arabic: أَفَتُرَاكَ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا إِلَهِي وَبِحَمْدِكَ، تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا صَوْتَ عَبْدٍ مُّسْلِمٍ
segments.transliteration: afaturaka sub-hanaka ya ilahi wa biham-dika tas-mau' fiha saw-ta `ab-dim-mus-limin
segments.translation: Canst You see Yourself — Glory be to You My God, and Thine is the praised — hearing within the Fire the voice of a slave surrendered to You,
Imprisoned there because of his violations,
Tasting the favour of its torment because of his disobedience,

segments.transliteration: wa hubisa bayna at-baqiha bijur-mih wa jariratih
segments.translation: And confined within its levels because of his sin and crime,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ يَضِجُّ إلَيْكَ ضَجِيجَ مُؤَمِّلٍ لِّرَحْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa huwa yadij-ju ilayka dajija muammilil-lirah-mat-k
segments.translation: While he laments to You with the lament of one hopeful for Your mercy,
And calls to You with the tongue of those who profess Your Unity
And entreats You by Your lordship!

segments.arabic: يَا مَوْلاي فَكَيْفَ يَبقَى فِي الْعَذَابِ وَهُوَ يَرْجُو مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ حِلْمِكَ
segments.transliteration: ya mawlay fa-kayfa yabqa fil-`adhabi wa huwa yar-ju ma salafa min hil-mik
segments.translation: My Protector, so how should he remain in the chastisement, while he has hope for Your previous clemency?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ تُؤْلِمُهُ النَّارُ وَهُوَ يَامَلُ فَضْلَكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ
segments.transliteration: am kayfa tu-limuhun-naru wa huwa ya-malu fadlaka wa rah-mataka
segments.translation: Or how should the Fire cause him pain while he expects Your bounty and mercy?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ يُحْرِقُهُ لَهِيبُهَا وَأَنتَ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتَهُ وَتَرَى مَكَانَهُ
segments.transliteration: am kayfa yuh-riquhu lahibuha wa anta tas-mau' saw-tahu wa tara makanah
segments.translation: Or how should its flames burn him, while You hearest his voice and seest his place?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ زَفِيرُهَا وَأَنتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفَهُ
segments.transliteration: am kayfa yash-tamilu `ailayhi zafiruha wa anta ta`lamu da`fah
segments.translation: Or how should its groaning encompass him, while You knowest his weakness?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَتَقَلْقَلُ بَيْنَ أَطْبَاقِهَا وَأَنتَ تَعْلَمُ صِدْقَهُ
segments.transliteration: am kayfa yataqalqalu bayna at-baqiha wa anta ta`lamu sid-qah
segments.translation: Or how should he be convulsed among its levels, while You knowest his sincerity?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ تَزْجُرُهُ زَبَانِيَتُهَا وَهُوَ يُنَادِيكَ يَا رَبَّهُ
segments.transliteration: am kayfa tazjuruhu zabani-yatuha wa huwa yunadika ya rab-bah
segments.translation: Or how should its keepers torture him while he calls out to You, O Lord?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَرْجُو فَضْلَكَ فِي عِتْقِهِ مِنْهَا فَتَتْرُكُهُ فِيهَا
segments.transliteration: am kayfa yar-ju fadlaka fi i't-qihi minha fatat-rukuhu fiha
segments.translation: Or how should he have hope of Your bounty in freeing him from it, while You abandonest him within it?
Far be it from You! That is not what is expected of You,
Nor what is well-known of Your bounty,

segments.arabic: وَلا مُشْبِهٌ لِمَا عَامَلْتَ بِهِ الْمُوَحِّدِينَ مِنْ بِرِّكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa-la mush-biha lima `amal-ta bihil-muah-hidina mim bir-rika wa ih-sanik
segments.translation: Nor it is similar to the goodness and kindness You hast shown to those who profess Your Unity.

segments.arabic: فَبِالْيَقِينِ أَقْطَعُ لَوْلا مَا حَكَمْتَ بِهِ مِن تَعْذِيبِ جَاحِدِيكَ
segments.transliteration: fa-bial-yaqini aq-tau' law-la ma hakam-ta bihi min ta`dhibi jahidik
segments.translation: So I declare with certainty that were it not for what You hast decreed concerning the chastisement of Your deniers

segments.transliteration: wa qadayta bihi min ikh-laydi mu`anidik
segments.translation: And what You hast foreordained concerning the everlasting home of those who stubbornly resist,
You wouldst make the Fire, all of it, coolness and safety,

segments.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لأَحَدٍ فِيهَا مَقَرّاً وَّلا مُقَاماً
segments.transliteration: wa ma kana li-ahadin fiha maqar-raw-wa-la muqama
segments.translation: And no one would have a place of rest or abode within it.

segments.arabic: لَّكِنَّكَ تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُكَ أَقْسَمْتَ أَنْ تَمْلأَهَا مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ،
segments.transliteration: lakin-naka taqad-dasat as-ma-uka aq-sam-ta an tam-laha minal-kafirina;
segments.translation: But You—holy are Your Names—hast sworn that You wilt fill it with the unbelievers,
Both Jinn and men together,
And that You wilt place those who stubbornly resist therein forever.

segments.arabic: وَأَنتَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ قُلْتَ مُبْتَدَئاً، وَّتَطَوَّلْتَ بِالإِنْعَامِ مُتَكَرِّماً:
segments.transliteration: wa anta jal-la thana-uka qul-ta mub-tadiwaw-wa tataw-wal-ta bil-in-`ami mutakar-rima
segments.translation: And You— majestic is Your eulogy— said at the beginning and wernt gracious through kindness as a favour,

segments.arabic: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا ۚ لَّا يَسْتَوُونَ
segments.transliteration: afaman kana muminan kaman kana fasiqal-la yas-tawun
segments.translation: (What? Is he who has been believer like unto him who has been ungodly? They are not equal)

segments.arabic: إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي فَأَسْألُكَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِي قَدَّرْتَهَا
segments.transliteration: ilahi wa say-yidi fa-as-aluka bial-qud-ratil-lati qad-dartaha
segments.translation: My God and my Master! So I ask You by the power You hast apportioned

segments.arabic: وَبِالْقَضِيَّةِ الَّتِي حَتَمْتَهَا وَحَكَمْتَهَا وَغَلَبْتَ مَنْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرَيْتَهَا
segments.transliteration: wa bil-qadi-yatil-lati hatam-taha wa hakam-taha wa ghalab-ta man `ailayhi aj-raytaha
segments.translation: And by the decision which You hast determined and imposed and through which You hast overcome him toward whom it has been put into effect,

segments.arabic: أَن تَهَبَ لِي، فِي هذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَفِي هَذِهِ السَّاعَةِ
segments.transliteration: an tahaba li fi hadhihil-laylati wa fi hadhihis-sa'ah
segments.translation: That You forgivest me in this night and at this hour
Every offence I have committed,
And every sin I have performed,
And every ugly thing I have concealed
And every folly I have enacted
Whether I have hidden or announced it,
Or I have concealed it or manifested it

segments.arabic: وَكُلَّ سَيِّئَةٍ أَمَرْتَ بِإِثْبَاتِهَا الْكِرَامَ الكَاتِبِينَ
segments.translation: And every evil act which You hast commanded the Noble Writers to record,

segments.arabic: الَّذِينَ وَكَّلْتَهُم بِحِفْظِ مَا يَكُونُ مِنِّي
segments.transliteration: al-ladhina wak-kal-tahum bi-hif-zi ma yakunu min-ni
segments.translation: Those whom You hast appointed to watch over what appears from me
And whom You hast made, along with my bodily members, witness against me.

segments.arabic: وَكُنتَ أَنتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيَّ مِن وَّرَائِهِمْ،
segments.translation: And You wast Yourself the Watcher over me from behind them,
And the Witness of what is hidden from them
But through Your mercy You concealed it
And through Your bounty You veiled it.

segments.arabic: وَأَن تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّي مِن كُلِّ خَيْرٍ تُنْزِلُهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa an tuwf-fira haz-zi min kul-li khayrin tunziluh
segments.translation: [And I ask You] that You bestowest upon me an abundant share of every good You sendest down,
Or kindness You conferrest,
Or goodness You unfoldest,
Or provision You spreadest out,
Or sin You forgivest,
Or error You coverest.

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
segments.transliteration: ya rab-bi ya rab-bi ya rabb
segments.translation: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!

segments.arabic: يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلاي وَمَاِلكَ رِقِّي
segments.transliteration: ya ilahi wa say-yidi wa maw-laya wa malika riq-qi
segments.translation: My God! My Master! My Protector! Owner of my bondage!
O He in whose hand is my forelock!
O He who knows my affliction and my misery!
O He who is aware of my poverty and indigence!

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
segments.transliteration: ya rab-bi ya ya rab-bi ya rabb
segments.translation: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!
I ask You by Your Truth and Your Holiness
And the greatest of Your Attributes and Names,

segments.arabic: أن تَجْعَلَ أَوْقَاتِي فِي اللَّيلِ وَالنَّهَارِ بِذِكْرِكَ مَعْمُورَةً،
segments.transliteration: an taj-`ala aw-qati fil-layli wan-nahari bi-dhik-rika ma`murah
segments.translation: That You makest my times in the night and the day inhabited by Your remembrance,
And joined to Your service
And my works acceptable to You,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَعْمَاِلي وَأَوْرَادِي كُلُّهَا وِرْداً وَّاحِداً،
segments.transliteration: hat-ta takuna a`mali wa aw-radi kul-luha wir-daw-wahidan
segments.translation: So that my works and my litanies may all be a single litany
And my occupation with Your service everlasting.

segments.arabic: يَا سَيِّدِي، يَا مَنْ عَلَيْهِ مُعَوَّلِي
segments.translation: My Master! O He upon whom I depend!
O He to whom I complain about my states!

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
segments.transliteration: ya rab-bi ya rab-bi ya rabb
segments.translation: My Lord! My Lord! My Lord!
Strengthen my bodily members in Your service,
And fortify my ribs in determination
And bestow upon me earnestness in my fear of You
And continuity in my being joined to Your service

segments.arabic: حَتَّى أَسْرَحَ إِلَيكَ فِي مَيَادِينِ السَّابِقِينَ
segments.translation: So that I may move easily toward You in the battlefields of the foremost
And hurry to You among the prominent
And desire fervently Your proximity among the fervently desirous
And move nearer to You with the nearness of the sincere
And fear You with the fear of those who have certitude
And gather with the believers in Your vicinity.

segments.transliteration: allahumma wa man aradani bisuo-in farid-hu
segments.translation: O Allah, whoever desires evil for me, desire [it] for him!
whoever deceives me-deceive him!

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَحَسَنِ عَبِيدِكَ نَصِيباً عِنْدَكَ
segments.translation: And make me one of the most excellent of Your slaves in Portion from You,
And the nearest of them in station to You
And the most elected of them in proximity to You.

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لا يُنَالُ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ بِفَضْلِكَ
segments.transliteration: fa-in-nahu la yunalu dha-lika il-la bi-fadlik
segments.translation: For that cannot be attained except by Your bounty.
And grant generously to me through Your munificence,
And incline toward me with Your splendour
And protect me with Your mercy!
And make my tongue remember You without ceasing
And my heart enthralled by Your love!
And be gracious to me by answering me favourably,
And nullify my slips
And forgive my lapses!
For You hast decreed Your worship for Your servants
And commanded them to supplicate You
And assured them that they would be answered.
So toward You, my Lord, I have turned my face

segments.transliteration: wa ilayka ya rab-bi madad-tu yadi
segments.translation: And toward You, my Lord, I have extended my hand.
So by Your might, comply with my supplication
And make me attain my desires!
Do not severe my hoping for Your Favours

segments.arabic: وَاكْفِنِي شَرَّ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ مِنْ أَعْدَائِي
segments.translation: And spare me the evil of my enemies from among the jinn and men!
O He, whose pleasure is quickly achieved!

segments.arabic: اغْفِرْ لِمَن لا يَمْلِكُ إِلاَّ الدُّعَاءَ
segments.translation: Forgive him who owns nothing but supplication
For You dost what You wilt.
O He whose Name is a remedy,
And whose remembrance is a cure,
And whose obedience is wealth!
Have mercy upon him whose capital is hope
And whose weapon is tears!
O Ample in blessings!
O Repeller of adversities!
O Light of those who are lonely in the darkness!
O Knower who was never taught!
Bless Muhammad and Muhammad's household!
And do with me what is worthy of You!

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ وَالأَئِمَّةِ الْمَيَامِينَ مِنْ آلِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa sal-lallahu `ala rasulihi wal-aimmatil-mayamina min a-lihi
segments.translation: And Allah bless His messenger and the holy Imams of his household
And give them abundant peace!

reference: Misbah al-Mutahajjid by Shaykh al-Tusi (d. 460 A.H.)

segments.arabic: وَبِحُبِّكُمْ وَبِقُرْبِكُمْ ارْجُو نَجَاةً مِنَ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: wa bihubbikum wa biqurbikum arju najatan mina allahi
segments.translation: and through my love for you and my seeking nearness to you do I hope for salvation from Allah.
So, be my hope before Allah.
O my masters! O Allahâs intimate servants!
May Allah bless you all

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu a`da'a allahi zalimihim
segments.translation: and may Allah curse the enemies of Allah; those who wronged you,
from the past and the last generations.
Respond to us, O Lord of the Worlds!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى ابْنَتِهِ وَ عَلَى ابْنَيْهَا وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِهِمْ أَنْ تُعِينَنِي عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ وَ رِضْوَانِك
segments.translation: Oh Allah send your blessings on Mohammad and his daughter and her children and I ask you for their sake that you help me in your obedience and in pleasing you and

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تُبَلِّغَنِي بِهِمْ أَفْضَلَ مَا بَلَّغْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ إِنَّكَ جَوَادٌ كَرِيمٌ‏
segments.translation: because of them make me attain the loftiest of position near you like your sincere worshipers. Verily you give generously when asked and without asking.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِلاَّ انْتَقَمْتَ بِهِ مِمَّنْ ظَلَمَنِي وَ غَشَمَنِي
segments.translation: Oh Allah I ask you for the sake of Ameer Al Momineen Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) that you take revenge from the people who have oppressed me and are my enemies

segments.arabic: وَ آذَانِي وَ انْطَوَى عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَ كَفَيْتَنِي بِهِ مَئُونَةَ كُلِّ أَحَدٍ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِين
segments.translation: and have troubled me and continue to do so and for his sake make me free from wants so that I should not ask from anyone else, oh the most merciful.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ وَلِيِّكَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِلاَّ كَفَيْتَنِي بِهِ مَئُونَةَ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيد
segments.translation: Oh Allah I ask you for the sake of Ali ibn Hussain (as) that you repel the evil that could occur through satan Â

segments.arabic: وَ سُلْطَانٍ عَنِيدٍ يَتَقَوَّى عَلَيَّ بِبَطْشِهِ وَ يَنْتَصِرُ عَلَيَّ بِجُنْدِهِ إِنَّكَ جَوَادٌ كَرِيمٌ يَا وَهَّاب
segments.translation: and the arrogant and stubborn king who uses his power to torture me and acts like he can win over me because of his army.Verily you give generously when asked and without asking,oh bestower.
