title: Du`a Mashlool Duas.org

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O Allah, verily I beseech You by Your Name:
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O Lord of majesty and honor!
O Ever-living! O Self-subsistent!

segments.arabic: يَا حَيُّ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انتَ
segments.transliteration: ya hayyu la ilaha illa anta
segments.translation: O Ever-Living! There is no god but You!

segments.arabic: يَا هُوَ يَا مَنْ لاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا هُوَ
segments.transliteration: ya huwa ya man la ya`lamu ma huwa
segments.translation: O He Whom none knows what He is,
nor how He is,
nor where He is,

segments.transliteration: wa la haythu huwa illa huwa
segments.translation: nor in what respect He is, but He!
O Possessor of dominion and kingdom!
O Possessor of might and invincibility!

segments.arabic: يَا مَلِكُ يَا قُدُّوسُ يَا سَلاَمُ
segments.transliteration: ya maliku ya quddusu ya salamu
segments.translation: O King! O All-holy! O Giver of peace!
O Granter of security! O All-preserver!

segments.arabic: يَا عَزِيزُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا مُتَكَبِّرُ
segments.translation: O Almighty! O All-compeller! O All-sublime!

segments.arabic: يَا خَاِلقُ يَا بَارِئُ يَا مُصَوِّرُ
segments.translation: O Creator! O Maker! O Shaper!
O grantor of Benefits! O Director!
O Severe (in punishing the evildoers)! O Originator!
O Returner! O Destroyer!

segments.arabic: يَا وَدُودُ يَا مَحْمُودُ يَا مَعْبُودُ
segments.transliteration: ya wadudu ya mahmudu ya ma`budu
segments.translation: O All-loving! O All-praiseworthy! O All-worshipped!
O Far! O Nigh!

segments.arabic: يَا مُجِيبُ يَا رَقِيبُ يَا حَسِيبُ
segments.translation: O Responder! O Watcher! O Reckoner!
O Innovator! O Exalter!
O Inaccessible! O All-hearing!

segments.arabic: يَا عَلِيمُ يَا حَلِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ
segments.translation: O All-knowing! O All-clement! O All-generous!
O All-wise! O Eternal!
O All-high! O All-tremendous!
O All-commiserating! O All-gracious!
O Condemner! O Recourse!
O All-majestic! O All-handsome!
O Guardian! O Surety!
O Annuller! O Bestower!
O All-noble! O Leader!
O Guide! O All-Apparent!
O First! O Last!
O Outward! O Inward!
O All-steadfast! O Everlasting!
O Knower! O Decider!
O Judge! O Just!
O Separator! O Joiner!
O Pure! O Purifier!
O All-powerful! O All-able!
O All-great! O All-sublime!

segments.arabic: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا احَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
segments.transliteration: ya wahidu ya ahadu ya samadu
segments.translation: O One! O Unique! O eternally Besought of all!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
segments.transliteration: ya man lam yalid wa lam yulad
segments.translation: O He Who begets not and was not begotten,

segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu kufwan ahadun
segments.translation: equal to Whom is none,
Who has no consort,
with Him is no aide
nor has He taken any adviser,
nor needs He any assistant,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنَ إِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ
segments.transliteration: wa la kana ma`ahu min ilahin ghayruhu
segments.translation: nor with Him is any god but Heâ
there is no god but You.

segments.arabic: فَتَعَالَيْتَ عَمَّا يَقُولُ ٱلظَّالِمُونَ عُلُوّاً كَبِيراً
segments.translation: So exalted are You above what the evildoers say, a great exaltation!

segments.arabic: يَا عَلِيُّ يَا شَامِخُ يَا بَاِذخُ
segments.translation: O All-high! O All-lofty! O All-towering!

segments.arabic: يَا فَتَّاحُ يَا نَفَّاحُ يَا مُرْتَاحُ
segments.transliteration: ya fattahu ya naffahu ya murtahu
segments.translation: O All-opener! O All-diffuser! O All-restful!

segments.arabic: يَا مُفَرِّجُ يَا نَاصِرُ يَا مُنْتَصِرُ
segments.transliteration: ya mufarriju ya nasiru ya muntasiru
segments.translation: O Bestower of relief! O Helper! O Giver of victory!

segments.arabic: يَا مُدْرِكُ يَا مُهْلِكُ يَا مُنْتَقِمُ
segments.transliteration: ya mudriku ya muhliku ya muntaqimu
segments.translation: O Comprehender! O Destroyer! O Avenger!
O Upraiser! O Inheritor!
O Seeker! O Vanquisher!
O He from Whom no fugitive can escape!

segments.arabic: يَا تَوَّابُ يَا اوَّابُ يَا وَهَّابُ
segments.transliteration: ya tawwabu ya awwabu ya wahhabu
segments.translation: O All-relenting! O All-forbearing! O All-bestower!
O Originator of all means!
O Opener of all doors!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ حَيْثُ مَا دُعِي اجَابَ
segments.transliteration: ya man haythu ma du`iya ajaba
segments.translation: O He Who answers wherever He is called upon!
O All-Pure! O All-thankful!
O Exempter! O Forgiver!
O Light of light!
O Director of all affairs!
O All-subtle! O All-aware!
O Protector! O Illuminator!

segments.arabic: يَا بَصِيرُ يَا ظَهِيرُ يَا كَبِيرُ
segments.transliteration: ya basiru ya zahiru ya kabiru
segments.translation: O All-seeing! O All-aiding! O All-great!
O Alone! O Solitary!

segments.arabic: يَا ابَدُ يَا سَنَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
segments.transliteration: ya abadu ya sanadu ya samadu
segments.translation: O Eternity without end! O Support! O Everlasting Refuge!
O All-sufficient! O All-healing!
O All-fulfilling! O All-relieving!
O All-kind! O All-gracious!
O All-benevolent! O All-bountiful!
O All-beneficent! O All-solitary!
O He Who is exalted and dominates!
O He Who is master and exercises power!
O He Who is inward and aware!
O He Who is worshipped and thankful!
O He Who is disobeyed and forgives!
O He Who is not encompassed by thoughts,
nor perceived by vision,
and from Whom no trace remains hidden!
O Provider of mankind!
O Determiner of every lot!
O Lofty in place!
O Firm in supports!
O Transformer of times!
O Accepter of sacrifices!
O Lord of graciousness and benevolence!
O Lord of might and force!
O All-compassionate! O All-merciful!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ فِي شَانٍ
segments.transliteration: ya man huwa kulla yawmin fi sha'nin
segments.translation: O He Who is every day upon some labor!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَشْغَلُهُ شَانٌ عَنْ شَانٍ
segments.transliteration: ya man la yashghaluhu sha'nun `an sha'nin
segments.translation: O He Who is not distracted from one labor by another!
O Tremendous in rank!
O He Who is in every place!
O He Who hears all sounds!
O He Who answers all supplications!
O He Who fulfils all entreaties!
O He Who provides all needs!
O He Who sends down blessings!
O He Who has mercy upon tears!
O He Who annuls slips!
O He Who removes troubles!
O He Who sponsors good things!
O He Who exalts in rank!
O He Who bestows requests!
O He Who gives life to the dead!
O He Who gathers all scattered things!
O He Who is aware of all intentions!
O He Who brings back what has passed away!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ تَشْتَبِهُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلاصْوَاتُ
segments.translation: O He for Whom sounds are never indistinct!
O He Who never becomes annoyed at requests
nor covered by shadows!
O Light of the earth and the heavens!
O Ample in blessings!
O Repeller of adversities!
O Maker of the breaths of life!
O He Who gathers together the nations!
O Healer of illnesses!
O Creator of light and darkness!
O Lord of munificence and generosity!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَطَا عَرْشَهُ قَدَمٌ
segments.translation: O He upon Whose Throne no foot treads!
O Most Munificent of the most munificent!
O Most Generous of the most generous!
O Most Hearing of the hearers!
O Most Seeing of the viewers!
O Protector of those who seek protection!
O Sanctuary of the fearful!
O Asylum of the refugees!
O Patron of the believers!
O Helper of those who seek aid!
O Goal of the seekers!
O Companion of every stranger!
O Intimate of everyone alone!
O Refuge of every outcast!
O Shelter of every wanderer!
O Custodian of everyone astray!
O He Who is merciful to old men!
O He Who provides for small infants!
O He Who sets broken bones!
O He Who releases every prisoner!
O He Who enriches the miserable pauper!
O He Who safeguards the fearful seeker of protection!
O He Who governs and determines!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنِ ٱلْعَسِيرُ عَلَيْهِ سَهْلٌ يَسِيرٌ
segments.translation: O He for Whom the difficult is simple and easy!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَىٰ تَفْسِيرٍ
segments.transliteration: ya man la yahtaju ila tafsirin
segments.translation: O He Who never needs an explanation!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.transliteration: ya man huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadirun
segments.translation: O He Who is powerful over everything!'

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَبِيرٌ
segments.transliteration: ya man huwa bikulli shay'in khabirun
segments.translation: O He Who is aware of everything!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ بَصِيرٌ
segments.transliteration: ya man huwa bikulli shay'in basirun
segments.translation: O He Who sees everything!
O Sender of the winds!
O Cleaver of the dawn!
O Dispatcher of the spirits!
O Lord of munificence and forbearance!
O He in Whose Hand is every key!
O He Who hears every sound!
O He Who takes precedence over everything that passes away!

segments.arabic: يَا مُحْيِي كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بَعْدَ ٱلْمَوْتِ
segments.transliteration: ya muhyiya kulli nafsin ba`da almawti
segments.translation: O He Who gives life to every soul after death!
O my Provision in my hardship!
O my Maintainer in my exile!
O my Intimate in my lonesomeness!
O my Sponsor in my blessings!
O my haven when the ways make me weary,
when relatives give me up
and when every companion forsakes me!

segments.arabic: يَا عِمَادَ مَنْ لاَ عِمَادَ لَهُ
segments.translation: O Backing of him who has no backing!

segments.arabic: يَا سَنَدَ مَنْ لاَ سَنَدَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: ya sanada man la sanada lahu
segments.translation: O Support of him who has no support!

segments.arabic: يَا ذُخْرَ مَنْ لاَ ذُخْرَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: ya dhukhra man la dhukhra lahu
segments.translation: O Store of him who has no store!

segments.arabic: يَا حِرْزَ مَنْ لاَ حِرْزَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: ya hirza man la hirza lahu
segments.translation: O Sanctuary of him who has no sanctuary!

segments.arabic: يَا كَهْفَ مَنْ لاَ كَهْفَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: ya kahfa man la kahfa lahu
segments.translation: O Cave of him who has no cave!

segments.arabic: يَا كَنْزَ مَنْ لاَ كَنْزَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: ya kanza man la kanza lahu
segments.translation: O Treasure of him who has no treasure!

segments.arabic: يَا رُكْنَ مَنْ لاَ رُكْنَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: ya rukna man la rukna lahu
segments.translation: O castle of him who has no castle!

segments.arabic: يَا غِيَاثَ مَنْ لاَ غِيَاثَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: ya ghiyatha man la ghiyatha lahu
segments.translation: O Help of him who has no help!

segments.arabic: يَا جَارَ مَنْ لاَ جَارَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: ya jara man la jara lahu
segments.translation: O backer of him who has no backer!
O my Adjacent Neighbor!
O my Sturdy Pillar!
O My God in truth!
O Lord of the Ancient House!
O All-affectionate! O Friend!
Deliver me from the chains of strictures,

segments.arabic: وَٱصْرِفْ عَنِّي كُلَّ هَمٍّ وَغَمٍّ وَضِيقٍ
segments.transliteration: wasrif `anni kulla hammin wa ghammin wa diqin
segments.translation: turn away from me every care, grief and distress,
protect me from the evil of that which I cannot bear,
and help me in that which I am able to bear!
O He Who returned Joseph to Jacob!
O He Who removed the affliction of Job!
O He Who forgave the sin of David!

segments.arabic: يَا رَافِعَ عِيسَىٰ بْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَمُنجِيهِ مِنْ ايْدِي ٱلْيَهُودِ
segments.transliteration: ya rafi`a `isa ibni maryama wa munjiyahu min a y di alyahudi
segments.translation: O He Who caused Jesus, the son of Mary, to ascend and delivered him from the hands of the Jews!

segments.arabic: يَا مُجِيبَ نِدَاءِ يُونُسَ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَاتِ
segments.transliteration: ya mujiba nida'i yunusa fi alzzulumati
segments.translation: O He Who answered Jonah's call in the darkness!
O He Who chose Moses by spoken words!
O He Who forgave Adam his slip
and raised Idris to a high place through his mercy!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ نَجَّىٰ نُوحاً مِنَ ٱلغَرَقِ
segments.transliteration: ya man najja nuhan mina algharaqi
segments.translation: O He Who saved Noah from drowning!
O He Who destroyed `Âªd, the ancient,
and Thamud, and did not spare them,
and the people of Noah before;

segments.transliteration: innahum kanu hum azlama wa atgha
segments.translation: certainly, they were most unjust and more rebellious,
and al-Mu'tafikah, He also overthrew.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ دَمَّرَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
segments.translation: O He Who destroyed the people of Lot
and crushed the people of Shu`ayb!
O He Who took Abraham for a friend!
O You Who took Moses for an object of His words,

segments.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذَ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ اجْمَعِينَ حَبِيباً
segments.transliteration: wattkhadha muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa `alayhim ajma`ina habiban
segments.translation: and took Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, for a beloved!
O He Who gave Luqman wisdom,
and bestowed upon Solomon a kingdom
such as may not befit anyone after him!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ نَصَرَ ذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ عَلىٰ ٱلْمُلُوكِ ٱلْجَبَابِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: ya man nasara dhalqarnayni `ala almuluki aljababirati
segments.translation: O He Who gave Dhul-Qarnayn victory over the tyrannical kings!
O He Who gave al-Khadir (eternal) life

segments.arabic: وَرَدَّ لِيُوشَعَ بْنِ نُونٍ ٱلشَّمْسَ بَعْدَ غُرُوبِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa radda liyusha`a bni nunin alshshamsa ba`da ghurubiha
segments.translation: and returned the sun to Joshua, the son of Nun, after its setting!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ رَبَطَ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِ امِّ مُوسَىٰ
segments.transliteration: ya man rabata `ala qalbi ummi musa
segments.translation: O He Who strengthened the heart of Moses' mother,
and guarded the virginity of Mary, the daughter of `Imran!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ حَصَّنَ يَحْيَىٰ بْنَ زَكَرِيَّا مِنَ ٱلذَّنْبِ
segments.transliteration: ya man hassana yahya ibna zakariyya mina aldhdhanbi
segments.translation: O He Who fortified John, the son of Zachariah, against sins
and calmed the anger of Moses!
O He Who gave Zachariah the good news of the birth of John!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ فَدَىٰ إِسْمَاعِيلَ مِنَ ٱلذَّبْحِ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
segments.transliteration: ya man fada isma`ila mina aldhdhabhi bidhibhin `azimin
segments.translation: O He Who ransomed Ishmael from the sacrifice with a mighty sacrifice!
O He Who accepted the sacrifice of Abel
and placed a curse upon Cain!

segments.arabic: يَا هَازِمَ ٱلاحْزَابَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.transliteration: ya hazima al-ahzabi limuhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: O He Who routed the parties for Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household!
(please do) Bless Muhammad, the household of Muhammad,

segments.transliteration: wa `ala jami`i almursalina wa mala'ikatika almuqarrabina
segments.translation: all the messengers, Your archangels,
and all those who obey You!

segments.arabic: وَاسْالُكَ بِكُلِّ مَسْالَةٍ سَالَكَ بِهَا احَدٌ
segments.transliteration: wa as'aluka bikulli mas'alatin sa'alaka biha ahadun
segments.translation: I beseech You the supplication of every one who has besought you

segments.arabic: مِمَنْ رَضِيتَ عَنْهُ فَحَتَمْتَ لَهُ عَلىٰ ٱلإِجَابَةِ
segments.translation: and with whom You have been pleased and thus decided to grant his request.

segments.arabic: يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ya allahu ya allahu ya allahu
segments.translation: O Allah! O Allah! O Allah!

segments.arabic: يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ
segments.transliteration: ya rahmanu ya rahmanu ya rahmanu
segments.translation: O All-merciful! O All-merciful! O All-merciful!

segments.arabic: يَا رَحِيمُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا رَحِيمُ
segments.transliteration: ya rahimu ya rahimu ya rahimu
segments.translation: O All-compassionate! O All-compassionate! O All-compassionate!
O Lord of majesty and honor!
O Lord of majesty and honor!
O Lord of majesty and honor!

segments.arabic: بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: bihi bihi bihi bihi bihi bihi bihi
segments.translation: By Him! By Him! By Him! By Him! By Him! By Him! By Him!

segments.arabic: اسْالُكَ بِكُلِّ ٱسْمٍ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ
segments.transliteration: as'aluka bikulli ismin sammayta bihi nafsaka
segments.translation: I beseech You by every Name with which You have named Yourself

segments.arabic: اوْ انْزَلْتَهُ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ كُتُبِكَ
segments.transliteration: aw anzaltahu fi shay'in min kutubika
segments.translation: or which You have sent down in one of Your scriptures

segments.arabic: اوِ ٱسْتَاثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ ٱلَّذِي عِنْدَكَ
segments.translation: or kept for Yourself in the knowledge of the Unseen with You,
by the junctures of might for Your Throne,
by the utmost limit of mercy from Your Book,

segments.arabic: وَبِمَا ﴿وَلَوْ انّ َمَا فِي ٱلارْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ اقْلاَمٌ
segments.transliteration: wa bima wa law anna ma fi al-ardi min shajaratin aqlamun
segments.translation: by the fact that, âthough all the trees in the earth were pens

segments.arabic: وَٱلْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ ابْحُرٍ
segments.transliteration: walbahru yamudduhu min ba`dihi sab`atu abhurin
segments.translation: and the sea - seven seas after it to replenish it,
yet the words of Allah not be spent.
Allah is All-mighty, All-wise.â
And I beseech You by Your Most Excellent Names
that You have described in Your book thus saying,

segments.transliteration: wa lillahi al-asma'u alhusna fad`uhu biha
segments.translation: âTo Allah belong the Most Excellent Names, so call Him by them!â
And You said: âCall upon Me and I will answer you.â

segments.arabic: وَقُلْتَ: ﴿وَإِذَا سَالَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
segments.transliteration: wa qulta wa idha sa'alaka `ibadi `anni fa'inni qaribun
segments.translation: And You said: âAnd when My servants ask you concerning Me, then surely I am very near;
I answer the prayer of the suppliant when he calls on Me.â

segments.arabic: وَقُلْتَ: ﴿قُلْ يَا عِبَادِي ٱلَّذِينَ اسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ انْفُسِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: wa qulta qul ya `ibadiya alladhina asrafu `ala anfusihim
segments.translation: And You said: âSay: O My servants who have been prodigal against yourselves;
do not despair of Allah's mercy.
Surely, Allah forgives all sins.
Surely, He is the All-forgiving, the All-compassionate.â
And I ask You, O my God,
I call You, O my Lord,
I please You, O my Master,

segments.arabic: وَاطْمَعُ فِي إِجَابَتِي يَا مَوْلايَ كَمَا وَعَدتَّنِي
segments.transliteration: wa atma`u fi ijabati ya mawlaya kama wa`adtani
segments.translation: and I desire for You to respond to me, O my Protector, just as You have promised meâ
for I have called You just as You have commanded me.

segments.arabic: فَٱفْعَلْ بِي مَا انتَ اهْلُهُ يَا كَرِيمُ
segments.transliteration: faf`al bi ma anta ahluhu ya karimu
segments.translation: So, do to me what is worthy of You, O All-generous!
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ اجْمَعِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi ajma`ina
segments.translation: May Allah bless Muhammad and his entire Household.

text: Dua Mashlool Ø¯Ø¹Ø§Ø¡ Ø§ÙÙ Ø´ÙÙÙ This du-a'a known as "supplication of the youth stricken for his sin," is quoted from the work of Kaf-ami and from Muhaj al Da-wat by Sayyid ibn Tawus. from Imam Ali ibn abi Talib(as) who wrote his dua'a and gave it to a paralized man instruction to recite after Isha salat Signifance of this Dua Signifance/Background of this Dua × This du-a'a known as "supplication of the youth stricken for his sin," is quoted from the work of Kaf-ami and from Muhaj al Da-wat by Sayyid ibn Tawus. Through Imam Hussain(as) it is reported that one day he and his father, after performing Hajj, caught sight of a paralysed young man crying his eyes out in repentance. They went near to console him and find out the reason of his sorry plight. He was a habitual sinner, always teased his father, disobeyed him and treated him with contempt. One day, disgusted, the father invoked curse upon him. So he was affected with paralysis. Then and there Imam Ali ibn abi Talib(as) wrote his dua'a and gave it to him with instruction to recite after Isha salat. Next day fully cured, he came to Imam Ali and said that he had recited the dua'a as told and went to sleep. He saw the Holy Prophet (sa) in the dream. The holy prophet, gently touched his body with his hand and asked him to remember this dua'a as it contain ismi azam (the great name of Allah). Recite this dua'a after Isha salat. It brings countless blessings. All your legitimate desires will be fulfilled. It drives away poverty and sickness. Sins are for given. Debts are cleared. Enemies become friends. Domestic affairs are set aright. Disputes are settled in your favour. Prisoners are set free mental worries disappear. Prosperity, sound mind and healthy body stand by you at all times. Mercy and forgiveness of sins are the main advantages the almighty Allah makes available if this dua'a is recited regularly. he effective prayer is undoubtedly an inspired work. Any one who is acquainted with the soul-stirring experience of great religious thoughts cannot help seeing in these immortal words of Hazrat Ali (as) the dazzling light of Universal Truth. × . title: Du`a Sabah Duas.org

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ دَلَعَ لِسَانَ ٱلصَّبَاحِ بِنُطْقِ تَبَلُّجِهِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ya man dala`a lisana alssabahi binutqi taballujihi
segments.translation: O Allah, O He Who extended the morning's tongue in the speech of its dawning,

segments.arabic: وَسَرَّحَ قِطَعَ ٱللَّيْلِ ٱلْمُظْلِمِ بِغَيَاهِبِ تَلَجْلُجِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa sarraha qita`a allayli almuzlimi bighayahibi talajlujihi
segments.translation: dispatched the fragments of the dark night into the gloom of its stammering,

segments.arabic: وَأَتْقَنَ صُنْعَ ٱلْفَلَكِ الدَّوَّارِ فِي مَقَادِيرِ تَبَرُّجِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa atqana sun`a alfalaki alddawwari fi maqadiri tabarrujihi
segments.translation: made firm the structure of the turning spheres in the measure of its display,

segments.transliteration: wa sha`sha`a diya'a alshshamsi binuri ta'ajjujihi
segments.translation: and beamed forth the brightness of the sun through the light of its blazing!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِهِ بِذَاتِهِ
segments.translation: O He Who demonstrates His Essence by His Essence,
transcends from congeniality with His creatures,
and is exalted beyond conformity with His qualities!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ قَرُبَ مِنْ خَطَرَاتِ ٱلظُّنُونِ
segments.transliteration: ya man qaruba min khatarati alzzununi
segments.translation: O He Who is near to the passing thoughts of opinions,
far from the regards of eyes,

segments.arabic: وَعَلِمَ بِمَا كَانَ قَبْلَ أَن يَكُونَ
segments.transliteration: wa `alima bima kana qabla an yakuna
segments.translation: and knows what will be before it comes to be!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ أَرْقَدَنِي فِي مِهَادِ أَمْنِهِ وَأَمَانِهِ
segments.transliteration: ya man arqadani fi mihadi amnihi wa amanihi
segments.translation: O He Who has put me at ease in the cradle of His security and sanctuary,

segments.arabic: وَأَيْقَظَنِي إِلَىٰ مَا مَنَحَنِي بِهِ مِنْ مِنَنِهِ وَإِحْسَانِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa ayqazani ila ma manahani bihi min minanihi wa ihsanihi
segments.translation: awakened me to the favors and kindness that He has bestowed upon me,

segments.arabic: وَكَفَّ أَكُفَّ السُّوءِ عَنِّي بِيَدِهِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa kaffa akuffa alssu'i `anni biyadihi wa sultanihi
segments.translation: and held back from me the claws of evil with His hand and His authority!

segments.arabic: صَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَىٰ ٱلدَّلِيلِ إِلَيْكَ فِي ٱللَّيْلِ ٱلأَلْيَلِ
segments.transliteration: salli allahumma `ala alddalili ilayka fi allayli al-alyali
segments.translation: Bless, O Allah, the guide to You in the darkest night,

segments.arabic: وَٱلْمَاسِكِ مِنْ أَسْبَابِكَ بِحَبْلِ ٱلشَّرَفِ ٱلأَطْوَلِ
segments.transliteration: walmasiki min asbabika bihabli alshsharafi al-atwali
segments.translation: who, of Your ropes, clings to the cord of the longest nobility,

segments.arabic: وَٱلنَّاصِعِ ٱلْحَسَبِ فِي ذِرْوَةِ ٱلْكَاهِلِ ٱلأَعْبَلِ
segments.transliteration: walnnasi`i alhasabi fi dhirwati alkahili al-a`bali
segments.translation: whose pure lineage evident at the summit of stout shoulders,

segments.arabic: وَٱلثَّابِتِ ٱلْقَدَمِ عَلَىٰ زَحَاِليْفِهَا فِي ٱلزَّمَنِ ٱلأَوَّلِ
segments.transliteration: walththabiti alqadami `ala zahalifiha fi alzzamani al-awwali
segments.translation: and whose feet were entrenched in spite of slippery places in ancient time.
And [bless] his household, the good, chosen, and pious.
Open for us, O Allah, the leaves of the morning's door
with the keys of mercy and prosperity!

segments.arabic: وَأَلْبِسْنِي ٱللَّهُمَّ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ خِلَعِ ٱلْهِدَايَةِ وَٱلصَّلاَحِ
segments.transliteration: wa albisni allahumma min afdali khila`i alhidayati walssalahi
segments.translation: Clothe me, O Allah, with the most excellent robes of guidance and righteousness!

segments.arabic: وَٱغْرِسِ اللَّهُمَّ بِعَظَمَتِكَ فِي شِرْبِ جَنَانِي يَنَابِيعَ ٱلْخُشُوعِ
segments.transliteration: wa ighris allahumma bi`azamatika fi shirbi janani yanabi`a alkhushu`i
segments.translation: Plant, O Allah, through Your tremendousness, the springs of humility in the watering place of my heart!

segments.arabic: وَأَجْرِ ٱللَّهُمَّ لِهَيْبَتِكَ مِنْ آمَاقِي زَفَرَاتِ ٱلدُّمُوعِ
segments.transliteration: wa ajri allahumma lihaybatika min amaqi zafarati alddumu`i
segments.translation: Cause to flow, O Allah, through fear of You, tears of moaning from the corners of my eyes!

segments.arabic: وَأَدِّبِ ٱللَّهُمَّ نَزَقَ ٱلْخُرْقِ مِنِّي بِأَزِمَّةِ ٱلْقُنُوعِ
segments.transliteration: wa addib allahumma nazaqa alkhurqi minni bi-azimmati alqunu`i
segments.translation: Chastise, O Allah, the recklessness of my clumsiness with the reins of contentment!

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي إِن لَمْ تَبْتَدِئْنِي ٱلرَّحْمَةُ مِنْكَ بِحُسْنِ ٱلتَّوْفِيقِ
segments.transliteration: ilahi in lam tabtadi'ni alrrahmatu minka bihusni alttawfiqi
segments.translation: My God, if mercy from You does not begin with fair success for me,

segments.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱلسَّاِلكُ بِي إِلَيْكَ فِي وَاضِحِ ٱلطَّرِيقِ
segments.transliteration: faman alssaliku bi ilayka fi wadihi alttariqi
segments.translation: then who can take me to You upon the evident path?

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ أَسْلَمَتْنِي أَنَاتُكَ لِقَائِدِ ٱلأَمَلِ وَٱلْمُنَىٰ
segments.transliteration: wa in aslamatni anatuka liqa'idi al-amali walmuna
segments.translation: If Your deliberateness should turn me over to the guide of hope and wishes,

segments.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱلْمُقِيلُ عَثَرَاتِي مِنْ كَبَوَاتِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
segments.translation: then who will annul my slips from the stumbles of caprice?

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ خَذَلَنِي نَصْرُكَ عِنْدَ مُحَارَبَةِ ٱلنَّفْسِ وَٱلشَّيْطَانِ
segments.transliteration: wa in khadhalani nasruka `inda muharabati alnnafsi walshshaytani
segments.translation: If Your help should forsake me in the battle against the soul and Satan,

segments.arabic: فَقَدْ وَكَلَنِي خِذْلاَنُكَ إِلَىٰ حَيْثُ ٱلنَّصَبِ وَٱلْحِرْمَانِ
segments.transliteration: faqad wakalani khidhlanuka ila haythu alnnasabi walhirmani
segments.translation: then Your forsaking will have submitted me to where there is hardship and deprivation.

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي أَتَرَانِي مَا أَتَيْتُكَ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ ٱلآمَاِل
segments.transliteration: ilahi atarani ma ataytuka illa min haythu al-amali
segments.translation: My God, do You see that I have only come to You from the direction of hopes,

segments.arabic: أَمْ عَلِقْتُ بِأَطْرَافِ حِبَاِلكَ إِلاَّ حِينَ بَاعَدَتْنِي ذُنُوبِي عَنْ دَارِ ٱلْوِصَاِل
segments.transliteration: am `aliqtu bi-atrafi hibalika illa hina ba`adatni dhunubi `an dari alwisali
segments.translation: or clung to the ends of Your cords when my sins have driven me from the house of union?

segments.arabic: فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَطِيَّةُ الَّتِي ٱمْتَطَتْ نَفْسِي مِنْ هَوَاهَا
segments.transliteration: fabi'sa almatiyyatu allati imtatat nafsi min hawaha
segments.translation: So what an evil mount upon which my soul has mounted-its caprice!

segments.arabic: فَوَاهاً لَهَا لِمَا سَوَّلَتْ لَهَا ظُنُونُهَا وَمُنَاهَا
segments.transliteration: fawahan laha lima sawwalat laha zununuha wa munaha
segments.translation: Woe upon it for being seduced by its own opinions and wishes!

segments.arabic: وَتَبّاً لَهَا لِجُرْأَتِهَا عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِهَا وَمَوْلاهَا
segments.transliteration: wa tabban laha lijur'atiha `ala sayyidiha wa mawlaha
segments.translation: Destruction be upon it for its audacity toward its Master and Protector!

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي قَرَعْتُ بَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ بِيَدِ رَجَائِي
segments.transliteration: ilahi qara`tu baba rahmatika biyadi raja'i
segments.translation: My God, I have knocked upon the door of Your mercy with the hand of my hope,

segments.arabic: وَهَرَبْتُ إِلَيْكَ لاَجِئاً مِنْ فَرْطِ أَهْوَائِي
segments.transliteration: wa harabtu ilayka laji'an min farti ahwa'i
segments.translation: fled to You seeking refuge from my excessive caprice,
and fixed the fingers of my love to the ends of Your cords.

segments.arabic: فَٱصْفَحِ اللَّهُمَّ عَمَّا كُنتُ أَجْرَمْتُهُ مِنْ زَلَلِي وَخَطَائِي
segments.transliteration: fasfah allahumma `amma kuntu ajramtuhu min zalali wa khata'i
segments.translation: So pardon, O Allah, the slips and errors I have committed,
and release me from the foot-tangling of my robe,

segments.transliteration: fa'innaka sayyidi wa mawlaya wa mu`tamadi wa raja'i
segments.translation: for You are my Master, my Protector, my Support and my Hope,

segments.arabic: وَأَنتَ غَايَةُ مَطْلُوبِي وَمُنَايَ فِي مُنْقَلَبِي وَمَثْوايَ
segments.transliteration: wa anta ghayatu matlubi wa munaya fi munqalabi wa mathwaya
segments.translation: and You are the object of my search and my desire in my ultimate end and stable abode.

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي كَيْفَ تَطْرُدُ مِسْكِيناً ٱلْتَجَأَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلذُّنُوبِ هَارِباً
segments.transliteration: ilahi kayfa tatrudu miskinan iltaja'a ilayka mina aldhdhunubi hariban
segments.translation: My God, how could You drive away a poor beggar who seeks refuge in You from sins, fleeing?

segments.arabic: أَم كَيْفَ تُخَيِّبُ مُستَرْشِداً قَصَدَ إِلَىٰ جَنَابِكَ سَاعِياً
segments.transliteration: am kayfa tukhayyibu mustarshidan qasada ila janabika sa`iyan
segments.translation: How could You disappoint one seeking guidance who repairs to Your threshold, running?

segments.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ تَرُدُّ ظَمْآناً وَرَدَ إِلَىٰ حِيَاضِكَ شَارِباً
segments.transliteration: am kayfa taruddu zam'anan warada ila hiyadika shariban
segments.translation: How could You reject a thirsty man who comes to Your pools to drink?

segments.arabic: كَلاَّ وَحِيَاضُكَ مُتْرَعَةٌ فِي ضَنْكِ ٱلْمُحُولِ
segments.transliteration: kalla wa hiyaduka mutra`atun fi danki almuhuli
segments.translation: Never! For Your pools are full in the hardship of drought,
Your door is open for seeking and penetration,

segments.transliteration: wa anta ghayatu almas'uli wa nihayatu alma'muli
segments.translation: and You are the goal of requests and the object of hopes.

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي هٰذِهِ أَزِمَّةُ نَفْسِي عَقَلْتُهَا بِعِقَاِل مَشِيئَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: ilahi hadhihi azimmatu nafsi `aqaltuha bi`iqali mashi'atika
segments.translation: My God, these are the reins of my soul I have bounded with the ties of Your will.

segments.arabic: وَهٰذِهِ أَعْبَاءُ ذُنُوبِي دَرَاْتُهَا بِعَفْوِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa hadhihi a`ba'u dhunubi dara'tuha bi`afwika wa rahmatika
segments.translation: These are the burdens of my sins I have averted with Your pardon and mercy.

segments.arabic: وَهٰذِهِ أَهْوَائِيَ ٱلْمُضِلَّةُ وَكَلْتُهَا إِلَىٰ جَنَابِ لُطفِكَ وَرَاْفَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa hadhihi ahwa'i almudillatu wakaltuha ila janabi lutfika wa ra'fatika
segments.translation: These are my misleading caprices I have referred to the threshold of Your gentleness and kindliness.

segments.arabic: فَٱجْعَلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ صَبَاحِي هٰذَا نَازِلاً عَلَيَّ بِضِيَاءِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
segments.transliteration: faj`al allahumma sabahi hadha nazilan `alayya bidiya'i alhuda
segments.translation: So, make this morning of mine, O Allah, descend upon me with the radiance of guidance
and safety in religion and this world!

segments.transliteration: wa masa'i junnatan min kaydi al`ida
segments.translation: And [make] my evening a shield against the deception of enemies
and a protection against the destructive blows of caprice!
Verily, You have power to do what You will!
You give the kingdom to whom You will,
seize the kingdom from whom You will,
exalt whom You will,
and abase whom You will.
In Your hand is the good
and You are powerful over all things.
You make the night to enter into the day,
make the day to enter into the night,
bring forth the living from the dead,
bring forth the dead from the living,

segments.transliteration: wa tarzuqu man tasha'u bighayri hisabin
segments.translation: and provide whomsoever You will without measure!
There is no god but You!
Glory be to You, O Allah, and Yours is the praise!

segments.arabic: مَنْ ذَا يَعْرِفُ قَدْرَكَ فَلاَ يَخَافُكَ
segments.transliteration: man dha ya`rifu qadraka fala yakhafuka
segments.translation: Who knows Your measure and yet does not fear You?

segments.arabic: وَمَن ذَا يَعْلَمُ مَا أَنتَ فَلاَ يَهَابُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa man dha ya`lamu ma anta fala yahabuka
segments.translation: Who knows what You are and yet does not stand in awe of You?
Through Your power, You have joined disparate things,
through Your gentleness, You have cleaved apart the daybreak,
through Your generosity, You have illumined the dark shrouds of night,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْهَرْتَ ٱلْمِيَاهَ مِنَ ٱلصُّمِّ ٱلصَّيَاخِيدِ عَذْباً وَأُجَاجاً
segments.transliteration: wa anharta almiyaha mina alssummi alssayakhidi `adhban wa ujajan
segments.translation: made waters, sweet and salt, flow forth from hard shining stones,

segments.transliteration: wa anzalta mina almu`sirati ma'an thajjajan
segments.translation: sent dawn out of rain-clouds water cascading,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ لِلْبَرِيَّةِ سِرَاجاً وَهَّاجاً
segments.transliteration: wa ja`alta alshshamsa walqamara lilbariyyati sirajan wahhajan
segments.translation: and appointed the sun and the moon a blazing lamp for the creatures

segments.arabic: مِنْ غَيْرِ أَن تُمَارِسَ فِيمَا ٱبْتَدَأْتَ بِهِ لُغُوباً وَلاَ عِلاَجاً
segments.transliteration: min ghayri an tumarisa fima ibtada'ta bihi lughuban wa la `ilajan
segments.translation: without experiencing in that which You originated either weariness or effort.
So, O He Who is alone in might and subsistence
and dominates His slaves with death and annihilation,
(please) bless Muhammad and his household, the god-fearing,
answer my supplication, hear my call,

segments.transliteration: wa haqqiq bifadlika amali wa raja'i
segments.translation: and actualize through Your favor my hope and desire.

segments.arabic: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ دُعِيَ لِكَشْفِ ٱلضُّرِّ
segments.transliteration: ya khayra man du`iya likashfi alddurri
segments.translation: O Best of those who are called to remove affliction
and object of hope in difficulty and ease!

segments.arabic: بِكَ أَنزَلْتُ حَاجَتِي فَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي مِنْ سَنِيِّ مَوَاهِبِكَ خَائِباً
segments.transliteration: bika anzaltu hajati fala taruddani min saniyyi mawahibika kha'iban
segments.translation: I have stated my need to You; so, do not reject me despairing of Your exalted gifts.

segments.arabic: يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ
segments.transliteration: ya karimu ya karimu ya karimu
segments.translation: O All-generous! O All-generous! O All-generous!
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
May Allah bless the best of His creatures,
Muhammad, and his entire Household!
My God, my heart is veiled,
my soul is deficient,
my intelligence is defeated,
my caprice is triumphant,
my obedience is little,
my disobedience is much,
and my tongue confesses of sinning;
so, what am I to do?
O He Who covers defects!
O He Who knows the unseen!
O He Who removes troubles!
Forgive my sins, all of them,

segments.transliteration: ya ghaffaru ya ghaffaru ya ghaffaru
segments.translation: in the name of the sacredness of Muhammad and the household of Muhammad!

segments.arabic: يَا غَفَّارُ يَا غَفَّارُ يَا غَفَّارُ
segments.translation: O All-forgiver! O All-forgiver! O All-forgiver!
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

title: Salat-Dua Azumal Bala Imam Mahdi(ajtfs) Faraj

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful
O my Lord! The calamity has aggravated; the absence prolonged;
The curtain of modesty has been lifted; hope has been curtailed;
The earth has been narrow; and sky has been denied.
And You are the One from whom help is sought and complaints are made
And in You we trust in the times of difficulty.

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَيْكَ الْمُعَوَّلُ فِيْ الشِّدَّةِ وَالرَّخَاءِ،
segments.transliteration: Allahumma salli âala Muhammad wa ali Muhammad
segments.translation: O Allah! Send blessings upon Muhammad (S) and the progeny of Muhammad (S),

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَي مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: The possessors of authority whose obedience you have enjoined upon us

segments.arabic: أُوْلِي الْأَمْرِ الَّذِيْنَ فَرَضْتَ عَلَيْنَا طَا عَتَهُمْ
segments.transliteration: Wa âarraftana bidhalika manzilatahum fafarrij âanna bi-haqqihim farajan âajilan qariban kalamhiâl-basari aw huwa aqrab
segments.translation: And by that made us aware of their position. Then make open for us, by their truth, an immediate opening, immediate as a wink or sooner.

segments.arabic: وَ عَرَّفْتَنَا بِذَالِكَ مَنْزِلَتَهُمْ ، فَفَّرِجْ عَنَّا بِحَقِّهِمْ فَرَجاً عَاجِلاً قَرِيْباً كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ
segments.transliteration: Ya Muhammadu ya âAliyyu ya Muhammad
segments.translation: O Muhammad! O âAli! O âAli! O Muhammad!

segments.transliteration: Ikfiyani fainnakuma kafiyani waân-surani fainnakuma nasiran
segments.translation: Suffice me both of you as both of you are sufficient.Help meâtwo of youâfor you are my helpers.

segments.arabic: ِكْفِيَانِيْ فَإِنَّكُمَا كَافِيَانِ وَ انْصُرَانِيْ فَإِنَّكُمَا نَاصِرَانِ
segments.translation: O our Master, O Master of the Time!
Help! Help!
Rescue me! Rescue me! Rescue me!
This moment! This moment! This moment!
Hasten, hasten, hasten!

segments.transliteration: Ya arhamaâr-rahimina bi-haqqi Muhammad wa alihiât-tahirin
segments.translation: O Most Merciful of the Merciful,For the sake of Muhammad (S) and his holy progeny.

segments.arabic: يَا أَرْحَمَ لرَّاحِمِيْنَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهِ الطَّا هِرِيْنَ
segments.translation: You do we worship, and Yours aid we seek.
O Allah, unbearable is our tribulation!
The hidden has been disclosed!
The cover has been exposed!

segments.transliteration: wa daqat al-ardu bima wasa`at alssama'u
segments.translation: The earth has become too narrow to carry that which could be embraced by the sky.
To You, my Lord, is the complaint
and in You is the trust in sorrow and in joy.

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: whom You have commanded us to obey,
and hasten their Relief through the Rising Imam among them;
and make manifest Your fortifying him.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Save me, for you both are true saviors of me.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Aid me, for you both are true aides of me.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Protect me, for you both are true protectors of me.
O my master, the Patron of the Age!
O my master, the Patron of the Age!
O my master, the Patron of the Age!
Help, help, help!
[come to] succor me, [come to] succor me, [come to] succor me!
[grant me] security, [grant me] security, [grant me] security!

segments.transliteration: Allaahumma in atâaâtuka fal mahâmadatu lak. Wa in asâaituka falhâujjatu lak. Minkar rauhâu wa minkal faraj. Sub-hâaana man an-aâma wa shakara sub-hâaana man qaddara wa ghafarallaahumma in kuntu aâsâaituka fa-innee qad atâaâtuka fee ahâabbil ashyaa-i ilaika wahuwal eemaanu bika lam attakhidh laka waladanw wa lam ad-uâ laka shareekam mannaa minka bihi aâlayya laa mannam minni bihi aâlaika wa qad aâsâaituka yaa ilaahee aâlaa ghairi wajhil mukaabarati wa lal khurooji aân uâboodeeyatika wa lal juhâoodi liruboobeeyatika wa laakin atâaâtu hawaaya wa azallanish shaitâaanu falakal hâujjatu aâlayya wal bayaanu fa-in tuadhdhibnee fabidhunoobee ghairu zâaalimil lee. Wa in taghfirlee wa tarhâamnee fa-innaka jawaadun kareemun yaa kareemun yaa kareem.<
segments.translation: O Allah, if I obey You, then the essence of praise is for You, and if I disobey You then the Proof is for You. From You is comfort and from You is success. Glory be to the one who has bestowed favors and thanked. Glory be to the One who commanded and forgave. O Allah, if I am disobedient to you, then I indeed I have also obeyed You in those matters that You prefer most, and it is belief (faith) in You. I have not taken for You any son and neither have I considered anyone Your partner even then the favor is from you upon me and there is no favor from me upon You. Also I have indeed disobeyed You O My Allah, this disobedience was not due to pride or due to leaving Your worship or due to the denial of Allah. It is only that I have obeyed my desires and the Satan misled me. Then Your proof is complete upon me and Your decision. Then if You punish me for my sins, You would not be unjust to me. But if You forgive me and have mercy on me, then indeed You are the Generous, the Kind, O Kind O Kind â¦. (till the breath breaks)

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنْ اَطَعْتُكَ فَالْمَحْمَدَةُ لَكَ، وَ إِنْ عَصَيْتُكَ فَالْحُجَّةُ لَكَ، مِنْكَ الرَّوْحُ وَ مِنْكَ الْفَرَجُ، سُبْحَانَ مَنْ اَنْعَمَ وَ شَكَرَ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ قَدَّرَ وَ غَفَرَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَصَيْتُكَ فَإنِّیْ قَدْ اَطَعْتُكَ فِىْ اَحَبِّ اْلاَشْيَاءِ إِلَيْكَ وَ هُوَ الإِيْمَانُ بِكَ لَمْ اَتَّخِذْ لَك وَلَدًا وَّ لَمْ اَدْعُ لَك شَرِيْكًا مَنًّا مِنْكَ بِهِ عَلَىَّ لاَ مَنَّا مِنِّیْ بِهِ عَلَيْكَ وَ قَدْ عَصَيْتُكَ يَا إِلٰهِىْ عَلٰی غَيْرِ وَجْهِ الْمُكَابَرَةِ وَ لاَ الْخُرُوْجِ عَنْ عُبُوْدِيَّتِكَ وَ لاَ الْجُحُوْدِ لِرُبُوْبِيَّتِكَ وَ لٰكِنْ اَطَعْتُ هَوٰاىَ وَ اَزَلَّنِيْ الشَّيْطَانُ فَلَكَ الْحُجَّةُ عَلَىَّ وَ الْبَيَانُ فَإِنْ تُعَذِّبْنِيْ فَبِذُنُوْبِىْ غَيْرُ ظَالِمٍ لِىْ، وَ إِنْ تَغْفِرْ لِىْ وَ تَرْحَمْنِيْ فَإِنَّكَ جَوَادٌ كَرِيْمٌ يَا كَرِيْمُ يَا كَرِيْمُ...
segments.transliteration: Yaa aaminam min kulli shai-inw wa kullu shai-im minka khaa-ifun hâadhirun as-aluka bi-amnika min kulli shai-inw wa khaufi kulli shai-im minka an tusâalliya aâlaa muhâammadinw wa aali muhâammad. Wa antutâ tâiyanee amaanal linafsee wa ahlee wa waladee wa saa-iri maa an-aâmta bihi aâlayya hâatta laa akhaafa wa laa ahâdhara min shai-in abadan innaka aâlaa kulli shai-in qadeer. Wa hâasbunallaahu wa niâmal wakeel. Yaa kaafiya ibraaheema numrooda wa yaa kaafiya moosaa firaâuna as-aluka antusâalliya aâlaa muhâammadinw wa aali muhâammadinw wa antakfiyanee sharra fulaanabna fulaan.
segments.translation: O One Who is safe from everything and everything is fearful of Him. I ask in the name of this safety and in the name of the fearfulness of everything that You bless Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad and accord me safety in my self, my family and my children, so in me also no fear remains of anything, ever. You are powerful over everything and Allah is sufficient for us and the best of the executors. O one who sufficed for Ibrahim against Nimrod and sufficed for Musa against Pharaoh. I beseech You that You bless Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad and be sufficient for me against the mischief of the enemy. (Then soon Allah would prevent the mischief of one whose mischief one fears)

segments.arabic: يَا آمِنًا مِنْ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ وَ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ مِنْكَ خَائِفٌ حَذِرٌ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاَمْنِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَ خَوْفِ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مِنْك اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَنْ تُعْطِيَنِيْ اَمَانًا لِنَفْسِىْ وَ اَهْلِىْ وَ وَلَدِىْ وَ سَائِرِ مَا اَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَىَّ حَتَّی لاَ اَخَافَ وَ لاَ اَحْذَرَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ اَبَدًا إِنَّكَ عَلٰی كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ وَ حَسْبُنَا اللهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ يَا كَافِىَ إبْرَاهِيْمَ نَمْرُوْدَ وَ يَا كَافِىَ مُوْسٰی فِرْعَوْنَ اَسْاَلَُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَنْ تَكْفِيَنِيْ شَرَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ.

text: Salat-Dua Azumal Bala Imam Mahdi(ajtfs) Sahifa Mahdi(ajtfs) . Dua Salat-Dua For Needs Other Faraj duas Arabic Transliteration Translation Shaykh Tabarsi (a.r.), the renowned commentator of the Holy Quran, has recorded this supplication in his book âKunooz al-Najaahâ and says, âThis supplication was taught by our master Saaheb al-Zamaan (a.t.f.s.) to Abul Hasan Muhammad Ibn Ahmad Ibn Abi al-Lais in the city of Baghdad at the Graves of Quraish ( Ù ÙØ§Ø¨Ø± ÙØ±ÙØ´ ), where the latter had taken refuge, due to fear of death. On account of the blessings of this supplication, he was saved. This dua'a is attributed to the living Imam Mehdi (atfs). It brings immediate help from our living imam. It is recommended to be recited often by Ulama .Kafami says in his book Baladul Amin that if a wrongfully confined prisoner recites this dua'a he will soon be set free. If a person find himself surrounded by misfortunes or intrigues he must recite this dua'a to come through tight situations, deadlock and crises. One who has a need should perform Ghusl on Friday eve after midnight, and come to the place of prayers and perform two rakats (units) prayer and in the first rakat he should recite Surah al-Hamd and when he reaches: âIyyaka Naâbudoo we iyyaka Nastaeenâ, â Ø§ÙÙÙ ÙØ¹Ø¨Ø¯Ù Ù Ø§ÙÙ ÙØ³ØªØ¹Ù âhe should repeat this a hundred times and continue with the Surah and after that recite Surah Tawheed once.
