title: Duas for Rizq- Sustenance

segments.arabic:
اِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلِيْهِ راجِعُون، 
اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِى فَرَجاً وَ مَخْرَجًا وَ الرْزُقْنِىْ خَيْرَ مِنْ حَيْثُ اَحْتَسِبُ وَ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا اَحْتَسِبُ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration:
inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi rajiâoon, 
allahummajâalni farajan wa makhrajan war zuqni khaira min haithu ahtasibu wa min haithu la ahtasib ,
 bi haqqi Muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation:
We are from Allah & will return to Him. 
Oh Allah, let my affairs be free from care & make them profitable & give me means of livelihood from my share & from where I have no expectation. For the sake of Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad

segments.arabic: لاَ اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اللهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِيْنُ
segments.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahul malikul hâaqqul mubeen.
segments.translation: There is no god except Allah, the True and Manifest Ruler.

segments.arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ
segments.translation: It is as Allah has pleased, there is no power save in Allah
there is neither might nor power save with Allah, the All-high and All-great.

segments.arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. And whoever is careful of (his duty to) Allah, He will make for him an outlet. And give him sustenance from whence he thinks not; and whoever trusts in Allah, He is sufficient for him; surely Allah attains His purpose; Allah indeed has appointed a measure for everything.[5]

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ. وَ مَن يَتَّقِ اللهَ يَجْعَلْ لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا.
 وَ يَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ يَحْتَسِبُ 
 وَ مَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ 
 إِنَّ اللهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا.
segments.transliteration: Bismillaahir rahâmaanir rahâeem. Wa mayn yattaqillaaha yaj-aâl lahu makhrajaa. Wa yarzuqhu min hâaithu laa yahâtasibu wa mayn yatawakkal aâlallaahi fahuwa hâasbuhu innallaaha baalighu amrihi qad ja-aâlallaahu likulli shai-in qadraa.
segments.translation: O Lord of the first and the last.
O Best of the first and the last.
O Possessor of the firm strength.
O Merciful to the needy.
O Allah, (please) provide me out of Your all-inclusive,
legal, and pleasant sustenance
with sustenance that is expansive,
legally gotten, pleasant,
covering all this-worldly and other-worldly demands,
pouring, torrential,
enjoyable, and wholesome,
without exhaustive affairs
and without the favor of any of Your creatures;
rather, with a favor out of Your all-inclusive favors.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ مَنٍّ مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa la mannin min ahadin min khalqika
segments.translation: You have said, âAsk Allah of His grace.â
Thus, from Your grace only do I ask,

segments.transliteration: fa'innaka qulta was'alu allaha min fadlihi
segments.translation: from Your gift only do I ask,
and from Your abounding donation do I ask.
O best of all those whom may be besought
and O best of all those who may give,
(please) provide me and my dependants with sustenance out of Your grace,
for You verily the Lord of great favoring.
O best of all those whom may be besought,
O best of all those whom may be begged,
O most ample-giver of all those who may give,
and O best of all those whom may be pleased,
(please) provide me with sustenance, grant me liberal sustenance,
and cause me to receive sustenance from Your Presence,
for You have power over all things.

segments.transliteration: wa sabbib li rizqan min qibalika
segments.translation: O Sustainer of the impoverished,
O Compassionate to the poor,
O Patron of the believers,
and O Lord of power and strong,
(please) send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household,
provide me with sustenance, grant me wellbeing,
and save me from what has distressed me.
O Allah, I beseech You for excellent livelihood;
such livelihood by which I can be competent enough to settle all of my needs
and by which I can pave my way to my otherworldly life by means of this life,

segments.arabic: مَعِيشَةً أَتَقَوَّىٰ بِهَا عَلَىٰ جَمِيعِ حَوَائِجِي
segments.translation: but do not make me so luxurious that I may be inordinate

segments.arabic: وَأَتَوَصَّلُ بِهَا فِي ٱلْحَيَاةِ إِلَىٰ آخِرَتِي
segments.transliteration: wa atawassalu biha fi alhayati ila akhirati
segments.translation: and do not straiten my means of life that I may be miserable.

segments.arabic: مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ تُتْرِفَنِي فِيهَا فَأَطْغَىٰ
segments.transliteration: min ghayri an tutrifani fiha fa'atgha
segments.translation: Rather, You may grant me expansive and legally gotten sustenance
and endue me kindly with the torrential favors of You,
such pleasant graces,
and enduring gifts.
Then, (please) do not cause me to be distracted from thanking Your graces
through granting me excessive sustenance whose joy may divert me

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ لاَ تَشْغَلْنِي عَنْ شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ
segments.translation: and whose vainglory may lead me astray
or through giving me very little amount of sustenance
due to which my painstaking efforts fail to meet my needs
and due to which my heart is filled with grief.
(Please) give me, O my God, an amount
that makes me dispense with Your evil creatures
and makes me attain Your pleasure.
I pray Your protection, O my God, against the evil of this world
and the evil therein.

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ يَا إِلٰهِي مِنْ شَرِّ ٱلدُّنْيَا
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika ya ilahi min sharri alddunya
segments.translation: Do not cause this world to be like prison for me
and do not cause my departure from it to be grief for me.
(Please) take me out of it while You are pleased with me
and my deeds are accepted by You
to the habitat of true life and the abode of the virtuous ones.
Give me in exchange for this terminating life

segments.transliteration: ila dari alhayawani wa masakini al-akhyari
segments.translation: the bliss of the everlasting abode.
O Allah, I pray for Your protection against this worldâs hardships and tribulations
and against the sways of its devils, rulers, and chastisement

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَزْلِهَا وَزِلْزَالِهَا
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min azliha wa zilzaliha
segments.translation: as well as against the oppression of whoever has oppressed me in this world.

segments.transliteration: wa satawati shayatiniha wa salatiniha wa nakaliha
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) frustrate whoever intends to deceive me,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ بَغْيِ مَنْ بَغَىٰ عَلَيَّ فِيهَا
segments.transliteration: wa min baghyi man bagha `alayya fiha
segments.translation: thwart whoever intends evil to me,
break off the sharp edge of whoever has targeted at me,
extinguish the fire of whoever has collected its wood against me,

segments.arabic: وَفُلَّ عَنِّي حَدَّ مَنْ نَصَبَ لِي حَدَّهُ
segments.transliteration: wa fulla `anni hadda man nasaba li haddahu
segments.translation: save me from the trickeries of the cunning ones,

segments.arabic: وَأَطْفِئْ عَنِّي نَارَ مَنْ شَبَّ لِي وَقُودَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa atfi' `anni nara man shabba li waqudahu
segments.translation: gouge out the eyes of the disbelievers,
save me from the grief of whoever has grieved me,
defend me against the evil of the envious ones,

segments.arabic: وَٱكْفِنِي هَمَّ مَنْ أَدْخَلَ عَلَيَّ هَمَّهُ
segments.translation: protect me against all that through tranquility,
dress me Your invulnerable armor,
cause me to live under the shade of Your protective covering,
set aright all of my affairs,
make congruous my words and my deeds,
and bless my family members for me.
O Glorious! O One an Only! O All-generous!
I turn my face towards You in the name of Muhammad, Your Prophet, the Prophet of Mercy,

segments.arabic: يَا مَاجِدُ يَا وَاحِدُ يَا كَرِيمُ
segments.transliteration: ya majidu ya wahidu ya karimu
segments.translation: Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household;

segments.arabic: أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ نَبِيِّ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ
segments.transliteration: atawajjahu ilayka bimuhammadin nabiyyika nabiyyi alrrahmati
segments.translation: O Muhammad! O Allahâs Messenger!
I turn my face in your name towards Allah,
my and your Lord and the Lord of all things.
I thus beseech You, O Allah, to send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: rabbi wa rabbika wa rabbi kulli shay'in
segments.translation: and I beseech You to grant me one of Your generous gifts,

segments.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ ٱللَّهُمَّ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa as'aluka allahumma an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ahli baytihi
segments.translation: an easy opening,

segments.transliteration: wa as'aluka nafhatan karimatan min nafahatika
segments.translation: and expansive sustenance
by which I can put together my scattered things,
settle my debts,
and have the ability to cover the needs of my dependants.
I begin this day by Allahâs might and power.
I begin it by no might or power of mine;
rather, by Your might and power, O my Lord.

segments.arabic: وَغَدَوْتُ بِلاَ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
segments.transliteration: wa ghadawtu bila hawlin minni wa la quwwatin
segments.translation: O Allah, I am verily your servant.

segments.transliteration: wa lakin bihawlika wa quwwatika ya rabbi
segments.translation: I am seeking Your favor, as You have ordered me to do.
So, (please) make it easy for me while I am enjoying wellbeing that You confer upon me.
O Allah, nothing has indeed left for my sins except my hope for You pardon

segments.arabic: فَيَسِّرْ لِي ذٰلِكَ وَأَنَا خَافِضٌ فِي عَافِيَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: fayassir li dhalika wa ana khafidun fi `afiyatika
segments.translation: although I have done things due to which I deserve deprivation of Your pardon.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ ذُنُوبِي لَمْ يَبْقَ لَهَا إِلاَّ رَجَاءُ عَفْوِكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inna dhunubi lam yabqa laha illa raja'u `afwika
segments.translation: Therefore, I beseech You for what I do not deserve,

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ آلَةَ ٱلْحِرْمَانِ بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ
segments.transliteration: wa qad qaddamtu alata alhirmani bayna yadayya
segments.translation: I seek from You what I do not merit,
and I implore You for what I do not earn.
My situation is not concealed from You

segments.transliteration: wa atadarra`u ilayka bima la asta'hiluhu
segments.translation: although the actual knowledge of my manners is hidden from people.
O Allah, if my sustenance in the sky, then (please) send it down to me,

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ خَفِيَ عَلَىٰ ٱلنَّاسِ كُنْهُ مَعْرِفَةِ امْرِي
segments.transliteration: wa in khafiya `ala alnnasi kunhu ma`rifati amri
segments.translation: if it is in the earth, then (please) show it to me,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ رِزْقِي فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ فَاهْبِطْهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma in kana rizqi fi alssama'i fa'ahbithu
segments.translation: if it is far off, then (please) draw it near me,

segments.transliteration: wa in kana fi al-ardi fa'azhirhu
segments.translation: if it is near, then (please) make it easy for me to reach it,
and if it is little, then (please) multiply it for me
and grant me its blessings.
My God, the ambitions of hopes have failed, except those directed to You,
and the pursuits of aspirations have been cut off, except those relying upon You,

segments.arabic: اِلٰهِيْ طُمُوْحُ الْآمَالِ قَدْ خَابَتْ إِلَّا اِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: Ilahi tumoohul aamaali qad khaabat illa ilayk
segments.translation: and the paths of intellects have transcended, but only towards You.

segments.arabic: وَ مَعَاكِفُ الْهِمَمِ قَدْ تَقَطَّعَتْ إِلَّا عَلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa maakiful himami qad taqattaat illa alayk
segments.translation: So in You is all hope, and to You is the only refuge.

segments.arabic: وَ مَذَاهِبُ الْعُقُوْلِ قَدْ سَمَتْ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa mazaahibul uqooli qad samat illa ilayk,
segments.translation: O most generous of all sought, and O most bountiful of all asked,

segments.transliteration: fa ilaykar rajaau wa ilaykal multaja.
segments.translation: I have fled to You with my whole self, O refuge of those who flee.

segments.arabic: يَا أَكْرَمَ مَقْصُوْدٍ وَ يَا أَجْوَدَ مَسْئُوْلٍ
segments.transliteration: Ya akrama maqsoodin wa ya ajwada masoolin
segments.translation: With the heavy burdens of sins, I carry them on my back,

segments.arabic: هَرَبْتُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَفْسِيْ يَا مَلْجَأَ الْهَارِبِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: harabtu ilayka binafsi ya maljaal haaribeen
segments.translation: and I find no intercessor for me except my knowledge that You are the nearest one hoped for by seekers,

segments.transliteration: bi athqaaliz zunoobi ahmiluha ala zahri
segments.translation: and the one to whom the distressed take refuge,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا أَجِدُ لِيْ شَافِعًا سِوٰى مَعْرِفَتِيْ بِأَنَّكَ أَقْرَبُ مَنْ رَجَاهُ الطَّالِبُوْنَ
segments.transliteration: wa laa ajidu lee shaafian siwa ma rifatee bi annaka aqrabu man rajaahut taaliboon
segments.translation: and the one in whom the desirous place their hopes.
O He who opened the minds with His Gnosis knowledge of Him,
and loosened the tongues with His praise,

segments.transliteration: Ya man fataqal uqoola bima rifatihi
segments.translation: and made what He bestowed upon His servants a sufficient means to fulfill what is due to Him.
Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,

segments.arabic: وَ جَعَلَ مَا امْتَنَّ بِهٖ عَلٰى عِبَادِهٖ كِفَاءً لِتَأْدِيَةِ حَقِّهٖ
segments.transliteration: wa jaala mam tanna bihi ala ibaadihi kifaaan li taadiyati haqqihi
segments.translation: and do not make for worries a path over my mind,
nor for falsehood a guide over my actions.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ لِلْهُمُوْMِ عَلٰى عَقْلِيْ سَبِيْلًا
segments.transliteration: wa laa tajal lil humoomi ala aqli sabeela
segments.translation: And open for me the goodness of this world and the Hereafter, O Guardian of Goodness.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا لِلْبَاطِلِ عَلٰى عَمَلِيْ دَلِيْلًا
segments.transliteration: wa laa lil baatili ala amali daleela
segments.translation: Say, âO Allah, Owner of all sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will,â

segments.arabic: وَ افْتَحْ لِيْ بِخَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ يَا وَلِيَّ الْخَيْرِ .
segments.transliteration: waf tah lee bikhayrid dunya wal aakhirah, ya waliyyal khayr.
segments.translation: And You take sovereignty away from whom You will, and You honor whom You will,

segments.arabic: قُلِ اللّٰهُمَّ مَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ
segments.transliteration: Quli AllÄhumma MÄlika al-Mulk tuâtÄ« al-mulka man tashÄâ
segments.translation: And You humble whom You will. In Your Hand is all good. Indeed, You are capable of all things.

segments.arabic: وَتَنْزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِمَّنْ تَشَاءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشَاءُ
segments.transliteration: wa tanziÊ¿u al-mulka mimman tashÄâ wa tuÊ¿izzu man tashÄâ
segments.translation: You cause the night to enter into the day, and You cause the day to enter into the night.

segments.arabic: وَتُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشَاءُ بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.transliteration: wa tu dhillu man tashÄâu biyadika al-khayr, innaka Ê¿alÄ kulli shayâin qadÄ«r
segments.translation: You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living,

segments.arabic: تُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ
segments.transliteration: tÅ«liju al-layla fÄ« an-nahÄr, wa tÅ«liju an-nahÄra fÄ« al-layl
segments.translation: And You provide for whom You will without measure.

segments.arabic: وَتُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ
segments.transliteration: wa tukhâriju al-á¸¥ayya mina al-mayyiti wa tukhâriju al-mayyita mina al-á¸¥ayyi
segments.translation: O Most Merciful of this world and the Hereafter,

segments.transliteration: wa tarzuqu man tashÄâu bighayri á¸¥isÄb
segments.translation: You give from them to whom You will, and withhold from whom You will,
Settle my debt for me.â

segments.arabic: تُعْطِي مِنْهُمَا مَا تَشَاءُ وَتَمْنَعُ مِنْهُمَا مَا تَشَاءُ
segments.transliteration: tuÊ¿á¹­Ä« minhumÄ mÄ tashÄâu wa tamnaÊ¿u minhumÄ mÄ tashÄâ
segments.translation: English?

In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. So her Lord accepted her with a good acceptance and made her grow up a good growing, and gave her into the charge of Zakaria; whenever Zakaria entered the sanctuary to (see) her, he found with her food. He said: O Maryam! whence comes this to you? She said: It is from Allah. Surely Allah gives to whom He pleases without measure.[10] Allah the Mighty, has said the truth.

segments.arabic:
وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ بِحَقِّ وَلِيِّكَ أَبِيْ جَعْفَرٍ الْجَوَادِ ؑ
 إِلَّا جُدْتَ عَلَيَّ بِهٖ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَ تَفَضَّلْتَ عَلَيَّ بِهٖ مِنْ وُسْعِكَ مَا أَسْتَغْنِي بِهٖ عَمَّا فِي أَيْدِيْ خَلْقِكَ وَ خَاصَّةً يَا رَبِّ لِئَامَهُمْ وَ بَارِكْ لِيْ فِيْهِ وَ فِيْمَا لَكَ عِنْدِيْ مِنْ نِعَمِكَ وَ فَضْلِكَ وَ رِزْقِكَ إِلٰهِي انْقَطَعَ الرَّجَاءُ إِلَّا مِنْكَ وَ خَابَتِ الْآمَالُ إِلَّا فِيْكَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ
أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مَنْ حَقُّهٗ عَلَيْكَ وَاجِبٌ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهٖ وَ أَنْ تَبْسُطَ عَلَيَّ مَا حَظَرْتَهٗ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ وَ أَنْ تُسَهِّلَ ذٰلِكَ وَ تُيَسِّرَهٗ فِي خَيْرٍ مِنْكَ وَ عَافِيَةٍ وَ أَنَا فِي‏خَفْضِ عَيْشٍ وَ دَعَةٍ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration:
wa as'alukallahumma bi haqqi waliyyika abi ja'farinil jawaad,
muhammadibni 'aliyyin 'alayhis salaam,
illa judta 'alayya bihi min fadhlik,  wa tafadh-dhalta 'alayya bihi min wus'ik,
maa astaghni bihi 'ammaa fi aydi khalqik,
wa khaassatan ya rabbi li'aamihim
wa baarik lee feehi wa fee ma laka 'indee min ni'amika wa fadhlika wa rizqik.
ilaahi anqata'ar rajaa'u illa mink,  wa khaabatil aamaalu illa feek,
ya dhal jalaali wal ikraam,
as'aluka bihaqqi man haqquhu 'alayka waajibun
an tusalliya 'ala muhammadin wa ahli baytihi
wa an tabsuta 'alayya maa khatartahu min rizqik
wa an tusahhila dhaalika wa tuyassirahu fee khayrin minka wa 'aafiyatin
wa ana fee khaffadhi 'aiyshin wa da'a   ya arhamar rahimeen
segments.translation: O Allah, O the cause of one for whom there is no cause, O cause of all that have cause. O cause of causes in that where there is no cause. Bless Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad. Make me needless through Your permissible from Your prohibited. And through Your obedience from Your disobedience and by Your Grace from others than You. O the Living, O the Everlasting.[11]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُوْلٍ حَسَنٍ وَ أَنْبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا وَ كَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا الْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقاً قَالَ يَا مَرْيَمُ أَنّٰى لَكِ هٰذَا قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ اللهِ إِنَّ اللهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ صَدَقَ اللهُ الْعَظِيْمُ.
segments.transliteration: Bismillaahir rahâmaanir rahâeem. Fataqbbalahaa rabbuhaa biqaboolin hâasaninw wa ambatahaa nabaatan hâasananw wa kaffalahaa zakareeyaa. Kullamaa dakhala aâlaihaa zakareeyal mihâraaba wajada iândahaa rizqaa. Qaala yaa maryamu annaa laki haadhaa qaalat huwa min iândillaahi innallaaha yarzuqu mayn yashaa-u bighairi hâisaab. sâadaq allaahul aâzâeem.
segments.translation: O Allah, we ask You from Your Grace that which befits Your Grace, like it befits Your Grace. And more than Your Grace by Your Grace. O one with Grace, give me a wide sustenance, O Munificent.[12]

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ يَا سَبَبَ مَنْ لاَ سَبَبَ لَهُ يَا سَبَبَ كُلِّ ذِیْ سَبَبٍ يَا مُسَبِّبُ اْلاَسْبَابِ بِغَيْرِ سَبَبٍ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَغْنِنِیْ بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَ بِطَاعَتِكَ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَ بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاك يَا حَیُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma yaa sababa mallaa sababa lah. Yaa sababa kulli dhee sabab. Yaa musabbilal asbaabi fee ghairi sabab. Sâalli aâalaa muhâammadinw wa aali muhâammadinw wa-aghninee bihâalaalika an hâaraamika wa bitâaa-aâtika aâm maâsâiyatika wa bifazâlika aâmman siwaaka yaa hâayyu yaa qayyoom.
segments.translation: Allah is Benignant to His servants; He gives sustenance to whom He pleases, and He is the Strong, the Mighty.[6]

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْاَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ مَا يَلِيْقُ بِفَضْلِكَ كَمَا يَلِيْقُ بِفَضْلِكَ، وَ زِيَادَةً مِنْ فَضْلِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ، يَا ذَا الْفَضْلِ، اُرْزُقْنِيْ رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا يَا كَرِيْمُ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma innaa nas-aluka min fazâlika maa yaleequ bifazâlika kamaa yaleequ bifazâlik. Wa ziyaadatam min fazâlika bifazâlik yaa dhal fazâli urzuqnee rizqanw wasiaâyn yaa kareem.
segments.translation: O Allah make permanent Your bounty and Your Grace for us in what You have ordained.

segments.arabic: اَللهُ لَطِيْفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَآءُ وَ هُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيْزُ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahu latâeefum bi-iâbaadihi yarzuqu mayn ya shaa-u wa huwal qaweeyul aâzeez.
segments.translation: O Allah, give me from Your wide Grace, and the permissible and the pure, a sustenance that is permissible and pure, sufficient for the world and the Hereafter, in continuous outpour, pleasing to eat and drink without undue struggle and without being under an obligation of one of Your creatures. Except that You widen it by Your wide favor; for indeed You have said: âAnd ask Allah through His Graceâ. Then from Your Grace I ask. And I ask you through Your bestowal and I ask You from Your hands that are full of bounties.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اَدِمْ نِعْمَتَكَ وَ الْطُفْ بِنَا فِيْمَا قَدَّرْتَهُ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma adim niâmataka waltâuf binaa feemaa qaddartah.
segments.translation: O Glorious, O the One, O Noble, I turn towards You through Muhammad, Your Prophet, the prophet of mercy. May Allah bless him and his family. O Muhammad, O Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.), indeed I turn through you to Allah, My Lord and your Lord and the Lord of everything and I ask You O Allah that you bless Muhammad and his Ahle Bayt and I ask You for a noble bestowal from Your bestowals and an easy victory and a wide sustenance, so that I can reform my muddled affairs and repay my loans and maintain by it, my family.[4]

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِيْ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْوَاسِعِ، الْحَلاَلِ الطَّيِّبِ، رِزْقًا حَلاَلاً طَيِّبًا، بَلاَغًا لِلدُّنْيَا وَ اْلآخِرَةِ، صَبًّا صَبًّا هَنِيْئًا مَرِيْئًا، مِنْ غَيْرِ كَدٍّ وَ لاَ مَنٍّ مِنْ اَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، إِلاَّ سَعَةً مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْوَاسِعِ، فَإِنَّكَ قُلْتَ. وَ اسْاَلُوْا اللهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ. فَمِنْ فَضْلِكَ اَسْاَلَ، وَ مِنْ عَطَيْتِكَ اَسْاَلَ، وَ مِنْ يَدِكَ الْمَلاَیٰ اَسْاَلَ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahummar zuqnee min fazâlikal wasiiâl hâalaalitâ tâiyyibi rizqan hâalaalan tâayyibaM balaaghaL LIDdunyaa wal aakhirah. Sâabban sâabban hanee-am maree-aa. Min ghairi kadinW wa laa mannim min ahâadim min khalqika illaa sAaâtam min fazâlikal waasiiâ fa-innaka qulta was alullaaha min fazâlihi famin fazâlika asa-ala wa min aâtâiatika asa-ala wa miyn yakal malaayaa as-al.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. So her Lord accepted her with a good acceptance and made her grow up a good growing, and gave her into the charge of Zakaria; whenever Zakaria entered the sanctuary to (see) her, he found with her food. He said: O Maryam! whence comes this to you? She said: It is from Allah. Surely Allah gives to whom He pleases without measure.[10] Allah the Mighty, has said the truth.

segments.arabic: يَا مَاجِدُ يَا وَاحِدُ يَا كَرِيْمُ اَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ نَبِیِّ الرَّحْمَةِ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَا مُحَمَّدُ يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ إِنِّيْ اَتَوَجَّهُ بِكَ إلَی اللهِ رَبِّىْ وَ رَبِّكَ وَ رَبِّ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَ اَسْاَلُكَ اَللَّهُمَّ اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ اَسْاَلُكَ نَفْحَةً كَرِيْمَةً مِنْ نَفَحَاتِكَ وَ فَتْحًا يَسِيْراً وَ رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا اَلُمُّ بِهِ شَعَثِىْ وَ اَقْضِىْ بِهِ دَيْنِيْ وَ اَسْتَعِيْنُ بِهِ عَلٰی عِيَالِىْ.
segments.transliteration: Yaa maajidu yaa waahâidu yaa kareemu atawajjahu ilaika bi muhâammadin nabeeyika nabeeyir rahâmati sâallallaahu aâlaihi wa aalihi yaa muhâammadu yaa rasoolallaahi innee atawajjahu bika ilallaahi rabbi wa rabbika wa rabbee kulli shai. Wa as-aluka allaahumma an tusâalli aâlaa muhâammadinw wa ahlibaitihi wa as-aluka nafhâatan kareematam min nafahâaatika wa fat-hâayn yaseeranw wa rizqan waasiaân alummu bihi shaaâthee wa aqzâee bihi dainee wa astaeâeânu bihi aâlaa iâyaalee.
segments.translation: O Allah, we ask You from Your Grace that which befits Your Grace, like it befits Your Grace. And more than Your Grace by Your Grace. O one with Grace, give me a wide sustenance, O Munificent.[12]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُوْلٍ حَسَنٍ وَ أَنْبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا وَ كَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا الْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقاً قَالَ يَا مَرْيَمُ أَنّٰى لَكِ هٰذَا قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ اللهِ إِنَّ اللهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ صَدَقَ اللهُ الْعَظِيْمُ.
segments.transliteration: Bismillaahir rahâmaanir rahâeem. Fataqbbalahaa rabbuhaa biqaboolin hâasaninw wa ambatahaa nabaatan hâasananw wa kaffalahaa zakareeyaa. Kullamaa dakhala aâlaihaa zakareeyal mihâraaba wajada iândahaa rizqaa. Qaala yaa maryamu annaa laki haadhaa qaalat huwa min iândillaahi innallaaha yarzuqu mayn yashaa-u bighairi hâisaab. sâadaq allaahul aâzâeem.
segments.translation: Imam Ali (a.s.) said, 'He apportions sustenance, abundantly and sparingly, and He distributes them to those in need as well as to those who prosper, and He is Just in His allotment in order that he may test whomever He wishes with prosperity or with hardship, and that He may test therewith the gratefulness and perseverance expressed by both rich and poor.â Nahjul Balaghah, Sermon 91

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ يَا سَبَبَ مَنْ لاَ سَبَبَ لَهُ يَا سَبَبَ كُلِّ ذِیْ سَبَبٍ يَا مُسَبِّبُ اْلاَسْبَابِ بِغَيْرِ سَبَبٍ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَغْنِنِیْ بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَ بِطَاعَتِكَ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَ بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاك يَا حَیُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma yaa sababa mallaa sababa lah. Yaa sababa kulli dhee sabab. Yaa musabbilal asbaabi fee ghairi sabab. Sâalli aâalaa muhâammadinw wa aali muhâammadinw wa-aghninee bihâalaalika an hâaraamika wa bitâaa-aâtika aâm maâsâiyatika wa bifazâlika aâmman siwaaka yaa hâayyu yaa qayyoom.
segments.translation:
Imam al-âAaskari (a.s.) said, 'Do not let [preoccupation with] a sustenance that is guaranteed avert you from an act that is incumbent.â

Bihar al-Anwar, v. 78, p. 374, no. 22

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْاَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ مَا يَلِيْقُ بِفَضْلِكَ كَمَا يَلِيْقُ بِفَضْلِكَ، وَ زِيَادَةً مِنْ فَضْلِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ، يَا ذَا الْفَضْلِ، اُرْزُقْنِيْ رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا يَا كَرِيْمُ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma innaa nas-aluka min fazâlika maa yaleequ bifazâlika kamaa yaleequ bifazâlik. Wa ziyaadatam min fazâlika bifazâlik yaa dhal fazâli urzuqnee rizqanw wasiaâyn yaa kareem.
segments.translation: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'No one has the power to withhold or bestow sustenance except the All-Sustainer.â[Ghurar al-Hikam, no. 10838]

segments.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): وقَدَّرَ الأرزاقَ فَكَثَّرَها وقَلَّلَها ، وقَسَّمَها على الضِّيقِ والسَّعَةِ ، فَعَـدَلَ فيها لِيَبتَلِيَ مَن أرادَ ، بِمَيسورِها ومَعسورِها ، ولِيَختَبِرَ بذلكَ الشُّكرَ والصَّبرَ مِن غَنِيِّها وفَقيرِها
segments.translation: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'He apportions sustenance, abundantly and sparingly, and He distributes them to those in need as well as to those who prosper, and He is Just in His allotment in order that he may test whomever He wishes with prosperity or with hardship, and that He may test therewith the gratefulness and perseverance expressed by both rich and poor.â[Nahj al-Balagha, Sermon 91]

segments.arabic: الإمامُ العسكريُّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَشغَلْكَ رِزقٌ مَضمونٌ عن عَمَلٍ مَفروضٍ
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Do not preoccupy yourself away from the duties incumbent upon you in your bid to secure that which is guaranteed to you, for indeed neither will you miss out on that which has been apportioned for you, nor will you attain that which has been placed beyond your reach.â[Bihar al-Anwar, v. 77, p. 187, no. 10]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَملِكُ إمساكَ الأرزاقِ وإدرارَها إلّا الرَّزَّاقُ.
segments.translation: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Go out and seek your livelihood for it is guaranteed to the one who goes in search of it.â[al-Irshad, v. 1, p. 303]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): وقَدَّرَ الأرزاقَ فَكَثَّرَها وقَلَّلَها ، وقَسَّمَها على الضِّيقِ والسَّعَةِ ، فَعَـدَلَ فيها لِيَبتَلِيَ مَن أرادَ ، بِمَيسورِها ومَعسورِها ، ولِيَختَبِرَ بذلكَ الشُّكرَ والصَّبرَ مِن غَنِيِّها وفَقيرِها.
segments.translation: Imam al-`Aaskari (AS) said, 'Do not let [preoccupation with] a sustenance that is guaranteed avert you from an act that is incumbent.â[Bihar al-Anwar, v. 78, p. 374, no. 22]

segments.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ‏ِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَتَشاغَلْ عمّا فُرِضَ علَيكَ بِما قد ضُمِنَ لَكَ فإنّهُ لَيسَ بفائتِكَ ما قد قُسِّمَ لَكَ ، ولَستَ بِلاحِقٍ ما قد زُوِيَ عنكَ.
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Sustenance cannot be pulled by the greed of an avaricious person nor repelled by the repugnance of a hostile person.â[Bihar al-Anwar, v. 77, p. 68, no. 7]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اُطلُبُوا الرِّزقَ فإنّهُ مَضمونٌ لِطالِـبِهِ .
segments.translation: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Know that even if a servant was devoid of shrewdness and was feeble in his schemes, it would not reduce the amount of sustenance that Allah has apportioned for him, and even if a servant were to be skilfully shrewd and crafty, it would not do anything to increase the sustenance that Allah has apportioned for him.â[Amali al-Mufid, p. 207, no. 39]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ العسكريُّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لا يَشغَلْكَ رِزقٌ مَضمونٌ عن عَمَلٍ مَفروضٍ.
segments.translation: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Verily Allah, most High, has abundantly distributed sustenance even to the idiots, so that intelligent men may take a lesson from this and know that the wealth of this world cannot be obtained by work or cunning.â[Bihar al-Anwar, v. 103, p. 34, no. 63]

segments.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ‏ِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): إنّ الرِّزقَ لا يَجُرُّهُ حِرصُ حَريصٍ ولا يَصرِفُهُ كَراهِيَةُ كارِهٍ.
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Verily the archangel Gabriel blew into my mind that no soul shall pass away before the depletion of his sustenance in this world, so be wary of your duty to Allah and seek your livelihood through decent means, and let not a delay in your provision cause any of you to seek it through unlawful means, for verily what is with Allah is only acquired through His obedience.â[al-Kafi, v. 2, p. 74, no. 2]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): اِعلَمُوا أنَّ عَبدا وإن ضَعُفَتْ حِيلَتُهُ ، ووَهَنَتْ مَكِيدَتُهُ أنَّهُ لَن يُنقَصَ مِمّا قَدَّرَ اللّه‏ُ لَهُ ، وإن قَوِيَ عَبدٌ في شِدَّةِ الحِيلَةِ وقُوَّةِ المَكِيدَة أ نّهُ لن يُزادَ عَلى ما قَدَّرَ اللّه‏ُ لَهُ.
segments.translation: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Take from [the wealth of] this world that which comes to you, and avoid that which evades you, and if you cannot do this, then at least seek your livelihood through decent means.â[Nahj al-Balagha, Saying 393]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ اللّه‏َ تعالى وَسَّعَ أرزاقَ الحَمقى لِيَعتَبِرَ العُقَلاءُ ويَعلَمُوا أنّ الدنيا ليسَ يُنالُ ما فيها بِعَمَلٍ ولا حِيلَةٍ.
segments.translation: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Your quest to secure your means of subsistence should be such that it is neither like the earning of a wasteful squanderer, nor like the greedy man who loves and depends on this world. Rather, you must raise yourself from the level of weakness and incapacity, and bring yourself down [from the level of greed] to the level of an equitable and virtuous man, and seek your earning the way a believer should.â[Bihar al-Anwar, v. 103, p. 33, no. 63]

segments.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ‏ِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): ألا وإنّ الرُّوحَ الأمينَ نَفَثَ في رُوعِي أ نّهُ لَن تَمُوتَ نفسٌ حتّى تَستَكمِلَ رِزقَها ، فاتَّقُوا اللّه‏َ وأجمِلُوا في الطَّلَبِ ، ولا يَحمِلْ أحَدَكُم استِبطاءُ شَيءٍ مِنَ الرِّزقِ أن يَطلُبَهُ بغَيرِ حِلِّهِ ، فإنّهُ لا يُدرَكُ ما عِندَ اللّه‏ِ إلّا بطاعَتِهِ.
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'If man was to flee from his sustenance as he flees from death, it would find him just as death finds him.â[Makarim al-Akhlaq, v. 2, no. 40377]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): خُذْ مِن الدنيا ما أتاكَ وتَوَلَّ عمّا تَوَلّى عنك ، فإن أنتَ لَم تَفعَلْ فَأجمِلْ في الطَّلَبِ.
segments.translation: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Sustenance runs after the one who does not run after it.â[Ghurar al-Hikam, no. 1408]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): لِيَكُن طَلَبُكَ المَعيشَةَ فَوقَ كَسبِ المُضَيِّعِ ، دُونَ طَلَبِ الحَريصِ الراضِي بالدنيا المُطمَئنِّ إلَيها ، ولكنْ أنزِلْ نفسَكَ مِن ذلكَ بمَنزِلَةِ المُنصِفِ المُتَعَفِّفِ تَرفَعُ نفسَكَ عن مَنزِلَةِ الواهِي الضَّعيفِ وتَكتَسِبُ ما لابُدَّ للمُؤمنِ مِنهُ.
segments.translation: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'There are two types of sustenance: the sustenance that you seek out, and the sustenance that seeks you out, which even if you do not pursue it, it pursues you.â[Nahj al-Balagha, Letter 31]

segments.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ‏ِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لَو أنَّ ابنَ آدَمَ فَرَّ مِن رِزقِهِ كما يَفِرُّ مِنَ المَوتِ لَأدرَكَهُ كما يُدرِكُهُ المَوتُ.
segments.translation: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Verily Allah, Mighty and Exalted, has placed the believers' livelihoods whence they do not anticipate it to come, and that is because when the servant does not know the location of his livelihood, his supplication for it increases.[ Nur al-Thaqalayn, v. 5, p. 354, no. 34]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): الرِّزقُ يَطلُبُ مَن لا يَطلُبُهُ .
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Do not worry about tomorrow's sustenance for every morrow brings its own sustenance.â[Bihar al-Anwar, v. 81, p. 195, no. 52]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنَّ الرِّزقَ رِزقانِ: رِزقٌ تَطلُبُهُ ، ورِزقٌ يَطلُبُكَ ، فإن أنتَ لَم تَأتِهِ أتاكَ .
segments.translation: The Prophet (S) said, 'Do not preoccupy yourself away from the duties incumbent upon you in your bid to secure that which is guaranteed to you, for indeed neither will you miss out on that which has been apportioned for you, nor will you attain that which has been placed beyond your reach.â Bihar al-Anwar, v. 77, p. 187, no. 10

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ اللّه‏َ عزّوجلّ جَعَلَ أرزاقَ المؤمنينَ مِن حيثُ لا يَحتَسِبُونَ ، وذلكَ أنَّ العَبدَ إذا لَم يَعرِفْ وَجهَ رِزقِهِ كَثُرَ دُعاؤهُ .
segments.translation: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'He who worries about his sustenance is recorded as having sinned.â[Amali al-Tusi, p. 300, no. 593]

segments.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ‏ِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَهتَمَّ لِرِزقِ غَدٍ فإنّ كُلَّ غَدٍ يَأتِي بِرِزقِهِ.
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Allah, Glorified and most High, says, "Let my servant be warned that if he is impatient with regard to My sustenance, then I will get angry and open to him a door of this world [and its temptations]â.â[Bihar al-Anwar, v. 81, p. 195, no. 52]

segments.arabic: رسولُ اللهِ‏ِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): لا تَتَشاغَلْ عمّا فُرِضَ علَيكَ بِما قد ضُمِنَ لَكَ فإنّهُ لَيسَ بفائتِكَ ما قد قُسِّمَ لَكَ ، ولَستَ بِلاحِقٍ ما قد زُوِيَ عنكَ
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Whoever Allah bestows His bounties upon must praise Allah, and whoever is impatient with regards to his sustenance must seek Allah's forgiveness.â[`Uyoun Akhbar al-Ridha (AS), v. 2, p. 46, no. 171]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ الصّادقُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مَنِ اهتَمَّ لِرِزقِهِ كُتِبَ علَيهِ خَطِيئَةٌ.
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'He who is impatient with regards to his sustenance must increase his proclamation of Allah's greatness [takbir or proclaiming allahu akbar: Allah is the greatest (ed.)], and he who worries and frets much [about his livelihood] must increase his seeking of forgiveness.â[Kanz al-`Ummal, no. 9325]

segments.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ‏ِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): يقولُ اللّه‏ُ سبحانَهُ وتعالى: لِيَحذَرْ عَبدِي الذي يَستَبطِئُ رزقِي أن أغضَبَ فَأفتَحَ علَيهِ باباً مِن الدنيا!
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Sustenance comes to those who feed others faster than a knife can cut though flesh.â[Bihar al-Anwar, v. 74, p. 362, no. 71]

segments.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن أنعَمَ اللّه‏ُ تعالى علَيهِ نِعمَةً فَليَحمَدِ اللّه‏َ تعالى ، ومَنِ استَبطَأ (علَيهِ) الرِّزقَ فَليَستَغفِرِ اللّه‏َ.
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) was once asked how one could bring about an increase in one's sustenance, to which he replied, 'Always remain in the state of purity (Tahara) and your sustenance will be plentiful.â[Kanz al-`Ummal, no. 44154]

segments.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن استَبطَأ الرِّزقَ فَليُكثِرْ مِن التَّكبيرِ ، ومَن كَثُرَهَمُّهُ وغَمُّهُ فَليُكثِرْ مِن الاستِغفارِ .
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Increase your charity and you will be provided more.â[Bihar al-Anwar, v. 77, p. 176, no. 10]

segments.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ‏ِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): الرِّزقُ أسرَعُ إلى مَن يُطعِمُ الطَّعامَ ، مِن السِّكِّينِ في السَّنامِ .
segments.translation: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Helping out one's brother in faith from one's own wealth, for the sake of Allah, increases sustenance.[ Bihar al-Anwar, v. 74, p. 395, no. 22]

segments.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ) ـ لمّا قيلَ لَهُ: اُحِبُّ أن يُوَسَّعَ عَلَيَّ في الرِّزقِ ؟ ـ: دُمْ على الطَّهارَةِ يُوَسَّعْ علَيكَ في الرِّزقِ.
segments.translation: Imam Ali (AS) said, 'Attract sustenance by giving in charity.â[Nahj al-Balagha, Saying 137]

segments.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): أكثِرُوا مِن الصَّدَقَةِ تُرزَقُوا .
segments.translation: Imam al-Baqir (AS) said, 'You must pray fervently for your brothers [in faith] in secret, and sustenance will pour down on you.â[Bihar al-Anwar, v. 76, p. 60, no. 14]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): مُواساةُ الأخِ في اللّه‏ِ عزّوجلّ تَزِيدُ في الرِّزقِ .
segments.translation: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said, 'Verily kindness leads to an increase in sustenance.â[Bihar al-Anwar, v. 74, p. 81, no. 84]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): استَنزِلُوا الرِّزقَ بالصَّدقَةِ.
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'Whoever deprives a fellow Muslim brother of his right, Allah forbids him the benediction of sustenance until he repents.â[Amali al-Saduq, p. 350, no. 1]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ الباقرُ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): علَيكَ بالدعاءِ لإخوانِكَ بظَهْرِ الغَيبِ فإنّهُ يَهِيلُ الرِّزقَ.
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'O Allah provide moderation and sufficiency to Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and to those who love Muhammad and his family, and provide abundance of wealth and progeny to those who harbour hatred for Muhammad and his family.â[al-Kafi, v. 2, p. 140, no. 3]

segments.arabic: ـ الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ): إنّ البِرَّ يَزِيدُ في الرِّزقِ .
segments.translation: The Prophet (SAWA) said, 'That which is little yet sufficient is better than that which is abundant and distracting [as a result].â[Amali al-Saduq, p. 395, no. 1]

segments.arabic: ـ رسولُ اللهِ‏ِ (صَلَّيَ اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَ آلِهِ): مَن حَبَسَ عن أخيهِ المسلمِ شيئا مِن حَقٍّ حَرَّمَ اللّه‏ُ علَيهِ بَرَكةَ الرِّزقِ إلّا أن يَتوبَ .
segments.translation: 1. Chapter al-ÄârÄf - 7:96: )  (âAnd if the people of the towns were to believe and observe piety, surely we would have opened to them the blessings of the heaven and the earthâ¦â

text: Duas for Rizq- Sustenance . Basics Baqiyatus-Salehat Sahifas-Other Misc Hadith/Actions Arabic Transliteration Translation Imam Ali(as) in 'Nahjulbalagha' on SUSTENANCE: Allah has guaranteed your livelihood and has commanded you to act. Therefore, the pursuit of that which has been guaranteed to you should not get preference over that whose performance has been enjoined upon you. But by Allah, most certainly the position is that doubt has overtaken and certainty has been shattered and it seems as if what has been guaranteed to you is obligatory on you and what was made obligatory on you has been taken away from you. So, hasten towards (good) actions and dread the suddenness of death, because the return of age cannot be hoped for, as the return of livelihood can be hoped for. Whatever is missed from livelihood today may be hoped tomorrow with increase, but whatever is lost from the age yesterday, its return cannot be expected today. Hope can be only for that which is to come, while about that which is passed there is only disappointment. So ";fear Allah as He ought to be feared and do not die until you are (true) Muslim."; (Qur'an , 3:102) 1. Tasbih of Fatima Zehra (sa) :- Once the Prophet's (saw) daughter Fatima Zehra (as) asked the prophet for a helper. The Prophet(saw) advised her to recite the Tasbih which is known as 'Tasbih e Zehra'. This Tasbih is usually recited after each obligatory salat. However it also has great value for solving the problems of Rizq, Sustenance, Business, Job etc. Recite the tasbih with the niyat (intention) of seeking rizq (sustenance) , before leaving the house ,before commencing business and before starting work at office. 34 times -Allah o Akbar, 33 times- Alhumdolillah & 33 times- Subhanallah 3. Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq (as) said:âOne who is busy in recitations after Morning Namaz till the sun rises is more successful in acquiring sustenance than through business for a whole monthâ -Reference: Makarimul Akhlaq, Pg. 304; 4. Tawasul of lady Khadija(sa): Seek intercession from her to overcome Rizq problems as her wealth made the Prophet (saws) wealthy 5. Saying Salam upon entering home A person came to the Prophet (saws.) and complained of poverty and straitening of sustenance. The Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.) told him: When you enter your house, say 'Salam' whether there is someone therein or not. Then recite Surah Tawheed, once. The man did as advised and Allah gave him so much that he even passed some of it to his neighbors.[8] Tibb al-Aaimma, As-Sayyid Shubbar, Pg. 524 6. Dua NE'MUL Badal Lady Umme Salma was widowed in Madina and in difficulty when she requested the Holy Prophet (saws) for a Dua. The Prophet (saws) asked her to recite the following Dua: As a consequence of reciting this dua, she became the wife of the Holy Prophet (saws) when she had no hope of earning respect and a decent living. title: Duas for Debt Repayment

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ وَ مُنَفِّسَ الْغَمِّ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma yaa faarijal hammi wa munaffisal ghammi
segments.translation: O Allah! O the averter of sorrows. O the dispeller of grief!

segments.arabic: وَ مُذْهِبَ اْلاَحْزَانِ وَ مُجِيْبَ دَعْوَةِ الْمُضْطَرِّيْنَ
segments.transliteration: wa muzhâibal ahâzaani wa mujeeba daâwatil muzâtâarreen.
segments.translation: O the one to ward off the sorrow and O the one to accept the prayers of uneasy people.

segments.arabic: يَا رَحْمٰنَ الدُّنْيَا وَ اْلآخِرَةِ وَ رَحِيْمَهُمَا
segments.transliteration: Yaa rahâmaanad dunyaa wal aakhirati wa rahâeemahumaa
segments.translation: O the Beneficent in this world and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: اَنْتَ رَجائِى وَ رَحْمٰنَ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ
segments.transliteration: anta rajaa-ee wa rahâmaana kulli shai-in
segments.translation: You are my only hope, and O the one to show mercy on everything, have mercy on me.

segments.arabic: فَارْحَمْنِیْ رَحْمَةً تَغْنِيْنِیْ بِهَا عَنْ رَحْمَةٍ مِنْ سِوَاكَ
segments.transliteration: farhâamnee rahâmatan taghneenee bihaa aânr rahâmatim min siwaaka
segments.translation: Shower such a mercy on me which excels every other mercy

segments.arabic: وَ تَقْضِیْ بِهَا عَنِّیْ الدَّيْنَ كُلَّهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa taqzâee bihaa aânnid daina kullah.
segments.translation: and free me from all the debts.[3]

segments.arabic: َللَّهُمَّ اَغْنِني بِحَلالِكَ عَنْ حَرامِكَ، وَ بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِواكَ.
segments.transliteration:
bismil laahirrahmaanir raheem.allaahumma aghnenee behalaalekaaân
haraameka wa befazleka aâmman siwaaka Birahmatik, Yaa Arhamar Raahimeen.
segments.translation:
In the name of Allah the Beneficent the Merciful.
O Allah! Make me self-sufficient by permitted things from prohibited ones and by Your grace from all possessing powers:
O Allah, (please grant me) one of Your looks
by which You may make it easy for my debtors to settle their debts
and for me to recover my loans.
You verily have power over all things.
O Allah, (please) help me pay back to all of Your creatures
their dues for which I am liable,
both the insignificant and the large,
with easiness and wellbeing from Your Presence.
As for the dues that I am too weak to settle,
I am too poor to make up,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَقْوَ عَلَيْهِ بَدَنِي وَيَقِينِي وَنَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: wa lam yaqwa `alayhi badani wa yaqini wa nafsi
segments.translation: and my physique, certitude, and self are too short to satisfy,

segments.arabic: فَادِّهِ عَنِّي مِنْ جَزِيلِ مَا عِنْدَكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
segments.transliteration: fa'addihi `anni min jazili ma `indaka min fadlika
segments.translation: (please) settle them on behalf of me out of the abundant favor You own.

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ لاَ تُخَلِّفْ عَلَيَّ مِنْهُ شَيْئاً تَقْضِيهِ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِي
segments.transliteration: thumma la tukhallif `alayya minhu shay'an taqdihi min hasanati
segments.translation: Then, (please) do not cut off any amount of it from my good deeds.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy!

segments.arabic: اشْهَدُ انْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah,
One and Only and having no associate with Him.

segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger,
the religion is as exactly as He has legislated,
Islam is as exactly as He has described,
the Book is as exactly as He has revealed,
the truth is as exactly as He has said,

segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha huwa alhaqqu almubinu
segments.translation: and Allah is the manifest truth.

segments.arabic: ذَكَرَ ٱللَّهُ مُحَمَّداً وَاهْلَ بَيْتِهِ بِخَيْرٍ
segments.transliteration: dhakara allahu muhammadan wa ahla baytihi bikhayrin
segments.translation: May Allah make good mention of Muhammad and his Household

segments.transliteration: wa hayya muhammadan wa ahla baytihi bilssalami
segments.translation: and may He greet Muhammad and his Household with peace.

segments.arabic: مَنْ مَطَلَ عَلَى ذِي حَقٍّ حَقَّهُ، وَ هُوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَدَاءِ حَقِّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ خَطِيئَةُ عَشَّار.
segments.translation: 112 - O God, suffice me with what is lawful and keep me from what is unlawful, and enrich me with Your grace so that I do not need anyone other than You, O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining.

segments.translation: 113 - Oh God, I ask you, by the right of your guardian, Muhammad ibn Ali, to be gracious to me by your grace and to be generous with him and to be generous to me. Your sustenance, and make what you have permitted sufficient for your forbidden, and you have made it for me to you, for you can do whatever you wish.

From whomever You will, and You honor whomever You will, and You abase whomever You will. In Your hand is all good. Indeed, You are over all things competent. You merge the night into the day, and You merge the day into the night, and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living, and You provide for whomever You will without account.

O Most Merciful of this world and the Hereafter, and Most Merciful of them.
You give from them whomever You wish and withhold from them whomever You wish. Bless Muhammad and his family and clear my debt from me.

115 - Oh God, I ask you, O there is no god but You, in truth.There is no god but You, to have mercy on me, there is no god but You, O God, I ask you, there is no god but You, truly, there is no god but You, to be satisfied with me There is no god but You, O God, I ask you, there is no god but You, by the truth, there is no god but You, to forgive me, there is no god but You.
117 - There is no god but You, Glory be to You. Indeed, I was one of The oppressors -

119 - O Lord, the eyes have fallen asleep and the stars have set, and You are the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Drowsiness and sleep do not overtake You. Neither a dark night nor a resting land nor a deep sea nor layers of darkness, one above another, will be hidden from You. O Hearer of the clear cry of the righteous and O Helper of those who seek Your mercy, I seek help, so bless Muhammad and his family and decide for me. In need, and do not send me back disappointed or deprived, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

Whoever postpones repaying someoneâs right while he is capable of doing has the sin of an extortionist written down for him as every day passes by.
Prophet Mohammad (PBUH)â
Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 73, pg. 336
