title: Curing Ailments Duas

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
Sufficient to us is Allah, and most excellent is the Protector.
Blessed be Allah, the Best of all creators.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاََّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power save with Allah, the Most High and All-great.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ كَبَسَ ٱلأَرْضَ عَلَىٰ  ٱلْمَاءِ
segments.translation: O He Who has pressed the earth on water,
blocked the air with the sky,
and chose for Himself the most excellent of all names,
(please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
do to meâ¦
grant me sustenance, and cure me

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَىٰ هَوْلِ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) help me encounter the horror of the Resurrection Day,
take me out of this world soundly,
give me in marriage the Paradisiacal women,
save me from procuring the provisions of myself, my family members,
and people,
and include me, in the name of Your mercy, with Your righteous servants.
O Most High! O All-great!
O All-beneficent! O All-merciful!
O Hearer of all prayers!
O Giver of the good things!
(Please) bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَعْطِنِي مِنْ خَيْرِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: wa a`tini min khayri alddunya wal-akhirati ma anta ahluhu
segments.translation: give me from the good of this world and the Next World in the amount that fits You,

segments.arabic: وَٱصْرِفْ عَنِّي مِنْ شَرِّ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: wasrif `anni min sharri alddunya wal-akhirati ma anta ahluhu
segments.translation: dispel from me the evils of this world and the Next World in the way that fits You,
and remove from me this ailmentâ¦The disease or ailment may be now mentionedâ¦
for it has enraged and depressed me.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَيَّرْتَ أَقْوَاماً فِي كِتَابِكَ
segments.translation: O Allah! Having rebuked some people in Your Book,

segments.arabic: فَقُلْتَ: ﴿قُلِ ٱدْعُوٱ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ
segments.transliteration: faqulta qul id`u alladhina za`amtum min dunihi
segments.translation: You said, âSay, âCall on those whom you assert besides Him.

segments.arabic: فَلاَ يَمْلِكُونَ كَشْفَ الضُّرِّ عَنْكُمْ وَلاَ تَحْوِيلاًَ﴾
segments.transliteration: fala yamlikuna kashfa alddurri `ankum wa la tahwilan
segments.translation: They shall not control the removal of distress from you nor its transference.ââ

segments.arabic: فَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَمْلِكُ كَشْفَ ضُرِّي وَلاَ تَحْوِيلَهُ عَنِّي أَحَدٌ غَيْرُهُ
segments.transliteration: fayaman la yamliku kashfa durri wa la tahwilahu `anni ahadun ghayruhu
segments.translation: O He save Whom no one controls the removal of distress nor its transference,
(please) bless Muhammad and his Household,
remove my distress,

segments.arabic: وَحَوِّلْهُ إِلَىٰ  مَنْ يَدْعُو مَعَكَ إِلٰهاً آخَرَ
segments.transliteration: wa hawwilhu ila man yad`u ma`aka ilahan akhara
segments.translation: and transfer it to one who calls on another deity besides You,

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
segments.transliteration: fa'inni ashhadu an la ilaha ghayruka
segments.translation: for I bear witness that there is no god save You.

segments.arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa nunazzilu min alqur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatun lilmu'minina
segments.translation: â[And] We reveal of the Qur'an that which is a healing and a mercy for believers

segments.transliteration: wa la yazidu alzzalimina illa khasaran
segments.translation: though it increase the evil-doers in naught save ruin.â
O Allah, I beseech You in the name of Your Nameâ

segments.arabic: ٱلَّذِي إِذَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ ٱلْمُضْطَرُّ كَشَفْتَ مَا بِهِ مِنْ ضُرٍّ
segments.transliteration: alladhi idha sa'alaka bihi almudtarra kashafta ma bihi min durrin
segments.translation: if the distressed asks You by Your Name, You shall remove whatever harm he suffers,
give him power in the land,
and make him Your representative among Your creatures

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa `ala ahli baytihi
segments.translation: to bless Muhammad and his Household
and to cure me of my ailment.
Allah, Allah, Allah is my Lord indeed.
I do not associate with Him anything.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ لَهَا وَلِكُلِّ عَظِيمَةٍ فَفَرِّجْهَا
segments.transliteration: allahumma anta laha wa likulli `azimatin fafarrijha
segments.translation: O Allah, You are the only besought for this and for every terrible thing; so (please) relieve it.
I pray for the protection of Allahâs almightiness,
I pray for the protection of Allahâs omnipotence,
I pray for the protection of Allahâs majesty,
I pray for the protection of Allahâs greatness,
I pray for the protection of Allahâs wholeness,

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِرَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu birasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: I pray for the protection of Allahâs Messenger, may Allahâs blessings be upon him and hisHousehold,<
and I pray for the protection of Allahâs Names
against the evil of what I concern

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَخَافُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri ma akhafu `ala nafsi
segments.translation: and the evil of what I fear for myself.
O Allah, O my Lord! It is You Who have given him to me
and it is You Who have endued me with Him.
O Allah, so (please) renew Your donation to me on this day.
You are verily all-powerful and omnipotent.
O Allah, (please) remove ailments and maladies from him,
restore him to health and cure,
supply him with excellent protection,
return him to excellent wellbeing,

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ مَا نَالَهُ فِي مَرَضِهِ هٰذَا مَادَّةً لِحَيَاتِهِ
segments.transliteration: waj`al ma nalahu fi maradihi hadha maddatan lihayatihi
segments.translation: and cause what has afflicted him in this ailment of him to be material of his life
and remission of his evildoings.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma wa salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
O Allah, endue me with reliance on You,
entrusting (all my affairs) with You,
satisfaction with Your decree,
and submission to Your ordinance

segments.arabic: حَتَّىٰ لاَ أُحِبَّ تَعْجِيلَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ
segments.transliteration: hatta la uhibba ta`jila ma akhkharta
segments.translation: so that I would not long for hastening what You delay
and delaying what You hasten.
O Lord of the worlds!

segments.arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa nunazzilu min alqur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatun lilmu'minina
segments.translation: â[And] We reveal of the Qurâan that which is a healing and a mercy for believers.â
O revealer of cure and remover of remedy,
(please) bless Muhammad and his Household
and reveal cure upon my ailment.
O my God, whenever You bestow upon me a favor,
I am too short to thank it properly.
Whenever You test me with a tribulation,
I am too short to endure it.

segments.arabic: فَيَا مَنْ قَلَّ شُكْرِي عِنْدَ نِعَمِهِ فَلَمْ يَحْرِمْنِي
segments.transliteration: faya man qalla shukri `inda ni`amihi falam yahrimni
segments.translation: O He Whose favors have not been thanked by me properly; yet, He has not deprived me of them!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ قَلَّ صَبْرِي عِنْدَ بَلاَئِهِ فَلَمْ يَخْذُلْنِي
segments.transliteration: wa yaman qalla sabri `inda bala'ihi falam yakhdhulni
segments.translation: O He Whose tribulations have not been endured by me properly; yet, He has not disappointed me!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ رَآنِي عَلَىٰ ٱلْمَعَاصِي فَلَمْ يَفْضَحْنِي
segments.transliteration: wa ya man ra'ani `ala alma`asi falam yafdahni
segments.translation: O He Who has seen me committing acts of disobedience to Him; yet, He has not exposed me!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ رَآنِي عَلَىٰ ٱلْخَطَايَا فَلَمْ يُعَاقِبْنِي عَلَيْهَا
segments.transliteration: wa ya man ra'ani `ala alkhataya falam yu`aqibni `alayha
segments.translation: O He Who has seen me committing wrongdoings; yet, He has not punished me for them!
(Please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
forgive my sin
and cure me of my ailment.
Verily, You have power over all things.â
In the Name of Allah; the King and the Manifest Truth.

segments.arabic: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ هُوَ
segments.transliteration: shahida allahu annahu la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: Allah is witness that there is no god save Him.
The angels and the men of learning too are witness.
Maintaining His creation in justice,

segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa huwa al`azizu alhakimu
segments.translation: there is no god save Him; the Almighty and Wise.
Lo! The religion with Allah is Islam.
To Allah there are light, wisdom,
might, power,

segments.transliteration: wa qudratun wa sultanun wa burhanun
segments.translation: omnipotence, authority, and clear evidence.
There is no god save Allah.
Adam is the choice of Allah.
There is no god save Allah.
Abraham is the friend of Allah.
There is no god save Allah.
Moses is the spoken by Allah.
There is no god save Allah.
Muhammad the Arab is the messenger of Allah,

segments.transliteration: wa habibuhu wa khiyaratuhu min khalqihi
segments.translation: as well as His most beloved and best of all His creatures.
Calm down, O all pains,
illnesses, diseases,
all ailments,
and all fevers.

segments.arabic: سَكَّنْتُكَ بِٱلَّذِي سَكَنَ لَهُ مَا فِي ٱللَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ
segments.transliteration: sakkantuka billadhi sakana lahu ma fi allayli walnnahari
segments.translation: I make you calm down in the name of the One to Whom whatsoever in the night and daylight rests
and He is the All-hearing and All-knowing.
May Allah bless the best of His creatures;
Muhammad, and his entire Household.
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاََّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْمُبِينُ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu almaliku alhaqq almubinu
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah, the King and the manifest truth.

segments.arabic: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
segments.transliteration: shahida allahu annahu la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: Allah bears witness that there is no god but He
and so do the angels and those possessed of knowledge
maintaining His creation with justice.

segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa huwa al`azizu alhakimu
segments.translation: There is no god but Him, the Mighty, the Wise.
To Allah there are light, wisdom,
might, power,
clear argument, omnipotence,
authority, and mercy.
O He Who never sleeps!
There is no god save Allah.
Abraham is the friend of Allah.
There is no god save Allah.
Moses is the spoken by Allah.
There is no god save Allah.
Jesus and Allahâs spirit and word.
There is no god save Allah.
Muhammad is Allahâs messenger,
choice, and select.

segments.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa sallama
segments.translation: May Allah send blessings and peace upon him and his Household.
Calm down!

segments.arabic: سَكَّنْتُكَ بِمَنْ يَسْكُنُ لَهُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ
segments.transliteration: sakkantuka biman yaskunu lahu ma fi alssamawati wal-ardi
segments.translation: I make you calm down in the name of the One before Whom whatever is in the heavens and theearth rests<

segments.arabic: وَبِمَنْ سَكَنَ لَهُ مَا فِي ٱللَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ
segments.transliteration: wa biman sakana lahu ma fi allayli walnnahari
segments.translation: and in the name of the One to Whom whatsoever in the night and daylight rests
and He is the All-hearing and All-knowing.
Then, We made the wind subservient to him; it made his command
to run gently wherever he desired
and the devils, every builder and diver.
Verily, all things return to Allah.

segments.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي سَكَنَ لَهُ مَا فِي ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ
segments.transliteration: a`udhu billahi alladhi sakana lahu ma fi albarri walbahri
segments.translation: I beseech the protection of the One to Whom whatsoever in the lands, in the sea,
in the heavens, and in the earth rests
and He is the All-hearing and All-knowing.
âDo not those who disbelieve
see that the heavens and the earth
were closed up, but We have opened them

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ
segments.transliteration: wa ja`alna min alma'i kulla shay'in hayyin
segments.translation: and We have made of water everything living?
Will they not then believe?â

segments.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ أَنْ تَزُولاَ
segments.transliteration: inna allaha yumsiku alssamawati wal-arda an tazula
segments.translation: Surely, Allah upholds the heavens and the earth lest they come to naught;

segments.arabic: وَلَئِنْ زَالَتَا إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa la'in zalata in amsakahuma min ahadin min ba`dihi
segments.translation: and if they should come to naught, there is none who can uphold them after Him.
Surely, He is the Forbearing, the Forgiving.
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: كَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ لِلَّهِ فِي عِرْقٍ سَاكِنٍ
segments.transliteration: kam min ni`matin lillahi fi `irqin sakinin
segments.translation: Too many graces of Allah are in dormant vein.
ha-mim `ayn-sin-qaf
They shall not be affected with headache thereby nor shall they get exhausted.
Due to the words of the All-beneficent Lord, fires are extinguished.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاََّ بِٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power save with Allah.
Let the benefit of medicine pervade in you

segments.arabic: كَمَا يَجُولُ مَاءُ ٱلرَّبِيعِ فِي ٱلْغُصْنِ
segments.transliteration: kama yajulu ma'u alrrabi`i fi alghusni
segments.translation: just as the spring water pervades in twigs.
O Manifestly Existent,
O never missing although immanent!

segments.arabic: أُرْدُدْ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِكَ ٱلضَّعِيفِ أَيَادِيَكَ ٱلْجَمِيلَةَ عِنْدَهُ
segments.translation: Confer back Your excellent favors upon your weak servant

segments.arabic: وَأَذْهِبْ عَنْهُ مَا بِهِ مِنْ أَذىٰ
segments.transliteration: wa adhhib `anhu ma bihi min adhan
segments.translation: and remove from him the harm from which he is suffering.
Verily, You are All-merciful and Omnipotent.

segments.arabic: لَوْ أَنْزَلْنَا هٰذَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ عَلَى جَبَلٍ…
segments.translation: Had We sent down this Qur'an on a mountain
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ ٱسْمِهِ دَاءٌ
segments.transliteration: bismi allah alladhi la yadurru ma`a ismihi da'un
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah with Whose Name no malady will harm.

segments.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَهَا شَيْءٌ
segments.transliteration: a`udhu bikalimati allahi allati la yadurru ma`aha shay'un
segments.translation: I pray for the protection of Allahâs Words with which nothing will harm.
All-holy. All-holy. All-holy.
I beseech You, O my Lord, in Your Name,
the all-pure, the sacred, the all-blessed;
whoever beseeches You in Your Name, You will give him
and whoever implores You in Your Name, You will respond to him.

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: as'aluka ya allahu ya allahu ya allahu
segments.translation: I beseech you, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah,

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلنَّبِيِّ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin alnnabiyyi wa ahli baytihi
segments.translation: to bless Muhammad, the Prophet, and his Household

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُعَافِيَنِي مِمَّا أَجِدُ فِي فَمِي وَفِي رَأْسِي
segments.transliteration: wa an tu`afiyani mimma ajidu fi fami wa fi ra'si
segments.translation: and to cure me of the ache from which I am suffering in my mouth, my head,

segments.transliteration: wa fi sam`i wa fi basari
segments.translation: my hearing, my sight,

segments.transliteration: wa fi batni wa fi zahri
segments.translation: my stomach, my back,

segments.transliteration: wa fi yadi wa fi rijli
segments.translation: my hand, my leg,
and all of my organs.
And you see the mountains, you think them to be solid,
and they shall pass away as the passing away of the cloud--

segments.arabic: صُنْعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
segments.transliteration: sun`a allahi alladhi atqana kulla shay'in
segments.translation: the handiwork of Allah Who has made every thing thoroughly.
Surely, He is Aware of what you do.
In the Name of Allah.
The (true) Healer is Allah.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاََّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power save with Allah, the Most High and All-great.
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: وَلَهُ مَا سَكَنَ فِي ٱللَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ
segments.transliteration: wa lahu ma sakana fi allayli walnnahari
segments.translation: And to Him belongs whatever dwells in the night and the day
and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

segments.arabic: قُلْنَا يَا نَارُ كُونِي بَرْدًا وَسَلاَمًا عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
segments.transliteration: qulna ya naru kuni bardan wa salaman `ala ibrahima
segments.translation: We said: O fire! Be a comfort and peace to Abraham.

segments.transliteration: wa aradu bihi kaydan faja`alnahumu al-akhsarina
segments.translation: They desired a war on him but We made them the greatest losers.

segments.arabic: نُودِيَ أَنْ بُورِكَ مَنْ فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا
segments.transliteration: nudiya an burika man fi alnnari wa man hawlaha
segments.translation: Blessed is Whoever is in the fire and whatever is about it
and glory be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا كَافِياً مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ya kafiyan min kulli shay'in
segments.translation: O Allah, O He Who saves from all things
while nothing can save from You,
(please) save Your servant and the son of Your she-servant

segments.transliteration: min sharri ma yakhafu wa yahdharu
segments.translation: from the evil of what he fears and anticipates

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ ٱلْوَجَعِ ٱلَّذِي يَشْكُوهُ إِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri alwaja`i alladhi yashkuhu ilayka
segments.translation: and from the evil of the ache about which he is complaining to You.
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
In the Name of Allah (I begin) and in Allah (I trust).
Muhammad is the messenger of Allah
and Abraham is the friend of Allah.

segments.arabic: أُسْكُنْ بِٱلَّذِي سَكَنَ لَهُ مَا فِي ٱللَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ بِإِذْنِهِ
segments.transliteration: uskun billadhi sakana lahu ma fi allayli walnnahari bi'idhnihi
segments.translation: Calm down in the name of the One to Whom whatsoever is in the night and day rests by His permission<
and He has power over all things.
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
How wonderful! It is the wonder of wonders
that a worm in the mouth
eats the bone
and causes blood to come out.
I use this amulet
but Allah is the healer and the savior.
There is no god save Allah.
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

segments.transliteration: wa idh qataltum nafsan faddara'tum fiha
segments.translation: âAnd when you killed a man, then you disagreed with respect to that,
and Allah was to bring forth that which you were going to hide.
So, We said: Strike the dead body with part of the sacrificed cow.
Thus Allah brings the dead to life
and He shows you His signs so that you may understand.â
O Allah, You are my hope
and You are my trust and relianceâ¦

segments.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ya allahu ya allahu ya allahu
segments.translation: O Allah! O Allah! O Allah!
O All-beneficent! O All-merciful!
O Lord of all lords!
O God of all gods!
O King of all kings!
O Master of all masters!

segments.arabic: إِشْفِنِي بِشِفَائِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ وَسُقْمٍ
segments.transliteration: ishfini bishifa'ika min kulli da'in wa suqmin
segments.translation: (Please) cure me, with Your cure, of all maladies and illnesses,
for I am Your servant and the son of Your two servants
and I turn living under Your control.
I pray the protection of Allahâs almightiness and majesty
against the evil of what I feel.
In the Name of Allah.
I pray the protection of the Face of the All-great Allah,
His almightiness that is invulnerable,

segments.arabic: وَبِقُدْرَتِهِ ٱلَّتِي لاَ يَمْتَنِعُ مِنْهَا شَيْءٌ
segments.transliteration: wa biqudratihi allati la yamtani`u minha shay'un
segments.translation: and His omnipotence against which nothing can stop
against the evil of this pain,
the evil of whatever is in it,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri ma ajidu minhu
segments.translation: and the evil of what I feel because of it.

segments.arabic: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنْ ٱلْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّي نَسْفًا.
segments.transliteration: wa yas'alunaka `an aljibali faqul yansifuha rabbi nasfan
segments.translation: They ask thee concerning the Mountains, say, âMy Lord will uproot them and scatter them as dust;
He will leave them as plains smooth and level;

segments.arabic: لاَ تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلاَ أَمْتًا.
segments.transliteration: la tara fiha `iwajan wa la amtan
segments.translation: Nothing crooked or curved wilt thou see in their place.

segments.arabic: وَ مَثَلُ كَلِمَۃٍ خَبِيْثَۃٍ كَشَجَرَۃٍ خَبِيْثَۃِۨ اجْتُثَّتْ مِنْ فَوْقِ الْاَرْضِ مَا لَہَا مِنْ قَرَارٍ۝۲۶ وَ بُسَّتِ الْجِبَالُ بَسًّا۝۵ۙ فَكَانَتْ ہَبَاۗءً مُّنْۢبَثًّا۝۶ۙ
segments.transliteration: Wa Masalo Kalematin Khabeesatin Ka-Shajaratin Khabeesate Nij-Tussat Min Fawqil Arze Maa Lahaa Min Qaraar. Wa Bussatil Jebaalo Bassaan. Fa-Kaanat Habaaa-Am Munbassan.
segments.translation: And the parable of an evil word is as an evil tree pulled up from the earthâs surface; it has no stability. And the mountains shall be made to crumble with (an awful) crumbling, So that they shall be as scattered dust.

segments.arabic: لَوْ أَنْزَلْنَا هٰذَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ…
segments.translation: Had We sent down this Qur'an on a mountainâ¦
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
On the day that they shall see what they are promised,

segments.arabic: لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٱ إِلاََّ سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ
segments.transliteration: lam yalbathu illa sa`atan min naharin
segments.translation: they shall be as if they had not tarried save an hour of the day.
On the day that they see it,

segments.arabic: لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٱ إِلاََّ عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَاهَا
segments.translation: it will be as though they had not tarried but the latter part of a day or the early part of it.
When a woman of `Imran said:

segments.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطْنِي مُحَرَّراً
segments.transliteration: rabbi inni nadhartu laka ma fi batni muharraran
segments.translation: My Lord! Surely, I vow to You what is in my womb, to be devoted (to Your service);

segments.arabic: فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
segments.transliteration: fataqabbal minni innaka anta alssami`u al`alimu
segments.translation: accept therefore from me. Surely, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
And the throes (of childbirth) compelled her to betake herself to the trunk of a palm tree.

segments.arabic: قَالَتْ يَا لَيْتَنِي مِتُّ قَبْلَ هٰذَا
segments.transliteration: qalat ya laytani mittu qabla hadaa
segments.translation: She said: Oh, would that I had died before this,
and had been a thing quite forgotten.
Then (the child) called out to her from beneath her: Grieve not!
Surely, your Lord has made a stream to flow beneath you.
And shake towards you the trunk of the palm tree,
it will drop on you fresh ripe dates.
âAnd Allah has brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers;
you did not know anything;

segments.transliteration: wa ja`ala lakumu alssam`a wal-absara wal-af'idata
segments.translation: and He gave you hearing, sight, and hearts
that you may give thanks.â
So, come out O throes.
Come out, by the permission of Allah.
O Allah, O reliever of agonies,
dispeller of distresses,

segments.transliteration: wa rahmana alddunya wal-akhirati wa rahimahuma
segments.translation: and beneficent and merciful of this world and the Hereafter,
(please) have mercy uponâ¦

segments.arabic: رَحْمَةً تُغْنِيهَا بِهَا عَنْ رَحْمَةِ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: rahmatan tughniha biha `an rahmati jami`i khalqika
segments.translation: with such mercy that makes her dispense with the mercy of all of Your creatures,
relieve her anguish,
repel her distress,
and makes easy her childbirth.

segments.transliteration: wa qudiya baynahum bilhaqqi wa hum la yuzlamuna
segments.translation: âAnd judgment shall be given between them with justice,

segments.transliteration: wa qila alhamdu lillahi rabbi al`alamina
segments.translation: and it shall be said: All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.â
O Allah, (please) have mercy upon my soft skin
and my fragile bone.

segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min fawrati alhariqi
segments.translation: I pray Your protection against the outburst of fire.
O Ummu-Mildam (i.e. fever),
if you believe in Allah,
then do not eat the flesh,
do not drink the blood,
do not boil in the mouth,

segments.arabic: وَٱنْتَقِلِي إِلىٰ مَنْ يَزْعَمُ أَنَّ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلٰهاً آخَرَ
segments.transliteration: wantaqili ila man yaz`amu anna ma`a allahi ilahan akhara
segments.translation: and move to one who claims that there is another god with Allah,

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: fa'inni ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: for I bear witness that there is no god but Allah,
One and Only and having no associate,

segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.

segments.arabic: Ø¨ÙØ³ÙÙÙ Ø§ÙÙÙÙ Ø§ÙØ±ÙÙØ­ÙÙÙ°ÙÙ Ø§ÙØ±ÙÙØ­ÙÙÙÙ
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: ‏ بِسْمِ اللهِ‏ النُّوْرِ بِسْمِ اللهِ نُوْرِ النُّوْرِ
segments.translation: in the name of Allah, the light,

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ نُورٌ عَلٰى نُوْرٍ بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِيْ هُوَ مُدَبِّرُ الْاُمُوْرِ
segments.translation: in the name of Allah, the light, the light,in the name of Allah, who is He who manages all affairs,

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ النُّوْرَ مِنَ النُّوْرِ
segments.translation: In the. name of Allah who created light from light.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ النُّوْرَ مِنَ النُّوْرِ وَ اَنْزَلَ النُّوْرَ عَلَى الطُّوْرِ فِيْ‏ كِتَابٍ مَسْطُوْرٍ. فِيْ رَقٍّ مَنْشُوْرٍ بِقَدَرٍ مَقْدُوْرٍ عَلٰى نَبِيٍّ مَحْبُوْرٍ
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah who created light from light, and sent down light on the mountain (Tur), in between the inscribed book, in the parchment unrolled, by a means well-determined, on the (Holy) Prophet, the giver of glad tidings.

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ هُوَ بِالْعِزِّ مَذْكُوْرٌ وَ بِالْفَخْرِ مَشْهُوْرٌ وَ عَلَى السَّرَّاءِ وَ الضَّرَّاءِ مَشْكُوْرٌ
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah; it is He who is remembered with the highest of the high attributes, who is known to be the most glorious.In joy and happiness, in sand distress, He (alone) is thankfully praised.

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
segments.translation: Blessings of Allah be on our master, Muhammad, and on his pure children.

segments.arabic:
وَ لَہٗ مَا سَكَنَ فِيْ الَّيْلِ وَ النَّہَار۝۰ۭ وَ ہُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ۝۱۳
يَا اُمَّ مُلْدَمٍ اِنْ كُنْتِ اٰمَنْتِ بِاللهِ الْعَظِيْمِ وَ رَسُوْلِهِ الْكَرِيْمِ، فَلَا تَهْشِمِي الْعَظْمَ، وَ لَا تَاْكُلِيْ اللَّحْمَ، وَ لَا تَشْرَبِيْ الدَّمَ، اُخْرُجِيْ مِنْ حَامِلِ كِتَابِيْ هٰذَا اِلٰى مَنْ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللهِ الْعَظِيْمِ وَ رَسُوْلِهِ الْكَرِيْمِ وَ اٰلِهٖ، مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ فَاطِمَةَ وَ الْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ.‏
segments.transliteration:
Wa Lahu Maa Sakan Fil Layle Wan Nahaar, Wa Howas Samee-Uâl Aâleem.
Yaa Umma Muldamin In Kunte Aamante Bil-Laahil Aâzeeme Wa Rasoolehil Kareeme, Falaa Tahshemil Aâzma, Wa Laa Taakolil Lahma, Wa Laa Tashrabid Dama, Ukrojee Min Haamele Ketaabee Haazaa Elaa Maa Laa Yoameno Bil-Laahil Aâzeeme Wa Rasoolehil Kareeme Wa Aalehi, Mohammadin Wa Aâliyyin Wa Faatemata Wal Hasane Wal Husayne Aâlayhemus Salaamo.
segments.translation:
âAnd to Him belongs whatever dwells in the night and the day; and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.â 
O Umme Muldam! If you believe in Allah and His Messenger, the honorable, then do not make the bones decay, do not eat the flesh and do not drink the blood. Go out from the bearer of this writing to one, who does not believe in Allah, the Mighty and His honorable Messenger and his progeny, Muhammad and Ali and Fatima and al-Hasan and al-Husain (peace be upon them all).
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
âFear not! Surely, you shall be the uppermost.â
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: لاَ تَخَفْ نَجَوْتَ مِنْ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
segments.transliteration: la takhaf najawta min alqawmi alzzalimina
segments.translation: âFear not! You are secure from the unjust people.â
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
âSurely, His is the creation and the command.
Blessed is Allah, the Lord of the worlds.â
O Allah, I beseech You in the name of Your almightiness,
omnipotence, authority,
and whatever is comprehended by Your knowledge

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ لاَ تُسَلِّطَ عَلَىٰ… شَيْئاً مِمَّا خَلَقْتَ بِسُوءٍ
segments.transliteration: wa an la tusallta `alaâ¦ ibniâ¦ shay'an mimma khalaqta bisu'in
segments.translation: not to overload over [so-and-so] the son of [so-and-so] any thing evil that You have created,
and to have mercy upon his soft skin
and his fragile bone
against the outbursts of fire.
Come out, O Ummu-Mildam (i.e. fever),
eater of flesh,
and drinker of blood.
Its heat and coldness are from Hell.
If you have believed in Allah the Greatest,
then do not eat any thing of the flesh of [so-and-so] the son of [so-and-so],
do not suck any amount of his blood,
do not weaken any part of his bones,
do not stir up distress over him,
do not excite headache over him,
and move away from his hair, skin,
flesh, and blood

segments.arabic: إِلىٰ مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلٰهاً آخَرَ
segments.transliteration: ila man za`ama anna ma`a allahi ilahan akhara
segments.translation: to one who claims that there is another god with Allah
save Whom there is no god.
Glory be to Him and Exalted be Him against whatever they associate with Him.
âIn the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
The Beneficent, the Merciful.
Master of the Day of Judgment.
Thee do we serve and Thee do we beseech for help.
Keep us on the right pathâ
the path of those upon whom You have bestowed favors.
Not (the path) of those upon whom Your wrath is brought down,
nor of those who go astray.â
In the Name of Allah (I begin) and in Allah (I trust).
I pray the protection of all the perfect words of Allah,

segments.arabic: ٱلَّتِي لاَ يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلاَ فَاجِرٌ
segments.transliteration: allati la yujawizuhunna barrun wa la fajirun
segments.translation: beyond which neither a pious nor an impious can go,

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَذَرَأَ وَبَرَأَ
segments.transliteration: min sharri ma khalaqa wa dhara'a wa bara'a
segments.translation: against the evil of whatsoever He has created, fashioned, and made,
against the evil of the pestles, the poisonous,
the general (evils), and the ill sights,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri tawariqi allayli walnnahari
segments.translation: against the evil of the comers at nights and in days,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri fussaqi al`arabi wal`ajami
segments.translation: against the evil of the wicked Arabs and non-Arabs,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri fasaqati aljinni wal-insi
segments.translation: against the evil of the wicked jinn and men,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri alshshaytani wa shirkihi
segments.translation: against the evil of Satan and his snares,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri kulli dhi sharrin
segments.translation: against the evil of all evil things,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ هُوَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri kulli dabbatin huwa akhidhun binasiyatiha
segments.translation: and against the evil of every living creature that He holds it by its forelock.
Surely, my Lord is on the right path.
âOur Lord, on You do we rely,
to You do we turn,
and to You is the eventual coming.â

segments.arabic: يَا نَارُ كُونِي بَرْداً وَسَلاَماً عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
segments.transliteration: ya naru kuni bardan wa salaman `ala ibrahima
segments.translation: âO fire, be a comfort and peace to Abraham.

segments.transliteration: wa aradu bihi kaydan faja`alnahum al-akhsarina
segments.translation: They desired a war on him, but We made them the greatest losers.â
Let it be comfort and peace to [so-and-so] the son of [so-and-so (his motherâs name)].

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
segments.transliteration: rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na
segments.translation: âOur Lord, do not punish us if we forget or make a mistake.
Our Lord, do not lay on us a burden

segments.arabic: كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا
segments.translation: as You did lay on those before us.

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ
segments.transliteration: rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bihi
segments.translation: Our Lord, do not impose upon us that which we have not the strength to bear.
Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us.
You are our Patron;
so, help us against the unbelieving people.â
âSufficient to me is Allah.
There is no god save Him.
So, take Him for a protector.â

segments.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ
segments.transliteration: wa tawakkal `ala alhayyi alladhi la yamutu
segments.translation: âRely on the Ever-living Who dies not
and celebrate His praise.

segments.arabic: وَكَفىٰ بِهِ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيراً بَصِيراً
segments.transliteration: wa kafa bihi bidhunubi `ibadihi khabiran basiran
segments.translation: And Sufficient is He as being aware of the faults of His servants.â
There is no god but Allah,
One and Only and having no associate.
He has truly fulfilled His promise,
given victory to His servant,
and defeated the allies alone.
Only what Allah wills shall come to pass.
âThere is no power save with Allah.â

segments.transliteration: kataba allahu la'aghlibanna ana wa rusuli
segments.translation: âAllah has written down: I will most certainly prevail, I and My messengers.
Surely, Allah is Strong, Mighty.â
âSurely, the party of Allah are they that shall be triumphant.â
âAnd whoever holds fast to Allah,
he indeed is guided to the right path.â
May Allah bless Muhammad
and his pure and immaculate Household.
I will be tied up by the permission of Allah.
I have fled by the permission of Allah.
I will be calmed down by the permission of Allah.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا كَانَ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَمِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ma kana min khayrin faminka
segments.translation: O Allah, whatsoever good thing I have ever experienced has been from You
and I have no praiseworthy thing about it.

segments.arabic: وَمَا عَمِلْتُ مِنْ سُوءٍ فَقَدْ حَذَّرْتَنِيهِ
segments.transliteration: wa ma `amiltu min su'in faqad hadhdhartanihi
segments.translation: As for whatsoever evil I have done, You have already warned me against it;
therefore, I am not excused in doing it at all.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَتَّكِلَ عَلَىٰ مَا لاَ حَمْدَ لِي فِيهِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika an attakila `ala ma la hamda li fihi
segments.translation: O Allah, I thus pray Your protection against that I rely upon things that I have nopraiseworthy interference it them

segments.arabic: أَوْ آمَنَ مِمَّا لاَ عُذْرَ لِي فِيهِ
segments.transliteration: aw amana mimma la `udhra li fihi
segments.translation: or that I feel secure against things that I am unexcused in committing them.

segments.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا رَحْمَٰنُ يَا رَحِيمُ
segments.transliteration: ya allahu ya rahmanu ya rahimu
segments.translation: O Allah! O All-beneficent! O All-merciful!
O Hearer of prayers!
O Donor of the good!

segments.transliteration: a`tini khayra alddunya wa khayra al-akhirati
segments.translation: (Please) give me the good of this world and the good of the Hereafter,

segments.transliteration: wa qini sharra alddunya wa sharra al-akhirati
segments.translation: protect me against the evil of this world and the evil of the Hereafter,
and remove from me what I am facing,
for this matter has enraged and saddened me.
O Most High! O All-great!
O All-beneficent! O All-merciful!
O Hearer of prayers!
O Donor of the good!
(Please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.transliteration: wa a`tini min khayri alddunya wal-akhirati ma anta ahluhu
segments.translation: give me from the good of this world and the Hereafter

segments.transliteration: wasrif `anni min sharri alddunya wal-akhirati ma anta ahluhu
segments.translation: in a way that fits You,

segments.arabic: وَٱصْرِفْ عَنِّي مِنْ شَرِّ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.translation: repel from me the evil of this world and the Hereafter
in a way that fits You,
and remove from me this pain,
for it has enraged and saddened me.
âIn the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
And the parable of an evil word
is as an evil tree
pulled up from the earth's surface;
it has no stability.â
âFrom it, We created you
and into it, We shall send you back,
and from it, will We raise you a second time.â

segments.transliteration: allahu akbaru wa anta la tukabbiru
segments.translation: Allah is the Most Great, but you do not glorify His greatness.

segments.transliteration: allahu yabqa wa anta la tabqa
segments.translation: Allah shall remain forever, but you do not remain forever.
Allah has power over all things.
In the Name of Allah (I begin) and in Allah (I trust).

segments.arabic: بَلىٰ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ
segments.transliteration: bala man aslama wajhahu lillahi wa huwa muhsinun
segments.translation: âYes! Whoever submits himself entirely to Allah and he is the doer of good (to others),
he has his reward from his Lord,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
segments.transliteration: wa la khawfun `alayhim wa la hum yahzanuna
segments.translation: and there is no fear for him nor shall he grieve.â
O Allah, I have submitted myself to You
and entrusted my affair to You.

segments.arabic: لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَىٰ مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayka
segments.translation: There is neither shelter nor refuge against You except with You.
O most magnanimous of all those who may donate!
O best of all those who may be besought!
O most merciful of all those whose mercy is asked!
(Please) have mercy upon my weakness and my confusion
and release me from my pain.

segments.arabic: وَٱتْلُ مَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ كِتَابِ رَبِّكَ
segments.transliteration: watlu ma uhiya ilayka min kitabi rabbika
segments.translation: âAnd recite what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord.
There is none who can alter His words

segments.transliteration: wa lan tajida min dunihi multahadan
segments.translation: and you shall not find any refuge besides Him.â

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bihaqqi muhammadin wa ali muhammadin `alayka
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of the right of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad that is incumbent upon You

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.transliteration: wa an taj`ala alnnura fi basari
segments.translation: and to place light in my sight,
insight in my faith,
certitude in my heart,
sincerity in my deeds,
safety in my self,
opulence in my sustenance,
and thanks for You forever as long as You keep me alive.
I pray the protection of Allahâs almightiness,
I pray the protection of Allahâs all-powerfulness,
I pray the protection of Allahâs omnipotence,
I pray the protection of Allahâs light,
I pray the protection of Allahâs grandeur,
I pray the protection of Allahâs majesty,
I pray the protection of Allahâs beauty,
I pray the protection of Allahâs splendor,
I pray the protection of Allahâs wholeness,
I pray the protection of Allahâs pardon,
I pray the protection of Allahâs forgiveness,
I pray the protection of Allahâs Messenger
I pray the protection of the Imams:
`Ali ibn Abi-Talib,
al-Hasan ibn `Ali,
al-Husayn ibn `Ali,
`Ali ibn al-Husayn,
Muhammad ibn `Ali,
Ja`far ibn Muhammad,
Musa ibn Ja`far,
`Ali ibn Musa,
Muhammad ibn `Ali,
`Ali ibn Muhammad,
al-Hasan ibn `Ali,
and al-Hujjah (the Argument-person) ibn al-Hasan,
over whatever we wish
against the evil of what I am feeling.
O Allah! O Lord of the obedient!
For the light of my sight, I pray
the protection of Allahâs light that is inextinguishable.
Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein a lamp is.
The lamp is in a glass.
The glass is as it were a shining star.
(This lamp is) kindled from a blessed tree, an olive
neither of the east nor of the west,
whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself)
though no fire touched it.
Light upon light.
Allah guides to His light whom He will.
And Allah speaks to mankind in allegories,
for Allah is Knower of all things.

segments.arabic: يَا قَرِيبُ يَا مُجِيبُ يَا سَمِيعَ الدُّعَاءِ يَا لَطِيفاً لِمَا تَشَاءُ رُدَّ عَلَيَّ بَصَرِي

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ وَ أَدْعُوكَ وَ أَرْغَبُ إِلَيْكَ وَ أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنِّي أَتَوَجَّهُ بِكَ إِلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّي وَ رَبِّكَ لِيَرُدَّ بِكَ عَلَيَّ نُورَ بَصَرِي
اُعِيْذُ نُوْرَ بَصَرِىْ بِنُوْرِ اللهِ الَّذِىْ لاَ يُطْفَا
وَ قُلْ رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَ أَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَ اجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطاناً نَصِيراً
‎بسم الله و بالله محمد رسول الله ، و لا حول و لا قوة إلا بالله العلي العظيم ، اللهم امسح عني ما أحذر

title: Duas to overcome Worries Anxiety Hardship

segments.translation: O Allah, drive the misfortune away from me.
O the (ever) existing who is a priori to all existence; O the creator (who says âbeâ and it becomes) of all things, O the everlasting eternal even when everything (created) shall perish:

segments.arabic:
يَا كَائِنًا قَبْلَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ

 وَ يَا مُكَوِّنَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ء

ٍ وَ يَا بَاقِي بَعْدَ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ء

ٍ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ افْعَلْ بِيْ
segments.transliteration: yaa kaaa-inan qabla kulli shay -in wa yaa mukawwina kulli shay -in wa yaa baaqiya ba'da kulli shay -in s'alli ala muh'ammadin wa ahli baytihee waf-a'l bee
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him. I seek protection of Allah and I beseech Him to give me His bounties generously.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْعَظِيْمِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ وَاَسْألَهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ
segments.transliteration: subh'aanallaahil a'z'eemi wa bih'amdihee astaghfirullaaahaa wa as-aluhoo min faz'lihee
segments.translation: I enumerate the merits of all that which are glorious and magnificent (to know that) there is no god save Allah; and for (removal of) pains and sorrows there is no power nor strength (in any) save in Allah. Muhammad is the first light, Ali the second light; and all the pious Imams (of the Ahlul Bayt) are a means to reach the presence of Allah and a protection from the enemies of Allah. All things are dwarfed in presence of the greatness of Allah. I seek sufficient (support) from Allah, the mighty, the glorious.

segments.arabic: اَعْدَدْتُ لِكُلِِّ عَظِيْمَةٍ لَآ اِله اِلاَّ اللهُ وَ لِكُلِِّ هَمٍٍّ وَ غَمِِِّ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ اِلاَّ باِللهِ مُحَمَّدٌ نُوْرُ الْاوَّلُ وَ عَلِىٌّ نُوْرُ الثَّانِىْ وَ الْاَءِمَّةُ الْاَبْرَارُ عُدَّةٌ لِلِقَآءِ اللهِ وَ حِجَابٌ مِنْ اَعْدَآءِ اللهِ ذَلَّ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ لِعَظَمَةِ اللهِ وَأَسْأَلُ اللهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ الْكِفَايَةَ
segments.transliteration: a'-dadtu likulli a'z'eematin laa ilaaha illallaahu wa likulli hammin wa ghammin laa h'awla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah muh'ammadun noorul awwalu wa a'liyaun nooruth thaanee wal a-immatul abraaru u'ddatun liliqaaa-illaahi wa h'ijaabun min a-daaa-illaahi d'alla kulli shay-in li-a'z'amatillaahi wa as-alullaaha a'zza wa jallal kifaayah
segments.translation: O Allah, if my sins have blackened my face, I turn to You through Your prophet, Muhammad, the prophet of mercy, blessings of Allah be on him and on his children, (and through) Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, Husayn and the (rest of the) Imams (of the Ahl ul Bayt), peace be on all of them.

segments.arabic: اَلَّلهُمَّ اِنْ كَانَتْ ذَنُوْبِىْ قَدْ اَخْلَقَتْ وَجْهِیْ عِنْدَكَ فَاِنِِّیْ اَتَوَجَّهُ اِلَيْكَ نَبِىِِّ الرَّحْمَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اَلِهِ وَ عَلِىِِِّ وَ فَاطِمَةَ وَالْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ وَ الْأِمَّةِ عَلَيْهِمْ السَلَامُ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma in kaanat d'unoobee qad akhlaqat wajhee i'ndaka fa innee atawajjahu ilayka bi nabiyyika nabiyyir rah'mati muhammadin s'allallaahu a'layhi wa aalihee wa a'liyyin wa faat'imata walah'asani wal h'usayni wal a-immati a'layhimus salaam
segments.translation: Allah suffices me. There is no god but He. On Him do I rely, and He is the Lord of the great throne.

segments.arabic: حَسْبِىَ اللهُ لَآ اٍلَهَ اِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ-
segments.transliteration: h'asbiyallaahu laaa ilaaha illaa huw a'layhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul a'rshil a'z'eem.
segments.translation: I entrust my affair to Allah, verily, Allah keeps an eye on (His) servants.

segments.arabic: وَ أُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِيْ إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيْرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ
segments.transliteration: wa ufawwiz'u amree ilallaah innallaaha bas'eerum bil ibaad
segments.translation: There is no god save You. Glory be to You. Verily I was of there unjust. Then We responded to him and delivered him from grief, thus do We deliver the believers.

segments.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّيْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهٗ وَ نَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَ كَذٰلِكَ نُنْجِي الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: laa ilaaha illaaa anta subh'aanaka innee kuntu minaz'z'aalimeen fas-tajabnaa lahoo wa najjaynaahu minal ghamm wa kad'aalika nunjil moomineen
segments.translation: Allah is sufficient for us; and most excellent is He (who) protects us.
There is no power and no strength save with Allah the high, the great.

segments.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ.
segments.transliteration: LAA H'AWLA WA LAA QUWWATA ILLAA BILLAAHIL A'LIYYIL A'Z'EEM
segments.translation: O Allah, give us welfare from wheresoever You desire, as You wish and when You want. Verily You do that which You find satisfying because it pleases You.

segments.arabic: اَلَّلهُمَّ اَتِنِىْ بِالْعَافِيَةِ مِنْ حَيْثُ شِئْتَ وَ كَيْفَ شِئْتَ وَ اَنَّی شِئْتَ فَاِنَّكَ تَفْعَلُ مَا شِئْتَ كَيْفَ شِئْتَ-
segments.transliteration: allaahumma aatinee bin a'afiyati min h'aythu shi-ta wa kayfa shi-ta wa annaa shi-ta fa-innaka taf-a'lu maa shi-ta kayfa shi-ta
segments.translation:
O Allah, verily You, unto those who love You, are more loving than any who loves; You are ever at hand to fulfill atonce the desires of those who rely on You; You take notice of their wishes, You perceive their innermost thoughts, You know the depth of their intelligence. You are fully aware of their confidential concerns. There hearts long for (relief from) You. Whenever miserable and forsaken Your remembrance comfort them in distress. Whenever misfortunes assult them, they turn to You, knowing well that the reins of all affairs are in Your hand and every affair rise from and flow out as soon as Your decision is made. O my Allah, if I falter in speaking my request and wander astray in describing my needs and wants, show me the way that leads to that which promotes my interests and turn my heart to its course, because it is neither against (the principles of) Your guidance nor Your act of giving succour can be described as unlikely.
O my Allah, support me with Your pardon, do not burden me with Your justice.

segments.arabic: اَلَّلهُمَّ اِنَّكَ اَنَسُ اَنِسِيْنَ لِاَوْلِيَآئِكَ وَ اَحْضَرَهُمْ بِالْكِفَايَةِ لِلْمُتَوَكِِّلِيْنَ عَلَيْكَ تُشَاهِدُهُمْ فِىْ سَرَائِرِهِمْ وَ تَطَّلِعُ عَلَيْهِمْ فِىْ ضَمَائِرِهِمْ وَ تَعْلَمُ سَبْلَغَ بَصَئِرِهِمْ فَاَسْرَرَهُمْ لَكَ مَكْشُوْفَةٌ وَ قُلُوبُهُمْ اِلَيْكَ مُلْهُوفَةٌ اِنْ اَوْ حَشَتْهُمُ اَلْغُرْبَةُ اَنَسَهُمْ ذِكْرُك وَ اِنْ صَبَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ الْمَصَائِبُ لَجَآئُا اِلَى الْاِسْتِجَارَةِ بِكَ عِلْمًا بِاَنَّ اَزِمَّةِ الْاَمُوْرِ بِيَدِكَ بِمَصَادِرَهَا عَنْ قَضَآئِكَ- اَلَّلهُمَّ اِنْ فَهَهْتُ عَنْ مَسْأَلَتِىْ اَوْ عَمِهْتُ عَنْ طَلِبَتِىْ فَدُلَّنِىْ عَلىَ مَصَالِحِیْ وَ خُذْ بِقَلْبِىْ اِلىَ مَرَاشِدِىْ فَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ بِنُکْرِ مِنْ هِدَايَاتِكَ وَلاَ بِبَدَعٍ مِنْ كِفَايَاتِكَ- اَلَّلهُمَّ احْمِلْنِىْ عَلىَ عَفْوِك وَلاَ تَحْمِلْنِىْ عَلىَ عَدْلِكَ-
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma innaka annisul aaneeseena li-awliyaa-ika wa ah'z"uruhum bil kifaayati lil mutawakkileena a'layka tashhaduhum fee sarra-irihim wea tat't'ali-u fee z"amaa--irihim wa ta'lamu mablagha bas'aa-irihim fa-asraaruhum laka makshoofatun wa quloobuhum ilayka malhoofatun in awh'ashat-humul ghurbatu aanasahum d'ikruka wa in s'ubbat a'layhimul mas'aa-ibu lajaaa-u ilal istijaarati bika i'lman bi-anna a'z'eematal umoori biyadika wa mas'aadirahaa a'n qaz" aaa-ika allaahumma in fahah-tu mas-alatee aw a'mihtu a'n t'alibatee fadullanee a'laa mas'aalih'ee wa khud' biqalbee ilaa maraashidee fa laysa d'aalika binukrin min hidaayatika wa laa bibad-i'n min kifaayatika allaahummah-malnee a'laa a'fwika wa laa tah'milnee a'laa a'dlika
segments.translation: O God, verily You are the closest companion to Your friends (saints),
and You are present with sufficiency for those who rely upon You.
You witness them in their innermost thoughts,
and You are aware of what is in their consciences,
and You know the extent of their insights.
So, their secrets are revealed to You,
and their hearts yearn towards You.
If loneliness makes them feel desolate, Your remembrance comforts them,
and if calamities pour down upon them,
they turn to seek Your protection,
knowing that the reins of all affairs are in Your Hand,
with their origin stemming from Your decree.
O God, if I become confused about my request,
or become unaware of what I truly need,
then guide me to what is beneficial for me,
and take my heart towards what is right for me,
for that is not unheard of among Your guidance,
nor is it an innovation among Your fulfillments.
O God, bear with me with Your pardon,
and do not bear with me with Your justice.
O Pillar of him who has no pillar,

segments.arabic: يَا عِمادَ مَنْ لا عِمادَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: YÄ âImÄda man lÄ âimÄda lah
segments.translation: and O Treasure of him who has no treasure,

segments.arabic: وَ يَا ذُخْرَ مَنْ لَا ذُخْرَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ Dhukhra man lÄ dhukhra lah
segments.translation: and O Support of him who has no support,

segments.arabic: وَ يَا سَنَدَ مَنْ لَا سَنَدَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ Sanada man lÄ sanada lah
segments.translation: and O Sanctuary of him who has no sanctuary,

segments.arabic: وَ يَا حِرْزَ مَنْ لَا حِرْزَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ á¸¤irza man lÄ á¸¥irza lah
segments.translation: and O Succour of him who has no succour,

segments.arabic: وَ يَا غِيَاثَ مَنْ لَا غِيَاثَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ GhiyÄtha man lÄ ghiyÄtha lah
segments.translation: and O Treasure of him who has no treasure,

segments.arabic: وَ يَا كَنْزَ مَنْ لَا كَنْزَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ Kanza man lÄ kanza lah
segments.translation: and O Honour of him who has no honour,

segments.arabic: وَ يَا عِزَّ مَنْ لَا عِزَّ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ âIzza man lÄ âizza lah
segments.translation: O Generous in Forgiveness,
O Excellent in Overlooking (sins),
O Helper of the weak,
O Treasure of the poor,
O Great in Hope,
O Rescuer of the drowned,
O Deliverer of the perished,
O Benefactor,
O Beautifier (Giver of Grace),
O Bestower of blessings,
O Giver of abundance,
You are the One to Whom the darkness of the night prostrates,

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ الَّذِي سَجَدَ لَكَ سَوادُ اللَّيْلِ
segments.transliteration: Anta l-ladhÄ« sajada laka sawÄdu l-layl
segments.translation: and the light of the day,
and the brightness of the moon,
and the ray of the sun,
and the rustling of the trees,
and the humming (rushing sound) of the water.
O God, O God, O God,

segments.arabic: يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ يَا اللهُ
segments.transliteration: YÄ AllÄhu yÄ AllÄhu yÄ AllÄh
segments.translation: there is no god but You, You alone, there is no partner for You.

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
segments.transliteration: lÄ ilÄha illÄ Anta waá¸¥daka lÄ sharÄ«ka lak
segments.translation: O My Lord! O God!
Bless Muá¸¥ammad and the Family of Muá¸¥ammad,

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: and deal with us as is befitting of You.

segments.arabic: وَ افْعَلْ بِنَا مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: wa fâal binÄ mÄ Anta ahluh.
segments.translation: Then ask for your need.

-this (and) this-and you were not (present) in the western side when We sent our command to Musa, neither you were there to witness. O accursed, go away by the power of Allah, and by the honour of the Lord of the worlds. Get out imprisoned. Get out from this. It is not for you to show pride here, so get out, verily you are of those despised. Get out of this, despised, driven away; accursed as We cursed the people of the Sabbath, and the command of Allah is always executed. Get out, O afflicted. Get out O Sooran O Sooran in the name of that name which is kept secret, O Tatâaaroon Tâaroon Mar-oâon. Blessings be for Allah who is the best creator. O Hayaa, O Hayaa, in the name of the everliving ever-subsisting name which is written on the forehead of Israafeel disappear at once from the holder of this written text, (whoever it may be) a genie (male or female), a devil (male or female) or a follower of (the devil, male or female), a sorcerer or sorcersess, a demon (male or female), a juggler or a trickster, whoever endangers the lives of the sons of Adam and daughters of Hawwaa. There is no power and strength (with any one) save with Allah, the highest, the greatest. Blessings of Allah be on Muhammad and on his pure, purified, and infallible children.

segments.arabic: ی کنوش ارکنوش اره شش عطبیطسفينخ یَا مططرون قریالسيون وما سوما سوما طيطسالوس خبظوس مسفقيس مسا معوش افرطیعوش لطيفکش لطیفوش هَذَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنْتَ بِجَانِبِ الْغَرْبِىِِّ اِذْ قَضَيْنَا اِلىَ مُوْسَى الْاَمْرَ وَمَا كُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُشَاهِدِيْنَ اُخْرُجْ بِقُدْرَةِ اللهِ مِنْهَا اَيُّهَا الْلَّعِيْنُ بِعزَّةِ اللهِ رَبِِّ الْعْاَمِيْنَ اُخْرُجْ مِنْهَا وَ اِلاَّ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِيْنَ اُخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَمَا يَكُوْنُ لَكَ اَنْ تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيْهَا فَاخْرُجْ اِنَّكَ مِنَ الصَّاغِرِيْنَ اُخْرُجْ مِنْهَا مُذْئُوْمًا مَدْحُوْرًا مَلْعُوْنًا كَمَا لَعَنَّا اَصْحَابَ السَّبْتِ وَ كَانَ اَمْرُ اللهِ مَفْعُوْلاً اُخْرُجْ يَا ذَوِىْ الْمَحْزُوْنَ اُخْرُجْ یَا سُوْرًا یَا سُوْرًا سُوْرٌ بِالاِسْمِ الْمَحْتزُوْنِ يَا طَطَرُونَ طَرْعُوْنَ مَرَعُوْنَ تَبَارَكَ اللهُ اَحْسَنَ الْخَالِقِيْنَ یَا هَيَا يَا هَيَا شَرَاهِيَّا حَيَّا قَيُّومًا بِالاِسْمِ الْمَكْتُوْبُ عَلىَ جَبْهَةِ اِسْرَافِيْلَ اَطْرُدُوْا عَنْ صَاحِبِ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ كُلَّ جِنِِّىٍ وَ جِنَيَّةٍ وَ شَيْطَانٍ وَ شَیْطَانَةٍ وَتَابِعٍ وَ تَابِعَةٍ وَ صَاحِرٍ وَ صَاحِرَةٍ وَ غَوْلٍ وَ غَوْلَةٍ
segments.transliteration: iykanoosh arkanoosh arahshah a'tbeetas faneekh yaa matt'aroon qaryaa laysiyoon maa wa maa soomaa soomaa taytasaaloos khabt'oos musfaqees masaama-o'osh afartee-o'osh lateefakash lat'eefoosh haad'aa haad'aa wa maa kunta bijaanibil gharibbee id'qaz"aynaa ilaa moosal amra wa maa kunta minashshaahi deenaa ukhruj biqudratillaahi minhaa ayyuhal la-e'enu bi-i'zzatillaahi rabbil a'alameen ukhruj minhaa wa illaa kunta minal masjooneena ukhruj minhaa famaa yakoonu laka an tatakabbara feehaa fakhruj innaka minas' s'aaghireen ukhruj minhaa mad-ooman madh'ooran mal-o'onan kamaa la-a'nnaa as'h'aabas sabri wa kaana amrullaahi maf-o'olan ukhruj yaa d'awil mah'zoona ukhruj yaa sooran yaa sooran yuaa sooran bil ismil makhzooni yaa t'at'aroon tar -o'on maraa - o'on tabaarakallaahu ah'sanul hiyyaa h'ayyan qayyooman bil-ismil maktoobi a'laa jabhati israafeela ut'rudoo a'n s'aah'ibi haad'al kitaabi kulla jinnin wa jinniyyatin shayt'aanin wa shayt'aanatin wa taabi-i'n wa taabi-a'tin wa saah'irin wa saah'iratin wa ghoolin wa ghoolatin wa kulla muta-a'bbithin wa a'abithin yaa'bathu bibni aadama wa binaati h'awwaa wa laa h'awla wa laa quwwata illaa billaahil a'liyyil a'z'eem wa s'allallaahu a'laa muh'ammadin wa aalihee ajma-e'enat tayyibeenat t'aahireenal maa'soomeen
segments.translation: O Humiliator of all tyrants! O Dignifier of all humble ones! I, swearing by You, have exerted all efforts; so, send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household and relieve me.[1]

segments.arabic: يَا مُذِلَّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيْدٍ يَا مُعِزَّ كُلِّ ذَلِيْلٍ قَدْ وَ حَقِّكَ بَلَغَ مَـجْهُوْدِيْ فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهٖ وَ فَرِّجْ عَنِّيْ.
segments.transliteration: yaa mozilla kulle jabbaarin aâneedin yaa o-iâzza kulle zaleelin qad wa haqqeqa balagha majhoodee fa-salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aalehi wa farrij aânnee.
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, Praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, He is One and there are no partners for Him, He is Living, and He will not die, all good is through Him, and He has power over all things

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَ الْـحَمْدُ لِلهِ وَ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَ لَهُ الْـحَمْدُ يُـحْيِيْ وَ يُـمِيْتُ وَ هُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَـمُوْتُ بِيَدِهِ الْـخَيْرُ وَ هُوَ عَلٰى‏ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيْر
segments.transliteration: subhaanal laahe wal hamdo lillaahe wa laa elaaha illal laaho wahdahu laa shareeka lahu lahul mulko wa lahul hamdo yohyee wa yomeeto wa howa hayyun laa yamooto beyadehil khayro wa howa aâlaa kulle shayin qadeer.
segments.translation:
.
There are no means and no power without Allah the Most High, the Most Great.

segments.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ.
segments.transliteration: laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaahil aâliyyi
segments.translation: O Allah! I implore You in by the right of Your friend, Ali Ibn Moosa al-Reza (a.s.) to secure me during my journeys; in lands and seas, on mountains and in plains, in valleys and in jungles, against all that which I fear or anticipate. Certainly You are All-Kind and All-Merciful.[3]

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِـحَقِّ وَلِيِّكَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوْسَى الرِّضَا اِلَّا مَا سَلَّمْتَنِيْ بِهٖ فِيْ جَـمِيْعِ اَسْفَارِيْ فِيْ الْبَرَارِيْ وَ الْبِحَارِ وَ الْـجِبَالِ وَ الْقِفَارِ وَ الْاَوْدِيَةِ وَ الْغِيَاضِ مِنْ جَـمِيْعِ مَا اَخَافُهٗ وَ اَحْذَرُهٗ اِنَّكَ رَءُوْفٌ رَحِيْمٌ.‏
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-aloka be-haqqe waliyyeka aâliy yibne moosar rezaa illaa maa sallamtanee behi fee jamee-eâ asfaaree fil baraaree wal behaare wal jebaale wal qefaare wal aw-deyate wal gheyaaze min jamee-eâ maa akhaafohu wa ahzarohu innaka raoofur raheem.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, I believe in Allah, I place my trust in Allah, as Allah wills. There are no means and no power without Allah.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ آمَنْتُ بِاللهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ مَا شَاءَ اللهُ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ
segments.transliteration: bismil laahe aamanto bil-laahe tawakkalto aâlal laahe maa shaa allaaho laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, I have come out, in the name of Allah, I enter, in Allah I have placed my trust, and there are no means and no power without Allah the Most High, the Most Great.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ خَرَجْتُ وَ بِسْمِ اللهِ وَلَـجْتُ وَ عَلَى اللهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ‏
segments.transliteration: bismil laahe kharajto wa bismil laahe walajto wa aâlal laahe tawakkalto wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa bil-laahil aâliyyil aâzeem.
segments.translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

O Allah! My many sins have made me lose face before You, prevented me from being worthy of Your mercy, and kept me away from deserving Your forgiveness! I have adhered to Your boons and clung to supplicating You, for You have promised those who are like me in acting extravagantly (against their own souls), making errors, and despairing of Your mercy through Your words: âSay: O My servants who have acted extravagantly against their own souls, do not despair of the mercy of Allah; surely Allah forgives the faults altogether; surely He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.â[9] You have warned those who despair of Your mercy and said: âAnd who despairs of the mercy of his Lord but the erring ones.â[10] Then You have summoned us through Your mercy to supplicate You, thus You have said: âCall upon me, I will answer you; surely those who are too proud for My mercy shall soon enter hell abased.â[11] O my Lord! Hopelessness has covered me, and despair of Your mercy has wrapped me! O my Lord! You have promised to reward him who has good opinion in You and to punish him who has bad opinion in You! O Allah! My eye has been seized by good opinion of You in releasing my neck from the Fire, covering my slips, releasing (me) from my stumble! O Allah! Your words, which have neither alteration nor change, are true: â(Remember) the day when We will call every people with their Imam.â[12] That is the Day of Resurrection when the trumpet shall be blown and âwhat is in the graves shall be raised.â[13] O Allah! I believe, witness, confess, do not deny, do not renege, conceal, announce, manifest, and hide that You are Allah, there is no god but You, One with no partner with You, that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger, may Allah bless him and his Family, and that Ali, the Commander of the faithful, master of the testamentary trustees, inheritor of knowledge of the prophets, emblem of religion, destroyer of the hypocrites, the fighter against the Renegades (Maareqeen), my Imam, my proof, my handle, my path, my guide, and my argument. I do not trust my deeds though pure; nor do I see that they will save me though righteous but through (showing) friendship to him, following his example, acknowledging his great virtues, accepting from those who delivered them, and submitting to those who narrated them. I confess that his testamentary trustees from among his grandsons are Imams, arguments, guides, lamps, guideposts, lighthouses, masters, and pious. I believe in their secret, their openness, their outward, their inward, their present, their absent, their living, and their dead. In that there is neither doubt nor suspicion nor change when You turn away (from that). O Allah! summon me on the day of my mustering and my resurrecting through their Imamate, and save me, O My Master! From the heat of the Fires through them, and supply me with the repose of the Gardens! Surely, if You release me from the Fire, I will be one of the achievers. O Allah! I rose in the morning of this day of mine (while) I have neither confidence nor hope nor asylum nor place of flight nor shelter except those through whom I seek access to You, seeking nearness to Your Messenger Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Family, then Ali, the Commander of the faithful, al-Zahra, the mistress of the women of the worlds, al-Hasan, al-Husain, Ali, Muhammad, Jaâfar, Moosa, Ali, Muhammad, Ali, al-Hasan and the one after them who will pave the way for the hidden proof from among his children, hoped for the community after him. O Allah! Make them in this day and after it my fortress against detested things and my stronghold against fears; save me through them from every enemy, tyrant, oppressor, sinner, the evil of what I know, what I deny, what has hidden from me, what I see, and the evil of every crawling creature that You have taken by the forelock! Surely You are on a straight path. O Allah! Through my seeking access through them to You, seeking nearness to You through showing love for them, fortifying myself with their Imamate, open for me the doors to Your provision; spread upon me Your mercy; make Your creatures love me; turn me aside from their detest and their enmity! Verily You are powerful over everything. O Allah! There is reward for everyone (who) seek access (through them to You); there is right for all the possessors of intercession, hence by him whom You have appointed as Your friend and placed ahead my request, I ask You to make me recognize the blessing of this day of mine, this month of mine, and this year of mine! O Allah! They are my place of flight and my help during my hardship, my ease, my well-being, my tribulation, my sleep, my wakefulness, my departure, my residence, my difficulty, my facility, my openness, my secret, my morning, my evening, my movement, my habitation, my secret, and my apparent! O Allah! Through them, disappoint me not of Your favor; cut not my hope from Your mercy; disappoint me not of Your repose; tempt me not with the closure of the doors to provisions and of the ways to them; open for me an easy opening from You; appoint for me a way out from every hardship and a road for every plenty! Surely, You are the Most Merciful of the merciful. May Allah bless Muhammad and his good and pure Household! Amen, Lord of the worlds![14]

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ‏

اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ ذُنُوْبِيْ وَ كَثْرَتَهَا قَدْ اَخْلَقَتْ وَجْهِيْ عِنْدَكَ وَ حَـجَبَتْنِيْ عَنِ اسْتِيْهَالِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ بَاعَدَتْنِيْ عَنِ اسْتِيْجَابِ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ لَوْ لَا تَعَلُّقِيْ بِآلَائِكَ وَ تَـمَسُّكِيْ بِالدُّعَآءِ وَ مَا وَعَدْتَ اَمْثَالِيْ مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِيْنَ وَ اَشْبَاهِيْ مِنَ الْـخَاطِئِيْنَ وَ اَوْعَدْتَ الْقَانِطِيْنَ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ بِقَوْلِكَ ’’يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِہِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَۃِ اللہِ۝۰ۭ اِنَّ اللہَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا۝۰ۭ اِنَّہٗ ہُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ‘‘ وَ حَذَّرْتَ الْقَانِطِيْنَ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ فَقُلْتَ ’’وَمَنْ يَّقْنَطُ مِنْ رَّحْمَۃِ رَبِّہٖٓ اِلَّا الضَّاۗلُّوْنَ‘‘ ثُمَّ نَدَبْتَنَا بِرَاْفَتِكَ اِلٰى دُعَآئِكَ فَقُلْتَ ’’اُدْعُوْنِيْٓ اَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ۝۰ۭ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِيْ سَيَدْخُلُوْنَ جَہَنَّمَ دٰخِرِيْنَ‘‘ اِلٰهِيْ لَقَدْ كَانَ ذٰلِكَ الْاِيَاسُ عَلَيَّ مُشْتَمِلًا وَ الْقُنُوْطُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مُلْتَحِفًا. اِلٰهِيْ لَقَدْ وَعَدْتَ الْمُحْسِنَ ظَنَّهٗ بِكَ ثَوَابًا وَ اَوْعَدْتَ الْمُسِيْۗ‏ءَ ظَنَّهٗ بِكَ عِقَابًا. اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ قَدْ اَمْسَكَ رَمَقِيْ حُسْنُ الظَّنِّ بِكَ فِيْ عِتْقِ رَقَبَتِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ وَ تَغَمُّدِ زَلَّتِيْ وَ اِقَالَةِ عَثْرَتِيْ. اَللّٰهُمَّ قُلْتَ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ وَ قَوْلُكَ الْـحَقُّ الَّذِيْ لَا خُلْفَ لَهٗ وَ لَا تَبْدِيْلَ ’’يَوْمَ نَدْعُوْا كُلَّ اُنَاسٍؚبِـاِمَامِہِمْ‘‘ وَ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ النُّشُوْرِ اِذَا نُفِخَ فِيْ الصُّوْرِ وَ ’’بُعْثِرَ ما فِيْ الْقُبُوْرِ‘‘ اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاِنِّيْ اَوْفٰي وَ اَشْهَدُ وَ اَقِرُّ وَ لَا اُنْكِرُ وَ لَا اَجْـحَدُ وَ اُسِرُّ وَ اُعْلِنُ وَ اُظْهِرُ وَ اُبْطِنُ بِاَنَّكَ اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ وَ اَنَّ مُـحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُوْلُكَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِہٖ وَ اَنَّ عَلِيًّا اَمِيْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ سَيِّدُ الْاَوْصِيَآءِ وَ وَارِثُ عِلْمِ الْاَنْبِيَآءِ عَلَمُ الدِّيْنِ وَ مُبِيْرُ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ وَ مُـمَيِّزُ الْمُنَافِقِيْنَ وَ مُـجَاهِدُ الْمَارِقِيْنَ وَ اِمَامِيْ وَ حُـجَّتِيْ وَ عُرْوَتِيْ وَ صِرَاطِيْ وَ دَلِيْلِيْ وَ حُـجَّتِيْ وَ مَنْ لَا اَثِقُ بِاَعْمَالِيْ وَ لَوْ زَكَتْ وَ لَا اَرَاهَا مُنْجِيَةً لِيْ وَ لَوْ صَلُحَتْ اِلَّا بِوِلَايَتِهٖ وَ الْاِئْتِـمَامِ بِهٖ وَ الْاِقْرَارِ بِفَضَآئِلِهٖ وَ الْقَبُوْلِ مِنْ حَمَلَتِهَا وَ التَّسْلِيْمِ لِرُوَاتِهَا وَ اُقِرُّ بِاَوْصِيَآئِهٖ مِنْ اَبْنَآئِهٖ اَئِـمَّةً وَ حُـجَجًا وَ اَدِلَّةً وَ سُرُجًا وَ اَعْلَامًا وَ مَنَارًا وَ سَادَةً وَ اَبْرَارًا وَ اُوْمِنُ بِسِرِّهِمْ وَ جَهْرِهِمْ وَ ظَاهِرِهِمْ وَ بَاطِنِهِمْ وَ شَاهِدِهِمْ وَ غَآئِبِهِمْ وَ حَيِّهِمْ وَ مَيِّتِهِمْ لَا شَكَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ وَ لَا ارْتِيَابَ عِنْدَ تَـحَوُّلِكَ وَ لَا انْقِلَابَ. اَللّٰهُمَّ فَادْعُنِيْ يَوْمَ حَشْرِيْ وَ نَشْرِيْ بِاِمَامَتِهِمْ وَ اَنْقِذْنِيْ بِهِمْ يَا مَوْلَايَ مِنْ حَرِّ النِّيْرَانِ وَ اِنْ لَمْ تَرْزُقْنِيْ رُوْحَ الْـجِنَانِ فَاِنَّكَ اِنْ اَعْتَقْتَنِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ كُنْتُ مِنَ الْفَآئِزِيْنَ. اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ قَدْ اَصْبَحْتُ يَوْمِيْ هٰذَا لَا ثِقَةَ لِيْ وَ لَا رَجَآءَ وَ لَا لَـجَاَ وَ لَا مَفْزَعَ وَ لَا مَنْجٰى غَيْرَ مَنْ تَوَسَّلْتُ بِهِمْ اِلَيْكَ مُتَقَرِّبًا اِلٰى رَسُوْلِكَ مُـحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ ثُمَّ عَلِيٍّ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الزَّهْرَآءِ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَآءِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ وَ الْـحَسَنِ وَ الْـحُسَيْنِ وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ جَعْفَرٍ وَ مُوْسٰى وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ الْـحَسَنِ وَ مَنْ بَعْدَهُمْ يُقِيْمُ الْمَحَجَّةَ اِلَى الْـحُجَّةِ الْمَسْتُوْرَةِ مِنْ وُلْدِهِ الْمَرْجُوِّ لِلْاُمَّةِ مِنْ بَعْدِهٖ. اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاجْعَلْهُمْ فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَ مَا بَعْدَهٗ حِصْنِيْ مِنَ الْمَكَارِهٖ وَ مَعْقِلِيْ مِنَ الْمَخَاوِفِ وَ نَـجِّنِيْ بِهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ عَدُوٍّ وَ طَاغٍ وَ بَاغٍ وَ فَاسِقٍ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اَعْرِفُ وَ مَا اُنْكِرُ وَ مَا اسْتَتَرَ عَنِّيْ وَ مَا اَبْصُرُ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَآبَّةٍ رَبِّيْ اٰخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا اِنَّكَ عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيْمٍ. اَللّٰهُمَّ بِتَوَسُّلِيْ بِهِمْ اِلَيْكَ وَ تَقَرُّبِيْ بِـمَحَبَّتِهِمْ وَ تَـحَصُّنِيْ بِاِمَامَتِهِمْ اِفْتَحْ عَلَيَّ فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ اَبْوَابَ رِزْقِكَ وَ انْشُرْ عَلَيَّ رَحْمَتَكَ وَ حَبِّبْنِيْ اِلٰى خَلْقِكَ وَ جَنِّبْنِيْ بُغْضَهُمْ وَ عَدَاوَتَهُمْ اِنَّكَ عَلٰى‏ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيْرٌ. اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ لِكُلِّ مُتَوَسِّلٍ ثَوَابٌ وَ لِكُلِّ ذِيْ شَفَآعَةٍ حَقٌّ فَاَسْاَلُكَ بِـمَنْ جَعَلْتُهٗ وَسِيْلَتِيْ اِلَيْكَ وَ قَدَّمْتُهٗ اَمَامَ طَلِبَتِيْ اَنْ تُعَرِّفَنِيْ بَرَكَةَ يَوْمِيْ هٰذَا وَ شَهْرِيْ هٰذَا وَ عَامِيْ هٰذَا. اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ هُمْ مَفْزَعِيْ وَ مَعُوْنَتِيْ فِيْ شِدَّتِيْ وَ رَخَآئِيْ وَ عَافِيَتِيْ وَ بَلَائِيْ وَ نَوْمِيْ وَ يَقَظَتِيْ وَ ظَعْنِيْ وَ اِقَامَتِيْ وَ عُسْرِيْ وَ يُسْرِيْ وَ عَلَانِيَتِيْ وَ سِرِّيْ وَ اِصْبَاحِيْ وَ اِمْسَآئِيْ وَ تَقَلُّبِيْ وَ مَثْوَايَ وَ سِرِّيْ وَ جَهْرِيْ. اَللّٰهُمَّ فَلَا تُـخَيِّبْنِيْ بِهِمْ مِنْ نَآئِلِكَ وَ لَا تَقْطَعْ رَجَآئِيْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ لَا تُؤْيِسْنِيْ مِنْ رُوْحِكَ وَ لَا تَبْتَلِنِيْ بِانْغِلَاقِ اَبْوَابِ الْاَرْزَاقِ وَ انْسِدَادِ مَسَالِكِهَا وَ ارْتِيَاحِ مَذَاهِبِهَا وَ افْتَحْ لِيْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَتْحًا يَسِيْرًا وَ اجْعَلْ لِيْ مِنْ كُلِّ ضَنَكٍ مَـخْرَجًا وَ اِلٰى كُلِّ سِعَةٍ مَنْهَجًا اِنَّكَ اَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ اٰمِيْنَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ.
