ja-aâltohu waseelatee elayka wa qaddam-tohu amaama talebatee an to-aârrefanee barakata yawmee haazaa wa shahree haazaa wa aâamee haazaa. allaahumma wa hum maf-za-eâe wa ma-oâonatee fee shiddateewa rakhaaa-ee wa aâafeyatee wa balaa-ee wa nawmee wa yaqazatee wa zaânee wa eqaamatee wa uâsree wa yusree wa aâlaaneyatee wa sirree wa is-baahee wa imsaaa-ee wa taqallobee wa mas-waaya wa sirree wa jahree. allaahumma falaa tokhayyibnee behim min naaa-eleka wa laa taq-taâ rajaaa-ee min rahmateka wa laa toa-yisnee min rooheka wa laa tab-talenee bin-ghelaaqe abwaabil arzaaqe wan sedaade masaa-lekehaa war teyaahe mazaa-hebehaa waf tah lee min ladunka fat-han yaseeran waj aâl lee min kulle zanakin makhrajan wa elaa kulle se-aâtin man-hajan innaka arhamur raahemeena wa sallal laaho aâlaa mohammadin wa aalehit tayyebeenat taahereena aameena rabbal aâalameen.
segments.translation: In the Name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
O God, verily my sins, and their great number,
have worn out my standing before You,
and have veiled me from deserving Your mercy,
and have distanced me from meriting Your forgiveness.
And were it not for my clinging to Your blessings,
and my holding fast to supplication,
and what You have promised people like me, the transgressors,

segments.arabic: وَ مَا وَعَدْتَ أَمْثَالِي مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa mÄ waâadta amthÄlÄ« mina l-musrifÄ«n
segments.translation: and those similar to me, the sinners,
and what You have warned against for those despairing of Your mercy,
by Your saying: "O My servants who have exceeded limits
against their own souls, do not despair of the mercy of God.

segments.arabic: عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: âalÄ anfusihim lÄ taqnaá¹­Å« min raá¸¥mati LlÄh
segments.translation: Indeed, God forgives all sins.
Indeed, He is the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful."
And You warned those who despair of Your mercy,
and You said: "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord

segments.transliteration: fa-qulta: "Wa man yaqnaá¹­u min raá¸¥mati Rabbih
segments.translation: except for those astray?"
Then, with Your kindness, You invited us to supplicate to You,
and You said: "Call upon Me; I will respond to you.
Indeed, those who disdain My worship
will enter Hell, humbled."
My God, indeed that despair
was encompassing me,
and despair of Your mercy was covering me.
My God, You have promised the one who thinks well of You a reward,

segments.arabic: إِلَهِي لَقَدْ وَعَدْتَ الْمُحْسِنَ ظَنَّهُ بِكَ ثَوَابًا
segments.transliteration: IlÄhÄ« laqad waâadta l-muá¸¥sina áºannahu bika thawÄbÄ
segments.translation: and You have threatened the one who thinks ill of You with punishment.

segments.arabic: وَ أَوْعَدْتَ الْمُسِيءَ ظَنَّهُ بِكَ عِقَابًا
segments.transliteration: wa awâadta l-musÄ«âa áºannahu bika âiqÄbÄ
segments.translation: O God, good thought of You
has sustained my last breath regarding the freeing of my neck from the Fire,

segments.arabic: حُسْنُ الظَّنِّ بِكَ فِي عِتْقِ رَقَبَتِي مِنَ النَّارِ
segments.transliteration: á¸¥usnu áº-áºanni bika fÄ« âitqi raqabatÄ« mina n-nÄr
segments.translation: and the covering of my slip,
and the overlooking of my stumble.
O God, You said in Your Book,
and Your Word is the Truth which has no change nor substitution,

segments.arabic: وَ قَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ الَّذِي لَا خُلْفَ لَهُ وَ لَا تَبْدِيلَ
segments.transliteration: wa qawluka l-á¸¥aqqu l-ladhÄ« lÄ khulfa lahu wa lÄ tabdÄ«l
segments.translation: "The Day We will call forth every people with their leader,"
and that is the Day of Resurrection,
when the Horn is blown,
and "what is in the graves is scattered."
O God, verily I fulfill, and I bear witness,
and I affirm, and I do not deny, and I do not disavow,

segments.arabic: وَ أُقِرُّ وَ لَا أُنْكِرُ وَ لَا أَجْحَدُ
segments.transliteration: wa uqirru wa lÄ unkiru wa lÄ ajá¸¥ad
segments.translation: and I keep secret, and I announce, and I manifest, and I conceal,

segments.arabic: وَ أُسِرُّ وَ أُعْلِنُ وَ أُظْهِرُ وَ أُبْطِنُ
segments.transliteration: wa usirru wa uâlinu wa uáºhiru wa ubá¹­in
segments.translation: that You are God, there is no god but You,

segments.arabic: بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
segments.transliteration: bi-annaka Anta LlÄhu lÄ ilÄha illÄ Ant
segments.translation: Alone, You have no partner,
and that Muá¸¥ammad is Your servant and Your Messenger,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُولُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa anna Muá¸¥ammadan âabduka wa rasÅ«luk
segments.translation: may God bless him and his progeny,
and that âAlÄ«, the Commander of the Faithful,
is the Master of the Successors and the inheritor of the knowledge of the Prophets,

segments.arabic: سَيِّدُ الْأَوْصِيَاءِ وَ وَارِثُ عِلْمِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ
segments.transliteration: sayyidu l-awá¹£iyÄâ wa wÄrithu âilmi l-anbiyÄâ
segments.translation: the flag of the religion and the destroyer of the polytheists,
and the discriminator of the hypocrites,
and the striver against the renegades,
and my Leader and my proof and my handhold,

segments.arabic: وَ إِمَامِي وَ حُجَّتِي وَ عُرْوَتِي
segments.transliteration: wa imÄmÄ« wa á¸¥ujjatÄ« wa âurwatÄ«
segments.translation: and my path and my guide and my evidence,

segments.arabic: وَ صِرَاطِي وَ دَلِيلِي وَ حُجَّتِي
segments.transliteration: wa á¹£irÄá¹­Ä« wa dalÄ«lÄ« wa á¸¥ujjatÄ«
segments.translation: and the one without whose guardianship I do not trust my deeds, even if they are pure,

segments.arabic: وَ مَنْ لَا أَثِقُ بِأَعْمَالِي وَ لَوْ زَكَتْ
segments.transliteration: wa man lÄ athiqu bi-aâmÄlÄ« wa law zakat
segments.translation: and I do not see them as saving me, even if they are righteous,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا أَرَاهَا مُنْجِيَةً لِي وَ لَوْ صَلُحَتْ
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ arÄhÄ munjiyatan lÄ« wa law á¹£aluá¸¥at
segments.translation: except through his guardianship and taking him as a leader,
and the affirmation of his merits and the acceptance from those who bear them (the merits),

segments.arabic: وَ الْإِقْرَارِ بِفَضَائِلِهِ وَ الْقَبُولِ مِنْ حَمَلَتِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa l-iqrÄri bi-faá¸Äâilihi wa l-qabÅ«li min á¸¥amaltihÄ
segments.translation: and submission to those who narrate them.
And I affirm his successors from his sons
as leaders and proofs and guides,
and lamps and flags and beacons,

segments.arabic: وَ سُرُجًا وَ أَعْلَامًا وَ مَنَارًا
segments.transliteration: wa surujÄn wa aâlÄmÄn wa manÄrÄ
segments.translation: and masters and righteous ones.
And I believe in their secret and their open,
and their apparent and their hidden,
and their present and their absent,
and their living and their dead.
There is no doubt in that, and no suspicion,

segments.arabic: لَا شَكَّ فِي ذَلِكَ وَ لَا ارْتِيَابَ
segments.transliteration: LÄ shakka fÄ« dhÄlika wa lÄ rtÄ«yÄb
segments.translation: at Your changing nor Your turning.
O God, call me on the Day of my gathering and my resurrection

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَادْعُنِي يَوْمَ حَشْرِي وَ نَشْرِي
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma fa-dâunÄ« yawma á¸¥ashrÄ« wa nashrÄ«
segments.translation: by their leadership,
and save me through them, O my Master, from the heat of the Fires,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْقِذْنِي بِهِمْ يَا مَوْلَايَ مِنْ حَرِّ النِّيرَانِ
segments.transliteration: wa anqidhnÄ« bihim yÄ MawlÄya min á¸¥arri n-nÄ«rÄn
segments.translation: and even if You do not grant me the fragrance of the gardens (of Paradise).

segments.arabic: وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَرْزُقْنِي رَوْحَ الْجِنَانِ
segments.transliteration: wa in lam tarzuqnÄ« rawá¸¥a l-jinÄn
segments.translation: For verily, if You free me from the Fire,
I will be among the successful.
O God, I have entered this day

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ قَدْ أَصْبَحْتُ يَوْمِي هَذَا
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa qad aá¹£baá¸¥tu yawmÄ« hÄdhÄ
segments.translation: with no trust, no hope, and no refuge,

segments.arabic: لَا ثِقَةَ لِي وَ لَا رَجَاءَ وَ لَا لَجَاءَ
segments.transliteration: lÄ thiqata lÄ« wa lÄ rajÄâa wa lÄ lajÄâa
segments.translation: and no shelter, and no escape,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا مَفْزَعَ وَ لَا مَنْجَى
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ mafzaâa wa lÄ manjÄ
segments.translation: except through those whom I have made my means to You,
seeking proximity to Your Messenger Muá¸¥ammad,
may God bless him and his progeny,
then âAlÄ«, the Commander of the Faithful,
and Az-ZahrÄâ, the Mistress of the women of the worlds,
and Al-á¸¤asan and Al-á¸¤usayn, and âAlÄ«, and Muá¸¥ammad,

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: wa l-á¸¤asani wa l-á¸¤usayni wa âAlÄ«yin wa Muá¸¥ammadin
segments.translation: and Jaâfar, and MÅ«sÄ, and âAlÄ«,

segments.arabic: وَ جَعْفَرٍ وَ مُوسَى وَ عَلِيٍّ
segments.transliteration: wa Jaâfarin wa MÅ«sÄ wa âAlÄ«yin
segments.translation: and Muá¸¥ammad, and âAlÄ«, and Al-á¸¤asan,

segments.arabic: وَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ الْحَسَنِ
segments.transliteration: wa Muá¸¥ammadin wa âAlÄ«yin wa l-á¸¤asan
segments.translation: and the one after them who establishes the clear path
to the concealed Proof from his offspring,
who is hoped for by the community after him.
O God, make them, on this day,
and what follows, my fortress against detestable things,

segments.arabic: وَ مَا بَعْدَهُ حِصْنِي مِنَ الْمَكَارِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa mÄ baâdahu á¸¥iá¹£nÄ« mina l-makÄrih
segments.translation: and my stronghold against fears,
and save me through them from every enemy,

segments.arabic: وَ نَجِّنِي بِهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ عَدُوٍّ
segments.transliteration: wa najjinÄ« bihim min kulli âaduww
segments.translation: and oppressor, and transgressor, and wicked person,

segments.arabic: وَ طَاغٍ وَ بَاغٍ وَ فَاسِقٍ
segments.transliteration: wa á¹­Äghin wa bÄghin wa fÄsiq
segments.translation: and from the evil of what I know and what I deny,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَعْرِفُ وَ مَا أُنْكِرُ
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri mÄ aârifu wa mÄ unkir
segments.translation: and what is hidden from me and what I see,

segments.arabic: وَ مَا اسْتَتَرَ عَنِّي وَ مَا أُبْصِرُ
segments.transliteration: wa mÄ statara âannÄ« wa mÄ ubá¹£ir
segments.translation: and from the evil of every creature whose forelock my Lord seizes;

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ رَبِّي آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri kulli dÄbbatin RabbÄ« Äkhidhun bi-nÄá¹£iyatihÄ
segments.translation: indeed, You are on a straight path.
O God, through my seeking means to You by them,
and my seeking proximity through my love for them,
and my seeking protection through their leadership,
open for me on this day the doors of Your provision,

segments.arabic: افْتَحْ عَلَيَّ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ أَبْوَابَ رِزْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: iftaá¸¥ âalayya fÄ« hÄdhÄ l-yawmi abwÄba rizqik
segments.translation: and spread Your mercy upon me,
and make me beloved to Your creation,
and keep me away from their hatred and their enmity.
Indeed, You are capable of all things.
O God, for every seeker of means there is a reward,
and for every possessor of intercession there is a right.
So, I ask You by those whom I have made my means to You,
and whom I have placed before my request,
to make me know the blessing of this day of mine,
and this month of mine, and this year of mine.

segments.arabic: وَ شَهْرِي هَذَا وَ عَامِي هَذَا
segments.transliteration: wa shahrÄ« hÄdhÄ wa âÄmÄ« hÄdhÄ
segments.translation: O God, they are my shelter and my aid

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ هُمْ مَفْزَعِي وَ مَعُونَتِي
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa hum mafzaâÄ« wa maâÅ«natÄ«
segments.translation: in my hardship and my ease,
and my well-being and my tribulation,
and my sleep and my wakefulness,
and my travel and my stay,
and my difficulty and my ease,
and my open and my secret,
and my morning and my evening,
and my movements and my resting place,
and my secret and my open.
O God, do not disappoint me through them from Your gift,

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَلَا تُخَيِّبْنِي بِهِمْ مِنْ نَائِلِكَ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma fa-lÄ tukhayyibnÄ« bihim min nÄâilik
segments.translation: and do not cut off my hope from Your mercy,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَقْطَعْ رَجَائِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ taqá¹­aâ rajÄâÄ« min raá¸¥matik
segments.translation: and do not make me despair of Your solace,
and do not try me with the closing of the doors of provisions,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَبْتَلِنِي بِانْغِلَاقِ أَبْوَابِ الْأَرْزَاقِ
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ tabtalinÄ« bi-inghilÄqi abwÄbi l-arzÄq
segments.translation: and the blockage of its paths,
and the turning away of its sources.
And open for me from Your presence an easy opening,

segments.arabic: وَ افْتَحْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَتْحًا يَسِيرًا
segments.transliteration: Wa ftaá¸¥ lÄ« min ladunka fatá¸¥an yasÄ«rÄ
segments.translation: and make for me an exit from every distress,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ كُلِّ ضَنَكٍ مَخْرَجًا
segments.transliteration: wa jâal lÄ« min kulli á¸anakin makhrajÄ
segments.translation: and a path to every amplitude.
Indeed, You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
And may God bless Muá¸¥ammad and his pure and clean progeny.

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: Wa á¹£allÄ LlÄhu âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi á¹­-á¹­ayyibÄ«na á¹­-á¹­ÄhirÄ«n
segments.translation: Amen, O Lord of the worlds.
O Compassionate, O Merciful.

I seek protection for myself in the Lord of the earth and the Lord of the heavens. I seek protection for myself in Him with Whose Name no disease causes harm. I seek protection for myself in Him Whose Name is a blessing and a healing.[16]

segments.arabic: اُعِيْذُ نَفْسِيْ بِرَبِّ الْاَرْضِ وَ رَبِّ السَّمَاءِ اُعِيْذُ نَفْسِيْ بِالَّذِيْ لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهٖ دَاءٌ اُعِيْذُ نَفْسِيْ بِالَّذِيْ اسْمُهٗ بَرَكَةٌ وَ شِفَاءٌ.
segments.transliteration: o-eâezo nafsee be-rabbil arze wa rabbis samaaa-e o-eâezo nafsee bil-lazee laa yazurro ma-aâs mehi daa-un o-eâezo nafsee bil-lazis mohu baraktun wa shefaaun.
segments.translation: O Bestower of healing and Remover of illness, send down healing for my ailment.â[17]

segments.arabic: يَا مُنْزِلَ الشِّفَاءِ وَ مُذْهِبَ الدَّاءِ اَنْزِلْ عَلٰى وَجَعِيَ الشِّفَاءِ.
segments.transliteration: yaa munzelash shefaaa-e wa muzhebad daa-e anzil aâlaa waja-eâyash shefaa-e.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Great, in the name of Allah, the Great, Lord of the Mighty Throne, but that it left and perished.[19]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الْعَظِيْمِ بِسْمِ اللهِ الْعَظِيْمِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیْمِ اِلَّا ذَہَبْتَ وَ انْقَرَضْتَ.
segments.transliteration: bismil laahil aâzeeme bismil laahil aâzeeme rabbil aârshil aâzeeme illaa zahab-ta wan qarazta.
segments.translation: With Him are the keys of the unseen, the treasures that none knows but He. He knows whatever there is on the earth and in the sea. Not a leaf does fall but with His knowledge: there is not a grain in the darkness (or depths) of the earth, nor anything fresh or dry (green or withered), but is (inscribed) in a record clear (to those who can read).[21]

segments.arabic: وَعِنْدَہٗ مَفَاتِـحُ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُہَآ اِلَّا ہُوَ۝۰ۭ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِيْ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ۝۰ۭ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِنْ وَّرَقَۃٍ اِلَّا يَعْلَمُہَا وَلَا حَبَّۃٍ فِيْ ظُلُمٰتِ الْاَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍ وَّلَا يَابِسٍ اِلَّا فِيْ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيْنٍ۝۵۹
segments.transliteration: wa iândahu mafaatehul ghaybe laa yaâlamohaa illaa hoo, wa yaâlamo maa fil barre wal bahr, wa maa tasqoto minw waraqatin illaa yaâlamohaa wa laa habbatin fee zolomaatil arze wa laa ratbinw wa laa yaabesin illaa fee ketaabim mobeen.
segments.translation: O Allah! You guide one who is misguided and You save from blindness, and return the lost property. Bless Muhammad and his progeny and forgive me and return to me my lost property and bless Muhammad and his progeny and peace (be upon them).[22]

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّكَ تَـهْدِيْ مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ وَ تُنْجِيْ مِنَ الْعَمٰى وَ تَرُدُّ الضَّالَّةَ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَ رُدَّ ضَالَّتِيْ وَ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهٖ وَ سَلَّمَ.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innaka tahdee menaz zalaalate wa tunjee menal aâmaa wa tarudduz zaallata salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin wagh fir lee wa rudda zaal-latee wa salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aalehi wa sallam.
segments.translation: 1.O Reliever of worry! O Remover of grief!
2.O Merciful in this world and the next and Compassionate in both!
3.Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
4.relieve my worry, and remove my grief!
5.O One, O Unique, O Eternal Refuge!

segments.arabic: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا أَحَدُ، يَا صَمَدُ،
segments.transliteration: yaa waah'idu yaaa ah'adu yaa s'amad
segments.translation: 6.O He Who has not begotten, nor has been begotten,
7.and equal to Him is not any one!
8.Preserve me, purify me, and take away my affliction!</h6
9.Here You Should Recite The Throne Verse (2:255), The Two Suras Of Taking Refuge (113-114), And Unity (112). Then Say:

segments.arabic: [وَاقْرَأْ آيَةَ الْكُرسِيّ وَالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ  وَقُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ وَقُلْ:]
segments.transliteration: waq-raa aaayatal-kur-see-yi wal-mua'w-wad'atay-ni wa (qul huwal-laahooo ah'ad) waqul:
segments.translation: 10.O God, I ask You with the asking of him whose neediness is intense,

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-neee as-aluka soo-aala man ishtad-dat faaqatuh
segments.translation: 11.whose strength is frail, whose sins are many,

segments.transliteration: wa z''au'fat qoo-watuh wa kathurat d'unoobuh
segments.translation: 12.the asking of one who finds no helper in his neediness,

segments.arabic: سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ يَجِدُ لِفَاقَتِهِ مُغِيْثاً،
segments.translation: 13.no strengthener in his frailty,
14.no forgiver of his sin other than You,
15.O Possessor of majesty and munificence!
16.I ask of You a work through which You wilt love him who works it

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ عَمَلاً تُحِبُّ بِهِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: as-aluk a'malana tuh'ib-bu bihee man a'mila bih
segments.translation: 17.and a certainty by which You wilt profit him who is certain

segments.arabic: وَيَقِيناً تَنْفَعُ بِهِ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَنَ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa yaqeenana tanfau' bihee mani as-tay-qana bihee
segments.translation: 18.with the truth of certainty concerning the execution of Your command!
19.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.translation: 20.take my soul while it is firm in sincerity,
21.cut off my need for this world,
22.make my desire for what is with You
23.become a yearning to meet You,
24.and give me true confidence in You!
25.I ask of You the good of the writ that has been made and I seek refuge with You

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ كِتَاب قَدْ خَلاَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ
segments.transliteration: as-aluka min khay-ri kitaabin qad khalaa wa au'wd'u bika
segments.translation: 26.from the evil of the writ that has been made.
27.I ask of You the fear of The worshipers,
28.the worship of those humbly fearful of You,
29.the certainty of those who have confidence in You,
30.and the confidence of those who have faith in You.
31.O God, make my desire in my asking
32.like the desire of Your friends in their asking,
33.and my fear like the fear of Your friends!
34.Employ me in Your good pleasure through works
35.in which I will not leave aside anything of Your religion

segments.arabic: عَمَلاً لاَ أَتْرُكُ مَعَهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ دِيْنِكَ
segments.translation: 36.fearing any of Your creatures!
37.God, this is my need, so make my desire for it great,

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ هَذِهِ حَاجَتِي، فَأَعْظِمْ فِيهَا رَغْبَتِي،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma hd'ihee h'aajatee faaa'-z'im feehaa ragh-batee
segments.translation: 38.within it make manifest my excuse, through it instil me with my argument, and by means of it make well my body!

segments.arabic: وَأَظْهِرْ فِيهَا عُذْرِي، وَلَقِّنِي فِيهَا حُجَّتِي وَعَافِ فِيْهَا جَسَدِيْ.
segments.transliteration: wa az'-hir feehaa u'd'-ree wa laq-qinee feehaa h'uj-jatee wa a'afi feehaa jasadee
segments.translation: 39.O God, some rise in the morning having trust or hope in other than You.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَصْبَحَ لَهُ ثِقَةٌ أَوْ رَجَآءٌ غَيْرُكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma man as'-bah'a lahoo thiqatun aw rajaaa-un ghay-ruk
segments.translation: 40.I rise in the morning, and You art my trust
41.and my hope in all affairs,
42.so decree for me those which are best in outcome
43.and deliver me from misguiding trials,
44.O Most Merciful of the merciful!
45.And God bless our chief, Muhammad the Messenger of God, the chosen,

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّد رُسُولِ اللهِ المُصْطَفَى،
segments.translation: 46.and his Household, the pure!

title: Duas for Protection from Distress,Grief and Fear

segments.arabic: يَا عِمَادَ مَنْ لاَ عِمَادَ لَهُ
segments.translation: O Support of him who lacks support!

segments.arabic: ويَا ذُخْرَ مَنْ لاَ ذُخْرَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa ya dhukhra man la dhukhra lahu
segments.translation: O  protector of him who has no other

segments.arabic: وَيَا سَنَدَ مَنْ لاَ سَنَدَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa ya sanada man lasanada lahu
segments.translation: O Prop of him who lacks prop!

segments.arabic: ويَا حِرْزَ مَنْ لاَ حِرْزَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa ya hirza man la hirza lahu
segments.translation: O Shelter of him who lacks shelter!

segments.arabic: وَيَا غِيَاثَ مَنْ لاَ غِيَاثَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa ya ghiyatha man la ghiyatha lahu
segments.translation: O Aid of him who is aidless!

segments.arabic: وَيَا كَنْزَ مَنْ لاَ كَنْزَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yakanza man la kanza lahu
segments.translation: O Treasure of him who has no treasure!

segments.arabic: وَيَا عِزَّ مَنْ لاَ عِزَّ لَهُ
segments.translation: O Might of him who wants might!
O He Who pardons generously!
O He Who overlooks excellently!
O Helper of the weak!
O Treasure of the poor!
O He Who is greatly hoped!
O Savior of the drowned!
O Rescuer of the perishing!
O All-munificent! O All- benign!
O All-gracious! O All-benevolent!

segments.arabic: انْتَ ٱلَّذِي سَجَدَ لَكَ سَوَادُ ٱللَّيْلِ وَنُورُ ٱلنَّهَارِ
segments.transliteration: anta alladhi sajada laka sawadu allayli wa nuru alnnahari
segments.translation: It is You alone before Whom the darkness of night has prostrated. So have the light of day,

segments.transliteration: wa daw'u alqamari wa shu`a`u alshshamsi
segments.translation: the brightness of the moon, the radiance of the sun,

segments.transliteration: wa hafifu alshshajari wa dawiyyu alma'i
segments.translation: the rustle of trees, and the murmur of water.

segments.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ya allahu ya allahu ya allahu
segments.translation: O Allah! O Allah! O Allah!
There is no god save You;
You are the One and Only without having any partner.
O my Lord! O Allah!
(Please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and do to us all that which suits You.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَكْفِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
segments.transliteration: ya man yakfi min kulli shay'in
segments.translation: O He Who protects against all things
while nothing can ever stand against Him,
(please do) save me from that which has aggrieved me.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
O God, I turn to You through the mediation of Muhammad and Progeny of Muhammad
and I adjure by that right of theirs,
whose reality is not known to anyone, except You.

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ مَنْ حَقُّهٗ عِنْدَكَ عَظِيْمٌ،
segments.transliteration: wa behaqqe man haqqohu iândaka aâzeemun,
segments.translation: And I adjure by the rights of those,

segments.arabic: وَ بِاَسْمَائِكَ الْحُسْنٰى وَ كَلِمَاتِكَ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِيْ اَمَرْتَنِيْ اَنْ اَدْعُوَكَ بِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa be-asmaa-ekal husnaa wa kalemaatekat taammaatil latee amartanee an ad-oâoka behaa,
segments.translation: whose right is great in your view and I adjure by your beautiful names and the perfect words through which You have commanded us to supplicate.

segments.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ الَّذِيْ اَمَرْتَ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ - ؑ - اَنْ يَدْعُوَ بِهِ الطَّيْرَ فَاَجَابَتْهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa as-aloka bismekal aâzeemil lazee amarta ibraaheema â aâlayhis salaamo â an yad-oâwa behit tayra fa-ajaabatho.
segments.translation: And I adjure You by that name through which You commanded Ibrahim Khaleel to call the dead birds.

segments.arabic: وَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ الَّذِيْ قُلْتَ لِلنَّارِكُوْنِيْ بَرْدًا وَ سَلَامًا عَلٰى‏ اِبْراهِيْمَ فَكَانَتْ،
segments.transliteration: wa bismekal aâzeemil lazee qulta lin-naare koonee bardan wa salaaman aâlaa ibraaheema fakaanat,
segments.translation: And by that great name, which You blew on fire and made it cool and safe.

segments.arabic: وَ بِاَحَبِّ اَسْمَائِكَ اِلَيْكَ، وَ اَشْرَفِهَا عِنْدَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa be-ahabbe asmaaeka elayka, wa ashrafehaa iândaka
segments.translation: And by your most loved, noble and great names,

segments.arabic: وَ اَعْظَمِهَا لَدَيْكَ وَ اَسْرَعِهَا اِجَابَةً، وَ اَنْجَحِهَا طَلِبَةً،
segments.transliteration: wa a-aâzamehaa ladayka wa asra-eâhaa ejaabatan,wa anjahehaa talebatan
segments.translation: through which supplication is accepted immediately and needs are fulfilled

segments.arabic: وَ بِمَا اَنْتَ اَهْلُهٗ وَ مُسْتَحِقُّهٗ وَ مُسْتَوْجِبُهٗ.
segments.transliteration: wa bemaa anta ahlohu wa mustahiqqohu wa mustawjebohu.
segments.translation: and which You are deserving of and owner of.

segments.arabic: وَ اَتَوَسَّلُ اِلَيْكَ، وَ اَرْغَبُ اِلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa atawassalo elayka, wa arghabo elayka,
segments.translation: I seek mediation to You, I am attentive to You and I seek your help.
And I seek bestowal and favor;
and I am a petitioner;
and I am humble
and sincere before You,

segments.arabic: وَ اَخْشَعُ لَكَ وَ اُقِرُّ لَكَ بِسُوْءِ صَنِيْعَتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa akhsha-oâ laka wa oqirro laka be-soo-e sanee-aâtee,
segments.translation: and I confess to my evil deeds .
and I insist and persist before You

segments.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُكَ بِكُتُبِكَ الَّتِيْ اَنْزَلْتَهَا عَلٰى اَنْبِيَائِكَ وَ رُسُلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa as-aloka bekotobekal latee anzaltahaa aâlaa anbeyaa-eka wa rosoleka,
segments.translation: I adjure by your Books that You revealed on the prophets and messengers
(your blessings and mercy be on them all).

segments.arabic: مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَ الْاِنْجِيْلِ وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيْمِ،
segments.transliteration: menat tawraate wal injeele wal qur-aanil aâzeeme,
segments.translation: That is Taurat, Injeel and the great Quran
from its beginning till its end.
As it contains your great name and your beautiful names,

segments.arabic: وَ بِمَا فِيْهَا مِنْ اَسْمَائِكَ الْعُظْمٰى اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa bemaa feehaa min asmaa-ekal uâzmaa ataqarrabo elayka,
segments.translation: through which I seek your proximity.

segments.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهٖ،
segments.transliteration: wa as-aloka an tosalleya aâlaa mohammadin wa aalehi,
segments.translation: I beseech You to bless Muhammad and progeny of Muhammad and remove their grief and sorrow and through their intercession,

segments.arabic: وَ اَنْ تُفَرِّجَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهٖ وَ تَجْعَلَ فَرَجِيْ مَقْرُوْنًا بِفَرَجِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa an tofarreja aân mohammadin wa aalehi wa taj-aâla farajee maqroonan be-farajehim,
segments.translation: remove my grief and sorrow as well,

segments.arabic: (وَ تُقَدِّمَهُمْ فِيْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ) وَ تَبْدَاَ بِهِمْ فِيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: (wa toqaddemahum fee kulle khayrin) wa tabda-a behim feehe,
segments.translation: and keep them at the forefront in every good,

segments.arabic: وَ تَفْتَحَ اَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ لِدُعَائِيْ فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ،
segments.transliteration: wa taftaha abwaabas samaa-e le-do-aâa-ee fee haazal yawme,
segments.translation: and begin this only with them and today open the gates of heavens for my supplications

segments.arabic: وَ تَاْذَنَ فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ بِفَرَجِيْ،
segments.transliteration: wa taazana fee haazal yawme wa haazehil laylate befarajee,
segments.translation: and today and tonight command peace for me

segments.arabic: وَ اِعْطَائِيْ سُؤْلِيْ وَ اَمَلِیْ فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa e-aâtaa-ee soalee wa amalee fid dunyaa wal aakherate,
segments.translation: and fulfillment of all my demands as
poverty has besieged me
and difficulties surround me.

segments.arabic: وَ سَلَّمَتْنِي الْخَصَاصَةُ وَ اَلْجَاَتْنِيْ الْحَاجَةُ،
segments.transliteration: wa salla-matnil khasaasato wa al-ja-atnil haajato,
segments.translation: Needs have turned me over to You and needs have made me a refugee.
Humiliation has targeted
and poverty had overpowered,
and your word is proved true
and mistakes have surrounded me.

segments.arabic: وَ هٰذَا الْوَقْتُ الَّذِيْ وَعَدْتَ اَوْلِيَاءَكَ فِيْهِ الْاِجَابَةَ.
segments.transliteration: wa haazal waqtul lazee wa-aâdta awleyaa-aka feehil ejaabata.
segments.translation: This is the time,  when You promised acceptance to your friends.
bless Muhammad and progeny of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَ امْسَحْ مَا بِيْ بِيَمِيْنِكَ الشَّافِيَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wam sah maa bee be-yameenekash shaafeyate,
segments.translation: and remove my difficulties through your curative hands
and look upon me with mercy
and admit me in your wide mercy.

segments.arabic: وَ اَقْبِلْ اِلَيَّ بِوَجْهِكَ الَّذِيْ اِذَا اَقْبَلْتَ بِهٖ عَلٰى اَسِيْرٍ فَكَكْتَهٗ،
segments.transliteration: wa aqbil elayya be-wajhekal lazee ezaa aq-balta behi aâlaa aseerin fakaktahu,
segments.translation: Turn your towards me,  which if it is turned to the prisoner, he is freed.
And if it is turned to the misguided, he becomes guided.

segments.arabic: وَ عَلٰى جَائِزٍ اَدَّيْتَهٗ وَ عَلٰى فَقِیْرٍ اَغْنَيْتَهٗ،
segments.transliteration: wa aâlaa jaa-ezin addaytahu wa aâlaa faqeerin aghnaytahu,
segments.translation: And if it is turned to the perplexed, he is freed from perplexity. And if it is turned to the destitute, he becomes affluent.
If it is turned to the weak, he becomes strong.
If it is turned to the fearful, he is granted security.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تُخْلِنِيْ لِقَاءَ عَدُوِّكَ وَ عَدُوِّيْ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tukhlenee leqaa-a aâduwweka wa aâduwwee,
segments.translation: O God, allow my and your enemy to meet me,
O owner of might and majesty.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَيْفَ هُوَ،
segments.transliteration: yaa man laa yaâlamo kayfa howa,
segments.translation: O One, whose reality, position

segments.arabic: وَ حَيْثُ هُوَ وَ قُدْرَتَهٗ اِلَّا هُوَ،
segments.transliteration: wa hayso howa wa qudratahu illaa howa,
segments.translation: and power is not known to anyone,except Him
O One, who has confined the atmosphere by the sky
and placed the earth on water
and chose the best names for Himself.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ سَمّٰى نَفْسَهٗ بِالْاِسْمِ الَّذِيْ بِهٖ تَقْضِيْ حَاجَةَ كُلِّ طَالِبٍ يَدْعُوْهُ بِهٖ.
segments.transliteration: yaa man sammaa nafsahu bil-ismil lazee behi taqzee haajata kulle taalebin yad-oâoho behi.
segments.translation: O that God, who adopted for Himself every that name through which He fulfills the needs of all those, who pray through them.
I beseech You through the mediation of your names
as I have no intercessor stronger than this.

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ (اَسْاَلُكَ) اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: wa be-haqqe mohammadin wa aale mohammadin (as-aloka) an tosalleya aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin,
segments.translation: And I adjure You by the right of Muhammad and progeny of Muhammad that You bless Muhammad and progeny of Muhammad
and fulfill all my pleas.

segments.arabic: وَ تُسْمِعَ مُحَمَّدًا وَ عَلِيًّا وَ فَاطِمَةَ،
segments.transliteration: wa tusme-aâ mohammadan wa aâliyyan wa faatemata,
segments.translation: And make my plea reach upto His Eminence Muhammad, Ali Fatima

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَسَنَ وَ الْحُسَيْنَ وَ عَلِيًّا وَ مُحَمَّدًا،
segments.transliteration: wal hasana wal husayna wa aâliyyan wa mohammadan,
segments.translation: Hassan Hussain Ali Muhammad
Jafar Musa

segments.arabic: وَ عَلِيًّا وَ مُحَمَّدًا وَ عَلِيًّا،
segments.transliteration: wa aâliyyan wa mohammadan wa aâliyyan,
segments.translation: Ali Muhammad Ali

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَسَنَ وَ الْحُجَّةَ - صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ بَرَكَاتُكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ – صَوْتِيْ،
segments.transliteration: wal hasana wal hujjata â salawaatoka aâlayhim wa barakaatoka wa rahmatoka â sawtee,
segments.translation: Hasan and Hujjat Qaim [your blessings and mercy be on them all],

segments.arabic: فَيَشْفَعُوْا لِيْ اِلَيْكَ وَ تُشَفِّعَهُمْ فِيَّ،
segments.transliteration: fayashfa-oâo lee elayka wa toshaf-fe-aâhum fiyya,
segments.translation: so that they may be able to recommend my case in your court and You allow them to intercede for me.
And donât turn me away in despair,
I adjure You by âthere is no god, except Allahâ and

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: wa be-haqqe mohammadin wa aale mohammadin,
segments.translation: I adjure You by Muhammad and progeny of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.transliteration: salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin,
segments.translation: Bless Muhammad and his progeny

segments.arabic: وَ افْعَلْ بِيْ ’’كَذَا وَ كَذَا‘‘ يَا كَرِيْمُ.
segments.transliteration: waf aâl bee âkazaa wa kazaaâ yaa kareemo.
segments.translation: conduct with me âas followsâ, O merciful God.

segments.arabic: بِحَقِّ يٰسۗ وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْحَكِيْمِ، وَ بِحَقِّ طٰہٰ وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيْمِ.
segments.transliteration: be-haqqe yaa-seen wal qur-aanil hakeeme, wa be-haqqe taahaa wal qur-aanil aâzeeme.
segments.translation: By the right of Yasin and the wise Quran and by the right of Taha and the great Quran.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَقْدِرُ عَلٰى حَوَائِجِ السَّائِلِيْنَ،
segments.transliteration: yaa man yaqdero aâlaa hawaa-ejis saa-eleena,
segments.translation: O One, who is capable of fulfilling the needs of all who ask.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِيْ الضَّمِيْرِ
segments.transliteration: yaa man yaâlamo maa fiz zameere
segments.translation: O One, who is aware of the secrets of the hearts.
O, One, who removes the distress from the distressed.
O One, who cures the grief of the aggrieved.
O One, who has mercy on the aged, helpless ones.
O sustainer of the small infant.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يَحْتَاجُ اِلَى التَّفْسِيْرِ، صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَ افْعَلْ بِيْ كَذَا وَ كَذَا
segments.transliteration: yaa man laa yahtaajo elat tafseere,salle aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadin, waf aâl bee kazaa wa kazaa.
segments.translation: O that God, who is not needful of any exegesis and explanation, bless Muhammad and progeny of Muhammad and conduct with me and do so and so.
O best seer of all those who can see,
O best hearer of all those who can hear,
O swiftest of those who settle account,
and O most merciful of all those who show mercy!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً
segments.transliteration: allahu rabbi la ushriku bihi shay'an
segments.translation: Allah is my Lord; I never associate any thing to Him.

segments.arabic: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ
segments.translation: I put my trust in the Ever-living Who never dies.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bi-anna laka lhamda
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of (the fact) that to You is all praise;
there is no god save You, the All-donor,
the excellent originator of the heavens and the earth,
and the Lord of majesty and honor

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَ لِي مِمَّا أَنَا فِيهِ فَرَجاً وَمَخْرَجاً
segments.transliteration: wa an taj`ala li mimma ana fihi farajan wa makhrajan
segments.translation: and to prepare for me a relief and way out from what I a

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ لاَ يَكْفِي مِنْكَ أَحَدٌ
segments.transliteration: allahumma innaka la yakfi minka ahadun
segments.translation: O Allah, nothing can ever save from You

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ تَكْفِي مِنْ كُلِّ أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa anta takfi min kulli ahadin min khalqika
segments.translation: while You alone can save from any of Your creatures;
so, save me fromâ¦
O He Who saves from all things
while nothing can ever save from You
neither in the heavens nor on the earth,

segments.arabic: ٱكْفِنِي مَا أَهَمَّنِي مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: ikfini ma ahammani min amri alddunya wal-akhirati
segments.translation: (please) save me from what has distressed me, be it a this-worldly or a otherworldly affair,
and send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household.
With Allah do I commence,
from Allah do I seek success,

segments.arabic: وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَتَوَجَّهُ
segments.transliteration: wa bimuhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi atawajjahu
segments.translation: and in the name of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, do I turn my face (towards Allah).
O Allah, (please) make easy for me the difficulty of this matter
and facilitate for me its complication,

segments.transliteration: fa'innaka tamhu ma tasha'u wa tuthbitu
segments.translation: for You verily efface what You will and establish (what You will)
and with You is the source of ordinance.
Sufficient to me is Allah.
There is no god but Him.
In Him do I trust
and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

segments.transliteration: wa amtani`u bihawli allahi wa quwwatihi
segments.translation: I take shelter in Allahâs might and power
against their might and power.
I take shelter in the Lord of the dawn
against the evil of what He has created.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power except with Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
forgive me, have mercy upon me,
multiply my (good) deed, make easy my place of return,
guide my heart, secure my fear,
grant me wellbeing throughout my whole lifetime,
admit my plea, forgive my wrongdoings,

segments.transliteration: wa bayyid wajhi wa`simni fi dini
segments.translation: whiten my face, preserve me with regard to my faith,

segments.arabic: وَسَهِّلْ مَطْلَبِي وَوَسِّعْ عَلَيَّ فِي رِزْقِي
segments.transliteration: wa sahhil matlabi wa wassi` `alayya fi rizqi
segments.translation: make easy for me to attain my aim, and expand Your sustenance to me,
for I am too weak to do that.
(Please) overlook the evil I have done
in the name of the good You always do,
do not make me suffer from the loss of myself,
and do not make me suffer from the loss of one I intimately love.

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي يَا إِلٰهِي لَحْظَةً مِنْ لَحَظَاتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa hab li ya ilahi lahzatan min lahazatika
segments.translation: (Please) grant me, O my God, one of Your glances

segments.arabic: تَكْشِفُ بِهَا عَنِّي جَمِيعَ مَا بِهِ ابْتَلَيْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: takshifu biha `anni jami`a ma bihi ibtalaytani
segments.translation: through which You may relieve me from all what You have tested me through

segments.arabic: وَتَرُدُّ بِهَا عَلَيَّ مَا هُوَ أَحْسَنُ عَادَتِكَ عِنْدِي
segments.transliteration: wa taruddu biha `alayya ma huwa ahsanu `adatika `indi
segments.translation: and through which You may endue me again with the best of Your usual bestowals to me,

segments.transliteration: faqad da`ufat quwwati wa qallat hilati
segments.translation: for my power has decreased, my plans have failed,
and my hope in Your creatures have lost

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَبْقَ إِلاَّ رَجَاؤُكَ وَتَوَكُّلِي عَلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa lam yabqa illa raja'uka wa tawakkuli `alayka
segments.translation: and nothing remained except my hope in You and my trust in You.

segments.arabic: وَقُدْرَتُكَ عَلَيَّ يَا رَبِّ أَنْ تَرْحَمَنِي وَتُعَافِيَنِي
segments.transliteration: wa qudratuka `alayya ya rabbi an tarhamani wa tu`afiyani
segments.translation: Your power, O my Lord, to have mercy upon me and to grant me wellbeing
is the same as Your power to chastise and afflict me.
O my God, my remembrance of Your conferrals entertains me
and my expectation of Your favors strengthens me.

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ أَخْلُ مِنْ نِعَمِكَ مُنْذُ خَلَقْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: wa lam akhlu min ni`amika mundhu khalaqtani
segments.translation: I have never done without Your favors since You created me.
So, You are my lord, my master,
my shelter, my haven,
my protector, my defender,
the merciful to me, the guarantor of my sustenance,

segments.arabic: وَفِي قَضَائِكَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ كُلُّ مَا أَنَا فِيهِ
segments.transliteration: wa fi qada'ika wa qudratika kullu ma ana fihi
segments.translation: and whatever I am in is under Your decree and authority.
So, O my master and cherisher,

segments.transliteration: fima qadayta wa qaddarta wa hatamta
segments.translation: within Your decrees, decisions, and inevitable commands,

segments.arabic: تَعْجِيلُ خَلاَصِي مِمَّا أَنَا فِيهِ جَمِيعِهِ
segments.transliteration: ta`jilu khalasi mimma ana fihi jami`ihi
segments.translation: (please) decide on my salvation from all that which I am suffering
and on granting me wellbeing,

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي لاَ أَجِدُ لِدَفْعِ ذٰلِكَ أَحَداً غَيْرَكَ
segments.transliteration: fa'inni la ajidu lidaf`i dhalika ahadan ghayraka
segments.translation: for I cannot find any one who can do all that except You
and I trust in none save You.
O Lord of majesty and honor,

segments.arabic: عِنْدَ أَحْسَنِ ظَنِّي بِكَ وَرَجَائِي لَكَ
segments.transliteration: `inda ahsani zanni bika wa raja'i laka
segments.translation: (please) act according to the good idea I have about You and according to the hope I have in You,

segments.transliteration: warham tadarru`i wastikanati wa da`fa rukni
segments.translation: have mercy on my earnest humbleness, my submission, and the weakness of my support,

segments.arabic: وَٱمْنُنْ بِذٰلِكَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ دَاعٍ دَعَاكَ
segments.transliteration: wamnun bidhalika `alayya wa `ala kulli da`in da`aka
segments.translation: and endue me, as well as all suppliants that supplicate You, with all of that.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy!

segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi
segments.translation: May Allah bless Muhammad and his Household.
In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I trust),

segments.transliteration: wa min allahi wa ila allahi
segments.translation: from Allah (I derive power), to Allah (I resort),
in the way of Allah (I proceed),
and on the principles of Allahâs Messenger (I advance),
may Allah bless him and his Household.
O Allah, to You have I submitted myself,
towards You have I turned my face,
to You have I commended my cause,
and with You have I entrusted my affairs.
O Allah, (please) safeguard me with the safeguard of faith

segments.transliteration: min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi
segments.translation: before me, behind me,
to my right side, to my left side,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَمِنْ تَحْتِي وَمَا قِبَلِي
segments.transliteration: wa min fawqi wa min tahti wa ma qibali
segments.translation: above me, beneath me, and in front of me,
and defend me with Your might and power,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِكَ
segments.transliteration: fa'innahu la hawla wa la quwwata illa bika
segments.translation: since there is neither might nor power except with You.
O He Who existed before all things!
O He Who composed all things!

segments.transliteration: wa ya baqiyan ba`da kulli shay'in
segments.translation: O He Who shall survive after all things!
(Please) bless Muhammad and Muhammadâs Household andâ¦

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَكْفِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
segments.transliteration: ya man yakfi min kulli shay'in
segments.translation: O He Who saves from all things
but nothing can ever save from Him,
(please) save me from what has distressed me.
O target of all complaints!
O hearer of all confidential talks!
O witness of all gatherings!
O knower of all hidden things!

segments.arabic: وَيَا دَافِعَ مَا يَشَاءُ مِنْ بَلِيَّةٍ
segments.transliteration: wa ya dafi`a ma yasha'u min baliyyatin
segments.translation: O repelling of whatever tribulation You will to repel!
O friend of Abraham!
O talker to Moses!
O chooser of Muhammad,
may Allah bless him and his Household!
I supplicate You with the supplication of one whose indigence is extreme,
whose stratagem has failed,
and whose ability has fallen short;
the supplication of one who is stranger, drowned, distressed;

segments.arabic: ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَجِدُ لِكَشْفِ مَا هُوَ فِيهِ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
segments.transliteration: alladhi la yajidu likashfi ma huwa fihi illa anta
segments.translation: one who has no one at all to relieve him from what he is suffering save You,
O most merciful of all those who show mercy!
O Reliever of distress
and Remover of agony!

segments.transliteration: ya rahmana alddunya wal-akhirati wa rahimahuma
segments.translation: O Beneficent and Merciful of this world and the Hereafter,
(please) relieve my distress
and remove my agony.
O Allah Who is the One,
the One and Only, and the eternally besought of all;

segments.transliteration: alladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad
segments.translation: Who begets not nor was begotten

segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu kufwan ahadun
segments.translation: and there is none comparable unto Him,
(please) protect me, purify me,
and eliminate my tribulation.
O He Who is ever-living! O He Who is self-subsisting!
O He save Whom there is no god!
In the name of Your mercy do I seek aid;
so, (please) save me from what has distressed me
and do not refer me to myself.
O Allah, I beseech You
in the name of Muhammad and `Ali,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّ لَهُمَا عِنْدَكَ شَأْناً مِنَ ٱلشَّأْنِ
segments.translation: for they both enjoy a remarkable standing with You
and a significant status;
so, (I beseech You) in the name of this standing
and in the name of this status

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَنْ…
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin wa anâ¦
segments.translation: (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, andâ¦

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ عَلِيٍّ عِنْدَكَ ٱغْفِرْ لِعَلِيٍّ.
segments.translation: O Allah, (I beseech You) in the name of `Aliâs standing with You, (please) forgive `Ali.

title: Seeking Forgiveness - Isteghfar-Repentance

segments.arabic:
رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي إِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ
الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنتَ.
segments.transliteration: rabbi  innee z'alamtu nafsee faghfirlee innahoo laa yaghfirud 'd'unooba illa anta
segments.translation: O Lord, I have wronged myself. So forgive me. Verily save You there is no one who can protect from the consequences of sinning.

segments.arabic: للَّهُمَّ إنِّيِ اَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِكُلِّ ذَنْبٍ جَرٰى بِهٖ عِلْمُكَ فِىَّ وَ عَلَىَّ اِلٰى اَخِرِ عُمْرِىْ بِجَمِيْعِ ذُنُوْبِىْ لِاَوَّلِهَا وَ اَخِرِهَا
segments.transliteration: allahumma innee astaghfiruka likulli d'ambin jaraa bihee i'lmuka fiyya wa a'layya ilaa aakhiri u'mree
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek forgiveness for every sin, I committed, about which, of course, You know inside and out, from the beginning to the end of my life,

segments.arabic: وَ عَمَدِهَا وَ خَطَئِهَا وَ قَلِيْلِهَا وَ كَثِيْرِهَا وَ دَقِيْقِيْهَا وَ جَلِيْلِهَا وَ قَدِيْمِهَا وَ حَدِيْثِهَا مَآ اَنَا مُذْنِبُهُ وَ اَتُوْبُ اِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: bi-jamee-i d'unoobee li-awwalihaa wa aakhirihaa wa a'madihaa wa khat a-ihaa wa qaleelihaa wa katheerihaa wa daqeeqihaa wa jaleelihaa wa qadeemihaa wa h'adeethihaa wa sirrihaa wa a'laaniyatihaa wa jamee-i maa anaa mud'nibuhoo wa atoobu ilayka
segments.translation: whether committed deliberately or intentionally, few or many, obscure or manifest, old or new, secretly carried out or openly done; and for whatever wrong I have done I turn repentant unto You

segments.arabic:
وَ اَسْئَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلىَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَنْ تُغْفِرْلِىْ جَمِيْعِ مَآ اَحْصَيْتُ مِنْ مَّظَالِمِ الْعِبَادِ قَبَلِىْ فَاِنَّ لِعِبَادِكَ عَلَىَّ حُقُوْقًا وَّ اَنَا 
مُرْتَهِنٌ بِهَا تُغْفِرْهَا كَيْفَ شِئْتَ وَ اَنَّى شِئْتَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّ احِمِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: wa as-aluka an tus'alliya a'laa muh'ammadin wa aali muh'ammadin wa an taghfira lee jamee-a, maa ah's'aytu mim maz'aalimil i'baadi qibalee fa-inna li-ibaadika a'layya h'uqooqan wa anaa murtahinum bihaa taghfiruhaa kayfa shi-ta wa annaa shia-ta yaa arh'amar raah'imeen
segments.translation: and beseech You to bless Muhammad and the children of Muhammad and forgive all my unjust acts I did to wrong the people (because they have rights which I have to recognize and fulfill) but You have full authority to forgive those wrongdoings whenever and howsoever You wish, O the most merciful.

segments.arabic:
اسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَ الشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ وَ أَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
segments.transliteration: astaghfirul-laahal lad'ee laa ilaaha illaa huwa a'alimul ghaybi wash shahadaatil a'zeezul h'akeemul ghafoorul rah'eem d'ul jalaali wal ikraami wa atoobu ilayhi.
segments.translation: I seek forgiveness of Allah who is: âThere is no god save He, the knower of the unknown and the known, the mighty, the wise, the oft-forgiving, the merciful, the owner of glory and graceâ; and I turn repentant unto Him.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
segments.transliteration: fa-subh'aanallaahi h'eena tumsoona wa h'eena tus'bih'oon.
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah when you enter the night and when you enter the morning.

segments.transliteration: wa lahul h'amdu fis samaawaati wal arz'i
segments.translation: Unto Him be praise in the heavens, the earth,
at the sun's decline, and in the noonday.

segments.arabic:
يَا رَبِّ أَعْطِنِي الْبَصِيرَةَ فِي أَمْرِ الْإِيمَانِ، حَتَّى لَا يُوقِعَنِي الشَّيْطَانُ أَثْنَاءَ أَدَاءِ الْأَعْمَالِ الصَّالِحَةِ فِي الْمَخَاوِفِ وَالتَّصَوُّرَاتِ الْخَاطِئَةِ، فَيَدْفَعَنِي إِلَى مُسْتَنْقَعِ الشَّرِّ.
.
segments.transliteration: ya rabi 'aetini albasirat fi 'amr al'iimani, hataa la yuqieani alshaytan 'athna' 'ada' al'aemal alsaalihat fi almakhawif waltasawurat alkhatiati, fayadfaeuni 'iilaa mustanqae alshar.
segments.translation: " O sustainer give me vision in the matter of Faith! That during performance of good deeds Satan doesn't involve me in fears misapprehensions and thus push me into the morassÂ ofÂ evil."
O Lord, [I beseech for] Your pardon. [I beseech for] Your pardon.
O Lord, [I beseech for] Your pardon. I implore Allahâs forgiveness.

segments.arabic: وَ اعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ يَوْمٍ اَوَّلُهُ فَزَعٌ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min yawmin awwaluhu faza`un
segments.translation: I seek refuge in You from a day whose beginning is fright,
whose middle is anxiety,
and whose end is pain!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِكُلِّ نَذْرٍ نَذَرْتُهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni astaghfiruka likulli nadhrin nadhartuhu
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek forgiveness from You for every vow I have vowed,
every promise I have made,
and every pledge I have pledged
and then I failed to keep it for You.

segments.arabic: وَ اسْالُكَ فِي مَظَالِمِ عِبَادِكَ عِنْدِي
segments.translation: I ask You concerning the complaints of Your servants against me:
If there is a servant from among Your servants
or a bondmaid from among Your bondmaids,

segments.arabic: كَانَتْ لَهُ قِبَلِي مَظْلَمَةٌ ظَلَمْتُهَا إِيَّاهُ
segments.transliteration: kanat lahu qibali mazlamatun zalamtuha iyyahu
segments.translation: who has against me a complaint
because I have wronged him in respect to himself, his reputation,

segments.arabic: اوْ فِي مَالِهِ اوْ فِي اهْلِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ
segments.transliteration: aw fi malihi aw fi ahlihi wa waladihi
segments.translation: his property, his wife or his child,
or because evil words I have spoken about him in his absence,

segments.arabic: اوْ تَحَامُلٌ عَلَيهِ بِمَيْلٍ اوْ هَوًىٰ
segments.translation: an imposition upon him through inclination, caprice,
scorn, zeal,
false show, bigotry,
whether he be absent or present,
alive or dead,
such that my hand has fallen short
and my capacity has been too narrow to make restitution to him
or to annul my obligation to him,

segments.transliteration: fa as'alika ya man yamliku alhajati
segments.translation: I ask You, O He who owns all objects of need,
which are granted by His will
and hasten to His desire

segments.arabic: انْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: that You bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and make [the one I have wronged] satisfied with me in the manner that You will,
and gift me mercy from You,
because, indeed, forgiveness does not disadvantage You
and giving does not have any loss for You.
O Most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

text: Seeking Forgiveness - Isteghfar - Tawbah- Repentance Importance Significance × stighfaar means seeking forgiveness of Allah for the sins so far committed and turning repentant unto Allah. Ibn Abbas relates that the was in the company of Imam Ali(as) when a man came and said Mawla, I have transgressed much "Imam told him: ISTIGHFAAR. Another man came and said : Mawla my land has become arid and parched, what shall I do ?. Imam told him ISTIGHFAR. After a few moments another came and said Mawla I am poverty stricken. Nothing I do bearts fruit. Is there any remedy. Imam said: ISTIGHFAR. Then another man came and said : Mawla Allah has not yet blessed me with a child. What should I do. Imam told him ISTIGHAFAR. I asked him : O AMIRUL MUMININ - though the problems were different, but to each of them you advised to pray ISTIGHFAAR. Imam said : Because Allah says in surah Nuh: And I said : seek forgiveness of your Lord. Verily he is ever most forgiving. He will send you abundant rain from the heaven and will help you with wealth and sons, and will make for you gardens and will make for your rivers. Imam Mohammed Taqi Al Jawad (as) :"Touba" depends upon four things: sincere regrets, verbal "istighfar", deeds and determination never to repeat the sin. O you who believe! turn (in repentance) to Allah a sincere turning; May be your Lord will remove from you your evilÃ¯Â¿Â½ (Qur'an, 66: 8) Said the Prophet of Allah (s): There are four signs of a repentant: 1) He is sincere to God in his actions 2) He shuns falsehood 3) He attaches firmly to truth and 4) He is eager to do good.[Al-Harani, Tohaf al-Uqool, p. 20] Imam JaÃ¯Â¿Â½far al-Sadiq (a) said: 'When a servant turns to God with sincere repentance (tawbatan nasuhan), God loves him and covers him (i.e. his sins) in the world and the Hereafter.' I said, 'And how does He cover him? 'The Imam (a) replied, "He makes the two angels (assigned to write his deeds) forget that which they have writÃ¯Â¿Â½ten of his sins. Then He inspires his bodily members (saying), "Do conceal his sins," and He inspires the earth's places (saying), "Conceal the sins that he used to commit over you." Then he meets God, at the time that he meets Him, in such a manner that there is nothing to give witness against him regarding any sin." × . Eighth: DUA'A 23 Imam Jafar bin Muhammad as Sadiq said: 1) He who has intended to do good but could not, is credited with the good in his record of good deeds. 2) He who intends to do good and actually does so will receive tenfold of reward determined for that one good deed. 3) He who intends to do wrong but does not put it into practice will not be asked for any explanation. (4) He who intends to do evil and actually does so, has an hour at his disposal to turn repentant unto Allah. The angel who records good deeds asks the angel who records evil deeds to wait. May be the sinner does a good deed which wipes out the evil deed done by him. Verily good deeds take away evil deeds. If he repents and recites the following istighfar his sin will not be recorded. Extract Isteaaza Dastaghaib shirazi Satan strives hard to find a place in the heart of a momin. It is narrated that even if a momin escapes unscathed from the trap of Satan because his good deeds ninety nine times, he might become the victim on hundredth attempt! It is quite possible that the instigation for the gou deeds ninety nine times too was by Satan only to make the pen complacent that he fell into the trap on the hundredth attempt! The Satan derives satisfaction from destroying in one stroke the effects of good actions of the person spread over long period. The dividing in between the good and the evil is very narrow and one must take care not to falter towards evil. segments.arabic: يَا مُسَبِِّبَ الْاَسْبَابِ يَا مُفَتِِّحَ الْاَبْوَابِ يَا مَنْ حَيْثُ مَادُعِىَ اَجَابَ

âMake easy (my difficulties), by Your superabundant favours, Oâ the Most Mighty.â
âIt is We who give you sustenance, and the good of the hereafter is for those who have Allah consciousness and guard themselves against evil.â

segments.arabic: يَا نُوْرَ كُلٌِ شَىْءٍ وَهُدَيهُ اَنْتَ الٌَذِىْ فَلَقَ الظٌُلُمَاتِ بِنُوْرِهِ
segments.transliteration: yaa noora kulli shay-in wa hudaahu antallad'ee falaqaz' z'ulumaati binooruhoo
segments.translation: O Light of everything which guides them, You are He who cuts asunder darkness with His light.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنِّيْ اُرِيْدُ التَّزْوِيْجَ فَسَهَّلْ لِيْ مِنَ النِّسَآءِ اَحْسَنَهُنَّ خَلْقًا وَ خُلْقًا وَ اَعَفَّهُنَّ فَرْجًا وَ اَحْفَظَهُنَّ نَفْسًا فِيَّ وَ فِيْ مَالِيْ وَ اكْمَلَهُنَّ جَمَالًا وَ اَكْثَرَهُنَّ اَوْلَادًا.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee oreedut tazweeja fa-sahhal lee menan nesaaa-e ahsanahunna khalqan wa khulqan wa a-a'ffahunna farjan wa ahfazahunna nafsan fiyya wa fee maalee wak-malahunna jamaalan wa aksarahunna awlaadan.
segments.translation: O Allah! I desire to marry, so facilitate for me a woman whose creation and nature is best and who willingly abstain from what is unlawful, who safeguards herself for me and for my wealth, and whose beauty is perfect and who can give many children.[12]

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اُرِيْدُ اَنْ اَتَزَوَّجَ فَقَدِّرْ لِيْ مِنَ النِّسَآءِ اَعْفِهُنَّ فَرْجًا وَ احْفَظِهُنَّ لِيْ فِيْ نَفْسِهَا وَ اَوْسِعْهُنَّ لِيْ رِزْقًا وَاَعْظَمِهُنَّ لِيْ بَرَكَةً فِيْ نَفْسِهَا وَ مَا لِيْ فَقَدِّرْ لِيْ مِنْهَا وَلَدًا طَيِّبًا تَجْعَلُهٗ خَلَفًا صَالِحًا فِيْ حَيَاتِيْ وَ بَعْدَمَوْتِي
segments.transliteration: Allahumma Innee Urreedu An Atazawwaja Faqaddir Lee Minan Nisaa-I Aâfihunna Farjajan wa Ahâfadhâihunna Lee Fee Nafsihaa Wa Awsa-i-Hunna Lee Rizwan Wa A-dhamahunna Lee Barakatan Fee Nafsihaa Wa Maaleee Faqaddir Lee Minhaa Waladan Tayyiban Tajaluhoo Khalafan Saalihan Fee Hayaatee Wa Ba`da Mawtee.
segments.translation: âOâ Allah! I desire to marry, so arrange for me a woman from those who willingly abstain from what is unlawful and who safeguards her soul for my sake and because of her, not only my means of sustenance will increase, but also make there be in it abundance and also make it sure that she will give me a virtuous son, who will be a noble successor in my life and after my death.â

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنبِتُ الْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ﴿٣٦﴾
segments.transliteration: "subh'aanallad'ee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul arz'u wa min anfusihim wa mimmaa laa ya'lamoon, "
segments.translation: Do not strain your eyes towards that which we have given for enjoyment to parties (wedded pairs) of them, the splendor of the life of this world, so that we may try them in it. The provision of your lord is better and more lasting. Enjoin prayer (salat) on your followers, and adhere steadily to it, we do not ask you to provide (subsistence), (it is) We who give you subsistence; and (the good of) the hereafter is for those who safeguard themselves against evil with full awareness of divine laws.]

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ اِلٰى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهٖ اَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا، لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيْهِ، وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَّ اَبْقٰى. وَاْمُرْ اَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَاصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا، لاَ نَسْئَلُكَ رِزْقًا، نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ، وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوٰى.
segments.transliteration: wa laa tamuddanna aâynayka elaa maa mattaânaa behi azwaajam minhum zahratal hayaatid dunyaa, le naftenahum feehe, wa rizqo rabbeka khayruwn wa abqaa. waamur ahlaka bis-salaate wasâtâabir aâlayhaa laa nas-aloka rizqaa nahâno narzoqok wal aâaqebato littaqwaa.
segments.translation: Surely We have given to you a clear victory. That Allah may forgive your community their past faults and those to follow and complete His favor to you and keep you on a right way. And that Allah might help you with a mighty help. He it is Who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers that they might have more of faith added to their faith and Allahâs are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is Knowing, Wise. That He may cause the believing men and the believing women to enter gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein and remove from them their evil; and that is a grand achievement with Allah. And (that) He may punish the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women, and the polytheistic men and the polytheistic women, the entertainers of evil thoughts about Allah. On them is the evil turn, and Allah is wroth with them and has cursed them and prepared hell for them, and evil is the resort. And Allahâs are the hosts of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is Mighty, Wise. [1][1] Surah Fath 48:1-7

segments.arabic: إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُّبِيْنًا. لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَ مَا تَأَخَّرَ وَ يُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَ يَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا. وَ يَنصُرَكَ اللهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيْزًا. هُوَ الَّذِيْ أَنْزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ لِيَزْدَادُوْا إِيْمَانًا مَّعَ إِيْمَانِهِمْ وَ ِللهِ جُنُوْدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَاْلأَرْضِ وَ كَانَ اللهُ عَلِيْمًا حَكِيْمًا. لِيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا اْلأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا وَ يُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَ كَانَ ذٰلِكَ عِنْدَ اللهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيْمًا. وَ يُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَافِقِيْنَ وَ الْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ وَ الْمُشْرِكَاتِ الظَّانِّيْنَ بِاللهِ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ عَلَيْهِمْ دَائِرَةُ السَّوْءِ وَ غَضِبَ اللهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ لَعَنَهُمْ وَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ وَ سَائَتْ مَصِيْرًا. وَ ِللهِ جُنُوْدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ اْلأَرْضِ وَ كَانَ اللهُ عَزِيْزًا حَكِيْمًا.
