segments.translation: âAnd of everything We have created pairs that you may be mindful.â O Allah, by the right of this Your saying and by the right of Muhammad and Ali (a.s.) that You bestow to this woman a suitable husband and not unsuitable for her, by the right of Muhammad and all his progeny.

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ. اَللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ قَوْلِكَ هٰذَا وَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلِىٍّ اَنْ تَرْزُقَ هٰذِهِ الْمَرَاةِ زَوْجًا مُوَافِقًا غَيْرُ مُخَالِفٍ، بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Wa min kulli shai-in khalaqnaa zaujaini la-aâllakum tadhakkaroon. Allaahumma bihâaqqi qaulika haadhaa wa bihâaqqi muhâammadinw wa aâleey. An tarzuqa haadhihil maraa-ti zaujam muwaafiqan ghaira mukhaalif. Bihâaqqi muhâammadinw wa aalihi ajmaeâeân.
segments.translation: There is no god except Allah, and Allah is the greatest. I ask You after forty days and Your mercy, the two of them are before You. No one has any power except You and bless Muhammad and all his progeny.[4]

segments.arabic: لاَ اِلٰهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَ اللهُ اَكْبَرُ، اَسْاَلُكَ مِنْ بَعْدِ اَرْبَعِيْنَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ، فَإِنَّهُمَا بِيَدَيْكَ لاَ يَمْلُكُهَا مِنْ اَحَدٍ غَيْرُكَ، وَ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu allaahu Akbar, as-aluka mim baâdi arbaeâeâna wa rahâmatuka, fa-inna humaa biyadaika laa yamlukuhaa min ahâadin ghairuk. Sâallallaahu aâlaa muhâammadinw wa aalihi ajmaeâeân.
segments.translation: âO AllÄh (SwT)! Bless me with her affection, love and her acceptance of me; and make me pleased with her, and bring us together in the best form of a union and in absolute harmony; surely You like lawful things and dislike unlawful things.â

segments.arabic:
أَللٌّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي إِلْفَهَا وَ وُدَّهَا وَ رِضَاهَا وَ رَضِّـنِي بِهَا ثُمَّ اجْمَعْ بَيْنَـنَا بِأَحْسَنِ اجْتِمَاعٍ وَ أَسَرِّ ائْتِلاَفٍ فَإِنَّكَ تُحِبُّ 

    الْحَلاَلَ وَ تَكْرَهُ الْحَرَام.
segments.transliteration: allaahummar-zuqnee ilfahaa wa wuddahaa wa rezaahaa wa arzenee behaa wajmaâ baynanaa be-ahsanij temaa-iân asarre telaafin fa-innaka tohibbul halaala wa tukrehul haraama.
segments.translation: âO AllÄh! I have taken her as Your trust and have made her lawful for myself by Your words. Therefore, if you have decreed for me a child from hver, then make him/her blessed and pious from among the followers of the family of MuÄ¥ammad; and do not let the Satan have any part in him/her.â

segments.arabic: أَللٌّهُمَّ بِأَمَانَتِكَ أَخَذْتُهَا وَ بِكَلِمَاتِكَ اسْتَحْلَلْـتُهَا فَإِنْ قَضَيْتَ لِي مِنْهَا وَلَداً فَاجْعَلْهُ مُبَارَكاً تَقِيًّا مِنْ شِيعَةِ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ لاَ تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيهِ شِرْكاً وَ لاَ نَصِيباً.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma be amaanateka akhaztohaa wa bekalemaatekas tahlaltohhaa fa-in qazayta lee minhaa waladan faj-aâlho mobaarakan taqiyyan min shee-aâte aale mohammadin wa laa taj-aâlish shaytaane feehi shirkan wa laa naseeban.
segments.translation: âO AllÄh! I have made her lawful for myself with Your words, and I have taken her in Your trust. O AllÄh! Make her fertile and devoted.â

segments.arabic: أَللٌّهُمَّ بِكَلِمَاتِكَ اسْتَحْلَلْتُهَا وَ بِأَمَانَتِكَ أَخَذْتُهَا. أَللٌّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا وَلُوداً وَدُوداً لاَ تَفْرَكُ تَأْكُلُ مِمَّا رَاحَ وَ لاَ تَسْأَلُ عَمَّا سَرَحَ.
segments.transliteration: Bismillaahir Rahâmaanir Rahâeem. Al hâamdu lillaahi iqraaran bi niâmatihi wa laa ilaaha illallaahu ikhlaasâan li wahâdaniyyatihi wa sâallallaahu aâlaa muhâammadin sayyidi bareeyatihi wa aâlaa asâfiyaai min Iâtratihi amma baâdu faqad kaana min fazâlil laahi aâlal anaami an aghnaahum bil hâalaali aânil hâaraami fa qaala sub hâaanahu wa taâala wan kihâul ayaami minkum wasâ sâaalihâeena min Iâbaadikum wa imaa-ikum inây yakoonu fuqraa-a yughnihimul laahu min fazâlihi wal laahu waasiuân aâlaihim. Wa qaala rasoolul laahi sâallallaahu aâlaihi wa aalihi wa sallam tanaakahâu wa tanaasaloo takthuru fa inni ubaahi bikumul umama yaumal qiyaamati wal au bissiqtâI wa qaalan nikaahâu min sunnati faman raghiba aân sunnati fa laisa minni wa sâallallaahu aâlaa muhâammadinw wa aalihitâ tâayyibeenatâ tâaahireen.
segments.translation: O Allah, by Your (declaration of) security I have taken her, and through Your words I have regarded her as lawful (for me). If you decree a child for me from her, then make him blessed, god-fearing, from the Shia of AhIul Bayt, and do not give Shaytan a part and a share in him.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِأَمَانَتِكَ أَخَذْتُهَا وَ بِكَـلِمَاتِكَ اسْتَحْلَلْتُهَا فَإِنْ قَضَيْتَ لِي مِنْهَا وَلَدًا فَاجْعَلْهُ مُبَارَكًا تَقِيًّا مِنْ شِيْعَةِ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيهِ شِرْكًا وَ لَا نَصِيْبًا.
segments.transliteration:
Zawwajtu-ka muwakkilat-Ä«â¦.(name of the bride)

         muwakkila-kaâ¦..(name of bridegroom) âala s-sadÄqi l-ma âlÅ«m.
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah confessing to His bounties and there is no god except Allah with sincere belief in His Oneness. And bliss of Allah be on Muhammad the chief of the creatures and on his chosen ones from his progeny. So to say: among the bounties of Allah upon the mankind is that He made it needless with lawful from that which is unlawful. Thus, Allah, the Glorified and the High said: And marry those among you who are single and those who are fit among your male slaves and your female slaves; if they are needy, Allah will make them free from want out of His grace; and Allah is Ample-giving, Knowing. And the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w.s.) said: âMarry and increase your population, for I will boast of my large Ummah on the Day of Judgment.â And he said: Nikah is from my Sunnah. Thus one who abandons my Sunnah is not from me. And may Allah bless Muhammad and the chaste and purified progeny.

segments.arabic:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اِقْرَارًا بِنِعْمَتِهِ وَلآَ اِلَهَ اِلاَّ اللهُ اِخْلاَصًا لِوَحْدًا نِيَّتِهِ وَ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَي مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ بَرِيَّتِهِ وَ عَلَي الْاَصْفِيَآءِ مِنْ عِتْرَتِهِ اَمَّا بَعْدُ فَقَدْ كَانَ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللهِ عَلَي الْاَنَامِ اَنْ اَغْنَاهُمْ بِالْحَلاَلِ عَنِ الْحَرَامِ فَقَالَ سُبْحَانَهُ وَ تَعَالٰي وَانْكِحُوْ الْاَيَامٰي مِنْكُمْ وَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَ اِمَآئِكُمْ اِنْ يَّكُوْنُوْا فُقَرَآءَ يُغْنِهِمُ اللهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَ اللهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيْمٌ. وَ قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهِ وَ سَلَّمَ تَنَاكَحُوْا وَ تَنَاسَلُوْا تَكْثُرُوْا فَاِنِّيْ اُبَاهِيْ بِكُمُ الْاُمَمَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَ لَوْ بِالسِّقْطِ وَ قَالَ النِّكَاحُ مِنْ سُنَّتِيْ فَمَنْ رَغِبَ عَنْ سُنَّتِيْ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّيْ وَ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَي مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Qabiltu t-tazwÄ«ja li-muwakkil- â¦.(name of the bridegroom) âalas-sadÄqi l-maâluma.
segments.translation: I marry my client,â¦â¦(name of the bride)  to your client,â¦.(name of bridegroom) for the dower that was agreed.

segments.arabic: زَوَّجْتُ مُوَكِّلَتِىْ بِمُوَكِّلِكَ عَلَى الصِّدَاقِ الْمَعْلُوْمِ
segments.translation: I accept on behalf of my client. â¦(name of bridegroom) for the dower that was agreed.

segments.arabic: ÙÙØ¨ÙÙÙØªÙ Ø§ÙØªÙÙØ²ÙÙÙÙÙØ¬Ù ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙ Ø§ÙØµÙÙØ¯ÙØ§ÙÙ Ø§ÙÙÙÙØ¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙ
segments.translation: I have married mayself to you for the dower that was agreed.

segments.transliteration: BismillÄhir-raHmÄnir-raHÄ«m AllÄhumma Salli âalÄ MuHammadin- wa-Äli MuHammad
segments.translation: I accept the marriage.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: سْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ  الرَّحِيْمِ   اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, unite the two of them and unite their hearts

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْمَعْ شَمْلَهُمَا  وَألِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمَا
segments.translation: Make the two of them and their progeny amongst the heirs to the Paradise (full) of bliss (cf. Holy Qurâan 26:85)

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْهُمَا وَذُرِّيَّتَهُمَا مِنْ وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيْمِ
segments.translation: Grant them a pure, pleasant & blessed progeny

segments.transliteration: Wajâalhum aâimmatan yahdÅ«na bi-amrika ilÄ TÄâatik WayaâmurÅ«na bimÄ yardhÄ«ka
segments.translation: Make their progeny (full of) blessings

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma Salli âalÄ MuHammadin- wa-Äli MuHammad
segments.translation: And make them leaders guiding others by Your command (cf.21:72) to your obedience, commanding that which pleases You

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بأَمْرِكَ إِلَى طَاعَتِكَ وَيأْمُرُونَ بِمَا يُرْضِيْكَ
segments.transliteration: rabbi laa tad'arnee fardaw wa anta khayrul waaritheen
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: rabbi hab lee mil ladunka d'urriyyatan t'ayyibah innaka samee-u'd du-a'aa
segments.translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, unite [the affairs] of the two (i.e. the bride & the groom), and unite the hearts the two
Make them and their children among the heirs of the blissful paradise (Q 26: 85),
Provide them with children that are pure, pleasant and blessed and instill (Your) blessings in their off springs
Make them leaders guiding others by Your command to Your obedience (Q 21:72)
And let them command others to that which pleases You
O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
(Ibn Shahar ÄshÅ«b, ManÄqib Äli AbÄ« TÄlib (a), 3:356; also quoted by MajlisÄ« in his BiHÄr, v. 43, p. 117)

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ  الرَّحِيْمِ اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
 اَللَّهُمَّ اجْمَعْ شَمْلَهُمَا، وَألِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمَا، وَاجْعَلْهُمَا وَذُرِّيَّتَهُمَا مِنْ وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيْمِ، وَارْزُقْهُمَا ذُرِّيَّةً طَاهِرَةً طَيِّبَةً مُبَارَكَةً، وَاجْعَلْ فِى ذُرِّيَّتَهُمَا الْبَرَكَةَ، وَاجْعَلهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بأَمْرِكَ إِلَى طَاعَتِكَ، وَيأْمُرُونَ بِمَا يُرْضِيْكَ-
segments.transliteration:
allaahumma innee as-aluka bimaa sa-alaka bihee zakariyyaa rabbi laa tad'arnee fardaw wa anta khayrul waaritheen allaahumma hab lee mil ladunka d'urriyyatan t'ayyibah innaka samee - u'd du-a'aa 
allaahumma bismika istah'laltuhaa wa fee amaanatika akhad'tuhaa fa-in qaz'ayta fee rah'imihaa waladan faj-a'lhoo ghulaaman mubakaran d'akiyaan wa laa taj-a'l lish shayt'aani feehi shirkan wa laa nas'eebaa
segments.translation: O my Lord, do not leave me alone (childless), though You are the best of inheritors.

segments.arabic: الٰهم لا تزرني فرداً و انتٓ خيرُ الوارثين.
segments.translation: O Lord, bestow on me a goodly offspring from You; verily, You are the hearer of prayer.

segments.arabic: وحيداً وحشاً فيكسُرُ ان تفكُّرِ بِالْحٓبْلِيْ عاكبةَ صدقٍ ذكوراً.
segments.translation:
O my Allah, I beseech You in the name of that which Zakariyyaa referred to: O Lord, do not leave me alone (childless), though You are the best of inheritors. O my Allah, bestow on me a goodly offspring from You; verily, You are the hearer of prayers.
 O my Allah, in Your name I have lawfully taken her (as my wife) and I have appropriated and treated her (as) Your bounty entrusted to me, so if You decide to put a child in her womb, please make (this child) submissive, blessed, intelligent and do not let Shaytan be one of the two therein and let him not plant (himself with the child).

segments.transliteration: wa yumdidkum bi-amwaaliw wa baneena wa yaj-a'l lakum jannatiw wa yaj-a'l lakum anhaaraa
segments.translation: Seek forgiveness of your Lord. Verily He is ever most forgiving.

segments.transliteration:
wa samaaa-a baynanaaha bi-aydiw wa innaa lamoosi-o'on
wal arz'a farshnaaha fani-mal maahidoon
segments.translation: He will send you abundant rain from the heaven.

segments.transliteration: wa laqad khalaqnal insaana min sulaalatim min t'een thumma ja-a'lnaahu nut'fatan fee qaraarim makeen thumma khalaqnan nut'fata a'laqatan fakhalaqnal a'laqata muz'ghatan fakhalaqnal muz'ghata i'zaaman fakasawnal i'z'aama lah'maa thumma anshaanaahu khalqan aakhar fatabaarakallaahu ah'sanul khaaliqeen
segments.translation: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will make for you gardens, and will make for you rivers.

segments.arabic: يٓا وٓحَّابُ يٓا عٓظِيْمُ يٓا مُعٓظِّمُ
segments.transliteration: wa law anna quraanan suyyirat bihal jibaalu aw qut'ti - a't bihil arz'u aw kullima bihil mawtaa bal lillaahil amru jamee - a'a
segments.translation:
We built the heavens with might, and verily We are the Lord of power and expanse.
We spread the earth (like a carpet) â an excellent spreader (We are).

segments.arabic: ثُمّٓ اَتِنِيْ فِيْ كُلِّ عَاْفِيَةٍ شُكْراً حتَّى تَبْلُغٓنِيْ مِنْها
segments.transliteration: allaahumma antash shaheedu wa anal mashhoodu faman yad-u'l mashhoodu illash shaheedu yaa rabb
segments.translation: Verily We created man from an extract of clay. Then We made him of a sperm, in a firm resting place; Then We made the sperm into a clot, then We made the clot into a lump of flesh, then We made in the lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh; thereafter We caused it to grow into another creation; so blessed be Allah, the best of creators.

segments.arabic: .رِضْوَانُكَ فِيْ صِدْقِ الْحٓدِيْثِيْ وَ عٓدٓاءِل اَمَاْنٓتِيْ وٓ وٓفٓاءٍ بِالْآحٓدِ.
segments.transliteration: rabbi hab lee mil ladunka d'urriyyatan t'aaibah innka samee-u'd du-a'aa
segments.translation: And if there were a Quran with which the mountains were moved, or the earth cloven asunder, or the dead were made to speak (the disputants would not believe). Nay, but truly the command belongs to Allah altogether.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِمَا سَاَلَكَ بِهٖ زَكَرِيَّا يَا رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِيْ فَرْدًا وَّ اَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِيْنَ اَللّٰهُمَّ هَبْ لِىْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً اِنَّكَ سَمِيْعُ الدُّعَاءِ، اَللّٰهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ اسْتَحْلَلْتُهَا وَ فِىْ اَمَانَتِكَ اَخَذْتُهَا فَاِنْ قَضَيْتَ فِىْ رَحْمِهَا وَلَدًا فَاجْعَلْهُ غُلَامًا مُبَارَكًا وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيْهِ شَرَكًا وَ لَا نَصِيْبًا.
segments.transliteration: wallad'eena yaqooloona rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa d'urriyaatinaa qurraata a'yuniw waj-a;lnaa lil muttaqeena imaamaa
segments.translation: O my Allah, You witness and I am observed. So who takes care of the observed save He who witnesses, O Lord?

segments.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِيْ فَرْدًا وَّ اَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِيْنَ وَ اجْعَلْ لِیْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا يَرِثُنِيْ فِىْ حَيَاتِىْ وَ يَسْتَغْفِرُ لِىْ بَعْدَ مَوْتِىْ وَ اجْعَلْهُ خَلْقًا سَوِيًّا وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيْهِ نَصِيْبًا، اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَ اَتُوْبُ اِلَيْكَ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma Laa Tazar'nee Fardan Wa Anta Khayrul Waaritheen,
segments.translation: O Lord, bestow on me a goodly offspring from You; verily, You are the hearer of prayer.

segments.arabic: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ۝۰ۭ اِنَّہٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًا۝۱۰ۙ يُّرْسِلِ السَّمَاۗءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّدْرَارًا۝۱۱ۙ وَّيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِاَمْوَالٍ وَّبَنِيْنَ وَيَجْعَلْ لَّكُمْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّيَجْعَلْ لَّكُمْ اَنْہٰرًا۝۱۲ۭ
segments.transliteration: Waheedan Wahashan Fa Yaksuru An Tafakkuri Bal Habalee Aakibata Swidqin Dhukooran
segments.translation: And those who say: O Our Lord, grant us out of our wives and our offspring that which cheers our eyes, and make us Imams of those who safeguard themselves against evil.

segments.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِيْ فَرْدًا وَّ اَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِيْنَ وَ اجْعَلْ لِیْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا يَرِثُنِيْ فِىْ حَيَاتِىْ وَ يَسْتَغْفِرُ لِىْ بَعْدَ مَوْتِىْ وَ اجْعَلْهُ خَلْقًا سَوِيًّا وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيْهِ شَرَكًا وَ لَا نَصِيْبًا، اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَ اَتُوْبُ اِلَيْكَ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ.
segments.translation: O Allah do not leave me alone and You are the Best of Inheritors

segments.arabic: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ۝۰ۭ اِنَّہٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًا۝۱۰ۙ يُّرْسِلِ السَّمَاۗءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّدْرَارًا۝۱۱ۙ وَّيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِاَمْوَالٍ وَّبَنِيْنَ وَيَجْعَلْ لَّكُمْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّيَجْعَلْ لَّكُمْ اَنْہٰرًا۝۱۲ۭ
segments.translation: Single, alone, so much that my gratitude falls short upon remembering You

segments.arabic: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ۝۰ۭ اِنَّہٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًا۝۱۰ۙ يُّرْسِلِ السَّمَاۗءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّدْرَارًا۝۱۱ۙ وَّيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِاَمْوَالٍ وَّبَنِيْنَ وَيَجْعَلْ لَّكُمْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّيَجْعَلْ لَّكُمْ اَنْہٰرًا۝۱۲ۭ
segments.translation:
Who will bring me happiness during my solitude and
So (please) grant me an honest son and daughter,

segments.arabic: و ل و ا ن ق ر ا ن ا س ي ر ت ب هـ ا ل ج ب ا ل ا و ق ط ع ت ب هـ ا ل ا ر ض ا و ك ل م ب هـ ا ل م و ت ی ب ل ل ل هـ ا ل ا م ر ج م ي ع ا وَ لَوْ اَنَّ قُرْآنًا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ الْجِبَالُ اَوْ قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ اْلاَرْضُ اَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ الْمَوْتٰى بَلْ لِلهِ اْلاَمْرُ جَمِيْعًا
segments.transliteration: Yaa Wahhaabu Yaa Adhweemu Yaa Mu'adh-dhamu,
segments.translation: who will bring me solace during my loneliness

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ. اِنَّ اللہَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ اَنْ تَزُوْلَا، كَذٰلِكَ اَمْسَكْتُكَ يَا وِلْدَ فُلَانَةَ بِنْتِ فُلَانَةٍ بِاَنْ تَعْرِفَ مَقَرَّكَ وَ مُسْتَوْدَعَكَ بِاللهِ الَّذِىْ لَهٗ مَا سَكَنَ فِىْ اللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ وَ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ.
segments.transliteration: Thumma A'atwini Fee Kulli Aafiyatin Shukran Hattaa Tablughanee Minha
segments.translation: And thank You for the completion of blessings

segments.transliteration: Ridhwaanuka Fi Sidqil Hadeethi Wa Adaa'il Amaanati Wa Wafaa'in Bil Ahadi
segments.translation: O Giver of all things O Grand One O Supreme One

segments.arabic: اُسْكُنْ يَا وِلْدَ فُلَانَةَ بِنْتِ فُلَانَةٍ بِاللهِ الَّذِىْ اَسْلَمَ لَهٗ مَنْ فِىْ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ طَوْعًا اَوْ كَرْهًا وَ اِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ ولَبِثُوْا فِىْ كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةَ سِنِيْنَ وَ ازْدَادُوْا تِسْعًا وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِىِّ الْعَظِيْمِ.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-aloka bemaa sa-alaka behi zakariyyaa yaa rabbe laa tazarnee fardanw wa anta khayrul waareseen. allaahumma hablee min ladunka zurriyyatan tayyebatan innaka sameeuâd doaâa. allaahumma bismekas tahlaltohaa wa fee amaanteka akhaztohaa fa-in qazayta fee rahmehaa waladan faj-aâlho gholaaman mobaarakan wa laa taj-aâl lish-shaytaane feehe sharakan wa laa naseebaa.
segments.translation: Then please give me for every wellbeing gratitude (towards You)

segments.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ سُلٰـلَـۃٍ مِّنْ طِيْنٍ۝۱۲ۚ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنٰہُ نُطْفَۃً فِيْ قَرَارٍ مَّكِيْنٍ۝۱۳۠ ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَۃَ عَلَقَۃً فَخَـلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَۃَ مُضْغَۃً فَخَـلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَۃَ عِظٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظٰمَ لَحْــمًا۝۰ۤ ثُمَّ اَنْشَاْنٰہُ خَلْقًا اٰخَرَ۝۰ۭ فَتَبٰرَكَ اللہُ اَحْسَنُ الْخٰلِقِيْنَ۝۱۴ۭ اَمْسَكْتُ وِلْدَ فُلَانَةَ بِنْتِ فُلَانَةٍ بِاللهِ الَّذِىْ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَآءَ اَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَی الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهٖ وَ بِقُدْرَةِ اللهِ الَّذِىْ يُمْسِكُ السَّمٰوَاتُ اَنْ تَزُوْلَا.
segments.transliteration: Rabbe laa tazarnee fardanW wa anta khayrul waareseena waj-aâl lee min ladunka waliyyan yaresonee fee hayaatee wa yastaghfero lee baâda mawtee waj-aâlho khalqan sawiyyan wa laa taj-aâl lish SHAYTAANe FEEHE nasâeebaa. Allaahumma innee astaghferoka wa atoobo ELAYKA innaka antal ghafoorur RAHEEM.
segments.translation: so much that I am given Your Satisfaction for being sincere in my word, and giving back trusts, and being loyal to covenant

segments.transliteration: FaqultuS taghferoo rabbakum, innahu kaana ghaffaaraa. Yurselis samaa-a aâlaykum midraaraa. Wa yumdidkum be-amwaalinw wa baneena wa yaj-aâl lakum jannaatinw wa yaj-aâl lakum anhaaraa.
segments.translation: O Allah, indeed I ask You by that through which Zakaria asked You. That is he said: O My Lord! Leave me not alone and Thou art the best of inheritors. O Allah, grant me from Thee good offspring: surely Thou art the Hearer of prayer. O Allah by Your Pure name I have taken this woman as lawful for myself and taken her as a trust from You. If You have decreed to conceive a child in her womb, then make him a blessed boy and do not make Satan a partner or a shareholder in him.[2]

segments.arabic: یَا خَالِقَ النَّفْسِ مِنَ النَّفْسِ وَ مُخْرِجَ النَّفْسِ مِنَ النَّفْسِ وَ مُخَلِّصَ النَّفْسَ مِنَ النَّفْسِ خَلِّصْہَا.
segments.transliteration: Rabbe laa tazarnee fardanW wa anta khayrul waareseena waj-aâl lee min ladunka waliyyan yaresonee fee hayaatee wa yastaghfero lee baâda mawtee waj-aâlho khalqan sawiyyan wa laa taj-aâl lish SHAYTAANe FEEHE sharakan wa laa nasâeebaa. Allaahumma innee astaghferoka wa atoobo ELAYKA innaka antal ghafoorur RAHEEM.
segments.translation: O my Lord! Leave me not alone, and Thou art the best of inheritors. And make me from You a successor who would inherit me in my life and seek forgiveness for me after my death. And make him a goodly creation and do not make Satan have a share in him. O Allah, indeed I seek Your forgiveness and turn towards You. Indeed You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.[3]

segments.arabic:
وَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْ اَنَّ السَّمَوَتِ وَ اَلْاَرْضَ
كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَهُمَا وَ جَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمآءِ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ حَيٍّ اَفَلاَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ ۔
وَ اَيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الَّليْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ النَّهَارَ فَاِذَاهُمْ مُّظْلٍمُوْنَ-
وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِىْ مُسْتَقَرِّ لَّهَا ذَلِكَ تَقْدِيْرُ
الْعَزِيْزِ الْعَلِيْمِ-
و َالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّى عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُوْنِ الْقَدِيْمِ-
لاَ الشَّمْسُ يَنْبَغِى لَهَآ اَنْ تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلاَ الَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ وَ كُلُّ فِىْ فَلَكِ يَّسْبَحُوْنَ-
وَ اَيَةٌ لَّهُمْ اَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمُ فِى الْفُلْكِ
الْمَشْحُوْنِ-
وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ مِّثْلِهِ مَا يَرْكَبُوْنَ-
وَاِنْ نَّشَاْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلاَ صَرِيْخَ لَهُمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يُنْقَزُوْنَ-
اِلاَّ رَحْمَةً وَ مَتَاعًا اِلىَ حِيْنِى-
وَ نُفِخَ فِى الصُّوْرِ فَاِذَا هُمْ مِّنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ اِلىَ
segments.transliteration: FaqultuS taghferoo rabbakum, innahu kaana ghaffaaraa. Yurselis samaa-a aâlaykum midraaraa. Wa yumdidkum be-amwaalinw wa baneena wa yaj-aâl lakum jannaatinw wa yaj-aâl lakum anhaaraa.
segments.translation: Then I said: Ask forgiveness of your Lord, surely He is the most Forgiving: He will send down upon you the cloud, pouring down abundance of rain: And help you with wealth and sons, and make for you gardens, and make for you rivers.[5]

segments.arabic: يَا خَالِقَ اانَّفْسِ وَ مُخْرِجَ النَّفْسِ مِنَ النَّفْسِ وَمُخْلِصَ النَّفْسِ مِنَ النَّفْسِ خَلِّصْهَا-
segments.transliteration: Faqultus taghferoo rabbakum, innahu kaana ghaffaaraa. Yurselis samaa-a aâlaykum midraaraa. Wa yumdidkum be-amwaalinw wa baneena wa yaj-aâl lakum jannaatinw wa yaj-aâl lakum anhaaraa.
segments.translation: O my Lord! Leave me not alone and You are the best of the inheritors. And appoint for me from You a successor who would do good to me during my life and seek forgiveness for me after I died. And make him a goodly creation and do not make Satan a partner or shareholder in him. O Allah indeed I seek Your forgiveness and turn towards You. Indeed You are Forgiving, Merciful.

segments.arabic:
فَاَجَآئَهَا الْمَخَاضُ اِلىَ جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ، قَالَتْ يَالَیْتَنِی مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَذَا وَ كُنْتُ نَسْيًا مَّنْسِيًا۔
فَنَادَيهَا مِنْ تَحْتِهَآ اَلاَّ تَحْزَنِی قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكَ تَحْتْكِ سَرَیًّا۔
وَهَزِّىْ اِلَيْكَ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَقِطْ عَلَيْكَ رُطَبًا جَنِيًا-
وَ اللهُ اَخْرَجَكُمْ مِنْ بُطُوْنِ اُمَّهَتِكُمْ لاَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ شَيْئًا وَ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَ الْاَبْصَارَ وَ الْاَفْنِدَةَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ-
segments.transliteration: Wa law anna qur-aanan suyyerat behil jebaalo aw qutteaât behil arzo aw kullema behil mawtaa bal lillaahil amro jameeaâa.
segments.translation: Then I said, Ask forgiveness of your Lord, surely He is the most Forgiving: He will send down upon you the cloud, pouring down abundance of rain: And help you with wealth and sons, and make for you gardens, and make for you rivers.[8]

segments.arabic:
فَاِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرَا
اِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرَا-
يَاَیُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْا رَبَّكُمْ اِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَىْءٌ عَظِيْمٌ-
يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ اَرْضَعَتْ وَ تَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلِ حَمْلَهَا وَ تَرَى النَّاسَ سُكَرَی وَمَا هُمْ بِشُکَرَی وَ لكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللهِ شَدِيْدٌ-
segments.transliteration:
wallateee ah's'anat farjahaa fanafkhanaa feehaa mir rooh'inaa wa ja-a'lnaahaa wabnahaaa aayatal lil-a'alameen

inna haad'ihee ummatukum ummataw waah'idataw wa anaa rabbukum fa'-budoon

wa taqat't'a -o'oo amrahum baynahum kullun ilaynaa raaji-o'on
segments.translation: Then I said: Ask forgiveness of your Lord, surely He is the most Forgiving: He will send down upon you the cloud, pouring down abundance of rain: And help you with wealth and sons, and make for you gardens, and make for you rivers.[9]

segments.arabic: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِىْ قَّصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِاُولِى الْاَلْبَابِ مَا كَانَ حَدِيْثًا يٍُفْتَرَى وَ لكِنْ تَضْدِيْقَ الَّذِيْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَ تَفْصِيْلَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَّ هُدًی وَّ رَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ-
segments.transliteration:
Fallaahu khayrun h'aafiz'aw wa huwa arh'amur raah'imeen

allaahu ya-lamu maa tah'milu kullu unthaa wa maa tagheez'ul arh'aamu wa maa tazdaad wa kullu shay-in i'ndahoo bimiqdaar
segments.translation: âAnd even if there were a Quran with which the mountains were made to pass away, or the earth were traveled over with it, or the dead were made to speak thereby; nay! the commandment is wholly Allahâs.â[11]

segments.arabic: بِاسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِىْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَلِيْمُ الْكَرِيْمُ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ رَبِّ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ، اَلْحمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، كَاَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْا اِلَّا عَشِيَّةً اَوْ ضُحَاهَا كَاَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوْعَدُوْنَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْا اِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّنْ نَّهَارٍ بَلَاغٌ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ اِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْفَاسِقُوْنَ وَ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهٖ اَجْمَعِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: was-'bir wa maa s'abruka illaa billaahi wa laa tah'zan a'layhim wa laa taku fee z'eeqim mimmaa yamkuroon innallaaha ma-a'llad'eenat-taqaw wal-lad'eena hum muh'sinoon
segments.translation:
(Remember) her (Maryam) who guarded her chastity. Then We breathed into her of Our spirit, and We made her and her son a sign for all peoples.

Verily, this is your group, one group, and I am your Lord, therefore, worship Me,

But they have rent asunder their (this) affair among themselves (into sects). All shall return to Us.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ، وَ كَاشِفَ الْغَمِّ، وَ رَحْمٰنُ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ وَ رَحِيْمَهُمَا، اِرْحَمْ، فُلَانَةَ بِنْتِ فُلَانَةٍ رَحْمَةً تُغْنِيْهَا بِهَا عَنْ رَحْمَةِ جَمِيْعِ خَلْقِكَ، تُفَرِّجُ بِهَا كُرْبَتَهَا وَ تَكْشِفُ بِهَا غَمَّهَا وَ تُيَسِّرَ وِلَادَتَهَا وَ قُضِىْ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَ هُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ وَ قِيْلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: bismil laahir rahmaanir raheem. innal laaha yumsekus samaawaate wal arza antazoolaa kazaaleka amsaktoka yaa wilda folaanata binte folaanah. be-an taârefa maqarraka wa mustawda-aâka billaahil lazee lahu maa sakana fil layle wan nahaare wa howas sameeuâl aâleem.
segments.translation:
But Allah is the best of guardians; and He is the most merciful of the merciful.

Allah knows what every female bears, and that which the wombs fall short (of completion) and that which they exceed. And every thing with Him is measured.

segments.arabic: فَاَجَاۗءَہَا الْمَخَاضُ اِلٰى جِذْعِ النَّخْلَۃِ۝۰ۚ قَالَتْ يٰلَيْتَنِيْ مِتُّ قَبْلَ ھٰذَا وَكُنْتُ نَسْـيًا مَّنْسِـيًّا۝۲۳ فَنَادٰىہَا مِنْ تَحْتِہَآ اَلَّا تَحْزَنِيْ قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا۝۲۴ وَہُزِّيْٓ اِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَۃِ تُسٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا۝۲۵ۡ
segments.translation: Be patient (O Muhammad)! And your patience is only with (the help of) Allah; and do not grieve for them, and do not be distressed because of what they devise. Verily Allah is with those who safeguard themselves against evil and those who do good.

segments.arabic: وَاللہُ اَخْرَجَكُمْ مِّنْۢ بُطُوْنِ اُمَّہٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ شَـيْـــًٔـا۝۰ۙ وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْــِٕدَۃَ۝۰ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ۝۷۸
segments.transliteration: uskun yaa wilda folaanata binte folaanatin billaahil lazee aslama lahu man fissamawaate wal arze tawaân aw karhan wa elayhe turjaoona wa labesoo fee kahfehim salaasa me-ata seneena waz daadoo tisaân wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaahil aâliyyil aâzeem.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. Indeed Allah had stopped the havens and the earth from falling down. In the same way you have been stopped O child of so and so daughter or so and so, so that you are recognized in your position and you are supplicated about from Allah, the One who has settled in the night and the day and He is the hearing, the knowing.

segments.arabic: كَاَنَّہُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوْعَدُوْنَ۝۰ۙ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْٓا اِلَّا سَاعَۃً مِّنْ نَّہَارٍ۝۰ۭ بَلٰغٌ۝۰ۚ فَہَلْ يُہْلَكُ اِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْفٰسِقُوْنَ. كَاَنَّہُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَہَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْٓا اِلَّا عَشِـيَّۃً اَوْ ضُحٰىہَا.
segments.transliteration: wa laqad khalaqnal insaana min solaalatim min teen. summa ja-aâlnaaho nutfatan fee qaraarim makeen. summa khalaqnan nutfata aâlaqatan fakhalaqnal aâlaqata muzghatan fakhalaqnal muzghata eâzaaman fakasawnal eâzaama lahma, summa anshaa-naaho khalqan aakhar. fatabaarakal laaho ahsanul khaaleqeen. amsakto wilda folaanata binte folaanatin billaahil lazee yumsekus samaa-a antaqa-aâ aâlal arze illaa be-izneh. wa bequdratil laahil lazee yumsekus samaawaato an tazoolaa.
segments.translation: Stop, by the majesty of Allah, by the majesty of Allah.

segments.arabic: كَاَنَّہُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوْعَدُوْنَ۝۰ۙ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْٓا اِلَّا سَاعَۃً مِّنْ نَّہَارٍ. كَاَنَّہُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَہَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْٓا اِلَّا عَشِـيَّۃً اَوْ ضُحٰىہَا.
segments.translation: Stop! O child of so and so daughter of so and so by Allah, the One for Whom submit all those who are in the heavens and the earth willingly or unwillingly and to Him they return and they remained in their cave for 300 years and increased it by nine (309 years). And there is no power and might except by Allah, the Exalted and the Mighty.

segments.arabic: اِذْ قَالَتِ امْرَاَتُ عِمْرٰنَ رَبِّ اِنِّىْ نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِيْ بَطْنِىْ مُحَرَّرًا
segments.transliteration: Yaa Khaaleqan Nafse Menan Nafse Wa Mukhrejan Nafse Menan Nafse Wa Mokhallesan Nafsa Menan Nafse Khallishaa.
segments.translation: And certainly We created man of an extract of clay. Then We made him a small seed in a firm resting-place. Then We made the seed a clot, then We made the clot a lump of flesh, then We made (in) the lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, then We caused it to grow into another creation, so blessed be Allah, the best of the creators.[41] I stop the child of so and so, daughter of so and so, by Allah, the One who âHe withholds the heaven from falling on the earth except with His permission;â and by the power of Allah, âthe One Who upholds the heavens and the earth lest they come to naught.â

segments.arabic: فَاَجَاۗءَہَا الْمَخَاضُ اِلٰى جِذْعِ النَّخْلَۃِ۝۰ۚ قَالَتْ يٰلَيْتَنِيْ مِتُّ قَبْلَ ھٰذَا وَكُنْتُ نَسْـيًا مَّنْسِـيًّا۝۲۳ فَنَادٰىہَا مِنْ تَحْتِہَآ اَلَّا تَحْزَنِيْ قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا۝۲۴ وَہُزِّيْٓ اِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَۃِ تُسٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا۝۲۵ۡ
segments.transliteration:
allaahumma laa tad'arnee fardaw wa anta khayrul waaritheen

waah'idean wah'shan fayaqs'uru shukree a'n tafakkuree bal hab lee a'aqibatan s'idqan d'ukooran wa inaathan aanis bihim minal wah'shati waskun ilayhim minal wah'dati wa ashkuruka i'nda tamaamin ni'mati yaa wahhaabu wa yaa a'z'eemu wa yaa mu'a'z'z'im thumma a't'inee fee kulli a'afiyatin shukran h'attaa tablughanee minhaa riz'waanaka fee s'idqil h'adeethi wa adaa-il amaanati wa wafaa-im bil a'hd
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segments.arabic: وَاللہُ اَخْرَجَكُمْ مِّنْۢ بُطُوْنِ اُمَّہٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ شَـيْـــًٔـا۝۰ۙ وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْــِٕدَۃَ۝۰ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ۝۷۸
segments.transliteration:
Ka-annahum yawma yarawna maa yoo-a'doona lam yalbathooo illaa saa-a'tam min nahaar.

ka-annahum yawma yarawnahaa lam yalabathooo illaa a'shiyyatan aw z'uh'aahaa

id qaalatim-ra-atu i'mraana rabbi innee nad'artu laka maa fee bat'nee muh'arraran
segments.translation: O the creator of one life from another! And the one Who takes one life from another! O the one to separate one life from another life release this newborn from the prison of the womb.

segments.arabic: كَاَنَّہُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَہَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْٓا اِلَّا عَشِـيَّۃً اَوْ ضُحٰىہَا.
segments.transliteration:
awlam yarallad'eena kafarooo annas samaawaati wal arz'a kaanataa ratqan fa-fataqnaaahumma wa ja-a'lnaa minal maaa-i kulla shay-in h'ayy a-falaa yoominoon wa aayatullahumul layl naslakhu minhun nahaara fa-id'aa hum muz'limoon

wash shaamsu taajree limustaqarril lahaa d'aalika taqdeerul a'zeezil a'leem wal qamara qaddarnaahu manaazila h'attaa a'ada kal-u'rjoonil qadeem lash shamsu yambaghee lahaaa an tudrikal qamara wa lal laylu saabiqun nahaar wa kullun fee falakiy yasbah'oon

wa aayatul lahum annha h'amalnaa d'urriyyatahum fil fulkil mashh'oon wa khalaqna lahum mim mithlihee maa yarkaboon.

wa innashaa nughriqhum falaa s'areekha lahum wa laa hum yunqad'oon

illaa rah'matam minnaa wa mataa-a'n ilaa h'een wa nufikha fis' s'oori fa-id'aa hum minal ajdaathi ilaa rabbihum yansiloon
segments.translation:
O my Allah, do not leave me alone (childless), though You are the best of inheritors.
Sorrowfulness due to loneliness and sense of abandonment made me fall short of what I should have done to thank You, but (I beseech You to) give me an upright and honest posterity, male and female. On account of them change my loneliness with companionship and let there be ease and comfort instead of desolation, so that I should thank You on the completion of bounty, O the great, the giver of greatness, then keep me continuously in ease and comfort, till I am favoured with Your pleasure, because of my truthfulness in whatever I say, I promise and I do.

segments.arabic: فَاصْبِرْ كَـمَا صَبَرَ اُولُوا الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلْ لَّہُمْ۝۰ۭ كَاَنَّہُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوْعَدُوْنَ۝۰ۙ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْٓا اِلَّا سَاعَۃً مِّنْ نَّہَارٍ۝۰ۭ بَلٰغٌ۝۰ۚ فَہَلْ يُہْلَكُ اِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْفٰسِقُوْنَ۝۳۵ۧ
segments.transliteration: ka-annahum yawma yarawna maa yoo-a'doona lam yalbathooo illaa saa-a'tam min nahaar balaagh fahal yuhlaku illal qawmul faasiqoon ka-annahum yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbathooo illaa a'shiyyatan aw z'uh' aahaa
segments.translation:
On the day when they will see what they have been promised, (they will realize) that they had not tarried but an hour of the day.

On the day they see it, it will seem as if they had not tarried (in their graves) but a (single) evening, or the following morning.

When (Hannah) the wife of Imran said: âMy Lord, verily I have vowed to You that whatever is in my womb to be (exclusively) dedicated (to Your service).

segments.arabic: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِيْ قَصَصِہِمْ عِبْرَۃٌ لِّاُولِي الْاَلْبَابِ۝۰ۭ مَا كَانَ حَدِيْثًا يُّفْتَرٰى وَلٰكِنْ تَصْدِيْقَ الَّذِيْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْہِ وَتَفْصِيْلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَّہُدًى وَّرَحْمَۃً لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ۝۱۱۱ۧ
segments.transliteration: yaa khaaliqan nafsi minan nafsi wa mukhrijan nafsi minan nafsi wa mukhlis'an nafsi minan nafsi khallis'haa
segments.translation:
Have not those who disbelieve seen that the heavens and the earth were closed up, and that We clove them asunder? Out of water We made all things alive. Will they not then believe?

There is a sign in the night for them. We draw off the day from it, an lo! They are in darkness.

The sun travels to an appointed place. This is the decree of the mighty, the all-knowing (Lord).

And the moon-We have determined stages for it till it returns like the old (dried) branch of a palm-tree.

It is not permitted to the sun that it should overtake the moon, nor can the night outsrip the day; each in an orbit, they float. A sign unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ark; And We have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.

If We will, We can drown them, then there shall be no one to help them, nor shall they be rescued.

Save by way of mercy from Us (to enable them) to enjoy themselves for a while.
When the trumpet is blown, then lo! From their graves unto their Lord they shall be hastening.

segments.arabic: اَوَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اَنَّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنٰہُمَا۝۰ۭ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَاۗءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ۝۰ۭ اَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ۝۳۰
segments.transliteration:
fa-ajaaa-a hal makhaaz'u ilaa jid-i'n nakhlah qaalat yaalaytanee mittu qabla haad'aa wa kuntu nasyam mansiyyaa

fanaadaaha min tah'tihaaa allaa tah'zanee qad ja-a'la rabbuki tah'taki sariyyaa

wa huzzeee ilayki bijid -in nakhlati tusaaqit a'layki rut'aban janiyya

wallaahu akhrajakum mim but'ooni ummahaatikum laa ta'-lamoona shay-aw wa ja-a'la lakumus sam-a'wal abs'aara wal af-idata la-a'llakum tashkuroon
segments.translation:
On the day when they will see what they have been promised, (they will realize) that they had not tarried but an hour of the day. A (clear) deliverance (of the message this is). So none will be destroyed save those who transgress.
On the day they see it, it will seem as if they had not tarried (in their graves) but a (single) evening, or the following morning.

segments.arabic: وَاٰيَۃٌ لَّہُمُ الَّيْلُ۝۰ۚۖ نَسْلَخُ مِنْہُ النَّہَارَ فَاِذَا ہُمْ مُّظْلِمُوْنَ۝۳۷ۙ وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِيْ لِمُسْتَــقَرٍّ لَّہَا۝۰ۭ ذٰلِكَ تَــقْدِيْرُ الْعَزِيْزِ الْعَلِــيْمِ۝۳۸ۭ وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنٰہُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰى عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُوْنِ الْقَدِيْمِ۝۳۹ لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنْۢبَغِيْ لَہَآ اَنْ تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا الَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّہَارِ۝۰ۭ وَكُلٌّ فِيْ فَلَكٍ يَّسْبَحُوْنَ۝۴۰ وَاٰيَۃٌ لَّہُمْ اَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّــتَہُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُوْنِ۝۴۱ۙ وَخَلَقْنَا لَہُمْ مِّنْ مِّثْلِہٖ مَا يَرْكَبُوْنَ۝۴۲ وَاِنْ نَّشَاْ نُغْرِقْہُمْ فَلَا صَرِيْخَ لَہُمْ وَلَا ہُمْ يُنْقَذُوْنَ۝۴۳ۙ اِلَّا رَحْمَۃً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا اِلٰى حِيْنٍ۝۴۴
segments.transliteration:
fa-inna ma-a'l u'sri yusraa inna ma-a'l u'sri yusraa

yaaa ayyuhan naasut-taqoo rabbakum inna zalzalatas saa-a'ti shay-un a'z'eem

yawma tarawnahaa tad'halu kullu murz'i -a tin a'mmaaa arz'a-at wa taz'a-u kullu d'aati h'amlin h'amlahaa wa taran-naasa sukaaraa wa maa hum bisukaara wa laakinna a'd'aaballaahi shadee
segments.translation: O He who creates life from life, O He who brings out life from life, O He who delivers life from life, deliver (the child from the womb).

segments.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّوْرِ فَاِذَا ہُمْ مِّنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ اِلٰى رَبِّہِمْ يَنْسِلُوْنَ۝۵۱
segments.transliteration: laqad kaana fee qas'as'ihim i'bratul li-oolil albaab maa kaana h'adeethay yuftaraa wa laakin tas'deeqallad'ee bayna yadayhi wa tafs'eela kulli shay-iw wa hudaw wa rah'matal liqawmiy yoominoon
segments.translation:
The birth-pangs led her to the trunk of a palm-tree. âWould that I had died before thisâ, she said, âand had been a thing forgotten, lost in oblivion!â

Then (a voice) called her from beneath her: âDo not grieve; verily your Lord has made a river flow right below you.

Shake the trunk of the palm-tree towards yourself, it will drop fresh and ripe dates on you.

O my Lord, do not leave me alone (childless), though You are the best of inheritors.

segments.arabic: فَاصْبِرْ كَـمَا صَبَرَ اُولُوا الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلْ لَّہُمْ۝۰ۭ كَاَنَّہُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوْعَدُوْنَ۝۰ۙ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْٓا اِلَّا سَاعَۃً مِّنْ نَّہَارٍ۝۰ۭ بَلٰغٌ۝۰ۚ فَہَلْ يُہْلَكُ اِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْفٰسِقُوْنَ۝۳۵ۧ
segments.transliteration: bismil laahil lazee laa elaaha illaa howal haleemul kareem. sub-hanal laahe rabbis samaawaate wa rabbil aârshil aâzeem. alhamdo lillaahe rabbil aâalameen. ka-annahum yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasoo illaa aâshiyyatan awzohaahaa. ka-annahum yawma yarawna maa yooaâdoona lam yalbasoo illaa saa-aâtam min nahaarin balaaghun fahal yohlako illal qawmul faaseqoon. wa sallal laaho aâlaa mohammadin wa aalehi ajmaeâen.
segments.translation:
Verily, with every difficulty there is ease, Verily with every difficulty there is ease.

O people, fear your Lord. Verily, the quake of the hour is a terrible thing!
The day you shall behold it, every suckling mother shall forsake her suckling, and every pregnant female shall drop her load. Your shall behold the people (as) drunken, yet they will not be drunken, but the wrath of Allah will be terrible.

segments.arabic: كَاَنَّہُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَہَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْٓا اِلَّا عَشِـيَّۃً اَوْ ضُحٰىہَا.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma yaa faarejaL hAmme wa kaashefaL ghamme wa rahmaanUd dunyaa wal aakherate wa raheemahomaa irham folaanata binte folaanatIN rahmatan tughneehaa BEHAA aân rahmate jamee-eâ khalqek. Tofarrejo BEHAA kurbatahaa wa takshefo behaa ghammahaa wa toyassera welaadatAhaa wa qozEE baynahum bilhaqqe wa hum laa yuzlamoona wa qeelal HAMDO lillaahe rabbil aâalameen.
segments.translation: Indeed there is a lesson in their narratives for men of understanding. It is not a forged tale but a confirmation of what went before it, and a detailed exposition of all things, and a guide and a mercy for those who believe.

segments.arabic: كَاَنَّہُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَہَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْٓا اِلَّا عَشِـيَّۃً اَوْ ضُحٰىہَا.
segments.transliteration: fa-ajaa-ahal makhaazo elaa jiz-iân nakhlah, qaalat yaalahytanee mitto qabla haazaa wa kunto nasyam mansiyyaa. fanaadaaha min tahteha allaa tahzanee qad ja-aâla rabboke tahtake sariyyaa. wa huzzee elayke bejiz-iân nakhlate tosaaqit aâlayke rotaban janiyyaa.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the One except Whom there is no god, the Forbearing, the Kind. Glory be to Allah, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the great throne (Arsh). Praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds. âOn the day that they see it, it will be as though they had not tarried but the latter part of a day or the early part of it.â âOn the day that they shall see what they are promised they shall be as if they had not tarried save an hour of the day. A sufficient exposition! Shall then any be destroyed save the transgressing people?â And may Allah bless Muhammad and all his progeny.[13]

segments.arabic: اِذْ قَالَتِ امْرَاَتُ عِمْرٰنَ رَبِّ اِنِّىْ نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِيْ بَطْنِىْ مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىْ۝۰ۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ۝۳۵
segments.transliteration: wal laaho akhrajakum mim botoone ummahaatekum laa taâlamoona shay-anw wa ja-aâla lakomus sam-aâ wal absaara wal af-edata, la-aâllakum tashkoroon.
segments.translation: O Allah, O easer of sorrow, and remover of grief, the Beneficent of the world and the Hereafter and their Merciful. Have mercy on so and so daughter of so and so with such a mercy that she becomes needless of the mercy of all Your creation. Ease for her, her afflictions and remove from her, her grief and make easy her delivery and judgment between them would be with truth and they would not be dealt with unjustly and it was said: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.[14]

segments.arabic: فَاَجَاۗءَہَا الْمَخَاضُ اِلٰى جِذْعِ النَّخْلَۃِ۝۰ۚ قَالَتْ يٰلَيْتَنِيْ مِتُّ قَبْلَ ھٰذَا وَكُنْتُ نَسْـيًا مَّنْسِـيًّا۝۲۳ فَنَادٰىہَا مِنْ تَحْتِہَآ اَلَّا تَحْزَنِيْ قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا۝۲۴ وَہُزِّيْٓ اِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَۃِ تُسٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا۝۲۵ۡ
segments.transliteration: Ka-annahum yawma yarawna maa yooaâdoona lam yalbasoo illaa saa-aâtam min nahaar, Balaagh, fahal yohlako illal qawmul faaseqoon. Ka-annahum yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasoo ilLaa aâshiyyatan aw zohaahaa.
segments.translation: And the throes (of childbirth) compelled her to betake herself to the trunk of a palm tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died before this, and had been a thing quite forgotten! Then (the child) called out to her from beneath her: Grieve not, surely your Lord has made a stream to flow beneath you; And shake towards you the trunk of the palm tree, it will drop on you fresh ripe dates.[15]

segments.arabic: وَاللہُ اَخْرَجَكُمْ مِّنْۢ بُطُوْنِ اُمَّہٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ شَـيْـــًٔـا۝۰ۙ وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْــِٕدَۃَ۝۰ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ۝۷۸
segments.transliteration: Ka-annahum yawma yarawna maa yooaâdoona lam yalbasoo illaa saa-aâtam min nahaar. Ka-annahum yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasoo ilLaa aâshiyyatan aw zohaahaa.
segments.translation: And Allah has brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers-you did not know anything- and He gave you hearing and sight and hearts that you may give thanks.[16]

segments.arabic: فَقُلْنَا اضْرِبْ بِّعَصَاكَ الْحَجَرَ۝۰ۭ فَانْفَجَرَتْ مِنْہُ اثْنَتَا عَشْرَۃَ عَيْنًا. وَّفَجَّــرْنَا الْاَرْضَ عُيُوْنًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَاۗءُ عَلٰٓي اَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ. فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ۝۰ۭ اِنَّہٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًا۝۱۰ۙ يُّرْسِلِ السَّمَاۗءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّدْرَارًا۝۱۱ۙ كَذٰلِكَ تَدُرُّ هٰذِهِ الْمَرْاَةُ لَبَنًا خَالِصًا سَائِغًا لِلشَّارِبِيْنَ وَ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلٰي سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهٖ وَ سَلَّمَ وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ.
segments.transliteration: Iz qaalatim ra-ato iâmraana RABBe innee nazarto laka maa fee batnee moharraran.
segments.translation: On the day that they shall see what they are promised they shall be as if they had not tarried save an hour of the day. A sufficient exposition! Shall then any be destroyed save the transgressing people?[18] On the day that they see it, it will be as though they had not tarried but the latter part of a day or the early part of it.[19]

segments.arabic: فِيْہَآ اَنْہٰرٌ مِّنْ مَّاۗءٍ غَيْرِ اٰسِنٍ۝۰ۚ وَاَنْہٰرٌ مِّنْ لَّبَنٍ لَّمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُہٗ۝۰ۚ وَاَنْہٰرٌ مِّنْ عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّى
segments.transliteration: Fa-ajaa-ahal makhaazo elaa jiz-iân nakhlah, qaalat yaalahytanee mitto qabla HAAZAA wa kunto nasyaM mansiyyaa. FanaaDAAHA min tahteha Allaa tahzanee qad ja-aâla rabboke tahtake sariyyaa. Wa huzzee elayke bejiz-iân nakhlate tosaaqit aâlayke rotaban janiyyaa.
segments.translation: On the day that they shall see what they are promised they shall be as if they had not tarried save an hour of the day.[21] On the day that they see it, it will be as though they had not tarried but the latter part of a day or the early part of it.[22]

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاَنَّكَ اَنْتَ اللهُ الَّذِىْ لَيْسَ كَمِثلِكَ شَیْءٌ اَنْ تَفْعَلْ بِىْ كَذَا وَ كَذَا.
segments.transliteration: WAL LAAHO akhrajakum mim botoone ummahaatekum laa taâlamoona shay-anw wa ja-aâla lakomus sam-aâ wal absaara wal af-edata, la-aâllakum tashkoroon.
segments.translation: When a woman of Imran said: My Lord! Surely I vow to Thee what is in my womb, to be devoted (to Thy service). [23]

segments.transliteration: Ka-annahum yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasoo ilLaa aâshiyyatan aw zohaahaa.
segments.translation: And the throes (of childbirth) compelled her to betake herself to the trunk of a palm tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died before this, and had been a thing quite forgotten! Then (the child) called out to her from beneath her: Grieve not, surely your Lord has made a stream to flow beneath you; And shake towards you the trunk of the palm tree, it will drop on you fresh ripe dates.[26]

segments.arabic: احد رس صطع كلم هؤلاء حوطا يحوطا حوطا لوطا لوطا لوطا اطرمتا سلك الدم بحق آدم سحطا ورس يصطلق
segments.transliteration: fasbir kamaa sabara oolul aâzme menar rosole wa tas-taâjal lahum, Ka-annahum yawma yarawna maa yooaâdoona lam yalbasoo illaa saa-aâtam min nahaar, Balaagh, fahal yohlako illal qawmul faaseqoon.
segments.translation: And Allah has brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers- you did not know anything-and He gave you hearing and sight and hearts that you may give thanks.[27]

segments.arabic: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الْحَلِيْمُ الْكَرِيْمُ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوٰاتِ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ. كَاَنَّہُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَہَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْٓا اِلَّا عَشِـيَّۃً اَوْ ضُحٰىہَا. لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْا اِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّنْ نَّهَارٍ
segments.transliteration: Laqad kaana fee qasasehim iâbratul le-oolil albaab, maa kaana hadeesany yuftaraa wa laakin tasdeeqal LAZEE BAYNA yadayhe wa tafseela KULLE shay-inw wa hodanw wa rahmatal leqawminy yoa-menoon.
segments.translation: On the day that they see it, it will be as though they had not tarried but the latter part of a day or the early part of it.[28]

segments.arabic: رَبِّ اَنْتَ اَعْطَيْتَنِيْهِ وَ اَنْتَ وَهَبْتَهٗ لِيْ اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاجْعَلْ هِبَتُكَ الْيَوْمَ جَدِيْدَةً اِنَّكَ قَادِرٌ مُقْتَدِرٌ.
segments.transliteration: awa lam yaral lazeena kafaroo annas samaawaate wal arza kaanataa ratqan fafataqnaahomaa, wa ja-aâlnaa menal maa-e kulla shay-in hayy, afalaa yoa-menoon.
segments.translation: Therefore bear up patiently as did the apostles endowed with constancy bear up with patience and do not seek to hasten for them (their doom). On the day that they shall see what they are promised they shall be as if they had not tarried save an hour of the day. A sufficient exposition! Shall then any be destroyed save the transgressing people?[29]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ بِسْمِ اللهِ، وَ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ الْمُبَارَكَاتِ، الَّتِىْ نَامَ بِهَا اَهْلُ الْكَهْفِ وَ الرَّقِيْمِ اَللهُ يَتَوَفَّى اْلاَنفُسَ حِيْنَ مَوْتِهَا وَ الَّتِيْ لَمْ تَمُتْ فِيْ مَنَامِهَا فَيُمْسِكُ الَّتِيْ قَضٰى عَلَيْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَ يُرْسِلُ اْلاُخْرٰى اِلٰی اَجَلٍ مُسَمّٰی وَ تَحْسَبُهُمْ اَيْقَاظًا وَ هُمْ رُقُوْدٌ اَفَمِنْ هٰذَا الْحَدِيْثِ تَعْجَبُوْنَ وَ تَضْحَكُوْنَ وَ لَا تَبْكُوْنَ وَ اَنتُمْ سَامِدُوْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Wa aayaatul lahomul laylo, naslakho minhun nahaara fa-ezaa hum muzlemoon. Wash shamso tajree lemustaqarril lahaa, zaaleka taqdeerul aâzeezil aâleem. Wal qamara qaddarnaaho manaazela hattaa aâada kal-uârjoonil qadeem. Lash shamso yambaghee lahaa an tudrekal qamara wa lal laylo saabeqUn nahaar, wa kullun fee falakiny yasbahoon. Wa aayaatul lahum annaa hamalnaa zurriyyatahum fil fulkil mash-hoon. Wa khalaqnaa lahum mim mislehi maa yarkaboon. Wa in NAshaa nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum wa laa hum yunqazoon. Illaa rahmatam minnaa wa mataa-aân elaa heen.
segments.translation: In their histories there is certainly a lesson for men of understanding. It is not a narrative which could be forged, but a verification of what is before it and a distinct explanation of all things and a guide and a mercy to a people who believe.[30]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ اَلْآنَ خَفَّفَ اللهُ عَنْكُمْ وَ عَلِمَ اَنَّ فِيْكُمْ ضَعْفًا.
segments.transliteration: Wa nofekha fissoore fa-ezaa hum menal ajdaase elaa rabbehim yanseloon.
segments.translation: Do not those who disbelieve see that the heavens and the earth were closed up, but We have opened them; and We have made of water everything living, will they not then believe?[31]

segments.transliteration: fasbir kamaa sabara oolul aâzme menar rosole wa tas-taâjal lahum, Ka-annahum yawma yarawna maa yooaâdoona lam yalbasoo illaa saa-aâtam min nahaar, Balaagh, fahal yohlako illal qawmul faaseqoon.
segments.translation: And a sign to them is the night: We draw forth from it the day, then lo! they are in the dark; And the sun runs on to a term appointed for it; that is the ordinance of the Mighty, the Knowing. And (as for) the moon, We have ordained for it stages till it becomes again as an old dry palm branch. Neither is it allowable to the sun that it should overtake the moon, nor can the night outstrip the day; and all float on in a sphere. And a sign to them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship. And We have created for them the like of it, what they will ride on. And if We please, We can drown them, then there shall be no succorer for them, nor shall they be rescued, But (by) mercy from Us and for enjoyment till a time.[32]

segments.arabic: وَ عَنَتِ الْوُجُوْهُ لِلْحَيِّ الْقَيُّوْمِ وَ قَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا.
segments.transliteration: Ka-annahum yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasoo ilLaa aâshiyyatan aw zohaahaa.
segments.translation: Therefore bear up patiently as did the apostles endowed with constancy bear up with patience and do not seek to hasten for them (their doom). On the day that they shall see what they are promised they shall be as if they had not tarried save an hour of the day. A sufficient exposition! Shall then any be destroyed save the transgressing people?[34]

segments.arabic: قُلْنَا يَا نَارُ كُوْنِيْ بَرْدًا وَّ سَلَامًا.
segments.transliteration: Ka-annahum yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasoo ilLaa aâshiyyatan aw zohaahaa.
segments.translation: On the day that they see it, it will be as though they had not tarried but the latter part of a day or the early part of it.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الْعِزُّ وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَ النُّوْرُ وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهٖ اَجْمَعِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Iz qaalatim ra-ato iâmraana RABBe innee nazarto laka maa fee batnee moharraran fa-taqabbal minnee, innaka antas samee-uâl aâleem.
segments.translation: On the day that they see it, it will be as though they had not tarried but the latter part of a day or the early part of it.[36]

segments.arabic: وَ مَنْ يَّتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهٗ اِنَّ اللهَ بَالِغُ اَمْرِهٖ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا.
segments.transliteration: fa-ajaa-ahal makhaazo elaa jiz-iân nakhlah, qaalat yaalahytanee mitto qabla haazaa wa kunto nasyam mansiyyaa. fanaadaaha min tahteha allaa tahzanee qad ja-aâla rabboke tahtake sariyyaa. wa huzzee elayke bejiz-iân nakhlate tosaaqit aâlayke rotaban janiyyaa.
segments.translation: When a woman of Imran said: My Lord! Surely I vow to Thee what is in my womb, to be devoted (to Thy service); accept therefore from me, surely Thou art the Hearing, the Knowing.[37]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَبِاللهِ اَلٌلهُمٌَ هَاذِهِ عَقِيْقَةُ عَنْ...بْنِ... لَحْمُهَا بِلَحْمِهِ وَدَمُهَا بِدَمِهِ بِعَظْمُهَا  بِعَظْمٍهِ وَ شَعْرُهاَ بِشَعْرِهِ بِجَلْدُهَا بِجِلْدِهِ اَللهُمٌَ اَجْعَلهَا وَقَاءً لِاَلِ مُحَمٌَدٍ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ السٌَلامُ
segments.transliteration: WAL LAAHO akhrajakum mim botoone ummahaatekum laa taâlamoona shay-anw wa ja-aâla lakomus sam-aâ wal absaara wal af-edata, la-aâllakum tashkoroon.
segments.translation: And the throes (of childbirth) compelled her to betake herself to the trunk of a palm tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died before this, and had been a thing quite forgotten! Then (the child) called out to her from beneath her: Grieve not, surely your Lord has made a stream to flow beneath you; And shake towards you the trunk of the palm tree, it will drop on you fresh ripe dates:

segments.arabic: سْمِ اللهِ وَبِاللهِ اَلٌلهُمٌَ هَاذِهِ عَقِيْقَةُ... ابْنَةِ.... لَحْمُهَا بِلَحْمِهَا وَدَمُهَا بِدَمِهَا بِعَظْمُهَا  بِعَظْمٍهَا وَ شَعْرُهاَ بِشَعْرِهَا بِجَلْدُهَا بِجِلْدِهَا اَللهُمٌَ اَجْعَلْهَا وَقَاءً لِاَلِ مُحَمٌَدٍ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ السٌَلامُ
segments.transliteration: Faqulnaz rib be-aâsaakal hajar, fanfajarat minhus nataa aâshrata aâynaa. Wa fajjarnal ARZA oâyoonan faltaqal maa-o aâlaa amrin qad qoder. Faqultus taghferoo rabbakum innahu kaana ghaffaaraa. Yurselis samaa-a aâlaykum midraaraa. kazaaleka tadurro haazehil mar-ato labanan khaalesan saa-eghan lish-shaarebeen wa sallal laaho aâlaa sayyedenaa mohammadin nabiyye sallal laaho aâlayhe wa aalehi wa sallam wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa bil-laahil aâliyyil aâzeem.
segments.translation: And Allah has brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers- you did not know anything and He gave you hearing and sight and hearts that you may give thanks.[40]

segments.arabic: ياقَوْمِ اِنٌِى بَرِىءُ مِِّمَّا تُشْرِكُوْنَ، اِنٌِى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِىْ فَطَرَ السَّمَوَتِ وَالْاَرْضَ حَنِيْفًا وَّمَآ اَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ- اِنَّ صَلَاتِىْ وَ نُسُكِىْ وَ مَحْيَاىَ وَمََاتِىْ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ- لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ اُمِرْتُ وَ اَنَا اَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ- اَلّلهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَ لَكَ بِسْمِ اللهِ وَاللهُ اَكْبَرُ اَلّلهُمَّ صَلِِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ تَقَبَّلْ مِنْ....بْنِ...
segments.transliteration: feehaa anhaarum mim maaa-in ghayre aasen, wa anhaarum mil labanil lam yataghayyar taâmoh, wa anhaarum min aâsalim mosaffan.
segments.translation: We said: Strike the rock with your staff. So there gushed from it twelve springs.[42] And We made water to flow forth in the land in springs, so the water gathered together according to a measure already ordained.[43] Then I said: Ask forgiveness of your Lord, surely He is the most Forgiving: He will send down upon you the cloud, pouring down abundance of rain.[44] In this way increase the breast milk of this woman and make it pure and enough for those who nurse at her. May Allah bless our chief, Muhammad the Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and there is no Power and Strength, except by Allah, the Exalted and the Mighty.[45]

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللهِ وَ بِاللهِ اَلَّلهُمَّ هَذِهِ عَقِيْقَةُ عَنْ (  ) لَحْمُهَا بِلَحْمِهِ (بِلَحْمِهَا) وَدَمُهَا بِدَمِهِ (بِدَمِهَا) وَعَظْمُهَا بِعَظْمِهِ (بِعَظْمِهَا) اَلَّلهُمَّ اَجْعَلْهَا وِقَاءً
َلهُ (لَهَا) بِاَلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اَلِهِ وَسَلَّمْ-
 بِسْمِ اللهِ وَ بِاللهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِله وَاللهُ اَكْبَرُ اِيْمَانًا بِاللهِ وَثَنَاءً عَلىَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَالْعَصْمَةُ لِاَمْرِهِ وَالشُّكْرُ لِرِزْقِهِ و الْمَعْرِفَةُ بِفَضْلِهِ عَلَيْنَا اَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ-
 اَلَّلهُمَّ اِنَّكَ وَهَبْتَ لَنَا ذَكَرًا وَ اَنْتَ اَعْلَمَ بِمَا وَهَبْتَ وَمِنْكَ مَا اَعْطَيْتَ وَكُلَّمَا صَنَعْتَ فَتَقَبَّلْهُ مِنَّا عَلَى سُنَّتِكَ وَسُنَّةِ نَبِيّكَ وَرسُوْلِكَ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَاخْسَعْ عَنَّا الشَّيْطَانَ الرَّجِيْمَ لَكَ سَفَكْتُ ادِِّمآءَ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَكَ اَلَّلهُمَّ وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِِّ الْعَلَمِيْنَ اَلَّلهُمَّ لَحْمُهَا بِلَحْمِهِ وَدَمُهَا بِدَمِهِ وَعَظْمُهَا بِعَظْمِهِ وَشَعْرُهَا بِشَعْرِهِ وَجَلْدُهَا بِجَلْدِهِ اَلَّلهُمَّ اَجْعَلْهُ فِدَآءً-
segments.transliteration: wa inna lakum fil an-a'ami la-ibrah nusqeekum mimmaa fee but'oonihaa wa lakum feehaa manaafi-u katheeratuw wa minhaa taakuloon.
segments.translation: Therein are rivers of water that does not alter, and rivers of milk the taste whereof does not change and rivers of drink delicious to those who drink, and rivers of honey clarified.[46]

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ هذِهِ سُنَّتُكَ وَ سُنَّةُ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَاتِّباعٌ مِنّا لَكَ وَ لِنَبِّيِكَ بِمَشِيَّتِكَ وَ بِاِرادَتِكَ وَ قَضاَّئِكَ لاَِمْرٍ اَرَدْتَهُ وَ قَضاَّءٍ حَتَمْتَهُ وَ اَمْرٍ اَنْفَذْتَهُ وَ اَذَقْتَهُ حَرَّ الْحَديدِ فى خِتانِهِ وَ حِجامَتِهِ بِاَمْرٍ اَنْتَ اَعْرَفُ بِهِ مِنّى اَللّهُمَّ فَطَهِّرْهُ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَزِدْ فى عُمْرِهِ وَادْفَعِ الاْفاتِ عَنْ بَدَنِهِ وَالاَْوْجاعَ عَنْ جِسْمِهِ وَ زِدْهُ مِنَ الْغِنى وَ ادْفَعْ عَنْهُ الْفَقْرَ فَاِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ وَلانَعْلَمُ
segments.transliteration: allaahu ya'-lamu maa gtah'milu kullu unthaa wa maa tagheez'ul arh'aamu wa maa tazdaad wa kullu shay-in i'ndahoo bimiqdaar a'alimul ghaybi wash shahaadatil kaaabeerul muta-a'al
segments.translation: Verily there is a lesson for you in the cattle. We give you to drink of what is in their bellies; there are, in them, many benefits for you; and of them you eat:

segments.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ ﴿٤٠﴾
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-aloka be-annaka antal laahul lazee laysa kamisleka shay-un an taf-aâl bee kazaa wa kazaa
segments.translation: Allah knows what every female bears, and that which the wombs fall short (of completion) and that which they exceed. And every thing with Him is measured. (He is) the knower of the unseen and the seen, the great, the highest high

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا ﴿٧٤
segments.translation: O Allah, indeed I ask You by that You are Allah like Whom there is none. Do for me such and such.

segments.arabic: قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللّهَ فَاتَّبِعُونِي يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللّهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَاللّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
segments.transliteration: Laa ELAAHA illal laahul haleemul kareem, laa ELAAHA ILLAL LAAHO rabbus samawaatis sab-eâ wa rabbul aârshil AâZEEM. Ka-annahum yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasoo ilLaa aâshiyyatan aw zohaahaa. lam yalbasoo illaa saa-aâtam min nahaar.
segments.translation: Purify me from menses.

segments.arabic: ‏فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ ‎
segments.transliteration: Rabbe anta aaâtaytaneehe wa anta wahabtahu lee allaahumma faj-aâl hebatokal yawma jadeedatan innaka qaaderun muqtader.
segments.translation: There is no god except Allah, the forbearing the kind. There is no god except Allah, the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the great throne (Arsh) âOn the day that they see it, it will be as though they had not tarried but the latter part of a day or the early part of it. They had not tarried save an hour of the dayâ

segments.arabic: ÙÙØ³ÙØ¨ÙØ­ÙÙ°ÙÙ Ù±ÙÙÙØ°ÙÙ Ø¨ÙÙÙØ¯ÙÙÙÛ¦ ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙØªÙ ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø´ÙÙÙØ¡Ù ÙÙØ¥ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ØªÙØ±ÙØ¬ÙØ¹ÙÙÙÙ- ÙÙ ÙØ§ÙØ­ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙÙØ§Ù ÙÙÙÙÙØ©Ù Ø§ÙÙØ§ÙÙ Ø¨Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø§ÙÙØ¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø§ÙÙØ¹ÙØ¸ÙÙÙÙ
segments.transliteration: bismil laahir rahmaanir raheem. bismil laahe wa bekalemaatil laahit taaammaatil mobaarakaatil latee naama behaa ahlul kahfe war raqeeme allaaho yatawaffal anfosa heena mawtehaa wal latee lam tamut fee manaamehaa. fayumsekul latee qazaa aâlayhal mawta wa yurselul ukhra elaa ajalim mosammaa wa tahsabohum ayqaazan wa hum roqoodun afamin haazal hadeese taâjaboona wa tazhakoona wa laa tabkoona wa antum saamedoon.
segments.translation: My Lord, You gave me to him and You granted him to me. O Allah, renew Your grant today, surely You are Able and Powerful.

segments.arabic: مَّا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَا أَحَدٍ مِّن رِّجَالِكُمْ وَلَكِن رَّسُولَ اللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا
segments.transliteration: bismil laahir rahmaanir raheem. al-aana khaffafal laaho aânkum wa aâlema anna feekum zaâfaa
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. And by the perfect and blessed words of Allah. With which slept the people of the Cave and the Inscription. Allah takes the souls at the time of their death and those that die not during their sleep. And you might think them awake while they were asleep. Then He withholds those on whom He has passed the decree of death and sends the others back till an appointed term. And will you laugh and not weep? While you are indulging in varieties?[50]

segments.arabic: لَـقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ مِّنۡ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡ عَزِيۡزٌ عَلَيۡهِ مَا عَنِتُّمۡ حَرِيۡصٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ بِالۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ رَءُوۡفٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. For the present Allah has made light your burden, and He knows that there is weakness in you.[51]

segments.arabic: يُّحِبُّهُمۡ وَيُحِبُّوۡنَهٗۤ ۙ اَذِلَّةٍ عَلَى الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ اَعِزَّةٍ عَلَى الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
segments.transliteration: Wa aânatil wojooho lil-hayyil qayyoome wa qad khaaba man hamala zulmaa.
segments.translation: â¦and man is created weak.[52]

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ- وَالٌَله الْمُسْتَعَانٌ عَلَى مَا تَصِفُوْنَ يَا رَفِيْقُ يَا شَفِيْقُ نَجٌِنِىْ مِنْ كُلٌِ ضَيْقٍ- اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: Qulnaa yaa naaru koonee bardanw wa salaamaa.
segments.translation: And the faces shall be humbled before the Living, the Self-subsistent God, and he who bears iniquity is indeed a failure.[53]

segments.arabic: يُوسُفُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَٰذَا وَٱسْتَغْفِرِى لِذَنۢبِكِ إِنَّكِ كُنتِ مِنَ ٱلْخَاطِـِٔينَ- وَقَالَ نِسْوَةٌ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ تُرَٰوِدُ فَتَىٰهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا إِنَّا لَنَرَىٰهَا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
segments.transliteration: Bismil laahil iâzzo wal kibreyaa-o wan nooro wa sallAL LAAHO aâlaa MOHAMMADin WA AALEhi ajmaeâen.
segments.translation: We said: O Fire! Be a comfort and peace.[54]

segments.arabic: لَقَدْ جَآئَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مِّنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيْزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيْصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ رَؤُوْفٌ رَّحِيْمٌ.
segments.transliteration: Wa many yatawakkal aâlal laahe fahowa hasbohu innal laaha baalegho amrehi qad ja-aâlAL LAAHO lekulle SHAY-IN qadraa.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Mighty, the Greatness and the effulgence and may Allah bless Muhammad and all his progeny.

segments.arabic: وَ اعْتَصِمُواْ بِحَبْلِ اللهِ جَمِيْعًا وَ لاَ تَفَرَّقُواْ وَ اذْكُرُواْ نِعْمَةَ اللهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ كُنْتُمْ أَعْدَآءً فَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوْبِكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُمْ بِنِعْمَتِهِ إِخْوَانًا يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُم مِّنْ ذَكَرٍ وَ أُنْثٰى وَ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ شُعُوْبًا وَ قَبَائِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوْا إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِنْدَ اللهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلِيْمٌ خَبِيْرٌ.
segments.transliteration:
Bi-âsmi âllÄhi wa-bi âllÄh.  AllÄhumma hÄdhihi âaqÄ«qatun âan â¦.(name of the boy)

                Ibne â¦. (name of the father) lahmu-hÄbi-lahmi-hi wa-damu-hÄbi-dami-hi wa-âazmu-hÄbi-âazmi-hi wa-shaâru-hÄ bishaâri-hi wa-jildu-hÄbi-jildi-h.  AllÄhummaâjÎal-hÄ waqÄâan li-Äli Muhammadin âalay-hi wa-Äli-hi s-salÄm.
segments.translation: And whoever trusts in Allah, He is sufficient for him; surely Allah attains His purpose; Allah indeed has appointed a measure for everything.[55]

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اَلِّفْ بَيْنَ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنَةٍ وَ بَيْنَ فُلاَنَةَ بِنْتِ فُلاَنَةٍ، كَمَا اَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ مُوْسٰی وَ هَارُوْنَ وَ كَمَا اَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ جَبْرَائِيْلَ وَ مِيْكَائِيْلَ، وَ بَيْنَ خَدِيْجَةَ الْكُبْرٰی وَ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَ سَلَّمَ وَ بَيْنَ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ وَ عَلِىٍّ الْمُرْتَضٰی عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ. اَللَّهُمَّ اَلِّفْ بَيْنَ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنَةٍ وَ فُلاَنَةَ بِنْتِ فُلاَنَةٍ مَثَلاً كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ اَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَ فَرْعُهَا فِیْ السَّمَآءِ. تُوْتِیْ اُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِيْنٍ بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهَا، وَ يَضْرِبُ اللهُ اْلاَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Bi-âsmi âllÄhi wa-bi-llÄh.  AllÄhumma hÄdhihi âaqÄ«qatun âan â¦.(name of the girl) Ibnati . . . (name of the father) lahmu-hÄbi-lahmi-hÄ wa-damu-hÄbi-dami-hÄwa- âazmu-hÄbi- âazmi-hÄ wa-shaÎru-hÄbi-shaÎri-hÄ wa-jildu- hÄbi-jildi-hÄ.  AllÄhmmaâ jÎal-hÄ waqÄâan li-Äli Muhammadin âalay-hi wa-Äli-hi s-salÄm.
segments.translation: In the Name of God and through God, this is the âaqÄ«qa ofâ¦. (name of the boy), son of â¦. (name of the father): its flesh [i.e., the flesh of the sacrifice of the âaqÄ«qa] for his flesh blood, its bone for his bone, its hair for his hair, its skin for his skin.  O God, let it be a protection of the family of Muhammad, peace be upon him  and his family.

segments.arabic: يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطْفِؤُوا نُورَ اللَّهِ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ…نَصْرٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌ قَرِيبٌ
segments.transliteration:
YÄ qawmi innÄ« barÄ«âun mim-mÄ tushrikÅ«na innÄ« wajjahtu wajhÄ«ya li-âlladhÄ« fatara s-samÄwÄti wa-l-arda hanÄ«fam musliman, wa-mÄ anÄ mina l-mushrikÄ«na.   Inna salÄt-Ä« wa nusuk-Ä« wa-mahyÄyÄ wa-mamÄt-Ä«li-âllÄhi rabbil-âalamÄ«na sharÄ«ka la-h.

                 Wa-bi dhÄlika umirtu wa-anÄ mina l-muslimÄ«na allÄhumma min-ka wa-la-kabi-âsmiâllÄhi wa-âllÄhu akabar.
