segments.translation: In the Name of God and through God, this is the âaqÄ«qa ofâ¦..(name of the girl), daughter of â¦. (name of the father): its flesh for her flesh, its blood for her blood, its bones for her bones, its hair for her hair, its skin for her skin.  O God, let it be a protection of the family of Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ. اَللَّهُمَّ اَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْكَبِيْرُ، وَ اَنَا عَبْدُكَ الضَّعِيْفُ الذَّلِيْلُ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَ لاَ قُوَّةَ اِلاَّ بِكَ، اَللَّهُمَّ سَخَّرَ لِىْ فُلاَنًا كَمَا سَخَّرْتَ الْبَحْرَ لِمُوسٰی ابْنِ عِمْرَانَ وَ اَلِنْ قَلْبَهُ كَمَا اَلَنْتَ الْحَدِيَْد لِدَاوُوْدَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَنْطِقُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِكَ، نَاصِيَتُهُ فِىْ قَبْضَتِكَ وَ قَلْبَهُ فِىْ يَدِكَ تُقلِّبْهُ كَيْفَ تَشَآءُ إِنَّكَ عَلٰی كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ.
segments.transliteration:
bismillaahi wa billaahi allaahumma haad'ihee a'qeeqatun a'n (mention the name of the child with father's name) lah'muhaa bilah'mihee (bilah'mihaa) wa damuhaa bidamihee (bidamihaa) wa a'z'muhaa bi-a'z'mihee (bia'z'mihaa) allaahummaj-a'lhaa wiqaa -an lahoo (lahaa) bi-aali muh'ammadin s'allallaahu a'layhi wa aalihee wa sallam

                bismillaahi wa billaahi walh'amdu lillaahi wallaahu akbar eemaanan billaahi wa thanaa-an a'laa rasoolillaahi s'allallaahu a'layhi wa aalihee wal a's'matu li-amrihee wash shukru lirizqihee wal ma-rifatu bifaz lihee a'laynaa ahlil bayti

                allaahumma innka wahabta lanaa d'akaran wa anta a'-lamu bimaa wahabta wa minka maa a't'ayta wa kullamaa s'ana -ta fataqabbaalhu minaa a'laa sunnatika wa sunnati nabiyyika wa rasoolika s'allallaahu a'layhi wa aalihee wakh-sa a'nnash shayt'aanar rajeema laka safaktud dimaa-a laa shareeka laka allaahumma wal h'amdu lillaahi rabbil a'alameen allaahumma lah'muhaa bilah'mihee wa damuhaa bidamihee wa a'z'muhaa bi-a'z'mihee wa sha'ruhaa bisha - rihee wa jilduhaa bijildihee allaahummaj-a'lhu fidaa-an
segments.translation:
O gathering, I am free from what you associate; I turn my face to He who split the heavens and the earth, a true believer and a Muslim, and not one of the polytheists.  My prayer, my piety, my living, and my dying are for God, the Lord of the Words.  O God, from You and to You, in the Name of God; God is greater.  O God, bless Muhammad, and accept [this] from â¦ (name of the child).

Son / daughter of â¦â¦ (name of the father).

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ، يَا مَنْ وَضَعَ نَيْرِ الْمَذَلَّةِ عَلٰی رِقَابِ الْمُلُوْكِ الْجَبَابِرَةِ فَهُمْ مِنْ سَطْوَتِهِ خَائِفُوْنَ، يَا مَنْ تَعَزَّزَ بِالْعِزَّةِ وَ الْعَظَمَةِ فَجَمِيْعُ خَلْقِهِ مِنْ خَيْفَتِهِ وَ جِلُوْنَ، وَ يَا مَنْ يَحْشُرُ الْعِظَامَ الدَّارِ سَاتِ وَهِیَ رَمِيْم يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُوْنَ، يَا مَنْ اَعَزَّ اَولِيَآئَهُ بِطَاعَتِهِ فَهُمْ مِنَ الْفَزَعِ يَوْمَئِذٍ قَالَ رَجُلاَنِ مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ يَخَافُوْنَ اَنْعَمَ اللهُ عَلَيْهِمَا ادْخُلُوْا عَلَيْهِمُ الْبَابَ، فَاِذَا دَخَلْتُمُوْةُ فَاِنَّكُمْ غٰلِبُوْنَ، وَ عَلَی اللهِ فَتَوَكَّلُوْآ اِنْ كنْتُمْ مُّؤْمِنِيْنَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Allahumma hadhihi sunnatu-ka wa-sunatu nabiy-ka salawatu-ka âalay-hi wa-ali-hi- wa- âttabaâu mithali-ka wa-kutubi-ka li-mashiâ ati-ka wa-iradati-ka wa-qadaâI-kal-amrin aradta-hu wa-qadaâin hatamta-huwa-hukmin anfadhta-hu fa-ârjaââ an-hu hurra l-hadidi fi khitani-hi wa-hajamati-hi l-amrin, anta aârafu bi-hi min-ni. Allahumma fa-tahhir -hu mina dh-dhunubi wa-zid-niâumri-hi wa-âdfi âl-afat âan badani-hi wa-l-aqjaâa âan jisim-hi wa-zid-hu fi l-ghina wa-âdfaââ an-hu l-faqra fa-inna-ka taâlamu wa-la na âlam.
segments.translation:
In the name of Allah and by Allah, this aqiqa (sheep slaughtered) is of (mention the name of the child with fatherâs name); its flesh (instead of) his/her flesh, its blood (instead of) his/her blood, its bones, (instead of) his/her bones (are offered) to You. O Allah, (accept it) as that by which (this child) may be protected and preserved, in the name of the children of Muhammad, blessings of Allah be on him and on his children, and peace.

In the name of Allah, by Allah, praise be to Allah, Allah is the greatest, faith is in Allah, thanks to the messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be on him and on his children) for safeguarding His command, gratitude for His sustenance, and awareness of us Ahl ul Bayt (our merits) by His grace.

O Allah, verily You have given us a son. You alone know what You have given and what has been granted, and (You alone know everything about) whatever You create. So accept (our offering offered) in accordance with Your command and the traditions of Your prophet and messenger (blessings of Allah be on him and on his children), and keep away the accursed Shaytan from us. This blood is pouring out for Your sake only (a.s.) there is no partner to share (it) with You, O my Allah, praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds. O my Allah, this meat (instead of) his meat, this blood (instead of) his blood, these bones (instead of) his bones., these hair (instead of) his hair, this skin (instead of) his skin (are offered to You), so O my Allah, accept this (sacrifice) instead of the sacrifice of (mention the name of the child.

segments.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْلى وَ لِوالِدَىَّ وَ لِلْمُؤْمِنينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسابُ
segments.transliteration: Rabbi ijAAalnee muqeema alssalati wamin thurriyyatee rabbana wtaqabbal duAAai
segments.translation: O God, this is Your practice and the practice of Your Prophet, Your blessings be upon him and his family; obeying Your ideal and Your Books is the result of Your volition, and Your will and judgement you decreed, a rule You executed. So take away from him the pain of the knife in his circumcision and his scarification through a command â You are more knowing of it than I, O God. And cleanse him of sins, prolong his life for me, drive away injury and pain from his body, increase him in wealth, and fend off poverty from him; for You know and we do not.

segments.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْلى وَ لِوالِدَىَّ وَ لِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِناً وَ لِلْمُؤْمِنينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِناتِ
segments.transliteration: Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana hab lana min azwajina wathurriyyatina qurrata aAAyunin waijAAalnalilmuttaqeena imaman
segments.translation: My Lord! Make me a maintainer of prayer, and my descendants [as well]. Our Lord, accept my supplication.

segments.transliteration: wa was's'aynal insaana biwaalidayh h'amalat-hu ummuhoo wahnan a'laa wahniw wa fis'aaluhoo fee a'amayni anish-kur lee wa liwaalidayk ilayyal mas'eer
segments.translation: And those who say, âOur Lord! Give us joy and comfort in our spouses and offspring, and make us imams of the Godwary.â

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
segments.transliteration: wa qad kafaroo bihee min qabl wa yaqd'ifoona bilghaybi mim makaanim ba-eed. wa h'eela baynahum wa bayna maa yashtahoona kamaa fu-i'la bi-ashyaa-ihim min qabl innahum kanoo fee shakkim mureeb
segments.translation: âBe grateful to Me and to your parents. To Me is the ultimate return.â

segments.transliteration:
yawma-id'iy yattabi - o'onad daa-i'ya laa i'waja lah wa khasha-atil as'waatu lirrah'maani falaa tasma-u' illaa hamsaa yawma-id'il laa tanfa-u'sh shafaa-a'tu illaa man ad'ina lahur rah'maanu wa raz'iya lahoo qawlaa ya'-lamu maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yuh'eet'oona bihee i'lmaa

wa a'natil wujoohu lilh'ayyil qayyoom wa qad khaaba man h'amala z'ulmaa

wa may ya'mal minas s'aalih 'aati wa huwa moominun falaa yakhaafu z'ulmaw wa laa haz'maa
segments.translation: They disbelieved in it before, and conjectured about the unseen from a far off place. A gulf shall be created between them and that which they will (eagerly) desire, as was done in the past for the likes of them. Verily they were also in disquieting doubt.

segments.transliteration: rabbi as'lih lee fee d'urriyyatee innee tubtu ilayka wa innee minal muslimeen
segments.translation:
On that day they shall follow the summoner (straight); no crookedness (can they show) him, and the voices shall be lowered before Arrahman, and you shall not hear a sound but the lightest footfall. On that day no intercession shall be of any service other than his whom Arrahman grants permission, and whose word He is pleased to accept. He knows what is before them and what is behind them, while they do not comprehend it with (their) knowledge.

Allah faces shall be humble before the everliving, the self-subsisting, and whosoever bears a load of iniquity will certainly be disappointed. And whosoever does good deeds, and is a believer, shall not fear injustice, nor any curtailment (of what is his due).

segments.transliteration: qul in kuntum tuh'ibboonallaaha fattabi-o'onee yuh'bibkumullaahu wa yaghfir lakum d'unoobakum wallaahu ghafooruru rah'eem.
segments.translation: O Lord, do good to me with regard to my offspring. Verily I turn repentant to You, andverily I am one of those who submit.

segments.transliteration: (faqaala) inneee ah'babtu h'ubbal khayri a'n d'ikri rabbee h'attaa tawaarat bil h'ijaab
segments.translation: Say (O Muhammad): âIf you love Allah, then follow me: Allah will love you and forgive you your sins, verily. Allah is forgiving merciful."

segments.transliteration:
fasubh'aanallad'ee biyadihee malakootu kulli sshay-iw wa ilayhi turja-o'on

wa laa h'awla wa laa quwwata illaa billahil a'liyyil a'z'eem
segments.translation: He said: âVerily I have loved the love of (earthly) good above the rememberance of my Lord until (the sun) was hidden in the veil (of night).â

segments.transliteration: maa kaana muh'ammadun abaaa ah'adim mir rijaalikum wa laakir rasoolallaahi wa khataman nabiyeen wa kaanallaahu bikulli shay-in a'leemaa
segments.translation:
Therefore glory be o Him in whose hand in the kingdom of all things. Unto Him you will all return.

There is no might nor strength with (any one) save Allah, the high, the great.

segments.transliteration:
laqad jaaa-akum rasoolum min anfusikum a'zeezun a'layhi maa a'nittum h'arees'un
a'laykum bilmoomineena ra-oofur rah'eem
segments.translation: Muhammad is not the father of any man among you, but a messenger of Allah, and the seal of the prophets. Allah is the knower of all things.

segments.transliteration: uh'ibbuhum wa yuh'ibboonahooo ad'illatin a'lal moomineena a-i'zzatin a'lal kaafireen
segments.translation: Indeed a messenger from among you has come to you. Any distress that befalls you grieves him, (he is) most kind and merciful to the believers.

segments.transliteration:
allaahumma s'alli a'laa muh'ammadin wa aali muhammad.

wallahul musta-a'anu a'laa maa tas'ifoon yaa rafeequ yaa shafeequ najjinee min kulli z'eeqin

allahumma s'alli a'laa muh'ammadin wa aali muh'ammad
segments.translation: He loves them and who love Him, humble towards the believers, mighty against the infidels.

segments.transliteration: yoosufu a'riz a'n haad'aa wastaghfiree lid'ambiki innaka funti minal khaat'i-een  wa qaala niswatun fil madeenatimra-atul a'zeezi turaawidu fataahaa a'n nafsih qad shaghafahaa h'ubbaa innaa lanaraahaa fee z'alaalim mubeen
segments.translation:
O my Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and on the progeny of Muhammad.

Then say - Allah is He whose help is to be sought against what you describe. O my helper. O my affectionate Lord, save me from every anguish.
O my Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and on the progeny of Muhammad.

segments.transliteration: allahumma s'alli a'laa muh'ammadin wa aali muh'ammad.
segments.translation: (Al Aziz said:) âIgnore this affair, O Yusuf; and you (O my wife) ask forgiveness for your sin; verily you have been of the guilty.â And the women in the city said: âThe wife of al Aziz (nobleman of high rank) seeks to seduce here page from his (pure) self. Verily he has inflamed her with violent love. Verily we see her in manifest error.â
O my Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and on the children of Muhammad.

segments.transliteration: S'allallaahu A'laa khayri khalqihee muh'ammadin wa aalihee ajma-e'en lih'ubbi (name of husband with his mother) A'laa H'ubbi (name of wife with her mother)
segments.translation: O my Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and on the children of Muhammad.

segments.transliteration: allahumma s'alli a'laa muh'ammadin wa aali muh'ammad.
segments.translation: Verily those who believe and do good deeds, ARRAHMAN will appoint for them love.

segments.transliteration: innallad'eena aamanoo wa a'milus s'aalih'aati sayaj -a'lu lahumur rah'maanu wuddaa
segments.translation:
It is He who strengthened you with His help and with the believers.
He has put affection between their hearts. Had you spent all that is in the earth you could not have put affection between their hearts, but Allah put affection between them; verily He is mighty, wise.

segments.transliteration:
huwallad'eee ayyadaka binas'rihee wa bil moomineen

wa allafa bayna quloobihim law anfaqta maa fil arz'i jamee-am maaa allafta bayna quloobihim wa laakinnallaaha allafa baynahum innahoo a'zeezun h'akeem
segments.translation:
If you ask them: âWho created the heavens and the earth?â

They will certainly say: âThe all-mighty, the all-knowing created them.â

He who made the earth for you as a cradle, and laid out paths upon it for you so that you may be rightly guided.

Who sends down water from the heaven in due measure; then We raise to life with it a land which was dead-so shall We bring you forth (from your graves on the day of resurrection).

He who created pairs of every thing and made for you ships and cattle on which you ride,

So that (when) you sit firm and square on their backs, and remember the bounty of your Lord, and when so seated, you may say: âGlory be to Him who subjected these to us, because we were not able to do so ourselves.

Verily we shall return to our Lord.â

segments.transliteration:
wa la-in sa-altahum man khalaqas saamaawaati wal arz'a layaqoolunna khalaqahunnal a'zeezul a'leem

allad'ee ja-a'la lakumul arz'a mahdaw wa ja-a'la laaakum feehaa subulal la-a'llakum tahtadoon

wallad'ee nazzala minas samaaa-i maaa-am biqadar fa-ansharnaa bihee baldatam maytaa kad'aalika tukhrajoon

wallad'ee khalqal azwaaja kullahaa waa ja-a'la lakum minal fulki wal an-a'ami maa tarkaboon litastawoo aaaaa'laa z'uhoorihee thumma tad'kuroo ni-mata rabbikum id'as - tawaytum a'layhi wa taqooloo subh'aanal lad'ee sakhkhara lanaa haad'aa subh'aanal lad'ee sakhkhara lanaa haad'aa wa maa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen wa inaaa ilaa rabbinaa lamunqaliboon
segments.translation:
He has put affection between their hearts. Had you spent all that is in the earth you could not have put affection between their hearts, but Allah put affection between them; verily He is mighty, wise.

It may be that Allah will create friendship between you and those of them whom you holed as enemies. Allah is all-powerful. Allah is oft-forgiving, ever-merciful.

segments.transliteration:
Wa allafa bayna quloobihim law anfaqta maa fil arz'i jamee-a'm maaa allafta bayna quloobihim waq laa kinnallaaha allafa baynahum innahoo a'zeezun h'hakeem

a'sallaahu ay yaj-a'la baynakum wa baynallad'eena a'adaytum minham mawaddah wallaahu qadeer wallaahu ghafoor ur raheem
segments.translation: And yet there are some among men who take for themselves objects of worship besides Allah whom they love as they love Allah; but the believers are stronger in love from Allah. And if those who are unjust could only see when they see the punishment, that to Allah belongs all powers, and verily Allah is severe in punishment.

segments.transliteration: wa minan naasi may yattakhid'u min doonillaahi andaaday yuh'ibboonahum kah'ubbillaah wallad'eena aamanooo ashaddu h'ubbal lillaah wa law yaral lad'eena z'alamood id'yarawnal a'd'aaba annal quwwata lillaahi jamee-a'w wa annallaaha shadeedul a'd'aab
segments.translation: âAllah suffices me. There is no god but He. On Him do I rely, and He is the Lord of the great throne.â

segments.transliteration: fa-in tawallaw  faqul h'asbiyallaahu laaa ilaaha illaa huw a'layhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul a'rshil a'z'eem
segments.translation: O my Allah, You are (my) Lord, be sufficient for me to make her heart yield to me and submit to me in (love and affection).

segments.transliteration: allaahumma anta yaa rabbi 'asbee a'laa (mention the name of the spouse with mother's name) qa-t'if qalbahaa a'layya wa d'allihaa lee
segments.translation: Did not a space of time pass over man when he was not anything worth mentioning?Verily We created man from a drop of mingled fluid (life-germ) in order to test and try him; so We gave him hearing and sight.

segments.transliteration:
hal ataa a'lal insaani h'eenum minad dahri lam yakun shay-an mad'kooraa
innaa khalaqnal insaana min nut'fatin amshaajin nabtaleehi faja-a'lnaahu samee-a'm baseeraa
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and on the progeny of Muhammad, as many asthose who beseech You to send blessings on him.

segments.transliteration: allaahumma s'alli a'laa muh'ammadin wa aali muhammadin bi-a'dadi man s'alli a'layhi)
segments.translation: O my Allah, let (mention husbandâs name) heart grow soft and gentle just as You melt the iron for Dawud, peace be on him, and make him mild and yielding to me just as You made the winds tractable and submissive to Sulayman son of Dawud, peace be on both of them, and put affection between us just as You put love between Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be on him and on his children) and Khadijah (blessings of Allah be on her), and between Ali (peace be on him) and Fatimah Zahra, blessings of Allah be on her, O the most beneficent.

segments.transliteration: allaahumma layyin qalba (mention husband's name) kamaa layyantal h'adeeda lidaawooda a'layhis salaamu wa sakhkhir lee kamaa sakhkhartar reeh'a lisulaymaanabni daawooda a'layhim as salaamu wa allif baynanaa kamaa allafta bayna muhammadan s'allallaahu a'layhi wa aalihee wa sallam wa khadeejah wa a'layhi wa aalihee wa sallam wa khadeejah wa a'liyyin a'layhis salaamu wa fatimataz zahraa-i s'alawaatullaahi a'layhaa yaa arh'aamar raahimeen
segments.translation: O everliving, O self-subsisting, O beneficent, O merciful (help me) by Your mercy, O the most merciful.

segments.transliteration: yaa h'ayyu yaa qayyoom yaa rah'maanu yaa raheem birah'matika yaa arh'amar raahimeen

segments.transliteration: wa ma fihinna wa ma baynahunna
segments.translation: whatever is in them, whatever is between them,

segments.transliteration: wa ma fawqahunna wa ma tahtahunna
segments.translation: whatever is above them, and whatever is beneath them,
and the Lord of the Great Throne.
All praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds.
Blessings be upon Muhammad and his Immaculate Household.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الْکَثِيرَ مِن مَّعَاصِيكَ،
segments.transliteration: allÄhummagh fir liyal kathÄ«ra mim maÊ¿Äá¹£Ä«k,
segments.translation: O Allah! Pardon the many times I have disobeyed You,

segments.arabic: وَ اقْـبَلْ مِنِّيَ الْیَسِيرَ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ،
segments.translation: and accept the few instances when I have obeyed You.

segments.arabic: یَا مَن یَّـقْبَلُ الْیَسِيرَ وَ یَعْفُو عَنِ الْکَثِيرِ،
segments.transliteration: yÄ may yaqbalul yasÄ«ra wa yaÊ¿fÅ« Ê¿anil kathÄ«r,
segments.translation: O You Who accept the few and pardon the many!

segments.arabic: اِقْـبَلْ مِنِّيَ الْیَسِيرَ وَ اعْفُ عَنِّيَ الْکَثِيرَ،
segments.transliteration: iqbal minnÄ«yal yasÄ«ra waÊ¿ fu Ê¿annÄ«yal kathÄ«r,
segments.translation: Accept from me what are few and pardon me for the many.
Indeed, You are the All-Pardoning, the All-Forgiving.
O Allah! Have mercy on me, for You are the Ever-Merciful.
âO Allah! O Designer of the heavens and the earth!
O Knower of the unseen and seen!
O most Beneficent! O most Merciful!
I confide in You

segments.arabic: أَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ﭐللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: anni ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: that I bear witness that there is no god save Allah
alone, without Your having any associate.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ﭐللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
segments.transliteration: wa anna muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi `abduhu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ ﭐلسَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لاَ رَيْبَ فِيهَا
segments.transliteration: wa anna alssa`ata atiyatun la rayba fiha
segments.translation: that the Hour shall undoubtedly come,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ ﭐللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي ﭐلْقُبُورِ
segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha yab`athu man fi alquburi
segments.translation: that Allah shall raise the dead from their graves,
that the Interrogation is true,
that Paradise is true,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مَا وُعِدَ فِيهَا مِنَ ﭐلنَّعِيمِ
segments.transliteration: wa anna ma wu`ida fiha min alnna`imi
segments.translation: that whatever is promised to be thereinâsuch as bliss,
eating, drinking and marriageâis true,
that Hellfire is true,
that faith is true,
that the religion is as exactly as He has described,
that Islam is exactly as He has established,
that all what He has said is exactly the truth,
that the Qur'an is as exactly as what He has revealed,

segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha huwa alhaqqu almubinu
segments.translation: and that Allah is verily the Manifest Truth.

segments.arabic: وَأَنِّي أَعْهَدُ إِلَيْكَ فِي دَارِ ﭐلدُّنْيَا
segments.transliteration: wa anni a`hadu ilayka fi dari alddunya
segments.translation: I also confide in You in this world
that I submit to You being my Lord,
Islam being my religion,

segments.arabic: وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ﭐللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ نَبِيّاً
segments.transliteration: wa bimuhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi nabiyyan
segments.translation: Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, being my Prophet,
`Ali being my Imam,
the Qur'an being my Book,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ أَهْلَ بَيْتِ نَبِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ أَئِمَّتِي
segments.transliteration: wa anna ahla bayti nabiyyika `alayhi wa `alayhim alssalamu a'immati
segments.translation: and Your Prophetâs HouseholdâYour peace be upon him and themâbeing my Imams.
O Allah, in You I trust in tribulations,
You are my only hope in agonies,

segments.arabic: وَعُدَّتِي عِنْدَ ٱلأُمُورِ ٱلَّتِي تَنْزِلُ بِي
segments.translation: You are my only provision when misfortunes befall me,
You are my sponsor in my blessings,
and You are my God and my ancestorsâ God.
So (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ أَبَداً
segments.transliteration: wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata `aynin abadan
segments.translation: and do not make me depend on my own self even for the winking of an eye.
Please, entertain me in my grave and loneliness

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ لِي عِنْدَكَ عَهْداً يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ مَنْشُوراً
segments.translation: and keep my confidence in You active for the day on which I shall meet You.â

segments.arabic: «لاَ يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَاعَةَ إِلاَّ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ ٱلرَّحْمٰنِ عَهْداً.»
segments.transliteration: yashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: [so-and-so] bears witness that there is no god save Allah,
One and Only and having no associate,
that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah,
that `Ali is the commander of the believers,
and that the Imams from his progeny:
al-Hasan, al-Husayn,
`Ali the son of al-Husayn,
Muhammad the son of `Ali,

segments.transliteration: allahumma inna la na`lamu minhu illa khayran
segments.translation: O Allah, we do not know about him but goodness,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا لاَ نَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ خَيْراً
segments.translation: while You know him better than we do.

segments.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan rasulu allahi
segments.translation: and I bear witness that Muhammad is Allahâs messenger.

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) forgive the believing men and women.
O Allah, (please) forgive this dead person.
(1) Allah is the Most Great.

segments.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah,

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.translation: One and Only and having no associate,

segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger;
He has sent him with the truth as conveyor of good tidiness and warner (against His chastisement)
before the coming of the Hour (of Resurrection).
(2) Allah is the Most Great.

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: wa barik `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: send benedictions upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and show mercy to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.transliteration: ka'afdali ma sallayta wa barakta wa tarahhamta
segments.translation: in the most favorable way You have sent blessings, benedictions, and mercy

segments.arabic: كَأَ فْضَلِ مَا صَلَّيْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ وَتَرَحَّمْتَ
segments.translation: to Abraham and the Household of Abraham.
Verily, You are praiseworthy and All-glorious.
And (please) send blessings upon all the prophets and messengers.
(3) Allah is the Most Great.
O Allah, (please) forgive the believing men and women
and the Muslim men and women,
both the alive and the dead.
(Please) combine between them and us in bliss and happiness.
Verily, You are the responding to the prayers.
Verily, You have power over all things.
(4) Allah is the Most Great.
O Allah, this is Your servant
and the son of Your servant and Your she-servant;
he is now Your guest
and You are the ever best of all those who receive guests.

segments.transliteration: allahumma inna la na`lamu minhu illa khayran
segments.translation: O Allah, we know about him nothing but goodness

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا لاَ نَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ خَيْراً
segments.translation: while You know about him better than we do.
O Allah, if he is good-doer,
then (pleas) grant him more good turns from You,
and if he is wrongdoer,
then (please) excuse and forgive him.
O Allah, (please) place him with You in the highest point of the Highest Position,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْهُ عِنْدَكَ فِي أَعْلَىٰ عِلِّيِّينَ
segments.translation: make those of his family members who remained behind him to take his place,
and have mercy on him with Your mercy.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
O Allah, this is Your she-servant
and the daughter of Your servant and Your she-servant;
she is now Your guest
and You are the ever best of all those who receive guests.

segments.transliteration: allahumma inna la na`lamu minha illa khayran
segments.translation: O Allah, we know about her nothing but goodness

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا لاَ نَعْلَمُ مِنْهَا إِلاَّ خَيْراً
segments.translation: while You know about her better than we do.
O Allah, if she is good-doer,
then (pleas) grant her more good turns from You,
and if she is wrongdoer,
then (please) excuse and forgive her.
O Allah, (please) place her with You in the highest point of the Highest Position,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْهَا عِنْدَكَ فِي أَعْلَىٰ عِلِّيِّينَ
segments.translation: make those of her family members who remained behind her to take her place,
and have mercy on her with Your mercy.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
O Allah, (please) forgive those who have repented
and followed Your Path
and protect them against the chastisement of Hellfire.
O Allah, (please) make for his parents and for us
a progeny, a precedence, and a reward.
Our Lord! Grant us good in this world
and good in the hereafter,
and save us from the chastisement of the fire.
Allah is the Most Great.

segments.transliteration: hadha ma wa`adana allahu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: This is what Allah and His Messenger promised us,
and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth.
O Allah, (please) increase us faith and submission (to You).
All praise be to Allah Who has been almighty due to His omnipotence
and Who has overpowered the servants (of Him) by death.
In the Name of Allah (I begin) and in Allah (I put my trust).

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and forgive the believing men and women.

segments.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi lam yaj`alani min alssawadi almukhtarami
segments.translation: All praise be to Allah Who has not included me with the extinct beings.

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلسَّوَادِ ٱلْمُخْتَرَمِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`alha rawdatan min riyadi aljannati
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) make this grave to be one of the gardens of Paradise,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْهَا رَوْضَةً مِنْ رِيَاضِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ
segments.transliteration: wa la taj`alha hufratan min hufari alnnari
segments.translation: but do not make it to be one of the holes of the Fire.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْهَا حُفْرَةً مِنْ حُفَرِ ٱلنَّارِ
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, in Allah,
on the way of Allah,
and following the principles of Allahâs Messengers.
O Allah, (this is on the basis of the) belief in You
and giving credence to Your Book.

segments.transliteration: hadha ma wa`adana allahu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: This is what Allah and His Messenger promised us,
and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth.
O Allah, (pleas) increase us faith and submission (to You).
O Allah, (please) maintain (communion) his loneliness,
entertain his lonesomeness,
have mercy upon his seclusion,
put with him part of Your mercy

segments.transliteration: rahmatan yastaghni biha `an rahmati man siwaka
segments.translation: due to which he will dispense with the mercy of any one other than You,

segments.arabic: رَحْمَةً يَسْتَغْنِي بِهَا عَنْ رَحْمَةِ مَنْ سِوَاكَ
segments.translation: and resurrect him with those to whom he has been loyal;
namely, the Immaculate Imams, peace be upon them.

segments.transliteration: bismillaahi wa fee sabeelil-laahee wa aâlaa millati rassolilaah allaakum-maftahâ lahoo feeâ qabrihee wa alhâiqhu bi-nabiyyih Allahumma in kaana muhâsi- nan fazid fee ihâsaanihee wa in kaana musee-an fagh- firlahoo warhâamhoo wa tajaawaz aânhu.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah and in the path of Allah and on the faith of the Holy Prophet. O Allah open (the door of Heaven) in his grave and make him meet his Prophet. O Allah if he was good and virtuous increase his virtues and if he was bad forgive his sins, shower mercy on him and ignore his mistakes.

segments.arabic: بسْمِ اللَّهِ وَفِي سَبِيْلِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ افْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَأَخْقْهُ بِنَبِيِّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِي اِحْسَانِهِ وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيْنًا فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَتَجَاوَزْ عنه
segments.transliteration: bismillaahi wa fee sabeelillaahi wa aâlaa millati rasoolillaah allaahum-maftah â lahaa fee qabrihaa wa alhâiqhaa bi-nabiyyihaa Allahumma in kaanat muhâsinatan fazid fee ihâsaanihaa wa in kaanat mu- see-ata faghfir lahaa warhâamhaa watajaawaz aânhaa.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah and in the path of Allah and on the faith of the Holy Prophet. O Allah open (the doors of Heaven) in her grave and make her meet her Prophet. O Allah if she was good and virtuous increase her virtues and if she was bad forgive her sins, shower mercy on her and ignore her mistakes.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَفِي سَبِيْلِ اللهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ افْسَحْ لَهَا فِي قَبْرِهَا وَأَلْحِقْهَا بِنَبِيَّهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَتْ مُحْسِنَةً فَزِدْ فِي اِحْسَانِهَا وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مُسِيِّئَةً فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا وَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهَا
segments.transliteration: Allahumma jaafil arzâa aân janbayhi wa sâaa-iâd aâma- lahoo wa laqqihee minka rizâwanaa
segments.translation: O Allah! Make the earth give freedom on his both sides and accept his record of deeds and grant him Your pleasure.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ جَافِ الْأَرْضَ عَنْ جَنْبَيْهِ وَصَاعِدْ عَمَالَهُ وَلَقِهِ مِنْكَ رِضْوَانًا
segments.transliteration: Allahumma jaafil arzâa aân janbayha wa sâaa-iâd aâmalahaa wa laqqihaa minka rizâwanaa
segments.translation: O Allah I Make the earth give freedom sides and accept her record of deeds and grant her Your pleasure.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ جَافِ الْأَرْضَ عَنْ جَنْبَيْهَا وَصَاعِدْ عَمَالَهَا وَلَقِهَا مِنْكَ رِضْوَانًا
segments.translation: Listen! Understand! O [so-and-so] the son of [so-and-so]!
Are you still keeping the covenant on which you have departed us:

segments.arabic: هَلْ أَنْتَ عَلَىٰ ٱلْعَهْدِ ٱلَّذِي فَارَقْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: min shahadati an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: that you bear witness that there is no god save Allah,

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.translation: One and Only and having no associate,

segments.transliteration: wa anna muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: that Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.translation: is his servant, messenger,
the chief of the Prophets,
and the seal of the Messengers,
that `Ali is the commander of the faithful believers,
the chief of the Prophetâs successors,

segments.transliteration: wa imamun iftarada allahu ta`atahu `ala al`alamina
segments.translation: and the Imam the obedience to whom has been made obligatory upon all people by Allah,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَامٌ ٱفْتَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ طَاعَتَهُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
segments.translation: and that al-Hasan, al-Husayn,
`Ali the son of al-Husayn,
Muhammad the son of `Ali,
Ja`far the son of Muhammad,
Musa the son of Ja`far,
`Ali the son of Musa,
Muhammad the son of `Ali,
`Ali the son of Muhammad,
al-Hasan the son of `Ali,
and the Rising, Argument, and well-guided Imam,
may Allahâs blessings be upon them all,
are the leaders of the faithful believers,
the arguments of Allah against all of the creatures,
and your Imams; the immaculate leaders to true guidance.
O [so-and-so] the son of [so-and-so]!
When the two archangels come to you

segments.transliteration: rasulayni min `indi allahi tabaraka wa ta`ala
segments.translation: as two messengers from Allah the All-blessed and All-exalted,

segments.arabic: رَسُولَيْنِ مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱللَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَىٰ
segments.translation: and asked you about your lord,
your prophet, your religion,
your book, your direction,
and your Imams, then do not be scared;
rather, you should, answering them, say,
âAllah, Whose majesty is all-majestic, is my Lord,

segments.transliteration: wa muhammadun salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi nabiyyi
segments.translation: Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, is my prophet,

segments.arabic: وَمُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ نَبِيِّي
segments.translation: Islam is my religion,
the Qur'an is my book,
the Ka`bah is my direction,

segments.transliteration: wa amiru almu'minina `aliyyu ibnu abi talibin imami
segments.translation: the Commander of the Faithful `Ali the son of Abu-Talib is my Imam,

segments.arabic: وَأَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ إِمَامِي
segments.translation: al-Hasan the son of `Ali the well-chosen is my Imam,
al-Husayn the son of `Ali the martyred in Karbala' is my Imam,

segments.arabic: وَٱلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ ٱلشَّهِيدُ بِكَرْبَلاَءَ إِمَامِي
segments.translation: `Ali the adornment of the worshippers is my Imam,
Muhammad who split the knowledge of the Prophets is my Imam,
Ja`far the veracious is my Imam,
Musa the suppressor of rage is my Imam,
`Ali the amicable is my Imam,
Muhammad the magnanimous is my Imam,
`Ali the guide is my Imam,
al-Hasan the resident of `Askar city is my Imam,
and the Awaited argument-person is my Imam.
These, may Allahâs blessings be upon all of them, are my Imams,

segments.arabic: هٰؤُلاَءِ صَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ أَئِمَّتِي
segments.transliteration: wa sadati wa qadati wa shufa`a'i
segments.translation: my chiefs, my leaders, and my interceders.
I am loyal to them
and I repudiate their enemies
in the world and the Hereafter.â
Be it known to you, O [so-and-so] the son of [so-and-so],

segments.transliteration: anna allaha tabaraka wa ta`ala ni`ma alrrabbu
segments.translation: that Allah the All-blessed and All-exalted is the most excellent Lord,

segments.arabic: أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالىٰ نِعْمَ ٱلرَّبُّ
segments.transliteration: wa anna muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi ni`ma alrrasulu
segments.translation: Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, is the most excellent Messenger,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ نِعْمَ ٱلرَّسُولُ
segments.transliteration: wa anna amira almu'minina `aliyya ibna abi talibin
segments.translation: the Commander of the Faithful `Ali the son of Abu-Talib

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ
segments.transliteration: wa awladahu al-a'immata al-ahada `ashara ni`ma al-a'immatu
segments.translation: and the eleven Imams who are his descendants are the most excellent Imams,

segments.arabic: وَأَوْلاَدَهُ ٱلأَئِمَّةَ ٱلأَحَدَ عَشَرَ نِعْمَ ٱلأَئِمَّةُ
segments.transliteration: wa anna ma ja'a bihi muhammadun salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi haqqun
segments.translation: whatever has been conveyed by Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, is true,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مَا جَاءَ بِهِ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ حَقٌّ
segments.translation: death is true,

segments.transliteration: wa su'ala munkarin wa nakirin fi alqabri haqqun
segments.translation: the interrogation of Munkar and Nakir in the grave is true,

segments.arabic: وَسُؤَالَ مُنْكَرٍ وَنَكِيرٍ فِي ٱلْقَبْرِ حَقٌّ
segments.translation: the raising from the dead is true,
the Resurrection is true,
the Discriminating Bridge is true,
the Scale is true,
the dispersion of the records is true,
Paradise is true,
the Fire is true,

segments.transliteration: wa anna alssa`ata atiyatun la rayba fiha
segments.translation: the Hour (of Resurrection) shall come; there is no doubt about it,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لاَ رَيْبَ فِيهَا
segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha yab`athu man fi alquburi
segments.translation: and Allah shall resurrect those who are in graves.

segments.translation: the profession that there is no god save Allah,

Muhammad the son of `Ali,

Allah is your lord,
Muhammad is your prophet,
the Qur'an is your book,
the Ka`bah is your direction,
`Ali is your Imam,
and al-Hasan, al-Husayn,

Muhammad the son of `Ali,
Ja`far the son of Muhammad,

peace be upon them all

text: Death Related duas & Info Itidhar- Death- Funeral- Will -Inheritance Reflections Reflections × Major portion of our supplications are devoted to discussion on death and the Day of Judgment, so that man may wake up from the slumber of negligence. If we ponder over reality, we learn that the world deceives the one who craves for it. One who keeps death in front of his eyes and awaits for it, not only performs his routine tasks sincerely, but constantly strives to do more actions which becomes the cause of Allah's satisfaction. He is aware that death can overtake him at any moment and he does not have time on his side. The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) says,'Surely the heart rusts like iron.' People inquired, 'How can it be polished?' He (s.a.w.s.) said, 'By remembering death and with the recitation of Quran.' (Nahjul Fasahah) Article & Duas for the time of Death /Barzakh ââ¦verily, the death from which you run away, will, surely, overtake you & will send you back to the Knower of the visible & invisible things & He will then inform you of what you used to do.â (Q. 62:8) × . What to do when next to a Dying Person Recite 'Will' from Baqiyatus salehat for dying person i) When signs of death appear to someone, he more than anyone else must prepare himself for receiving it, because he will start a journey from which he will never return; namely, the journey to the Other World. In this journey, he requires suitable provisions. The first thing he must do is to confess of his sins, admit of failure to do what ought to be done, show regret at the wrongdoings he has done, declare pure repentance, weep for himself, implore the All-holy God for forgiveness, and pray Him to stand by him and not to leave him alone facing the imminent shocks and horrors. ii) As a second step, he must pay considerable attention to his will; he must therefore fulfill his liabilities and duties towards Almighty Allah and people and must not entrust others to do so on behalf of him. He will very soon lose any control over his properties; rather, he will not be able to do anything rather than watching sorrowfully how his properties will be spent. In fact, the devilish jinn and human beings will inspire evil things to his heirs in order to prevent them from absolving him from the financial liabilities and he will have not stratagem other than shouting, âMy Lord, send me back haply I may do good in that which I have left!â Yet, this call will not be heard and regret will not be helpful anymore. In this respect, one who feels his imminent departure of this life must bequeath one third of his properties to his relatives and to charitable purposes in a way that corresponds to the financial situation. Legally, a legator has no right to dispose of more than one third of his legacy. iii) The next step is that he must absolve himself from his obligations towards his brethren-in-faith, ask those whom he had backbitten, insulted, or injured to forgive him if he can contact with them, and ask his present brethren-in-faith to ask the absent ones to release him from any wrongdoing he had done to them. He must then nominate somebody as his guardian over his immature sons and entrust a trustworthy person with managing the affairs of his children and family members. Of course, this step, as well as all other steps, must be preceded by putting full trust in Almighty Allah. iv) The next step is that he must prepare his shroud (i.e. kafan), in case that he has not already prepared it, and to order that the supplicatory prayers and holy verses, which are too many to be mentioned in this thesis, must be written on his shroud with a liquid made of a mixture of water and soil taken from Imam al-Husaynâs holy tomb. However, a true believer must always have his shroud prepared. In this regard, Imam al-Sadiq (`a) is reported to have said, âWhoever has his shroud kept in his house, will not be registered with the inadvertent ones and will be granted a reward whenever he looks at it.â v) One who is near death must no longer think of the future of his family members, sons, and property; rather, he must think of nothing except Allah (swt) and must understand that such transient matters will not help or save him neither in this world nor in the other world, and nothing will help except the kindness and mercy of Almighty Allah. Hence, if one puts his full trust in Almighty Allah, the affairs of his household will certainly go well. It must be also known for sure that no one, be he alive or dead, can provide any help or fend off any harm unless Almighty Allah wills so, since He, Who has created the beings, is more compassionate to His creatures than anyone else. As a result, one who is near death must be full of hope for the mercy of his Lord and must entertain expectation of the intercession of the Holy Prophet (saw) and the Holy Imams (`a) and wait for their coming at the hour of death. In fact, it must be known that they all come at the last hour of death to convey good tidings to their loyalists and to ask the Angel of Death to be lenient to the dead who has been faithful to them. vi) In Misbah al-Mutahajjid, Shaykh al-Tusi says that it is recommended to pay much attention to the last will, which must not be belittled by every human being. In this respect, it is reported that one must not spend a single night without having his will placed under his head. This advice becomes more emphatic in cases of ailments. Hence, one must write down his will as excellently as possible and must absolve himself from the liabilities and responsibilities towards Almighty All

rotten bodies,

segments.arabic: يَا اهْلَ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ

in the name of âThere is no god save Allah,â

segments.arabic: كَيْفَ وَجَدْتُمْ قَوْلَ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ

from âThere is no god save Allah?â
O He to Whom âThere is no god save Allahâ is said,
I beseech You in the name of âThere is no god save Allahâ

segments.arabic: ٱغْفِرْ لِمَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ighfir liman qala la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: to forgive any one who professed that âThere is no god save Allahâ

segments.arabic: وَٱحْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَةِ مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ

segments.translation: and to include us in the group of those who professed that âThere is no god save Allah.
Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.
`Ali is the authority from Allah.â
O Allah, (please) turn them to that to which they have turned
and join them to those whom they have loved.
O Allah, (please) have mercy on his strangeness,
connect his loneliness,
entertain his isolation,
secure his horror,
attach Your mercy to him;

Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ù±ÙÙÙÙÙÙ >aliyyun waliyyu allahi `Ali is the authority from Allah.â Dua 4 According to another tradition, the best thing to be said whenever one passes by a graveyard is : Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙ ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ù Ù ÙØ§ ØªÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ± allahumma wallihim ma tawallaw O Allah, (please) turn them to that to which they have turned ÙÙÙ±Ø­ÙØ´ÙØ±ÙÙÙÙ Ù Ù ÙØ¹Ù Ù ÙÙÙ Ø§Ø­ÙØ¨ÙÙÙÙ± wahshurhum ma`a man ahabbu and join them to those whom they have loved. Dua 5 In his book of Misbah al-Za'ir, Sayyid ibn Tawus says: When you intend to visit the graves of the faithful believers, you may choose Thursday; otherwise, you may visit them on any other day.Turn your face towards the kiblah direction, put your hand on the grave, and say the followingÂ words: Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙ Ù±Ø±ÙØ­ÙÙ Ù ØºÙØ±ÙØ¨ÙØªÙÙÙ allahumma irham ghurbatahu O Allah, (please) have mercy on his strangeness, ÙÙØµÙÙÙ ÙÙØ­ÙØ¯ÙØªÙÙÙ wa sil wahdatahu connect his loneliness, ÙÙØ¢ÙÙØ³Ù ÙÙØ­ÙØ´ÙØªÙÙÙ wa anis wahshatahu entertain his isolation, ÙÙØ¢Ù ÙÙÙ Ø±ÙÙÙØ¹ÙØªÙÙÙ wa amin raw`atahu secure his horror, ÙÙØ§Ø³ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¥ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙÙ Ø±ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙØªÙÙÙ wa askin ilayhi min rahmatika attach Your mercy to him; Ø±ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙØ©Ù ÙÙØ³ÙØªÙØºÙÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙÙÙØ§ Ø¹ÙÙÙ Ø±ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙØ©Ù Ù ÙÙÙ Ø³ÙÙÙØ§ÙÙ rahmatan yastaghni biha `an rahmati man siwaka such mercy by which he can do without the mercy of anyone other than You, ÙÙØ§ÙÙØ­ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙÙ ÙÙÙ ÙÙØ§ÙÙ ÙÙØªÙÙÙÙØ§ÙÙÙÙ wa alhiqhu biman kana yatawallahu and join him to those to whom he has adhered. Reciting Sura Qadr 7 times with hands on grave facing Qibla Through an authentic chain of authority, Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya al-Ash`ari is reported to have said, âI was in Fayd (a station on the way of Makkah) when I accompanied `Ali ibn Bilal in visiting the grave of Muhammad ibn Isma`il ibn Buzaygh.`Ali related to me, saying: The one buried in this grave told me that Imam al-Rida (`a) said, âWhoever comes to the graves of his brother-in-faith and puts his hand on the grave ,directs his face towards the kiblah and recites Surah al-Qadr (No. 97) seven times, will be secured on the Great Horror Day.â "It is one of the rights of a Muslim over another Muslim that he should visit his grave."Imam Ja'fer As-Sadiq (A.S.)Â Â Knocking Heavens door -Visiting Graveyard booklet pdf NEW Important Death Related Content Merits of Visiting the Tombs of Faithful Believers The trustworthy and sublime Shaykh Ja`far ibn Qawlawayh al-Qummi reports `Amr ibn `Uthman al-Razi as saying that he heard Imam Abuâl-Hasan Musa ibn Ja`far, peace be upon him, saying, âWhoever is unable to visit us, may visit the righteous adherents of us. If he does so, he will be endued with the reward of visiting us. Likewise, whoever is unable to connect us, may connect the righteous adherents of us. If he does so, he will also be endued with the reward of connecting us.â Reciting Sura Qadr 7 times with hands on grave facing Qibla Through an authentic chain of authority, Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya al-Ash`ari is reported to have said, âI was in Fayd (a station on the way of Makkah) when I accompanied `Ali ibn Bilal in visiting the grave of Muhammad ibn Isma`il ibn Buzaygh.`Ali related to me, saying: The one buried in this grave told me that Imam al-Rida (`a) said, âWhoever comes to the graves of his brother-in-faith and puts his hand on the grave ,directs his face towards the kiblah and recites Surah al-Qadr (No. 97) seven times, will be secured on the Great Horror Day.â The method and rewards of visiting the graves of faithful believers have been demonstrated in another tradition reported from Fudayl who, accordingly, said: As to any one who recites Surah al-Qadr at the grave of a faithful believer seven times, Almighty Allah will send to him an angel who will worship Him (i.e. Almighty Allah) next to that grave and the reward of all the devotional acts that are done by that angel will be recorded for the dead person. When Almighty Allah raises him from the grave, He will make easy for him all the horrors by which he will pass until he is allowed to enter Paradise. Along with Surah al-Qadr, Surah al-Fatihah (No. 1), Surah al-Tawhid (No. 112), Surah al-Falaq (No. 113), Surah al-Nas (No. 114), and Âªyah al-Kursi (2:155) may be also recited three times each. Sayyid Ibn Tawus then added: While you are in a graveyard, you should recite Surah al-Tawhid eleven times and dedicate the reward to the dead. title: Dua to combat against Black Magic - Duas.org

segments.translation: [I take refuge (to seek protection from the evil threatening me)
with the might of Allah,
the power of Allah,
the strength of Allah,
the greatness of Allah,
the demonstration of Allah,
the sovereignty of Allah,
the assistance of Allah,
the security of Allah,
the amnesty of Allah,
the shield of Allah,
the kindness of Allah,
the pride of Allah,
the attention of Allah,
the beauty of Allah,
the grandeur of Allah,
the perfection of Allah
there is no god save Allah

segments.arabic: مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اَجِدُ.
segments.transliteration: Muh'ammadun Rasoolullaahi Min Sharri Ma Ajidu
segments.translation: and Muhammad is the messenger of Allah]
[There is no god save He.

segments.arabic: تَوَکَّلْتُ وَ ہُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیْمِ
segments.transliteration: Tawakkaltu Wa Huwa Rabbul A'rshil A'z'eem
segments.translation: I rely on Him. He is the Lord of the great a'rsh.
What He wills takes place;

segments.arabic: وَ مَا لَمْ یَشَآئَ لَمْ یَکُنْ
segments.transliteration: Wa Maa Lam Yashaa Lam Yakun
segments.translation: and what He does not will does not take place.

segments.arabic: اَشْہَدُ اَنَّ اللهَ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْر
segments.transliteration: Ashhadu Annallaaha A'laa Kulli Shay-In Qadeer
segments.translation: I bear witness that, verily, Allah, has power over all things:

segments.arabic: وَ اَنَّ اللهَ قَدْ اَحَاطَ بِکُلِّ شَیْءٍ عِلْمًا
segments.transliteration: Wa Annallaaha Qad Ah'aat'a Bikulli Shay-In Ilmaa
segments.translation: and, verily, Allah encompasses every thing in (His) knowledge,

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَعُوْذُ بِکَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِیْ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma Innee A-O'od'u Bika Min Sharri Nafsee
segments.translation: O my Allah, I seek refuge with You from the evil inside me
and from the evil of every creature
whom You seizes with its forelock.
Verily my lord is on the right path]

segments.arabic: اِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللہُ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ فِيْ سِـتَّۃِ اَيَّامٍ
segments.transliteration: Inna Rabbakumullaahul Lad'ee Khalaqas Samaawaati Wal Arz'a Fee Sittati Ayyaamin
segments.translation: [Verily your Lord is Allah who created the heavens and the earth in six days,
then established Himself on the throne.
He draws the night as a veil over the day, which pursues it incessantly;

segments.transliteration: Wash Shamsa Wal Qamara Wan Najooma
segments.translation: and made the sun and the moon and the stars subservient to His command.
Verily, His is the creation and the command.
Blessed be Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
Call on your Lord humbly and in secret.
Verily Allah does not love the transgressors.
And do not make mischief in the earth after it has been reformed;

segments.arabic: وَلَا تُفْسِدُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ بَعْدَ اِصْلَاحِہَا وَادْعُوْہُ خَوْفًا وَّطَمَعًا۝۰ۭ ۳۵
segments.transliteration: Wa Laa Tufsidoo Fil Arz'i Ba-Da Is'laah'ihaa Wad-O-Ohu Khawfaw
segments.translation: and call on Him fearing (His wrath) and longing (his mercy).

segments.arabic: اِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللہِ قَرِيْبٌ مِّنَ الْمُحْسِـنِيْنَ۝۵۶
segments.transliteration: Wa T'ama-A'a Inna Rah'matallaahi Qareebum Minal Muh'sineen
segments.translation: Verily the mercy of Allah is near to those who do good]

segments.arabic: قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِاَخِيْكَ وَنَجْعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلْطٰنًا
segments.transliteration: Qaala Sanashuddu A'z'udaka Bi-Akheeka Wa Naj-A'lu Lakumaa Sult'aanan
segments.translation: [(Allah) said : "We will strengthen your arm with your brother and we will give you such authority
that they will not be able to touch and of you.
With our signs, both of you and your followers shall certainly triumph"]
[In The Name Of Allah, With Allah,
From Allah, Unto Allah,
And In The Way Of Allah;
O Allah, I Surrender Myself To You,
I Direct Myself Towards You,
I Entrust My Affairs To You,
So Keep Me Safe, With The Preservation Of Belief,

segments.arabic: فَیَا مَنْ قَلَّ شُکْرِیْ عِنْدَ نِعْمَۃٍ فَلَمْ یَحْرِمْنِیْ
segments.translation: From In Front Of Me, From Behind Me,

segments.arabic: وَ یَا مَنْ قَلَّ صَبْرِیْ عِنْدَ بَلِیَّۃٍ فَلَمْ یَخْذُلْنِیْ
segments.transliteration: Wa Min Khalfee Wa A'n Yameenee
segments.translation: From My Right Side, From My Left Side,

segments.arabic: وَ یَا مَنْ رَانِیْ عَلَی الْمَعَاصِیْ فَلَمْ یَفْضَحْنِیْ
segments.transliteration: Wa A'n Shimaalee Wa Min Fawqee
segments.translation: From Above Me, From Below Me, And

segments.arabic: وَ یَا مَنْ رَانِیْ عَلَی الْخَطَایَا فَلَمْ یَقِبْنِیْ عَلَیْہَا
segments.transliteration: Wa Min Tah'tee Wad-Fa A'nnee Bih'awlika
segments.translation: Repel (Evil) From Me With Your Strength And Power,

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Because, Verily, There Is No Strength And No Power

segments.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ لِیْ ذَنْبِیْ وَاشْفِعْنِیْ مِنْ مَرَضِیْ
segments.transliteration: Laa H'awla Wa Laa Quwwata Illa Billaahil A'liyyil A'zeem
segments.translation: Save With Allah, The High, The Great]
[Allah Is Sufficient And Satisfying For Me.
Allah Hears (The Call Of) Whosoever Calls (Him).
There Is No One (And Nothing) As The Ultimate Save Allah]

segments.arabic: وَ لاَ تَکِلْنِیْ اِلٰی نَفْسِیْ تَرْفَۃَ عَیْنٍ اَبَدً
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma Inee As-Aluka Bih'aqqi Muh'ammadin Wa Aali Muhammadin
segments.translation: [O My Allah, I Beseech You In The Name Of The Rights Of Muhammad And The Children Of Muhammad

segments.arabic: ا وَ اَصْلِحْ لِیْ شَأْنِیْ کُلَّہٗ.
segments.transliteration: An Tus'alliya A'laa Muh'ammadin Wa Aali Muh'ammadin Wa An Tunjiyanee
segments.translation: To Send Blessings On Muhammad And On The Children Of Muhammad And Free Me (From Whatever Affliction That Has Surrounded Me)]

segments.arabic: اُعِیْذُ نَفْسِیْ وَ ذُرِّیَّتِیْ وَ اَہْلَ بَیْتِیْ وَ مَالِیْ
segments.translation: [O My God; When You Gave Me Any Bounty,
I Did Not Thank You As I Should Have;
Whenever You Tested Me With A Trial

segments.arabic: وَ ہَامَّۃٍ وَ مِنْ کُلِّ عَیْنٍ لاَمَّۃٍ۔
segments.translation: I Did Not Manage It With The Patience I Should Have.

segments.transliteration: Fayaa Man Qalla Shukree I'nda Ni'-Matin Falam Yah'rimnee
segments.translation: O He Who Did Not Deprive Me Of (Favour) Inspite Of My Too Little Thanks.

segments.transliteration: Wa Yaa Man Qalla S'abree I'nda Baliyyatin Falam Yakhd'ulnee
segments.translation: O He Who Did Not Withhold Assistance Inspite Of My Very Deficient Self Control.

segments.transliteration: Wa Yaa Man Raanee A'lal Ma-A'as'ee Falam Yafz'ah'nee
segments.translation: O He Who Saw My Wrongdoings Yet Did Not Disgrace Me:

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّۃَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ  الْعَلِیِّ الْعَظِیْمِ
segments.transliteration: Wa Yaa Man Raanee A'lal Khat'aayaa Falam Ya'qibnee A'layhaa
segments.translation: O He Who Saw My Shortcomings Yet Did Not Punish Me;

segments.arabic: قَالَ مُوْسٰى مَا جِئْتُمْ بِہِ۝۰ۙ السِّحْرُ۝۰ۭ
segments.transliteration: S'alli A'laa Muh'ammadin Wa Aali Muh'ammadin
segments.translation: Send Blessings On Muhammad And On The Children Of Muhammad,

segments.transliteration: Waghfir Lee D'anbee Washfinee Min Maraz'ee
segments.translation: Forgive My Sins, Cure My Diseases; Verily,

segments.arabic: اِنَّ اللہَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ الْمُفْسِدِيْنَ۝۸۱
segments.translation: You Have Power Over All Things.]

segments.arabic: وَ يُحِقُّ اللہُ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِہٖ وَ لَوْ كَرِہَ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ۝۸۲ۧ
segments.translation: [O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting,

segments.arabic: فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَ بَطَلَ مَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ۝
segments.translation: I Beseech (You) In The Name Of Your Mercy To Help Me.

segments.transliteration: Wa Laa Takilnee Ilaa Nafsee Turfata A'ynin Abadan
segments.translation: So Help Me And Do Not Leave Me To Myself Even For The Flash Of An Eye(Without You Being With Me),
And Look After Properly All My Affairs.]

segments.transliteration: U-E'edu Nafsee Wa D'urriyyatee Wa Ahla Baytee Wa Maalee
segments.translation: [I Put Myself, My Children, My Family, My Property
Under (Allah's Protection ) In The Name Of Allah's Perfected Words,
From All Devils, Poisonous Animals,

segments.transliteration: Wa baammatin Wa Min Kulli A'ynin Laammatin
segments.translation: And From Every Evil Eye.]
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
In the name of Allah and with Allah
in the name of Allah-that which Allah wills (takes place)

segments.transliteration: Bismillaahi Wa Laa Hawla Wa La Quwwata Illa Billaah
segments.translation: in the name of Allah- there is no power nor strength save with Allah.

segments.transliteration: Qaala Moosaa Maa Ji-Tum Bihis Sih'r
segments.translation: Musa said : What you have brought is sorcery;
verily Allah will soon make it vain:
verily Allah does not put in order the work of the mischief-makers.

segments.transliteration: Wa Yohiqqul Laahul Haqqa Bekalemaatehi Wa Law Karehal Mujremoon
segments.translation: And Allah will show the truth to be the truth by His words, though the guilty may be averse (to it).

segments.transliteration: Fawaqa-A'l H'aqqu Wa Bat'ala Maa Kanoo Ya'-Maloon
segments.translation: Thus the truth was established, and what they were doing was made vain.
So there and then (Firawn and his enchanters) were defeated and made to look small, humiliated]

segments.transliteration: Allaahumma Rabbi Moosaa Wa Khaas's Ahoo Bikalaamihee
segments.translation: [O My Allah - The Lord Of Musa, When He Particularly Selected To Honour Him With His Spoken Words.

segments.transliteration: Wa Haazima Man Kaadahoo Bish'rihee Bi-A's'aahu
segments.translation: He Routed Those Who Teased Musa With Their (Tricks Of) Magic,
With The Help Of His Rod (Granted To Musa By Allah) .
He Transformed (The Rod) Into A Serpent.

segments.transliteration: Wa Mubt'ila Kaydi Ahlil Fasaadi Man Kaadanee Bisih'rin
segments.translation: And Again Brought It Back To Its Original State,

segments.transliteration: Aw Biz'urrin A'madan Aw Ghayra A'madin A'lamuhoo
segments.translation: After It Destroyed The Work Of The Magicians
And Rendered Ineffective The Deceit Of The Mischief Makers

segments.transliteration: Aw Laa Akhaafuhoo Faq-Ta'min Asbaabis Samaawaati A'malahoo
segments.translation: Whosoever Tries To Harm Me With Magic Or Affliction, Intentionally Or Unintentionally,
Whether I Know About It Or Not, Whether It Frightens Me Or Not,

segments.transliteration: Wa Laa Z'aarrin Lee Wa Laa Shammatin
segments.translation: Cut Off His (Evil) Designs With The Help Of Divine Medium,

segments.transliteration: Lee Innee Adra-U Bi-A'z'matika Fee Nuh'ooril A'-Daa-I Fakun
segments.translation: So That It Does Not Reach Me And Never Carried Out To Hurt Me Or Terrorize Me.
Verily, I Ward Off, With The Help Of Your Greatness, The Threats Of My Enemies.
So Protect Me With The Best Protection And Make It Thoroughly Effective. O Liberal Giver]
