title: Evil Repelling Duas Baqeyatus salehat

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, in Allah (I trust),
and on Allah do I rely.

segments.arabic: إِنَّهُ مَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
segments.transliteration: innahu man yatawakkal `ala allahi fahuwa hasbuhu
segments.translation: Verily, whoever trusts in Allah, He is sufficient for him.
Surely, Allah attains His purpose.

segments.arabic: قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْراً
segments.transliteration: qad ja`ala allahu likulli shay'in qadran
segments.translation: Allah indeed has appointed a measure for everything.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْنِي فِي كَنَفِكَ وَفِي جِوَارِكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`alni fi kanafika wa fi jiwarika
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) put me under Your shade and in Your vicinity

segments.transliteration: waj`alni fi amanika wa fi man`ika
segments.translation: and put me under Your security and in Your shield.
O Allah, (please) entertain my loneliness,
secure my dread,
and help me against my being alone.
I pray for Your protection the perfect Words of Allah
and all of His excellent names totally
against the evil of poisonous things and the pestles,
against the evil of all evil eyes,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri hasidin idha hasada
segments.translation: and against the evil of the envious when he envies.
O black, leaping fleas

segments.arabic: ٱلَّذِي لاَ يُبَالِي غَلَقاً وَلاَ بَاباً
segments.transliteration: alladhi la yubali ghalaqan wa la baban
segments.translation: that care for neither a lock nor a door,
I adjure you in the name of the Mother of the Book
not to annoy my companions and me
until night terminates
and morning comes carrying what it carries.
I pray the protection of the Lord of Daniel and the well (in which Daniel was thrown with beasts)
against all strong, ravenous lions.
I adjure you by the adjuration of Allah,

segments.arabic: وَعَزِيمَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa `azimati muhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: the adjuration of Muhammad, Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household,
the adjuration of Solomon the son of David,

segments.arabic: وَعَزِيمَةِ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segments.transliteration: wa `azimati amiri almu'minina `aliyyi ibni abi talibin `alayhi alssalamu
segments.translation: the adjuration of the Commander of the Faithful `Ali the son of Abi-Talib, peace be upon him,

segments.arabic: وَٱلأَئِمَّةِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ
segments.translation: and the adjuration of the immaculate Imams after him, peace be upon them.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظيِمِ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power save with Allah the All-high and All-great.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bihaqqi muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.transliteration: wa an tunjiyani min hadha alghammi
segments.translation: and to save me from this distress.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O He Who is Ever-living; O He Who is Self-subsisting,
in the name of Your mercy I pray for Your aid; so, (please) come to my aid,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ أَبَداً
segments.transliteration: wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata `aynin abadan
segments.translation: do not leave me with myself even for a winking of an eye,
and set aright my entire affair.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
In the Name of Allah (I begin) and in Allah (I put my trust).
I shut the mouths of jinn, human beings,
devils, sorcerers, demons,
both jinn and human beings,
rulers, and their protÃ©gÃ©s
in the name of Allah the Almighty and Mightiest,
in the name of Allah the Great and Greatest,
and in the name of Allah that is evident, immanent,
hoarded, and stored,
and by which Allah has established the heavens and the earth
and then prevailed on the Throne.
âIn the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
And the word shall come to pass against them because they were unjust,
so they shall not speak.â

segments.transliteration: qala ikhsa'u fiha wa la tukallimuni
segments.translation: âHe shall say: Go away into it and speak not to Me.â
âAnd the faces shall be humbled before the Living, the Self-subsistent Allah,

segments.transliteration: wa qad khaba man hamala zulman
segments.translation: and he who bears iniquity is indeed in a failure.â
âAnd the voices shall be low before the Beneficent Allah
so that you shall not hear aught but a soft sound.â

segments.transliteration: wa ja`alna `ala qulubihim akinnatan an yafqahuhu
segments.translation: âAnd We have cast veils over their hearts lest they understand it
and a heaviness into their ears.â

segments.transliteration: wa idha dhakarta rabbaka fi alqur'ani wahdahu
segments.translation: âAnd when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur'an
they turn their backs in aversion.â
âAnd when you recite the Qur'an,

segments.arabic: جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: ja`alna baynaka wa bayna alladhina la yu'minuna bilakhirati
segments.translation: We place between you and those who do not believe in the hereafter
a hidden barrier.â

segments.transliteration: wa ja`alna min bayni aydihim saddan
segments.translation: âAnd We have made before them a barrier
and a barrier behind them,
then We have covered them over so that they do not see.â
âOn that day, We will set a seal upon their mouths,
and their hands shall speak to Us.â
âSo, they shall not speak.â

segments.transliteration: law anfaqta ma fi al-ardi jami`an
segments.translation: âHad you spent all that is in the earth,
you could not have united their hearts,
but Allah united them.
Surely, He is Mighty, Wise.â

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi alttahirina
segments.translation: May Allah bless Muhammad and his immaculate Household.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O Creator of the creation!
O Amplifying of sustenance!
O Splitter of grains!
O Originator of spirits!
O Reviver of the dead!
O Deadener of the living!
O constantly Firm!
O Bringer forth of plants!
(Please) do to me what befits You to do,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَفْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: wa la taf`al bi ma ana ahluhu
segments.translation: but do not do to me what I deserve,

segments.transliteration: wa anta ahlu alttaqwa wa ahlu almaghfirati
segments.translation: for You are the worthiest to be feared and the worthiest to forgive.

segments.transliteration: ilahi kam min `aduwwin shahadha li zubata mudyatihi
segments.translation: O my God, too many are the enemies who honed their daggersâ edge against me,
sharpened the heads of their weapons against me,

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي كَمْ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ شَحَذَ لِي ظُبَةَ مُدْيَتِهِ
segments.translation: mixed for me their deadly poisons,
and kept a sleepless eye on me,

segments.transliteration: falamma ra'ayta da`fi an ihtimali alfawadihi
segments.translation: but when You considered that I am too weak to bear hardships
and I am too powerless to bear the accumulating cataclysms,

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ ضَعْفِي عَنِ ٱحْتِمَالِ ٱلْفَوَادِحِ
segments.translation: You warded off all that from me through Your might and power,

segments.transliteration: la bihawlin minni wa la quwwatin
segments.translation: but not through my might or power.

segments.transliteration: fa'alqaytahu fi alhafiri alladhi ihtafarahu li
segments.translation: You have thus thrown him in the hole, which he had dug for me,
making him lose any hope he had in this world

segments.arabic: فَأَلْقَيْتَهُ فِي ٱلْحَفِيرِ ٱلَّذِي ٱحْتَفَرَهُ لِي
segments.translation: and move away from what he had expected in the Hereafter.
So, all praise be to you for that;
praise that is comparable to what You deserve, O my master.
So, O Allah, (please) grasp him by Your almightiness,
notch his sharpness against me with Your omnipotence,
and cause him to be engaged with what will inflict him
and to be too weak to face his rivals.
O Allah, (please) help me against his animosity with such help that is in progress
and due to which my rage will be healed
and my anger will protect me against him.
O Allah, (please) connect my prayer with Your response,
attach my complaint to the reply that changes my state,
show him very soon and practically what You have prepared threateningly for the wrongdoers,

segments.transliteration: wa `arrifni ma wa`adta fi ijabati almudtarrina
segments.translation: and show me very soon and practically how You respond to the distressed ones.

segments.arabic: وَعَرِّفْهُ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ مَا أَوْعَدْتَ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
segments.translation: Verily, You are the Lord of great favor

segments.arabic: وَعَرِّفْنِي مَا وَعَدْتَ فِي إِجَابَةِ ٱلْمُضْطَرِّينَ
segments.translation: and generous conferral.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
In the Name of Allah.

segments.transliteration: inni a`udhu bilrrahmani minka in kunta taqiyyan
segments.translation: Surely, I seek refuge in the Beneficent Allah from you, if you are pious
or impious.

segments.arabic: إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمٰنِ مِنْكَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَقِيّاً
segments.translation: I seek Allah the All-hearing and All-seeing
to guard me against your hearing and your sight.
You have authority neither over me,
nor over my hearing,
nor over my sight,
nor over my hair,
nor over my skin,
nor over my flesh,
nor over my blood,
nor over my brain,
nor over my veins,
nor over my bones,
nor over my property,
nor over what my Lord has provided me.

segments.transliteration: satartu bayni wa baynaka bisitri alnnubuwwati
segments.translation: I block between you and me with the blockage of prophecy
with which the prophets of Allah blocked
against the sways of the tyrants and the oppressive rules.
Gabriel is to my right side,
Michael to my left side,
Seraph to my backside,

segments.transliteration: wa muhammadun salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi amami
segments.translation: Muhammad, Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household, to my front side,
and Allah is overseeing me

segments.arabic: وَمُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَمَامِي
segments.translation: to prevent you from me
and prevent Satan from me.
O Allah, let not his intolerance overcome Your forbearance
lest he may provoke and belittle me.
O Allah, to You do I resort.
O Allah, to You do I resort.
O Allah, to You do I resort.
O Light! O Demonstrative Argument!
O Evident! O Brilliant!
O Lord, (please) save me from all evils
and vicissitudes of times,

segments.transliteration: wa as'aluka alnnajata yawma yunfakhu fi alssuri
segments.translation: and I beseech You for redemption on the day when the Trumpet will be blown.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ ٱلنَّجَاةَ يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ
segments.translation: O Mighty of all might in His almightiness!
How mighty the mighty of all might in His almightiness is!
O Mighty, (please) make me mighty in the name of Your almightiness,

segments.arabic: مَا أَعَزَّ عَزِيزَ ٱلْعِزِّ فِي عِزِّهِ
segments.translation: aide me with Your support,
ward off from me the inspirations of devils,
defend me with Your defense,
protect me with Your making,
and make me of the best of Your creatures.
O One! O One and Only!
O Unique! O eternally besought of all.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O my means in my ordeals!
O my aide in my agonies!
O my entertainment in my loneliness!
(Please) guard me with Your eye that never sleeps
and embrace me with Your support that is invincible.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O owner of all selves!
O defeater of the allies!
O opener of all doors!
O creator of all causes!
(Please) create for us a cause
that we cannot find anywhere else,
in the name of âThere is no god but Allah.
Muhammad is the messenger of Allah.â
May Allahâs blessings be upon him and all of the members of his Household.

segments.transliteration: ma man awa ila ma'wan fa'anta ma'waya
segments.translation: O Allah, if someone may resort to a shelter, then my shelter is You.

segments.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa man laja'a ila malja'in fa'anta malja'i
segments.translation: If someone may seek refuge in an asylum, they my asylum is You.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَوَىٰ إِلَىٰ مَأْوَىًٰ فَأَنْتَ مَأْوَايَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ لَجَأَ إِلىٰ مَلْجإٍ فَأَنْتَ مَلْجَئِي
segments.translation: listen to my call,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: respond to my prayer,
decide my final return and abode to be with You,
and guard me, when I am afflicted by an ordeal,
against failure in the trial
and against the influence of Satan,

segments.transliteration: bi`azamatika allati la yashubuha wala`u nafsin bitaftinin
segments.translation: [please do it] in the name of Your greatness that is admixed with neither infatuating fondness
nor assumed and transitory apparition

segments.arabic: بِعَظَمَتِكَ ٱلَّتِي لاَ يَشُوبُهَا وَلَعُ نَفْسٍ بِتَفْتِينٍ
segments.transliteration: wa la yalummu biha farahun hatta taqlibani ilayka bi'iradatika
segments.translation: and is not charmed by a joyful situation, until You decide to take me to You by Your will
while I am neither accused, suspect,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَلُمُّ بِهَا فَرَحٌ حَتَّىٰ تَقْلِبَنِي إِلَيْكَ بِإِرَادَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa la murabin wa la murtabin
segments.translation: suspicious, nor doubtful.
Verily, You are the most merciful of all those who show mercy.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
There is no god but Allah.
In Him do I put my trust
and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
What Allah wills shall come to pass,

segments.transliteration: wa ma lam yasha' lam yakun
segments.translation: but what He does not will shall never come to pass.

segments.transliteration: ashhadu anna allaha `ala kulli shay'in qadirun
segments.translation: I bear witness that Allah has power over all things

segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha qad ahata bikulli shay'in `ilman
segments.translation: and Allah has encompassed all things in His knowledge.

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min sharri nafsi
segments.translation: O Allah, I pray Your protection against the evils of my self

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْماً
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri kulli dabbatin anta akhidhun binasiyatiha
segments.translation: and against the evil of every living creature that You hold by its forelock.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي
segments.translation: Surely, my Lord is on the right path.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
In the Name of Allah; the best of all names.
In the Name of Allah; the Lord of the earth and the heavens.

segments.transliteration: bismillahi alladhi la yadurru ma`a ismihi sammun wa la da'un
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah with Whose Name, neither poison nor malady can harm.
In the Name of Allah, I begin my day

segments.arabic: بِسمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ ٱسْمِهِ سَمٌّ وَلاَ دَاءٌ
segments.translation: and in Allah, I put my trust.
In the Name of Allah on my heart and my self.
In the Name of Allah on my faith and my intellect.
In the Name of Allah on my family members and my property.
In the Name of Allah on what Allah has given me.

segments.transliteration: bismillahi alladhi la yadurr ma`a ismihi shay'un
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah with Whose Name nothing can ever harm

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا أَعْطَانِي رَبِّي
segments.transliteration: fi al-ardi wa la fi alssama'i
segments.translation: neither in the earth nor in the heavens,

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ ٱسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ
segments.translation: and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.
Allah, Allah is my Lord.
I do not associate any thing with Him.
Allah is the Most Great.

segments.transliteration: allahu akbaru wa a`azzu wa ajallu
segments.translation: Allah is greater, mightier, and more majestic
than what I fear and what I am afraid of.
Strong is one who is in Your vicinity,
majestic is the praise of You,
and there is no god save You.

segments.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min sharri nafsi
segments.translation: O Allah, I pray Your protection against the evil of my self,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri kulli sultanin shadidin
segments.translation: the evil of all stern rulers,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri kulli shaytanin maridin
segments.translation: the evil of all rebellious devils,
the evil of all obstinate tyrants,
the evil of all misfortunate decrees,

segments.transliteration: wa min kulli dabbatin anta akhidhun binasiyatiha
segments.translation: and [the evil of] all living creatures that You grasp from the forelock.
Verily, You are on a straight path

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.translation: and You are the custodian over all things.

segments.transliteration: inn waliyyiya allahu alladhi nazzala alkitaba
segments.translation: âSurely, my guardian is Allah Who revealed the Book
and He keeps the righteous people under His custody.â

segments.arabic: «إِنَّ وَ لِيِّيَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ ٱلْكِتَابَ
segments.translation: âBut if they turn back, then say, âAllah is sufficient for me.
There is no god but He.
On Him do I rely
and He is the Lord of mighty power.ââ
O Allah, I pray Your protection
lest that I may be needy while Your riches are there for me,
I may be led astray while Your guidance is there for me,
I may be humiliated while Your honoring is there for me,
I may be subjugated while Your absolute authority is there for me,
or I may be persecuted while the entire affair is Yours.
O Allah, I pray Your protection
lest I may say false things,
commit wickedness,
or be seduced to exceed Your limits.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
Sufficient to me is Allah.
I put my trust in Allah.

segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka khayra umuri kulliha
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You for success in all of my affairs

segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min khizyi alddunya wa `adhabi al-akhirati
segments.translation: and I pray Your protection against disgrace in this world and chastisement in the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ أُمُورِي كُلِّهَا
segments.transliteration: ya man idha ista`adhtu bihi a`adhani
segments.translation: O He Who unquestionably protects me whenever I pray Him for protection,

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ خِزْيِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ ٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa idha istajartu bihi `inda alshshada'idi ajarani
segments.translation: Who unquestionably shelters me whenever I pray for His shelter against hardships,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ إِذَا ٱسْتَعَذْتُ بِهِ أَعَاذَنِي
segments.transliteration: wa idha istaghathtu bihi `inda alnnawa'ibi aghathani
segments.translation: Who unquestionably aids me whenever I pray for His aid at calamities,

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱسْتَجَرْتُ بِهِ عِنْدَ ٱلشَّدَائِدِ أَجَارَنِي
segments.transliteration: wa idha istansartu bihi `ala `aduwwi nasarani wa a`anani
segments.translation: and Who unquestionably supports and assists me whenever I pray for His support against my enemy.

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱسْتَغَثْتُ بِهِ عِنْدَ ٱلنَّوَائِبِ أَغَاثَنِي
segments.translation: Towards You is the flight

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱسْتَنْصَرْتُ بِهِ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّي نَصَرَنِي وَأَعَانَنِي
segments.translation: and You are the most trustful;
so, (please) subdue whoever intends evil to me
and overcome whoever plots against me.

segments.transliteration: ya man qala in yansurkum allahu fala ghaliba lakum
segments.translation: O He Who has said, âIf Allah assists you, then there is none that can overcome you.â

segments.transliteration: ya man najja nuhan min alqawmi alzzalimina
segments.translation: O He Who has saved Noah from the oppressing people!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ قَالَ «إِنْ يَنْصُرْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَلاَ غَالِبَ لَكُمْ.»
segments.transliteration: ya man najja lutan min alqawmi alfasiqina
segments.translation: O He Who has saved Lot from the wicked people!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ نَجَّىٰ نُوحاً مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
segments.transliteration: ya man najja hudan min alqawmi al`adina
segments.translation: O He Who has saved Hud from the transgressing people!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ نَجَّىٰ لُوطاً مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَاسِقِينَ
segments.transliteration: ya man najja muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi min alqawmi alkafirina
segments.translation: O He Who has saved Muhammad, Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household, from the disbelieving people!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ نَجَّىٰ هُوداً مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْعَادِينَ
segments.translation: (Please) save me from my and Your enemies,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ نَجَّىٰ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَافِرِينَ
segments.translation: in the name of Your Names; O All-beneficent, O All-merciful.

segments.transliteration: la sabila lahum `ala man ta`awwadha bilqur'ani
segments.translation: They have no way to harm whoever prays the protection of the Qur'an
and prays the shelter of You in the name of Your Names: the All-merciful and the All-beneficent.

segments.arabic: لاَ سَبِيلَ لَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَنْ تَعَوَّذَ بِٱلْقُرْآنِ
segments.translation: âThe All-beneficent is firmly established on the throne (of authority).â
âTruly, strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.
It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life),
and He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,
Lord of the Throne of Glory,
and Doer (without let) of all that He intends.â
âBut if they turn away, then say: âAllah suffices me:
there is no god but He.:
On Him is my trust,
and He the Lord of the Throne (of Glory) Supreme.ââ
I put my trust in the ever-living Lord Who never dies.
I pray the immunity of the Lord of almightiness and omnipotence.

segments.arabic: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ
segments.translation: I pray the aid of the Lord of grandeur and kingdom.
O my Master, I surrender to You; so, (please) do not disappoint me,
I put my trust in You; so, (please) do not thwart me,

segments.transliteration: wa laja'tu ila zillika albasiti fala tatrahni
segments.translation: and to Your extensive shadow do I resort; so, (please) do not throw me away.
You are the utmost purpose and to You are all flights made.

segments.arabic: وَلَجَأْتُ إِلَىٰ ظِلِّكَ ٱلْبَسِيطِ فَلاَ تَطْرَحْنِي
segments.transliteration: ta`lamu ma ukhfi wa ma u`linu
segments.translation: You know whatever I hide and whatever I do openly.

segments.transliteration: wa ta`lamu kha'inata al-a`yuni wa ma tukhfi alssuduru
segments.translation: You know the stealthy looks of eyes and what is concealed in breasts.
So, O Allah, (please) withhold the hands of the transgressors against me,

segments.arabic: وَتَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ ٱلأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي ٱلصُّدُورُ
segments.translation: including all jinn and all human beings,
heal me, and grant me wellbeing,
O most merciful of all those who show mercy!
The Creator is greater than the creatures.
The Sustaining Lord is more liberal than the sustained beings.
The awning over fire of Allah
in outstretched columns
will frustrate the plots of the hearts of the rebellious
and will thwart the trickeries of the envious
in the name of the Oaths, the Decrees,
the Preserved Tablet,
the Hanged Down Screen,
and the Throne of our Great Lord.
I seek the screen, the covering,
the shelter, the safeguard,

segments.transliteration: wa tahassantu bi-alif lam mim wa bikaf ha' ya' `ayn sad
segments.translation: and the haven of âail-lam-mim,â âkaf-ha'-ya'-`ayn-sad,â

segments.transliteration: wa bita ha wa bita' sin mim
segments.translation: âta-ha,â âta'-sin-mim,â

segments.transliteration: wa biha' mim wa biha' mim `ayn sin qaf wa nun
segments.translation: âha'-mim,â âha'-mim-`ayn-sin-qaf,â ânun,â

segments.transliteration: wa bita sin wa biqaf walqur'ani almajidi
segments.translation: âta-sin,â âqaf,â âthe Glorious Qur'an,â
and âAnd most surely, it is a very great oath if you only knew.â
Allah is my guardian, and the most excellent protector is He.
O All-compassionate! O All-merciful!

segments.transliteration: allahumma inna dhunubi lam yabqa laha illa raja'u `afwika
segments.translation: O Allah, nothing has indeed left for my sins except my hope for You pardon

segments.transliteration: wa qad qaddamtu alata alhirmani bayna yadayya
segments.translation: although I have done things due to which I deserve deprivation of Your pardon.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ ذُنُوبِي لَمْ يَبْقَ لَهَا إِلاَّ رَجَاءُ عَفْوِكَ
segments.translation: Therefore, I beseech You for what I do not deserve,

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ آلَةَ ٱلْحِرْمَانِ بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ
segments.translation: I seek from You what I do not merit,

segments.transliteration: wa atadarra`u ilayka bima la asta'hiluhu
segments.translation: and I implore You for what I do not earn.
My situation is not concealed from You

segments.transliteration: wa in khafiya `ala alnnasi kunhu ma`rifati amri
segments.translation: although the actual knowledge of my manners is hidden from people.

segments.transliteration: allahumma in kana rizqi fi alssama'i fa'ahbithu
segments.translation: O Allah, if my sustenance in the sky, then (please) send it down to me,

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ خَفِيَ عَلَىٰ ٱلنَّاسِ كُنْهُ مَعْرِفَةِ أَمْرِي
segments.transliteration: wa in kana fi al-ardi fa'azhirhu
segments.translation: if it is in the earth, then (please) show it to me,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ رِزْقِي فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ فَأَهْبِطْهُ
segments.translation: if it is far off, then (please) draw it near me,
if it is near, then (please) make it easy for me to reach it,
and if it is little, then (please) multiply it for me
and grant me its blessings.
O Allah, Iblis is not but one of Your servants;
he can see me from whence I cannot see him,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ إِبْلِيسَ عَبْدٌ مِنْ عَبِيدِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa anta tarahu min haythu la yaraka
segments.translation: but You can see him from whence he cannot see You.
While You have full power over all of his deeds,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ تَرَاهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ يَرَاكَ
segments.transliteration: wa huwa la yaqwa `ala shay'in min amrika
segments.translation: he has no power over any of Your decrees.

segments.transliteration: allahumma fa'ana asta`inu bika `alayhi ya rabbi
segments.translation: So, O Allah, I pray Your help against him, O Lord,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ لاَ يَقْوَىٰ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ
segments.translation: for I have no strength to challenge him

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَأَنَا أَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَيْهِ يَا رَبِّ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata li `alayhi illa bika ya rabbi
segments.translation: and I have neither might nor power against him except through You, O my Lord.
O Allah, if he intends evil to me, then (please) deter him,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ لِي عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ
segments.translation: if he plots against me, then (please) plot against him,
save me from his evils,
and make his trickery to be hanged to his own neck,
in the name of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.

segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi alttahirina
segments.translation: May Allah bless Muhammad and his Immaculate Household.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ

Commenting, the Holy Prophet (s) added, âThus did (Prophet) Abraham use to repel evil from Ishmael and Isaac.â Fourth: The companions of the Holy Prophet (s) are reported, in one of the military expeditions, to have complained to him about fleas that annoyed them. Instructing them, the Holy Prophet (s) said: When you go to sleep, you may say this supplicatory prayer: evil repelling baqiyaus salehat Ø£ÙÙÙÙÙÙØ§ Ù±ÙØ£ÙØ³ÙÙÙØ¯Ù Ù±ÙÙÙÙØ«ÙÙØ§Ø¨Ù ayyuha al-aswadu alwaththabu O black, leaping fleas Ù±ÙÙÙØ°ÙÙ ÙØ§Ù ÙÙØ¨ÙØ§ÙÙÙ ØºÙÙÙÙØ§Ù ÙÙÙØ§Ù Ø¨ÙØ§Ø¨Ø§Ù alladhi la yubali ghalaqan wa la baban that care for neither a lock nor a door, Ø¹ÙØ²ÙÙ ÙØªÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙØ£ÙÙ ÙÙ Ù±ÙÙÙÙØªÙØ§Ø¨Ù `azamtu `alayka bi'ummi alkitabi I adjure you in the name of the Mother of the Book Ø£ÙÙÙ ÙØ§Ù ØªÙØ¤ÙØ°ÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ£ÙØµÙØ­ÙØ§Ø¨ÙÙ an la tu'dhiyani wa ashabi not to annoy my companions and me Ø¥ÙÙÙÙÙ° Ø£ÙÙÙ ÙÙØ°ÙÙÙØ¨Ù Ù±ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ila an yadhhaba allaylu until night terminates ÙÙÙÙØ¬ÙÙâØ¡Ù Ù±ÙØµÙÙØ¨ÙØ­Ù Ø¨ÙÙ ÙØ§ Ø¬ÙØ§Ø¡Ù wa yaji'a alssubhu bima ja'a and morning comes carrying what it carries. If you do so, the beast will go away, by the will of Allah the All-exalted. Sixth: The Holy Prophet (s) is reported to have said to Imam `Ali Amir al-Mu'minin (`a): When you fall in a trouble or an ordeal , you may say the following words. Once you do, Allah the Almighty and All-exalted will ward off from you whatever sort of misfortune He wills: evil repelling baqiyaus salehat Ø¨ÙØ³ÙÙ Ù Ù±ÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ù±ÙØ±ÙÙØ­ÙÙ Ù°ÙÙ Ù±ÙØ±ÙÙØ­ÙÙÙ Ù bismi allahi alrrahmani alrrahimi In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. Chapter 5 Each Infalliable dua 1-10 BRIEF SUPPLICATORY AND EVIL-REPELLING PRAYERS This section comprises a number of brief supplicatory and evil-repelling prayers that are selected from the two books entitled Muhaj al-Da`awat and al-Mujtana compiled by Sayyid Radi al-Din Ibn Tawus. First: Imam Musa ibn Ja`far (`a) is reported to have quoted the Holy Prophet (s) as instructing Imam `Ali (`a) to say this supplicatory prayer whenever a hardship would bother him: evil repelling baqiyaus salehat Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙ Ø¥ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø£ÙØ³ÙØ£ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙØ­ÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙÙØ¯Ù ÙÙØ¢ÙÙ Ù ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙÙØ¯Ù allahumma inni as'aluka bihaqqi muhammadin wa ali muhammadin O Allah, I beseech You in the name of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad Ø£ÙÙÙ ØªÙØµÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙ° Ù ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙÙØ¯Ù ÙÙØ¢ÙÙ Ù ÙØ­ÙÙ ÙÙØ¯Ù an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad ÙÙØ£ÙÙÙ ØªÙÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙÙ ÙÙ°Ø°ÙØ§ Ù±ÙÙØºÙÙ ÙÙ wa an tunjiyani min hadha alghammi and to save me from this distress. title: Freedom from Captivity Duas.org

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ الْعَرْشِ وَ مَنْ عَلاَهُ وَ بِحَقِّ الْوَحْيِ وَ مَنْ أَوْحَاهُ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma Bi Haqqil Arshi Wa Man 'Alaahu Wa Bi Haqqil Wahee Wa Man Awhaahu
segments.translation: O' Allah! for the sake of the Throne and the One Who is above it, and for the sake of Revelation and the One Who revealed it,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ النَّبِيِّ وَ مَنْ نَبَّأَهُ وَ بِحَقِّ الْبَيْتِ وَ مَنْ بَنَاهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa Bi Haqqinnabee'ee Wa Mannabbaahu Wa Bi Haqqil Bayti Wa Man Banaahu.
segments.translation: and for the sake of the Prophet and the One Who appointed him, and for the sake of the House and the One Who constructed it.

segments.arabic: يَا سَامِعَ كُلِّ صَوْتٍ يَا جَامِعَ كُلِّ فَوْتٍ يَا بَارِئَ النُّفُوسِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.transliteration: Ya Saamia' Kulli Sawt. Yaa Jaamia' Kulli Fawt. Yaa Baarian Nufuusi Badal Mawt. Salli 'Ala Muhammad Wa Ahle Bayte-Hee
segments.translation: O' Hearer of every sound! O' Collector of all that will pass. O' Creator of the souls after (their) death. Send Your blessings on Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: وَ آتِنَا وَ جَمِيعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَ مَغَارِبِهَا فَرَجاً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ عَاجِلاً بِشَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa Aatinaa Wa Jameefal Mo'meneen Wal Mo'menaat Fee Mashaariqal Ardhee Wa Maghaaribihaa Farajan Min 'Indika 'Aajilan Bi Shahaadati An Laa Ilaha Illa Allaah
segments.translation: and grant us and (grant all) the believing men and believing women in the east of the Earth and the west of if (the Earth) deliverance from Yourself, speedily (in this world), with the bearing witness that there is no god except Allah

segments.arabic: وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ عَلَى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً كَثِيراً
segments.transliteration: Wa An-Na Muhammadan 'Abduka Wa Rasuluka. Salla Allahu 'Alayhi Wa Aalehee Wa 'Ala Dhuriyateheet Tayyibeenat Taaheereen Wa Salla-Ma Tasleeman Katheera.
segments.translation: and verily Muhammad is Your slave and Your Prophet, blessings of Allah be upon him and upon his family and upon his children, the righteous and pure, and send salutations (upon them), an appropriate salutation in multitude.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma Eeyaaka Arjuu Wa Eeyaaka Ad'oou Fa Bal-Ligh-Nee Amalee Wa Aslih 'Amalee.
segments.translation: O' Allah! Verily we turn to You and verily we call upon You, so help me to reach my hopes and desires and make my actions righteous.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَلْكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ وَ الْمُعَافَاةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma Innee As-Alukal A'fwa Wal A'afiyata Wal Mu-A'afaata Fid Dunyaa Wal Aakhirati
segments.translation: Oh God, I ask you for forgiveness, well-being, and well-being in this world and the hereafter.

segments.arabic: يَا مُخَلَّصَ الشَّجَرِ مِنْ بَيْنِ رَمْلٍ وَ طِينِ وَمَاءِ وَ يَا مُخَلِّصَ اللَّبَنِ مِنْ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَ دَمٍ وَ يَا مُخَلَّصَ الْوَلَدِ مِنْ بَيْنِ مَشِيمَةٍ رَحِمٍ وَ يَا مُخَلِّصَ النَّارِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الْحَدِيدِ وَ الْحَجَرِ وَ يَا مُخَلِّصَ الرُّوحِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الْأَحْشَاءِ وَ الْأَمْعَاءِ خَلَصْنِي مِنْ يَدَى ......
segments.transliteration: Yaa Mukhallis'ash Shajari Min Bayni Ramlin Wa T'eenin Wa Maa-In Wa Yaa Mukhallis'al Labani Min Bayni Farthin Wa Damin Wa Yaa Mukhallis'al Waladi Min Bayni Masheematin Wa Rah'imin Wa Yaa Mukhallis'an Naari Min Baynil H'adeedi Wal H'ajari Wa Yaa Mukhallisar Rooh'i Min Baynil Ah'shaa-I Wal Am-A'a-I Khallis'nee Min Yadayo
segments.translation: O Savior of trees from between sand and clay and water, O Savior of milk from between dung and blood, O Savior of the child from between the placenta of a womb, and O Savior The fire is from between the iron and the stone, and O Savior of the soul, from between the entrails and the intestines, save me from my hand......

segments.arabic: يَا مُخَلِصَ اللَّبْنَ مِنْ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَ دَمٍ نَجِّنِي مِنَ الْمَحْبَسِ بِحَقِّ عِبَادِكَ الْمُخْلِصِ
segments.transliteration: Ya mukhalis alllabn min bayn farth w dam najjini min almahbas bihaqq eibadik almukhlis
segments.translation: O the One who has purified the milk (that comes) from between the refuse and blood. Save me from the prison for the sake of your sincere servants.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ الْعَرْشِ وَ مَنْ عَلَاهُ،
segments.translation: O Allah, by the right of the Throne and its bearer,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ الْوَحِي وَ مَنْ أَوْحَاهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa bihaqqi al-wahi wa man awhahu,
segments.translation: and by the right of the Revelation and its receiver,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ النَّبِيِّ وَ مَنْ نَبَّاهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa bihaqqi al-nabiyyi wa man nabba'ahu,
segments.translation: and by the right of the Prophet and his teachings,

segments.arabic: وَ بِحَقِّ الْبَيْتِ وَ مَنْ بَنَاهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa bihaqqi al-bayti wa man banahu,
segments.translation: and by the right of the Sacred House and its builder.
O Hearer of every sound,
O Gatherer of all that is lost,
O Creator of souls after death,

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ.
segments.translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: وَ آتِنَا وَ جَمِيعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa atina wa jami'a al-mu'minina wa al-mu'minat,
segments.translation: And grant us and all believing men and women,
across the East and the West of the earth,
relief from You, swiftly,

segments.arabic: بِشَهَادَةِ أَن لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ.
segments.transliteration: Bi shahadati an la ilaha illa Allah,
segments.translation: with the testimony that there is no god but Allah.
and that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger,
may Allah send blessings upon him and his family,
and upon his pure and righteous offspring,
and grant abundant peace and salutations.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ أَرْجُو وَ إِيَّاكَ ادْعُو،
segments.transliteration: Allahumma iyaka arju wa iyaka ad'u,
segments.translation: O Allah, in You I hope and to You I pray,
so fulfill my aspirations and rectify my deeds.

segments.arabic: اَلَّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلىٰ فَاطِمَةَ وَ اَبِيْهَا وَ بَعْلِهَا وَ بَنِيْهَا وَ سِرِِّ الْمُسْتَوْدِعِ فِيْهَا بِعَدَدِ مَا اَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
segments.transliteration: ma Salle al Fatima wa abeeha wa baleha wa baneeha wa sirril mustaudaeh fiha beadada maa ahaata be
segments.translation: Oh Allah send blessings on Fatima and her father, her husband and her sons, and by the secret installed in her (S)) which only is in YOUR know

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیْمِ.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma rabbas samaawaatis sab-eâ wa rabbal aârshil aâzeeme.
segments.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the great Throne.

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، مُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَ الْاِنْجِيْلِ وَ الْفُرْقَانِ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَ النَّوٰی، اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ اَنْتَ اٰخِذٌ بِنَاصِیَتِہٖ.
segments.transliteration: rabbanaa wa rabba kulle shayin, munzelat tawraate wal injeele wal furqaane, faaleqal habbe wan nawaa, a-oâozo beka min kulle shay-in anta aakhezun be-naaseyatehi.
segments.translation: O our Lord and the Lord of everything, revealer of the Taurat, Injeel and Furqan, splitter of the seed and grain. I seek your refuge from everything, whose control is in your hands.

segments.arabic: اَنْتَ الْاَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَ اَنْتَ الْاٰخِرُ فَلَیْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَیْءٌ وَ اَنْتَ الظَّاہِرُ فَلَیْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَیْءٌ، وَ اَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَیْسَ دُوْنَكَ شَیْءٌ اِقْضِ عَنِّی الدَّیْنَ، وَ اَغْنِنِیْ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ.
segments.transliteration: antal awwalo falaysa qablaka shay-un, wa antal aakhero fa-laysa baâdaka shay-un wa antaz zaahero fa-laysa fawqaka shay-un, wa antal baateno fa-laysa doonaka shay-un iqze aânneyad dayna, wa aghnenee menal faqre.
segments.translation: You are the first, there is nothing before You; and You are the last and there is nothing after You. You are the apparent and there is nothing above You; and You are the concealed and there is nothing nearer than You, facilitate the repayment of my debt and make me needless from poverty.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِحَقِّ الْعَرْشِ وَ مَنْ عَلَاهُ، وَ بِحَقِّ الْوَحْيِ وَ مَنْ اَوْحَاهُ، وَ بِحَقِّ النَّبِيِّ وَ مَنْ نَبَّاَهُ، وَ بِحَقِّ الْبَيْتِ وَ مَنْ بَنَاهُ، يَا سَامِعَ كُلِّ صَوْتٍ، يَا جَامِعَ كُلِّ فَوْتٍ، يَا بَارِءَ النُّفُوْسِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَهْلِ بَيْتِهٖ وَ اٰتِنَا وَ جَمِيْعَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فِيْ مَشَارِقِ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَغَارِبِهَا فَرَجًا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ عَاجِلًا بِشَهَادَةِ اَنْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ، وَ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُوْلُكَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ، وَ عَلٰى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ، وَ سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا.
segments.transliteration: allaahumma be-haqqil aârshe wa man aâlaaho, wa be-haqqil wahye wa man awhaaho, wa be-haqqin nabiyye wa man nabbaaho, wa be-haqqil bayte wa man nabaaho, yaa saame-aâ kulle sawtin, yaa jaame-aâ kulle fawtin, yaa baare-an nofoose baâdal mawte, salle aâlaa mohammadin wa ahle baytehi wa aatenaa wa jamee-aâl moameneena wal moamenaate fee mashaareqil arze wa maghaarebehaa farajan min iândeka aâajelan be-shahaadate an laa elaaha illal laaho, wa anna mohammadan aâbdoka wa rasooloka sallal laaho aâlayhe wa aalehi, wa aâlaa zurriyyatehit tayyebeenat taahereena, wa sallama tasleeman kaseeran.
segments.translation: O God, I adjure You by the right of the Arsh and the one, who raised it, and by the right of revelation and by one, who sent; and by the right of the Prophet and one, who made him a prophet; and by the right of Kaaba and one, who made it. O one, who listens to every voice. O one, who gathers all that are lost. O one, who revives the souls after death, bless Muhammad and his Ahle Bayt and grant from your side to me and the believer men and women of the east and the west of the world immediate tranquility and peace. I adjure by the right of âthere is no god, except Allah and Muhammad is the messenger of Allahâ. May Allah have mercy on Muhammad and his purified progeny and convey my salutation to them in excess.

segments.arabic: - اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ اَعْدَائِيْ وَ مَنْ كَادَنِيْ بِسُوءٍ اِنْ اَتَوْا بَرًّا فَجَبِّنْ شَجِيْعَهُمْ...
segments.transliteration: - allaahumma wa a-aâdaa-ee wa man kaadanee be-soo-in in ataw barran fa-jabbin sha-jee-aâhumâ¦
segments.translation: - O God, if my enemies and those, who deceive me, if they intend to cause distress, weaken the strength of their heartâ¦[1]

segments.arabic: - اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْفِنِيْ حَسَدَ الْحَاسِدِيْنَ، وَ بَغْيَ الْبَاغِيْنَ، وَ كَيْدَ الْكَافِرِيْنَ‏...
segments.transliteration: - allaahummak fenee hasadal haasedeena, wa baghyal baagheena, wa kaydal kaafereenaâ¦
segments.translation: - O Allah, suffice me against the envy of the envious and the tyranny of the tyrants and the machination of the disbelieversâ¦[2]

segments.arabic: - اَللّٰهُمَّ احْرُسْنَا بِعَيْنِكَ الَّتِيْ لَا تَنَامُ، وَ رُكْنِكَ الَّذِي لَا يُرَامُ...
segments.transliteration: - allaahummah rusnaa be-aâynekal latee laa tanaamo, wa ruknekal lazee laa yoraamoâ¦
segments.translation: - O God, protect us through the eyes that never sleep and through that support no one can reachâ¦[3]

segments.arabic: يَا عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَ السَّرَائِرِ، يَا مُطَاعُ يَا عَلِيْمُ، يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا هَازِمَ الْاَحْزَابِ لِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، يَا كَائِدَ فِرْعَوْنَ لِمُوْسٰى، يَا مُنْجِيَ عِيْسٰى مِنْ اَيْدِي الظَّلَمَةِ، يَا مُخَلِّصَ قَوْمِ نُوْحٍ مِنَ الْغَرَقِ، يَا رَاحِمَ عَبْدِهٖ يَعْقُوْبَ يَا كَاشِفَ ضُرِّ اَيُّوْبَ، يَا مُنْجِيَ ذِي النُّوْنِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ، يَا فَاعِلَ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، يَا هَادِيًا اِلٰى كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، يَا دَالًّا عَلٰى كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، يَا اٰمِرًا بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ، يَا خَالِقَ الْخَيْرِ، وَ يَا اَهْلَ الْخَيْرِ، اَنْتَ اللهُ رَغِبْتُ اِلَيْكَ فِيْمَا قَدْ عَلِمْتَ وَ اَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوْبِ، اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ...
segments.transliteration: yaa aâalemal ghaybe was saraa-ere, yaa motaa-oâ yaa aâleemo, yaa allaaho yaa allaaho yaa allaaho yaa haazemal ahzaabe le-mohammadin sallal laaho aâlayhe wa aalehi, yaa kaa-eda fir-aâwna le-moosaa, yaa munjeya eâesaa min aydiz zalamate, yaa mokhallesa qawme noohin menal gharaqe, yaa raahema a'bdeâi yaâqooba yaa kaashefa zurre ayyooba, yaa munjeya zeen noone menaz zolomaate, yaa faa-eâla kulle khayrin, yaa haadeyan elaa kulle khayrin, yaa daal-lan aâlaa kulle khayrin, yaa aameran be-kulle khayrin, yaa khaaleqal khayre, wa yaa ahlal khayre, antal laaho ra-ghibto elayka feemaa qad aâlimta wa anta aâllaamul ghoyoobe, as-aloka an tosalleya aâlaa mohammadin wa aale mohammadinâ¦
segments.translation: O knower of the unseen and the secrets, O one, worthy of obedience and the most knowing, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O one, who defeated all the parties for Muhammad (s.a.w.a.), O one, who took revenge of Musa from Firon. O one, who saved Isa from the oppressors. O One, who saved the people of Nuh from drowning. O one, who had mercy on His servant, Yaqub. O one, who dispelled the troubles of Ayyub. O one, who gave relief to Yunus from the darknesses. O the doer of every good. O the guide to every good. O one, who shows the way to every good. O, one who commands every good. O creator of every good. O owner of all the good. You are that Allah, towards whom I have turned in the issues that You know well. As You are the knower of all the unseen. I beseech You to send mercy on Muhammad and progeny of Muhammadâ¦

O you who are safe from everything and every thing is afraid of you, cautious, I ask you by your security from everything and the fear of everything from you, to send blessings upon Muhammad and To give me security for myself, my family, my money, and my children, so that I will not fear anyone or be wary of anything at all. You are powerful over all things.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma Salle ala Mohammed wa Aalehi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: يا آمِناً مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْى ءٍ وَ كُلُّ شَيْى ءٍ مِنْكَ خآئِفٌ حَذِرٌ اَسْئَلُكَ بِاَمْنِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَ خَوْفِ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مِنْكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَنْ تُعْطِيَنى اَماناً لِنَفْسى وَ اَهْلى وَ مالى وَ وَلَدى حَتّى لا اَخافَ اَحَداً وَ لا اَحْذَرَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ اَبَدَاً اِنَّكَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْى ءٍ قَديرٌ
segments.transliteration: Be haqqe Fatima wa abeeha wa baleha wa baneeha wa sirril mustaudaeh fiha
segments.translation: Fatima and her father, her husband and her sons, and by the secret installed in her (sa)

segments.transliteration: An tusslle `ala Muhammadin wa ali Muhammad
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: بِ حَقِّ فَاطِمَةَ وَ اَبِيْهَا وَ بَعْلِهَا وَ بَنِيْهَا وَ سِرِِّ الْمُسْتَوْدِعِ فِيْهَا
segments.transliteration:
Wa an tafal be anta ahlo 
Wa la tafalbe ma Ana ahlo
segments.translation: Please act as per your stature and do not act based on what I deserve

segments.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّ علَىٰ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد

وَ اَنْ تَفْعَل بِىْ اَنْتَ اَهْلُهُ
وَلاَ تَفْعَلْ بِىْ مَا اَنَا اَهْلُهُ

text: Freedom from Captivity . Duas Syeda Fatima(sa) Duas Salat of Syeda Resources Arabic Transliteration Translation Protection against Opression duas page FREEDOM FROM CAPTIVITY To be out of prison or be free from captivity recite the following du-a'a Fourth: The du`a for being released from prison: In his book Muhaj al-Da`awat, Sayyid ibn Tawus has written, "It has been related that a person was imprisoned in Shaam (Syria) for a long time. He dreamt about Hazrat Fatimah (`a) , who taught him this du`a and advised him to recite it. When he did so, he was released and went home. The holy Prophet said : Whosoever recites verses 156 and 157 of al Baqarah: verses 135 and 136 and 173 and 174 of Ali Imran, verses 83 and 84 and 87 and 88 of al Anbiya, verses 44 and 45 of al Munim shall always have sufficient means and if in prison soon shall be set free It has been narrated in the various books of supplication that the following supplication should be written by the brother or sister in prison and kept with him/herself at all times: ÙÙØ§ Ù ÙØ®ÙÙÙØµÙ Ø§ÙÙÙÙØ¨ÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙÙ Ø¨ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ±ÙØ«Ù ÙÙ Ø¯ÙÙ Ù ÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙÙ Ø§ÙÙÙ ÙØ­ÙØ¨ÙØ³Ù Ø¨ÙØ­ÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙØ¨ÙØ§Ø¯ÙÙÙ Ø§ÙÙÙ ÙØ®ÙÙÙØµÙ Ya mukhalis alllabn min bayn farth w dam najjini min almahbas bihaqq eibadik almukhlis O the One who has purified the milk (that comes) from between the refuse and blood. "O' Allah, I ask from You the best in Your knowledge, so bless Muhammad and his household and decree for me the best! Inspire us with knowledge to choose the best and make that a means to being pleased with what You have decreed for us and submitting to what You have decided!" Section 2: The Outcome of the Istikhara 4) Divine Inspiration to the Right Path alâImam Jafar alâSadiq (âas), said: "... there is no believing slave (of Allah) who asks the best from Allah one time in his affair, except that He makes a means between the two ways. â 110 Allah, the Glorious and the High is the Purest Perfect Being, and as long as there are no obstacles from the servant's side to prevent His mercy from being manifested, then He will not withhold His blessings and grace. Thus, if a true servant of Allah , with sincerity and a pure heart asks Him for guidance even one time, then without doubt, Allah will guide him towards that which is good and advisable for him. 5) Help in Choosing the Right Path alâImam Jafar alâSadiq (âas), said: "There is no believing slave (of Allah) that asks Allah âthe Glorious and High âfor goodness except that Allah prepares the best for him even if he (the person) does not like it. "2 How unfortunate is it for man that sometimes that which is good for him lies in something that he does not like! Therefore, after one asks the best from Allah , he should not anticipate that what he is asking for will automatically be given to him and just as he would like it to be (since that may not be the right thing for him). 6) A Way Out of Confusion The Prophet of Islam(âs) said, "O' 'Ali! Whosoever asks the best (from Allah), will never be confused, and whosoever asks (others) for advice will never be regretful.â 312 The above hadith was a special piece of advice from the Prophet of Islam (âs) to Amir alâMu'minin `Ali ibn Abi Talib (âas), during one of his travels to Yemen to spread the faith of Islam. In such a dangerous mission, the most important thing that one could have asked for is a strong heart, confidence, and conviction. Asking the best from Allah , is the method to attain these spiritual traits and characteristics. 7) Removal of Remorse and Sorrow alâImam 'Ali (âas), said, "Whosoever asks the best (from Allah) will never be regretful.â 413 The greatest outcome of asking for the best from Allah before performing an action and in all matters is to arrive at the stage of having satisfaction of the heart, removal of all doubt and dilemma, and the elimination of all confusion and distress. (In all your actions) continuously ask (Allah) for the best. "Nahj alâBalaagha, Saying 31. and "Any time you have decided to perform an act, then ask (Allah) for what is best." Ghurur alâHikm, Saying 3988 Imam Ali(as)-Sahifa 85 For âSeeking The Bestâ Sahifa Sajjadia dua 33-âSeeking The Bestâ Imam Mohammed Taqi (as) Munajat 01 for âSeeking The Bestâ Â Source Al-Islam.org book Section 1: The Necessity of Performing an Istikhara for all Affairs 1) Istikhara: Success for a Muslim The Prophet of Allah said: `Among the felicities of the children of Adam is that he asks the best from Allah and His pleasure in that which Allah has decreed for him. And among the misfortunes of the children of Adam is abandoning the asking of what is best from Allah and not being pleased with what Allah has decreed. " 15 The actual meaning of the word Istikhara is to seek the best from Allah in one's affairs, which is not only commendable, but is also highly recommended (mustahab) in Islam. This type of Istikhara which has been continuously mentioned in the ahadith is in actuality, one form or type of supplication (Dua) which Allah Himself has given great importance to in the Holy Book: (ÙÙÙÙ Ù ÙØ§ ÙÙØ¹ÙØ¨ÙØ¤Ù Ø¨ÙÙÙÙ Ù Ø±ÙØ¨ÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙ ÙØ§Ù Ø¯ÙØ¹ÙØ§Ø¦ÙÙÙÙ Ù...) "Say: My Lord would not care for you were it not for your prayer (supplication)... " (alâQur'an 25:77) In this, the first hadith, before starting any job or action, a supplication, which is a form of Istikhara has been recommended to be performed. We have been told that this is one of the roads that lead to a person's happiness. 2) Istikhara: A Recommendation from the Ahl alâBait alâImam 'Ali (âas) in the will to his son recommended that, "... (In all your actions) continuously ask (Allah) for the best. "2 He also said, `Any time you have decided to perform an act, then ask (Allah) for what is best. " 37 The method of asking for what is best that has been most often mentioned in the ahadith, including the hadith mentioned above and has been emphasized, is that one in which one asks for the best from Allah in the form of a Dua' (supplication). This type of seeking what is best is not associated with the instance in which a person has a doubt or can not make a decision. Rather, from the traditions of the Ahl alâBait (âas), it is clear that before we carry out any action â no matter how small or insignificant it may be â we are recommended and encouraged to seek help, and constantly remember Allah in all of our affairs. 48 3) Istikhara: As Taught by the Ahl alâBait alâImam alâBaqir (âas), said: "We (the Ahl alâBait) teach the method of Istikhara (asking Allah for what is best) just as we teach the Surahs of the Book of Allah, the Glorious and the High. " 59 In reality, the Istikhara or asking the best from Allah is a type of spiritual link or connection and request of one's needs from the humble servant to the Needless and SelfâExisting Creator. The supplications and requesting what is best â both before and during all acts, establishes a deep and continuous relationship between the servant of Allah â who is always in need of help, and his needless Master. This is the type of Istikhara that has been emphasized by the A'immah of the Ahl alâBait , and was part of their natural disposition (fitrah). The Istikhara with the Tasbih beads and the Qur'an is the final step after one still entertains doubts and uncertainty in his mind and should only be done after seeking the best from Allah , thinking, weighing out the pros and cons, and requesting advice from others. segments.arabic: سُبْحانَ مَنْ لا يَعْتَدي عَلى أهْلِ مَمْلَكَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: subh'aana man laa ya-tadee aa'laa ahli mamlakatihee
segments.translation: glory be to him who does not treat the citizens of his kingdom unjustly and harshly,

segments.arabic: سُبْحانَ مَنْ لا يَأخُذُ اَهْلَ الاَْرْضِ بأَلْوانِ الْعَذابِ
segments.transliteration: subh'aana man laa yaakhud'u ahlal arz'i bilwaanil a'd'aabi
segments.translation: glory be to him who does not let torment and pain come suddenly upon mankind,
glory be to the compassionate, the merciful.

segments.arabic: اَللّـهُمَّ اْجَعلْ لي في قَلْبى نُوراً وَبَصَراً وَفَهْماً وَعِلْماً اِنَّكَ عَلى كُلِّ شَي قَديرٌ .
segments.transliteration: allaahummaj-a'l lee fee qalbee nooran wa bas'aran wa fahman wa i'lman innaka a'laa kulli shay-in qadeer
segments.translation: o Allah fill my heart and mind with true enlightenment, discerning intelligence, quick understanding and knowledge, Verily Thou art able to do all things.

segments.arabic: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَ هَا أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَة
segments.transliteration: innee as-aluka yaa mud'akkiral khayri wa faa-ilahoo wal aamira bihee an tus'alliya a'laa muh'ammadin wa aali muh'ammadin wa tud'akkiranee maa ansaaneehish shayt'aan
segments.translation: Q 69:12 That We might make it for you a reminder and that receptive ears might remember it.

segments.transliteration: allaahummar-h'amnee bitarkil ma-a'as'ee abdan maa abqaytanee far-h'amnee min takallufi maa laa yuneenee warzuqnee h'usnal manz'ari feemaa yurz'eeka a'nnee wal-zam qalbee h'ifz'a kitaabika kamaa a'llamtanee warzuqnee an atluwahoo a'lan nah'wil lad'ee yurz'eeka a'nnee allaahumma nawwir bas'aree wash-rah bihee s'adre wa farru bihee qalbee wa at'liq bihee lisaaanee was-ta-mil bihee badanee wa qawwinee a'laa d'aalika wa a-i'nnee a'layhi innahoo laa mu-e'ena a'layhi illaa anta laa ilaaha illaa anta
segments.translation: I beseech You, O He who reminds about doing good, does good and commands to do good. Send blessings on Muhammed and the family of Muhammed and let me remember what shaytan makes me forget.

O Allah have mercy on me to be able to leave disobeying you till I am
alive. Show mercy on me by not imposing a troublesome and difficult
task on me. Make me do good deeds that please you. Make me learn your
book by heart, just like you have taught me. Give me the ability to
recite it in a manner that pleases you. O Allah (through the quran)
enlighten my wisdom, open the doors of understanding and liberate my
heart. Loosen my tongue, let my body be active and give me strength
for it. No one can help me save you. There is no god except you.

segments.arabic:
اَللّٰهُمَّ اَخْرِجْنِيْ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ 
الْوَهْمِ وَ اَكْرِمْنِيْ بِنُوْرِ الْفَهْمِ
segments.transliteration: Allhumma Akhrijni min zulumatil wahmi ,wa akrimni be nuril fahmi .
segments.translation: O GOD, please bring me out of the darkness of doubt and favour me with the light of comprehension,

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ افْتَحْ عَلَيْنَا اَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ انْشُرْ عَلَيْنَا خَزَآئِنَ عُلُوْمِكَ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma afta alayna abwaba rahmateka, wa anshur alyna khazaena uloomeka
segments.translation: O GOD open to us the doors of your mercy and unfold for us the treasure of your knowledge by your mercy
O the most merciful of the merciful ones.

segments.arabic: للَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْـتَنِي وَ عَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي
segments.transliteration: âAllahumma infa'nii bimaa 'allamtanii wa'allimnii maa yanfa'uunii.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Make useful for me what you have taught me and teach me knowledge that will be useful to me.

segments.arabic: .اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَهْمَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَ حِفْظَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma inii as'aluka fahmal-nabiyyen wa hifzal mursaleen al-muqarrabeen.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! I ask you for the understanding of the prophets and the memory of the messengers, and those nearest to you.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِسَانِي عَامِرًا بِذِكْرِكَ وَ قَلْبِي بِخَشْيَتِك.
segments.transliteration: .Allahumma ijal leesanee 'aiman bi dhikrika wa qalbi bi khashyatika.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Make my tongue full of your remembrance and my heart with awe of you.

segments.arabic: َ.إِنَّكَ عَلَى مَا تَشَاءُ قَدِيرٌ وَ أَنْتَ حَسْـبُنَا اللَّهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
segments.transliteration: Innaka 'ala ma-tasha'u qadeer wa anta hasbun-allahu wa na'mal wakeel.'
segments.translation: Oh Allah! You do whatever you wish, and you are my availer and protector and best of aid.

segments.arabic: َللَّهُمَّ اَكْرِمْنْيْ بِنُوْرِ الْفَهْمِ وَ خَرَّجَنِيْ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ الْوَهْمِ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma akrimnee binooril fahmi wa kharrajanee min z'ulumaatil wahmi
segments.translation: O Allah, honor me by the light of understanding and take me out from the darknesses of doubt
and open upon us the doors of Your knowledge

segments.arabic: وَ انْشُرْ عَلَيْنَا خُزَّانَ مَعْرِفَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ،
segments.transliteration: Wan shur a'lainaa khuzzaanu ma'rifatika yaa arh'amar raah'imeen.
segments.translation:
and open upon us the treasure of Your recognition,
 O the best of the Merciful ones.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَفِّقْنِيْ فِىْ الْمُطَالَعَةِ بِحَلِّ جَمِيْعِ مُشْكِلاَتِ الْمَسَآئِلِ مِنَ الْكُتُبِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma waffiqnee fil mut'aala'ti bih'ablee jamee-i' mushkilaatil masaa-ili minal kutubi birah'matika yaa arh'amar raah'imeen
segments.translation: .O Allah, and give me Tawfeeq to the study and solving all the difficult problems through books. By Your mercy, O the best of the merciful ones

segments.arabic: للَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَ الْحَزَنِ  وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ العَجْزِ وَ الْكَسَلِ
segments.transliteration: Allhumma inni adhu bika min al-hammi wa al-hazan. Wa adhu bika min al-ajzi wa al-kasal.
segments.translation: Oh Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief,from helplessness and laziness,

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَ الْبُخْلِ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ و قَهْرِ الرجال
segments.transliteration: Wa adhu bika min al-jubni wa al-bukhl. Wa adhu bika min ghalabat id-dayni wa qahr ir-rijal.
segments.translation: from cowardice and stinginess,and from overpowering of debt and from oppression of men

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِيْ فِيْ قَلْبِيْ نُوْرًا وَ بَصَرًا وَ فَهْمًا وَ عِلْمًا اِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْر
segments.transliteration: âAllahumma inni astaodeeka ma qaraâtu wama hafaz-tu.
segments.translation: O Allah let my heart be filled with light & insight & understanding & knowledge ,verily You control everything.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ مَا قَرأتُ وَمَا حَفَظْتُ،
segments.translation: Oh Allah! I entrust you with what I have read and I have studied.

segments.transliteration: Innaka âala ma-tashaâ-u qadeer wa anta hasbeeya wa naâmal wakeelâ
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Bring it back to me when I am in need of it.

segments.arabic: إِنّكَ عَلى مَا تَشَاءُ قَدِيرُ وَأَنْتَ حَسْبِي وَنِعْمَ الوَكِيل
segments.transliteration: Allhumma l sahla ill m jaaltahu sahl wa anta tajalu al-hazana idh shita sahl.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! You do whatever you wish, you are my availer and protector and the best of aid

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلاً إِلّاَ مَا جَعَلّتَهٌ سَهْلاً وَأَنّتَ تَجّعَلَ الحَزَنَ إِذَا شِئتَ سَهْلاً
segments.transliteration: salla-l-laahu alaa muhammad wa aal-e muhammad. allahumma inni asaluka yaa mudhakkira-l khayr wa faailahu wa-l-aamira bihi dhakir-ni maa ansaani-hi-shaytan.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Nothing is easy except what You have made easy. If You wish, You can make the difficult easy.

segments.arabic: صَلّىَ اللهُ عَلى مُحَمّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمّد. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ يَا مُذَكِرَ الخَيْرِ وَفَاعِلَهُ  وَالآمِرَ بِهِ ذَكِرّنِي مَا اَنّسَانِهِ الشّيطَان
segments.transliteration: âYa sayyedas-sada-te, ya mojeebad-daâvate, ya rafeâad-darajate, ya vali-yal hasanate, ya ghaferal-khatiâate, ya moâti-yal masâalate, ya qabi-lat-tavbate, ya sameâal-asvate, ya âalemal-khafiyate, ya dafeâal bali yate.â
segments.translation: Blessings of God be upon Muhammad and his progeny. O God, I ask you, the one who mentions goodness and actualizes it and commands it, remind me of that which the shaytan makes me forget.

segments.arabic: يَا سَيِّدَ السَّادَاتِ يَا مُجِيبَ الدَّعَوَاتِ يَا رَافِعَ الدَّرَجَاتِ يَا وَلِيَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يَا غَافِرَ الْخَطِيئَاتِ يَا مُعْطِيَ الْمَسْأَلاتِ يَا قَابِلَ التَّوْبَاتِ يَا سَامِعَ الأَصْوَاتِ يَا عَالِمَ الْخَفِيَّاتِ يَا دَافِعَ الْبَلِيَّاتِ
segments.translation: Oh the chief of all chiefs! Oh the acceptor of prayers! Oh the elevator of ranks! Oh the master of virtues! Ohthe forgiver of sins! Oh the granter of requests! Oh the excerptor of penance! Oh the hearer of all voices! Oh the one who knows all mysteries! Oh the remover of calamities!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ رَبِّي وَ رَبُّكَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَنِي وَ خَلَقَكَ وَ قَدَّرَكَ فِي مَنَازِلِكَ [وَ قَدَّرَ مَنَازِلَكَ‌] وَ جَعَلَكَ آيَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ يُبَاهِي اللَّهُ بِكَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ
segments.translation:
Exalt the Sublime God and say: "God is the Great! God is the Great! God is the Great!
	God is my Lord and your Lord! God is the Lord of the worlds.
	There are no Gods but God. Praise be to God, Who created me, created you, destined Your Path and established you as a sign for the people of the world.God takes pride in you near the angels.

segments.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَ الْإِيمَانِ وَ السَّلَامَةِ وَ الْإِسْلَامِ وَ الْغِبْطَةِ وَ السُّرُورِ وَ الْبَهْجَةِ
	وَ ثَبِّتْنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ وَ الْمُسَارَعَةِ فِيمَا يُرْضِيكَ
segments.transliteration: wa akhta'tu fatafaddalta lith-thiqati minni bi-'afwika
segments.translation:
O' my God!Please let this month be a period of peace, faith, safety and total submission to Your will .
	Please establish us firmly in Your obedience and make us walk apace swiftly to that which You like and approve.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي شَهْرِنَا هَذَا وَ ارْزُقْنَا خَيْرَهُ وَ بَرَكَتَهُ وَ يُمْنَهُ وَ عَوْنَهُ وَ فَوْزَهُ وَ اصْرِفْ عَنَّا شَرَّهُ وَ بَلَاءَهُ وَ فِتْنَتَهُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.translation:
O' my God! Please bless us in this month. And please bless us with its generous goodness and abundance, its blessedness, assistance and salvation. and safeguard us from any evil, misfortune and mischief during this month. 
	By Your Mercy! O' the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful."

segments.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَ بِكَلِمَاتِكَ وَ أَسْمَائِكَ الْحُسْنَى كُلِّهَا 

وَ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَ رُسُلِكَ وَ أَوْلِيَائِكَ وَ مَلَائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ [الْمُؤْمِنِينَ‌] وَ جَمِيعِ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ 

أَلَّا تُخَلِّيَنِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْ‌ءٍ
segments.translation:
Say, âO' my God! You are Allah! There is no God but You! I ask You through Yourself, Your Words, all Your Beautiful Names, Your Prophets, Your Messengers, Your Guardians, Your nearby-stationed angels and all Your Servants in the ranks of the righteous.
 O' God! O' Beneficent to the believers! Please do not deprive me of Your Mercy which encompasses all things.

segments.arabic:
يَا اللَّهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا وَاحِدُ يَا حَيُّ يَا أَوَّلُ يَا آخِرُ يَا ظَاهِرُ يَا بَاطِنُ يَا مَلِكُ يَا غَنِيُّ يَا مُحِيطُ يَا سَمِيعُ يَا عَلِيمُ يَا عَلِيُّ يَا شَهِيدُ يَا قَرِيبُ يَا مُجِيبُ يَا حَمِيدُ يَا مَجِيدُ يَا عَزِيزُ يَا قَهَّارُ يَا خَالِقُ 
 
 يَا مُحْسِنُ يَا مُنْعِمُ يَا مَعْبُودُ يَا قَدِيمُ يَا دَائِمُ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ يَا فَرْدُ يَا وَتْرُ يَا أَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ يَا بَاعِثُ يَا وَارِثُ يَا سَمِيعُ يَا عَلِيمُ يَا لَطِيفُ يَا خَبِيرُ يَا جَوَادُ يَا مَاجِدُ يَا قَادِرُ يَا مُقْتَدِرُ يَا قَاهِرُ 
 
 يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا قَابِضُ يَا بَاسِطُ يَا حَلِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا عَفُوُّ يَا رَءُوفُ يَا غَفُورُ
segments.translation: O' God! O' Compassionate to the believers! O' the One! O' the Living! O' the First! O' the Last! O' Outward! O' Inward! O' King! O' Rich! O' the All-Encompassing! O' the All-Hearing, O' the All-Knowing! O' the Sublime! O' Witness! O' the All-Near! O' the Responder! The Praiseworthy! O' the Most Glorious One! O' Exalted in Might! O' Irresistible! O' Creator! O' the Kind! O' He who bestows bounties! O' the Worshipped! O' the Eternal! O' the Enduring! O' the Living! O' the Self-Subsisting! O' the One! O' the Odd O' the One! O' Eternal, Absolute! O' Resurrector! O' Inheritor! O' the All-Hearing, O' the All-Knowing! O' Knower of subtleties! O' the All Aware! O' Munificent! O' the Noble! O' the Able! O' The Affluent! O' the Subduer! O' the Compassionate! O' the Merciful! O' the Constrictor! O' the Expander! O' the Forbearing! O' the All-Generous! O' Pardoner! O' the Compassionate! O' the All-Forgiving!

segments.arabic:
هَا أَنَا ذَا صَغِيرٌ فِي قُدْرَتِكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ رَاغِبٌ إِلَيْكَ مَعَ كَثْرَةِ نِسْيَانِي وَ ذُنُوبِي وَ لَوْ لَا سَعَةُ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ لُطْفِكَ وَ رَأْفَتِكَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْهَالِكِينَ يَا مَنْ هُوَ عَالِمٌ بِفَقْرِي إِلَى جَمِيلِ نَظَرِهِ وَ سَعَةِ رَحْمَتِهِ أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ كُلِّهَا مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهَا وَ مَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ 
 
 وَ بِحَقِّكَ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ وَ بِقِدَمِكَ وَ أَزَلِكَ وَ إِبَادِكَ وَ خُلْدِكَ وَ سَرْمَدِكَ وَ كِبْرِيَائِكَ وَ جَبَرُوتِكَ وَ عَظَمَتِكَ وَ شَأْنِكَ وَ مَشِيَّتِكَ
segments.translation:
Here I am right in front of You and under Your Reign! I am inclined towards you in spite of my many wrong-doings and sins.
 Were it not due to Your Mercy, Your Favor and Your Kindness I would have been of the ruined ones.
 O' He who is aware of my poverty.
 Please look at me with favor and extend Your Mercy upon me.
  O' my God! Indeed I ask You by the totality of Your Names â those I know and those I do not know - and by Your Right over Your creatures!
I ask You by Your having existed forever before, being Eternal, Your Abode, Your being Everlasting, Your Magnificence, Your Omnipotence, Your Grandeur, Your Loftiness and Your Will!

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَرْحَمَنِي وَ تُقَدِّسَنِي بِلَمَحَاتِ حَنَانِكَ وَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رِضْوَانِكَ وَ تَعْصِمَنِي مِنْ كُلِّ مَا نَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهُ وَ تُوَفِّقَنِي لِمَا يُرْضِيكَ عَنِّي وَ تُجْبِرَنِي عَلَى مَا أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ وَ أَحْبَبْتَهُ مِنِّي
segments.transliteration: wa ja'alta li minhu makhrajan wa manjan bi-qudratika wa fadlika
segments.translation:
I ask You to bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny(as) have Mercy on me, and sanctify me by Your Benevolence and Your Pleasure.
 I ask You to protect me from all which You admonished against and help me succeed in doing what pleases You with me, and make me do whatever You have ordered me to do and pleases You.

segments.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ امْلَأْ قَلْبِي وَقَارَ جَلَالِكَ وَ جَلَالَ عَظَمَتِكَ وَ كِبْرِيَائِكَ وَ أَعِنِّي عَلَى جَمِيعِ أَعْدَائِكَ وَ أَعْدَائِي 

يَا خَيْرَ الْمَالِكِينَ وَ أَوْسَعَ الرَّازِقِينَ وَ يَا مُكَوِّرَ الدُّهُورِ وَ يَا مُبَدِّلَ الْأَزْمَانِ وَ 

يَا مُولِجَ اللَّيْلِ فِي النَّهَارِ وَ مُولِجَ النَّهَارِ فِي اللَّيْلِ يَا مُدَبِّرَ الدُّوَلِ وَ الْأُمُورِ وَ الْأَيَّامِ

 أَنْتَ الْقَدِيمُ الَّذِي لَمْ تَزَلْ وَ الْمَالِكُ الَّذِي لَا يَزُولُ سُبْحَانَكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ بِحَمْدِكَ وَ حَوْلِكَ عَلَى كُلِّ حَمْدٍ وَ حَوْلٍ دَائِماً مَعَ دَوَامِكَ وَ سَاطِعاً بِكِبْرِيَائِكَ 
 
 أَنْتَ إِلَهِي وَلِيُّ الْحَامِدِينَ وَ مَوْلَى الشَّاكِرِينَ يَا مَنْ مَزِيدُهُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ وَ يَا مَنْ نِعَمُهُ لَا تُجَازَى وَ شُكْرُهُ لَا يُسْتَقْصَى وَ مُلْكُهُ لَا يَبِيدُ
segments.translation:
O' my God! My heart is filled with the tranquility of Your Glory, and the glory of Your Grandeur and Magnificence.
 O' the Best of the Owners! Assist me against all Your enemies and mine.
 O' the best Sustainer of our needs.
 O' He who changes the periods.
 O' He who changes the seasons.
 O' He who merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night.
 O' He who runs the governments, the affairs and the routine things.
 You are the Eternal One who have existed forever and You are the Owner who shall exist forever.
 Glory be to You! Praise belongs to You accompanied by Your Praise and Power.
 Praise that is Perpetual with Your Perpetuity, and is illuminated by Your Magnificence.
 You are my God! You are the Guardian of those who praise! You are the Master of those who are grateful.
 O' He who gives without any measure.
 O' He whose blessings cannot be repaid.
 And He who cannot be thanked enough and Whose Dominion does not diminish.

segments.arabic:
وَ أَيَّامُهُ لَا تُحْصَى صِلْ أَيَّامِي بِأَيَّامِكَ مَغْفُوراً لِي مُحَرَّماً لَحْمِي وَ دَمِي وَ مَا وَهَبْتَ لِي مِنَ الْخَلْقِ وَ الْحَيَاةِ وَ الْحَوْلِ وَ الْقُوَّةِ عَلَى النَّارِ 
 
 يَا جَارَ الْمُسْتَجِيرِينَ وَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ‌ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ‌ تَوَكَّلْتُ‌عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ‌ 
 
 الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ مالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَ إِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ‌ لِنَفْسِي وَ دِينِي وَ سَمْعِي وَ بَصَرِي وَ جَسَدِي وَ جَمِيعِ جَوَارِحِي وَ وَالِدَيَّ وَ أَهْلِي وَ مَالِي وَ أَوْلَادِي وَ جَمِيعِ مَنْ يَعْنِينِي أَمْرُهُ وَ سَائِرِ مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينِي عَلَى جَمِيعِ مَنْ أَخَافُهُ وَ أَحْذَرُهُ بَرّاً وَ بَحْراً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَ أَعَزُّ وَ أَجَلُّ وَ أَمْنَعُ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَ أَحْذَرُ عَزَّ جَارُ اللَّهِ وَ جَلَّ ثَنَاءُ اللَّهِ وَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ 
 اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي فِي جِوَارِكَ الَّذِي لَا يُرَامُ وَ فِي حِمَاكَ الَّذِي لَا يُسْتَبَاحُ وَ لَا يَذِلُّ وَ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ الَّتِي لَا تُخْفَرُ وَ فِي مَنْعَتِكَ الَّتِي لَا تُسْتَذَلُّ وَ لَا تُسْتَضَامُ وَ جَارُ اللَّهِ آمِنٌ مَحْفُوظٌ وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.transliteration: wa bi-umurina fasahhilha wa bi-duyunina fa'addiha
segments.translation:
Please join my days to Your Days having forgiven me and having made my flesh, blood, and all that You have bestowed upon me like my creation, life, strength and power immune from the Fire.
 O' the Protector of those seeking Your protection.
 O' the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.
 âIn the name of God, Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.
 I rely upon Him who is Everlasting and shall not perish! âPraise be to God!, the Cherisher and Sustainer of the worlds; Most Compassionate, Most Merciful; Master of the Day of Judgment.
 You do we worship, and Your aid we seek-1:2-5.
 Oâ He Whose days cannot be counted.
I seek Your Help for myself, my religion, my hearing, my sight, my body, all my organs, my parents, family, wealth and children, all under my custody, and others under my rein against all fears, dangers of all Your Creatures whether on the land or at sea.
 God is the Great! God is the Great! He is Honorable! He is Exalted! He fends off what I fear and threatens me.
 Anyone seeking Godâs Protection is honored.
 Glorious and sublime is God's Praise.
 And there is no God but God! O' my God! Please establish me in a place near Yourself that cannot be penetrated and under Your own support that cannot be violated or debased and Under Your Covenant that cannot be violated.
 Please put me in Your Fence that cannot be penetrated.
 Anyone seeking protection from God is protected.
 There is no Change or Power except with God the Sublime, the Supreme.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا كَافِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْ‌ءٍ وَ لَا يَكْفِي مِنْهُ شَيْ‌ءٌ يَا مَنْ لَيْسَ مِثْلَ كِفَايَتِهِ شَيْ‌ءٌ اكْفِنِي كُلَّ شَيْ‌ءٍ حَتَّى لَا يَضُرَّنِي مَعَكَ شَيْ‌ءٌ وَ اصْرِفْ عَنِّي الْهَمَّ وَ الْحُزْنَ وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ [بك‌] الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ يَا اللَّهُ يَا كَرِيمُ
segments.transliteration: wa bi-hawa'ijina faqdihÄ bi-qudratika wa fadlika
segments.translation:
O' my God! O' He who is needless of all things while nothing is needless of Him! O' He who nothing suffices like He does! Please take care of me such that nothing hurts me being with You.
 Please remove grief and sadness from me.
 There is no Change or Power except with God - the Sublime, the Supreme.
  O' God! O' the All-Generous.

segments.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَدْرَأُ بِكَ فِي نُحُورِ أَعْدَائِي وَ كُلِّ مَنْ يُرِيدُنِي سوء [بِسُوءٍ] وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ وَ أَسْتَعِينُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَاكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ وَ كَيْفَ شِئْتَ وَ مِنْ حَيْثُ شِئْتَ وَ أَنَّى شِئْتَ‌ فَسَيَكْفِيكَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ‌ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِأَخِيكَ وَ نَجْعَلُ لَكُما سُلْطاناً فَلا يَصِلُونَ إِلَيْكُما بِآياتِنا أَنْتُما وَ مَنِ اتَّبَعَكُمَا الْغالِبُونَ‌ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَنْ يَصِلُوا إِلَيْكَ‌ لا تَخافا 

إِنَّنِي مَعَكُما أَسْمَعُ وَ أَرى‌ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِالرَّحْمنِ مِنْكَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَقِيًّا اخْسَؤُا فِيها وَ لا تُكَلِّمُونِ‌ أَصْبَحْتُ وَ أَمْسَيْتُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي‌ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْ‌ءٌ مُمْتَنِعاً وَ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ كُلِّهَا مُحْتَرِزاً وَ بِأَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ الْحَسَنَةِ مُتَعَوِّذاً وَ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ مُوسَى وَ هَارُونَ وَ رَبِّ عِيسَى‌ وَ إِبْراهِيمَ الَّذِي وَفَّى‌ مِنْ شَرِّ الْمَرَدَةِ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْإِنْسِ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ أَخَذْتُ سَمْعَ كُلِّ طَاغٍ وَ بَاغٍ وَ عَدُوٍّ وَ حَاسِدٍ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْإِنْسِ عَنِّي وَ عَنْ أَوْلَادِي وَ أَهْلِي وَ مَالِي وَ جَمِيعِ مَنْ يَعْنِينِي أَمْرُهُ وَ أَخَذْتُ سَمْعَ كُلِّ مُطَالِبٍ وَ بَصَرَهُ وَ قُوَّتَهُ وَ يَدَيْهِ وَ رِجْلَيْهِ وَ لِسَانَهُ وَ شَعْرَهُ وَ بَشَرَهُ وَ جَمِيعَ جَوَارِحِهِ 

بِسَمْعِ اللَّهِ وَ أَخَذْتُ أَبْصَارَهُمْ عَنِّي بِبَصَرِ اللَّهِ وَ كَسَرْتُ قُوَّتَهُمْ عَنِّي بِقُوَّةِ اللَّهِ وَ بِكَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْمَتِينِ فَلَيْسَ لَهُمْ عَلَيَّ سُلْطَانٌ وَ لَا سَبِيلٌ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَهُمْ حِجَابٌ مَسْتُورٌ وَ بِسَتْرِ اللَّهِ وَ سَتْرِ النُّبُوَّةِ الَّذِي احْتَجَبُوا بِهِ مِنْ سَطَوَاتِ الْفَرَاعِنَةِ فَسَتَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِهِ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَنْ أَيْمَانِكُمْ وَ مِيكَائِيلُ عَنْ شَمَائِلِكُمْ وَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ سَلَّمَ 

بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَ اللَّهُ جَلَّ وَ عَزَّ عَالٍ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ مُحِيطٌ بِكُمْ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَ مِنْ وَرَائِكُمْ وَ آخِذٌ بِنَوَاصِيكُمْ وَ بِسَمْعِكُمْ وَ أَبْصَارِكُمْ وَ قُلُوبِكُمْ وَ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَ قُوَاكُمْ وَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَ أَرْجُلِكُمْ يَحُولُ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَ‌ شُرُورِكُمْ وَ جَعَلْنا فِي أَعْناقِهِمْ أَغْلالًا فَهِيَ إِلَى الْأَذْقانِ فَهُمْ مُقْمَحُونَ وَ جَعَلْنا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْناهُمْ فَهُمْ لا يُبْصِرُونَ‌ شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوهُ‌ صُمٌّ بُكْمٌ عُمْيٌ‌ طه‌ حم‌ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
segments.translation:
O' my God! I shall fend off my enemies and all who wish me harm by Your assistance.
 I take refuge in You from their evil! I seek Your help against them! Please help me against their evil with whatever You wish, however You wish, wherever You wish, and whenever You wish.
 ââ¦ but Allah will suffice thee as against them, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.â2:137. 
 We will certainly strengthen thy arm through thy brother, and invest you both with authority, so they shall not be able to touch you: with Our Sign shall ye triumph,- you two as well as those who follow you.28:35.
"â¦ We are Messengers from thy Lord! By no means shall they reach thee!-11:81.
 "Fear not: for I am with you: I hear and see (everything).-20:46
 "I seek refuge from thee to ((Allah)) Most Gracious: (come not near) if thou dost fear Allah.19:18
"Be ye driven into it (with ignominy)! And speak ye not to Me!-23:108
 I made it to the morning and the evening by Godâs Honor! There is none like Him.36:8-9
 I take refuge in Godâs Perfect Words all of which are Reserved.
 I take refuge in Godâs Good Names in which refuge is taken.
 I take refuge in the Lord of Moses and Aaron! The Lord of Jesus and Abraham who was loyal.
 I take refuge from the evils of rebels from the genies or men, from the evils of all the followers of Satan, from the evils of all oppressors!
I take the ears of all rebels, oppressors, tyrants, enemies and jealous ones from the genies and men off of me, my children, wife and property and all under my custody.
 I take the ears, the eyes, the power, the hands, the feet, the tongue, the hair, the skin and all their parts by Godâs Ear and took their eyes by Godâs Eyes, and I took their strength by Godâs Power and Godâs Plots.

They no longer have any authority over me, and have no way to influence me by the cover of God and the Prophet (as) that protected them from the wrath of the Pharaohs of their time.
 God protected them with Gabriel on the right, Michael on the left, and Muhammad (as) between you and us.
