title: Safar Month Daily Dua

segments.translation: O Lord of mighty prowess!
O Lord of mighty power!

segments.arabic: يَا عَزِيزُ يَا عَزِيزُ يَا عَزِيزُ
segments.translation: O Exalted in might! O Exalted in might! O Exalted in might!
Submissive to Your Almightiness are all of Your creatures;
so, (please) save me from the evil of Your creatures.
O All-liberal! O All-bountiful!
O Source of all bounties! O Doer of favors!

segments.arabic: يَا لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ
segments.transliteration: ya la ilaha illa anta subhanaka
segments.translation: O He save Whom there is no god! All glory be to You!
Verily, I have been a wrongdoer.

segments.transliteration: fastajabna lahu wa najjaynahu min alghammi
segments.translation: So We heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish.
Thus do We save the believers.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi alttayyibina alttahirina
segments.translation: May Allah send blessings to Muhammad and his Household, the pure and immaculate.

segments.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الْعَلِيمُ الْخَالِقُ الرَّازِقُ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الْقَدِيرُ الْمُقْتَدِرُ الْقَادِرُ 
أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: âO' God! You are the All-knowing, the Creator, the Provider! And You are God Who Destines, the Affluent! the Powerful! Therefore, I ask You to Bestow Blessings upon Muhammad and His Progeny (MGB).

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تُعَرِّفَنَا بَرَكَةَ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ وَ يُمْنَهُ وَ تَرْزُقَنَا خَيْرَهُ وَ تَصْرِفَ عَنَّا شَرَّهُ وَ تَجْعَلَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْفَائِزِينَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
segments.translation:
Please let us know the blessedness of this month and its having good omen.
 O' God! Please bless us with the its abundant goodness, and safeguard us from any evil.
 Please let us be amongst the saved ones during it.
 O' the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful!"

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اجْعَلْنِي أَكْثَرَ الْعَالَمِينَ قَدْراً وَ أَبْسَطَهُمْ عِلْماً وَ أَعَزَّهُمْ عِنْدَكَ مَقَاماً وَ أَكْرَمَهُمْ لَدَيْكَ جَاهاً كَمَا خَلَقْتَ آدَمَ ع مِنْ تُرَابٍ وَ نَفَخْتَ فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِكَ وَ أَسْجَدْتَ لَهُ مَلَائِكَتَكَ وَ عَلَّمْتَهُ الْأَسْمَاءَ كُلَّهَا وَ جَعَلْتَهُ خَلِيفَةً فِي أَرْضِكَ وَ سَخَّرْتَ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعاً مِنْكَ وَ كَرَّمْتَ ذُرِّيَّتَهُ وَ فَضَّلْتَهُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
segments.translation:
O' my God! Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny (MGB) and let me be of the highest rank, the most knowledgeable, and the most honorable of the people of the world near You as You made Adam (MGB) out of clay, blew Your Spirit into him, ordered Your angels to prostrate to him, and taught him all the Names.
 You established him as Your Caliph on Your earth.
 You brought all that is in the heavens and on the earth under his control.
 You honored his progeny and made them superior to all the people of the world.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَ مِنْكَ النَّعْمَاءُ وَ لَكَ الشُّكْرُ دَائِماً يَا لَطِيفاً بِعِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَا سَمِيعَ الدُّعَاءِ ارْحَمْ وَ اسْتَجِبْ
segments.translation: O' my God! Praise belongs to You and all Blessings are from You! Eternal Thanks are to You! O' Knower of subtleties of the worshipping of the believers! O' the All-hearing of supplications! Have Mercy and fulfill!

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ وَ لَا أَعْلَمُ وَ تَقْدِرُ وَ لَا أَقْدِرُ وَ أَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ فَاجْعَلْ قَلْبِي وَ عَزْمِي وَ هِمَّتِي [وَ نِيَّتِي‌] وَفْقَ [وقف‌] مَشِيَّتِكَ وَ أَسِيرَ أَمْرِكَ
segments.translation:
You know all and I do not know.
 You can destine but I cannot.
 And You are the Knower of all that is hidden.
 Please let my heart and my will and efforts be according to Your Will and adhering to Your Orders.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي لَا أَقْدِرُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِكَ وَ لَا أَقْدِرُ إِلَّا أَسْأَلُكَ بَعْدَ إِذْنِكَ خَوْفاً مِنْ إِعْرَاضِكَ وَ غَضَبِكَ فَكُنْ حَسْبِي يَا مَنْ هُوَ الْحَسْبُ وَ الْوَكِيلُ وَ النَّصِيرُ
segments.translation:
O' my God! I have no power to ask You for anything without Your Permission, and I have no power not to ask You after You Grant permission.
 I fear Your turning away and Your Wrath.
 Please take care of me.
 O' He who is my caretaker and helper.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ مَلَائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَ أَنْبِيَائِكَ [وَ] الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
segments.translation:
O' my God! Please bestow Blessings upon Muhammad and His Progeny (MGB)! And upon all Your nearby-stationed angels and Your dispatched Prophets (MGB), and all Your Servants in the ranks of the righteous.
 O' the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

segments.arabic: يَا جَالِيَ الْأَحْزَانِ يَا مُوَسِّعَ الضِّيقِ يَا مَنْ هُوَ أَوْلَى بِخَلْقِهِ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ يَا فَاطِرَ تِلْكَ الْأَنْفُسِ أَنْفُساً وَ مُلْهِمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَ التَّقْوَى نَزَلَ بِي يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ هَمٌّ ضِقْتُ بِهِ ذَرْعاً وَ صَدْراً حَتَّى خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ عَرَضَتْ فِتْنَةٌ
segments.translation:
Oâ He who removes sorrow! Oâ He who removes restrictions! O' He who is closer to the creatures than themselves!
O' Creator of souls and He who induces them about bad and good! O' He who removes grief! I have such grief that restricts my heart and I fear something has happened to me.

segments.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ فَبِذِكْرِكَ‌ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ‌ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ قَلِّبْ قَلْبِي مِنَ الْهُمُومِ إِلَى الرَّوْحِ وَ الدَّعَةِ وَ لَا تَشْغَلْنِي عَنْ ذِكْرِكَ بِتَرْكِكَ مَا بِي مِنَ الْهُمُومِ إِنِّي إِلَيْكَ مُتَضَرِّعٌ
segments.translation:
Oâ my God! The hearts are only consoled by Your Remembrance! Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny (MGB).
 Please change the state of my heart from anxieties to spirit and gentleness.
 Please do not abandon me with anxieties so that I forget Your Remembrance.
 I cry to You.

The following is found narrated on the authority of the Prophet (MGB): "I swear by Him who rightfully appointed me to the Prophethood that whoever says this prayer and fasts as a servant, God the Sublime will fend off the evils of the residents of the heavens and the earth, the Evil Ones and kings from him. Then you would have it available to perform. If the first of the month does not coincide with a Thursday, you should perform it on the first coming Thursday to be cautious and avoid negligence. We found the following highly honored narration on the deeds for the month of Shaâban on the authority of our Master Ali ibn Abi Talib (MGB), who narrated that Godâs Prophet (MGB) said, "On every Thursday of the month of Shaâban, the heavens are decorated and the angels say, âO God! Whoever fasts for one day during it, Godwould forbid the Hell-fire from touching his body.â â We read the following in another narration on the authority of the Prophet (MGB): âGod would grant anyone who fasts on the twenty-fifth day of Shaâban to get some reward. God would fulfill twenty of his needs in this world and twenty of his needs for the Hereafter.â FIRST DAY OF SHABAN -Imam Ali (as) Narration about Tree of Tuba and Zaqoom It is also worth mentioning that the book of Tafsir (exegesis of the Holy Qurâan) that is ascribed to the Imam (a.s.) has comprised a narration referring to the great value of the month of Shaâban. At the end of his Persian book of Kelimeh Teyyibeh, Shaykh al-Nuri, a master scholar, has referred to this narration, which is too long to be mentioned literally herein. However, let us refer to the summary of this wonderful narration: On the first day of Shaâban, Imam AliAmeer al-Momineen(a.s.) passed by a group of Muslims who sat in a mosque debating about theological matters, such as fatalism, with loud voices and intense arguments. The Imam (a.s.) stopped by them and greeted them. They responded to his greeting, made him room, and begged him to sit with them. However, the Imam (a.s.) did not care for them; rather, he addressed to them saying: âO you people who discuss matters that are neither their business nor benefiting them! You should have known that Almighty Allah has certain servants who are silent although they are neither inexpressive nor mute. Rather, whenever they consider the magnificence of Almighty Allah, their tongues die down, their hearts repose, their intellects halt, and their minds cease, on account of their glorifying, honoring, and feeling the majesty of Almighty Allah. When they regain consciousness, they compete with each other on seeking nearness to Him by means of pure acts. They regard themselves as wrongdoers and transgressors while they are free from any negligence or immoderation; rather, they do not accept to give little to Almighty Allah and they do not regard anything that they do for Him as adequate. They therefore exert all efforts in acts of worship to Him. When you notice them as they prepare themselves for acts of worship, you find them fearful, frightened, anxious, and terrified. Thus, great is the difference between them and you, the heretic people! You should have known that the more one may know about fatalism the more silent one will be. On the contrary, the most ignorant with fatalism are those who debate about it very much. O group of heretic people! This day is the first day of Shaâban, the honorable month. Our Lord has given it this name (i.e. Shaâban), because welfare is distributed in this month. Your Lord has opened wide the gates of His Paradise and offered you the palaces and bliss of Paradise with the cheapest costs and the easiest matters; therefore, you should purchase them. On the other hand, Iblis the cursed (i.e. Satan) has presented before you the varieties of his evils and ordeals. You always wander in the paths of error and tyranny, taking the paths of Iblis and missing the paths of goodness whose doors are open wide before you. This is the first day of Shaâban. The sections of its benefits are prayer, almsgiving, enjoining the right, forbidding the wrong, piety to parents, relatives and neighbors, setting aright matters of difference, and conferring upon the poor and the needy with charity. Nevertheless, you are discussing matters (i.e. fatality) that you are not asked to discuss and matters that you are asked not to deal with since they lead to revealing the secrets of Almighty Allah; and those who try to track the secrets of Almighty Allah shall be of those who will perish. text: Sahifa Alavia Index From Imam Ali (as) ) About Sahifa Alavia About Sahifa × Abdullah bin Saleh Samahiji collected the supplications of Hazrat Ameerul Momineen Ali Ibne Abi Talib (a.s.) and named the collection: Sahifa Alawiyyah. Other scholars also compiled their collections of Duas related from Imam Ali (a.s.) but the collection that became most popular was that of Abdullah bin Saleh. It had 160 Duas. Sahifa Alawiyyah was first published in 1305 A.H. (1887 A.D.) from Bombay. Then from Majmaâ al-Bahrayn Press, Ludhiana and after this in 1311 A.H. (1893 A.D.) from Tehran. The fourth time it was published from Nizami Press, Lucknow with translation and commentary in 1371 A.H. (1951 A.D.). But it is regretful that it did not mention the sources. The supplications of Sahifa Alawiyyah can be broadly divided into two sections. The expression of Allahâs slaveship and the entreaties of the supplicant. Each of the supplications is a masterpiece of the expression of ones helplessness before the grandeur of the Almighty and only a personality like Imam Ali (a.s.) could have composed such Duas. The present English Version is based on the Urdu translation of Sahifa Alawiya by Maulana Sayyid Murtuza Husain Lakhnavi, republished by Hyderi Kutub Khana. × . Zayn al-'Abidin (as)was the fourth of the Shi'ite Imams, after his father Husayn(as), his uncle Hasan(as), and his grandfather 'Ali(as), the Prophet's son-in-law. title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 50 Supplication in Fear

segments.translation: O God, You created me sound (or well-formed),
and You nurtured me when little, and You provided for me sufficiently.

1.O God, You created me without fault,

segments.translation: 20.If You chastisest me, I am worthy of that,

segments.transliteration: wa huwa yaa rab-bi minka a'd-l
segments.translation: 21.and it would be, my Lord, an act of justice from You.

segments.arabic: وَإنْ تَعْفُ  عَنِّي فَقَدِيماً شَمَلَنِي عَفْوُكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa in taa'-fu a'n-nee faqadeemana shamalanee a'f-wuk
segments.translation: 22.But if You pardonest me, anciently has Your pardon enfolded me
23.and Your well-being garmented me!
24.So I ask You, O God, by Your names stored in Your treasury
25.and Your splendour masked by the veils!
26.If You hast no mercy upon this anxious soul
27.and these uneasy, decaying bones -
28.he cannot endure the heat of Your sun,
29.so how can he endure the heat of Your Fire?
30.He cannot endure the sound of Your thunder,
31.so how can he endure the sound of Your wrath?

segments.arabic: فَارْحَمْنِي اللَّهُمَّ فَإنِّي امْرُؤٌ حَقِيرٌ، وَخَطَرِي يَسِيرٌ،
segments.transliteration: far-h'am-neel-laahum fa in-nee am-roo-un h'aqeer wa khat'aree yaseer
segments.translation: 32.So have mercy upon me, O God, for I am a vile man and my worth is little.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ عَذَابِي مِمَّا يَزِيدُ فِي مُلْكِكَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّة،
segments.transliteration: wa lay-sa a'd'aabee mim-maa yazeedu fee mul-kika mith-qaala d'ar-rah
segments.translation: 33.Chastising me will not add the weight of a dust mote to Your kingdom.

segments.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّ عَذَابِي مِمَّا يَزِيدُ فِي مُلْكِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa law an-na a'd'aabee mim-maa yazeedu fee mul-kik
segments.translation: 34.Were chastising me something that would add to Your kingdom,
35.I would ask You for patience to bear it
36.and would love for it to belong to You;
37.but Your authority, my God, is mightier,

segments.arabic: وَمُلْكُكَ أَدْوَمُ مِنْ أَنْ تَزِيـدَ فِيْهِ  طَاعَةُ الْمُطِيعِينَ،
segments.transliteration: wa mul-kuka ad-wam min an tazeeda feehee t'aaa'tul-mut'eee'en
segments.translation: 38.and Your kingdom more lasting, than that the obedience of the obeyers should increase it
39.or the disobedience of the sinners diminish it!
40.So have mercy upon me, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: وَتَجاوَزْ عَنِّي يا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإكْرَامِ،
segments.transliteration: wa tajaawaz a'n-nee yaa d'aal-jalaali wal-ik-raam
segments.translation: 41.Show me forbearance, O Possessor of majesty and munificence!

segments.arabic: وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ.
segments.translation: 42.And turn toward me, Surely You art Ever-turning, All-compassionate!

segments.arabic: وَ جَعَلَنَا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى مَنْ جَحَدَ،
segments.transliteration: wa jaâalanÄ shuhadÄâa âalÄ man jaá¸¥ad,
segments.translation: and made us witnesses against those who denied,

segments.transliteration: wa kaththaranÄ bi-mannihi âalÄ man qall.
segments.translation: and, by His grace, multiplied us over those who were few.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ أَمِينِكَ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma faá¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin amÄ«nika âalÄ waá¸¥yika,
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your trustee of Your revelation,
Your chosen one from Your creation,
and Your pure one from Your servants,
the leader of mercy and the guide to goodness,
and the key to blessings.
Just as he dedicated himself to Your command,
and exposed his body to harm for Your sake,

segments.transliteration: wa kÄshafa fÄ« ad-duâÄâi ilayka á¸¥Ämmatahu,
segments.translation: and faced his close kin openly in calling to You,
and fought his own family for Your pleasure,

segments.transliteration: wa qaá¹­aâa fÄ« iá¸¥yÄâi dÄ«nika raá¸¥imahu,
segments.translation: and severed his ties for the revival of Your religion,

segments.transliteration: wa aqá¹£Ä al-adnayn âalÄ juá¸¥Å«di him,
segments.translation: and distanced those closest to him for their denial,

segments.arabic: وَ قَرَّبَ الْأَقْصَيْنَ عَلَى اسْتِجَابَتِهِمْ لَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa qarraba al-aqá¹£ayn âalÄ istijÄbatihim laka,
segments.translation: and drew near those most distant for their response to You,
and befriended the furthest for Your sake,
and antagonized the closest for Your sake.

segments.arabic: وَ أَدْأَبَ نَفْسَهُ فِي تَبْلِيغِ رِسَالَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa adâaba nafsahu fÄ« tablÄ«ghi risÄlatika,
segments.translation: And he tirelessly exerted himself in conveying Your message,
and wearied himself with calling to Your faith,

segments.transliteration: wa shaghala ha bi-an-nuá¹£á¸¥i li-ahli daâwatika,
segments.translation: and occupied himself with advising the people of Your call.
He migrated to a foreign land,

segments.transliteration: wa maá¸¥alli an-naâyi âan mawá¹­ini raá¸¥lihi,
segments.translation: a place far from his homeland,

segments.transliteration: wa mawá¸iâi rijlihi wa masqaá¹­i raâsihi,
segments.translation: and the walkway of his steps, his birthplace and of his forefathers,
and the comfort of his soul,
with the intention of giving Your religion glory,

segments.transliteration: wa istiná¹£Äran âalÄ ahli al-kufri bika,
segments.translation: and seeking Your help against the people of disbelief in You.

segments.arabic: حَتَّى ٱسْتَتَبَّ لَهُ مَا حَاوَلَ فِي أَعْدَائِكَ،
segments.transliteration: á¸¥attÄ istatabba lahu mÄ á¸¥Äwala fÄ« aâdÄâika,
segments.translation: Until what he strove for against Your enemies was established for him,

segments.arabic: وَاسْتَتَمَّ لَهُ مَا دَبَّرَ فِي أَوْلِيآئِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa istatamma lahu mÄ dabbara fÄ« awliyÄâika,
segments.translation: and what he planned for Your friends(awliya)  was completed for him.
So he rose against them, seeking victory with Your help,
and strengthening himself against his weakness with Your victory.
He raided them in the heart of their homes,

segments.transliteration: wa hajama âalayhim fÄ« buá¸¥bÅ«á¸¥ati qarÄrihim,
segments.translation: and attacked them in the midst of their settled places,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى ظَهَرَ أَمْرُكَ وَعَلَتْ كَلِمَتُكَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ.
segments.transliteration: á¸¥attÄ áºahara amruka wa âalat kalimatuka wa law kariha al-mushrikÅ«n.
segments.translation: until Your command became manifest and Your word was exalted, even though the polytheists disliked it.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَارْفَعْهُ بِمَا كَدَحَ فِيكَ إِلٰى الدَّرَجَةِ الْعُلْيَا مِنْ جَنَّتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma farfaâhu bimÄ kadaá¸¥a fÄ«ka ilÄ ad-darajati al-âulyÄ min jannatika,
segments.translation: O Allah, for his striving in Your cause, raise him to the highest rank in Your Paradise,
so that he is not equaled in station,
and not matched in rank,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يُوَازِيَهُ لَدَيْكَ مَلَكٌ مُقَرَّبٌ وَلَا نَبِيٌّ مُرْسَلٌ.
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ yuwÄziyahu ladayka malakun muqarrabun wa lÄ nabÄ«yun mursal.
segments.translation: and no close angel or sent prophet can be his equal in Your presence.

segments.arabic: وَعَرِّفْهُ فِي أَهْلِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَاُمَّتِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ حُسْنِ الشَّفَاعَةِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa âarrifhu fÄ« ahlihi aá¹­-á¹­ÄhirÄ«na wa ummatihi al-muâminÄ«na min á¸¥usni ash-shafÄâah,
segments.translation: And grant him, in the presence of his purified family and his believing nation, the best of intercession,
the most magnificent of what You have promised him.
O You who fulfill promises,
O You who are true to Your word,

segments.arabic: يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ،
segments.transliteration: yÄ mubaddila as-sayyiâÄti bi-aá¸âÄfihÄ mina al-á¸¥asanÄt,
segments.translation: O You who exchange bad deeds for many times their like in good deeds.

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ الْجَوَادُ اَلْكَرِيمُ.
segments.transliteration: innaka dhÅ« al-faá¸li al-âaáºÄ«mi al-jawÄdu al-karÄ«m.
segments.translation: Truly, You are the Possessor of immense favor, the Generous, the Bountiful.
1. Praise belongs to God who was kind to us

segments.arabic: بِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
segments.translation: 2. through Muhammad, His Prophet (God bless him and his Household)
3. to the exclusion of past communities and bygone generations,

segments.arabic: بِقُدْرَتِهِ الَّتِي لَا تَعْجِزُ عَنْ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ إِنْ عَظُمَ
segments.transliteration: biqud-ratihil-latee laa taa'-jizu a'n shay-iw-wa in a'z'um
segments.translation: 4. displaying thereby His power, which nothing can render incapable though it be great,

segments.arabic: وَ لا يَفُوتُهَا شَيءٌ وَإنْ لَطُفَ،
segments.translation: 5. and nothing can escape though it be subtle.

segments.transliteration: fakhatama binaa a'laa jameei' man d'araa
segments.translation: 6. He sealed through us all He created,

segments.arabic: وَ جَعَلَنَا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى مَنْ جَحَدَ
segments.transliteration: wa jaa'lanaa shuhadaaa-a a'laa man jah'ad
segments.translation: 7. appointed us witnesses over those who deny,

segments.transliteration: wa kath-tharanaa biman-nihee a'laa man qal
segments.translation: 8. and increased us by His kindness over those who are few.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ أَمِينِكَ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-mad ameenika a'laa wah'-yik
segments.translation: 9. O God, bless Muhammad, entrusted by You with Your revelation,
10. distinguished by You among Your creatures,
11. devoted to You among Your servants,
12. the imam of mercy, the leader of good,
13. the key to blessing,
14. who wearied his soul for Your affairs,
15. exposed his body to detested things for Your sake,
16. showed open enmity toward his next of kin by summoning to You,
17. fought against his family for Your good pleasure,

segments.transliteration: wa qat'aa' feee ih'-yaaa-i deenika rah'imah
segments.translation: 18. cut the ties of the womb in giving life to Your religion,
19. sent far those close because of their denial,

segments.arabic: وَ قَرَّبَ الْأَقْصَيْنَ عَلَى اسْتِجَابَتِهِمْ لَكَ
segments.translation: 20. brought near those far because of their response to You,
21. showed friendship to the most distant for Your sake,
22. displayed enmity toward the nearest for Your sake,

segments.arabic: و أَدْأَبَ نَفْسَهُ فِي تَبْلِيغِ رِسَالَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa ad-aba naf-sahoo fee tab-leeghi risaalatik
segments.translation: 23. made his soul persevere in delivering Your message,
24. tired it in summoning to Your creed,
25. busied it in counselling those worthy of Your summons,
26. migrated to the land of exile
27. and the place of remoteness from the home of his saddlebags,

segments.transliteration: wa mawz''ii' rij-lih wa mas-qat'i raa-sih
segments.translation: 28. the walkway of his feet, the ground of his birth,

segments.arabic: وَمَأْنَسِ نَفْسِهِ إِرَادَةً مِنْهُ لِإِعْزَازِ دِينِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa maa-nasi naf-sihee iraadatam-min-hoo liia'-zaazi deenik
segments.translation: 29. and the intimate abode of his soul, desiring to exalt Your religion
30. and seeking help against those who disbelieved in You,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى ٱسْتَتَبَّ لَهُ مَا حَاوَلَ فِي أَعْدَائِكَ
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa as-tatab-ba lahoo maa h'aawala feee aa'-daaa-ik
segments.translation: 31. until what he attempted against Your enemies went well with him

segments.arabic: وَاسْتَتَمَّ لَهُ مَا دَبَّرَ فِي أَوْلِيآئِكَ
segments.transliteration: was-tatam-ma lahoo maa dab-bara feee aw-leeaaa-ik
segments.translation: 32. and what he arranged for Your friends was accomplished.
33. He rose up against them seeking victory through Thine aid,
34. becoming strong in spite of his weakness with Your help.
35. He fought against them in the centre of their cities

segments.transliteration: wa hajama a'lay-him fee buh'-booh'ati qaraarihim
segments.translation: 36. and attacked them in the midst of their dwellings,
37. until Your command prevailed,

segments.transliteration: wa a'lat kalimatuka wa law karihal-mush-rikoon
segments.translation: 38. and Your word rose up, though the idolaters were averse.
39. O God, so raise him, because of his labours for Your sake,
40. to the highest degree of Your Garden,
41. that none may equal him in station,
42. none may match him in level,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يُوَازِيَهُ لَدَيْكَ مَلَكٌ مُقَرَّبٌ وَلَا نَبِيٌّ مُرْسَلٌ
segments.transliteration: wa laa yuwaazeehoo laday-ka malakum-muqar-raboo-wa laa nabee-yum-mur-sal
segments.translation: 43. and no angel brought nigh or prophet sent out may parallel him in Your sight.
44. And inform him concerning his Household the pure
45. and his community the faithful of an excellent intercession,

segments.arabic: أَجَلَّ مَا وَعَدْتَهُ يَا نَافِذَ الْعِدَةِ
segments.translation: 46. greater than what You hast promised him! O Keeper of promises!

segments.arabic: يَا وَافِىَ الْقَوْلِ يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ
segments.transliteration: yaa waafeeal-qaw-l yaa mubad-dilas-say-yi-aati biz''-a'afihaa minal-h'asanaat
segments.translation: 47. O Faithful to Your word! O He who changes evil deeds into manifold good deeds!

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ الْجَوَادُ اَلْكَرِيمُ
segments.translation: 48. You art of bounty abounding!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 27 His Supplication for People of the Frontiers

segments.translation: 1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
2.fortify the frontiers of the Muslims through Your might,
3.support their defenders through Your strength,
4.and lavish upon them gifts through Your wealth!
5.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
6.increase their number, hone their weapons,
7.guard their territory, defend their midst,

segments.transliteration: wa al-lif jam-a'hum- wa db-bir am-rahum
segments.translation: 8.unite their throng, arrange their affair,

segments.arabic: وَوَاتِرْ بَيْنَ مِيَرِهِمْ، وَتَوَحَّدْ بِكِفَايَةِ مَؤَنِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa waatir bay-na meearihim- wa tawah'-h'ad bikifaayati moo-anihim
segments.translation: 9.send them supplies in a steady string, undertake Yourself to suffice them with provisions,
10.support them with victory, help them with patience,
11.and give them subtlety in guile!
12.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
13.give them the knowledge of that of which they are ignorant,
14.teach them what they do not know,
15.and show them what they do not see!
16.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
17.make them forget when they meet the enemy
18.to remember this cheating and delusive world of theirs,

segments.arabic: وَامْحُ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ خَطَرَاتِ الْمَالِ الْفَتُونِ،
segments.translation: 19.erase from their hearts the thought of enchanting possessions,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلِ الْجَنَّةَ نَصْبَ أَعْيُنِهِمْ وَلَوِّحْ مِنْهَا لأِبْصَارِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: waj-a'lil-jan-nata nas'-ba aa'-yunihim- wa law-wih' min-haa liab-s'aarihim
segments.translation: 20.place the Garden before their eyes, and display to their sight that part of it

segments.arabic: مَا أَعْدَدْتَ فِيهَا مِنْ مَسَاكِنِ الْخُلْدِ وَمَنَازِلِ الْكَرَامَةِ
segments.transliteration: maaa aa'-dat-ta feehaa min- masaakinil-khul-d wa manaazilil-karaamah
segments.translation: 21.which You hast prepared for them - the homes of everlastingness and mansions of honour,

segments.arabic: وَالْحُورِ الْحِسَانِ وَالأَنْهَارِ الْمُطَّرِدَةِ بِأَنْوَاعِ الأَشْرِبَـةِ ،
segments.translation: 22.the beautiful houris, the rivers gushing forth with all sorts of drinks,
23.the trees hanging, low with all kinds of fruits -

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ يَهُمَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ بِالأدْبَارِ،
segments.translation: 24.lest any of them think of turning his back

segments.arabic: وَلا يُحَدِّثَ نَفْسَهُ عَنْ قِرْنِهِ بِفِرَار.
segments.transliteration: wa laa yuh'ad-ditha naf-sahoo a'n qir-nihee bifraar
segments.translation: 25.or suggest to himself to flee his opponent!
26.O God, defeat their enemy through that,

segments.arabic: وَاقْلِمْ عَنْهُمْ أَظْفَارَهُمْ، وَفَرِّقْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَسْلِحَتِهِمْ ،
segments.transliteration: wa aq-lim a'n-hum az'-faarahum- wa far-riq bay-nahum wabay-na as-lih'atihim
segments.translation: 27.trim their nails from them, separate them from their weapons,

segments.arabic: وَاخْلَعْ وَثَائِقَ أَفْئِدَتِهِمْ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَزْوِدَتِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: wakh-laa' wathaaa-iqa af-idatihim- wa baai'd bay-nahum wabay-na az-widatihim
segments.translation: 28.pull out the firm ties from their hearts, keep them far away from their stores,

segments.arabic: وَحَيِّرْهُمْ فِي سُبُلِهِمْ، وَضَلِّلْهُمْ عَنْ وَجْهِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa h'ay-yir-hum fee subulihim- wa z''al-lil-hum a'w-waj-hihim
segments.translation: 29.bewilder them in their roads, turn them astray from their direction,

segments.arabic: وَاقْـطَعْ عَنْهُمُ الْمَدَدَ وَانْقُصْ مِنْهُمُ الْعَدَدَ،
segments.translation: 30.cut off reinforcements from them, chop them down in numbers,

segments.arabic: وَامْلاْ أَفْئِدَتَهُمُ الرُّعْبَ، وَاقْبِضْ أَيْـدِيَهُمْ عَنِ البَسْطِ،
segments.translation: 31.fill their hearts with terror, hold back their hands from stretching forth,
32.tie back their tongues from speaking,

segments.arabic: وَشَرِّدْ بهِمْ مَنْ خَلْفَهُمْ، وَنَكِّلْ بِهِمْ مَنْ وَرَاءَهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa shar-rid bihim man khal-fahum- wa nak-kil bihim maw-waraaa-ahum
segments.translation: 33."scatter by them the ones behind them" (8:57), make them a lesson for those beyond them,
34.and through their degradation cut off the hopes of those who come after them!
35.O God, make the wombs of their women barren
36.dry up the loins of their men,
37.cut off the breeding of their mounts and their cattle,

segments.arabic: لاَ تَأذَنْ لِسَمَائِهِمْ فِي قَطْر وَلاَ لارْضِهِمْ فِي نَبَات.
segments.transliteration: laa taa-d'al-lisamaaa-ihim fee qat'-r wa laa liar-z''ihim fee nabaat
segments.translation: 38.and permit not their sky to rain or their earth to grow!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَقَوِّ بِذَلِكَ مِحَالَّ أَهْلِ الإسْلاَمِ ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa qaw-wi bid'alika mih'aala ah-lil-is-laam
segments.translation: 39.O God, through that strengthen the prowess of the People of Islam,

segments.arabic: وَحَصِّنْ بِهِ دِيَارَهُمْ ، وَثَمِّرْ بِـهِ أَمْوَالَهُمْ ،
segments.transliteration: wa h'as'-s'im-bihee deeaarahum- wa tham-mir biheee am-waalahum
segments.translation: 40.fortify their cities, increase their properties,

segments.arabic: وَفَرِّغْهُمْ عَنْ مُحَارَبَتِهِمْ لِعِبَادَتِكَ وَعَنْ مُنَابَذَتِهِمْ للْخَلْوَةِ بِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa far-righ-hum a'm-muh'aarabatihim lii'baadatika wa a'm-munaabad'atihim lil-khal-wati bika
segments.translation: 41.give them ease from their fighting to worship You and from their warfare to be alone with You,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لا يُعْبَدَ فِي بِقَاعِ الارْضِ غَيْرُكَ
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa laa yua'-bada fee biqaai'l-ar-z''i ghay-ruk
segments.translation: 42.so that none will be worshipped in the regions of the earth but You

segments.arabic: وَلاَ  تُعَفَّرَ لاَِحَد مِنْهُمْ جَبْهَةٌ دُونَكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa tua'f-fara liah'adim-min-hum jab-hatun doonak
segments.translation: 43.and no forehead of theirs may be rubbed in dust for less than You!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اغزُ بِكُلِّ نَـاحِيَـة مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
segments.translation: 44.O God, send out the Muslims of every region on raids
45.against the idolaters who face them!
46.Reinforce them with angels in ranks from You,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى يَكْشِفُـوهُمْ إلَى مُنْقَطَعِ التُّـرابِ قَتْـلاً فِي أَرْضِكَ
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa yak-shifoohum ilaa munqat'ai't-turaabi qat-lan feee ar-z''ika
segments.translation: 47.till the idolaters are routed by them to the end of the land, slain in Your earth

segments.arabic: وَأَسْراً أَوْ يُقِرُّوا بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ الَّذِي لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ
segments.transliteration: wa as-raa aw yuqir-roo bin-naka antal-laahool-lad'ee laaa ilaha il-laaa ant
segments.translation: 48.or taken captive, or till they admit that You art God, other than whom there is no god,
49.You alone, who hast no associate!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَاعْمُمْ بِذَلِكَ أَعْدَاءَكَ فِي أَقْطَارِ الْبِلاَدِ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma waa'-mum bid'alika aa'-daaa-aka feee aq-t'aaril-bilaadi
segments.translation: 50.O God, include in this Your enemies in the regions of the lands,

segments.arabic: مِنَ الْهِنْدِ وَالرُّومِ وَالتُّـرْكِ وَالْخَزَرِ وَالْحَبَشِ
segments.translation: 51.the Indians, the Byzantines, the Turks, the Khazars, the Abyssinians,
52.the Nubians, the Zanjis, the Slavs, the Daylamites,

segments.arabic: وَسَائِرِ أُمَمِ الشِّرْكِ الَّذِي تَخْفَى أَسْمَاؤُهُمْ وَصِفاتُهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa saaa-iri umamish-shir-kil-lad'eena takh-faaa as-maaa-uhum wa s'ifaatuhum
segments.translation: 53.and the rest of the idol-worshipping nations, those whose names and attributes are concealed,

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ أَحْصَيْتَهُمْ بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ، وَأَشْرَفْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa qad ah'-s'ay-tahum bimaa'-rifatik wa ash-raf-ta a'lay-him biqud-ratik
segments.translation: 54.but whom You countest in Your cognizance and overseest through Your power!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اشْغَلِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ بِالمُشْرِكِينَ عَنْ تَنَاوُلِ أَطْرَافِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma ash-ghalil-mush-rikeena bil-mush-rikeena a'n tanaawli at'-raafil-muslimeen
segments.translation: 55.O God, distract the idolaters from reaching for the borders of the Muslims through the idolaters,
56.bar them from cutting them down through being cut down,
57.and hold them back from massing together against them through dissension!
58.O God, empty their hearts of security

segments.arabic: وَأَبْدَانَهُمْ مِنَ الْقُوَّةِ وَأَذْهِلْ قُلُوبَهُمْ عَنِ الاحْتِيَالِ
segments.transliteration: wa ab-daanahum mina alqoo-wah wa ad'-hil quloobahum a'nilih'-teeaal
segments.translation: 59.and their bodies of strength, distract their hearts from thinking of stratagems,
60.make their limbs too feeble for clashing with men,
61.make them too cowardly for contending with champions,
62.send against them a troop of Your angels

segments.arabic: بِبَأس مِنْ بَأْسِكَ كَفِعْلِكَ يَوْمَ بَدْر
segments.translation: 63.with some of Your severity as You didst on the Day of Badr,

segments.arabic: تَقْطَعُ بِهِ دَابِرَهُمْ وَتَحْصُدُ بِهِ شَوْكَتَهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: taq-t'au' bihee daabirahum- wa tah'-s'udu bihee shaw-katahum
segments.translation: 64.so that through it You mayest cut off their roots, harvest their thorns,
65.and disperse their number!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَامْزُجْ مِيَاهَهُمْ بِالْوَبَاءِ وَأطْعِمَتَهُمْ بِالأَدْوَاءِ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wam-zuj meeaahahum bil-wabaaa-i wa at'-i'matahum bil-ad-waaa-i
segments.translation: 66.O God, mix their waters with pestilence and their foods with maladies,

segments.arabic: وَارْمِ بِلاَدَهُمْ بِالْخُسُوفِ وَأَلِـحَّ عَلَيْهَا بِـالْقُذُوفِ وَافْـرَعْهَا بِالْمُحُولِ.
segments.transliteration: war-mi bilaadahum bil-khusoof wa alih'-h'a a'lay-haa bil-qud'oof waf-raa'-haa bil-muh'ool
segments.translation: 67.hurl down their cities, harass them with peltings, hinder them through drought,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ مِيَرَهُمْ فِي أَحَصِّ أَرْضِكَ وَأَبْعَـدِهَا عَنْهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l meearahum feee ah'as'-s'i ar-z''ika wa ab-a'dihaa a'n-hum
segments.translation: 68.place their supplies in the most ill-omened part of Your earth and the farthest from them,

segments.arabic: وَامْنَـعْ حُصُونَهَا مِنْهُمْ، أَصِبْهُمْ بِالْجُوعِ الْمُقِيمِ وَالسُّقْمِ الالِيمِ.
segments.transliteration: wam-naa' h'us'oonahaa min-hum- as'ib-hum bil-jooi'l-muqeemi was-suq-mil-aleem
segments.translation: 69.bar them from its fortresses, and strike them with constant hunger and painful illness!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا غَاز  غَزَاهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa ay-yumaa ghaazin ghazaahum min ah-li mil-latik
segments.translation: 70.O God, if a warrior from the people of Your creed wars against them

segments.arabic: أَوْ مُجَاهِد جَاهَدَهُمْ مِنْ أَتْبَاعِ سُنَّتِكَ لِيَكُونَ دِينُكَ الاعْلَى
segments.transliteration: aw mujaahidin jaahadahum min atabaai' sun-natik leeakoona deenukal-aa'-laa
segments.translation: 71.or a struggler from the followers of Your prescriptions struggles against them so that Your religion may be the highest,

segments.arabic: وَحِزْبُكَ الأقوَى وَحَظُّكَ الأوْفَى فَلَقِّهِ الْيُسْرَ،
segments.translation: 72.Your party the strongest, and Your share the fullest, cast ease to him,

segments.transliteration: wa hay-yi lahul-am-r wa tawal-lahoo bin-nuj-h'
segments.translation: 73.arrange his affair, attend to him by granting success,

segments.arabic: وَتَخَيَّرْ لَهُ الأصْحَابَ، وَاسْتَقْوِ لَهُ الظَّهْرَ،
segments.translation: 74.select for him his companions, strengthen his back,

segments.arabic: وَأَسْبِغْ عَلَيْهِ فِي النَّفَقَةِ وَمَتِّعْهُ بِالنَّشَاطِ،
segments.transliteration: wa as-bigh a'lay-hee fin-nafaqah wa mat-tia'-hoo bin-nashaat'
segments.translation: 75.lavish upon him livelihood, give him enjoyment of joyous vitality,

segments.arabic: وَأَطْفِ عَنْهُ حَرَارَةَ الشَّوْقِ، وَأَجِرْهُ مِنْ غَمِّ الْوَحْشَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wat'-fi a'n-hoo h'araaratash-shaw-q wa ajir-hoo min gham-mil-wah'-shah
segments.translation: 76.cool for him the heat of yearning, give him sanctuary from the gloom of loneliness,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْسِهِ ذِكْرَ الاهْلِ وَالْوَلَدِ وَأَثُرْ لَهُ حُسْنَ النِّيَّةِ وَتَوَلَّه بِالْعَافِيَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa ansihee d'ik-ral-ah-li wal-walad wa aaathur lahoo h'us-nan-nee-yah wa tawal-lahoo bil-a'afeeah
segments.translation: 77.make him forget the remembrance of wife and child, pass along to him an excellent intention, attend to him with well-being,
78.make safety his companion, release him from cowardice,

segments.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْهُ الْجُرْأَةَ وَارْزُقْهُ الشِّدَّةَ وَأَيِّدْهُ بِالنُّصْرَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa al-him-hul-jur-ah war-zuq-hush-shid-dah wa ay-yid-hoo bin-nus'-rah
segments.translation: 79.inspire him with boldness, provide him with strength, support him with help,

segments.arabic: وَعَلِّمْهُ السِّيَرَ وَالسُّنَنَ، وَسَدِّدْهُ فِي الْحُكْمِ،
segments.transliteration: wa a'l-lim-hus-seeara was-sunan wa sad-did-hoo fil-h'uk-m
segments.translation: 80.teach him right conduct and the norms of the Sunna, point him straight in judgement,

segments.arabic: وَاعْزِلْ عَنْهُ الرِّياءَ، وخَلِّصْهُ مِنَ السُّمْعَةِ
segments.translation: 81.remove from him hypocrisy, purify him from seeking fame,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ فِكْرَهُ وَذِكْرَهُ وَظَعْنَهُ وَإقَامَتَهُ فِيْكَ وَلَكَ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l fik-rahoo wad'ik-rahoo waz'aa'-nahoo waaqaamatahoo feeka wa lak
segments.translation: 82.and make his thinking and remembrance, his departing and his staying, be in You and for You!

segments.arabic: فَإذا صَافَّ عَدُوَّكَ وَعَدُوَّهُ فَقَلِّلْهُمْ فِي عَيْنِهِ
segments.transliteration: faad'aa s'aaaf-fa a'doo-waka waa'doo-wahoo faqal-lil-hum fee a'y-nih
segments.translation: 83.When he stands in ranks before Your enemy and his enemy, make them few in his eye,
84.diminish their importance in his heart,

segments.arabic: وَأَدِلْ لَهُ مِنْهُـمْ وَلاَ تُدِلْهُمْ مِنْهُ
segments.transliteration: wa adil-lahoo min-hum- wa laa tudil-hum min-h
segments.translation: 85.give him a turn to prevail over them, not them a turn to prevail over him!

segments.arabic: فَإنْ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِالسَّعَادَةِ وَقَضَيْتَ لَهُ بِالشَّهَادَةِ
segments.transliteration: faan khatam-ta lahoo bis-saa'adati wa qaz''ay-ta lahoo bish-shahaadah
segments.translation: 86.But if You sealest him with felicity and decreest for him martyrdom,
87.then let it be after he has exterminated Your enemies by slaying,
88.captivity has afflicted them,
89.the borders of the Muslims are secure,
90.and Your enemy has turned his back in flight!

segments.arabic: Ø£ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ£ÙÙÙÙÙÙØ§ ÙÙØ³ÙÙÙÙ
segments.translation: 91.O God, and if a Muslim should

segments.arabic: خَلَفَ غَازِياً أَوْ مُرَابِطاً فِي دَارِهِ
segments.transliteration: khalafa ghaazeean aw muraabit'an fee daarih
segments.translation: 92.take the place of a warrior or a soldier in his home,
93.attend to those left behind in his absence,
94.help him with a portion of his property,

segments.arabic: أَوْ أَمَدَّهُ بِعِتَاد، أَوْ شَحَذَهُ عَلَى جِهَاد،
segments.transliteration: aw amad-dahoo bia'taad aw shah'ad'ahoo a'laa jihaad
segments.translation: 95.assist him with equipment, hone him for the struggle,
96.send along with him a supplication for his purpose,

segments.arabic: أَوْ رَعَى لَهُ مِنْ وَرَآئِهِ حُرْمَةً.
segments.translation: 97.or guard his honour in his absence,
98.reward him with the like of his reward

segments.arabic: وَزْناً بِوَزْن وَمِثْلاً بِمِثْل وَعَوِّضْهُ مِنْ فِعْلِهِ
segments.transliteration: waz-nam-biwaz-niw-wa mith-lam-bimith-l wa a'w-wiz''-hoo min fi'-lihee
segments.translation: 99.measure for measure, like for like, and recompense him for his act

segments.arabic: عِوَضاً حَاضِراً يَتَعَجَّلُ بِهِ نَفْعَ مَا قَدَّمَ،
segments.transliteration: i'waz''ana h'aaz''iray-yataa'j-jalu bihee naf-a' maa qad-dama
segments.translation: 100.with an immediate compensation through which he will hasten to the profit of what he has sent forth

segments.arabic: وَسُرُورَ مَا أَتَى به، إلَى أَنْ  يَنْتَهِيَ بِهِ الْوَقْتُ
segments.transliteration: wa suroora maaa ataa biheee ilaaa ay-yantaheea bihil-waq-tu
segments.translation: 101.and the joy of what he has given, till the present moment takes him

segments.transliteration: ilaa maa aj-ray-ta lahoo min faz''-lik
segments.translation: 102.to the bounty You hast granted to him
103.and the generosity You hast prepared for him!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا  مُسْلِم أَهَمَّهُ أَمْرُ الإِسْلاَمِ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa ay-yumaa mus-limin aham-mahooo am-rul-is-laam
segments.translation: 104.O God, and if the affair of Islam should worry a Muslim
105.and the alliance of the idolaters' against Islam should grieve him,
106.so that he has the intention to go to war and is about to enter the struggle,

segments.arabic: فَقَعَدَ بِـهِ ضَعْفٌ أَوْ أَبطَأَتْ بِهِ فَاقَةٌ،
segments.transliteration: faqaa'da bihee z''aa'-f aw ab-t'aat bihee faaqah
segments.translation: 107.but frailty keeps him seated, neediness keeps him waiting,
108.a mishap delays him,

segments.arabic: أَوْ عَرَضَ لَهُ دُونَ إرَادَتِهِ  مَانِعٌ،
segments.transliteration: aw a'raz''a lahoo doona iraadatihee maania'
segments.translation: 109.or an obstruction prevents him from his wish,
110.write his name among the worshipers,
111.make incumbent for him the reward of the strugglers,
112.and place him among the ranks of the martyrs and the righteous!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madin a'b-dika wa rasoolika
segments.translation: 113.O God, bless Muhammad, Your slave and Your messenger,

segments.arabic: وَآلِ مُحَمَّد صَلاَةً عَالِيَةً عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ
segments.transliteration: wa aaali muh'am-madin s'alaatan a'aleeatan a'laas'-s'alawaat
segments.translation: 114.and the Household of Muhammad, with a blessing high above all other blessings,
115.towering beyond all other salutations,
116.a blessing whose end is never reached
117.and whose number is never cut off,
118.like the most perfect of Your blessings that has passed
119.to any one of Your friends!
120.You art All-kind, Praiseworthy,
121.the Originator who takes back again,
122.Accomplisher of what You desirest.

segments.transliteration: wa ia'-t'aaa-i maa yajibu lahum qab-las-soo-aal
segments.translation: 11.and giving what is due to them before they ask!

segments.transliteration: w aj-a'l-nee al-laahum aj-zee bil-ih'-saani musee-ahum
segments.translation: 12.Let me, O God, repay their evildoer with good-doing,
13.turn away from their wrongdoer with forbearance.

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَعْمِلْ حُسْنَ الظّنِّ فِي كَافَّتِهِمْ، وَأَتَوَلَّى بِالْبِرِّ عَامَّتَهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa as-taa'-milu h'us-naz'-z'an-ni fee kaaaf-fatihim- wa atawal-laa bil-bir-ri a'aam-matahum
segments.translation: 14.have a good opinion of every one of them, attend to all of them with devotion,
15.lower my eyes before them in continence,
16.make mild my side toward them in humility,

segments.arabic: وَأَرِقُّ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْبَلاءِ مِنْهُمْ رَحْمَةً،
segments.transliteration: wa ariq-qu a'laaa ah-lil-balaaa-i min-hum rah'-mah
segments.translation: 17.be tender toward the afflicted among them in mercy,
18.make them happy in absence through affection,
19.love that they continue to receive favour through good will,

segments.transliteration: wa oojibu lahum maaa oojibu lih'aaam-matee
segments.translation: 20.grant them what I grant my next of kin,

segments.transliteration: wa sr-a'a lahum maaa ar-a'a likhaaas'-s'atee
segments.translation: 21.and observe for them what I observe for my special friends!
22.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
23.provide me the like of that from them,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لِي أَوْفَى الْحُظُوظِ فِيمَا عِنْدَهُمْ ،
segments.translation: 24.appoint for me the fullest share of what is with them,

segments.arabic: وَزِدْهُمْ بَصِيْرَةً فِي حَقِّي، وَمَعْرِفَةً بِفَضْلِي،
segments.transliteration: wa zid-hum bas'eeratan fee h'aq-qee wa maa'-rifatam-bifaz''-lee
segments.translation: 25.increase them in insight toward my right and knowledge of my excellence

segments.transliteration: h'at-taa yas-a'doo bee wa as-a'da bihim-
segments.translation: 26.so that they will be fortunate through me and I fortunate through them!
27.Amen, Lord of the worlds!

our acquaintance we long for,

segments.translation: When You bring it upon us and send it down to us,

segments.translation: do not make us wretched by hosting it or disgrace us by its visit.

segments.translation: Make it a gate from the gates of Your forgiveness,
and a key from the keys of Your mercy.
Cause us to die guided, not astray,
obedient, not reluctant,

segments.translation: repentant, not rebellious nor persisting in sin,
O Guarantor of the reward of the righteous,
and Reformer of the deeds of the corrupt!
1.O God, Bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَاكْفِنَا طُـولَ الأمَـلِ، وَقَصِّرْهُ عَنَّا بِصِدْقِ الْعَمَلِ
segments.transliteration: wak-finaa t'oolal-amal wa qas'-s'ir-hoo a'n-naa bis'id-qil-a'mal
segments.translation: 2.spare us drawn out expectations and cut them short in us through sincerity of works,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لا نُؤَمِّلَ اسْتِتْمَامَ سَاعَةٍ بَعْدَ سَاعَةٍ
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa laa noo-am-mila is-tit-maama saaa'tim-baa'-da saaa'h
segments.translation: 3.that we may not hope expectantly for completing an hour after an hour,
4.closing a day after a day,
5.joining a breath to a breath,
6.or overtaking a step with a step!

segments.arabic: وَسَلِّمْنَا مِنْ غُرُورِهِ، وَآمَنَّا مِنْ شُـرُوْرِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa sal-lim-naa min ghuroorih wa aaamin-naa min shuroorih
segments.translation: 7.Keep us safe from the delusions of expectations, make us secure from their evils,
8.set up death before us in display.

segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-a'l d'ik-ranaa lahoo ghib-baa
segments.translation: 9.and let not our remembering of it come and go!
10.Appoint for us from among the righteous works
11.a work through which we will feel the homecoming to You as slow

segments.arabic: وَنحْـرِصُ لَهُ عَلَى وَشْكِ اللِّحَاقِ بِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa nah'-ris'u lahoo a'laa wash-kil-lah'aaqi bik
segments.translation: 12.and crave a quick joining with You,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى يَكُونَ الْمَوْتُ مَأنَسَنَا الَّذِي نَأنَسُ بِهِ،
segments.translation: 13.so that death may be our intimate abode with which we are intimate,

segments.arabic: وَمَألَفَنَا الَّذِي نَشْتَاقُ إلَيْهِ، وَحَامَّتَنَا الَّتِي نُحِبُّ الدُّنُوَّ مِنْهَا
segments.transliteration: wa maa-lafanaal-lad'ee nash-taaqu ilay-h wa h'aaam-matanaal-latee nuh'ib-bud-dunoo-wa min-haa
segments.translation: 14.our familiar place toward which we yearn, and our next of kin whose coming we love!

segments.transliteration: fa id'aaa aw-rat-tahoo a'lay-naa wa anzal-tahoo binaa
segments.translation: 15.When You bringest it to us and sendest it down upon us,

segments.arabic: فَأسْعِدْنَا بِهِ زَائِراً، وَآنِسْنَا بِهِ قَادِماً،
segments.transliteration: faas-i'd-naa bihee zaaa-iraa wa aaanis-naa bihee qaadimaa
segments.translation: 16.make us happy with it as a visitor, comfort us with its arrival,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُشْقِنَا بِضِيافَتِهِ، وَلا تُخْزِنَا بِزِيارَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tush-qinaa biz''eeaafatih wa laa tukh-zinaa bizeeaaratih
segments.translation: 17.make us not wretched through entertaining it, degrade us not through its visit,
18.and appoint it one of the gates to Your forgiveness
19.and the keys to Your mercy!
20.Make us die guided, not astray,

segments.arabic: طائِعِينَ غَيْرَ مُسْتَكْرِهِينَ تَائِبينَ غَيْرَ عاصِينَ وَلا مُصِرِّينَ
segments.transliteration: t'aaa-ie'ena ghay-ra mus-tak-riheen taaa-ibeena ghay-ra a'as'eena wa laa mus'ir-reen
segments.translation: 21.obedient, not averse, repentant, not disobedient or persisting,
22.O He who guarantees the repayment of the good-doers
23.and seeks to set right the work of the corrupt!

segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man âawwada âibÄdahu qabÅ«la al-tawbati
segments.translation: And O He who has accustomed His servants to accepting repentance.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ أَلْهَمَ عِبَادَهُ ذِكْرَهُ وَشُكْرَهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man alhama âibÄdahu dhikrahu wa-shukrahu
segments.translation: And O He who has inspired His servants to remember and thank Him.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ جَعَلَ لَهُمْ مَفَازًا مِمَّا اقْتَرَفُوا بِفَضْلِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man jaâala lahum mafÄzan mimmÄ iqâtarafÅ« bi-faá¸lih
segments.translation: And O He who has made for them deliverance from what they committed, by His grace.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ سَتَرَ ذُنُوبَهُمْ عَلى رَغْمِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man satara dhunÅ«bahum âalÄ raghmihim
segments.translation: And O He who concealed their sins despite their persistence.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ جَاوَزَ خَطَايَاهُمْ عَلى كَرَمِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man jÄwaza khaá¹­ÄyÄhum âalÄ karamih
segments.translation: And O He who has overlooked their faults with His generosity.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لَمْ يُؤَاخِذْهُمْ بِالْجَرَائِمِ وَالزَّلَلِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man lam yuâÄkhidhhum bi-l-jarÄâimi wa-z-zalal
segments.translation: And O He who has not punished them for crimes and slips.
And O He to whom the fearful turn in hope.
And O He to whom those with hope seek refuge.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ صَدَقَ فِي وَعْدِهِ وَضَمِنَ الْمَغْفِرَةَ بِمَنِّهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man á¹£adaqa fÄ« waâdih wa-á¸amina al-maghfirata bi-mannih
segments.translation: And O He who is true in His promise, and who guaranteed forgiveness through His grace.
And O He who stretches out His hand with mercy.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَضْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man wasiâa kulla shayâin faá¸luh
segments.translation: And O He whose bounty has encompassed all things.
And O He whose pleasure has outstripped His wrath.
And O He whose mercy has preceded His punishment.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ تَعَاطَفَ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ بِإِحْسَانِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man taâÄá¹­afa âalÄ âibÄdihi bi-iá¸¥sÄnih
segments.translation: And O He who shows compassion to His servants through His kindness.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ فَتَحَ لِخَلْقِهِ بَابًا إِلَى عَفْوِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man fataá¸¥a li-khalqihi bÄban ilÄ âafwih
segments.translation: And O He who has opened for His creation a door to His pardon.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ قَالَ وَقَوْلُهُ الْحَقُّ وَوَعْدُهُ الصِّدْقُ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man qÄla wa-qawluhu al-á¸¥aqqu wa-waâduhu aá¹£-á¹£idq
segments.translation: And O He who has spoken, and His word is truth, and His promise is sure.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ قَالَ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man qÄla: udâÅ«nÄ« astajib lakum
segments.translation: And O He who has said: "Call upon Me, I will answer you."

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ قَالَ وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man qÄla: wa-idhÄ saâalaka âibÄdÄ« âannÄ« fa-innÄ« qarÄ«b
segments.translation: And O He who has said: "And when My servants ask you about Me, indeed I am near."
"I answer the call of the caller when he calls upon Me."

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ قَالَ مَا يَفْعَلُ اللهُ بِعَذَابِكُمْ إِنْ شَكَرْتُمْ وَآمَنْتُمْ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man qÄla: mÄ yafâalu -llÄhu bi-âadhÄbikum in shakartum wa-Ämantum
segments.translation: And O He who has said: "What would Allah do with your punishment if you are grateful and believe?"

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ جَعَلَ الشُّكْرَ ثَمَنًا لِزِيَادَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man jaâala ash-shukra thamanan li-ziyÄdatih
segments.translation: And O He who has made gratitude the price for His increase.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ جَعَلَ التَّوَكُّلَ عَلَيْهِ سَبَبًا لِكِفَايَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man jaâala at-tawakkula âalayhi sababan li-kifÄyatih
segments.translation: And O He who has made reliance upon Him the cause for sufficiency.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ جَعَلَ طَاعَتَهُ وَوِلاَيَةَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ حِصْنًا حَصِينًا لِمَنْ دَخَلَهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa-yÄ man jaâala á¹­Äâatahu wa-wilÄyata awliyÄâihi á¸¥iá¹£nan á¸¥aá¹£Ä«nan li-man dakhala-hu
segments.translation: And O He who has made obedience to Him and loyalty to His friends a fortified fortress for whoever enters it.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَحُصِّنُ نَفْسَهُ بِطَاعَتِكَ وَوِلاَيَةِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa-jâalnÄ mimman yaá¸¥uá¹£á¹£inu nafsahu bi-á¹­Äâatika wa-wilÄyati awliyÄâika
segments.translation: And make us among those who fortify themselves with Your obedience and the loyalty of Your friends.
Until You save him from Your wrath and Your displeasure.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.
And make us among those who converse with You in supplication.
And reconcile upon the truth of knowing You.
And whom the world does not distract away from You.
And whom no heedlessness diverts away from You.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.
And make us among those who sincerely dedicate their deeds to You.
And does not desire through it anyone but You.
Fill our hearts with obedience to You.
And do not disgrace us through disobedience to You.
And grant us the love of Your friends.
And employ us in that which You love and are pleased with.
O Allah, make the end of our deeds Your good pleasure.

segments.arabic: وَاقْطَعْ أَيَّامَنَا فِي خَيْرٍ مِنْكَ وَرِضْوَانٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa-qá¹­aâ ayyÄmanÄ fÄ« khayrin minka wa-riá¸wÄn
segments.translation: And conclude our days with goodness from You and satisfaction.
Surely, You have power over all things.
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
And send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
And fulfill my need and grant success to my request.
And forgive my sins and secure me from the fear of myself.
Indeed, You are able over all things.
And that is easy for You.
Ameen, Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّهُ يَحْجُبُنِي عَنْ مَسْأَلَتِكَ خِلاَلٌ ثَلاثٌ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-nahoo yah'-jubunee a'm-mas-alatika khilaalun thalaath wa tah'-doonee a'lay-haa khal-latoo-waah'idah
segments.translation: O God, three traits have prevented me from asking Thee
and one trait has urged me on:

segments.arabic: يَحْجُبُنِي أَمْرٌ أَمَرْتَ بِهِ فَأَبْطَأتُ عَنْهُ،
segments.transliteration: yah'-jubunee am-run amar-ta bihee faab-t'aa-tu a'n-h
segments.translation: I am prevented by a command Thou hast commanded in which I have been slow,
a prohibition Thou hast prohibited toward which I have hurried,

segments.arabic: وَنِعْمَةٌ أَنْعَمْتَ بِهَا عَلَيَّ فَقَصَّرْتُ فِي شُكْرِهَـا.
segments.transliteration: wa nia'-matun an-a'm-ta bihaa a'lay-ya faqas'-s'ar-tu fee shuk-rihaa
segments.translation: and a favour through which Thou hast favoured for which I have not given sufficient thanks.
I am urged to ask Thee by Thy gratuitous bounty
upon him who turns his face toward Thee
and comes to Thee with a good opinion,
since all Thy beneficence is gratuitous bounty
and every one of Thy favours a new beginning!

segments.arabic: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا يَا إلهِيْ وَاقِفٌ بِبَابِ عِزِّكَ
segments.transliteration: fahaaa ana d'aa yaaa ilaahee waaqifum-bibaabi i'z-zika
segments.translation: So here I am, my God, standing at the gate of Thy might,

segments.arabic: وُقُوفَ المُسْتَسْلِمِ الذَّلِيْل، وَسَائِلُكَ عَلَى الْحَيَاءِ مِنّي
segments.translation: the standing of the lowly, the surrendered, asking Thee in my shame,

segments.arabic: سُؤَالَ الْبَائِسِ الْمُعِيْلِ. مُقـرٌّ لَكَ بأَنّي
segments.translation: the asking of the destitute, the pitiful, admitting to Thee that

segments.arabic: لَمْ أَسْتَسْلِمْ وَقْتَ إحْسَانِـكَ إلاَّ بِالاِقْلاَعِ عَنْ عِصْيَانِكَ،
segments.transliteration: lam as-tas-lim waq-ta ih'-saanika il-laa bil-iq-laai' a'n i's'-yaanik
segments.translation: at the time of Thy beneficence I surrendered not save through abstaining from disobedience toward Thee

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ أَخْلُ فِي الْحَالاتِ كُلِّهَا مِنِ امْتِنَانِكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa lam akh-lu fil-h'aalaati kul-lihaa mini am-tinaanik
segments.translation: and in none of my states was I ever without Thy Kindness.

segments.arabic: فَهَلْ يَنْفَعُنِي يَا إلهِي إقْرَارِي عِنْدَكَ بِسُوءِ مَا اكْتَسَبْتُ؟
segments.transliteration:
fahal yanfau'nee yaaa ilaaheee iq-raaree i'ndaka bisooo-i mak-tasab-tu ?
6- Will it profit me, my God, to admit to Thee the evil of what I have earned?

wahal yunjeenee minka aa'-tiraafee laka biqabeehee mar-takab-tu?
segments.translation: 6- Will it profit me, my God, to admit to Thee the evil of what I have earned?

segments.arabic: وَهَلْ يُنْجِيْنِي مِنْكَ اعْتِرَافِي لَكَ بِقَبِيْحِ مَا ارْتَكَبْتُ؟
segments.transliteration: am aw-jab-ta lee fee maqaamee had'aa sukh-t'aka?
segments.translation: Will it save me from Thee to confess the ugliness of what I have done?

segments.arabic: أَمْ أَوْجَبْتَ لِي فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا سُخْطَكَ؟
segments.transliteration: am lazimanee fee waq-ti dua'aa-ee maq-tuka?
segments.translation: Or wilt Thou impose upon me in this my stationThy displeasure?

segments.arabic: أَمْ لَزِمَنِي فِي وَقْتِ دُعَائِي مَقْتُكَ؟
segments.transliteration: sub-h'aanaka laaa ay-asu minka waqad fatah'-ta lee baabat-taw-bati ilay-k
segments.translation: Will Thy hate hold fast to me in the time of my supplication?

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! لاَ أَيْأَسُ مِنْكَ وَقَدْ فَتَحْتَ لِيَ بَابَ التَّوْبَةِ إلَيْكَ،
segments.translation: Glory be to Thee! I do not despair of Thee, for Thou hast opened the door of repentance toward Thyself.

segments.arabic: بَلْ أَقُولُ مَقَالَ الْعَبْدِ الذَّلِيلِ الظَّالِمِ لِنَفْسِهِ
segments.translation: Rather, I say, the words of a lowly servant, Â  having wronged himself Â

segments.transliteration: al-lad'ee a'z'umat d'unoobuhoo fajal-lat-wa ad-barat ay-yaamuhoo fawal-lat-
segments.translation: and made light of his Lord's inviolability,Â

segments.arabic: الَّذِي عَظُمَتْ ذُنُوبُهُ فَجَلَّتْ وَأَدْبَرَتْ أَيّامُهُ فَوَلَّتْ
segments.transliteration: h'at-taaa id'aa raaa mud-datal-a'mali qadi anqaz''at
segments.translation: and whose sins are dreadful, great,whose days have parted, fled,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى إذَا رَأى مُدَّةَ الْعَمَلِ قَدِ انْقَضَتْ
segments.translation: until, when he sees the term of his works expired and the limit of his lifetime reached

segments.transliteration: wa ay-qana an-nahoo laa mah'ees'a lahoo mink wa laa mah-raba lahoo a'nk
segments.translation: and knows with certainty that he has no escape from Thee,

segments.arabic: وَأَيْقَنَ أَنَّهُ لا مَحيصَ لَهُ مِنْكَ ،وَلاَ مَهْرَبَ لَهُ عَنْكَ
segments.translation: no place to flee from Thee, he turns his face toward Thee in repeated turning,
makes his repentance toward Thee sincere,
stands before Thee with a pure and purified heart,t

segments.transliteration: qad t-tat'aa-t'aa laka fan-h'anaawa nak-kasa raa-sahoo faanthanaa
segments.translation: hen supplicates Thee with a feeble, quiet voice.

segments.arabic: قَدْ تَطَأطَأَ لَكَ فَانْحَنى، وَنَكَّسَ رَأسَهُ فَانْثَنَى ،
segments.transliteration: qad sr-a'shat khash-yatuhoo rij-lay-h wa ghar-raqat d-dumoou'hoo khad-day-h
segments.translation: He is bowed before Thee, bent,his head lowered, thrown down,

segments.arabic: قَدْ أَرْعَشَتْ خَشْيَتُهُ رِجْلَيْهِ، وَغَرَّقَتْ دُمُوعُهُ خَدَّيْهِ ،
segments.transliteration: yad-u'wka beeaaa ar-h'amar-raah'imeen wa yaaa ar-h'ama mani antaabahul-mus-tar-h'imoon
segments.translation: his legs shaking in fear,his tears flooding his cheeks.

segments.arabic: يَدْعُوكَ بِيَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ وَيَا أَرْحَمَ مَنِ انْتَابَهُ الْمُسْتَرْحِمُونَ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaaa aa'-t'afa man at'aafa bihil-mus-tagh-firoon
segments.translation: He supplicates Thee: O Most Merciful of the merciful!O Most Merciful of those toward whom seekers of mercy keep on turning

segments.arabic: وَيَا أَعْطَفَ مَنْ أَطَافَ بِهِ الْمُسْتَغْفِرُونَ ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man a'f-wuhooo ak-tharu min-naqimatih
segments.translation: O Tenderest of those around whom run seekers of forgiveness!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ عَفْوُهُ أكْثَرُ مِنْ نِقْمَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mar-riz''aahooo aw-faru min sakhat'ih
segments.translation: O He whose pardon is greater than His vengeance!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ رِضَاهُ أَوْفَرُ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man tah'am-mada ilaa khal-qihee bih'us-nit-tajaawuz
segments.translation: O He whose good pleasure is more abundant than His anger

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ إلَى خَلْقِهِ بِحُسْنِ التَّجاوُزِ ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man a'w-wada i'baadahoo qaboolal-inaabah
segments.translation: O He who seeks His creatures' praise with excellent forbearance!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ عَوَّدَ عِبادَهُ قَبُولَ الإنَابَةِ ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mani as-tas'-lah'a faasidahum bit-taw-bah
segments.translation: O He who has accustomed His servants to the acceptance of their repeated turning!

segments.transliteration: wa yaa mar-raz''eea min fia'-lihim bil-yaseer
segments.translation: O He who seeks to heal their corruption through repentance!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ رَضِيَ مِنْ فِعْلِهِمْ بِالْيَسيرِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man kaafaa qaleelahum bil-katheer
segments.translation: O He who is pleased with the easy of their acts!

segments.transliteration: wa yaa man z''amina lahum ijaabatad-dua'aa-i
segments.translation: O He who recompenses with the much their little!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ ضَمِنَ لَهُمْ إجَابَةَ الدُّعاءِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa maw-waa'dahum a'laa naf-sihee bitafaz''-z''ulihee h'us-nal-jazaaa-i
segments.translation: O He who has made himself accountable to them to respond to supplication!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ وَعَدَهُمْ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِتَفَضُّلِهِ حُسْنَ الْجَزاءِ،
segments.transliteration: maaa ana bia'-s'aa man a's'aaka faghafar-ta lah
segments.translation: O He who pledged Himself by His gratuitous bounty to give them excellent repayment!

segments.arabic: مَا أَنَا بِأَعْصَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ فَغَفَرْتَ لَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa maaa ana bil-wami mani aa'-tad'ara ilay-ka faqabil-ta min-h
segments.translation: I am not the most disobedient of those who have disobeyed Thee

segments.arabic: وَمَا أَنَا بِأَلْوَمِ مَنِ اعْتَذَرَ إلَيْكَ فَقَبِلْتَ مِنْهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa maaa ana biz'-lami man taaba ilay-ka fau't-ta a'lay-h
segments.translation: and whom Thou hast forgiven,Â nor am I the most blameworthy to offer excusesÂ which Thou hast accepted,Â Â

segments.arabic: وَمَا أَنَا بِأَظْلَمِ مَنْ تَابَ إلَيْكَ فَعُدْتَ عَلَيْهِ ،
segments.transliteration: atoobu ilay-ka fee maqaamee had'aa taw-bata naadimin a'laa maa farat'a min-h
segments.translation: nor am I the most wrongdoing of those who have repented to Thee,Â and to whom Thou hast returned

segments.arabic: أَتُوبُ إلَيْكَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا تَوْبَةَ نَادِم عَلَى مَا فَرَطَ مِنْهُ
segments.transliteration: mush-fiqim-mim-maj-tamaa' a'lay-h khaalis'il-h'ayaaa-i mim-maa waqaa' feeh
segments.translation: Â I repent to Thee in this my station,Â Â the repentance of oneÂ remorseful over what preceded from him

segments.arabic: مُشْفِق مِمَّا اجْتَمَعَ عَلَيْهِ خَالِصِ الْحَيَاءِ مِمَّا وَقَعَ فِيْهِ ،
segments.translation: hastily,Â apprehensive of what has gathered around him,Â pure in shame for that into which he has fallen,

segments.arabic: عَالِم بِأَنَّ الْعَفْوَ عَنِ الذَّنْبِ الْعَظِيمِ لاَ يَتَعـاظَمُكَ،
segments.translation: knowing thatÂ pardoning great sins is nothing great for Thee.Â

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ التَّجَـاوُزَ عَنِ الإثْمِ الْجَلِيْلِ لا يَسْتَصْعِبُكَ ،
segments.translation: overlooking enormous misdeeds is not difficult for thee

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ احْتِمَالَ الْجنَايَاتِ الْفَـاحِشَةِ لا يَتَكَأَّدُكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa an-na ah'ab-ba i'baadika ilay-ka man tarakalis-tik-baara a'lay-k
segments.translation: putting up with indecent crimes does not trouble Thee,Â

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ أَحَبَّ عِبَادِكَ إلَيْكَ مَنْ تَرَكَ الاسْتِكْبَارَ عَلَيْكَ،
segments.translation: and the most beloved of Thy servants toÂ Thee is he whoÂ refrains from arrogance before thee

segments.transliteration: wa ana ab-ra-u ilay-ka min sn ss-tak-bir
segments.translation: pulls aside from persistence,Â and holds fast to praying forgiveness!

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا أَبْرَأُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَسْتَكْبِرَ،
segments.transliteration: wa su'wd'u bika min sn us'ir
segments.translation: I am clear before Thee of arrogance,
I seek refuge in Thee from persistence,

segments.transliteration: wa as-tae'enu bika a'laa maa a'jaz-tu a'n-h
segments.translation: I pray forgiveness from Thee for shortcomings,

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا عَجَزْتُ عَنْهُ.
segments.translation: Â I seek help from Thee in incapacity!

segments.transliteration: wa hab lee maa yajibu a'lay-ya lak
segments.translation: O God bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي مَا يَجبُ عَلَيَّ لَكَ ،
segments.translation: dispense with what is incumbent upon me toward Thee,Â
release me from what I merit from Thee,

segments.transliteration: fa in-naka malee-um-bil-a'f-w mar-joo-wu lil-magh-firah maa'-roofum-bit-tajaawz
segments.translation: and grant me sanctuary from what the evildoers fear!

segments.arabic: فَإنَّكَ مَلِيءٌ بِالْعَفْوِ، مَرْجُوٌّ لِلْمَغْفِرَةِ، مَعْرُوفٌ بِالتَّجَاوُزِ ،
segments.translation: For Thou art full of pardon, the hoped-for source of forgiveness,Â well known for Thy forbearance.

segments.transliteration: wa laa lid'ambee ghaafirun ghay-ruk h'aashaak
segments.translation: My need has no object but Thee,Â

segments.transliteration: wa laaa akhaafu a'laa naf-seee il-laaa ee-yaak
segments.translation: Â my sin no forgiver other than TheeÂ - could that be possible?

segments.arabic: وَلاَ أَخَافُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إلاّ إيَّاكَ
segments.translation: I have no fear for myself except from Thee;
Thou art worthy of reverential fear,Â and worthy to forgive!

segments.transliteration: wa aq-z''i h'aajatee wa anjih' t'alibatee
segments.translation: Bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wagh-fir d'ambee wa aaamin khaw-fa naf-see
segments.translation: grant my need,answer my request favorably,
forgive my sin and give me security from fear for myself!

segments.transliteration: wa d'alika a'lay-ka yaseer aaameena rab-bal-a'alameen
segments.translation: Thou art powerful over everything,

segments.arabic: وَذلِكَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ .
segments.translation: and that is easy for Thee.Amen, Lord of the worlds

segments.translation: the station of the wretched ones who dared against You, those who took Your promise lightly.
Glory be to You! What daring did I dare against You?
And what deception did I deceive myself with?
My Master, have mercy on my fall (down) upon my noble face,

segments.arabic: وَزَلَّةَ قَدَمِي، وَعُدْ بِحِلْمِكَ عَلَى جَهْلِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-zallata qadamÄ«, wa-âud bi-á¸¥ilmika âalÄ jahlÄ«,
segments.translation: and the slip of my foot, and return with Your forbearance upon my ignorance,

segments.arabic: وَبِإحْسَانِكَ عَلَى إسَآءَتِي، فَأَنَا الْمُقِرُّ بِذَنْبِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-bi-iá¸¥sÄnik âalÄ isÄâatÄ«, fa-ana l-muqirru bi-dhanbÄ«,
segments.translation: and with Your benevolence upon my wrongdoing, for I am the one confessing my sin,
the one acknowledging my mistake, and here is my hand and my forelock,
I humble myself to be led by myself (to submit to punishment).
Have mercy on my gray hair, and the running out of my days,
and the nearness of my term (of death), and my weakness,
and my wretchedness, and the fewness of my resourcefulness.

segments.arabic: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي إذَا انْقَطَعَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا أَثَرِي،
segments.transliteration: MawlÄya wa-rá¸¥amnÄ« idhÄ nqaá¹­aâa mina d-dunyÄ atharÄ«,
segments.translation: My Master, and have mercy on me when my trace is cut off from the world,
and my mention is wiped away from the creatures,

segments.arabic: وَكُنْتُ فِي الْمَنْسِيِّينَ، كَمَنْ قَدْ نُسِيَ.
segments.transliteration: wa-kuntu fÄ« l-mansiyyÄ«n, ka-man qad nusÄ«.
segments.translation: and I am among the forgotten, like one who has been forgotten.
My Master, and have mercy on me when my form changes

segments.arabic: وَحَالِي إذَا بَلِيَ جِسْمِي، وَتَفَرَّقَتْ أَعْضَائِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-á¸¥ÄlÄ« idhÄ baliya jismÄ«, wa-tafarraqat aâá¸ÄâÄ«,
segments.translation: and my state, when my body wears out, and my limbs disperse,

segments.arabic: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ أَوْصَالِيْ، يا غَفْلَتِي عَمَّا يُرَادُ بِيَ.
segments.transliteration: wa-taqaá¹­á¹­aâat awá¹£ÄlÄ«, yÄ ghaflatÄ« âammÄ yurÄdu biya.
segments.translation: and my joints are severed. Oh, my heedlessness concerning what is intended for me!
My Master, and have mercy on me at my gathering and resurrection,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَل فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَومِ مَعَ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ مَوْقِفِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-jâal fÄ« dhÄlika l-yawmi maâa awliyÄâika mawqifÄ«,
segments.translation: and make my station on that Day with Your friends,
and my proceeding (or return) with Your beloved ones,

segments.arabic: وَفِي جِوَارِكَ مَسْكَنِي يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: wa-fÄ« jiwÄrik maskanÄ« yÄ Rabba l-âÄlamÄ«n.
segments.translation: and my dwelling place in Your vicinity, O Lord of the Worlds.
1.My Lord, my sins have silenced me, and my words have been cut off.

segments.arabic: فَلاَ حُجَّةَ لِي، فَأَنَا الأَسِيـرُ بِبَلِيَّتِي،
segments.translation: 2.I have no argument, for I am the prisoner of my own affliction,
3.the hostage to my works, the frequenter of my own offense,
4.the confused in my intended way, the thwarted.

segments.arabic: قَدْ أَوْقَفْتُ نَفْسِي مَوْقِفَ الأَذِلاَّءِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ،
segments.translation: 5.I have brought myself to a halt in the halting place of the abased sinners,

segments.arabic: مَوْقِفَ الأَشْقِيآءِ الْمُتَجَرِّينَ عَلَيْكَ، الْمُسْتَخِفِّينَ بِوَعْدِكَ.
segments.translation: 6.the halting place of the wretched and insolent, those who think lightly of Your promise.
7.Glory be to You! What insolence I have insolently shown toward You!
8.What delusion with which I have deluded myself!
9.My Master, have mercy on my falling flat on my face

segments.arabic: وَزَلَّةَ قَدَمِي، وَعُدْ بِحِلْمِكَ عَلَى جَهْلِي،
segments.transliteration: wa zal-lata qadamee wa u'd bh'il-mika a'laa jah-lee
segments.translation: 10.the slipping of my foot, grant me my ignorance through Your clemency,

segments.arabic: وَبِإحْسَانِكَ عَلَى إسَآءَتِي، فَأَنَا الْمُقِرُّ بِذَنْبِي،
segments.transliteration: wa biih'-saanika a'laaa isaaa-atee faanaal-muqir-ru bid'ambee
segments.translation: 11.and my evildoing through Your beneficence, for I admit my sin

segments.transliteration: al-mua'-tarifu bikhat'ee-atee wa hd'ihee yadee wa naas'eeatee
segments.translation: 12.and I confess my offense: Here are my hand and my forelock!
13.I am resigned to retaliation against my soul!
14.Have mercy on my white hair, the depletion of my days,
15.the nearing of my term, my frailty,
16.my misery, and the paucity of my stratagems!

segments.arabic: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي إذَا انْقَطَعَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا أَثَرِي،
segments.transliteration: maw-laaya war-h'am-neee id'aa anqat'aa' minad-dunyaaa atharee
segments.translation: 17.My Master, and have mercy upon me when my trace is cut off from this world,
18.my mention is effaced among the creatures,

segments.arabic: وَكُنْتُ فِي الْمَنْسِيِّينَ، كَمَنْ قَدْ نُسِيَ.
segments.transliteration: wa kuntu fil-mansee-yeena kaman qad nusee
segments.translation: 19.and I join the forgotten, like the forgotten ones!
20.My Master, and have mercy upon me at the change of my form and state

segments.arabic: وَحَالِي إذَا بَلِيَ جِسْمِي، وَتَفَرَّقَتْ أَعْضَائِي،
segments.transliteration: wa h'aalee id'aa baleea jis-mee wa tafar-raqat aa'-z''aaa-ee
segments.translation: 21.when my body decays, my limbs are scattered,

segments.arabic: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ أَوْصَالِيْ، يا غَفْلَتِي  عَمَّا يُرَادُ بِيَ.
segments.transliteration: wa taqat'-t'aa't aw-s'aalee yaa ghaf-latee a'm-maa yuraadu bee
segments.translation: 22.and my joints are dismembered! O my heedlessness toward what was wanted from me!

segments.transliteration: maw-laaya war-h'amnee fee h'ash-ree wa nash-ree
segments.translation: 23.My Master, have mercy upon me at my mustering and uprising

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَل فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَومِ مَعَ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ مَوْقِفِي،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l fee d'alikal-yawmi maa' aw-leeaaa-ika maw-qifee
segments.translation: 24.and on that day, appoint my standing place with Your friends,
25.my place of emergence with Your beloveds,

segments.arabic: وَفِي جِوَارِكَ مَسْكَنِي يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: wa fee jiwaarika mas-kanee yaa rab-bal-a'alameen
segments.translation: 26.and my dwelling in Your neighbourhood! O Lord of the worlds!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua52 His Supplication in Imploring God

segments.translation: O God, bless Muá¸¥ammad and his family (Älih),

segments.arabic: يَا أَللهُ الَّذِي لاَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: YÄ AllÄhu l-ladhÄ« lÄ yakhfÄ âalayh
segments.translation: O God, from Whom nothing is concealed

segments.arabic: شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ،
segments.transliteration: shayâun fÄ« l-ará¸i wa-lÄ fÄ« s-samÄâ,

segments.arabic: وَكَيْفَ يَخْفى عَلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي مَا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهُ؟
segments.transliteration: wa-kayfa yakhfÄ âalayka yÄ IlÄhÄ« mÄ Anta khalaqtah?
segments.translation: And how can what You created be concealed from You, O my God?

segments.arabic: وَكَيْفَ لاَ تُحْصِي مَا أَنْتَ صَنَعْتَهُ؟
segments.transliteration: wa-kayfa lÄ tuá¸¥á¹£Ä« mÄ Anta á¹£anaâtah?
segments.translation: And how can You not enumerate what You have fashioned?

segments.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَغِيبُ عَنْكَ مَا أَنْتَ تُدَبِّرُهُ؟
segments.transliteration: aw kayfa yaghÄ«bu âanka mÄ Anta tudabbiruh?
segments.translation: Or how can what You administer be absent from You?

segments.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَهْرُبَ مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ حَياةَ لَهُ إلاَّ بِرِزْقِكَ؟
segments.transliteration: aw kayfa yastaá¹­Ä«âu an yahruba minka man lÄ á¸¥ayÄta lahÅ« illÄ bi-rizqik?
segments.translation: Or how can he who has no life except through Your provision be able to flee from You?

segments.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَنْجُو مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ مَذْهَبَ لَهُ فِي غَيْرِ مُلْكِكَ؟
segments.transliteration: aw kayfa yanjÅ« minka man lÄ madhhaba lahÅ« fÄ« ghayri mulkik?
segments.translation: Or how can he escape from You who has no resort other than Your dominion?

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! أَخْشى خَلْقِكَ لَكَ أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Änak! AkhshÄ khalqika lak aâlamuhum bik,
segments.translation: Glory be to You! The most fearful of Your creation toward You is the one who knows You best,
and the most submissive of them to You is the one who acts most upon Your obedience,

segments.arabic: وَأَهْوَنُهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مَنْ أَنْتَ تَرْزُقُهُ وَهُوَ يَعْبُدُ غَيْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-ahwanuhum âalayk man anta tarzuquhÅ« wa-huwa yaâbudu ghayrak,
segments.translation: and the least significant of them to You is the one whom You provide for while he worships other than You.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! لاَ يُنْقِصُ سُلْطَانَكَ مَنْ أَشْرَكَ بِكَ، وَكَذَّبَ رُسُلَكَ،
segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Änak! LÄ yunqiá¹£u sulá¹­Änak man ashraka bik, wa-kadhdhabu rusulak,
segments.translation: Glory be to You! He who associates partners with You, and denies Your Messengers, does not diminish Your sovereignty,

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ يَسْتَطِيعُ مَنْ كَرِهَ قَضَآءَكَ أَنْ يَرُدَّ أَمْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-laysa yastaá¹­Ä«âu man kariha qaá¸Äâak an yarudda amrak,
segments.translation: and he who dislikes Your decree cannot repel Your command,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَمْتَنِعُ مِنْكَ مَنْ كَذَّبَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ yamtanuâu minka man kadhdhaba bi-qudratik,
segments.translation: and he who denies Your power cannot withhold himself from You,
and he who worships other than You will not escape You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُعَمَّرُ فِي الدُّنْيَا مَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَآءَكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ yuâammaru fÄ« d-dunyÄ man kariha liqÄâak.
segments.translation: and he who disliked meeting You will not be given long life in the world.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ، وَأَقْهَرَ سُلْطَانَكَ،
segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Änak! MÄ aâáºama shaânak, wa-aqhara sulá¹­Änak,
segments.translation: Glory be to You! How immense is Your dignity! And how overwhelming is Your sovereignty!
And how severe is Your power! And how penetrating is Your command!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! قَضَيْتَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ الْمَوْتَ:
segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Änak! Qaá¸ayta âalÄ jamÄ«âi khalqik al-mawt:
segments.translation: Glory be to You! You decreed death upon all Your creation:
both he who affirms Your oneness and he who disbelieves in You,
and everyone is a taster of death,
and everyone is bound for You, so blessed and exalted are You!

segments.arabic: لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكَ،

segments.translation: There is no god but You, alone, without a partner, I believe in You,
and I affirmed Your Messengers and accepted Your Book,
and I disbelieved in every deity other than You,
and I disassociated myself from whoever worshipped anything other than You.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أُصْبحُ وَأُمْسِي مُسْتَقِلاًّ لِعَمَلِي،
