segments.translation: O God, truly I begin my day and enter my evening regarding my deed as small (or insufficient),
confessing my sin, acknowledging my mistakes,
I am humiliated by my transgression against my soul,
My deed has destroyed me, and my caprice has led me to ruin,
and my desires have deprived me.

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ سُؤالَ مَنْ نَفْسُهُ لاَهِيَةٌ لِطُولِ أَمَلِهِ،

segments.translation: So I ask You, O my Master, the asking of one whose soul is heedless due to the length of his hope,
and whose body is neglectful due to the stillness of his veins,
and whose heart is captivated by the abundance of blessings upon him,

segments.arabic: وَفِكْرُهُ قَلِيلٌ لِمَا هُوَ صَائِرٌ إلَيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-fikruhÅ« qalÄ«lun li-mÄ huwa á¹£Äâirun ilayh,
segments.translation: and whose thought is meager concerning what he is heading toward,

segments.arabic: سُؤَالَ مَن قَدْ غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الاَمَلُ،
segments.transliteration: suâÄla man qad ghalaba âalayhi l-amal,
segments.translation: The asking of one over whom hope has surely prevailed,
and caprice has tempted him, and the world has gotten a strong hold over him,

segments.arabic: وَأَظَلَّهُ الاَجَلُ، سُؤَالَ مَنِ اسْتَكْثَرَ ذُنُوبَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa-aáºallahu l-ajal, suâÄla mani stakthara dhunÅ«bah,
segments.translation: and the term (of death) has overshadowed him, the asking of one who considered his sins many,

segments.arabic: وَاعْتَرَفَ بِخَطِيئَتِهِ، سُؤَالَ مَن لاَ رَبَّ لَهُ غَيْرُكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-aâtarafa bi-khaá¹­Ä«âatih, suâÄla man lÄ Rabba lahÅ« ghayruk,
segments.translation: and acknowledged his mistake, the asking of one who has no Lord other than You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ وَلِيَّ لَهُ دُونَكَ، وَلاَ مُنْقِذَ لَهُ مِنْكَ،

segments.translation: and no protector besides You, and no deliverer from You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ مَلْجَأَ لَهُ مِنْكَ إلاَّ إلَيْكَ .
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ maljaâa lahÅ« minka illÄ ilayk.
segments.translation: and no refuge from You except to You.

segments.arabic: إلهِي أسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْـوَاجِبِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ،

segments.translation: My God, I ask You by Your right which is incumbent upon all Your creation,

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَ رَسُولَكَ أَنْ يُسَبِّحَكَ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-bi-smika l-âaáºÄ«m illadhÄ« amarta rasÅ«lak an yusabbiá¸¥ak bih,
segments.translation: and by Your Mighty Name with which You commanded Your Messenger to glorify You,

segments.arabic: وَبِجَلاَلِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ الذِي لاَ يَبْلى

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَتَغَيَّرُ، وَلاَ يَحُولُ وَلاَ يَفْنى،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ yataghayyar, wa-lÄ yaá¸¥Å«lu wa-lÄ yafnÄ,
segments.translation: and does not change, nor move, nor perish,

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.transliteration: an tuá¹£alliya âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Äli Muá¸¥ammad,
segments.translation: that You bless Muá¸¥ammad and the family of Muá¸¥ammad,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُغْنِيَنِي عَنْ كُلِّ شَيْء بِعِبادَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-an tughniyanÄ« âan kulli shayâin bi-âibÄdatik,
segments.translation: and that You make me independent of everything by Your worship,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُسَلِّيَ نَفْسِيْ عَنِ الدُّنْيَا بِمَخَافَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-an tusalliya nafsÄ« âani d-dunyÄ bi-makhÄfatika,
segments.translation: and that You console my soul from the world with my fear of You,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُثْنِيَنِي بِالْكَثِيرِ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-an tuthniyanÄ« bi-l-kathÄ«r min karÄmatik bi-raá¸¥matik,
segments.translation: and that You grant me in return much of Your generosity by Your mercy.

segments.arabic: فَإلَيْكَ أَفِرُّ، و مِنْكَ أَخَافُ، وَبِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ،
segments.transliteration: Fa-ilayk affirr, wa-minka akhÄf, wa-bika astaghÄ«th,

segments.arabic: وَإيَّاكَ أَرْجُو، وَلَكَ أَدْعُو، وَإلَيْكَ أَلْجَأُ،

segments.translation: and in You I trust, and Your help I seek, and in You I believe,

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic: يَا أَللهُ الَّذِي لاَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ
segments.translation: 1.O God, from whom nothing is concealed

segments.arabic: شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ،
segments.translation: 2.in earth or heaven!

segments.arabic: وَكَيْفَ يَخْفى عَلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي  مَا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهُ؟
segments.transliteration: wa kay-fa yakh-faa a'leeka yaaa ilaahee maaa anta khalaq-tahu?
segments.translation: 3.How should what You hast created, my God, be concealed from You?

segments.arabic: وَكَيْفَ لاَ تُحْصِي مَا أَنْتَ صَنَعْتَهُ؟
segments.transliteration: wakay-fa laa tuh'-s'ee maaa anta s'anaa'-tahu?
segments.translation: 4.How shouldst You not number what You hast made?

segments.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَغِيبُ عَنْكَ مَا أَنْتَ تُدَبِّرُهُ؟
segments.transliteration: aw kay-fa yagheebu a'nka maaa anta tudab-biruhu?
segments.translation: 5.How should what You governest be absent from You?

segments.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَهْرُبَ مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ حَياةَ لَهُ إلاَّ بِرِزْقِكَ؟
segments.transliteration: aw kay-fa yas-tat'eeu' ay-yah-ruba minka mal-laa h'ayaata lahooo il-laa biriz-qika?
segments.translation: 6.How should one who has no life except through Your provision have the ability to flee from You?

segments.arabic: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَنْجُو مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ مَذْهَبَ لَهُ فِي غَيْرِ مُلْكِكَ؟
segments.transliteration: aw kay-fa yanjoo minka mal-laa mad'-haba lahoo fee ghay-ri mul-kika?
segments.translation: 7.How should one who has no road except in Your kingdom escape from You?

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! أَخْشى خَلْقِكَ لَكَ أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِكَ،
segments.transliteration: sub-h'aanak akh-shaa khal-qika laka aa'-lamuhum bik
segments.translation: 8.Glory be to You! He among Your creatures who fears You most knows You best,
9.he among them most bent in humility is most active in obeying You,

segments.arabic: وَأَهْوَنُهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مَنْ أَنْتَ تَرْزُقُهُ وَهُوَ يَعْبُدُ غَيْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ah-wanuhum a'lay-ka man anta tar-zuquhoo wa huwa yaa'-budu ghay-rak
segments.translation: 10.and he among them whom You providest while he worships another is most contemptible before You!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! لاَ يُنْقِصُ سُلْطَانَكَ مَنْ أَشْرَكَ بِكَ، وَكَذَّبَ رُسُلَكَ،
segments.transliteration: sub-h'aanak laa yanqus'u sul-t'aanaka man ash-raka bika wakad'-d'aba rusulak
segments.translation: 11.Glory be to You! He who associates others with You and denies Your messengers diminishes not Your authority.

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ يَسْتَطِيعُ مَنْ كَرِهَ قَضَآءَكَ أَنْ يَرُدَّ أَمْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa lay-sa yas-tat'eeu' man kariha qaz''aaa-aka ay-yarud-da am-rak
segments.translation: 12.He who dislikes Your decree cannot reject Your command.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَمْتَنِعُ مِنْكَ مَنْ  كَذَّبَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yam-taniu' minka man kad'-d'aba biqud-ratik
segments.translation: 13.He who denies Your power keeps himself not away from You.

segments.transliteration: wa laa yafootuka man a'bada ghay-rak
segments.translation: 14.He who worships other than You escapes You not.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُعَمَّرُ فِي الدُّنْيَا مَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَآءَكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa yua'm-maru fid-dunyaa man kariha liqaaa-ak
segments.translation: 15.He who dislikes meeting You will not be given endless life in this world.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ!  مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ، وَأَقْهَرَ سُلْطَانَكَ،
segments.transliteration: sub-h'aanak maaa aa'-z'ama shaa-nak wa sq-hara sul-t'aanak
segments.translation: 16.Glory be to You! How mighty is Your station, overpowering Your authority,

segments.transliteration: wa sshad-da qoo-watak wa anfad'a am-rak
segments.translation: 17.intense Your strength, penetrating Your command!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ! قَضَيْتَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ الْمَوْتَ:
segments.translation: 18.Glory be to You! You hast decreed death for all Your creatures,
19.both him who professes Your Unity and him who disbelieves in You;
20.each one will taste death,

segments.transliteration: wa kul-lu s'aaa-irun ilay-ka fatabaarak-ta wataa'alay-t
segments.translation: 21.each one will come home to You. Blessed art You and high exalted!

segments.arabic: لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكَ،
segments.transliteration: laaa ilaha il-laaa anta wah'-daka laa shareeka lak aaamantu bik
segments.translation: 22.There is no god but Thou, You alone, who hast no associate. I have faith in You,

segments.transliteration: wa s'ad-daq-tu rusulak wa qabil-tu kitaabak
segments.translation: 23.I attest to Your messengers, I accept Your Book,
24.I disbelieve in every object of worship other than You,
25.I am quit of anyone who worships another!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أُصْبحُ وَأُمْسِي مُسْتَقِلاًّ لِعَمَلِي،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-neee us'-bihoo wa um-see mus-taqil-lal-lia'malee
segments.translation: 26.O God, I rise in the morning and enter the evening making little of my good works,
27.confessing my sins, admitting my offenses;
28.I am abased because of my prodigality against myself.
29.My works have destroyed me, my caprice has ruined me,
30.my passions have deprived me.

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ سُؤالَ مَنْ نَفْسُهُ لاَهِيَةٌ لِطُولِ أَمَلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: faas-aluka yaa mawlaaya soo-aala man naf-suhoo laaheeatul-lit'ooli amalih
segments.translation: 31.So I ask You, my Master, the asking of him whose soul is diverted by his drawn out expectations,
32.whose body is heedless because of the stillness of his veins,
33.whose heart is entranced by the multitude of favours done for him,

segments.arabic: وَفِكْرُهُ قَلِيلٌ لِمَا هُوَ صَائِرٌ  إلَيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa fik-ruhoo qaleelul-limaa huwa s'aaa-irun ilay-h
segments.translation: 34.whose reflection is little concerning that to which he is coming home;

segments.arabic: سُؤَالَ مَنْ قَدْ غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الاَمَلُ،
segments.translation: 35.the asking of him whom false expectation has overcome,
36.caprice has entranced, and this world has mastered,

segments.arabic: وَأَظَلَّهُ الاَجَلُ، سُؤَالَ مَنِ اسْتَكْثَرَ ذُنُوبَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa az'al-lahul-ajal soo-aala man is-tak-thara d'unoobah
segments.translation: 37.and over whom death has cast its shadow; the asking of him who makes much of his sins

segments.arabic: وَاعْتَرَفَ بِخَطِيئَتِهِ، سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ رَبَّ لَهُ غَيْرُكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa aa'-tarafa bikhat'ee-atih soo-aala mal-laa rab-ba lahoo ghay-ruk
segments.translation: 38.and confesses his offense; the asking of him who has no Lord but Thou,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ وَلِيَّ لَهُ دُونَكَ، وَلاَ مُنْقِذَ لَهُ مِنْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa walee-ya lahoo doonak wa laa munqid'a lahoo mink
segments.translation: 39.no friend besides You, no one to deliver him from You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ مَلْجَأَ لَهُ مِنْكَ إلاَّ إلَيْكَ .
segments.transliteration: wa laa mal-jaa lahoo minka il-laaa ilay-k
segments.translation: 40.and no asylum from You except in You.

segments.arabic: إلهِي أسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْـوَاجِبِ عَلَى  جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ،
segments.translation: 41.My God, I ask You by Your right incumbent upon all Your creatures,

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَ رَسُولَكَ أَنْ يُسَبِّحَكَ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa bis-mikal-a'z'eemil-lad'eee amar-ta rasoolaka ay-yusab-bih'aka bih
segments.translation: 42.by Your mighty name with which You commanded Your messenger to glorify You,

segments.arabic: وَبِجَلاَلِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ الذِي لاَ يَبْلى
segments.translation: 43.and by the majesty of Your generous face, which ages not,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَتَغَيَّرُ، وَلاَ يَحُولُ وَلاَ يَفْنى،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yataghay-yar wa laa yah'oolu wa laa yaf-naa
segments.translation: 44.nor changes, nor alters, nor passes away,

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.transliteration: an tus'al-leea a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaali muh'am-mad
segments.translation: 45.that You blessest Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُغْنِيَنِي عَنْ كُلِّ شَيْء بِعِبادَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa an tugh-neeanee a'n kul-li shay-im-bii'baadatik
segments.translation: 46.that You freest me from need for all things through worshipping You,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُسَلِّيَ نَفْسِيْ عَنِ الدُّنْيَا بِمَخَافَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa an tusal-leea naf-see a'nid-dunyaa bimakhaafatik
segments.translation: 47.that You distractest my soul from this world through fear of You,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُثْنِيَنِي بِالْكَثِيْرِ  مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa an tuth-neeanee bil-katheeri min karaamatika birah'-matik
segments.translation: 48.and that You turnest me back toward Your abundant generosity through Your mercy!

segments.arabic: فَإلَيْكَ أَفِرُّ، و مِنْكَ أَخَافُ، وَبِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ،
segments.transliteration: faalay-ka afir wa minka akhaaf wa bika as-tagheeth
segments.translation: 49.To You I flee, You I fear, from You I seek aid,

segments.arabic: وَإيَّاكَ أَرْجُو، وَلَكَ أَدْعُو، وَإلَيْكَ أَلْجَأُ،
segments.transliteration: wa ee-yaaka ar-joo wa laka ad-u'w wa ilay-ka al-jaa
segments.translation: 50.in You I hope, You I supplicate, in You I seek asylum,

segments.arabic: وَبِكَ أَثِقُ، وَإيَّاكَ أَسْتَعِينُ، وَبِكَ أُؤمِنُ،
segments.transliteration: wa bika athiq wa ee-yaaka as-tae'en wa bika oo-min
segments.translation: 51.in You I trust, from You I ask help, in You I have faith,
52.in You I have placed my confidence,
53.and upon Your munificence and Your generosity I rely.

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 30 His Supplication for help in repaying debts

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älih
segments.translation: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِيَ الْعَافِيَةَ مِنْ دَيْن تُخْلِقُ بِهِ وَجْهِي،
segments.transliteration: wa hab liya al-âÄfiyata min daynin tukhliqu bihÄ« wajhÄ«,
segments.translation: and grant me well-being from a debt by which my face is worn out,

segments.arabic: وَيَحَارُ فِيهِ ذِهْنِي، وَيَتَشَعَّبُ لَهُ فِكْرِي،
segments.transliteration: wa yaá¸¥Äru fÄ«hi dhihnÄ«, wa yatashaââabu lahÅ« fikrÄ«,
segments.translation: and my mind is confused therein, and my thought is scattered for it,
and my preoccupation with practicing it is prolonged.

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ هَمِّ الدَّيْنِ وَفِكْرِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa aâÅ«dhu bika yÄ Rabbi min hammi ad-dayn wa fikrih,
segments.translation: And I seek refuge in You, O Lord, from the worry of debt and its contemplation,
and the preoccupation of debt and its sleeplessness.

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْهُ.
segments.transliteration: Fa-á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa ÄlihÄ« wa aâidhnÄ« minh.
segments.translation: So bless Muhammad and his Household, and protect me from it.

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَجيرُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ ذِلَّتِهِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ
segments.transliteration: wa astajÄ«ru bika yÄ Rabbi min dhillatihÄ« fÄ« al-á¸¥ayÄh
segments.translation: And I seek Your aid, O Lord, from its humiliation in life
and from its consequence after death.

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْهُ
segments.transliteration: Fa-á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa ÄlihÄ« wa ajirnÄ« minh
segments.translation: So bless Muhammad and his Household, and shelter me from it
with an overflowing sufficiency or an adequate subsistence that reaches.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älih
segments.translation: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
and veil me from extravagance and increase,
and make me upright with generosity and moderation,
and teach me good estimation,
and restrain me with Your kindness from wastefulness,

segments.transliteration: wa ajri min asbÄbi al-á¸¥alÄl arzÄqÄ«,
segments.translation: and let my provisions flow from lawful means,

segments.transliteration: wa wajjih fÄ« abwÄbi al-birr infÄqÄ«,
segments.translation: and direct my spending in the ways of devotion,

segments.arabic: وَازْوِ عَنِّي مِنَ الْمَالِ مَا يُحْدِثُ لِي مَخِيلَةً
segments.transliteration: wa izwi âannÄ« mina al-mÄl mÄ yuá¸¥dithu lÄ« makhÄ«lah
segments.translation: and ward off from me of wealth whatever might generate vanity for me,

segments.arabic: أَوْ تَأَدِّياً إلَى بَغْي، أَوْ مَا أَتَعَقَّبُ مِنْهُ طُغْيَـاناً.
segments.transliteration: aw taâaddiyan ilÄ baghy, aw mÄ ataâaqqabu minhu á¹­ughyÄnÄ.
segments.translation: or lead to transgression, or whatever I might inherit from it of tyranny.
O God, make the company of the poor beloved to me,

segments.transliteration: wa aâinnÄ« âalÄ á¹£uá¸¥batihÄ«m bi-á¸¥usni aá¹£-á¹£abr,
segments.translation: and help me to keep their company with excellent patience,

segments.arabic: وَمَـا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي مِنْ مَتَاعِ الدُّنْيَاالفَانِيَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa mÄ zawayta âannÄ« min matÄâi ad-dunyÄ al-fÄniyah
segments.translation: and what You have withheld from me of the enjoyment of this fleeting world,
then store it for me in Your everlasting treasuries,

segments.transliteration: wa ijâal mÄ khawwaltanÄ« min á¸¥uá¹­ÄmihÄ,
segments.translation: and make what You have granted me of its fragments,

segments.arabic: وَعَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ مَتَاعِهَا بُلْغَةً إلَى جِوَارِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa âajjalta lÄ« min matÄâihÄ bulghatan ilÄ jiwÄrik,
segments.translation: and hastened to me of its enjoyment, a means to reach Your proximity,

segments.arabic: وَوُصْلَةً إلَى قُرْبِكَ، وَذَرِيعَةً إلَى جَنَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa wuá¹£latan ilÄ qurbik, wa dharÄ«âatan ilÄ jannatik
segments.translation: and a connection to Your nearness, and a way to Your Paradise,
Surely You are the Possessor of the immense Favor,
and You are the Munificent, the Generous.
1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِيَ الْعَافِيَةَ مِنْ دَيْن تُخْلِقُ بِهِ وَجْهِي،
segments.transliteration: wa hab leeal-a'afeeata min day-nin tukh-liqu bihee waj-hee
segments.translation: 2.and release me from a debt which makes me lose face,

segments.arabic: وَيَحَارُ فِيهِ ذِهْنِي، وَيَتَشَعَّبُ لَهُ فِكْرِي،
segments.transliteration: wa yah'aaru feehee d'ih-nee wa yatashaa'-a'bu lahoo fik-ree
segments.translation: 3.confuses my mind, disrupts my thinking,
4.and prolongs my occupation with attending to it!

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ هَمِّ الدَّيْنِ وَفِكْرِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa au'wd'u bika yaa rab-bi min ham-mid-day-ni wafik-rih
segments.translation: 5.I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from worry and thought about debt,
6.from the distraction and sleeplessness of debt;

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْهُ.
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih wa ai'd'-nee min-h
segments.translation: 7.so bless Muhammad and his Household and give me refuge from it!

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَجيرُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ ذِلَّتِهِ  فِي الْحَيَاةِ
segments.transliteration: wa as-tajeeru bika yaa rab-bi min d'il-latihee fil-h'ayaah
segments.translation: 8.I seek sanctuary in You, my Lord, from debt's abasement in life
9.and its ill effects after death,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْهُ
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih wa ajir-nee min-hoo
segments.translation: 10.so bless Muhammad and his Household and give me sanctuary from it
11.through a bountiful plenty or a continually arriving sufficiency!
12.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
13.prevent me from extravagance and excess,
14.put me on the course of generous spending and moderation,
15.teach me excellent distribution,
16.hold me back through Your gentleness from squandering,
17.allow me to attain my provisions through lawful means,
18.direct my spending toward the gateways of devotion,

segments.arabic: وَازْوِ عَنِّي مِنَ الْمَالِ مَا يُحْدِثُ لِي مَخِيلََةً
segments.transliteration: waz-wi a'n-nee minal-maali maa yuh'-dithu lee makhi-latan
segments.translation: 19.and take away from me any possession which will bring forth pride in me,

segments.arabic: أَوْ تَأَدِّياً إلَى بَغْي، أَوْ مَا أَتَعَقَّبُ مِنْهُ طُغْيَـاناً.
segments.transliteration: aw taad-deean ilaa bagh-yin aw maaa ataa'q-qabu min-hoo t'ugh-yaanaa
segments.translation: 20.lead to insolence, or drag me in its heels to rebellion!
21.O God, make me love the companionship of the poor
22.and help me be their companion with excellent patience!

segments.arabic: وَمَـا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي مِنْ مَتَاعِ الدُّنْيَاالفَانِيَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa maa zaway-ta a'n-nee mim-mataai'd-dunyaa al-faaneeati
segments.translation: 23.Whenever You takest away from me the goods of this perishing world,
24.store them for me in Your abiding treasuries!
25.Make this world's broken pieces which You hast conferred upon me

segments.arabic: وَعَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ مَتَاعِهَا بُلْغَةً إلَى جِوَارِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa a'j-jal-ta lee mim-mataai'haa bul-ghatan ilaa jiwaarik
segments.translation: 26.and its goods which You hast quickly granted to me a way to reach Your neighbourhood,

segments.arabic: وَوُصْلَةً إلَى قُرْبِكَ، وَذَرِيعَةً إلَى جَنَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa wus'-latan ilaa qur-bik wa d'areea'tan ilaa jan-natik
segments.translation: 27.a link to Your nearness, and a means to Your Garden!
28.Verily You art Possessor of bounty abounding,
29.and You art the Munificent, the Generous.

segments.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا فِي قَبْضَتِكَ، يَحْوِينَا مُلْكُكَ وَسُلْطَانُكَ،
segments.transliteration: aá¹£baá¸¥nÄ fÄ« qabá¸atika, yaá¸¥wÄ«nÄ mulkuka wa-sulá¹­Änuka,
segments.translation: We have entered the morning within Your grasp, encompassed by Your dominion and authority,

segments.arabic: وَتَضُمُّنَا مَشِيَّتُكَ، وَنَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ، وَنَتَقَلَّبُ فِي تَدْبِيرِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-taá¸ummunÄ mashÄ«yyatuka, wa-nataá¹£arrfu Ê¿an amrika, wa-nataqallabu fÄ« tadbÄ«rika,
segments.translation: and encompassed by Your will; we move only by Your command, and we change only by Your management,

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَمْرِ إِلَّا مَا قَضَيْتَ، وَلَا مِنَ الْخَيْرِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْطَيْتَ.
segments.transliteration: laysa lanÄ mina l-amri illÄ mÄ qaá¸ayta, wa-lÄ mina l-khayri illÄ mÄ aÊ¿á¹­ayta,
segments.translation: we have no affair except what You have decreed, and no good except what You have granted.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يَوْمٌ حَادِثٌ جَدِيدٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا شَاهِدٌ عَتِيدٌ،
segments.transliteration: wa-hÄdhÄ yawmun á¸¥Ädithun jadÄ«dun, wa-huwa Ê¿alaynÄ shÄhidun Ê¿atÄ«dun,
segments.translation: And this is a new day, and it is a present witness over us,

segments.arabic: إِنْ أَحْسَنَّا وَدَّعَنَا بِحَمْدٍ، وَإِنْ أَسَأْنَا فَارَقَنَا بِذَمٍّ.
segments.transliteration: in aá¸¥sannÄ wadaÊ¿anÄ bi-á¸¥amdin, wa-in asÄÊ¾nÄ fÄraqanÄ bi-dhamm,
segments.translation: if we do good, it leaves us with praise; and if we do evil, it leaves us with blame.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family,
Grant us good companionship with him and protect us,

segments.transliteration: Min sÅ«âi mufÄraqatihÄ« bi irtikÄbi jarÄ«rah,
segments.translation: From the harm of parting from him by committing a sin,
Whether committing a small or large sin.

segments.arabic: وَأَجْزِلْ لَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ وَأَخْلِنَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ.
segments.transliteration: Wa ajzil lanÄ fÄ«hi mina al-á¸¥asanÄti wa akhlinÄ fÄ«hi mina as-sayyiâÄt,
segments.translation: And generously grant us in it good deeds and spare us from evils.

segments.arabic: وَامْلَأْ لَنَا مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ حَمْدًا وَشُكْرًا وَأَجْرًا وَذُخْرًا وَفَضْلًا وَإِحْسَانًا.
segments.transliteration: Wa amlaâ lanÄ mÄ bayna á¹­arafayhi á¸¥amdan wa shukran wa ajran wa dhukhran wa faá¸lan wa iá¸¥sÄnan,
segments.translation: And fill for us between its two edges with praise, thanks, reward, treasure, bounty, and goodness.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ عَلَى الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ مَؤُونَتَنَا،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma yassir Ê¿alÄ al-kirÄmi al-kÄtibÄ«n maâÅ«natana,
segments.translation: O Allah, ease for the noble scribes our provision,

segments.transliteration: Wa amlaâ lanÄ min á¸¥asanÄtinÄ á¹£aá¸¥Äâifana,
segments.translation: And fill our pages with our good deeds.

segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ tukhzinÄ Ê¿indahum bisÅ«âi aÊ¿mÄlinÄ,
segments.translation: And do not disgrace us before them by our bad deeds.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ مِنْ سَاعَاتِهِ حَظًّا مِنْ عِبَادِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma ijÊ¿al lanÄ fÄ« kulli sÄÊ¿atin min sÄÊ¿Ätihi á¸¥aáºáºan min Ê¿ibÄdika,
segments.translation: O Allah, make for us in every hour of its hours a share among Your servants,

segments.arabic: وَنَصِيبًا مِنْ شُكْرِكَ وَشَاهِدَ صِدْقٍ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ.
segments.transliteration: Wa naá¹£Ä«ban min shukrika wa shÄhida á¹£idqin min malÄÊ¾ikatika,
segments.translation: And a portion of Your thanks and a truthful witness from Your angels.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi,
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muá¸¥ammad and his family,

segments.arabic: وَاحْفَظْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِينَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا وَعَنْ أَيْمَانِنَا وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا،
segments.transliteration: Wa iá¸¥faáºnÄ min bayni aydÄ«nÄ wa min khalfina wa Ê¿an aymÄnina wa Ê¿an shamÄâilina,
segments.translation: And protect us from before us, behind us, from our right and our left,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ جَمِيعِ نَوَاحِينَا حِفْظًا عَاصِمًا مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa min jamÄ«Ê¿i nawÄá¸¥inÄ á¸¥ifáºan Ê¿Äá¹£iman min maÊ¿á¹£iyatika,
segments.translation: And from all our directions, a protective guard from Your disobedience,

segments.transliteration: HÄdiyÄn ilÄ á¹­ÄÊ¿atika mustaÊ¿milan li maá¸¥abbatika,
segments.translation: Guiding us to obey You and using us for Your love.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muá¸¥ammad and his family,

segments.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِي يَوْمِنَا هَذَا وَلَيْلَتِنَا هَذِهِ وَفِي جَمِيعِ أَيَّامِنَا
segments.transliteration: Wa waffiqnÄ fÄ« yawmnÄ hÄdhÄ wa laylatinÄ hÄdhihi wa fÄ« jamÄ«Ê¿i ayyÄminÄ,
segments.translation: And grant us success on this day of ours, this night, and all our days,

segments.arabic: لاِسْتِعْمَالِ الْخَيْرِ وَهِجْرَانِ الشَّرِّ وَشُكْرِ النِّعَمِ،
segments.transliteration: Li istiÊ¿mÄli al-khayr wa hijrÄni ash-sharr wa shukri an-niÊ¿am,
segments.translation: For practicing good, abandoning evil, and being grateful for blessings,

segments.transliteration: Wa itti'bÄÊ¿i as-sunan wa mujÄnabati al-bidaÊ¿,
segments.translation: Following the traditions and avoiding innovations,

segments.transliteration: Wa al-amri bil-maÊ¿rÅ«f wa an-nahy Ê¿an al-munkar,
segments.translation: Enjoining good and forbidding evil,

segments.transliteration: Wa á¸¥iyÄá¹­ati al-islÄm wa intiqÄá¹£i al-bÄá¹­il wa idhlÄlih,
segments.translation: Protecting Islam and reducing falsehood and humiliating it,

segments.transliteration: Wa nuá¹£rati al-á¸¥aqq wa iÊ¿zÄzihi, wa irshÄdi aá¸-á¸Äll,
segments.translation: Supporting the truth and elevating it, and guiding the lost,

segments.transliteration: Wa muÊ¿Äwanati aá¸-á¸aÊ¿Ä«f wa idrÄki l-lahÄ«f,
segments.translation: And helping the weak and reaching out to the troubled/distressed.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muá¸¥ammad and his family,
And make it the most auspicious day we have ever pledged,
And the best companion we have accompanied,
And the best time we have lived in.

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَرْضَى مَنْ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ خَلْقِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa jÊ¿alnÄ min ardÄ man marra Ê¿alayhi al-laylu wa an-nahÄru min jumlat khalqik,
segments.translation: And make us among those most pleasing to whom the night and day pass of Your creation,

segments.transliteration: Wa ashkarahum limÄ awlayta min niÊ¿amik,
segments.translation: And the most grateful for what You have given in blessings,

segments.transliteration: Wa aqwamahum bimÄ sharaÊ¿ta min sharÄÊ¾iÊ¿ik,
segments.translation: And the most upright in following Your laws,

segments.transliteration: Wa awqafahum Ê¿ammÄ á¸¥adhharta min nahyik,
segments.translation: And the one who restrains himself from what You have warned against forbidding.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَشْهَدُكَ وَكَفَى بِكَ شَهِيدًا وَأُشْهِدُ سَمَاءَكَ وَأَرْضَكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« ashhaduka wa kafÄ bika shahÄ«dan wa ush-hidu samÄÊ¾aka wa ará¸aka,
segments.translation: O Allah, I bear witness to You and enough is You as a witness, and I call upon Your sky and Your earth,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَسْكَنْتَهُمَا مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ وَسَائِرِ خَلْقِكَ فِي يَوْمِي هَذَا،
segments.transliteration: Wa man askantahumÄ min malÄÊ¾ikatika wa sÄÊ¾iri khalqika fÄ« yawmi hÄdhÄ,
segments.translation: And those You have made inhabit them of Your angels and all Your creation on this day of mine,

segments.arabic: وَسَاعَتِي هَذِهِ، وَلَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ، وَمُسْتَقَرِّي هَذَا،
segments.transliteration: Wa sÄÊ¿atÄ« hÄdhihi, wa laylatÄ« hÄdhihi, wa mustaqarrÄ« hÄdhÄ,
segments.translation: And this hour of mine, this night of mine, and this resting place of mine,

segments.arabic: أَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي
segments.transliteration: AnnÄ« ash-hadu annaka anta allÄhu alladhÄ«
segments.translation: That I bear witness that You are Allah who

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ قَائِمٌ بِالْقِسْطِ،
segments.transliteration: LÄ ilÄha illÄ anta qÄâimun bil-qisá¹­,
segments.translation: There is no deity but You, established in justice,
Just in judgment, compassionate to the servants,
Master of the kingdom, merciful to creation,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ وَخِيَّرَتُكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa anna Muá¸¥ammadan Ê¿abduka wa rasÅ«luka wa khÄ«yaratuka min khalqik,
segments.translation: And that Muá¸¥ammad is Your servant and messenger and Your chosen among Your creation,

segments.arabic: حَمَّلْتَهُ رِسَالَتَكَ فَأَدَّاهَا وَأَمَرْتَهُ بِالنُّصْحِ لِأُمَّتِهِ فَنَصَحَ لَهَا.
segments.transliteration: Hammaltahu risÄlataka fa addÄhÄ wa amartahu bin-nuá¹£á¸¥ li ummatihi fa naá¹£aá¸¥a lahÄ,
segments.translation: You entrusted him with Your message, and he delivered it and commanded earnest advice for his nation, so he advised them well.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ أَكْثَرَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma faá¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi akthara mÄ á¹£allayta Ê¿alÄ aá¸¥adin min khalqik,
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muá¸¥ammad and his family more than You have sent blessings on anyone of Your creation,

segments.arabic: وَآتِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا آتَيْتَ أَحَدًا مِنْ عِبَادِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa Ätih Ê¿annÄ afá¸ala mÄ Ätayta aá¸¥adan min Ê¿ibÄdik,
segments.translation: And grant him on our behalf the best of what You have given any of Your servants,

segments.arabic: وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ وَأَكْرَمَ مَا جَزَيْتَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِكَ عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ.
segments.transliteration: Wa ajzih Ê¿annÄ afá¸ala wa akrama mÄ jazayta aá¸¥adan min anbiyÄâika Ê¿an ummatih,
segments.translation: And reward him on our behalf the best and most generous of what You rewarded any of Your prophets for his nation.

segments.arabic: إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْجَسِيمِ الْغَافِرِ لِلْعَظِيمِ،
segments.transliteration: Inna ka anta al-mannÄn bi al-jasÄ«m al-ghÄfir lil-Ê¿aáºÄ«m,
segments.translation: Indeed, You are the Benefactor, the Great, the Forgiver of the Great sins,

segments.transliteration: Wa anta ará¸¥amu min kulli raá¸¥Ä«m,
segments.translation: And You are more Merciful than all who show mercy,

segments.transliteration: Fa á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: So send blessings on Muá¸¥ammad and his family,
The pure, the clean, the good, the most noble.

segments.arabic: أَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهارَ بِقُوَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: 1.Praise belongs to God, who created night and day through His strength,
2.set them apart through His power,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا حَدّاً مَحْدُوداً، وَأَمَداً مَمْدُوداً ،
segments.transliteration: wa jaa'la likul-li waah'idim-minhumaa h'ad-dam-mah'-doodaw-wa amadam-mam-doodaa
segments.translation: 3.and appointed for each a determined limit and a drawn-out period.

segments.arabic: يُولِجُ كُلَّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا فِي صَاحِبِهِ،
segments.translation: 4.He makes each of the two enter into its companion,

segments.arabic: وَيُولِجُ صَاحِبَهُ فِيهِ بِتَقْدِير مِنْهُ لِلْعِبَادِ
segments.transliteration: wa yooliju s'aah'ibahoo feeh bitaq-deerim-min-hoo lil-i'baadi
segments.translation: 5.and makes its companion enter into it, as an ordainment from Him for His servants

segments.transliteration: feemaa yagh-d'oohum bihee wa yunshi-uhum a'lay-h
segments.translation: 6.in that through which He feeds them and with which He makes them grow.

segments.arabic: فَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ اللَّيْـلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيْهِ مِنْ حَرَكَاتِ التَّعَبِ،
segments.transliteration: fakhalaqa lahumul-lay-l leeas-kunoo feehee min h'arakaatit-taa'bi
segments.translation: 7.He created for them the night, "that they might rest in it" (10:67) from tiring movements

segments.arabic: وَنَهَضَاتِ النَّصَبِ، وَجَعَلَهُ لِبَاساً لِيَلْبَسُوا مِنْ رَاحَتِهِ وَمَنَامِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa nahaz''aatin-nas'ab wa jaa'lahoo libaasal-leeal-basoo mir-raah'atihee wamanaamihee
segments.translation: 8.and wearisome exertions and He made it a garment for them that they might be clothed in its ease and its sleep,

segments.arabic: فَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ جَمَاماً وَقُوَّةً، وَلِيَنَالُوا بِهِ لَذَّةً وَشَهْوَةً.
segments.transliteration: fayakoona d'alika lahum jamaamaw-waqoo-wah wa leeanaaloo bihee lad'-d'ataw-washah-wah
segments.translation: 9.that it might be for them refreshment and strength, that they might reach therein pleasure and passion.

segments.arabic: وَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ النَّهارَ مُبْصِراً لِيَبْتَغُوا فِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa khalaqa lahumun-nahaara mub-s'ira leeab-taghoo feehee min faz''-lih
segments.translation: 10.He created for them the daytime, "giving sight, that they might seek within it of His bounty" (ref. 17:12)

segments.arabic: وَلِيَتَسَبَّبُوا  إلَى رِزْقِهِ، وَيَسْرَحُوا فِي أَرْضِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa leeatasab-baboo ilaa riz-qih wa yas-rah'oo feee ar-z''ih
segments.translation: 11.find the means to His provision, and roam freely in His earth,

segments.arabic: طَلَباً لِمَا فِيـهِ نَيْلُ الْعَاجِلِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ،
segments.translation: 12.searching for that through which to attain the immediate in their life in this world

segments.arabic: وَدَرَكُ الاجِلِ فِيْ اُخْراهُمْ. بِكُلِّ ذلِكَ يُصْلِحُ شَأنَهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa darakul-aaajili feee ukh-raahum- bikul-li d'alika yus'-lihoo shaa-nahum-
segments.translation: 13.and to achieve the deferred in their life to come. Through all of this He sets right their situation,

segments.arabic: وَيَبْلُو أَخْبَارَهُمْ وَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ هُمْ فِي أَوْقَاتِ طَاعَتِـهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yab-looo akh-baarahum- wa yanz'uru kay-fa hum feee aw-qaati t'aaa'tih
segments.translation: 14.tries their records, and watches their state in the times for obeying Him,

segments.transliteration: wa manaazili furooz''ih wa mawaaqii' ah'-kaamih
segments.translation: 15.the waystations of His obligations, and the places of His ordinances,

segments.arabic: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى.
segments.transliteration: (leeaj-zeeal-lad'eena asaaa-oo bimaa a'miloo wa yaj-zeeal-lad'eena ah'-sanoo bil-h'us-naa)
segments.translation: 16.that He may repay those who do evil with what they have done and repay those who do good with goodness.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَافَلَقْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الإصْبَاحِ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma falakal-h'am-du a'laa maa falaq-ta lanaa minal-is'-baah'
segments.translation: 17.O God, to You belongs praise for the sky You hast split into dawn for us,
18.giving us to enjoy thereby the brightness of daytime,
19.showing us sought-after nourishments,
20.and protecting us from the striking of blights.

segments.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَتِ الاَشْياءُ كُلُّهَا بِجُمْلَتِهَا لَكَ:
segments.transliteration: as'-bah'-naa wa as'-bah'atil-ash-yaaa-u kul-luhaa bijum-latihaa lak
segments.translation: 21.In the morning we and all things, every one, rise for You,

segments.transliteration: samaaaw-uhaa wa ar-z''uhaa wa maa bathath-ta
segments.translation: 22.the heaven and the earth and what You hast scattered

segments.arabic: فِي كُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا سَاكِنُهُ وَمُتَحَرِّكُهُ وَمُقِيمُهُ
segments.transliteration: fee kul-li waah'idim-min-humaa saakinuhoo wa mutah'ar-rikuh wa muqeemuhoo
segments.translation: 23.in each, the still and the moving, the resident

segments.arabic: وَشَاخِصُهُ وَمَا عَلا فِي الْهَواءِ وَمَا كَنَّ تَحْتَ الثَّرى
segments.transliteration: wa shaakhis'uh wa maa a'laa fil-hawaaa-i wa maa kan-na tah'-tath-tharaa
segments.translation: 24.and the journeying, what towers up in the air and what hides under the ground.
25.We rise in the morning in Your grasp:

segments.transliteration: yah'-weenaa mul-kuka wa  sul-t'aanuk wa taz''um-munaa mashee-yatuk
segments.translation: 26.Your kingdom and authority contain us and Your will embraces us.

segments.arabic: وَنَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ، وَنَتَقَلَّبُ فِيْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa natas'ar-rafu a'n am-rik wa nataqal-labu fee tad-beerik
segments.translation: 27.We move about by Your command and turn this way and that through Your governing.

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الامْرِ إلاّ مَا قَضَيْتَ
segments.transliteration: lay-sa lanaa minal-am-ri il-laa maa qaz''ay-t
segments.translation: 28.We own nothing of the affair except what You hast decreed

segments.arabic: وَلا مِنَ الْخَيْـرِ إلا مَـا أَعْطَيْتَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa minal-khay-ri il-laa maaa aa'-t'ay-t
segments.translation: 29.and nothing of the good except what You hast given.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يَوْمٌ حَادِثٌ جَدِيدٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا شَاهِدٌ عَتِيدٌ ،
segments.transliteration: wa had'aa yaw-mun h'aadithun jadeed wa huwa a'lay-naa shaahidun a'teed
segments.translation: 30.This is a fresh, new day, over us a ready witness.

segments.arabic: إنْ أحْسَنَّا وَدَّعَنَا بِحَمْد، وَإِنْ أسَأنا فارَقَنا بِذَمّ
segments.transliteration: in ah'-san-naa wad-daa'naa bih'am-d wa in asaa-naa faaraqanaa bid'am
segments.translation: 31.If we do good, it will take leave from us with praise, and if we do evil, it will part from us in blame.
32.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
33.provide us with the day's good companionship and preserve us
34.against parting from it badly by doing a misdeed
35.or committing a sin, whether small or great!

segments.arabic: وَأجْزِلْ لَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَسَناتِ وَأَخْلِنَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ.
segments.transliteration: wa aj-zil-lanaa feehee minal-h'asanaat wa akh-linaa feehee minas-say-yi-aat
segments.translation: 36.Make our good deeds within it plentiful empty us therein of evil deeds,

segments.arabic: وَامْلا لَنَا مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ حَمْداً وَشُكْراً وَأجْراً وَذُخْراً وَفَضْلاً وَإحْسَاناً.
segments.transliteration: wa am-laa lanaa maa beena t'arafay-hee h'am-daw-washuk-raa wa aj-raw-wa d'ukh-raa wa faz''-law-wa ih'-saanaa
segments.translation: 37.and fill what lies between its two sides for us with praise and thanksgiving, wages and stores, bounty and beneficence!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يسِّرْ عَلَى الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ مَؤُونَتَنَا،
segments.translation: 38.O God, ease our burden on the Noble Writers,

segments.transliteration: wa am-laa lanaa min h'asanaatinaa s'ah'aaa-ifanaa
segments.translation: 39.fill our pages for us with our good deeds,

segments.transliteration: wa laa tukh-zinaa i'ndahum bisooo-i aa'-maalinaa
segments.translation: 40.and degrade us not before them with our evil works!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِهِ حَظّاً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma aj-a'l-lanaa fee kul-li saaa'tim-min saaa'atih h'az'-z'am-min i'baadik
segments.translation: 41.O God, appoint for us in each of the day's hours a share from Your servants,

segments.arabic: وَنَصِيباً مِنْ شُكْرِكَ وَشَاهِدَ صِدْق مِنْ  مَلائِكَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa nas'eebam-min shuk-rik wa shaahida s'id-qim-mim-malaaa-ikatik
segments.translation: 42.a portion of giving thanks to You, and a truthful witness among Your angels!
43.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَاحْفَظْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أيْدِينَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا وَعَنْ أيْمَانِنَا  وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا،
segments.transliteration: wa ah'-faz'-naa mim-bay-ni ay-deenaa? wa min khal-finaa wa a'n ay-maaninaa? wa a'n shamaaa-ilinaa
segments.translation: 44.and safeguard us from before us and behind us, from our right hands and our left hands

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ جَمِيْعِ نَوَاحِيْنَا حِفْظاً عَاصِماً مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa min jameei' nawaah'eenaa h'if-z'aa a'as'imam-mim-maa'-s'eeatik
segments.translation: 45.and from all our directions, a safeguarding that will preserve from disobeying You,
46.guide to obeying You, and be employed for Your love!
47.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِي يَوْمِنَا هذا ولَيْلَتِنَا هذِهِ وَفِي جَمِيعِ أيّامِنَا
segments.transliteration: wa waf-fiq-naa fee yaw-minaa had'aa wa lay-latinaa had'ihi? wa fee jameei' ay-yaaminaa
segments.translation: 48.and give us success in this day of ours, this night of ours, and in all our days,

segments.arabic: لاسْتِعْمَالِ الْخَيْرِ وَهِجْـرَانِ الشَرِّ وَشُكْـرِ ألنِّعَمِ
segments.translation: 49.to employ the good, stay away from the evil, give thanks for favours,
50.follow the Sunna's norms, avoid innovations,
51.enjoin good behaviour, forbid the disapproved,

segments.transliteration: wa h'eeaat'atil-is-laam wa antiqaas'il-baat'ili wa id'-laalih
segments.translation: 52.defend Islam, diminish falsehood and abase it,

segments.transliteration: wa nus'-ratil-h'aq-qi wa ia'-zaazih wa ir-shaadiz''-z''aaal
segments.translation: 53.help the truth and exalt it, guide the misguided,
54.assist the weak, and reach out to the troubled!
55.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
56.and make this the most fortunate day we have known,
57.the most excellent companion we have accompanied,
58.and the best time in which we have lingered!

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أرْضَى مَنْ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْـلُ وَالنَّهَارُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-naa min ar-z''aa mam-mar-ra a'lay-hil-lay-lu wan-nahaaru min jum-lati khal-qik
segments.translation: 59.Place us among the most satisfied of all Your creatures whom night and day have passed by,
60.the most thankful of them for the favours You hast done,

segments.transliteration: wa aq-wamahum bimaa sharaa'-ta min sharaaa-ii'k
segments.translation: 61.the firmest of them in the laws You hast set down in the Shari'a,
62.and the most unyielding of them toward the prohibited acts against which You hast cautioned!

segments.arabic: اللَهُمَّ إنِّي اشْهِدُكَ وَكَفَى بِكَ شَهِيداً وَاُشْهِدُ سَمَاءكَ وَأَرْضَكَ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-neee ush-hiduka wa  kafaa bika shaheedaa wa ush-hidu samaaa-aka wa ar-z''aka
segments.translation: 63.O God, I call You to witness - and You art sufficient witness - and I call Your heaven and Your earth to witness

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَسْكَنْتَهُما مِنْ مَلائِكَتِـكَ وَسَائِرِ خَلْقِكَ فِي يَوْمِي هَذَا ،
segments.transliteration: wa man as-kantahumaa mim-malaaa-ikatika wa saaa-iri khal-qik fee yaw-mee had'aa
segments.translation: 64.and Your angels and Your other creatures who inhabit them in this my day,

segments.arabic: وَسَاعَتِي هَذِهِ ، وَلَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ ، وَمُسْتَقَرِّي هَذَا ،
segments.transliteration: wa saaa'tee had'ih? wa lay-latee had'ih wa mus-taqar-ree had'aa
segments.translation: 65.this my hour, this my night, and this my resting place,

segments.arabic: أنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أنْتَ اللهُ الِذَّي
segments.translation: 66.that I bear witness that You art God,

segments.arabic: لاَ إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ قَائِمٌ بِـالْقِسْطِ ،
segments.translation: 67.other than whom there is no god, Upholding justice,
68.Equitable in judgement, "Clement to the servants" (2:207),
69."Master of the kingdom" (3:26), Compassionate to the creatures,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ وَخِيرَتُكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: wa an-na muh'am-madan a'b-duka warasooluk wa kheearatuka min khal-qik
segments.translation: 70.and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your messenger, Your chosen from among Your creatures.

segments.arabic: حَمَّلْتَهُ رِسَالَتَكَ فَأدَّاهَا وَأَمَرْتَهُ بالنُّصْحِ لاُِمَّتِهِ فَنَصَحَ لَهَا.
segments.transliteration: h'am-mal-tahoo risaalataka faad-daahaa wa amar-tahoo bin-nus'-hee lium-matihee fanas'ah'a lahaa
segments.translation: 71.You didst charge him with Your message and he delivered it; You didst command him to counsel his community and he counselled it.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ أكْثَرَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih ak-thara maa s'al-lay-ta a'laaa ah'adim-min khal-qik
segments.translation: 72.O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household more than You hast blessed any of Your creatures!

segments.arabic: وَآتِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا آتَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa aaatihee a'n-naaa af-z''ala maaa aaatay-ta ah'adam-min i'baadik
segments.translation: 73.Give him for our sake the best You hast given any of Your servants,

segments.arabic: وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ وَأكْرَمَ مَا جَزَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ أَنْبِيائِـكَ  عَنْ أمَّتِهِ.
segments.transliteration: wa aj-zihee a'n-naaa af-z''ala wa ak-rama maa jazay-ta ah'adam-min ambeeaaa-ika a'n um-matih
segments.translation: 74.and repay him on our behalf better and more generously than You hast repaid any of Your prophets on behalf of his community!

segments.arabic: إنَّـكَ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْجَسِيمِ الْغَـافِر لِلْعَظِيمِ ،
segments.transliteration: in-nak antal-man-naanu bil-jaseem wa al-ghaafiru lil-a'z'eem
segments.translation: 75.You art All-kind with immensity, the Forgiver of the great,

segments.transliteration: wa anta ar-h'amu min kul-li rah'eem
segments.translation: 76.and You art more merciful than every possessor of mercy!
77.So bless Muhammad and his Household,
78.the good, the pure, the chosen, the most distinguished!

segments.arabic: أَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهارَ بِقُوَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Al-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi alladhÄ« khalaqa al-layla wa an-nahÄra bi quwwatihi,
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah who created the night and the day by His power,
And distinguished between them by His ability,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا حَدًّا مَحْدُودًا، وَأَمَدًا مَمْدُودًا،
segments.transliteration: Wa jaÊ¿ala likulli wÄá¸¥idin minhumÄ á¸¥addan maá¸¥dÅ«dan wa amadan mamdÅ«dan,
segments.translation: And made for each of them a fixed limit and an extended time,

segments.arabic: يُولِجُ كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا فِيْ صَاحِبِهِ،
segments.transliteration: YÅ«liju kulla wÄá¸¥idin minhumÄ fÄ« á¹£Äá¸¥ibihi,
segments.translation: He causes each of them to enter its companion,

segments.arabic: وَيُولِجُ صَاحِبَهُ فِيهِ بِتَقْدِيرٍ مِنْهُ لِلْعِبَادِ
segments.transliteration: Wa yÅ«liju á¹£Äá¸¥ibahu fÄ«hi bi taqdÄ«rin minhu lil-Ê¿ibÄd,
segments.translation: And causes its companion to enter it by decree from Him for the servants,

segments.transliteration: FÄ«mÄ yughdhÅ«hum bihi wa yunshiâuhum Ê¿alayh,
segments.translation: In that with which He nourishes them and raises them,

segments.arabic: فَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ مِنْ حَرَكَاتِ التَّعَبِ،
segments.transliteration: Fa khalaqa lahumu al-layla liyas kunÅ« fÄ«hi min á¸¥arakÄti at-taÊ¿ab,
segments.translation: So He created the night for them to rest in it from labor,

segments.arabic: وَنَهَضَاتِ النَّصَبِ، وَجَعَلَهُ لِبَاسًا لِيَلْبَسُوا مِنْ رَاحَتِهِ وَمَنَامِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa nahadhÄti an-naá¹£ab, wa jaÊ¿alahu libÄsan li yalbasÅ« min rÄá¸¥atihi wa manÄmihi,
segments.translation: And from the exertion they rise from, and made it a garment to wear for comfort and sleep,

segments.arabic: فَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ جَمَامًا وَقُوَّةً، وَلِيَنَالُوا بِهِ لَذَّةً وَشَهْوَةً.
segments.transliteration: FayakÅ«na dhÄlika jamÄman wa quwwatan, wa li yanÄlÅ« bihi ladhdhatan wa shahwata,
segments.translation: Thus it is rest and strength, so they may attain by it pleasure and desire.

segments.arabic: وَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ النَّهارَ مُبْصِرًا لِيَبْتَغُوا فِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa khalaqa lahumu an-nahÄra mubá¹£iran li yabtaghÅ« fÄ«hi min faá¸lihi,
segments.translation: And He created the day for them as sight to seek from His bounty,

segments.arabic: وَلِيَتَسَبَّبُوا إِلَى رِزْقِهِ، وَيَسْرَحُوا فِي أَرْضِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa li yatasabbabÅ« ilÄ rizqihi, wa yasrahÅ« fÄ« ará¸ihi,
segments.translation: And so they may endeavor to earn their provision, and wander on His earth,

segments.arabic: طَلَبًا لِمَا فِيهِ نَيْلُ الْعَاجِلِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: á¹¬alaban limÄ fÄ«hi naylu al-Ê¿Äjili min dunyÄhum,
segments.translation: Seeking what attains the immediate benefit from their worldly life,
And the reaching of the last time in their Hereafter.
With all that He sets their affairs right,

segments.arabic: وَيَبْلُو أَخْبَارَهُمْ وَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ هُمْ فِي أَوْقَاتِ طَاعَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa yablÅ« akhbÄrahum wa yanáºur kayfa hum fÄ« awqÄti á¹­ÄÊ¿atihi,
segments.translation: And tests their stories and watches how they fare in times of obedience to Him,

segments.transliteration: Wa manÄzili furÅ«á¸ihi wa mawÄqiÊ¿i aá¸¥kÄmihi,
segments.translation: And the stations of His duties and places of His judgments,

segments.arabic: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى.
segments.transliteration: LiyajzÄ« al-ladhÄ«na asÄÅ« bimÄ Ê¿amilÅ« wa yajzÄ« al-ladhÄ«na aá¸¥sanÅ« bil-á¸¥usnÄ.
segments.translation: To recompense those who did evil by what they did, and those who did good with the best.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا فَلَقْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الإِصْبَاحِ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma falaka al-á¸¥amdu Ê¿alÄ mÄ falaqta lanÄ mina al-iá¹£bÄá¸¥,
segments.translation: O Allah, to You be the praise for what You have dawned upon us this morning,

segments.transliteration: Wa mattaÊ¿nÄ bihi min á¸awâi an-nahÄr,
segments.translation: And gave us the enjoyment of the daylight,
And made us discerning in seeking provision,

segments.transliteration: Wa waqaytanÄ fÄ«hi min á¹­awÄriqi al-ÄfÄt,
segments.translation: And protected us in it from the attacks of calamities.

segments.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَتِ الْأَشْيَاءُ كُلُّهَا بِجُمْلَتِهَا لَكَ:
segments.transliteration: Aá¹£baá¸¥nÄ wa aá¹£baá¸¥at al-ashyÄÊ¾u kulluhÄ bijumlatihÄ laka:
segments.translation: We have entered the morning, and all things in their entirety belong to You:

segments.transliteration: SamÄÊ¾uhÄ wa ará¸uhÄ wa mÄ bathatha
segments.translation: Its sky, its earth, and whatever You have spread,

segments.arabic: فِي كُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا سَاكِنُهُ وَمُتَحَرِّكُهُ وَمُقِيمُهُ،
segments.transliteration: FÄ« kulli wÄá¸¥idin minhumÄ sÄkinuhu wa mutaá¸¥arrikuhu wa muqÄ«muhu,
segments.translation: In each one of them its rest, its movement, and its permanence,

segments.arabic: وَشَاخِصُهُ وَمَا عَلَا فِي الْهَوَاءِ وَمَا كَنَّ تَحْتَ الثَّرَى،
segments.transliteration: Wa shÄkhiá¹£uhu wa mÄ Ê¿alÄ fÄ« al-hawÄâ wa mÄ kanna taá¸¥ta ath-tharÄ,
segments.translation: And its fixed points, that which is in the air and that which is beneath the earth,
We have entered into Your grasp;

segments.transliteration: Yaá¸¥wÄ«nÄ mulkuka wa sulá¹­Änuka wa taá¸ummunÄ mashÄ«yatuka,
segments.translation: Your kingdom surrounds us, Your authority, and Your will encloses us,

segments.arabic: وَنَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ، وَنَتَقَلَّبُ فِي تَدْبِيرِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa nataá¹£arrafu Ê¿an amrika, wa nataqallabu fÄ« tadbÄ«rika,
segments.translation: Yet we act by Your command and turn within Your management,

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَمْرِ إِلَّا مَا قَضَيْتَ،
segments.transliteration: Laysa lanÄ mina al-amri illÄ mÄ qaá¸ayta,
segments.translation: We have no command except what You decree,

segments.arabic: وَلَا مِنَ الْخَيْرِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْطَيْتَ.
segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ mina al-khayri illÄ mÄ aÊ¿á¹­ayta.
segments.translation: And no good except what You give.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يَوْمٌ حَادِثٌ جَدِيدٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا شَاهِدٌ عَتِيدٌ،
segments.transliteration: Wa hÄdhÄ yawmun á¸¥Ädiá¹¯un jadÄ«dun, wa huwa Ê¿alaynÄ shÄhidun Ê¿atÄ«dun,

So to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, we offer praise,
And for all matters, we express our gratitude to Him,
We seek His protection, as one who is preoccupied with His obedience,

segments.arabic: وَنَسْتَرْشِدُهُ إِرْشَادَ مَنْ لَا يَقْتَصِرُ نَظَرُهُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ.
segments.transliteration: wa-nastarshiduhu irshÄda man lÄ yaqtaá¹£iru naáºaruhu âalÄ nafsih,
segments.translation: And we seek His guidance, as one whose vision is not confined to himself alone.
O Allah, You alone we worship, and You alone we seek for help,
In You alone we desire, and to You alone we hasten,
You alone we serve diligently, and You alone we fear,
Hoping for Your mercy and fearing Your punishment,
O Allah, make my soul content with Your decree,
Pleased with Your judgment,
Passionately devoted to Your remembrance and supplication,
Loving the chosen ones among Your friends,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا أَصْبَحْتُ فِيهِ مِمَّا أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa-mÄ aá¹£baá¸¥tu fÄ«hi mimmÄ anâamta bihi âalayya,
segments.translation: O Allah, whatever I have entered this morning with, from among Your blessings upon me,

segments.arabic: فِي دِيْنٍ أَوْ دُنْيَا، فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ،
segments.transliteration: fÄ« dÄ«n aw dunyÄ, fa-minka waá¸¥daka lÄ sharÄ«ka lak,
segments.translation: Whether in religion or worldly life, it is from You alone, with no partner beside You,
So to You belongs all praise for that,

segments.arabic: وَعَلَيَّ التَّمَامُ وَبِكَ الَّذِي زِدْتَنَا مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-âalayya al-tamÄmu wa-bika al-ladhÄ« zidtanÄ min faá¸lik wa-raá¸¥matik,
segments.translation: And upon me is the completion of it, and it is through You that You increase us in Your bounty and mercy,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أَشْهَدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ مَلَائِكَتَكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« aá¹£baá¸¥tu ashhaduk, wa-ushhidu malÄâikatak,
segments.translation: O Allah, I have entered this morning bearing witness to You, and I call upon Your angels to witness,
As well as the bearers of Your Throne and all of Your creation,

segments.arabic: أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ،
segments.transliteration: annaka anta AllÄh, lÄ ilÄha illÄ anta,
segments.translation: That You are Allah, there is no deity but You,
You alone, without partner,
And that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُجَدِّدُ لَكَ فِي صَبَاحِ يَوْمِي هَذَا،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« ujadidu laka fÄ« á¹£abÄá¸¥i yawmÄ« hÄdhÄ,
segments.translation: O Allah, I renew for You on this morning of mine,

segments.arabic: وَمَا عِشْتُ مِنْ أَيَّامِي، إِقْرَارِي بِوَحْدَانِيَّتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-mÄ âishtu min ayyÄmÄ«, iqrÄrÄ« bi-waá¸¥dÄniyyatik,
segments.translation: And for as long as I live, my acknowledgment of Your Oneness,
And my sincerity in religion for You,
O Allah, then accept it from me,
O Allah, protect me from doubt and associating others with You,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ أَشْرَكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ،
segments.transliteration: wa-an ashrika bika shayâan wa-anÄ aâlam,
segments.translation: And from knowingly associating anything with You,
And I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُرِيدُكَ وَأُرِيدُ الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« aá¹£baá¸¥tu urÄ«duka wa-urÄ«du al-dÄra al-Äkhirah,
segments.translation: O Allah, I have entered this morning desiring You and the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: فَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ أَنْ أَكُوْنَ فِي يَوْمِي هَذَا أَوْ لَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ أُرِيْدُ فِيهِمَا شَيْئًا يُخَالِفُ ذَلِكَ.
segments.transliteration: fa-aâidhnÄ« min an akÅ«na fÄ« yawmÄ« hÄdhÄ aw laylatÄ« hÄdhih urÄ«du fÄ«himÄ shayâan yukhÄlifu dhÄlik,
segments.translation: So protect me from wanting anything in this day or this night that contradicts that desire.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا سَقَيْتَنَا مِنْ مَطَرٍ، فَاجْعَلْهُ بَلَاغًا وَصَحِيحًا وَنَافِعًا وَمُبَارَكًا،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma mÄ saqaytanÄ min maá¹­arin, fa-jâalhu balÄghan wa-á¹£aá¸¥Ä«á¸¥an wa-nÄfiâan wa-mubÄrakan,
segments.translation: O Allah, whatever rain You send upon us, make it sufficient, pure, beneficial, and blessed,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْهُ سَيْبًا رَحْمَةً، وَلَا تَجْعَلْهُ سَيْبًا عَذَابًا وَلَا هَدْمًا وَلَا غَرَقًا.
segments.transliteration: wa-jâalhu sayban raá¸¥matan, wa-lÄ tajâalhu sayban âadhÄban wa-lÄ hadman wa-lÄ gharqan,
segments.translation: And make it a shower of mercy, and do not make it a shower of punishment, destruction, or drowning.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ لَكَ عَبْدًا، وَعَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« aá¹£baá¸¥tu laka âabdan, wa-âalÄ âahdika wa-waâdika,
segments.translation: O Allah, I have entered this morning as Your servant, upon Your covenant and promise,

segments.arabic: فَأَحْيِنِي عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ، وَأَمِتْنِي عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ.
segments.transliteration: fa-aá¸¥yinÄ« âalÄ al-Ä«mÄn, wa-amitnÄ« âalÄ al-islÄm,
segments.translation: So grant me life upon faith and grant me death upon Islam.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma ajâalnÄ« min ahli al-jannah, wa-aâidhnÄ« min ahli al-nÄr,
segments.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of Paradise, and protect me from being among the people of Hellfire,

segments.arabic: وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ،
segments.transliteration: wa-aâidhnÄ« min sharri kulli dhÄ« sharr,
segments.translation: And protect me from the evil of every evil being,

segments.arabic: وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقْتَ وَذَرَأْتَ وَبَرَأْتَ.
segments.transliteration: wa-aâidhnÄ« min sharri mÄ khalaqta wa-dharaâta wa-baraâta,
segments.translation: And protect me from the evil of what You have created, spread, and fashioned.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رِضَاكَ وَالْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَالنَّارِ.
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« asâaluka riá¸Äka wa-al-jannah, wa-aâÅ«dhu bika min sakhaá¹­ika wa-al-nÄr,
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Your pleasure and Paradise, and I seek refuge in You from Your wrath and Hellfire.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ عِبَادُكَ الصَّالِحُونَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« asâaluka min khayri mÄ saâalaka minhu âibÄduka al-á¹£Äliá¸¥Å«n,
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the best of what Your righteous servants have asked You for,

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَ مِنْهُ عِبَادُكَ الْمُخْلَصُونَ.
segments.transliteration: wa-aâÅ«dhu bika min sharri mÄ istaâÄdha minhu âibÄduka al-mukhlaá¹£Å«n,
segments.translation: And I seek refuge in You from the evil from which Your sincere servants have sought refuge.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« asâaluka al-âÄfiyata fÄ« al-dunyÄ wa-al-Äkhirah,
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْمُعَافَاةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي.
segments.transliteration: wa-asâaluka al-âafwa wa-al-muâÄfÄta fÄ« dÄ«nÄ« wa-dunyÄya wa-ahlÄ« wa-mÄlÄ«,
segments.translation: And I ask You for pardon and protection in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth.
O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears,

segments.arabic: وَاحْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-aá¸¥faáºnÄ« min bayni yadayya wa-min khalfÄ«, wa-âan yamÄ«nÄ« wa-âan shimÄlÄ«,
segments.translation: And protect me from what is before me and behind me, from my right and my left,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي.
segments.transliteration: wa-min fawqÄ«, wa-aâÅ«dhu bi-âaáºamatika an ughtÄla min taá¸¥tÄ«,
segments.translation: And from above me, and I seek refuge in Your majesty from being taken from beneath me.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ تَهْدِي بِهَا قَلْبِي،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« asâaluka raá¸¥matan min âindika tahdÄ« bihÄ qalbÄ«,
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You for a mercy from You that will guide my heart,

segments.arabic: وَتَجْمَعُ بِهَا أَمْرِي، وَتَلُمُّ بِهَا شَعَثِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-tajmaâu bihÄ amrÄ«, wa-tulummu bihÄ shaâathÄ«,
segments.translation: And through it, unite my affairs and mend what is scattered within me,

segments.arabic: وَتَرُدُّ بِهَا غَائِبِي، وَتَرْفَعُ بِهَا شَاهِدِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-taruddu bihÄ ghÄâibÄ«, wa-tarfaâu bihÄ shÄhidÄ«,
segments.translation: And return through it what is absent from me, and elevate what is present within me,

segments.arabic: وَتُزَكِّي بِهَا عَمَلِي، وَتُلْهِمُنِي بِهَا رُشْدِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-tuzakkÄ« bihÄ âamalÄ«, wa-tulhimunÄ« bihÄ rushdÄ«,
segments.translation: And purify through it my deeds, and inspire me with righteousness,

segments.arabic: وَتَرُدُّ بِهَا أُلْفَتِي، وَتَعْصِمُنِي بِهَا مِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ.
segments.transliteration: wa-taruddu bihÄ ulfatÄ«, wa-taâá¹£imunÄ« bihÄ min kulli sÅ«â,
segments.translation: And restore through it my unity, and protect me through it from all harm.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنَا إِيمَانًا وَيَقِينًا لَيْسَ بَعْدَهُ كُفْرٌ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma aâá¹­inÄ Ä«mÄnan wa-yaqÄ«nan laysa baâdahu kufr,
segments.translation: O Allah, grant us faith and certainty after which there is no disbelief,

segments.arabic: وَرَحْمَةً نَنَالُ بِهَا شَرَفَ كَرَامَتِكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ.
segments.transliteration: wa-raá¸¥matan nanÄlu bihÄ sharafa karÄmatika fÄ« al-dunyÄ wa-al-Äkhirah,
segments.translation: And mercy through which we attain the honor of Your grace in this world and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الصَّبْرَ عِنْدَ الْبَلَاءِ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« asâaluka al-á¹£abra âinda al-balÄâ,
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You for patience in times of trial,
And success at the time of meeting (You), and the ranks of the martyrs,
And the life of the blessed, and victory over enemies.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَنْزِلُ بِكَ حَاجَتِي، وَإِنْ قَصُرَ رَأْيِي وَضَعُفَ عَمَلِي،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« anzilu bika á¸¥ÄjÄtÄ«, wa-in qaá¹£ura raâyÄ« wa-á¸aâufa âamalÄ«,
segments.translation: O Allah, I bring my needs to You, though my judgment falls short and my deeds are weak,

segments.arabic: افْتَقَرْتُ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا قَاضِيَ الأُمُورِ،
segments.transliteration: iftaqartu ilÄ raá¸¥matika, fa-asâaluka yÄ qÄá¸iya al-umÅ«r,
segments.translation: I am in need of Your mercy, so I ask You, O Disposer of affairs,

segments.arabic: وَيَا شَافِيَ صُدُورِ الْمَكْرُوبِينَ، أَنْ تُجِيرَنِي مِنْ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-yÄ shÄfiya á¹£udÅ«ri al-makrÅ«bÄ«n, an tujÄ«ranÄ« min âadhÄbi al-saâÄ«r,
segments.translation: And O Healer of the hearts of the distressed, that You save me from the torment of Hellfire,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُجِيرَنِي مِنْ دَعْوَةِ الثَّبُورِ، وَفِتْنَةِ الْقُبُورِ.
segments.transliteration: wa-an tujÄ«ranÄ« min daâwati al-thabÅ«r, wa-fitnati al-qubÅ«r,
segments.translation: And that You protect me from the cry of despair and the trial of the grave.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاقْضِ لَنَا فِي الْخَيْرِ، وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا مَوْطِناً فِي الصِّدْقِ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma faqá¸i lanÄ fÄ« al-khayr, wa-ajâal lanÄ mawá¹­inan fÄ« al-á¹£idq,
segments.translation: O Allah, decree goodness for us and grant us a place in truth,
And settle us in the abode of permanence and mercy,

segments.arabic: وَارْزُقْنَا الْفَوْزَ بِالْجَنَّةِ، وَالنَّجَاةَ مِنَ النَّارِ.
segments.transliteration: wa-arzuqnÄ al-fawza bi-al-jannah, wa-al-najÄta mina al-nÄr,
segments.translation: And grant us success in attaining Paradise and salvation from the Fire.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسِنْ عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma aá¸¥sin âÄqibatana fÄ« al-umÅ«ri kullihÄ,
segments.translation: O Allah, grant us a good outcome in all our affairs,

segments.arabic: وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ خِزْيِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الآخِرَةِ.
segments.transliteration: wa-ajirnÄ min khizy al-dunyÄ wa-âadhÄbi al-Äkhirah,
segments.translation: And save us from the disgrace of this world and the punishment of the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا يَحُولُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma aqsim lanÄ min khashyatika mÄ yaá¸¥Å«lu baynanÄ wa-bayna maâÄá¹£Ä«k,
segments.translation: O Allah, grant us a share of Your reverence that keeps us away from disobeying You,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-min á¹­Äâatika mÄ tuballighunÄ bihi jannatak,
segments.translation: And from Your obedience what will lead us to Your Paradise,

segments.arabic: وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مُصِيبَاتِ الدُّنْيَا.
segments.transliteration: wa-min al-yaqÄ«n mÄ tuhawwinu bihi âalaynÄ muá¹£Ä«bÄti al-dunyÄ,
segments.translation: And from certainty what makes the trials of this world easy for us.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا، وَأَبْصَارِنَا، وَقُوَّاتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma mattiânÄ bi-asmÄâinÄ, wa-abá¹£ÄrinÄ, wa-quwwÄtinÄ mÄ aá¸¥yaytanÄ,
segments.translation: O Allah, bless us with the use of our hearing, sight, and strength as long as we live,
And make them last until our end,
And let our vengeance be against those who wrong us,
And grant us victory over those who oppose us.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma lÄ tajâal muá¹£Ä«batana fÄ« dÄ«nina,
segments.translation: O Allah, do not make our affliction in our religion,

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا، وَلاَ مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ tajâali al-dunyÄ akbara hammÄ«nÄ, wa-lÄ mablagha âilminÄ,
segments.translation: And do not make this world our greatest concern or the extent of our knowledge,

segments.arabic: وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا.
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ tusalliá¹­ âalaynÄ man lÄ yará¸¥amunÄ,
segments.translation: And do not place over us those who do not have mercy on us.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَدَعْ لَنَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma lÄ tadaâ lanÄ fÄ« hÄdhÄ al-yawmi dhanban illÄ ghafartahu,
segments.translation: O Allah, do not leave for us any sin on this day except that You forgive it,
Nor any worry except that You relieve it,

Nor any sick person except that You heal him,

segments.translation: a severance for our concern with the provision which You guaranteed,

segments.arabic: وَحَسْمَاً لِلاشْتِغَالِ بِمَا ضَمِنْتَ الْكِفَايَةَ لَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa á¸¥asman li-al-ishtighÄl bi-mÄ á¸aminta al-kifÄyah lah,
segments.translation: and a decisive end to preoccupation with what You secured sufficiency for,
for You have saidâand Your saying is the truest truthâ

segments.transliteration: wa aqsamta wa qasamuka al-abarru al-awfÄ:
segments.translation: and You have swornâand Your oath is the most righteous, the most perfect:

segments.transliteration: (Wa fÄ« as-samÄâi rizqukum wa mÄ tÅ«âadÅ«n)
segments.translation: ("And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised") [Qur'an 51:22]

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ قُلْتَ: ( فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ إنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُوْنَ ).
segments.transliteration: Thumma qulta: (Fa-wa-rabbi as-samÄâi wa al-ará¸i innahÅ« la-á¸¥aqqun mithla mÄ annakum taná¹­iqÅ«n).
segments.translation: Then You said: ("Then, by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, indeed, it is the truth, just as you speak.") [Qur'an 51:23]

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ ابْتَلَيْتَنَا فِي أَرْزَاقِنَا بِسُوءِ الظَّنِّ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-naka abtalay-tanaa feee ar-zaaqinaa bisooo-iz'-z'an
segments.translation: 1.O God, You hast tried us with distrust in our provisions
2.and the expectation of long lives,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى الْتَمَسْنَا أَرْزَاقَكَ  مِنْ عِنْدِ الْمَرْزُوقِينَ،
segments.translation: 3.until we begged for provisions from those who are provided
4.and craved in our expectations the life-spans of the long-lived!
5.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ  لَنَا يَقِيناً صَادِقاً تَكْفِينا بِهِ مِنْ مَؤونَةِ الطَّلَبِ،
segments.transliteration: wa hab lanaa yaqeenana s'aadiqana tak-feenaa bihee mim-ma-oonatit'-t'alab
segments.translation: 6.give us a true certainty that will suffice us the burden of seeking,

segments.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْنَا ثِقَةً خَالِصَةً تُعْفِينَا بِهَا مِنْ شِدَّةِ  النَّصَبِ،
segments.transliteration: wa al-him-naa thiqatan khaalis'atan tua'-feenaa bihaa min shid-datin-nas'ab
segments.translation: 7.and inspire us with a sincere trust that will release us from the hardship of exertion!

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ مَا صَرَّحتَ بِهِ مِنْ عِدَتِكَ فِي وَحْيِكَ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l maa s'ar-rah'-ta bihee min i'datika fee wah'-yika
segments.translation: 8.Let Your clear promise in Your Revelation

segments.transliteration: wa at-baa'-tahoo min qasamika fee kitaabik
segments.translation: 9.which You hast followed in Your Book with Your oath

segments.arabic: قَاطِعاً لاهْتِمَامِنَا بِالرِّزْقِ الَّـذِيْ تَكَفَّلْتَ بِهِ
segments.translation: 10.cut off our worry about the provision for which You hast made Yourself responsible

segments.arabic: وَحَسْمَاً لِلاشْتِغَالِ بِمَا ضَمِنْتَ الْكِفَايَةَ لَهُ،
segments.translation: 11.and sever our occupation with everything whose sufficiency You hast guaranteed!
12.For You hast said - and Your word is the most truthful truth
13.and You hast sworn - and Your oath is the most kept and fulfilled
14."In the heaven are your provision and everything you are promised" (51:22)!

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ  قُلْتَ: ( فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ إنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُوْنَ ).
segments.transliteration: thum-ma qul-ta: (fawarab-bis-samaaa-i wal-ar-z''i in-nahoo lah'aq-qu mith-la maaa an-nakum tant'iqoon)
segments.translation: 15.And then You hast said, "So by the Lord of heaven and earth, it is as surely true as that you have speech" (51:23)!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 28 His Supplication in Fleeing to God for Protection

segments.translation: O God, I have become sincere by cutting myself off for You,
and I have turned toward You with my whole being,

segments.arabic: وَصَـرَفْتُ وَجْهِي عَمَّنْ يَحْتَاجُ إلَى رِفْدِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa á¹£araftu wajhÄ« âamman yaá¸¥tÄju ilÄ rifdik,
segments.translation: and I have turned my face away from him who is in need of Your help,

segments.arabic: وَقَلَبْتُ مَسْأَلَتِي عَمَّنْ لَمْ يَسْتَغْنِ عَنْ فَضْلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa qalabtu masâalatÄ« âamman lam yastaghnÄ« âan faá¸lik,
segments.translation: and I have directed my request away from him who is not independent of Your favour,

segments.arabic: وَرَأَيْتُ أَنَّ طَلَبَ الْمُحْتَاجِ إلَى الْمُحْتَاجِ
segments.transliteration: wa raâaytu anna á¹­alaba al-muá¸¥tÄji ilÄ al-muá¸¥tÄj
segments.translation: and I have seen that the request of the needy from the needy

segments.arabic: سَفَهٌ مِنْ رَأْيِهِ وَضَلَّةٌ مِنْ عَقْلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: safahun min raâyihÄ« wa á¸allatun min âaqlih,
segments.translation: is foolishness in his opinion and an error in his intellect,
How many times have I seen, O my God,

segments.arabic: مِنْ أُنَاسٍ طَلَبُوا الْعِزَّ بِغَيْرِكَ فَذَلُّوا،
segments.transliteration: min unÄsin á¹­alabÅ« al-âizza bi-ghayrika fa-dhallÅ«,
segments.translation: people who sought honour from other than You and were humiliated,

segments.transliteration: wa rÄmÅ« ath-tharwata min siwÄk fa-iftaqarÅ«,
segments.translation: and strove for wealth from other than You and became poor,
and attempted elevation and were brought low!
Thus, through the observation of their likes, a prudent man is confirmed,
whose consideration makes him successful,

segments.transliteration: wa arshadahÅ« ilÄ á¹­arÄ«qi á¹£awÄbihÄ« ikhtiyÄruh.
segments.translation: and whose testing guides him to the path of correctness.
So You, O my Master,
are, before every person asked, the object of my request,

segments.arabic: وَدُونَ كُلِّ مَطْلُوبٍ إِلَيْهِ وَلِيُّ حَاجَتِي.
segments.transliteration: wa dÅ«na kulli maá¹­lÅ«bin ilayhÄ« waliyyu á¸¥ÄjatÄ«.
segments.translation: and before every person sought, the guardian of my need.

segments.arabic: اَنتَ الْمَخْصُوصُ قَبْلَ كُلِّ مَدْعُوٍّ بِدَعْوَتِي
segments.translation: You are the One singled out before every person prayed to with my supplication.
No one shares with You in my hope,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَتَّفِقُ أَحَدٌ مَعَكَ فِي دُعَائِي،
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ yattafiqu aá¸¥adun maâak fÄ« duâÄâÄ«,
segments.translation: and no one unites with You in my prayer,

segments.transliteration: wa lÄ yanáºimuhÅ« wa iyyÄka nidÄâÄ«
segments.translation: and my call does not join him and You.
Yours, O my God, is the oneness of number,
and the sovereignty of eternal, absolute power (aá¹£-á¹¢amad),
and the pre-eminence of ability (al-á¸¥awl) and strength,
and the degree of exaltation and elevation.

segments.transliteration: Wa man siwÄk mará¸¥Å«mun fÄ« âumrih,
segments.translation: And whoever is other than You is one shown mercy in his life,

segments.arabic: مَغْلُوبٌ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ، مَقْهُورٌ عَلَى شَأْنِهِ،
segments.transliteration: maghlÅ«bun âalÄ amrih, maqhÅ«run âalÄ shaânih,
segments.translation: overpowered in his affair, subdued in his condition,
differing in circumstances, shifting in attributes.
So You are exalted beyond all likenesses and opposites,

segments.transliteration: wa takabbarta âani al-amthÄl wa al-andÄd,
segments.translation: and You are too majestic for parallels and peers,
Glory be to You! There is no god but You.
1.I showed sincerity by cutting myself off from everything but You.
2.I approached You with my whole self.

segments.arabic: وَصَـرَفْتُ وَجْهِي عَمَّنْ يَحْتَاجُ إلَى رِفْدِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa s'araf-tu waj-hee a'm-may-yah'-taaju ilaa rif-dik
segments.translation: 3.I averted my face from everyone who needs Your support.

segments.arabic: وَقَلَبْتُ مَسْأَلَتِي عَمَّنْ لَمْ يَسْتَغْنِ عَنْ فَضْلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa qalab-tu mas-alatee a'm-mal-lam yas-tagh-ni a'n faz''-lik
segments.translation: 4.I ceased to ask from any who cannot do without Your bounty.

segments.arabic: وَرَأَيْتُ أَنَّ طَلَبَ الْمُحْتَاجِ إلَى الْمُحْتَاجِ
segments.translation: 5.I saw that the needy who seeks from the needy

segments.arabic: سَفَهٌ مِنْ رَأيِهِ وَضَلَّةٌ مِنْ عَقْلِهِ،
segments.translation: 6.is foolish in his opinion, and misguided in his intellect.
7.How many people have I seen, my God,

segments.arabic: مِنْ أُناس طَلَبُوا الْعِزَّ بِغَيْرِكَ فَذَلُّوا،
segments.transliteration: min unaasin t'alaboo ali'z-za bighay-rika fad'al-loo
segments.translation: 8.who sought exaltation through other than You and were abased,
9.who wanted wealth from someone else and became poor,
10.who tried to rise high and fell down low!
11.Observing the likes of them corrects a prudent man;
12.his taking heed gives him success;

segments.transliteration: wa arshadahÅ« ilÄ á¹­arÄ«qi á¹£awÄbihÄ« ikhtiyÄruh.
segments.translation: 13.his choosing the best guides him to the path of right.
14.So Thou, my Master,
15.art the object of my asking to the exclusion of all those who are asked

segments.arabic: وَدُونَ كُلِّ مَطْلُوب إلَيْهِ وَلِيُّ حَاجَتِي.
segments.transliteration: wa doona kul-li mat'-loobin ilay-hee waly-yu h'aajatee
segments.translation: 16.and the patron of my need to the exclusion of all those from whom requests are made.

segments.arabic: اَنتَ الْمَخْصُوصُ قَبْلَ كُلِّ مَدْعُوٍّ بِدَعْوَتِي
segments.translation: 17.You art singled out for my call before all who are called;
18.none is associated with You in my hope,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَتَّفِقُ أَحَدٌ مَعَكَ فِي دُعَائِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yat-tafiqu ah'adum-maa'ka fee dua'aa-ee
segments.translation: 19.none comes along with You in my supplication,

segments.transliteration: wa laa yanz'imuhoo wa ee-yaaka nidaaa-ee
segments.translation: 20.nor does any join with You within it, for to You is my appeal.
21.To You, my God, belongs the Unity of number,
22.the property of eternal power,
23.the excellence of force and strength,
24.the degree of sublimity and elevation.

segments.transliteration: wa man siwaak mar-h'oomun fee u'm-rih
segments.translation: 25.Everyone other than You is the object of compassion in his lifetime,

segments.arabic: مَغْلُوبٌ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ، مَقْهُورٌ عَلَى شَأنِهِ،
segments.transliteration: magh-loobun a'laaa am-rih maq-hoorun a'laa shaa-nih
segments.translation: 26.overcome in his affair, overwhelmed in his situation,
27.diverse in states, constantly changing in attributes.
28.So You art high exalted above likenesses and opposites,
29.proudly magnified beyond similitudes and rivals!
30.Glory be to You! There is no God but Thou.
