segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يُخَيِّبُ الْمُلِحِّينَ عَلَيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ man lÄ yukhayyibu al-muliá¸¥á¸¥Ä«n âalayh,
segments.translation: and O He who does not disappoint those who insistently plead to Him,

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يَجْبَهُ بِالرَّدِّ أَهْلَ الدَّالَّةِ عَلَيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ man lÄ yajbahÅ« bi-ar-radd ahl ad-dÄllah âalayh,
segments.translation: and O He who does not meet those who presume upon Him with rejection,

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَجْتَبِي صَغِيرَ مَا يُتْحَفُ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ man yajtabÄ« á¹£aghÄ«ra mÄ yutá¸¥afu bihÄ«,
segments.translation: and O He who chooses the small gift which is offered to Him,

segments.transliteration: wa yashkuru yasÄ«ra mÄ yuâmalu lah.
segments.translation: and thanks for the little that is done for Him.

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَشْكُرُ عَلَى الْقَلِيلِ، وَيُجَازي بِالْجَلِيلِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa yÄ man yashkuru âalÄ al-qalÄ«l, wa yujÄzÄ« bi-al-jalÄ«l,
segments.translation: And O He who thanks for the little, and recompenses with the great,

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَدْنُو إِلَى مَنْ دَنَا مِنْهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ man yadnÅ« ilÄ man danÄ minh,
segments.translation: and O He who comes near to him who comes near to Him,

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَدْعُو إِلَى نَفْسِهِ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ عَنْهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ man yadâÅ« ilÄ nafsihÄ« man adbara âanh,
segments.translation: and O He who invites to Himself him who turns away from Him,

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يُغَيِّرُ النِّعْمَةَ، وَلَا يُبَادِرُ بِالنَّقِمَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ man lÄ yughayyiru an-niâmah, wa lÄ yubÄdiru bi-an-naqimah,
segments.translation: and O He who does not change the favor, and does not hasten with vengeance,

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُثْمِرُ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتَّى يُنْمِيَهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa yÄ man yuthmiru al-á¸¥asanah á¸¥attÄ yunmÄ«hÄ,
segments.translation: and O He who makes the good deed fruitful until He increases it,

segments.transliteration: wa yatajÄwazu âani as-sayyiâah á¸¥attÄ yuâaffÄ«hÄ.
segments.translation: and overlooks the evil deed until He wipes it out.

segments.arabic: انْصَرَفَتِ الْآمَالُ دُونَ مَدَى كَرَمِكَ بِالْحَاجَاتِ
segments.transliteration: Iná¹£arafati al-ÄmÄlu dÅ«na madÄ karamika bi-al-á¸¥ÄjÄt
segments.translation: Hopes have turned away short of the extent of Your generosity with [the fulfillment of] needs,

segments.transliteration: wa imtalaâat bi-fayá¸i jÅ«dik awâiyatu aá¹­-á¹­alibÄt,
segments.translation: and the vessels of requests have been filled by the overflowing of Your bounty,

segments.transliteration: wa tafassakhat dÅ«na bulÅ«ghi naâtika aá¹£-á¹£ifÄt,
segments.translation: and descriptions have dissolved short of attaining the expression of Your quality.

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْعُلُوُّ الْأَعْلَى فَوْقَ كُلِّ عَالٍ،
segments.transliteration: Fa-laka al-âuluwwu al-aâlÄ fawqa kulli âÄl,
segments.translation: So Yours is the supreme exaltation above every high one,

segments.transliteration: wa al-jalÄlu al-amjad fawqa kulli jalÄl,
segments.translation: and the most glorious majesty above every majesty.
Every great thing is small beside You,

segments.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَرِيفٍ فِي جَنْبِ شَرَفِكَ حَقِيرٌ،
segments.transliteration: wa kullu sharÄ«fin fÄ« janbi sharafika á¸¥aqÄ«r.
segments.translation: and every noble thing is contemptible beside Your nobility.
Disappointed are those who come to anyone other than You,
and lost are those who expose themselves to anyone but You,
and wasted are those who resort to anyone but You,

segments.arabic: وَأَجْدَبَ الْمُنْتَجِعُونَ إِلَّا مَنِ انْتَجَعَ فَضْلَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ajdaba al-muntajiâÅ«na illÄ mani intajaâa faá¸lak.
segments.translation: and barren are those who seek pasture, except him who seeks Your favor as pasture.
Your door is open to those who desire,
and Your bounty is allowed to those who ask,
and Your assistance is near to those who seek help.
The hopers are not disappointed by You,

segments.transliteration: wa lÄ yayâasu min âaá¹­Äâika al-mutaâarriá¸Å«n,
segments.translation: and those who expose themselves to Your giving do not despair,
and those who seek forgiveness are not wretched through Your vengeance.
Your provision is spread out for him who disobeys You,
and Your forbearance confronts him who opposes You.
Your custom is beneficence toward the evil-doers,
and Your wont is to keep the transgressors alive,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لَقَدْ غَرَّتْهُمْ أَنَاتُكَ عَنِ الرُّجُوعِ،
segments.transliteration: á¸¥attÄ laqad gharrathum anÄtuka âani ar-rujÅ«â,
segments.translation: until Your clemency almost deluded them from returning,
and Your delay turned them away from repentance.

segments.arabic: وَإِنَّمَا تَأَنَّيْتَ بِهِمْ لِيَفِيئُوا إِلَى أَمْرِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa innamÄ taâannayta bihim li-yafÄ«âÅ« ilÄ amrik,
segments.translation: But You only delayed them so they might return to Your command,
and You gave them respite, trusting in the permanence of Your kingdom.

segments.arabic: فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِهَا،
segments.transliteration: Fa-man kÄna min ahli as-saâÄdah khatamta lahÅ« bihÄ,
segments.translation: So whoever was among the people of felicity, You sealed his end with it,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ خَذَلْتَهُ لَهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa man kÄna min ahli ash-shaqÄwah khadhaltahÅ« lahÄ,
segments.translation: and whoever was among the people of wretchedness, You abandoned him to it.
All of them are proceeding to Your judgment,
and their affairs are tending toward Your command.

segments.arabic: لَمْ يَهُنْ عَلَى طُـولِ مُـدَّتِهِمْ سُلْطَانُـكَ
segments.transliteration: Lam yahin âalÄ á¹­Å«l muddatÄ«him sulá¹­Änuk
segments.translation: Your sovereignty was not weakened by their long duration,

segments.transliteration: wa lam yadá¸¥aá¸ li-tarki muâÄjalatihim burhÄnuk.
segments.translation: and Your proof was not refuted by Your leaving off their hastening [to punishment].
Your proof is standing, never refuted,
and Your sovereignty is firm, never ceasing.
So lasting woe belongs to him who swerved from You,

segments.transliteration: wa al-khaybatu al-khÄdhilatu li-man khÄba mink,
segments.translation: and disappointing loss to him who was disappointed by You,

segments.transliteration: wa ash-shaqÄâu al-ashqÄ li-mani ightarra bik.
segments.translation: and the most wretched wretchedness to him who was deluded by You.
How much he will be turned about in Your punishment,

segments.transliteration: wa mÄ aá¹­wala taraddudahÅ« fÄ« âiqÄbik,
segments.translation: and how long he will be moved back and forth in Your penalty,

segments.transliteration: wa mÄ abâada ghÄyatahÅ« min al-faraj,
segments.translation: and how distant his limit is from relief,

segments.transliteration: wa mÄ aqnaá¹­ahÅ« min suhÅ«lati al-makhraj
segments.translation: and how hopeless he is of an easy way out!

segments.arabic: عَدْلًا مِنْ قَضَائِكَ لَا تَجُورُ فِيهِ،
segments.transliteration: âAdlan min qaá¸Äâika lÄ tajÅ«ru fÄ«h,
segments.translation: As justice from Your decree, in which You do not act wrongfully,

segments.arabic: وَإِنْصَافاً مِنْ حُكْمِكَ لَا تَحِيفُ عَلَيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa iná¹£Äfan min á¸¥ukmik lÄ taá¸¥Ä«fu âalayh,
segments.translation: and as equity from Your judgment, against which You do not incline.
For You have made the proofs manifest,
and set forth the excuses,
and You have preceded with the threat
and dealt kindly in enticing,
and cited the examples,
and prolonged the respite,

segments.transliteration: wa akhkharta wa anta mustaá¹­Ä«âun li-al-muâÄjalah,
segments.translation: and delayed, though You are able to hasten,

segments.transliteration: wa taâannayta wa anta malÄ«âun bi-al-mubÄdarah,
segments.translation: and acted with clemency, though You are able to commence.
Your clemency was not helplessness,
and Your delay was not weakness,
and Your withholding was not heedlessness,
and Your waiting was not flattering,
but [it was] so that Your proof might be more eloquent,
and Your generosity more perfect,
and Your beneficence more abundant,
and Your blessing more complete.

segments.transliteration: Kullu dhÄlika kÄna wa lam tazal,
segments.translation: All of that was and You have not ceased,

segments.transliteration: wa huwa kÄâinun wa lÄ tazÄl,
segments.translation: and it is being and You will not cease.

segments.arabic: حُجَّتُكَ أَجَلُّ مِنْ أَنْ تُوصَفَ بِكُلِّهَا،
segments.transliteration: á¸¤ujjatuka ajallu min an tÅ«á¹£afa bi-kullihÄ,
segments.translation: Your proof is too magnificent to be described in its totality,

segments.arabic: وَمَجْدُكَ أَرْفَعُ مِنْ أَنْ يُحَدَّ بِكُنْهِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa majdÅ«ka arfaâu min an yuá¸¥adda bi-kunhih,
segments.translation: and Your glory is too sublime to be limited in its essence,

segments.arabic: وَنِعْمَتُكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُحْصَى بِأَسْرِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa niâmatuka aktharu min an tuá¸¥á¹£Ä bi-asrihÄ,
segments.translation: and Your blessing is too abundant to be counted in its entirety,

segments.arabic: وَإِحْسَانُكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُشْكَرَ عَلَى أَقَلِّهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa iá¸¥sÄnuka aktharu min an tushkara âalÄ aqallih.
segments.translation: and Your beneficence is too much to be thanked for its least part.

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ قَصَّرَ بِيَ السُّكُوتُ عَنْ تَحْمِيدِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa qad qaá¹£á¹£ara biya as-sukÅ«tu âan taá¸¥mÄ«dik,
segments.translation: And silence has fallen short of praising You,
and withholding has made me speechless from glorifying You,
and my utmost is the acknowledgment of the inability

segments.arabic: لَا رَغْبَةً ـ يَا إِلَهِي ـ بَلْ عَجْزاً،
segments.transliteration: lÄ raghbatan â yÄ IlÄhÄ« â bal âajzan,
segments.translation: â not from reluctance, O my God, but from incapacity.
So here I am, seeking You by coming to You,
and asking You for the excellence of reception.
So bless Muhammad and his Household,
and hear my secret supplication,
and answer my prayer,
and do not seal my day with my disappointment,

segments.transliteration: wa lÄ tajbahnÄ« bi-ar-raddÄ« fÄ« masâalatÄ«,
segments.translation: and do not meet me with rejection in my request,
and make my departure from You honorable,
and my return to You.
Surely You are not constrained by what You will,
and not incapable of what You are asked,

segments.transliteration: wa anta âalÄ kulli shayâin qadÄ«r,
segments.translation: and You are powerful over everything,

segments.arabic: وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ á¸¥awla wa lÄ quwwata illÄ bi-AllÄh al-âAlÄ«yy al-âAáºÄ«m.
segments.translation: and there is no might and no power except with God, the Most High, the Most Great.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَرْحَمُ مَنْ لا يَرْحَمُهُ الْعِبَادُ.
segments.translation: 1.O He who has mercy upon him toward whom the servants show no mercy!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَقْبَلُ مَنْ لا تَقْبَلُهُ الْبِلاَدُ.
segments.translation: 2.O He who accepts him whom the cities will not accept!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَن لاَ يَحْتَقِرُ أَهْلَ الْحَاجَةِ إلَيْهِ.
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa yah'-taqiru ah-lal-h'aajati ilay-h
segments.translation: 3.O He who looks not down upon those who have need of Him!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُخَيِّبُ المَلِحِّيْنَ عَلَيْـهِ،
segments.translation: 4.O He who disappoints not those who implore Him!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَجْبَهُ بِالرَّدِّ أَهْلَ الدَّالَّةِ عَليهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa yaj-bahoo bir-rad-di ah-lad-daaal-lati a'lay-h
segments.translation: 5.O He who slaps not the brow of the people of boldness toward Him with rejection!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَجْتَبِي صَغِيرَ مَايُتْحَفُ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa may-yaj-tabee s'agheera maa yut-h'afu bihee
segments.translation: 6.O He who collects the little that is given to Him

segments.transliteration: wa yash-kuru yaseera maa yua'-malu lah
segments.translation: 7.and shows gratitude for the paltry that is done for Him!

segments.arabic: وَيَامَنْ يَشْكُرُ عَلَى الْقَلِيْلِ، وَيُجَازيْ بِالْجَلِيلِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa may-yash-kuru a'laal-qaleeli wa yujaazee bil-jaleel
segments.translation: 8.O He who shows gratitude for the small and rewards with the great!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَدْنُو إلَى مَنْ دَنا مِنْهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yaa may-yad-nooo ilaa man danaa min-h
segments.translation: 9.O He who comes close to him who comes close to Him!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَدعُو إلَى نَفْسِهِ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ عَنْهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa may-yad-o'ow ilaa naf-sihee man ad-bara a'n-h
segments.translation: 10.O He who invites to Himself him who turns his back on Him!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُغَيِّرُ النِّعْمَةَ، وَلا يُبَادِرُ بِالنَّقِمَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa yughay-yirun-nia'-mah wa laa yubaadiru bin-naq-mah
segments.translation: 11.O He who changes not favour and rushes not to vengeance!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُثْمِرُ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتَّى يُنْمِيَهَا،
segments.translation: 12.O He who causes the good deed to bear fruit so that He may make it grow,
13.and overlooks the evil deed so that He may efface it!

segments.arabic: انْصَرَفَتِ الآمَالُ دُونَ مَدى كَرَمِكَ بِالحَاجَاتِ
segments.translation: 14.Hopes turn back with needs fulfilled short of the extent of Your generosity,
15.the cups of requests fill up with the overflow of Your munificence,
16.and attributes fall apart without reaching Your description.

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْعُلُوُّ الأعْلَى فَوْقَ كُلِّ عَال،
segments.translation: 17.For to You belongs the highest highness above everything high,
18.and the most glorious majesty beyond every majesty!
19.Everything majestic before You is small,

segments.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَرِيف فِي جَنْبِ شَرَفِكَ حَقِيرٌ،
segments.transliteration: wa kul-lu shareefin fee jambi sharafika h'aqeer
segments.translation: 20.everything eminent beside Your eminence vile!
21.Those who reach other than You are disappointed,

segments.arabic: وَخَسِرَ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ إلاَّ لَكَ، وَضَاعَ الْمُلِمُّونَ  إلاّ بِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa khasiral-mutaa'r-riz''oona il-laa lak wa z''aaa'l-mulim-moona il-laa bik
segments.translation: 22.those who present themselves to other than You have lost, those who stay with other than You have perished,

segments.arabic: وَأَجْدَبَ الْمُنْتَجِعُـونَ إلاَّ مَنِ انْتَجَعَ فَضْلَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa aj-dabal-muntajiu'wna il-laa mani antajaa' faz''-lak
segments.translation: 23.and those who retreat - except those who retreat to Your bounty - are desolate!

segments.arabic: بَابُكَ مَفْتُوحٌ لِلرَّاغِبِينَ، وَجُودُكَ مُبَاحٌ لِلسَّائِلِينَ،
segments.translation: 24.Your door is open to the beseechers, Your munificence free to the askers,
25.Your help near to the help-seekers!

segments.arabic: لاَ يَخِيبُ مِنْـكَ الآمِلُونَ، وَلاَ يَيْأَسُ مِنْ عَطَائِكَ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ،
segments.transliteration: laa yakheebu minkal-aaamiloon wa laa yay-asu min a't'aaa-ikal-mutaa'r-riz''oon
segments.translation: 26.The expectant are not disappointed by You, those who present themselves despair not of Your bestowal,
27.the forgiveness-seekers become not wretched through Your vengeance!
28.Your provision is spread among those who disobey You,
29.Your clemency presents itself to those hostile toward You,
30.Your habit is beneficence toward the evildoers,
31.and Your wont is to spare the transgressors,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لَقَدْ غَرَّتْهُمْ أَنَاتُكَ عَنِ الرُّجُوعِ،
segments.translation: 32.so much so that Your lack of haste deludes them from returning,
33.and Your disregard bars them from desisting!

segments.arabic: وَإنَّمَا تَأَنَّيْتَ بهمْ لِيَفِيئُوا إلَى أَمْرِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa in-namaa taan-nay-ta bihim leeafee-oo ilaaa am-rik
segments.translation: 34.You actest without haste toward them so that they will come back to Your command
35.and You disregardest them confident in the permanence of Your kingdom,

segments.arabic: فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِهَا،
segments.transliteration: faman kaana min ah-lis-saa'adati khatam-ta lahoo bihaa
segments.translation: 36.so You sealest him who is worthy of it with felicity,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ خَذَلْتَهُ لَهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa man kaana min ah-lish-shaqaawati khad'al-tahoo lahaa
segments.translation: 37.and You abandonest him who is worthy of it to wretchedness!

segments.arabic: كُلُّهُمْ صَائِرُونَ إلَى حُكْمِكَ وَأُمُورُهُمْ آئِلَةٌ إلَى أَمْـرِكَ،
segments.transliteration: kul-luhum s'aaa-iroona ilaa h'uk-mik wa umooruhum aaa-ilatun ilaaa am-rik
segments.translation: 38.All of them come home to Your decree, their affairs revert to Your command;

segments.arabic: لَمْ يَهِنْ عَلَى طُـولِ مُـدَّتِهِمْ سُلْطَانُـكَ
segments.transliteration: lam yahin a'laa t'ooli mud-datihim sul-t'aanuk
segments.translation: 39.Your authority grows not feeble through their drawn out term,

segments.transliteration: wa lam yud-h'az'' litar-ki mua'ajalatihim bur-haanuk
segments.translation: 40.Your proof is not refuted by the failure to hurry after them.
41.Your argument is established, never refuted,
42.Your authority fixed, never removed.
43.Permanent woe belongs to him who inclines away from You,
44.forsaking disappointment to him who is disappointed by You,
45.and the most wretched wretchedness to him who is deluded about You!
46.How much he will move about in Your chastisement!

segments.transliteration: wa maaa at'-wala tarad-dudahoo fee i'qaabika?
segments.translation: 47.How long he will frequent Your punishment!
48.How far his utmost end from relief!
49.How he will despair of an easy exit!

segments.arabic: عَدْلاً مِنْ قَضَائِكَ  لاَ تَجُورُ فِيهِ،
segments.translation: 50.[All of this] as justice from Your decree (Thou art not unjust in it!),

segments.arabic: وَإنْصَافاً مِنْ حُكْمِكَ لاَ تَحِيفُ عَلَيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa ins'aafam-min h'uk-mika laa tah'eefu a'lay-h
segments.translation: 51.and equity from Your judgement (Thou dost not act wrongfully against him!).
52.You supported the arguments, tested the excuses,

segments.arabic: وَقَـدْ تَقَدَّمْتَ بِـالْوَعِيْـدِ وَتَلَطَّفْتَ فِي التَّرْغِيْبِ،
segments.transliteration: wa qad t-taqad-dam-ta bil-wae'ed wa talat'-t'af-ta fit-tar-gheeb
segments.translation: 53.began with threats, showed gentleness with encouragement,
54.struck similitudes, made long the respite,
55.delayed, while You art able to hurry,
56.and acted without haste, while You art full of quick accomplishment!

segments.arabic: لَمْ تَكُنْ أَنَاتُكَ عَجْزاً، وَلا إمْهَالُكَ وَهْناً،
segments.transliteration: lam takun anaatuka a'j-zaa wa laaa im-haaluka wah-naa
segments.translation: 57.Not because of incapacity is Your slowness, feebleness Your giving respite,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ إمْسَاكُكَ غَفْلَةً، وَلاَ انْتِظَارُكَ مُدَارَاةً،
segments.transliteration: wa laaa im-saakuka ghaf-lah wa laa antiz'aaruka mudaaraah
segments.translation: 58.heedlessness Your showing restraint, dissemblance Your waiting!

segments.arabic: بَلْ لِتَكُونَ حُجَّتُكَ أَبْلَغَ، وَكَرَمُكَ أكمَلَ،
segments.transliteration: bal-litakoona h'uj-jatuka ab-lagh wa karamuka ak-mal
segments.translation: 59.But that Your argument be more conclusive, Your generosity more perfect,

segments.transliteration: wa ih'-saanuka aw-faa wa nia'-matuka atam
segments.translation: 60.Your beneficence more exhaustive, Your favour more complete!

segments.arabic: كُلُّ ذلِكَ كَانَ وَلَمْ تَزَلْ، وَهُوَ كائِنٌ وَلاَ تَزَالُ ،
segments.transliteration: kul-lu d'alika kaana wa lam tazal wa huwa kaaa-inoo-wa laa tazaal
segments.translation: 61.All of this has been and always was, is and ever will be.

segments.arabic: حُجَّتُكَ أَجَلُّ مِنْ أَنْ توصَفَ بِكُلِّهَا،
segments.transliteration: h'uj-jatuka ajal-lu min an toos'afa bikul-lihaa
segments.translation: 62.Your argument is greater than that its totality be described,

segments.arabic: وَمَجْدُكَ أَرْفَـعُ مِنْ أَنْ يُحَدَّ بِكُنْهِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa maj-duka ar-fau' min ay-yuh'ad-da bikun-hih
segments.translation: 63.Your glory more elevated than that it be limited in its core,

segments.arabic: وَنِعْمَتُكَ أكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ  تُحْصَى بِأَسْرِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa nia'-matuka ak-tharu min an tuh'-s'aa bi s-rihaa
segments.translation: 64.Your favour more abundant than that its entirety be counted,

segments.arabic: وَإحْسَانُكَ أكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُشْكَرَ عَلَى أَقَلِّهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa ih'-saanuka ak-tharu min an tush-kara a'laaa aqal-lih
segments.translation: 65.Your beneficence more abundant than that thanks be given for its least amount!

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ قَصَّرَ بِيَ السُّكُوتُ عَنْ تَحْمِيدِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa qad qas'-s'ara beeas-sukootu a'n tah'-meedik
segments.translation: 66.Speechlessness has made me fall short of praising You,
67.restraint has made me powerless to glorify You,
68.and the most I can do is admit to inability,

segments.arabic: لاَ رَغْبَةً ـ يا إلهِي ـ بَلْ عَجْزاً،
segments.translation: 69.not out of desire, my God, but out of incapacity.

segments.arabic: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا أَؤُمُّكَ بِالْوِفَادَةِ، وَأَسأَلُكَ حُسْنَ الرِّفَادَةِ،
segments.transliteration: fahaaa ana d'aa aw-um-muka bil-wifaadah wa as-aluka h'us-nar-rifaadah
segments.translation: 70.So here I am: I repair to You by coming forward, and I ask from You good support

segments.arabic: فَصلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاسْمَعْ نَجْوَايَ،
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih was-maa' naj-waay
segments.translation: 71.So bless Muhammad and his Household, hear my whispered words,

segments.arabic: وَاسْتَجِبْ دُعَائِي وَلاَ تَخْتِمْ يَوْمِيَ بِخَيْبَتِي،
segments.transliteration: was-tajib dua'aa-ee wa laa takh-tim yaw-mee bikhay-batee
segments.translation: 72.grant my supplication, seal not my day with disappointment,

segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-bah-nee bir-rad-di fee mas-alatee
segments.translation: 73.slap not my brow by rejecting my request,

segments.arabic: وَأكْرِمْ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مُنْصَرَفِي وَإلَيْكَ مُنْقَلَبِي،
segments.transliteration: wa ak-rim min i'ndika muns'arafee wa ilay-ka munqalabee
segments.translation: 74.and make noble my coming from You and my going back to You!

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ غَيْرُ ضَائِق بِمَا تُرِيْدُ  وَلاَ عَاجِزٍ عَمَّا تُسْأَلُ،
segments.transliteration: in-naka ghay-ru z''aaa-iqim-bimaa tureed wa laa a'ajizin a'm-maa tus-al
segments.translation: 75.Surely You art not constrained by what You desirest, nor incapable of what You art asked!

segments.transliteration: wa anta a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer
segments.translation: 76.You art powerful over everything,

segments.arabic: وَلا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إلاَّ بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa h'aw-la wa laa qoo-wata il-laa bil-lahil-a'lee-yil-a'z'eem
segments.translation: 77.and there is no force and no strength save in God, the All-high, the All-mighty!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 18 When Perils were repelled or Requests quickly granted

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ قَضَائِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma laka al-á¸¥amdu âalÄ á¸¥usni qaá¸Äâika,
segments.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise for the goodness of Your decree,
And for what You have averted from me of Your trials,

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَجْعَلْ حَظِّي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: FalÄ tajâal á¸¥aáºáºÄ« min raá¸¥matika mÄ âajjalta lÄ« min âÄfiyatika,
segments.translation: So do not make my share of Your mercy what You hastened for me of well-being,

segments.arabic: فَأَكُونَ قَدْ شَقِيتُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتُ وَسَعِدَ غَيْرِي بِمَا كَرِهْتُ،
segments.transliteration: Fa-akÅ«na qad shaqÄ«tu bimÄ aá¸¥babtu wa-saâida ghayrÄ« bimÄ karihtu,
segments.translation: So that I may end up wretched through what I loved, while others are happy with what I disliked,

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مَا ظَلِلْتُ فِيهِ أَوْ بِتُّ فِيهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْعَافِيَةِ،

segments.translation: And if what I spent my day or night in of this well-being,

segments.arabic: بَيْنَ يَدَيْ بَلاءٍ لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ وَوِزْرٍ لاَ يَرْتَفِعُ،

segments.translation: Is before a trial that does not cease, and a burden that does not lift,

segments.transliteration: Faqaddim lÄ« mÄ akhkharta wa-akhkhir âannÄ« mÄ qaddamta,
segments.translation: Then advance for me what You have delayed, and delay from me what You have advanced,

segments.arabic: فَغَيْرُ كَثِيرٍ مَا عَاقِبَتُهُ الْفَنَاءُ وَغَيْرُ قَلِيلٍ مَا عَاقِبَتُهُ الْبَقَاءُ،
segments.transliteration: Faghayru kathÄ«rin mÄ âÄqibatuhu al-fanÄâ wa-ghayru qalÄ«lin mÄ âÄqibatuhu al-baqÄâ,
segments.translation: For what ends in perishing is not great, and what ends in lasting is not small,
And send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ قَضَائِكَ،
segments.translation: 1.O God, to You belongs praise for Your excellent accomplishment
2.and for Your trial which You hast turned away from me!

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَجْعَـلْ حَظِّي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ

segments.translation: 3.But make not my share of Your mercy the well-being which You hast quickly granted to me,

segments.arabic: فَأكُونَ قَدْ شَقِيتُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتُ وَسَعِدَ غَيْرِي بِمَا كَرِهْتُ،

segments.translation: 4.lest I become wretched through what I have loved and someone else gain felicity through what I have disliked!

segments.arabic: وَإنْ يَكُنْ مَا ظَلِلْتُ فِيهِ أَوْ بِتُّ فِيهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْعَافِيَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa ee-yakum-maa z'alil-tu feeheee aw bit-tu feehee min had'ihil-a'afeeah
segments.translation: 5.If this well-being in which I pass the day or night

segments.arabic: بَيْنَ يَدَيْ بَلاء لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ، وَوِزْر لاَ يَرْتَفِعُ
segments.transliteration: bay-na yaday balaaa-il-laa yanqat'ia'- wa wiz-ril-laa yar-tafia'-
segments.translation: 6.should precede a trial that does not cease and a burden that does not pass away,

segments.arabic: فَقَدِّمْ لِي مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَأَخِّرْ عَنّي مَا قَدَّمْتَ
segments.transliteration: faqad-dim lee maaa akh-khar-t wa akh-khir a'n-nee maa qad-dam-t
segments.translation: 7.then set before me what You hadst set behind and set behind me what You hadst set before!
8.For that which ends in annihilation is not great
9.and that which ends in subsistence is not little.
10.And bless Muhammad and his Household!

segments.translation: O Allah, grant us rain,

And revive Your lands with flourishing blossoms.

segments.translation: And do not let its fall strike us,

segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ tajâal mÄâahu âalaynÄ ujÄjÄ,
segments.translation: And do not let its water become brackish upon us.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Äli Muá¸¥ammad,
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,

segments.transliteration: Wa urzuqnÄ min barakÄti al-samÄwÄti wa al-ará¸,
segments.translation: And provide us from the blessings of the heavens and the earth,
Indeed, You are capable of all things.
1.O God, water us with rain,
2.unfold upon us Your mercy through Your copious rain

segments.arabic: مِنَ الْسَّحَابِ الْمُنْسَـاقِ لِنَبَاتِ أَرْضِكَ الْمُونِقِ فِي جَمِيـعِ الآفَاقِ،
segments.translation: 3.from the driven clouds, so that Your goodly earth may grow on all horizons!
4.Show kindness to Your servants through the ripening of the fruit,
5.revive Your land through the blossoming of the flowers,
6.and let Your angels - the noble scribes - be witness
7.to a beneficial watering from You, lasting in its abundance,
8.plenty in its flow, heavy, quick, soon,

segments.arabic: تُحْيِي بِهِ مَا قَدْ مَات، وَتَرُدُّ بهِ مَا قَدْ فَاتَ،
segments.transliteration: tuh'-yee bihee maa qad maat wa tarud-du bihee maa qad faat
segments.translation: 9.through which You revivest what has died, returnest what has vanished,

segments.transliteration: wa tukh-riju bihee maa huwa aaat
segments.translation: 10.bringest forth what is coming,
11.and providest plentiful foods,
12.through heaped up, wholesome, productive clouds, in reverberating layers,
13.the rain's downpour not without cease,
14.the lightning's flashes not without fruit!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مَغيثَاً مَرِيعاً مُمْرِعاً عَرِيْضَاً،
segments.translation: 15.O God, give us water through rain, helping, productive, fertilizing, widespread,

segments.arabic: وَاسِعاً غَزِيراً تَرُدُّ بِهِ النَّهِيضَ وَتَجْبُرُ بِهِ الْمَهِيضَ.
segments.transliteration: waasia'na ghazeeraa tarud-du bihin-naheez'' wa taj-buru bihil-maheez''
segments.translation: 16.plentiful, abundant, bringing back the risen, restoring the broken!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا سَقْياً تُسِيلُ مِنْهُ الظِّرابَ،
segments.translation: 17.O God, give us water with a watering through which You wilt make the stone hills pour,
18.fill the cisterns,
19.flood the rivers,
20.make the trees grow,

segments.arabic: وَتُرْخِصُ بِهِ الأسْعَارَ فِي جَمِيع الأمْصَارِ،
segments.translation: 21.bring down prices in all the lands,
22.invigorate the beasts and the creatures,
23.perfect for us the agreeable things of provision,
24.make grow for us the fields,
25.let flow for us the teats,

segments.transliteration: wa tazeedunaa bihee qoo-watan ilaa qoo-watinaa
segments.translation: 26.and add for us strength to our strength!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ لا تَجْعَلْ ظِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا سَمُوماً
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma laa taj-a'l z'il-lahoo a'lay-naa samoomaa
segments.translation: 27.O God, make not the cloud's shadow over us a burning wind,

segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-a'l bar-dahoo a'lay-naa h'usoomaa
segments.translation: 28.allow not its coldness to be cutting,

segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-a'l s'aw-bahoo a'lay-naa rujoomaa
segments.translation: 29.let not its pouring down upon us be a stoning,

segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-a'l maaa-ahoo a'lay-naaa ujaajaa
segments.translation: 30.and make not its waters for us bitter!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.translation: 31.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
32.and provide us with the blessings of the heavens and the earth!
33."Thou art powerful over everything"! (3:26)

title: Supplication 48 On the Day of Sacrifice and Friday - Duas.org

segments.translation: O God, this is a blessed, auspicious day,

segments.arabic: وَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فِيهِ مُجْتَمِعُونَ فِي أَقْطَارِ أَرْضِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-l-muslimÅ«na fÄ«hi mujtamiâÅ«na fÄ« aqá¹­Äri ará¸ik,
segments.translation: and the Muslims are gathered in it in the regions of Your earth,

segments.arabic: يَشْهَدُ السَّائِلُ مِنْهُمْ وَ الطَّالِبُ وَ الرَّاغِبُ وَ الرَّاهِبُ
segments.transliteration: yashhadu s-sÄâilu minhum wa-á¹­-á¹­Älibu wa-r-rÄghibu wa-r-rÄhibu
segments.translation: the petitioner, the seeker, the desirous, and the dreader are present from among them,
and You are the Looker at their needs,

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ وَ هَوَانِ مَا سَأَلْتُكَ عَلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: fa-asâaluka bi-jÅ«dika wa-karamika wa-hawÄni mÄ saâaltuka âalayk
segments.translation: so I ask You by Your generosity, Your nobleness, and the ease of what I ask of You upon You,

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
segments.translation: to bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْمُلْكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-asâaluka AllÄhumm RabbanÄ bi-anna laka l-mulka wa-laka l-á¸¥amd,
segments.translation: And I ask You, O God, our Lord, by the fact that the dominion is Yours and the praise is Yours,

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ الْحَنَّانُ الْمَنَّانُ
segments.transliteration: lÄ ilÄha illÄ Ant, al-á¸¤alÄ«mu l-KarÄ«mu l-á¸¤annÄnu l-MannÄn
segments.translation: there is no god but You, the Forbearing, the Noble, the Compassionate, the Bestower,

segments.arabic: ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ، بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ،
segments.transliteration: dhÅ« l-jalÄl wa-l-ikrÄm, badÄ«âu s-samÄwÄt wa-l-ará¸,
segments.translation: Possessor of Majesty and Honor, Originator of the heavens and the earth,
whatever You distribute among Your believing servants

segments.arabic: مِنْ خَيْرٍ أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ أَوْ بَرَكَةٍ أَوْ هُدًى أَوْ عَمَلٍ بِطَاعَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: min khayr aw âÄfiyatin aw barakatin aw hudÄ aw âamalin bi-á¹­Äâatik
segments.translation: of good, or well-being, or blessing, or guidance, or action in Your obedience,

segments.arabic: أَوْ خَيْرٍ تَمُنُّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ تَهْدِيهِمْ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: aw khayr tamunnu bihÄ« âalayhim tahdÄ«him bihÄ« ilayk
segments.translation: or goodness You bestow upon them, by which You guide them to You,
or You raise a rank for them with You,

segments.arabic: أَوْ تُعْطِيهِمْ بِهِ خَيْراً مِنْ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: aw tuâá¹­Ä«him bihÄ« khayran min khayri d-dunyÄ wa-l-Äkhirah
segments.translation: or You give them through it good from the good of this world and the Hereafter â

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّي وَ نَصِيبِي مِنْهُ.
segments.translation: to increase my share and portion of it.
And I ask You, O God, by the fact that
the dominion and the praise are Yours,
there is no god but You,
to bless Muá¸¥ammad,
Your servant and Your messenger,
and Your beloved and Your chosen one,
and Your best selection from Your creation,

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَبْرَارِ الطَّاهِرِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ
segments.transliteration: wa-âalÄ Äli Muá¸¥ammad al-abrÄr iá¹­-á¹­ÄhirÄ«n al-akhyÄr
segments.translation: and upon the Household of Muá¸¥ammad, the pious, the pure, the excellent,

segments.arabic: صَلَاةً لَا يَقْوَى عَلَى إِحْصَائِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
segments.transliteration: á¹£alÄtan lÄ yaqwÄ âalÄ iá¸¥á¹£ÄâihÄ illÄ Ant,
segments.translation: a blessing that none can enumerate except You,
and to include us in

segments.arabic: صَالِحِ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ
segments.transliteration: á¹£Äliá¸¥i man daâÄk fÄ« hÄdhÄ l-yawm
segments.translation: the good of those who supplicated You on this day
of Your believing servants,
O Lord of the Worlds,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا وَ لَهُمْ
segments.translation: and to forgive us and them,
truly You have power over everything.
O God, to You I have directed my need,
and in You I have presented my poverty today,
and my destitution and my wretchedness,

segments.arabic: وَ إِنِّي بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ أَوْثَقُ مِنِّي بِعَمَلِي
segments.transliteration: wa-innÄ« bi-maghfiratik wa-raá¸¥matik awthaqu minnÄ« bi-âamalÄ«
segments.translation: and I am more confident in Your forgiveness and Your mercy than in my own action,

segments.arabic: وَ لَمَغْفِرَتُكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
segments.translation: and surely Your forgiveness and Your mercy are wider than my sins,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and the Household of Muá¸¥ammad,

segments.arabic: وَ تَوَلَّ قَضَاءَ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ هِيَ لِي
segments.transliteration: wa-tawalla qaá¸Äâa kulli á¸¥Äjatin hiya lÄ«
segments.translation: and undertake the fulfilling of every need that is mine,
by Your power over it,
and the ease of that upon You,
and by my poverty toward You,
and Your being free of need for me,

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي لَمْ أُصِبْ خَيْراً قَطُّ إِلَّا مِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: fa-innÄ« lam uá¹£ib khayran qaá¹­á¹­u illÄ mink,
segments.translation: for I have never attained any good at all except from You,

segments.arabic: وَ لَمْ يَصْرِفْ عَنِّي سُوءاً قَطُّ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa-lam yaá¹£rif âannÄ« sÅ«âan qaá¹­á¹­u aá¸¥adun ghayruk,
segments.translation: and no one has ever averted evil from me at all other than You,
and I do not hope for the matter of
my Hereafter and my world except You.
O God, whoever prepares himself, and equips himself,
and makes ready, and makes preparations,
for a delegation to a creature,

segments.arabic: رَجَاءَ رِفْدِهِ وَ نَوَافِلِهِ وَ طَلَبَ نَيْلِهِ وَ جَائِزَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: rajÄâa rifdihÄ« wa-nawÄfilihÄ« wa-á¹­alaba naylihÄ« wa-jÄâizatih,
segments.translation: hoping for his gift and his supererogatory grants, and seeking his attainment and his prize,
then to You, O my Master, was today
my preparation and my equipping,
and my readiness and my preparations,
hoping for Your pardon and Your gift,
and seeking Your attainment and Your prize.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumm fa-á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: O God, so bless Muá¸¥ammad and the Household of Muá¸¥ammad,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تُخَيِّبِ الْيَوْمَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَجَائِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ tukhayyibi l-yawm dhÄlik min rajÄâÄ«,
segments.translation: and do not disappoint that hope of mine today,
O You whom no petitioner tires,
and whom no bestower diminishes,
for I did not come to You trusting
in a righteous action I presented,
and not the intercession of a creature I hoped for,

segments.arabic: إِلَّا شَفَاعَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.translation: except the intercession of Muá¸¥ammad and his Household,
upon him and upon them be Your peace,

segments.arabic: أَتَيْتُكَ مُقِرّاً بِالْجُرْمِ وَ الْإِسَاءَةِ إِلَى نَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: ataytuka muqirran bi-l-jurm wa-l-isÄâati ilÄ nafsÄ«
segments.translation: I came to You confessing the offense and the wrong done to myself,
I came to You hoping for Your great pardon,
by which You pardoned the sinners,

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلَى عَظِيمِ الْجُرْمِ
segments.transliteration: thumma lam yamnaâka á¹­Å«lu âukÅ«fihim âalÄ âaáºÄ«mi l-jurm
segments.translation: and the prolonged devotion of theirs to the grave offense did not prevent You

segments.arabic: أَنْ عُدْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
segments.translation: from returning to them with mercy and forgiveness,
so O You whose mercy is vast,
and whose pardon is great,
O Great One, O Great One,
O Noble One, O Noble One,

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: bless Muá¸¥ammad and the Household of Muá¸¥ammad,
and return to me with Your mercy,
and show me affection with Your favor,
and be vast toward me with Your forgiveness.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَقَامَ لِخُلَفَائِكَ وَ أَصْفِيَائِكَ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumm inna hÄdhÄ l-maqÄma li-khulafÄâika wa-aá¹£fiyÄâik
segments.translation: O God, truly this station belongs to Your Successors (KhulafÄâ) and Your Chosen Ones (Aá¹£fiyÄâ),
and the positions of Your Trustees (UmanÄâ)

segments.arabic: فِي الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ الَّتِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ بِهَا
segments.transliteration: fÄ« d-darajati r-rafÄ«âati l-latÄ« khaá¹£á¹£aá¹£tahum bihÄ
segments.translation: in the lofty rank You singled out for them,
they have been usurped from it,
and You are the Ordainer of that,
Your command is not to be overcome,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يُجَاوَزُ الْمَحْتُومُ مِنْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
segments.translation: and the predetermined of Your governance is not to be transgressed,
how You willed and whenever You willed,
and for what You know best,

segments.arabic: غَيْرُ مُتَّهَمٍ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ وَ لَا لِإِرَادَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: ghayru muttaham âalÄ khalqik wa-lÄ li-irÄdatik
segments.translation: without being accused concerning Your creation or Your will,
until Your chosen ones and Your successors became
defeated, subdued, and usurped,
they see Your judgment changed,
and Your Book abandoned,

segments.arabic: وَ فَرَائِضَكَ مُحَرَّفَةً عَنْ جِهَاتِ أَشْرَاعِكَ
segments.translation: and Your ordinances distorted from the directions of Your religious laws,
and the practices of Your Prophet abandoned.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ أَعْدَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَ الْآخِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumm ilâan aâdÄâahum min al-awwalÄ«n wa-l-ÄkhirÄ«n
segments.translation: O God, curse their enemies from the former and the latter generations,
and those who were pleased with their deeds,
and their followers and their adherents.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumm á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: O God, bless Muá¸¥ammad and the Household of Muá¸¥ammad,
truly You are Praiseworthy (á¸¤amÄ«d), Glorious (MajÄ«d),
like Your blessings, and Your benedictions, and Your greetings,

segments.arabic: عَلَى أَصْفِيَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
segments.translation: upon Your chosen ones IbrÄhÄ«m and the Household of IbrÄhÄ«m,
and hasten the relief (al-faraj),

segments.arabic: وَ الرَّوْحَ وَ النُّصْرَةَ وَ التَّمْكِينَ وَ التَّأْيِيدَ لَهُمْ
segments.translation: and the comfort (ar-rawá¸¥), and the help (an-nuá¹£rah), and the establishment (at-tamkÄ«n), and the support (at-taâyÄ«d) for them.
O God, and make me
one of the people of Monotheism (at-tawá¸¥Ä«d),
and faith in You,
and belief in Your Messenger,
and the Imams whose obedience You made obligatory,

segments.arabic: مِمَّنْ يَجْرِي ذَلِكَ بِهِ وَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: mimman yajrÄ« dhÄlik bihÄ« wa-âalÄ yadayh
segments.translation: from those by whom and upon whose hands that runs
Amen, O Lord of the Worlds.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَيْسَ يَرُدُّ غَضَبَكَ إِلَّا حِلْمُكَ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumm laysa yaruddu ghaá¸abaka illÄ á¸¥ilmuk,
segments.translation: O God, nothing wards off Your anger except Your forbearance,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يَرُدُّ سَخَطَكَ إِلَّا عَفْوُكَ
segments.translation: and nothing wards off Your displeasure except Your pardon,

segments.arabic: وَ لا يُجِيرُ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَتُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ yujÄ«ru min âiqÄbika illÄ raá¸¥matuk
segments.translation: and nothing grants refuge from Your punishment except Your mercy,
and nothing saves me from You

segments.arabic: إِلَّا التَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
segments.translation: except humility to You and before You,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and the Household of Muá¸¥ammad,

segments.arabic: وَ هَبْ لَنَا يَا إِلَهِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَرَجاً
segments.transliteration: wa-hab lanÄ yÄ IlÄhÄ« min ladunka farajÄ
segments.translation: and grant us, O my God, from Your presence a relief (faraj),

segments.arabic: بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِي بِهَا تُحْيِي أَمْوَاتَ الْعِبَادِ
segments.transliteration: bi-l-qudrati l-latÄ« bihÄ tuá¸¥yÄ« amwÄta l-âibÄd
segments.translation: by the power by which You bring the dead of Your servants back to life,
and by which You spread the dead of the lands,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِي يَا إِلَهِي غَمّاً
segments.translation: and do not destroy me, O my God, with grief,
until You answer me,
and let me know the answer to my supplication,

segments.arabic: وَ أَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي
segments.transliteration: wa-adhiqnÄ« á¹­aâma l-âÄfiyati ilÄ muntahÄ ajalÄ«
segments.translation: and let me taste the savor of well-being (al-âÄfiyah) until the end of my term,
and do not make my enemy gloat over me,
and do not give him power over my neck,
and do not give him authority over me.
My God, if You raise me,
then who is there that can put me down?
And if You put me down,
then who is there that can raise me?
And if You honor me,
then who is there that can disgrace me?
And if You disgrace me,
then who is there that can honor me?
And if You punish me,
then who is there that can have mercy on me?
And if You destroy me,

segments.arabic: فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِي عَبْدِكَ
segments.transliteration: fa-man dhÄ l-ladhÄ« yaâriá¸u lak fÄ« âabdik
segments.translation: then who is there that can challenge You concerning Your servant,
or ask You about his affair?

segments.arabic: وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ
segments.transliteration: wa-qad âalimtu annahÅ« laysa fÄ« á¸¥ukmik áºulm
segments.translation: And I have known that there is no injustice (áºulm) in Your judgment,
and no haste in Your retribution,

segments.arabic: وَ إِنَّمَا يَعْجَلُ مَنْ يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ
segments.translation: and surely only one who fears loss is hasty,

segments.arabic: وَ إِنَّمَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى الظُّلْمِ الضَّعِيفُ
segments.translation: and surely only the weak is in need of injustice,
and You have been exalted, O my God,
far above that, a great exaltation.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumm á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Äli Muá¸¥ammad
segments.translation: O God, bless Muá¸¥ammad and the Household of Muá¸¥ammad,
and do not make me a target for tribulation (balÄâ),
and not an object for Your retribution (naqimah),
and grant me respite, and relieve me,
and overlook my slip,
and do not afflict me with a tribulation
upon the heels of a tribulation,
for You see my weakness,
and the fewness of my resource,
and my humility to You.

segments.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ
segments.transliteration: AâÅ«dhu bik AllÄhumm al-yawm min ghaá¸abik
segments.translation: I seek refuge in You, O God, today from Your anger,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِذْنِي.
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household, and grant me refuge.

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ
segments.translation: And I seek protection in You today from Your displeasure,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَجِرْنِي
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household, and protect me.
And I ask You for security from Your punishment,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ آمِنِّي
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household, and grant me security.
And I seek guidance from You,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اهْدِنِي
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household, and guide me.
And I seek Your help,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ انْصُرْنِي
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household, and help me.
And I seek Your mercy,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْحَمْنِي
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household, and have mercy on me.
And I seek Your sufficiency,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اكْفِنِي
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household, and suffice me.
And I seek provision from You,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْزُقْنِي
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household, and provide for me.
And I seek Your aid,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِنِّي
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household, and aid me.

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
segments.translation: And I seek Your forgiveness for what has passed of my sins,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اغْفِرْ لِي
segments.transliteration: fa-á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-ÄlihÄ«, wa-ghfir lÄ«.
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household, and forgive me.
And I seek infallibility from You,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اعْصِمْنِي
segments.translation: so bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household, and make me infallible.

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي لَنْ أَعُودَ لِشَيْ‏ءٍ كَرِهْتَهُ مِنِّي إِنْ شِئْتَ ذَلِكَ
segments.transliteration: fa-innÄ« lan aâÅ«da li-shayâin karihtahÅ« minnÄ« in shiâta dhÄlik
segments.translation: For I shall not return to anything You dislike from me, if You will that

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ، يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ
segments.transliteration: yÄ Rabb, yÄ Rabb, yÄ á¸¤annÄn, yÄ MannÄn,
segments.translation: O Lord, O Lord, O Compassionate One, O Bestower,
O Possessor of Majesty and Honor,
bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household,
and answer for me all
that I have asked of You and requested from You,
and desired of You,

segments.arabic: وَ أَرِدْهُ وَ قَدِّرْهُ وَ اقْضِهِ وَ أَمْضِهِ
segments.translation: and will it, and decree it, and determine it, and ratify it,

segments.arabic: وَ خِرْ لِي فِيمَا تَقْضِي مِنْه
segments.translation: and choose the best for me in what You determine of it,
and bless me in that,
and favor me with it,
and make me happy with what You give me of it,
and increase me from Your favor,
and the vastness of what is with You,
for truly You are Vast, Noble,

segments.arabic: وَ صِلْ ذَلِكَ بِخَيْرِ الْآخِرَةِ وَ نَعِيمِهَا
segments.translation: and connect that with the good of the Hereafter and its bliss,
O Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

segments.arabic: تَدْعُو بِمَا بَدَا لَكَ، وَ تُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ هَكَذَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
segments.transliteration: TadâÅ« bi-mÄ badÄ lak, wa-tuá¹£allÄ« âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-ÄlihÄ« alfa marratin, hÄkadhÄ kÄna yafâalu âalayhi s-salÄm.
segments.translation: You supplicate with whatever seems right to you, and you bless Muá¸¥ammad and his Household one thousand times. Thus he (peace be upon him) used to do.
1.O God, this is a blessed and fortunate day,

segments.arabic: وَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فِيهِ مُجْتَمِعُونَ فِي أَقْطَارِ أَرْضِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wal-mus-limoona feehee muj-tamiu'wna feee aq-t'aari ar-z''ik
segments.translation: 2.within which the Muslims are gathered in the quarters of Your earth.

segments.arabic: يَشْهَدُ السَّائِلُ مِنْهُمْ وَ الطَّالِبُ وَ الرَّاغِبُ وَ الرَّاهِبُ
segments.translation: 3.Among them are present the asker, the seeker, the beseecher, the fearful,
4.while You art looking upon their needs.

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ وَ هَوَانِ مَا سَأَلْتُكَ عَلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: faas-aluka bijoodika wa karamika wa hawaani maa saal-tuka a'lay-ka
segments.translation: 5.So I ask You by Your munificence and generosity and easy upon You is what I ask You!

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
segments.translation: 6.- that You blessest Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْمُلْكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ،
segments.transliteration: wa as-alukal-laahum-ma rab-banaa  bi n-na lakal-mul-ka wa lakal-h'am-d
segments.translation: 7.And I ask You, O God, our Lord -for Thine is the kingdom and Thine is the praise

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ الْحَنَّانُ الْمَنَّانُ
segments.translation: 8.there is no god but Thou,the Clement, the Generous,the All-loving, the All-kind,

segments.arabic: ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ، بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ،
segments.translation: 9.Possessor of majesty and munificence,Originator of the heavens and the earth
10.whenever You apportionest among Your faithful servants

segments.arabic: مِنْ خَيْرٍ أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ أَوْ بَرَكَةٍ أَوْ هُدًى أَوْ عَمَلٍ بِطَاعَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: min khay-rin aw a'afeeah  aw barakatin aw hudana aw a'malim-bit'aaa'tik
segments.translation: 11.good, well being, blessing, guidance, works in obedience to You,

segments.arabic: ،أَوْ خَيْرٍ تَمُنُّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ تَهْدِيهِمْ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: aw khay-rin tamun-nu bihee a'lay-him tah-deehim biheee ilay-k
segments.translation: 12.or good through which You art kind to them by guiding them to You,
13.or raisest them up a degree with You,

segments.arabic: ، أَوْ تُعْطِيهِمْ بِهِ خَيْراً مِنْ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: aw tua'-t'eehim bihee khay-ram-min khay-rid-dunyaa wal-akhirah
segments.translation: 14.or givest them the good of this world or the next,
15.that You givest me amply my share and allotment of it.
16.And I ask You, O God -
17.for Thine is the kingdom and the praise;
18.there is no god but You -
19.that You blessest Muhammad
20.Your servant and Your messenger,
21.Your beloved and Your selected friend,
22.Your chosen from among Your creation,

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَبْرَارِ الطَّاهِرِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ
segments.translation: 23.and the Household of Muhammad, the pious, the pure, the chosen,

segments.arabic: ,صَلَاةً لَا يَقْوَى عَلَى إِحْصَائِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
segments.transliteration: s'alaatal-laa yaq-waa a'laaa ih'-s'aaa-ihaaa il-laaa ant
segments.translation: 24.with a blessing no one has strength to count but Thou,

segments.transliteration: wa an tush-rikanaa fee s'aalihee man daa'aka
segments.translation: 25.that You associatest us with

segments.arabic: صَالِحِ مَنْ دَعَاكَ  فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ
segments.translation: 26.the most righteous of those who supplicate You today
27.of Your faithful servants
28.- O Lord of the worlds!â

segments.transliteration: wa an tagh-fira lanaa wa lahum-
segments.translation: 29.and that You forgivest us and them!
30."Surely You art powerful over everything" (3:26).
31.O God, toward You I aim with my need
32.and before You today I set my poverty,
33.my neediness, my misery,

segments.arabic: وَ إِنِّي بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ  أَوْثَقُ مِنِّي بِعَمَلِي
segments.transliteration: wa in-nee bimagh-firatika wa rah'-matika aw-thaqu min-nee bia'malee
segments.translation: 34.for I have more trust in Your forgiveness and Your mercy than in my own works.

segments.arabic: وَ لَمَغْفِرَتُكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
segments.transliteration: wa lamagh-firatuka wa rah'-matuka aw-sau' min d'unoobee
segments.translation: 35.Your forgiveness and Your mercy are vaster than my sins.

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: 36.So bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: ، وَ تَوَلَّ قَضَاءَ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ هِيَ لِي
segments.transliteration: wa tawal-la qaz''aaa-a kul-li h'aajatin heea lee
segments.translation: 37.and attend to the accomplishment of every need of mine through
38.Your power over it,
39.its easiness for You,
40.my poverty toward You,
41.and Your freedom from need for me!

segments.arabic: ، فَإِنِّي لَمْ أُصِبْ خَيْراً قَطُّ إِلَّا مِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: fa in-nee lam us'ib khay-rana qt'-t'u il-laa mink
segments.translation: 42.I will come upon no good whatsoever unless through You,

segments.arabic: ، وَ لَمْ يَصْرِفْ عَنِّي سُوءاً قَطُّ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa lam yas'-rif a'n-nee sooo-ana qat'-t'u ah'adun ghay-ruk
segments.translation: 43.no one other than You will turn any evil away from me,
44.and I have hope in none but You for my affair
45.in the next world and in this world.
46.O God, if anyone has ever arranged, made ready,
47.prepared, and drawn himself up
48.to be received by a creature

segments.arabic: رَجَاءَ رِفْدِهِ وَ نَوَافِلِهِ وَ طَلَبَ نَيْلِهِ وَ جَائِزَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: rajaaa-a rif-dihee wa nawaafilih wa t'alaba nay-lihee wajaaa-izatih
segments.translation: 49.in hope of his support and awards,
50.then today toward You, my Master,
51.is my arrangement, my making ready,
52.my preparation, and my drawing up
53.in hope of Your pardon and support
54.and in seeking to attain to You and Your prize.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: 55.O God, so bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تُخَيِّبِ الْيَوْمَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَجَائِي،
segments.translation: 56.and disappoint not my hope in that today!
57.O He who is not troubled by those who ask
58.and diminished by those who attain their desire!
59.I come not before You trusting
60.in a righteous work I have sent ahead,
61.nor in the intercession of any creature in whom I have hope,

segments.arabic: إِلَّا شَفَاعَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.translation: 62.except the intercession of Muhammad and the Folk of his House
63.(upon him and upon them be Your peace).

segments.arabic: أَتَيْتُكَ مُقِرّاً بِالْجُرْمِ وَ الْإِسَاءَةِ إِلَى نَفْسِي
segments.translation: 64.I come to You admitting sin and evildoing toward myself.
65.I come to You hoping for Your abounding pardon
66.through which You hast pardoned the offenders,

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلَى عَظِيمِ الْجُرْمِ
segments.transliteration: thum-ma lam yam-naa'-ka t'oolu u'koofihim a'laa a'z'eemil-jur-mi
segments.translation: 67.while their long persistence in dreadful sin did not prevent You

segments.arabic: أَنْ عُدْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
segments.translation: 68.from returning toward them with mercy and forgiveness!
69.O He whose mercy is wide
70.and whose pardon is abounding!
71.O All-mighty! O All-mighty!
72.O All-generous! O All-generous!

segments.arabic: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: 73.Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
74.return toward me through Your mercy,
75.be tender toward me through Your bounty,
76.and spread out Your forgiveness upon me!

segments.arabic: . اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَقَامَ لِخُلَفَائِكَ وَ أَصْفِيَائِكَ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-na had'aal-maqaama likhulafaaa-ika wa as'-feeaaa-ik
segments.translation: 77.O God, this station belongs to Your vicegerents, Your chosen,
78.while the places of Your trusted ones

segments.arabic: فِي الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ الَّتِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ بِهَا
segments.translation: 79.in the elevated degree which You hast singled out for them
80.have been forcibly stripped!
81.But You art the Ordainer of that -
82.Your command is not overcome,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يُجَاوَزُ الْمَحْتُومُ مِنْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
segments.translation: 83.the inevitable in Your governing is not overstepped!
84.However You willest and whenever You willest!
85.In that which You knowest best,

segments.arabic: غَيْرُ مُتَّهَمٍ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ وَ لَا لِإِرَادَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: ghay-ru mut-tahamin a'laa khal-qika wa laa liiraadatik
segments.translation: 86.Thou art not accused for Your creation or Your will!
87.Then Your selected friends, Your vicegerents,
88.were overcome, vanquished, forcibly stripped;
89.they see Your decree replaced,
90.Your Book discarded,

segments.arabic: ، وَ فَرَائِضَكَ مُحَرَّفَةً عَنْ جِهَاتِ أَشْرَاعِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa faraaa-iz''aka muh'ar-rafatan a'n jihaati ash-raai'k
segments.translation: 91.Your obligations distorted from the aims of Your laws,
92.and the Sunna of Your Prophet abandoned!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ أَعْدَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَ الْآخِرِينَ
segments.translation: 93.O God, curse their enemies among those of old and the later folk,
94.and all those pleased with their acts,
95.and their adherents and followers!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: 96.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
97.(surely You art All-laudable, All-glorious)
98.like Your blessing, benedictions, and salutations

segments.arabic: عَلَى أَصْفِيَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
segments.transliteration: a'laaa as'-feeaaa-ika ib-raaheema wa aaali ib-raaheem
segments.translation: 99.upon Your chosen Abraham and the people of Abraham!
100.And hasten for them relief,

segments.arabic: وَ الرَّوْحَ وَ النُّصْرَةَ وَ التَّمْكِينَ وَ التَّأْيِيدَ لَهُمْ
segments.translation: 101.ease, help, strengthening,and confirmation!
102.O God, and make me
103.one of the people who profess Your Unity,
104.have faith in You,
105.and attest to Your Messenger
106.and the Imams toward whom You hast enjoined obedience,

segments.arabic: مِمَّنْ يَجْرِي ذَلِكَ بِهِ وَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ
segments.translation: 107.and one of those through whom and at whose hands this takes place!
108.Amen, Lord of the worlds!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَيْسَ يَرُدُّ غَضَبَكَ إِلَّا حِلْمُكَ
segments.translation: 109.O God, nothing repels Your wrath but Your clemency,

segments.arabic: ، وَ لَا يَرُدُّ سَخَطَكَ إِلَّا عَفْوُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laa yarud-du sakhat'aka il-laa a'f-wuk
segments.translation: 110.nothing repels Your displeasure but Your pardon,

segments.arabic: وَ لا يُجِيرُ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَتُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laa yujeeru min i'qaabika il-laa rah'-matuk
segments.translation: 111.nothing grants sanctuary from Your punishment but Your mercy,
112.and nothing will deliver me from You

segments.arabic: إِلَّا التَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: minka il-laat-taz''ar-ruu' ilay-ka wa bay-na yaday-k
segments.translation: 113.except pleading to You before You,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: 114.so bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَ هَبْ لَنَا يَا إِلَهِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَرَجاً
segments.transliteration: wa hab lanaa yaaa ilaahee mil-ladunka farajan
segments.translation: 115.and give us on Your part, my God, relief
116.by means of the power through which You bringest the dead servants to life
117.and revivest the dead lands.

segments.arabic: . وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِي يَا إِلَهِي غَمّاً
segments.transliteration: wa laa tuh-lik-nee yaaa ilaahee gham-man
segments.translation: 118.Destroy me not through gloom, my God,
119.before You respondest to me
120.and givest me the knowledge of Your response to my supplication!

segments.arabic: وَ أَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي
segments.transliteration: wa ad'iq-nee t'aa'-mal-a'afeeati ilaa muntahaaa ajalee
segments.translation: 121.Let me taste the flavour of well-being to the end of my term!
122.And let not my enemy gloat over me,
123.place not my neck in his power,
124.and give him not authority over me!
125.My God, if You raisest me up,
126.who is there to push me down?
127.If You pushest me down,
128.who is there to raise me up?
129.If You honourest me,
130.who is there to humiliate me?
131.If You humiliatest me,
132.who is there to honour me?
133.If You chastisest me,
134.who is there to have mercy upon me?
135.If You destroyest me,

segments.arabic: فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِي عَبْدِكَ
segments.transliteration: faman d'aal-lad'ee yaa'-riz''u laka fee a'b-dika
segments.translation: 136.who is there to stand up for Your servant against You
137.or ask You about his affair?

segments.arabic: وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ
segments.transliteration: waqad a'lim-tu an-nahoolay-sa fee h'uk-mika z'ul-m
segments.translation: 138.But I know that there is no wrong in Your decree
139.and no hurry in Your vengeance.

segments.arabic: وَ إِنَّمَا يَعْجَلُ مَنْ يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ
segments.translation: 140.He alone hurries who fears to miss,

segments.arabic: وَ إِنَّمَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى الظُّلْمِ الضَّعِيفُ
segments.translation: 141.and only the weak needs to wrong.
142.But You art exalted, my God,
143.high indeed above all that!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: 144.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
145.make me not the target of affliction
146.nor the object of Your vengeance,
147.respite me, comfort me,
148.release me from my stumble,
149.and afflict me not with an affliction
150.in the wake of an affliction,
151.for You hast seen my frailty,
152.the paucity of my stratagems,
153.and my pleading to You!

segments.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ
segments.translation: 154.I seek refuge in You today, my God, from Your wrath,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ  وَ أَعِذْنِي.
segments.translation: 155.so bless Muhammad and his Household and give me refuge!

segments.arabic: ، وَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ
segments.translation: 156.I seek sanctuary in You today from Your displeasure,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَجِرْنِي
segments.translation: 157.so bless Muhammad and his Household, and give me sanctuary!
158.I ask You security from Your chastisement,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ آمِنِّي
segments.transliteration: salle ala mohmmadan wa aale muhammad
segments.translation: 159.so bless Muhammad and his Household, and give me security!
160.I seek guidance from You,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اهْدِنِي
segments.translation: 161.so bless Muhammad and his Household and guide me!
162.I seek help from You,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ انْصُرْنِي
segments.translation: 163.so bless Muhammad and his Household and help me!
164.I ask You for mercy,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْحَمْنِي
segments.translation: 165.so bless Muhammad and his Household and have mercy upon me!
166.I seek sufficiency from You,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اكْفِنِي
segments.translation: 167.so bless Muhammad and his Household and suffice me!
168.I seek provision from You,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْزُقْنِي
segments.translation: 169.so bless Muhammad and his Household and provide for me!
170.I seek assistance from You,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِنِّي
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wa ai'n-nee
segments.translation: 171.so bless Muhammad and his Household and assist me!

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
segments.transliteration: wa astagh-firuka limaa salafa min d'unoobee
segments.translation: 172.I pray forgiveness for my past sins,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اغْفِرْ لِي
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wagh-fir lee
segments.translation: 173.so bless Muhammad and his Household and forgive me!
174.I ask You to preserve me from sin,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اعْصِمْنِي
segments.translation: 175.so bless Muhammad and his Household and preserve me,

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي لَنْ أَعُودَ لِشَيْ‏ءٍ كَرِهْتَهُ مِنِّي إِنْ شِئْتَ ذَلِكَ
segments.transliteration: fa in-nee lan au'wda lishay-in karih-tahoo min-nee in shi-ta d'alik
segments.translation: 176.for I will not return to anything You dislikest from me, if You willest that!

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ، يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ
segments.transliteration: yaa rab-bi yaa rab yaa h'an-naanu yaa man-naan
segments.translation: 177.My Lord! My Lord! O All-loving! O All-kind!
178.O Possessor of majesty and munificence!
179.Bless Muhammad and his Household,
180.and grant me everything
181.that I ask from You, seek from You,
182.and beseech from You!

segments.arabic: وَ أَرِدْهُ وَ قَدِّرْهُ وَ اقْضِهِ وَ أَمْضِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa arid-hoo wa qad-dir-hoo wa aq-z''ihee wa am-z''ih
segments.translation: 183.Will it, ordain it, decree it, and accomplish it!

segments.arabic: وَ خِرْ لِي فِيمَا تَقْضِي مِنْه
segments.transliteration: wa khir lee feemaa taq-z''ee min-h
segments.translation: 184.Give me good in that of it which You decreest!
185.Bless me in that,
186.be gratuitously bountiful toward me through it,
187.make me happy in that of it which You givest to me,
188.and increase me in Your bounty
189.and the plenty of what is with You,
190.for You art Boundless, Generous!

segments.arabic: وَ صِلْ ذَلِكَ بِخَيْرِ الْآخِرَةِ وَ نَعِيمِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa s'il d'alika bikhay-ril-aaakhirati wa nae'emihaa
segments.translation: 191.And link that to the good and the bliss of the next world,
192.O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: تَدْعُو بِمَا بَدَا لَكَ، وَ تُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ هَكَذَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
segments.transliteration: then you supplicate as seems proper to you and you call down blessings on muhammed and his household one thousand times. this is what he used to do (upon him be peace).
segments.translation: 193.Then you supplicate as seems proper to you and you call down blessings on Muhammed and his Household one thousand times. this is what he used to do (upon him be peace).

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 41 Asking Covering & Protection

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And spread beneath me the bed of Your generosity
And bring me to the springs of Your mercy
And settle me in the spaciousness of Your Paradise
And do not label me as one turned away from You
And do not deprive me by Your rejection
And do not hold me accountable for what I have committed
Nor debate me about what I have acquired

segments.arabic: وَلَا تُبْرِزْ مَكْتُومِي، وَلَا تَكْشِفْ مَسْتُورِي
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ tubriz maktÅ«mÄ«, wa-lÄ takshif mastÅ«rÄ«
segments.translation: Do not expose my hidden faults, nor unveil my private matters

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَى مِيزَانِ الْأَنْصَافِ عَمَلِي
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ taá¸¥mil Ê¿alÄ mÄ«zÄni al-aná¹£Äfi Ê¿amalÄ«
segments.translation: Do not weigh my deeds with the strict scale of justice

segments.arabic: وَلَا تُعْلِنْ عَلَى عُيُونِ الْمَلَاءِ خَبَرِي
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ tuÊ¿lin Ê¿alÄ Ê¿uyÅ«ni al-malÄÊ¾i khabari
segments.translation: Nor disclose my news before the eyes of the assembly

segments.arabic: أَخْفِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يَكُونُ نَشْرُهُ عَلَيَّ عَارًا
segments.transliteration: Akhfi Ê¿anhum mÄ yakÅ«nu nashruhu Ê¿alayya Ê¿Äran
segments.translation: Hide from them what would bring me shame if made public

segments.arabic: وَاطْوِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يُلْحِقُنِي عِندَكَ شَنَارًا
segments.transliteration: Waá¹­wi Ê¿anhum mÄ yulá¸¥iqunÄ« Ê¿indak shanÄran
segments.translation: And conceal from them what would disgrace me before You
Honor my rank with Your satisfaction
And perfect my dignity through Your forgiveness
And enroll me among the companions of the right
Enable me to travel the paths of the secure
And make me among the group of the successful
Let me fill the gatherings of the righteous
Amen, Lord of the worlds
1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
2.spread for me the bed of Your honour,
3.bring me to the wateringholes of Your mercy,
4.set me down in the midst of Your Garden,
5.stamp me not with rejection by You,
6.deprive me not through disappointment by You,
7.settle not accounts with me for what I have committed,
8.make no reckoning with me for what I have earned,

segments.arabic: وَلا تُـبْرِزْ مَكْتُوْمِي، وَلاَ تَكْشِفْ مَسْتُورِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tub-riz mak-toomee wa laa tak-shif mas-tooree
segments.translation: 9.display not what I have hidden, expose not what I have covered over,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَى مِيزانِ الأنْصَافِ عَمَلِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tah'-mil a'laa meezaanil-ins'aafi a'malee
segments.translation: 10.weigh not my works on the scales of fairness,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُعْلِنْ عَلَى عُيُونِ الْمَلاَءِ خَبَـرِي.
segments.transliteration: wa laa tua'-lin a'laa u'yoonil-malaa khabaree
segments.translation: 11.and make not my tidings known to the eyes of the crowd!

segments.arabic: أَخْفِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يَكُونُ نَشْرُهُ عَلَيَّ عَاراً،
segments.transliteration: akh-fi a'n-hum maa yakoonu nash-ruhoo a'lay-ya a'araa
segments.translation: 12.Conceal from them everything whose unfolding would shame me

segments.arabic: وَاطْوِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يُلْحِقُنِي عِنْدَكَ شَنَاراً،
segments.transliteration: wat'-wi a'n-hum maa yul-h'iqunee i'ndaka shanaaraa
segments.translation: 13.and roll up before them all which would join me to disgrace with You!
14.Ennoble my degree through Your good pleasure,
15.perfect my honour through Your forgiveness,
16.rank me among the companions of the right hand,
17.direct me to the roads of the secure,
18.place me in the throng of the triumphant,
19.and through me let the sessions of the righteous thrive!
20.Amen, Lord of the worlds!

segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.
All praise is for Allah, in satisfaction with His decree.

segments.transliteration: awfara min shukrÄ« iyyÄka âalÄ mÄ khawwaltanÄ«
segments.translation: Greater than my gratitude for what You granted me.

segments.arabic: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ أَنْ أَظُنَّ بِذِي عَدَمٍ خَسَاسَةً،
segments.transliteration: wa-âá¹£imnÄ« min an aáºunna bidhÄ« âadamin khasÄsatan
segments.translation: And protect me from thinking the poor are lowly.
Or from thinking that the wealthy have virtue.
For the noble one is he whom Your obedience ennobles.
And the mighty is he whom Your worship strengthens.
So bless Muhammad and his family.
And grant us an endless wealth.
And support us with a strength that never vanishes.
And let us roam freely in the kingdom of eternity.
Indeed, You are the One, the Only, the Eternal Refuge.
The One who neither begets nor is begotten.
And none is comparable to You.

segments.transliteration: aal-h'am-du ll-lahee riz''an bih'uk-mil-laah shahit-tu an-nal-laah
segments.translation: 1.Praise belongs to God in satisfaction with God's decision!

segments.arabic: شَهِدْتُ أَنَّ اللهَ قَسَمَ مَعَايِشَ عِبَادِهِ بِالْعَدْلِ ،
segments.translation: 2.I bear witness that God has apportioned the livelihoods of His servants with justice

segments.transliteration: wa akhad'a a'laa jameei' khal-qihee bil-faz''-l
segments.translation: 3.and undertaken bounty for all His creatures.
4.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
5.tempt me not with what You hast given to Your creatures

segments.arabic: وَلا تَفْتِنْهُمْ بِمَا مَنَعْتَنِي فَأحْسُدَ خَلْقَكَ، وَأَغْمِطَ حُكْمَكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa taf-tin-hum bimaa manaa'-tanee faah'-suda khal-qak wa agh-mit'a h'uk-mak
segments.translation: 6.and tempt them not with what You hast withheld from me, lest I envy Your creatures and despise Your decision!
7.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
8.delight my soul through Your decree,
9.expand my breast through the instances of Your decision,
10.give to me a trust through which I may admit

segments.arabic: بِأََنَّ قَضَاءَكَ لَمْ يَجْرِ إلاَّ بِالْخِيَرَةِ
segments.transliteration: bi an-na qaz''aaa-aka lam yaj-ri il-laa bil-kheearah
segments.translation: 11.that Your decree runs only to the best,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ شُكْرِي لَكَ عَلَى مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنّي
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l shuk-ree laka a'laa maa zaway-ta a'n-neee
segments.translation: 12.and let my gratitude to You for what You hast taken away from me

segments.arabic: أَوْفَرَ مِنْ شُكْرِي إيَّاكَ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: aw-fara min shuk-reee ee-yaaka a'laa maa khaw-wal-tanee
segments.translation: 13.be more abundant than my gratitude to You for what You hast conferred upon me!

segments.arabic: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِن أنْ أظُنَّ بِذِي عَدْم خَسَاسَةً،
segments.transliteration: waa'-s'im-nee min an az'un-na bid'ee a'damin khasaasah
segments.translation: 14.Preserve me from imagining any meanness in someone who is destitute
15.or imagining any superiority in someone who possesses wealth,
16.for the noble is he whom obedience to You has ennobled
17.and the exalted is he whom worship of You has exalted!
18.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَمَتِّعْنَا بِثَرْوَة لاَ تَنْفَدُ، وَأَيِّدْنَا بِعِزٍّ لاَ يُفْقَدُ
segments.transliteration: wa mat-tia'-naa bithar-watil-laa tanfad wa ay-yid-naa bii'z-zil-laa yuf-qad
segments.translation: 19.give us to enjoy a wealth which does not run out, confirm us with an exaltation which will never be lost,
20.and let us roam freely in the kingdom of everlastingness!
21.Surely You art the One, 'the Unique, the Eternal Refuge;
22.You hast not begotten, nor hast You been begotten,
23.and equal to You is not any one' (ref.112:1-4)!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-7 When Faced with a Worrisome Task - Duas.org

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ تُحَلُّ بِهِ عُقَدُ الْمَكَارِهِ،
segments.transliteration: ya man tuá¸¥allu bihi Ê¿uqadu l-makÄrih,
segments.translation: O You by Whom the knots of difficulties are undone,

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُفْثَأُ بِهِ حَدُّ الشَّدَائِدِ،
segments.transliteration: wa ya man yufthaÊ¾u bihi á¸¥addu l-shadÄÊ¾id,
segments.translation: And O You by Whom the extremes of hardships are removed,

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُلْتَمَسُ مِنْهُ الْمَخْرَجُ إِلَى رَوْحِ الْفَرَجِ،
segments.transliteration: wa ya man yultamasu minhu al-makhraju ilÄ rawá¸¥i l-faraj,
segments.translation: And O You from Whom a way to relief is sought,
The difficulties have yielded to Your power,
And the means have been facilitated by Your kindness,
And by Your power, the decree proceeds,
And all things move according to Your will,
So by Your command, they act without speaking,
And by Your will, they are restrained without Your prohibition,
You are the one called upon for important matters,
And You are the refuge in calamities,

segments.arabic: لَا يَنْدَفِعُ مِنْهَا إِلَّا مَا دَفَعْتَ،
segments.transliteration: lÄ yandafiÊ¿u minhÄ illÄ mÄ dafaÊ¿ta,
segments.translation: Nothing is removed from them except by Your removal,

segments.arabic: وَلَا يَنْكَشِفُ مِنْهَا إِلَّا مَا كَشَفْتَ،
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ yankashifu minhÄ illÄ mÄ kashfta,
segments.translation: Nothing is revealed from them except what You unveil,

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ نَزَلَ بِي يَا رَبِّ مَا قَدْ تَكَأدَنيَّ ثِقْلُهُ،
