segments.translation: Indeed, O Lord, what has befallen me is almost unbearable,

segments.arabic: وَأَلَمَّ بِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa allamma bÄ« mÄ qad bahazani á¸¥amluhu,
segments.translation: And the burden of it has caused me pain,
So bless Muhammad and his family,

segments.arabic: وَافْتَحْ لِي يَا رَبِّ بَابَ الْفَرَجِ بِطَوْلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-iftaá¸¥ lÄ« yÄ rabbi bÄba al-faraj bi-á¹­awlik,
segments.translation: And open for me, O Lord, the door of relief by Your power,
And break from me the power of distress by Your strength,
And grant me good perception in what I complain of,
And let me taste the sweetness of good deeds in what I ask,

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَفَرَجاً هَنِيئاً،
segments.transliteration: wa-hab lÄ« min ladunka raá¸¥matan wa-farajan hanÄ«Ê¾an,
segments.translation: And grant me from You mercy and a joyful relief,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مَخْرَجاً وَحِيّاً،
segments.transliteration: wa-jÊ¿al lÄ« min Ê¿indik makhrajan wa-á¸¥iyyan,
segments.translation: And make for me from You a way out and guidance,

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَشْغَلْنِي بِالاهْتِمَامِ عَنْ تَعَاهُدِ فُرُوضِكَ وَاسْتِعْمَالِ سُنَّتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ tashghalnÄ« bil-ihtimÄm Ê¿an taÊ¿Ähudi furÅ«á¸ika wa-istiÊ¿mÄli sunnatika,
segments.translation: And do not occupy me with concern away from fulfilling Your obligations and following Your Sunnah,

segments.arabic: فَقَدْ ضِقْتُ لِمَا نَزَلَ بِي يَا رَبِّ ذَرْعاً،
segments.transliteration: fa-qad á¸iqqtu limÄ nazala bÄ« yÄ rabbi dharÊ¿an,
segments.translation: Indeed, I am constrained by what has befallen me, O Lord,

segments.arabic: وَامْتَلَأْتُ بِحَمْلِ مَا حَدَثَ عَلَيَّ هَمّاً،
segments.transliteration: wa-imtalÄtu bi-á¸¥amli mÄ á¸¥adatha Ê¿alayya hamman,
segments.translation: And I am filled with the burden of what has occurred to me,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى كَشْفِ مَا مُنِيتُ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-anta al-qÄdiru Ê¿alÄ kashfi mÄ munÄ«tu bihi,
segments.translation: And You are capable of removing what I am afflicted with,
And of averting what has befallen me,

segments.arabic: فَافْعَلْ بِي ذَلِكَ وَإِنْ لَمْ أَسْتَوْجِبْهُ مِنْكَ،
segments.transliteration: fa-ifÊ¿al bÄ« dhÄlika wa-in lam astawjibhu minka,
segments.translation: So do this for me even if I have not deserved it from You,
O Possessor of the Great Throne."

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ تُحَلُّ بِهِ عُقَدُ الْمَكَارِهِ ،
segments.translation: 1.O He through whom the knots of detested things are untied!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُفْثَأُ بِهِ حَدُّ الشَّدَائِدِ،
segments.translation: 2.O He through whom the cutting edge of hardships is blunted!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُلْتَمَسُ مِنْهُ الْمَخْرَجُ إلَى رَوْحِ الْفَرَجِ ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa may-yul-tamasu min-hul-makh-raju ilaa raw-h'il-faraj
segments.translation: 3.O He from whom is begged the outlet to the freshness of relief!
4.Intractable affairs yield to Your power,
5.means are made ready by Your gentleness,
6.the decree goes into effect through Your power,
7.and all things proceed according to Your desire.
8.By Your desire they follow Your command without Your word
9.and by Your will they obey Your bans without Your prohibition.
10.You art the supplicated in worries
11.and the place of flight in misfortunes;

segments.transliteration: laa yandafiu' min-haaa il-laa maa dafaa'-t
segments.translation: 12.none of them is repelled unless You repellest,

segments.arabic: وَلا يَنْكَشِفُ مِنْهَا إلاّ مَا كَشَفْتَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa yankashifu min-haaa il-laa maa kashaf-ta
segments.translation: 13.and none is removed unless You removest.

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ نَزَلَ بِي يا رَبِّ مَا قَدْ تَكَأدَنيَّ ثِقْلُهُ ،
segments.transliteration: wa qad nazala bee yaa rab-bi maa qad t-takaa-adanee thiq-luh
segments.translation: 14.Upon me has come down, My Lord, something whose weight burdens me

segments.arabic: وَأَلَمَّ بِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ ،
segments.transliteration: wa alam-ma bee maa qad bahaz'anee h'am-luh
segments.translation: 15.and upon me has fallen something whose carrying oppresses me.
16.Through Your power You hast brought it down upon me
17.and through Your authority You hast turned it toward me.
18.None can send away what You hast brought,
19.none can deflect what You hast turned,
20.none can open what You hast closed,
21.none can close what You hast opened,
22.none can make easy what You hast made difficult,
23.none can help him whom You hast abandoned.
24.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَافْتَحْ لِي يَا رَبِّ بَابَ الْفَرَجِ بِطَوْلِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: wa af-tah' lee yaa rab-bi baabal-faraji bit'aw-lik
segments.translation: 25.open for me, my Lord, the door of relief through Your graciousness,
26.break from me the authority of worry by Your strength,
27.confer the beauty of Your gaze upon my complaint,
28.let me taste the sweetness of benefaction in what I ask,

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَفَرَجاً هَنِيئاً
segments.transliteration: wa hab lee mil-ladunka rah'-mataw-wa farajan hanee-aa
segments.translation: 29.give me from Yourself mercy and wholesome relief,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مَخْرَجاً وَحِيّاً.
segments.translation: 30.and appoint for me from Yourself a quick way out!

segments.arabic: وَلا تَشْغَلْنِي بالاهْتِمَامِ عَنْ تَعَاهُدِ فُرُوضِكَ وَاسْتِعْمَالِ سُنَّتِكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa tash-ghal-nee biiah-timaami a'n taa'ahudi furooz''ik was-tia'-maali sun-natik
segments.translation: 31.Distract me not through worry from observing Your obligations and acting in accordance with Your prescriptions.

segments.arabic: فَقَدْ ضِقْتُ لِمَا نَزَلَ بِي  يَا رَبِّ ذَرْعاً ،
segments.transliteration: faqad z''iq-tu limaa nazala bee yaa rab-bi d'ar-a'a
segments.translation: 32.My capacity has been straitened, my Lord, by what has come down on me,

segments.arabic: وَامْتَلاتُ بِحَمْلِ مَا حَـدَثَ عَلَيَّ هَمّاً ،
segments.transliteration: wa am-talaa-tu bih'am-li maa h'adatha a'lay-ya ham-maa
segments.translation: 33.and I am filled with worry by carrying what has happened to me,

segments.arabic: وَأنْتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى كَشْفِ مَا مُنِيتُ  بِهِ ،
segments.transliteration: wa antal-qaadiru a'laa kash-fi maa muneetu bih
segments.translation: 34.while You hast power to remove what has afflicted me
35.and to repel that into which I have fallen.

segments.arabic: فَافْعَلْ بِي ذلِـكَ وَإنْ لَمْ أَسْتَوْجِبْهُ مِنْكَ ،
segments.transliteration: faf-a'l bee d'alika wa il-lam as-taw-jib-hoo mink
segments.translation: 36.So do that for me though I merit it not from You,
37.O Possessor of the Mighty Throne!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma laa t'aaqata lee bil-jah-d wa laa s'ab-ra lee a'laal-balaaa
segments.translation: 5.O God, I have no endurance for effort, no patience in affliction,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ قُوَّةَ لِي عَلَى الْفَقْرِ، فَلاَ تَحْظُرْ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa qoo-wata lee a'laal-faq-r falaa tah'-z'ur a'lay-ya riz-qee
segments.translation: 6.no strength to bear poverty. So forbid me not my provision

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَكِلْنِيْ إلَى خَلْقِكَ بَلْ تَفَرَّدْ بِحَاجَتِي، وَتَولَّ كِفَايَتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa takil-neee ilaa khal-qik bal tafar-rad bih'aajatee wa tawal-la kifaayatee
segments.translation: 7.and entrust me not to Your creatures, but take care of my need alone and Yourself attend to sufficing me!

segments.arabic: وَانْظُرْ إلَيَّ وَانْظُرْ لِي فِي جَمِيْعِ اُمُورِي،
segments.transliteration: wanz'ur ilay-ya wanz'ur lee fee jameei' umooree
segments.translation: 8.Look upon me and look after me in all my affairs,

segments.arabic: فَإنَّكَ إنْ وَكَلْتَنِي إلَى نَفْسِي عَجَزْتُ عَنْهَا،
segments.transliteration: fa in-naka iw-wakal-taneee ilaa naf-see a'jaz-tu a'n-haa
segments.translation: 9.for if You entrust me to myself, I will be incapable before myself

segments.transliteration: wa lam uqim maa feehee mas'-lah'atuhaa
segments.translation: 10.and fail to undertake that in which my best interest lies.
11.If You entrust me to Your creatures, they will frown upon me,

segments.transliteration: wa in al-jaa-taneee ilaa qaraabatee h'aramoonee
segments.translation: 12.and if You makest me resort to my kinsfolk, they will refuse to give to me;
13.if they give, they will give little and in bad temper,
14.making me feel long obliged and blaming me much.
15.So through Your bounty, O God, free me from need, through Your mightiness, lift me up,

segments.arabic: وَبِسَعَتِكَ فَابْسُطْ يَدِي، وَبِمَا عِنْدَكَ فَاكْفِنِي.
segments.transliteration: wa bisaa'tika fab-sut' yadee wa bimaa i'ndaka fak-finee
segments.translation: 16.through Your boundless plenty, open my hand, and with that which is with You, suffice me!
17.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَخَلِّصْنِي مِنَ الْحَسَدِ، وَاحْصُرْنِي عَن الذُّنُوبِ،
segments.translation: 18.rid me of envy, encircle me against sins,

segments.arabic: وَوَرِّعْنِي عَنِ الْمَحَارِمِ، وَلا تُجَرِّئْنِي عَلَى الْمَعَاصِي،
segments.transliteration: wa war-ria'-nee a'nil-mah'aarim wa laa tujar-ri-nee a'laal-maa'as'ee
segments.translation: 19.make me abstain from things unlawful, give me not the boldness of disobedient acts,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ هَوايَ عِنْدَكَ، وَرِضَايَ فِيمَا يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ مِنْكَ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l hawaaya i'ndaka wa riz''aaya feemaa yaridu a'lay-ya mink
segments.translation: 20.assign me love for that which is with You and satisfaction with that which comes to me from You,

segments.arabic: وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيْمَا رَزَقْتَنِي، وَفِيمَا خَوَّلْتَنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa baarik lee feemaa razaq-tanee wafeemaa khaw-wal-tanee
segments.translation: 21.bless me in that which You providest me, that which You conferrest upon me,

segments.arabic: وَفِيمَا أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ، وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي كُلِّ حَالاَتِي
segments.transliteration: wa feemaaa an-a'm-ta bihee a'lay waj-a'l-nee fee kul-li h'aalaatee
segments.translation: 22.and that through which You favourest me, and make me in all my states

segments.arabic: مَحْفُوظَاً مَكْلُوءاً مَسْتُوراً مَمْنُوعاً مُعَاذاً مُجَاراً.
segments.translation: 23.safeguarded, watched, covered, defended, given refuge, and granted sanctuary!
24.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَاقْضِ عَنِّي كُلّ مَا أَلْزَمْتَنِيهِ وَفَرَضْتَهُ عَلَيَّ لَكَ فِي وَجْه مِنْ  وُجُوهِ طَاعَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: waq-z''i a'n-nee kul-la maaa al-zam-taneehee wa faraz''-tahoo a'lay-ya laka fee waj-him-miw-wujoohee t'aaa'tik
segments.translation: 25.and let me accomplish everything which You hast enjoined upon me or made obligatory for me toward You, in one of the ways of Your obedience,

segments.arabic: أَوْ لِخَلْق مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَإنْ ضَعُفَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ بَدَنِي، وَوَهَنَتْ عَنْهُ قُـوَّتِي،
segments.transliteration: aw likhal-qim-min khal-qik wa in z''au'fa a'n d'alika badanee wa wahanat a'n-hoo qoo-watee
segments.translation: 26.or toward one of Your creatures, though my body be too frail for that, my strength too feeble,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ تَنَلْهُ مَقْدِرَتِي، وَلَمْ يَسَعْهُ مَالِي وَلاَ ذَاتُ يَدِي، ذَكَرْتُهُ أَوْ نَسِيتُهُ
segments.transliteration: wa lam tanal-hoo maq-duratee wa lam yasaa'-hoo maalee wa laa d'aatu yadee d'akar-tuhooo aw naseetuh
segments.translation: 27.my power not able to reach it, and my possessions and what my hand owns not encompass it, and whether I have remembered it or forgotten it.

segments.arabic: هُوَ يَا رَبِّ مِمَّا قَدْ أَحْصَيْتَهُ عَلَيَّ وَأَغْفَلْتُهُ أَنَا مِنْ نَفْسِي،
segments.transliteration: huwa yaa rab-bi mim-maa qad ah'-s'ay-tahoo a'lay wa agh-fal-tuhooo ana min-naf-see
segments.translation: 28.It, my Lord, is among that which You hast counted against me while I have been heedless of it in myself.

segments.arabic: فَأَدِّهِ عَنِّي مِنْ جَزِيْلِ عَطِيَّتِكَ وَكَثِيرِ مَا عِنْدَكَ،
segments.transliteration: faad-dihee a'n-nee min jazeeli a't'ee-yatika wa kabeeri maa i'ndaka
segments.translation: 29.Let me perform it through Your plentiful giving and the abundance which is with You

segments.arabic: فَإنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ  كَرِيمٌ حَتَّى لاَ يَبْقَى عَلَيَّ شَيْ مِنْهُ
segments.transliteration: fa in-naka waasiu'n kareemun h'at-taa laa yab-qaa a'lay-ya shay-um min-hoo
segments.translation: 30.- for You art Boundless, Generous - so that nothing of it may remain against me,

segments.arabic: تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُقَاصَّنِي بِهِ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِي،
segments.transliteration: tureedu an tuqaaas'-s'anee bihee min h'asanaatee
segments.translation: 31.lest You wouldst wish to settle accounts for it from my good deeds

segments.arabic: أَوْ تُضَاعِفَ بِهِ مِنْ سَيِّئاتِي يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ يَا رَبِّ.
segments.transliteration: aw tuz''aai'fa bihee min say-yi-aatee yaw-ma al-qaaka yaa rab
segments.translation: 32.or to compound my evil deeds on the day I meet You, my Lord!
33.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَارْزُقْنِي الرَّغْبَةَ فِي الْعَمَـلِ لَكَ لآخِـرَتِي،
segments.translation: 34.and provide me with desire to serve You for the sake of my state in the hereafter,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى أَعْرِفَ صِدْقَ ذلِكَ مِنْ قَلْبِي،
segments.translation: 35.such that I know the truthfulness of that [desire] in my heart,

segments.arabic: وَحَتَّى يَكُونَ الْغَالِبُ عَلَيَّ الزُّهْدُ فِي دُنْيَايَ،
segments.transliteration: wa h'at-taa yakoonal-ghaalibu a'lay-yaz-zuh-da fee dunyaay
segments.translation: 36.be dominated by renunciation while in this world,
37.do good deeds with yearning,
38.and remain secure from evil deeds in fright and fear!

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي نُوراً أَمْشِي بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ، وَأَهْتَدِي بِهِ فِي الظُّلُماتِ،
segments.transliteration: wa hab lee noorana am-shee bihee fin-naas wa ah-tadee bihee feez'-z'ulumaat
segments.translation: 39.And give me 'a light whereby I may walk among the people' (ref.6:122), be guided in the shadows,
40.and seek illumination in doubt and uncertainty!
41.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
42.and provide me with fear of the threatened gloom

segments.arabic: وَشَوْقَ ثَوَابِ الْمَوْعُودِ حَتَّى أَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا أَدْعُوكَ لَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa shaw-qa thawaabil-maw-u'wdi h'at-taa ajida lad'-d'ata maaa ad-u'wka lah
segments.translation: 43.and yearning for the promised reward, such that I may find the pleasure of that for which I supplicate You

segments.transliteration: wa kaa-bata maaa as-tajeeru bika min-h
segments.translation: 44.and the sorrow of that from which I seek sanctuary in You!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ قَـدْ تَعْلَمُ مَا يُصْلِحُنِي مِنْ أَمْرِ دُنْيَايَ وَآخِـرَتِي،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma qad t-taa'-lamu maa yus'-lih'unee min am-ri dunyaaya wa aaakhiratee
segments.translation: 45.O God, You knowest what will set my affairs right in this world and the next,
46.so be ever gracious toward my needs!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
segments.translation: 47.O God, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household

segments.arabic: وَارْزُقْنِي الْحَقَّ عِنْدَ تَقْصِيرِي فِي الشُّكْرِ لَكَ
segments.translation: 48.and provide me with what is Your right when I fall short in thanking You

segments.arabic: بِمَا أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ فِي اليُسـرِ وَالْعُسْرِ وَالصِّحَّـةِ وَالسَّقَمِ
segments.transliteration: bimaaa an-a'm-ta a'lay-ya feel-yus-ri wal-u's-r was'-s'ih'-h'ati was-saqam
segments.translation: 49.for that through which You hast favoured me in ease and difficulty, health and sickness,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى أَتَعَرَّفَ مِنْ نَفْسِي رَوْحَ الرِّضَا
segments.translation: 50.such that I may come to know in myself repose in satisfaction

segments.arabic: وَطُمَأنِينَةَ النَّفْسِ مِنِّي بِمَا يَجِبُ لَكَ فِيمَا يَحْدُثُ
segments.transliteration: wa t'umaa-neenatan-naf-si min-nee bimaa yajibu lak feemaa yah'-duthu
segments.translation: 51.and serenity of soul in that which You hast made incumbent upon me
52.in whatever states may occur: fear and security,
53.satisfaction and displeasure, loss and gain!
54.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
55.and provide me with a breast safe from envy,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ أَحْسُدَ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ عَلَى شَيْء مِنْ فَضْلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa laaa ah'-suda ah'adam-min khal-qika a'laa shay-im-min faz''-lik
segments.translation: 56.such that I envy none of Your creatures and in anything of Your bounty

segments.arabic: وَحَتَّى لاَ أَرى نِعْمَـةً مِنْ نِعَمِـكَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa h'at-taa laaa araa nia'-matam-min-nia'mika a'laaa ah'adim-min khal-qika
segments.translation: 57.and such that I see none of Your favours toward any of Your creatures

segments.arabic: فِي دِيْن أَوْ دُنْيا، أَوْ عَافِيَة أَوْ تَقْوَى،
segments.transliteration: fee deenin aw dunyaa aw a'afeeatin aw taq-waa
segments.translation: 58.in religion or this world, well-being or reverential fear,

segments.arabic: أَوْ سَعَة أَوْ رَخاء، إلاّ رَجَوْتُ لِنَفْسِي أَفْضَلَ ذلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: aw saa'tin aw rakhaaa- il-laa rajaw-tu linaf-seee af-z''ala d'alika
segments.translation: 59.plenty or ease, without hoping for myself better than it

segments.arabic: بِكَ وَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ.
segments.transliteration: bika wa minka wah'-daka laa shareeka lak
segments.translation: 60.through and from You alone, who hast no associate!
61.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
62.and provide me with caution against offenses

segments.arabic: وَالاحْتِرَاسَ مِنَ الزَّلَلِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ،
segments.translation: 63.and wariness against slips in this world and the next
64.in the state of satisfaction and wrath,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى أكُونَ بِمَا يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَنْزِلَة سَوَاء،
segments.transliteration: h'at-taaa akoona bimaa yaridu a'lay-ya min-humaa bimanzilatin sawaaa
segments.translation: 65.such that I may remain indifferent toward that which enters upon me from the two states,

segments.arabic: عَامِلاً بِطَاعَتِكَ مُؤْثِراً لِرِضَاكَ عَلَى مَا سِوَاهُمَا فِي الأَوْلِياءِ وَالأعْدَاءِ
segments.transliteration: a'amilam-bit'aaa'tika  moo-thiral-liriz''aaka a'laa maa siwaahumaa fil-aw-leeaaa-i wal-aa'-daaa-i
segments.translation: 66.work toward Your obedience, and prefer it and Your good pleasure over all else in both friends and enemies.

segments.arabic: حَتّى يَأْمَنَ عَدُوِّي مِنْ ظُلْمِي وَجَوْرِي،
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa yaa-mana a'doo-wee min z'ul-mee wa jaw-ree
segments.translation: 67.Then my enemy may stay secure from my wrongdoing and injustice

segments.arabic: وَيَيْأَسَ وَلِيِّي مِنْ مَيْلِي وَانْحِطَاطِ هَوَايَ،
segments.transliteration: wa yay-ssa wa lee-yee mim-may-lee wa an-h'it'aat'i hawaay
segments.translation: 68.and my friend may despair of my inclination and the bent of my affection.

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلنِي مِمَّنْ يَدْعُوكَ مُخْلِصاً في الرَّخَاءِ
segments.translation: 69.Make me one of those who supplicate You with sincerity in ease

segments.arabic: دُعَـاءَ الْمُخْلِصِينَ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ لَـكَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ
segments.translation: 70.with the supplication of those who supplicate You with sincerity in distress!
71.Verily You art Praiseworthy, Glorious.

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 17-When he Mentioned Satan and Sought Refuge from him

segments.translation: O Allah, we seek refuge in You,

segments.arabic: مِنْ نَزَغَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَكَيْدِهِ وَمَكَائِدِهِ،

segments.translation: From the instigations of the accursed Satan, and his plots and traps,

segments.translation: And from trusting in his false hopes, promises, deceptions, and snares,

segments.translation: And disgrace us with disobedience to You, or make seem good to us what he beautified for us,

segments.translation: Or make burdensome to us what he has made hateful to us.
O Allah, drive him away from us through our worship of You,
And suppress him by our persistence in Your love,

segments.translation: And place between us and him a veil he cannot tear,
And a solid barrier he cannot break open.
O Allah, bless Muá¸¥ammad and his family,
And occupy him away from us with some of Your enemies,

segments.arabic: وَاعْصِمْنَا مِنْهُ بِحُسْنِ رِعَايَتِكَ، وَاكْفِنَا خَتْرَهُ،

segments.translation: And protect us from him with Your good care, and suffice us from his harm,
Turn his back to us, and cut off his tracks from us.
O Allah, bless Muá¸¥ammad and his family,
Grant us enjoyment of guidance equal to his misguidance,
And provide us with piety as an opposite to his error,

segments.translation: And lead us in the way of piety, against his path of ruin.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَمَا سَوَّلَ لَنَا مِنْ بَاطِلٍ فَعَرِّفْنَاهُ،

segments.translation: O Allah, whatever falsehood he suggests to us, make us know it,

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا عَرَّفْتَنَاهُ فَقِنَاهُ، وَبَصِّرْنَا مَا نُكَايِدُهُ بِهِ،

segments.translation: And once You make us know it, protect us from it, and show us how to resist him with it,

segments.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْنَا مَا نُعِدُّهُ لَهُ، وَأَيْقِظْنَا عَنْ سِنَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ بِالرُّكُونِ إِلَيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa-alhimnÄ mÄ nuâidduhÅ« lahÅ«, wa-ayqiáºnÄ âan sinati l-ghaflati bi-r-rukÅ«ni ilayhÄ«,
segments.translation: And inspire us with what we prepare against him, and awaken us from the slumber of heedlessness by leaning toward him,
O Allah, occupy us from him with Your remembrance,
And protect us from him through obedience to You,
And suffice us against his burden through Your help,
And make us needless of his deceit through Your support,
And grant us the triumph of forgiveness, and the adornment of spoils.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family,
And make beloved to us the companionship of the righteous,
And open for us the doors of Your obedience,
And close for us the doors of disobedience,
And make us among the people of Your obedience,
And grant us sincerity in our deeds for You,
And reliance upon You, and submission to Your command.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family,
And make us mindful of You,
And grateful to You, and praising Your blessings,
And opposing Your enemy,
And loyal to Your friends,
And grant us the greatest share and the highest fortune.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family,
And make our livelihood pleasant,
And our lives happy,
And our sustenance abundant,
And our states upright,
And our secrets concealed,
And our needs fulfilled,
And our deeds accepted,
And our sins forgiven,
And our needs granted,
And our hopes attained,
And our good ends achieved,
And our good returns reached,
And our needs fulfilled,
And grant us safety in our homelands,
And rectify our leaders,
And the governors of our affairs,
And strengthen our authority,
And grant victory to our soldiers,
And protect our borders,
And keep us safe in our lands,
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
Amen, Lord of the worlds.
O God, we seek refuge in You

segments.arabic: مِنْ نَزَغَـاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَكَيْدِهِ وَمَكَائِدِهِ،

segments.translation: from the instigations of the accursed Satan, his trickery, and his traps,

segments.arabic: وَمِنَ الثِّقَةِ بِأَمَـانِيِّهِ وَمَوَاعِيدِهِ وَغُرُورِهِ وَمَصَائِدِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa minath-thiqati bimaanee-yihee wa mawaae'edih wa ghuroorihee wa mas'aaa-idih
segments.translation: from trust in his false hopes, his promises, his delusions, and his snares,
and lest he should make himself crave to lead us away
from Your obedience and to degrade us through our disobeying You,

segments.arabic: أَوْ أَنْ يَحْسُنَ عِنْدَنَا مَا حَسَّنَ لَنَا،
segments.transliteration: aw ay-yah'-suna i'ndanaa maa h'as-sana lanaa
segments.translation: and lest what he has shown us as beautiful be beautiful for us

segments.arabic: أَوْ أَنْ يَثْقُلَ عَلَيْنَا مَا كَرَّهَ إلَيْنَا.
segments.transliteration: aw ay-yath-qula a'lay-naa maa kar-raha ilay-naa
segments.translation: and what he has shown us as detestable weigh down upon us.
O God, drive him away from us through Your worship,
throw him down through our perseverance in Your love,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ سِتْراً لاَ يَهْتِكُهُ،
segments.translation: and place between him and us a covering that he cannot tear away
and a solid barrier that he cannot cut through!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
distract Satan from us with some of Your enemies,

segments.arabic: وَاعْصِمْنَا مِنْهُ بِحُسْنِ رِعَايَتِكَ، وَاكْفِنَا خَتْرَهُ،
segments.transliteration: waa'-s'im-naa min-hoo bih'us-ni ria'ayatik wak-finaa khat-rah
segments.translation: preserve us from him through Your good guarding, spare us his treachery,

segments.transliteration: wa wal-linaa z'ah-rah waq-t'aa' a'n-naaa ith-rah
segments.translation: turn his back toward us, and cut off from us his trace!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
give us to enjoy guidance the like of his misguidance,
increase us in piety against his seduction,

segments.arabic: وَاسْلُكْ بِنَـا مِنَ التُّقى خِـلافَ سَبِيلِهِ مِنَ الـرَّدى.
segments.transliteration: was-luk binaa minat-tuqaa khilaafa sabeelihee minar-radaa
segments.translation: and make us walk in reverential fear contrary to his path of ruin!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْ لَهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا مَدْخَلاً
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma laa taj-a'l-lahoo fee quloobinaa mad-khalaa
segments.translation: O God, assign him no place of entrance into our hearts

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُوطِنَنَّ لَهُ فِيمَا لَدَيْنَا مَنْزِلاً.
segments.transliteration: wa laa toot'inan-na lahoo feemaa laday-naa manzilaa
segments.translation: and do not allow him to make his home in that which is with us!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا سَوَّلَ لَنَا مِنْ بَاطِل فَعَرِّفْنَاهُ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa maa saw-wala lanaa mim-baat'ilin faa'r-rif-naahoo
segments.translation: O God, cause us to recognize the falsehood with which he tempts us,

segments.arabic: وَإذَا عَرَّفْتَنَاهُ فَقِنَاهُ، وَبَصِّرْنَا مَا نُكَايِدُهُ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa id'aa a'r-raf-tanaahoo faqinaahu wa bas'-s'ir-naa maa nukaayiduhoo bih
segments.translation: and once You hast caused us to recognize it, protect us from it! Make us see what will allow us to outwit him,

segments.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْنَا مَا نُعِدُّهُ لَهُ، وَأَيْقِظْنَا عَنْ سِنَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ بِالرُّكُونِ إلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: wa al-him-naa maa nui'd-duhoo lah wa ay-qiz'-naa a'n sinatil-ghaf-lati bir-rukooni ilay-h
segments.translation: .inspire us with all that we can make ready for him, awaken us from the heedless slumber of relying upon him,
and help us well, through Your giving success, against him!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa ash-rib quloobanaaa inkaara a'malih
segments.translation: O God, saturate our hearts with the rejection of his works
and be gentle to us by destroying his stratagems!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَحَوِّلْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَنَّا،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih wa h'aw-wil sul-t'aanahoo a'n-naa
segments.translation: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, turn his authority away from us,

segments.arabic: وَاقْطَعْ رَجَاءَهُ مِنَّا ، وادْرَأْه عَنِ الْوُلُوعِ بِنَا.
segments.transliteration: waq-t'aa' rajaaa-ahoo min-naa wad-raa-hoo a'nil-wlooi' binaa
segments.translation: cut off his hope from us, and keep him from craving for us!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: waj-a'l aaabaaa-anaa wa um-mahaatinaa wa aw-laadanaa wa ahaaleenaa
segments.translation: and place our fathers, our mothers, our children, our wives,

segments.transliteration: wa d'aweee ar-h'aaminaa wa qaraabaatinaa wa jeeraananaa
segments.translation: our siblings, our relatives, and the faithful among our neighbours,

segments.arabic: مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـاتِ مِنْهُ فِي حِرْز حَـارِز،
segments.transliteration: minal-moo-mineena wal-moo-minaati min-hoo fee h'ir-zin h'aariz
segments.translation: male and female, in a sanctuary impregnable to him,

segments.arabic: وَحِصْن حَافِظ ، وَكَهْف مَانِع، وَألْبِسْهُمْ مِنْهُ جُنَناً وَاقِيَةً،
segments.transliteration: wa h'is'-nin h'aafiz' wa kah-fim-maania'- wa al-bis-hum min-hoo junanaw-waaqeeah
segments.translation:
ÙÙØ£ÙØ¹ÙØ·ÙÙÙÙÙ Ø¹ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ Ø£ÙØ³ÙÙÙØ­ÙØ©Ù ÙÙØ§Ø¶ÙÙÙØ©Ù
wa aa'-t'ihim a'lay-heee as-lih'atam-maaz''eeah
and give them arms that will cut him down!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَاعْمُمْ بِذلِكَ مَنْ شَهِدَ لَكَ بِالرُّبُوبِيَّةِ،
segments.translation: O God, include in that everyone who witnesses to You as Lord,

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma waa'-mum bid'alika man- shahida laka bir-rubwbee-yah
segments.translation: devotes himself sincerely to Your Unity,
shows enmity toward him through the reality of servanthood,

segments.arabic: وَاسْتَظْهَرَ بِكَ عَلَيْهِ فِي مَعْرِفَةِ الْعُلُومِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ.
segments.translation: and seeks help from You against him through knowledge of the divine sciences!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ احْلُلْ مَا عَقَدَ، وَافْتقْ مَا رَتَقَ،
segments.translation: O God, undo what he ties, unstitch what he sews up,

segments.arabic: وَافسَخ مَا دَبَّرَ، وَثَبِّطْهُ إذَا عَزَمَ، وَانْقُضْ مَا أَبْرَمَ.
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma ah'-lul maa a'qad waf-tuq maa rataq
segments.translation: dislocate what he devises, frustrate him when he makes up his mind, and destroy what he establishes!

segments.transliteration: waf-sakh maa dab-bar wa thab-bit'-hooo id'aa a'zam wanquz'' maaa ab-ram
segments.translation: O God, rout his troops, nullify his trickery,

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wah-zim jundah wa ab-t'il kay-dah
segments.translation: make his cave collapse, and rub his nose in the ground!
O God, place us in the ranks of his enemies
and remove us from the number of his friends,
that we obey him not when he entices us
and answer him not when he calls to us!

segments.transliteration: wa laa nas-tajeebu lahooo id'aa daa'anaa
segments.translation: We command everyone who obeys our command to be his enemy

segments.arabic: وَنَعِظُ عَنْ مُتَابَعَتِهِ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ زَجْرَنَا.
segments.translation: and we admonish everyone who follows our prohibition not to follow him!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَسَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa nai'z'u a'm-mutaabaa'tihee mani at-tabaa' zaj-ranaa
segments.translation: O God, bless Muhammad the Seal of the prophets and lord of the emissaries,

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madin khaatamin-nabee-yeena wa say-yidil-mur-saleena
segments.translation: and the folk of his house, the good, the pure!
Give refuge to us, our families, our brothers,

segments.arabic: وَجَمِيـعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِمَّا اسْتَعَذْنَا مِنْهُ،
segments.translation: and all the faithful, male and female, from that from which we seek refuge,

segments.arabic: وَأَجِرْنَا مِمَّا اسْتَجَرْنَا بِكَ مِنْ خَوْفِهِ
segments.translation: and grant us sanctuary from that through fear of which we seek sanctuary in You!

segments.arabic: وَاسْمَعْ لَنَا مَا دَعَوْنَا بِهِ وَأَعْطِنَا مَا أَغْفَلْنَاهُ وَاحْفَظْ لَنَا مَا نَسِيْنَاهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa ajir-naa mim-mas-tajar-naa bika min khaw-fih
segments.translation: Hear our supplication to You, bestow upon us that of which we have been heedless, and safeguard for us what we have forgotten!

segments.transliteration: was-maa' lanaa maa daa'w-naa bih wa a'-t'inaa maaa agh-fal-naah wah'-faz' lanaa maa naseenaah
segments.translation: Through all this bring us into the ranks of the righteous
and the degrees of the faithful!
Amen, Lord of the worlds!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ تَرَاهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَرَاكَ وَأَنْتَ أَقْوَى
segments.translation: And You see him from where he sees You not, and You are stronger.

segments.arabic: عَلَى أَمْرِهِ كُلِّهِ وَهُوَ لَا يَقْوَى عَلَى شَيْءٍ

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَتُوبُ إلَيْـكَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا

segments.translation: and my covenant that I will abandon all acts of disobedience to You.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا عَمِلْتُ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا عَلِمْتَ،

segments.translation: and all of them are in Your eye that does not sleep,
and Your knowledge that does not forget;

segments.arabic: فَعَوِّضْ مِنْهَا أَهْلَهَا وَاحْطُطْ عَنّي وِزْرَهَا،

segments.translation: a repentance by which every limb, singly, is preserved from Your consequences,

segments.translation: and spread over me Your favor and cover me with Your covering,

segments.transliteration: wa á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Älih
segments.translation: and bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.transliteration: wa yaa man huwa muntahaa khaw-fil-a'abideen
segments.translation: 4.O He who is the ultimate object of the fear of the worshipers!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ هُوَ غَايَةُ خَشْيَةِ الْمُتَّقِينَ.
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man huwa ghaayatu khash-yatil-mut-taqeen
segments.translation: 5.O He who is the utmost limit of the dread of the godfearing!

segments.arabic: هَذا مَقَامُ مَنْ تَدَاوَلَتْهُ أَيْدِي الذُّنُوبِ ،
segments.translation: 6.This is the station of him whom sins have passed from hand to hand.
7.Offenses' reins have led him on,
8.and Satan has gained mastery over him.
9.He fell short of what You hast commanded through neglect

segments.transliteration: wa taa'at'aa maa nahay-ta a'n-hoo tagh-reeraa
segments.translation: 10.and he pursued what You hast prohibited in delusion,
11.like one ignorant of Your power over him
12.or one who denies the bounty of Your beneficence toward him,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى إذَا انْفَتَحَ لَهُ بَصَرُ الْهُدَى،
segments.translation: 13.until, when the eye of guidance was opened for him

segments.arabic: وَتَقَشَّعَتْ عَنْهُ  سَحَائِبُ الْعَمَى أَحْصَى مَا ظَلَمَ بِهِ نَفْسَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa taqash-shaa't a'n-hoo sah'aaa-ibul-a'maa ah'-s'aa maa z'alama bihee naf-sah
segments.translation: 14.and the clouds of blindness were dispelled, he reckoned that through which he had wronged himself

segments.transliteration: wa fak-kara feemaa khaalafa bihee rab-bah
segments.translation: 15.and reflected upon that in which he had opposed his Lord.

segments.arabic: فَرَأى كَبِيْرَ عِصْيَانِهِ كَبِيْراً، وَجَلِيل مُخالفَتِهِ جَلِيْلاً،
segments.transliteration: faraaa kabeera i's'-yaanihee kabeeraw-wa jaleela mukhaalafatihee jaleelaa
segments.translation: 16.He saw his vast disobedience as vast and his great opposition as great.

segments.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ نَحْوَكَ مُؤَمِّلاً لَكَ، مُسْتَحْيِيَاً مِنْكَ،
segments.translation: 17.So turned to You, hoping in You and ashamed before You,
18.and he directed his beseeching toward You, having trust in You.

segments.arabic: فَأَمَّكَ بِطَمَعِهِ يَقِيناً، وَقَصَدَكَ بِخَوْفِهِ إخْلاَصَاً،
segments.transliteration: faam-maka bit'amai'hee yaqeenaa wa qas'adaka bikhaw-fiheee ikh-laas'aa
segments.translation: 19.He repaired to You in his longing with certitude and he went straight to You in fear with sincerity.

segments.arabic: قَدْ خَلاَ طَمَعُهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَطْمُوع فِيهِ غَيْرِكَ،
segments.transliteration: qad khalaa t'amau'hoo min kul-li mat'-mooi'n feehee ghay-rik
segments.translation: 20.His longing was devoid of every object of longing but You,

segments.arabic: وَأَفْرَخَ رَوْعُهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَحْذُور مِنْهُ سِوَاكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa af-rakha raw-u'hoo min kul-li mah'-d'oorim-min-hoo siwaak
segments.translation: 21.and his fright departed from every object of fear but You.
22.So he stood before You pleading,
23.his eyes turned toward the ground in humbleness,
24.his head bowed before Your might in lowliness;

segments.arabic: وَأَبَثَّكَ مِنْ سِرِّهِ مَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنْهُ خَضُوعاً،
segments.transliteration: wa abath-thaka min sir-rihee maaa anta sa'-lamu bihee min-hoo khuz''ooa'a
segments.translation: 25.he revealed to You in meekness those secrets of his which You knowest better than he;

segments.arabic: وَعَدَّدَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِهِ مَا أَنْتَ أَحْصَى لَهَا خُشُوعاً
segments.transliteration: wa a'd-dada min d'unoobihee maaa anta ah'-s'aa lahaa khushooa'a
segments.translation: 26.he numbered for You in humility those sins of his which You countest better than he;

segments.arabic: وَاسْتَغَاثَ بِكَ مِنْ عَظِيمِ مَاوَقَعَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِكَ
segments.transliteration: was-taghaatha bika min- a'z'eemi maa waqaa' bihee fee i'l-mik
segments.translation: 27.he sought help from You before the dreadful into which he has fallen in Your knowledge

segments.transliteration: wa qabeehee maa faz''ah'ahoo fee h'uk-mika
segments.translation: 28.and the ugly which has disgraced him in Your judgement:
29.the sins whose pleasures have turned their backs and gone
30.and whose evil consequences have stayed and stuck fast.

segments.arabic: لا يُنْكِرُ يَا إلهِي عَدْلَكَ إنْ عَاقَبْتَهُ،
segments.transliteration: laa yunkiru yaaa ilaahee a'd-laka in a'aqab-tah
segments.translation: 31.He will not deny Your justice, my God, if You punishest him,

segments.arabic: وَلا يَسْتَعْظِمُ عَفْوَكَ إنْ عَفَوْتَ عَنْهُ وَرَحِمْتَهُ;
segments.transliteration: wa laa yas-taa'-z'imu a'f-waka in a'faw-ta a'n-hoo wa rah'im-tah
segments.translation: 32.nor will he consider Your pardon great if You pardonest him and hast mercy upon him,
33.for You art the Generous Lord

segments.arabic: الَّذِي لا يَتَعَاظَمُهُ غُفْرَانُ الذَّنْبِ الْعَظِيم.
segments.translation: 34.for whom the forgiveness of great sins is nothing great!

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ فَهَا أَنَا ذَا قَدْ جئْتُكَ مُطِيعاً
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma fahaaa ana d'aa qad ji-tuka mut'eea'n liam-rik
segments.translation: 35.O God, so here I am: I have come to You obeying Your command

segments.arabic: لاِمْرِكَ فِيمَا أَمَرْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ،
segments.translation: 36.(for You hast commanded supplication)

segments.arabic: مَتَنَجِّزاً وَعْدَكَ فِيمَا وَعَدْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الإجَابَةِ إذْ تَقُولُ
segments.translation: 37.and asking the fulfilment of Your promise, (for You hast promised to respond):
38.You hast said, "Supplicate Me and I will respond to you" (40:60).
39.O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa al-qanee bimagh-firatika kamaa laqeetuka biiq-raaree
segments.translation: 40.meet me with Your forgiveness just as I have met You with my confession,

segments.arabic: وَارْفَعْنِي عَنْ مَصَارعِ الذُّنُوبِ كَمَا وَضَعْتُ لَكَ نَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: war-faa'-nee a'm-mas'aarii'd'-d'unoobi kamaa waz''aa'-tu laka naf-see
segments.translation: 41.lift me up from the fatal infirmities of sins just as I have let myself down before You,

segments.arabic: وَاسْتُرْنِي بِسِتْرِكَ كَمَا تَأَنَّيْتَنِي عَنِ الانْتِقَامِ مِنِّي.
segments.transliteration: was-tur-nee bisit-rika kamaa taan-nay-tanee a'n?lintiqaami min-nee
segments.translation: 42.and cover me with Your covering just as You hast shown no haste to take vengeance on me!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa thab-bit fee t'aaa'tika nee-yatee
segments.translation: 43.O God, make firm my intention to obey You,
44.strengthen my insight in worshipping You,
45.give me the success of works

segments.arabic: لِمَا تَغْسِلُ بِهِ دَنَسَ الخَطَايَا عَنِّي،
segments.translation: 46.which will wash away the defilement of offenses,

segments.transliteration: wa tawaf-fanee a'laa mil-latika wamil-lati nabee-yika
segments.translation: 47.and take me when You takest me in the creed of Your prophet
48.Muhammad (upon him be peace).

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَتُوبُ إلَيْـكَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-neee atoobu ilay-ka fee maqaamee had'aa
segments.translation: 49.O God, I repent to You in this my station from
50.my sins, great and small,
51.my evil deeds, inward and outward,
52.my lapses, past and recent,

segments.arabic: تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لا يُحَدِّثُ نَفْسَهُ بِمَعْصِيَةٍ
segments.translation: 53.with the repentance of one who does not tell himself that he might disobey

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُضْمِرُ أَنْ يَعُودَ فِي خَطِيئَةٍ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yuz''-miru ay-yau'wda fee khat'ee-ah
segments.translation: 54.or secretly think that he might return to an offense.

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ قُلْتَ يَا إلهِي فِي مُحْكَمِ كِتابِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa qad qul-ta yaaa ilaahee fee muh'-kami kitaabika
segments.translation: 55.You hast said, my God, in the firm text of Your Book,
56.that You 'acceptest repentance from Your servants,
57.pardonest evil deeds' (ref.42:25), and lovest the repenters (ref.2:222),

segments.arabic: فَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِي كَمَا وَعَدْتَ وَأعْفُ عَنْ سَيِّئاتِي كَمَا ضَمِنْتَ،
segments.transliteration: faq-bal taw-batee kamaa waa't-t waa'-fu a'n say-yi-aatee kamaa z''amint
segments.translation: 58.so accept my repentance as You hast promised, pardon my evil deeds as You hast guaranteed,

segments.transliteration: wa aw-jib lee mah'ab-bataka kamaa sharat'-t
segments.translation: 59.and make obligatory toward me Your love as You hast stipulated!

segments.arabic: وَلَـكَ يَـا رَبِّ شَـرْطِي أَلاّ أَعُودَ فِي مَكْرُوهِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laka yaa rab shar-t'eee al-laaa au'wda fee mak-roohik
segments.translation: 60.To You, my Lord, belongs my stipulation that I will not return to what is disliked by You,

segments.transliteration: wa z''amaaneee al-laaa ar-jia' fee mad'-moomik
segments.translation: 61.my guarantee that I will not go back to what You blamest,

segments.transliteration: wa a'h-deee an ah-jura jameea' maa'as'eek
segments.translation: 62.and my covenant that I will stay away from acts of disobedience to You.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا عَمِلْتُ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا عَلِمْتَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-naka aa'-lamu bimaa a'mil-t fagh-fir lee maa a'lim-t
segments.translation: 63.O God, You knowest better what I have done, so forgive me what You knowest
64.and turn me through Your power to what You lovest!
65.O God, counted against me are claims that stay in my memory
66.and claims that I have forgotten,
67.while all of them remain in Your eye that does not sleep
68.and Your knowledge that does not forget!

segments.arabic: فَعَوِّضْ مِنْهَا أَهْلَهَا وَاحْطُطْ عَنّي وِزْرَهَا،
segments.transliteration: faa'w-wiz'' min-haaa ah-lahaa wah'-t'ut' a'n-nee wiz-rahaa
segments.translation: 69.So compensate their owners, lighten their load upon me,

segments.arabic: وَخَفِّفْ عَنِّي ثِقْلَهَا، وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ أَنْ اُقَارِفَ مِثْلَهَا.
segments.transliteration: wa khaf-fif a'n-nee thiq-lahaa waa'-s'im-nee min an uqaarifa mith-lahaa
segments.translation: 70.lift up their weight from me, and preserve me from approaching their like!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنَّهُ لاَ وَفَاءَ لِي بِالتَّوْبَةِ إلاَّ بِعِصْمَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa in-nahoo laa wafaaa-a lee bit-taw-bati il-laa bii's'-matik
segments.translation: 71.O God, but I can not be faithful to my repentance without Your preservation,

segments.arabic: وَلا اسْتِمْسَاكَ بِي عَنِ الْخَطَايَا إلاَّ عَنْ قُوَّتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa as-tim-saaka bee a'nil-khat'aayaaa il-laa a'n qoo-watik
segments.translation: 72.nor can I refrain from offenses without Your strength.

segments.arabic: فَقَوِّنِي بِقُوَّة كَافِيَة، وَتَوَلَّنِي بِعِصْمَة مَانِعَة.
segments.transliteration: faqaw-winee biqoo-watin kaafeeah wa tawal-lanee bii's'-matim-maania'h
segments.translation: 73.So strengthen me with a sufficient strength and attend to me with a defending preservation!
74.O God, if any servant repents to You,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ فَاسِخٌ لِتَوْبَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa huwa fee i'l-mil-ghay-bi i'ndaka faasikhul-litaw-batih
segments.translation: 75.while in Your knowledge of the Unseen he will break his repentance
76.and return to his sin and offense,

segments.arabic: فَإنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أنْ أَكُوْنَ كَذلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: fa in-nee e au'wd'u bika an akoona kad'alik
segments.translation: 77.I seek refuge in You lest I be like that!

segments.arabic: فَاجْعَلْ تَوْبَتِي هَذِهِ تَوْبَةً لا أَحْتَاجُ بَعْدَهَا إلَى تَوْبَة،
segments.transliteration: faj-a'l taw-batee hd'ih taw-batal-laaa ah'-taaju baa'-dahaaa ilaa taw-bah
segments.translation: 78.So make this my repentance a repentance after which I will need no repentance

segments.arabic: تَوْبَةً مُوجِبَةً لِمَحْوِ مَا سَلَفَ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ فِيمَـا بَقِيَ.
segments.transliteration: taw-batam-moojibatal-limah'-wi maa salafa was-salaamati feemaa baqee
segments.translation: 79.and a repentance which will obligate the erasing of what has gone by and safety in what remains!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَعْتَـذِرُ إلَيْـكَ مِنْ جَهْلِي،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-neee aa'-tad'iru ilay-ka min jah-lee
segments.translation: 80.O God, I ask pardon from You for my ignorance,
81.and I ask You to disregard my evil acts!
82.So join me to the shelter of Your mercy through graciousness
83.and cover me with the covering of Your well-being through bounteousness!
84.O God, I repent to You
85.from everything opposed to Your will
86.or far from Your love -
87.the thoughts of my heart,
88.the glances of my eye,
89.the tales of my tongue -

segments.arabic: تَوْبَةً تَسْلَمُ بِهَا كُلُّ جَارِحَة عَلَى حِيَالِهَا مِنْ تَبِعَاتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: taw-batan tas-lamu bihaa kul-lu jaarih'atin a'laa h'eeaalihaa min tabia'atika
segments.translation: 90.with a repentance through which each bodily part will by itself stay safe from ill consequences with You

segments.arabic: وَتَأْمَنُ مِمَّا يَخَافُ الْمُعْتَدُونَ  مِنْ أَلِيْمِ سَطَوَاتِكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa taa-manu mim-maa yakhaaful-mua'-tadoona min sleemi sat'awaatik
segments.translation: 91.and remain secure from Your painful penalties feared by transgressors!
92.O God, so have mercy on my being alone before You,
93.the pounding of my heart in dread of You,
94.the trembling of my limbs in awe of You!

segments.arabic: فَقَدْ أَقَامَتْنِي يَا رَبِّ ذُنُوبِي مَقَامَ الْخِزْيِ بِفِنَائِكَ،
segments.transliteration: faqad aqaamat-nee yaa rab-bi d'unoobee maqaamal-khiz-yi bifinaaa-ik
segments.translation: 95.My sins, my God, have stood me in the station of degradation in Your courtyard.

segments.arabic: فَإنْ سَكَتُّ لَمْ يَنْطِقْ  عَنِّي أَحَدٌ،
segments.transliteration: faan sakat-tu lam yant'iq a'n-neee ah'ad
segments.translation: 96.If I remain silent, none will speak for me;
97.if I seek an intercessor, I am not worthy for intercession.
98.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
99.make Your generosity intercede for my offenses,
100.follow up my evil deeds with Your pardon,

segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-zinee jazaaa-ee min u'qoobatik
segments.translation: 101.repay me not with the punishment that is my proper repayment,

segments.transliteration: wab-sut' a'lay-ya t'aw-lak wa jal-lil-nee bisit-rik
segments.translation: 102.spread over me Your graciousness, wrap me in Your covering,

segments.arabic: وَافْعَلْ بِي فِعْلَ عَزِيز تَضَرَّع إلَيْهِ عَبْدٌ ذَلِيلٌ فَرَحِمَهُ،
segments.transliteration: waf-a'l bee fia'-l a'zeezin taz''ar-raa' ilay-hee a'b-dun d'aleelun farah'imah
segments.translation: 103.and do with me what is done by a mighty man, when a lowly slave pleads to him and he shows him mercy,

segments.arabic: أَوْ  غَنِيٍّ تَعَرَّضَ لَهُ عَبْدٌ فَقِيرٌ فَنَعَشَهُ.
segments.transliteration: aw ghanee-yin taa'r-raz''a lahoo a'b-dun faqeerun fanaa'shah
segments.translation: 104.or a rich man, when a poor slave submits himself and he raises him to wealth!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ خَفِيرَ لِي مِنْكَ فَلْيَخْفُرْنِيْ عِزُّكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma laa khafeera lee mink fal-yakh-fur-nee i'z-zuk
segments.translation: 105.O God, I have no protector against You, so let Your might be my protector!

segments.arabic: وَلا شَفِيعَ لِيْ إلَيْكَ فَلْيَشْفَعْ لِي فَضْلُكَ،
segments.transliteration: walaa shafeea' leee ilay-ka fal-yash-faa' lee faz''-luk
segments.translation: 106.I have no intercessor with You, so let Your bounty be my intercessor!

segments.transliteration: wa qad aw-jalat-nee khat'aayaaya fal-yoo-min-nee a'f-wuk
segments.translation: 107.My offenses have set me quaking, so let Your pardon give me security!

segments.arabic: فَمَا كُلُّ مَا نَطَقْتُ بِهِ عَنْ جَهْل مِنِّي بِسُوْءِ أَثَرِي،
segments.transliteration: famaa kul-lu maa nat'aq-tu bihee a'n- jah-lim-min-nee bisooo-i atharee
segments.translation: 108.Not all that I have said rises up from my ignorance of my evil footsteps

segments.arabic: وَلاَ نِسيَان لِمَا سَبَقَ مِنْ ذَمِيمِ فِعْلِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa nis-yaanil-limaa sabaqa min d'ameemi fia'-lee
segments.translation: 109.or forgetfulness of my blameworthy acts in the past,
110.but in order that Your heaven and those within it

segments.arabic: وَأَرْضُكَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا مَا أَظْهَرْتُ لَكَ مِنَ النَّدَمِ،
segments.transliteration: wa ar-z''uka waman a'lay-haa maa az'-har-tu laka minan-nadam
segments.translation: 111.and Your earth and those upon it may hear the remorse which I have professed to You
112.and the repentance through which I have sought asylum with You.

segments.arabic: فَلَعَـلَّ بَعْضَهُمْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَرْحَمُنِي لِسُوءِ مَوْقِفِي،
segments.transliteration: falaa'l-la baa'-z''ahum birah'-matik yar-h'amunee lisooo-i maw-qifee
segments.translation: 113.Then perhaps one of them, through Your mercy, may show mercy upon my evil situation

segments.arabic: أَوْ تُدْرِكُهُ الرِّقَّةُ عَلَىَّ لِسُوءِ حَالِي
segments.translation: 114.or be seized by tenderness for my evil state.

segments.arabic: فَيَنَالَنِي مِنْهُ بِدَعْوَةٍ أَسْمَعُ لَدَيْكَ مِنْ دُعَائِي،
segments.transliteration: fayanaalanee min-h bidaa'-watin heea as-mau' laday-ka min dua'aa-ee
segments.translation: 115.There may come from him for my sake a supplication to which You givest ear more than to my supplication

segments.arabic: أَوْ شَفَاعَـةٍ أَوْكَدُ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ شَفَاعَتِي
segments.transliteration: aw shafaaa'tin aw-kadu i'ndaka min shafaaa'tee
segments.translation: 116.or an intercession surer with You than my intercession

segments.arabic: تَكُونُ بِهَا نَجَاتِي مِنْ غَضَبِكَ وَفَوْزَتِي بِرضَاكَ.
segments.transliteration: takoonu bihaa najaatee min ghaz''abik wa faw-zee biriz''aak
segments.translation: 117.through which I may be delivered from Your wrath and attain to Your good pleasure!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنْ يَكُنِ النَّدَمُ تَوْبَةً إلَيْكَ فَأَنَا أَنْدَمُ اْلنَّادِمِينَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma ee-yakunin-nadamu taw-batan ilay-ka faanaa andamun-naadimeen
segments.translation: 118.O God, if remorse is a repentance toward You, then I am the most remorseful of the remorseful!

segments.arabic: وَإنْ يَكُنِ التَّرْكُ لِمَعْصِيَتِكَ إنَابَةً فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُنِيبينَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ee-yakunit-tar-ku limaa'-s'eeatika inaabatan faanaa aw-walul-muneebeen
segments.translation: 119.If refraining from disobedience is a turning back to You, then I am the first of those who turn back!

segments.arabic: وَإنْ يَكُنِ الاسْتِغْفَارُ حِطَّةً لِلذُّنُوبِ فَإنَي لَكَ مِنَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ.
segments.transliteration: wa ee-yak-nilis-tigh-faaru h'it'-t'atal-lild'-d'unoobi fa in-nee ? laka minal-mus-tagh-fireen
segments.translation: 120.If praying for forgiveness alleviates sins, surely I am one of those who pray for Your forgiveness!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا أَمَرْتَ بِالتَّوْبَةِ وَضَمِنْتَ الْقَبُولَ
segments.translation: 121.O God, as You hast commanded repentance and guaranteed acceptance,
122.as You hast urged supplication, and promised to respond,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ وَآلِهِ وَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِي
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih waq-bal taw-batee
segments.translation: 123.so also bless Muhammad and his Household, accept my repentance,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَرْجِعْني مَرجَعَ الخَيبَةِ منْ رَحْمَتِك
segments.translation: 124.and return me not to the returning place of disappointment in Your mercy!
125.Surely You art "Ever-turning" (2:128) toward the sinners,
126."All-compassionate" (2:128) toward the offenders who turn back!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا هَدَيْتَنَا بِهِ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee kamaa haday-tanaa bih
segments.translation: 127.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household just as You hast guided us by him!

segments.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا اسْتَنْقَذْتَنَا بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee kamas-tanqad'-tanaa bih
segments.translation: 128.Bless Muhammad and his Household just as You hast rescued us through him!
129.Bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: صَلاَةً تَشْفَعُ لَنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَوْمَ الْفَاقَةِ إلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: s'alaatan tash-fau' lanaa yaw-mal-qeeaamati wayaw-mal-faaqati ilay-k
segments.translation: 130.with a blessing that will intercede for us on the Day of Resurrection, the day of neediness toward You!

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ .
segments.transliteration: in-naka a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer wa huwa a'lay-ka yaseer
segments.translation: 131."Thou art powerful over everything" (3:26), and that is easy for You!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 51 Supplication In Pleading and Abasement

segments.arabic: إلهِي أَحْمَـدُكَ ـ وَأَنْتَ لِلْحَمْدِ أَهْلٌ ـ
segments.translation: My God, I praise You â and You are worthy of praise â

segments.arabic: عَلَى حُسْنِ صَنِيعِكَ إلَيَّ، وَسُبُـوغِ نَعْمَآئِكَ عَلَيَّ،
segments.transliteration: âalÄ á¸¥usni á¹£anÄ«âik ilayya, wa-subÅ«ghi naâmÄâika âalayy,
segments.translation: for Your excellent work toward me, and the fullness of Your blessings upon me,
and Your plentiful gift with me,
and for what You favored me with of Your mercy,
and for what You perfected upon me of Your bounty.

segments.arabic: فَقَدِ اصْطَنَعْتَ عِنْدِي ما يَعْجِزُ عَنُهُ شُكْرِي، وَلَوْلاَ إحْسَانُكَ، إلَيَّ
segments.transliteration: Fa-qadi á¹£á¹­anaâta âindÄ« mÄ yaâjizu âanuhu shukrÄ«, wa-lawlÄ iá¸¥sÄnuka, ilayy
segments.translation: You have indeed done for me what my thanks are incapable of reaching, and were it not for Your benevolence toward me,
and the fullness of Your blessings upon me,

segments.arabic: مَا بَلَغْتُ إحْرازَ حَظِّي، وَلاَ إصْلاَحَ نَفْسِي،
segments.transliteration: mÄ balaghtu iá¸¥rÄza á¸¥aáºáºÄ«, wa-lÄ iá¹£lÄá¸¥a nafsÄ«,
segments.translation: I would not have attained the securing of my portion, nor the rectifying of my soul,
But You initiated me with benevolence,
and You provided me with sufficiency in all my affairs,
and You turned away from me the burden of tribulation,
and You averted from me the feared decree.

segments.arabic: إلهِي فَكَمْ مِنْ بَلاء جَاهِد قَدْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: IlÄhÄ« fa-kam min balÄâin jÄhidin qad á¹£arafta âannÄ«,
segments.translation: My God, how many an arduous tribulation You have turned away from me,

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَة سَابِغَة أَقْرَرْتَ بِهَا عَيْنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-kam min niâmatin sÄbighatin aqrarta bihÄ âaynÄ«,
segments.translation: and how many a full blessing You have delighted my eye with,

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ صَنِيعَة كَرِيمَة لَكَ عِنْدِي.
segments.transliteration: wa-kam min á¹£anÄ«âatin karÄ«matin lak âindÄ«.
segments.translation: and how many a noble favour You have with me.

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَجَبْتَ عِنْدَ الاضْطِرَارِ دَعْوَتِي،
segments.transliteration: Anta l-ladhÄ« ajabta âinda l-iá¸á¹­irÄri daâwatÄ«,
segments.translation: You are the One Who answered my prayer when I was in dire need,
and You overlooked my slip when I stumbled,
and You took my due from the enemies for my being wronged.

segments.arabic: إلهِي مَا وَجَدْتُكَ بَخِيلاً حِينَ سَأَلْتُكَ،
segments.transliteration: IlÄhÄ« mÄ wajadtuka bakhÄ«lan á¸¥Ä«na saâaltuk,
segments.translation: My God, I have not found You stingy when I asked You,
and not holding back when I desired You,

segments.arabic: بل وَجَدْتُكَ لِدُعَآئِي سَامِعاً، وَلِمَطَالِبِي مُعْطِياً،
segments.transliteration: bal wajadtuka li-duâÄâÄ« sÄmiâan, wa-li-maá¹­ÄlibÄ« muâá¹­iyÄ,
segments.translation: Rather, I found You hearing my prayer, and granting my requests,
and I found Your bounty upon me full,

segments.arabic: فِي كُلِّ شَأْن مِنْ شَأْنِي، وَكُلِّ زَمَان مِنْ زَمَانِي،
segments.transliteration: fÄ« kulli shaânin min shaânÄ«, wa-kulli zamÄnin min zamÄnÄ«,
segments.translation: in every affair of mine, and every time of my time,

segments.arabic: فَأَنْتَ عِنْدِي مَحْمُودٌ، وَصَنِيعُكَ لَدَيَّ مَبْرُورٌ،
segments.transliteration: fa-anta âindÄ« maá¸¥mÅ«d, wa-á¹£anÄ«âuk ladayya mabrÅ«r,
segments.translation: so You are praised by me, and Your work is approved by me.

segments.arabic: تَحْمَدُكَ نَفْسِي وَلِسَانِيْ وَعَقْلِي حَمْداً يَبْلُغُ الوَفَآءَ وَحَقِيقَةَ الشُّكْرِ،
segments.transliteration: taá¸¥maduk nafsÄ« wa-lisÄnÄ« wa-âaqlÄ« á¸¥amdan yablughu l-wafÄâa wa-á¸¥aqÄ«qata sh-shukr,
segments.translation: My soul, my tongue, and my intellect praise You with a praise that reaches fulfillment and the reality of thanks,
a praise that is the extent of Your good pleasure with me.

segments.arabic: فَنَجِّنِي مِنْ سَخَطِكَ يَا كَهْفِي حِينَ تُعْيينِي الْمَذَاهِبُ،
segments.transliteration: fa-najjinÄ« min sakhaá¹­ika yÄ kahfÄ« á¸¥Ä«na tuâyÄ«nÄ« l-madhÄhib,
segments.translation: So deliver me from Your displeasure, O my refuge when the paths weary me,
and O One Who overlooks my slip,

segments.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ سَتْرُكَ عَوْرَتِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَفْضُوحِينَ،
segments.transliteration: fa-lawlÄ satruk âawratÄ« la-kuntu mina l-mafá¸Å«á¸¥Ä«n,
segments.translation: for were it not for Your concealment of my fault, I would have been among the disgraced,
and O One Who strengthens me with help,

segments.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ نَصْرُكَ إيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَغْلُوبِينَ،
segments.transliteration: fa-lawlÄ naá¹£ruk iyyÄya la-kuntu mina l-maghlÅ«bÄ«n,
segments.translation: for were it not for Your helping me, I would have been among the overcome,

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ وَضَعَتْ لَهُ الْمُلُوكُ نِيرَ الْمَذَلَّةِ عَلى أَعْنَاقِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa-yÄ man waá¸aâat lahu l-mulÅ«ku nÄ«ra l-madhallati âalÄ aânÄqihÄ,
segments.translation: and O You for whom the kings have placed the yoke of humiliation upon their necks,

segments.arabic: فَهُمْ مِنْ سَطَواتِهِ خَائِفُونَ، وَيَا أَهْلَ التَّقْوَى،
segments.transliteration: fa-hum min saá¹­awÄtihÄ« khÄâifÅ«n, wa-yÄ Ahl at-TaqwÄ,
segments.translation: so they are fearful of His assaults, and O You who are worthy of reverent fear (TaqwÄ),

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لَهُ الأَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنى أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa-yÄ man lahu l-asmÄâu l-á¸¥usnÄ asâaluka an taâfuwa âannÄ«,
segments.translation: and O You to whom belong the Beautiful Names (al-AsmÄâ al-á¸¤usnÄ), I ask You to pardon me,
and to forgive me, for I am not innocent, so that I may excuse myself,
nor am I possessed of strength, so that I may triumph,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ مَفَرَّ لِي فَأَفِرَّ. وَأَسْتَقِيْلُكَ عَثَراتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ mafarra lÄ« fa-afirra. Wa-astaqÄ«luka âatharÄtÄ«,
segments.translation: nor is there a way for me to escape, so that I may flee. And I ask You to overlook my slips,

segments.arabic: وَأَتَنَصَّلُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي الَّتِي قَدْ أَوْبَقَتْنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-atanassalu ilayk min dhunÅ«bÄ« l-latÄ« qad awbaqatnÄ«,
segments.translation: and I disavow to You my sins that have surely ruined me,
and surrounded me so that they destroyed me.
From them I have fled to You, Lord, repentingâ
so accept my repentance; seeking refuge, so grant me refuge; seeking protectionâ

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَخْذُلْنِي سَآئِلاً، فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي مُعْتَصِماً،
segments.transliteration: fa-lÄ takhdhulnÄ« sÄâilan, fa-lÄ taá¸¥rimnÄ« muâtaá¹£iman,
segments.translation: so do not forsake me; a petitioner, so do not deprive me; holding fastâ

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تُسْلِمْنِي دَاعِياً، فَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً،
segments.transliteration: fa-lÄ tuslimnÄ« dÄâiyan, fa-lÄ taruddanÄ« khÄâiban,
segments.translation: so do not abandon me; a caller, so do not turn me back disappointed.
I called upon You, O Lord, as one destitute, humbled,

segments.arabic: مُشْفِقاً، خَائِفاً، وَجِلاً، فَقِيراً، مُضْطَرّاً، إلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: mushfiqan, khÄâifan, wajilÄ, faqÄ«ran, muá¸á¹­arran, ilayk
segments.translation: anxious, fearful, apprehensive, poor, compelled (to turn) to Youâ

segments.arabic: أَشْكُو إلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي ضَعْفَ نَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: ashkÅ« ilayk yÄ IlÄhÄ« á¸aâfa nafsÄ«
segments.translation: I complain to You, O my God, of the weakness of my soul
to hasten to what You promised Your friends,
and to shun what You warned Your enemies against,
and the abundance of my worries and the whispering of my soul.
My God, You have not disgraced me because of my hidden sin,
and You have not destroyed me because of my crime; I call You, and You answer me
even though I am slow when You call me.
And I ask You for all that I wish of my needs,

segments.arabic: وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنْتُ وَضَعْتُ عِنْدَكَ سِرِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa-á¸¥aythu mÄ kuntu waá¸aâtu âindak sirrÄ«,
segments.translation: and wherever I was, I placed my secret with You,

segments.arabic: فَلاَ أَدْعُو سِوَاكَ، وَلاَ أَرْجُو غَيْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: fa-lÄ adâÅ« siwÄk, wa-lÄ arjÅ« ghayrak,
segments.translation: so I do not call upon anyone other than You, nor do I hope for anyone other than You.

segments.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ، تَسْمَعُ مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: Labbayk, labbayk, tasmaâu man shakÄ ilayk,
segments.translation: At Your service, at Your service! You hear the one who complains to You,
and You meet the one who relies on You,
and You deliver the one who holds fast to You,
and You bring relief to the one who seeks shelter in You.

segments.arabic: إلهِي فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي خَيْرَ الآخِرَةِ وَالأُولى لِقِلَّةِ شُكْرِي،
segments.transliteration: IlÄhÄ« fa-lÄ taá¸¥rimnÄ« khayra l-Äkhirati wa-l-Å«lÄ li-qillati shukrÄ«,
segments.translation: My God, do not deprive me of the good of the Hereafter and the first life (the world) because of the fewness of my thanks,

segments.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا تَعْلَمُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-ghfir lÄ« mÄ taâlamu min dhunÅ«bÄ«,
segments.translation: and forgive me what You know of my sins.
If You punish, then I am the wrongdoer, the negligent,
the waster, the sinner, the failing, the one lying down (in neglect),
the one heedless of his soul's portion,
and if You forgive, then You are the Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

segments.arabic: إلهِي أَحْمَـدُكَ ـ وَأَنْتَ لِلْحَمْدِ أَهْلٌ ـ
segments.transliteration: ilaaheee ah'-maduk wa anta lil-h'am-di ah-lun
segments.translation: 1.My God, I praise You, - and You art worthy of praise -

segments.arabic: عَلَى حُسْنِ صَنِيعِكَ إلَيَّ، وَسُبُـوغِ نَعْمَآئِكَ عَلَيَّ،
segments.transliteration: a'laa h'us-ni s'aneei'ka ilay wa subooghi naa'-maaa-ika a'lay
segments.translation: 2.for Your benefaction toward me, the lavishness of Your favours toward me,
3.and Your plentiful bestowal upon me,
4.and for showing bounty toward me through Your mercy
5.and lavishing Your favour upon me.

segments.arabic: فَقَدِ اصْطَنَعْتَ عِنْدِي ما يَعْجِزُ عَنُهُ شُكْرِي، وَلَوْلاَ إحْسَانُكَ، إلَيَّ
segments.transliteration: faqadi as'-t'anaa'-ta i'ndee maa yaa'-jizu a'n-hoo shuk-ree wa law-laaa ih'-saanuka ilay
segments.translation: 6.You hast done well toward me and I am incapable of thanking You. Were it not for Your beneficence toward me
7.and the lavishness of Your favours upon me,

segments.arabic: مَا  بَلَغْتُ إحْرازَ حَظِّي، وَلاَ إصْلاَحَ نَفْسِي،
segments.transliteration: maa balagh-tu ih'-raaza h'az'-z'ee wa laaa is'-laah'a naf-see
segments.translation: 8.I would not have reached the taking of my share nor would my soul have been set right,
9.but You began with beneficence toward me,
10.provided me sufficiency in all my affairs,
11.turned away from me the toil of affliction,
12.and held back from me the feared decree.

segments.arabic: إلهِي فَكَمْ مِنْ بَلاء جَاهِد قَدْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: ilaahee fakam mim-balaaa-in jaahidin qad s'araf-ta a'n-nee
segments.translation: 13.My God, how many a toilsome affliction which You hast turned away from me!

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَة سَابِغَة أَقْرَرْتَ بِهَا عَيْنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa kam min-nia'-matin saabighatin aq-rar-ta bihaa a'y-nee
segments.translation: 14.How many a lavish favour with which You hast gladdened my eye!

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ صَنِيعَة كَرِيمَة  لَكَ عِنْدِي.
segments.transliteration: wa kam min s'aneea'tin kareematil-laka i'ndee
segments.translation: 15.How many a generous benefaction of Thine which is present with me!

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَجَبْتَ عِنْدَ الاضْطِرَارِ دَعْوَتِي،
segments.translation: 16.It is You who responded to my supplication at the time of distress,
17.released me from my slip in stumbling,
18.and took my enemies to task for doing wrong to me.

segments.arabic: إلهِي مَا وَجَدْتُكَ بَخِيلاً حِينَ سَأَلْتُكَ،
segments.transliteration: ilaahee maa wajat-tuk bakheelana h'eena saal-tuk
segments.translation: 19.My God, I did not find You a miser when I asked of You
20.nor a withholder when I desired from You.

segments.arabic: بل وَجَدْتُكَ لِدُعَآئِي سَامِعاً، وَلِمَطَالِبِي مُعْطِياً،
segments.transliteration: bal wajat-tuka lidua'aa-ee saamia'a wa limat'aalibee mua'-t'eeaa
segments.translation: 21.No, 1 found You a hearer of my supplication and a bestower of my requests;
22.I found Your favours toward me

segments.arabic: فِي كُلِّ شَأْن مِنْ شَأْنِي، وَكُلِّ زَمَان مِنْ زَمَانِي،
segments.transliteration: fee kul-li shaa-nim-min shaa-nee wa kul-li zamaanim-min zamaanee
segments.translation: 23.lavish in my every situation and in my every time.

segments.arabic: فَأَنْتَ عِنْدِي مَحْمُودٌ، وَصَنِيعُكَ لَدَيَّ مَبْرُورٌ،
segments.transliteration: faanta i'ndee mah'-mood wa s'aneeu'ka laday-ya mab-roor
segments.translation: 24.So You art praised by me and Your benefaction honoured.

segments.arabic: تَحْمَدُكَ نَفْسِي وَلِسَانِيْ وَعَقْلِي حَمْداً يَبْلُغُ الوَفَآءَ وَحَقِيقَةَ الشُّكْرِ،
segments.transliteration: tah'-maduka naf-see walisaanee wa a'q-lee h'am-day-yab-lughul-wafaaa-a wa h'aqeeqatash-shuk-r
segments.translation: 25.My soul, my tongue, and my intelligence praise You, a praise that reaches fulfilment and the reality of thanksgiving,
26.a praise that attains to Your good pleasure with me -

segments.arabic: فَنَجِّنِي مِنْ سَخَطِكَ يَا كَهْفِي حِينَ تُعْيينِي الْمَذَاهِبُ،
segments.transliteration: fanaj-jinee min sakhat'ik yaa kah-fee h'eena tua'-yeeneel-mad'aahib
segments.translation: 27.so deliver me from Your displeasure! O my cave when the ways thwart me!
28.O He who releases me from my stumble!

segments.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ سَتْرُكَ عَوْرَتِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَفْضُوحِينَ،
segments.translation: 29.Were it not for Your covering my shameful defects, I would be one of the disgraced.
30.O my confirmer through help!

segments.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ نَصْرُكَ إيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَغْلُوبِينَ،
segments.translation: 31.Were it not for Your helping me, I would be one of the overcome!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ وَضَعَتْ لَهُ الْمُلُوكُ نِيرَ الْمَذَلَّةِ عَلى أَعْنَاقِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa maw-waz''aa't lahul-mulwku neeral-mad'al-lati a'laaa aa'-naaqihaa
segments.translation: 32.O He before whom kings place the yoke of lowliness around their necks,

segments.arabic: فَهُمْ مِنْ سَطَواتِهِ خَائِفُونَ، وَيَا أَهْلَ التَّقْوَى،
segments.transliteration: fahum min sat'awaatihee khaaa-ifoon wa yaaa ah-lat-taq-waa
segments.translation: 33.fearing His penalties! O worthy of reverent fear!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لَهُ الأَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنى أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-lahul-as-maaa-ul-h'us-naa as-aluka an taa'-fuwa a'n-nee
segments.translation: 34.O He to whom belong the names most beautiful! I ask You to pardon me

segments.transliteration: wa tagh-fira lee falas-tu baree-ana faaa'-tad'ir
segments.translation: 35.and to forgive me, for I am not innocent that I should offer excuses,
36.nor a possessor of strength that I should gain victory,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ مَفَرَّ لِي فَأَفِرَّ. وَأَسْتَقِيْلُكَ عَثَراتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa mafar-ra lee faafir wa as-taqeeluka a'tharaatee
segments.translation: 37.nor have I any place of flight that I should flee! I ask You to release me from my stumbles,

segments.arabic: وَأَتَنَصَّلُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي الَّتِي قَدْ أَوْبَقَتْنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa atanas'-s'alu ilay-ka min d'unwbeeal-latee qad aw-baqat-nee
segments.translation: 38.and before You I disavow my sins, which have laid me waste,
39.encompassed me, and destroyed me!
40.I flee from them to You, my Lord, turning repentantly,
41.so turn toward me, seeking refuge, so grant me refuge, asking sanctuary,

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَخْذُلْنِي سَآئِلاً، فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي مُعْتَصِماً،
segments.transliteration: falaa takh-d'ul-nee saaa-ilana falaa tah'-rim-nee mua'-tas'imana
segments.translation: 42.so abandon me not, requesting, so deprive me not, holding fast,

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تُسْلِمْنِي دَاعِياً، فَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً،
segments.transliteration: falaa tus-lim-nee daae'eana falaa tarud-danee khaaa-ibaa
segments.translation: 43.so leave me not, supplicating, so send me not back disappointed!
44.I have supplicated You, my Lord, as one miserable, abased,

segments.arabic: مُشْفِقاً، خَائِفاً، وَجِلاً، فَقِيراً، مُضْطَرّاً، إلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: mush-fiqana khaaa-ifaa wajilana faqeeraa muz''-t'ar-ran ilay-k
segments.translation: 45.apprehensive, fearful, quaking, poor, driven to have recourse to You!

segments.arabic: أَشْكُو إلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي ضَعْفَ نَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: ash-kw ilay-ka yaaa ilaahee z''aa'-fa naf-see
segments.translation: 46.I complain to You, my God, of my soul - which is too weak
47.to hurry to that which You hast promised Your friends
48.or to avoid that against which You hast cautioned Your enemies -

segments.transliteration: wa kath-rata humoomee wa was-wasata naf-see
segments.translation: 49.and of the multitude of my concerns, and of my soul's confusing thoughts.
50.My God, You hast not disgraced me through my secret thoughts

segments.transliteration: wa lam tuh-lik-nee bijareeratee ad-u'wka fatujeebunee
segments.translation: 51.or destroyed me because of my misdeeds! I call upon You, and You respondest,

segments.transliteration: wa in kuntu bat'ee-ana h'eena tad-u'wnee
segments.translation: 52.even if I am slow when You callest upon me.

segments.transliteration: wa as-aluka kul-lamaa shi-tu min h'awaaa-ijee
segments.translation: 53.I ask You everything I want of my needs,

segments.arabic: وَحَيْثُ  مَا كُنْتُ وَضَعْتُ عِنْدَكَ سِرِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa h'ay-thu maa kuntu waz''aa'-tu i'ndaka sir-ree
segments.translation: 54.and I deposit with You my secret wherever I may be.

segments.arabic: فَلاَ أَدْعُو سِوَاكَ، وَلاَ أَرْجُو غَيْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: falaaa ad-u'w siwaak wa laaa ar-joo ghay-rak
segments.translation: 55.I supplicate no one besides You, and I hope for no one other than You.

segments.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ، تَسْمَعُ مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: lab-bay-ka lab-bay-k tas-mau' man shakaaa ilay-k
segments.translation: 56.At Your service! At Your service! You hearest him who complains to You!
57.You receivest him who has confidence in You!
58.You savest him who holds fast to You!
59.You givest relief to him who seeks shelter in You!

segments.arabic: إلهِي  فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي خَيْرَ الآخِرَةِ وَالأُولى لِقِلَّةِ شُكْرِي،
segments.transliteration: ilaahee falaa tah'-rim-nee khay-ral-akhirati wal-oolaa  liqil-lati shuk-ree
segments.translation: 60.My God, so deprive me not of the good of the last world and the first because of the paucity of my thanksgiving

segments.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا تَعْلَمُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي،
segments.transliteration: wagh-fir lee maa taa'-lamu min d'unoobee
segments.translation: 61.and forgive me the sins of mine which You knowest!
62.If You chastisest, I am the wrongdoer, the neglecter,
63.the negligent, the sinner, the derelict, the sluggard,
64.the heedless of the share of my soul!
65.And if You forgivest - You art the Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: وَلاَ عَاقِّينَ وَلا مُخَالِفِينَ وَلاَ خـاطِئِينَ،

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِيْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ مَعَهُمْ أَوْلاداً ذُكُوراً ،

segments.transliteration: wa ijâalhum lÄ« âawnan âalÄ mÄ saâaltuk,
segments.translation: and make them a help for me in what I asked You for.

segments.arabic: سَلَّطْتَهُ مِنَّا عَلَى مَا لَمْ تُسَلِّطْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ،

segments.translation: You housed him in our hearts, and made him flow in the streams of our blood,

segments.translation: he does not become heedless if we become heedless, nor does he forget if we forget.
He makes us feel safe from Your punishment, and frightens us with others besides You.
If we intend a wicked deed, he encourages us to do it,

segments.arabic: وَإنْ هَمَمْنَا بِعَمَل صَالِح ثَبَّطْنَا عَنْهُ،

segments.transliteration: wa illÄ taá¹£rif âannÄ kaydahu yuá¸illunÄ,
segments.translation: And unless You turn his plot away from us, he will mislead us,
and unless You guard us from his corruption, he will make us stumble.
O Allah, then subdue his authority over us with Your authority,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى تَحْبِسَهُ عَنَّا بِكَثْرَةِ الدُّعَاءِ لَكَ،
segments.transliteration: á¸¥attÄ taá¸¥bisahu âannÄ bi-kathrati ad-duâÄâi lak,
segments.translation: until You restrain him from us through the abundance of our prayer to You,

segments.arabic: فَنُصْبحَ مِنْ كَيْدِهِ فِي الْمَعْصُومِينَ بِكَ.
segments.transliteration: fa-nuá¹£biá¸¥a min kaydihi fÄ« al-maâá¹£Å«mÄ«na bik.
segments.translation: so that we become, from his plotting, among those protected by You.
O Allah, grant me every request of mine,
and fulfill my needs for me,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَمْنَعْنِي الإجَابَةَ وَقَدْ ضَمِنْتَهَا لِي،

segments.transliteration: wa umnun âalayya bi-kulli mÄ yuá¹£liá¸¥unÄ«
segments.translation: and favor me with everything that rectifies me
in my world and my Hereafter,

segments.transliteration: mÄ dhakartu minhu wa mÄ nasÄ«t,
segments.translation: of what I remembered of it and what I forgot,
or revealed or concealed,
or announced or kept secret.

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي جَمِيعِ ذلِكَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ بِسُؤَالِي إيَّـاكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ijâalnÄ« fÄ« jamÄ«âi dhÄlika mina al-muá¹£liá¸¥Ä«na bi-suâÄlÄ« iyyÄk,
segments.translation: And make me, in all of that, among those who are rectified by asking You,
those who succeed by seeking from You,
those who are not denied due to reliance upon You,
those accustomed to seeking refuge in You,
those who profit in the trade with You,
those granted protection by Your might,

those granted honor from humiliation by You,
and those protected from oppression by Your justice,
and those granted well-being from affliction by Your mercy,
and those made rich from poverty by Your wealth,

segments.arabic: وَالْمَعْصومِينَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالزَّلَلِ وَالْخَطَأِ بِتَقْوَاكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa al-maâá¹£Å«mÄ«na mina adh-dhunÅ«bi wa az-zalali wa al-khaá¹­aâi bi-taqwÄk,
segments.translation: and those protected from sins, slipping, and error by Your piety (fear of You),

segments.transliteration: wa al-muwaffaqÄ«na li-al-khayri wa ar-rushdi wa aá¹£-á¹£awÄbi bi-á¹­Äâatik,
segments.translation: and those granted success in goodness, right guidance, and correctness by Your obedience,

segments.transliteration: wa al-muá¸¥Äli baynahum wa bayna adh-dhunÅ«bi bi-qudratik,
segments.translation: and those between whom and sins You interpose by Your power,
those who abandon every act of disobedience to You,

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma aâá¹­inÄ jamÄ«âa dhÄlika bi-tawfÄ«qika wa raá¸¥matik

and grant us refuge from the punishment of the Blazing Fire,

segments.transliteration: wa al-muâminÄ«na wa al-muâminÄti mithla alladhÄ« saâaltuka li-nafsÄ«
segments.translation: and believing men and believing women, the like of what I have asked You for myself

segments.arabic: وَلِوُلْدِي فِي عَاجِلِ الدُّنْيَا وَآجِلِ الآخِرَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa li-wildÄ« fÄ« âÄjili ad-dunyÄ wa Äjili al-Äkhirah,
segments.translation: and for my children in the immediate world and the delayed Hereafter.
Truly, You are Near, Responsive, Hearing, Knowing,
Pardoning, Forgiving, Compassionate, Merciful.
And grant us goodness in the world

segments.arabic: وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ.
segments.transliteration: wa fÄ« al-Äkhirati á¸¥asanatan wa qinÄ âadhÄba an-nÄr.
segments.translation: and goodness in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
1.O God, be kind to me through the survival of my children,

segments.transliteration: wa biis'-laah'ihim lee wa biim-taae'e bihim
segments.translation: 2.setting them right for me, and allowing me to enjoy them!
3.My God, make long their lives for me,
4.increase their terms,
5.bring up the smallest for me,
6.strengthen the weakest for me,

segments.transliteration: wa as'ih'-h'a leee ab-daanahum wa ad-yaanahum wa akh-laaqahum
segments.translation: 7.rectify for me their bodies, their religious dedication, and their moral traits,

segments.transliteration: wa a'afihim feee anfusihim wa fee jawaarih'ihim
segments.translation: 8.make them well in their souls, their limbs,

segments.arabic: وَفِي كُلِّ مَا عُنِيْتُ بِهِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa fee kul-li maa u'neetu bihee min am-rihim
segments.translation: 9.and everything that concerns me of their affair,

segments.transliteration: wa ad-rir lee wa a'laa yaday-ya ar-zaaqahum
segments.translation: 10.and pour out for me and upon my hand their provisions!
11.Make them pious, fearing, insightful, hearing,

segments.transliteration: mut'eee'ena lak wa liaw-leeaaa-ika muh'ib-beena munaas'ih'een
segments.translation: 12.and obedient toward You, loving and well-disposed toward Your friends,

segments.transliteration: wa lijameei' aa'-daaa-ika mua'anideena wamub-ghiz''een aaameen

14.O God, through them strengthen my arm,

segments.arabic: وَأَقِمْ بِهِمْ أَوَدِيْ، وَكَثِّرْ بِهِمْ عَدَدِي،
segments.transliteration: wa aqim bihim awadee wa kath-thir bihim a'dadee

segments.transliteration: wa zay-yim-bihim mah'-z''aree wa ah'-yi bihim d'ik-ree
segments.translation: 16.adorn my presence, keep alive my mention,

segments.arabic: وَاكْفِنِي بِهِمْ  فِي غَيْبَتِي وَأَعِنِّي بِهِمْ عَلَى حَاجَتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa ak-finee bihim fee ghay-batee wa ai'n-nee bihim a'laa h'aajatee
