segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْهُمْ لِي مُحِبِّينَ، وَعَلَيَّ حَدِبِينَ مُقْبِلِينَ مُسْتَقِيمِينَ لِيْ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-hum lee muh'ib-beena wa a'lay-ya h'adibeena muq-bileen mus-taqeemeena lee
segments.translation: 18.and make them loving toward me, affectionate, approaching, upright,
19.obedient, never disobedient,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ عَاقِّينَ وَلا مُخَالِفِينَ وَلاَ خـاطِئِينَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa a'aaq-qeen wa laa mukhaalifeena wa laa khaat'i-een
segments.translation: 20.disrespectful, opposed, or offenders!

segments.transliteration: wa ai'n-nee a'laa tar-beeatihim wataa-deebihim wabir-rihim
segments.translation: 21.Help me in their upbringing, their education, and my devotion toward them,

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِيْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ مَعَهُمْ أَوْلاداً ذُكُوراً ،
segments.transliteration: wa hab lee mil-ladunka maa'hum aw-laadana d'ukooraa
segments.translation: 22.give me among them from Yourself male children,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ خَيْراً لي وَاجْعَلْهُمْ  لِي عَوناً عَلَى مَا سَأَلْتُكَ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l d'alika khay-ral-lee waj-a'l-hum lee a'w-nan a'laa maa saal-tuk

24.Give me and my progeny refuge from the accursed Satan,

segments.transliteration: fa in-naka khalaq-tanaa wa amar-tanaa wa nahay-tanaa wa ragh-ghab-tanaa
segments.translation: 25.for You hast created us, commanded us, and prohibited us, and made us desire

segments.arabic: فِي ثَوَابِ ما أَمَرْتَنَا وَرَهَّبْتَنَا عِقَابَهُ،
segments.transliteration: fee thawaabi maaa amar-tanaa wa rah-hab-tanaa i'qaabah
segments.translation: 26.the reward of what You hast commanded, and fear its punishment!
27.You assigned to us an enemy who schemes against us,

segments.arabic: سَلَّطْتَهُ مِنَّا عَلَى مَا لَمْ تُسَلِّطْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ،
segments.transliteration: sal-lat'-tahoo min-naa a'laa maa lam tusal-lit'-naa a'lay-hee min-h
segments.translation: 28.gave him an authority over us in a way that You didst not give us authority over him

segments.transliteration: as-kantahoo s'udooranaa wa aj-ray-tahoo majaareea dimaaa-inaa
segments.translation: 29.allowed him to dwell in our breasts and let him run in our blood vessels;

segments.arabic: لاَ يَغْفُلُ إنْ  غَفَلْنَا، وَلاَ يَنْسَى إنْ نَسِينَا،
segments.transliteration: laa yagh-fulu in ghafal-naa wa laa yansaaa in-naseenaa
segments.translation: 30.he is not heedless, though we be heedless, he does not forget, though we forget;
31.he makes us feel secure from Your punishment and fills us with fear toward other than You.
32.If we are about to commit an indecency, he gives us courage to do so,

segments.arabic: وَإنْ هَمَمْنَا بِعَمَل صَالِح ثَبَّطَنَا عَنْهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa in hamam-naa bia'malin s'aalih'in thab-bat'anaa a'n-h
segments.translation: 33.and if we are about to perform a righteous work, he holds us back from it.

segments.arabic: يَتَعَرَّضُ لَنَا بِالشَّهَوَاتِ، وَيَنْصِبُ لَنَا بِالشَّبُهَاتِ،
segments.transliteration: yataa'r-raz''u lanaa bish-shahawaat wa yans'ibu lanaa bish-shubuhaat
segments.translation: 34.He opposes us through passions, and sets up for us doubts.

segments.arabic: إنْ وَعَدَنَا كَذَبَنَا وَإنْ مَنَّانا، أَخْلَفَنَا
segments.translation: 35.If he promises us, he lies, and if he raises our hopes, he fails to fulfil them.

segments.transliteration: wa il-laa tas'-rif a'n-naa kay-dahoo yuz''il-lanaa
segments.translation: 36.If You dost not turn his trickery away from us, he will misguide us,
37.and if You dost not protect us from his corruption, he will cause us to slip.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ فَاقْهَرْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَنَّا بِسُلْطَانِكَ حَتَّى تَحْبِسَهُ عَنَّا
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma faq-har sul-t'aanahoo a'n-naa bisul-t'aanika h'at-taa tah'-bisahoo a'n-naa
segments.translation: 38.O God, so defeat his authority over us through Your authority, such that You holdest him back from us

segments.arabic: بِكَثْرَةِ الدُّعَاءِ لَكَ، فَنُصْبحَ مِنْ كَيْدِهِ فِي الْمَعْصُومِينَ بِكَ.
segments.transliteration: bikath-ratid-dua'aa-i laka fanus'-bih'a min kay-dihee fil-maa'-s'oomeena bik
segments.translation: 39.through the frequency of our supplication to You and we leave his trickery and rise up among those preserved by You from sin!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي كُلَّ سُؤْلِي، وَاقْضِ لِي حَوَائِجِي،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma aa'-t'inee kul-la soo-lee waq-z''i lee h'awaaa-ijee
segments.translation: 40.O God, grant me my every request, accomplish for me my needs,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَمْنَعْنِي الإجَابَةَ وَقَدْ ضَمِنْتَهَا لِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tam-naa'-neel-ijaabata waqad z''amintahaa lee
segments.translation: 41.withhold not from me Your response when You hast made Yourself accountable for it to me,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَحْجُبْ دُعَائِي عَنْكَ وَقَدْ أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tah'-jub dua'aa-ee a'nka waqad amartanee bih
segments.translation: 42.veil not my supplication from Yourself, when You hast commanded me to make it,
43.and be kind to me through everything that will set me right

segments.arabic: فِيْ دُنْيَايَ وَآخِرَتِي مَا ذَكَرْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَـا نَسِيتُ،
segments.transliteration: fee dunyaaya wa aaakhiratee maa d'akar-tu min-hoo wa maa naseet
segments.translation: 44.in this world and the next, in everything that I remember or forget,

segments.arabic: أَوْ أَظْهَـرتُ أَوْ أَخْفَيْتُ، أَوْ أَعْلَنْتُ أَوْ أَسْرَرْتُ،
segments.transliteration: aw az'-har-tu aw akh-fay-t aw aa'-lantu aw as-rar-t
segments.translation: 45.display or conceal, make public or keep secret!

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي جَمِيعِ ذلِكَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ بِسُؤَالِي إيَّـاكَ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-nee fee jameei' d'alika mina al-mus'-lih'eena bisoo-aaleee ee-yaak
segments.translation: 46.In all of this, place me through my asking You among those who set things right,
47.those who are answered favourably when they request from You
48.and from whom is not withheld when they put their trust in You,

segments.arabic: الْمُعَوَّدِينَ بِالتَّعَوُّذِ بِكَ، الرَّابِحِينَ فِي التِّجَارَةِ عَلَيْـكَ، الْمُجَارِيْنَ بِعِـزِّكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-mua'w-wad'eena bit-taa'w-wud'i bik ar-raabih'eena fit-tijaarati a'lay-k al-mujaareena bii'z-zik
segments.translation: 49.those accustomed to seek refuge in You, those who profit through commerce with You, those granted sanctuary through Your might,
50.those given lawful provision in plenty
51.from Your boundless bounty through Your munificence and generosity,

segments.arabic: الْمُعَزِّينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ بِكَ، وَالْمُجَارِينَ مِن الظُّلْمِ بِعَدْلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-mua'z-zeena minad'-d'ul-li bik wal-mujaareena minaz'-z'ul-mi bia'd-lik
segments.translation: 52.those who reach exaltation after abasement through You, those granted sanctuary from wrong through Your justice,

segments.arabic: وَالْمُعَافَيْنَ مِنَ الْبَلاءِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَالْمُغْنَيْنَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ بِغِنَاكَ،
segments.transliteration: wal-mua'afay-na minal-balaaa-i birah'-matik wal-mugh-nay-na minl-faq-ri bighnaak
segments.translation: 53.those released from affliction through Your mercy, those delivered from need after poverty through Your riches,

segments.arabic: وَالْمَعْصومِينَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالزَّلَلِ وَالْخَطَأِ بِتَقْوَاكَ،
segments.translation: 54.those preserved from sins, slips, and offenses through reverential fear toward You,

segments.transliteration: w almuwaf-faqeena lil-khay-ri wr-rush-di was'-s'awaabi bit'aaa'tik
segments.translation: 55.those successful in goodness, right conduct, and propriety through obeying You,
56.those walled off from sins through Your power,

segments.arabic: التَّـارِكِينَ لِكُلِّ مَعْصِيَتِكَ، السَّاكِنِينَ فِي جِوَارِكَ.
segments.transliteration: at-taarikeena likul-li maa'-s'eeatik as-saakineena fee jiwaarik
segments.translation: 57.the refrainers from every act of disobedience toward You, the dwellers in Your neighbourhood!
58.O God, give me all of that through Your bestowal of success
59.and Your mercy, grant us refuge from the chastisement of the burning,
60.and give to all the Muslims, male and female,

segments.arabic: وَالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِثْلَ الَّذِي سَأَلْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي
segments.translation: 61.and all the faithful, male and female, the like of what I have asked for myself

segments.arabic: وَلِوُلْدِي فِي عَاجِلِ الدُّنْيَا وَآجِلِ الآخِرَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa liwul-dee fee a'ajilid-dunyaa wa aaajilil-aaakhirah
segments.translation: 62.and my children, in the immediate of this world and the deferred of the next!
63.Verily You art the Near, the Responder, the All-hearing, the All-knowing,
64.the Pardoner, the Forgiving, the Clement, the Merciful!

segments.arabic: وَآتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ.
segments.transliteration: wa aaatinaa fid-dunyaa h'asanataw-wa fil-aaakhirati h'asanah wa qinaa a'd'aaban-naar
segments.translation: 65.And "give to us in this world good, and in the next world good, and protect us from the chastisement of the Fire" (2:201)!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 11 His Supplication for Good Outcomes

segments.translation: O He whose remembrance is an honor for those who remember.
And O He whose gratitude is success for the thankful.
And O He whose obedience is salvation for the obedient.
Send blessings upon Muá¸¥ammad and his family.

segments.arabic: وَاشْغَلْ قُلُوبَنَا بِذِكْرِكَ عَنْ كُلِّ ذِكْرٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa-ashghil qulÅ«banÄ bidhikrika âan kulli dhikr
segments.translation: And occupy our hearts with Your remembrance from all other remembrance.
And our tongues with Your thanks from all other thanks.
And our limbs with Your obedience from all other obedience.

segments.arabic: فَإِنْ قَدَّرْتَ لَنَا فَرَاغًا مِنْ شُغْلٍ فَاجْعَلْهُ فَرَاغَ سَلَامَةٍ
segments.transliteration: Fa-in qaddarta lanÄ farÄghan min shughlin fa-jâalhu farÄgha salÄmah
segments.translation: And if You decree for us a time free from work, then make it a time of safety.

segments.arabic: لَا تُدْرِكْنَا فِيهِ تَبِعَةٌ وَلَا تَلْحَقْنَا فِيهِ سَآمَةٌ
segments.transliteration: LÄ tudriknÄ fÄ«hi tabiâatun wa-lÄ talá¸¥aqnÄ fÄ«hi saâÄmah
segments.translation: In which no burden overtakes us, and no weariness afflicts us.

segments.arabic: حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ عَنَّا كُتَّابُ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِصَحِيفَةٍ خَالِيَةٍ مِنْ ذِكْرِ سَيِّئَاتِنَا
segments.transliteration: á¸¤attÄ yaná¹£arifa âannÄ kuttÄbu al-sayyiâÄti bi-á¹£aá¸¥Ä«fatin khÄliyyatin min dhikri sayyiâÄtinÄ
segments.translation: Until the recorders of evil deeds depart from us with a scroll empty of any mention of our sins.

segments.arabic: وَيَتَوَلَّى كُتَّابُ الْحَسَنَاتِ عَنَّا مَسْرُورِينَ بِمَا كَتَبُوا مِنْ حَسَنَاتِنَا
segments.transliteration: Wa-yatawallÄ kuttÄbu al-á¸¥asanÄti âannÄ masrÅ«rÄ«na bimÄ katabÅ« min á¸¥asanÄtinÄ
segments.translation: And the recorders of good deeds depart from us rejoicing in what they have written of our good deeds.

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا انْقَضَتْ أَيَّامُ حَيَاتِنَا وَتَصَرَّمَتْ مُدَدُ أَعْمَارِنَا
segments.transliteration: Wa-idhÄ inqaá¸at ayyÄmu á¸¥ayÄtinÄ wa-taá¹£arramat mudadu aâmÄrinÄ
segments.translation: And when the days of our lives have ended, and the spans of our ages have passed.

segments.arabic: وَاسْتَحْضَرَتْنَا دَعْوَتُكَ الَّتِي لَا بُدَّ مِنْهَا وَمِنْ إِجَابَتِهَا
segments.transliteration: Wa-istaá¸¥á¸aratnÄ daâwatuka allatÄ« lÄ budda minhÄ wa-min ijÄbatihÄ
segments.translation: And Your summons, which cannot be avoided and must be answered, has attended us.
Then send blessings upon Muá¸¥ammad and his family.

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ خِتَامَ مَا تُحْصِي عَلَيْنَا كَتَبَةُ أَعْمَالِنَا تَوْبَةً مَقْبُولَةً
segments.transliteration: Wa-jâal khitÄma mÄ tuá¸¥á¹£Ä« âalaynÄ katabatu aâmÄlinÄ tawbatan maqbÅ«lah
segments.translation: And make the conclusion of what the scribes of our deeds record against us a repentance accepted.

segments.arabic: لَا تُوقِفْنَا بَعْدَهَا عَلَى ذَنْبٍ اجْتَرَحْنَاهُ
segments.transliteration: LÄ tÅ«qifnÄ baâdahÄ âalÄ dhanbin ijtaraá¸¥nÄhu
segments.translation: Do not expose us after it to a sin we have committed.
Nor to a disobedience we have perpetrated.

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَكْشِفْ عَنَّا سِتْرًا سَتَرْتَهُ عَلَى رُؤُوسِ الْأَشْهَادِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ takshif âannÄ sitran satartahu âalÄ ruâÅ«si al-ashhÄd
segments.translation: And do not uncover from us a covering You have concealed over us before witnesses.
On the day You test the reports of Your servants.

segments.arabic: إِنَّكَ رَحِيمٌ بِمَنْ دَعَاكَ، وَمُسْتَجِيبٌ لِمَنْ نَادَاكَ
segments.transliteration: Innaka raá¸¥Ä«mun biman daâÄk, wa-mustajÄ«bun liman nÄdÄk
segments.translation: Indeed, You are Merciful to the one who calls upon You, and Responsive to the one who invokes You.
1.O He remembering whom brings honour to those who remember!
2.O He thanking whom brings triumph to those who give thanks!
3.O He obeying whom brings deliverance to those who obey!
4.Bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَاشْغَلْ قُلُوبَنَا بِذِكْرِكَ عَنْ كُلِّ ذِكْر،
segments.transliteration: wa ash-ghal quloobanaa bid'ik-rika a'n kul-li d'ik-r
segments.translation: 5.and divert our hearts through remembering You from every act of remembrance,

segments.transliteration: wa al-sinatanaa bishuk-rika a'n kul-li shuk-r
segments.translation: 6.our tongues through thanking You from every act of thanksgiving,

segments.transliteration: wa jawaarih'anaa bit'aaa'tika a'n kul-li t'aaa'h
segments.translation: 7.our limbs through obeying You from every act of obedience!

segments.arabic: فَإنْ قَدَّرْتَ لَنَا فَرَاغاً مِنْ شُغُل فَاجْعَلْهُ فَرَاغَ سَلاَمَة
segments.transliteration: faan qad-dar-ta lanaa faraagham-min shugh-lin  faj-a'l-hoo faraagha salaamah
segments.translation: 8.If You hast ordained for us idleness from these occupations, make it an idleness of safety,

segments.arabic: لا تُدْرِكُنَا فِيهِ تَبِعَةٌ وَلاَ تَلْحَقُنَا فِيهِ سَاَمَةٌ
segments.transliteration: laa tud-rikunaa feehee tabia'h wa laa tal-h'aqunaa feehee saa-mah
segments.translation: 9.within which no ill consequence visits us or weariness overtakes us!

segments.arabic: حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ عَنَّا كُتَّابُ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِصَحِيفَة خَالِيَة  مِنْ ذِكْرِ سَيِّئاتِنَا
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa yans'arifa a'n-naa kut-taabus-say-yi-aati bis'ah'eefatin khaaleeatim-min d'ik-ri say-yi-aatinaa
segments.translation: 10.Then the writers of evil deeds may depart from us with a page empty of the mention of our evil deeds,
11.and the writers of good deeds may turn away from us

segments.transliteration: a'n-naa mas-rooreena bimaa kataboo min h'asanaatinaa
segments.translation: 12.happy with the good deeds of ours which they have written.

segments.arabic: وَإذَا انْقَضَتْ أَيَّامُ حَيَاتِنَـا وَتَصَرَّمَتْ مُـدَدُ أَعْمَارِنَـا،
segments.transliteration: wa id'aa anqaz''at ay-yaamu h'ayaatinaa wa tas'ar-ramat mudadu aa'-maarinaa
segments.translation: 13.And when the days of our life have passed by, the terms of our lifetimes have elapsed,

segments.arabic: وَاسْتَحْضَرَتْنَا دَعْوَتُكَ الَّتِي لاَ بُدَّ مِنْهَا وَمِنْ إجَابَتِهَا ،
segments.transliteration: was-tah'-z''arat-naa daa'-watukal-latee laa bud-da min-haa wamin ijaabatihaa
segments.translation: 14.and Your call, which must come and be answered, summons us forth,
15.then bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ خِتَامَ مَا تُحْصِي عَلَيْنَا كَتَبَةُ أَعْمَالِنَا
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l khitaama maa tuh'-s'ee a'lay-naa katabatu aa'-maalinaa
segments.translation: 16.and make the outcome of what the writers of our works count against us

segments.arabic: تَوْبَةً مَقْبُولَةً لا تُوقِفُنَا بَعْدَهَا عَلَى ذَنْب اجْتَرَحْنَاهُ،
segments.transliteration: taw-batam-maq-boolah laa tooqifunaa baa'-dahaa a'laa d'ambin aj-tarah'-naahu
segments.translation: 17.an accepted repentance, which afterwards gave us no rest in a sin that we committed
18.or an act of disobedience that we performed!

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَكْشِفْ عَنَّا سِتْراً سَتَرْتَهُ عَلَى رُؤُوسِ الأشْهَادِ
segments.transliteration: wa laa tak-shif a'n-naa sit-ran satar-tahoo a'laa ru-oosil-ash-haadi
segments.translation: 19.Remove not from us any covering with which You hast covered over the heads of the witnesses
20.on the day when the records of Your servants are tried!

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ رَحِيمٌ بِمَنْ دَعَاكَ، وَمُسْتَجيبٌ لِمَنْ نَادَاكَ .
segments.translation: 21.Verily You art compassionate to him who supplicates You, the responder to him who calls upon You!

segments.translation: and bless Muhammad and his Household as long as the night and the day follow each other,
a blessing whose supply is not cut off,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُحْصَى عَدَدُهَا صَلاَةً تَشْحَنُ الْهَوَاءَ،
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ yuá¸¥á¹£Ä âadaduhÄ á¹£alÄtan tashá¸¥anu al-hawÄâ,
segments.translation: and whose number is not counted, a blessing that loads the atmosphere,
and fills the earth and the sky.
May God bless him until He is pleased,

segments.transliteration: wa á¹£allÄ AllÄhu âalayhÄ« wa ÄlihÄ«
segments.translation: and may God bless him and his Household

segments.arabic: بَعْدَ الرِّضَا صَلاَةً لا حَدَّ لَها
segments.transliteration: baâda ar-riá¸Ä á¹£alÄtan lÄ á¸¥adda lahÄ
segments.translation: after His pleasure, with a blessing that has no limit

segments.transliteration: wa lÄ muntahÄ yÄ ará¸¥ama ar-rÄá¸¥imÄ«n.
segments.translation: and no end, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا ذَا الْمُلْكِ الْمُتأبِّدِ بِالْخُلُودِ وَالْسُلْطَانِ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma yaa d'aal- mul-kil-mutaab-bidi bil-khulood was-sul-t'aan
segments.translation: 1.O God, O Possessor of kingdom perpetual in everlastingness,
2.authority invincible without armies or helpers,
3.might abiding through aeons past,
4.years gone by, times and days elapsed!

segments.arabic: عَزَّ سُلْطَانُكَ عِزّاً لا حَدَّ  لَهُ بِأَوَّلِيَّةٍ وَلاَ مُنْتَهَى لَهُ بِآخِرِيَّةٍ،
segments.transliteration: a'z-za sul-t'aanuka i'z-zal-laa h'ad-da lahoo biw-walee-yatiw-wa laa muntahaa lahoo biaakharee-yah
segments.translation: 5.Your authority is mighty with a might that knows no bound by being first nor utmost end by being last!

segments.arabic: وَاسْتَعْلَى مُلْكُكَ عُلُوّاً سَقَطَتِ الأشْيَاءُ دُونَ بُلُوغِ أَمَدِهِ
segments.transliteration: was-taa'-laa mul-kuka u'loo-wana saqat'atil-ash-yaaa-u doona bulooghi amadih
segments.translation: 6.Your kingdom towers high with a towering before which all things fall down without reaching its term;

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَبْلُغُ أَدْنَى مَا اسْتَأثَرْتَ بِـهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَقْصَى نَعْتِ النَّـاعِتِينَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa yab-lughu ad-naa mas-taa-thar-ta bihee min d'alika aq-s'aa naa'-tin-naai'teen
segments.translation: 7.the least of it which You hast kept to Yourself is not reached by the furthest description of the describers!

segments.arabic: ضَلَّتْ فِيْـكَ الصِّفَاتُ وَتَفَسْخَتْ دُونَكَ النُّعُوتُ
segments.translation: 8.Attributes go astray in You, descriptions fall apart below You,
9.the subtlest of imaginations are bewildered by Your magnificence!

segments.arabic: كَذلِكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ الأَوَّلُ فِي أَوَّلِيَّتِكَ،
segments.translation: 10.So art Thou: God, the First in Your firstness,

segments.arabic: وَعَلَى ذَلِكَ أَنْتَ دَائِمٌ لا تَزُولُ،
segments.transliteration: wa a'laa d'alika anta daaa-imul-laa tazool
segments.translation: 11.and so art You everlastingly. You dost not pass away.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا الْعَبْدُ الضَّعِيْفُ عَمَلاً الجَسِيْمُ أَمَلاً،
segments.transliteration: wa anaal-a'b-d az''-z''ae'efu a'malaan al-jaseemu amalaa
segments.translation: 12.But I am the slave, feeble in works, immense in hopes.

segments.arabic: خَرَجَتْ  مِنْ يَدِي أَسْبَابُ الْوُصُلاَت إلاّ مَا وَصَلَهُ رَحْمَتُكَ ،
segments.transliteration: kharajat mee-yadeee as-baabul-wus'ulaati il-laa maa was'alahoo rah'-matuk
segments.translation: 13.The tying links are outside my hand, except what is tied by Your mercy;
14.the bonds of hopes have been cut away from me,

segments.arabic: إلاّ مَا أَنَا مُعْتَصِمٌ بِهِ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ،
segments.transliteration: il-laa maaa ana mua'-tas'imum-bihee min a'f-wik
segments.translation: 15.except the pardon to which I hold fast.

segments.arabic: قَلَّ عِنْدِي مَا أَعْتَدُّ بِهِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: qal-la i'ndee maaa aa'-tad-du bihee min t'aaa'tik
segments.translation: 16.Little on my part is the obedience toward You upon which I count,

segments.arabic: وَكَثُرَ عَلَيَّ مَا أَبُوءُ بِهِ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa kathura a'lay-ya maaa abooo-u bihee mim-maa'-s'eeatik
segments.translation: 17.and great against me the disobedience toward You to which I have reverted.

segments.arabic: وَلَنْ يَضِيْقَ عَلَيْكَ عَفْوٌ عَنْ عَبْدِكَ وَإنْ أَسَاءَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
segments.transliteration: wa lay-yaz''eeqa a'lay-ka a'f-wun a'n a'b-dika wa in asaaa-a faa'-fu a'n-nee
segments.translation: 18.But pardoning Your slave will not constrain You, even if he be bad, so pardon me!

segments.arabic: أللَّهًمَّ وَقَدْ أَشْرَفَ  عَلَى خَفَايَا الأَعْمَالِ عِلْمُكَ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma waqad ash-rafa a'laa khafaayaal-aa'-maali i'l-muk
segments.translation: 19.O God, Your knowledge watches over hidden works
20.every covered thing is exposed before Your awareness,
21.the intricacies of things are not concealed from You,
22.and unseen mysteries slip not away from You.

segments.arabic: وَقَدِ اسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيَّ عَدُوُّكَ الَّذِي اسْتَنْظَرَكَ  لِغِوَايتِي فَأَنْظَرْتَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa qadi as-tah'-wad'a a'lay-ya a'doo-wukal-lad'ee s-tanz'araka lighawaayatee faanz'ar-tah
segments.translation: 23.But over me Your enemy has gained mastery: He asked a delay from You to lead me astray, and You gavest him the delay!

segments.arabic: وَاسْتَمْهَلَكَ إلَى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ لاِضْلاَلِي فَأَمْهَلْتَهُ،
segments.translation: 24.He asked a respite from You until the Day of Doom to misguide me, and You gavest him the respite!
25.So he threw me down, though I had fled to You
26.from small, ruinous sins
27.and great, deadly works,
28.until, when I had yielded to disobeying You
29.and merited Your anger through my bad efforts,
30.he turned the bridle of his treachery away from me,
31.met me with the word of his ingratitude,

segments.arabic: وَتَوَلَّى الْبَراءَةَ مِنِّي وَأَدْبَرَ مُوَلِّيَاً عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa tawal-laal-baraaa-ata min-nee wa ad-bara muwal-leeana a'n-nee
segments.translation: 32.undertook to be quit of me, turned his back to flee from me,
33.threw me to the desert of Your wrath alone,

segments.transliteration: wa akh-rajaneee ilaa finaaa-i naqimatika t'areedaa
segments.translation: 34.and sent me as an outcast into the courtyard of Your vengeance.
35.There is no intercessor to intercede for me with You,
36.no protector to make me feel secure against You,
37.no fortress to veil me from You,

segments.transliteration: wa laa malaad'un al-jaa ilay-hee mink
segments.translation: 38.no shelter in which to seek asylum apart from You!

segments.arabic: فَهَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ، وَمَحَلُّ الْمُعْتَرِفِ لَكَ،
segments.transliteration: fahd'aa maqaamul-a'aa-id'i bika wa mah'al-lul-mua'-tarifi lak
segments.translation: 39.This is the station of him who takes refuge with You, the place of the confessor to You:

segments.arabic: فَلاَ يَضِيقَنَّ عَنِّي فَضْلُكَ، وَلا يَقْصُـرَنَّ دونِي عَفْوُكَ،
segments.transliteration: falaa yaz''eeqan-na a'n-nee faz''-luk wa laa yaq-s'uran-na doonee a'f-wuk
segments.translation: 40.Let not Your bounty be too narrow for me, let not Your pardon fall short of me!
41.Let me not be the most disappointed of Your repentant servants,
42.nor the most despairing of those who come to You with expectations!
43.Forgive me, surely You art the best of the forgivers!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَمَرْتَنِي فَتَرَكْتُ، وَنَهَيْتَنِي فَرَكِبْتُ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-nak amar-tanee fatarak-t wa nahay-tanee farakib-t
segments.translation: 44.O God, You commanded me, and I refrained, You prohibited me, and I committed.

segments.arabic: وَسَوَّلَ لِيَ الْخَطَأَ خَاطِرُ  السُّوءِ فَفَرَّطْتُ،
segments.translation: 45.evil thoughts tempted me to offend, and I was negligent.

segments.transliteration: wa laaa as-tash-hidu a'laa s'eeaamee nahaaraa
segments.translation: 46.I cannot call upon daytime to witness my fasting,
47.nor can I seek sanctuary in night because of my vigil;

segments.transliteration: wa laa tuth-nee a'lay-ya biih'-yaaa-ihaa sun-natun
segments.translation: 48.no Sunna praises me for keeping it alive,

segments.arabic: حَـاشَا فُرُوضِـكَ الَّتِي مَنْ ضَيَّعَها هَلَكَ،
segments.translation: 49.only Your obligations, he who neglects which has perished.

segments.transliteration: wa las-tu atawas-salu ilay-ka bifaz''-li naafilatin
segments.translation: 50.I cannot seek access to You through the excellence of a supererogatory work,

segments.arabic: مَعَ كَثِيرِ مَا أَغْفَلْتُ مِنْ وَظَائِفِ فُرُوضِكَ،
segments.transliteration: maa' katheeri maaa agh-fal-tu miw-waz'aaa-ifi furooz''ik
segments.translation: 51.given the many duties of Your obligations of which I have been heedless
52.and the stations of Your bounds which I have transgressed,

segments.arabic: إلَى حُرُمَات انْتَهَكْتُهَا، وَكَبَائِرِ ذُنُوب اجْتَرَحْتُهَا
segments.transliteration: ilaa h'urumaatin antahak-tuhaa wa kabaaa-iri d'unoobin aj-tarah'-tuhaa
segments.translation: 53.thereby violating sacred things and committing great sins,

segments.arabic: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لِي مِنْ فَضَائِحِهَا سِتْراً.
segments.transliteration: kaanat a'afeeatuka lee min faz''aaa-ih'ihaa sit-raa
segments.translation: 54.though You hast given me safety from their disgraces as a covering.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اسْتَحْيَى لِنَفْسِهِ مِنْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa had'aa maqaamu man as-tah'-yaa linaf-sihee mink
segments.translation: 55.This is the station of him who is ashamed of himself before You,

segments.transliteration: wa sakhit'a a'lay-haa wa raz''eea a'nka
segments.translation: 56.angry with himself, and satisfied with You.

segments.arabic: فَتَلَقَّاكَ بِنَفْس خَاشِعَة، وَرَقَبَة خَاضِعَة، وَظَهْر مُثْقَل مِنَ الْخَطَايَا
segments.transliteration: fatalaq-qaaka binaf-sin khaashia'h wa raqabatin khaaz''ia'h wa z'ah-rim-muth-qalim-mina alkhat'aayaa
segments.translation: 57.He meets You with a humble soul, a neck bent down, a back heavy with offenses,

segments.arabic: وَاقِفاً بَيْنَ الرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ،
segments.translation: 58.hesitating between longing for You and fear of You.
59.You art the most worthy of those in whom he might hope,

segments.transliteration: wa ah'aq-qu man khasheeahoo wa at-taqaah
segments.translation: 60.the most deserving for him to dread and fear.

segments.arabic: فَاعْطِنِي يَا رَبِّ مَا رَجَوْتُ، وَآمِنِّي مَا حَذِرْتُ،
segments.transliteration: faaa'-t'inee yaa rab-bi maa rajaw-t wa aaamin-nee maa h'ad'ir-t
segments.translation: 61.So give me, my Lord, what I hope for, make me secure against what frightens me,

segments.arabic: وَعُدْ عَلَيَّ بِعَائِدَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ إنَّكَ أكْرَمُ الْمَسْؤُولِينَ.
segments.transliteration: wa u'd a'lay-ya bia'aa-idati rah'-matik in-naka ak-ramul-mas-ooleen
segments.translation: 62.and act kindly toward me with the kindly act of mercy! Surely You art the most generous of those from whom are asked!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإذْ سَتَـرْتَنِي بِعَفْوِكَ وَتَغَمَّـدْتَنِي بِفَضْلِكَ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa id' satar-tanee bia'f-wik wa tagham-mat-tanee bifaz''-lika
segments.translation: 63.O God, since You hast covered me with Your pardon and shielded me with Your bounty
64.in the abode of annihilation and the presence of equals
65.grant me sanctuary from the disgraces of the Abode of Subsistence

segments.arabic: عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الأشْهَادِ مِنَ المَلائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
segments.translation: 66.at the standing places of the Witnesses (the angels brought nigh,
67.the messengers honoured, the martyrs, the righteous)
68.before the neighbour from whom I have hidden my evil deeds

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ ذِي رَحِم كُنْتُ أَحْتَشِمُ مِنْهُ فِي سَرِيرَاتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa min d'ee rah'imin kuntu ah'-tashimu min-hoo fee sareeraatee
segments.translation: 69.and the womb relative before whom I feel ashamed in my secret thoughts!

segments.arabic: لَمْ أَثِقْ بِهِمْ رَبِّ فِي السِّتْرِ عَلَيَّ،
segments.transliteration: lam athiq bihim rab-bi fis-sit-ri a'lay
segments.translation: 70.I trust them not, my Lord, to cover me over,

segments.arabic: وَوَثِقْتُ  بِكَ رَبِّ فِي الْمَغفِرَةِ لِيْ،
segments.transliteration: wa wathiq-t bika rab-bi fil-magh-firati lee
segments.translation: 71.but I trust You, my Lord, to forgive me!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ أوْلَى مَنْ وُثِقَ بِهِ وَأَعْطَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: wa anta aw-laa maw-wuthiqa bih wa aa'-t'aa mar-rughiba ilay-h
segments.translation: 72.You art the most worthy of those in whom confidence is had, the most giving of those who are besought,
73.and the most clement of those from whom mercy is asked. So have mercy upon me!

segments.arabic: أللهُمَّ وَأنتَ حَدَرْتَنِي مَاءً مَهِيناً مِنْ صُلب،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa anta h'adar-tanee maaa-am-maheenaa min s'ul-bim
segments.translation: 74.O God, You caused me to descend as mean water from loins
75.of narrow bones and tight passages
76.into a constricted womb which You hadst covered with veils;

segments.arabic: تُصَرِّفُنِي حَالاًَ عَنْ حَال حَتَّى انْتَهَيْتَ بِيْ إلَى تَمَامِ الصُّورَةِ
segments.transliteration: tus'ar-rifunee h'aalana a'n h'aalin h'at-taa antahay-ta beee ilaa tamaamis'-s'oorah
segments.translation: 77.You turned me about from state to state until You tookest me to the completion of the form
78.and fixed within me the bodily parts,
79.as You hast described in Your Book:

segments.arabic: نُطْفَةً ثُمَّ عَلَقَةً ثُمَّ مُضْغَةً ثُمَّ عِظَاماً
segments.transliteration: (nut'-fatan thum-ma a'laqatan thum-ma muz''-ghatan thum-ma i'z'aamana
segments.translation: 80.a drop, then a clot, then a tissue, then bones,

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ كَسَوْتَ الْعِظَامَ لَحْماً ثُمَّ أَنْشَأتَنِي خَلْقَاً آخَرَ كَمَا شِئْتَ،
segments.transliteration: thum-ma kasaw-tal-i'z'aama lah'-mana thum-ma anshaa-tanee khal-qan aaakhar) kamaa shi-t
segments.translation: 81.then You garmented the bones with flesh, then You produced me as another creature as You willed (ref.23:12-14).
82.Then, when I needed Your provision,

segments.transliteration: wa lam as-tagh-ni a'n gheeaathi faz''-lik
segments.translation: 83.and could not do without the aid of Your bounty,

segments.arabic: جَعَلْتَ لِي قُـوتـاً مِنْ فَضْلِ طَعَام وَشَرَاب
segments.transliteration: jaa'l-ta lee qootam-min faz''-li t'aa'amiw-wa sharaabin
segments.translation: 84.You appointed for me a nourishment from the bounty of the food and drink

segments.arabic: أَجْرَيْتَهُ لاِمَتِكَ  الَّتِيْ أَسْكَنْتَنِي جَوْفَهَا وَأَوْدَعْتَنِي قَرَارَ رَحِمِهَا،
segments.transliteration: aj-ray-tahoo liamatikal-latee as-kantanee jaw-fahaa wa aw-daa'-tanee qaraara rah'imihaa
segments.translation: 85.which You bestowed upon Your handmaid in whose belly You gavest me to rest and in the lodging of whose womb You deposited me.

segments.arabic: وَلَوْ تَكِلُنِي يَا رَبِّ فِي تِلْكَ الْحَـالاتِ إلَى حَوْلِي،
segments.transliteration: wa law takil-nee yaa rab-bi fee til-kal-h'aalaati ilaa h'aw-leee
segments.translation: 86.Hadst You entrusted me in those states, my Lord, to my own force
87.or driven me to have recourse to my own strength,

segments.arabic: لَكَانَ الْحَوْلُ عَنِّي مُعْتَزِلاً، وَلَكَانَتِ الْقُوَّةُ مِنِّي بَعِيدَةً،
segments.transliteration: lakaanal-h'aw-lu a'n-nee mua'-tazilaa wa lakaanati alqoo-watu min-nee bae'edah
segments.translation: 88.force would have been removed from me and strength taken far away.
89.So You hast fed me through Your bounty with the food of the Good, the Gentle;

segments.arabic: تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ بِي تَطَوُّلاً عَلَيَّ إلَى غَايَتِي هَذِهِ،
segments.transliteration: taf-a'lu d'alika bee tat'aw-wulana a'lay-ya ilaa ghaayatee had'ih
segments.translation: 90.You hast done that for me in graciousness toward me up to this my present point.

segments.arabic: لاَ أَعْدَمُ بِرَّكَ وَلاَ يُبْطِئُ بِي حُسْنُ صَنِيعِكَ،
segments.transliteration: laaa aa'-damu bir-rak wa laa yub-t'i-u bee h'us-nu s'aneei'k
segments.translation: 91.I do not lack Your goodness nor does Your benefaction keep me waiting.

segments.transliteration: wa laa tataak-kadu maa' d'alika thiqatee
segments.translation: 92.Yet with all that, my trust has not become firm enough

segments.arabic: فَأَتَفَرَّغَ لِمَا هُوَ أَحْظَى لِيْ عِنْدَكَ،
segments.transliteration: faatafar-ragha limaa huwa ah'-z'a lee i'ndak
segments.translation: 93.that I might free myself for that which is more favoured by You.

segments.arabic: قَدْ مَلَكَ الشَّيْطَانُ عِنَانِي فِي سُوءِ الظَّنِّ وَضَعْفِ الْيَقِينِ،
segments.transliteration: qad malakash-shay-t'aanu i'naanee fee sooo-iz'-z'an-ni waz''aa'-fil-yaqeen
segments.translation: 94.Satan has taken possession of my reins through my distrust and frail certainty.

segments.arabic: فَأَنَا أَشْكُو سُوْءَ مُجَاوَرَتِهِ لِي وَطَـاعَةَ نَفْسِي لَـهُ،
segments.transliteration: faanaa ash-koo sooo-a mujaawaratihee lee wa t'aaa'ta naf-see lah
segments.translation: 95.I complain of his evil neighbourhood with me and my soul's obedience toward him!

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَعْصِمُـكَ مِنْ مَلَكَتِهِ، وَأَتَضَـرَّعُ إلَيْكَ في صَرفِ كَيدِهِ عَنّي
segments.transliteration: wa as-taa'-s'imuka mim-malakatih wa ataz''ar-rau' ilay-ka fee s'arf-i kaydihee 'annee
segments.translation: 96.I ask You to preserve me against his domination, and I plead with You to turn his trickery away from me!

segments.arabic: و أسأَلُكَ فِي أَنْ تُسَهِّلَ إلَى رِزْقِي سَبِيلاً،
segments.transliteration: wa as-aluka feee an tusah-hila ilaa riz-qee sabeela
segments.translation: 97.I ask You to make the path to my provision easy,

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ابْتِدَائِكَ بِالنِّعَمِ الْجِسَامِ،
segments.translation: 98.since to You belongs praise for Your beginning with immense favours
99.and Your inspiring gratitude for beneficence and bestowing favour!
100.Bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِي وَأَنْ تُقَنِّعَنِي بِتَقْدِيرِكَ لِيْ ،
segments.transliteration: wasah-hil a'lay-ya riz-qee wa an tuq-nia'nee bitaq-deerika lee
segments.translation: 101.and make the way to my provision easy for me! [I ask You] to make me content with Your ordainment for me,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ  تُرْضِيَنِي بِحِصَّتِيْ فِيمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ،
segments.transliteration: wa an tur-z''eeanee bih'is'-s'atee feemaa qasam-ta lee
segments.translation: 102.to make me satisfied with my lot in that which You hast apportioned for me

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تَجْعَـلَ مَـا ذَهَبَ مِنْ جِسْمِيْ وَعُمُرِيْ
segments.transliteration: wa an taj-a'la maa d'ahaba min jis-mee wau'm-ree
segments.translation: 103.and to place what has gone of my body and my life-span

segments.arabic: فِي سَبِيْلِ طَاعَتِكَ إنَّكَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ.
segments.translation: 104.into the path of Your obedience! Surely You art the Best of providers!

segments.arabic: أللَهُمَّ إنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مَنْ نَارٍ تَغَلَّظْتَ بِهَا عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-neee su'wd'u bika min-naar taghal-laz'-ta bihaa a'laa man a's'aak
segments.translation: 105.O God, I seek refuge in You from the Fire through which You art harsh toward him who disobeys You

segments.arabic: وَتَوَعَّدْتَ بِهَا مَنْ صَدَفَ عَنْ رِضَاكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa tawaa'-a't-ta bihaa man s'adafa a'r-riz''aak
segments.translation: 106.and by which You hast threatened him who turns away from Your good pleasure;

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ نَارٍ نورُهَا ظُلْمَة وَهَيِّنُهَا أَلِيمٌ، وَبَعِيدُهَا قَرِيبٌ،
segments.transliteration: wa min-naarin-nooruhaa z'ul-mah wa hay-yinuhaaa aleem wa bae'eduhaa qareeb
segments.translation: 107.from the Fire whose light is darkness, whose ease is pain, and whose far is near;
108.from the Fire parts of which devour parts
109.and parts of which leap upon parts;
110.from the Fire which leaves bones decayed
111.and lets its people drink boiling water;

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ نَارٍ لاَ تُبْقِي عَلَى مَنْ تَضَرَّعَ إلَيْهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa min-naaril-laa tub-qee a'laa man taz''ar-raa' ilay-haa
segments.translation: 112.from the Fire which 'does not spare him who pleads to it,'
113.has no mercy on him who seeks sympathy from it,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَى التَّخْفِيفِ عَمَّنْ خَشَعَ لَهَا وَاسْتَسْلَمَ إلَيْهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa laa taq-diru a'laat-takh-feefi a'm-man khashaa' lahaa was-tas-lama ilay-haa
segments.translation: 114.and has no power to relieve him who humbles himself before it and yields himself to it;

segments.arabic: تَلْقَى سُكَّانَهَا بِأَحَرِّ مَا لَدَيْهَا مِنْ أَلِيْمِ النَّكَالِ وَشَدِيدِ الْوَبَالِ،
segments.transliteration: tal-qaa suk-kaanahaa bih'ar-ri maa laday-haa min aleemin-nakaali washadeedil-wabaal
segments.translation: 115.it meets its inhabitants with the hottest that it possesses: painful punishment and intense noxiousness.

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بكَ مِنْ عَقَارِبِهَا الْفَاغِرَةِ أَفْوَاهُهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa au'wd'u bika min- a'qaaribihaal-faaghirati af-waahuhaa
segments.translation: 116.seek refuge in You from its gaping-jawed scorpions,
117.its scraping-toothed serpents,

segments.arabic: وَشَرَابِهَا الَّذِي يُقَطِّعُ أَمْعَاءَ وَأَفْئِدَةَ سُكَّانِهَا، وَيَنْزِعُ قُلُوبَهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa sharaabihaal-lad'ee yuqat'-t'iu' am-a'aa-a wa af-idata suk-kaanihaa wa yanziu' quloobahum
segments.translation: 118.and its drinks, which tear apart the intestines and hearts of its inhabitants and root out their marrows.

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَهْدِيْكَ لِمَا باعَدَ مِنْهَا وَأَخَّرَ عَنْهَا.
segments.transliteration: wa as-tah-deeka limaa baaa'da min-haa wa akh-khara a'n-haa
segments.translation: 119.I ask guidance from You to that which will keep far from it and make it retreat!
120.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
121.grant me sanctuary from it through the bounty of Your mercy,
122.release me from my stumbles through Your good releasing,
123.and abandon me not, O Best of the sanctuary-granters!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ  إنَّكَ تَقِي الْكَرِيهَةَ ، وَتُعْطِي الْحَسَنَةَ ،
segments.translation: 124.O God, You protectest from the disliked, givest the good,

segments.arabic: وَتَفْعَلُ مَا  تُرِيـدُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ.
segments.transliteration: wa taf-a'lu maa tureed wa anta a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer
segments.translation: 125.dost what You wilt, and You art "powerful over everything" (3:26).

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، إذَا ذُكِرَ الأبْرَارُ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaaliheee id'aa d'ukiral-ab-raar
segments.translation: 126.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household when the pious are mentioned

segments.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ مَا اخْتَلَفَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ
segments.transliteration: wa s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee makh-talafal-lay-lu wan-nahaar
segments.translation: 127.and bless Muhammad and his Household as long as night and day come
128.and go with a blessing whose replenishment is never cut off

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُحْصَى عَدَدُهَا صَلاَةً تَشْحَنُ الْهَوَاءَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yuh'-s'aa a'daduhaa s'alaatan tash-h'anul-hawaaa-a
segments.translation: 129.and whose number cannot be counted, a blessing that will fill up the air
130.and crowd the earth and the heaven!
131.God bless him until he is well pleased
132.and God bless him and his Household

segments.arabic: بَعْدَ الرِّضَا صَلاَةً لا حَدَّ لَها
segments.translation: 133.after good pleasure with a blessing that has neither bound
134.nor utmost limit! O Most Merciful of the merciful!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua34 When he was afflicted or saw someone afflicted with the Disgrace of Sin

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى سِتْرِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ ،

How many prohibitions of Yours have we transgressed,

You were the Observer of it without the sight of others,

So make what You covered of the faults,

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى سِتْرِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma lakal-h'am-du a'laa sit-rika baa'-da i'l-mik
segments.translation: 1.O God, to You belongs praise for Your covering over after Your knowledge
2.and Your pardon after Your awareness!

segments.arabic: فَكُلُّنَا قَدِ اقْتَرَفَ الْعَائِبَةَ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْهُ ،
segments.translation: 3.Each of us has committed faults, but You hast not made him notorious,
4.done indecencies, but You hast not disgraced him,

segments.transliteration: wa tasat-tara bil-masaawi-i falam tad-lul a'lay-h
segments.translation: 5.and covered over evil deeds, but You hast not pointed to him.
6.How many are Your prohibited acts which we have performed,

segments.transliteration: wa am-rin qad waqaf-tanaa a'lay-hee fataa'd-day-naah
segments.translation: 7.Your commandments of which You hast told us which we have transgressed,

segments.transliteration: wa say-yi-atin ak-tasab-naahaa wa khat'ee-atin ar-takab-naahaa
segments.translation: 8.the evil deeds which we have earned, the offenses which we have committed!
9.You seest them to the exclusion of all observers;
10.You hast the power to make them public above all the powerful!

segments.arabic: كَانَتْ عَافِيَتُكَ لَنَا حِجَاباً دُونَ أَبْصَارِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: kaanat a'afeeatuka lanaa h'ijaabana doona ab-s'aarhim
segments.translation: 11.By giving us safety You hast veiled their eyes
12.and stopped their ears.
13.So make the shameful things You hast covered over
14.and the inward reality You hast concealed our admonisher,

segments.arabic: وَزَاجِراً عَنْ سُوْءِ الْخُلْقِ وَاقْتِرَافِ الخَطِيئَـةِ،
segments.translation: 15.a restrainer upon bad character traits and committing offenses,

segments.arabic: وَسَعْياً إلَى التَّوْبَةِ الْمَاحِيَةِ وَالطَّرِيْقِ الْمَحْمُودَةِ،
segments.translation: 16.and a striving toward the repentance that erases [sins] and the praiseworthy path!
17.Bring the time of striving near
18.and visit us not with heedlessness of You!

segments.arabic: إنَّا إلَيْكَ رَاغِبُونَ ، وَمِنَ الذُّنُوبِ تَائِبُونَ.
segments.transliteration: in-naaa ilay-ka raaghiboon wa minad'-d'unoobi taaa-iboon
segments.translation: 19.Surely we are Your beseechers, the repenters of sins.

segments.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى خِيَرَتِكَ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa s'al-li a'laa kheearatikal-laahum-ma min khal-qika
segments.translation: 20.And bless Your chosen, O God, from Your creation,

segments.arabic: مُحَمَّد وَعِتْرَتِهِ الصِّفْـوَةِ مِنْ بَرِيَّتِـكَ الطَّاهِرِينَ ،
segments.translation: 21.Muhammad and his descendants, the friends selected from among Your creatures, the pure,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَامِعِينَ وَمُطِيعِينَ كَمَا أَمَرْتَ .
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-naa lahum saamie'ena wamut'eee'ena kamaaa amar-t
segments.translation: 22.and make us listeners to them and obeyers, as You hast commanded!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 16 In Asking Release from sins and Seeking Pardon

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ يَسْتَغِيثُ الْمُذْنِبُونَ،
segments.translation: 1.O God, O He through whose Mercy sinners seek aid!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ إلَى ذِكْرِ إحْسَانِهِ يَفْزَعُ الْمُضْطَرُّونَ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man ilaa d'ik-ri ih'-saanihee yaf-zau'l-muz''-t'ar-roon
segments.translation: 2.O He to the remembrance of whose beneficence the distressed flee!
3.O He in fear of whom the offenders weep!
4.O Comfort of every lonely stranger!

segments.transliteration: wa yaa faraja kul-li mak-roobin ka-eeb
segments.translation: 5.O Relief of all who are downcast and distressed!

segments.transliteration: wa yaa ghaw-tha kul-li makh-d'oolin fareed
segments.translation: 6.O Aid of everyone abandoned and alone!

segments.transliteration: wa yaa a'z''uda kul-li muh'-taajin t'areed
segments.translation: 7.O Support of every needy outcast!

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ الَّذِي وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء رَحْمَةً وَعِلْماً،
segments.translation: 8.You art He who "embracest everything in mercy and knowledge"! (40:7)

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي جَعَلْتَ لِكُلِّ مَخْلُوق فِي نِعَمِكَ سَهْماً،
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee jaa'l-ta likul-li makh-looqin fee nia'mika sah-maa
segments.translation: 9.You art He who hast appointed for each creature a share of Your favours!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ عَفْوُهُ أَعْلَى مِنْ عِقَابِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee a'f-wuhooo aa'-laa min i'qaabih
segments.translation: 10.You art He whose pardon is higher than His punishment!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي تَسْعَى رَحْمَتُهُ أَمَامَ غَضَبِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee tas-a'a rah'-matuhooo amaama ghaz''abih
segments.translation: 11.You art He whose mercy runs before His wrath!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي عَطَآؤُهُ أكْثَرُ مِنْ مَنْعِهِ،
segments.translation: 12.You art He whose bestowal is greater than His withholding!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ اتَّسَعَ الْخَلاَئِقُ كُلُّهُمْ فِي رَحمَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee at-tasaa'l-khalaaa-iqu kul-luhum fee rah'matih
segments.translation: 13.You art He by whose mercy all creatures are embraced!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي لا يَرْغَبُ فِي جَزَاءِ مَنْ أَعْطَاهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee laa yar-ghabu fee jazaaa-i man aa'-t'aah
segments.translation: 14.You art He who desires no repayment by him upon whom He bestows!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ  الَّذِي لا يُفْرِطُ فِي عِقَابِ مَنْ عَصَاهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee laa yuf-rit'u fee i'qaabi man a's'aah
segments.translation: 15.You art He who does not overdo the punishment of him who disobeys You!

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا يَا إلهِي عَبْدُكَ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَهُ بِالدُّعاءِ فَقَالَ:
segments.transliteration: wa ana yaaa ilaahee a'b-dukal-lad'eee amar-tahoo bid-dua'aa-i faqaala:
segments.translation: 16.And I, my God, am Your servant whom You commanded to supplicate and who said:

segments.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، هَا أَنَا ذَا يَا رَبِّ مَطْرُوحٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: lab-bay-ka wa saa'-day-k haaa ana d'aa yaa rab-bi mat'-rooh'um-bay-na yaday-k
segments.translation: 17.I am at Your service and disposal! Here am I, my Lord, thrown down before You.
18.I am he whose back offenses have weighed down!
19.I am he whose lifetime sins have consumed!

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا الَّذِي بِجَهْلِهِ عَصاكَ وَلَمْ تَكُنْ أَهْلاً مِنْهُ لِذَاكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa anaal-lad'ee bijah-lihee a's'aak wa lam takun ah-lam-min-hoo lid'aak
segments.translation: 20.I am he who was disobedient in his ignorance, while You didst not deserve that from him!

segments.arabic: هَلْ أَنْتَ يَا إلهِي رَاحِمٌ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فَأُبْلِغَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ
segments.transliteration: hal anta yaaa ilaahee raah'imum-man daa'aka faab-ligha fid-dua'aa-i?
segments.translation: 21.Wilt Thou, my God, be merciful toward him who supplicates You, that I should bring my supplication before You?

segments.arabic: أَمْ أَنْتَ غَافِرٌ لِمَنْ بَكَاكَ فَأُسْرِعَ فِي الْبُكَاءِ
segments.translation: 22.Wilt You forgive him who weeps to You that I should hurry to weep?

segments.arabic: أَمْ أَنْتَ  مُتَجَاوِزٌ عَمَّنْ عَفَّرَ لَكَ وَجْهَهُ تَذَلُّلاً
segments.transliteration: am anta mutjaawizun a'm-man a'f-fara laka wj-hahoo tad'al-lula?
segments.translation: 23.Wilt You show forbearance toward him who puts his face in the dust before You in lowliness?

segments.arabic: أَم أَنْتَ مُغْن مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ فَقْرَهُ تَوَكُّلاً؟
segments.transliteration: am anta mugh-nim-man shakaaa ilay-ka faq-rahoo tawak-kulaa
segments.translation: 24.Wilt You free from need him who complains to You of his indigent need with confidence?

segments.arabic: إلهِي لاَ تُخيِّبْ مَنْ لا يَجدُ مُعْطِياً غَيْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: ilaahee laa tukhay-yib mal-laa yajidu mua'-t'eean ghay-rak
segments.translation: 25.My God, disappoint not him who finds no bestower other than You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَخْذُلْ مَنْ لا يَسْتَغْنِي عَنْكَ بِأَحَدٍ دُونَكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa takh-d'ul mal-laa yas-tagh-nee a'nka bih'adin doonak
segments.translation: 26.and abandon not him who cannot be freed from his need for You through less than You!
27.My God, so bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُعْرِضْ عَنِّي وَقَدْ أَقْبَلْتُ عَلَيْكَ ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tua'-riz'' a'n-nee waqad aq-bal-tu a'lay-k
segments.translation: 28.turn not away from me when I have turned my face toward You,

segments.transliteration: wa laa tah'-rim-nee waqad raghib-tu ilay-k
segments.translation: 29.deprive me not when 1 have besought You,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَجْبَهْنِي بِالرَّدِّ وَقَدْ انْتَصَبْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-bah-nee bir-rad-di waqadi antas'ab-tu bay-na yaday-k
segments.translation: 30.and slap not my brow with rejection when I have stood before You!
31.You art He who has described Himself by mercy,
32.so bless Muhammad and his Household and have mercy upon me!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ نَفْسَكَ بِالعَفْوِ، فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
segments.transliteration: wa antal-lad'ee sam-may-ta naf-saka bil-a'f-wi faa'-fu a'n-nee
segments.translation: 33.You art He who has named Himself by pardon so pardon me!

segments.arabic: قَـدْ تَرَى يَـا إلهِي فَيْضَ دَمْعِي مِنْ خِيفَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: qad t-taraa yaaa ilaahee fay-z''a dam-e'e min kheefatik
segments.translation: 34.You hast seen, my God, the flow of my tears in fear of You,
35.the throbbing of my heart in dread of You,
36.and the infirmity of my limbs in awe of You.

segments.arabic: كُلُّ ذَلِكَ حَيَاءٌ مِنْكَ لِسُوءِ عَمَلِي,
segments.translation: 37.All this from my shame before You because of my evil works!

segments.arabic: وَلِذَاكَ خَمَدَ صَوْتِي عَنِ الْجَارِ إلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa lid'alik khamada s'aw-tee a'nil-jaa-ri ilay-k
segments.translation: 38.So my voice has become silent, no longer crying to You,
39.and my tongue has gone dumb, no longer whispering in prayer.

segments.arabic: يَا إلهِي فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، فَكَم مِنْ عَائِبَةٍ سَتَرْتَهَا عَلَيَّ فَلَم تَفْضَحْنِي،
segments.transliteration: yaaa ilaahee falakal-h'am-d fakam min a'aa-ibatin satar-tahaa a'lay-ya falam taf-z''ah'-nee
segments.translation: 40.My God, so to You belongs praise! How many of my flaws You hast covered over without exposing me!

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ ذنْبِ غَطَّيْتَهُ عَلَيَّ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa kam min d'ambin ghat'-t'ay-tahoo a'lay-ya falam tash-har-nee
segments.translation: 41.How many of my sins You hast cloaked without making me notorious!

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ شَائِبَة أَلْمَمْتُ بِهَا فَلَمْ تَهْتِكْ عَنِّي سِتْرَهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa kam min shaaa-ibatin al-mam-tu bihaa falam tah-tik a'n-nee sit-rahaa
segments.translation: 42.How many faults I have committed, yet You didst not tear away from me their covering,
43.collar me with their detested disgrace,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ تُبْدِ سَوْأَتِهَا لِمَنْ يَلْتَمِسُ مَعَايِبِي مِنْ جِيْرَتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa lam tub-di saw-aaatihaa limay-yal-tamisu maa'ayibee min jeeratee
segments.translation: 44.or make their dishonour plain to those of my neighbours who search for my defects
45.and to those who envy Your favour toward me!

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْهَنِي ذَلِكَ  عَنْ أَنْ جَرَيْتُ إلَى سُوءِ مَا عَهِدْتَ مِنّي
segments.transliteration: thum-ma lam yan-hanee d'alika a'n an jaray-tu ilaa sooo-i maa a'hit-ta min-nee
segments.translation: 46.But that did not prevent me from passing on to the evil that You knowest from me!

segments.arabic: فَمَنْ أَجْهَلُ مِنِّي يَا إلهِيْ بِرُشْدِهِ
segments.transliteration: faman aj-halu min-nee yaaa ilaahee birush-dihi?
segments.translation: 47.So who is more ignorant than I, my God, of his own right conduct?
48.Who is more heedless than I of his own good fortune?

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَبْعَدُ مِنِّي مِنِ اسْتِصْلاَحِ نَفْسِهِ
segments.transliteration: waman ab-a'du min-nee mini as-tis'-laahee naf-sihi?
segments.translation: 49.Who is further than I from seeking to set himself right?

segments.arabic: حِيْنَ اُنْفِقُ مَا أَجْرَيْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: h'eena unfiqu maaa sj-ray-ta a'lay-ya mir-riz-qika
segments.translation: 50.For I spend the provision You deliverest to me
51.in the disobedience You hast prohibited to me!

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَبْعَدُ غَوْراً فِي الْبَاطِلِ وَأَشَدُّ إقْدَاماً عَلَى السُّوءِ مِنّي
segments.transliteration: wa man ab-a'du ghaw-ran fil-baat'il wa ashad-du iq-daaman a'laas-sooo-i min-nee?
segments.translation: 52.Who sinks more deeply into falsehood and is more intensely audacious in evil than I?

segments.arabic: حِينَ أَقِفُ بَيْنَ دَعْوَتِكَ وَدَعْوَةِ الشَّيْطَانِ،
segments.transliteration: h'eena aqifu bay-na daa'-watika wa daa'-watish-shay-t'aani
segments.translation: 53.For I hesitate between Your call and the call of Satan

segments.arabic: فَـأتَّبعُ دَعْوَتَهُ عَلَى غَيْرِ عَمىً مِنّي فِيْ مَعْرِفَة بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: faat-tabiu' daa'-watahoo a'laa ghay-r a'mam-min-nee fee maa'-rifatim-bih
segments.translation: 54.and then follow his call without being blind in my knowledge of him

segments.arabic: وَلا نِسْيَان مِنْ حِفْظِي لَهُ وَأَنَا حِينَئِذ مُوقِنٌ
segments.transliteration: wa laa nis-yaanim-min h'if-z'ee lah wa ana h'eena-id'im-mooqinum
segments.translation: 55.or forgetful in my memory of him, while I am certain

segments.arabic: بِأَنَّ مُنْتَهَى دَعْوَتِكَ إلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمُنْتَهَى دَعْوَتِهِ إلَى النَّارِ
segments.transliteration: bianna muntahaa daa'-watika ilaal-jan-nah wa muntahaa daa'-watiheee ilaan-naar
segments.translation: 56.that Your call takes to the Garden and his call takes to the Fire!

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَعْجَبَ مَا أَشْهَدُ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: sub-h'aanaka maaa aa'-jaba maaa ash-hadu bihee
segments.translation: 57.Glory be to You! How marvellous the witness I bear

segments.arabic: عَلَى نَفْسِي وَاُعَدِّدُهُ مِنْ مَكْتُوْمِ أَمْرِي،
segments.transliteration: a'laa naf-see wa ua'd-diduhoo mim-mak-toomi am-ree?
segments.translation: 58.against my own soul and the enumeration of my own hidden affairs!

segments.transliteration: wa aa'-jabu min d'alika anaatuka a'n-nee
segments.translation: 59.And more marvellous than that is Your lack of haste with me,

segments.transliteration: wa ib-t'aaaw-uka a'm-mua'ajalatee wa lay-sa d'alika
segments.translation: 60.Your slowness in attending to me! That is not because I possess

segments.arabic: مِنْ كَرَمِي عَلَيْكَ بَلْ تَأَنِّياً مِنْكَ لِي،
segments.transliteration: min karamee a'lay-k bal taan-neeam-minka lee
segments.translation: 61.honour with You, but because You waitest patiently for me
62.and art bountiful toward me
63.that I may refrain from disobedience displeasing to You
64.and abstain from evil deeds that disgrace me,

segments.arabic: وَلاَِنَّ عَفْوَكَ عَنّي أَحَبُّ إلَيْكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa lian-na a'f-waka a'n-neee ah'ab-bu ilay-ka min u'qoobatee
segments.translation: 65.and because You lovest to pardon me more than to punish!

segments.arabic: بَلْ أَنَا يَا إلهِي أكْثَرُ ذُنُوباً
segments.transliteration: bal ana yaaa ilaahee ak'tha-ru d'unoobaa
segments.translation: 66.But I, my God, am more numerous in sins,

segments.transliteration: wa aq-bahoo aaathaaraa wa ash-nau' af-a'alaa
segments.translation: 67.uglier in footsteps, more repulsive in acts,
68.more reckless in rushing into falsehood,
69.weaker in awakening to Your obedience,
70.and less attentive and heedful toward Your threats,
71.than that I could number for You my faults
72.or have the power to recount my sins.

segments.arabic: وَإنَّمَا أُوبِّخُ بِهَذا نَفْسِي طَمَعَـاً فِي رَأْفَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa in-namaaa uwab-bikhu bihad'aa naf-see t'amaa'na fee raa-fatik
segments.translation: 73.I only scold my own soul, craving Your gentleness,
74.through which the affairs of sinners are set right,

segments.arabic: وَرَجَاءً لِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي بِهَا فَكَاكُ رِقَابِ الْخَاطِئِينَ.
segments.translation: 75.and hoping for Your mercy, through which the necks of the offenders are freed.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَهَذِهِ رَقَبَتِي قَدْ أَرَقَّتْهَا الذُّنُوبُ،
segments.translation: 76.O God, this is my neck, enslaved by sins,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَعْتِقْهَا بِعَفْوِكَ،
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wa aa'-tiq-haa bia'f-wik
segments.translation: 77.so bless Muhammad and his Household and release it through Your pardon!
78.This is my back, weighed down by offenses,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَخَفِّفْ عَنْهُ بِمَنِّكَ.
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wa khaf-fif a'n-hoo biman-nik
segments.translation: 79.so bless Muhammad and his Household and lighten it through Your kindness!

segments.arabic: يَا إلهِي لَوْ بَكَيْتُ إلَيْكَ حَتَّى تَسْقُطَ أَشْفَارُ عَيْنَيَّ ،
segments.transliteration: yaaa ilaahee law bakay-tu ilay-ka h'at-taa tas-qut'a ash-faaru a'y-nay
segments.translation: 80.My God, were I to weep to You until my eyelids drop off,
81.wail until my voice wears out,

segments.transliteration: wa qum-tu laka h'at-taa tatanash-shara qadamaay
segments.translation: 82.stand before You until my feet swell up,

segments.transliteration: wa rakaa'-tu laka h'at-taa yan-khalia' s'ul-bee
segments.translation: 83.bow to You until my backbone is thrown out of joint,

segments.transliteration: wa sajat-tu laka h'at-taa tatafaq-qaa h'adaqataay
segments.translation: 84.prostrate to You until my eyeballs fall out,
85.eat the dirt of the earth for my whole life,
86.drink the water of ashes till the end of my days,

segments.arabic: وَذَكَرْتُكَ فِي خِلاَلِ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَكِلَّ لِسَانِي
segments.transliteration: wa d'akar-tuka fee khilaali d'alika h'at-taa yakil-la lisaanee
segments.translation: 87.mention You through all of that until my tongue fails,

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ أَرْفَعْ طَرْفِي إلَى آفَاقِ السَّمَاءِ اسْتِحْيَاءً مِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: thum-ma lam ar-faa' t'ar-feee ilaaa aaafaaqis-samaaa-i as-tih'-yaaa-am-minka
segments.translation: 88.and not lift my glance to the sky's horizons in shame before You,

segments.arabic: مَا اسْتَوْجَبْتُ بِذَلِكَ مَحْوَ سَيِّئَة وَاحِـدَة مِنْ سَيِّئـاتِي،
segments.translation: 89.yet would I not merit through all of that the erasing of a single one of my evil deeds!

segments.arabic: وَإنْ كُنْتَ تَغْفِـرُ لِي حِيْنَ أَسْتَوْجِبُ مَغْفِرَتَكَ
segments.transliteration: wa in kunt tagh-firu lee h'eena as-taw-jibu magh-firatak
segments.translation: 90.Though You forgivest me when I merit Your forgiveness

segments.transliteration: wa taa'-foo a'n-nee h'eena as-tah'iq-qu a'f-wak
segments.translation: 91.and pardonest me when I deserve Your pardon,

segments.arabic: فَإنَّ ذَلِكَ غَيْرُ وَاجِب لِيْ بِاسْتِحْقَاق،
segments.transliteration: fa in-na d'alika ghay-ru waajibil-lee bis-tih'-qaaqiw
segments.translation: 92.yet I have no title to that through what I deserve,
93.nor am I worthy of it through merit,

segments.arabic: إذْ كَـانَ جَزَائِي مِنْكَ فِي أَوَّلِ مَا عَصَيْتُكَ النَّارَ;
segments.transliteration: id' kaana jazaaa-ee minka feee aw-wali maa a's'ay-tukan-naar
segments.translation: 94.since my repayment from You from the first that I disobeyed You is the Fire!

segments.arabic: فَإنْ تُعَذِّبْنِي، فَأَنْتَ غَيْرُ ظَالِم لِيْ.
segments.transliteration: fa in tua'd'-d'ib-nee fa anta ghay-ru z'aalimil-lee
segments.translation: 95.So if You punishest me, You dost me no wrong.

segments.arabic: إلهِي فَـإذْ قَـدْ تَغَمَّـدْتَنِي بِسِتْـرِكَ فَلَمْ تَفْضَحْنِي
segments.transliteration: ilaahee faad' qad-tagham-mat-tanee bisit-rika falam taf-z''ah'-nee
segments.translation: 96.My God, since You hast shielded me with Your covering and not exposed me,
97.waited patiently for me through Your generosity, and not hurried me to punishment,

segments.arabic: َو حَلُمْتَ عَنِّي بِتَفَضُّلِكَ فَلَمْ تُغَيِّـرْ نِعْمَتَـكَ عَلَيَّ،
segments.transliteration: wa h'alum-ta a'n-nee bitafaz''-z''ulika falam tughay-yir nia'-mataka a'lay-ya
segments.translation: 98.and shown me clemency through Your bounty, and not changed Your favour upon me
99.or muddied Your kindly acts toward me,

segments.arabic: فَارْحَمْ طُولَ تَضَرُّعِيْ وَشِـدَّةَ مَسْكَنَتِي وَسُوءَ مَوْقِفِيْ.
segments.transliteration: far-h'am t'oola taz''ar-rue'e wa shid-data mas-kanatee wa sooo-a maw-qifee
segments.translation: 100.have mercy on my drawn out pleading, my intense misery, and my evil situation!
101.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
102.protect me from acts of disobedience, employ me in obedience,
103.provide me with excellent turning back [to You], purify me through repentance,
104.strengthen me through preservation from sin, set me right through well being,
105.let me taste the sweetness of forgiveness,

segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-nee t'aleeqa a'f-wika wa a'teeqa rah'-matik
segments.translation: 106.make me the freedman of Your pardon and the slave released by Your mercy,
107.and write for me a security from Your displeasure!

segments.arabic: وَبَشِّرْنِي بِذلِكَ فِي الْعَاجِلِ دُونَ الآجِلِ بُشْرى أَعْرِفُهَا
segments.transliteration: wa bash-shir-nee bid'alika fil-a'ajili doonal-aaajili bush-raaa aa'-rifuhaa
segments.translation: 108.Give me the good news of that in the immediate, not the deferred - a good news I recognize -
109.and make known to me therein a sign which I may clearly see!

segments.arabic: إنَّ ذلِكَ لاَ يَضيقُ عَلَيْكَ فِي وُسْعِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: in-na d'alik laa yaz''eequ a'lay-ka fee wus-i'k
segments.translation: 110.That will not constrain You in Your plenty,
111.distress You in Your power,
112.ascend beyond Your lack of haste,

segments.arabic: وَلا يَؤودُك فِي جَزِيلِ هِباتِكَ الَّتِي دَلَّتْ عَلَيْهَا آيَاتُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laa yaw-uduka fee jazeeli hibaatikal-latee dal-lat a'lay-haaa aaayaatuk
segments.translation: 113.or tire You in Your great gifts, which are pointed to by Your signs.

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ تَفْعَلُ مَا تَشَاءُ وَتَحكُمُ مَا تُرِيدُ،
segments.transliteration: in-naka taf-a'lu maa tashaaa- wa tah'-kumu maa tureed
segments.translation: 114.Verily You dost what You wilt, You decreest what You desirest.
115."Thou art powerful over everything". (3:26)

segments.arabic: وَعَلَى الْوَهْنِ بَنَيْتَنَا ، وَمِنْ ماُءٌُِِ مَهِين ابْتَدَأتَنَا ،
segments.translation: 14.built us up from feebleness, and began us from a mean water;

segments.arabic: فَلاَ حَوْلَ لَنَا  إلاّ بِقُوَّتِكَ وَلا قُوَّةَ لَنَا إلاّ بِعَونِِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: falaa h'aw-la lanaaa il-laa biqoo-watik wa laa qoo-wata lanaaa il-laa biqoo-watika
segments.translation: 15.we have no force except through Your strength and no strength except through Your help.
16.So confirm us by giving us success, point us the right way by Your pointing,

segments.arabic: وَأعْمِ أَبْصَارَ قُلُوبِنَا عَمَّا خَالَفَ مَحَبَّتَكَ
segments.transliteration: wa aa'-mi ab-s'aara quloobinaa a'm-maa khaalafa mah'b-batak
segments.translation: 17.blind the eyes of our hearts toward everything opposed to Your love,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَجْعَلْ لِشَيْء مِنْ جَوَارِحِنَا نُفُوذاً فِي مَعْصِيَتِكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-a'l-lishay-im-min jawaarih'inaa nufood'an fee maa'-s'eeatik
segments.translation: 18.and set not in any of our limbs passage to disobeying You!
19.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
20.and assign the whisperings of our hearts, the movements of our members,

segments.arabic: وَلَمَحَاتِ أَعْيُنِنَا ، وَلَهَجَاتِ ألسِنَتِنَا فِيْ مُوجِبَاتِ ثَوَابِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa lamah'aati aa'-yuninaa wa lahajaati al-sinatinaa fee moojibaati thawaabik
segments.translation: 21.the glances of our eyes, and the idioms of our tongues, to that which makes incumbent Your reward,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ تَفُوتَنَا حَسَنَةٌ نَسْتَحِقُّ بِهَا جَزَآءَكَ ،
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa laa tafootanaa h'asanatun-nas-tah'iq-qu bihaa jazaaa-ak
segments.translation: 22.lest a good deed slip by us, through which we might deserve Your repayment,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَبْقَى لَنَا سَيِّئـةٌ نَسْتَوْجِبُ بِهَا عِقَابَكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa tab-qaa lanaa say-yi-atun-nas-taw-jibu bihaa i'qaabak
segments.translation: 23.or an evil deed remain with us, by which we might merit Your punishment!

segments.translation: And we seek refuge in You from the greatest regret

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَيَجَـانِ الْحِرْصِ ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-neee au'wd'u bika min- hayajaanil-h'ir-s'
segments.translation: 1.O God, I seek refuge in You from the agitation of craving,

segments.arabic: وَسَوْرَةِ الغَضَبِ وَغَلَبَةِ الْحَسَدِ وضَعْفِ الصَّبْرِ
segments.transliteration: wa saw-ratil-ghaz''ab wa ghalabatil-h'asad wa z''aa'-fis'-s'ab-r
segments.translation: 2.the violence of wrath, the domination of envy, the frailty of patience,
3.the lack of contentment, surliness of character,
4.urgency of passion, the disposition to vehemence,
5.following caprice, opposing guidance,
6.the sleep of heedlessness, undertaking the toilsome,

segments.arabic: وَإيْثَارِ الْبَاطِلِ عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَالإصْرَارِ عَلَى الْمَأثَمِ ،
segments.translation: 7.preferring falsehood over truth, persisting in sin,
8.making little of disobedience, making much of obedience,
9.Vying with the wealthy, showing contempt tothe poor,
10.guarding badly over those in our hands,

segments.arabic: وَتَرْكِ الشُّكْرِ لِمَنِ اصْطَنَعَ الْعَارِفَةَ عِنْدَنَا ،
segments.translation: 11.failing to thank those who have done good to us,

segments.arabic: أَوْ أَنْ نَعْضُدَ ظَالِماً ، أَوْ نَخْذُلَ مَلْهُوفاً ،
segments.transliteration: aw an-naa'-z''uda z'aalimaa aw nakh-d'ula mal-hoofaa
segments.translation: 12.aiding a wrongdoer, abandoning someone troubled,

segments.arabic: أَوْ نَرُومَ مَا لَيْسَ لَنَا بِحَقّ،
segments.transliteration: aw narooma maa lay-sa lanaa bih'aqqan
segments.translation: 13.wanting what is not rightfully ours,

segments.translation: 14.and speaking about knowledge without knowing.

segments.arabic: وَنَعُـوذُ بِـكَ أَنْ نَنْطَوِيَ عَلَى غِشِّ أَحَد ،
segments.transliteration: wa nau'wd'u bika an-nant'aweea a'laa ghish-shi ah'ad
segments.translation: 15.We seek refuge in You from harbouring dishonesty toward anyone,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ نُعْجَبَ بِأَعْمَالِنَا ، وَنَمُدَّ فِي آمَالِنَا ،
segments.transliteration: wa an-nua'-jiba bia'-maalinaa wa namud-da feee aaamaalinaa
segments.translation: 16.being pleased with our works, and stretching out our expectations.

segments.arabic: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سُوءِ السَّرِيرَةِ ، وَاحْتِقَارِ الصَّغِيرَةِ ،
segments.transliteration: wa nau'wd'u bika min sooo-is-sareerah wa ah'-tiqaaris'-s'agheerah
segments.translation: 17.We seek refuge in You from ill-mindedness, looking down on the small,
18.Satan's gaining mastery over us,

segments.arabic: أَوْ يَنْكُبَنَـا الزَّمَانُ ، أَوْ يَتَهَضَّمَنَا السُّلْطَانُ.
segments.translation: 19.time's afflicting us, and the sovereign's oppressing us.

segments.arabic: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ تَنَاوُلِ الإسْرَافِ ، وَمِنْ فِقْدَانِ الْكَفَـافِ
segments.transliteration: wa nau'wd'u bika min tanaawulil-is-raaf wa min fiq-daanil-kafaaf
segments.translation: 20.We seek refuge in You from acting with prodigality and not having sufficiency.

segments.arabic: وَنَعُوذُ بِـكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الأَعْدَاءِ وَمِنَ الْفَقْرِ إلَى الاَكْفَاءِ
segments.transliteration: wa nau'wd'u bika min shamaatatil-aa'-daaa-i wa minal-faq-ri ilaal-ak-faaa-i
segments.translation: 21.We seek refuge in You from the gloating of enemies, indigent need for equals,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ مَعِيشَة فِي شِدَّة وَمَيْتَة عَلَى غَيْـرِ عُدَّة.
segments.transliteration: wa mim-mae'eshatin fee shid-dah wa meetatin a'laa ghay-ri u'd-dah
segments.translation: 22.living in hardship, and dying without readiness.
23.We seek refuge in You from the most dreadful remorse,

segments.arabic: وَالْمُصِيبَةِ الْكُبْرَى ، وَأَشْقَى الشَّقَآءِ وَسُوءِ المآبِ ،
segments.translation: 24.the greatest affliction, the most wretched wretchedness, the evil end to the journey,
25.the deprivation of reward, and the advent of punishment.
26.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.transliteration: wa ai'd'-nee min kul-li d'alika birah'-matika
segments.translation: 27.and through Your mercy, give to me refuge from all of that,
28.and to all the faithful, both men and women!
29.O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: يَامَنْ لاَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ أَنْبَآءُ الْمُتَظَلِّمِينَ
segments.translation: 1.O He from whom is not concealed news of the aggrieved!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَحْتَاجُ فِي قِصَصِهِمْ إلَى شَهَادَاتِ الشَّاهِدِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa yah'-taaju fee qas'as'ihim ilaa shahaadaatish-shaahideen
segments.translation: 2.O He who has no need to be told about them by the witnessing of the witnesses!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ قَرُبَتْ نُصْرَتُهُ مِنَ الْمَظْلُومِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man qarubat nus'-ratuhoo minal-maz'-loomeen
segments.translation: 3.O He who whose help is near to the wronged!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ بَعُدَ عَوْنُهُ عَنِ الظَّالِمِينَ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mam-bau'da a'w-nuhoo a'niz'-z'aalimeen qad a'lim-ta
segments.translation: 4.O He whose aid is far from the wrongdoers! You knowest,

segments.arabic: يَا إلهِي  مَا نالَنِي مِنْ [فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَن] مِمَّا حَظَرْتَ
segments.transliteration: yaaa ilaahee maa naalanee min (fulaani ibn fulaanin) mim-maa h'az'ar-ta
segments.translation: 5.my God, how so-and-so, son of so-and-so, has harmed me in that which You hast forbidden,

segments.arabic: وَانْتَهَكَهُ مِنّي مِمَّا حَجَزْتَ عَلَيْهِ بَطَراً فِي نِعْمَتِكَ عِنْدَهُ وَاغْتِرَاراً بِنَكِيرِكَ عَلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: wantahakahoo min-nee mim-maa h'ajaz-ta a'lay-h bat'aran fee nia'-matika i'ndah wagh-tiraaram-binakeerika a'lay-h
segments.translation: 6.and how he has violated me in that which You hast prohibited, showing thereby ingratitude toward Your favour upon him and delusion concerning what You hast denied him.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
segments.translation: 7.O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَخُذْ ظَالِمِي وَعَدُوِّي عَنْ ظُلْمِي بِقُوَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa khuz'-z'aalimee wa a'doo-wee a'n z'ul-mee biqoo-watik
segments.translation: 8.keep my wrongdoing enemy from wronging me through Your strength,

segments.arabic: وَافْلُلْ حَدَّهُ عَنِّي بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَاجْعَلْ لَهُ
segments.translation: 9.blunt his blade toward me through Your power, and assign to him

segments.arabic: شُغْلاً فِيَما يَلِيهِ وَعَجْزاً عَمَّا يُناوِيْهِ
segments.transliteration: shugh-lan feemaa yaleeh w a'j-zan a'm-maa yunaaweeh
segments.translation: 10.a diversion in that which is close to him and the inability to reach his enemy!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 11.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُسَوِّغْ لَهُ ظُلْمِي وَأَحْسِنْ عَلَيْـهِ عَوْنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tusaw-wigh lahoo z'ul-mee wa ah'-sin a'lay-hee a'w-nee
segments.translation: 12.let the wrongdoer not find it easy to wrong me, give me good help against him,

segments.arabic: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ مِثْـلِ أَفْعَالِهِ، وَلا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي مِثْلِ حَالِهِ.
segments.transliteration: waa'-s'im-nee mim-mith-li af-a'alih wa laa taj-a'l-nee fee mith-li h'aalih
segments.translation: 13.preserve me from the like of his acts, and place me not in the like of his situation!
14.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَعِدْنِي عَلَيْهِ عَدْوى حَاضِرَةً  تَكُونُ مِنْ غَيْظِي بِهِ شِفَاءً،
segments.transliteration: wa ai'd-nee a'lay-hee a'd-wana h'aaz''iratan takoonu  min ghay-z'ee bihee shifaaa
segments.translation: 15.and assist me with an immediate assistance that will heal my rage toward him
16.and redeem my fury toward him!
17.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa a'w-wiz''-nee min z'ul-mihee lee a'f-wak
segments.translation: 18.compensate me for his wronging me with Your pardon

segments.transliteration: wa ab-dil-nee bisooo-i s'aneei'hee bee rah'-matak
segments.translation: 19.and replace his evil action toward me with Your mercy,
20.for every detested thing less than Your anger is slight
21.and every disaster next to Your rancour indifferent!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا كَـرَّهْتَ إلَيَّ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ فَقِنِي مِنْ أَنْ أُظْلَمَ.
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma fakamaa kar-rah-ta ilay-ya an uz'-lama faqinee min an az'-lim
segments.translation: 22.O God, just as You hast made me detest being wronged, so also protect me from doing wrong!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ أَشْكُو إلَى أَحَد سِوَاكَ،
segments.transliteration: sll-lahum-ma laaa ashkooo ilaaa ah'adin siwaak
segments.translation: 23.O God, I complain to no one but You,

segments.transliteration: wa laaa as-tae'enu bih'aakimin ghay-rik h'aashaak
segments.translation: 24.and I seek help from no ruler other than You - how could I?
25.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَصِلْ دُعَائِي بِالإِجَابَةِ، وَأَقْرِنْ شِكَايَتِي بِالتَّغْيِيرِ.
segments.transliteration: wa s'il dua'aa-ee bil-ijaabah waq-rin shikaayatee bit-tagh-yeer
segments.translation: 26.join my supplication to response, and unite my complaint with change!

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ لا تَفْتِنِّي بِالْقُنُوطِ مِنْ إنْصَافِكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma laa taf-tin-nee bil-qunoot'i min ins'aafik
segments.translation: 27.O God, tempt me not with despair of Your just treatment

segments.transliteration: wa laa taf-tin-hoo bil-am-ni min inkaarik
segments.translation: 28.and tempt him not with feeling secure from Your disapproval,

segments.transliteration: fayus'ir-ra a'laa z'ul-mee wa yuh'aas'iranee bih'aq-qee
segments.translation: 29.lest he persist in wronging me and constrain me in my rights.

segments.arabic: وَعَرِّفْهُ عَمَّا قَلِيْل مَا أَوْعَدْتَ الظَّالِمِينَ،
segments.translation: 30.Let him soon recognize what You hast promised the wrongdoers

segments.arabic: وَعَرِّفْنِي مَا وَعَدْتَ مِنْ إجَابَةِ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ.
segments.transliteration: wa a'r-rif-nee maa waa't-ta min ijaabatil-muz''-t'ar-reen
segments.translation: 31.and let me recognize Your promised response to the distressed!
32.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنِي لِقَبُولِ مَا قَضَيْتَ لِيْ وَعَليَّ،
segments.transliteration: wa waf-fiq-nee liqabooli maa qaz''ay-ta lee wa a'lay
segments.translation: 33.give me success in accepting Your decrees for me and against me,

segments.transliteration: wa raz''-z''inee bimaaa akhad'-ta lee wa min-nee
segments.translation: 34.make me pleased with what You takest for me and from me,

segments.arabic: وَاهْـدِنِي لِلَّتِيْ هِي أَقْوَمُ وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِمَا هُوَ أَسْلَمُ.
segments.transliteration: wah-dinee lil-latee heea aq-wam was-taa'-mil-nee bimaa huwa as-lam
segments.translation: 35.guide me to that which is most upright and employ me in that which is safest!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كَانَتِ الْخِيَرَةُ لِيْ عِنْدَكَ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa in kaanatil-kheearatu lee i'ndaka
segments.translation: 36.O God, if the best for me with You lies

segments.arabic: فِي تَأْخِيرِ الأَخْذِ لِي وَتَرْكِ الانْتِقَامِ
segments.translation: 37.in delaying the taking to task for my sake of him

segments.arabic: مِمَّنْ ظَلَمَنِيْ إلَى يَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ وَمَجْمَعِ الْخَصْمِ،
segments.transliteration: mim-man z'alamaneee ilaa yaw-mil-fas'-li wa maj-mai'l-khas'-m
segments.translation: 38.who has wronged me and in refraining from vengeance toward him until the Day of Decision and the Gathering of Disputants,
39.then bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَيِّدْنِي مِنْكَ بِنِيَّة صَادِقَة وَصَبْر دَائِم،
segments.transliteration: wa ay-yid-nee minka binee-yatin s'aadiqatiw-wa s'ab-rin daaa-im
segments.translation: 40.strengthen me from You with true intention and lasting patience,

segments.arabic: وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ سُوءِ الرَّغْبَةِ، وَهَلَعِ أَهْلِ الْحِرْصِ،
segments.transliteration: wa ai'd'-nee min sooo-ir-ragh-bati wa halai' ah-lil-h'ir-s'
segments.translation: 41.give me refuge from evil desire and the impatience of the greedy

segments.arabic: وَصَوِّرْ فِي قَلْبِي مِثَالَ مَا ادَّخَـرْتَ لِي مِنْ ثَوَابِـكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa s'aw-wir fee qal-bee mithaala mad-dakhar-ta lee min thawaabika
segments.translation: 42.and form in my heart the image of Your reward

segments.transliteration: wa aa'-dat-ta likhas'-mee min jazaaa-ika wai'qaabik
segments.translation: 43.which You hast stored away for me and the repayment and punishment

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ سَبَباً لِقَنَاعَتِي بِمَا قَضَيْتَ ،
segments.translation: 44.which You has prepared for my disputant! Make this a cause of my contentment with what You hast decreed

segments.arabic: وَثِقَتِي بِمَا تَخَيَّرْتَ، آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ ،
segments.transliteration: wa thiqatee bimaa takhay-yar-t aaameena rab-bal-a'alameen
segments.translation: 45.and my trust in what You hast chosen! Amen, Lord of the worlds!

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ  الْعَظِيمِ ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ .
segments.transliteration: in-naka d'ool-faz''-lil-a'z'eem wa anta a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer
segments.translation: 46.You art of bounty abounding and You art powerful over everything.
