title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 49 Repelling trickery of enemies

segments.translation: My God, You guided me, yet I indulged (in heedlessness),
and You admonished, yet I hardened (my heart),
and You showed beautiful favour, yet I disobeyed,
Then I knew what You had issued (the warning)?
When You made me know it, I sought forgiveness, and You overlooked (my fault), yet I returned (to sin),
and You concealed (my fault), so for You, my God, is the praise.
I plunged into the valleys of perdition,

segments.arabic: وَحَلَلْتُ شِعَابَ تَلَف تَعَرَّضْتُ فِيهَا لِسَطَوَاتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-á¸¥alaltu shiâÄba talaf taâarraá¸tu fÄ«hÄ li-saá¹­awÄtik,
segments.translation: and I settled in the passes of ruin, where I exposed myself to Your assaults,
and to the descent of Your punishments by settling in them,
And my means (of approach) to You is Monotheism (at-tawá¸¥Ä«d),

segments.arabic: وَذَرِيْعَتِي أَنِّي لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِكَ شَيْئاً،
segments.transliteration: wa-dharÄ«âatÄ« annÄ« lam ushrik bik shayâÄ,
segments.translation: and my plea is that I did not associate anything with You,
and I did not take any god alongside You,
and I have fled to You with myself,
and to You is the escape of the one who does wrong,
and the refuge of the one who wasted his own portion, the refugee.

segments.arabic: فَكَمْ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ انْتَضى عَلَيَّ سَيْفَ عَدَاوَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Fa-kam min âaduwwin antaá¸Ä âalayya sayfa âadÄwatih,
segments.translation: So how many an enemy has unsheathed his sword of enmity against me,
and sharpened the blade of his knife for me,
and made keen the sharpness of its edge for me,
and mixed the deadly poisons of his venom for me,
and aimed the accurate shots of his arrows at me,
and the eye of his guard did not sleep concerning me,

segments.arabic: وَأَضْمَرَ أَنْ يَسُومَنِي الْمَكْرُوهَ وَيُجَرِّ عَنِّي زُعَافَ مَرَارَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-aá¸mara an yasÅ«manÄ« l-makrÅ«h wa-yujarri âannÄ« zuâÄfa marÄratih,
segments.translation: and he intended to impose evil upon me and to make me swallow the deadly bitterness of his venom â

segments.arabic: فَنَظَرْتَ يا إلهِيْ إلَى ضَعْفِي عَنِ احْتِمَـالِ الْفَـوَادِحِ،
segments.transliteration: fa-naáºarta yÄ IlÄhÄ« ilÄ á¸aâfÄ« âani á¸¥timÄli l-fawÄdiá¸¥,
segments.translation: Then You looked, O my God, at my weakness in bearing the calamities,

segments.arabic: وَعَجْزِي عَنِ الانْتِصَارِ مِمَّنْ قَصَدَنِيْ بِمُحَارَبَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-âajzÄ« âani l-intiá¹£Äri mimman qaá¹£adanÄ« bi-muá¸¥Ärabaith,
segments.translation: and my incapacity to defend myself against the one who intended to make war on me,

segments.arabic: وَوَحْدَتِي فِي كَثِيرِ عَدَدِ مَنْ نَاوَانِيْ
segments.transliteration: wa-waá¸¥datÄ« fÄ« kathÄ«ri âadadi man nÄwÄnÄ«
segments.translation: and my solitude amid the large number of those who showed me hostility

segments.arabic: وَأَرْصَدَ لِيْ بِالْبَلاءِ فِيمَا لَمْ أُعْمِلْ فِيهِ فِكْرِي،
segments.transliteration: wa-ará¹£ada lÄ« bi-l-balÄâ fÄ«mÄ lam uâmil fÄ«hi fikrÄ«,
segments.translation: and lay in wait for me with tribulation in a matter in which I did not employ my thoughtâ
So You began by granting me Your help,
and You strengthened my back with Your power,
Then You blunted his edge for me,

segments.arabic: وَصَيَّرْتَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ جَمْع عَدِيْد وَحْدَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa-á¹£ayartahÅ« min baâdi jamâin âadÄ«d waá¸¥dah,
segments.translation: and You made him, after a large gathering, stand alone,
and You raised my heel above him (gave me victory over him),
and You made what he aimed return upon him,
So You drove him back without his having satisfied his rage,
and without his heat of thirst being quenched,
he bit his lips,
and he turned away in retreat, his expeditions having failed.
And how many an oppressor sought to oppress me with his plots,
and set up the net of his traps for me,
and assigned to me the checking of his vigilance,
and lay in wait for me like a wild beast for its quarry,
waiting to seize the opportunity for his prey,
while he displayed to me the cheerfulness of flattery,
and looked at me with intense wrathâ

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ يَا إلهِي تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ دَغَلْ سَرِيرَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: fa-lammÄ raâayta yÄ IlÄhÄ« tabÄrakta wa-taâÄlayta daghala sarÄ«ratih,
segments.translation: So when You saw, O my Godâblessed and exalted be Youâthe corruption of his inner being,

segments.arabic: وَقُبْحَ مَا انْطَوى عَلَيْهِ، أَرْكَسْتَهُ لاُِمِّ رَأْسِهِ فِي زُبْيَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-qubá¸¥a mÄ ná¹­awÄ âalayh, arkastahÅ« li-umm rÄâsihÄ« fÄ« zubyatih,
segments.translation: and the foulness of what he concealed, You made him fall headlong into his own pit,
and You turned him back into the downfall of his own hole,

segments.arabic: فَانْقَمَعَ بَعْدَ اسْتِطَالَتِهِ ذَلِيلاً فِي رِبَقِ حِبالتِهِ
segments.transliteration: fa-nqamaâa baâda stiá¹­ÄlatihÄ« dhalÄ«lan fÄ« ribaq á¸¥ibÄlatih
segments.translation: So he was humbled after his aggression, disgraced in the snares of his own trap

segments.arabic: الَّتِي كَانَ يُقَدِّرُ أَنْ يَرَانِي فِيهَا،
segments.transliteration: allatÄ« kÄna yuqaddir an yarÄnÄ« fÄ«hÄ,
segments.translation: in which he intended to see me,

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ كَادَ أَنْ يَحُلَّ بِيْ لَوْلاَ رَحْمَتُكَ مَا حَلَّ بِسَاحَتِهِ.
segments.transliteration: wa-qad kÄda an yaá¸¥ulla bÄ« lawlÄ raá¸¥matuka mÄ á¸¥alla bi-sÄá¸¥atih.
segments.translation: and what befell his courtyard had nearly fallen upon me, were it not for Your mercy.

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ حَاسِد قَدْ شَرِقَ بِي بِغُصَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa-kam min á¸¥Äsidin qad shariqa bÄ« bi-ghuá¹£á¹£atih,
segments.translation: And how many an envier (á¸¥Äsid) has choked on account of me with his grief,

segments.arabic: وَشَجِيَ مِنِّي بِغَيْظِهِ، وَسَلَقَنِي بِحَدِّ لِسَانِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-shajÄ« minnÄ« bi-ghayáºih, wa-salaqanÄ« bi-á¸¥addi lisÄnih,
segments.translation: and suffered on my account with his rage, and stung me with the sharpness of his tongue,
and vexed me by slandering my faults,
and made my honour a target for his aims,
and accused me of qualities that were never absent from him,
and vexed me with his guile, and intended me with his plotâ
So I called upon You, O my God, seeking help in You,
confident in the swiftness of Your response,

segments.arabic: عَالِماً أَنَّهُ لاَ يُضْطَهَدُ مَنْ آوى إلَى ظِلِّ كَنَفِكَ،
segments.transliteration: âÄliman annahÅ« lÄ yuá¸á¹­ahadu man ÄwÄ ilÄ áºilli kanafika,
segments.translation: knowing that no one who takes shelter under the shadow of Your protection will be wronged,

segments.translation: and no one who seeks refuge in the stronghold of Your help will be terrifiedâ
So You fortified me against his malice with Your power.

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ سَحَائِبِ مَكْرُوه جَلَّيْتَهَا عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: Wa-kam min saá¸¥Äâibi makrÅ«hin jallaytahÄ âannÄ«,
segments.translation: And how many clouds of detestable things You cleared away from me,
and clouds of blessings You showered upon me,
and streams of mercy You spread,
and well-being You clothed me in, and eyes of calamities You blinded,
and overpowering distresses You removed,

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ ظَنٍّ حَسَن حَقَّقْتَ، وَعَدَم جَبَرْتَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-kam min áºannin á¸¥asanin á¸¥aqqaqt, wa-âadamin jabart,
segments.translation: And how many a good expectation You fulfilled, and a lack You remedied,
and a fall You revived, and wretchedness You transformedâ
All of that being favour and bestowal from You,

segments.arabic: وَفِي جَمِيعِهِ انْهِمَاكاً مِنِّي عَلَى مَعَاصِيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-fÄ« jamÄ«âihÄ« inhimÄkan minnÄ« âalÄ maâÄá¹£Ä«k,
segments.translation: while in all of it, I was absorbed in Your acts of disobedience,

segments.arabic: لَمْ تَمْنَعْكَ إساءَتِي عَنْ إتْمَامِ إحْسَانِكَ،
segments.transliteration: lam tamnaâk isÄâatÄ« âan itmÄmi iá¸¥sÄnik,
segments.translation: My wrongdoing did not prevent You from completing Your benevolence,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَجَرَنِي ذالِكَ عَنِ ارْتِكَابِ مَسَاخِطِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ á¸¥ajaranÄ« dhÄlik âani rtikÄbi masÄkhiá¹­ik,
segments.translation: and that did not restrain me from committing Your displeasing acts,

segments.arabic: لاَ تُسْأَلُ عَمَّا تَفْعَلُ، وَلَقَدْ سُئِلْتَ فَأَعْطَيْتَ،
segments.transliteration: lÄ tusâalu âammÄ tafâal, wa-laqad suâilta fa-aâá¹­ayt,
segments.translation: You are not questioned about what You do, and You were asked, and You gave,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ تُسْأَلْ فابْتَدَأْتَ، وَاسْتُمِيحَ فَضْلُكَ فَمَا أَكْدَيْتَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-lam tusâal fa-btadaât, wa-stumÄ«á¸¥a faá¸luk fa-mÄ akdayt,
segments.translation: and You were not asked, and You initiated, and Your favour was sought, and You did not failâ
You refused, O my Master, except to show benevolence,
and bestowal of grace, and granting of favour, and blessing,
and I refused except to plunge into violation of Your sanctities,
and transgression of Your bounds, and heedlessness of Your threat.

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ إلهِي مِنْ مُقْتَدِر لاَ يُغْلَبُ،
segments.transliteration: Fa-laka l-á¸¥amdu IlÄhÄ« min muqtadirin lÄ yughlab,
segments.translation: So for You is the praise, O my God, as the One who is Powerful, Who is not overcome,
and the One Possessing Deliberation, Who does not hasten.

segments.arabic: هَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ بِسبوغِ النِّعَمِ،
segments.transliteration: HÄdhÄ maqÄmu mani âtarafa bi-subÅ«gh i-n-niâam,
segments.translation: This is the station of one who acknowledged the fullness of blessings,

segments.arabic: وَقَابَلَهَا بِالتَّقْصِيرِ، وَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّضْيِيْعِ.
segments.transliteration: wa-qÄbalahÄ bi-t-taqá¹£Ä«r, wa-shahida âalÄ nafsihÄ« bi-t-taá¸yÄ«â.
segments.translation: and met them with deficiency, and bore witness against himself of wasting (them).

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ فَإنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِالْمُحَمَّدِيَّةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumm fa-innÄ« ataqarrabu ilayk bi-l-Muá¸¥ammadiyyati r-rafÄ«âah,
segments.translation: O God, truly I draw near to You by the lofty Muá¸¥ammadiyyah (the path/status of Muá¸¥ammad),
and the radiant âAlawiyyah (the path/status of âAlÄ«), and I turn to You through them both,

segments.arabic: تُعِيذَنِيْ مِنْ شَرِّ [كَذَا وَكَذَا] فَإنَّ ذَالِكَ
segments.transliteration: tuâÄ«dhanÄ« min sharr [kadhÄ wa-kadhÄ] fa-inna dhÄlik
segments.translation: (asking that) You grant me refuge from the evil of [such and such], for truly that
does not strain You in Your richness,
and it does not weary You in Your power,
and You have power over everything,

segments.arabic: فَهَبْ لِي يا إلهِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَدَوَامِ تَوْفِيقِكَ،
segments.transliteration: fa-hab lÄ« yÄ IlÄhÄ« min raá¸¥matik wa-dawÄmi tawfÄ«qik,
segments.translation: So grant me, O my God, from Your mercy and the lastingness of Your enabling (tawfÄ«q),

segments.arabic: مَا أَتَّخِذُهُ سُلَّماً أَعْرُجُ بِهِ إلى رِضْوَانِكَ،
segments.transliteration: mÄ attakhidhuhÅ« sullaman aâruju bihÄ« ilÄ riá¸wÄnik,
segments.translation: that which I may take as a ladder by which I may ascend to Your good pleasure,

segments.arabic: وَآمَنُ بِهِ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: wa-Ämanu bihÄ« min âiqÄbik, yÄ Ará¸¥ama r-RÄá¸¥imÄ«n.
segments.translation: and by which I may be safe from Your punishment, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones.
1.My God, You guided me but I diverted myself,
2.You admonished me but my heart became hardened,
3.You tried me graciously but I disobeyed.
4.Then, when You caused me to know it, I came to know that from
5.which You hadst turned [me] away, so I prayed forgiveness and You released, and I returned
6.and You covered over. So Thine, my God, is the praise!
7.I plunged into the valleys of destruction

segments.arabic: وَحَلَلْتُ شِعَابَ تَلَف تَعَرَّضْتُ فِيهَا لِسَطَوَاتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa h'alal-tu shia'aba talaf taa'r-raz''-tu feehaa lisat'awaatik
segments.translation: 8.and settled in the ravines of ruin, exposing myself to Your chastisements
9.and the descent of Your punishments!
10.My mediation with You is the profession of Unity,

segments.arabic: وَذَرِيْعَتِي أَنِّي لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِكَ شَيْئاً،
segments.transliteration: wa d'areea'teee an-nee lam ush-rik bika shay-aa
segments.translation: 11.my way of coming to You that I associate nothing with You,
12.nor do I take along with You a god;
13.I have fled to You with my soul -
14.in You is the place of flight for the evildoer,
15.the place of escape for him who has squandered the share of his soul and seeks asylum.

segments.arabic: فَكَمْ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ انْتَضى عَلَيَّ سَيْفَ عَدَاوَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: fakam min a'dooin intaz''aa a'lay-ya say-fa a'daawatih
segments.translation: 16.How many an enemy has unsheathed the sword of his enmity toward me,
17.honed the cutting edge of his knife for me,
18.sharpened the tip of his blade for me,
19.mixed his killing potions for me,
20.pointed toward me his straight-flying arrows,

segments.transliteration: wa lam tanam a'n-nee a'y-nu h'iraasatih
segments.translation: 21.not allowed the eye of his watchfulness to sleep toward me,

segments.arabic: وَأَضْمَرَ أَنْ يَسُومَنِي الْمَكْرُوهَ وَيُجَرِّ عَنِّي زُعَافَ مَرَارَتِهِ ،
segments.transliteration: wa az''-mara ay-yasoomaneel-mak-rooh wa yujar-ria'nee zua'aqa maraaratih
segments.translation: 22.and secretly thought of visiting me with something hateful and making me gulp down the bitter water of his bile!

segments.arabic: فَنَظَرْتَ يا إلهِيْ إلَى ضَعْفِي عَنِ احْتِمَـالِ الْفَـوَادِحِ ،
segments.transliteration: fanaz'ar-ta yaaa ilaaheee ilaa z''aa'-fee a'ni ah'-timaalil-fawaadih'
segments.translation: 23.So You looked my God, at my weakness in bearing oppressive burdens,

segments.arabic: وَعَجْزِي عَنِ الانْتِصَارِ مِمَّنْ قَصَدَنِيْ بِمُحَارَبَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa a'j-zee a'nilints'aari mim-man qas'adanee bimuh'aarabatih
segments.translation: 24.my inability to gain victory over him who aims to war against me,

segments.arabic: وَوَحْدَتِي فِي كَثِيرِ عَدَدِ مَنْ نَاوَانِيْ
segments.transliteration: wa wah'-datee fee katheeri a'dadi man-naawaanee
segments.translation: 25.and my being alone before the great numbers of him who is hostile toward me

segments.arabic: وَأَرْصَدَ لِيْ بِالْبَلاءِ فِيمَا لَمْ أُعْمِلْ فِيهِ فِكْرِي،
segments.transliteration: wa ar-s'ada leeal-balaaa-a feemaa lam ua'-mil feehee fik-ree
segments.translation: 26.and lies in wait for me with an affliction about which I have not thought.
27.You set out at once to help me
28.and You braced up my back!
29.You blunted for me his blade,

segments.arabic: وَصَيَّرْتَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ جَمْع عَدِيْد وَحْدَهُ،
segments.translation: 30.made him, after a great multitude, solitary,
31.raised up my heel over him,

segments.transliteration: wa jaa'l-ta maa sad-dadahoo mar-doodana a'lay-h
segments.translation: 32.and turned back upon him what he had pointed straight.
33.So You sent him back, his rage not calmed,
34.his burning thirst not quenched!
35.Biting his fingers,

segments.transliteration: wa ad-bara muwal-leeana qad akh-laf-ta saraayaah
segments.translation: 36.he turned his back in flight, his columns having been of no use.
37.How many an oppressor has oppressed me with his tricks,
38.set up for me the net of his snares,
39.appointed over me the inspection of his regard,
40.and lay in ambush for me, the lying in ambush of a predator for its game,
41.waiting to take advantage of its prey,
42.while he showed me the smile of the flatterer
43.and looked at me with the intensity of fury!

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ يَا إلهِي تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ دَغَلْ سَرِيرَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: falam-maa raay-ta yaaa ilaahee tabaarak-ta wa taa'alay-t daghala sareeratih
segments.translation: 44.So when You saw, my God, (blessed art You and high exalted) the depravity of his secret thoughts

segments.arabic: وَقُبْحَ مَا انْطَوى عَلَيْهِ، أَرْكَسْتَهُ لاُِمِّ رَأْسِهِ فِي زُبْيَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa qub-h'a mant'awaa a'lay-h ar-kas-tahoo lium-mi raa-sihee fee zub-yatih
segments.translation: 45.and the ugliness of what he harboured, You threw him on his head into his own pitfall
46.and dumped him into the hole of his own digging.

segments.arabic: فَانْقَمَعَ بَعْدَ اسْتِطَالَتِهِ ذَلِيلاً فِي رِبَقِ حِبالتِهِ
segments.transliteration: faanqamaa' baa'-da as-tit'aalatihee d'aleelan fee ribaqi h'ibaalatihi
segments.translation: 47.So he was brought down low, after his overbearing, by the nooses of his own snare,

segments.arabic: الَّتِي كَانَ يُقَدِّرُ أَنْ يَرَانِي فِيهَا،
segments.translation: 48.wherein he had thought he would see me;

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ كَادَ أَنْ  يَحُلَّ بِيْ لَوْلاَ رَحْمَتُكَ مَا حَلَّ بِسَاحَتِهِ.
segments.transliteration: wa qad kaada ay-yah'ul-la bee law-laa rah'-matuka maa h'al-la bisaah'atih
segments.translation: 49.and what came down upon his courtyard - had it not been for Your mercy - was on the point of coming down upon me!

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ حَاسِد قَدْ شَرِقَ بِي بِغُصَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa kam min h'aasidin qad shariqa bee bighus'-s'atih
segments.translation: 50.How many an evier has choked upon me in his agony,

segments.arabic: وَشَجِيَ مِنِّي بِغَيْظِهِ، وَسَلَقَنِي بِحَدِّ لِسَانِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa shajeea min-nee bighay-z'ih wa salaqanee bih'ad-d lisaanih
segments.translation: 51.fumed over me in his rage, cut me with the edge of his tongue,
52.showed malice toward me by accusing me of his own faults,
53.made my good repute the target of his shots,
54.collared me with his own constant defects,

segments.transliteration: wa wah'aranee bikaydih wa qas'adanee bimakeedatih
segments.translation: 55.showed malice toward me with his trickery, and aimed at me with his tricks!
56.So I called upon You, my God, seeking aid from You,
57.trusting in the speed of Your response,

segments.arabic: عَالِماً أَنَّهُ لاَ يُضْطَهَدُ مَنْ آوى إلَى ظِلِّ كَنَفِكَ،
segments.transliteration: a'aliman an-nah laa yuz''-t'ahadu man awaaa ilaa z'il-li kanafik
segments.translation: 58.knowing that he who seeks haven in the shadow of Your wing will not be mistreated,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَفْزَعُ مَنْ  لَجَأَ إلَى مَعْقِل انْتِصَارِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa lay-yaf-zaa' mal-lajaa ilaa maa'-qili antis'aarik
segments.translation: 59.and he who seeks asylum in the stronghold of Your victory will not be frightened.
60.So You fortified me against his severity through Your power.

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ سَحَائِبِ مَكْرُوه جَلَّيْتَهَا عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa kam min- sah'aaa-ibi mak-roohin jal-lay-tahaa a'n-nee
segments.translation: 61.How many a cloud of detested things You hast dispelled from me,
62.a cloud of favour You hast made rain down upon me,
63.a stream of mercy You hast let flow,

segments.transliteration: wa a'afeeatin al-bas-tahaa wa aa'-yuni ah'-daathin t'amas-tahaa
segments.translation: 64.a well-being in which You hast clothed me, an eye of mishap You hast blinded,
65.and a wrap of distress You hast removed!

segments.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ ظَنٍّ حَسَن حَقَّقْتَ، وَعَدَم جَبَرْتَ،
segments.transliteration: wa kam min- z'an-nin h'asanin h'aq-qaq-t wa a'damin jabar-t
segments.translation: 66.How many a good opinion You hast verified, a destitution You hast redressed,

segments.transliteration: wa s'ara'tin an-a'sh-t wa mas-kanatin h'aw-wal-t
segments.translation: 67.an infirmity You hast restored to health, and a misery You hast transformed!
68.All of that was favour and graciousness from You,

segments.arabic: وَفِي جَمِيعِهِ انْهِمَاكاً مِنِّي عَلَى مَعَاصِيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa fee jameei'hee an-himaakam-min-nee a'laa maa'as'eek
segments.translation: 69.and in all of it I was occupied with acts of disobeying You.

segments.arabic: لَمْ تَمْنَعْكَ إساءَتِي عَنْ إتْمَامِ إحْسَانِكَ،
segments.transliteration: lam tam-naa'-ka isaaa-atee a'n it-maami ih'-saanik
segments.translation: 70.My evildoing did not hinder You from completing Your beneficence,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَجَرَنِي ذالِكَ عَنِ ارْتِكَابِ مَسَاخِطِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa h'ajaranee d'alika a'ni ar-tikaabi masaakhit'ik
segments.translation: 71.nor was I stopped from committing acts displeasing to You.

segments.arabic: لاَ تُسْأَلُ عَمَّا تَفْعَلُ، وَلَقَدْ سُئِلْتَ فَأَعْطَيْتَ،
segments.transliteration: laa tus-alu a'm-maa taf-a'l wa laqad su-il-ta faaa'-t'ay-t
segments.translation: 72.You art not questioned as to what You dost! You wert asked, and You bestowed.

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ تُسْأَلْ فابْتَدَأْتَ، وَاسْتُمِيحَ فَضْلُكَ فَمَا أَكْدَيْتَ،
segments.transliteration: wa lam tus-al fab-tadaa-t was-tumeeh'a faz''-luka famaaa ak-day-t
segments.translation: 73.You wert not asked, and You began. Your bounty was requested, and You didst not skimp.
74.You refused, my Master, everything but beneficence,
75.kindness, graciousness, and favour,
76.and I refused everything but plunging into what You hast made unlawful,
77.transgressing Your bounds, and paying no heed to Your threat!

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ إلهِي مِنْ مُقْتَدِر لاَ يُغْلَبُ،
segments.translation: 78.So Thine is the praise, my God, the All-powerful who is not overcome,
79.and the Possessor of patient waiting who does not hurry!

segments.arabic: هَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ بِسبوغِ النِّعَمِ،
segments.translation: 80.This is the station of one who confesses to lavishness of favours,

segments.arabic: وَقَابَلَهَا بِالتَّقْصِيرِ، وَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّضْيِيْعِ.
segments.transliteration: wa qaabalahaa bit-taq-s'eer wa shahida a'laa naf-sihee bit-taz''-yeea'
segments.translation: 81.counters them with shortcomings, and bears witness to his own negligence.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ فَإنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِالْمُحَمَّدِيَّةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma fa in-neee ataqar-rabu ilay-ka bil-muh'am-madee-yatir-rafeea'h
segments.translation: 82.O God, so I seek nearness to You through the elevated rank of Muhammad and the radiant degree of 'Ali,
83.and I turn to You through them so that You wilt give me

segments.arabic: تُعِيذَنِيْ مِنْ شَرِّ [كَذَا وَكَذَا] فَإنَّ ذَالِكَ
segments.transliteration: an tue'ed'anee min shar-ri kad'aa wa  kad'aa fa in-na d'alika
segments.translation: 84.refuge from the evil of [so and so],
85.for that will not constrain You in Your wealth,
86.nor trouble You in Your power,

segments.transliteration: wa anta a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer
segments.translation: 87.and You art powerful over everything!

segments.arabic: فَهَبْ لِي يا إلهِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَدَوَامِ تَوْفِيقِكَ،
segments.transliteration: fahab lee yaaa ilaahee mir-rah'-matika wa dawaami taw-feeqik
segments.translation: 88.So give me, my God, by Your mercy and Your lasting bestowal of success,

segments.arabic: مَا أَتَّخِذُهُ سُلَّماً أَعْرُجُ بِهِ إلى رِضْوَانِكَ،
segments.transliteration: mat-takhid'-hoo sul-laman aa'-ruju bih ilaa riz''-waanik
segments.translation: 89.that which I may take as a ladder with which to climb to Your good pleasure

segments.arabic: وَآمَنُ بِهِ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: wa aaamanu bih min i'qaabk yaaa ar-h'am-r-raah'imeen
segments.translation: 90.and be secure from Your punishment, O Most merciful of the merciful!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 43 When he looked at the new crescent moon

segments.translation: O obedient creature,
speedy and untiring,
frequenter of the mansions of determination,
moving about in the sphere of governance!
I have faith in Him Who lights up darkness through you,
illuminates jet-black shadows by you,

segments.transliteration: wa ja`alaka ayatan min ayati mulkihi
segments.translation: appointed you one of the signs of His kingdom
and one of the marks of His authority,
so, He identified time through You,
and humbled you through increase and decrease,
and rising and setting,
and illumination and eclipse.

segments.arabic: فِي كُلِّ ذٰلِكَ أَنْتَ لَهُ مُطِيعٌ
segments.transliteration: fi kulli dhalika anta lahu muti`un
segments.translation: In all of this you are obedient to Him,
and prompt toward His will.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَهُ مَا أَعْجَبَ مَا دَبَّرَ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ
segments.transliteration: subhanahu ma a`jaba ma dabbara min amrika
segments.translation: Glory be to Him! How wonderful is what He has arranged in Your situation!

segments.transliteration: wa altafa ma sana`a fi sha'nika
segments.translation: How subtle what He has made for Your task!

segments.arabic: جَعَلَكَ مِفْتَاحَ شَهْرٍ حَادِثٍ لأَمْرٍ حَادِثٍ
segments.transliteration: ja`alaka miftaha shahrin hadithin li'amrin hadithin
segments.translation: He has made You the key to a new month for a new situation.
So I ask Allah, my Lord and Your Lord,
my Creator and Your Creator,
my Determiner and Your Determiner,
my Form-giver and Your Form-giver,

segments.arabic: أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an yusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: that He bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ يَجْعَلَكَ هِلاَلَ بَرَكَةٍ لاَ تَمْحَقُهَا ٱلأَيَّامُ
segments.transliteration: wa an yaj`alaka hilala barakatin la tamhaquha al-ayyamu
segments.translation: and appoint You a crescent of blessings not effaced by days
and of purity not defiled by sins;
a crescent of security from blights
and of safety from evil deeds;
a crescent of auspiciousness containing no misfortune,
of prosperity accompanied by no adversity,
of ease not mixed with difficulty,
of good unstained by evil;
a crescent of security and faith,
favor and good-doing,
safety and submission!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَرْضَىٰ مَنْ طَلَعَ عَلَيْهِ
segments.translation: place us among the most satisfied of those over whom the crescent has risen,
the purest of those who have looked upon it,

segments.transliteration: wa as`ada man ta`abbada laka fihi
segments.translation: the most fortunate of those who have worshiped You under it;

segments.transliteration: wa waffiqna allahumma fihi liltta`ati walttawbati
segments.translation: give us the success during [the new month] to repent,
preserve us within it from misdeeds and exposition to punishment,
allot to us within it thanksgiving for Your favor,
clothe us during it in the shields of well-being,

segments.arabic: وَأَتْمِمْ عَلَيْنَا بِٱسْتِكْمَالِ طَاعَتِكَ فِيهِ ٱلْمِنَّةَ
segments.transliteration: wa atmim `alayna bistikmali ta`atika fihi alminnata
segments.translation: and complete for us Your kindness by perfecting therein obedience to You!
Surely You are All-kind, Praiseworthy.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi alttayyibina
segments.translation: And bless Muhammad and his Household, the good, the pure.

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ لَنَا فِيهِ عَوْناً مِنْكَ عَلَىٰ مَا نَدَبْتَنَا إِلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: waj`al lana fihi `awnan minka `ala ma nadabtana ilayhi
segments.translation: And grant us aid from You to carry out that which You have ordered us to do in it;
Such as the obedience to You which You have made incumbent upon us,

segments.arabic: وَتَقَبَّلْهَا إِنَّكَ ٱلأَكْرَمُ مِنْ كُلِّ كَرِيمٍ
segments.transliteration: wa taqabbalha innaka al-akramu min kulli karimin
segments.translation: and accept them from us, for You are the most Generous of all those who show generosity
and the most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
Respond! Respond! O Lord of the Worlds.

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-DuaDua 39 In asking Pardon & Mercy

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And break my desire from every forbidden thing
And turn away my greed from every sin

segments.arabic: وَامْنَعْنِي عَنْ أَذَى كُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ وَمُؤْمِنَةٍ وَمُسْلِمٍ وَمُسْلِمَةٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa-mnaÊ¿nÄ« Ê¿an adhÄ kulli muÊ¾minin wa muÊ¾minatin wa muslimin wa muslimatin
segments.translation: And prevent me from harming any believing man, believing woman, Muslim man, or Muslim woman

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ نَالَ مِنِّي مَا حَظَرْتَ عَلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa ayyuma Ê¿abdin nÄla minnÄ« mÄ á¸¥azarta Ê¿alayh
segments.translation: O Allah, whomever among Your servants gained from me what You have prohibited
And violated from me what You have forbidden
And so he went with my wrongdoing against him as a deceased
Or it remains for me against him while he is alive

segments.arabic: فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ مَا أَلَمَّ بِهِ مِنِّي
segments.transliteration: Faghfir lahu mÄ alamma bihi minnÄ«
segments.translation: Then forgive him for what befell him from me

segments.arabic: وَاعْفُ لَهُ عَمَّا أَدْبَرَ بِهِ عَنِّي
segments.transliteration: Wa-Ê¿fu lahu Ê¿ammÄ adbara bihi Ê¿annÄ«
segments.translation: And pardon him for what he kept away from me

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَقِفْهُ عَلَى مَا ارْتَكَبَ فِيَّ
segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ taqifhu Ê¿alÄ mÄ irtakaba fÄ«ya
segments.translation: And do not hold him accountable for what he committed against me

segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ takshifhu Ê¿ammÄ iktasaba bÄ«
segments.translation: And do not expose him for what he gained through me

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ مَا سَمَحْتُ بِهِ مِنَ الْعَفْوِ عَنْهُمْ
segments.transliteration: Wa-jÊ¿al mÄ samaá¸¥tu bihi mina al-Ê¿afwi Ê¿anhum
segments.translation: And make my forgiveness of them
And my charity towards them
Most pure of the charities of the charitable
And highest of the acts of approach by those close to You
And exchange my forgiveness of them with Your forgiveness for me
And my prayers for them for Your mercy

segments.arabic: حَتَّى يَسْعَدَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنَّا بِفَضْلِكَ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤attÄ yasÊ¿ada kullu wÄá¸¥idin minnÄ bi-faá¸lika
segments.translation: So that each one of us is made happy by Your grace
And each one of us is saved by Your bounty

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa ayyuma Ê¿abdin min Ê¿abÄ«dika
segments.translation: O Allah, whichever servant of Yours

segments.arabic: أَدْرَكَهُ مِنِّي دَرَكٌ أَوْ مَسَّهُ مِنْ نَاحِيَتِي أَذًى
segments.transliteration: Adrakahu minnÄ« darakun aw massahu min nÄá¸¥iyatÄ« adhÄ
segments.translation: Who was touched by me or harmed by my actions

segments.arabic: أَوْ لَحِقَهُ بِي أَوْ بِسَبَبِي ظُلْمٌ
segments.transliteration: Aw laá¸¥iqahu bÄ« aw bi-sababÄ« áºulmun
segments.translation: Or was wronged by me or through my actions
Or I neglected his right
Or I was quicker to wrong him
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And please him from Your bounty
And grant him his right from Yourself

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ قِنِي مَا يُوجِبُ لَهُ حُكْمُكَ
segments.transliteration: Thumma qinÄ« mÄ yÅ«jibu lahu á¸¥ukmuk
segments.translation: Then protect me from what Your judgment imposes on him
And save me from what Your justice decrees
For my strength cannot withstand Your punishment
And my capacity cannot bear Your anger
If You judge me by truth, You will destroy me
And unless You envelop me in Your mercy, I will perish

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إِلَهِي مَا لَا يَنْقُصُكَ بَذْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« astawhibuka yÄ IlÄhÄ« mÄ lÄ yanquá¹£uka badhluhu
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek as a gift what You never lose by giving
And I ask You to carry what is not heavy for You

segments.arabic: أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إِلَهِي نَفْسِيَ الَّتِي لَمْ تَخْلُقْهَا لِتَمْتَنِعَ بِهَا مِنْ سُوءٍ
segments.transliteration: Astawhibuka yÄ IlÄhÄ« nafsÄ« allÄtÄ« lam takhluqha li-tamteniÊ¿ bihÄ min sÅ«Ê¾in
segments.translation: I request from You, O my God, my soul which You didn't create to withhold from evil
Or to use it for benefit

segments.arabic: وَلَكِنْ أَنْشَأْتَهَا إِثْبَاتًا لِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى مِثْلِهَا
segments.transliteration: WalÄkin anshaÊ¾taha ithbÄtan li-qudratika Ê¿alÄ mithlihÄ
segments.translation: But You originated it to affirm Your power over its like
And as an argument over whatever resembles it

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَحْمِلُكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa-astaá¸¥miluka min dhunÅ«bÄ« mÄ qad bahaáºanÄ« á¸¥amluhu
segments.translation: And I ask You to carry for me from my sins that which burdens me

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا قَدْ فَدَحَنِي ثِقْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa-astaÊ¿Ä«nu bika Ê¿alÄ mÄ qad fadaá¸¥anÄ« thiquluhu
segments.translation: And I seek Your help for what I struggle with its weight
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And grant my soul to myself, despite its wrongdoing
And assign Your mercy to bear my burden
How often Your mercy has reached the wrongdoers
How often Your forgiveness has encompassed the transgressors

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْنِي أُسْوَةَ مَنْ قَدْ أَنْهَضْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: Faá¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Älihi wa-jÊ¿alnÄ« uswat man qad anhaá¸tahu
segments.translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family, and make me an example of those whom You have raised
By Your pardon from the downfall of the erring
And You saved him, through Your guidance, from the traps of the criminals

segments.arabic: فَأَصْبَحَ طَلِيقَ عَفْوِكَ مِنْ إسَارِ سُخْطِكَ
segments.transliteration: Fa-aá¹£baá¸¥a á¹­alÄ«qa Ê¿afwika min isÄri sukhá¹­ika
segments.translation: And so he became freed by Your pardon from the bonds of Your anger
And emancipated by Your favor from the chains of Your justice

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ إنْ تَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ يَا إِلَهِي تَفْعَلْهُ بِمَنْ
segments.transliteration: Innaka in tafÊ¿al dhalika yÄ IlÄhÄ« tafÊ¿alhu biman
segments.translation: If You do that, O my God, You do it for one
Who does not ever deny deserving Your punishment

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُبَرِّئُ نَفْسَهُ مِنِ اسْتِيجَابِ نَقِمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ yubarriÊ¾u nafsahu min istÄ«jÄbi naqimatika
segments.translation: And does not absolve himself of deserving Your wrath

segments.arabic: تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ يَا إِلَهِي بِمَنْ خَوْفُهُ مِنْكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ طَمَعِهِ فِيكَ
segments.transliteration: TafÊ¿alu dhalika yÄ IlÄhÄ« bi-man khawfuhu minka aktharu min á¹­amaÊ¿ihi fÄ«k
segments.translation: You treat in this way, my God, those whose fear of You is greater than their hope in You

segments.arabic: وَبِمَنْ يَأْسُهُ مِنَ النَّجَاةِ أَوْكَدُ مِنْ رَجَائِهِ لِلْخَلاَصِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-biman ya'suhu mina an-najÄti awkadu min rajÄ'ihi lil-khalÄá¹£
segments.translation: And those whose despair of deliverance is stronger than their hope for salvation
Not because his despair is disbelief
Nor his hope is recklessness
But due to the scarcity of his good deeds among his sins
And his weak excuses for all of his consequences

segments.arabic: فَأَمَّا أَنْتَ يَا إِلَهِي فَأَهْلٌ أَنْ لاَ يَغْتَرَّ بِكَ الصِّدِّيقُونَ
segments.transliteration: Fa-ammÄ anta yÄ IlÄhÄ« fa-ahlu an lÄ yagh-tarra bika as-á¹£iddÄ«qÅ«n
segments.translation: As for You, my God, it is fitting that the sincere do not become deluded by You
And that the guilty do not despair of You

segments.arabic: لاِنَّكَ الرَّبُّ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِيْ لاَ يَمْنَعُ أَحَدًا فَضْلَهُ
segments.transliteration: Li-annaka ar-rabbu al-Ê¿aáºÄ«m alladhÄ« lÄ yamnaÊ¿u aá¸¥adan faá¸lahu
segments.translation: For You are the Supreme Lord who never withholds His bounty from anyone
Nor exacts from anyone all of his due
Exalted is Your remembrance above those who are mentioned
And hallowed are Your names above those who are attributed
And Your blessings have spread in all creation

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
segments.transliteration: Fa-laka al-á¸¥amdu Ê¿alÄ dhÄlika yÄ Rabba al-Ê¿ÄlamÄ«n
segments.translation: So to You is all praise for that, O Lord of the worlds
1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
2.break my passion for every unlawful thing,
3.take away my craving for any sin,

segments.arabic: وَامْنَعْنِي عَنْ أَذَى كُـلِّ مُؤْمِن وَمُؤْمِنَـة وَمُسْلِم وَمُسْلِمَة،
segments.transliteration: wam-naa'-nee a'n ad'a kul-li moo-miniw-wa moo-minatiw-wa mus-limiw-wa mus-limah
segments.translation: 4.and bar me from harming any believer, male or female, and any Muslim, male or female!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا عَبْد نالَ مِنِّي مَا حَظَرْتَ عَلَيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa ay-yumaa a'b-d naala min-nee maa h'az'ar-ta a'lay-h
segments.translation: 5.O God, if any of Your servants should harm me in what You hast forbidden
6.or violate me in what You hast interdicted,
7.and if he should pass into death with my complaint
8.or I come to have a complaint against him while he is alive,

segments.arabic: فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ مَا أَلَمَّ بِهِ مِنِّي،
segments.transliteration: fagh-fir lahoo maaa alam-ma bihee min-nee
segments.translation: 9.forgive him what he did to me

segments.arabic: وَاعْفُ لَهُ عَمَّا أَدْبَرَ بِهِ عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: waa'-fu lahoo a'm-maaa ad-bara bihee a'n-nee
segments.translation: 10.and pardon him that through which he turned his back on me!

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَقِفْـهُ عَلَى مَا  ارْتَكَبَ فِيَّ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa taqif-hoo a'laa mar-tkaba fee
segments.translation: 11.Inquire not from him about what he committed toward me
12.and expose him not through what he earned by me!

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ مَا سَمَحْتُ بِهِ مِنَ الْعَفْـوِ عَنْهُمْ
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l maa samah'-tu bihee minal-a'f-wi a'n-hum
segments.translation: 13.Make my open-handedness in pardoning such servants
14.and my contribution in charity toward them
15.the purest charity of the charitable
16.and the highest gift of those seeking nearness to You!

segments.transliteration: wa a'w-wiz''-nee min a'f-wee a'n-hum a'f-wak
segments.translation: 17.Recompense me for my pardoning them with Your pardon
18.and for my supplicating for them with Your mercy

segments.arabic: حَتَّى يَسْعَدَ كُلُّ وَاحِد مِنَّا بِفَضْلِكَ
segments.translation: 19.so that each one of us may gain felicity through Your bounty
20.and each may attain deliverance through Your kindness!
21.O God, if there is a servant from among Your servants

segments.arabic: أدرَكَهُ مِنِّي دَرَكٌ أَوْ مَسَّهُ مِنْ نَاحِيَتِي أَذَىً،
segments.transliteration: ad-rakahoo min-nee darak aw mas-sahoo min-naah'eeateee ad'ana
segments.translation: 22.whom an ill visits on my account, a harm touches from my direction,

segments.arabic: أَوْ لَحِقَـهُ بِي أَوْ بِسَبَبي ظُلْمٌ
segments.transliteration: aw lah'iqahoo beee aw bisababee z'ul-m
segments.translation: 23.or a wrong overtakes through me or because of me,
24.and should I fail to take care of his right
25.or go before him [in death] with his complaint,
26.bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَرْضِهِ عَنِّي مِنْ وُجْدِكَ، وَأَوْفِهِ حَقَّهُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ar-z''ihee a'n-nee miw-wuj-dik wa aw-fihee h'aq-qahoo min i'ndik
segments.translation: 27.satisfy him toward me through Your wealth, and give him his full right from Yourself!

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ قِنيْ مَا يُوجِبُ لَهُ حُكْمُكَ،
segments.transliteration: thum-ma qinee maa yoojibu lahoo h'uk-muk
segments.translation: 28.Then protect me from what Your decision mandates

segments.transliteration: wa khal-lis'-nee mim-maa yah'-kumu bihee a'd-luk
segments.translation: 29.and save me from what Your justice decides,

segments.transliteration: fa in-na qoo-watee laa tas-taqil-lu binaqimatik
segments.translation: 30.for my strength cannot bear Your vengeance

segments.transliteration: wa in-na t'aaqatee laa tan-haz''u bisukh-t'ik
segments.translation: 31.and my power cannot stand up to Your displeasure!

segments.transliteration: fa in-naka in tukaafinee bil-h'aq-qi tuh-lik-nee
segments.translation: 32.If You recompensest me with the right, You wilt destroy me,
33.and if You dost not shield me in Your mercy, You wilt lay me waste.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إلهِي مَا لا يَنْقُصُكَ بَذْلُهُ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-nee as-taw-hibuka yaaa ilaahee maa laa yanqus'uka bad'-luh
segments.translation: 34.O God, I ask You to grant, my God, that whose giving will not decrease You,

segments.transliteration: wa as-tah'-miluka maa laa yab-haz'uka h'am-luh
segments.translation: 35.and I ask You to carry that whose carrying will not weigh You down:

segments.arabic: أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إلهِي نَفْسِيَ الَّتِيْ لَمْ تَخْلُقْهَا لِتَمْتَنِعَ بِهَا  مِنْ سُوء،
segments.transliteration: as-taw-hibuka yaaa ilaahee naf-seeal-latee lam takh-luq-haa litam-tania' bihaa min sooo-in
segments.translation: 36.My God, I ask You to give my soul, which You didst not create to keep Yourself from evil
37.nor to find the way to profit.

segments.arabic: وَلكِنْ أَنْشَأتَهَا إثْبَاتاً لِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى مِثْلِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa lkin anshaa-tahaa ith-baatal-liqud-ratika a'laa mith-lihaa
segments.translation: 38.No, You brought it forth to demonstrate Your power over its like
39.and to provide an argument against its similar.

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَحْمِلُكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa as-tah'-miluka min d'unoobee maa qad bahaz'anee h'am-luh
segments.translation: 40.I ask You to carry those of my sins whose carrying weighs me down

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا قَدْ فَدَحَنِي ثِقْلُهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa as-tae'enu bika a'laa maa qad fadah'anee thiq-luh
segments.translation: 41.and I seek help from You in that whose heaviness oppresses me.
42.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa hab linaf-see a'laa z'ul-mihaa naf-see
segments.translation: 43.give to me my soul in spite of its wrongdoing,
44.and appoint Your mercy to carry my burden!
45.How many evildoers Your mercy has overtaken!
46.How many wrongdoers Your pardon has embraced!

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنِي أُسْوَةَ مَنْ قَدْ أَنْهَضْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih waj-a'l-neee us-wata man qad an-haz''-tahoo
segments.translation: 47.So bless Muhammad and his Household and make me the model of him whom You hast aroused
48.through Your forbearance from the deadly infirmities of the offenders
49.and saved through Your giving success from the tangled plights of the sinners,

segments.arabic: فَأَصْبَحَ طَلِيقَ عَفْوِكَ مِنْ إسَارِ سُخْطِكَ،
segments.transliteration: faas'-bah'a t'aleeqa a'f-wika mn isaari sukh-t'ik
segments.translation: 50.so that I may rise up freed by Your pardon from the bonds of Your displeasure
51.and released by Your benefaction from the ties of Your justice!

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ إنْ تَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ يَا إلهِي تَفْعَلْهُ بِمَنْ
segments.transliteration: in-naka in taf-a'l d'alika yaaa ilaahee taf-a'l-hoo biman
segments.translation: 52.Surely if You dost that, my God, You wilt do it to one
53.who does not deny deserving Your punishment

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُبَرِّئُ نَفْسَهُ  مِنِ اسْتِيجَابِ نَقِمَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yubar-ri-u naf-sahoo min as-teejaabi naqimatik
segments.translation: 54.or acquit himself from merit for Your vengeance.

segments.arabic: تَفْعَلُ ذلِكَ يَا إلهِي بِمَنْ خَوْفُهُ مِنْكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ طَمَعِهِ فِيكَ،
segments.transliteration: taf-a'lu d'alika yaaa ilaahee biman khaw-fuhoo minka ak-tharu min t'amai'hee feek
segments.translation: 55.Do that, my God, for one whose fear of You is greater than his craving from You,

segments.arabic: وَبِمَنْ يَأْسُهُ مِنَ النَّجَاةِ أَوْكَدُ مِنْ رَجَائِهِ لِلْخَلاَصِ،
segments.transliteration: wa bimay-yaa-suhoo minan-najaati aw-kadu mir-rajaaa-ihee lil-khalaas'
segments.translation: 56.whose hopelessness of deliverance is firmer than his hope for salvation!
57.Not that his hopelessness is despair,
58.nor that his expectation is deluded.
59.No, rather his good deeds are few among his evil deeds

segments.transliteration: wa z''aa'-fi h'ujajihee fee jameei' tabia'atih
segments.translation: 60.and his arguments are frail in face of everything due from his acts.

segments.arabic: فَأَمَّا أَنْتَ يَا إلهِي فَأَهْلٌ أَنْ
segments.transliteration: faam-maaa anta yaaa ilaahee faah-lun an
segments.translation: 61.But Thou, my God, art worthy that
62.the righteous not be deluded concerning You
63.and the sinners not lose hope in You,

segments.arabic: لاَِنَّكَ ألرَّبُّ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِيْ لاَ يَمْنَعُ أَحَداً فَضْلَهُ
segments.translation: 64.for You art the All-mighty Lord who holds back His bounty from none

segments.transliteration: wa laa yas-taq-s'ee min ah'adin h'aq-qah
segments.translation: 65.and takes His full right from no one.
66.High exalted is Your mention above those mentioned!
67.Holy are Your names beyond those described!
68.Spread is Your favour among all creatures!

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ .

segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ ghÄfilan li-iá¸¥sÄnika fÄ«mÄ ablaytanÄ«
segments.translation: Nor heedless of Your kindness in what You test me with

segments.arabic: وَلَا آيِسًا مِنْ إِجَابَتِكَ لِي وَإِنْ أَبْطَأَتْ عَنِّي
segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ Äyisan min ijÄbatika lÄ« wa in abá¹­aâat âannÄ«
segments.translation: Nor despairing of Your response to me, even if it is delayed
In ease or hardship
Or difficulty or comfort
Or well-being or trial
Or misery or blessings
Or prosperity or adversity
Or poverty or wealth

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segments.transliteration: Wa ajâal thanÄâÄ« âalayka wa madá¸¥Ä« iyyÄka
segments.translation: And make my praise for You and my extolling of You

segments.transliteration: Wa á¸¥amdÄ« laka fÄ« kulli á¸¥ÄlÄtÄ«
segments.translation: And my gratitude to You in all my states

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لَا أَفْرَحَ بِمَا آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الدُّنْيَا
segments.transliteration: á¸¤attÄ lÄ afraá¸¥a bimÄ ÄtaytanÄ« mina ad-dunyÄ
segments.translation: So I do not rejoice in what You give me of this world

segments.arabic: وَلَا أَحْزَنَ عَلَى مَا مَنَعْتَنِي فِيهَا
segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ aá¸¥zana âalÄ mÄ manaâtanÄ« fÄ«hÄ
segments.translation: Nor grieve over what You withhold from it
And instill in my heart Your piety

segments.transliteration: Wa istaâmil badanÄ« fÄ«mÄ taqbaluhu minnÄ«
segments.translation: And employ my body in what You accept from me
And occupy my soul with Your obedience
From all that comes to me

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لَا أُحِبَّ شَيْئًا مِنْ سُخْطِكَ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤attÄ lÄ uá¸¥ibba shayâan min sukhá¹­ika
segments.translation: So I do not love anything of Your displeasure

segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ askhaá¹­a shayâan min riá¸Äka
segments.translation: Nor be displeased with anything of Your pleasure

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And empty my heart for Your love
And occupy it with Your remembrance

segments.transliteration: Wa anâashhu bikhawfika wa bil-wajali minka
segments.translation: And revive it with Your fear and awe of You
And strengthen it with longing for You
And incline it toward Your obedience

segments.arabic: وَأَجْرِ بِهِ فِي أَحَبِّ السُّبُلِ إِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa ajri bihi fÄ« aá¸¥abbi as-subuli ilayka
segments.translation: And guide it on the most beloved paths to You
And humble it with desire for what is with You
All the days of my life

segments.transliteration: Wa ajâal taqwÄka mina ad-dunyÄ zÄdÄ«
segments.translation: And make Your piety my provision from this world
And to Your mercy my journey
And in Your pleasure my entry
And make Your paradise my abode

segments.transliteration: Wa hab lÄ« quwwatan aá¸¥tamilu bihÄ
segments.translation: And grant me strength to bear
All of Your pleasure
And make my flight to You
And my desire for what is with You

segments.arabic: وَأَلْبِسْ قَلْبِي الْوَحْشَةَ مِنْ شِرَارِ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa albis qalbÄ« al-waá¸¥shata min shirÄri khalqika
segments.translation: And clothe my heart with alienation from the wicked of Your creation
And grant me intimacy with You
And with Your friends and the people of Your obedience

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ لِفَاجِرٍ وَلَا كَافِرٍ عَلَيَّ مِنَّةً
segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ tajâal lifÄjirin wa lÄ kÄfirin âalayya minnatan
segments.translation: And do not let a sinner or disbeliever have favor over me
Nor let them have a hand over me
Nor let me have need of them
Rather, make my heartâs tranquility
And my soulâs intimacy and sufficiency

segments.transliteration: Wa kifÄyatÄ« bika wa bikhiyÄri khalqika
segments.translation: And my contentment with You and the best of Your creation

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And make me a companion to them
And make me a supporter for them
And favor me with longing for You

segments.transliteration: Wa bil-âamali laka bimÄ tuá¸¥ibbu wa tará¸Ä
segments.translation: And with working for You in what You love and are pleased with
Indeed, You are capable of all things
And that is easy for You

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا كَافِيَ الْفَرْدِ الضَعِيْفِ، وَوَاقِيَ الامْرِ الْمَخُوْفِ،
segments.translation: 1.O God, O Sufficer of the isolated and weak and Protector against terrifying affairs!
2.Offenses have isolated me, so there is none to be my companion.

segments.arabic: وَضَعُفْتُ عَنْ غَضَبِكَ; فَلاَ مُؤَيِّدَ لِي،
segments.transliteration: wa z''au'f-tu a'n ghaz''abika falaa moo-ay-yida lee
segments.translation: 3.I am too weak for Your wrath and there is none to strengthen me.

segments.arabic: وَأَشْرَفْتُ عَلَى خَوْفِ لِقَائِكَ; فَلاَ مُسَكِّنَ لِرَوْعَتِي،
segments.transliteration: wa ash-raf-tu a'laa khaw-fi liqaaa-ika falaa musak-kina liraw-a'tee
segments.translation: 4.I have approached the terror of meeting You and there is none to still my fear.

segments.transliteration: wa may-yoo-minunee minka wa anta akhaf-tanee?
segments.translation: 5.Who can make me secure from You when You hast filled me with terror?
6.Who can come to my aid when You hast isolated me?
7.Who can strengthen me when You hast weakened me?

segments.arabic: لاَ يُجيرُ يا إلهي إلاّ رَبٌّ عَلَى مَرْبُوب،
segments.transliteration: laa yujeeru yaaa ilaaheee il-laa rab-bun a'laa mar-boob
segments.translation: 8.None can grant sanctuary to a vassal, my God, but a lord,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُؤْمِنُ إلاّ غالِبٌ عَلَى  مَغْلُوب،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yoo-minu il-laa ghaalibun a'laa magh-loob
segments.translation: 9.none can give security to one dominated but a dominator,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُعِينُ إِلاّ طالِبٌ عَلَى مَطْلُوب،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yue'enu il-laa t'aalibun a'laa mat'-loob
segments.translation: 10.none can aid him from whom demands are made but a demander.

segments.arabic: وَبِيَـدِكَ يَـاَ إلهِي جَمِيعُ ذلِكَ السَّبَبِ، وَإلَيْكَ الْمَفَرُّ وَالْمَهْربُ.
segments.transliteration: wa beeadika yaaa ilaahee jameeu' d'alikas-sabab wa ilay-kal-mafar-ru wal-mah-rab
segments.translation: 11.In Your hand, my God, is the thread of all that, in You the place of escape and flight,
12.so bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa ajir harabee wa anjih' mat'-labee
segments.translation: 13.give sanctuary to me in my flight, and grant my request!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ إنْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي وَجْهَكَ الْكَرِيْمَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-naka in s'araf-ta a'n-nee waj-hakal-kareem
segments.translation: 14.O God, if You shouldst turn Your generous face away from me,
15.withhold from me Your immense bounty,

segments.arabic: أَوْ حَظَرْتَ عَلَيَّ رِزْقَكَ أَوْ قَطَعْتَ عَنِّي سَبَبَـكَ
segments.transliteration: aw h'az'ar-ta a'lay-ya riz-qak aw qat'aa'-ta a'n-nee sababak
segments.translation: 16.forbid me Your provision, or cut off from me Your thread,

segments.arabic: لَمْ أَجِدِ السَّبِيـلَ إلَى شَيْء مِنْ أَمَلِي غَيْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: lam ajidis-sabeela ilaa shay-im-min amalee ghay-rak
segments.translation: 17.I will find no way to anything of my hope other than You

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ أَقْدِرْ عَلَى مَا عِنْدَكَ بِمَعُونَةِ  سِوَاكَ; فَإنِّي عَبْدُكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa lam aq-dir a'laa maa i'ndaka bimau'wnati siwaak fa in-nee  a'b-duka
segments.translation: 18.nor be given power over what is with You through another's aid, for I am Your servant

segments.arabic: وَفِي قَبْضَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، لاَ أَمْرَ لِي مَعَ أَمْرِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa fee qab-z''atik naas'eeatee beeadik laaa am-ra lee maa' am-rik
segments.translation: 19.and in Your grasp; my forelock is in Your hand. I have no command along with Your command.

segments.arabic: مَاض فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ،
segments.transliteration: maaz''in fee-ya h'uk-muk a'd-lun fee-ya qaz''aaaw-uk
segments.translation: 20.'Accomplished is Your judgement of me, just Your decree for me!'

segments.arabic: وَلاَ قُوَّةَ لِي عَلَى الْخُـرُوجِ مِنْ سُلْطَانِـكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa qoo-wata lee a'laal-khurooji min sul-t'aanik
segments.translation: 21.I have not the strength to emerge from Your authority
22.nor am I able to step outside Your power.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ أَسْتَـمِيلُ هَوَاكَ، وَلاَ أبْلُغُ رِضَاكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laaa as-tameelu hawaak wa laaa ab-lughu riz''aak
segments.translation: 23.I cannot win Your inclination, arrive at Your good pleasure,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ أَنَالُ مَا عِنْدَكَ إلاَّ بِطَاعَتِكَ وَبِفَضْل رَحْمَتِكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laaa anaalu maa i'ndaka il-laa bit'aaa'tika wabifaz''-li rah'-matik
segments.translation: 24.or attain what is with You except through obeying You and through the bounty of Your mercy.

segments.arabic: إلهِي أَصْبَحْتُ وَأَمْسَيْتُ عَبْداً دَاخِراً لَكَ،
segments.transliteration: ilaaheee as'-bah'-tu wa am-say-tu a'b-dana daakhiral-lak
segments.translation: 25.O God, I rise in the morning and enter into evening as Your lowly slave.

segments.arabic: لا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعاً وَلاَ ضَرّاً إلاَّ بِكَ
segments.transliteration: laaa am-liku linaf-see naf-a'w-wa laa z''ar-ran il-laa bik
segments.translation: 26.I own no profit and loss for myself except through You.

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ بِذَلِكَ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَأَعْتَـرِفُ بِضَعْفِ قُـوَّتِي وَقِلَّةِ حِيْلَتِي
segments.transliteration: ash-hadu bid'alika a'laa naf-see wa aa'-tarifu biz''aa'-fi qoo-watee wa qil-lati h'eelatee
segments.translation: 27.I witness to that over myself and I confess to the frailty of my strength and the paucity of my stratagems.

segments.arabic: فَأَنْجزْ لِي مَا وَعَدْتَنِي،  وَتَمِّمْ لِي مَا آتَيْتَنِي;
segments.transliteration: fa anjiz lee maa waa't-tanee wa tam-mim lee maaa aaatay-tanee
segments.translation: 28.So accomplish what You hast promised me and complete for me what You hast given me,
29.for I am Your slave, miserable, abased, frail,

segments.arabic: الضَّـرِيـرُ الذَّلِيلُ الْحَقِيرُ الْمَهِينُ الْفَقِيرُ الْخَائِفُ الْمُسْتَجِيرُ.
segments.translation: 30.distressed, vile, despised, poor, fearful, and seeking sanctuary!
31.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي نَاسِيَاً لِذِكْرِكَ فِيمَا أَوْلَيْتَنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-a'l-nee naaseeal-lid'ik-rika feemaaa aw-lay-tanee
segments.translation: 32.and let me not forget to remember You in what You hast done for me,
33.be heedless of Your beneficence in Your trying me,

segments.arabic: وَلا آيسَاً مِنْ إجَابَتِكَ لِي وَإنْ أَبْطَأتَ عَنِّي
segments.transliteration: wa laaa aaayisam-min ijaabatika lee wa in ab-t'aat a'n-nee fee
segments.translation: 34.or despair of Your response to me, though it keep me waiting,

segments.arabic: فِي سَرَّاءَ كُنْتُ أَوْ ضَرَّاءَ، أَوْ شِدَّة أَوْ رَخَاء،
segments.transliteration: sar-raaa-a kuntu aw z''ar-raaa wa shid-datin aw rakhaaa-
segments.translation: 35.whether I be in prosperity or adversity, hardship or ease,

segments.arabic: أَوْ عَافِيَة أَوْ بَلاء، أَوْ بُؤْس أَوْ نَعْمَاءَ،
segments.transliteration: aw a'afeeatin aw balaaa- aw boo-sin aw naa'-maaa-
segments.translation: 36.well-being or affliction, misery or comfort,

segments.arabic: أَوْ جِدَة  أَوْ لأوَاءَ، أَوْ فَقْر أَوْ غِنىً.
segments.transliteration: aw jidatin aw laa-waaa-a aw faq-rin aw ghinana
segments.translation: 37.wealth or distress, poverty or riches!
38.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: waj-a'l thanaaa-ee a'lay-ka wa mad-h'eee ee-yaaka
segments.translation: 39.make me laud You, extol You,

segments.transliteration: wa h'am-dee laka fee kul-li h'aalaatee h'at-taa
segments.translation: 40.and praise You in all my states

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ أَفْرَحَ بِمَا آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الدُّنْيَا،
segments.translation: 41.so that I rejoice not over what You givest me of this world

segments.arabic: وَلاَ أَحْـزَنَ عَلَى مَا مَنَعْتَنِي فِيهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa laaa ah'-zana a'laa maa manaa'-tanee feehaa
segments.translation: 42.nor sorrow over that of it which You withholdest from me!
43.Impart reverential fear of You to my heart,
44.employ my body in that which You acceptest from me,

segments.arabic: وَاشْغَلْ بِطَاعَتِكَ نَفْسِي  عَنْ كُلِّ مَايَرِدُ عَلَىَّ
segments.transliteration: wa ash-ghal bit'aaa'tika naf-see a'n kul-li maa yaridu a'lay-ya
segments.translation: 45.and divert my soul through obedience to You from all that enters upon me,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ اُحِبَّ شَيْئَاً مِنْ سُخْطِكَ،
segments.translation: 46.so that I love nothing that displeases You
47.and become displeased at nothing that pleases You!
48.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa far-righ qal-bee limah'ab-batik wash-ghal-hoo bid'ik-rik
segments.translation: 49.empty my heart for Your love, occupy it with remembering You,
50.animate it with fear of You and quaking before You,

segments.arabic: وَقَوِّهِ بِالرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ، وَأَمِلْهُ إلَى طَاعَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa qaw-wihee bir-ragh-bati ilay-k wa amil-hooo ilaa t'aaa'tik
segments.translation: 51.strengthen it with beseeching You, incline it to Your obedience,

segments.arabic: وَأَجْرِ بِهِ فِي أَحَبِّ السُّبُلِ إلَيْكَ،
segments.translation: 52.set it running in the path most beloved to You,

segments.arabic: وَذَلِّلْهُ بِالرَّغْبَةِ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ أَيَّامَ حَيَاتِي كُلِّهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa d'al-lil-hoo bir-ragh-bati feemaa i'ndaka ay-yaama h'ayaatee kul-lihaa
segments.translation: 53.and subdue it through desire for what is with You all the days of my life!
54.Let my provision in this world be reverential fear of You (ref. 2:197),

segments.arabic: وَإلَى رَحْمَتِكَ رِحْلَتِي، وَفِي مَرْضَاتِكَ مَدْخَلِي.
segments.transliteration: wa ilaa rah'-matika rih'-latee wa fee mar-z''aatika mad-khalee
segments.translation: 55.my journey be toward Your mercy, and my entrance be into Your good pleasure!
56.Appoint for me a lodging in Your Garden,

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي قُوَّةً أَحْتَمِلُ بِهَا جَمِيعَ مَرْضَاتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa hab lee qoo-watan ah'-tamilu bihaa jameea' mar-z''aatik
segments.translation: 57.give me strength to bear everything that pleases You,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ فِرَارِي إلَيْكَ، وَرَغْبَتِي فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l firaareee ilay-ka wa ragh-batee feemaa i'ndak
segments.translation: 58.make me flee to You and desire what is with You,

segments.arabic: وَأَلْبِسْ قَلْبِي الْوَحْشَةَ مِنْ شِرارِ  خَلْقِكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa al-bis qal-beel-wah'-shata min shiraari khal-qik
segments.translation: 59.clothe my heart in estrangement from the evil among Your creatures,

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي الأُنْسَ بِكَ وَبِأَوْلِيَـآئِكَ وَأَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa hab leeal-unsa bika wa biw-leeaaa-ika wa ah-li t'aaa'tik
segments.translation: 60.and give me intimacy with You, Your friends, and those who obey You!

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ لِـفَاجِـر وَلا كَافِر  عَلَيَّ مِنَّةً،
segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-a'l-lifaajiriw-wa laa kaafirin a'lay-ya min-nataw
segments.translation: 61.Assign to no wicked person or unbeliever a kindness toward me

segments.arabic: وَلاَ لَـهُ عِنْدِي يَداً، وَلا بِي إلَيْهِمْ حَاجَةً،
segments.transliteration: wa laa lahoo i'ndee yadaw-wa laa beee ilay-him h'aajah
segments.translation: 62.or a hand that obliges me, nor to me a need for one of them!

segments.arabic: بَل اجْعَـلْ سُكُـونَ قَلْبِي وَاُنْسَ  نَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: bali aj-a'l sukoona qal-bee wa unsa naf-see
segments.translation: 63.Rather make the stillness of my heart, the comfort of my soul,

segments.transliteration: was-tigh-naaa-ee wa kifaayatee bika wa bikheeaari khal-qik
segments.translation: 64.my independence and my sufficiency lie in You and the best of Your creatures!
65.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي  لَهُمْ قَـرِيناً، وَاجْعَلْنِي لَهُمْ نَصِيْراً،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-nee lahum qareenaa waj-a'l-nee lahum nas'eeraa
segments.translation: 66.make me their comrade, make me their helper,

segments.arabic: وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِشَوْق إلَيْكَ، وَبِالْعَمَلِ لَكَ بِمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى
segments.transliteration: wam-nun a'lay-ya bishaw-qin ilay-ka wa bil-a'mali laka bimaa tuh'ib-bu watar-z''aa
segments.translation: 67.and oblige me with yearning for You and doing for You what You lovest and approvest!
68."Thou art powerful over everything" (3:26)
69.and that is easy for You.
