segments.arabic: وَلَوْ كَانُوا كَذلِكَ لَخَرَجُوا مِنْ حُدُودِ الانْسَانِيَّةِ
segments.transliteration: Wa law kÄnÅ« kaá¸Älika lakharaÇ§Å« min á¸¥udÅ«d al-insÄniyyah
segments.translation: And had they been such, they would have left the bounds of humanity
And reached the level of animality

segments.transliteration: FakÄnÅ« kamÄ waá¹£afa fÄ« muá¸¥kam kitÄbihi
segments.translation: And they would be as He has described in His mighty Book

segments.arabic: ( إنْ هُمْ إلا كَالانْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلا )
segments.transliteration: In hum illÄ kal-anâÄm bal hum aá¸allu sabÄ«lÄ
segments.translation: âThey are nothing but as cattle, rather they are further astray from the pathâ

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لله عَلَى مَا عَرَّفَنا من نفسه
segments.transliteration: Wal-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi âalÄ mÄ âarrafanÄ min nafsihi
segments.translation: And all praise to Allah for what He made us know of Himself
And for inspiring us to thank Him

segments.arabic: وَفَتَحَ لَنَا من أبوَابِ الْعِلْمِ بِرُبُوبِيّته
segments.transliteration: Wa fataá¸¥a lanÄ min abwÄbil-âilmi birubÅ«biyyatihi
segments.translation: And for opening to us the doors of knowledge of His Lordship

segments.arabic: وَدَلَّنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الاِخْلاَصِ لَهُ فِي تَوْحِيدِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa dallanÄ âalayhi mina al-ikhlÄá¹£i lahu fÄ« tawá¸¥Ä«dihi
segments.translation: And guiding us to Him through sincerity in His Oneness

segments.arabic: وَجَنَّبَنا مِنَ الالْحَادِ وَالشَّكِّ فِي أَمْرِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa jannabanÄ minal-ilá¸¥Ädi wash-shakki fÄ« amrihi
segments.translation: And sparing us from atheism and doubt in His command

segments.arabic: حَمْداً نُعَمَّرُ بِهِ فِيمَنْ حَمِدَهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤amdan nuâammaru bihi fÄ«man á¸¥amidahu min khalqihi
segments.translation: A praise by which we live among those of His creation who praised Him

segments.arabic: وَنَسْبِقُ بِـهِ مَنْ سَبَقَ إلَى رِضَاهُ وَعَفْوِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa nasbiqu bihi man sabaqa ilÄ riá¸Ähu wa âafwihi
segments.translation: And overtake those who hastened to His pleasure and pardon

segments.arabic: حَمْداً يُضِيءُ لَنَا بِهِ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرْزَخِ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤amdan yuá¸Ä«âu lanÄ bihi áºulumÄti al-barzakh
segments.translation: A praise that illuminates for us the darkness of the grave
And eases for us the path of resurrection

segments.arabic: وَيُشَرِّفُ بِهِ مَنَازِلَنَا عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الاشْهَادِ
segments.transliteration: Wa yusharrifu bihi manÄzilana âinda mawÄqifil-ashhÄd
segments.translation: And honors our places at the stations of witnesses

segments.arabic: يَوْمَ تُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْس بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لا يُظْلَمُونَ
segments.transliteration: Yawma tujzÄ kullu nafsin bimÄ kasabat wa hum lÄ yuáºlamÅ«n
segments.translation: On the day when every soul will be recompensed for what it earned, and they will not be wronged

segments.arabic: (يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي مَوْلىً عَنْ مَوْلىً شَيْئاً وَلاَ هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ)
segments.transliteration: Yawma lÄ yughni mawlÄ âan mawlÄ shayâan wa lÄ hum yuná¹£arÅ«n
segments.translation: âThe day when no relative shall avail another in anything, nor shall they be helpedâ

segments.arabic: حَمْداً يَرْتَفِعُ مِنَّا إلَى أَعْلَى عِلِّيِّينَ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤amdan yartaï¬âu minnÄ ilÄ aâlÄ âilliyyÄ«n
segments.translation: A praise that rises from us to the highest of âIlliyÄ«n
In a written book witnessed by those brought near

segments.arabic: حَمْداً تَقَرُّ بِهِ عُيُونُنَا إذَا بَرِقَت الابْصَارُ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤amdan taqarru bihi âuyÅ«nunÄ idhÄ bariqat al-abá¹£Är
segments.translation: A praise with which our eyes will be delighted when the eyes stare in fear

segments.arabic: وَتَبْيَضُّ بِهِ وُجُوهُنَا إذَا اسْوَدَّتِ الابْشَارُ،
segments.transliteration: Wa tabyaá¸á¸u bihi wujÅ«huna idhÄ iswad-datil-abshÄr
segments.translation: And with which our faces will shine when faces are darkened

segments.arabic: حَمْداً نُعْتَقُ بِهِ مِنْ أَلِيمِ نار الله
segments.transliteration: á¸¤amdan nuâtaqu bihi min alÄ«mi nÄrillÄh
segments.translation: A praise by which we are freed from the painful fire of Allah
Into the noble neighborhood of Allah
A praise by which we jostle with His nearest angels
And join with His sent prophets

segments.arabic: فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ الَّتِي لا تَزُولُ
segments.transliteration: FÄ« dÄr al-muqÄmati allatÄ« lÄ tazÅ«l
segments.translation: In the abode of permanence that never fades

segments.transliteration: Wa maá¸¥alli karÄmatihi allatÄ« lÄ taá¸¥Å«l
segments.translation: And in His place of honor that never changes

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي اخْتَارَ لَنَا مَحَاسِنَ الْخَلْقِ
segments.transliteration: Wal-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi allathee ikhtÄra lanÄ maá¸¥Äsina al-khalq
segments.translation: And praise be to Allah, who chose for us the best forms
And made flow upon us the wholesome provisions

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلَ لَنَا الفَضِيلَةَ بِالْمَلَكَةِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ الْخَلْقِ
segments.transliteration: Wa jaâala lanÄ al-faá¸Ä«lata bil-malakÄti âalÄ jamÄ«âil-khalq
segments.translation: And granted us superiority with domination over all creatures

segments.transliteration: Fa kullu khalÄ«qatihi munqÄdatun lanÄ biqudratihi
segments.translation: So that all His creation is made submissive to us by His power
And responsive to our obedience by His might

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لله الَّذِي أَغْلَقَ عَنَّا بَابَ الْحَّاجَةِ إلاّ إلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: Wal-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi alladhÄ« aghlaqa âannÄ bÄba al-á¸¥Äjati illÄ ilayhi
segments.translation: And praise be to Allah, who closed from us the door of need except towards Him

segments.arabic: فَكَيْفَ نُطِيقُ حَمْدَهُ أَمْ مَتَى نُؤَدِّي شُكْرَهُ؟ لا، مَتى؟
segments.transliteration: Fa kayfa nuá¹­Ä«qu á¸¥amdahu am matÄ nuâaddÄ« shukrahu? LÄ, matÄ?
segments.translation: So how can we bear His praise, or when shall we fulfill His thanks? Never, when?

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي رَكَّبَ فِينَا آلاَتِ الْبَسْطِ
segments.transliteration: Wal-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi alladhÄ« rakkaba fÄ«nÄ ÄlÄti al-basá¹­
segments.translation: And praise be to Allah, who placed within us the means of expansion
And made for us the tools of contraction
And delighted us with the spirits of life
And established within us the limbs of action
And nourished us with the wholesome provisions
And enriched us with His bounty
And granted us sufficiency by His grace
Then He commanded us to test our obedience
And forbade us to try our gratitude
But we opposed the way of His command
And we mounted upon the backs of His prohibitions

segments.transliteration: Falam yabtadirnÄ bi-âuqÅ«batihi walam yuâÄjilnÄ bi-niqmatihi
segments.translation: Yet He did not hasten us with His punishment, nor rush upon us with His vengeance

segments.arabic: بَلْ تَانَّانا بِرَحْمَتِهِ تَكَرُّماً، وَانْتَظَرَ مُراجَعَتَنَا بِرَأفَتِهِ حِلْماً.
segments.transliteration: Bal tÄnÄnÄ bi-raá¸¥matihi takarruman, wa-intaáºara murÄjaâatanÄ bi-raâfatihi á¸¥ilman
segments.translation: Rather, He deferred us with His mercy graciously, and waited for our return with compassion patiently

segments.transliteration: Wal-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi alladhÄ« dallanÄ âalÄ at-tawbah
segments.translation: And praise be to Allah, who guided us to repentance

segments.arabic: الَّتِي لَمْ نُفِدْهَا إلاّ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: AllatÄ« lam nufidâhÄ illÄ min faá¸lihi
segments.translation: Which we would not have attained except by His grace

segments.arabic: فَلَوْ لَمْ نَعْتَدِدْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إلاّ بِهَا
segments.transliteration: Fa law lam naâtidid min faá¸lihi illÄ bihÄ
segments.translation: If we counted nothing of His grace except it
Indeed His trial would be beautiful for us
And His beneficence great upon us
And His favor immense upon us

segments.arabic: فَمَا هكذا كَانَتْ سُنَّتُهُ فِي التَّوْبَةِ لِمَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَنَا
segments.transliteration: FamÄ hakadhÄ kÄnat sunnatuhu fi at-tawbati liman kÄna qablana
segments.translation: For such was not His custom in repentance with those who were before us

segments.arabic: لَقَدْ وَضَعَ عَنَّا مَا لا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Laqad waá¸aâa âannÄ mÄ lÄ á¹­Äqata lanÄ bihi
segments.translation: Indeed, He has lifted from us that which we had no strength to bear
And imposed upon us only what is within our capacity
And burdened us with nothing but ease

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَدَعْ لاَحَـد مِنَّا حُجَّةً وَلاَ عُذْراً
segments.transliteration: Walam yadaâ li-aá¸¥adin minnÄ á¸¥ujjatan wa lÄ âudhrÄ
segments.translation: And He left no proof nor excuse for anyone among us
So the doomed among us is he who perishes against Him

segments.arabic: وَ السَّعِيدُ مِنَّا مَنْ رَغِبَ إلَيْهِ
segments.translation: And the happy among us is he who turns in desire toward Him

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَمْد للهِ بِكُلِّ مَا حَمِدَهُ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wal-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi bikulli mÄ á¸¥amidahu bihi
segments.translation: And praise be to Allah with every praise with which
The nearest of His angels to Him
And the noblest of His creatures from Him
And the most pleasing of those who praise Him before Him
A praise that excels all other praise
Like the superiority of our Lord over all His creation

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ مَكَانَ كُلِّ نِعْمَة لَهُ عَلَيْنَا
segments.transliteration: Thumma lahu al-á¸¥amdu makÄna kulli niâmatin lahu âalaynÄ
segments.translation: Then His is the praise in place of every blessing He has given us

segments.arabic: وَ عَلى جَمِيعِ عِبَادِهِ الْمَاضِينَ وَالْبَاقِينَ
segments.transliteration: Wa âalÄ jamÄ«âi âibÄdihi al-mÄá¸Ä«na wal-bÄqÄ«n
segments.translation: And upon all His servants, those past and those remaining

segments.arabic: عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُهُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْاشْيَآءِ
segments.transliteration: âAdada mÄ aá¸¥Äá¹­a bihi âilmuhu min jamÄ«âil-ashyÄâ
segments.translation: According to the number encompassed by His knowledge of all things

segments.arabic: وَ مَكَانَ كُلِّ وَاحِدَة مِنْهَا عَدَدُهَا أَضْعافَاً مُضَاعَفَةً أَبَداً سَرْمَداً إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
segments.transliteration: Wa makÄna kulli wÄá¸¥idatin minhÄ âadaduha aá¸âÄfan muá¸Äâafatan abadan sarmadan ilÄ yawmil-qiyÄmah
segments.translation: And in place of each one of them multiplied times, forever, endlessly, until the Day of Resurrection
A praise without limit to its boundary
No reckoning for Its number
No reaching of its goal
And no end to its duration

segments.arabic: حَمْدَاً يَكُونُ وُصْلَةً إلَى طَاعَتِهِ وَعَفْوِهِ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤amdan yakÅ«nu wuá¹£latan ilÄ á¹­Äâatihi wa âafwihi
segments.translation: A praise that may be a means to His obedience and pardon
And a cause for His pleasure
And a way to His forgiveness
And a path to His Garden
And a shield from His wrath
And a security from His anger
And an aid to His obedience
And a barrier against disobedience to Him

segments.arabic: وَعَوْناً عَلَى تَأدِيَةِ حَقِّهِ وَ وَظائِفِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa âawnan âalÄ taâdiyati á¸¥aqqihi wa waáºÄâifihi
segments.translation: And a support in fulfilling His right and duties

segments.arabic: حَمْداً نَسْعَدُ بِهِ فِي السُّعَدَاءِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآئِهِ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤amdan nasâadu bihi fi-s-suâadÄâi min awliyÄâihi
segments.translation: A praise by which we may be among His happy friends

segments.arabic: وَنَصِيرُ بِهِ فِي نَظْمِ الشُّهَدَآءِ بِسُيُوفِ أَعْدَائِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa naá¹£Ä«ru bihi fÄ« naáºmi-sh-shuhadÄâi bisuyÅ«fi aâdÄâihi
segments.translation: And by which we may join the martyrs in line, by the swords of His enemies
Indeed, He is the Praiseworthy Guardian
1.Praise belongs to God,
2.the First, without a first before Him,

segments.arabic: وَ الاخِر بِلاَ آخِر يَكُونُ بَعْدَهُ
segments.translation: 3.the Last, without a last behind Him.
4.Beholders' eyes fall short of seeing Him,

segments.arabic: وَ عَجَزَتْ عَنْ نَعْتِهِ أَوهامُ اَلْوَاصِفِينَ
segments.translation: 5.describers' imaginations are not able to depict Him.
6.He originated the creatures through His power with an origination,
7.He devised them in accordance with His will with a devising.
8.Then He made them walk on the path of His desire,
9.He sent them out on the way of His love.

segments.transliteration: laa yam-likoona taa-kheerana a'm-maa qad-damahum ilay-h
segments.translation: 10.They cannot keep back from that to which He has sent them forward,

segments.arabic: وَلا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَقَدُّماً إلَى مَا أَخَّرَهُمْ عَنْهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yas-tat'eeu'wna taqad-duman ilaa maaa akh-kharahum a'n-h
segments.translation: 11.nor can they go forward to that from which He has kept them back.
12.He assigned from His provision to each of their spirits
13.a nourishment known and apportioned.
14.No decreaser decreases those whom He increases,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَزِيدُ مَنْ نَقَصَ منْهُمْ زَائِدٌ
segments.transliteration: wa laa yazeedu man-naqas'a min-hum zaaa-id
segments.translation: 15.no increaser increases those of them whom He decreases.

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ لَهُ فِي الْحَيَاةِ أَجَلاً مَوْقُوتاً،
segments.translation: 16.Then for each spirit He strikes a fixed term in life,
17.for each He sets up a determined end;
18.he walks toward it through the days of his span,
19.he overtakes it through the years of his time.
20.Then, when he takes his final step
21.and embraces the reckoning of his span,
22.God seizes him to the abundant reward

segments.arabic: مِنْ مَوْفُورِ ثَوَابِهِ أَوْ مَحْذُورِ عِقَابِهِ،
segments.translation: 23.or the feared punishment to which He has called him,
24."That He may repay those who do evil for what they have done
25.and repay those who do good with goodness" (53:31),
26.as justice from Him (holy are His names,
27.and manifest His boons).

segments.arabic: لاَ يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْأَلُونَ
segments.translation: 28."He shall not be questioned as to what He does, but they shall be questioned" (21:23).

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي لَوْ حَبَسَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ مَعْرِفَةَ
segments.transliteration: wal-h'am-du lil-laahil-lad'ee law h'abasa a'n i'baadihee maa'-rifata
segments.translation: 29.Praise belongs to God, for, had He withheld from His servants the knowledge

segments.arabic: حَمْدِهِ عَلَى مَا أَبْلاَهُمْ مِنْ مِنَنِهِ الْمُتَتَابِعَةِ
segments.translation: 30.to praise Him for the uninterrupted kindnesses with which He has tried them
31.and the manifest favours which He has lavished upon them,
32.they would have moved about in His kindnesses without praising Him,

segments.transliteration: wa tawas-sau'wa fee riz-qihee falam yash-kurooh
segments.translation: 33.and spread themselves out in His provision without thanking Him.

segments.arabic: وَلَوْ كَانُوا كَذلِكَ لَخَرَجُوا مِنْ حُدُودِ الانْسَانِيَّةِ
segments.transliteration: wa law kaanoo kad'alika lakharajoo min h'udoodil-insaanee-yah
segments.translation: 34.Had such been the case, they would have left the bounds of humanity
35.for that of beastliness

segments.transliteration: fakaanoo kamaa was'afa fee muh'-kami kitaabihi:
segments.translation: 36.and become as He has described in the firm text of His Book:

segments.arabic: ( إنْ هُمْ إلا كَالانْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلا )
segments.transliteration: (in hum il-laa kal-an-a'ami bal hum az''al-lu sabeelaa)
segments.translation: 37."They are but as the cattleânay, but they are further astray from the way"! (25:46)

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لله عَلَى مَا عَرَّفَنا من نفسه
segments.transliteration: wal-h'am-du lil-lahee a'laa maa a'r-rafanaa min-naf-sih
segments.translation: 38.Praise belongs to God, for the true knowledge of Himself He has given to us,
39.the thanksgiving He has inspired us to offer Him,

segments.arabic: وَفَتَحَ لَنَا من أبوَابِ الْعِلْمِ بِرُبُوبِيّته
segments.transliteration: wa fatah'a lanaa min ab-waabil-i'l-mi biruboobee-yatih
segments.translation: 40.the doors to knowing His Lordship He has opened for us,

segments.arabic: وَدَلَّنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الاِخْلاَصِ لَهُ فِي تَوْحِيدِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa dal-lanaa a'lay-hee minal-ikh-laas'i lahoo fee taw-h'eedih
segments.translation: 41.the sincerity towards Him in professing His Unity to which He has led us,

segments.arabic: وَجَنَّبَنا مِنَ الالْحَادِ وَالشَّكِّ فِي أَمْرِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa jan-nabanaa minal-il-h'aadi wash-shak-ki feee am-rih
segments.translation: 42.and the deviation and doubt in His Command from which He has turned us aside;

segments.arabic: حَمْداً نُعَمَّرُ بِهِ فِيمَنْ حَمِدَهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
segments.transliteration: h'am-daan nua'm-maru bihee fee man h'amidahoo min khal-qih
segments.translation: 43.a praise through which we may be given long life among those of His creatures who praise Him,

segments.arabic: وَنَسْبِقُ بِـهِ مَنْ سَبَقَ إلَى رِضَاهُ وَعَفْوِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa nas-biqu bihee man sabaqa ilaa riz''aahoo wa a'f-wih
segments.translation: 44.and overtake those who have gone ahead toward His good pleasure and pardon;

segments.arabic: حَمْداً يُضِيءُ لَنَا بِهِ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرْزَخِ
segments.translation: 45.a praise through which He will illuminate for us the shadows of the interworld,
46.ease for us the path of the Resurrection,

segments.arabic: وَيُشَرِّفُ بِهِ مَنَازِلَنَا عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الاشْهَادِ
segments.transliteration: wa yushar-rifu bihee manaazilanaa i'nda mawaaqifil-ash-haadi
segments.translation: 47.and raise up our stations at the standing places of the Witnesses

segments.arabic: يَوْمَ تُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْس بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لا يُظْلَمُونَ
segments.transliteration: yaw-ma tuj-zaa kul-lu naf-sim-bimaa kasabat wa hum laa yuz'-lamoon
segments.translation: 48."on the day when every soul will be repaid for what it has earned - they shall not be wronged" (45:21);

segments.arabic: (يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي مَوْلىً عَنْ مَوْلىً شَيْئاً وَلاَ هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ)
segments.transliteration: (yaw-ma laa yugh-nee maw-lana a'm-maw-lana shay-aw-wa laa hum yuns'aroon)
segments.translation: 49."the day a master shall avail nothing a client, and they shall not be helped" (44:41);

segments.arabic: حَمْداً يَرْتَفِعُ مِنَّا إلَى أَعْلَى عِلِّيِّينَ
segments.transliteration: h'am-daan yar-tafiu' min-naaa ilaaa aa'-laa i'l-lee-yeena
segments.translation: 50.a praise which will rise up from us to the highest of the 'Illiyun
51."in a book inscribed, witnessed by those brought nigh" (83:20-21),

segments.arabic: حَمْداً تَقَرُّ بِهِ عُيُونُنَا إذَا بَرِقَت الابْصَارُ
segments.transliteration: h'am-daan taqar-ru bih u'yoonunaaa id'aa bariqatil-ab-s'aar
segments.translation: 52.a praise whereby our eyes may be at rest when sight is dazzled,

segments.arabic: وَتَبْيَضُّ بِهِ وُجُوهُنَا إذَا اسْوَدَّتِ الابْشَارُ،
segments.transliteration: wa tab-yaz''-z''u bihee wujoohunaaa id'aa as-wad-datil-abshaar
segments.translation: 53.our faces whitened when skins are blackened,

segments.arabic: حَمْداً نُعْتَقُ بِهِ مِنْ أَلِيمِ نار الله
segments.transliteration: h'am-daan nua'-taqu bihee min aleemi naaril-laahee
segments.translation: 54.a praise through which we may be released from God's painful Fire
55.and enter God's generous neighbourhood,
56.a praise by which we may jostle the angels brought nigh
57.and join the prophets, the envoys,

segments.arabic: فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ الَّتِي لا تَزُولُ
segments.translation: 58.in a House of Permanence that does not remove,
59.the Place of His Generosity that does not change.

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي اخْتَارَ لَنَا مَحَاسِنَ الْخَلْقِ
segments.translation: 60.Praise belongs to God, who chose for us the good qualities of creation,
61.granted us the agreeable things of provision,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلَ لَنَا الفَضِيلَةَ بِالْمَلَكَةِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ الْخَلْقِ
segments.transliteration: wa jaa'la lanaal-faz''eelata bil-malakati a'laa jameei'l-khal-q
segments.translation: 62.and appointed for us excellence through domination over all creation;
63.every one of His creatures submits to us through His power
64.and comes to obey us through His might.

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لله الَّذِي أَغْلَقَ عَنَّا بَابَ الْحَّاجَةِ إلاّ إلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: wal-h'am-du lil-lahil-ld'eee agh-laqa a'n-naa baabal-h'aajati il-laaa ilay-h
segments.translation: 65.Praise belongs to God, who locked for us the gate of need except toward Him.

segments.arabic: فَكَيْفَ نُطِيقُ حَمْدَهُ أَمْ مَتَى نُؤَدِّي شُكْرَهُ؟ لا، مَتى؟
segments.transliteration: fakay-fa nut'eequ h'am-dahu? am mataa noo-ad-dee shuk-rahu? laa mataa?
segments.translation: 66.So how can we praise Him? When can we thank Him? Indeed, when?

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي رَكَّبَ فِينَا آلاَتِ الْبَسْطِ
segments.translation: 67.Praise belongs to God, who placed within us the organs of expansion,
68.assigned for us the agents of contraction,
69.gave us to enjoy the spirits of life,
70.fixed within us the limbs of works,
71.nourished us with the agreeable things of provision,
72.freed us from need through His bounty,
73.and gave us possessions through His kindness.
74.Then He commanded us that He might test our obedience

segments.arabic: وَنَهَانَا لِيَبْتَلِيَ شُكْرَنَا فَخَالَفْنَا عَنْ طَرِيْقِ أمْرِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa nahaanaa leeab-taleea shuk-ranaa fakhaalaf-naa a'n t'areeqi am-rih
segments.translation: 75.and prohibited us that He might try our thanksgiving. So we turned against the path of His commandments
76.and mounted the backs of His warnings.

segments.transliteration: falam yab-tadir-naa biu'qoobatih wa lam yua'ajil-naa binaqimatih
segments.translation: 77.Yet He hurried us not to His punishment,nor hastened us on to His vengeance, ,

segments.arabic: بَلْ تَانَّانا بِرَحْمَتِهِ تَكَرُّماً، وَانْتَظَرَ مُراجَعَتَنَا بِرَأفَتِهِ حِلْماً.
segments.transliteration: bal taan-naanaa birah'-matihee takar-rumaawa antaz'ara muraajaa'tanaa biraa-fatihee h'il-maa
segments.translation: 78.No, He went slowly with us through His mercy, in generosity, and awaited our return through His clemency, in mildness.
79.Praise belongs to God, who showed us the way to repentance,

segments.arabic: الَّتِي لَمْ نُفِدْهَا إلاّ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: allatee lam nufid-haaa il-laa min faz''-lih
segments.translation: 80.which we would not have won save through His bounty.
81.Had we nothing to count as His bounty

segments.transliteration: il-laa bihaa laqad h'asuna balaaaw-uhoo i'ndanaa
segments.translation: 82.but this, His trial of us would have been good,
83.His beneficence toward us great,
84.His bounty upon us immense.

segments.arabic: فَمَا هكذا كَانَتْ سُنَّتُهُ فِي التَّوْبَةِ
segments.translation: 85.For such was not His wont in repentance
86.with those who went before us.
87.He has lifted up from us
88."what we have not the strength to bear"(2:286) ,
89.charged us only to our capacity,
90.imposed upon us nothing but ease,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَدَعْ لاَحَـد مِنَّا حُجَّةً وَلاَ عُذْراً
segments.transliteration: wa lam yadaa' liah'adim-min-naa h'uj-jataw-wa laa u'd'-raa
segments.translation: 91.and left none of us with an argument or excuse.
92.So the perisher among us is he who perishes in spite of Him
93.and the felicitous among us he who beseeches Him.

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَمْد للهِ بِكُلِّ مَا حَمِدَهُ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wal-h'am-du lil-lahee bikul-li maa h'amidahoo bihee
segments.translation: 94.And praise belongs to God with all the praises of
95.His angels closest to Him,
96.His creatures most noble in His eyes,
97.and His praisers most pleasing to Him;
98.a praise that may surpass other praises
99.as our Lord surpasses all His creatures.
100.Then to Him belongs praise,
101.in place of His every favour upon us

segments.arabic: وَ عَلى جَمِيعِ عِبَادِهِ الْمَاضِينَ وَالْبَاقِينَ
segments.translation: 102.and upon all His servants, past and still remaining,

segments.arabic: عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُهُ مِنْ جَمِيعِالاشْيَآءِ
segments.transliteration: a'dada maaa ah'aat'a bihee i'l-muhoo min jameei'l-ash-yaaa-i
segments.translation: 103.to the number of all things His knowledge encompasses,

segments.arabic: وَ مَكَانَ كُلِّ وَاحِدَة مِنْهَا عَدَدُهَا
segments.translation: 104.and in place of each of His favours,

segments.arabic: أَضْعافَاً مُضَاعَفَةً أَبَداً سَرْمَداً إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
segments.translation: 105.their number doubling and redoubling always and forever, to the Day of Resurrection;
106.a praise whose bound has no utmost end,
107.whose number has no reckoning,
108.whose limit cannot be reached,
109.whose period cannot be cut off;

segments.arabic: حَمْدَاً يَكُونُ وُصْلَةً إلَى طَاعَتِهِ وَعَفْوِهِ
segments.transliteration: h'am-day-yakoonu wus'-latan ilaa t'aaa'tihee wa a'f-wih
segments.translation: 110.a praise which will become a link to His obedience and pardon,
111.a tie to His good pleasure,
112.a means to His forgiveness,
113.a path to His Garden,
114.a protector against His vengeance,
115.a security against His wrath,
116.an aid to obeying Him,
117.a barrier against disobeying Him,

segments.arabic: وَعَوْناً عَلَى تَأدِيَةِ حَقِّهِ وَ وَظائِفِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa a'w-nan a'laa taa-deeati h'aq-qihee wawaz'aaa-ifih
segments.translation: 118.a help in fulfilling His right and His duties;

segments.arabic: حَمْداً نَسْعَدُ بِهِ فِي السُّعَدَاءِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآئِهِ
segments.transliteration: h'am-daan nas-a'du bihee fis-sua'daaa-i min aw-leeaaa-ih
segments.translation: 119.a praise that will make us felicitous among His felicitous friends,

segments.arabic: وَنَصِيرُ بِهِ فِي نَظْمِ الشُّهَدَآءِ بِسُيُوفِ أَعْدَائِهِ
segments.transliteration: nas'eeru bihee fee naz'-mish-shuhadaaa-i bisuyoofi aa'-daaa-ih
segments.translation: 120.and bring us into the ranks of those martyred by the swords of His enemies.
121.He is a Friend, Praiseworthy!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua36 When he saw Clouds and Lightning and heard the Thunder

segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّ هذَيْن آيَتَانِ مِنْ آياتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma inna hadhayni ÄyatÄni min ÄyÄtika,
segments.translation: O Allah! Indeed these two are among Your signs,
And these two are among Your helpers,

segments.arabic: يَبْتَدِرَانِ طَاعَتَكَ بِرَحْمَةٍ نَافِعَةٍ أَوْ نِقْمَةٍ ضَارَّةٍ،
segments.transliteration: YabtadirÄni á¹­Äâataka biraá¸¥matin nÄfiâatin aw niqmatin á¸Ärratin,
segments.translation: They hasten to obey You, bringing either helpful mercy or harmful punishment,
So do not pour upon us their evil rain,
And do not clothe us with affliction through them.
Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا نَفْعَ هَذِهِ السَّحَائِبِ وَبَرَكَتَهَا،
segments.transliteration: Wa anzil âalaynÄ nafâa hÄdhihi as-saá¸¥Äâibi wa barakatahÄ,
segments.translation: And send down upon us the benefit and blessing of these clouds,
And turn away from us their harm and damage,
And do not strike us with calamity through them,
And do not send blight upon our livelihoods.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كُنْتَ بَعَثْتَهَا نِقْمَةً وَأَرْسَلْتَهَا سَخْطَةً
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa in kunta baâathtahÄ niqmah wa arsaltahÄ sakhta,
segments.translation: O Allah, if You have sent them as a punishment and anger,
Then we seek refuge in You from Your anger,

segments.transliteration: Wa nabtahilu ilayka fÄ« suâÄli âafwika,
segments.translation: And we implore You in asking for Your pardon,
So direct Your anger towards the polytheists,

segments.transliteration: Wa adir raá¸¥Ä niqmatika âalÄ al-mulá¸¥idÄ«n,
segments.translation: And turn the mill of Your punishment upon the disbelievers.
O Allah, remove the drought of our land with Your rain,
And bring out the burning of our hearts with Your provision,
And do not distract us from You with anything else,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ،
segments.transliteration: WalÄ taqá¹­aâ âan kÄffatinÄ mÄddata birrik,
segments.translation: And do not cut off from us the flow of Your goodness,
For the truly rich is the one whom You enrich,
And the safe one is the one You protect,
No one besides You has defense,
And no one can resist Your might,

segments.arabic: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ،
segments.transliteration: Taá¸¥kumu bimÄ shiâta âalÄ man shiâta,
segments.translation: You judge as You will over whom You will,

segments.transliteration: Wataqá¸Ä« bimÄ aradta fÄ« man aradta,
segments.translation: And You decree as You wish upon whom You wish.

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
segments.transliteration: Falaka al-á¸¥amdu âalÄ mÄ waqaytanÄ minal-balÄâ,
segments.translation: So praise is Yours for protecting us from affliction,

segments.arabic: وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النِّعْمَاءِ
segments.transliteration: Walaka ash-shukru âalÄ mÄ khawwaltanÄ minan-niâmÄâ,
segments.translation: And thanks are Yours for what You granted us of blessings,
A praise that surpasses the praise of those who praise,
A praise that fills His earth and His heaven,
Surely, You are the Bestower of immense favors,
The Giver of great blessings,
The Accepter of even little praise,
The Thankful for even little gratitude,
The Beneficent, the Generous, the Possessor of bounty,

segments.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ إلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
segments.transliteration: LÄ ilÄha illÄ anta ilayka al-maá¹£Ä«r,
segments.translation: There is no god but You; to You is the return.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّ هذَيْن آيَتَانِ مِنْ آياتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-na hd'ay-ni aaayataani min aaayaatik
segments.translation: 1.O God, these are two of Your signs
2.and these are two of Your helpers.

segments.arabic: يَبْتَدِرَانِ طَاعَتَكَ بِرَحْمَة نَافِعَة أَوْ نَقِمَة ضَارَّة،
segments.transliteration: yab-tadiraani t'aaa'taka birah'-matin-naafia'tin aw naqimatin z''aaar-rah
segments.translation: 3.They rush to obey You with beneficial mercy or injurious vengeance,
4.so rain not down upon us from them the evil rain
5.and clothe us not through them in the garment of affliction!
6.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا نَفْعَ هَذِهِ السَّحَائِبِ وَبَرَكَتَهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa anzil a'lay-naa naf-a' had'ihs-sah'aaa-ibi wa barakatahaa
segments.translation: 7.send down upon us the benefit of these clouds and their blessing,
8.turn away from us their harm and their injury,
9.strike us not through them with blight,

segments.transliteration: wa laa tur-sil a'laa maa'ayishinaa a'ahah
segments.translation: 10.and loose not upon our livelihoods any bane!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كُنْتَ بَعَثْتَهَا نَقِمَةً وَأَرْسَلْتَهَا سَخْطَةً
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa in kunta baa'th-tahaa naqimah wa ar-sal-tahaa sakh-t'ah
segments.translation: 11.O God, if You hast incited them as vengeance and loosed them in anger,
12.we seek sanctuary with You from Your wrath

segments.transliteration: wa nab-tahilu ilay-ka fee soo-aali a'f-wik
segments.translation: 13.and implore You in asking Your pardon!
14.So incline with wrath toward the idolaters
15.and set the millstone of Your vengeance turning upon the heretics
16.O God, take away the barrenness of our lands with Your watering,
17.dislodge the malice from our breasts with Your providing,
18.distract us not from You through other than You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa taq-t'aa' a'n kaaaf-fatinaa maaad-data bir-rik
segments.translation: 19.and cut none of us off from the stuff of Your goodness,
20.for the rich is he to whom You hast given riches,
21.and the safe he whom You hast protected!
22.No one has any defense against You,

segments.transliteration: wa laa bih'adin a'n sat'-watika am-tinaaa'
segments.translation: 23.nor any means to bar Your penalty.

segments.arabic: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ،
segments.transliteration: tah'-kumu bimaa shi-ta a'laa man shi-t
segments.translation: 24.You decidest what You wilt for whom You wilt

segments.transliteration: wa taq-z''ee bimaaa arat-ta fee man arat-t
segments.translation: 25.and You decreest what You desirest for any whom You desirest!

segments.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
segments.translation: 26.So to You belongs praise for protecting us from affliction

segments.arabic: وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النّعْمَاءِ
segments.transliteration: wa lakash-shuk-ru a'laa maa khaw-wal-tanaa minan-naa'-maaa-i
segments.translation: 27.and to You belongs thanks for conferring upon us blessings,
28.a praise which will leave behind the praise of the praisers,
29.a praise which will fill the earth and the heaven!
30.Surely You art the All-kind through immense kindnesses,
31.the Giver of abounding favours,
32.the Accepter of small praise,
33.the Grateful for little gratitude,
34.the Beneficent, the Benevolent, Possessor of graciousness!

segments.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ إلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
segments.translation: 35.There is no god but Thou; unto You is the homecoming

title: Sahifa Sajjadiya - Supplication 20 Makaremul Akhlaq - Duas.org

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-merciful, the All-compassionate
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
cause my faith to reach the most perfect faith,
make my certainty the most excellent certainty,

segments.arabic: وَانتَهِ بِنِيَّتِي إِلَى أَحْسَنِ النِّيَّاتِ، وَبِعَمَلِي إِلَى أَحْسَنِ الأَعْمَاِل
segments.transliteration: wantahi bi-ni-yati ila ah-san-ni-yati wa bi-a'mali ila ah-sanil-a'-mal
segments.translation: and take my intention to the best of intentions, and my works to the best of works!
O Allah,
complete my intention through Your gentleness,
rectify my certainty through what is with You,
And set right what is corrupt in me through Your power!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
spare me the concerns which distract me,
employ me in that about which You will ask me tomorrow,
And let me pass my days in that for which You hast created me!

segments.transliteration: wa agh-nini wa aw-sia' a'lay-ya fi rizqik
segments.translation: Free me from need, and expand Your provision toward me,
And tempt me not with ingratitude!

segments.transliteration: wa ai'z-za ni wa-la tab-tali-yani-y bil-kib-r
segments.translation: Exalt me and afflict me not with pride!

segments.arabic: وَعَبِّدْنِي لَكَ وَلا تُفْسِدْ عِبِادَتِي بِالعُجْبِ
segments.transliteration: wa a'b-bid-ni laka wa-la tuf-sid i'bidati bil-u'j-b
segments.translation: Make me worship You and corrupt not my worship with self-admiration!

segments.arabic: وَأَجْرِ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى يَدَيَّ الْخَيْرَ وَلا تَمْحَقْهُ بِالْمَنِّ
segments.transliteration: wa aj-ri lin-nasi a'la yaday-yal-khayra wa-la tam-haq-hu bil-man-n
segments.translation: Let good flow out from my hands upon the people and efface it not by my making them feel obliged!
Give me the highest moral traits
And preserve me from vainglory!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَرْفَعْنِي فِي النَّاسِ دَرَجَةً إِلا حَطَطْتَنِي عِندَ نَفْسِي مِثْلَهَا
segments.transliteration: wa la tar-fa'-ni fin-nasi darajatan il-la hatat-tani i'nda naf-si mith-laha
segments.translation: raise me not a single degree before the people without lowering me its like in myself

segments.arabic: وَلا تُحْدِثْ لِي عِزّاً ظَاهِراً إِلاَّ أَحْدَثْتَ لِي ذِلَّةً بَاطِنَةً عِندَ نَفْسِي بِقَدَرِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa-la tuh-dith li i'z-zan zahiran il-la ah-dath-ta li dhil-latam batinatan i'nda naf-si biqadariha
segments.translation: And bring about no outward exaltation for me without an inward abasement in myself to the same measure!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma sal-li a'la muhammadiw-wa a-li muhammad
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household,

segments.arabic: وَمَتِّعْنِي بِهُدَىً صَاِلحٍ لا أَسْتَبْدِلُ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa mat-tia'-ni bihudan salihil-la as-tabdilu bih
segments.translation: give me to enjoy a sound guidance which I seek not to replace,
a path of truth from which I swerve not,
And an intention of right conduct in which I have no doubts!

segments.arabic: وَعَمِّرْنِي مَا كَانَ عُمْرِي بِذْلَةً فِي طَاعَتِكَ، فَإِذَا كَانَ عُمْرِي مَرْتَعاً لِلشَّيْطَانِ فَاقْبِضْنِي إِلَيْكَ، قَبْلَ أَن يَّسْبِقَ مَقْتُكَ إِلَيَّ، أَوْ يَسْتَحْكِمَ غَضَبُكَ عَلَيَّ
segments.transliteration: wa a'mmir-ni ma kana u'm-ri bidhlatan fi ta'tika fa-idha kana u'm-ri mar-ta'al-lish-shaytani faq-bizni ilayka qab-la ayyasbiqa maq-tuka ilay-ya aw yas-tah-kima ghazabuka a'lay-ya
segments.translation: Let me live as long as my life is a free gift in obeying You, but if my life should become a pasture for Satan, seize me to Yourself before Your hatred overtakes me or Your wrath against be becomes firm!
O Allah,

segments.arabic: لا تَدَعْ خِصْلَةً تُعَابُ مِنِّي إِلاَّ أَصْلَحْتَهَا
segments.transliteration: la tada' khas-latan tua'abu min-ni il-la as-lah-taha
segments.translation: deposit in me no quality for which I will be faulted, unless You settest it right,

segments.arabic: وَلا عَائِبَةً أُؤَنَّبُ بِهَا إِلاَّ حَسَّنتَهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa-la a'a-ibatan uan-nabu biha il-la has-santaha
segments.translation: no flaw for which I will be blamed, unless You makest it beautiful,

segments.arabic: وَلا أُكْرُومَةً فِيَّ نَاقِصَةً إِلاَّ أَتْمَمْتَهَا
segments.transliteration: wa-la uk-rumatan fi-ya naqisatan il-la at-mam-taha
segments.translation: And no deficient noble trait, unless You completest it!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma sal-li a'la muhammadiw-wa a-li muhammad
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَبْدِلْنِي مِنْ بُغْضَةِ أَهْلِ الشَّنَانَ الْمَحَبَّةَ
segments.translation: and replace for me the animosity of the people of hatred with love,
the envy of the people of insolence with affection,
the suspicion of the people of righteousness with trust,
the enmity of those close with friendship,
the disrespect of womb relatives with devotion,
the abandonment of relatives with help,
the attachment of flatterers with love set right,
the rejection of fellows with generous friendliness,

segments.arabic: وَمِن مَّرَارَةِ خَوْفِ الظَّالِمِينَ حَلاَوَةَ الأَمنَةَ
segments.translation: And the bitterness of the fear of wrongdoers with the sweetness of security!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَل لِّي يَداً عَلى مَن ظَلَمَنِي،
segments.translation: appoint for me a hand against him who wrongs me,
a tongue against him who disputes with me,
And a victory over him who stubbornly resists me!

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي مَكْراً عَلَى مَن كَايَدَنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa hab li mak-ran a'la man kayadani
segments.translation: Give me guile against him who schemes against me,
power over him who oppresses me,
refutation of him who reviles me,
And safety from him who threatens me!
Grant me success to obey him who points me straight
And follow him who guides me right!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
and point me straight to
resist him who is dishonest toward me without counsel,
repay him who separates from me with gentle devotion,
reward him who deprives me with free giving,
recompense him who cuts me off with joining,

segments.arabic: وَأُخَاِلفَ مَنْ اغْتَابَنِي إِلَى حُسْنِ الذِّكْرِ،
segments.translation: oppose him who slanders me with excellent mention,
give thanks for good,
And shut my eyes to evil!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
adorn me with the adornment of the righteous,
And clothe me in the ornaments of the god-fearing, through:
spreading justice,
restraining rage,
quenching the flame of hate,
bringing together the people of separation,
correcting discord,
spreading about good behavior,
covering faults,
mildness of temper,
lowering the wing,
beauty of conduct,
gravity of bearing,
agreeableness in comportment,
precedence in reaching excellence,
preferring bounteousness,
refraining from condemnation,
bestowing bounty on the undeserving,
speaking the truth, though it be painful,

segments.arabic: وَاسْتِقْلاَلِ الْخَيْرِ وَإِن كَثُرَ مِن قَوْلِي وَفِعْلِي
segments.transliteration: was-tiq-lalil-khayri wa in kathura min qaw-li wa fia'-li
segments.translation: making little of the good in my words and deeds, though it be much,

segments.arabic: وَاسْتِكْثَارِ الْشَّرِ وَإِن قلَّ مِن قَوْلِي وَفِعْلِي
segments.transliteration: was-tik-tharish-shari wa in ql-la min qaw-li wa fia'-li
segments.translation: And making much of the evil in my words and deeds, though it be little!
Perfect this for me through
lasting obedience,
holding fast to the community,

segments.arabic: وَرَفْضِ أَهْلِ الْبِدَعِ، وَمُسْتَعْمِلِي الرَّأْيِ الْمُخْتَرَعِ
segments.translation: And rejecting the people of innovation and those who act in accordance with original opinions.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ أَوْسَعَ رِزْقِكَ عَلَيَّ إِذَا كَبِرْتُ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l aw-sa' rizqika a'lay-ya idha kabir-tu
segments.translation: appoint for me Your widest provision in my old age

segments.transliteration: wa aq-wa qu-watika fi-ya idha nasib-tu
segments.translation: And Your strongest strength when I am exhausted,
And try me not with laziness in worship of You,
blindness toward Your path,
undertaking what opposes love for You,
joining with him who has separated himself from You,
And separating from him who has joined himself to You!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أَصُولُ بِكَ عِندَ الضَّرُورَةِ،
segments.translation: O Allah, make me leap to You in times of distress,
ask from You in needs,
And plead to You in misery!

segments.arabic: وَلا تَفْتِنِّي بِالإِسْتِعَانَةِ بِغَيْرِكَ إِذَا اضْطُرِرْتُ،
segments.translation: Tempt me not to seek help from other than You when I am distressed,

segments.arabic: وَلا بِالْخُضُوعِ لِسُؤَاِل غَيْرِكَ إِذَا افْتَقَرْتُ،
segments.translation: to humble myself in asking from someone else when I am poor,

segments.arabic: وَلا بِالتَّضَرُّعِ إِلَى مَن دُونِكَ إِذَارَهِبْتُ
segments.transliteration: wa-la bit-tazar-rui' ila man dunaka idharahib-tu
segments.translation: or to plead with someone less than You when I fear,

segments.transliteration: fas-tahiq-qu bidhlika khidhlanaka wa man-a'ka wa ia'-razak
segments.translation: for then I would deserve Your abandonment, Your withholding, and Your turning away,
O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ فِي رَوْعِي منِ التَّمَنِّي وَالتَّظَنِّي وَالْحَسَدِذِكْراً لِعَظَمَتِكَ، وَتَفَكُّراً فِي قُدْرَتِكَ، وَتَدْبِيراً عَلَى عَدُوِّكَ،
segments.transliteration: allahummaj-a'l ma yul-qish-shaytanu fi raw-e'e mint-taman-ni wat-tazan-ni wal-hasadidhik-ral-li-a'zamatika wa tafak-kuran fi qud-ratika wa tad-biran a'la a'du-wika
segments.translation: O Allah, make the wishing, the doubt, and the envy which Satan throws into my heart a remembrance of Your mightiness, a reflection upon Your power, and a devising against Your enemy!

segments.arabic: وَمَا أَجْرَى عَلَى لِسَانِى مِن لَّفْظَةِ فُحْشٍ أَوْ هَجْرٍ أَوْ شَتْمِ عِرْضٍ أَوْ شَهَادَةِ بَاطِلٍ أَوِ اغْتِيَابِ مُؤْمِنٍ غَائِبٍ أَوْ سَبِّ حَاضِرٍ أَوْ مَا أَشْبَهَ ذَلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ma aj-ra a'la li-sani mil-laf-zati fuh-shin aw haj-rin aw shat-mi i'r-zin aw shahadati batilin awigh-tiyabi mu-minin gha-ibin aw sab-bi hazirin aw ma ash-baha dhalika
segments.translation: Make everything he causes to pass over my tongue - the indecent or ugly words, the maligning of good repute, the false witness, the speaking ill of an absent man of faith, or the reviling of one present, and all things similarâ
a speech in praise of You,
a pursual of eulogizing You,
an excursion in magnifying You,
a thanksgiving for Your favour,
an acknowledgment of Your beneficence,
And an enumeration of Your kindness!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَلا أُظْلَمَنَّ وَأَنتَ مُطِيقٌ لِّلدَّفْعِ عَنِّي
segments.transliteration: wa-la uzlaman-na wa anta mutiqul-lid-daf-i' a'n-ni
segments.translation: let me not be wronged, while You canst repel from me,

segments.arabic: وَلا أَظْلِمَنَّ وَأَنتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلى الْقَبْضِ مِنِّي
segments.transliteration: wa-la azliman-na wa antal-qadiru a'lil-qab-zi min-ni
segments.translation: let me not do wrong, while You are powerful over holding me back,

segments.transliteration: wa-la azil-lan-na wa qad am-kanat-ka hidayati
segments.translation: let me not be misguided, while You are able to guide me,

segments.transliteration: wa-la af-taqiran-na wa min i'ndika wus-e'e
segments.translation: let me not be poor, while with You is my plenty,

segments.transliteration: wa-la at-ghayan-na wa min i'ndika wuj-di
segments.translation: let me not be insolent, while from You comes my wealth!
O Allah,
I come to Your forgiveness,
I go straight to Your pardon,
I yearn for Your forbearance,
And I trust in Your bounty,

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ عِندِي مَا يُوجِبُ لِي مَغْفِرَتَكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laysa i'ndi ma yujibu li magh-firatak
segments.translation: but there is nothing with me to make me warrant but Your forgiveness,

segments.arabic: وَلا فِي عَمَلِي مَا أَسْتَحِقُّ بِهِ عَفْوَكَ
segments.transliteration: wa-la fi a'mali ma as-tahiq-qu bihi a'f-wak
segments.translation: nothing in my works to make me merit but Your pardon,

segments.arabic: وَمَا لِي بَعْدَ أَنْ حَكَمْتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إلاَّ فَضْلُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa ma li ba'-da an hakam-tu a'la naf-si il-la fazluka
segments.translation: And nothing on my behalf after I judge my soul but Your bounty,
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
O Allah, bestow Your bounty upon me!
make my speech be guidance,
inspire me with reverential fear,
give me success in that which is most pure,
And employ me in what is most pleasing to You!
O Allah, let me tread the most exemplary path

segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-ni a'la mil-latika amutu wa ah-ya
segments.translation: And make me live and die in Your creed!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
give me to enjoy moderation,
make me into one of the people of right behavior,
the proofs of right conduct,
And the servants of righteousness,
And provide me with triumph at the place of Return
And safety from the Ambush!
O Allah,

segments.arabic: خُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ مِن نَّفْسِي مَا يُخَلِّصُهَا
segments.translation: take to Yourself from my soul what will purify it

segments.arabic: وَأَبْقِ لِنَفْسِي مِن نَّفْسِي مَا يُصْلِحُهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa ab-qi linaf-si min-naf-si ma yus-lihuha
segments.translation: And leave for my soul that of my soul that will set it right,
for my soul will perish unless You preservest it!
O Allah,
You are my stores when I sorrow,
You are my recourse when I am deprived,
from You I seek aid when troubled
and with You is a substitute for everything gone by,
a correction for everything corrupted,
a change from everything You is approvest.
So show kindness to me with well-being before affliction,
wealth before asking,
right conduct before misguidance;
suffice me against the burden of shame toward the servants,
give me security on the Day of Return,
And grant me excellent right guidance!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
repel from me through Your gentleness,
feed me through Your favour,
set me right through Your generosity,
heal me through Your benefaction,
shade me in Your shelter,
wrap me in Your good pleasure,

segments.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنِي إِذَا اشْتَكَلَتْ عَلَيَّ الأُمُورُ لأَهْدَاهَا،
segments.translation: And give me success to reach the most guided of affairs when affairs confuse me,
the purest of works when works seem similar,
and the most pleasing to You of creeds when creeds conflict!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
crown me with sufficiency,
place in me excellent guardianship
give me to guide correctly ,
tempt me not with plenty,
grant me excellent ease,
make not my life toil and trouble,
And refuse not my supplication in rejection,
for I make none rival to You
And I supplicate none with You as equal!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
hold me back from prodigality,
fortify my provision against ruin,
increase my possessions through blessing them,

segments.arabic: وَأَصِبْ بِي سَبِيلَ الْهِدَايَةِ لِلْبِرِّ فِيمَا أُنفِقُ مِنْهُ
segments.transliteration: wa asib bi sabilal-hidayati lil-bir-ri fima unfiqu minh
segments.translation: And set me upon the path of guidance through piety in what I spend!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
And spare me the burden of earning,
provide for me without reckoning,
lest I be distracted from Your worship through seeking
And carry the load of earning's ill results!
O Allah,
bestow upon me what I seek through Your power
And grant me sanctuary from what I fear through Your might!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
save my face through ease,
And demean not my dignity through neediness,
lest I seek provision from those whom You hast provided
And ask for bestowal from the worst of Your creatures!
And Then I would be tried by praising him who gave to me
afflicted with blaming him who held back from me,

segments.arabic: وَأَنتَ مِن دُونِهِمْ وَلِيُّ الإِعْطَاءِ وَالْمَنْعِ
segments.transliteration: wa anta min dunihim wali-yul-ia'-ta-i wal-man-i'
segments.translation: While Youâ not theyâ art patron of giving and holding back
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
And provide me with soundness in worship,
detachment in renunciation,
knowledge put into action,
And abstinence in measure!
O Allah, seal my term with Your pardon,

segments.transliteration: wa haq-qiq fi raja-i rah-matika amali
segments.translation: verify my expectation in hoping for thy mercy,

segments.transliteration: wa sah-hil ila bulughi rizaka subuli
segments.translation: smooth my paths to reach Your good pleasure,

segments.transliteration: wa has-sin fi jamii' ah-wali a'mali
segments.translation: And make my works good in all my states!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
Incite me to remember You in times of heedlessness,
employ me in Your obedience in days of disregard,

segments.arabic: وَانْهَجْ لِي إِلَى مَحَبَّتِكَ سَبِيلاً سَهْلَةً
segments.transliteration: wan-haj li ila mahab-batika sabilan sah-lah
segments.translation: open a smooth road for me to Your love,

segments.arabic: أَكْمِلْ لِي بِهَا خَيْرَ الدُّنيَا وَالآخِرَةِ
segments.translation: And complete for me thereby the good of this world and the next!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهِ كَأَفْضَلِ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِّنْ خَلْقِكَ قَبْلَهُ وَأَنتَ مُصَلٍّ عَلى أَحَدٍ بَعْدَهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma sal-li a'la muhammadiw-wa a-lihi ka-af-zali ma sal-layta a'la ahadim min khal-qika qab-lahu wa anta musal-lin a'la ahadim-ba'-dah
segments.translation: O Allah, and bless Muhammad and his Household the best You hast blessed any of Your creatures before him and wilt bless any of them after him,

segments.arabic: وَآتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً
segments.transliteration: wa a-tina fid-dunya hasanataw-wa fil-a-khirati hasanah
segments.translation: And give to us in this world good, and in the next world good,
And protect me through Your mercy from the chastisement of the Fire!

segments.arabic: إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيٍْء قَدِيرٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ
segments.transliteration: in-naka a'la kul-li shay-in qadiruw-wahua a'ilayka yasir
segments.translation: You are powerful over everything, and that is easy for You!

Islam believes in the elevation of the human being, that a human is a great and dignified creation, far above the animal world. One of the signs of this dignity is the possession of noble and magnanimous qualities. In order to achieve this behavioral excellence, man needs to overcome his base and selfish attributes, and cultivate noble qualities. In this Du"a the Imam specifies these qualities, and shows how we can try to inculcate them in ourselves. . segments.translation: 15.and avoidance of the disobedience which You hast prohibited for me!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa am-nun a'lay bil-h'aj-ji wal-u'm-rah
segments.translation: 16.O God, oblige me through the hajj, the umra,

segments.transliteration: wa zeeaarati qab-ri rasoolika s'alawaatuka a'lay-hee
segments.translation: 17.and visiting the graves of Your Messenger (Your blessings,
18.mercy, and benedictions upon him and upon his Household)

segments.arabic: وَآلِ رَسُولِكَ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ أَبَداً مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa a'laaa aaali rasoolika a'lay-himus-salaamu abadam-maaa ab-qay-tanee
segments.translation: 19.and the Household of Your Messenger (upon them be peace) for as long as You causest me to live,

segments.arabic: فِي عَامِي هَذَا وَفِي كُلِّ عَام،
segments.transliteration: fee a'amee had'aa wa fee kul-li a'am
segments.translation: 20.in this year of mine and in every year,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ مَقْبُولاً مَشْكُوراً مَذْكُوراً لَدَيْكَ،
segments.translation: 21.and make that accepted, thanked, and mentioned before You
22.and stored away with You!

segments.arabic: وَأَنْطِقْ بِحَمْدِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَذِكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ الثَّناءِ  عَلَيْكَ لِسَانِي،
segments.transliteration: wa ant'iq bih'am-dika washuk-rika wad'ik-rika wah'us-nith-thanaaa-i a'lay-ka lisaanee
segments.translation: 23.Make my tongue utter Your praise, Your thanksgiving, Your remembrance, and Your excellent laudation,
24.and expand my heart toward the right goals of Your religion!

segments.arabic: ÙÙØ£ÙØ¹ÙØ°ÙÙÙÙ ÙÙØ°ÙØ±ÙÙÙÙÙØªÙÙ ÙÙÙÙ Ø§ÙØ´ÙÙÙÙØ·ÙØ§ÙÙ Ø§ÙØ±ÙÙØ¬ÙÙÙ
segments.translation: 25.Give me and my progeny refuge from the accursed Satan,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ السَّامَّةِ وَالْهَامَّةِ وَالْعَامَّةِ وَاللاَّمَّةِ
segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ris-saaam-mati wal-haaam-mati wal-a'aam-mati wal-l-laaam-mah
segments.translation: 26.the evil of venomous vermin, threatening pests, swarming crowds, and evil eyes,
27.the evil of "every rebel satan" (22:3),

segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li sul-t'aanin a'need
segments.translation: 28.the evil of every refractory sovereign,

segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li mut-rafin h'afeed
segments.translation: 29.the evil of everyone living in ease and served,

segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li z''ae'efiw-wa shadeed
segments.translation: 30.the evil of everyone weak or strong,

segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li shareefiw-wa waz''eea'
segments.translation: 31.the evil of everyone born high or low,

segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li s'agheeriw-wa kabeer
segments.translation: 32.the evil of everyone small or great,

segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li qareebiw-wa bae'ed
segments.translation: 33.the evil of everyone near or far,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ مَنْ نَصَبَ لِرَسُولِكَ وَلأهْلِ بَيْتِهِ حَرْبَـاً مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالإنْسِ،
segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li man-nas'aba lirasoolika waliah-li bay-tihee h'ar-bam-minal-jin-ni wal-ins
segments.translation: 34.the evil of every one, jinn or man, who declares war on Your Messenger and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرّ كُلِّ دَابَّة أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa min shar-ri kul-li daaab-batin anta aaakhid'um-binaas'eeatihaa
segments.translation: 35.and the evil of "every crawling creature that You hast taken by the forelock!
36.Surely You art on a straight path"(ref.11:56).
37.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَرَادَنِي بِسُوء فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَادْحَرْ عَنِّي مَكْرَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa man araadanee bisooo-in  faas'-rif-hoo a'n-nee wa ad-h'ar a'n-nee mak-rah
segments.translation: 38.and if someone desires ill for me turn him away from me, drive away from me his deception,

segments.arabic: وَادْرَأ عَنِّي شَرَّهُ، وَرُدَّ كَيْدَهُ فِي نَحْرِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa ad-raa a'n-nee shar-rah wa rud-da kay-dahoo fee nah'-rih
segments.translation: 39.avert from me his evil, send his trickery back to his own throat,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ سَدّاً حَتَّى تُعْمِيَ عَنِّي بَصَرَهُ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l bay-na yaday-hee sad-dana h'at-taa tua'-meea a'n-nee bas'arah
segments.translation: 40.and place before him a barricade, so that You mayest blind his eyes toward me,

segments.arabic: وَتُصِمَّ عَنْ ذِكْري سَمْعَهُ، وَتُقْفِلَ دُونَ إخْطَارِي قَلْبَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa tus'im-ma a'n d'ik-ree sam-a'h wa tuq-fila doona ikh-t'aaree qal-bah
segments.translation: 41.deafen his ears toward my mention, lock his heart toward recalling me,

segments.transliteration: wa tukh-risa a'n-nee lisaanah wa taq-maa' raa-sah
segments.translation: 42.silence his tongue against me, restrain his head,

segments.transliteration: wa tud'il-la i'z-zah wa tak-sira jabarootah
segments.translation: 43.abase his exaltation, break his arrogance,

segments.transliteration: wa tud'il-la raqabatah wa taf-sakha kib-rah
segments.translation: 44.abase his neck, disjoint his pride,
45.and make me secure from all his injury,

segments.transliteration: washar-rih wa gham-zihee wa ham-zihee wa lam-zih wa h'asadihee
segments.translation: 46.his evil, his slander, his backbiting, his faultfinding, his envy,

segments.transliteration: wa a'daawatih wa h'abaaa-ilihee wa mas'aaa-idih wa raj-lihee wakhay-lih
segments.translation: 47.his enmity, his snares, his traps, his foot soldiers, and his cavalry!
48.Surely You art Mighty, Powerful!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 10 In Seeking Asylum with God

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ تَشَأْ تَعْفُ عَنَّا فَبِفَضْلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma in tashaÊ¾ taÊ¿fu Ê¿annÄ fabifaá¸lika
segments.translation: O Allah, if You will, You forgive us by Your grace,
And if You will, You punish us by Your justice,
So make easy for us Your pardon by Your bounty,
And save us from Your punishment by Your forgiveness;
For we have no strength to bear Your justice,

segments.arabic: وَلَا نَجَاةَ لِأَحَدٍ مِنَّا دُونَ عَفْوِكَ.
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ najÄta li-aá¸¥adin minnÄ dÅ«na Ê¿afwika
segments.translation: And none of us can be saved without Your pardon.

segments.arabic: يَا غَنِيَّ الأَغْنِيَاءِهَا، نَحْنُ عِبَادُكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: YÄ ghanÄ«ya alaghniyÄÊ¾, hÄ naá¸¥nu Ê¿ibÄduka bayna yadayka
segments.translation: O Richest of the rich, here we are, Your servants before You,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا أَفْقَرُ الفُقَرَاءِ إِلَيْكَ، فَاجْبُرْ فَاقَتَنَا بِوُسْعِكَ،
segments.transliteration: WaanÄ afqaru alfuqarÄÊ¾ ilayka, faajbur fÄqatana biwusÊ¿ika
segments.translation: And I am the poorest of the poor to You, so mend our poverty with Your ability,
And do not cut off our hope by withholding,

segments.arabic: فَتَكُونَ قَدْ أَشْقَيْتَ مَنِ اسْتَسْعَدَ بِكَ،
segments.transliteration: FatakÅ«na qad ashqayta mani istasÊ¿ada bika
segments.translation: So You would have made wretched one who sought happiness through You,
And deprived one who sought the bounty from You.
Then to whom shall we turn away from You,?
And where shall we go away from Your door,

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ نَحْنُ الْمُضْطَرُّونَ الَّذِينَ أَوْجَبْتَ إِجَابَتَهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Änaka naá¸¥nu almuá¸á¹­arrÅ«na alladhÄ«na awjabta ijÄbatahum
segments.translation: Glory be to You, we are the distressed ones whose answer You have made obligatory,

segments.arabic: وَأَهْلُ السُّوءِ الَّذِينَ وَعَدْتَ الْكَشْفَ عَنْهُمْ.
segments.transliteration: Waahlu assÅ«Ê¾ alladhÄ«na waÊ¿adta alkashfa Ê¿anhum
segments.translation: And the people of evil whom You promised to relieve.
And the most resembling of things to Your will,

segments.arabic: وَأَوْلَى الأُمُورِ بِكَ فِي عَظَمَتِكَ رَحْمَةُ مَنِ اسْتَرْحَمَكَ،
segments.transliteration: WaawlÄ alumÅ«ri bika fÄ« Ê¿aáºamatika raá¸¥matu mani istará¸¥amaka
segments.translation: And the most befitting of matters for You in Your greatness is the mercy upon one who seeks it from You,
And the aid to one who seeks help from You,
So have mercy upon our supplication to You,

segments.arabic: وَأَغْنِنَا إِذْ طَرَحْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ.
segments.transliteration: WaaghninÄ idh á¹­araá¸¥nÄ anfusanÄ bayna yadayka
segments.translation: And enrich us as we have cast ourselves before You.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ شَمِتَ بِنَا إِذْ شَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma inna ashshayá¹­Äna qad shamita binÄ idh shÄyaÊ¿nÄhu Ê¿alÄ maÊ¿á¹£iyatika
segments.translation: O Allah, Satan has rejoiced over us when we sided with him in disobeying You,
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,

segments.arabic: وَلَا تُشْمِتْهُ بِنَا بَعْدَ تَرْكِنَا إِيَّاهُ لَكَ،
segments.transliteration: WalÄ tushmithu binÄ baÊ¿da tarkinÄ iyyÄhu laka
segments.translation: And do not let him rejoice over us after we abandoned him for Your sake,
And turned our desire away from him towards You.

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ إن تَشَأْ تعفُ عَنّا فَبِفضْلِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in tashaa taa'-fu a'n-naa fabifaz''-lik
segments.translation: 1. O God, if You willest, You wilt pardon us through Your bounty

segments.arabic: وَانْ تَشَأْ تُعَذِّبْنا فَبَعدْلِكَ. فَسَهِّلْ لَنَا عَفْوَكَ بِمنِّكَ ،
segments.transliteration: wa in tashaa tua'd'-d'ib-naa fabia'd-lik fasah-hil-lanaa a'f-waka biman-nik
segments.translation: 2. and if You willest, You wilt chastise us through Your justice. So make our ways smooth to Your pardon through Your kindness

segments.arabic: وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ عَذَابِكَ بِتَجاوُزكَ; فَإنَّهُ لاَ طاقَةَ لَنَا بَعدلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ajir-naa min a'd'aabika bitajaawuzik fa in-nahoo laa t'aaqata lanaa bia'd-lik
segments.translation: 3. and grant us sanctuary from Your chastisement through Your forbearance, for none of us has the endurance for Your justice

segments.arabic: وَلاَ نجاةَ لأحَد مِنّا دُوْنَ عَفْوِكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa najaata liah'adim-min-naa doona a'f-wik
segments.translation: 4. and none of us can reach deliverance without Your pardon!

segments.arabic: يا غَنِيَّ الأغْنياء هَا نَحَنُ عِبادُكَ بين يدَيكَ
segments.transliteration: yaa ghanee-yal-agh-neeaaa-i haa nah'-nu i'baaduka bay-na yaday-k
segments.translation: 5. O Richest of the rich! Here we are, Your servants, before You.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا أَفقَرُ الفْقَراء إليْكَ فَأجْبُرْ فاقَتَنا بِوُسْعِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: wa ana af-qarul-fuqaraaa-i ilay-k faj-bur faaqatanaa biwus-i'k
segments.translation: 6. I am the neediest of the needy toward You, so redress our neediness through Your plenty

segments.arabic: ولا تَقْطَعَ رَجَاءنا بِمَنْعِكَ فَتَكُوْنَ قد أَشْقَيْتَ مَنِ اسْتَسْعَدَ بِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa taq-t'aa' rajaaa-naa biman-i'k fatakoona qad ash-qay-ta mani as-tas-a'da bikÙÙa
segments.translation: 7. and cut us not off from our hopes through Your withholding, lest You makest wretched him who seeks felicity through You
8. and deprivest him who seeks help from Your bounty!
9. Then to whom would we return after You?
10. Where would we go from Your gate?

segments.arabic: سُبْحَنَكَ نَحْنُ المضْطُّرون الذّينَ أَوْجَبْتَ إجابَتَهُمْ ،
segments.translation: 11. Glory be to You! We are the distressed, the response to whom You hast made incumbent,

segments.arabic: وَأهْلُ  السُّوْء الذّيْنَ وَعَدْتَ الْكَشْفَ عَنْهُمْ.
segments.translation: 12. the people from whom You hast promised to remove the evil.
13. That thing most resembling Your will

segments.arabic: وَأَوْلَى الأمُورِ بِكَ فِيْ عَظَمَتِكَ رَحْمَةُ مَنِ اسْتَرْحَمَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa aw-laal-umoori bika fee a'z'amatik rah'-matu mani as-tar-h'amak
segments.translation: 14. and that affair most worthy for You in Your mightiness is showing mercy to him who asks You for mercy

segments.arabic: وَغَوْثُ مَنِ اسْتَغَاثَ بِكَ، فَارْحَمْ تَضَرُّعَنَا إلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ghaw-thu mani as-taghaatha bik far-h'am taz''ar-rua'naaa ilay-k
segments.translation: 15. and helping him who seeks help from You. So show mercy upon our pleading with You

segments.arabic: وَأَغْنِنَا إذْ طَرَحْنَـا أَنْفُسَنَا بَيْنَ يَـدَيْكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa agh-ninaaa id' t'arah'-naaa anfusanaa bay-na yaday-k
segments.translation: 16. and free us from need when we throw ourselves before You!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ شمِتَ بِنَا إذْ شَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-nash-shay-t'aana qad shamita binaaa id' shaayaa'-naahoo a'laa maa'-s'eeatak
segments.translation: 17. O God, Satan will gloat over us if we follow him in disobeying You,
18. so bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَلا تُشْمِتْهُ بِنَا بَعْدَ تَرْكِنَا إيَّاهُ لَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tush-mit-hoo binaa baa'-d tar-kinaaa ee-yaahoo lak
segments.translation: 19. and let him not gloat over us after we have renounced him for You
20. and beseeched You against him!
