segments.translation: and single out my parents with the best of what You singled out

segments.arabic: آبَاءَ عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَاُمَّهَاتِهِمْ يَا أَرْحَمَ الـرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: ÄbÄâa âibÄdika al-muâminÄ«na wa ummahÄtihim yÄ ará¸¥ama ar-rÄá¸¥imÄ«n.
segments.translation: the fathers of Your believing servants and their mothers, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُنْسِنِي ذِكْرَهُمَا فِي أَدْبَارِ صَلَوَاتِي
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma lÄ tunsÄ«nÄ« dhikrahumÄ fÄ« adbÄri á¹£alawÄtÄ«
segments.translation: O Allah, do not make me forget their remembrance at the conclusions of my prayers,

segments.transliteration: wa fÄ« anan min ÄnÄâi laylÄ«,
segments.translation: and in any part of the moments of my night,

segments.arabic: وَفِي كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِ نَهَارِي.
segments.transliteration: wa fÄ« kulli sÄâatin min sÄâÄti nahÄrÄ«.
segments.translation: and in every hour of the hours of my day.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älih
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family,
and forgive me through my prayer for them,
and forgive them through their dutifulness to me,
a definite forgiveness,

segments.arabic: وَارْضَ عَنْهُمَا بِشَفَاعَتِي لَهُمَا رِضَىً عَزْماً،
segments.transliteration: wa irá¸a âanhumÄ bi-shafÄâatÄ« lahumÄ riá¸an âazmÄ,
segments.translation: and be pleased with them through my intercession for them, a resolute pleasure,
and convey them with honor to the abodes of peace.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُكَ لَهُمَا فَشَفِّعْهُمَا فِيَّ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa in sabaqat maghfiratuka lahumÄ fa-shaffiâhumÄ fiyy,
segments.translation: O Allah, if Your forgiveness preceded them, then make them intercede for me,

segments.arabic: وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُـكَ لِي فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيْهِمَا،
segments.transliteration: wa in sabaqat maghfiratuka lÄ« fa-shaffiânÄ« fÄ«himÄ,
segments.translation: and if Your forgiveness preceded me, then make me intercede for them,

segments.arabic: حَتّى نَجْتَمِعَ بِرَأفَتِكَ فِي دَارِ كَرَامَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: á¸¥attÄ najtamiâa bi-raâfatika fÄ« dÄri karÄmatik
segments.translation: so that we may gather by Your compassion in the abode of Your honor,
and the place of Your forgiveness and Your mercy.

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ وَالْمَنِّ الْقَدِيْمِ
segments.transliteration: innaka dhÅ« al-faá¸li al-âaáºÄ«mi wa al-manni al-qadÄ«m
segments.translation: Truly, You are the Possessor of immense favor and ancient bounty,
and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
1.O God, bless Muhammad, Your slave
2.and Your messenger, and his Household, the pure,

segments.arabic: وَاخْصُصْهُمْ بِأَفْضَلِ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ وَسَلاَمِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa akh-s'us'-hum bif-z''ali s'alawaatika wa rah'-matika wa barakaatika wa salaamik
segments.translation: 3.and single them out for the best of Your blessings, Your mercy, Your benedictions, and Your peace!
4.And single out my parents, O God, for honour with You
5.and blessings from You, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
6.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْنِي عِلْمَ مَا يَجبُ لَهُمَا عَلَىَّ  إلْهَاماً،
segments.transliteration: wa al-him-nee i'l-ma maa yajibu lahumaa a'l-lay il-haamaa
segments.translation: 7.teach me through inspiration knowledge of everything incumbent upon me toward them,

segments.arabic: وَاجْمَعْ لِي عِلْمَ ذلِكَ كُلِّهِ تَمَامـاً،
segments.transliteration: wa aj-maa' lee i'l-ma d'alika kul-lihee tamaamaa
segments.translation: 8.and gather within me knowledge of all that completely!
9.Then make me act in accordance with what You hast inspired me

segments.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنِي لِلنُّفُوذِ  فِيمَا تُبَصِّـرُنِيْ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa waf-fiq-nee liln-nufood'i feemaa tubas'-s'irunee min i'l-mih
segments.translation: 10.and give me the success to put into practice the knowledge You hast shown to me,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ يَفُوتَنِي اسْتِعْمَالُ شَيْء عَلَّمْتَنِيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa laa yafootanee as-tia'-maalu shay-in a'l-lam-taneeh
segments.translation: 11.lest I fail to act according to something You hast taught me

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَثْقُلَ أَرْكَانِي عَنِ الْحُفُوفِ فِيمَا أَلْهَمْتَنِيهِ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa tath-qula ar-kaanee a'nil-h'ufoofi feemaaa al-ham-taneeh
segments.translation: 12.or my limbs feel too heavy to perform that with which You hast inspired me!
13.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
14.as You hast ennobled us through him,
15.and bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: كَمَا أَوْجَبْتَ لَنَا الْحَقَّ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ بِسَبَبِهِ.
segments.translation: 16.as You hast made incumbent upon us rights toward the creatures because of him!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أَهَابُهُمَا هَيْبَةَ السُّلْطَانِ الْعَسُوفِ،
segments.translation: 17.O God, fill me with awe of my parents, the awe one has toward a tyrannical sovereign,
18.and let me be devoted to them, with the devotion of a compassionate mother!

segments.transliteration: waj-a'l t'aaa'tee liwaaliday-ya wa bir-ree bihimaa
segments.translation: 19.Make my obedience and devotion to them
20.more gladdening to my eyes than sleep to the drowsy
21.and more refreshing to my breast than drink to the thirsty,
22.so that I may prefer their inclination to my inclination,

segments.arabic: وَأُقَدِّمَ عَلَى رِضَاىَ رِضَاهُمَا وَأَسْتَكْثِرَ بِرَّهُمَا
segments.transliteration: wa uqad-dima a'laa riz''aaya riz''aahumaa wa as-tak-thira bir-rahumaa
segments.translation: 23.set their satisfaction before my satisfaction, make much of their devotion to me

segments.arabic: بِي وَإنْ قَلَّ وَأَسْتَقِلَّ بِرِّي بِهِمَا وَإنْ كَثُرَ.
segments.transliteration: bee wa in qal wa as-taqil-la bir-ree bihimaa wa in kathur
segments.translation: 24.though it be little, and make little of my devotion to them though it be great.
25.O God, lower before them my voice,
26.make agreeable to them my words,
27.make mild before them my temper,
28.make tender toward them my heart,

segments.transliteration: wa s'ay-yir-nee bihimaa rafeeqaw-wa a'lay-himaa shafeeqaa
segments.translation: 29.and turn me into their kind companion, their loving friend!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اشْكُرْ لَهُمَا تَرْبِيَتِي وَأَثِبْهُمَا عَلَى تَكْرِمَتِي،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma ush-kur lahumaa tar-beeatee wa athib-humaa a'laa tak-rimatee
segments.translation: 30.O God, thank them for my upbringing, reward them for honouring me,

segments.arabic: وَاحْفَظْ لَهُمَا  مَا حَفِظَاهُ مِنِّي فِي صِغَرِي.
segments.transliteration: wa ah'-faz' lahumaa maa h'afiz'aahoo min-nee fee s'igharee
segments.translation: 31.and guard them as they guarded me in my infancy!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا مَسَّهُمَا مِنِّي مِنْ أَذَىً أَوْ خَلَصَ إلَيْهِمَا عَنِّي مِنْ  مَكْرُوه
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa maa mas-sahumaa min-nee min ad'ana aw khalas'a ilay-himaa a'n-nee mim-mak-rooh
segments.translation: 32.O God, and whatever harm has touched them from me, detested thing has reached them from me,

segments.arabic: أَوْ ضَاعَ قِبَلِي لَهُمَا مِنْ حَقٍّ
segments.transliteration: aw z''aaa' qibalee lahumaa min h'aq
segments.translation: 33.or right of theirs which has been neglected by me,
34.allow it to alleviate their sins,
35.raise them in their degrees,
36.and add to their good deeds!

segments.arabic: يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ.
segments.translation: 37.O He who changes evil deeds into manifold good deeds!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَمَا تَعَدَّيَا عَلَيَّ فِيهِ مِنْ قَوْل،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa maa taa'd-dayaa a'lay-ya feehee min qaw-l
segments.translation: 38.O God, whatever word through which they have transgressed against me,

segments.arabic: أَوْ أَسْرَفَا عَلَىَّ فِيْهِ مِنْ فِعْل،
segments.transliteration: aw as-rafaa a'lay-ya feehee min fia'-l
segments.translation: 39.act through which they have been immoderate with me,

segments.arabic: أَوْ ضَيَّعَاهُ لِي مِنْ حَقٍّ أَوْ قَصَّرا بِي عَنْهُ مِنْ وَاجِب
segments.transliteration: aw z''ay-yaa'ahoo lee min h'aq aw qas'-s'araa bee a'n-hoo miw-waajib
segments.translation: 40.right of mine which they have left neglected, or obligation toward me in which they have fallen short,

segments.transliteration: faqad wahab-tuhoo lahumaa wa jut-tu bihee a'lay-himaa
segments.translation: 41.I grant it to them and bestow it upon them,

segments.arabic: وَرَغِبْتُ إلَيْكَ فِي وَضْعِ تَبِعَتِهِ عَنْهُمَا
segments.transliteration: wa raghib-tu ilay-ka fee waz''-i' tabia'tihee a'n-humaa
segments.translation: 42.and I beseech You to remove from them its ill consequence,

segments.transliteration: fa in-nee laaa at-tahimuhumaa a'laa naf-see
segments.translation: 43.for I do not accuse them concerning myself,
44.find them slow in their devotion toward me,

segments.arabic: وَلا أكْرَهُ مَا تَوَلَّياهُ مِنْ أَمْرِي يَا رَبِّ
segments.transliteration: wa laaa ak-rahoo maa tawal-layaahoo min am-ree yaa rab
segments.translation: 45.or dislike the way they have attended to my affairs, my Lord!
46.They have rights against me which are more incumbent,
47.precedence in beneficence toward me that is greater

segments.arabic: وَأَعْظَمُ مِنَّةً لَـدَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أقَاصَّهُمَا بِعَدْل،
segments.transliteration: wa aa'-z'amu min-natal-laday min an uqaaas'-s'ahumaa bia'd-l
segments.translation: 48.and kindness toward me that is mightier than that I should settle accounts with justice
49.or repay them with equivalents.

segments.arabic: أَيْنَ إذاً  يَا إلهِيْ طُولُ شُغْلِهِمَا بِتَرْبِيَتِي ؟
segments.transliteration: sy-na id'ay-yaaa ilaahee t'oolu shugh-lihimaa bitarbeeatee?
segments.translation: 50.Where then, my God, would be their long occupation with bringing me up?

segments.transliteration: wa ay-na shid-datu taa'bihimaa fee h'iraasatee?
segments.translation: 51.Where the hardship of their toil in taking care of me?

segments.arabic: وَأَيْنَ إقْتَارُهُمَا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمَا لِلتَّوْسِعَةِ عَلَيَّ؟
segments.transliteration: wa ay-na iq-taaruhumaa a'laaa anfusihimaa lilt-taw-sia'ti a'lay-ya?
segments.translation: 52.Where the stinting of themselves to provide me with plenty?
53.What an idea! I can never discharge their right against me,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ اُدْرِكُ مَا يَجِبُ عَلَيَّ لَهُمَا
segments.transliteration: wa laaa ud-riku maa yajibu a'lay-ya lahumaa
segments.translation: 54.fulfil my obligations toward them,
55.or accomplish the duty of serving them.
56.So bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَأَعِنِّي يَا خَيْرَ مَنِ اسْتُعِينَ بِهِ.
segments.transliteration: wa ai'n-nee yaa khay-ra mani as-tue'ena bih
segments.translation: 57.and help me, O Best of those whose help we seek!

segments.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنِي يَا أَهْدَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa waf-fiq-nee yaaa ah-daa mar-rughiba ilay-h
segments.translation: 58.Give me success, O Most Guiding of those whom we beseech!

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي فِي أَهْلِ الْعُقُوقِ لِلآباءِوَالأُمَّهاتِ
segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-a'l-nee feee ah-lil-u'qooqi lil-abaaa-i wal-um-mahaati
segments.translation: 59.Place me not among the people of disrespect to fathers and mothers

segments.arabic: يَوْمَ تُجْزى كُلُّ نَفْس بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لاَيُظْلَمُونَ.
segments.transliteration: (yaw-ma tuj-zaa kul-lu naf-sim-bimaa kasabat wahum laa yuz'-lamoon)
segments.translation: 60.on the day when "every soul will be repaid for what it has earned, they shall not be wronged" (45:22).

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wad'ur-ree-yatih
segments.translation: 61.O God, bless Muhammad, his Household, and his progeny

segments.arabic: وَاخْصُصْ  أَبَوَيَّ بِأَفْضَلِ مَا خَصَصْتَ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa akh-s'us' abaway-ya bif-z''ali maa khas'as'-ta biheee
segments.translation: 62.and single out my parents for the best which You hast singled out for

segments.arabic: آبَاءَ عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَاُمَّهَاتِهِمْ يَا أَرْحَمَ الـرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.translation: 63.the fathers and mothers of Your faithful servants, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ  لاَ تُنْسِنِي ذِكْرَهُمَا فِي أَدْبَارِ صَلَوَاتِي
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma laa tunsinee d'ik-rahumaa feee ad-baari s'alawaatee
segments.translation: 64.O God, let me not forget to remember them after my ritual prayers,

segments.transliteration: wa feee inana min aaanaaa-i lay-lee
segments.translation: 65.at every time throughout my night,

segments.arabic: وَفِي كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِ نَهَارِي.
segments.transliteration: wa fee kul-li saaa'tim-min saaa'ati nahaaree
segments.translation: 66.and in each of the hours of my day!
67.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
68.forgive me through my supplication for my parents,
69.and forgive them through their devotion toward me
70.with unfailing forgiveness, be well pleased with them
71.through my intercession for them with resolute good pleasure,
72.and make them reach through Your generosity the abodes of safety!

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُكَ لَهُمَا فَشَفِّعْهُمَا فِيَّ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa in sabaqat magh-firatuka lahumaa fashaf-fia'-humaa fee
segments.translation: 73.O God, if Your forgiveness reaches them first, make them my intercessors,

segments.arabic: وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُـكَ لِي فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيْهِمَا،
segments.transliteration: wa in sabaqat magh-firatuka lee fashaf-fia'-nee feehimaa
segments.translation: 74.and if Your forgiveness reaches me first, make me their intercessors,

segments.arabic: حَتّى نَجْتَمِعَ بِرَأفَتِكَ فِي دَارِ كَرَامَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa naj-tamia' biraa-fatika fee daari karaamatika
segments.translation: 75.so that we may gather together through Your gentleness in the house of Your generosity
76.and the place of Your forgiveness and mercy!

segments.arabic: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ  الْعَظِيمِ وَالْمَنِّ الْقَدِيْمِ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ .
segments.transliteration: in-naka d'ool-faz''-lil-a'z'eemi wal-man-nil-qadeem wa anta ar-h'amur-raah'imeen
segments.translation: 77.Verily You art Possessor of abounding bounty and ancient kindness, and "Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful" (7:151)!

segments.transliteration: wa-alladhÄ«na hajarathumu al-âashÄâiru idh taâallaqÅ« bi-âurwatih,
segments.translation: and those whom their tribes abandoned when they clung to his handhold,

segments.arabic: وَانْتَفَتْ مِنْهُمُ الْقَرَاباتُ إذْ سَكَنُوا فِي ظلِّ قَرَابَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa intafat minhumu al-qarÄbÄtu idh sakanÅ« fÄ« áºilli qarÄbatih.
segments.translation: and whom their relatives disowned when they took shelter in the shade of his kinship.

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَنْسَ لَهُمُ اللّهُمَّ مَا تَرَكُوا لَكَ وَفِيكَ،
segments.transliteration: falÄ tansa lahumu AllÄhumma mÄ tarakÅ« laka wa fÄ«k,
segments.translation: So, O Allah, do not forget what they left for You and for Your sake,

segments.arabic: وَأَرْضِهِمْ مِنْ رِضْوَانِكَ وَبِمَا حَاشُوا الْخَلْقَ عَلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ará¸ihim min riá¸wÄnika wa bi-mÄ á¸¥ÄshÅ« al-khalqa âalayk,
segments.translation: and make them pleased with Your pleasure, and for how they gathered the creation for You,

segments.arabic: وَكَانُوا مَعَ رَسُولِكَ دُعَاةً لَكَ إلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa kÄnÅ« maâa rasÅ«lika duâÄtan laka ilayk,
segments.translation: and were with Your messenger, callers for You to Yourself.

segments.arabic: وَاشكُرْهُمْ عَلَى هَجْرِهِمْ فِيْكَ دِيَارَ قَوْمِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa ashkurhum âalÄ hajrihim fÄ«ka diyÄra qawmihim,
segments.translation: And thank them for their migration for Your sake from the homes of their people,

segments.arabic: وَخُرُوجِهِمْ مِنْ سَعَةِ الْمَعَاشِ إلَى ضِيْقِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa khurÅ«jihim min saâati al-maâÄshi ilÄ á¸Ä«qih,
segments.translation: and for their departure from a life of ease to one of hardship,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ كَثَّرْتَ فِي إعْزَازِ دِيْنِـكَ مِنْ مَظْلُومِهِمْ.
segments.transliteration: wa man kaththarta fÄ« iâzÄzi dÄ«nika min maáºlÅ«mihim.
segments.translation: and for those among them who were oppressed, whom You multiplied in giving glory to Your religion.

segments.arabic: ألّهُمَّ وَأوْصِلْ إلَى التَّابِعِينَ لَهُمْ بِإحْسَان الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ:
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa awá¹£il ilÄ at-tÄbiâÄ«na lahum bi-iá¸¥sÄnin alladhÄ«na yaqÅ«lÅ«n:
segments.translation: O Allah, and grant to the followers who follow them with goodness, who say:

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلاخْوَانِنَا الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقُونَا بِالاِيمَانِ خَيْرَ جَزَائِكَ،
segments.transliteration: RabbanÄ ighfir lanÄ wa li-ikhwÄninÄ alladhÄ«na sabaqÅ«nÄ bi-al-Ä«mÄni khayra jazÄâik,
segments.translation: "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith," the best of Your reward,
those who sought their way,
and aimed for their direction,
and proceeded on their path,
whom no doubt turned away in their insight,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَخْتَلِجْهُمْ شَكٌّ فِي قَفْوِ آثَارِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: wa lam yakhtalijhum shakkun fÄ« qafwi ÄthÄrihim
segments.translation: and no hesitation troubled them in following their footsteps
and being guided by the light of their landmarks,
being their allies and supporters,
practicing their religion,
and being guided by their guidance,
agreeing with them,

segments.transliteration: wa lÄ yattahimÅ«nahum fÄ«mÄ addaw ilayhim.
segments.translation: and not accusing them of anything they conveyed to them.

segments.arabic: ألَّلهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى التّابِعِيْنَ مِنْ يَوْمِنَا هَذا إلَى يَوْم الدِّينِ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa á¹£alli âalÄ at-tÄbiâÄ«na min yawminÄ hÄdhÄ ilÄ yawmi ad-dÄ«n,
segments.translation: O Allah, and send blessings upon the followers from this day until the Day of Judgment,
and upon their spouses,
and upon their descendants,
and upon those among them who obeyed You,
a blessing that protects them from disobeying You,

segments.transliteration: wa tafsaá¸¥u lahum fÄ« riyÄá¸i jannatik,
segments.translation: and expands for them in the gardens of Your Paradise,

segments.transliteration: wa tamnaâuhum bi-hÄ min kaydi ash-shayá¹­Än,
segments.translation: and by which You prevent the plot of Satan from them,

segments.arabic: وَتُعِينُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى مَا اسْتَعَانُوكَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بِرٍّ،
segments.transliteration: wa tuâÄ«nuhum bi-hÄ âalÄ mÄ istaâÄnÅ«ka âalayhi min birr,
segments.translation: and by which You assist them in the righteousness for which they sought Your help,

segments.transliteration: wa taqÄ«him á¹­awÄriqa al-layli wa an-nahÄr
segments.translation: and protect them from the calamities of the night and day,
except for a calamity that comes with goodness,

segments.arabic: وَتَبْعَثُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى اعْتِقَادِ حُسْنِ الرَّجَـاءِ لَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa tabâathuhum bi-hÄ âalÄ iâtiqÄdi á¸¥usni ar-rajÄâi lak,
segments.translation: and by which You inspire them with the belief in a good hope in You,
and a desire for what is with You,

segments.arabic: وَتَرْكِ النُّهَمَةِ فِيمَا تَحْويهِ أيْدِي الْعِبَادِ
segments.transliteration: wa tarki an-nuhamati fÄ«mÄ taá¸¥wÄ«hi aydÄ« al-âibÄd
segments.translation: and the abandonment of greed for what the hands of servants hold,

segments.arabic: لِتَرُدَّهُمْ إلَى الرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ،
segments.transliteration: li-taruddahum ilÄ ar-raghbati ilayka wa ar-rahbati mink,
segments.translation: so that You return them to desire for You and awe of You.
And make them ascetic toward the abundance of this fleeting world,
and make them love to work for the Hereafter,
and to prepare for what is after death,

segments.arabic: وَتُهَوِّنَ عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّ كَرْب يَحُلُّ بِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: wa tuhawwina âalayhim kulla karbin yaá¸¥ullu bihim
segments.translation: and make easy for them every anguish that befalls them
on the day souls depart from their bodies,

segments.arabic: وَتُعَافِيَهُمْ مِمَّا تَقَعُ بِهِ الْفِتْنَةُ مِنْ مَحْذُورَاتِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa tuâÄfiyahum mimmÄ taqaâu bihi al-fitnatu min maá¸¥dhÅ«rÄtihÄ,
segments.translation: and protect them from the forbidden things that cause sedition,

segments.transliteration: wa kabbati an-nÄri wa á¹­Å«li al-khulÅ«di fÄ«hÄ,
segments.translation: and the fall into the fire and a long stay in it,

segments.arabic: وَتُصَيِّرَهُمْ إلَى أَمْن مِنْ مَقِيلِ الْمُتَّقِينَ .
segments.transliteration: wa tuá¹£ayyirahum ilÄ amnin min maqÄ«li al-muttaqÄ«n.
segments.translation: and make them reach a safe haven, the resting place of the righteous.
1.O God, as for the followers of the messengers and those of the people

segments.arabic: مِنْ أَهْلِ الاَرْضِ بِالْغَيْبِ عِنْدَ مُعَارَضَةِ الْمُعَـانِدينَ لَهُمْ
segments.transliteration: min ah-lil-ar-z''i bil-ghay-bi i'nda mua'araz''atil-mua'anideena lahum
segments.translation: 2.of the earth who attested to them unseen (while the obstinate resisted them

segments.arabic: بِالتَّكْذِيبِ وَالاشْتِيَاقِ إلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ بِحَقائِقِ الايْمَانِ .
segments.translation: 3.through crying lies) - they yearned for the emissaries through the realities of faith

segments.arabic: فِي كُلِّ دَهْر وَزَمَان أَرْسَلْتَ فِيْهِ رَسُولاً، وَأَقَمْتَ لاهْلِهِ دَلِيلاً،
segments.transliteration: fee kul-li dah-riw-wa zamaan ar-sal-ta feehee rasoolaa wa aqam-ta liah-lihee daleelaa
segments.translation: 4.in every era and time in which You didst send a messenger and set up for the people a director

segments.arabic: مِنْ لَدُنْ آدَمَ إلَى مُحَمَّد صَلَّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِـهِ مِنْ أَئِمَّةِ الْهُـدَى،
segments.transliteration: mil-ladun aaadama ilaa muh'am-madin s'al-laal-laahoo a'lay-hee wa aaalih min a-im-matil-hudaa
segments.translation: 5.from the period of Adam down to Muhammad (God bless him and his Household) from among the imams of guidance

segments.arabic: وَقَادَةِ أَهْـلِ التُّقَى عَلَى جَمِيعِهِمُ السَّلاَمُ،
segments.translation: 6.and the leaders of the godfearing (upon them all be peace) -
7.remember them with forgiveness and good pleasure!

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّد خَاصَّةً الَّـذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا الصَّحَابَةَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa as'-h'aabu muh'am-madin khaaas'-s'atan al-lad'eena ah'-sanoos'-s'ah'aabata
segments.translation: 8.O God, and as for the Companions of Muhammad specifically, those who did well in companionship,

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ أَبْلَوْا الْبَلاَءَ الْحَسَنَ فِي نَصْرِهِ،
segments.translation: 9.who stood the good test in helping him,

segments.arabic: وَكَانَفُوهُ وَأَسْرَعُوا إلَى وِفَادَتِهِ وَسَابَقُوا إلَى دَعْوَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa kaanafoohoo wa as-rau'waaa ilaa wifaadatih wa saabaqoo ilaa daa'-watihee
segments.translation: 10. supported his mission, promptly advanced at his call, answered it as soon as he made them

segments.arabic: واسْتَجَابُوا لَهُ حَيْثُ أَسْمَعَهُمْ حجَّةَ رِسَالاَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: was-tajaaboo lahoo h'ay-thu as-maa'hum h'uj-jata risaalaatih
segments.translation: 11.responded to him when he made them hear his messages' argument,

segments.arabic: وَفَارَقُوا الازْوَاجَ وَالاوْلادَ فِي إظْهَارِ كَلِمَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa faaraqool-az-waaja wal-aw-laada feee iz'-haari kalimatih
segments.translation: 12.separated from mates and children in manifesting his word,

segments.arabic: وَقَاتَلُوا الاباءَ وَ الابناءَ فِي تَثْبِيتِ نبُوَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa qaatalool-abaaa-a wal-ab-naaa-a fee tath-beeti nuboo-watihee
segments.translation: 13.fought against fathers and sons in strengthening his prophecy,

segments.arabic: وَانْتَصَرُوا بهِ وَمَنْ كَانُوا مُنْطَوِينَ عَلَى
segments.transliteration: wa antas'aroo bih wa man kaanoo munt'aweena a'laa
segments.translation: 14.and through him gained victory; those who were wrapped in

segments.arabic: مَحبَّتِهِ يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَنْ تَبُورَ فِي مَوَدَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: mah'ab-batihee yar-joona tijaaratal-lan taboora fee mawad-datih
segments.translation: 15.affection for him, "hoping for a commerce that comes not to naught" (35:29) in love for him;

segments.arabic: وَالّذينَ هَجَرَتْهُمُ العَشَائِرُ إذْ تَعَلَّقُوا بِعُرْوَتِهِ،
segments.translation: 16.those who were left by their clans when they clung to his handhold

segments.arabic: وَانْتَفَتْ مِنْهُمُ الْقَرَاباتُ إذْ سَكَنُوا فِي ظلِّ قَرَابَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: wantafat min-humul-qaraabaatu id' sakanoo fee z'il-li qaraabatih
segments.translation: 17.and denied by their kinsfolk when they rested in the shadow of his kinship;

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَنْسَ لَهُمُ اللّهُمَّ مَا تَرَكُوا لَكَ وَفِيكَ،
segments.transliteration: falaa tansa lahumul-laahum-ma maa tarakoo laka wa feeka
segments.translation: 18.forget not, O God, what they abandoned for You and in You,

segments.arabic: وَأَرْضِهِمْ مِنْ رِضْوَانِكَ وَبِمَا حَاشُوا الْخَلْقَ عَلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ar-z''ihim mir-riz''-waanik wa bimaa h'aashool-khal-qa a'lay-k
segments.translation: 19.and make them pleased with Your good pleasure for the sake of the creatures they drove to You

segments.arabic: وَكَانُوا مَعَ رَسُولِكَ دُعَاةً لَكَ إلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa kaanoo maa' rasoolika dua'atal-laka ilay-k
segments.translation: 20.while they were with Your Messenger, summoners to You for You.

segments.arabic: وَاشكُرْهُمْ عَلَى هَجْرِهِمْ فِيْكَ دِيَارَ قَوْمِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa ash-kur-hum a'laa haj-rihim feeka deeaara qaw-mihim-
segments.translation: 21.Show gratitude to them for leaving the abodes of their people for Your sake

segments.arabic: وَخُرُوجِهِمْ مِنْ سَعَةِ الْمَعَاشِ إلَى ضِيْقِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa khuroojihim min saa'til-maa'ashi ilaa z''eeqih
segments.translation: 22.and going out from a plentiful livelihood to a narrow one,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ كَثَّرْتَ فِي إعْزَازِ دِيْنِـكَ مِنْ مَظْلُومِهِمْ.
segments.transliteration: wa man kath-thar-ta feee ia'-zaazi deenika mim-maz'-loomihim-
segments.translation: 23.and [show gratitude to] those of them who became objects of wrongdoing and whom You multiplied in exalting Your religion.

segments.arabic: ألّهُمَّ وَأوْصِلْ إلَى التَّابِعِينَ لَهُمْ بِإحْسَان الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ :
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa aw-s'il ilaat-taabie'ena lahum biih'-saaninl-lad'eena yaqooloona:
segments.translation: 24.O God, and give to those who have done well in following the Companions, who say,

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلاخْوَانِنَا الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقُونَا بِالاِيمَانِ خَيْرَ جَزَائِكَ،
segments.transliteration: (rab-banaa igh-fir lanaa wa liikh-waaninaal-lad'eena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaan) khay-ra jazaaa-ika
segments.translation: 25."Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who went before us in faith" (59:10), Your best reward;

segments.arabic: الَّذِينَ قَصَدُوا سَمْتَهُمْ، وَتَحَرَّوْا وِجْهَتَهُمْ، وَمَضَوْا عَلى شاكِلَتِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: al-lad'eena qas'adoo sam-tahum wa tah'ar-raw-a wij-hatahum- wa maz''aw-a a'laa shaakilatihim-
segments.translation: 26.those who went straight to the Companions' road, sought out their course, and proceeded in their manner.

segments.arabic: لَمْ يَثْنِهِمْ رَيْبٌ فِي بَصِيْرَتِهِمْ، وَلَمْ يَخْتَلِجْهُمْ شَكٌّ
segments.transliteration: lam yath-nihim ray-bun fee bas'eeratihim wa lam yakh-talij-hum shak-kun
segments.translation: 27.No doubt concerning their sure insight diverted them and no uncertainty shook them

segments.arabic: فِي قَفْوِ آثَارِهِمْ وَالاِئْتِمَامِ بِهِدَايَةِ مَنَارِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: fee qaf-wi aaathaarihim wa aal-ai-timaam bihidaayati manaarihim
segments.translation: 28.from following in their tracks and being led by the guidance of their light.

segments.arabic: مُكَانِفِينَ وَمُوَازِرِيْنَ لَهُمْ، يَدِيْنُونَ بِدِيْنِهِمْ، وَيَهْتَدُونَ بِهَدْيِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: mukaanifeena wa muwaazireena lahum- yadeenoona bideenihim- wa yah-tadoona bihad-yihim-
segments.translation: 29.As their assistants and supporters, they professed their religion, gained guidance through their guidance,

segments.arabic: يَتَّفِقُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَلاَ يَتَّهِمُونَهُمْ فِيمَا أدَّوْا إلَيْهِمْ.
segments.transliteration: yat-tafiqoona a'lay-him- wa laa yat-tahimoonahum feemaaa ad-daw-aaa ilay-him-
segments.translation: 30.came to agreement with them, and never accused them in what they passed on to them.

segments.arabic: ألَّلهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى التّابِعِيْنَ مِنْ يَوْمِنَا هَذا إلى يَوْم الدِّينِ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma was'al-li a'laat-taabie'ena mee-yaw-minaa had'aaa ilaa yaw-mid-deen
segments.translation: 31.O God, and bless the Followers, from this day of ours to the Day of Doom,

segments.transliteration: wa a'laaa az-waajihim- wa a'laa d'ur-ree-yaatihim-
segments.translation: 32.their wives, their offspring,

segments.arabic: وَعَلَى مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ مِنْهُمْ صَلاْةً تَعْصِمُهُمْ بِهَامِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa a'laa man at'aaa'ka min-hum- s'alaatan taa'-s'imuhum bihaa mim-maa'-s'eeatik
segments.translation: 33.and those among them who obey You, with a blessing through which You wilt preserve them from disobeying You,

segments.arabic: وَتَفْسَحُ لَهُمْ فِي رِيَاضِ جَنَّتِكَ، وَتَمْنَعُهُمْ بِهَا مِنْ كَيْدِ الشَيْطَانِ،
segments.transliteration: wa taf-sahoo lahum fee reeaaz''i jan-natik wa tam-nau'hum bihaa min kay-dish-shay-t'aan
segments.translation: 34.make room for them in the plots of Your Garden, defend them from the trickery of Satan,

segments.arabic: وَتُعِينُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى مَا اسْتَعَانُوكَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بِرٍّ،
segments.transliteration: wa tue'enuhum bihaa a'laa mas-taa'anooka a'lay-hee mim-birr
segments.translation: 35.help them in the piety in which they seek help from You,

segments.arabic: وَتَقِيهِمْ طَوَارِقَ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ إلاّ طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْر،
segments.transliteration: wa taqeehm t'awaariqal-lay-li wan-nahaari il-laa t'aariqay-yat'-ruqu bikhay-r
segments.translation: 36.protect them from sudden events that come by night and day - except the events which come with good -

segments.arabic: وَتَبْعَثُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى اعْتِقَادِ حُسْنِ الرَّجَـاءِ لَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa tab-a'thuhum bihaa a'laa  ia'-tiqaadi h'us-nir-rajaaa-i laka
segments.translation: 37.and incite them to tie firmly the knot of good hope in You,

segments.arabic: وَالطَّمَعِ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ، وَتَرْكِ النُّهَمَةِ فِيمَا تَحْويهِ
segments.transliteration: wat'-t'amai' feemaa i'ndak wa tar-kit-tuh-mati feemaa tah'-weeheee
segments.translation: 38.desire what is with You, and refrain from ill thoughts [toward You] because of what

segments.arabic: أيْدِي الْعِبَادِ لِتَرُدَّهُمْ إلَى الرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ،
segments.transliteration: ay-deel-i'baad litarud-dahum ilaar-ragh-bati ilay-ka war-rah-bati minka
segments.translation: 39.the hands of Your servants' hold. Thus You mayest restore them to beseeching You and fearing You,

segments.arabic: وَتُزَهِّدُهُمْ فِي سَعَةِ العَاجِلِ وَتُحَبِّبُ إلَيْهِمُ
segments.transliteration: wa tuzah-hidahum fee saa'til-a'ajil wa tuh'ab-biba ilay-him
segments.translation: 40.induce them to renounce the plenty of the immediate, make them love to

segments.arabic: الْعَمَلَ لِلاجِلِ، وَالاسْتِعْدَادَ لِمَا بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَتُهَوِّنَ عَلَيْهِمْ
segments.transliteration: himul-a'mala lil-aaajil walis-tia'-daada limaa baa'-dal-maw-t wa tuhaw-wina a'lay-him
segments.translation: 41.work for the sake of the deferred and prepare for what comes after death, make easy for them

segments.arabic: كُلَّ كَرْب يَحُلُّ بِهِمْ يَوْمَ خُـرُوجِ الانْفُسِ مِنْ أَبْدَانِهَا
segments.transliteration: kul-la kar-bee-yah'il-lu bihim yaw-ma khuroojil-anfusi min ab-daanihaa
segments.translation: 42.every distress that comes to them on the day when souls take leave from bodies,

segments.arabic: وَتُعَافِيَهُمْ مِمَّا تَقَعُ بِهِ الْفِتْنَةُ  مِنْ مَحْذُورَاتِهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa tua'afeeahum mim-maa taqau' bihil-fit-natu mim-mah'-d'ooraatihaa
segments.translation: 43.release them from that which brings about the perils of temptation
44.and being thrown down in the Fire and staying forever within it,

segments.arabic: وَتُصَيِّرَهُمْ إلَى أَمْن مِنْ مَقِيلِ الْمُتَّقِينَ .
segments.translation: 45.and take them to security, the resting place of the godfearing.

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua 54 Removal of Worries

segments.translation: O Reliever of anxiety and Remover of sorrow!
O Most Compassionate of this world and the Hereafter, and the Most Merciful of both!
Bless Muá¸¥ammad and the family of Muá¸¥ammad,
and relieve my anxiety, and remove my sorrow!

اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ.

segments.arabic:
2. سورة الإخلاص (112):
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ.

segments.translation: Say, "He is God, [Who is] One. God, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is begotten, Nor is there to Him any equivalent." (Qur'an 112:1-4)

segments.arabic:
3. سورة الفلق (113):
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ، مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ، وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ، وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ.

segments.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created, And from the evil of darkness when it settles, And from the evil of the blowers in knots, And from the evil of an envier when he envies." (Qur'an 113:1-5)

segments.arabic:
4. سورة الناس (114):
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِكِ النَّاسِ، إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ، مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ.

Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers in the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind." (Qur'an 114:1-6)

and grant me the sincerity of reliance upon You.
I ask You from the good of a Book that has passed (or been decreed) and I seek refuge in You

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ كِتَاب قَدْ خَلاَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ

and the certainty of those who rely upon You,
and the reliance of the believers upon You.
O God, make my desire in my petition
like the desire of Your friends in their petitions,
and my dread like the dread of Your friends,
and employ me in Your pleasure,
with a deed by which I do not abandon anything of Your religion,

segments.arabic: عَمَلاً لاَ أَتْرُكُ مَعَهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ دِيْنِكَ

O God, this is my need, so magnify my desire in it,

segments.arabic: وَأَظْهِرْ فِيهَا عُذْرِي، وَلَقِّنِي فِيهَا حُجَّتِي وَعَافِ فِيْهَا جَسَدِيْ.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumm man aá¹£baá¸¥a lahÅ« thiqatun aw rajÄâun ghayruk,
segments.translation: then I have begun my day with You being my trust,
and my hope in all affairs,
so decree for me the best outcome for them,
and save me from the misguiding trials (or temptations),
by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّد رُسُولِ اللهِ المُصْطَفَى،
segments.transliteration: Wa-á¹£allÄ AllÄhu âalÄ SayyidinÄ Muá¸¥ammad RasÅ«li llÄhi l-Muá¹£á¹­afÄ,
segments.translation: and upon his pure family.
1.O Reliever of worry! O Remover of grief!
2.O Merciful in this world and the next and Compassionate in both!
3.Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
4.relieve my worry, and remove my grief!
5.O One, O Unique, O Eternal Refuge!

segments.arabic: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا أَحَدُ، يَا صَمَدُ،
segments.transliteration: yaa waah'idu yaaa ah'adu yaa s'amad
segments.translation: 6.O He Who has not begotten, nor has been begotten,
7.and equal to Him is not any one!
8.Preserve me, purify me, and take away my affliction!
10.O God, I ask You with the asking of him whose neediness is intense,

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-neee as-aluka soo-aala man ishtad-dat faaqatuh
segments.translation: 11.whose strength is frail, whose sins are many,

segments.transliteration: wa z''au'fat qoo-watuh wa kathurat d'unoobuh
segments.translation: 12.the asking of one who finds no helper in his neediness,

segments.arabic: سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ يَجِدُ لِفَاقَتِهِ مُغِيْثاً،
segments.translation: 13.no strengthener in his frailty,
14.no forgiver of his sin other than You,
15.O Possessor of majesty and munificence!
16.I ask of You a work through which You wilt love him who works it

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ عَمَلاً تُحِبُّ بِهِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: as-aluk a'malana tuh'ib-bu bihee man a'mila bih
segments.translation: 17.and a certainty by which You wilt profit him who is certain

segments.arabic: وَيَقِيناً تَنْفَعُ بِهِ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَنَ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa yaqeenana tanfau' bihee mani as-tay-qana bihee
segments.translation: 18.with the truth of certainty concerning the execution of Your command!
19.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.translation: 20.take my soul while it is firm in sincerity,
21.cut off my need for this world,
22.make my desire for what is with You
23.become a yearning to meet You,
24.and give me true confidence in You!
25.I ask of You the good of the writ that has been made and I seek refuge with You

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ كِتَاب قَدْ خَلاَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ
segments.transliteration: as-aluka min khay-ri kitaabin qad khalaa wa au'wd'u bika
segments.translation: 26.from the evil of the writ that has been made.
27.I ask of You the fear of The worshipers,
28.the worship of those humbly fearful of You,
29.the certainty of those who have confidence in You,
30.and the confidence of those who have faith in You.
31.O God, make my desire in my asking
32.like the desire of Your friends in their asking,
33.and my fear like the fear of Your friends!
34.Employ me in Your good pleasure through works
35.in which I will not leave aside anything of Your religion

segments.arabic: عَمَلاً لاَ أَتْرُكُ مَعَهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ دِيْنِكَ
segments.translation: 36.fearing any of Your creatures!
37.God, this is my need, so make my desire for it great,

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ هَذِهِ حَاجَتِي، فَأَعْظِمْ فِيهَا رَغْبَتِي،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma hd'ihee h'aajatee faaa'-z'im feehaa ragh-batee
segments.translation: 38.within it make manifest my excuse, through it instil me with my argument, and by means of it make well my body!

segments.arabic: وَأَظْهِرْ فِيهَا عُذْرِي، وَلَقِّنِي فِيهَا حُجَّتِي وَعَافِ فِيْهَا جَسَدِيْ.
segments.transliteration: wa az'-hir feehaa u'd'-ree wa laq-qinee feehaa h'uj-jatee wa a'afi feehaa jasadee
segments.translation: 39.O God, some rise in the morning having trust or hope in other than You.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَصْبَحَ لَهُ ثِقَةٌ أَوْ رَجَآءٌ غَيْرُكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma man as'-bah'a lahoo thiqatun aw rajaaa-un ghay-ruk
segments.translation: 40.I rise in the morning, and You art my trust
41.and my hope in all affairs,
42.so decree for me those which are best in outcome
43.and deliver me from misguiding trials,
44.O Most Merciful of the merciful!
45.And God bless our chief, Muhammad the Messenger of God, the chosen,

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّد رُسُولِ اللهِ المُصْطَفَى،
segments.translation: 46.and his Household, the pure!

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua33 His Supplication in Asking for best

segments.translation: O Allah! I seek the best from You through Your knowledge.

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ، وَاقْضِ لِي بِالْخِيَرَةِ
segments.transliteration: Fa-á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-ÄlihÄ«, wa-qá¸i lÄ« bil-khÄ«rah
segments.translation: So bless Muá¸¥ammad and his family, and decree for me the best choice.
And inspire us with knowledge of choosing rightly.
And make that a means to contentment.

segments.arabic: بِمَا قَضَيْتَ لَنَا، وَالتَّسْلِيمِ لِمَا حَكَمْتَ
segments.transliteration: BimÄ qaá¸ayta lanÄ, wa-al-taslÄ«mi limÄ á¸¥akamta
segments.translation: With what You have decreed for us, and submitting to what You decide.
So remove from us the doubts of uncertainty.
And strengthen us with the certainty of the sincere.

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَسُمْنَا عَجْزَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ عَمَّا تَخَيَّرْتَ
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ tasumnÄ Ê¿ajza al-maÊ¿rifati Ê¿ammÄ takhayyarta
segments.translation: And do not make us suffer the ignorance of what You have chosen.
So that we belittle Your decree or dislike the place of Your pleasure.

segments.arabic: وَنَجْنَحَ إِلَى الَّتِي هِيَ أَبْعَدُ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْعَاقِبَةِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-najnaá¸¥a ilÄ allatÄ« hiya abÊ¿adu min á¸¥usni al-Ê¿Äqibah
segments.translation: And incline towards that which is far from a good outcome.
And nearer to the opposite of well-being.

segments.arabic: حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا مَا نَكْرَهُ مِنْ قَضَائِكَ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤abbib Ê¾ilaynÄ mÄ nakrahu min qaá¸ÄÊ¾ika
segments.translation: Make beloved to us what we dislike from Your decree.

segments.arabic: وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيْنَا مَا نَسْتَصْعِبُ مِنْ حُكْمِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa-sahhil Ê¿alaynÄ mÄ nastasÊ¿ibu min á¸¥ukmika
segments.translation: And make easy for us what we find difficult from Your judgment.

segments.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْنَا الِانْقِيَادَ لِمَا أَوْرَدْتَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ مَشِيَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa-alhimnÄ al-inqiyÄda limÄ awradta Ê¿alaynÄ min mashÄ«Ê¾atika
segments.translation: And inspire us to submit to whatever You bring upon us from Your will.

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لَا نُحِبَّ تَأْخِيرَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤attÄ lÄ nuá¸¥ibba taÊ¾khÄ«ra mÄ Ê¿ajjalta
segments.translation: So that we do not wish to delay what You hasten.

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَعْجِيلَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ، وَلَا نَكْرَهَ مَا أَحْبَبْتَ
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ taÊ¿jÄ«la mÄ akhkharta, wa-lÄ nakraha mÄ aá¸¥babta
segments.translation: Nor hasten what You delay, nor dislike what You love.
Nor choose what You dislike.

segments.arabic: وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْمَدُ عَاقِبَةً وَأَكْرَمُ مَصِيرًا
segments.transliteration: Wa-akhtim lanÄ billatÄ« hiya aá¸¥madu Ê¿Äqibatan wa-akramu maá¹£Ä«rÄ
segments.translation: And seal for us with that which is the best outcome and most honorable end.
Surely You bestow generosity and grant great gifts.

segments.arabic: وَتَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيدُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.transliteration: Wa-tafÊ¿alu mÄ turÄ«du, wa-anta Ê¿alÄ kulli shayÊ¾in qadÄ«r
segments.translation: And You do what You will, and You are powerful over all things.
1.O God, I ask from You the best in Your knowledge,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاقْضِ لِيْ بِالْخِيَرَةِ
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih waq-z''i lee bil-kheearah
segments.translation: 2.so bless Muhammad and his Household and decree for me the best!
3.Inspire us with knowledge to chose the best
4.and make that a means to being pleased

segments.arabic: بِمَا قَضَيْتَ لَنَا وَالتَّسْلِيْمِ لِمَا حَكَمْتَ.
segments.transliteration: bimaa qaz''ay-ta lanaa wat-tas-leemi limaa h'akam-t
segments.translation: 5.with what You hast decreed for us and submitting to what You hast decided!
6.Banish from us the doubt of misgiving
7.and confirm us with the certainty of the sincere!

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَسُمْنَا عَجْزَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ عَمَّا تَخَيَّرْتَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tasum-naa a'j-zal-maa'-rifati a'm-maa takhay-yar-t
segments.translation: 8.Visit us not with incapacity to know what You hast chosen,

segments.transliteration: fanagh-mit'a qad-rak wa nak-raha maw-z''ia' riz''aak
segments.translation: 9.lest we despise Your measuring out, dislike the place of Your good pleasure,

segments.arabic: وَنَجْنَحَ إلَى الَّتِي هِيَ أَبْعَدُ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْعَاقِبَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa naj-nah'a ilaal-latee hee ab-a'du min h'us-nil-a'aqibah
segments.translation: 10.and incline toward that which is further from good outcome
11.and nearer to the opposite of well-being!

segments.arabic: حَبِّبْ إلَيْنَا مَا نَكْرَهُ مِنْ قَضَائِكَ
segments.transliteration: h'ab-bib ilay-naa maa nak-rahoo min qaz''aaa-ik
segments.translation: 12.Make us love what we dislike in Your decree

segments.arabic: وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيْنَا مَا نَسْتَصْعِبُ مِنْ حُكْمِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa sah-hil a'lay-naa maa nas-tas'-i'bu min h'uk-mik
segments.translation: 13.and make easy for us what we find difficult in Your decision!

segments.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْنَـا الانْقِيَـادَ لِمَا أَوْرَدْتَ عَلَيْنَـا مِنْ مَشِيَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa al-him-naalinqeeaada limaaa aw-rat-ta a'lay-naa mim-mashee-yatik
segments.translation: 14.Inspire us to yield to that which You bringest upon us by Your will,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ نُحِبَّ تَأخِيْرَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ،
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa laa nuh'ib taa-kheera maa a'j-jal-t
segments.translation: 15.lest we love the delay of what You hast hastened

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَعْجيْلَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ، وَلا نَكْرَهَ مَا أَحْبَبْتَ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa taa'-jeela maaa skh-khar-t wa laa nak-raha maaa ah'-bab-t
segments.translation: 16.and the hastening of what You hast delayed, dislike what You lovest,
17.and choose what You dislikest!

segments.arabic: وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْمَدُ عَاقِبةً وَأكْرَمُ مَصِيراً
segments.transliteration: wakh-tim lanaa bil-latee hee ah'-madu a'aqibah wa ak-ramu mas'eeraa
segments.translation: 18.Seal us with that which is most praised in outcome and most generous in issue!
19.Surely You givest generous gain, bestowest the immense,

segments.arabic: وَتَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيدُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ .
segments.transliteration: wa taf-a'lu maa tureed wa anta a'laa kul-li shay-in qadeer
segments.translation: 20.dost what You wilt, and You art "powerful over everything" (3:26).

segments.transliteration: Faá¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi, wa amnaÊ¿nÄ bi Ê¿izzika min Ê¿ibÄdika,
segments.translation: So send blessings on Muá¸¥ammad and his family, and protect us by Your glory from Your servants,

segments.transliteration: Wa aghninÄ Ê¿an ghayrika bi irfÄdika,
segments.translation: And enrich us besides anyone else by Your aid,

segments.transliteration: Wa asluk binÄ sabÄ«la al-á¸¥aqqi bi irshÄdika.
segments.translation: And guide us on the path of truth by Your guidance.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْ سَلاَمَةَ قُلُوبِنَا
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi wa-jÊ¿al salÄmata qulÅ«binÄ,
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings on Muá¸¥ammad and his family and make the safety of our hearts

segments.arabic: فِي ذِكْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَفَرَاغَ أَبْدَانِنَا فِي شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: FÄ« dhikri Ê¿aáºamatika wa farÄgha abdaninÄ fÄ« shukri niÊ¿matika,
segments.translation: In the remembrance of Your greatness and the emptiness of our bodies in gratitude for Your blessings,

segments.transliteration: Wa iná¹­ilÄqa alsinatinÄ fÄ« waá¹£fi minnatikÄ.
segments.translation: And the release of our tongues in praising Your favor.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings on Muá¸¥ammad and his family

segments.transliteration: Wa jÊ¿alnÄ min duÊ¿Ätika ad-dÄÊ¿Ä«n ilayka,
segments.translation: And make us among those who call to You,
And Your guides who lead to You,
And from Your chosen, the special ones near You,
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
1.O He the wonders of whose mightiness will never end!
2.Bless Muhammad and his Household
3.and prevent us from deviation concerning Your mightiness!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تَنْتَهِي مُدَّةُ مُلْكِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa tantahee mud-datu mul-kih
segments.translation: 4.O He the term of whose kingdom will never cease!
5.Bless Muhammad and his Household
6.and release our necks from Your vengeance!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا تَفْنَى خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa taf-naa khazaaa-inu rah'-matih
segments.translation: 7.O He the treasuries of whose mercy will never be exhausted!
8.Bless Muhammad and his Household
9.and appoint for us a portion of Your mercy!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ تَنْقَطِعُ دُونَ رُؤْيَتِهِ الابْصَارُ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man tanqat'iu' doona roo-yatihil-ab-s'aar
segments.translation: 10.O He whom eyes fall short of seeing!
11.Bless Muhammad and his Household
12.and bring us close to Your nearness!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ تَصْغُرُ عِنْدَ خَطَرِهِ الاخْطَارُ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man tas'-ghuru i'nda khat'arihil-akh-t'aar
segments.translation: 13.O He before whose greatness all great things are small!
14.Bless Muhammad and his Household
15.and give us honour with You!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ تَظْهَرُ عِنْدَهُ بَوَاطِنُ الاخْبَارِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yaa man taz'-haru i'ndahoo bawaat'inul-akh-baar
segments.translation: 16.O He to whom all hidden tidings are manifest!
17.Bless Muhammad and his Household
18.and expose us not before You!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ هِبَةِ الْوَهّابِيْنَ بِهِبَتِكَ،
segments.translation: 19.O God, remove our need for the gifts of the givers through Your gift,
20.spare us the loneliness of those who break off through Your joining,

segments.arabic: حَتّى لا نَرْغَبَ إلَى أحَد مَعَ بَذْلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa laa nar-ghaba ilaaa ah'adim-maa' bad'-lik
segments.translation: 21.that we may beseech no one along with Your free giving,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ نَسْتَوْحِشَ مِنْ أحَد مَعَ فَضْلِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laa nas-taw-h'isha min ah'adim-ma'aa faz'-lik
segments.translation: 22.that we may feel lonely at no one's absence along with Your bounty!
23.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa kid lanaa wa laa takid a'lay-naa
segments.translation: 24.scheme for us, not against us,

segments.transliteration: wa am-kur lanaa wa laa tam-kur binaa
segments.translation: 25.devise to our benefit, not to our loss,

segments.transliteration: wa adil-lanaa wa laa tudil min-naa
segments.translation: 26.give the turn to prevail to us, not to others!
27.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَقِنَا مِنْكَ، وَاحْفَظْنَا بِكَ، وَاهْدِنَا إلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa qinaa mink wa ah'-faz'-naa bik wa ah-dinaaa ilay-k
segments.translation: 28.protect us from Yourself, safeguard us through Yourself, guide us to Yourself,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُبَاعِدْنَا عَنْكَ إنّ مَنْ تَقِهِ يَسْلَمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tubaai'd-naa a'nk in-na man taqihee yas-lam-
segments.translation: 29.and take us not far from Yourself! he whom You protectest stays safe,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ تَهْدِهِ يَعْلَمْ، وَمَنْ تُقَرِّبُهُ إلَيْكَ يَغْنَمْ.
segments.transliteration: wa man tah-dihee yaa'-lam- wa man tuqar-rib-hooo ilay-ka yagh-nam-
segments.translation: 30.he whom You guidest knows, and he whom You bringest near Yourself takes the spoils.
31.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
32.and spare us the cutting edge of time's turning changes,

segments.arabic: وَشَرَّ مَصَائِدِ الشّيطانِ وَمَرَارَةَ صَوْلَةِ السُّلْطَانِ.
segments.transliteration: wa shar-ra mas'aaa-idish-shay-t'aan wa maraarata s'aw-latis-sul-t'aan
segments.translation: 33.the evil of Satan's snares, and the bitterness of the sovereign's aggression!
34.O God, the spared are spared only through the bounty

segments.transliteration: qoo-watik fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wak-finaa
segments.translation: 35.of Your strength, so bless Muhammad and his Household, and spare us!

segments.arabic: وَإنَّمَا يُعْطِي الْمُعْطُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ جِدَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa in-namaa yua'-t'eel-mua'-t'oona min faz''-li jidatik
segments.translation: 36.The givers give only through the bounty of Your wealth,

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ و اعطنا
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee wa aa'-t'inaa
segments.translation: 37.so bless Muhammad and his Household and give to us!
38.The guided are guided only by the light of Your face,
39.so bless Muhammad and his Household and guide us!

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ إنّكَ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ لَمْ يَضْرُرْهُ خِذْلانُ الْخَاذِلِينَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-nak maw-waalay-ta lam yaz''-rur-hoo khid'-laanul-khaad'ileen
segments.translation: 40.O God, he whom You befriendest will not be injured by the abandonment of the abandoners,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أعْطَيْتَ لَمْ يَنْقُصْهُ مَنْـعُ الْمَانِعِينَ،
segments.transliteration: wa man aa'-t'ay-ta lam yanqus'-hoo man-u'l-maanie'en
segments.translation: 41.he to whom You givest will not be diminished by the withholding of the withholders,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ هَدَيْتَ لَمْ يُغْوِهِ إضْلاَلُ المُضِلِّيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: wa man haday-ta lam yugh-wiheee iz''-laalul-muz''il-leen
segments.translation: 42.he whom You guidest will not be misled by the misguidance of the misguiders.

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَامْنَعْنَا بِعِزَّكَ، مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih wa am-naa'-naa bii'z-zika min i'baadik
segments.translation: 43.So bless Muhammad and his Household, defend us from Your servants
44.through Your might, free us from need for other than You through Your support,
45.and make us travel the path of the Truth through Your right guidance!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاجْعَلْ سَلاَمَةَ قُلُوبِنَا
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih waj-a'l- salaamata quloobinaa
segments.translation: 46.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and put the soundness of our hearts

segments.arabic: فِي ذِكْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَفَرَاغَ أبْدَانِنَا فِي شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: fee d'ik-ri a'z'amatik wa faraagha ab-daaninaa fee shuk-ri nia'-matik
segments.translation: 47.into the remembrance of Your mightiness, the idleness of our bodies into giving thanks for Your favour,
48.and the flow of our tongues into the description of Your kindness!
49.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
50.and make us one of Your summoners who summon to You,
51.Your guiders who direct to You,
52.and Your special friends whom You hast singled out!
53.O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.translation: 7.Your permission and the descent of the Command, that he may arouse through the Blast

segments.arabic: صَرْعى رَهَائِنِ الْقُبُورِ. وَمِيكَآئِيلُ ذُو الْجَاهِ عِنْدَكَ،
segments.transliteration: s'ar-a'a rahaaa-inil-quboor wa meekaaa-eelu d'ool-jaahee i'ndaka
segments.translation: 8.the hostages thrown down in the graves; Michael, possessor of standing with You
9.and a raised up place in Your obedience;
10.Gabriel, entrusted with Your revelation,
11.obeyed by the inhabitants of Your heavens,
12.distinguished in Your Presence, brought nigh to You;

segments.arabic: وَالرُّوحُ الَّذِي هُوَ عَلَى مَلائِكَةِ الْحُجُبِ،
segments.translation: 13.the spirit who is over the angels of the veils;
14.and the spirit who is of Your command -
15.O God! bless them and the angels below them:

segments.arabic: الَّـذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ مِنْ سُكَّـانِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ
segments.transliteration: lad'eena min doonihim min suk-kaani samaawaatik
segments.translation: 16.the residents in Your heavens,
17.those entrusted with Your messages,

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ لا تَدْخُلُهُمْ سَأْمَةٌ مِنْ دؤُوب ،
segments.translation: 18.those who become not wearied by perseverance,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ إعْيَاءٌ مِنْ لُغُوب وَلاَ فُتُورٌ،
segments.translation: 19.or exhausted and flagged by toil,
20.whom passions distract not from glorifying You,

segments.arabic: وَلا يَقْطَعُهُمْ عَنْ تَعْظِيمِكَ سَهْوُ الْغَفَـلاَتِ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yaq-t'au'hum a'n taa'-z'eemika sah-wl-ghafalaat
segments.translation: 21.and whose magnification of You is never cut off by the inattention of heedless moments;

segments.arabic: الْخُشَّعُ الابْصارِ فلا يَرُومُونَ النَّظَرَ إلَيْكَ ،
segments.translation: 22.their eyes lowered, they do not attempt to look at You;

segments.arabic: النَّواكِسُ الاذْقانِ الَّذِينَ قَدْ طَالَتْ رَغْبَتُهُمْ فِيمَا لَدَيْكَ
segments.translation: 23.their chins bowed, they have long desired what is with You;
24.unrestrained in mentioning Your boons,
25.they remain humble before Your mightiness and the majesty of Your magnificence;

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ إذَا نَظَرُوا إلَى جَهَنَّمَ تَزْفِرُ  عَلَى أَهْلِ مَعْصِيَتِكَ:
segments.transliteration: wal-lad'eena yaqooloona id'aa naz'aroo ilaa jahan-nama taz-firu a'laaa ah-li maa'-s'eeatika:
segments.translation: 26.those who say when they look upon Gehenna roaring over the people who disobeyed You:
27.'Glory be to You, we have not worshipped You with the worship You deservest!'

segments.arabic: فَصَـلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلَى الرَّوْحَانِيِّينَ مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'lay-him wa a'laa r-raw-h'aanee-yeena mim-malaaa-ikatik
segments.translation: 28.Bless them, and Your angels who are the Reposeful,

segments.arabic: وَ أهْلِ الزُّلْفَةِ عِنْدَكَ، وَحُمَّالِ الْغَيْبِ إلى رُسُلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ah-liz-zul-fati i'ndak wa h'um-maalil-ghay-bi ilaa rusulik
segments.translation: 29.those of proximity to You, those who carry the unseen to Your messengers,

segments.arabic: وَالْمُؤْتَمَنِينَ على وَحْيِكَ وَقَبائِلِ الْمَلائِكَةِ الَّذِينَ اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wal-moo-tamaneena a'laa wah'-yik wa qabaaa-ilil-malaaa-ikatil-lad'een akh-tas'as'-tahum linaf-sik
segments.translation: 30.those entrusted with Your revelation, the tribes of angels whom You hast singled out for Yourself,
31.freed from need for food and drink by their calling You holy,
32.and made to dwell inside Your heavens' layers,

segments.arabic: وَالّذينَ عَلَى أرْجَآئِهَا إذَا نَزَلَ الامْرُ بِتَمَامِ وَعْدِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wal-lad'eena a'laaa ar-jaaa-ihaaa id'aa nazalal-am-ru bitamaami waa'-dik
segments.translation: 33.those who will stand upon the heavens' borders when the Command descends to complete Your promise,
34.the keepers of the rain, the drivers of the clouds,

segments.arabic: وَالّذِي بِصَوْتِ زَجْرِهِ يُسْمَعُ زَجَلُ ألرُّعُوْدِ،
segments.translation: 35.him at whose driving's sound is heard the rolling of thunder,

segments.arabic: وَإذَا سَبَحَتْ بِهِ حَفِيفَةُ السّحَـابِ الْتَمَعَتْ صَوَاعِقُ الْبُرُوقِ.
segments.transliteration: wa id'aa sabah'at bihee h'afeefatus-sah'aabil-tamaa't s'awaai'qul-burooq
segments.translation: 36.and when the reverberating clouds swim before his driving, bolts of lightning flash;

segments.arabic: وَمُشَيِّعِيْ الْثَلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ. وَالْهَابِطِينَ مَعَ قَطْرِ الْمَطَر إَذَا نَزَلَ،
segments.transliteration: wa mushay-yie'eth-thal-ji wal-barad wal-haabit'eena maa' qat'-ril-mat'ari id'aa nazal
segments.translation: 37.the escorts of snow and hail, the descenders with the drops of rain when they fall,
38.the watchers over the treasuries of the winds,
39.those charged with the mountains lest they disappear,
40.those whom You hast taught the weights of the waters

segments.arabic: وَكَيْلَ مَا تَحْوِيهِ لَوَاعِجُ الامْطَارِ وَعَوَالِجُهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa kay-la maa tah'-weehee lawaai'jul-am-t'aari wa a'waalijuhaa
segments.translation: 41.and the measures contained by torrents and masses of rain;

segments.arabic: وَرُسُلِكَ مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ  إلَى أهْلِ الارْضِ بِمَكْرُوهِ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
segments.transliteration: wa rusulika minal-malaaa-ikati ilaaa ah-lil-ar-z''i bimak-roohee maa yanzilu minal-balaaa
segments.translation: 42.the angels who are Your messengers to the people of the earth with the disliked affliction that comes down
43.and the beloved ease; the devoted, noble scribes,

segments.arabic: وَالْحَفَظَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ، وَمَلَكِ الْمَوْتِ وَأعْوَانِهِ،
segments.translation: 44.the watchers, noble writers, the angel of death and his helpers,

segments.transliteration: wa munkariw-wa nakeer wa roomaana fat-taanil-quboor
segments.translation: 45.Munkar and Nakir, Rumaan, the tester in the graves,
46.the circlers of the Inhabited House, Malik
47.and the guardians, Ridwan and the gatekeepers of the gardens,

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ لاَ يَعْصُوْنَ اللّهَ مَا أمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ.
segments.transliteration: wal-lad'eena (laa yaa'-s'oonal-laaha maaa amarahum wa yaf-a'loona maa yoo-maroon)
segments.translation: 48.those who "disobey not God in What He commands them and do What they are commanded" (66:6);

segments.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ: سَلاَمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى الـدّارِ.
segments.transliteration: wal-lad'eena yaqooloona (salaamun a'lay-kum bimaa s'abar-tum fania'-ma u'q-baad-daar)
segments.translation: 49.those who say, "Peace be upon you, for that you were patient - and fair is the Ultimate Abode" (13:24);

segments.arabic: والزّبانيةُ الذّينَ إذَا قِيْـلَ لَهُمْ: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوْهُ
segments.translation: 50.the Zabaniya, who, when it is said to them, "take him, and fetter him,

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوْهُ ابْتَدَرُوهُ سِرَاعاً وَلَمْ يُنْظِرُوهُ.
segments.translation: 51.then roast him in hell" (69:30), hasten to accomplish it, nor do they give him any respite;

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أوْهَمْنَا ذِكْرَهُ، وَلَمْ نَعْلَمْ مَكَانَهُ مِنْكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa man aw-ham-naa d'ik-rahoo wa lam naa'-lam makaanahoo minka
segments.translation: 52.him whom we have failed to mention, not knowing his place with You,

segments.arabic: وَبأيِّ أمْر وَكَّلْتَهُ. وَسُكّانُ الْهَوَآءِ  وَالارْضِ وَالمآءِ،
segments.transliteration: wa biy-yi am-riw-wak-kal-tah wa suk-kaanil-hawaaa-i wal-ar-z''i wal-maaa-i
segments.translation: 53.nor with which command You hast charged him; and the residents in the air, the earth, and the water,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ
segments.translation: 54.and those of them charged over the creatures; bless them

segments.arabic: يَوْمَ تَأْتي كُلُّ نَفْس مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ  وَشَهِيدٌ،
segments.translation: 55.on the day when "every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness" (50:21),

segments.arabic: وَصَلّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلاَةً تَزِيدُهُمْ كَرَامَةً عَلى كَرَامَتِهِمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa s'al-li a'lay-him s'alaatan tazeeduhum  karaamatan a'laa karaamatihim-
segments.translation: 56.and bless them with a blessing that will add honour to their honour
57.and purity to their purity.

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ  وَإذَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَلاَئِكَتِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa id'aa s'al-lay-ta a'laa malaaa-ikatika
segments.translation: 58.O God, and when You blessest Your angels and Your messengers

segments.transliteration: warusulika wa bal-lagh-tahum s'alaatanaa a'lay-him fas'al-li a'lay-na
segments.translation: 59.and You extendest our blessings to them, bless us

segments.arabic: بِمَا فَتَحْتَ لَنَا مِنْ حُسْنِ الْقَوْلِ فِيْهِمْ إنَّكَ جَوَاْدٌ كَرِيمٌ .
segments.transliteration: bimaa fatah'-ta lanaa min h'us-nil-qaw-li feehim- in-naka jawaadun kareem
segments.translation: 60.through the good words about them which You hast opened up for us! You art Munificent, Generous.

title: Sahifa Sajjadia-Dua38 In asking Pardon

segments.translation: O Allah, I apologize to You

segments.arabic: مِنْ مَظْلُومٍ ظُلِمَ بِحَضْرَتِي فَلَمْ أَنْصُرْهُ

segments.translation: From an oppressed person who was wronged in my presence, yet I did not aid him

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ مَعْرُوفٍ أُسْدِيَ إِلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَشْكُرْهُ

segments.transliteration: Wa min haqqi dhÄ« á¸¥aqqin lazimani limuÊ¾minin fa-lam uwaffirhu
segments.translation: And from the right due to a believer that was my duty, but I did not fulfill it

I apologize to You, my God, for these
And from their similar actions, a regretful apology

segments.arabic: يَكُونُ وَاعِظاً لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنْ أَشْبَاهِهِنَّ

segments.translation: So that it may be a lesson for what lies ahead among their likes
So send blessings on Muá¸¥ammad and his family

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ نَدَامَتِي عَلَى مَا وَقَعْتُ فِيهِ مِنَ الزَّلَّاتِ
segments.transliteration: Wa-jÊ¿al nadÄmatÄ« Ê¿alÄ mÄ waqaÊ¿tu fÄ«hi mina az-zallÄt
segments.translation: And make my regret for the slips I fell into

segments.arabic: وَعَزْمِي عَلَى تَرْكِ مَا يَعْرِضُ لِي مِنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ

segments.translation: And my resolution to avoid the misdeeds that may come before me
A repentance that makes me deserving of Your love
O Lover of those who repent
1.O God, I ask pardon from You for

segments.arabic: مِنْ مَـظْلُوم ظُلِمَ بِحَضْرَتِي فَلَمْ أَنْصُرْهُ،
segments.translation: 2.the person wronged in my presence whom I did not help,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ مَعْرُوف أُسْدِيَ  إلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَشْكُرْهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa mim-maa'-roofin us-deea ilay-ya falam ash-kur-h
segments.translation: 3.the favour conferred upon me for which I returned no thanks,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ مُسِيء أعْتَذَرَ إلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَعْذِرْهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa mim-musee-in aa'-tad'ara ilay-ya falam aa'-d'ir-h
segments.translation: 4.the evildoer who asked pardon from me and whom I did not pardon,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ ذِيْ فَاقَة سَأَلَنِي فَلَمْ اُوثِرْهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa min d'ee faaqatin saalanee falam oo-thir-h
segments.translation: 5.the needy person who asked from me and whom I preferred not over myself,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ حَقِّ ذي حَقٍّ لَزِمَنِي لِمُؤْمِن فَلَمْ أوَفِّـرْهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa min h'aq-qi d'ee h'aq-qil-lazimanee limoo-minin falam uwaf-fir-h
segments.translation: 6.the right of a believer who possesses a right incumbent upon me which I did not fulfil,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ عَيْبِ مُؤْمِن ظَهَر لِي فَلَمْ أَسْتُرْهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa min a'y-bi moo-minin z'ahara lee falam as-tur-h
segments.translation: 7.the fault of a believer which became evident to me and which I did not conceal,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ كُلِّ  إثْم عَرَضَ لِيْ فَلَمْ أَهْجُرْهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa min kul-li ith-min a'raz''a lee falam ah-jur-h
segments.translation: 8.and every sin which presented itself to me and which I failed to avoid.
9.I ask pardon, my God, for all of these
10.and their likes, with an asking of pardon in remorse

segments.arabic: يَكُونُ وَاعِظاً لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنْ أَشْبَاهِهِنَّ.
segments.transliteration: yakoonu waai'z'al-limaa bay-na yaday-ya min ash-baahihin
segments.translation: 11.which may act as an admonisher against similar things ahead of me.
12.So bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ نَدَامَتِي عَلَى مَا وَقَعْتُ  فِيهِ مِنَ الـزَّلاّتِ
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l nadaamatee a'laa maa waqaa'-tu feehee minaz-zal-laat
segments.translation: 13.and make my remorse for the slips into which I have fallen

segments.arabic: وَعَزْمِي عَلَى تَـرْكِ مَا يَعْـرِضُ لِيْ مِنَ السَّيِّئـاتِ
segments.transliteration: wa a'z-mee a'laa tar-ki maa yaa'-riz''u lee mina-s say-yi-aat
segments.translation: 14.and my determination to refrain from the evil deeds which present themselves to me
15.a repentance which will make Your love for me obligatory,
16.O lover of those who repent!
