segments.transliteration: wa-á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Älihi á¹£alÄtan dÄÊ¾imatan nÄmiyatan lÄ inqiá¹­ÄÊ¿a li-abadihÄ
segments.translation: And bless Muhammad and his Household with a lasting, ever-increasing blessing, whose eternity shall never end,

segments.arabic: وَلَا مُنْتَهَى لِأَمَدِهَا وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ عَوْنًا لِي وَسَبَبًا لِنَجَاحِ طَلِبَتِي إِنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيمٌ
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ muntahÄ li-amadihÄ wa-jÊ¿al dhÄlika Ê¿awnan lÄ« wa-sababan li-najÄá¸¥i á¹­alibatÄ« innaka wÄsiÊ¿un karÄ«m
segments.translation: and whose span has no limit. Make that a support for me and a cause for the success of my requestâsurely You are All-Encompassing, Generous.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ حَاجَتِي يَا رَبِّ كَذَا وَكَذَا
segments.transliteration: wa-min á¸¥ÄjatÄ« yÄ rabbÄ« kadhÄ wa-kadhÄ
segments.translation: And of my needs, O my Lord, are such and such...
Your bounty has comforted me, and Your kindness has guided me.

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ لَا تَرُدَّنِي خَائِبًا
segments.transliteration: fa-asÊ¾aluka bika wa-bimuá¸¥ammadin wa-Älihi á¹£alawÄtuka Ê¿alayhim an lÄ taruddani khÄÊ¾iban
segments.translation: So I ask Youâby You, and by Muhammad and his Household (Your blessings be upon them)ânot to send me away disappointed.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَإِنِّي وَجَدْتُ الطَّلَبَ إِلَيْكَ جَمِيلًا
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa-innÄ« wajadtu al-á¹­alaba ilayka jamÄ«lan
segments.translation: O Allah, I found asking from You beautiful.

segments.arabic: وَالتَّضَرُّعَ إِلَيْكَ نَفْعًا، وَالسُّؤَالَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ غَنِيمَةً
segments.transliteration: Wa-al-taá¸arruÊ¿a ilayka nafÊ¿an, wa-al-suÊ¾Äla min faá¸lika ghanÄ«mah
segments.translation: And supplication to You beneficial, and requesting from Your bounty a gain.

segments.arabic: وَرَأَيْتُ أَنَّ قِلَّةَ الْمَسْأَلَةِ إِلَيْكَ فَقْرٌ
segments.transliteration: Wa-raÊ¾aytu anna qillata al-masÊ¾alati ilayka faqrun
segments.translation: And I saw that asking little from You is poverty.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ الْكَثِيرَ فِيهَا غِنًى، فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا إِلَهِي
segments.transliteration: Wa-anna al-kathÄ«ra fÄ«hÄ ghinan, fa-asÊ¾aluka yÄ ilÄhÄ«
segments.translation: And that much in it is wealthâso I ask You, O my God.

segments.arabic: مَا لَا يَنْقُصُكَ إِعْطَاؤُهُ، وَلَا يُضِرُّكَ وَهْبُهُ
segments.transliteration: MÄ lÄ yanquá¹£uka iÊ¿á¹­ÄÊ¾uhu, wa-lÄ yuá¸irruka wahbuhu
segments.translation: For what granting does not diminish You, nor does giving harm You.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ، وَاقْضِ حَاجَتِي
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma fa-á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Älihi, waqá¸i á¸¥Äjati
segments.translation: O Allah, so bless Muhammad and his family, and fulfill my need.

segments.arabic: وَاسْمَعْ دُعَائِي، وَاسْتَجِبْ نِدَائِي، وَلَا تَخَيَّبْ رَجَائِي
segments.transliteration: WasmaÊ¿ duÊ¿ÄÊ¾Ä«, wa-stajib nidÄÊ¾Ä«, wa-lÄ tukhaayyib rajÄÊ¾Ä«
segments.translation: Hear my supplication, answer my call, and do not disappoint my hope.

segments.arabic: وَكُنْ لِي فِي جَمِيعِ أُمُورِي وَلِيًّا وَحَافِظًا وَمُعِينًا
segments.transliteration: Wa-kun lÄ« fÄ« jamÄ«Ê¿i umÅ«rÄ« waliyyan wa-á¸¥Äfiáºan wa-muÊ¿Ä«nan
segments.translation: And be for me in all my affairs a Guardian, Protector, and Helper.

segments.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً لَا انْقِطَاعَ لَهَا
segments.transliteration: Wa-á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Älihi á¹£alÄtan dÄÊ¾imatan lÄ inqiá¹­ÄÊ¿a lahÄ
segments.translation: And send blessings upon Muhammad and his familyâblessings everlasting, never ending.

segments.arabic: وَلَا غَايَةَ لِأَمَدِهَا، وَلَا نِهَايَةَ لِعَدَدِهَا
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ ghÄyata li-amadihÄ, wa-lÄ nihÄyata li-Ê¿adadihÄ
segments.translation: With no limit to their duration, and no end to their number.
1.O God, O ultimate object of needs!
2.O He through whom requests are attained!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا يَبِيْعُ نِعَمَهُ بالأثْمَانِ
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa yabeeu' nia'mahoo bil-ath-maan
segments.translation: 3.O He whose favours are not bought by prices!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُكَدِّرُ عَطَايَاهُ بِالامْتِنَانِ
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa yukad-diru a't'aayaahoo biiam-tinaan
segments.translation: 4.O He who does not muddy His gifts by the imposition of obligations!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُسْتَغْنَى بِهِ وَلاَ يُسْتَغْنَى عَنْهُ
segments.transliteration: wa yaa may-yus-tagh-naa bihee wa laa yus-tagh-naa a'n-h
segments.translation: 5.O He along with whom nothing is needed and without whom nothing can be done!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُرْغَبُ إلَيْهِ وَلا يُرْغَبُ عَنْهُ.
segments.transliteration: wa yaa may-yur-ghabu ilay-hee wa laa yur-ghabu a'n-h
segments.translation: 6.O He toward whom desire is ever directed and never turned away!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا تُفنى خَزَآئِنَهُ الْمَسَائِلُ
segments.translation: 7.O He whose treasuries cannot be exhausted by demands!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تُبَدِّلُ حِكْمَتَهُ الْوَسَائِلُ.
segments.translation: 8.O He whose wisdom cannot be altered by any means!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهُ حَوَائِجُ الْمُحْتَاجِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa yaa mal-laa tanqat'iu' a'n-hoo h'awaaa-ijul-muh'-taajeen
segments.translation: 9.O He from whom the needs of the needy are never cut off!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُعَنِّيهِ دُعَاءُ الدَّاعِينَ
segments.translation: 10.O He who is not distressed by the supplications of the supplicators!

segments.arabic: تَمَدَّحْتَ بِالْغَنَاءِ  عَنْ خَلْقِكَ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْغِنَى عَنْهُمْ
segments.transliteration: tamad-dah'-ta bil-ghanaaa-i a'n khal-qik wa anta ah-lul-ghinaa a'n-hum-
segments.translation: 11.You hast lauded Yourself for having no need for Your creatures, and it suits You to have no need for them,

segments.arabic: وَنَسَبْتَهُمْ إلَى الفَقْرِ وَهُمْ أَهْلُ الْفَقْرِ إلَيْكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa nasab-tahum ilaal-faq-r wa hum ah-lul-faq-ri ilay-k
segments.translation: 12.and You hast attributed to them poverty, and it suits them to be poor toward You.

segments.arabic: فَمَنْ حَاوَلَ سَدَّ خَلَّتِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
segments.transliteration: faman h'aawala sad-da khal-latihee min i'ndik
segments.translation: 13.So he who strives to remedy his lack through what is with You

segments.arabic: وَرَامَ صَرْفَ الْفَقْر عَنْ نَفْسِهِ بِكَ فَقَدْ طَلَبَ حَاجَتَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa raama s'ar-fal-faq-ri a'n-naf-sihee bik faqad t'alaba h'aajatahoo
segments.translation: 14.and wishes to turn poverty away from himself through You has sought his need

segments.arabic: فِي مَظَانِّها وَأَتَى طَلِبَتَهُ مِنْ وَجْهِهَا
segments.transliteration: fee? maz'aaan-nihaa wa ataa t'ilabatahoo miw-waj-hihaa
segments.translation: 15.in the most likely place and come to his request from the right quarter.

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ تَوَجَّهَ بِحَاجَتِهِ إلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَوْ جَعَلَهُ سَبَبَ نُجْحِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa man tawj-jaha bih'aajatiheee ilaaa ah'adim-min khal-qika aw jaa'lahoo sababa nuj-h'ihaa
segments.translation: 16.But he who turns in his need toward one of Your creatures or assigns the cause of its being granted
17.to other than You, has exposed himself to deprivation
18.and deserves to miss Your beneficence.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَلِي إلَيْكَ حَاجَةٌ قَـدْ قَصَّرَ عَنْهَـا جُهْدِي
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma wa leee ilay-ka h'aajah qad qas'-s'ara a'n-haa juh-dee
segments.translation: 19.O God, I have a need of You: my exertion has fallen short of it
20.and my stratagems have been cut back before reaching it.

segments.arabic: وَسَوَّلَتْ لِيْ نَفْسِي رَفْعَهَا إلَى مَنْ يَرْفَعُ حَوَائِجَهُ إلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa saw-walat lee naf-see raf-a'haaa ilaa may-yar-fau' h'awaaa-ijahooo ilay-ka
segments.translation: 21.My soul induced me to present it to him who presents his needs to You

segments.transliteration: wa laa yas-tagh-nee fee t'alibaatihee a'nka
segments.translation: 22.and can do nothing without You in his requests,
23.but this is one the slips of the offenders,
24.one of the stumbles of the sinners!

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ انْتَبَهْتُ بِتَذْكِيرِكَ لِي مِنْ غَفْلَتِي
segments.transliteration: thum-ma antabah-tu bitad'-keerika lee min ghaf-latee
segments.translation: 25.Then through Your reminding me, I was aroused from my heedlessness,
26.through Your giving success, I stood up from my slip,

segments.arabic: وَ رَجَعتُ وَنَكَصْتُ بِتَسْـدِيدِكَ عَنْ عَثْـرَتِي
segments.transliteration: wa rajaa'-tu wa  nakas'-tu bitas-deedika a'n a'th-ratee
segments.translation: 27.and through Your pointing the way, I returned and withdrew from my stumble.

segments.arabic: وَقُلْتُ: سُبْحَانَ رَبّي كَيْفَ يَسْأَلُ مُحْتَاجٌ مُحْتَاجـاً
segments.transliteration: wa qul-tu: sub-h'aana rab-bee kay-fa yas-alu muh'-taajum-muh'-taajaa?
segments.translation: 28.I said: Glory be to my Lord! How can the needy ask from the needy?

segments.transliteration: wa an-naa yarghabu mua'-dimun ilaa mua'-dimin?
segments.translation: 29.How can the destitute beseech the destitute?
30.So I went straight to You, my God, in beseeching,

segments.transliteration: wa aw-fat-tu a'lay-ka rajaaa-ee bith-thiqati bik
segments.translation: 31.and I sent You my hope with trust in You.

segments.arabic: وَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّ كَثِيرَ مَا أَسْأَلُكَ يَسِيرٌ فِي وُجْدِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa a'lim-tu an-na katheera maaa as-aluka yaseerun fee wuj-dik
segments.translation: 32.I came to know that the many I request from You are few before Your wealth,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ خَطِيرَ مَا أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ حَقِيرٌ فِيْ وُسْعِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa an-na khat'eera maaa as-taw-hibuka h'aqeerun fee wus-i'k
segments.translation: 33.the weighty I ask from You is vile before Your plenty;

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ كَرَمَكَ لاَ يَضِيقُ عَنْ سُؤَال أحَد
segments.transliteration: wa an-na karamaka laa yaz''eequ a'n soo-aali ah'ad
segments.translation: 34.Your generosity is not constrained by anyone's asking,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ يَدَكَ بِالْعَطايا أَعْلَى مِنْ كُلِّ يَد.
segments.transliteration: wa an-na yadaka bil-a't'aayaaa aa'-laa min kul-li yad
segments.translation: 35.Your hand is higher in bestowing gifts than every hand!

segments.arabic: أللَهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاحْمِلْنِي بِكَرَمِكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih wa ah'-mil-nee bikaramika a'laat-tafaz''-z''ul
segments.translation: 36.O God, so bless Muhammad and His Household, take me through their generosity to Your gratuitous bounty
37.And take me not through Your justice to what I deserve!

segments.arabic: فَما أَنَا بِأَوَّلِ رَاغِبِ رَغِبَ إلَيْكَ فَأَعْطَيْتَهُ وَهُوَ يَسْتَحِقُّ الْمَنْعَ
segments.transliteration: famaaa ana biw-wali raaghibir-raghiba ilay-ka faaa'-t'ay-tahoo wa huwa yas-tah'iq-qul-man-a'-
segments.translation: 38.I am not the first beseecher to beseech You and You bestowed upon him while he deserved withholding,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ بِأَوَّلِ سَائِل سَأَلَكَ فَأَفْضَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَسْتَوْجِبُ الْحِرْمَانَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa biw-wali saaa-ilin saalaka faaf-z''al-ta a'lay-hee wa huwa yas-taw-jibul-h'ir-maan
segments.translation: 39.nor am I the first to ask from You and Your vast bounteous toward him while he merited deprivation.
40.O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَكُنْ لِدُعَائِي مُجِيباً وَمِنْ نِدائِي قَرِيباً
segments.transliteration: wa kul-lidua'aa-ee mujeebaa wa min-nidaaa-ee qareebaa
segments.translation: 41.respond to my supplication, come near my call,

segments.transliteration: wa litaz''ar-rue'e raah'imaa wa lis'aw-tee saamia'a
segments.translation: 42.have mercy on my pleading, listen to my voice,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ رَجَائِي عَنْكَ وَلا تَبُتَّ سَبَبِي مِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laa taq-t'aa' rajaaa-ee a'nk wa laa tabut-ta sababee mink
segments.translation: 43.cut not short my hope for You, sever not my thread to You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُوَجِّهْنِي فِي حَاجَتيْ هَذِهِ وَغَيْرِهَا إلى سِوَاكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laa tuwaj-jih-nee fee h'aajatee hd'ihee waghay-rihaaa ilaa siwaak
segments.translation: 44.turn not my face in this my need, and other needs, away from You,

segments.transliteration: wa tawal-lanee binuj-hee t'alibatee wa qaz''aaa-i h'aajatee
segments.translation: 45.attend for my sake to the fulfillment of my request, the granting of my need,

segments.arabic: وَنَيْلِ سُؤْلِي قَبْلَ زَوَالِي عَنْ مَوْقِفِي هَذَا
segments.transliteration: wa nay-li soo-lee qab-la zawaalee a'm-maw-qifee had'aa
segments.translation: 46.and the attainment of what I have asked before I leave this place

segments.arabic: بِتَيسِيرِكَ لِيَ الْعَسِيْرَ وَحُسْنِ تَقْدِيرِكَ لِي فِي جَمِيعِ الأُمُورِ.
segments.transliteration: bitay-seerika leeal-a'seer wa h'us-ni taq-deerika lee fee jameei'l-umoor
segments.translation: 47.through Your making easy for me the difficult and Your excellent ordainment for me in all affairs!

segments.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ صَلاَةً دَائِمَةً نَامِيَةً لاَ انْقِطَاعَ لأِبَدِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih s'alaatan daaa-imatan-naameeah laa anqit'aaa' liabadihaa
segments.translation: 48.Bless Muhammad and his Household with a permanent, ever-growing blessing, whose perpetuity has no cutting off

segments.arabic: وَلا مُنْتَهَى لأِمَدِهَا وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ عَوْناً لِيْ وَسَبَباً لِنَجَاحِ طَلِبَتِي إنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيْمٌ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa muntahaa liamadihaa waj-a'l d'alika a'w-nal-lee wa sababal-linajaahee t'alibatee in-naka waasiu'n kareem
segments.translation: 49.and whose term knows no limit, and make that a help to me and a cause for the granting of my request! You art Boundless, Generous!

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ حَاجَتِي يَا رَبِّ كَذَا وَكَذَا
segments.transliteration: wa min h'aajatee yaa rab-bi kad'aa wakad'aa
segments.translation: 50.And of my needs,my Lord, are such and such

segments.arabic: وَتَذْكُرُ حَاجَتَكَ ثمّ تَسْجُـدُ وَتَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِكَ:
segments.translation: .Your bounty has comforted me and Your beneficence has shown the way,

segments.transliteration: faas-aluka bika wa bimuh'am-madiw-wa aaalihee s'alawaatuka a'lay-him al-laa tarud-danee khaaa-ibaa
segments.translation: .So I ask You by You and by Muhammad and his Household (Your blessings be upon them) that You sendest me not back in disappointment!

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَبِمُحَمَّـد وَآلِهِ صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهمْ أَنْ لاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً.

segments.translation: and a reminder to erase sins with Your longstanding grace?

segments.transliteration: Wa fÄ« khilÄli dhÄlika mÄ kataba liya al-kÄtibÄni min zakiyyi al-aâmÄli
segments.translation: And amidst that, what the two angels recorded for me of pure deeds,

segments.arabic: مَا لَا قَلْبٌ فَكَّرَ فِيهِ وَلَا لِسَانٌ نَطَقَ بِهِ وَلَا جَارِحَةٌ تَكَلَّفَتْهُ
segments.transliteration: MÄ lÄ qalbun fakkara fÄ«hi wa lÄ lisÄnun naá¹­aqa bihi wa lÄ jÄriá¸¥atun takallafathu
segments.translation: which no heart conceived, nor tongue uttered, nor limb undertook,

segments.arabic: بَلْ إِفْضَالًا مِنْكَ عَلَيَّ وَإِحْسَانًا مِنْ صَنِيعِكَ إِلَيَّ
segments.transliteration: Bal ifá¸Älan minka âalayya wa iá¸¥sÄnan min á¹£anÄ«âika ilayya
segments.translation: but as a favor from You upon me, and kindness from Your doing toward me.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma faá¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and his family,

segments.transliteration: Wa á¸¥abbib ilayya mÄ raá¸Ä«ta lÄ«
segments.translation: and make beloved to me what You have decreed for me,

segments.transliteration: Wa yassir lÄ« mÄ aá¸¥lalta bÄ«
segments.translation: and ease for me what You have brought upon me,

segments.transliteration: Wa á¹­ahhirnÄ« min danasi mÄ aslaftu
segments.translation: and purify me from the taint of what I have committed,

segments.transliteration: Wa imá¸¥u âannÄ« sharra mÄ qaddamtu
segments.translation: and erase from me the evil of what I have sent forth.
And grant me the sweetness of well-being,
and let me taste the coolness of safety.

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ مَخْرَجِي عَنْ عِلَّتِي إِلَى عَفْوِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa ijâal makhrajÄ« âan âillatÄ« ilÄ âafwika
segments.translation: And make my escape from my illness to Your pardon,

segments.transliteration: Wa mutaá¸¥awwalÄ« âan á¹£arâatÄ« ilÄ tajÄwuzika
segments.translation: and my transition from my affliction to Your forbearance,

segments.transliteration: Wa khalÄá¹£Ä« min karbÄ« ilÄ rawá¸¥ika
segments.translation: and my deliverance from my distress to Your relief,

segments.arabic: وَسَلَامَتِي مِنْ هَذِهِ الشِّدَّةِ إِلَى فَرَجِكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa salÄmatÄ« min hÄdhihi ash-shiddati ilÄ farajika
segments.translation: and my safety from this hardship to Your ease.

segments.arabic: إِنَّكَ الْمُتَفَضِّلُ بِالْإِحْسَانِ الْمُتَطَوِّلُ بِالِامْتِنَانِ الْوَهَّابُ الْكَرِيمُ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
segments.transliteration: Innaka al-mutafaá¸á¸ilu bi-al-iá¸¥sÄni al-mutaá¹­awwilu bi-al-imtinÄni al-wahhÄbu al-karÄ«mu dhÅ« al-jalÄli wa al-ikrÄmi
segments.translation: For You are the Benefactor with kindness, the Bountiful with grace, the Generous Giver, Possessor of majesty and honor.

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا لَمْ أَزَلْ أَتَصَرَّفُ فِيهِ مِنْ سَلاَمَةِ بَدَنِي،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma lakal-h'am-du a'laa maa lam azal atas'ar-rafu feehee min salaamati badanee
segments.translation: 1.O God, to You belongs praise for the good health of my body which lets me move about,

segments.arabic: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا أَحْدَثْتَ بِيْ مِنْ عِلَّة فِي جَسَـدِي.
segments.transliteration: wa lakal-h'am-du a'laa maaa ah'-dath-ta bee min i'l-latin fee jasadee
segments.translation: 2.and to You belongs praise, for the ailments which You causest to arise in my flesh!

segments.arabic: فَمَا أَدْرِي يَـا إلهِي، أَيُّ الْحَالَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِالشُّكْرِ لَكَ،
segments.transliteration: famaaa ad-ree yaaa ilaahee ay-yul-h'aalay-ni ah'aq-qu bish-shuk-ri laka?
segments.translation: 3.For I know not, my God, which of the two states deserves more my thanking You
4.and which of the two times is more worthy for my praise of You:

segments.arabic: أَوَقْتُ الصِّحَةِ الَّتِي هَنَّـأْتَنِي فِيهَا طَيِّبَاتِ رِزْقِكَ،
segments.translation: 5.the time of health, within which You makest me delight in the agreeable things of Your provision,

segments.transliteration: wa nash-shat'-tanee bihaa liab-tighaaa-i mar-z''aatika wafaz''-lik
segments.translation: 6.through which You givest me the joy to seek the means to Your good pleasure and bounty,

segments.arabic: وَقَوَّيْتَنِي مَعَهَا عَلَى مَـا وَفَّقْتَنِي لَهُ مِنْ طَـاعَتِـكَ
segments.transliteration: wa qaw-way-tanee maa'haa a'laa maa waf-faq-tanee lahoo min t'aaa'tika?
segments.translation: 7.and by which You strengthenest me for the acts of obedience which You hast given me success to accomplish;

segments.arabic: أَمْ وَقْتُ الْعِلَّةِ الَّتِي مَحَّصْتَنِي بِهَا،
segments.translation: 8.or the time of illness through which You puttest me to the test
9.and bestowest upon me favours:

segments.arabic: تَخْفِيفاً لِمَا ثَقُلَ بِهِ عَلَى ظَهري مِنَ الْخَطِيئاتِ
segments.translation: 10.lightening of the offenses that weigh down my back,

segments.arabic: وَتَطْهيراً لِمَا انْغَمَسْتُ فيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ ،
segments.translation: 11.purification of the evil deeds into which I have plunged,

segments.arabic: وَتَنْبِيهاً لِتَنَاوُلِ التَّوْبَةِ، وَتَذْكِيراً لِمَحْوِ الْحَوْبَةِ بِقَدِيمِ النِّعْمَةِ،
segments.translation: 12.incitement to reach for repentance, reminder of the erasure of misdeeds through ancient favour;

segments.arabic: وَفِي خِلاَلِ ذَلِكَ مَا كَتَبَ لِيَ الْكَاتِبَانِ
segments.transliteration: wa fee khilaali d'alika maa kataba leeal-kaatibaani
segments.translation: 13.and, through all that, what the two writers write for me:

segments.arabic: مِنْ زَكِيِّ الأعْمَالِ، مَا لا قَلْبٌ فَكَّرَ فِيهِ،
segments.transliteration: min zaky-yil-aa'-maal maa laa qal-bun fak-kara feeh
segments.translation: 14.blameless acts, which no heart had thought,

segments.arabic: وَلا لِسَانٌ نَطَقَ بِهِ وَلاَ جَارِحَةٌ تَكَلَّفَتْهُ بَلْ إفْضَالاً مِنْكَ عَلَيَّ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa lisaanun-nat'aqa bih wa laa jaarih'atun takal-lafat-h bal if-z''aalam-minka a'lay
segments.translation: 15.no tongue had uttered, and no limb had undertaken, rather, as Your bestowal of bounty upon me
16.and the beneficence of Your benefaction toward me.
17.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa h'ab-bib ilay-ya maa raz''eeta lee
segments.translation: 18.make me love what You hast approved for me,

segments.transliteration: wa yas-sir lee maaa ah'-lal-ta bee
segments.translation: 19.make easy for me what You hast sent down upon me,

segments.transliteration: wa t'ah-hir-nee min danasi maaa as-laf-t
segments.translation: 20.purify me of the defilement of what I have sent ahead,
21.erase the evil of what I have done beforehand,

segments.arabic: وَأَوْجِدْنِي حَلاَوَةَ الْعَافِيَةِ ، وَأَذِقْنِي بَرْدَ السَّلاَمَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa aw-jid-nee h'alaawatal-a'afeeah wa ad'iq-nee bar-das-salaamah
segments.translation: 22.let me find the sweetness of well-being, let me taste the coolness of safety,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ مَخْرَجِي عَنْ عِلَّتِي إلَى عَفْوِكَ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l makh-rajee a'n i'l-lateee ilaa a'f-wik
segments.translation: 23.and appoint for me a way out from my illness to Your pardon,

segments.transliteration: wa mutah'aw-walee a'n s'ar-a'teee ilaa tajaawuzik
segments.translation: 24.transformation of my infirmity into Your forbearance,

segments.transliteration: wa khalaas'ee min kar-beee ilaa raw-h'ik
segments.translation: 25.escape from my distress to Your refreshment,

segments.arabic: وَسَلاَمَتِي مِنْ هَذِهِ الشِّدَّةِ إلَى فَرَجِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa salaamatee min hd'ihish-shid-dati ilaa farajik
segments.translation: 26.and safety from this hardship in Your relief!
27.You art gratuitously bountiful in beneficence,
28.ever gracious in kindness, the Generous, the Giver,
29.Possessor of majesty and munificence!

segments.arabic: وَكَرُمْتَ أَنْ يُخَافَ مِنْكَ إِلَّا الْعَدْلُ
segments.transliteration: Wa karumta an yukhÄfa minka illÄ al-Ê¿adl
segments.translation: You are Noble, none should fear You except in justice

segments.arabic: لَا يُخْشَى جَوْرُكَ عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ
segments.transliteration: LÄ yukhshÄ jawruka Ê¿alÄ man Ê¿Äá¹£Äk
segments.translation: No one fears injustice from You, even those who disobey

segments.arabic: وَلَا يُخَافُ إِغْفَالُكَ ثَوَابَ مَنْ أَرْضَاكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ yukhÄfu ighfÄluka thawÄba man ará¸Äk
segments.translation: Nor should anyone fear being deprived of reward who has pleased You

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَهَبْ لِي أَمَلِي
segments.transliteration: Fa-á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Älih wa hab lÄ« amalÄ«
segments.translation: So bless Muá¸¥ammad and his family, and grant me my hopes
And increase me in Your guidance

segments.arabic: مَا أَصِلُ بِهِ إِلَى التَّوْفِيقِ فِي عَمَلِي
segments.transliteration: MÄ aá¹£ilu bihi ilÄ at-tawfÄ«qi fÄ« Ê¿amalÄ«
segments.translation: So I may attain success in my actions through it
Truly, You are Most Generous and Noble

segments.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّ أَحَداً لاَ يَبْلُغُ مِنْ شُكْرِكَ غَايَةً
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-na ah'adal- laa yab-lughu min shuk-rika ghaayatan
segments.translation: 1.O God, no one reaches a limit in thanking You

segments.arabic: إلاّ حَصَلَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ إحْسَانِكَ مَا يُلْزِمُهُ شُكْرَاً،
segments.transliteration: il-laa h'as'ala a'lay-hee min ih'-saanika maa yul-zimuhoo shuk-ran
segments.translation: 2.without acquiring that of Your beneficence which enjoins upon him thanksgiving,

segments.arabic: وَلا يَبْلُغُ مَبْلَغاً مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَإن اجْتَهَدَ
segments.transliteration: wa laa yab-lughu mab-lagham-min t'aaa'tika waani aj-tahada
segments.translation: 3.nor does anyone reach a degree in obeying You, even if he strives,

segments.arabic: إلاَّ كَانَ مُقَصِّراً دُونَ اسْتِحْقَاقِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: laa kaana muqas'-s'irana doona as-tih'-qaaqika bifaz''-lik
segments.translation: 4.without falling short of what You deservest because of Your bounty.
5.The most thankful of Your servants has not the capacity to thank You,

segments.transliteration: wa aa'-baduhum lak mqas'-s'irun a'n t'aaa'tik
segments.translation: 6.and the most worshipful of them falls short of obeying You.

segments.arabic: لا يَجبُ لأِحَد أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَهُ بِاسْتِحْقَاقِهِ،
segments.transliteration: laa yajibu liah'adim-min-hum an tagh-fira lahoo bis-tih'-qaaqih
segments.translation: 7.To none of them is due Your forgiveness through what he himself deserves

segments.transliteration: wa laa yah'iq-qu lahooo an tar-z''aa a'n-hoo bis-teejaabih
segments.translation: 8.or Your good pleasure for his own merit.
9.When You forgivest someone, it is through Your graciousness,
10.and when You art pleased with someone, it is through Your bounty.

segments.arabic: تَشْكُرُ يَسِيرَ مَا شُكِرْتَهُ وَتُثِيبُ عَلَى قَلِيلِ مَا تُطَاعُ فِيهِ
segments.transliteration: tash-kuru yaseera maa shukir-tah wa tutheebu a'laa qaleeli maa tut'aau' feeh
segments.translation: 11.You showest gratitude for the paltry for which gratitude is shown to You and You rewardest the small act in which You art obeyed,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى كَأَنَّ شُكْـرَ عِبَادِكَ الَّذِيْ أَوْجَبْتَ  عَلَيْهِ ثَوَابَهُمْ
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa kaan-na shuk-ra i'baadikal-lad'ee aw-jab-ta a'lay-hee thawaabahum
segments.translation: 12.so that it seems as if Your servants' thanksgiving for which You hast made incumbent their reward
13.and made great their repayment

segments.arabic: أَمْرٌ مَلَكُوا اسْتِطَاعَةَ الامْتِنَاعِ مِنْهُ دُونَكَ
segments.translation: 14.is an affair from which they could have held back without You,

segments.arabic: فَكَافَيْتَهُمْ أَوْ  لَمْ يَكُنْ سَبَبُهُ بِيَدِكَ فَجَازَيْتَهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: fakaafaa-tahum- wa lam yakun sababuhoo beeadika fajaazay-tahum
segments.translation: 15.and hence You wilt recompense them, and whose cause is not in Your hand, and hence You wilt repay them.

segments.arabic: بَـلْ مَلَكْتَ يَا إلهِي أَمْرَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمْلِكُوا عِبَادَتَكَ،
segments.transliteration: bal malak-ta yaaa ilaaheee am-rahum qab-la ay-yam-likoo i'baadatak
segments.translation: 16.Nay, my God, You hadst power over their affair before they had power to worship You,

segments.arabic: وَأَعْدَدْتَ ثَوَابَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفِيضُوا فِي طَاعَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa aa'-dat-ta thawaabahum qab-la ay-yufeez''oo fee t'aaa'tik
segments.translation: 17.and You hadst prepared their reward before they began to obey You;
18.and that because Your wont is bestowal of bounty,
19.Your custom beneficence, Your way pardon.

segments.arabic: فَكُلُّ الْبَرِيِّةِ مًعْتَرِفَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ غَيْرُ ظَالِم لِمَنْ عَاقَبْتَ،
segments.transliteration: fakul-lul-baree-yah mua'-tarifatum-bi n-naka ghay-ru z'aalimil-liman a'aqab-t
segments.translation: 20.So all creatures confess that You wrongest not him whom You punishest

segments.arabic: وَشَاهِدَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ مُتَفَضِّلٌ عَلَى مَنْ عَافَيْتَ،
segments.transliteration: wa shaahidatum-bi n-naka mutafaz''-z''ilun a'laa man a'afay-t
segments.translation: 21.and bear witness that You bestowest bounty upon him whom You pardonest.

segments.arabic: وَكُلٌّ مُقِرٌّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّقْصِيْرِ عَمَّا اسْتَوْجَبْتَ،
segments.transliteration: wa kul-lu muqir-ru a'laa naf-sihee bit-taq-s'eeri a'm-mas-taw-jab-t
segments.translation: 22.Each admits that he has fallen short of what You meritest.

segments.arabic: فَلَوْلا أَنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَخْتَدِعُهُمْ عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ ما عَصاكَ عاصٍ
segments.transliteration: falaw-laaa an-nash-shay-t'aana yakh-tadiu'hum a'n t'aaa'tika maa a's'aaka a'as'
segments.translation: 23.Had Satan not misled them from Your obedience, no disobeyer would have disobeyed You,

segments.arabic: وَلَوْلا أَنَّهُ صَوَّرَ لَهُمُ البَاطِلَ فِي مِثَالِ الْحَقِّ
segments.translation: 24.and had he not shown falsehood to them in the likeness of truth

segments.transliteration: fee mithaalil-h'aq-qi maa z''al-la a'n t'areeqika z''aaal
segments.translation: 25.no strayer would have gone astray from Your path.
26.So glory be to You! How manifest is Your generosity

segments.arabic: فِي مُعَامَلَةِ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ أَوْ عَصَاكَ،
segments.transliteration: fee mua'amalati man at'aaa'ka aw a's'aak
segments.translation: 27.in dealing with him who obeys or disobeys You!

segments.arabic: تَشْكُرُ للْمُطِيْعِ مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ لَهُ،
segments.transliteration: tash-kurul-mut'eea' a'laa maaa anta tawal-lay-tahoo lah
segments.translation: 28.You showest gratitude to the obedient for that which You undertakest for him,

segments.arabic: وَتُمْلِي لِلْعَاصِي فِيْمَا تَمْلِكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُ فِيْهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa tum-lee lil-a'as'ee feemaa tam-liku mua'ajalatahoo feeh
segments.translation: 29.and You grantest a respite to the disobedient in that within which You art able to hurry him.

segments.arabic: أَعْطَيْتَ كُلاًّ مِنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَجِبْ لَهُ،
segments.transliteration: aa'-t'ay-ta kul-lam-min-humaa maa laa yajibu lah
segments.translation: 30.You givest to each of them that which is not his due,

segments.arabic: وَتَفَضَّلْتَ عَلَى كُلٍّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَا يَقْصُرُ عَمَلُهُ عَنْهُ
segments.transliteration: wa tafaz''-z''al-ta a'laa kul-lim-min-humaa bimaa yaq-s'uru a'maluhoo a'n-h
segments.translation: 31.and You bestowest bounty upon each in that wherein his works fall short.

segments.arabic: وَلَوْ كَافَأْتَ الْمُطِيعَ عَلَى مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa law kaafay-tal-mut'eea' a'laa maaa anta tawal-lay-tahoo
segments.translation: 32.Wert You to counterbalance for the obedient servant that which You Yourself hadst undertaken,
33.he would be on the point of losing Your reward
34.and seeing the end of Your favour,
35.but through Your generosity You hast repaid him

segments.arabic: عَلَى الْمُدَّةِ الْقَصِيرَةِ الفَانِيَةِ بِالْمُدَّةِ الطَّوِيلَةِ الْخَالِدَةِ،
segments.translation: 36.for a short, perishing term with a long, everlasting term,

segments.arabic: وَعَلَى الْغَايَةِ الْقَرِيبَةِ الزَّائِلَةِ بِالْغايَةِ الْمَدِيدَةِ الْبَاقِيَةِ،
segments.translation: 37.and for a near, vanishing limit with an extended, abiding limit.

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَسُمْهُ الْقِصَاصَ فِيمَا أَكَلَ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: thum-ma lam tasum-hul-qis'aas'a feemaaa akala mir-riz-qika
segments.translation: 38.Then You dost not visit him with a settling of accounts for Your provision
39.through which he gained strength to obey You,

segments.arabic: وَلَـمْ تَحْمِلْهُ عَلَى  الْمُنَاقَشَاتِ فِي الآلاتِ
segments.translation: 40.nor dost You force him to make reckonings for the organs
41.he employed to find the means to Your forgiveness.
42.Wert You to do that to him,
43.it would take away everything for which he had laboured
44.and all wherein he had exerted himself
45.as repayment for the smallest of Your benefits and kindnesses,

segments.arabic: وَلَبَقِيَ رَهيناً  بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ بِسَائِرِ نِعَمِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa labaqeea raheenam-bay-na yaday-ka bisaaa-iri nia'mik
segments.translation: 46.and he would remain hostage before You for Your other favours.

segments.arabic: فَمَتَى كَانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ شَيْئاً مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ ، لا ، مَتَى؟.
segments.transliteration: famataa kaana yastah'iq-qu shay-am-min thawaabika? laa mataa?
segments.translation: 47.So how can he deserve something of Your reward? Indeed, how?

segments.arabic: هَذَا يا إلهِي حَالُ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ وَسَبِيلُ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ،
segments.transliteration: had'aa yaaa ilaahee h'aalu man at'aaa'ka wa sabeelu man taa'b-bada lak
segments.translation: 48.This, my God, is the state of him who obeys You and the path of him who worships You.
49.But as for him who disobeys Your command and goes against Your prohibition,

segments.arabic: فَلَمْ تُعَاجِلْهُ بِنَقِمَتِكَ لِكَيْ يَسْتَبْدِلَ بِحَالِهِ فِي مَعْصِيَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: falam tua'ajil-hoo binaqimatika likay yas-tab-dila bih'aalihee fee maa'-s'eeatika
segments.translation: 50.You dost not hurry him to Your vengeance, so that he may seek to replace his state in disobeying You
51.with the state of turning back to obey You,

segments.arabic: وَلَقَـدْ كَـانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ فِي أَوَّلِ مَـا هَمَّ بِعِصْيَانِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laqad kaana yas-tah'iq-qu yaaa ilaahee feee aw-wali maa ham-ma bii's'-yaanika
segments.translation: 52.though he deserved from the time he set out to disobey You

segments.arabic: كُلَّ مَا أَعْدَدْتَ لِجَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: kul-la maaa aa'-dat-ta lijameei' khal-qika min u'qoobatik
segments.translation: 53.every punishment which You hast prepared for all Your creatures.

segments.arabic: فَجَمِيعُ مَا أَخَّرْتَ عَنْهُ  مِنْ الْعَذَابِ،
segments.translation: 54.Through each chastisement which You hast kept back from him

segments.arabic: وَأَبْطَأتَ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سَطَوَاتِ النَّقِمَةِ وَالْعِقَابِ تَرْكٌ مِنْ حَقِّكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ab-t'aa-ta a'lay-hee min sat'awaatin-niq-mati wal-i'qaab tar-kum-min h'aq-qika
segments.translation: 55.and each penalty of Your vengeance and Your punishment which You hast delayed from him, You hast refrained from Your right
56.and shown good pleasure in place of what You hast made obligatory.
57.So who is more generous, my God, than Thou?

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَشْقَى مِمَّنْ هَلَكَ عَلَيْـكَ، لا ، مَنْ؟
segments.transliteration: waman ash-qaa mim-man halaka a'lay-ka? laa man-?!
segments.translation: 58.And who is more wretched than he who perishes in spite of You? Indeed, who?
59.You art too blessed to be described by any but beneficence

segments.arabic: وَكَـرُمْتَ أَنْ يُخَافَ مِنْكَ إلاّ الْعَدْلُ،
segments.translation: 60.and too generous for any but justice to be feared from You!

segments.arabic: لا يُخْشَى جَوْرُكَ عَلَى  مَنْ عَصَاكَ،
segments.transliteration: laa yukh-shaa jaw-ruka a'laa man a's'aak
segments.translation: 61.There is no dread that You wilt be unjust toward him who disobeys You,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُخَافُ إغْفَالُكَ ثَوَابَ مَنْ أَرْضَاكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa yukhaafu igh-faaluka thawaaba man ar-z''aaka
segments.translation: 62.nor any fear of Your neglecting to reward him who satisfies You.

segments.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَهَبْ لِيْ أَمَلِي،
segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih wa hab lee minka amalee
segments.translation: 63.So bless Muhammad and his Household, give me my hope,
64.and increase me in that of Your guidance

segments.arabic: مَا أَصِلُ بِهِ إلَى التَّوْفِيقِ فِي عَمَلِي،
segments.transliteration: maaa as'ilu biheee ilaat-taw-feeqi fee a'malee
segments.translation: 65.through which I may be successful in my works!
66.Surely You art All-kind, Generous.

title: Dua after Ziyarat Aleyasin Duas.org

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You to send blessings upon Muhammad
the Prophet of Your mercy and the Word of Your Light,

segments.transliteration: wa an tamla'a qalbi nura alyaqini
segments.translation: and to fill in my heart with the illumination of certitude,
my chest with the illumination of faith,
my intellect with the illumination of honest intentions,
my determination with the illumination of knowledge,
my strength with the illumination of work,
my tongue with the illumination of honesty,
my religion with the illumination of clear evidence from You,
my sight with the illumination of brightness,
my hearing with the illumination of wisdom,

segments.transliteration: wa mawaddati nura almuwalati limuhammadin wa alihi
segments.translation: and my faculty of love with the illumination of sincere loyalty to Muhammad and his Household,
peace be upon them,

segments.arabic: حَتَّىٰ أَلْقَاكَ وَقَدْ وَفَيْتُ بِعَهْدِكَ وَمِيثَاقِكَ
segments.transliteration: hatta alqaka wa qad wafaytu bi`ahdika wa mithaqika
segments.translation: so that I, when I meet You, will have fulfilled the pledge and covenant that I made with You
and then Your mercy will encompass me.
O Protector! O Worthy of all praise!
O Allah, bless Muhammad (al-Mahdi)
Your argument in Your land,
Your viceroy in Your countries,
the caller to Your course,
the establisher of Your justice,
the revolting by Your command,
the authority of the believers,
the ruiner of the unbelievers,
the remover of the murk,
the illuminator of the truth,
the speaker with wisdom and honesty,
the perfect Word of You in Your lands,
the vigilant and fearful,
the well-wishing saint,
the ark of salvation,
the sign of guidance,
the light of the peoplesâ sights,

segments.transliteration: wa khayri man taqammasa wa irtada
segments.translation: the best of all those who put clothes on their bodies,
and the unveiler of blindness,
who will fill the lands with justice and equity
as it would be filled up with wrong and unfairness.
You verily have power over all things.
O Allah, bless Your vicegerent
and the son of Your vicegerents the obedience to whom You have made incumbent upon us
and the observance of the right of whom You have made obligatory
and from whom You have removed filth
and whom You have purified with thorough purifying.
O Allah, give him victory and make him the supporter of Your religion
and through him, give victory to Your and his adherents,
followers, and backers.
Include us with them.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ بَاغٍ وَطَاغٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma a`idhhu min sharri kulli baghin wa taghin
segments.translation: O Allah, protect him against the evil of every transgressor and tyrant
and against the evils of all Your creatures.

segments.arabic: وَٱحْفَظْهُ مِنْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ
segments.transliteration: wahfazhu min bayni yadayhi wa min khalfihi
segments.translation: Guard him from ahead of him, behind him,
his right side, and his left side.

segments.arabic: وَٱحْرُسْهُ وَٱمْنَعْهُ مِنْ أَنْ يوُصَلَ إِلَيْهِ بِسُوءٍ
segments.transliteration: wahrus-hu wamna`hu min an yusala ilayhi bisu'in
segments.translation: Watch him and defend him against anything that may cause evil to him.

segments.transliteration: wahfaz fihi rasulaka wa ala rasulika
segments.translation: Save through him Your Messenger and the family of Your Messenger.
Manifest justice through him.
Aid him with victory.
Help his backers.
Frustrate those who intend to disappoint him.
Terminate those who intend to eradicate him.
And, through him, terminate the tyrants of unbelief,
kill the disbelievers, the hypocrites,
and all atheists,

segments.arabic: حَيْثُ كَانُوٱ مِنْ مَشَارِقِ ٱلأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا
segments.transliteration: haythu kanu min mashariqi al-ardi wa magharibiha
segments.translation: wherever they are; in the east or the west of the earth
on the lands or in the oceans,
and, through him, fill in the earth with justice,
manifest the religion of Your Prophet,

segments.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa sallama
segments.translation: blessings and peace of You be upon him and his Household,

segments.transliteration: waj`alni allahumma min ansarihi wa a`wanihi
segments.translation: make me, O Allah, of his supporters, helpers,
followers, and adherents;

segments.arabic: وَأَرِنِي فِي آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ مَا يَأْمُلُونَ
segments.transliteration: wa arini fi ali muhammadin `alayhim alssalamu ma ya'muluna
segments.translation: allow me to see the hopes of the family of Muhammad, peace be upon them, come true,
and the hazards of their enemies come true.
O God of Truth, respond.
O Lord of Glory and Honor!
O most merciful of those who show mercy!

title: Ziyarat Warith - Duas.org

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ آدَمَ صَفْوَةِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha adama safwati allahi
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam the choice of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوحٍ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha nuhin nabiyyi allahi
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Noah the prophet of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha ibrahima khalili allahi
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Abraham the intimate friend of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوسَىٰ كَلِيمِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha musa kalimi allahi
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Moses the spoken by Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِيسَىٰ رُوحِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Jesus the spirit of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَبِيبِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha muhammadin habibi allahi
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Muhammad the most beloved by Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of Muhammad the well-chosen Prophet.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ عَلِيٍّ ٱلْمُرْتَضَىٰ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of `Ali the well-pleased.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah the luminous lady.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ خَدِيـجَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of Khadijah the grand lady.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ثَارَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ ثَارِهِ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya thara allahi wabna tharihi
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O vengeance of Allah, son of His vengeance,
and the unavenged so far.
I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rate,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,

segments.arabic: وَأَطَعْتَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ حَتَّىٰ أَتَاكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
segments.transliteration: wa ata`ta allaha wa rasulahu hatta ataka alyaqinu
segments.translation: and obeyed Allah and His Messenger until death came upon you.
So, may Allah curse the people who slew you.
May Allah curse the people who persecuted you.

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً سَمِعَتْ بِذٰلِكَ فَرَضِيَتْ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan sami`at bidhalika faradiyat bihi
segments.translation: May Allah curse the people who were pleased when they had heard of that.

segments.arabic: يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: O my Master, O Abu-`Abdullah!

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ كُنْتَ نُوراً فِي ٱلأَصْلاَبِ ٱلشَّامِخَةِ
segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka kunta nuran fi al-aslabi alshshamikhati
segments.translation: I bear witness that you were light in the sublime loins
and purified wombs;
the impurities of the Ignorance Era could not object you to filth

segments.transliteration: wa lam tulbiska min mudlahimmati thiyabiha
segments.translation: nor could it dress you its murky clothes.

segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka min da`a'imi alddini
segments.translation: I also bear witness that you are one of the mainstays of the religion
and the supports of the faithful believers.

segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka al-imamu albarru alttaqiyyu
segments.translation: I also bear witness that you are the God-fearing, pious,
pleased, immaculate,
guide, and well-guided Imam.

segments.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ ٱلأَئِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِكَ كَلِمَةُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ
segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna al-a'immata min wuldika kalimatu alttaqwa
segments.translation: And (I bear witness) that the Imams from your progeny are the spokesmen of piety,
the signs of guidance,
the firmest handle (of Islam),
and the decisive Argument against the inhabitants of the world.
And I call Allah, His angels,
His Prophets, and His Messenger
to witness for me that I believe in you all and in your Return,
I have full confidence in the laws of my religion and in the seals of my deeds,
my heart is at peace with you all,
and all my affairs are based on your commands.
May Allahâs benedictions be on your souls,
your bodies, your forms,
the present and the absent from you,
and the apparent and the invisible from you.

segments.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi yabna rasuli allahi
segments.translation: My father and mother be sacrificed for you, O son of the Messenger of Allah!

segments.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya aba `abdillahi
segments.translation: My father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Abu `Abdullah!
Extremely terrible was the calamity
and astounding is the misfortune that you suffered upon us
and upon all the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth.

segments.transliteration: fala`ana allahu ummatan asrajat wa aljamat
segments.translation: Therefore, Allah may curse the people who saddled up, gave rein to their horses,
and prepared themselves to kill you.

segments.arabic: يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: O my Master, O Abu `Abdullah!
I moved towards your sanctuary
and came to your shrine

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلشَّأْنِ ٱلَّذِي لَكَ عِنْدَهُ
segments.translation: beseeching Allah in the name of the standing that you enjoy with Him
and the position that you occupy with Him

segments.arabic: أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an yusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: to send blessings on Muhammad and on the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مَعَكُمْ فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa an yaj`alani ma`akum fi alddunya wal-akhirati
segments.translation: and to keep me with you in this world and in the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the Prophet of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the commander of the faithful.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of al-Husayn the martyr.
Peace be upon you, O martyr.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمَظْلُومُ وَٱبْنُ ٱلْمَظْلُومِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O wronged and harassed and the son of the wrong and harassed.
Curse of Allah be on those who killed you.
Curse of Allah be on those who persecuted you.

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً سَمِعَتْ بِذٰلِكَ فَرَضَيِتْ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan sami`at bidhalika faradiyat bihi
segments.translation: Curse of Allah be on those who heard this even but rested satisfied.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ وَلِيِّهِ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waliyya allahi wabna waliyyihi
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O intimate servant of Allah and the son of His intimate servant.
Extremely terrible was the calamity
and astounding is the misfortune that you suffered, upon us
and upon all Muslims.
So, curse of Allah be on those who killed you

segments.transliteration: wa abra'u ila allahi wa ilayka minhum
segments.translation: and I disavow them in the presence of Allah and You.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَوْلِيَاءَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَحِبَّائَهُ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum ya awliya'a allahi wa ahibba'ahu
segments.translation: Peace be upon all of you, O friends and dears of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَصْفِيَاءَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَوِدَّاءَهُ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum ya asfiya'a allahi wa awidda'ahu
segments.translation: Peace be upon all of you, O choice of Allah and sincerely attached to Him.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of Allahâs religion.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of the Messenger of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ فَاطِمَةَ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum ya ansara fatimata sayyidati nisa'i al`alamina
segments.translation: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of Fatimah the doyenne of the women of this world.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of Abu Muhammad,
al-Hasan the son of `Ali, the saintly and sincere.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَنْصَارَ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon all of you, O supporters of Abu-`Abdullah.
My father and mother be sacrificed for you.

segments.arabic: طِبْتُمْ وَطَابَتِ ٱلأَرْضُ ٱلَّتِي فِيهَا دُفِنْتُمْ
segments.transliteration: tibtum wa tabat al-ardu allati fiha dufintum
segments.translation: Verily, pure be you and pure be the soil in which you were buried.
You attained great success.

segments.arabic: فَيَا لَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ مَعَكُمْ فَأَفُوزَ مَعَكُمْ
segments.translation: Would that I were with you so that I could also share the accomplishment with you.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.
Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah)
and obedient to Allah and to His Messenger.

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad jahadta wa nasahta
segments.translation: I bear witness that you strove (in the way of Allah), acted sincerely,
and tolerated (harm) until death came upon you.

segments.arabic: لَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ لَكُمْ مِنَ ٱلاوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: la`ana allahu alzzalimina lakum min al-awwalina wal-akhirina
segments.translation: May Allah curse those who wronged you from the past and the present generations
and may He send them to the lowest layer of the blazing Hell.
O Allah, I take pride in Your religion,
And I honor Your guidance,
And so-and-so humiliates me with his evil,
And insults me with his harm,
And criticizes me for my loyalty to Your friends,
And slanders me with his claims,

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ جِئْتُ إِلى مَوْضِعِ الدُّعاءِ وَضِمانِكَ الاِْجابَةِ ،
segments.transliteration: Wa qad jiâthu ilÄ mawá¸iÊ¿ ad-duÊ¿ÄÊ¾ wa á¸amÄnik al-ijÄbah,
segments.translation: And I have come to the place of supplication and Your assurance of response,

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Äl Muá¸¥ammad,
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muá¸¥ammad and the family of Muá¸¥ammad,
And defend me against him immediately - immediately.
My master, my Imam,
The oppressed seeks aid against his oppressor,
Victory, victory - until the breath stops.

segments.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلايَ وَسَيِّدِي وَابْنَ سَيِّدِي ،
segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alayk yÄ mawlÄya wa sayyidÄ« wa ibn sayyidÄ«,
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O my master and my lord and son of my lord,

segments.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلايَ وَابْنَ مَوْلايَ ،
segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alayk yÄ mawlÄya wa ibn mawlÄya,
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O my master and son of my master,
O one slain, son of the one slain,
The martyr, son of the martyr,

segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alayk wa raá¸¥mat AllÄh wa barakÄtuh,
segments.translation: Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah and His blessings,

segments.transliteration: AnÄ zÄâiruka yÄ ibn RasÅ«l AllÄh,
segments.translation: I am visiting you, O son of the Messenger of Allah,
With my heart, my tongue, and my limbs,

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ لَمْ أَزُرْكَ بِنَفْسِي وَالْمُشَاهَدَةِ لِقُبَّتِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: Wa in lam azurka bi-nafsÄ« wa al-mushÄhadah li-qubbatik,
segments.translation: And if I did not visit you in person and see your dome,

segments.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ آدَمَ صَفْوَةِ اللّهِ ،
segments.transliteration: As-salÄmu Ê¿alayk yÄ wÄriá¹­a Ädam á¹£afwat AllÄh,
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam, the chosen one of Allah,
And inheritor of Noah, the prophet of Allah,
And inheritor of Abraham, the friend of Allah,
And inheritor of Moses, the one who spoke to Allah,
And inheritor of Jesus, the spirit of Allah,

segments.arabic: وَوارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَبِيبِ اللّهِ وَنَبِيِّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ،
segments.transliteration: Wa wÄriá¹­a Muá¸¥ammad á¸¥abÄ«b AllÄh wa nabÄ«yih wa rasÅ«lih,
segments.translation: And inheritor of Muhammad, the beloved of Allah and His prophet and messenger,
And inheritor of Ê¿AlÄ«, the Commander of the Faithful,

segments.transliteration: Wa waá¹£Ä« RasÅ«l AllÄh wa khalÄ«fatih,
segments.translation: And successor of the Messenger of Allah and his caliph,

segments.arabic: وَوَارِثَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ وَصِيِّ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ،
segments.transliteration: Wa wÄriá¹­a al-á¸¤asan ibn Ê¿AlÄ« waá¹£Ä« AmÄ«r al-MuâminÄ«n,
segments.translation: And inheritor of al-á¸¤asan ibn Ê¿AlÄ«, the successor of the Commander of the Faithful,

segments.arabic: لَعَنَ اللّهُ قَاتِلَكَ وَجَدَّدَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعَذَابَ فِي هذِهِ السَّاعَةِ وَفِي كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ ،
segments.transliteration: LaÊ¿ana AllÄh qÄtÄ«lak wa jaddad Ê¿alayhim al-Ê¿adhÄb fÄ« hÄdhihi as-sÄÊ¿ah wa fÄ« kull sÄÊ¿ah,
segments.translation: May Allah curse those who killed you and renew the punishment upon them in this moment and in every moment,

segments.arabic: أَنَا يَا سَيِّدِي مُتَقَرِّبٌ إِلى اللّهِ تَعَالى ،
segments.transliteration: AnÄ yÄ sayyidÄ« mutaqarrib ilÄ AllÄh taÊ¿ÄlÄ,
segments.translation: I am, O my master, seeking closeness to Allah, the Exalted,
And to your grandfather, the Messenger of Allah,
And to your father, the Commander of the Faithful,
And to your brother, al-á¸¤asan,
And to you, O my master,
Upon you be the peace of Allah and His mercy,

segments.arabic: بِزِيَارَتِي لَكَ بِقَلْبِي وَلِسَانِي وَجَمِيعِ جَوَارِحِي ،
segments.transliteration: Bi-ziyÄratÄ« laka bi-qalbÄ« wa lisÄnÄ« wa jamÄ«Ê¿ jawÄriá¸¥Ä«,
segments.translation: With my visit to you with my heart, my tongue, and all my limbs,

segments.arabic: فَكُنْ يَا سَيِّدِي شَفِيعِي لِقَبُولِ ذلِكَ مِنّي ،
segments.transliteration: Fa-kun yÄ sayyidÄ« shafÄ«Ê¿Ä« li-qabÅ«l dhÄlika minnÄ«,
segments.translation: So be, O my master, my intercessor for the acceptance of that from me,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَا بِالْبَرَاءَةِ مِنْ أَعْدَائِكَ وَاللَّعْنَةِ لَهُمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ ،
segments.transliteration: Wa anÄ bi-l-barÄÊ¾ah min aÊ¿dÄÊ¾ik wa al-laÊ¿nah lahum wa Ê¿alayhim,
segments.translation: And I disassociate myself from your enemies and curse them and upon them,

segments.arabic: أَتَقَرَّبُ بِذلِكَ إِلى اللّهِ تَعَالى وَإِلَيْكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ،
segments.transliteration: At-taqarrub bi-dhÄlika ilÄ AllÄh taÊ¿ÄlÄ wa ilaykum ajmaÊ¿Ä«n,
segments.translation: I seek closeness through that to Allah, the Exalted, and to all of you,

segments.transliteration: Fa-Ê¿alayk á¹£alawÄt AllÄh wa riá¸wÄnuh wa raá¸¥matuh.
segments.translation: So upon you be the blessings of Allah, His pleasure, and His mercy.

segments.arabic: أَنَا مُوَدِّعُكَ يَا مَوْلايَ وَابْنَ مَوْلايَ وَسَيِّدِي وَابْنَ سَيِّدِي ،
segments.transliteration: AnÄ muwaddiÊ¿uka yÄ mawlÄya wa ibn mawlÄya wa sayyidÄ« wa ibn sayyidÄ«,
segments.translation: I am bidding you farewell, O my master and son of my master and my lord and son of my lord,

segments.arabic: وَمُوَدِّعُكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَابْنَ سَيِّدِي يَا عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ ،
segments.transliteration: Wa muwaddiÊ¿uka yÄ sayyidÄ« wa ibn sayyidÄ« yÄ Ê¿AlÄ« ibn al-á¸¤usayn,
segments.translation: And I bid you farewell, O my lord and son of my lord, O Ê¿AlÄ« ibn al-á¸¤usayn,

segments.arabic: وَمُوَدِّعُكُمْ يَا سَادَاتِي يَا مَعْشَرَ الشُّهَدَاءِ ،
segments.transliteration: Wa muwaddiÊ¿ukum yÄ sÄdÄtÄ« yÄ maÊ¿shar ash-shuhadÄâ,
segments.translation: And I bid you farewell, O my lords, O group of martyrs,

segments.arabic: فَعَلَيْكُمْ سَلامُ اللّهِ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَبَركَاتُهُ وَرِضْوَانُهُ
segments.transliteration: Fa-Ê¿alaykum salÄm AllÄh wa raá¸¥matuh wa barakÄtuh wa riá¸wÄnuh
segments.translation: So upon you be the peace of Allah, His mercy, His blessings, and His pleasure.

segments.arabic:
نبراس الزائر في زيارة الحائر
تأليف: مهدي پور, علي اكبر
الناشر: مولود كعبه
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni sallaytu wa raka`tu wa sajadtu
segments.translation: O Allah, I have offered a prayer, genuflected, and prostrated myself
for Your sake purely without setting any partner with You
since all prayers, genuflection, and prostration
suit none except You.

segments.transliteration: li'annaka anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
segments.translation: Because You are Allah, there in n0 god save You.

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings on Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and convey to them my best greetings and compliments
and convey to me their replies.
O Allah, these two units of prayer
are present from me to my master
al-Husayn the son of `Ali, peace be upon both of them.
O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and on him,
accept my effort, and reward me for it
in the best rewarding that I anticipate and hope from You

segments.transliteration: wa fi waliyyika ya waliyya almu'minina
segments.translation: and from Your saint, O Guardian of the faithful!
Allah is verily the Most Great.
Very much thanks is due to Allah.

segments.transliteration: wa subhana allahi bukratan wa asilan
segments.translation: All praise be to Allah in morns and eves.
All praise is due to Allah Who has guided us to this

segments.transliteration: wa ma kunna linahtadiya lawla an hadana allahu
segments.translation: and we would not have found the way had it not been that Allah guided us.

segments.arabic: وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِيَ لَوْ لاَ أَنْ هَدَانَا ٱللَّهُ
segments.translation: Certainly, the apostles of our Lord brought the truth.
Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O seal of the prophets.
Peace be upon you, O chief of the Messengers.
Peace be upon you, O most beloved by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O commander of the faithful.
Peace be upon you, O chief of the Prophetsâ successors.
Peace be upon you, O leader of the white-forehead and white-footed ones (on the Day of Resurrection).

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا قَائِدَ ٱلْغُرِّ ٱلْمُحَجَّلِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of Fatimah
the doyenne of the women of this world.
Peace be upon you and upon the Imams from your progeny.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ ٱلأَئِمَّةِ مِنْ وُلْدِكَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O successor of the commander of the faithful.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَصِيَّ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O veracious and martyr.
Peace be upon you, O Angels of Allah
who reside in this holy shrine.
Peace be upon you, O my Lordâs Angels
who surround the tomb of al-Husayn, peace be upon him.
Peace be upon all of you forever

segments.transliteration: ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
segments.translation: as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.
Peace be upon you, O Abu-Abdullah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the commander of the faithful.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: I am your slave and son of your slave and bondmaid.
I confess of my servantship to you, acquit from being opposite to you,
accede to any one who accedes to you, and antagonize an yone who antagonizes you.
I direct towards your holy shrine, seek shelter with your (burial) place
and seeking nearness to you through directing to you.
O Messenger of Allah, may I enter?
O Prophet of Allah, may I enter?
O Commander of the faithful, may I enter?
O Chief of the prophetsâ successors, may I enter?

segments.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya fatimatu sayyidata nisa'i al`alamina
segments.translation: O Fatimah the doyenne of the women of the world, may I enter?

segments.arabic: أَأَدْخُلُ يَا فَاطِمَةُ سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
segments.translation: O my master Abu `Abdullah, may I enter?

segments.arabic: أَأَدْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mawlaya yabna rasuli allahi
segments.translation: O my master and son of the Messenger of Allah, may I enter?

segments.arabic: أَأَدْخُلُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: All praise is due to Allah the One, the Unique,
the Single, the Absolute,
Who has guided me to be loyal to you,
given me exclusively the chance to visit your tomb,
and made it easy for me to direct to you.
