segments.arabic:
السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَوَّلَ قَتِيلٍ مِنْ نَسْلِ خَيْرِ سَلِيلٍ مِنْ سُلَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْخَلِيلِ 
صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلَى أَبِيكَ 
إِذْ قَالَ فِيكَ قَتَلَ اللَّهُ قَوْماً قَتَلُوكَ 
يَا بُنَيَّ مَا أَجْرَأَهُمْ عَلَى الرَّحْمَنِ وَ عَلَى انْتِهَاكِ حُرْمَةِ الرَّسُولِ عَلَى الدُّنْيَا بَعْدَكَ الْعَفَاءِ كَأَنِّي بِكَ‌
بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مَاثِلًا وَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ قَائِلًا

أَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍ‌
		

نَحْنُ وَ بَيْتِ اللَّهِ أَوْلَى بِالنَّبِيِ‌

أَطْعَنُكُمْ بِالرُّمْحِ حَتَّى يَنْثَنِي‌
		

أَضْرِبُكُمْ بِالسَّيْفِ أَحْمِي عَنْ أَبِي‌

ضَرْبَ غُلَامٍ هَاشِمِيٍّ عَرَبِيٍ‌ 
وَ اللَّهِ لَا يَحْكُمُ فِينَا ابْنُ الدَّعِيِ‌ حَتَّى قَضَيْتَ نَحْبَكَ وَ لَقِيتَ رَبَّكَ 
أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَوْلَى بِاللَّهِ وَ بِرَسُولِهِ وَ أَنَّكَ ابْنُ رَسُولِهِ وَ حُجَّتُهُ وَ دِينُهُ وَ ابْنُ حُجَّتِهِ وَ أَمِينُهُ 
حَكَمَ اللَّهُ لَكَ عَلَى قَاتِلِكَ مُرَّةَ بْنِ مُنْقِذِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ الْعَبْدِيِّ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ وَ أَخْزَاهُ 
وَ مَنْ شَرِكَهُ فِي قَتْلِكَ وَ كَانُوا عَلَيْكَ ظَهِيراً أَصْلَاهُمُ اللَّهُ‌ جَهَنَّمَ وَ ساءَتْ مَصِيراً 
وَ جَعَلَنَا اللَّهُ مِنْ مُلَاقِيكَ [موافقيك‌] وَ مُرَافِقِيكَ وَ مُرَافِقِي جَدِّكَ وَ أَبِيكَ وَ عَمِّكَ وَ أَخِيكَ وَ أُمِّكَ الْمَظْلُومَةِ وَ أَبْرَأُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ أَعْدَائِكَ أُولِي الْجُحُودِ
 وَ أَبْرَأُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ قَاتِلِيكَ وَ أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ مُرَافَقَتَكَ فِي دَارِ الْخُلُودِ وَ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ الطِّفْلِ الرَّضِيعِ الْمَرْمِيِّ الصَّرِيعِ الْمُتَشَحِّطِ دَماً الْمُصَعَّدِ دَمُهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ الْمَذْبُوحِ بِالسَّهْمِ فِي حَجْرِ أَبِيهِ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ رَامِيَهُ حَرْمَلَةَ بْنَ كَاهِلٍ الْأَسَدِيَّ وَ ذَوِيهِ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مُبْلَى الْبَلَاءِ وَ الْمُنَادِي بِالْوَلَاءِ فِي عَرْصَةِ كَرْبَلَاءَ الْمَضْرُوبِ مُقْبِلًا وَ مُدْبِراً لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ هَانِيَ بْنَ ثُبَيْتٍ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى الْعَبَّاسِ [أَبِي الْفَضْلِ‌] بْنِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الْمَوَاسِي أَخَاهُ بِنَفْسِهِ الْآخِذِ لِغَدِهِ مِنْ أَمْسِهِ الْفَادِي لَهُ الْوَاقِي السَّاعِي إِلَيْهِ بِمَائِهِ الْمَقْطُوعَةِ يَدَاهُ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ [قَاتِلِيهِ‌] يَزِيدَ بْنَ الرُّقَادِ الحيتي [الْجُهَنِيَ‌] وَ حَكِيمَ بْنَ الطُّفَيْلِ الطَّائِيَّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الصَّابِرِ بِنَفْسِهِ مُحْتَسِباً وَ النَّائِي عَنِ الْأَوْطَانِ مُغْتَرِباً الْمُسْتَسْلِمِ لِلْقِتَالِ الْمُسْتَقْدِمِ لِلنِّزَالِ الْمَكْثُورِ بِالرِّجَالِ 
لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ هَانِيَ بْنَ ثُبَيْتٍ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ سَمِيِّ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ
 لَعَنَ اللَّهُ رَامِيَهُ بِالسَّهْمِ خَوْلِيَّ بْنَ يَزِيدَ الْأَصْبَحِيَّ الْأَيَادِيَّ [الْأَبَانِيَ‌] الدَّارِمِيَّ 
 السَّلَامُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَتِيلِ الْأَيَادِيِّ [الْأَبَانِيِ‌] الدَّارِمِيِّ
 لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ وَ ضَاعَفَ عَلَيْهِ الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ وَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِكَ الصَّابِرِينَ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الزَّكِيِّ الْوَلِيِّ الْمَرْمِيِّ بِالسَّهْمِ الرَّدِيِّ 
لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُقْبَةَ الْغَنَوِيَّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الزَّكِيِّ 
لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ وَ رَامِيَهُ حَرْمَلَةَ بْنَ كَاهِلٍ الْأَسَدِيَّ 

السَّلَامُ عَلَى الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْمَضْرُوبِ عَلَى هَامَتِهِ الْمَسْلُوبِ لَامَتُهُ حِينَ نَادَى الْحُسَيْنَ عَمَّهُ فَجَلَا عَلَيْهِ عَمُّهُ كَالصَّقْرِ وَ هُوَ يَفْحَصُ‌ بِرِجْلَيْهِ التُّرَابَ وَ الْحُسَيْنُ يَقُولُ بُعْداً لِقَوْمٍ قَتَلُوكَ وَ مَنْ خَصْمُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ جَدُّكَ وَ أَبُوكَ
 ثُمَّ قَالَ عَزَّ وَ اللَّهِ عَلَى عَمِّكَ أَنْ تَدْعُوَهُ فَلَا يُجِيبَكَ أَوْ أَنْ يُجِيبَكَ وَ أَنْتَ قَتِيلٌ جَدِيلٌ فَلَا يَنْفَعَكَ هَذَا 
 وَ اللَّهِ يَوْمٌ كَثُرَ وَاتِرُهُ وَ قَلَّ نَاصِرُهُ جَعَلَنِيَ اللَّهُ مَعَكُمَا يَوْمَ جَمَعَكُمَا وَ بَوَّأَنِي مُبَوَّأَكُمَا 
 وَ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَكَ عُمَرَ بْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ الْأَزْدِيَّ وَ أَصْلَاهُ جَحِيماً وَ أَعَدَّ لَهُ عَذَاباً أَلِيماً 
 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الطَّيَّارِ فِي الْجِنَانِ حَلِيفِ الْإِيمَانِ وَ مُنَازِلِ الْأَقْرَانِ النَّاصِحِ لِلرَّحْمَنِ التَّالِي لِلْمَثَانِي وَ الْقُرْآنِ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قُطْبَةَ [قطية] النَّبْهَانِيَّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الشَّاهِدِ مَكَانَ أَبِيهِ وَ التَّالِي لِأَخِيهِ وَ وَاقِيهِ بِبَدَنِهِ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ عَامِرَ بْنَ نَهْشَلٍ التَّمِيمِيَّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ وَ رَامِيَهُ بِشْرَ بْنَ خُوطٍ الْهَمْدَانِيَّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ وَ رَامِيَهُ عُمَرَ [عمير] بْنَ خَالِدِ بْنِ أَسَدٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى الْقَتِيلِ بْنِ الْقَتِيلِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ وَ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ عَامِرَ بْنَ صَعْصَعَةَ وَ قِيلَ أَسَدُ [أسيد] بْنُ مَالِكٍ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ [أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ‌] بْنِ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ وَ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ وَ رَامِيَهُ عمر [عَمْرَو] بْنَ صَبِيحٍ الصَّيْدَاوِيَّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ وَ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ لَقِيطَ بْنَ نَاشِرٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى سُلَيْمَانَ مَوْلَى الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَهُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ عَوْفٍ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى قَارِبٍ مَوْلَى الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى مُنْجِحٍ مَوْلَى الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى مُسْلِمِ بْنِ عَوْسَجَةَ الْأَسَدِيِّ الْقَائِلِ لِلْحُسَيْنِ وَ قَدْ أَذِنَ لَهُ فِي الِانْصِرَافِ أَ نَحْنُ نُخَلِّي عَنْكَ وَ بِمَ نَعْتَذِرُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَدَاءِ حَقِّكَ 
لَا وَ اللَّهِ حَتَّى أَكْسِرَ فِي صُدُورِهِمْ رُمْحِي هَذَا وَ أَضْرِبَهُمْ بِسَيْفِي مَا ثَبَتَ قَائِمُهُ فِي يَدِي وَ لَا أُفَارِقُكَ وَ لَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعِي سِلَاحٌ أُقَاتِلُهُمْ بِهِ لَقَذَفْتُهُمْ بِالْحِجَارَةِ
 وَ لَمْ أُفَارِقْكَ حَتَّى أَمُوتَ مَعَكَ وَ كُنْتَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ شَرَى نَفْسَهُ وَ أَوَّلَ شَهِيدٍ مِنْ شُهَدَاءِ اللَّهِ [شهد الله‌] وَ قَضَى نَحْبَهُ فَفُزْتَ بِرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ شَكَرَ اللَّهُ اسْتِقْدَامَكَ وَ مُوَاسَاتَكَ إِمَامَكَ إِذْ مَشَى إِلَيْكَ
 وَ أَنْتَ صَرِيعٌ فَقَالَ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ يَا مُسْلِمَ بْنَ عَوْسَجَةَ وَ قَرَأَ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَضى‌ نَحْبَهُ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ وَ ما بَدَّلُوا تَبْدِيلًا لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْمُشْتَرِكِينَ فِي قَتْلِكَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ الضَّبَابِيَّ وَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ خُشْكَارَةَ [خسكارة] الْبَجَلِيَّ [وَ مُسْلِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الضَّبَابِيَ‌] 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَنَفِيِّ الْقَائِلِ لِلْحُسَيْنِ ع وَ قَدْ أَذِنَ لَهُ فِي الِانْصِرَافِ لَا وَ اللَّهِ لَا نُخَلِّيكَ حَتَّى يَعْلَمَ‌ اللَّهُ أَنَّا قَدْ حَفِظْنَا غَيْبَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ص فِيكَ 
وَ اللَّهِ لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنِّي أُقْتَلُ ثُمَّ أُحْيَا ثُمَّ أُحْرَقُ ثُمَّ أُذْرَى وَ يُفْعَلُ بِي ذَلِكَ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً مَا فَارَقْتُكَ حَتَّى أَلْقَى حِمَامِي دُونَكَ وَ كَيْفَ لَا أَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ وَ إِنَّمَا هِيَ مَوْتَةٌ أَوْ قَتْلَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ ثُمَّ هِيَ بَعْدَهَا الْكَرَامَةُ الَّتِي لَا انْقِضَاءَ لَهَا أَبَداً فَقَدْ لَقِيتَ حِمَامَكَ وَ وَاسَيْتَ إِمَامَكَ وَ لَقِيتَ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْكَرَامَةَ فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ
 حَشَرَنَا اللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ فِي الْمُسْتَشْهَدِينَ وَ رَزَقَنَا مُرَافَقَتَكُمْ فِي أَعْلَى عِلِّيِّينَ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى بِشْرِ [سهد] بْنِ عُمَرَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ شَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ قَوْلَكَ [سعيك‌] لِلْحُسَيْنِ ع وَ قَدْ أَذِنَ لَكَ فِي الِانْصِرَافِ أَكَلَتْنِي إِذَنِ السِّبَاعُ حَيّاً إِنْ فَارَقْتُكَ وَ أَسْأَلُ عَنْكَ الرُّكْبَانَ وَ أَخْذُلُكَ مَعَ قِلَّةِ الْأَعْوَانِ لَا يَكُونُ هَذَا أَبَداً 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى يَزِيدَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ المشرفي [الْمَشْرِقِيِ‌] الْقَارِي الْمُجَدَّلِ بِالْمَشْرَفِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى نَعِيمِ بْنِ الْعَجْلَانِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى زُهَيْرِ بْنِ الْقَيْنِ الْبَجَلِيِّ الْقَائِلِ لِلْحُسَيْنِ ع وَ قَدْ أَذِنَ لَهُ فِي الِانْصِرَافِ لَا وَ اللَّهِ لَا يَكُونُ ذَلِكَ أَبَداً أَتْرُكُ ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أَسِيراً فِي يَدِ الْأَعْدَاءِ وَ أَنْجُو لَا أَرَانِي اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ قُرْطَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى حَبِيبِ بْنِ مُظَاهِرٍ الْأَسَدِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى الْحُرِّ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الرِّيَاحِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ الْكَلْبِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى نَافِعِ بْنِ هِلَالِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ الْبَجَلِيِّ الْمُرَادِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى أَنَسِ بْنِ كَاهِلٍ الْأَسَدِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ الصَّيْدَاوِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ابْنَيْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ حَرَّاقٍ الْغِفَارِيَّيْنِ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عون [جُونِ‌] بْنِ حَرِيٍّ مَوْلَى أَبِي ذَرٍّ الْغِفَارِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى شَبِيبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ النَّهْشَلِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى الْحَجَّاجِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ السَّعْدِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى قَاسِطٍ وَ كَرَشٍ [كردوس‌] ابْنَيْ زُهَيْرٍ [ظهر] التَّغْلِبِيَّيْنِ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى كِنَانَةَ بْنِ عَتِيقٍ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى ضَرْغَامَةَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى حُوَيِّ [جوين‌] بْنِ مَالِكٍ الضُّبَعِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ ضُبَيْعَةَ الضُّبَعِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ ثُبَيْتٍ الْقَيْسِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ابْنَيْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثبيط [ثُبَيْتٍ‌] الْقَيْسِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى عَامِرِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ

السَّلَامُ عَلَى زُهَيْرِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ الْخَثْعَمِيِّ

السَّلَامُ عَلَى الْحَجَّاجِ بْنَ مَسْرُوقٍ الْجُعْفِيِّ

السَّلَامُ عَلَى عَمَّارِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ الطَّائِيِّ

السَّلَامُ عَلَى عَابِسِ بْنِ شَبِيبٍ الشَّاكِرِيِّ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى شَوْذَبٍ مَوْلَى شَاكِرٍ 
السَّلَامُ عَلَى شَبِيبِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سَرِيعٍ

السَّلَامُ عَلَى الَمْرُتَّبِ مَعَهُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجُنْدُعِيِّ

السَّلَامُ‌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِما صَبَرْتُمْ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ بَوَّأَكُمُ اللَّهُ مُبَوَّأَ الْأَبْرَارِ

السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ.

text: Ziyarah Nahiya Salutation on Imam Hussain(as) by Imam Mahdi(ajtfs) Signifance of this ziyarah Signifance of this ziyarah × Introduction and Translation by: Vahid Majd Naba Organization ISBN: 964-8323-13-5, First Edition: 2004Email: [email protected] âBut as I have been hindered by the course of time, and (Allahâs) decree has prevented me from helping you, and as I could not fight those who fought you, and was not able to show hostility to those who showed hostility to you, I will, therefore, lament you morning and evening, and will weep blood in place of tears, out of my anguish for you and my sorrow for all that befell youâ¦â âImam al-Mahdi (PBUH) Of the several prescribed Ziyarat of Imam al-Husain (PBUH), one was recited by Imam al-Mahdi (PBUH) and reached us through one of his four special deputies. For that reason, it is known as the Ziyarat that was issued from the sacred side (Ziyarat al-Nahiya al-Muqaddasa).[1] One of the most important features of this Ziyarat is that in different phrases, Imam al-Mahdi (PBUH) graphically describes the events of Ashura and the agony that Imam al-Husain (PBUH) and his family faced on that horrific and ominous day. The text of the Ziyarat al-Nahiya is found in some early Ziyarat collections such as al-Mazar al-Kabir, by Muhammad Ibn Jaâfar al-Mashâhadi, pp. 496-513. It is also reported in al-Mazar, by al-Mufid as mentioned in Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 98, pp. 318-329. An overview of the Ziyarat al-Nahiya Since this Ziyarat (as reported in al-Mazar al-Kabir, by al-Mashâhadi) originated from an infallible Imam who is the tongue of Allah, it is replete with divine recognition, guidance, spirituality, knowledge of religion, lessons for humanity, and the historical facts. The method of presentation in this Ziyarat follows the formal method seen in other texts by Ahl al-Bait (PBUT). The text of this Ziyarat can be divided into the following ten major parts: 1- Offering peace and salutations to the Prophets (PBUT) (whose spiritual heir was Imam al-Husain (PBUH)), from the earliest ones up to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH&HF), and then his pure progeny (PBUT) in addition to describing some of their attributes. For instance, we recite: âPeace be upon Adam, the chosen one of Allah from among His creation ...â 2- Offering peace and salutations to the Chief of Martyrs (PBUH) and enumerating some of his spiritual qualities and divine titles: âPeace be upon al-Husain who sacrificed himself up to the last drops of the blood of his heart. Peace be upon him, who obeyed Allah secretly and openly... Peace be upon the son of the Garden of refuge. Peace be upon the son of Zamzam and al-Safaa. Peace be upon him who was saturated in (his) blood ...â 3- Sending salutations to the martyrs of Karbala, in general, who sacrificed their selves for the divine cause: âPeace be upon the bloodstained chests... Peace be upon the pallid bodies... Peace be upon the dismembered limbs. Peace be upon the heads raised upon lances ...â 4- Stating the motivations, wishes, and aims for visiting Imam al-Husain (PBUH): âPeace be upon you! Indeed, I intended your visitation and am hopeful of achieving the prosperity that is with you. Salutations to you, salutations from he who recognizes your sanctity, is a sincere (believer) in your guardianship, seeks nearness to Allah through your love, and is aloof from your enemies ...â 5- Bearing witness to the Imamâs exemplary way of conduct: âI bear witness that you certainly established prayer, gave alms, enjoined good, forbade evil and transgression, obeyed Allah, never disobeyed Him, held fast to Him and to His rope, pleased Him, and held Him in awe ...â 6- Explaining the Imamâs method of opposing evil: âwhen tyranny became wide-spread, injustice removed its veil, wickedness called upon its followers... the knowledge demanded you for disavowal (of falsehood), and made it incumbent on you to struggle against the deviant. Therefore, you set out in company of your children, kinsfolk, followers, and supporters, disclosed the truth and clear proofs, summoned people towards Allah with wisdom and fine exhortation ...â 7- Presenting some of the calamities and afflictions that befell the Imam, and describing his martyrdom and the capture of his family: âThe enemy then surrounded you from all sides, weakened you by inflicting wounds, while you did not have any helper left, and you were bereaved yet patient ...â 8- Enumerating the depth of the crime: âCertainly, by killing you, they have killed Islam, disrupted (the truth of) prayer and fasting, revoked the (prophetic) customs and the (divine) laws... Certainly, (by this event,) the Messenger of Allah (PBUH&HF) was wronged, left alone, and denied vengeance, the Book of Allah, the mighty and the majestic, was again abandoned ...â 9- Relating the mourning ceremonies of the Prophets, Angels, and the cosmos: âIndeed, the Messenger (PBUH&HF) became distressed and his depressed heart wept. The Angels and the Prophets offered their condolences to him for your martyrdom. Your mother, al-Zahra, became distressed and bereft of you. Legions of Angels came in waves to offer their condolences to your father, the Leader of the Faithful ...â 10- Praying to Allah and imploring Him: âO Allah! By the sanctity of this exalted place (the tomb of Imam al-Husain (PBUH)), bestow blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, assemble me in their company, and admit me to Paradise by their intercession ...â A blend of wisdom, cognizance, spirituality, ethics, elegy, enthusiasm, devotion, along with a detailed account of the events has made this divinely inspired Ziyarat, one of the most insightful Ziyarat of Imam al-Husain (PBUH) for the followers of Ahl al-Bait (PBUT). In what follows, the Arabic text alongside its English translation and transliteration of the original Ziyarat al-Nahiya as reported in al-Mazar al-Kabir, by Muhammad Ibn al-Mashâhadi, is presented. May Allah hasten the advent of Imam Mahdi (PBUH), the reviver of the religion of Allah, the avenger of the blood of the Chief of Martyrs (PBUH) from the oppressors, and the establisher of peace and justice over the globe. With request for prayers, Vahid J. Majd, 1 Dhul-Hijja 1424. Imam Mahdi (PBUH) said, âI pray for any believer who remembers the sufferings of my martyred grandfather, al-Husain (PBUH), and then prays for my relief (al-Faraj)â Mikyal al-Makarim fi Fawaâidi Dâuaa lil Qaâim, by Sayyid Muhammad Taqi Musawi al-Isfahani, vol. 2, p.75. Documentation of the Ziyarat The text of the Ziyarat al-Nahiya is found in some early Ziyarat collections such as al-Mazar al-Kabir, by Muhammad Ibn Jaâfar al-Mashâhadi, pp. 496-513. It is also reported in al-Mazar, by al-Mufid as mentioned in Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 98, pp. 318-329. It is noteworthy that Sayyid Ibn Tawus (d. 664 AH) in his Misbah al-Zaâir reports another Ziyarat, which has some common parts with Ziyarat al-Nahiya. However, this Ziyarat has not been attributed to the Imam (PBUH), and has been only ascribed to Sayyid Murtadha (d. 436 AH). As al-Majlisi mentioned in Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 98, p. 251, although these variations might have been due to different narrations, yet this Ziyarat is apparently the composition of Sayyid Murtadha (RA) who used a part of original Ziyarat al-Nahiya, made some changes to it, added some phrases from other Ziyarats, and used to recite it as his own Ziyarat. It should be noted that there is another Ziyarat known as al-Nahiya, which focuses on the Ziyarat of other martyrs of Karbala, specifying the names of the companions of Imam al-Husain (PBUH). However, as mentioned by al-Majlisi, the time mentioned in the documentation of the Hadith as the time of its release is four years before the time of the birth of Imam al-Mahdi (PBUH). Assuming that it was not a transcription error, that particular Ziyarat may have been transmitted by Imam Hasan al-Askari (PBUH) (Imam Mahdiâs father, the eleventh Imam), not Imam Mahdi (PBUH). In that case, al-Nahiya al-Muqaddasa (the sacred place) refers to the house of Imam Hasan al-Askari (PBUH) in Samarra. × . Arabic Transliteration Translation Ziarat Dua after salat Ziarat Martyrs Resources âBut as I have been hindered by the course of time, and (Allahâs) decree has prevented me from helping you, and as I could not fight those who fought you, and was not able to show hostility to those who showed hostility to you, I will, therefore, lament you morning and evening, and will weep blood in place of tears, out of my anguish for you and my sorrow for all that befell youâ¦â âImam al-Mahdi (ajtfs) Of the several prescribed Ziyarat of Imam al-Husain (as), one was recited by Imam al-Mahdi (PBUH) and reached us through one of his four special deputies. For that reason, it is known as al-Muqaddasa. One of the most important features of this Ziyarat is that in different phrases, Imam al-Mahdi (as) graphically describes the events of Ashura and the agony that Imam al-Husain (as) and his family faced on that horrific and ominous day. title: Salaat of Masomeen Duas.org

segments.translation: There is no god save Allah;
our Lord and the Lord of our fathers of old.
There is no god save Allah;

segments.transliteration: ilahan wahidan wa nahnu lahu muslimuna
segments.translation: one God, and to Him are we submissive.
There is no god save Allah;
we worship none save Him,
making our devotion sincere as in His sight
even though the polytheists may detest it.
There is no god save Allah;
alone, alone, alone,
He has truly fulfilled His promise,
granted His servant victory,
made powerful His soldiers,
and defeated the parties alone.
All sovereignty be His and all praise be to Him.
And He has power over all things.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ
segments.transliteration: allahumma anta nuru alssamawati wal-ardi wa man fihinna
segments.translation: O Allah, You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and whatever is in these two.
So, all praise be to You.

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ قَيَّامُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فيهِنَّ
segments.transliteration: wa anta qayyamu alssamawati wal-ardi wa man fihinna
segments.translation: And You are the Fashioner of the heavens and the earth and whatever exists in these two.
So, all praise be to You.
You are the (utter) Truth,
Your promise is utterly true,
Your word is true,
Your fulfillment is true,
Paradise is true,
and Hellfire is true.
O Allah, to You have I surrendered,
in You do I believe,
on You do I rely,
for Your sake do I dispute,
and Your judgment do I seek.

segments.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا ربِّ
segments.transliteration: ya rabbi ya rabbi ya rabbi
segments.translation: O my Lord; O my Lord; O my Lord;

segments.transliteration: ighfir li ma qaddamtu wa akhkhartu
segments.translation: (please) forgive me my past and next sins
and my hidden and open ones.

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ إِلٰهِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
segments.transliteration: anta ilahi la ilaha illa anta
segments.translation: You are verily my God; there is no god save You.
Send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
forgive me,
have mercy on me,
and accept my repentance.
Verily, You are the Oft-Returning, the Most Merciful.
Glory be to the Lord of Honor and Sublime Authority.
Glory be to the Lord of Majesty and Exalted Greatness.
Glory be to the Lord of eternal, splendid sovereignty.
Glory be to Him Who dressed Himself with splendor and beauty.
Glory be to Him Who is clad in light and dignity.

segments.arabic: سُبحَانَ مَنْ يَرَىٰ أَثَرَ ٱلَّنمْلِ فِي ٱلصَّفَا
segments.transliteration: subhana man yara athara alnnamli fi alssafa
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who makes out the footprints of the ant on the stone.

segments.arabic: سُبحَانَ مَنْ يَرَىٰ وَقْعَ ٱلطَّيْرِ فِِي ٱلْهَوَاءِ
segments.transliteration: subhana man yara waq`a alttayri fi alhawa'i
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who knows (the exact time and place of) the bird dipping down through the air.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ هٰكَذَا لاَ هٰكَذَا غَيْرُهُ
segments.transliteration: subhana man huwa hakadha la hakadha ghayruhu
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who is like this and no one (other than Him) is like this.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَيْسَ غَيْرَهُ رُبٌّ يُدْعَىٰ
segments.transliteration: ya man laysa ghayrahu rabbun yud`a
segments.translation: O He besides Whom there is no lord to be supplicated!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَيْسَ فَوْقَهُ إِلٰهٌ يُخْشَىٰ
segments.transliteration: ya man laysa fawqahu ilahun yukhsha
segments.translation: O He above Whom there is no god to be feared!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَيْسَ دُونَهُ مَلِكٌ يُتَّقَىٰ
segments.transliteration: ya man laysa dunahu malikun yuttaqa
segments.translation: O He except Whom there is no master to be revered!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَيْسَ لَهُ وَزِيْرٌ يُؤْتَىٰ
segments.transliteration: ya man laysa lahu wazirun yu'ta
segments.translation: O He Who has no counselor to be approached!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَيْسَ لَهُ حَاجِبٌ يُرْشَىٰ
segments.transliteration: ya man laysa lahu hajibun yursha
segments.translation: O He Who has no attendant to be bribed!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَيْسَ لَهُ بَوَّابٌ يُغْشَىٰ
segments.transliteration: ya man laysa lahu bawwabun yughsha
segments.translation: O He Who has no doorkeeper to be visited (secretly)!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَزْدَادُ عَلَىٰ كَثْرَةِ ٱلسُّؤَالِ إِلاَّ كَرَماً وَجُوداً
segments.transliteration: ya man la yazdadu `ala kathrati alssu'ali illa karaman wa judan
segments.translation: O He Who gives not but generously and liberally no matter how many the demands are

segments.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ كَثْرَةِ ٱلذُّنُوبِ إِلاَّ عَفْواً وَصَفْحاً
segments.transliteration: wa `ala kathrati aldhdhunubi illa `afwan wa safhan
segments.translation: and deals not with numerous sins but mercifully and kindly!
Send blessings upon Muhammad and his Householdâ¦
O My God and Master,
whilst one prepares oneself, sets up,
arranges, or gets ready
for visiting a mortal
in the hope of attaining a gift, interests,

segments.transliteration: wa na'ilihi wa fawadilihi wa jawa'izihi
segments.translation: a souvenir, bequests, or presents from him,

segments.transliteration: fa-ilayka ya ilahi kanat tahyi'ati wa ta`bi'ati
segments.translation: to You, O my God, have I prepared myself, set up,
arranged and got ready
in the hope of attaining Your interests, favors,
souvenirs, and presents.
Hence, (please) do not disappoint me of all these.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ تَخِيبُ عَلَيْهِ مَسْأَلَةُ ٱلسَّائِلِ
segments.transliteration: ya man la takhibu `alayhi mas'alatu alssa'ili
segments.translation: O You with Whom no asker is disappointed
and no present of an earner causes You reduction.

segments.arabic: فَإنِّي لَمْ آتِكَ بعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ قَدَّمْتُهُ
segments.transliteration: fa'inni lam atika bi`amalin salihin qaddamtuhu
segments.translation: In fact, I have not come to You with a righteous deed that I have done
nor with an intercession of a creature that I hope
to seek Your nearness through him
save Muhammad and his Household,
Your blessings be upon him and them.
I am coming to You hoping for Your munificent amnesty
that You have conferred upon the sinners
who confined themselves to the commitment to forbidden acts;

segments.arabic: فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلَىٰ ٱلْمَحَارِمِ
segments.translation: nevertheless, their long-lasting commitment to forbidden acts has not made You
stop conferring upon them with Your forgiveness.
You, O my Master, always confer upon me with Your graces
while I always recommit sins.

segments.transliteration: as'aluka bihaqqi muhammadin wa alihi alttahirina
segments.translation: I thus ask You by the Right of Muhammad and his Household, the Immaculate,
to forgive my grand sins,

segments.arabic: فَإنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلْعَظِيمَ إِلاَّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
segments.transliteration: fa'innahu la yaghfiru al`azima illa al`azimu
segments.translation: for none forgives the grand sins but the All-great.

segments.arabic: يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَظِيمُ
segments.translation: O All-great, O All-great, O All-great,

segments.arabic: يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَظِيمُ
segments.translation: O All-great, O All-great, O All-great,
O All-great!
Glory be to Him Whose signs never perish.
Glory be to Him Whose reserves never downgrade.
Glory be to Him Whose honor never vanishes.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لاَ يَنْفَدُ مَا عِنْدَهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Whose possessions never run out.
Glory be to Him Whose duration (of existence) is never interrupted.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لاَ يُشَارِكُ أَحَداً فِي أَمْرِهِ
segments.transliteration: subhana man la yushariku ahadan fi amrihi
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who never betakes to Himself a partner in His affairs.
Glory be to Him save Whom there is no god.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ عَفَا عَنِ ٱلسَّيِئَاتِ وَلَمْ يُجَازِ بِهَا
segments.transliteration: ya man `afa `ani alssayyi'ati wa lam yujazi biha
segments.translation: O He who overlooks sins and does not inflict punishment in return,
(please) have mercy on Your servant, O Allah,
that is I myself, that is I myself.
I am Your servant, O my Chief,

segments.arabic: أَنَا عَبْدُكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ يَا رَبَّاهُ
segments.translation: I am Your servant; I am at Your disposal; O my Lord.
O my God, in the name of Your Being, O my Hope,
O my All-beneficent, O my Supporter,
Your servant, Your servant, has no strategy.
O Ultimate of my desire!

segments.arabic: يَا مُجْرِيَ ٱلدَّمِ فِي عُرُوقِ عَبْدِكَ
segments.translation: O He Who makes blood run into the veins of Your slave!
O my Chief, O my Master!

segments.arabic: أَيَا هُوَ أَيَا هُوَ يَا رَبَّاهُ
segments.transliteration: aya huwa aya huwa ya rabbahu
segments.translation: O He Who is Unique! O He Who is Unique! O my Lord!
IâYour servant, Your servantâ

segments.arabic: لاَ حِيلَةَ لِي وَلاَ غِنىٰ بِي عَنْ نَفسِْي
segments.transliteration: la hilata li wa la ghinan bi `an nafsi
segments.translation: have no strategy and I cannot avail myself

segments.arabic: وَلاَ أَسْتَطِيعُ لَهَا ضَرّاً وَلاَ نَفْعاً
segments.transliteration: wa la astati`u laha darran wa la naf`an
segments.translation: and I have no control over loss or over profit.
I do not find anyone from whom I may seek help;
so, all profitable avenues have been blocked,
and all my expectations have turned into disappointments.
Helpless and forsaken I came to You,
So, I have presented myself before You in this current stand.

segments.arabic: يَا إِلٰهِي بِعِلْمِكَ كَانَ هٰذَا كُلُّهُ
segments.transliteration: ya ilahi bi`ilmika kana hadha kulluhu
segments.translation: O my God, You are aware of all that which I speak about.
So, how would You deal with me?

segments.transliteration: wa layta shi`ri kayfa taqulu lidu`a'i
segments.translation: If I but knew how would You dispense with my prayer?
Would You say, âYesâ or âNoâ?

segments.arabic: فَإِنْ قُلْتَ لاَ فَيَا وَيْلِي يَا وَيْلِي يَا ويْلِي
segments.transliteration: fa-in qulta la fayawayli yawayli yawayli
segments.translation: If You say âNo,â then I am ruined! I am ruined! I am ruined!

segments.arabic: يَا عَوْلِي يَا عَوْلِي يَا عَوْلِي
segments.translation: Woe to me! Woe to me! Woe to me!

segments.arabic: يَا شِقْوَتِي يَا شِقْوَتِي يَا شِقْوَتِي
segments.transliteration: ya shiqwati ya shiqwati ya shiqwati
segments.translation: Oh my misery! Oh my misery! Oh my misery!

segments.arabic: يَا ذُلّي يَا ذُلِّي يَا ذُلِّي
segments.transliteration: ya dhulli ya dhulli ya dhulli
segments.translation: Oh my ill-luck! Oh my ill-luck! Oh my ill-luck!
To whom? By Whom?

segments.arabic: أَوْ عِنْدَ مَنْ أَوْ كَيْفَ أَوْ مَاذَا
segments.transliteration: aw `inda man aw kayfa aw madha
segments.translation: From whom? How? What?
In which place to take shelter?
For whom shall I hope?

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ يَجُودُ عَلَيَّ بِفَضْلِهِ حِينِ تَرْفُضُنِي
segments.transliteration: wa man yajudu `alayya bifadlihi hina tarfuduni
segments.translation: Who shall bestow upon me with his favor when You forsake me?
O Liberal in forgiveness!

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ قُلْتَ نَعَمْ كَمَا هُوَ ٱلظَّنُّ بِكَ وَٱلرَّجَاءُ لَكَ
segments.transliteration: wa in qulta na`am kama huwa alzzannu bika walrraja'u laka
segments.translation: But if You say âYes,â as I expect You to say and as I desire from You,

segments.arabic: فَطُوبَىٰ لِي أَنَا ٱلسَّعيدُ وَأَنَا ٱلْمَسْعُودُ
segments.transliteration: fatuba li ana alssa`idu wa ana almas`udu
segments.translation: then joy is for me, I am successful, I am happy;
then joy is for me, I will receive (Your) mercy.
O Ever-merciful! O Ever-compassionate!
O Ever-sympathetic! O Ever-commiserating!
O Ever-sovereign! O Just!

segments.arabic: لاَ عَمَلَ لِي أَبْلُغُ بِهِ نَجَاحَ حَاجَتِي
segments.transliteration: la `amala li ablughu bihi najaha hajati
segments.translation: I lack any act due to which I can attain achievement of my desire.

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلْتَهُ فِي مَكْنُونِ غَيْبِكَ
segments.transliteration: as'aluka bismika alladhi ja`altahu fi maknuni ghaybika
segments.translation: I thus beseech You in the name of Your Name which You have reserved in the innermost of Your Hidden Knowledge

segments.arabic: وَٱسْتَقَرَّ عِنْدَكَ فَلاَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْكَ إِلىٰ شَيْءٍ سِوَاكَ
segments.transliteration: wastaqarra `indaka fala yakhruju minka ila shay'in siwaka
segments.translation: and it has thus settled with You so firmly that nothing of it can come out from You to any other thing.

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِهِ وَبِكَ فَإنَّهُ أَجَلُّ وَأَشْرَفُ أَسْمَائِكَ
segments.transliteration: as'aluka bihi wa bika fa'innahu ajallu wa ashrafu asma'ika
segments.translation: I beseech You by it and by You, for it is certainly the most exalted and honored of Your Names.
I have nothing to mention except this,
and no one can be more beneficent to me than You.
O Absolute Being! O Creator of creation!
O He Who has introduced Himself to me!
O He Who has commanded me to obey Him!
O He Who has warned me against disobeying Him!
O He Who is besought! O He Who is pleaded!
O He Who is desired!

segments.arabic: رَفَضْتُ وَصِيَّتَكَ ٱلَّتِي أَوْصَيْتَنِي وَلَمْ أُطِعْكَ
segments.transliteration: rafadtu wasiyyataka allati awsaytani wa lam uti`ka
segments.translation: I have overlooked Your instructions, which You gave me and have not obeyed You.

segments.arabic: وَلَوْ أَطَعْتُكَ فِيمَا أَمَرْتَنِي لَكَفَيْتَنِي مَا قُمْتُ إِلَيْكَ فيهِ
segments.transliteration: wa law ata`tuka fima amartani lakafaytani ma qumtu ilayka fihi
segments.translation: If I obeyed You in what You have ordered me, You would certainly grant my requests that I am presenting before You.

segments.transliteration: wa ana ma`a ma`siyati laka rajin
segments.translation: In spite of my transgression, I am hopeful for You.

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَحُلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ مَا رَجَوْتُ
segments.transliteration: fala tahul bayni wa bayna ma rajawtu
segments.translation: So, do not let my hope remain unfulfilled.

segments.arabic: يَا مُتَرَحِّماً لِي أَعِذْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْقِي
segments.transliteration: ya mutarahhiman li a`idhni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi
segments.translation: O He Who always has mercy upon me, keep me safe, under Your protection, from (all evils that are) before me, behind me,

segments.transliteration: wa min fawqi wa min tahti
segments.translation: above me, below me,

segments.transliteration: wa min kulli jihati al-ihatati bi
segments.translation: and from all sides that surround me.
O Allah, [I beseech You] in the name of Muhammad, my master,
and [in the name of] `Ali, my chief,
and [in the names of] the orthodox Imams (leaders), peace be upon them,

segments.transliteration: ij`al `alayna salawatika wa ra'fataka wa rahmataka
segments.translation: (please) bestow upon us with Your blessings, compassions, and mercy;
and grant us expansive shares of Your sustenance;
and help us repay our debts and settle all our needs,

segments.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: ya allahu ya allahu ya allahu
segments.translation: O Allah, O Allah, O Allah.
Verily, You have full power over all things.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلنَّبِيِّ ٱلْعَرَبِيِّ وَآلِهِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala alnnabiyyi al`arabiyyi wa alihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to the Arab Prophet and on his Household.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni ataqarrabu ilayka bijudika wa karamika
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek nearness to You in the name of Your magnanimity and nobility.

segments.transliteration: wa ataqarrabu ilayka bimuhammadin `abdika wa rasulika
segments.translation: I seek nearness to You in the name of Muhammad, Your servant and messenger.
I seek nearness to You in the name of Your Favorite Angels
and Your prophets and messengers,
[and I beseech You] to send blessings to Muhammad,
Your servant and messenger,
and upon the Household of Muhammad,
overlook my slips,
cover my sins,
forgive them for me,
settle all my needs,

segments.transliteration: wa la tu`adhdhibni biqabihin kana minni
segments.translation: and not to punish me for the evildoings that I have committed.
Verily, Your pardon and magnanimity include me.
Verily, You have power over all things.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الَّذِي ٱسْتَجَبْتَ لآِدَمَ وَحَوَّاءَ…
segments.transliteration: allahumma anta alladhi istajabta li-adama wa hawwa'aâ¦
segments.translation: O Allah, it is You who responded to Adam and Eveâ¦
O He Who has shown only goodness
and concealed the evil (deeds of His servants)!
O He Who has not censured for the offenses
and has not exposed the hidden!
O He Who is Ample in pardoning!
O He Who is Excellent in overlooking!
O He Who is Liberal in forgiving!
O He Who opens His hands wide with mercy!
O He Who is present in all confidential talks!
O He Who is the ultimate objective of all complaints!
O He Who is Generous in condonation!
O He Who is greatly hoped!
O He Who takes the initiative in favoring before they are deserved!

segments.transliteration: ya rabbana wa sayyidana wa mawlana
segments.translation: O our Lord, our Master, and our Chief!
O He Who is the ultimate of our desires!

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ ٱللَّهُمَّ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: as'aluka allahumma an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: I beseech You, O Allah, to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
All glory be to Allah,
all praise be to Allah,
there is no god save Allah,
and Allah is the Greatest.
O Allah, I beseech You,
O Indulgent, Forbearing,
Forgiving, and Loving-kind,

segments.arabic: أَنْ تَتَجَاوَزَ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِي وَمَا عِنْدِي
segments.translation: to overlook my sins and what I have had,
out of the excellence of what You have,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ تُعْطِيَنِي مِنْ عَطَائِكَ مَا يَسَعُنِي
segments.transliteration: wa an tu`tiyani min `ata'ika ma yasa`uni
segments.translation: to give me, out of Your giving, that which suffices me,

segments.transliteration: wa tulhimani fima a`taytani al`amala fihi
segments.translation: to inspire me to act upon what You have given me;
that is to obey You and to obey Your Messenger,
and to give me part of Your pardon
so much so that I ought to have Your honoring.
O Allah, (please) grant me that which befits You

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَفْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: wa la taf`al bi ma ana ahluhu
segments.translation: and do not do to me that which I deserve.
Verily, I exist through You

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ أُصِبْ خَيْراً قَطُّ إِلاَّ مِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: wa lam usib khayran qattu illa minka
segments.translation: and I have never been given any good thing from any source except You.
O He Who is the best Seer of all those who can see!
O He Who is the best Hearer of all those who can hear!
O He Who is the Justest of all those who judge!
O He Who aids those who seek His aid!
O He Who responds to the prayer of the oppressed!
Send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
O He Who Makes all made things!
O He Who splints all broken bones!
O He Who is present in all assemblages!
O He Who is the Witness of all confidential talks!
O He Who knows all hidden matters!
O He Who is always present and is never absent!
O He Who is always triumphant and is never defeated!
O He Who is always nigh and is never remote!
O He Who entertains all lonely ones!
O He Who is ever-living, raiser of the dead,
and causing the alive to die!

segments.arabic: ٱلْقَائِمُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ
segments.translation: O He Who watches every soul as to what it earns!

segments.transliteration: wa ya hayyan hina la hayya
segments.translation: O He Who was living when there was nothing existent!
There is no god save You!
(please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
O my God, all sounds are submissive to You,
all intellects are too short to recognize You [as exactly as You are],
all things are fearful of You,
all things flee to You,
all things are too tiny in comparison with You,
and Your light fills all things.
Therefore, You are the Exalted in Your majesty,
You are the Luminous in Your splendor,
You are the Great in Your omnipotence,

segments.transliteration: wa anta alladhi la ya'uduka shay'un
segments.translation: and You are Whom nothing can tire.
O He Who sends down my bounties!
O He Who relieves my agonies!
O He Who settles my needs!
(please) Give answer to my request,
in the name of âThere is no god save Youâ.
I believe in You and I am sincere to You in obedience.

segments.arabic: أَصْبَحْتُ عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ
segments.translation: I begin my day keeping my covenant and promise to You as much as I can.
I confess of Your favor to me

segments.arabic: وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِنَ ٱلذُّنُوبِ الَّتِي لاَ يَغْفِرُهَا غَيْرُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa astaghfiruka mina aldhdhunubi allati la yaghfiruha ghayruka
segments.translation: and I beseech You to forgive my sins that none else can forgive.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ فِي عُلُوِّهِ دَانٍ
segments.translation: O He Who is nigh in His sublimity,
Sublime in His nearness,
Brilliant in His glow,
and Powerful in His [absolute] authority!
(please) Send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household.
O My Companion in my distress!
O My Patron in my bounties!

segments.transliteration: wa ya ilahi wa ilaha ibrahima wa isma`ila
segments.translation: O My God and the God of Abraham, Ishmael,
Isaac, and Jacob!

segments.arabic: يَا رَبَّ كٰهٰيٰعصٰ وَيٰس وَٱلْقُرْآنِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
segments.transliteration: ya rabba kaf-ha'-ya'-`ayn-sad wa ya-sin walqur'ani alhakimi
segments.translation: O Lord of kaf-ha'-ya'-`ayn-sad, ya'-sin, and the Qur'an full of wisdom!
I beseech YouâO Most Excellent of all those who may be besought!
O Most Favorite of all those who may be prayed!
O Most Magnanimous of all those who may give!
O Most Preferred of all those who may be hoped!

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: I beseech You to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
O Allah, Lord of the souls passing away
and the rotten corpses!

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِطَاعَةِ ٱلأَرْوَاحِ ٱلرَّاجِعَةِ إِلَىٰ أَجْسَادِهَا
segments.transliteration: as'aluka bita`ati al-arwahi alrraji`ati ila ajsadiha
segments.translation: I beseech You in the name of the obedience of the souls that are restored to their bodies
and the obedience of the corpses that join their veins
and in the name of Your Word that is effective on them
and in the name of Your judging justly among them;
while the [other] creatures are standing before You
awaiting the decisions of Your judgment,
hoping for Your mercy, and fearing Your punishment;
(please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
place light in my sight,
strong belief in my heart,
and reference to You night and day on my tongue,
and provide me with a righteous deed.
O Foremost Beneficent! O Object of Love!
O He Who is the Witness of all unseen things!
O He Who is Nigh without being away (from any other thing)!
O He Who (always) prevails (but) is never overpowered!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَعْلَمُ كَيْفَ هُوَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
segments.transliteration: wa ya man la ya`lamu kayfa huwa illa huwa
segments.translation: O He Whom no one knows how He is except He!
O He Whose authority no one can challenge!
I beseech You, O Allah, in Your name: the Well-Guarded, the Treasured,
the Concealed from whom You will,
the Pure, the Purified, the Holy,
the utter Light,
the Ever-living, the Everlasting, the Greatest,
the Light of the heavens and the Light of the [layers of the] earth,
the Knower of the unseen and the seen
the Highest, the Sublime, the Glorious!
Send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bi-anna laka alhamda
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of all praise being to You;
there is no god save You,
[You are] the Premier before all things;
and You are the Ever-living, the Self-Subsistent;
and there is no god save You,
nothing can humiliate You;

segments.transliteration: wa anta kulla yawmin fi sha'nin
segments.translation: and You, every moment, are in a state (of glory).
There is no god save You,

segments.arabic: خَالِقُ مَا يُرَىٰ وَمَا لاَ يُرَىٰ
segments.transliteration: khaliqu ma yura wa ma la yura
segments.translation: the Creator of what is seen and what cannot be seen,
the Knower of all things without learning;
I beseech You in the name of Your bounties and gratuities
and in the name of Your being Allah, the One Lord,
there is no god save You,
the All-beneficent, the All-merciful;
and I beseech You in the name of Your being Allah;
there is no god save You,
the Unique, the Single,
the One, and the eternally Besought of all,

segments.transliteration: alladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad
segments.translation: Who begets not, nor is he begotten,

segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahadun
segments.translation: and none is like Him.
And I beseech You in the name of Your being Allah,
there is no god save You;
the Knower of subtleties, the All-aware,

segments.arabic: ٱلْقَائِمُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ
segments.translation: Who watches every soul as to what it earns,
the Watcher, the Preserver.
And I beseech You in the name of Your being Allah,
the First before all things,
the Last after all things,
the Knower of all hidden things,
the source of both harm [for those who deserve harm] and benefit,
the All-wise, and All-knowing.
And I beseech You in the name of Your being Allah,
there is no god save You,
the Ever-living, the Self-Subsistent,
the Resurrector, the Inheritor,
the All-tender, the All-favorer,
the Fashioner of the heavens and the earth,
the Lord of majesty and honor,

segments.arabic: وَذُو ٱلطَّوْلِ وَذُو ٱلْعِزَّةِ وَذُو ٱلسُّلْطَانِ
segments.transliteration: wa dhulttawli wa dhul`izzati wa dhulssultani
segments.translation: and the Lord of bounty, dignity, and absolute authority.
There is no god save You;
You encompass all things with knowledge,
and You record the number of all things;
(please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
You do we worship, and Yours aid we seek.
O Allah, unbearable is our tribulation!
The hidden has been disclosed!
The cover has been exposed!

segments.transliteration: wa daqat al-ardu bima wasa`at alssama'u
segments.translation: The earth has become too narrow to carry that which could be embraced by the sky.
To You, my Lord, is the complaint
and in You is the trust in sorrow and in joy.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
whom You have commanded us to obey,
and hasten their Relief through the Rising Imam among them;
and make manifest Your fortifying him.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Save me, for you both are true saviors of me.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Aid me, for you both are true aides of me.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Protect me, for you both are true protectors of me.
O my master, the Patron of the Age!
O my master, the Patron of the Age!
O my master, the Patron of the Age!
Help, help, help!
[come to] succor me, [come to] succor me, [come to] succor me!
[grant me] security, [grant me] security, [grant me] security!

text: Salaat of Masoomeen Recited on Friday and other days . Dua Resources Arabic Transliteration Translation Holy Prophet(saws) Lady Fatima (sa) 1st Imam 2nd Imam 3rd Imam 4th Imam 5th Imam 6th Imam 7th Imam 8th Imam 9th Imam 10th Imam 11th Imam 12th Imam Salaat of Masoomeen -Prayers on Fridays Excluding the Friday Supererogatory Prayer (Nafilat al-Jumu`ah), many other optional prayers are reported to be offered on Fridays. Although the majority of these prayers are not dedicated to Fridays, it is highly recommended to offer them on Fridays. The Holy Prophetâs (saw)Prayer Sayyid Ibn Tawus, may Allah have mercy on him, has narrated, through an authenticated chain of authority, that when he was asked about Ja`far al-Tayyarâs Prayer, Imam al-Rida (`a) said, âHave you known about the Holy Prophetâs Prayer? Perhaps, the Holy Prophet (s) had never offered Ja`far al-Tayyarâs Prayer and Ja`far al-Tayyar had never offered the Holy Prophetâs Prayer.â When the asker asked him to teach him that prayer, Imam al-Rida (`a) said, Offer a two-unit prayer reciting in each unit Surah al-Fatihah (No. 1) once and Surah al-Qadr (No. 97) fifteen times. When you come to the Ruku` (genuflection), repeat it (i.e. Surah al-Qadr) fifteen times; when you raise your body after the Ruku`, recite it fifteen times; when you do the Sujud (prostration), repeat it fifteen times; when you raise your head from the Sujud, repeat it fifteen times; when you do the second prostration, repeat it fifteen times; and when you raise your head from the second prostration, repeat it fifteen times. When you finish your prayer, you will have all your sins forgiven by Almighty Allah and you will have all your requests granted for you.
