title: Lady Zainab Binte Ali Ibn Abu Talib

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ سَيِّدِ الأَنْبِياءِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the leader of the Prophets.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ صَاحِبِ الحَوْضِ وَاللِّوَاءِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the owner of the (Heavenly) Pond and the Standard.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مَنْ عُرِجَ بِهِ إلى السَّمَاءِ وَوَصَلَ إلى مَقَامِ قَابِ قَوْسَينِ أوْ أدْنى
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo A'layke Yaa Binta Muhammadenil Mustafa
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of him who was taken to the skies and who reached the position of the length of two arrows or even closer.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ نَبِيِّ الهُدَى وَسَيِّدِ الوَرَى وَمُنْقِذِ العِبَادِ مِنَ الرَّدَى
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Prophet of right guidance, the master of (all) human beings, and the savior of the servants (of Allah) from being destroyed.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ صَاحِبِ الخُلُقِ العَظِيمِ وَالشَّرَفِ العَمِيمِ وَالآيَاتِ وَالذِّكْرِ الحَكِيمِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo A'layke Yaa Binta A'liyyenil Murtaza Sayyedilawseyaae Wassiddeeqeena
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the one who has conformed (himself) to sublime morality, enjoyed the broad honor, and owned the (Heavenly) Signs and the Wise Remembrance of Allah (i.e. the Holy Quran).

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ صَاحِبِ المَقَامِ المحْمُودِ وَالحَوضِ المَورُودِ وَاللِّوَاءِ المَشْهودِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo A'layke Yaa Binta Fatematuz Zahrae Sayyedate Nesaail Aalameena
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the owner of the Lofty Position, the Pond from which people shall drink (on the Resurrection Day), and the Standard, which shall be witnessed by everybody.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مَنْهَجِ دِينِ الإسْلامِ وَصَاحِبِ القِبْلَةِ وَالقُرْآنِ وَعَلَمِ الصِّدْقِ وَالحَقِّ وَالإحْسَانِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo A'layke Yaa Ukhtal Hasane Walhusayne Sayyeday Shabaabe Ahlil Jannate Ajmae'ena
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Path of Islam and the one given the qiblah and the Quran, and the example of honesty, right, and benevolence.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ صَفْوَةِ الأَنْبِياءِ وَعَلَمِ الأتْقِياءِ وَمَشْهورِ الذِّكْرِ في الأرْضِ وَالسَّماءِ، وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
segments.translation: Peace and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be upon you, O daughter of the choice of the Prophets, the example of the pious ones, and the well known in both the earth and the heavens.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ خَيْرِ خَلقِ اللهِ وَسَيِّدِ خَلْقِهِ وَأَوَّلِ العَدَدِ قَبْلَ إيجَادِ أَرْضِهِ وَسَماوَاتِهِ وَآخِرِ الأَبَدِ بَعْدَ فَناءِ الدُّنْيا وَأَهْلِهَا الَّذِي رُوحُهُ نُسْخَةُ اللاَّهُوتِ وَصُورَتُهُ نُسْخَةُ المُلْكِ وَالمَلَكُوتِ وَقَلْبُهُ خُزانَةُ الحَيِّ الَّذِي لا يمُوتُ، وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
segments.translation: Peace and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be upon you, O daughter of the best of Allah's creation, the master of His creatures, the foremost created individual before the existence of (Allah's) earth and heavens, the last of the existent ones (who shall endure) after the extinction of this world and its beings, and the one whose soul is a copy of the Divinity and whose heart is the treasury of the Eternal, Subsistent God.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ المُظَلَّلِ بِالغَمَامِ سَيِّدِ الكَوْنَيْنِ وَمَوْلى الثَّقَلَينِ وَشَفِيعِ الأُمَّةِ يَومَ المحْشَرِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
segments.translation: Peace and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be upon you, O daughter of the one who is shaded by clouds, is the master of the Two Worlds, is the chief of the two beings (i.e. man and jinn), and is the Intercessor of the ummah on the Resurrection Day.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ سَيِّدِ الأَوْصِياءِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the master of the Prophets' successors.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ إمَامِ الأتْقِياءِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo A'layke Ayyatohal A'alematul Ghairul Moa'llamate
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the leader of the God-fearing ones.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رُكْنِ الأوْلِيَاءِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo A'layke Ayyatohal Fahimatul Ghairul Mofahhamate
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the shelter of the saints.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ عِمَادِ الأصْفِيَاءِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the support of the choice ones.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ يَعْسوبِ الدِّينِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the leader of the Religion.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ أَمِيرِ المُؤمِنِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the commander of the faithful ones.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ سَيِّدِ الوَصِيِّينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the chief of the Prophets' successors.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ قَائِدِ البرَرَةِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the leader of the pious ones.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ قَامِعِ الكَفَرَةِ وَالفجَرَةِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the preventer of the infidels and the wantons.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ وَارِثِ النَّبِيِّينَ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo A'layke Ayyatoha Saahebatul Mosibatil Uzmaa
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the inheritor of the Prophets.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بنتَ خَلِيفَةِ سَيِّدِ المُرسَلِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the successor of the Apostles' chief.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ ضِياءِ الدِّينِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of brightness of the Religion.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ النَّبَأِ العَظِيمِ عَلى اليَقِينِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Great News (as it is certainly proved).

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مَنْ حِسابُ النَّاسِ عَلَيهِ وَالكَوْثَرُ بَينَ يَدَيْهِ وَالنَّصُّ يَومَ الغَدِيرِ عَلَيهِ، وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
segments.translation: Peace and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be upon you, O daughter of the one to whom the mission of settling accounts with people (on the Resurrection Day) is given, between whose hands the Heavenly Pond (of al-Kawthar) is put, and whom is intended by the (Prophet's) Statement of the Ghadir Day.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مَنْ قَادَ زِمَامَ نَاقَتِهَا جِبرَائِيلُ وَشَارَكَها في مُصَابهَا إسْرافِيلُ، وَغَضِبَ بِسَبَبِها الرَّبُّ الجَلِيلُ، وَبَكى لمُصَابهَا إبْراهِيمُ الخَلِيلُ وَنُوحٌ وَمُوسَى الكَلِيمُ فِي كَرْبَلاءَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the lady whose she-camel was driven by (Archangel) Gabriel, and whose misfortune (of Imam al-Husayn's being slain in Karbala) was shared by (Archangel) Israfil, and due to whose anger the All-exalted Lord was angry, and for whose misfortune of Karbala, (the Prophets) Abraham the Friend of Allah, Noah, and Moses the Spoken by Allah wept.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ البُدُورِ السَّواطِعِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the shining full moons.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ الشُّمُوسِ الطَّوَالِعِ، وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
segments.translation: Peace and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be upon you, O daughter of the brilliant suns.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ زَمْزَمَ وَالصَّفَا
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Well Zamzam and Safa (of the landmarks of Mecca)

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مَكَّةَ وَمِنىَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Mecca and Mina âa height in Mecca-

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مَنْ حُمِلَ عَلى البُرَاقِ في الهَوَاء
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of him whom was carried by Buraq to the heavens.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مَنْ حمَلَ الزَّكَاةَ بِأطْرافِ الرِّدَاءِ وَبَذَلَهُ عَلى الفُقَراءِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of him who carried the zakat(almsgiving) by the margins of his dress to give it to the paupers.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مَنْ أُسْرِيَ بهِ مِن المَسْجِدِ الحَرامِ إلى المسجِدِ الأقْصَى
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of him whom was taken by night from the Inviolable Masjid to the Farthest Masjid.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مَن ضَرَبَ بِالسَّيْفَين
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of him who fought with two swords.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مَن صَلَّى القِبْلَتَينِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of him who offered prayers to the two qiblas.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ المُصطَفَى
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Muhammad al-Mustafa (the Selected by God)

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ عَلِيٍّ المُرْتَضى
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Ali al-Murtada (the Pleased one)

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْراءِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Fatimah al-Zahraa (the Resplendent).

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ خَديجَةَ الكُبرَى
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Khadijah al-Kubra (the Grand)

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلى جَدِّكِ مُحَمَّدٍ المُخْتَارِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you and upon your grandfather, Muhammad al-Mukhtar (the Chosen.)

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ وعَلى أَبِيكِ حَيْدَر الكَرّار
segments.translation: Peace be upon you and upon your father, Haydar al-Karrar (the Attacking.)

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلى السَّادَاتِ الأطْهارِ الأخْيَارِ، وَهُمْ حُجَجُ اللهِ عَلى الأقْطارِ وَسَاداتُ الأرضِ والسَّمَاءِ الَّذِينَ حُبُّهُم فَرضٌ عَلى أَعْنَاقِ كُلِّ الخَلائِقِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you and upon the pure, choice masters who are the Arguments of Allah on lands, the chiefs of the earth and the heavens, and love for whom is a prescription that is incumbent upon all creatures.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ وَليِّ اللهِ المُعَظَّمِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the glorified, holy servant of Allah.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يا عَمَّةَ وَليِّ اللهِ المُكَرَّمِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O aunt of dignified, holy servant of Allah.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّ المَصائبِ يَا زَيْنَبُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
segments.translation: Peace and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be upon you, O mother of misfortunes; Zaynab.
Peace be upon youâthe virtuous, rightly guided one!

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتُهَا الكَامِلَةُ العَالمَةُ العَامِلةُ
segments.translation: Peace be upon youâthe perfect, knowledgeable good-doer.
Peace be upon youâthe noble gentlewoman.
Peace be upon youâthe pious, infallible one.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَن ظَهَرَتْ محَبَّتُها لِلحُسَينِ المَظْلومِ في مَوارِدَ عَديدَةٍ وَتحَمِلُ المَصَائبَ المحُرِقَةَ لِلقُلوبِ مَعَ تحَمُّلاتٍ شَديدَةٍ
segments.translation: Peace be upon youâwho showed her love for al-Husayn; the wronged, in many situations and had to suffer awful heartbreaking misfortunes.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَن حَفِظَتِ الإمَامَ في يَومِ عَاشُوراءَ في القَتْلى وَبَذلَتْ نَفسَها في نجَاةِ زَينِ العَابِدينَ في مجَلِسِ أشْقَى الأشْقِياءِ وَنَطَقَتْ كَنُطْقِ عَليٍّ عَليهِ السَّلاَمُ في سِكَكِ الكُوفَةِ وَحَولهَا كَثيرٌ مِن الأعْدَاءِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon youâwho guarded the Imam on the Day of Ashura when he was killed, and sacrificed her soul for the salvation of Zayn al-Abidin at the gathering of the most wretched one (i.e. Ubaydullah ibn Ziyad), and addressed a speech, just like (Imam) Ali's, in the streets of Kufa despite the presence of her enemies

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يا مَنْ نَطَحَتْ جَبينَها بِمُقَدَّمِ المحْمَلِ إذْ رَأتْ رَأسَ سَيّدِ الشُّهدَاءِ وَيخْرُجُ الدَّمُ مِن تحْتِ قِناعِها وَمِن محْمَلِها بحَيثُ يرى مَن حَولهَا مِن الأعْداءُ
segments.translation: Peace be upon youâwho thrust her forehead with the front part of the howdah, when she saw the severed head of the Chief of Martyrs (i.e. Imam al-Husayn), and caused blood to flow from beneath her veil and from the howdah in the view of the enemies.
Peace be upon you, O the representative of the Infallible Imam.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يا ممُْتَحَنَةُ في تحَمُّلِ المَصائبِ كالحُسَينِ المَظلُومِ، وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
segments.translation: Peace and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be upon you, O you who were tested through patience against misfortunes, like that of al-Husayn the oppressed.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتُهَا البَعيدَةُ عَن الأوْطانِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you who are far away from you home.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتُهَا الأَسِيرَةُ في البُلدانِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you who were wandered as captive in cities.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتُهَا المُتَحَيّرَةُ في خَرابَةِ الشَّامِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you when you were bewildered in that ruined place in Syria

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتُهَا المُتَحَيّرَةُ في وُقُوفِكِ عَلى جَسَدِ سَيِّد الشُّهَداءِ وخَاطَبْتِ جَدَّكِ رَسولَ اللهِ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيه وَآله بهَذا النِّدَاءِ: "صَلَّىٰ عَلَيْكَ مَلائِكَةُ السَّمَاءِ! هٰذَا حُسَيْنٌ بِالعَراءِ مَسْلُوبُ العِمَامَةِ وَالرِّدَاءِ، مُقَطَّعُ الأَعْضَاءِ، وَبَنَاتُكَ سَبَايَا! وَإلىٰ اللهِِ المُشْتَكَىٰ."
segments.translation: Peace be upon you when you were bewildered as you stood by the (severed) body of the Chief of Martyrs and called at your grandfather; the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, saying, "Oh, Muhammad! May the angels in the Heavens bless you! This is Husayn under the open sky! His turban and his clothes are stripped! His limbs are severed! And your daughters are taken captives! Complaining (about this) is only to Allah."

segments.arabic: وقَالَت: "يَا مُحَمَّدُ! هٰذَا حُسَيْنٌ تَسْفِي عَلَيْهِ رِيحُ الصَّبَا، مجْذُوذَ الرَّأسِ مِن القَفا، قَتِيلَ أَوْلادِ البِغا. وَاحُزْنَاهُ عَليْكَ يا أبَا عَبْدِ الله."
segments.translation: You also said, "O Muhammad! This is Husayn! Winds are blowing his body! His head is cutt off from the back! He is being killed by sons of wrongdoers ! Oh, for my grief for you, Abu Abdullah!

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَن تهَيَّجَ قَلبُها لِلحُسَينِ المَظلومِ العُريَانِ المَطْروحِ عَلى الثَّرَى وقَالَت بِصَوتٍ حَزينٍ: "بِأبي مَن نَفْسي لَهُ الفِداءُ، بِأبي المَهمُومُ حتَّى قَضى، بِأبي مَن شَيبَتُه تَقطِرُ بِالدِّمَاء."
segments.translation: Peace be upon you whose heart cried out for al-Husayn; the oppressed, the stripped, and the threwn on dust, and you said in a sad tone, "May my father be sacrificed for the one for whom I may sacrifice my soul! Oh, for him who was depressed until he passed away! Oh, for him who had been thirsty until he departed life! Oh, for him whose beard is dropping blood!"

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلى مَن بَكَتْ عَلى جَسَدِ أخِيها بَينَ القَتلَى حَتّى بَكى لبُكائِها كُلُّ صَدِيقٍ وَعَدُوٍّ، وَرَأى النَّاسُ دُموعَ الخَيلِ تَنحَدِرُ عَلى حَوافِرِهَا عَلى التَّحْقِيقِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon her who wept for the (severed) body of her brother among the killed ones so painfully that every oneâwhether friend or even enemy, wept for her and, moreover, people, as it is proved by authenticated narrations, saw even horses shed tears, which flew on their legs.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلى مَن تَكَفَّلَتْ وَجمَعَتْ في عَصْرِ عَاشُوراءَ بَناتِ رَسولِ اللهِ وَأطفَالِ الحُسينِ وَقامَت لهَا القِيامَةُ في شَهادَةِ الطِّفلَينِ الغَريبَين المَظلومَينِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon her who took the responsibility of gathering and guarding the daughters of the Messenger of Allah and the children of al-Husayn on the afternoon of the day of Ashura, and she stirred up the situation when the two oppressed, strange children were martyred.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلى مَن لم تَنَمْ عَينُها لأجْلِ حِراسَةِ آل رَسولِ اللهِ في طَف نِينَوَى وَصَارَت أَسيرَةً ذَليلَةً بِيَدِ الأعْداءِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon her whose eyes did not sleep so as to guard the family of the Messenger of Allah at Taff of Nineveh, and was taken as captive as she was humiliated at the hands of her enemies.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلى مَن رَكِبَتْ بَعيراً بِغَيرِ وِطاءٍ وَنَادَت أخَاها أبَا الفَضْلِ بهَذا النِّدَاء: "أخِي أبَا الفَضْلِ، أنْتَ الَّذي أرْكَبْتَني إذْ أرَدتُ الخُروجَ مِن المَدينَةِ"
segments.translation: Peace be upon her who had to ride a saddleless camel and then called on her brother Abu'l-Fadhl (al-Abbas), saying, "O brother! O Abu'l-Fadhl! It was you who helped me ride on a camel when I left Medina."

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلى مَن خَطَبَتْ في مَيدانِ الكُوفَةِ بخِطْبَةٍ نافِعَةٍ حَتّى سَكَنَتِ الأصْواتُ مِن كُلِّ ناحِيةٍ
segments.translation: Peace be upon her who addressed a remarkably expressive speech at the center of Kufa that she made all voices keep silent (to listen to her with astonishment)

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلى مَن احْتَجَّتْ في مَجلِسِ ابْنِ زِيادٍ بِاحتْجَاجَاتٍ وَاضِحَةٍ وَقالَت في جَوابِه بِبَيِّناتٍ صَادِقةٍ، إذْ قَالَ ابنُ زِيادٍ لِزَينَبَ سَلامُ اللهِ عَلَيهَا: "كَيفَ رَأَيْتِ صُنْعَ اللهِ بأخيكِ الحُسَينِ؟" قَالَت: "مَا رَأَيْتُ إِلاّ جَمِيلاً."
segments.translation: Peace be upon her who gave clear-cut arguments in the gathering of (Ubaydullah) Ibn Ziyad who said to her, "How did you see that what Allah had done to your brother?" Answering him, she said with honest evidences, "I saw nothing but good!"

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يا أَسيرَةً بِأيْدي الأعْداءِ في الفَلواتِ وَرَأيْتِ أهْلِ الشّامِ في حَالَةِ العَيشِ والسُّرورِ وَنشْرِ الرّاياتِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you who had to be imprisoned by the enemies under an open sky, and had to see people of Syria celebrate (the martyrdom of her brother) with pleasure, joy, and raised flags

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ على مَن شُدَّ الحَبلُ عَلى عَضُدِها وَعُنُقِ الإمامِ زَينِ العَابِدينَ وَأَدخَلُوها مَعَ سِتَّةَ عَشرَ نَفَراً مِن آلِ رَسولِ اللهِ وَهُم كَالأُسَرَاءِ مُقَرَّنينَ بِالحَديدِ مَظلومِينَ،
segments.translation: Peace be upon her who was tied with a rope on the arm and the neck of Imam Zayn al-Abidin, and she, along with sixteen persons from the family of the Messenger of Allah, was forced to enter (the session of Yazid) while they were enchained with iron fetters

segments.arabic: وَقَالَ عَلِيُّ بنُ الحُسَينِ عَلَيهِ السَّلاَمُ لِيَزيدَ: "يَا يَزيدُ ما ظَنُّكَ بِرَسُولِ اللهِ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيهِ وَآلِهِ لَو رَآنا عَلى هَذِه الحَالَةِ؟"
segments.translation: Meanwhile, Ali ibn al-Husayn (Imam Zayn al-Abidin) said to Yazid, âWhat if the Messenger of Allah sees us in such a manner? What will be his impression?â

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ قَالَت أُمُّ المَصائِبِ زَينَبُ لَهُ: "قَائلاً لَأَهَلُّوا وَاسْتَهَلُّوا فَرَحاً ثُمَّ قَالُوا يَا يَزِيدُ لا تُشَلْ، مُنْتَحِياً عَلَى ثَنَايَا أَبِي عَبْدِاللهِ، عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ، سَيِّدِ شَبَابِ أَهْلِ الجَنَّةِ تَنْكُتُهَا بِمِخْصَرَتِكَ؟"
segments.translation: Then, Lady Zaynab; mother of misfortunes, said to Yazid -after he had poetized, "(Had my forefather whom were killed at the Battle of Badr witnessed this, they would have been very much delighted. then theyâd have said, 'May your hands, O Yazid, never be paralyzed')"

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ قالَت: "وَلَئِنْ جَرَتْ عَلَيَّ الدَّوَاهِي مُخَاطَبَتَكَ، إنِّي لَأَسْتَصْغِرُ قَدْرَكَ وَأَسْتَعْظِمُ تَقْرِيعَكَ وَأَسْتَكْثِرُ تَوْبِيخَكَ، لَكِنِ العُيُونُ عَبْرَى وَالصُّدُورُ حَرَّى. اَلا فَالعَجَبُ كُلُّ الْعَجَبِ لِقَتْلِ حِزْبِ اللهِ النُّجَبَاءِ بِحِزْبِ الشَّيْطَانِ الطُّلَقَاءِ!
segments.translation:
"How dare you hit the lips of Abu âAbdullah (a), the Master of the Youths of Paradise?"
She then said, "Although calamities have forced me to speak to you, I see you trivial in my eyes and find your verbal attacks great and I regard your rebuke too much to bear, but the eyes are tearful, and the chests are filled with depression. What is even stranger is that the honored Party of Allah is being killed by the Party of the âReleased onesââParty of Shaitan.

segments.arabic: َلَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَنَا مَغْنَماً لَتَجِدُنَا وَشِيكاً مُغْرَماً حِينَ لا تَجِدُ اِلاّ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ، ﴿وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ﴾ فَإلَى اللهِ المُشْتَكَى وَعَلَيْهِ المُعَوَّلُ في الشِّدَّةِ والرَّخاءِ.
segments.translation: If you regard us as your booty, you shall soon find us as your opponentsâthat will be when you find nothing but what your hands had committed,Â âAnd your Lord never treats His servants unjustly.(41:46)âÂ To Allah is my complaint, and upon Him do I rely.Â

segments.arabic: فَكِدْ كَيْدَكَ وَاسْعَ سَعْيَكَ وَنَاصِبْ جَهْدَكَ! فَوَاللهِ لا تَمْحُوَنَّ ذِكْرَنَا وَلا تُمِيتُ وَحْيَنَا وَلا تُدْرِكُ أَمَدَنَا وَلا تَرْخَصُ عَنْكَ عَارَهَا.
segments.translation: So scheme whatever you wish to scheme, and carry out your plots, and intensify your efforts, for, by Allah, you shall never be able to obliterate our mention, nor will you ever be able to kill the revelation (that was revealed to us), nor will you ever exalt to our position, nor will your shame ever be washed away.

segments.arabic: وَهَلْ رَأْيُكَ إلاّ فَنَدٌ وَأيَّامُكَ إلاّ عَدَدٌ وَجَمْعُكَ إلاّ بَدَدٌ. يا يزيد أما سمعت قول الله تعالى: ﴿وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَمْوَاتًا بَلْ أَحْيَاءٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ يُرْزَقُونَ.﴾
segments.translation: Your view shall be proven futile, your days limited in number, and your wealth wasted on the Day when the caller calls out,Â Â âThink not of those, who are slain in the way of Allah as dead; they are alive (and) are provided sustenance from their Lordâ. (3:169)

segments.arabic: فَالحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ الَّذِي خَتَمَ لِأَوَّلِنَا بِالسَّعَادَةِ وَالمَغْفِرَةِ وَلِآخِرِنَا بِالشَّهَادَةِ وَالرَّحْمَةِ، وَنَسْأَلُ اللهَ أَنْ يُكْمِلَ لَهُمُ الثَّوَابَ وَيُوجِبَ لَهُمُ المَزِيدَ وَيُحْسِنُ عَلَيْنَا الخِلافَةَ؛ إنَّهُ رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ، وَحَسْبُنَا اللهُ وَنِعْمُ الوَكِيلُ .
segments.translation: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the Worlds, Who sealed the life of our early ones with happiness and forgiveness, and that of our last ones with martyrdom and mercy. We plead to Allah to complete His rewards for them, grant them an increase, and recompense us pleasingly; He is the most Merciful, the most Compassionate. Allah suffices us, and He is the best Guardian.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِين
segments.translation: May Allah bless Muhammad and his Pure, Immaculate Household

segments.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace Be On You. Odaughter Of The Apostle Of Allah!

segments.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace Be On You, Odaughter Of The Prophet Of Allah!

segments.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِئْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمُصْطَفَى
segments.translation: Peace Be On You, O Daughter Of Mohammad Al-Mustafa!

segments.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ وَلِيَ اللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace Be On You, Odaughter Of The Representative Of Allah!

segments.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ عَلِيِّ الْمُرْتَضَى سَيِّدِ الْأَوْصِيَاءِ وَالصَّدِيقِينَ
segments.translation: Peace Be On You, O Daughter Of The Ali-Al-Murtaza,Who Is The Leader Of The Regents And True Ones!

segments.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِسَيِّدَةِ نِسَاءِ الْعَلَمِينَ
segments.translation: Peace Be On You, O Daughter Of Fatemah Zahra, Who Is The Leader Of The Women Of All The Worlds!

segments.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُخْتَ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ سَيِّدَى شَبَابِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِأَجْمَعِينَ
segments.translation: Peace Be On You, O Sister Of Hazrat Imam Hasan And Hazrat Imam Husayn Who Are The Leaders Of All The Youths Of Heaven!
Peace Be On You, O The Leader, The Chaste!
Peace Be On You, O Invitor Towards Truth On All Occasions!
Peace Be On You, O One Who Is Always Afraid Of Allah, O Pure One!
Peace Be On You. O One Who Is Content With Allah And With Whom Allah Is Content!

segments.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْعَالِمَةُ الْغَيْرُ الْمُعَلَّمَةِ
segments.translation: Peace Be On You, O One Who Is Learned Without Being Taught By Anyone!

segments.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْفَهِيْمَةُ الْغَيْرُ الْمُفَهَّمَةِ
segments.translation: Peace Be On You, O One Who Understands Every Thing, Without Explanation From Any One!
Peace Be On You, O One Who Was Tormented!
Peace Be On You, O One Who Continued To Bear Unhappiness!
Peace Be On You, O One Whose Life Was Passed In Sadness!
Peace Be On You. O One Who Always Spoke The Truth!
Peace Be On You, O One Who Bore Hardships!
Peace Be On You, O One Who Was Always Surrounded By Tribulations!

segments.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتَهَا صَاحِبَةُ الْمُصِيبَةِ الْعُظمى
segments.translation: Peace Be On You, O One Who Always Shouldered Big Hardships!
Peace Be On You, O Zainab Al-Kubra
Peace be upon Adam, the chosen one of Allah,
Peace be upon Noah, the Prophet of Allah,
Peace be upon Abraham, the intimate friend of Allah,
Peace be upon Moses, the one who spoke with Allah,
Peace be upon Jesus, the spirit of Allah,
Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah,
Peace be upon you, O best of Allahâs creation,
Peace be upon you, O chosen one of Allah,
Peace be upon you, O Muhammad son of Abdullah, the seal of the Prophets,
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib, the successor of the Messenger of Allah,
Peace be upon you, O Fatimah, the leader of the women of the worlds,
Peace be upon you both, O grandsons of the Prophet of Mercy,
And leaders of the youth of Paradise,
Peace be upon you, O Ali ibn Husayn, the leader of the worshipers and the delight of those who behold,
Peace be upon you, O Muhammad ibn Ali, the expounder of knowledge after the Prophet,
Peace be upon you, O Ja'far ibn Muhammad, the truthful, the righteous, and the trustworthy,
Peace be upon you, O Musa ibn Ja'far, the pure and virtuous,
Peace be upon you, O Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha, the chosen one,
Peace be upon you, O Muhammad ibn Ali, the pious,
Peace be upon you, O Ali ibn Muhammad, the pure, the sincere, and the trustworthy,
Peace be upon you, O Hasan ibn Ali,
Peace be upon the guardian after him,
O Allah, send blessings upon Your light, Your lamp, and the protector of Your protector,
The successor of Your successor and Your proof over Your creation,
Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Messenger of Allah,
Peace be upon you, O daughter of Fatimah and Khadijah,
Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Commander of the Faithful,
Peace be upon you, O sister of Hasan and Husayn,
Peace be upon you, O daughter of the guardian of Allah,
Peace be upon you, O sister of the guardian of Allah,
Peace be upon you, O aunt of the guardian of Allah, and the mercy and blessings of Allah,
Peace be upon you; may Allah unite us and you in Paradise,
And may He gather us in your group,
And may He lead us to the fountain of your Prophet,
And may He quench our thirst with the cup of your grandfather, from the hand of Ali ibn Abi Talib,
Blessings of Allah be upon you,
I ask Allah to show us joy and relief through you,
And to gather us and you in the group of your grandfather Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family,
And that He does not deprive us of knowing you,
Indeed, He is a guardian and powerful,
I seek closeness to Allah through my love for you,
And my disassociation from your enemies,
And submission to Allah, content with Him, neither denying nor being arrogant,
And with certainty in what Muhammad brought,
And being pleased with it, we seek thereby Your countenance, O my Master,
O Allah, and Your pleasure and the Hereafter,
O my lady, O Zaynab,
Intercede for me in Paradise,
For you have a significant status before Allah,
O Allah, I ask You to conclude my life with happiness,
And do not take away from me what I am in,
And there is no power or strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Most Great,
O Allah, accept this from us through Your generosity and might,
And through Your mercy and well-being,
And may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and all his family,
And peace and salutations be upon them, O the most merciful of the merciful.

text: Lady Zainab binte Ali Ibn Abutalib(as) ( peace be upon her) Brief info Brief Life × Zaynab is thought to mean 'she who weeps excessively', and other linguistic sources state that it once meant a good looking or smelling tree. The name might also possibly be a compound of the two Arabic words, zayn (beauty) and ab (father). Birth on 5th Jamadi Awal 5 AH (1st shaban also recorded ) Death -15th Rajab 62 AH (Other dates also recorded in Jamadi uth-thani, the 24th of Safar, or the 16th of Dhu'l-Hijjah) Zaynab is thought to mean 'she who weeps excessively', and other linguistic sources state that it once meant a good looking or smelling tree. The name might also possibly be a compound of the two Arabic words, zayn (beauty) and ab (father). Birth on 5th Jamadi Awal 5 AH (1st shaban also recorded ) Death -15th Rajab (Image) (Other dates also recorded in Jamadi uth-thani, the 24th of Safar, or the 16th of Dhu'l-Hijjah) Sayyeda Zainab (s.a.), the daughter of Imam Ali (a.s.) and Sayyeda Fatima (s.a.), was an exemplary woman of great ability, intelligence, knowledge, insight, courage and perseverance; she performed her divine duties to the best of her ability. She was born to a family formed by the Prophet (SAW), the most outstanding figure in history. The Prophet's wife Sayyeda Khadija (s.a.) a devoted woman, was her maternal grandmother, and her paternal grandmother was Fatima daughter of Assad, who mothered and nursed the Prophet (SAW). The members of the family, in trio hierarchical order, were all great. Sayyeda Zainab (s.a.) was a brilliant star in the mandate sky that received rays of holiness from the five suns. It was through her holy origins and pious edification that she manifested so great a fortitude in Karbala (Iraq). The life of the daughter of Sayyeda Al-Zahra (s.a.) was always laden with hardships, but she never feared coping with difficulties, this enhanced her endurance and elevated her soul. Extract From 'Victory of Truth' Book.... It was five years after the Muslims had accompanied the Prophet [s.a.w.] and his family in the migration (hijrah) to Medina, when the Holy Prophet's daughter, Hadrat Fatima [a.s.], gave birth to a little girl. When her father, Imam Ali [a.s.], saw his daughter for the first time Imam Husayn [a.s.], who was then almost three years old, was with him. The boy exclaimed in delight, "O father, Allah has given me a sister." At those words Imam Ali [a.s.] began to weep, and when Husayn [a.s.] asked why he was crying so, his father answered that he would soon come to know. Fatima [a.s.] and Ali [a.s.] did not name their child until a few days after her birth, for they awaited the Prophet's return from a journey so that he could propose the name. When finally the baby girl was brought before him he held her in his lap and kissed her. The Angel Jibra'il came to him and conveyed the name that was to be hers, and then he began to weep. The Prophet [s.a.w.] asked why Jibra'il wept and he answered, "O Prophet of Allah, from early on in life this girl will remain entangled in tribulations and trials in this world.- First she will weep over your separation (from this world); thereafter she will bemoan the loss of her mother, then her father, and then her brother Hasan. After all this she will be confronted with the trials of the land of Karbala and the tribulations of that lonely desert, as a result of which her hair will turn grey and her back will be bent." When the members of the family heard this prophecy they all broke down in tears. Imam Husayn [a.s.] now understood why earlier his father had also wept. Then the Prophet [s.a.w.] named her Zaynab [a.s.]. When the news of Zaynab's birth reached Salman al-Farsi, he went to Ali [a.s.] to congratulate him. But instead of seeing him happy and rejoicing he saw Ali [a.s.] shed tears, and he too was apprised of the events of Karbala and the hardships that were to befall Zaynab [a.s.]. One day, when Zaynab [a.s.] was about five years old, she had a strange and terrible dream. A violent wind arose in the city and darkened the earth and the sky. The little girl was tossed hither and thither, and suddenly she found herself stuck in the branches of a huge tree. But the wind was so strong that it uprooted the tree. Zaynab [a.s.] caught hold of a branch but that broke. In a panic she grabbed two twigs but these too gave way and she was left falling with no support. Then she woke up. When she told her grandfather, the Prophet [s.a.w.], about this dream he wept bitterly and said, "O my daughter that tree is me who is shortly going to leave this world. The branches are your father Ali and your mother Fatima Zahra, and the twigs are your brothers Hasan and Husayn. They will all depart this world before you do, and you will suffer their separation and loss." The exact date of her birth is uncertain; however the most widely accepted dates are the first of Sha'ban or the fifth of Jamadi ul-Awwal of the fifth or sixth year A.H., or the ninth of Ramadan in the ninth year A.H. p.45-6 ibid. p.68 ibid. The date of her death is uncertain : she is variously thought to be buried (most popularly) in Damascus, There are two explanations given as to how she came to be buried in Damascus: one being that some time after their return Yazid once again sent his forces to attack them, this time at Medina, and she and other members of her family were taken as prisoners of war to Damascus where she died; another being that because of a famine that swept through Medina, her husband temporarily moved his family to a village near Damascus, and it was there while praying in a garden that Zaynab [a.s.] was accidentally but fatally struck by a gardener's spade, or fell victim to a serious illness from which she never recovered. The anniversary of her death is observed on the following dates: 15th rajab ,11th or 21st of Jamadi uth-thani, the 24th of Safar, or the 16th of Dh u'l-Hijjah. Death Anniversary on 15th Rajab The death of the vanguard of protection for the members of the family of the Prophet and the lady who carried forth the message of Kerbala for the future generations, Lady Zainab the daughter of Ali (AS) holds a special place in the hearts of all Muslims. Born into a family of spiritual purity with a grand-father, mother, father, and brothers belonging to the tree of infallibility and the house in which the Qurâan descended, her environment was one which permitted her to reach to great levels. Although she lost her mother when she was still a child of around 7 years, another Fatimah (later on she became known as Ummul Baneen), entered into her fatherâs life and took on the arduous task of raising future leaders of the Ummah. However, the loss of her mother at such a young age did not prevent her from picking up her exemplary qualities. Just as her mother stood up to speak in the Masjid of the Prophet when her rights were stolen from her (in regards to Fadak), so too when the caravan of the Ahlul Bayt were taken to the palaces of Ibne Ziyad and Yazid, this daughter of Fatimah, as the mirror image of her mother, stood up to defend the Ahlul Bait and their rights. A model woman for all generations, one of her claims to fame was her profound knowledge of Islam. Although she never frequented a school to learn the faith of Islam, memorization of the Qurâan and the commentary of the Book of Allah (swt) and all other aspects of the faith, she none the less was recognized as an authority. In fact, due to her not going to any formal school, her nephew, the 4th Imam commonly referred to her as the âThe Scholar who had no formal teacher.â A point which the sisters of today can learn from this towering personality, while in Kufah during the reign of her father, the Commander of the Faithful, she held special sessions for the Muslim women who would come to learn about Islam and a detailed expose' of the Qurâan. Thus, rather than the men teaching the women, she took it upon her self to teach those of her gender not about theology but also Islamic morals and ethics! Her lofty rank and status would however, not grant her immunity from the clutches of tyranny. Although the events surrounding her death are obscure, and there are definitely discrepancies as to what occurred after the massacre in Kerbala in 61 AH to this noble woman, however most historians write that she lived only one year after the massacre and at the age of 57, left this mortal world. Even the reports of where she was buried conflict with one another with three prominent opinions being put forward by the researchers. Some say that she died and was buried in Madinah; others claim Egypt where there is a large shrine for Sayyida Zainab while the third and most compelling belief is that she died in Damascus. âPeace be upon her the day she was born, the day she died and the day she will be brought back to lifeâ¦â Source http://www.world-federation.org/Secretariat/Articles/Archive/Wafat_SayyidaZainab.htm 15th Rajab 62AH. The death anniversary of Lady Zainab [s.a]:* *_On this occassion of sorrow and grief, I wish to extend my condolences to the Holy Prophet (s.a.w), the Holy Ahlul Bayt (a.s), Imam al-Mahdi (atf) and to all Momineen:*_ The mountain of patience, the champion of Karbala and the saviour of her brother Imam Hussein (a.s)'s message! *The Holy Prophet [s.a.w] asked why Jibra'il wept and he answered:* _âO Prophet of Allah, from early on in life this girl will remain entangled in tribulations and trials in this worldâ_ After bearing all those calamities from Karbala to Damascus to Madina, Bibi Zainab [s.a] had returned altered, her hair white, and her back bent. Although upon her return she had been reunited with her husband, she did not live long after the torturous trials she had to bear. After their release from prison, Bibi Zainab (s.a), along with the rest of the members of Ahlul Bayt (a.s) went to Medinah. Even in Medinah, she continued preaching. Islam spread rapidly. segments.translation: Allah Is The Great
Glory Be To Allah
Praise Be To Allah
Peace be upon Adam the choice of Allah.
Peace be upon Noah the prophet of Allah.
Peace be upon Abraham the friend of Allah.
Peace be upon Moses the spoken by Allah.
Peace be upon Jesus the spirit of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Allahâs Messenger.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَيْرَ خَلْقِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O Allahâs best creature.
Peace be upon you, O elite of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad the son of `Abdullah
and the seal of the Prophets.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful
`Ali the son of Abu-Talib
and the successor of Allahâs Messenger.
Peace be upon you, O Fatimah
the doyenne of the women of the worlds.
Peace be upon both of you, O grandsons of the Mercy
and two chiefs of the youth of Paradise.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَلِيُّ بْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O `Ali the son of al-Husayn,
the chief of the worshippers and the delight of the eye of all seers.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad the son of `Ali,
the splitter of knowledge after the Prophet.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا جَعْفَرُ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O Ja`far the son of Muhammad,
the veracious, dutiful, and honest.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O Musa the son of Ja`far,
the immaculate and ever-pure.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَلِيُّ بْنَ مُوسَىٰ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O `Ali the son of Musa,
the well-pleased and well-contented.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ ٱلتَّقِيُّ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad the son of `Ali, the pious.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَلِيُّ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O `Ali the son of Muhammad,
the immaculate, sincere, and honest.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حَسَنُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O Hasan the son of `Ali.
Peace be upon the next successor.
O Allah, send blessings upon Your light, Your lantern,
the representative of Your representative,
the successor of Your successor,
and the argument of You against Your creatures.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Allahâs Messenger.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بِنْتَ فَاطِمَةَ وَخَدِيـجَةَ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya binta fatimata wa khadijata
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Fatimah and Khadijah.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤمِنينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ ٱلْحَسَنِ وَٱلْحُسَيْنِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of al-Hasan and al-Husayn.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ وَلِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Allahâs representative.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُخْتَ وَلِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O sister of Allahâs representative.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا عَمَّةَ وَلِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O paternal aunt of Allahâs representative.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مُوسَىٰ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ
segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya binta musa bni ja`farin
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Musa the son of Ja`far.
Allahâs mercy and blessings, too, be upon you.
Peace be upon you.

segments.arabic: عَرَّفَ ٱللَّهُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ فِي ٱلْجَنَّةِ
segments.transliteration: `arrafa allahu baynana wa baynakum fi aljannati
segments.translation: May Allah introduce us to you all in Paradise,
include us with your group,
allow us to approach the pond of Your Prophet,
and serve us with water from the cup of your grandfather

segments.arabic: مِنْ يَدِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ
segments.translation: and from the hand of `Ali the son of Abu-Talib.
Allahâs blessings be upon you all.

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُ ٱللَّهَ أَنْ يُرِيَنَا فِيكُمُ ٱلسُّرُورَ وَٱلْفَرَجَ
segments.transliteration: as'alu allaha an yuriyana fikumu alssurura walfaraja
segments.translation: I beseech Allah to show us delight and relief through you,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْ يَجْمَعَنَا وَإِِيَّاكُمْ فِي زُمْرَةِ جَدِّكُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa an yajma`ana wa iyyakum fi zumrati jaddikum
segments.translation: to join us with you in the group of your grandfather
Muhammad, Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household,
and never to deprive us of our recognition of you.
Verily, He is Guardian and All-powerful.
I seek nearness to Allah through my love for you,
repudiation of your enemies,
and submission to Allah,

segments.arabic: رَاضِياً بِهِ غَيْرَ مُنْكِرٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَكْبِرٍ
segments.transliteration: radiyan bihi ghayra munkirin wa la mustakbirin
segments.translation: accepting Him without denial or arrogance,

segments.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ يَقيِنِ مَا أَتَىٰ بِهِ مُحَمَّدٌ
segments.transliteration: wa `ala yaqini ma ata bihi muhammadun
segments.translation: being fully certain of what Muhammad has brought,
and showing full satisfaction with it.
We, through this, only seek Your Face,
O my Master Allah, and Your satisfaction
as well as the Next Abode.

segments.arabic: يَا فَاطِمَةُ ٱشْفَعِي لِي فِي ٱلْجَنَّةِ
segments.transliteration: ya fatimatu ishfa`i li fi aljannati
segments.translation: O Fatimah, (please) intercede for me to win Paradise,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّ لَكِ عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ شَأْناً مِنَ ٱلشَّأْنِ
segments.transliteration: fa'inna laki `inda allahi sha'nan min alshsha'ni
segments.translation: for you enjoy an outstanding status with Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَخْتِمَ لِي بِٱلسَّعَادَةِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka an takhtima li bilssa`adati
segments.translation: O Allah, I do beseech You to seal my life with happiness;

segments.arabic: فَلاَ تَسْلُبْ مِنِّي مَا أَنَا فِيهِ
segments.transliteration: fala taslub minni ma ana fihi
segments.translation: so, (please) do not deprive me of that which I enjoy.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power except with Allah the All-high and All-great.
O Allah, (please) respond to us
and accept this from us in the name of Your generosity, almightiness,
mercy, and bestowal of wellbeing.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi ajma`ina
segments.translation: May Allah bless Muhammad and his entire Household

segments.transliteration: wa sallama tasliman ya arhama alrrahimina
segments.translation: and pour down peace on them, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.

segments.arabic: مَنْ زَارَ الْمَعْصُوْمَةَ بِقُمْ (فِيْ قُمْ) كَمَنْ زَارَنِيْ
وَ تُدْخَلُ بِشَفَاعَتِهَا شِيْعَتِي الْجَنَّةَ بِاَجْمَعِهِمْ.‏
یَا فَطِمَۃُ اِشْفَعِیْ لِیْ فِیْ الْجَنَّۃِ.
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكِ یَا بِنْتَ رَسُوْلِ اللہِ ... اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مُوْسَي بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ
فَاِنَّ لَكِ عِنْدَ اللہِ شَاْنًا مِنَ الشَّاْنِ

title: Hazrat Abbas Ibn Ali ( peace be upon him)

segments.transliteration: salamu allahi wa salamu mala'ikatihi almuqarrabina
segments.translation: O he who saw al-`Abbas attacking the groups of the sheep-like enemies,
followed by the sons of Haydar, who were as courageous as lions.
I have been told that my son was stricken on the head and had his hand cut!
Woe me for my young lion! Did the stroke of the iron post bow his head?

segments.transliteration: walzzakiyatu alttayyibatu fima taghtadi wa taruhu
segments.translation: Had his sword been in his hand, none could have ever approached him.

segments.arabic:
ـبَ بِرَأْسِهِ مَقْطُوعَ يَدْ
وَيْلِي عَلَىٰ شِبْلي أَمَا
لَ بِرَأْسِهِ ضَرْبُ ٱلْعَمَدْ
لَوْ كانَ سَيْفُكَ فِي يَدَيْـ
ـكَ لَما دَنا مِنْهُ أَحَدْ
segments.translation: Do not call me Ummuâl-Banin (Mother of the sons).
You will remind me of the lions of the lair.
I had sons by whom I was called,

segments.transliteration: likhalafi alnnabiyyi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi almursali
segments.translation: but today, I have no single son!
They were four; like eagles on heights.
They faced death by having their aorta cut off.
The ravenous lances crowded on their bodies.
So, all of them were pierced and stabbed.
Great is my distress! Is it true what they have told
that `Abbasâs right hand was severed?
Peace of Allah and peace of His favorite angels,
His commissioned prophets,
His righteous servants,
all the martyrs, and all the veracious (ones),
and also pure, true blessings that come and go,
be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man jahila haqqaka
segments.translation: I testify to you of submission (to the will of God), honest acceptance as true,
loyalty, and sincerity

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man hala baynaka wa bayna ma'i alfurati
segments.translation: to the descendant of the commissioned Prophet, Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household,

segments.arabic: لِخَلَفِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِ
segments.translation: the chosen grandson (of the Prophet),

segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha munjizun lakum ma wa`adakum
segments.translation: the well knowledgeable guide (to the true religion),

segments.transliteration: ji'tuka yabna amiri almu'minina wafidan ilaykum
segments.translation: the conveying successor,

segments.transliteration: wa qalbi musallimun lakum wa tabi`un
segments.translation: and the wrongfully oppressed one.
So, Allah may reward you on behalf of His Messenger,
the Commander of the Faithful,
al-Hasan, and al-Husayn,
peace of Allah be upon them,
with the best reward
for your steadfastness, dedication (to the sake of God), and support (for the right party).

segments.transliteration: inni bikum wa bi'iyabikum min almu'minina
segments.translation: Very excellent be the reward of the eternal life.

segments.transliteration: wa biman khalafakum wa qatalakum min alkafirina
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on him who killed you.

segments.transliteration: qatala allahu ummatan qatalatkum bil-aidi wal-alsuni
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on him who ignored your position
and belittled your sanctity.

segments.transliteration: almuti`u lillahi wa lirasulihi wa li'amiri almu'minina
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on him who precluded you from having from the water of the Euphrates.

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ حَالَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مَاءِ ٱلْفُرَاتِ
segments.transliteration: walhasani walhusayni salla allahu `alayhim wa sallama
segments.translation: I testify that you were killed wrongfully

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
segments.translation: and that Allah will verily fulfill His promise that He made with you.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُنْجِزٌ لَكُمْ مَا وَعَدَكُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa maghfiratuhu wa ridwanuhu wa `ala ruhika wa badanika
segments.translation: O son of the Commander of the Faithful, I have come to you to present myself before you.

segments.arabic: جِئْتُكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلُمْؤْمِنينَ وَافِداً إِلَيْكُمْ
segments.transliteration: ashhadu wa ushhidu allaha annaka madayta `ala ma mada bihi albadriyyuna
segments.translation: My heart is submissive to you and is following you.
And I am your follower.
I am ready to support you
until Allah decides.
He is surely the best of all those who decide.
I am verily with you,
not with your enemy.
I am one of those who believe in you and believe in your Return.

segments.transliteration: wa awfa jaza'i ahadin mimman wa fa bibay`atihi
segments.translation: I also one of those who deny your opposites and killers.
Allah may kill the group who killed you with hands and tongues (by giving orders of killing you.)

segments.arabic: قَتَلَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً قَتَلَتْكُمْ بِٱلأَيْدِي وَٱلأَلْسُنِ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah)

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad balaghta fi alnnasihati
segments.translation: and obedient to Allah, to His Messenger, to the Commander of the Faithful,
to al-Hasan, and to al-Husayn, peace and greetings of Allah be upon them.

segments.arabic: وَٱلحَسَنِ وَٱلحُسَيْنِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَسَلَّمَ
segments.translation: Peace, Allahâs mercy, blessings,

segments.transliteration: wa ja`ala ruhaka ma`a arwahi alssu`ada'i
segments.translation: forgiveness, and gratifications be upon you, your soul, and your body.

segments.transliteration: wa a`taka min jinanihi afsahaha manzilan
segments.translation: I testify, and call Allah to witness, that you abided by the same course that was taken by the warriors of (the battle of) Badr

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ وَأُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ أَنَّكَ مَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ مَا مَضَىٰ بِهِ ٱلبَدْرِيُّونَ
segments.translation: and the strivers for Allahâs sake
who sincerely served Him in the battlefields against His enemies,
did their bests for supporting His disciples,
and defended His intimate ones.
So, Allah may reward you the best,

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka lam tahin wa lam tankul
segments.translation: the maximum,

segments.transliteration: wa annaka madayta `ala basiratin min amrika
segments.translation: the most abundant,
and the most conclusive reward that He may give to any one who fulfills his homage,

segments.arabic: وَأَوْفَىٰ جَزَاءِ أَحَدٍ مِمَّنْ وَفَىٰ بِبَيْعَتِهِ
segments.translation: answers the call (of the religion),
and obeys his (divinely elected) leaders.
I testify that you acted extremely sincerely

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قَدْ بَالَغْتَ فِي ٱلنَّصِيحَةِ
segments.translation: and exerted all your efforts (in this regard).
Allah may attach you to the martyrs,

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: add your soul to the souls of the happy ones,

segments.transliteration: wa la tada` li fi hadha almakani almukarrami walmashhadi almu`azzami dhanban illa ghafartahu
segments.translation: give you the largest abode in His Paradise
and the most handsome room,
exalt your mention in `Illiyyin (the most elevated position),
and join you to the Prophets, the veracious ones,
the martyrs, and the righteous ones.
Very excellent is the companionship of such ones.
I testify that you did not lag behind and did not turn away the face,

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تَهِنْ وَلَمْ تَنْكُلْ
segments.transliteration: wa la gha'iban illa hafiztahu wa adnaytahu
segments.translation: and that you left this life with full awareness of the truth,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ مَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa la hajatan min hawa'iji alddunya wal-akhirati
segments.translation: following the examples of the righteous ones

segments.transliteration: laka fiha ridan wa liya fiha salahun
segments.translation: and sticking to the Prophets.
So, Allah may gather us with you,

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya aba alfadli al`abbasa ibna amiri almu'minina
segments.translation: with His Messenger, and with His disciples
in the abodes of those who practiced humbly (with their Lord).
He is certainly the most merciful of all the merciful ones.
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and do not leave for me, in this honored place and glorified shrine, any sin that I did but that You forgive it,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَدَعْ لِي فِي هٰذَا ٱلمَكَانِ ٱلمُكَرَّمِ وَٱلمَشْهَدِ ٱلمُعَظَّمِ ذَنْباً إِلاَّ غَفَرْتَهُ
segments.translation: any care but that You relieve it,

segments.transliteration: ashhadu laqad nasahta lillahi wa lirasulihi wa li'akhika
segments.translation: any illness but that You cure it,
any defect buth that You cover up,
any source of sustenance but that You expand it,
any item of terror but that You pacify it,

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan istahallat minka almaharima
segments.translation: any disunity but that You reunify it,
any absent one but that You guard it and approach (him to me),
and any single need, among the many needs for this life as well as the life to come

segments.arabic: وَلا حَاجَةً مِنْ حَوَائِجِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.translation: whose settlement achieves your gratification and my good,

segments.arabic: لَكَ فِيهَا رِضَىٰ وَلِيَ فِيهَا صَلاحٌ
segments.translation: but that You grant it. O He Who is the most merciful of all the merciful ones!
Peace be upon you, O Abuâl-Fadl al-`Abbas the son of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَاَ ٱلفَضْلِ ٱلعَبَّاسَ بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.transliteration: alrraghibu fima zahida fihi ghayruhu min alththwabi aljazili
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the successors (of the Prophets).

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the foremost to Islam,

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَوَّلِ ٱلْقَوْمِ إِسْلاَماً
segments.transliteration: wa alhaqaka allahu bidarajati aba'ika fi jannati alnna`imi
segments.translation: the first to believe,

segments.transliteration: allahumma inni ta`arradtu liziyarati awliya'ika raghbatan fi thawabika
segments.translation: the best to have served the religion of Allah,

segments.transliteration: wa raja'an limaghfiratika wa jazili ihsanika
segments.translation: and the most careful for Islam.

segments.transliteration: fa's'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa alihi alttahirina
segments.translation: I bear witness that you served Allah, His Messenger, and your brother sincerely.

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ لَقَدْ نَصَحْتَ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلأَخِيكَ
segments.transliteration: wa an taj`ala rizqi bihim darran
segments.translation: You were the most excellent self-sacrificing brother.
So, Allahâs curse be on the group who killed you.
Allahâs curse be on the group who wronged you.
Allahâs curse be on the group who violated your sanctities

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً ٱسْتَحَلَّتْ مِنْكَ ٱلْمَحَارِمَ
segments.translation: and infringed the sanctity of Islam.

segments.transliteration: waj`alni mimman yanqalibu min ziyarati mashahidi ahibba'ika
segments.translation: You were the most excellent steadfast fighter,
protector, supporter,
and brother who defended his brother,
responded to the obedience to his Lord,
and worked desirably for gaining the abundant reward, which others refused,

segments.arabic: ٱلرَّاغِبُ فِيمَا زَهِدَ فِيهِ غَيْرُهُ مِنَ ٱلثَّوَابِ ٱلْجَزِيلِ
segments.transliteration: innaka ahlu alttaqwa wa ahlu almaghfirati
segments.translation: and the nice tribute.
So, Allah may attach you to the rank of your fathers in the gardens of bliss.

segments.arabic: وَأَلْحَقَكَ ٱللَّهُ بِدَرَجَةِ آبَائِكَ فِي جَنَّاتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
segments.translation: O Allah, I have done the pilgrimage to Your disciples out of my desire for (winning) your reward

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي تَعَرَّضْتُ لِزِيَارَةِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ رَغْبَةً فِي ثَوَابِكَ
segments.transliteration: amanna billahi wa birasulihi wa bikitabihi
segments.translation: and my wish for Your forgiveness and Your abundant benevolence.

segments.transliteration: wa bima ja'a bihi min `indi allahi
segments.translation: So, I implore You to send Your blessings upon Muhammad and his immaculate Household

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
segments.translation: and to make my sustenance flow copiously in their names,

segments.transliteration: allahumma la taj`alhu akhira al`ahdi min ziyarati qabra ibni akhi rasulika
segments.translation: my living delightful in their names,
my pilgrimage rewardable in their names,
and my life pleasant in their names,

segments.transliteration: wahshurni ma`ahu wa ma`a aba'ihi fi aljinani
segments.translation: to make me take to the conduct of the honored ones,

segments.transliteration: wa `arrif bayni wa baynahu wa bayna rasulika wa awliya'ika
segments.translation: to make me one of those who, as returning from the pilgrimage to the tombs of Your beloved ones,

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ يَنْقَلِبُ مِنْ زِيَارَةِ مَشَاهِدِ أَحِبَّائِكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: win success and prosperity
and deserve forgiveness of sins,
covering up of defects,

segments.transliteration: walwilayati li`aliyyi bni abi talibin wal-a'immati min wuldihi
segments.translation: and relief of disasters.
You are surely worthy of being feared and worthy of forgiving.

segments.transliteration: fa'inni qad raditu ya rabbi bidhalika
segments.translation: I entrust you with Allah, beseech Him to keep you under His guard,

segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: and invoke peace upon you.
We have believed in Allah, in His Messenger, in His Book,
and in that which he conveyed from Allah.

segments.arabic: وَبِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.translation: O Allah, record our names with the witnesses.

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad jahadta wa nasahta
segments.translation: O Allah, do not decide this pilgrimage to the tomb of the son of Your Messengerâs brother to be the last one of mine.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لا تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ ٱلعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِي قَبْرَ ٱبْنِ أَخِي رَسُولِكَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon him (i.e. the Messenger) and upon his Household.

segments.transliteration: la`ana allahu alzzalimina lakum min al-awwalina wal-akhirina
segments.translation: Grant me opportunities to visit him so long as You keep me alive,
join me to him and to his fathers in the gardens of Paradise,

segments.arabic: وَٱحْشُرْنِي مَعَهُ وَمَعَ آبَائِهِ فِي ٱلْجِنَانِ
segments.translation: and introduce me to him, to Your Messenger, and to Your disciples.

segments.arabic: وَعَرِّفْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِكَ وَأَوْلِيَائِكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, send Your blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and take me to You while I am abiding by the believing in You,
giving credence to Your Messenger,
being faithful to `Ali the son of Abu-Talib and the Imams from his progeny,

segments.arabic: وَٱلوِلاَيَةِ لِعَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَٱلأَئِمَّةِ مِنْ وُلْدِهِ
segments.translation: and disavowing their enemy.
My Lord, I have accepted such.

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي قَدْ رَضِيتُ يَا رَبِّي بِذٰلِكَ
segments.translation: Allah may send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah)
and obedient to Allah and to His Messenger.
I bear witness that you strove (in the way of Allah), acted sincerely,
and tolerated (harm) until death came upon you.
May Allah curse those who wronged you from the past and the present generations

segments.arabic: لَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ لَكُمْ مِنَ ٱلاوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
segments.translation: and may He send them to the lowest layer of the blazing Hell.

text: Ziyarat Hazrat Abbas Ibn Ali(as) Brief info Brief Life × BRotherhood, Courage, and Loyalty in Abbas bin Ali - By SAYYID MUHAMMAD RIZVI Who was Abbas (peace be upon him), whose birth anniversary is being celebrated this week? To the Muslims, Abbas is known in different ways: as the lion of Ali, the hero of Karbala, the flag-bearer of Hussain, the beloved brother of Zainab, and the loving uncle of Sakina (peace be upon them all). Abbas was the son of Imam Ali, the first Imam and successor of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his progeny). He was the brother of Imam Hussain. Fifty years after the demise of the Prophet Muhammad, his grandson Hussain stood up against Yazid, the tyrant ruler of the time, and refused to pledge allegiance to him. As a result of this protest, Hussain, his family-members, and a small group of his companions were surrounded by Yazidi forces in the desert of Karbala, prevented from water for three days, and, finally, on the Day of Ashura, Hussain with about 100 souls faced an army of 25,000 soldiers. They were given the choice of pledging allegiance to Yazid or face death. In that uneven battle, Hussain chose an honorable death over a disgraceful life under a tyrant like Yazid. It was in that historical event that Abbas was made the commander-in-chief and flag-bearer of Hussaini forces. That battle-field gradually turned into a place of pilgrimage, and today the shrines of both these brothers, with their golden domes, form the skyline of Karbala in Iraq. Brotherhood By his supreme sacrifice, Abbas became a universal soul that transcends time and space. Let us start with concept of brotherhood: Brotherhood can be understood on two different levels, a physical and personal level, and a spiritual and social level. Both aspects are important. However, the brotherhood based on blood relationship should be synchronized with the brotherhood based on spiritual relationship. In case of tension between the two relationships, the spiritual brotherhood will take precedence over the physical brotherhood. ("Verily the believers are brethren [of one another]." 49:10) Imam Zainul Abideen (peace be upon him), the fourth Shia Imam and nephew of Abbas, in his famous the Charter of Rights, writes about the rights of a brother. He says brothers should consider one another as a source of support and protection, and they should be sincere in giving advice and helping one another towards the path of God. He concludes by writing: "â¦Then if he obeys his Lord and properly answers His call [it is good for all]; otherwise, Allah, rather than your brother, should be your choice and the object of your reverence." It is human nature for two brothers to love and support one another. Almighty God tends to leave natural issues to nature and does not talk about it that much, and only points out issues when humans deviate from their nature. On brotherhood, there are two negative examples in the Qur'an: the example of Qabil (Cain) who murdered his brother HÃ£bil (Abel); and the brothers of Yusuf (Joseph) who conspired to get rid of him. In the scale of zero to ten, we can put Qabil's relationship at zero, and that of Yusuf's brothers at three â on the positive side, we can surely put the relationship of Abbas to Imam Hussain at ten. The devotion of Abbas to Hussain was not just on the physical level; it was also based on the spiritual level. This is reflected in his statement to Shimr bin Dhil Jawshan. Shimr, one of commanders of the Yazidi forces, was related to Abbas through his mother who was from the Kilabiyya tribe (while Hussain's mother was the daughter of the Prophet). Shimr had come to Karbala with an amaan, assurance of protection or amnesty signed by Iraq's governor, for Abbas and his three full brothers. When Shimr presented that amnesty to Abbas, Abbas responded by saying: "May God curse you and your amnesty. You give assurance of protection to us, but the son of the Prophet's daughter has no amnesty!" Abbas bin Ali's message to us is quite clear: we have to strengthen the ties of brotherhood with fellow Muslims irrespective of their race, color, language, or geographical location. All of us are brethren in faith; all other relationships must be synchronized with that. We should be able to feel the pain of one another, as the Prophet Muhammad once said, "Muslims are like one body: when one limb is injured, the hurt is felt by the entire body." Between Abbas and Imam Hussain, this level of closeness and concern is symbolized in the words of Hussain: when he heard Abbas calling for help as he was falling down from the horse, the Imam felt the pain and said, "Now my back has broken, and my options are few." Courage What is courage? In Islamic ethics, courage is not defined by physical strength; courage means to have control over one's emotions and feelings and to use them only for the right cause. A person who only relies on his physical strength and cannot control his emotions is not a courageous person; he is rather a foolhardy person. While describing the Prophet and his true followers, Allah says: "Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, and those who are with him are firm against the enemies but soft with their own." (48:29) Iqbal, the famous poet of the Indian sub-continent, presents the same concept in his poetic style: In the struggle of truth, the believer is as solid as the steel But in midst of his friends, he is as soft as the silk Abbas was not the slave of his desires and emotions; even his courage was linked to the spiritual relationship: Abbas was very stern and firm when he confronted the enemies, but he was very kind, compassionate, and caring towards the good people. The children of Hussain and the clan of Banu Hashim adored him. He was the favorite uncle of Sakina, the four years old daughter of Imam Hussain. Unfortunately, what we see in the world today is that the tyrants, the kings, and the generals who rule over Muslim countries behave in the opposite manner: they are humble in front of the enemies but very bold when they deal with their own people and oppress them! When Imam Hussain asked Abbas to try and get water for the children, Abbas confronted the enemy force and he was easily able to disperse them and got access to the river. Abbas entered the river and filled the water-bag with water. On the way back, he had to pass through some palms trees, and that is where the enemy was hiding behind the trees to attack him from the back. One Yazidi soldier attacked him from behind in such a way that he lost his right hand. Abbas courageously got hold of the water-bag and consoled himself by the following verses: By God, though you have severed my right hand My faith, I will surely forever defend I will defend the truthful leader of conviction The grandson of the pure and truthful Prophet Loyalty We see that loyalty is a very important quality, especially the loyalty toward one's faith and community. Abbas's loyalty has become proverbial in the literature of Karbala. On the eve of Ashura, when Imam Hussain asked his friends and family members to go away and leave him, since the enemies were after his blood only, the first person to stand up and express his loyalty was Abbas bin Ali. He said, "And why should we abandon you? So that we may live after you! May God not show us such a day ever." On the day of Ashura, when Imam Hussain asked him to get water for the children, he succeeded in gaining access to the stream. He galloped into the stream, got down, and filled the water-bag. As a person who had been thirsty for three days, Abbas could have quenched his thirst, but he did not do so. Legally as well as morally, nothing prevented him from drinking water. But he did not do so. It was his sense of loyalty to Imam Hussain and the love for Hussain's children that prevented Abbas from drinking the water. While filling the water, he recited the following verses: While Hussain is drinking the syrup of death You are imbibing the coolness of joy When you look at the flag of Abbas, you always see that a water-bag is attached to it, hanging on to it. It reminds us of the loyalty of Abbas to Hussain and his children. That flag challenges us to be loyal and true to our faith and its values. It urges the followers of Abbas to stand up against oppression, tyranny, and injustice in whatever shape or form that we see in our own times â all in the name of God and to serve the cause of God. And so we end with a tribute to Abbas in the famous words of the Sixth Imam who praised him by saying: "I bear witness that you submitted [to your Imam], affirmed [his truth], and were loyal and sincere [to him]." × . segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اُمَّ الْاَئِمَّةِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اُمَّ المُؤْمِنِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Ummal A-Immatit Taahereena - Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Ummal Momineena
segments.translation: Peace on you, O the mother of the pure Imams, Peace be on you, O the mother of the believing men
Peace be on you, O the first of the believing women
Peace be on you, O the sincere lady among the devoted ones

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا سَيِّدَةَ الْحَرَمِ وَ مَلِكَةَ الْبَطْحَاءِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Sayyedatal Harame Wa Malekatal Bathaa-E
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the chief lady of the sacrosanct (haram) And the queen of Mecca

segments.arabic: السَّلاَم عَلَيْكِ يَا اَوَّلَ مَنْ صَدَّقَتْ ِرَسُوْلِ اللهِ مِنَ النِّسَآءِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Awwala Man Saddaqat Be Rasoolillaahe Menan Nesaaa-E
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the first one to believe in the Apostle of Allah from among the women

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ وَفَتْ بِالْعُبُوْدِيَّةِ حَقَّ الْوَفَاءِ وَ اَسْلَمَتْ نَفْسَهَا وَ اَنْفَقَتْ مَالَهَا لِسَيِّدِ الْاَنْبِيَآءِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Man Wafat Bil OâBoodiyyate Haqqal Wafaa-E Wa Aslamat Nafsahaa Wa Anfaqat Maalahaa Le Sayyedil Anbeyaaa-E
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the one who observed servitude as it ought to be observed, submitted herself and discharged her wealth in the service of the chief of the Prophets.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا قَرِيْنَةَ حَبِيْبِ اِلٰهِ السَّمَآءِ الْمُزَّوَّجَةِ بِخُلاَصَةِ الْاَصْفِيَآءِ يَابْنَةَ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ الْخَلِيْلِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Qareenata Habeebe Elaahis Samaaail Mozawwajate Be Kholaasatil Asfeyaaa-E  Yabnata Ibraahemal Khaleele
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the companion of the beloved of the Lord of the Heaven. The spouse of the epitome of the chosen ones. O the daughter of Ibraheem, the friend (of Allah)

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ سَلَّمَ عَلَيْهَا جَبْرَئِيْلُ وَ بَلَّغَ اِلَيْهَا
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Man Sallama AâLayhaa Jibraeelo Wa Ballagha Elayhas
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the one to whom Jibraeel used to salute and used to convey to her
the salutations from Allah, the Majestic.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا حَافِظَةَ دِيْنِ اللهِ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the protector of the religion of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا نَاصِرَةَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the helper of the Apostle of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ تَوَلىَّ دَفْنَهَا رَسُوْلُ اللهِ
segments.transliteration: Assalaamo AâLayke Yaa Man Tawallaa Dafnahaa Rasoolilaahe
segments.translation: Peace be on you, O the one whose burial was arranged by the Apostle of Allah
and he entrusted her to the Mercy of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكِ حَبِيْبَةُ اللهِ وَ خِيَرَةَ اُمَّتِهِ وَ اَنَّ اللهَ
segments.transliteration: Ash-Hado Annake Habeebullaahe Wa Kheyarata Ummatehi Wa Annallaaha
segments.translation: I bear witness that you are esteemed near Allah

segments.arabic: جَعَلَكِ فِىْ مُسْتَقَرِّ رَحْمَتِهِ فِىْ قَصْرٍ مِّنَ الْيَاقُوْتِ
segments.translation: and the chosen one among His nation and that Allah has placed you in His Mercy

segments.arabic: وَ الْعِقْيَانِ فِىْ اَعْلٰى مَنَازِلِ الْجِنَانِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْكِ وَ رَحْمَةُ الله وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
segments.transliteration: Fee Qasrin Menal Yaaqoote Wal EâQyaane Fee A-AâLaa Manaazelil Jenaane, Sallallaaho AâLayke Wa Rahmatullaahe Wa Barakaatohu
segments.translation: in a place built of ruby and in the highest grades of Paradise, May Allah send salutations upon you and His Mercy and Blessings .

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اَسْتَغِيْثُ فَاَغِثْنِى وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلٰى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى شَاْنِى كُلَّه
segments.transliteration:
Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoomu birahmatika astagheetho, fa-aghithni 
wa laa Takilni ila nafsee Tarfata Aynin abadan, wa as-lih Lee Shani kullahu
segments.translation: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek help, so help me and do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَا اللهُ يَا حَافِظُ يَا حَفِيظُ يَا رَقِيبُ
segments.transliteration: Ya Allaho Ya Haafizo Ya Hafizo Ya Raqeebo
segments.translation: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O God, O Preserver, O Guardian, O Watcher.

text: Ziyarat Khadija bint-e-Khawailad(sa) First and Most Beloved Wife of Holy Prophet(saw) Title : Umm-ul-Momineen / Tahira | Death 10th Ramadhan 3 years before Hijrah at the age of 64 years. | Buried in Makkah ( Jannatul Maala cemetry) Umm-ul-Momineen and mother of Syeda Fatima Zahra (sa) .
